*sicyaṃte taptatailena prataptena samaṃtataḥ \|\| 167 \|\|*

*paścātte vahninā bhūyo dūrasthena śanaiḥ śanaiḥ \|*  
*niḥśeṣayātanābhiśca pīḍyaṃte kramaśaḥ punaḥ \|\| 168 \|\|*

162-168. Then, he is tortured for long by means of insects, sharp iron roads, besides the serpents and other wild creatures. Then, the forepart of his tongue is bound with a chain and then makes him stand over his feet. They cause him pain with the iron weight. Then, his testicles are bound with excessive weight and he is made to stand erect, causing pain to him. 'Then his body is scratched with nails and then eat it in pieces. When he is out of breath after a longtime and his body is relieved of the flesh, it is plastered with saltish matter and then pour the rain water over it and then create sound with the air. After drying up, the hot oil is applied over him and then he is heated with fire slowly, causing him the pain again.

## \|\| 3.6.169 \|\|

*bhṛśaṃ bubhukṣayā pīḍā mūrcchayātipipāsayā \|*  
*atyuṣṇenātiśītena pāpānāṃ samareṇa ca \|\| 169 \|\|*

169\. Similarly, he is also made to suffer by hunger, thirst, fainting, the excessive heat and cold.

## \|\| 3.6.170 \|\|

*evamādimahāghorā yātanāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ \|*  
*ekaike narake caiva śataśotha sahasraśaḥ \|\| 170 \|\|*

170\. Thus, thev have to suffer hundreds of tortures in each and every hell at the same time for hundreds of years, which are quite terrific.

## \|\| 3.6.171-173 \|\|

*pratyekaṃ yātanāścitrāḥ sarveṣu narakeṣu ca \|*  
*kaṣṭaṃ varṣaśatenāpi soḍhuṃ sarvaiśca nārake \|\| 171 \|\|*

*ete ca vividhairghorairyātyamānāśca karmabhiḥ \|*  
*mriyante naiva pāpiṣṭhā vividhāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ \|\| 172 \|\|*

*mahāghorābhighorākhyā kālāgnisadṛśopamāḥ \|*  
*śrutairetairmahāraudrairmriyante mṛducetasaḥ \|\| 173 \|\|*

171-173. Because of their various sins, the sinners have to face various types of tortures in the hells depending on their misdeeds for hunched of years, but they do not meet with the death. To the contrary, like the horrible fire of the time of dissolution, for the sake of suffering of the awful terror, he has to become quite sweet tongued.

## \|\| 3.6.174-176 \|\|

*tatastenātra kathitāḥ pāpā gacchaṃti tānsvayam \|*  
*putramitrakalatrārthaṃ yadā puṇyaṃ tvapākṛtam \|\| 174 \|\|*

*ekākī dahyate tena na ca paśyati tāni saḥ \|*  
*ātmanā ca kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhoktavyaṃ dhruvamātmanā \|\| 175 \|\|*

*tatkimanyopaghātārthaṃ mūḍha pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā \|*  
*evaṃ dūtairupālabdhāste pṛcchaṃti tataḥ punaḥ \|\| 176 \|\|*

174-176. In this way, according to one’s own deeds, a sinful person has to reap the reward for his deeds, which are committed by him for the sake of his son, a friend and the wife. Reaching there, the sinful person has to suffer the torture alone. But the persons for whom he commits the misdeed, they are nowhere to be seen there. The messengers say repeatedly-“He one has to reap the reward of his misdeeds. Knowing this, you, out of foolishness, have committed the sins?”

## \|\| 3.6.177-178 \|\|

*kiyaṃtaṃ kena pāpena kālamatrāyate naraḥ \|*  
*devadravyavināśena gurudrohādikarmabhiḥ \|*  
*pāpātsarveṣu pacyaṃte narakeṣvāmahākṣayāt \|\| 177 \|\|*

*mahāpātakinaścāpi sarveṣu narakeṣviha \|*  
*ācaṃdratārakaṃ yāvatpīḍyaṃte vividhairvadhaiḥ \|\| 178 \|\|*

177-178. Thus, approaching all the sinners, they ask them accordingly- “O humans, what type of misdeed was committed by you and for how long? Similarly, the people who usurp the wealth of the gods or those who are envious of the preceptor and because of the misdeeds committed by them, they suffers pain in the hells, upto the time of dissolution. The extremely sinful person lives in ail hells till the moon and the stars last, suffering from various types of tortures.

## \|\| 3.6.179-180 \|\|

*mahāpātakinaścānye narakārṇavakoṭiṣu \|*  
*caturdaśasu pacyaṃte kalārdhaṃ vividhairvadhaiḥ \|\| 179 \|\|*

*upapātakinaścāpi tadarthaṃ yāṃti mānavāḥ \|*  
*śeṣapāpaistadardhaṃ tu kālaṃ cāpi tathāvidham \|\| 180 \|\|*

179-180. Some of the people have to rot in the crores of hell for all times to come. The troublesome people, after suffering several types of tortures in the fourteen hells for half the above said period, then for the redemption of the rest of the sins, he has to suffer for remaining half of that period.

## \|\| 3.6.181-182 \|\|

*tasmātpāpaṃ na kurvīta caṃcale jīvite sati \|*  
*pāpena hi dhruvaṃ yāṃti narakeṣu narāḥ svayam \|\| 181 \|\|*

*yaḥ karoti naraḥ pāpaṃ tasyātmā dhruvamapriyaḥ \|*  
*pāpasyeha phalaṃ duḥkhaṃ tadbhoktavyamihātmanā \|\| 182 \|\|*

181-182. Therefore, a person, after achieving the mobile body, should never commit a sin. Because after committing a sin, a person has surely to be lodged in a hell. A person who commits a sin, (it means that) he does not surely likes his soul, because to reap the result of the sin, he has to go to the hell.

## \|\| 3.6.183-184 \|\|

*kathaṃ te pāpaniratā narā rātriṣu śerate \|*  
*maraṇāṃtaritā yeṣāṃ nārakī tīvrayātanā \|\| 183 \|\|*

*evaṃ kliṣṭaviśuddhāśca sāvaśeṣeṇa karmaṇā \|*  
*tataḥ kṣitiṃ samāsādya jāyante dehinaḥ puna \|*  
*sthāvarā vividhākārāstṛṇagulmādibhedataḥ \|\| 184 \|\|*

183-184. Observing the awful tortures, how does a person, disregarding the sins, enjoys the company of his wife (instead of) following the means of redemption? With the awful torture of the hells in which several types of pains including the death are inherent, one has to suffer. When some deeds are left out, a person is reborn on earth. He has to appear on earth in the form of a straw, shrubs or the trees etc. and has to suffer horrible pains.

## \|\| 3.6.185 \|\|

*tatrānubhūya duḥkhāni jāyaṃte kīṭayoniṣu \|*  
*niṣkrāṃtāḥ kīṭayonibhyo jāyante pakṣiṇastataḥ \|\| 185 \|\|*

185\. Thereafter, he has to pass through the crores of births in the form of insects etc. and suffering the pains of all of them, he is born as a bird.

## \|\| 3.6.186-187 \|\|

*saṃśliṣṭāḥ pakṣibhāvena bhavaṃti mṛgajādiṣu \|*  
*mārgaṃ duḥkhamatikramya jāyaṃte paśuyoniṣu \|\| 186 \|\|*

*kramādgoyonimāsādya jāyante mānavāḥ punaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ yoniṣu sarvāsu parikramya krameṇa tu \|*  
*kālāṃtaravaśādyāṃti mānuṣyamatidurlabham \|\| 187 \|\|*

186-187. After having a birth as a bird, he is born as a deer or another animal. Thereafter, he is born as a cow and then he is reborn as a human. In this way, passing through the several birth forms, in due course of time he is born as a human being with great difficulty.

## \|\| 3.6.188-192 \|\|

*vyutkrameṇāpi mānuṣyaṃ prāpyate puṇyagocarāt \|*  
*vicitrā gatayaḥ proktāḥ karmaṇāṃ gurulāghavāt \|\| 188 \|\|*

*mānuṣyaṃ yaḥ samāsādya svargamokṣaprasādhakam \|*  
*dvayorna sādhayatyekaṃ sa mṛtastapyate ciram \|\| 189 \|\|*

*devāsurāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ mānuṣyamatidurlabham \|*  
*tatsaṃprāpya kathāḥ kuryānna gacchennarakaṃ yathā \|\| 190 \|\|*

*svargāpavargalābhāya yadi nāsti samudyataḥ \|*  
*svargasya mūlaṃ mānuṣyaṃ tadyatnādanupālayet \|\| 191 \|\|*

*dharmamūlena mānuṣyaṃ labdhvā sarvārthasādhakam \|*  
*yadi lābhe na yatnaste mūlaṃ rakṣasva yatnataḥ \|\| 192 \|\|*

188-192. Under the influence of the extremely auspicious deeds, (instead of) passing through the several births, sometimes he attains the human birth. Because according to the big or small deeds, one has to reap similar types of rewards. Therefore, the movement of the deeds has been said to be an astonishing one. After attaining a birth as a human, which is difficult to be achieved, which is the source for the attaining of the heaven and the salvation, a person instead of achieving either of them, he achieves death. After the death, he attains neither of them and suffers the torture in the hell for long, after his death, suffering badly. Of the Devas as well as the asuras, the human birth is difficult to achieve though it happens to be the best of all. Therefore, after achieving the human birth, a person should perform all the noble deeds, by which he does not have to face the tortures of the hell again. In case a person after achieving the human birth, does not make efforts to achieve the heaven or the moksa, then he should always aspire to keep his manhood stable, by making all the efforts. Because it is the human alone, which can be the source of achieving the heaven and the moksa. Therefore after achieving the human birth, which could be the source of achieving everything, in case one cannot achieve the heaven or moksa, then he should regularly make efforts to preserve his basic identity in all means.

## \|\| 3.6.193 \|\|

*manuṣyatve ca vipratvaṃ yaḥ saṃprāpyātidurllabham \|*  
*na karotyātmanaḥ śreyaḥ konyastasmādacetanaḥ \|\| 193 \|\|*

193\. The human birth is difficult to be achieved and out of the humans, to be a Brahmana is extremely difficult to get. Therefore, a Brahmana, after having been born as such, does not make efforts for the redemption of his soul continuously, who could be a more ignorant person than him?

## \|\| 3.6.194 \|\|

*sarveṣāmeva deśānāṃ madhyadeśaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*ataḥ svargaśca mokṣaśca yaśaḥ saṃprāpyate naraiḥ \|\| 194 \|\|*

194\. Similarly, out of all the countries of the world, the central region is surely the best, because by living here, a person can achieve the heaven, moksa and the pleasant glory.

## \|\| 3.6.195 \|\|

*etasminbhārate puṇye prāpya mānuṣyamadhruvam \|*  
*yaḥkuryādātmanaḥ śreyastenātmā rakṣitaḥ svayam \|*  
*yaḥ kuryānnātmanaḥ śreyastenātmā vaṃcitaḥ svayam \|\| 195 \|\|*

195\. In the land of the auspicious Bharata-varsa, by achieving the indefinite human life, a person who works for the welfare of his soul, he alone has saved his soul. A person, who could not look after his soul quite well, he himself deprives his soul (of the opportunity of redemption).

## \|\| 3.6.196 \|\|

*bhogabhūmiḥ smṛtaḥ svargaḥ karmabhūmiriyaṃ matā \|*  
*iha yatkriyate karma svarge tadupabhujyate \|\| 196 \|\|*

196\. The heaven is said to be the place for pleasures, while (the Bharat-varsa) has been said to be the Karma-bhumi or the land of activity where a person has to perform the deeds. In the heaven, one achieves all the pleasures.

## \|\| 3.6.197-198 \|\|

*yāvatsvāsthyaṃ śarīrasya tāvaddharmaṃ samācara \|*  
*asvasthaścātiyatnena na kiñcitkartumutsa het \|\| 197 \|\|*

*adhruveṇa śarīreṇa hyadhruvaṃ yaḥ prasādhayet \|*  
*dhruvaṃ tasya paribhraṣṭamadhruvaṃ naṣṭameva ca \|\| 198 \|\|*

197-198. Therefore, till such time a person remains healthy, upto that time a person should continuously follow dharma. Because when a person is unwell, he is unable to do anything. By getting this unsure body, a person who achieves the uncertain thing, his definite padartha (the heaven or moksa) gets destroyed or inaccessible, besides the definite aim is also destroyed.

## \|\| 3.6.199 \|\|

*āyuṣaḥ khaṃḍakhaḍāni nipataṃti tavā grataḥ \|*  
*ahorātrāpadeśena kimarthaṃ nāvabudhyase \|\| 199 \|\|*

199\. (It is not strange) that in your very presence, your own life, after passing of the day and the night getting shattered, gets destroyed. Then what for are you still not awakening?

## \|\| 3.6.200 \|\|

*yadā na jñāyate mṛtyuḥ kadā kasya bhaviṣyati \|*  
*ākasmike hi maraṇe dhṛtiṃ viṃdeta kastadā \|\| 200 \|\|*

200\. When it is not known as to who is going to die at what time? Then why are you still not waking up. When you are unable to know as to who is dying and when, then who is going to console you at the sudden death of someone.

## \|\| 3.6.201 \|\|

*parityajya yadā sarvamekākī yāsyasi dhuvam \|*  
*na dadāsi tadā kasmātpātheyārthamidaṃ dhanam \|\| 201 \|\|*

201\. This is certain that leaving everything here, you shall leave the world alone, then why do you not give away the charity, which could serve you as the provisions for the journey?

## \|\| 3.6.202 \|\|

*gṛhītadānapātheyā sukhaṃ yāṃti mahādhvani \|*  
*anyathā kliśyate jaṃtuḥ pātheyarahitaḥ pathi \|\| 202 \|\|*

202\. Since the charities serve as the provisions for the journey, a person does not have to suffer after doing the same. He does not feel painful during the journey on the contrary, while a person without the provisions for the journey, has to suffer badly on the way.

## \|\| 3.6.203-204 \|\|

*yeṣāṃ dvijendravāhitrī pūrṇabhāṃḍā tu gacchati \|*  
*svargadeśasya pura tasteṣāṃ lābhaḥ padepade \|\| 203 \|\|*

*iti jñātvā naraḥ puṇyaṃ kuryātpāpaṃ vivarjayet \|*  
*puṇyena yāti devatvamapuṇyānnarakaṃ vrajet \|\| 204 \|\|*

203-204. When a person is on his way to heaven with the provisions for the journey moving ahead of him, he derives the benefit at every step. Realising thus, a person should discard the sins and earn the noble deeds alone. Because the noble deeds lead to the heaven and the sins lead to the hell.

## \|\| 3.6.205-206 \|\|

*ye manāgapi deveśaṃ prapannāḥ śaraṇaṃ śivam \|*  
*tepi ghoraṃ na paśyaṃti yamasya vadanaṃ narāḥ \|\| 205 \|\|*

*kiṃ tu pāpairmahāghoraiḥ kiñcitkālaṃ śivājñayā \|*  
*bhavaṃti preta rājānastato yāṃti śivālayam \|\| 206 \|\|*

205-206. A person, who achieves the refuge of lord Siva even once, he also does not have to face the abode of Yama, even once. By committing the terrific and awful deeds, at the command of lord Siva, (the sinner) has to visit the place of Yama for a short while and thereafter, he achieves the abode of lord Siva.

## \|\| 3.6.207 \|\|

*ye punaḥ sarvabhāvena pratipannā maheśvaram \|*  
*na te lipyaṃti pāpena padmapatramivāṃbhasā \|\| 207 \|\|*

207\. One who totally takes refuge with lord Siva, then like the lotus leaf in the water he does not have to touch the sin.

## \|\| 3.6.208 \|\|

*tasmā dvivardhayedbhaktimīśvare satataṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*tanmāhātmyavicāreṇa bhavadoṣavirāgataḥ \|\| 208 \|\|*

208\. Therefore, a learned person, carefully thinking about the importance of his glory, getting free from the worldly blemishes, should worship lord Siva always.

## \|\| 3.6.209 \|\|

*pāpāni paṃca paramārthatayaiva pārtha duḥkhapradāni suciraṃ pitṛ rājaloke \|*  
*anyāni yāni cirakālabhayānakāni vaktuṃ na yāṃti kila tāni parisphuṭāni \|\| 209 \|\|*

209\. In the abode of Yama, one has to face the painful situation for five types of sins. It is no use to speak about the sins, which make a person to suffer in the hell for a long time, which are awful as well.

## Chapter 7. Glory of Sakata-vrata

## \|\| 3.7.1 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*yadetatte samākhyātaṃ gaṃbhīraṃ narakārṇavama \|*  
*vratopavāsaniyamaplavenottīryate sukham \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sri Krsna said- I have mentioned to you about the awful hell. After performing the good deeds as well as after fasting and observing all the rules, like crossing a river by a boat, a person lives thereafter with comfort.

## \|\| 3.7.2 \|\|

*durllabhaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ vidyutpatanacañcalam \|*  
*tathātmānaṃ samādadhyādbhraśyate na punaryathā \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Human birth is most difficult to achieve and is innocent like electricity. After achieving the same, a person should make all the efforts to save himself from falling in a deep pit.

## \|\| 3.7.3 \|\|

*dāna vratamayī kīrtiryasya syādiha dehinaḥ \|*  
*paraloke'pi sa tayā jñāyate jñātivarddhanaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. A person who is engaged in the giving of charities, then his glory is spread all over, and he is considered to be the enhancer of the caste or the race even in the other world.

## \|\| 3.7.4 \|\|

*jñāyate neha nāmutra vratasvādhyāyavarjitaḥ \|*  
*puruṣaḥ puruṣavyāghra tasmādvrataparo bhavet \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O lion among the humans, a person who is deprived of performing of the vratas or learnings, he does not gain reputation during the life or thereafter. Therefore, the vratas and the related rules must be performed.

## \|\| 3.7.5 \|\|

*atra te kathayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam \|*  
*siddhena saha saṃvādamavaṃtyāṃ brāhmaṇasya hi \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. In this regard, I am going to tell you a story, which had been told by lord Siva to a Brahmana yogi of Avanti.

## \|\| 3.7.6 \|\|

*yogarddhisiddhyā saṃsiddhaḥ kaścitsiddho mahītalam \|*  
*cacāra vikṛtaṃ kṛtvā vapuḥ paramabhīṣaṇam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Attaining all the success from yogic practices, a yogi turned all his limbs to suffer from leprosy. He became terrific to look at. Still, he wandered over the earth.

## \|\| 3.7.7 \|\|

*nigīrṇadaṃto laṃboṣṭhaḥ piṃgākṣastanumūrddhajaḥ \|*  
*truṭitaika karṇo durvaṇaḥ śīrṇavastro mahodaraḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He had protruding teeth, long lips and yellowish eyes. His body and head was full of hair. One of his ears had been broken. He had a blemished body, he wore tattered clothes, with pot belly.

## \|\| 3.7.8 \|\|

*cipiṭākṣaḥ sphuṭitapājjaṃghāḍhyaḥ kṛśakūrparaḥ \|*  
*diśaḥ paśyati saṃhṛṣṭo babhrāmodbhrāṃtacittavat \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The eyes were flat, his feet were shattered because of the ailment. His thighs were solid, the arms were quite thick, with a knot in the middle of them. With this type of his body, he looked with staring eyes everywhere.

## \|\| 3.7.9-11 \|\|

*mūlajālikavipreṇa dṛṣṭaḥ pṛṣṭaśca ko bhavān \|*  
*kadā svargātsamāyātaḥ kena kāryeṇa me vada \|\| 9 \|\|*

*kacciddṛṣṭā tvayā raṃbhā bhābhāsitadigaṃtarā \|*  
*cittasaṃmohanakarī devānāmekasundarī \|\| 10 \|\|*

*gatvā madvacanādvācyā nirvācyā doṣadarśibhiḥ \|*  
*āvaṃtyastvāṃ kuśalinīṃ pṛcchati sma dvijo ttamaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. At the same time, a Brahmana named Mulajala who belonged to Avanti, asked him-“When did you depart from the heaven for this place? Did you see the nymph Rambha and if so, with what purpose? When she walks, her glory spreads in all the quarters. She is the only beauty, who attracts the gods. In case you meet her, then you tell her on my behalf, since she is without blemish even in the eyes of a person who searches for blemishes alone, that a Brahmana of the city of Avanti had been enquiring of your welfare.”

## \|\| 3.7.12 \|\|

*siddhaḥ prasiddhaṃ taṃ vipraṃ prāhedaṃ vismayānvitaḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ tvayāhaṃ vijñātaḥ svargādabhyāgataḥ sphuṭam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. On hearing these words, the Siddha getting surprised, said to the famous Brahmana- “How could you know that I have surely arrived from the heaven?”

## \|\| 3.7.13-14 \|\|

*brāhmaṇastamathovāca vijñāto'si mayā yathā \|*  
*tathā te'haṃ pravakṣyāmi kṣīṇāghaughāvadhāraya \|\| 13 \|\|*

*gātratrayaṃ virūpaṃ syāddvitīyaṃ vā svarūpataḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā sarvāṃga vairūpyaṃ vijñāto'si tato mayā \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. On hearing this, the Brahmana said “O destroyer of the sins, I am going to tell you the symptoms, observing which I came to the conclusion that you have reached here from the heaven. The three limbs of your body are deformed and the other one is deformed by nature. Thus, observing your whole body as deformed, I have reached to this conclusion.

## \|\| 3.7.15 \|\|

*durllaṃghyā prakṛtiḥ sākṣādanubhūtakarī bhavet \|*  
*prakṛteranyathābhāvaḥ sarvathā lakṣyate janaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Though the nature is quite difficult to face the experience of which is getting apparent, therefore, the natural limbs with blemish can atonce be recognized.”

## \|\| 3.7.16 \|\|

*viprasyaivaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā jagāmādarśanaṃ śanaiḥ \|*  
*punaḥ kaiścidahorātrairājagāma sa tāṃ purīm \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. On hearing the words of the Brahmana, the yogi (who was none else than Siva himself), suddenly disappeared from the place. After sometime, the yogi again appeared before the Brahmana in Avanti.

## \|\| 3.7.17-19 \|\|

*mūlajālakavipreṇa pṛṣṭaḥ prāhāmarāvatīm \|*  
*gato'haṃ pṛṣṭavāṃstatra raṃbhāṃ vibhramakāriṇīm \|\| 17 \|\|*

*śakrasyāvasare vṛtte vrajantyāḥ svagṛhaṃ mayā \|*  
*tvatsaṃdeśaḥ samākhyātaḥ sāvadatko na vedmi tam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*vidyayā kalayā cāpi pauruṣeṇa vratena ca \|*  
*tapasā vā pumānmartyo divi vijñāyate ciram \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. Then the Brahmana named Mulajala again spoke to him, he said- “I had gone to the heaven, who at that point of time, was going to the Rambha’s own home from the home of Indra, and said- “A Brahmana named Mulajala from Avanti, wanted to know about your welfare.” On hearing these words, she replied- “Who is he, I am totally unaware of him.” She also said- “A person becomes popular in the heaven by being proficient in learnings, art, strength, vratas and tapas. His glory also remains alive for a long time.”

## \|\| 3.7.20 \|\|

*brāhmaṇastamathovāca mugdhā dagdhāgnisaṃbhavā \|*  
*na bhakṣayāmi śakaṭaṃ vratenaitena vetti mām \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Thereafter, the Brahmana again said- “I am performing the Sakata vrata. I do not desecrate it. Does the damsel who emerged out of the burning fire, is feeling shy of knowing this?”

## \|\| 3.7.21-22 \|\|

*tasyaitadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa siddhaḥ suviśuddhadhīḥ \|*  
*prahasyāmaṃtrya taṃ vipraṃ jagāmādarśanaṃ punaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*kadācicca ratā tena svargamārgaṃ yadṛcchayā \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā raṃbhāṃ dvijaproktaṃ sarvameva niveditam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. On hearing the words of the Brahmana, the yogi, with the spotless wisdom, smiled and spoke to him and then again disappeared. Walking over the path of the heaven, the yogi once again had an encounter with Rambha and he repeated the words of the Brahmana to her. Then hearing those words, Rambha said.

## \|\| 3.7.23-24 \|\|

*raṃbhovāca \|*  
*ko na jānāmi taṃ vipraṃ śakaṭavratacāriṇam \|*  
*mūlajālairvartayaṃtaṃ mahākālavanāśrayam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*darśanādatha saṃbhāṣādupakārātsahāsanāt \|*  
*caturdhā snehanirbaṃdho nṛṇāṃ saṃjāyate'dhikaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Rambha said- While living in the Mahakala forest, the Brahmana named Mulajala, who is observing the Sakata-vrata, is totally unknown to me. One feels more attached to a person by meeting him, talking to him, doing good to him or by walking together.

## \|\| 3.7.25 \|\|

*na darśanaṃ na saṃbhāṣā kadācitsaha tena me \|*  
*nāmaśravaṇamātreṇa snehaḥ saṃdarśito mahān \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. But I have neither met with that Brahmana, nor have I ever talked to him. He has expressed great love for me only by listening to my name.

## \|\| 3.7.26 \|\|

*ityevamuktvā raṃbhorū raṃbhā jaṃbhāriṇoṃtikam \|*  
*vismayotphullanayanā jagāma gajagāminī \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Having the thighs like the trunk of the banana tree, who was bom of Siva - the destroyer of Sambhasura, Rambha felt surprised, blossoming at the same time like the lotus.

## \|\| 3.7.27 \|\|

*gatvā nivedayāmāsa snehavrataviceṣṭitam \|*  
*purato ruddhahṛdayā brāhmaṇasya ca dhīmataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Thus speaking, she slowly kept on walking. She then went to Devaloka and she narrated the story of the Brahmana getting attracted towards her and the vrata performed by the Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.7.28-30 \|\|

*śakraḥ provāca cārvaṃgīṃ gīrvāṇahṛdayaṃgamām \|*  
*kimānayāmi taṃ vipraṃ samīpaṃ tava suvratam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*divyamālyāṃbaradharaṃ divyasragunulepanam \|*  
*vimānavaramāropya darśayāmāsa taṃ punaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tatrasthaḥ sa dvijo bhogīvibhunakti saha raṃbhayā \|*  
*śakaṭavratamāhātmyamityetatte mayoditam \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. Since she was also attracted towards the Brahmana, her voice before Indra was choked. Then she explained her desires in detail to Indra. Then Indra spoke to Rambha, who always attracted the gods towards herself, thus- “Shall I bring the Brahmana performing the vrata before you here.” Thus speaking, the Brahmana was decorated with sandal paste, divine costumes, garlands. He was then brought there by a divine plane. Thereafter, the Brahmana started enjoying all the pleasures with Rambha, living in the heaven. Thus, the glory of Sakata-vrata has been narrated to you. One who observes the rules for performing of the vratas strictly, he achieves the riches in the world, which is made use of by everyone. Ultimately, the person achieves the abode of £iva or Visnu. Nothing is beyond his reach in the world. Therefore, a person should always perform this vrata.that can be established on each one of these days. You kindly reveal the whole of it.

## Chapter 8. Glory of Tilaka-vrata

## \|\| 3.8.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*brahmeśa keśavādīnāṃ gauryā gaṇapatestathā \|*  
*durgāsūryāgnisomānāṃ vratāni madhusūdana \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- You kindly enlighten me about the vratas of Brahma, Siva, Kesava and other gods, besides the goddess Gauri, lord Ganapati, Durga, Surya, Agni and the Moon.

## \|\| 3.8.2-3 \|\|

*śāstrāṃtareṣu dṛṣṭāni tava buddhigatāni ca \|*  
*tāni sarvāṇi me deva vada devakiranandana \|\| 2 \|\|*

*pratipatkramayogena vihitā yasya yā tithiḥ \|*  
*devasya tasyāṃ yatkāryaṃ tadaśeṣeṇa kīrtaya \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. О son of Devaki, whatever is the number of vratas mentioned in the scriptures and those which are known to you, you kindly explain to me all of them. Similarly, the vratas which are to be performed in the sequence of the first moon day of the month onwards, should be spoken out. Besides whichever day is allotted to a particular god, the importance of the same may please be revealed together with the task

## \|\| 3.8.4-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*vasaṃte kiṃśukāśokaśobhane pratipattithiḥ \|*  
*śuklā tasyāṃ prakurvīta snānaṃ niyamatatparaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*nārī naro vā rājendra saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ \|*  
*nadyāstīre taḍāge vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Sri Krsna said- 0 Rajendra, on the first bright moon day of the spring season, the palasa (Bretea frondosa) and kimsuka trees look graceful with the flowers. During that season, both the men and the women should take bath appropriately in a river, a lake or the water of the well in the house itself and then offer oblation to the manes as well as the gods.

## \|\| 3.8.6-7 \|\|

*piṣṭātakena vilikhedvatsaraṃ puruṣākṛtim \|*  
*tataścandanacūrṇena puṣpadhūpādinārcayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dīpaiścāpi sanaivedyaiḥ pūjayedvatsaraṃ tadā \|*  
*māsartunāmabhiḥ paścānnamaskārāṃtayojitaiḥ \|*  
*pūjayedbrāhmaṇānvidvānmaṃtrairvedoditaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Then he should make a human figure as well as that of an year. Both the figures should be adored offering the sandal paste flowers, incense, lamp and eatables. Then, one should offer salutation to both the figures uttering the name of the month as well as the season. Then reciting the auspicious Vedic mantra, the learned Brahmanas should be adored.

## \|\| 3.8.8 \|\|

*saṃvatsaro'si parivatsarosīḍā vatsaro'bhitsaro'si uṣasaste kalpaṃtāmahorātrāste kalpaṃtāmardhamāsaste kalpatāṃ māsāste kalpatāmṛtavaste kalpantāṃ saṃvatsaraste kalpatām \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Then, one should say- “You are the form of Samvatsara (the year), the creator of the year, a full year and Abhivatsara. Therefore, all my early mornings, the days, nights, fortnights, months, seasons and years should be made as auspicious.

## \|\| 3.8.9 \|\|

*evamabhyarcya vāsobhiḥ paścāttamabhiveṣṭayet \|*  
*kālodbhavairmūlaphalainairvedyairmodakādibhiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Thus, adoring the same with humility, the cloth should be put around the same. Thereafter, the seasonal flowers, fruits, eatables, sweet-balls etc. besides the other sweet dishes should be offered to them.

## \|\| 3.8.10 \|\|

*tatastaṃ prārthayetpaścātpuraḥ sthitvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ \|*  
*bhagavaṃstvatprasādena varṣa śubhadamastu me \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Then, one should stand before him with folded hands and offer prayer to him- "O lord, let the year be auspicious for me by your grace.’

## \|\| 3.8.11 \|\|

*evamuktvā yathāśakti dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām \|*  
*lalāṭapaṭṭe tilakaṃ kuyaccāṃdanapaṅkajam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Thus speaking, the devotee should offer daksina to a Brahmana as per his means. At the same time, he should apply fragrant sandal paste over his forehead.

## \|\| 3.8.12-13 \|\|

*tataḥ prabhṛtyanudinaṃ tilakālaṃkṛtaṃ mukham \|*  
*dhāryaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvacchaśineva nabhastalam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*evaṃ naro vā nārī vā vratametatsamācaret \|*  
*sadaiva puruṣa vyāghra bhogānbhuvi bhunaktyasau \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Then starting from the same day, he should apple the sandalpaste over his face regularly, O best of the humans\> a man or a woman, who performs the vrata in this manner, they enjoy all the pleasures and comforts on earth.

## \|\| 3.8.14 \|\|

*bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca durvārā vairiṇo grahāḥ \|*  
*nirarthakā bhavaṃtyete tilakaṃ vīkṣya tatkṣaṇāt \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Observing the tilakam over the face of a person the bhutas, the goblins or the evil planets which essentially move in the space, becorne inactive from a distance.

## \|\| 3.8.15 \|\|

*pūrvamāsīnmahīpālo nāmnā śatruṃjayo jayī \|*  
*citralekheti tasyābhūdbhāryā cāritrabhūṣaṇā \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. In earlier times, there was a king named Satrunjaya, who had always been victorious in the battleground. He had a wife named Citralekha, who possessed the exemplary character.

## \|\| 3.8.16 \|\|

*tayā vratamidaṃ caitre gṛhītaṃ dvijasannidhau \|*  
*saṃvatsaraṃ pūjayitvā dhṛtvā hṛdi janārdanam \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. In the month of Caitra, she once called a Brahmana and completed the entire process of the vrata before him. She worshipped Samvatsara or the year, devoting her mind to lord Janardana.

## \|\| 3.8.17 \|\|

*asūyuḥ kṣeptukāmo vā samāgacchati yaḥ puraḥ \|*  
*prayāti priyakṛttasyā dṛṣṭvā mukhamadhomukhaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. As a result of this, whosoever went to her with an evil mind to denounce her, he instead started praising her on seeing her. Looking at her face, he lowered his face.

## \|\| 3.8.18 \|\|

*sapatnīdarpāpaharā vaśīkṛtamahītalā \|*  
*bharturiṣṭā prahṛṣṭā ca sukhamāste nirākulā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. She shattered the pride of her co-wives and conquered the entire world. No other woman was so loveable to her husband, than she herself. Thus, she always remained delightful and started leading the life with pleasure.

## \|\| 3.8.19 \|\|

*tāvatkareṇābhibhūto bhartā putraḥ savedanaḥ \|*  
*śiro'rtyā nāśaṃ prayātaḥ suhṛdāṃ duḥkhadāyakaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. In the meantime, having been humiliated by some source, her husband and the son, suffering from headache and after sometime, they met with their deaths.

## \|\| 3.8.20-21 \|\|

*dharmarājapuraṃ prāptuṃ sarvabhūtāpahārakaḥ \|*  
*tasminkṣaṇe mahārājaḥ dharmarājasya kiṃkarāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tasya dvāramanuprāptāḥ praveṣṭuṃ gṛhamañjasā \|*  
*śatruṃjayaṃ samānetuṃ kālamṛtyupuraḥsarāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Both of them used to her initiate even the noble people. The messengers of Yama arrived at the royal gate and stood there, because Satrunjaya had died in due time and it was necessary to carry him to the abode of Dharmaraja.

## \|\| 3.8.22 \|\|

*pārśvasthitāṃ citralekhāṃ tilakālaṃkṛtānanām \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā pranaṣṭasaṃkalpāḥ parāvṛtya gatāḥ punaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. But, the messengers of Yama found Citralekha standing behind them with her beautiful face over which tilakam has been plastered. Their resolve to carry the dead with them was shattered. The purpose for which they have arrived, could not be fulfilled. All of them, therefore returned to their place.

## \|\| 3.8.23 \|\|

*gateṣu teṣu sa nṛpaḥ putreṇa saha bhārata \|*  
*nīrujo bubhuje bhogānpūrvakarmārjitāñchubhān \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. After the departure of the messengers of Yama, the king and his son regained their lives and were freed from their ailments as well. They then, enjoyed all the pleasures in the world, which they had earned in several of their last births.

## \|\| 3.8.24-25 \|\|

*etadvrataṃ mahābhāga kīrtitaṃ te mahodayam \|*  
*śaṃkareṇa samākhyātaṃ mama pūrvaṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 24 \|\|*

*etattrilokatilakālakabhūṣaṇaṃ te khyātaṃ vrataṃ sakaladuḥkhaharaṃ paraṃ ca \|*  
*itthaṃ samācarati yaḥ sa sukhaṃ vihṛtya martyaḥ prayāti padamāpadi padmayoneḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. O Yudhisthira, O excellent one, the story of this excellent vrata was told to me by lord Siva in earlier times, which in turn has been repeated before you, which is the ornament of the three worlds, remover of all the pains and is said to be the best of all the vratas. A person who performs it appropriately, he overcoming all the difficulties of the world with ease and leading a comfortable life in the world, finally achieves the place of Brahmn.

## Chapter 9. Glory of Asoka-vrata

## \|\| 3.9.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*āśvayucchuklapakṣasya prathame'hni dinodaye \|*  
*aśokaṃ pūjayedvṛkṣaṃ prarūḍhaśubhapallavam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*virūḍhaiḥ saptadhānyaiśca guṇa kairmodakaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*phalaiḥ kālodbhavairdivyairnnālikeraiḥ sadāḍimaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*puṣpadhūpādinā tadvatpūjayettaddine'nagha \|*  
*aśokaṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha śokaṃ nāpnoti kutracit \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Sri Krsna said- “On the first bright moon day of the month of Asvina, the tree of Asoka should be worshipped during the day time, which should have tender roots and the leaves. O sinless and best of the Pandavas, seven types of cereals, the sweet balls, seasonal fruits, coconut, pomegranate, flowers, incense and lamp should be offered to the Asoka tree with devotion. A person, who does so, does not have to face grief in his life.

## \|\| 3.9.4 \|\|

*pitṛbhrātṛpatiśvaśrūśvaśurāṇāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*aśoka śokaśamano bhava sarvatra naḥ kule \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O best of Pandavas, one should pray that the grief of the pitrs (manes), brother, husband father-in-law, mother-in-law, besides other members of the family should be removed.”

## \|\| 3.9.5 \|\|

*ityuccārya tato dadyādarghyaṃ śraddhāsamanvi tam \|*  
*patākābhiralaṃkṛtya pracchādya śubhavāsasā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Thus speaking, one should offer with devotion in the arghya. Thereafter, the tree should be decorated with beautiful flags and banners.

## \|\| 3.9.6 \|\|

*damayantī yathā svāhā yathā vedavatī satī \|*  
*tathāśokavratādasmājjāyate pativallabhā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Then he should pray- “O Deva, let me also become the beloved of my husband like Damayanti, Svaha, Sati, Vedavati by adoring this Asoka tree.

## \|\| 3.9.7 \|\|

*vane vrajaṃtyā saddharmaḥ sītayā saṃpradarśitaḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā'śokaṃ vane pārtha pallavālaṃkṛtāṃbaram \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. During the period of exile, the goddess Janaki had glanced the Asoka tree with sprouting of the tender leaves as well the shoots. She adored the said tree.

## \|\| 3.9.8-9 \|\|

*kṛtvā samīpe bhartāraṃ devaraṃ ca tilākṣataiḥ \|*  
*dīpālaṃkṛtanaivedyadhūpasūtraphalārccanaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*arcayitvā hyarthito'sau raktāśoko yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*maithilyā prāñjalirbhūtvā śṛṇvato rāghavasya ca \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. O Yudhisthira, reaching before the said tree, she made her husband and his brother with sesamum seeds, besides the Asoka tree and then offered the same sesamum, unbroken rice, lamp, eatables, incense, cotton cord and the fruit and adored the tree with devotion. Thereafter, she prayed to the red Asoka tree. Then Janaki, getting seated before Sri Rama, folding both the hands, offered the prayer saying.

## \|\| 3.9.10 \|\|

*ciraṃ jīvatu me vṛddhaḥ śvaśuraḥ kośaleśvaraḥ \|*  
*bhartā me devarāścaiva jīvaṃtu bharatādayaḥ \|*  
*kauśalyāmapi jīvantīṃ paśyeyamiti maithilī \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. She said- “Let my old father-in-law, the lord of Kosala, attain long life. Similarly, let my husband, his brothers like Bharata and others, the mother Kausalya enjoy a long life, to enable me to meet them.”

## \|\| 3.9.11-12 \|\|

*yayāce taṃ mahābhāgā drumaṃ satyopayācanam \|*  
*pradakṣiṇamupāvṛtya tataste prayayuḥ punaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*evamanyāpi yā nārī pūjayedbhuvi taṃ nagam \|*  
*tila taṃḍulasaṃmiśrairyavagodhūmasarṣapaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. In this way, the valorous JanakI sought blessings from the truthful tree and then circumambulated it. Thereafter, she left the place. Similarly, the other men and women of the earth should offer sesamum, unbroken rice, mixture barley, wheat, besides mustard to the Asoka tree with red shoots.

## \|\| 3.9.13-14 \|\|

*kṣamāpya vandayenmūlaṃ pādapaṃ raktapallavam \|*  
*mantreṇānena kauṃteya praṇamya strī pativratā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*mahāvṛkṣa mahāśākha makaradhvajamandira \|*  
*prārthaye tvāṃ mahābhāga vanopavanabhūṣaṇa \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Sitting at the roots of the tree, one should worship it with devotion. О son of Kunti, an auspicious lady should offer prayer to him-“O great tree with many branches, you are the abode of Kama. You are the ornaments of the forest as well as the orchard. I am offering prayer to you.”

## \|\| 3.9.15-16 \|\|

*evamābhāṣya taṃ vṛkṣaṃ dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām \|*  
*sakhībhiḥ sahitā sādhvī tataḥ svabhavanaṃ vrajet \|\| 15 \|\|*

*yāḥ śokanāśanamaśokataruṃ taruṇyaḥ saṃpūjayaṃti kusumākṣatadhūpadīpaiḥ \|*  
*tāḥ prāpya saukhyamatulaṃ bhuvi bhartṛ jātaṃ gaurīpadaṃ pramuditāḥ punarāpnuvaṃti \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Thus offering the prayer, one should give the daksina to a Brahmana and then return to her abode with other ladies. A woman, who adores the Asoka tree which removes the grief and offers flowers, unbroken rice and lamp etc., she earns enormous pleasure on earth with her husband. She finally achieves the position of the Gauri.

## Chapter 10. Glory of Karavira vrata

## \|\| 3.10.1 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe prathame'hni dinodaye \|*  
*devodyānabhavaṃ hṛdyaṃ karavīraṃ samarcayeta \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O best of gods, you reveal a type of vrata before me, by performing which the house wives achieve the unlimited love of their husbands?

## \|\| 3.10.2-4 \|\|

*raktataṃtuparīdhānaṃ gandhadhūpavilepanaiḥ \|*  
*virūḍhaiḥ saptadhānyaiśca nāraṃgairbījapūrakaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*guṇakairghaṭakairdivyairnālikeraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ \|*  
*abhyukṣyākṣatatoyena maṃtreṇaivaṃ kṣamāpayet \|\| 3 \|\|*

*karavīra viṣāvāsa namaste bhānuvallabha \|*  
*maulimaṃḍanasadratna namaste keśaveśayoḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. A red cloth should be placed around it and then the fragrance, incense, sandal paste, seven types of cereals, orange, lemon, ganaka and the divine coconut should be offered to the tree. Thereafter, the water should be poured at its root. The prayer should then be offered- “0 Karavira (oleander), you are very close to the Sungod, besides you are the gem for the head of lord Visnu and Mahadeva. Therefore, salutation to you.

## \|\| 3.10.5-6 \|\|

*ākṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca \|*  
*hiraṇyayena savitā rathenādevo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan \|\| 5 \|\|*

*evaṃ bhaktyā samabhyarcya dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām \|*  
*pradakṣiṇāmatho kṛtvā tataḥ svabhavanaṃ vrajet \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Thereafter, littering the hymn- “Akrsnena RajasS” and with the mind filled with devotion, the tree should be adored. Thereafter, the Brahmana should be given the daksina and after circumambulating the place, then he should proceed towards his home.

## Chapter 11. Glory of Kokila-vrata

## \|\| 3.11.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*svabhartrā saha saṃbaddhamahāsneho yathā bhavet \|*  
*kulastrīṇāṃ tadācakṣva vrataṃ mama surottama \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sri Krsna said- On the bright first moon day of the month of Jyestha, at the time of dawn, one should worship the Karavira (oleander) tree in an orchard or a temple.

## \|\| 3.11.2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*yamunāyāstaṭe pūrvaṃ mathurāste purī śubhā \|*  
*tasyāṃ śatrughnanāmnābhūdrājā rāmapratiṣṭhitaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Sri Krsna said- Over the eastern bank of the river Yamuna, there had been a city named Mathura, where Satrughna ruled after Sri Rama established him there.

## \|\| 3.11.3-4 \|\|

*tasya bhāryā kīrtimālā nāmnāsītprathitā bhuvi \|*  
*tayā praṇamya bhagavānvaśiṣṭho munipuṃgavaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*pṛṣṭaḥ sukhaṃ muniśreṣṭha kathaṃ samupajāyate \|*  
*brūhi me tilasambandhakāraṇaṃ vratamuttamam \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. His wife was known by the name of Kirtimala, who had been extremely chaste and devoted to her husband on earth. She once asked Vasistha, the best of the sages, after offering her salutation to him- “O great sage, you kindly tell me the excellent vrata by performing which, one could earn the enormous comforts. Besides the (vrata should be simple) and could be performed by offering the sesamum seeds as well as the unbroken rice.”

## \|\| 3.11.5 \|\|

*evamuktastayā jñānī vaśiṣṭhaḥ kīrtimālayā \|*  
*dhyātvā muhūrtamācakhyau kokilāvratamuttamam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. When so enquired by Kirtimala, the extremely learned sage Vasistha, thinking for a moment, started speaking about the performing of the Kokila-vraia.

## \|\| 3.11.6-7 \|\|

*śrīvaśiṣṭha uvāca \|*  
*āṣāḍhapūrṇimāyāṃ tu saṃdhyākāle hyupasthite \|*  
*saṃkalpayenmāsamekaṃ śrāvaṇe śvaḥprabhṛtyaham \|\| 6 \|\|*

*snānaṃ kariṣye niyatā brahmacaryasthitā satī \|*  
*bhokṣyāmi naktaṃ bhūśayyāṃ kariṣye prāṇināṃ dayām \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. The sage Vasistha said- On the full moon day of the month of Asadha, one should resolve in the evening time, that starting from tomorrow and till the end of the month of Sravana, she would perform the brahmacarya vrata of celibacy. She would take a bath daily and take the food at night, sleeping on the ground and be compassionate on all the living beings.

## \|\| 3.11.8 \|\|

*iti saṃkalpya puruṣo nārī vā brāhmaṇāṃtike \|*  
*prāpyānujñāṃ tataḥ prātaḥ sarvasāmagrisaṃyutaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. With the intention of worshipping the Sungod, Anasuya, Ksama, Savitri, Satyabhama, Damayanti, Sarasvati, Gayatri, Ganga and other pious ladies had performed this vrata. Therefore, O Partha! The Karavira vrata bestows all the comforts.

## \|\| 3.11.9 \|\|

*puruṣaḥ pratipatkālāddantadhāvanapūrvakam \|*  
*nadyāṃ gatvā tathā vāpyāṃ taḍāge girinirjhare \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O foremost of the race of Bharata, thus, by worshipping the oleander tree appropriately, which should have the branches laden with flowers and the tree itself decorated with tree leaves, such a person, enjoying all the comforts in the world, attains the abode of the Sungod.

## \|\| 3.11.10 \|\|

*snānaṃ kuryādvratī pārtha sugandhāmalakaistilaiḥ \|*  
*dināṣṭakaṃ tathā paścātsarvauṣadhyā punaḥ pṛthak \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. A man or a woman shall take an oath accordingly, before a Brahmana. Then during the first day of the moon, one should take a bath in a river, step-well, tank or a mountain spring. The performer of the vrata should apply the fragrant oil of myrobalan over the body besides the sesamum oil. Then all the herbs should be touched with the body individually.

## \|\| 3.11.11 \|\|

*vacayāṣṭau punaḥ piṣṭvā śiroruhavimardanam \|*  
*snātvā dhyātvā raviṃ caiva vaṃditvā ca pitṝnatha \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Thereafter, using the powder the hair of the head should be cleaned properly. After the bath, adoring the Sungod one should offer prayer to the pitrs.

## \|\| 3.11.12-14 \|\|

*tarpayitvā tilāpiṣṭaiḥ kokilāṃ pakṣirūpiṇīm \|*  
*kalakaṇṭhīṃ śubhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayeccaṃpakodbhavaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*patrairvā dhūpanaivedyadīpālaktakacaṃdanaiḥ \|*  
*tila tanduladūrvāgraiḥ pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet \|*  
*nityaṃ tilavratī bhakto maṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tilasahe tilasaukhye tilavarṇe tilapriye \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ dravyaputrāṃśca dehi me kokile namaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. Thereafter, beautiful eight figures of the cuckoo should be made. The bird has a beautiful voice. The figures should then be worshipped by offering leaves, eatables, red paint for applying over the feet, besides the tender shoots of durva grass, sandal paste, sesamum, unbroken rice and then beg forgiveness. The performer of the vrata should repeat the same process daily and offer prayer to the tree, reciting the mantra- “Tilasahe tilasaukhye”, having the complexion of the sesamum, favourite of the sesamum- O Kokila (cuckoo), I offer my salutation to you. You kindly bestow fortunes, son, wealth etc. always.

## \|\| 3.11.15 \|\|

*ityuccārya tataḥ paścādgṛhamabhyetya saṃyataḥ \|*  
*kṛtvāhāraṃ svapetpārtha yāvanmāsaḥ samāpnute \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Offering prayer in this way, one should go home and take food, observing all the rules and go to sleep.

## \|\| 3.11.16-17 \|\|

*māsāṃte tāmrapātryāṃ tu kokilāṃ tilapiṣṭajām \|*  
*ratnanetrāṃ svarṇapakṣāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 16 \|\|*

*vastrairddhanairguḍairyuktāṃ śrāvaṇyāṃ kuṃḍale'tha vā \|*  
*śvaśrūśvaśuravarge vā daivajñe vā purohite \|*  
*vyāse vā saṃpradātavyā vratibhiḥ śubhakāmyayā \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. At the end of the month, performing similarly, the cuckoo bird, which is established in a copper plate, her body should be decorated with the pudding. Her eyes should be made of gems, the wings should be of gold. The costumes, cereals and sugarcane balls should also be offered to the figures. For the fulfillment of her own wishes, she should make all the offerings to her mother-in-law or father-in-law or some one of their race. Or otherwise, these articles can be given over to an astrologer, the priest, or a Vyasa.

## \|\| 3.11.18-19 \|\|

*evaṃ yā kurute nārī kokilāvratamādarāt \|*  
*sapta janmāni saubhāgyaṃ sā prāpnoti suvistaram \|\| 18 \|\|*

*niḥsāpatnyaṃ patiṃ bhavyaṃ sasnehaṃ prāpya bhūtale \|*  
*mṛtā gaurīpuraṃ yāti vimānenārkavarcasā \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Thus, a woman, who performs the vrata with grace and devotion, she enjoys the exclusive love of her husband without a cowife and enjoys the total love of her husband exclusively. On her death, she is mounted on a plane shining like a sun and achieves the position of Gauri or Parvati.

## \|\| 3.11.20 \|\|

*etadvrataṃ vaśiṣṭhena muninā kathitaṃ purā \|*  
*tathā cānuṣṭhitaṃ pārtha samastaṃ kīrtimālayā \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O Partha, the sage Vasistha in earlier times, had spoken about this vrata to Kirtimala, delighting her at the same time.

## \|\| 3.11.21 \|\|

*tasyāśca sarvaṃ saṃpannaṃ vaśiṣṭhavacanādiha \|*  
*putrasaubhāgyasaṃmānaṃ śatrughnasya prasādajam \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. According to the story narrated by the sage Vasistha after the performing of the vrata, she (Kirtimala) enjoyed all types of pleasures on earth. By the grace of her husband Satrughna, she got the son, fortunes, honour and respect enormously.

## \|\| 3.11.22 \|\|

*evaṃ yānyāpi kauṃteya kokilāvratamādarāt \|*  
*kariṣyati dhruvaṃ tasyāḥ saubhāgyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. O son of Kunti, similarly, any other woman who performs the Kokila-wata appropriately, she would attain the comforts beyond limit, besides the fortunes surely.

## \|\| 3.11.23 \|\|

*ye kokilāṃ kalaravāṃ kalakaṃṭhapīṭhāṃ yacchaṃti sājyatilapiṣṭamayīṃ dvijebhyaḥ \|*  
*te naṃdanādiṣu vaneṣu vihṛtya kāmaṃ martye sametya madhuradhvanayo bhavaṃti \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The ladies, who with the figure of cuckoo and with beautiful limbs, also gives the sesamum powder to the Brahmanas, she becoming desirous of enjoying pleasures, attains the sweet voice like the cuckoo.

## Chapter 12. Glory of Bphadtapa-vrata

## \|\| 3.12.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*atha pāpāpahaṃ vakṣye bṛhadvratamanuttamam \|*  
*surāsuramunīnāṃ ca durllabhaṃ vidhinā śṛṇu \|\| 1 \|\|*

*parvaṇyāśvayujasyāṃte pāyasaṃ ghṛta saṃyutam \|*  
*naktaṃ bhuñjīta śuddhātmā odanaṃ vaikṣavānvitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ācamyātha śucirbhūtvā bilvajaṃ daṃtadhāvanam \|*  
*bhakṣayitvā mahādevaṃ praṇamyedamudīrayet \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Sri Krsna said- I shall now talk to you about the Brhad-vrata which removes all the sins besides being beyond the reach of the gods, asuras and the sages. I am going to describe it in depth. You please listen to the same attentively. At the end of the full moon time of the month of Karttika, becoming a purified soul, one should consume the food of payasam with ghi, once in the night. It should be prepared with the sweet rice. During the next morning, rinsing the month and purifying the body, one should use the tooth stick of the wood apple tree. Then purifying himself, one should offer prayer to lord Mahadeva, by offering salutation to him.

## \|\| 3.12.4 \|\|

*ahaṃ devavratamidaṃ kartumicchāmi śāśvatam \|*  
*tavājñayā mahādeva yathā nirvahate kuru \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. He should pray- “O lord, at your command, I intend to perform this vrata regularly. O Mahadeva, the way this could be performed appropriately, you kindly do the same.

## \|\| 3.12.5-6 \|\|

*ityevaṃ niyamaṃ kṛtvā yāvadvarṣāṇi ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*tithayaḥ pratipatpūrvāṃ bhajiṣyāmītyanukramāt \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tato mārgaśire māsi pratipadyapare'hani \|*  
*pṛṣṭvā guruṃ copavāsaṃ mahādevaṃ smaranmuhuḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. I shall also try to accomplish it for sixteen years, observing all the rules starting on the first or the other moon days.” Thus, performing the samkalpa on the first moon day of the month of Margasirsa at the command of the preceptor in the early morning, and adoring lord Siva mentally, the fast should be initiated.

## \|\| 3.12.7-9 \|\|

*snātvā devaṃ samabhyarcya rātrau prajvālya dīpakān \|*  
*yamunāṃ ca mahādevaṃ natvā paścānnimaṃtrayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

*mahādevaratānviprānsapatnīkānyatavratān \|*  
*ṣoḍaśāṣṭau tadardhaṃ vā ekaṃ vā śaktyapekṣayā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*āmaṃtrya svagṛhaṃ gatvā mahādevaṃ smarankṣitau \|*  
*śucivastrāstṛtāyāṃ tu nirāhāro niśi svapeta \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. By taking bath in the early morning, the lamp should be lighted in the night. Then offering salutation to the river Yamuna and lord Mahadeva, he should invite, according to his means, sixteen, eight, four or even one Brahmana with his wife, who should be devoted to lord Siva, having controlled all the sense organs, besides being the performer of the vrata. Thereafter, returning to his own place, he should perform the fast, devoting his mind to lord Siva. During the night he should sleep at such a place, which the auspicious cloth is spread.

## \|\| 3.12.10-11 \|\|

*bhāskarodayamāsādya snātvā cādāya dīpakān \|*  
*naivedyaṃ snapanaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ gaccheṣchivālaye \|\| 10 \|\|*

*abhyaṃgayitvā deveśaṃ kaṣāyaiśca virūkṣayet \|*  
*snapayetpañcagavyena payasā tadanaṃtaram \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Then again at the sunrise, he should take his bath and then go to the temple of Siva and offer the lamp, eatables, water for bath, the flowers and incense to the lord and then worship him, anointing oil all over his body. Then, pancagavya should be applied over the body of the lord.

## \|\| 3.12.12-14 \|\|

*ghṛtena madhunā dadhnā rasena payasā punaḥ \|*  
*tilāṃbunā tataḥ snāpya snāpayeduṣṇavā riṇā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*lepayetsughanaṃ paścātkarpūrāgarucaṃdanaiḥ \|*  
*puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjya dātavyaṃ haimaṃ śirasi paṃkajam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*vastrayugmaṃ patākāṃ ca pañcavarṇaṃ vitānakam \|*  
*dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca ghaṃṭāñca dadyāddevasya śaktitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. Thereafter, the milk, ghi, honey, curd, juice, again milk and then the water mixed with sesamum seeds should be poured over the body. After bathing with the aforesaid materials, the image should be bathed with the warm water. Thereafter, camphor, agaru and the sandal paste should be offered to the image of the lord and adoration should then be performed. Then his head should be adored with golden lotus flowers. Thereafter, two clothes, a banner, canopy of five colours, besides incense, bell and other things should be offered to the lord as per one’s means.

## \|\| 3.12.15-16 \|\|

*paścānnivedya naivedyaṃ stutvā svabhavanaṃ vrajet \|*  
*susamiddhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pūjayejjātavedasam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*vratinaśca tathācāryaṃ bhojayenmithunāni ca \|*  
*hemavastrādidānena yathāśakti kṣamāpayet \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Thereafter, the prayer should be offered with eatables and the devotee should then return to the place of his living. Reaching there, he should worship the burning fire. Then he, together with his wife, should serve food to a Brahmana, besides the gold or other eatables and costumes as per his means by offering prayer to the Brahmanas at the same time. He should also beg forgiveness.

## \|\| 3.12.17-18 \|\|

*evaṃ visṛjya tānsarvānsārddhaṃ baṃdhujanaiḥ svayam \|*  
*āśayitvā pañcagavyaṃ hṛṣṭo bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*evameva vidhiṃ kṛtvā prārabhetādhano dhanī \|*  
*vittasāmarthyataścaiva pratimāsaṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. After completion of the worship, he should take his food with family, relatives and friends. He should break his fast by testing of the pancagavya delightfully. Following the same process, a person with poor or abundant means should perform the vrata.

## \|\| 3.12.19-20 \|\|

*vittahīno yathā kaścicchraddhayā ca punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*puṣpārcanavidhānena sarvametatsamācaret \|\| 19 \|\|*

*pratimāsamupoṣyaivaṃ prati patkārttikāvadhau \|*  
*pārayettaṃ hutaṃ pārtha prāraṃbhavidhinā sphuṭam \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. A poor but an extremely faithful person can perform this vrata by offering the flowers alone. Thus by starting from the first moon day and upto the month of Karttika, the vrata has to be performed every month by fasting regularly, following the simple process, followed by the performing of homa. All efforts should be made to perform this vrata accordingly.

## \|\| 3.12.21-27 \|\|

*dvitīye dve pañcadaśyāṃ kṛtvā naktaṃ narādhipaḥ \|*  
*pratipatsa dvitīyā cettasyāmupavasetsudhīḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*dvitīyopavasecchuklā tataḥ prabhṛti vatsaram \|*  
*prāraṃbhavidhinā caivaṃ dvitīyāmapi pārayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

*upavāsadvayaṃ kṛtvā tṛtīyāṃ prārabhettataḥ \|*  
*anena kramayogena yāvadvarṣaṃ samāpyate \|\| 23 \|\|*

*kṛtvaivaṃ ṣoḍaśe varṣe pūrṇamāsyāṃ samudyataḥ \|*  
*pūrvavaddevamabhyarcya kṛśānuṃ vābhitarpya ca \|\| 24 \|\|*

*hemaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ saghaṃṭāṃ kāṃsyadohanām \|*  
*mahādevāya gāṃ dadyāddīkṣitāya dvijāya vai \|\| 25 \|\|*

*śivabhaktiratānviprānviśuddhāṃścaiva ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*vastrābharaṇadānaiśca śaktyā saṃpūjayedvratī \|\| 26 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇāṃśca yathāśaktyā bhojayedaparānapi \|*  
*anyeṣāṃ ca kṣudhārtānāṃ dadyāddānaṃ yathecchayā \|\| 27 \|\|*

21-27. On both the second moon days and on the full moon days, one should take food only once in the night, and the vrata should be concluded. In case on the first moon day the dvitiya overlaps, the learned people shall have to fast on that day itself, which is essential. Starting from that day, till full one year, on the day of bright dvitiya, one should observe the fast regularly or otherwise on the pratipada and dvitiya (first and second days of the moon), one should observe two fasts, anu$thana of vrata and in the same process it should be followed for full one year. In this way, at the end of the period of one year, on the full moon day, the gods and the fire should be worshipped, besides offering oblation to lord Mahadeva. A diksita Brahmana should then be offered a cow in charity, with her horns decorated with gold and the hoofs decorated with silver and a bell hanging in the neck and elbow should be of bronze. The performer of the vrata should then, invite sixteen learned Brahmanas who should be immensely devoted to lord Siva besides being auspicious, and give them costumes and ornaments with respect, and should also serve food to them. Other Brahmanas should also be served food etc. as per one’s means. Similarly, other grieved persons should be given away the charities as per one’s liking.

## \|\| 3.12.28 \|\|

*bṛhattapovrataṃ caiva brahmaghnādyaghaśoṣaṇam \|*  
*bhūrbhuvādiṣu lokeṣu bhūribhogapradaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. This Brhattapovrata saves people from the sin of Brahmahatya and bestows the comforts of Вhu, Bhuva and other lokas.

## \|\| 3.12.29-32 \|\|

*caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ svargasopānavatsthitam \|*  
*na kuryādyo dhanaṃ prāpya sa muṣṭo naṣṭacetanaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*dhanyamāyuḥpradaṃ puṇyaṃ rūpasaubhāgyavarddhanam \|*  
*strīpuṃsayośca nirdiṣṭaṃ vratametatpurātanam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*vidhavayāpi kartavyaṃ bhūyo'vaidhavyahetave \|*  
*sadhavayāpi kartavyamaviyogāya sadvratam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*upoṣya pratimāsaṃ tu bhuṃjīta brāhmaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*ekadvitricaturbhirvā svaśaktyā pāṃḍunaṃdana \|\| 32 \|\|*

29-32. This vrata is the ladder for all the four varnas to reach the heaven. Therefore, a person who inspite of being wealthy, does not perform this vrata, who else would be a greater killer of his own soul? This eternal vrata enhances the fortunes, life, merits and prosperity. A widow woman in order not to face such a situation in future births, besides the women with their husbands alive, not to face such a misfortune in future and for the protection of their husbands, should perform this vrata every month and serve food to one, two or three Brahmanas, every month as per their means.

## \|\| 3.12.33 \|\|

*aṃte cāṃte suvarṇānāṃ prāraṃbhavidhinācaret \|*  
*puṇyasaṃbhāramanvicchangamayitvā śivālayam \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. O son of Pandu, at the end of the performing of the vrata, the performer should go to a Siva temple getting desirous of achieving of the excessive merit.

## \|\| 3.12.34 \|\|

*vratavighne mahārāja jāte daivātkathaṃcana \|*  
*tāvatyastithayaścānyāḥ samupoṣyāḥ samāptaye \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. In case due to any reason, some obstruction crops up in the vrata, then one should perform vrata for the same number of days for the conclusion of the same vrata.

## \|\| 3.12.35 \|\|

*atha śīghrataraṃ kaścidvrataṃ kartuṃ samudyataḥ \|*  
*vidhinānena rājendra tena grāhyaṃ tithidvayam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. O Rajendra! In case a person is desirous of completing the vrata earlier than the usual time, then following the same process, it should be performed on two tithis or moon days.

## \|\| 3.12.36-37 \|\|

*aṃte cāṃte ca varṣāṇāṃ prāraṃbhavidhinā ca ret \|*  
*athārabdhe vrate kaścidasamāpte mriyeta cet \|\| 36 \|\|*

*so'pi tatphalamāpnoti satyāraṃbhaprabhāvataḥ \|*  
*vācakāḥ śrāvakāścaiva vratasyāsya yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*bhavaṃti putrasaṃśliṣṭāḥ śivadhyānānubhāvataḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. At the end of each one of the years, it should be completed following the same process. In case a performer, after starting the vrata, meets with his end, with the influence of the truthful start of the vrata he still achieves the best of the rewards. O Yudhisthira! The performer of the vrata and the listener of the same, both of them spend most comfortable life by the grace of lord Siva.

## \|\| 3.12.38 \|\|

*puṇyaṃ bṛhattapa idaṃ vratamādarādye kurvaṃti ṣoḍaśasamā niratāḥ svadharme \|*  
*te bhānumaṃḍalamabhedyamaciṃtyamādyaṃ bhittvā prayānti śaśiśekharapādamūlam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. With the successful performing of Brhattapa vrata, the person gets immensely devoted to lord and following the dharma for sixteen years with devotion, he finally achieves the lotus like feet of Siva, breaking the impregnable Surya mandala.

## Chapter 13. Glory of Bhadra-vrata

## \|\| 3.13.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*jātismaratvaṃ deveśa duṣprāpyamiti me matiḥ \|*  
*tadahaṃ jñātumicchāmi prāpyate kena karmaṇā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*varapradānāddevānāmṛṣīṇāṃ sevanena vā \|*  
*tīrthasnānena vā deva tapohomavratena vā \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- O lord of gods, how does one know about the deeds perfonned in earlier births which are difficult to be achieved? I would like to known about them. You tell me about the relevant vrata. Does one achieve it as a result of some boon, or by serving the gods or the Rsis, taking bath at holy places, by performing tapas, or by performing of which one of vrata or an anusthana?

## \|\| 3.13.3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*catvāri rājanbhadrāṇi samupoṣyāṇi yatnataḥ \|*  
*tatprabhāvādbhavennūnaṃ rājañjātismaro naraḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Sri Krsna said- O king, when a person performs four fasts of Bhadra-vrata, with the influence of the same, the performing person surely retains the past memories.

## \|\| 3.13.4-6 \|\|

*śubhodayaḥ purā vaiśyo babhūva yamunātaṭe \|*  
*tena vratamidaṃ cīrṇaṃ mṛtaḥ kālakramādasau \|\| 4 \|\|*

*saṃjayasya suto jātaḥ svarṇaṣṭhīvīti viśrutaḥ \|*  
*vrataprabhāvājjātijñaḥ sa ca caurernipātitaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*nāradasya prabhāveṇa punaru jīvyate'pyasau \|*  
*sasmāra pūrvavṛttāṃtaṃ sakalaṃ vratadharmataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. In earlier times, a Vaisya anmed Subhodaya lived at the bank of the river Yamuna, who had performed this vrata in an appropriate manner. Ultimately at his death, he was reborn as a son with Sanjaya. He was well known as Svarnasthivi. With the influence of this vrata, he remembered his earlier caste. Though the thieves had killed him, still due to the influence of Narada, he regained his life and because of the influence of this vrata, he remembered the entire sequence of the past events.

## \|\| 3.13.7 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*saṃjayasya kathaṃ putraḥ svarṇaṣṭhīvīti vā katham \|*  
*dasyubhiśca kathaṃ nīto mṛtyuṃ vai jīvitaḥ katham \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Yudhisthira said- How was the son Svarnasthivi born to Sanjaya? How was he killed at the hands of the thieves and then how could he get back his life? You please tell us.

## \|\| 3.13.8 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*saṃjayo nāma rājāsītkuśāvatyāṃ narādhipa \|*  
*devarṣī tasya mitre ca sadā nāradaparvatau \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Sri Krsna said- O king, Sanjaya was the king of the city of Kusavati. He had two friends named Narada and Parvata who used to after visit Kusavati.

## \|\| 3.13.9 \|\|

*ekadā saṃjayagṛhaṃ saṃprāptau tau yadṛcchayā \|*  
*svagatāsanadānādyairupacārairapūjayat \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. While roaming about, both the friends once reached Kusavati, quite suddenly. The king welcomed both of them appropriately and gave them the proper seats.

## \|\| 3.13.10 \|\|

*teṣāmathopaviṣṭānāṃ pūrvavṛttāṃtabhāṣiṇau \|*  
*saṃjayasya sutā prāptā taruṇī pituraṃtikam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Thereafter, all the courtiers started narrating their respective stories to the king. Suddenly, a young daughter of the king Sanjaya reached there to meet her father.

## \|\| 3.13.11-13 \|\|

*parvataḥ prāha rājānaṃ kanyeyaṃ varavarṇinī \|*  
*guptagulphā saṃhatorūḥ pīnaśroṇipayodharā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*padmapatrekṣaṇanakhā padmakiṃjalkasaprabhā \|*  
*ākuñcitamṛdusnigdhaiḥ keśairavitatairghanaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*savilāsā gajagatiḥ sunāsā kokilasvarā \|*  
*aho rūpamaho dhairyamaho lāvaṇyamuttamam \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. Looking at her, the sage Parvata said to the king- “This is an astonishing type of a girl, because her heels being fleshy are quite secretive. Similarly, are her thick thighs and the corpulent ears and the thick lips. Both her eyes are blossoming like the lotus flowers and are soft. The nails are soft and the body has the complexion of the dust of lotus flowers. The hair of the head are curly and her walking resembles the cow elephant. The nose is beautiful and her voice resembles that of a cuckoo. Her beauty and charm besides loveliness are carting surprise. She is also quite patient and solace is quite enormous.

## \|\| 3.13.14-20 \|\|

*tilapuṣpasphuṭā nāsā rūpaṃ saṃparilakṣyate \|*  
*kasyeyaṃ bhadrikā bhadrā mamātihṛdayaṃgamā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*evaṃ bruvā ṇaṃ taṃ vipraṃ vismayotphullalocanam \|*  
*sa rājā prāha kanyeyaṃ duhitā mama parvata \|\| 15 \|\|*

*athovāca nṛpaṃ dhīmānnāradaḥ kṣubhitendriyaḥ \|*  
*rājanniveṣṭukāmo'haṃ kanyeyaṃ mama dīyatām \|\| 16 \|\|*

*īpsitaṃ tava dāsyāmi varaṃ martyeṣu durllabham \|*  
*evamukto nāradena prītātmā saṃjayastathā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kṛtāñjaliruvācedaṃ praharṣotphullalocanaḥ \|*  
*putro me dīyatāṃ kṣipramakṣīṇakanakākaraḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*yasya mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā śleṣmāṇaṃ kṣipati kṣitau \|*  
*jātarūpaṃ hi tatsarvaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavatu sthiram \|\| 19 \|\|*

*evamastviti taṃ rājannāradaḥ pratyabhāṣata \|*  
*suvarṇaṣṭhīvinaṃ putraṃ dadāmi tava suvrata \|\| 20 \|\|*

14-20. Like the sesamum flowers, her nose is constantly attracting the mind. She has a beautiful figure, which has attracted the mind of an ascetic like me. Whose beloved is she?” At these words spoken by the Brahmana whose eyes had blossomed with surprise, the king replied- “O Parvata, she is my daughter.” On hearing this, then Narada, suffering from lust, spoke- “O king, I am getting desirous to impregnate her. Therefore, you please give her hand to me, after which I shall give you the desired boon, which is difficult to get in this world.’’ At these words spoken by Narada, the king Sanjaya, feeling extremely delighted, who eyes had blossomed like the lotus flowers, prayed to him with folded hands-“You give me immediately a son who should have the unlimited gold, when his urine or refuse falls on earth, it should be turned atonce into gold.”

## \|\| 3.13.21-24 \|\|

*evamuktvā sa tāṃ kanyāṃ sālaṅkārāṃ sumadhyamām \|*  
*vivāhayāmāsa tayā nārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tattasya ceṣṭitaṃ dṛṣṭvā parvataḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ \|*  
*uvāca nāradaṃ roṣāddīptākṣaḥ sphuritādharaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*mayeyaṃ prārthitā pūrvaṃ tvayā yasmādvivāhitā \|*  
*tasmānmayā samaṃ svargaṃ na gaṃtāsi kathaṃcana \|\| 23 \|\|*

*dattastvayāsya yaḥ putro varadānena nārada \|*  
*so'pi caurairabhihataḥ pañcatvamupayāsyati \|\| 24 \|\|*

21-24. At this, Narada said- “Whatever you desire, would be done accordingly. I shall bestow you a golden son of the earth.” Thus speaking, Narada got the hand of the girl in marriage who was adorned with all types of ornaments and was quite beautiful, in an appropriate manner. Subsequently, getting enraged, getting extremely annoyed, with eyes getting red and the lips fluttering in anger, Parvata said- “Should you have married her, because of this blemish, you shall not be able to travel with me to heaven in anyway. Moreover, О Narada, the son who has been given by you to the king, he shall also getting ruined by the robbers, would die ultimately.”

## \|\| 3.13.25-27 \|\|

*evamuktaḥ parvatena nāradaḥ prāha durmanāḥ \|*  
*na tvaṃ dharmaṃ vijānāsi kiñcinmūḍho'si durmate \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sāmānyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ kanyā bhavati suvrata \|*  
*na tasyā varaṇe duḥkhaṃ paśyaṃtīha bahuśrutāḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*na sevitāstvayā vṛddhāstena māṃ śapase ruṣā \|*  
*paṇigrahaṇamaṃtrāṇāṃ niṣṭhā syātsaptame pade \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. At these words spoken by Parvata, Narada spoke painfully- “O wicked Parvata, you are a great fool. You are least aware of dharma, because the girl ordinarily belongs to all, but the people do not express grief when she is married. You have not served the elderly people. Therefore, getting annoyed, you are pronouncing a curse on me, knowing fully well that after reciting the last of the Saptapadi mantras, the marriage gets firmly solemnized.

## \|\| 3.13.28 \|\|

*yasmādetadavijñāya śapase māmanāgasam \|*  
*tasmāttvamapyaho svargaṃ na gaṃtāsi mayā vinā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Instead of taking this fact into account, you have pronounced a curse over an innocent person. Therefore, you would also not be able to visit the heaven without me.

## \|\| 3.13.29 \|\|

*saṃjayasya sutaḥ śāpādyadi pañcatvameṣyati \|*  
*ānayiṣye tathāpyenaṃ yamalokānna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. In case, the son of the king dies because of the curse pronounced by you, then it is certain that I shall get him back from the abode of Yama.”

## \|\| 3.13.30 \|\|

*evaṃ śaptvā tadā' nyonyaṃ devarṣī tāvubhau punaḥ \|*  
*pūjitau saṃjayenātha jagmatuḥ svāśramaṃ prati \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Thus pronouncing a curse mutually to each other, both of them were adored by the king Sanjaya, and they left for their asramas.

## \|\| 3.13.31 \|\|

*athāsya saptame māsi jātaḥ putro nṛpasya saḥ \|*  
*svarṇaṣṭhīvīti nāmāsya yathārthamakarotpitā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. After the seventh month, the son named Svarnasthivi was born to the king. The father performed all the birth rites for him appropriately.

## \|\| 3.13.32 \|\|

*jātismaraḥ smaravapuḥ suvarṇotpattikāraṇam \|*  
*sarvabhūtarutajño'bhūdbhadravrataphalādiha \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. By the effect of the Bhadra vrata performed by him, he had the memory of his earlier births, has the beautiful body like the god of love and the gold emerged out of his body. He could also understand the language of all the living beings.

## \|\| 3.13.33 \|\|

*mūtraśleṣmapurīṣādi yatkiñcitkṣipati kṣitau \|*  
*jāyate kanakaṃ sarvaṃ prasādānnāradasya ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. His refuse and the urine were turned into gold whenever they were dropped from his body by the grace of Narada.

## \|\| 3.13.34-35 \|\|

*tenāsau yajate rājā vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ \|*  
*rājasūyādibhiryajñairvi vidhairbrāhmaṇairvṛtaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*babhāra bhṛtyānaniśaṃ pupoṣa svajanātithīn \|*  
*cakāra devatāgāraṃ saraścārāmavāṭikāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. Collecting the same gold, Sanjaya used to invite all the learned Brahmanas and honoured them. He also performed Rajasuya yajnas and others. He also fed the servants of all grades quite well, besides his relatives and guests. He also well maintained the temples, lakes, tanks, gardens and orchards and also performed many constructive works.

## \|\| 3.13.36 \|\|

*jātasnehaṃ tathā putraṃ rarakṣa rakṣi bhirvṛtaḥ \|*  
*rāśayaḥ kanakasyāsya babhūvurnṛpateḥ sutāt \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Besides the soldiers, the son was guarded by the king himself. The unlimited measure of gold was produced out of the body of the prince.

## \|\| 3.13.37 \|\|

*athāsya dasyavaḥ kecicchrutvā taṃ kanakākaram \|*  
*dhanalolupayā jaghnurdākṣiṇātyā madoddha tāḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. After some time, the thieves of the southern country learnt about the prince being the mine of gold and they became greedy for getting wealth.

## \|\| 3.13.38 \|\|

*tasminvinaṣṭe tannaṣṭaṃ varadānasamudbhavam \|*  
*kanakaṃ tadapaśyaṃto jagmuranyonyataḥ kṣayam \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Therefore, they killed the child. At the death of the boy who had been born as a consequence of a boon, the treasure of gold of the king was also shattered.

## \|\| 3.13.39-42 \|\|

*pātitaṃ dasyubhiḥ putraṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā suduḥkhitaḥ \|*  
*vilalāpākulamatiḥ sa mumoha papāta ca \|\| 39 \|\|*

*vilapaṃtaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradaḥ prāha saṃjayam \|*  
*rājanviṣādaṃ mā kārṣīḥ śṛṇvimāṃ bhāratīṃ mama \|\| 40 \|\|*

*ityuktvā sa samācakhyau caritāni mahaujasām \|*  
*viśiṣṭānāṃ narendrāṇāṃ yatīnāṃ dakṣiṇāvatām \|\| 41 \|\|*

*śrutvā rājā nareṃdrāṇāṃ caritāni mahā tmanām \|*  
*vinaṣṭaśokaḥ sahasā prakṛtistho vabhūva saḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

39-42. Finding his son, having been killed by the thieves, the king felt extremely painful and while lamenting, fainted and fell down on the ground. Finding him in such a precarious condition, Narada said- “Don’t be so upset, you kindly listen to me, whatever is being spoken by me.” Thereafter, Narada narrated the stories of valorous kings, the great kings, the auspicious souls and their meeting with the death, hearing which the king was relieved from the grief and he became well composed as before.

## \|\| 3.13.43-46 \|\|

*nārado'pi nareṃdrasya mṛtaṃ putraṃ yamālayāt \|*  
*ānayāmāsa tarasā tathārūpaṃ yathā hatam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā sa putraṃ taṃ parituṣṭena cetasā \|*  
*vrīḍito vismitaścaiva kṛtāñjalirathāvravīt \|\| 44 \|\|*

*kimāścaryaṃ prasannena bhavatā mama nārada \|*  
*dattaḥ putrastathābhūto dasyubhirghātito yathā \|\| 45 \|\|*

*ṣaṇmāsāṃte punarasau jīvitaṃ sarvameva tat \|*  
*sasmāra pūrvaṃ vṛttāṃtaṃ bhadrāṇāṃ pāraṇātkila \|\| 46 \|\|*

43-46. Narada on his part, tried to bring back the dead son of the king from the abode of Yama.Pretting fully delighted, the king met with his son and touched his body. Thereafter, feeling ashamed and surprised, he said to Narada- “O great Rsi, you have brought back my son to me, who had been killed by the thieves. By this event, I feel sure that when can you get pleased. There is not task that cannot be done with the performing of the Bhadra-vrata. The infant started recalling the events of his earlier life during the sixth month itself.

## \|\| 3.13.47 \|\|

*etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ jātismaraṇakārakam \|*  
*vrataṃ vratādhikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kimanyatkathayāmi te \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Thus, I have narrated to you the events of earlier birth in detail. What else can I tell you about this best vrata?

## \|\| 3.13.48-49 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*brāhmaṇāścaiva śūdrāśca kule mahati janma ca \|*  
*dātā kṣamī dhanī vāgmī rūpī svairbhadrakairbhavet \|\| 48 \|\|*

*catvāri rājanbhadrāṇi catuṣpādāni tāni vai \|*  
*tānyeva bahuvighnāni duṣprāpyānyakṛtātmabhiḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. Sri Krsna said- By the grace of the performing of the Bhadra vrata, irrespective of his birth in the family of a Brahmana, a Sudra, high race, besides being the giver of charities, he becomes wealthy, the one who forgives others, excellent in speech, a learned person, besides being beautiful. There are four phases of the Bhadra-vrata, in achieving which one has to face many obstructions. It is protracted and difficult to achieve as well.

## \|\| 3.13.50-51 \|\|

*mārgaśīrṣe tu prathamaṃ dvitīyaṃ phālgune tathā \|*  
*jyeṣṭhe tṛtīyaṃ rājendra khyātaṃ bhādrapade param \|\| 50 \|\|*

*phālgunāmalapakṣādau trīnmāsāṃstu narādhipa \|*  
*tattripuṣpamiti khyātaṃ tapasyākaraṇaṃ param \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. O king, the first phase is said to be in Margasirsa; second is in the month of Phalguna; the third phase is in the month of Jyesfha; while the fourth phase is in the month of Bhadrapada. O ruler of the people, starting from the bright fortnight of the month of Phalguna. the period of three months is known as Tripuspa. which is most usefill for the performing of the tapas.

## \|\| 3.13.52 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhasya śuklapakṣādau trīnvai māsānyudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*tattrirāmamiti khyātaṃ satyaśauryapradāyakam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. O Yudhisthira, three months starting from the bright fortnight of the month of Jyestha are said to be truthful and full of strength, known as Trirama.

## \|\| 3.13.53 \|\|

*śukle bhādrapadasyādau trīnmāsānpāṃḍunaṃdana \|*  
*tattriraṃgamiti khyātaṃ vahuvidyāpradāyakam \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. O son of Pandu, from the bright fortnight of Bhadrapada, the period of three months is known as Triranga. It bestows various types of learnings.

## \|\| 3.13.54 \|\|

*śuklamārgaśirasyādau trīnmāsāṃstu narādhipa \|*  
*tadviṣṇupadamityuktaṃ sarvadharmapradāyakam \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. O lord of the people, similarly, from the bright fortnight of the month of Margasisa, the period of three months is known as Visnupada, which bestows all the dharmas.

## \|\| 3.13.55 \|\|

*samāsenaiva coktāni bhadrāṇyetāni bhārata \|*  
*kartavyāni naraiḥ strībhirvā brahmaṇānumatena vā \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. O Bharata, thus I have explained the divisions of the Bhadrapada. This vrata has to be performed by the men and the women, with the permission of a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.13.56 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*vistareṇaiva me brūhi devadeva jagatpate \|*  
*bhadrāṇāṃ niyamādhānaṃ pradhānaniyamāṃstathā \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Yudhisthira said- O god of gods and lord of the universe, what are the rules and the regulations of the performing of the Bhadra-vrata? You please speak out to me.

## \|\| 3.13.57 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu rājannavahito bhadrāṇāṃ vistaraṃ param \|*  
*kathayiṣye na kathitaṃ kasyacidyanmayāpurā \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Sri Krsna said- I am going to speak out exhaustively, the rules and regulations of Bhadra-vrata. You listen to me attentively, since no one has defined it earlier.

## \|\| 3.13.58-59 \|\|

*śukle mārgaśirasyādau catvārastithayo varāḥ \|*  
*dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca caturthī pañcamī tathā \|\| 58 \|\|*

*ekabhuktāsanastiṣṭhetpratipadyāṃ jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*prabhāte tu dvitīyāyāṃ kṛtvā yatkaraṇīyakam \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. The bright second, third or fourth moon day of the month of Margasirsa are said to be the best for the performing of the vrata. A well disciplined person should start the vrata from (one of) these days. On the second moon day, he should get up early in the morning and finish all his essential routine duties.

## \|\| 3.13.60-62 \|\|

*praharatraye samadhike gate snānaṃ samācaret \|*  
*mṛdgomayaṃ ca saṃgṛhya maṃtrairebhirvicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*ahaṃ te tu pradiśyāmi maṃtrāṇāṃ vidhimuttamam \|*  
*yeṣāṃ deyo na deyo vā tāñchṛṣva vadāmi te \|\| 61 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā ye śucayo'malāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ maṃtrāḥ pradeyā vai na tu saṃkīrṇadharmiṇām \|\| 62 \|\|*

60-62. The intelligent performer of the vrata should take his bath using cow’s urine and the cowdung with the reciting of the mantras. Besides those mantras, I am going to tell you as to whom these mantras have to be given and when not. The mantra can be revealed to a Brahmana, a Ksatriya, a Vaisya and even a 3udra with a purified and spotless heart. But it should never be revealed to a person following a degraded dharma.

## \|\| 3.13.63 \|\|

*yā strī bhartrā viyuktāpi svācāraiḥ saṃyutā śubhā \|*  
*sā ca mantrānpragṛhṇātu sabhartrī tadanujñayā \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. In separation from the husband, a woman, observing the good conduct and discipline, after getting permission from her husband, this mantra could be given to a woman who is quite auspicious and also close to her husband.

## \|\| 3.13.64 \|\|

*snānaṃ nadyāṃ taḍāge vā vāpyāṃ kūpe gṛhepi vā \|*  
*daśottaraṃ phalaṃ jñeyamadhikaṃ hi samantrakam \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Then the performer should take his bath in a river, a tank, a step-well or a well in the house, reciting the mantra. By having a bath in a river, one achieves ten times more merits.

## \|\| 3.13.65-66 \|\|

*mṛdaṃ maṃtreṇa saṃgṛhya sarvāṃgeṣu pralepayet \|*  
*tvaṃ mṛtsne vaṃditā devaiḥ samalairddaityaghātibhiḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*mayāpi vaṃditā bhaktyā māmato vimalaṃ kuru \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. One should pick up the dust reciting the mantra, which should be properly plastered over the body. Initially, one should pray to the dust, saying- “O dust, even the gods who are the killers of dirt and the daityas, have adored you. Similarly, I am also adoring you with devotion. You kindly make me spotless.”

## \|\| 3.13.67-69 \|\|

*iti mṛnmaṃtraḥ \|*  
*evaṃ japanmṛdaṃ dattvā svahastāgresamaṃtrakam \|*  
*jalāvagāhanaṃ kuryātkuṇḍamālikhya dharmavit \|*  
*siddhārthakaiḥ kṛṣṇatilairvacāsarvauṣadhīḥ kramāt \|\| 67 \|\|*

*tvamādiḥ sarvadevānāṃ jagatāṃ ca jaganmaye \|*  
*bhūtānāṃ vīrudhāṃcaiva rasānāṃpataye namaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*gaṃgāsāgarajaṃ toyaṃ pauṣkaraṃ nārmadaṃ tathā \|*  
*yāmunaṃ sāṃnihatyaṃ ca saṃnidhānamihāstu me \|\| 69 \|\|*

67-69. After reciting this mantra, the religious minded devotee, keeping the dust in his hand, should invoke the water in the kunda already made. Thereafter, the ausadhis with mustard seeds, black sesamum seeds, should be picked up with the reciting of the mantra- “O mother of the universe, you are the origin of the universe and the gods. You are the controller of all the trees as well as the other living beings. I therefore, offer my salutation to you.” Subsequently, uttering the mantra, one should take his bath- “Let the water of Gangasagara, Puskara, Narmada and that of the Yamuna collectively remain here with me.”

## \|\| 3.13.70-71 \|\|

*iti snānamaṃtraḥ \|*  
*śarīrālaṃbhanaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛtvā mṛdgomayāṃbubhiḥ \|*  
*evaṃ snātvā samāplutya ācamya taṭamāsthitaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*nivasya vāsasī śubhre śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ \|*  
*devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca tarpayetsusamādhinā \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. At the time of taking bath, initially, the dust and then the cowdung mixed with water, should be used, plastering the same over the body. Then reaching over the bank, one should sip the water and then wear two clean costumes. Getting purified, one should offer oblation to the gods, pitrs and the humans.

## \|\| 3.13.72-73 \|\|

*evaṃ gṛhītaniyamo gṛhaṃ gacchecchucivrataḥ \|*  
*upaviśya na saṃjalpedyāvaccandrasya darśanam \|\| 72 \|\|*

*snātvā caiva tato nāma tṛtīyādi caturdine \|*  
*namaḥ kṛṣṇācyutānaṃta hṛṣīkeśeti ca kramāta \|\| 73 \|\|*

72-73. Then, he should return home. The performer of the vrata, who is observing all the regulations, should start the vrata with purity. After sitting over his asana, he should not get up unless he spots the moon, nor should he talk till then. After taking his bath on the second, third, fourth or the fifth moon day respectively, the names of Krsna, Acyuta, Ananta, Hrsikesa and other names of the lord should be uttered like, “Salutation to Krsna” and so on.

## \|\| 3.13.74 \|\|

*caturdine dvitīyādau devamabhyarcaye'cyutam \|*  
*prathamehni smṛtā pūjā pādayoścakrapāṇinaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. Starting from the second day of the moon, on all the four days the worship of lord Acyuta should always be performed. On the first day, the feet of lord Cakrapani should be adored.

## \|\| 3.13.75-77 \|\|

*nābhipūjā dvitīyehni kartavyā vidhivannaraiḥ \|*  
*muradviṣastatīyehni pūjāṃ vakṣasivinyaset \|\| 75 \|\|*

*caturthehni jagaddhātuḥ pūjāṃ śirasi kalpayet \|*  
*puṣpairvilepanairdhūpairarghyaṃ dadyurvi bhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

*ghīvarairharinaivedyairdīpadānaiśca bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*pūjayitvā vidhānena viṣṇuṃ viśveśvaraṃ vratī \|\| 77 \|\|*
