75-77. On the second day, the navel should be adored. On the third day, the chest of lord Murari should be adored and on the fourth day, the lord of the universe should be adored. The flowers, the sandal paste, incense, ornaments, arghya, fried cakes, eatables and the lamps should be offered with devotion to lord Visvesvara.

## \|\| 3.13.78-79 \|\|

*tato dināvasāne tu muhūrte nirgate sati \|*  
*arghyaṃ pradadyātsomāya bhaktyātadbhāvabhāvitaḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

*śaśicandraśaśāṃkendunāmāni kramaśo naraḥ \|*  
*tṛtīyādiṣu candrasya saṃkīrtyārghyaṃ nivedayet \|\| 79 \|\|*

78-79. After a muhurta is passed subsequent to the performing of the puja, the arghya should be offered to Soma (the moon). Then reciting the various names, like Sasi, Candra, Sasanka, besides Indu, the arghya should be offered on the third moon days.

## \|\| 3.13.80-82 \|\|

*sa cārghyo yādṛśo deya ṛddhimadbhirathetaraiḥ \|*  
*tatte samyakpravakṣyāmi yudhiṣṭhira nibodha me \|\| 80 \|\|*

*candanāgurukarpūradadhi dūrvākṣatādibhiḥ \|*  
*ratnaiḥ samudrajaiścānyairvajravaidūryamauktikaiḥ \|\| 81 \|\|*

*puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ svakālotthaiḥ kharjūrairnnālikerakaiḥ \|*  
*vastrācchādanagovā jibhūmihemagajānvitaiḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

80-82. I am going to speak out the method with which this should be done. You listen to the same quite carefully. The arghyas should comprise of the sandal paste, agaruy camphor, curd, durva grass, gems of the Sun, or vajra or he lapiz lapuli, beads, flowers, seasonal lowers, date palm, coconut covered with cloth, the cow, land, the elephant decorated with gold, all these should be used in offering the arghya by the wealthy people of auspicious nature.

## \|\| 3.13.83-85 \|\|

*sattvayuktasya ṛddhasya rājanneṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*itarasya yathāśakti phalapuṣpākṣatodakaiḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*lavaṇaṃ guḍaṃ ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ payaḥkuṃbhāstilaiḥ saha \|*  
*argheṣvetāni śastāni śaśivṛddhyā vivarddhayet \|\| 84 \|\|*

*pratyahaṃ varddhayedarghyaṃ śaśi vṛddhyā narottama \|*  
*evamarghaḥ pradātavyaḥ śṛṇu maṃtravidhikramam \|\| 85 \|\|*

83-85. The other people can offer fruits, flower, unbroken rice, water, salt, ghi, oil, besides the sesamum seeds and pitcher filled with water. This is the praiseworthy arghya, which should go on increasing daily. О best of the humans, with the offering of such types of arghya, I am now speaking about the related mantras. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.13.86-90 \|\|

*navonavosi māsāṃte jāyamānaḥ punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*triragnisamaveto vai devānāpyāyase haviḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*gaganāṅgaṇasaddīpa dugdhābdhimathanodbhava \|*  
*bhābhāsitadigābhoga ramānuja namo'stu te \|\| 87 \|\|*

*dattvārghyaṃ dvijarājāya tadviprāya nivedayet \|*  
*nirvartyārghyakramamimaṃ tato bhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

*bhūmiṃ tu bhājanaṃ kṛtvā padmapatrasamāstṛtām \|*  
*pālāśairmadhupatrairvā surūpairvā śilātale \|\| 89 \|\|*

*samālabhya dharāṃ devīṃ maṃtreṇānena maṃtravit \|*  
*tvattale bhoktukāmo'haṃ devi sarvarasodbhave \|\| 90 \|\|*

86-90. Taking birth in each month, you always remain fresh. Similarly, by possessing all the three types of fires and feeding the gods in the form of havi, you are bom as an excellent lamp (the Sun) in the courtyard of the sky. During the churning of the ocean of milk also, you had been bom with your lustre, and because of that all the directions get illuminated. Therefore, salutation to you. Similarly, the arghya should be offered to the Moon, which should be offered to the Brahmana. Subsequently, this should be repeated daily and after completion of half of the time of such performance, one should offer prayer to the earth and take food silently. A lotus leaf should be placed over the purified land, besides the leaves of Butea frondosa, Bassia latifolia on the plain ground and say-“O goddess, you produce all the rasas on earth and are bom with them. I have arrived here to have food from you. Therefore, by your grace, you make the food as delicious as the nectar.”

## \|\| 3.13.91-93 \|\|

*madanugrahāya susvādaṃ kurvannamamṛtopamam \|*  
*evaṃ japtvā ca bhuktvā ca śākaṃ pākaṃ guṇottaram \|\| 91 \|\|*

*ācamya khānyupālabhya smṛtvā somaṃ svapedbhuvi \|*  
*bhoktavyaṃ tu dritīyāyāmakṣāralavaṇaṃ haviḥ \|\| 92 \|\|*

*munyannaṃ tu tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthyāṃ gorasottaram \|*  
*ghṛtāktāḥ saguṇāḥ śastāḥ pañcamyāṃ kṛśarāssadā \|\| 93 \|\|*

91-93. Thus offering the prayer, after consuming the cooked food and reciting the mantra, he should sleep besides the water kunda on the ground with his mind devoted to the Moon. Similarly, together with the natural salt, the offering of the rice of natural growth should be offered, mixed with butter milk on the fourth day. On the fifth day, ghi, sugarcane balls, and mixture of rice and pulses should be consumed as the food.

## \|\| 3.13.94 \|\|

*śastā bhadreṣu sarveṣu sadā śyāmākataṇḍulāḥ \|*  
*prasādhikā ghṛtaṃ gavyaṃ vanyaṃ phalamayācitam \|\| 94 \|\|*

94\. In all the Bhadra vratas, the rice of the natural growth should be fried in the ghi of the cow or the fruits which are naturally fallen from the tree, have been recommended to be consumed by the performer of the vrata.

## \|\| 3.13.95-97 \|\|

*prātaḥ snānaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā saṃtarjya pitṛdevatāḥ \|*  
*bhojayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā dattadānānvisarjayeta \|\| 95 \|\|*

*bhṛtyabandhujanaiḥ sārddhaṃ paścādbhuñjīta kāmataḥ \|*  
*evaṃ bhadreṣu sarveṣu trimāseṣu gateṣu yaḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

*karotyetannaro bhaktyā varṣamekamamatsarī \|*  
*tasya śrīrvijayaścaiva nityaṃ somaḥ prasīdati \|\| 97 \|\|*

95-97. After getting up at dawn and subsequent to the performing of the routine practices, the oblations to the gods and the pitrs should be made. Thereafter, the charities should be given to the Brahmanas with devotion besides the food, satisfying them at the same time and then sent off gracefully. After performing the above activities, one should take his food with the relatives and the servants. In this way, in all the Bhadra-vratas of three months duration a person who spends his whole time, such a person, who is free from wrath, always achieves prosperity and increase in fortunes. Somadeva always remains happy with him.

## \|\| 3.13.98 \|\|

*etatkaroti yā kanyā śubhaṃ prāpnoti sā patim \|*  
*durbhagā subhagā sādhvī bhavatyavidhavā sadā \|\| 98 \|\|*

98\. The unfortunate or a fortunate girl, whosoever performs this vrata, she achieves a fortunate husband and remains blissful always enjoying the company of her husband.

## \|\| 3.13.99 \|\|

*rājyārthī labhate rājyaṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam \|*  
*putrārthī labhate putrāniti prāha prabhākaraḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. Similarly, the one desirous of the kingdom gets the kingship; a person desirous of wealth gets the wealth; the one desirous of a son, gets a son.

## \|\| 3.13.100 \|\|

*yoṣitkulākulavivāhamanoramāṇi śayyānnayānaśayanāsanaśobhitāni \|*  
*bhadrāṇyavāpya dhanaputrakalatrajāni jātismaro bhavati bhārata bhadrakartā \|\| 100 \|\|*

100\. O Bharata, with the performing of the Bhadra-vrata, a person achieves a beautiful wife, wealth, son, pleasant bed, tasty food, betel and all the comforts and also retains the memories of the past.

## Chapter 14. Glory of the Dvitiya Vrata

## \|\| 3.14.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*saṃtyanyāstithayaḥ pārtha dvitīyādyāḥ pariśrutāḥ \|*  
*māsaiścaturbhiścatvāraḥ prāvṛṭchuklāḥ klamāpahāḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*gopitāśca sadā loke na proktāśca mayā kvacit \|*  
*prakāśayāmi tāḥ pārtha śṛṇu sarvā mayā hi tāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sri Krsna said- O Partha, starting from the bright fortnight of the month of Sravana, the Dvitiya tithis of the following four months are similarly auspicious. With the performing of the anusthana of the same, all the miseries of a person are destroyed. This fact had been kept as secret by me in the world and was not revealed to anyone else, but the same truth is being revealed to you today.

## \|\| 3.14.3-4 \|\|

*ekā tu śrāvaṇe māsi anyā bhādrapade tathā \|*  
*aparāśvayuje māsi caturthī kārtike bhavet \|\| 3 \|\|*

*śrāvaṇe kaluṣā nāma proṣṭhapāde ca gīrmalā \|*  
*āśvine pretasaṃcārā kārtike ca yamā smṛtā \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. The first bright moon day of the month of Sravana; the second is of the month of Bhadrapada; the third is of the month of Asvina; the fourth is of the month of Karttika, all of them are known as- Kaluga, Girmala, Pretasancara and Yama respectively.

## \|\| 3.14.5 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kasmātsā kaluṣā proktā kasmātsā gīrmalā matā \|*  
*kasmātsā pretasaṃcārā kasmādyāmyā prakīrtitā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Yudhisthira said- The bright moon days of the months of Sravana, Bhadrapada, Asvina and Karttika were given the names as Kalusa and others, what is the reason for the same, you kindly tell me.

## \|\| 3.14.6-13 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*purā vṛtravadhe vṛtte prāptarājye puraṃdare \|*  
*brahmahatyāpanodārthamaśvamedhe pravartite \|\| 6 \|\|*

*krodhādindreṇa vajeṇa brahmahatyā niṣūditā \|*  
*ṣaṭkhaṇḍā ca kṛtā kṣiptā vṛkṣe toye mahītale \|\| 7 \|\|*

*nāryāṃ brahmahane vahnau saṃvibhajya yathākramam \|*  
*tatpāpaṃ śrāvaṇe vyūḍhaṃ dvitīyāyāṃ dinodaye \|\| 8 \|\|*

*nārīvṛkṣanadībhūmivahnibrahmahaneṣvatha \|*  
*nirmalīkaraṇaṃ jātamatorthaṃ kaluṣā smṛtā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*madhukaiṭabhayo rakte purā magneti medinī \|*  
*aṣṭāṃgulā pavitrā sā nārīṇāṃ tu rajo malam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*nadyaḥ pūramalāḥ sarvā vahnerdhūmaśikhā malaḥ \|*  
*kaluṣāṇi caraṃtyasyāṃ tenaiṣā kaluṣā matā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*gīrgirā bhāratī vāṇī vācā medhā sarasvatī \|*  
*gīrmalaṃ vahate yasmādvitīyā gīrmalā matā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*devarṣipitṛdharmāṇāṃ niṃdakā nāstikāḥ śaṭhāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ sā vāgmalavyūḍhā dvitīyā tena gīrmalā \|\| 13 \|\|*

6-13. Sri Krsna said- In earlier times, Indra attracted the sin of Brahmahatya after killing the demon Vrtrasura. In order to free himself from the sin of Brahmahatya, he organized the Asvamedha yajna. But inspite of the successful completion of the yajna, he could not free himself of the sin. Therefore, getting enraged, he got ready to kill Brahmahatya with the use of his vajra. Accordingly, Brahmahatya was cut down into six pieces. Those pieces were equally distributed among the trees, water, earth, women, the husband of the low caste woman, besides the fire and then got rid of the same. Then those who received the parts of Brahmahatya like woman, trees and others, on the second bright moon day of the month of Havana, at the time of dawn, subsided their sins by taking the bath and they became spotless as before. Because of this reason, the second moon day of the said month earned the name of Kalusa. Though during the earlier times, with the killing of the daityas Madhu and Kaitabha, their blood was spread earth, still the earth of the length of eight angulas could maintain her purity. The menstrual blood of the ladies, the rivers remaining filled with water between both the banks and the smoke emerging out of the fire flames, have been considered to be blemished. On the same day of Dvitiya, the presence of these blemishes and their destruction as well, the name of Kaluga was given to them. The word gira stands for gira or speech- Bharati, Vani, Vaca, Megha and Sarasvati. Therefore, its blemish gets removed on the bright second day of the moon of the month of Bhadrapada. She was given the name of Girmala. Those who denounce the gods, Rsis as well as the dharma of the parents, unbelievers and because of the destruction of the blemishes of the speech, are also given the name of Girmala.

## \|\| 3.14.14-15 \|\|

*malā vyūḍhā dvitīyāyāmato'rthaṃ gīrmalā ca sā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*pretāstu pitaraḥ proktāsteṣāṃ tasyāṃ tu saṃcaraḥ \|*  
*dvitīyāyāṃ ca lokeṣu tena sā pretasaṃcarā \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. During the period from the cessation of work, those well-versed in grammar, the debaters besides those well-versed in Vedic knowledge, teach the Sastras, as a result of which the words which are spoken by them, irrespective of their being correct or incorrect, are said to be the form of blemish and for the suppression of the same, the said name becomes purposeful. On the second bright day of the month of Asvina, the manes communicate.

## \|\| 3.14.16-17 \|\|

*pitṛpitāmahapretasaṃcarātpretasaṃcarā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*putraiḥ pautraiśca dauhitraiḥ svadhāmaṃtraiḥ supūjitāḥ \|*  
*śrāddhadānamakhaistṛptā yātyataḥ pretasaṃcarāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. The pitrs known by the names of Agnisvata, Barhisada, Ajyapa, Somapa and others, also move at the same time. On the same day, the son or the daughter’s son, using the Svadha mantras, perform the Sraddha which satisfy the manes. It was given the name of Preta-Sancara.

## \|\| 3.14.18 \|\|

*kārtike śuklapakṣasya dvitīyāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*yamo yamunayā pūrvaṃ bhojitaḥ svagṛhe tadā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O Yudhisthira, similarly on the bright second day of the month of Karttika, Yamuna had served food to Yama at her place, which immensely satisfied the residents of the hell.

## \|\| 3.14.19-20 \|\|

*dvitīyāyāṃ mahotsarge nārakīyāśca tarpitāḥ \|*  
*pāpebhyo vipramuktāste muktāḥ sarve vibaṃdhanāḥ \|*  
*bhrāmitā nartitāstuṣṭāḥ sthitāḥ sarve yadṛcchayā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ mahotsavo vṛtto yamarāṣṭre sukhāvahaḥ \|*  
*tato yamadvitīyā sā proktā loke yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. Getting relieved of the sins, all the people were freed from the bondages, started moving at will, besides dancing delightfully. Because with the happy conclusion of the function, the people of the abode of Yama felt extremely comfortable, therefore it was given the name of Yama-dvitiya.

## \|\| 3.14.21-26 \|\|

*asyāṃ nijagṛhe pārtha na bhoktavyamato budhaiḥ \|*  
*snehena bhaginīhastādbhoktavyaṃ puṣṭivarddhanam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*dānāni ca pradeyāni bhaginībhyo vidhānataḥ \|*  
*svarṇālaṃkāravastrādyaiḥ pūjāsatkārabhojanaiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sarvā bhaginyaḥ saṃpūjyā abhāve pratipattigāḥ \|*  
*pitṛvyabhaginī hastātprathamāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 23 \|\|*

*mātulasya sutāhastādvitīyāyāṃ punarnṛpa \|*  
*pitṛmātṛsvasārau ye tṛtīyāyāṃ tayoḥ karāt \|\| 24 \|\|*

*bhoktavyaṃ sahajāyāśca bhaginyā hastataḥ param \|*  
*sarvāsu bhaginīhastādbhoktavyaṃ balavarddhanam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ dharmakāmārthavarddhanam \|*  
*vyākhyātaṃ sakalaṃ snehātsarahasyaṃ mayā tava \|\| 26 \|\|*

21-26. O Partha, on the day of this dvitiya, the learned people should not take food at their own home, should consume the tasteful food in the abodes of their sisters. At that point of time, the gold ornaments as well as the costumes should be given away in charity. On that particular day, the sisters should be adored. First of all, there should be the daughter of uncle, then the daughter of the maternal uncle, than the food should be taken from the hands of the sisters of the parents. Thereafter, one should take food with one’s real sister. Thus, one should taste the delicious food of all the sisters, which improves health, cereals, glory, age, dharma, kama and artha. Thus, I have explained everything to you in detail.

## \|\| 3.14.27 \|\|

*yasyāṃ tithau yamunayā yamarājadevaḥ sambhojito jagati sattvarasauhṛdena \|*  
*tasyāṃ svasuḥ karatalādiha yo bhunakti prāpnoti vittamatha bhojyamanuttamaṃ saḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. The day on which Yamuna had served food to Yama at her place, on that particular day, a person, who eats food prepared by his sister with her own hands, he always earns enormous wealth.

## Chapter 15. Glory of Asunya-Sayana Vrata

## \|\| 3.15.1-3 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*bhagavanbhavatā proktaṃ dharmārthādeḥ susādhanam \|*  
*gārhasthyaṃ tacca bhavati daṃpatyoḥ prīyamāṇayoḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*patnīhīnaḥ pumānpatnī bhartrā virahitā tathā \|*  
*dharmakāmārthasaṃsiddhī na syātāṃ madhusūdana \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tadbrūhi devadeveśa vidhavā strī na jāyate \|*  
*vratena yena goviṃda patnyā'virahito naraḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Yudhisthira said- The pious duty of a householder which yields dharma, artha and kama, is established with the delightful living of both the husband and wife. But, O Madhusudana! How could a man without a wife or a wife without a husband can establish with success, the kama?. This can never be done. Therefore, O Govinda - the god of gods, you speak about a vrata by performing which a woman never becomes a widow and a man never gets separated from his wife.

## \|\| 3.15.4-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*aśūnyaśayanīṃ nāma dvitīyāṃ śṛṇu tāṃ mama \|*  
*yāmupoṣya na vaidhavyaṃ prāpnoti strī yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 4 \|\|*

*patnīvimuktaśca naro na kadācitprajāyate \|*  
*śete jagatpatirviṣṇuḥ striyā sārddhaṃ yadā kila \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Sri Krsna said- There is a vrata which is known as Asunya Sayana vrata, the details about which are being spoken by me. By observing this vrata, a woman can never become a widow and a man can never be separated from his wife. When lord Visnu -the lord of the universe, sleeps with his beloved, the Asunya-vrata starts from that very period. In this vrata, one has to consume the desired food during the night itself.

## \|\| 3.15.6-9 \|\|

*aśūnyaśayanaṃ nāma tadā grāhyā ca sā tithiḥ \|*  
*upavāsena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ śrāvaṇe nṛpasattama \|*  
*snānaṃ nadyāṃ taḍāge vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kṛtvā pitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca devānsaṃ tarpya bhaktimān \|*  
*sthaṃḍilaṃ caturasraṃ tu mṛnmayaṃ kārayettataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tatrasthaṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīśaṃ bhaktyābhyarcya śriyā saha \|*  
*naivedyapuṣpadhūpādyaiḥ phalaiḥ kālodbhavaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

6-9. O best of the kings, the performer of this vrata should take a bath on the second dark moon day of the month of Sravana in a river or a tank or at the well in the house itself and then offer oblation to the gods and the manes. Thereafter, with faith and devotion, lord Sridhara should be consecrated over square pedestal of the earth. He should then be offered the eatables, flowers, incense and the seasonal fruits.

## \|\| 3.15.10-11 \|\|

*imamuccārayenmaṃtraṃ praṇamya jagataḥ patim \|*  
*śrīvatsadhāriñchrīkāṃta śrīdhāmañchrīpate'vyaya \|\| 10 \|\|*

*gārhasthyaṃ mā praṇāśaṃ me yātu dharmārthakāmadam \|*  
*agnayo mā praṇaśyaṃtu mā praṇaśyantu devatāḥ \|*  
*pitaro mā praṇaśyaṃtu matto dāṃpatyabhedataḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Then the lord should be worshipped with Laksmi. Thereafter, reciting the mantras, he should worship the lord of the universe- “O Sri Kanta, having the imprint of the food of Bhrgu over your chest, you are lord of Sri, the abode of the goddess Laksmi, Sripati and beyond destruction, this rite of a householder by which one earns dharma, artha and kama should never break. Similarly, my Agni and Devata should never come to an end. Even my manes should not be separated.

## \|\| 3.15.12-14 \|\|

*lakṣmyā viyujyate kṛṣṇa na kadācidyathā bhavān \|*  
*tathā kalatrasambandho deva mā me praṇaśyatu \|\| 12 \|\|*

*lakṣmyā na śūnyaṃ varada yathā te śayanaṃ sadā \|*  
*śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā janmanijanmani \|\| 13 \|\|*

*evaṃ prasādya pūjāṃ ca kṛtvā lakṣmyā harestathā \|*  
*candrodaye snānapūrvaṃ pañcagavyena saṃyutam \|*  
*viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsva śaktyā phalasaṃyutām \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. O lord, as you never get separated from Laksmi, similarly, I should also not get separated from my wife. O Narada, as your bedroom is never without Laksmi, similarly, my bed in each and every birth should have the company of my wife. Thus, by so offering prayer to the lord with Laksmi, a person take his bath with pancagavya and daksina should be offered to a Brahmana as per one’s means.

## \|\| 3.15.15-18 \|\|

*anenavidhinā rājanyāvanmāsacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*kṛṣṇapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ prāguktavidhimācaret \|\| 15 \|\|*

*kārttike cātha saṃprāpte śayyāṃ śrīkāṃtasaṃyutām \|*  
*sopaskarāṃ sodakuṃbhāṃ sānnāṃ dadyāddvijātaye \|\| 16 \|\|*

*pratimāsaṃ ca somāya arghyaṃ dadyātsamaṃtrakam \|*  
*dadhyakṣatairmūla phalai ratnaiḥ sauvarṇabhājanaiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*gaganāṃgaṇasaddīpa durābdhimathanodbhava \|*  
*ābhāsitadigābhoga ramānuja namostu te \|\| 18 \|\|*

15-18. O king, observing all the regulations, on the second moon days of all the four months, this vrata should be performed on the dark second moon day of the month of Karttika, and the Brahmana should be given over a bed with images of Laksmi and Visnu placed over the same. Besides these, the umbrella, kamandalu, wooden sandals, shoes, utensils for taking food, a pitcher filled with water etc. should also be given. Arghya should be offered with a golden vase. Thereafter, he should offer prayer thus- “O best lamp of the sky courtyard, salutation to you who emerged out of the churning of the ocean, you illuminate all the directions and are the younger brother of Laksmi. Salutation to you again and again.”

## \|\| 3.15.19 \|\|

*evaṃ karoti yaḥ samyaṅnaro māsacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*tasya janmatrayaṃ yāvadgṛhabhaṅgo na jāyate \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. A person, who following this process, performs vratas for all the four months, his household dharma remains intact for the future three months.

## \|\| 3.15.20 \|\|

*aśūnyaśayanaścaiva dharmakāmārthasādhakaḥ \|*  
*bhavatyavyāhataiśvaryaḥ puruṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. With the performing of the Asunya-Sayana-Vrata, the performer achieves enormous wealth besides success in dharma, artha, kama (desires) in all the times. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.15.21-22 \|\|

*nārī ca pārtha dharmajñā vratametadyathāvidhi \|*  
*yā karoti na sā śocyā bandhuvargasya jāyate \|\| 21 \|\|*

*vaidhavyaṃ durbhagatvaṃ ca bhartṛtyāgaṃ ca sattama \|*  
*prāpnoti janmatritayaṃ na sā pāṃḍukulodvaha \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. O Partha, similarly, a woman also, when performs this vrata in an appropriate manner, then the relatives do not have to grieve for her. O foremost of the Pandavas, she does not have to face widowhood, misfortune or separation from the husband for three births.

## \|\| 3.15.23 \|\|

*eṣā hyaśūnyaśayanā nṛpate dvitīyā khyātā samastakaluṣāpaharā'dvitīyā \|*  
*etāṃ samācarati yaḥ puruṣo'tha yoṣitprāpnotyasau śayanamagryamahārhabhogyam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. O ruler, a person should perform this Asunya-Sayana-Vrata appropriately on the dark second day of the moon. Because of this, the same dvitiya is well known for the removal of all the sins. All the men and women, who perform this vrata, achieve all the comforts in life.

## Chapter 16. Glory of Madhuka Trtiya Vrata

## \|\| 3.16.1-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*phālgune'pyasite pakṣe tṛtīyāyāmupoṣitā \|*  
*prātaḥ sthitvā brahmacarye jaṭāmukuṭaśobhitā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*godhārathagatāṃ devīṃ rudradhyānaparāyaṇām \|*  
*pūjayedgandhakusumairdīpālaktakacaṃdanaiḥ \|*  
*kesarairmadhurairdravyaiḥ svarṇamāṇikyapūjayā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*oṃ bhūṣikā devabhūṣā ca bhūṣikā lalitā umā \|*  
*tapovanaratā gaurī saubhāgyaṃ me prayacchatu \|\| 3 \|\|*

*daurbhāgyaṃ me śamayatu suprasannamanāḥ sadā \|*  
*avaidhavyaṃ kule janma dadātvaparajanmani \|\| 4 \|\|*

*aṅgeṅge ca mamopāṅge parvepave sthitāmṛtam \|*  
*sukhadṛṣṭisparśarasaṃ gaurī saubhāgyaṃ yacchatu \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Sri Krsna said- On the third dark moon day of the month of Phalguna, previous to that before the start of the vrata, one should observe Brahmacarya. On the day of the observing of the fast, one should take bath in the early morning and then finish his daily routine. Thereafter, the goddess has to be adored, seated over the vehicles of a lizard with her mind dedicated to words of lord Siva. Then the fragrance, flowers, the sandal paste, lamp, the red colour for the painting of feet, saffron, eatables, besides gold and gems should be offered to her. Thereafter, one should worship her with devotion and offer prayer, saying- “You are the form of ornament, because lord Siva looks graceful with you alone. Besides you happen to be most beautiful of all the goddesses, therefore, the goddess Gauri, who roams about in the forest, bestow fortunes on me. Getting immensely pleased, let her remove all my misfortunes, and let me be reborn in a high race and I should never face widowhood. Let the nectar be infused in all my limbs, bones, joints of the body. O goddess Gauri, you bestow the fortune on me in such a way which should be the ocean of pleasure, by sight, comforts and touch etc.”

## \|\| 3.16.6-10 \|\|

*evamuccārya maṃtrāṃśca nārījñānavatī satī \|*  
*pūjayedbrāhmaṇoktaistu maṃtrairmukhasuvāsinī \|\| 6 \|\|*

*jīrakaiḥ kaṭuhuṇḍaiśca lavaṇairguḍasarpiṣā \|*  
*hṛdyairārdraiḥ phalaiḥ svarṇairmanojñaiḥ puṣpabandhanaiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kusumaiḥ. kuṃkumairgandhaiḥ kāleyāgurucandanaiḥ \|*  
*sindūreṇātiraktena vastrairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*netrairanekadeśotthaiḥ pūpakaistilataṇḍulaiḥ \|*  
*aśokaiśca viguṇakairghṛtapūrṇaistu modakaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ityevamādinaivedyaiḥ pūjayitvā mahādrumam \|*  
*pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām \|\| 10 \|\|*

6-10. Thus, the learned and chaste woman should worship the goddess reciting the mantras uttered by the Brahmanas. Thereafter, saffron, cumin, salt, sugarcane cakes, ghi, tasty fruits, golden garlands, flowers, red powder, fragrance, agaru, sandalpaste, vermilion, several types of costumes, sweets of several countries, sesamum seeds, unbroken rice, Asoka flowers, besides the sweet balls should be offered, while worshipping the Bassia latifolia tree. After circumambulating the same, daksina should be distributed among the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.16.11 \|\|

*etatkaroti yā putrī tṛtīyāvratamuttamam \|*  
*tataḥ prāpsyati duṣprāpyaṃ trailokye śrīdharaṃ prati \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. A girl who performs this vrata appropriately, lord Sridhara would bestow on her the inaccessible fortunes of all the three worlds for many years.

## \|\| 3.16.12-14 \|\|

*etadvrataṃ mayā khyātaṃ yāsyaṃti śāśvatīḥ samā \|*  
*vyākhyātaṃ kaśyapenādau rukmiṇyā vratamuttamam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*yāścariṣyaṃti tāḥ sarvā bhaviṣyaṃti nirāmayāḥ \|*  
*aṅgapratyaṅgasubhagā lokadṛṣṭimanoharāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sthitvā varṣaśataṃ cānte tato rudrapuraṃ śubham \|*  
*yāsyaṃti haṃsayānena kiṃkiṇīśabdanādinā \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. Initially, the glory of this vrata and the procedure thereof had been revealed by the sage Kasyapa to Rukmini. The women who perform this vrata, their limbs get free from ailments and get attractive and comfortable. After enjoying all the comforts for a hundred years, they shall board over the plane of swan which produces the pleasant sound of small bells, and achieve the place of Rudra.

## \|\| 3.16.15 \|\|

*tatra tvāramayiṣyaṃti svabhartṝnvatsarānbahūn \|*  
*divyabhogabhujo hṛṣṭāḥ siddhyaṣṭakasamanvitāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Reaching there, they enjoy the divine comforts, remain with well-built bodies and live peacefully with their husbands, with all the eight siddhis.

## \|\| 3.16.16 \|\|

*arghaṃ mahārghamaṇikuṃkumakesarāḍhyaṃ sraggaṃdhamugdhamukharāli kulopagītam \|*  
*dattvā phalākṣatayutaṃ madhupādapasya gaurīva lokamahitā bhavatīha nārī \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Thus, by offering the precious gems, vermilion, saffron and the fragrant garland with the scent of which the black-wasps get attracted, besides the fruits to the Madhu tree (Bassia latifolia), the woman (who does so) is worshipped like the goddess Gauri.

## Chapter 17. Meghapali-trtiya Vrata

## \|\| 3.17.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*meghapālīvrata kṛṣṇa kadācitkriyate nṛbhiḥ \|*  
*kiṃ puṇyaṃ kimanuṣṭhānaṃ kīdṛgvallī smṛtā tu sā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O Krsna, the people have sometimes been found to be observing a vrata named Meghapali. Therefore, I intend to know the merit one earns by performing such a vrata. What is the process of performing it and what type of creeper is the same? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 3.17.2-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*āśvayukkṛṣṇapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*meghapālyai pradātavyo bhaktyā strībhirnṛbhistathā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*argho virūḍhairgodhūmaiḥ saptadhānyasamanvitaiḥ \|*  
*tilataṃḍulapiṃḍairvā dātavyo dharmalipsubhiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Sri Krsna said- On the dark moon day of the month of Asvina, with utmost devotion, men and women should perform the Meghapali vrata in which arghya has to be offered first. Then the wheat, the seven cereals, sesamum and pindas of unbroken rice have to be offered by those desirous of achieving the dharma.

## \|\| 3.17.4-5 \|\|

*tāṃbūlasadṛśaiḥ parvai raktā vallī samaṃjarī \|*  
*vāṭīṣu grāmamārgeṣu protthitā parvate'pi ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

*meghapālyāṃ dhānyatailaguḍakuṃkumahaimanān \|*  
*padānapi ca kurvaṃti janā vāṇijyajīvanāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. The leaves of the creeper are those resembling the betel leaves and the creeper is of red colour with bunches. The creeper is found rising in villages, the roads, as well as the mountains, rising upwards. On the third day of Meghapali, the business people keep cereals, oil, sugarcane balls, vermillion and gold pieces at several places and make their living with same.

## \|\| 3.17.6 \|\|

*pāpaṃ satyānṛtaṃ kṛtvā dravyalubdhāḥ phalānvitāḥ \|*  
*arghyaṃ dattvā meghapālye nāśayaṃti kṣaṇādiha \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. For the greed of wealth, they indulge in falsehood, as a result of which they earn sin. In order to get themselves relieved of the sin, they should offer arghya on the day of Meghapali, as a result of which all their sins are washed out.

## \|\| 3.17.7-9 \|\|

*mānonmānairjanma madhye yatpāpaṃ kutracitkṛtam \|*  
*satsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti vratenānena pāṃḍava \|\| 7 \|\|*

*meghapālī śubhe sthāne śubhe deśe samutthitā \|*  
*pūjanīyā varastrībhiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaistathākṣataiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*kharjūrairnālikeraiśca dāḍimaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ \|*  
*gaṃdhadhūpairdadhidīpairvirūḍhairdhānyasaṃcayaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. Whatever sin is committed at the time of grace and disgrace in life, it gets vanished by performing this vrata. The beautiful damsels should worship Meghapali by offering fruits, flowers, unbroken rice, date palm, coconut, pomegranate, oleander, flowers of oleander, fragrance, incense, lamp, besides the arghya of the cereals.

## \|\| 3.17.10-12 \|\|

*raktavastraiḥ samācchādya piṣṭātakavibhūṣitām \|*  
*kṛtvārghyaḥ saṃpradātavyo maṃtreṇānena bhārata \|\| 10 \|\|*

*vedoktena dvijo vidvāṃstacca tasyai nivedayet \|*  
*ityevaṃ pūjayitvā tāṃ meghapālīṃ pumāṃstataḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*nārī vā puruṣavyāghra prāpnoti paramāṃ śriyam \|*  
*sthitvā varṣaśataṃ martye sukhasaubhāgyagarvite \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. The red cloth should also be offered, besides the pudding. O Bharata, the mantras should be recited by the Vedic Brahmanas and Meghapali should be worshipped. By so adoring Meghapali, a person gets excellent riches, and the man or woman lives like a lion in this world for a hundred years, with pride and fortunes.

## \|\| 3.17.13-14 \|\|

*viṣṇulokamavāpnoti dehāṃte yānasaṃsthitaḥ \|*  
*kulāni sapta nayati svargaṃ svāni rasātalāt \|*  
*uddhṛtya nātra saṃdehastvayā kāryo yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 13 \|\|*

*naraka bhīrutayā dadāti yo'rghyaṃ phalādyanuyutaṃ nanu meghapāleḥ \|*  
*unmānakūṭakapaṭāni kṛtāni yāni pāpāni haṃti saviteva tamaḥ prarohān \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Then boarding an excellent plane, he reaches the abode of lord Visnu. Such a person redeems his seven earlier generations from the hell and sends them to the heaven. There is no doubt about it. Therefore, with the performing of this vrata, you must redeem your race. A person, who getting afraid of the hell, offers arghya and fruit for Meghapali, all his sins get vanished as the darkness vanishes with the rising of the sun.

## Chapter 18. Glory of Rupa-Rambha-Vrata

## \|\| 3.18.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*strīṇāṃ saṃpadyate yena martyaloke gṛhaṃ śubham \|*  
*patiprema tathātyaṃtaṃ tanme brūhi vrataṃ śubham \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- How could the ladies achieve the auspicious house and love for their husbands, excessively with the performing of a vrata and what type of vrata is it? You kindly enlighten me on this issue.

## \|\| 3.18.2-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ekadā pārvatīśaṃbhū sthitau munisurāvṛtau \|*  
*kailāsaśikhare ramye nānādhātuvicitrite \|\| 2 \|\|*

*nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpuṣpopaśobhite \|*  
*munikinnara saṃghuṣṭe geyanṛtyasamākule \|\| 3 \|\|*

*śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīṃ prāha kiṃ tvayā sadvrataṃ kṛtam \|*  
*vāmārūpeṇa metyaṃtaṃ priyāsi varavarṇini \|\| 4 \|\|*

*āgaccha jānudeśaṃ tu suprasannā tathā priye \|*  
*brūhi cāvitathaṃ sarvaṃ tvayā pārvati yatkṛtam \|\| 5 \|\|*

2-5. Sri Krsna said- Once both Siva and Parvati had been seated over a peak of the Himalaya, which was covered by the several types of metals, besides the astonishing types of the trees, the creepers and the flowers. Several of the gods and the Maharsis were also present there. For the entertainment of the courtiers, the kinnaras were dancing there quite artistically. At the same time, lord Siva said to Parvati- “O praiseworthy one, which is the best of the vrata that has been performed by you, by which you became my beloved and loveable to me? 0 dear one, be seated over my left thigh and tell the answer of this to the enlightened presence (audience). 0 Parvati, whatever has been done by you for this purpose, you speak out to me truthfully.”

## \|\| 3.18.6-7 \|\|

*ityuktā praṇatā bhūtvā gaurī prāha śivaṃ śubhā \|*  
*tṛtīyāyāṃ mayā cīrṇaṃ purā raṃbhāvrataṃ śubham \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tena me tvaṃ manohārī bhartā labdhosi śaṃkara \|*  
*īśvarī vāpyahaṃ strīṇāṃ tava dehārddhahāriṇī \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. At the words so spoken by the lord Siva, Parvati humbly spoke to lord Siva- “In earlier times (during my childhood), on the third day of the moon, I had performed the Rambha-vrata as a result of which you became my beloved husband and becoming a mistress of half of your body, I also became the mistress or Isvari all the ladies.

## \|\| 3.18.8 \|\|

*īśvara uvāca \|*  
*kīdṛśaṃ tadvrataṃ bhadre sarvasaukhyapradāyakam \|*  
*brūhi pārvati yatnena yaccīrṇaṃ pituraṃtike \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Isvara said- O noble Parvati, how does one perform this auspicious vrata which bestows all the comforts and had been performed by you while at parent’s home?

## \|\| 3.18.9-12 \|\|

*gauryuvāca \|*  
*purāhaṃ deva tiṣṭhāmi kumārī bhavane pituḥ \|*  
*himavadgahvare ramye sakhīgaṇasamāvṛtā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tato'haṃ menayā proktā svapitrā ca himādriṇā \|*  
*putri rabhāvrataṃ cāryaṃ varasaubhāgyavardhanam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yena prārabdhamātreṇa sarvaṃ saṃpatsyate tava \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ strīgaṇaiśvaryaṃ mahādevīpadaṃ tathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*evaṃ karomi vai mātarmama coktaṃ purastvayā \|*  
*manobhilaṣitaṃ yena yena prāpnomi śaṃkaram \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-12. Gauri said- O Deva, in earlier times, when I was still a maiden and played with other maids in my parent’s home, during those times, my parents- Mena and Himalaya, said to me- “O daughter, for the enhancement of the fortunes, you perform the Rambha-vrata, which would bestow all the fortunes on you, the majesty of the ladies, besides the place of a great goddess.” Then, I said— “0 mother, whatever has been spoken by you, shall be surely done by me, which may lead me to attain lord Siva as well as all the desired treasures.”

## \|\| 3.18.13-14 \|\|

*menovāca \|*  
*adya śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ snātvā niyamatatparā \|*  
*kuru pārśveṣu pañcāgnīñjvālamānānhutāśanān \|\| 13 \|\|*

*gārhapatyaṃ dakṣiṇāgnimanyaṃ cāhavanīyakam \|*  
*paṃcamaṃ bhāskaraṃ teja ityete paṃca vahnayaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Mena said- Today is the third bright moon day of the fortnight. Observing all the regulations, you take bath and for heating yourself with five types of fires, ignite on all the four sides which are known as Garhpatya, Daksinagni, Ahavaniya and the other type of fire. The fifth Agni would be the Sun in the sky, which has been included in the five fires.

## \|\| 3.18.15-18 \|\|

*eteṣāṃ madhyato bhūtvā tiṣṭha pūrvamukhā ciram \|*  
*caturbhujāṃ dhyānaparāṃ paddvayopari saṃsthitām \|\| 15 \|\|*

*mṛgājinacchannakucāṃ jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇīm \|*  
*sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ devīmabhimukhīṃ kuru \|\| 16 \|\|*

*mahālakṣmīrmahākālī mahāmāyā mahāmatiḥ \|*  
*gaṅgā ca yamunā siṃdhuḥ śatadurnarmadā mahī \|\| 17 \|\|*

*sarasvatī vaitariṇī saiva proktā mahāsatī \|*  
*tasyāśca prekṣaṇaparā bhava tadbhāvabhāsitā \|\| 18 \|\|*

15-18. Surrounded by these five fires, you be seated facing east and please the goddess, who is four armed and is engaged in the meditation of Siva standing on both her feet. She wears the matted locks of hair over the head and is clad in bark garments. She has covered her breasts with deer skin and is adorned with all the ornaments. The same Mahasati is also known by the names of Mahalaksmi, Mahakali, Mahamaya, Maha-Sarasvati, Ganga, Yamuna, Sindhu, Satadru, Narmada, Mahi, Sarasvati, Vaitarani etc. Therefore, fixing your gaze on her and without winking, you get absorbed in her devotion.

## \|\| 3.18.19-20 \|\|

*homaṃ kuryuryatātmāno brāhmaṇāḥ sarvatodiśam \|*  
*devyāḥ pūjā prakartavyā puṣpadhūpādinā tataḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*bahuprakāranaivedyaṃ naivedyaṃ ghṛtapācitam \|*  
*sthāpayetpurato devyāḥ pṛthaksaubhāgyameva ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. The homa should be performed by Yatmana Brahmanas on the four sides, offering flowers, incense and lamp to the goddess. Several types of eatables should be offered to her, which should be made in ghi These should be offered to the goddess for the sake of good fortune.

## \|\| 3.18.21-24 \|\|

*jīrakaṃ kaḍuhuṃḍaścāpyapūpānkusumaṃ tathā \|*  
*nipācāṃ pāvanatarāṃ lavaṇaṃ śarkarāṃ guḍam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*puṣpamaṃḍapikā kāryā gaṃdhapuṣpādhivāsitā \|*  
*padmāsanena saṃtiṣṭhedyāvatpariṇato raviḥ \|*  
*tataḥ praṇamya rudrāṇīṃ maṃtrametamudīrayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vedeṣu sarvaśāstreṣu divi bhūmau dharātale \|*  
*dṛṣṭaḥ śrutaśca bahuśaḥ śaṃkāvirahitaḥ stavaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tvaṃ śaktistvaṃ svadhā svāhā tvaṃ sāvitrī sarasvatī \|*  
*patiṃ dehi gṛhaṃ dehi vasu dehi namostu te \|\| 24 \|\|*

21-24. The cumin seeds, sour spices, mixed with sweet cakes, kusuma, extremely auspicious nipaca salt, sugarcane balls, raw sugar and fragrant flowers should be offered to her. A mandapa of fragrant flowers should be made for her, wherein the goddess should be lodged till the sunset. She should be seated there in padmasana. Thereafter, the goddess be offered salutation with folded hands. Then one should beg forgiveness from her, reciting the mantras- “This has been recorded in all the Vedas and the Sastras, which is quite well-known in the heaven and the earth that by offering prayer to you, no doubt is possible. You yourself represent Sakti, Svadha, Svaha, Savitri and Sarasvati. Therefore, O goddess, you kindly bestow on me a good house besides a pleasant and fortunate husband. I offer my salutation to you.”

## \|\| 3.18.25-27 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃkṣamayeddevīṃ praṇipatya punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*dehi bhaktyā gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ vicitraṃ bahubhūmikam \|*  
*ācchādyadvārakedārakapotādivibhūṣitam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*kuḍyastaṃbhagavākṣāḍhyaṃ maṇimaṃḍitatoraṇam \|*  
*padmarāgamahānīlavajravaiḍūryabhūṣitam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*gṛhadānavidhānena brāhmaṇāya yaśasvine \|*  
*sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya sarvopaskarasaṃyutam \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. Thus, by begging forgiveness and offering prayer repeatedly that I should be granted a beautiful an astonishing home with vast land, having several types of doors, with beautiful walls, pillars, windows, and arches studded with gems like rubies, vajra, Lapiz Lazuli, thereafter, following the process of donation of a house, the house with all the amenities found therein, should be given away to a disciplined well-established Brahmana, who should be adored with his wife. The house should then be given over to the noble couple.

## \|\| 3.18.28-30 \|\|

*suvāsinībhyastaddeyaṃ naivedyaṃ sūryasaṃsthitam \|*  
*nirvartya vidhinānena tatpaścātkṣamayedagham \|\| 28 \|\|*

*dāṃpatyāni ca bhojyāni caturthyāṃ madhurai rasaiḥ \|*  
*ityuktamumayā cīrṇaṃ hara raṃbhāvrataṃ param \|\| 29 \|\|*

*vratāṃtegastyamunaye dattaṃ gṛhavaraṃ śubham \|*  
*lopāmudrā priyā patnī tasya veśmani pūjitā \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. Before the sunset, the fortunate damsels whose husbands are alive, should be served with food. Thereafter, one should pray for forgiveness. Thereafter, on the fourth day, the couple should be served with delicious food with sweet juices. The couple should then be sent off with pleasure. The goddess Uma said-“O Hara, thus I performed the Rambha-vrata in an appropriate manner and the aforesaid house was given over to the sage Agastya, in which his adorable wife Lopamudra resides.

## \|\| 3.18.31-33 \|\|

*tena dharmeṇa deva tvaṃ bhartā labdho'si śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*arddhāṃke'pi sthitā tena yāścariṣyaṃti yoṣitaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*kauṃteya puruṣo vāpi khyātaṃ raṃbhāvrataṃ bhuvi \|*  
*tāsāṃ putrā gṛhaṃ bhogāḥ kulavṛddhirbhaviṣyati \|\| 32 \|\|*

*strīṇāṃ cāturyasaubhāgyaṃ gārhasthyaṃ sarvakāmikam \|*  
*bālāvṛddhāsumadhyānāṃ rūpalāvaṇyabṛṃhaṇam \|*  
*sapatnīdarpadalanaṃ vaśīkaraṇamuttamam \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. O Deva, O Sankara, with the performing of this same vrata, I got you as my husband. Besides that, with the glory of the same vrata, I became your better half as well as Isvari. O son of Kunti, this Rambha-vrata is quite well known on earth and when a man or a woman would perform this vrata, sons, abode, besides the pleasures would be achieved by them. Their race would expand at the same time. The intelligence of the ladies, besides their fortunes, household dharma, shall achieve all success. Besides, the girl young and old women would become more beautiful and healthy, besides shattering the pride of the cowives.

## \|\| 3.18.34-35 \|\|

*himavadviṃdhyayormadhye āryāvarte manohare \|*  
*utpatya śobhane vāse pūrvotpannadhane kule \|\| 34 \|\|*

*mṛtaḥ śakrapuraṃ yāti tato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet \|*  
*tataḥ śivapuraṃ yāti vyāsasya vacanaṃ yathā \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. With the glory of this vrata, the people of the area located in between Himalaya and Vindhya mountain known as Aryavartas, they are reborn in a high family and after their death, they achieve Indraloka, Visnuloka and Sivaloka as per the words of Vyasa.

## \|\| 3.18.36 \|\|

*yadraṃbhayā kila bhayāpaharaṃ tataśca gauryā himādribhavanasthitayāpi cīrṇam \|*  
*tasyā vrataṃ suvikaroti ratā ca dharme brahmeśakeśavapatiṃ sukhadaṃ labheta \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The goddess Gauri had performed this vrata, while living with Himalaya in an appropriate manner. Therefore, if a religious minded lady performs this vrata, she achieves Brahma or Visnu or Siva as her husband.

## Chapter 19. Glory of Gopada Trtiya-Vrata

## \|\| 3.19.1-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*pārtha bhādrapade māsi śuklapakṣe dinodaye \|*  
*tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthyāṃ ca śuddhāyāṃ prativatsaram \|\| 1 \|\|*

*upavāsena gṛhṇīyādvrataṃ nāmnā tu gopadam \|*  
*snātvā naro vā nārī vā puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*dadhyakṣataiśca mālābhiḥ piṣṭakairvanamālayā \|*  
*abhyaṃjayedgavāṃ śṛṃgaṃ khuraṃ pucchāntameva ca \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dadyādgavāhnikaṃ bhaktyā tāsāṃ pūrvāparāhṇayoḥ \|*  
*anagnipākaṃ bhuñjīta tailakṣāravivarjitam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*vrajaṃtīnāṃ gavāṃ nityamāyāṃtīnāṃ ca bhārata \|*  
*puradvāretha vā goṣṭhe mantreṇā nena maṃtravit \|*  
*arghyaṃ pradadyādgṛṣṭyāṃ vā gavāṃ pādeṣu pāṃḍava \|\| 5 \|\|*

*mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasādityānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ \|*  
*pranuvocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Sri Krsna said- O Partha, on the third and the fourth moon days of he bright fortnight of the month of Bhadrapada, the Gopada vrata is performed by fasting. On that particular day, at dawn, a man or a woman, after taking bath, should worship a cow offering flowers, incense, paste, curd, unbroken rice, garland and pudding. The horns of the cow, besides its hoofs and the tail should be decorated. In the forenoon as well as in the afternoon, offering the preparations made of the cow’s milk etc., the food cooked in fire besides the oil, should be discarded and other things should be used. O Bharata, while the cows leave for the pastures and till their return in the evening, at the entrance gates of the city, the hoofs of a cow, who has littered a calf should be worshipped, offering the arghya. O Pandava, a Brahmana well-versed in mantra should offer the arghya. Then the mantra- “Mata Rudranam.... vadhista”, should be recited.

## \|\| 3.19.7-9 \|\|

*iti gavāṃ maṃtraḥ \|*  
*gāvo me agrataḥ santu gāvo me saṃtu pṛṣṭhataḥ \|*  
*gāvo me hṛdaye saṃtu gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham \|\| 7 \|\|*

*itthaṃ saṃpūjya dattvārghaṃ tato gacchedgṛhāśramam \|*  
*paṃcamyāṃ krodharahito bhuñjīta gorasaṃ dadhi \|\| 8 \|\|*

*śālipiṣṭaṃ phalaṃ śākaṃ tilamannaṃ ca śobhanam \|*  
*bhuktāvasāne rājendra saṃyatastāṃ niśāṃ svapet \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. Thereafter, the devotee with folded hands should offer the prayer, saying- “Infront of me, or at my back and the heart, the cows are standing. In this way, I always dwell among the cows.” Thus offering arghya, one should worship the cows. Thereafter, reaching home, on the day of pancami, with a peaceful mind, powdered rice, fruits, vegetables, sesamum seeds and excellent food should be consumed with curd and butter milk. Thereafter, O king, one should sleep during the night controlling all the senses.

## \|\| 3.19.10-11 \|\|

*prabhāte gopadaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇāya hiraṇmayam \|*  
*kṣamayecca gavāṃ nāthaṃ goviṃdaṃ garuḍadhvajam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*arcyaṃte'tra yathā gāvastathā govardhano giriḥ \|*  
*praṇamyācyutamuddiśya śṛṇu yatphalamāpnuyāt \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. At the dawn, after taking bath and completing all other daily routines, the hoofs made of gold should be given over to a Brahmana. Thereafter, prayer should be offered to Gosvami, Garudadhvaja and Govinda. The way with which the cows were worshipped, similarly, the mount Govardhana should also be adored. Thereafter, salutation should be offered to lord Acyuta. By so doing, the merit one earns, the same is being narrated by me.

## \|\| 3.19.12-15 \|\|

*gobhakto govrataṃ kṛtvā bhaktyā śaktyā ca goṣpadam \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ rūpalāvaṇyaṃ prāpnoti pṛthivītale \|\| 12 \|\|*

*gotarṇakākulaṃ gehaṃ gokulaṃ ca samāsataḥ \|*  
*dhanadhānyasamopeta śālīkṣurasamṛddhimān \|\| 13 \|\|*

*saṃtānaṃ pūjitaṃ labdhvā tataḥ svarge'maro bhavet \|*  
*divyarūpadharaḥ sragvī divyālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*gandharvairgītavādyena sevyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ \|*  
*divyaṃ yugaśataṃ chittvā tato viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet \|\| 15 \|\|*

12-15. A person, who with devotion performs the Govrata, gives away a gospada (cow’s hoof made in gold) as per one’s means, he earns enormous fortunes and beauty. He on earth gets enough of cows and calves, Gokula, riches, cereals, paddy, hoofs and prosperity, noble progeny and finally the heaven at the end. There, turning as a god, he is adorned with beautiful ornaments and garlands and the Apsaras serve him with dance and music. Thus, he lives there for a hundred divine yugas and then he moves on to Visnuloka.

## \|\| 3.19.16 \|\|

*yo gopadavratamidaṃ kurute trirātraṃ gā vai prapūjayati gorasapūjanācca \|*  
*goviṃdamādipuruṣaṃ praṇataḥ savitrāmālokamuttamamupaiti gavāṃ pavitram \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Thus a person, who for three nights, performs the Gopada vrata and worships the cows, milk and offers worship to Lord Govinda and also offers salutation to the Sungod, he achieves the excellent and auspicious Goloka.

## Chapter 20. Hara Kali Vrata

## \|\| 3.20.1-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śukle bhādra padasyaiva tṛtīyāyāṃ samarcayet \|*  
*sarvadhānyaistāṃ virūḍhāṃ bhūtāṃ haritaśāḍvalām \|*  
*harakālīṃ devadevīṃ gaurīṃ śaṃkaravallabhām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalairdhūpairnaivedyairmodakādibhiḥ \|*  
*prīṇayitvā samācchādya padmarāgena bhāsvatā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ghaṇṭāvādyādibhirgītaiḥ śubhairdivyakathānugaiḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau prabhāte hyudgate ravau \|\| 3 \|\|*

*suvāsinībhiḥ sā neyā madhye puṇyajalāśaye \|*  
*tasminvisarjayetpārtha harakālīṃ haripriyām \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Sri Krsna said- On the third bright moon day of the month of Bhadrapada, Harakali -the beloved of lord Siva, should be worshipped who enhance the greenery of all the cereals and is also known by the name of Deva Gauri. On that particular day, fragrance, flowers, fruits, incense, lamp, eatables and sweet balls besides other things should be offered to her to please her. She should be decorated with the rubies and then the bell, should be offered. The divine stories together with songs and music should be narrated during the night, remaining awake. At the dawn, the fortunate ladies (with their husbands alive) should carry the image of the goddess and consigned it in a river water.

## \|\| 3.20.5 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*bhagavanharakālīti kā devī procyate bhuvi \|*  
*ārdradhānyaiḥ sthitā kasmātpūjyate strījanena sā \|*  
*pūjitā kiṃ dadātīha sarvaṃ me brūhi keśava \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Yudhisthira- said— The great goddess Harakali is quite popular in the world. Why is she established in the green cereals? Why do people of all the castes adore her? After getting worshipped, what type of grace is bestowed by her over the people? You kindly enlighten me on all these points.

## \|\| 3.20.6-12 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*sarvapāpaharāṃ divyāṃ mattaḥ śṛṇu kathāmimām \|*  
*āsīddakṣasya duhitā kālīnāmnī tu kanyakā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*varṇenāpi ca sā kṛṣṇā navanīlotpalaprabhā \|*  
*sā ca dattā tryaṃbakāya mahādevāya śūline \|\| 7 \|\|*

*vivāhitā vidhānena śaṃkhatūryānunādinā \|*  
*yatkuryādāgatairdevairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*nirvartite vivāhe tu tayā sārdhaṃ trilocanaḥ \|*  
*krīḍate vividhairbhogairmanasaḥ prītivardhanaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*atha devasamānastu kadācitsa vṛṣadhvajaḥ \|*  
*āsthānamaṃḍape ramye āste viṣṇusahāyavān \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tatrasthaścāhvayāmāsa narmaṇā tripurāṃtakaḥ \|*  
*kālī nīlotpalaśyāmāṃ gaṇamātṛgaṇāvṛtām \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ehyehi tvamitaḥ kāsi kṛṣṇāṃjanasamanvite \|*  
*kālasuṃdari matpārśve dhavale tvamupāviśa \|\| 12 \|\|*

6-12. Sri Krsna said- I am going to narrate the story which removes all the sins. You please listen. Daksa Prajapati had a daughter named Kali having the black complexion. She had the glory of fresh blue lotus flowers. Daksa Prajapati called for Trayambaka Mahadeva, who always carried a trident with him and appropriately married his daughter Kali to him. In the marriage, all the gods with their musical instruments like conches, drums, participated. With the reciting of the Vedic hymns by the Gods and the Brahmanas, the welfare ceremony was completed. Thereafter, the three eyed lord Siva departed for Kailasa (riding over the bull). Then he enjoyed various types of love sports with her. During those days, the bull-bannered Siva was seated over a lion throne in a beautiful mandapa. Lord Visnu was also present there. He jokingly called for his beloved Harakali having the complexion of blue lotus flowers. She was accompanied with other Matrkas of black complexion. Siva said O Kalasundari, come on and be seated beside me under the bright sky.

## \|\| 3.20.13-17 \|\|

*evamutkṣiptamanasā devī saṃkuddhamānasā \|*  
*śvāsayāmāsa tāmrākṣī bāṣpagadgadayā girā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ruroda sasvaraṃ bālā tatrasthā sphuritādharā \|*  
*kiṃdaivayogāttāmrā gaurgaurī cetyabhidhīyate \|\| 14 \|\|*

*yasmānmamopamā dattā kṛṣṇavarṇena śaṃkara \|*  
*harakālīti vāhūtā devarṣigaṇasevitā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tasmāddehamimaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ juhomi jvalite'nale \|*  
*ityuktvā vāryamāṇā tu harakālī ruṣānvitā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*mumoca haritacchāyākāṃtiṃ haritaśādvale \|*  
*cikṣepa doṣaṃ rāgeṇa jvalite havyavāhane \|\| 17 \|\|*

13-17. Having been enraged with the contemptuous words, the goddess Harakali was immensely enraged. She started having a deep sigh. Subsequently, the goddess with coppei like eyes (started sobbing) and her throat was choked with tears. At that point of time, the lips of the goddess were fluttering in anger. She started crying and said- “O Sankara, shall I have a white complexion by sitting with you? You are equating me with black colour. In the presence of the gods and the Rsis, you have addressed me as Harakali. Therefore, I shall burn this body which is of black colour in the fire flame.” Thus speaking, Harakali in full view of the Devas (and Rsis), having been filled with rage, placed her body in the burning flames over the green grass.

## \|\| 3.20.18-19 \|\|

*punaḥ parvatarājasya gṛhe gaurī babhūva sā \|*  
*mahādevasya dehārddhe sthitā saṃpūjyate suraiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*evaṃ sā harakālīti gaurīśasya vyavasthitā \|*  
*pūjanīyā mahādevī maṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Subsequently, the same goddess was bom again in the house of Himavan as Gauri and again became the spouse of Siva, who is still adored by the gods. O Pandavas, thus learning about the story of Harakali, Mahadeva should be worshipped with the reciting of the mantras.

## \|\| 3.20.20 \|\|

*harakarmasamutpanne harakāye harapriye \|*  
*māṃ trāhīśasya mūrtisthe praṇatāstu namonamaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. (One should say-) “The spouse of Siva, who is born for all the activities of Siva, protect me. O form of Siva, I am offering salutation to you with humility.”

## \|\| 3.20.21-22 \|\|

*itthaṃ saṃpūjya naivedyaṃ dadyādviprāya pāṃḍava \|*  
*tāṃ ca prātarjale ramye maṃtreṇaiva visarjayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

*arcitāsi mayā bhaktyā gaccha devi surālayam \|*  
*harakāle śive gauri punarāgamanāya ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. O Pandava! Thus adoring, the eatables should be offered to her. He should then consign the image in the water on the same day, praying- “O goddess, I have worshipped you with devotion. O Harakali, O Siva and 0 Gauri, now you can proceed on to the heaven and grace us again when you are invoked again.

## \|\| 3.20.23-26 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha harakālīvrataṃ caret \|*  
*varṣevarṣe vidhānena nārī narapate śubhā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*sā yatphalamavāpnoti tacchṛṇuṣva narādhipa \|*  
*martyaloke ciraṃ tiṣṭhetsarvarogavivarjitā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sarvabhogasamāyuktā sau bhāgyabalagarvitā \|*  
*putrapautrasuhṛnmitranaptṛdauhitrasaṃkulā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sāgraṃ varṣaśataṃ yāvadbhogānbhuktvā mahītale \|*  
*tatovasāne dehasya śivajñānā mahāmune \|\| 26 \|\|*

23-26. O Pandava king, a woman who performs the vrata of Harakali appropriately, the reward she earns by so doing is being stated by me. You please listen. O ruler of the people, such a woman, getting relieved of all the ailments, enjoys all the comforts of the world. Her fortunes always gain importance and her sons, grandsons and daughter’s sons, friends and other members of the family live for a hundred years each. At the end of their age, earning divine knowledge from lord Siva, they reach the Kailasa mountain.

## \|\| 3.20.27-28 \|\|

*cirabhadrā mahākālanaṃdīśvaravināyakāḥ \|*  
*tadājñākiṃkarāḥ sarve mahādevaprasādataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*saṃpūrṇasūryagaṇasaptavirūḍhaśasyāṃ tāṃ vai himādritanayāṃ harakālikākhyām \|*  
*saṃpūjya jāgaramanuddhatagītavādyairyacchaṃti yā iha bhavaṃti patipriyāstāḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. At the command of lord Mahadeva, Cirabhadra, Mahakali, Vinayaka, Nandisvara and others serve them. Thus, Harakali - the daughter of Himadri, should be adored and her vrata should be performed, followed by the dance and music during the night, remaining awake. One who does so, she always remains beloved of her husband and earns enormous fortunes.

## Chapter 21. Glory of Lalita Vrata

## \|\| 3.21.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*atha pṛcchāmi bhagavanvrataṃ dvādaśamāsikam \|*  
*lalitārādhanaṃ nāma māsamāsakrameṇa vā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O lord, the Lalitarddhana vrata which is observed in each one of the month, gets completed in four months. What is the process for observing the same? You please tell me.

## \|\| 3.21.2-6 \|\|

*kṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu pāṃḍava yatnena yathā vṛttaṃ purātanam \|*  
*śaṃkarasya mahādevyāḥ saṃvādaṃ kurusattama \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kailāsaśikhare ramye bahupuṣpaphalopage \|*  
*sahakāradrumacchanne caṃpakāśokabhūṣite \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kadaṃbabakulāmoda vaśīkṛtamadhuvrate \|*  
*mayūraravasaṃghuṣṭe rājahaṃsopaśobhite \|\| 4 \|\|*

*mṛgarkṣagajasiṃhaiśca śākhāmṛgagaṇāvṛte \|*  
*gaṃdharvayakṣadevarṣisiddhakinnarapannagaiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tapasvibhirmahābhāgaiḥ sevamānaṃ samaṃtataḥ \|*  
*sukhāsīnaṃ mahādevaṃ bhūtasaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtam \|\| 6 \|\|*

2-6. Sri Krsna said- O Pandava, I am going to repeat the talk between Siva and Parvati on the subject. You listen to me carefully. O best of the race of Kuru, once lord Siva and Parvati were present over the pleasant peak of the Kailasa mountain, which was rich in the growth of the flowers, fruit trees as well as the mango trees, besides Asoka, Kadamba, Bakula, Amoda trees and the fragrance of all these trees was spread everywhere which attracted the intoxicated black-wasps, which issued humming sound. The voice of peacocks and the royal goose was also heard there. The wild animals like the deer, bears, elephants, lions, besides the monkeys wandered there quite freely. Lord Siva with his goblins was seated there in the company of his beloved, quite comfortably. The Gandharvas, Yaksas, Devas, Rsis, Siddhas, Kinnaras, serpents as well as the ascetics were attending on the divine couple. The Apsaras attracted them with their dance and music. At that point of time, the goddess Uma spoke to Siva, offering her salutation to him.

## \|\| 3.21.7-10 \|\|

*apsarobhiḥ parivṛtamumā natvābravīdidam \|*  
*umovāca \|*  
*bhagavandevadeveśa śūlapāṇe vṛṣadhvaja \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kathayasva maheśāna tṛtīyāvratamuttamam \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ labhate yena dhanaṃ putrānpaśūnsukham \|\| 8 \|\|*

*nārī svargaṃ śubhaṃ rūpamārogyaṃ śriyamuttamām \|*  
*evamukto dayitayā bhāryayā prītipūrvakam \|*  
*vihasya śaṃkaraḥ prāha kiṃ vratena tava priye \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ye kāmāstriṣu lokeṣu divyā bhūmyaṃtīrakṣajāḥ \|*  
*sarvepi tena cāyattā vaśyastehaṃ yataḥ patiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. Uma said- O lord, O god of gods, the carrier of the trident, O Mahesana, you kindly tell me the process to be adopted for the performing of the Trtiya vrata by following which one achieves fortunes, wealth, sons and the domestic animals, besides an excellent wife, heaven, love, beauty, the body without ailments, enormous comforts, etc.” When the wife of lord Siva lovingly spoke so, lord Siva smiled and said- “O dear one, what is the use of your knowing the process of the performing of vrata, because in all the three Iokas all your desires get fulfilled, because Siva happens to be your husband.”

## \|\| 3.21.11-15 \|\|

*umovāca satyametatsureśāna tvayi dṛṣṭe na durlabham \|*  
*kiṃcittribhuvanābhogabhūṣaṇe śaśibhūṣaṇe \|\| 11 \|\|*

*bhaktyā striyo hi māṃ deva prajapaṃti śubhāśubham \|*  
*virūpāḥ sulabhāḥ kāścidaputrā bahuputrakāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*suśīlāstapasā kāścicchvaśrubhiḥ pīḍitā bhṛśam \|*  
*śaucācārasamāyuktā na rocantetha kasyacit \|\| 13 \|\|*

*evaṃ vahuvidhairduḥkhaiḥ pīḍyamānāstu dāruṇaiḥ \|*  
*śaraṇaṃ māṃ prapannāstāḥ kṛpāviṣṭā tato hyaham \|\| 14 \|\|*

*yena tāḥ sukhasaṃbhogarūpalāvaṇyasaṃpadā \|*  
*putraiḥ saubhāgyavittaughai ryuktāḥ syuḥ surasattama \|*  
*tanme kathaya tattvena vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam \|\| 15 \|\|*

11-15. Uma said- 0 lord of the gods, the words spoken by you are all correct, because when a husband having been adorned with the moon digit as well as the serpents is sighted by me, nothing in the three worlds remains beyond my reach, but the ladies worship me with devotion. A woman suffers, when she is ugly, an ordinary woman, childless woman, the one having many sons, as well as the ascetic women, inspite of their being quite humble, they are tortured by the mother-in-laws. Inspite of their following the good conduct, they feel painful because of the household quarrels. Similarly, the woman suffering from many problems, have to face enormous torture. Then they take refuge in me, I therefore, feel merciful for them. O best of the gods, therefore, I desire that you tell me an excellent vrata with the performing of which they could enjoy much of conjugal pleasure, beauty, achieve excessive wealth and fortunes. You kindly tell me an excellent vrata.

## \|\| 3.21.16-24 \|\|

*īśvara uvāca \|*  
*māghe māsi site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ yatavratāḥ \|*  
*mukhaṃ prakṣālya hastau ca pādau caiva samāhitāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*upavāsasya niyamaṃ daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam \|*  
*madhyāhne tu tataḥ snānaṃ bilvairāmalakaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*snātvā tīrthajale śubhre vāsasī paridhāya ca \|*  
*sugaṃdhaiḥ sumanobhiśca prabhūtaiḥ kuṃkumādibhiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*arcayaṃti sadā devi tvāṃ bhaktyā bhaktavatsale \|*  
*karpūrādyaistathā dhūpairnaivedyaiḥ śarkarādibhiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*yadṛcchālābhasaṃpannairdhūpadīpārcanādibhiḥ \|*  
*nāmneśānīṃ gṛhītvā tu pratīkṣeddhaṭikāṃ tataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*pātre tāmramaye śuddhe jalākṣatavimiśrite \|*  
*sahiraṇyaṃ dvijaṃ kṛtvā maṃtrapūrvaṃ samādhinā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*śirasi prakṣipettoyaṃ dhyāyaṃtī manasepsitam \|*  
*brahmāvartātsamāyātā brahmayonervinirgatā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*bhadreśvarā tato devī lalitā śaṃkarapriyā \|*  
*gaṃgādvārāddharaṃ prāptā gaṅgājalapavitritā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*saubhāgyārogyaputrārthamarthārthaṃ haravallabhe \|*  
*āyātā ghaṭikāṃ bhadre pratīkṣasva namonamaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

16-24. Isvara said- On the third bright moon day of the month of Magha, one should dutifully wash her face, hands and the feet. Then she should brush her teeth for starting the fast. During the noon time, she should take a bath with the water of wood-apple and myrobalan. Thereafter, she should be clad in two cloths, Then the goddess should be adored offering fragrant flowers, saffron, vermilion and other things like camphor, sugar and incense as per one’s means. Other things can also be added. Then uttering the name of the Tsani Devi, ghatika (watch) should be sighted. The water should then be placed in the copper leaf, besides the broken rice. Then gold should be given to a Brahmana as daksina. Then devoting the mind towards the goddess, the water should be poured over her head. Then she should offer the prayer, saying- “After emerging from Brahma-yoni and reaching in Brahmavarta, you came to be known as the beloved of Siva. O beloved of Hara, you have been purified at Haridvara with the water of the Ganga. Therefore, in order to achieve fortunes, good health, son and the wealth, I am worshipping you. You kindly examine this ghatika arriving here. Salutation to you again and again.

## \|\| 3.21.25-27 \|\|

*dattvā hiraṇyaṃ tattasmai prāśnīyācca kuśodakam \|*  
*ācamya prayato bhūtvā bhūbhisthā kṣapayetkṣapām \|\| 25 \|\|*

*dhyāyamānā umāṃ daivīṃ harite yavasaṃstare \|*  
*dvitīyehni tataḥ snātvā tathaivābhyarcya pārvatīm \|\| 26 \|\|*

*yathāśakti dvijānpūjya tato bhuñjīta vāgyatā \|*  
*evaṃ tu prathame māsi pūjanīyāsi kālike \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27.Then one should sip the water with kusa grass and sleep on the floor. One should conceive the goddess Uma, should sleep on green barley mat and spend the night. On the next day, performing the same routine, the goddess Parvati should be worshipped and daksina should be given to the Brahmana as per one’s means and then take food with discipline. O Kalika, you should be worshipped accordingly, by the same name during the first month.

## \|\| 3.21.28-30 \|\|

*dvitīye pārvatīnāma tṛtīye śaṃkarapriyā \|*  
*bhavānyatha caturthe tvaṃ skadamātātha pañcame \|\| 28 \|\|*

*dakṣasya duhitā ṣaṣṭhe mainākī saptame smṛtā \|*  
*kātyāyanyaṣṭame māsi navame tu himādrijā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*daśame māsi vikhyātā devi saubhāgyadāyinī \|*  
*umā tvekādaśe māsi gaurī tu dvādaśe parā \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. Similarly, during the second month, you should be worshipped by the name of Parvati. During the third month, she should be adored as Sahkarapriya; Bhavani in the fourth month; Skandamata in the fifth month; Daksaduhita in the sixth month; Mainaki in the seventh month; Katyayani in the eighth month; Himadrija or Girija in the ninth month; Saubhagyadayini in the tenth month; Uma in the eleventh month and as Gauri in the twelve month.

## \|\| 3.21.31-33 \|\|

*kuśodakaṃ payaḥ sarppirgomūtraṃ gomaya phalam \|*  
*niṃbapatraṃ kaṃṭakārī gavāṃ śṛṃgodakaṃ dadhi \|\| 31 \|\|*

*pañcagavyaṃ tathā śākaḥ prāśanāni kramādamī \|*  
*māsimāsi sthitā hyevamupavāsaparāyaṇā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*dadāti śraddhayaitāni vācake brāhmaṇottame \|*  
*kusuṃbhamājyaṃ lavaṇaṃ jīrakaṃ guḍameva ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. During these months, the fasts should be broken by taking (i) Kusa water (2) milk, water or corn, (3) ghi, (4) cow’s urine, (5) cowdung, (6) fruit, (7) lemon leal, (8) leaf 01 silk cotton tree. (0) Srngodaka, (10) curd. (11 Pancagavya and (12) vegetables, respectively. Observing the fast in each one of the months, a Brahmana orator should be given the saffron coloured drink, ghi, salt, cumin seed and sugarcane balls, in chanty.

## \|\| 3.21.34-38 \|\|

*dattairebhiḥ sūryasthā tvaṃ sūryasthā tuṣyasi priye \|*  
*māsimāsi bhavenmantro gakāro dvādaśākṣaraḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*oṅkārapūrvako devi namaskārāṃta īritaḥ \|*  
*ebhistvaṃ pūjitā maṃtraistuṣyasi vratataḥ priye \|\| 35 \|\|*

*tuṣṭā tvabhīpsitānkāmāndadāsi prītipūrvakam \|*  
*samāpte tu vrate tasminbrāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*sahitaṃ bhāryayābhyarcya gaṃdhapuṣpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*dvijaṃ maheśvaraṃ kṛtvā umāṃ bhāryāṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

*annaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ dadyāttathā śukle ca vāsasī \|*  
*raktaṃ vāsoyugaṃ dadyāttvāmuddiśya harapriye \|\| 38 \|\|*

34-38. At the end of every month, at the conclusion of the adoration, the twelve letter mantra with Omkara should be recited, offering salutation and then should say- “O goddess, remaining in the solar disc, you should always remain happy with me. Getting adored with this mantra, you kindly get pleased, you fulfill all my desires/' With the conclusion of the vrata lovingly, a Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas, should be invited with his wife. Both of them should be adored as Siva and Uma and then should be served with food along with two red costumes.

## \|\| 3.21.39-41 \|\|

*brāhmaṇe śraddhayā yuktastasyāṃ phalamidaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*daśavarṣasahasrāṇi lokānprāpya parāparān \|\| 39 \|\|*

*modate bhartṛsahitā yatheṃdreṇa śacī tathā \|*  
*mānuṣatvaṃ punaḥ prāpya svena bhartrā sahaiva sā \|\| 40 \|\|*

*puṇye kule śriyā yuktā nīrogā sukhamaśnute \|*  
*sapta janmāni yāvacca na vaidhavyamavāpnuyāt \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. O beloved of Hara, with the completion of this activity with devotion, the excellent reward one achieves is going to he told by me. you please listen. Such a woman, reaching the excellent place in the heaven, enjoys all the comforts in the heaven like Indrani. Thereafter, she is reborn in an excellent race and gets the same husband, with whom she spends the most comfortable life. She does not have to face v/idowhood for seven births, continuously.

## \|\| 3.21.42-44 \|\|

*putrānbhogāṃstathā rūpaṃ saubhāgyārogyameva ca \|*  
*ekapatnī tathā bhartuḥ prāṇebhyo'pyadhikā bhavet \|\| 42 \|\|*

*śṛṇuyādvācyamānaṃ tu bhaktyā yā lalitāvratam \|*  
*mayā snehena kathitaṃ sāpi tatphalabhāginī \|\| 43 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya lakṣalalitāṃ lalitāṃgayaṣṭiṃ gaṃdhodakāmṛtaghaṭīṃ śirasi kṣipedyaḥ \|*  
*sā svargametya lalitāsu lalāmabhūtā bhūpādhipaṃ patimavāpya bhuvaṃ bhunakti \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. She enjoys to have sons, the best of pleasures, beauty, fortunes, healthy body free of ailments and she remains beloved of her husband, besides being a single wife. A woman, who listens about the glory of this Lalita-vrata with devotion from a Brahmana orator, she also achieves similar rewards our of my love for you. 1 have narrated the precess of the performing of this vrata. Thus, the one who places the vase of nectar over her head, after adoring Laksa-Lalita Devi, with water mixed with fragrance, then she, becoming a beautiful damsel, after enjoying all the pleasures in the heaven, gets an emperor as her husband and enjoys a life of pleasure on earth.

## Chapter 22. Aviyoga Tptiya Vrata

## \|\| 3.22.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*ihāpi yogamāsādya bhartṛbaṃdhujanaiḥ saha \|*  
*vada nārī naraśreṣṭha vrajedyena śivālayam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*vidhavā ca pare loke bhūyo'pi na viyujyate \|*  
*sukhasaṃdohasaubhāgyayuktā bhavati bhāminī \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- O best of the humans, by which type of the vrata, after having birth in an excellent race, a woman gets an excellent husband and relatives, enjoys all the household comforts and after death reaches the abode of Siva with all the comforts and pleasures? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 3.22.3-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ubhayācaritaṃ yatnādbhavavāglalitāmṛtam \|*  
*labdhvā hi bhavato janma dakṣakopādviyuktayā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*mahāsaubhāgyasaṃdohaṃ dṛṣṭvā devyā mahātmanā \|*  
*aruṃdhatyā vaśiṣṭhena pṛṣṭena kathitaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Sri Krsna said- Getting enraged with Daksa, after ending her life and taking rebirth, Parvati had performed the Lalita-vrata happily and enjoyed all the comforts. Observing that, Arunadhati questioned the sage Vasistha and the reply she got is being repeated by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.22.5-6 \|\|

*māsi mārgaśire prāpte caṃdravṛddhau śucismitā \|*  
*dvitīyāyāṃ samāsādya naktaṃ bhuṃjīta pāyasam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*ācamya ca śucirbhūtvā daṃḍavacchaṃkaraṃ namet \|*  
*mudānvitā namaskṛtya vijñāpya parameśvaram \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. On the bright second moon day of the month of Margasirsa, one should observe fast with purity, one should take food of payasam (milk with rice) and rinsing her mouth, one should purify herself and prostrate before the image of lord Siva. Next day at dawn, one should offer her salutation to lord Siva and then declare the vrata.

## \|\| 3.22.7-9 \|\|

*audumbaramṛjuṃ gṛhya bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam \|*  
*uttarāśāgataṃ sāgraṃ satvacaṃ nirvraṇaṃ śubham \|\| 7 \|\|*

*dvitīyāyāṃ pare vāhni gaurīṃ śaṃbhuṃ ca pūjayet \|*  
*śālipiṣṭamaye kṛtvā rūpe strīpuṃsayoḥ śubhe \|*  
*pātre saṃsthāpya saṃpūjya jāgaraṃ niśi kalpayet \|\| 8 \|\|*

*vidhivatpūjayitvā tu śaṃkaraṃ kīrtayatsvapet \|*  
*prabhāte te gṛhītvā tu ācāryāya nivedayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. Then she should brush the teeth with the tooth stick of wild fig tree. The tooth stick should be long, pure, covered with the skin, uninjured and should be pleasant to look at. Thereafter, the images of Siva and Gauri should be worshipped, which should be beautifully made of powder of Sali rice. Both the figures should be placed in a vase and after worshipping them, one should remain awake upto midnight. Thereafter, performing the worship in an appropriate manner, reciting the name of Siva, one should go to sleep. In the morning, the figures (with vase) should be given over to an Acarya.

## \|\| 3.22.10-11 \|\|

*bhojayenmṛṣṭamannādyaṃ śivabhaktyā dvijottamān \|*  
*dāṃpatyāni ca tatraiva śaktyā tānyapi bhojayet \|\| 10 \|\|*

*pratimāsaṃ prakurvīta vidhinā tena saṃyatā \|*  
*kārtikāṃte tato māsi mārgaśīrṣe samudyamet \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. The Brahmana devoted to lord Siva should be served an excellent food. The Acarya couple should also be served with food (and given daksina as per one’s means). Following the same process, this type of anusthana should be performed during each month. The process should be ended in the month of Kartika.

## \|\| 3.22.12 \|\|

*nāmāni ca pravakṣyāmi pratimāsaṃ kramācchaṇu \|*  
*pūjājāpyanimittaṃ ca siddhyarthaṃ ceti tasya ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. During each month for the puja, japam, and success in vrata in an appropriate manner, the relevant names are also being spoken, which you please listen.

## \|\| 3.22.13-14 \|\|

*evaṃ pauṣe tu saṃprāpte giriśaṃ pārvatīṃ tathā \|*  
*samabhyarcya caturthyāṃ tu paṃcagavyaṃ pibetsudhīḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*etatpāraṇamuddiṣṭaṃ mārgādau mārgagocaram \|*  
*na cānyatpañcagavyādi pāvanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. During the month of Pausa, lord Girisa and Parvati should be worshipped. On the fourth day of the moon, the fast should be broken consuming the pancagavya. Because this is the method prescribed for the breaking of the fast during the months of Pausa and Margasirsa. There is nothing better for the breaking of the fast than pancagavya.

## \|\| 3.22.15-18 \|\|

*bhavaṃ caiva bhavānīṃ ca māsi māghe prapūjayet \|*  
*phālgune tu mahādevamumayā sahitaṃ matam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*lalitāṃ śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ caitre saṃpūjayettataḥ \|*  
*sthāṇuṃ vaiśākhamāse tu lolanetrāyutaṃ yajet \|\| 16 \|\|*

*jyeṣṭhe vīreśvaraṃ devamekavīrāsamanvitam \|*  
*āṣāḍhe paśunāthaṃ ca śaktyā sārddhaṃ trilocanam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*śrīkaṃṭhaṃ śrāvaṇe devaṃ sutānvitamathārcayet \|*  
*bhīmaṃ bhādrapade māsi durgayā sahitaṃ yajet \|*  
*īśānaṃ kārttike māsi śivādevīyutaṃ yajet \|\| 18 \|\|*

15-18. Similarly, during the month of Magha, Bhava and Bhavani should be adored. During the month of Phalguna, Mahadeva and Uma are to be adored; during the month of Caitra, Sankara and Lalita; during the month of Vaisakha, Sthanu and Lolanetra; during Jyestha, Vires vara and Ekavira; during the month of Asadha, Trilocana and Sakti; during Sravana, Srlkan(ha and Suta; during Bhadrapada, Bhima and Durga; and during the month of Karttika, Isana and Siva should be worshipped.

## \|\| 3.22.19 \|\|

*japyadhyānārcanāyaiva nāmānyetāni suvrata \|*  
*smṛtāni vidhinā rājanvratasiddhirbhaved dhuvam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. O Suvrata, while performing the vrata, the suitable names should be made use of because by so doing in an appropriate manner, the vrata surely meets with success.

## \|\| 3.22.20 \|\|

*pratimāsaṃ tu puṣpāṇi yāni pūjāsu yojayet \|*  
*tāni kramātpravakṣyāmi sadyaḥ prītikarāṇi vai \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. During the worship of each month, the prescribed flowers to be used are also being spoken by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.22.21 \|\|

*ādau nīlotpalaṃ yojyaṃ tadabhāve'parāṇyapi \|*  
*pavitrāṇi sugaṃdhīni yojayedbhaktito'rcane \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. During the puja of Margasirsa, blue lotus flowers should be used. Along with those flowers, other flowers can also be offered, but they should be fragrant and pure.

## \|\| 3.22.22-24 \|\|

*karavīraṃ bilvapatraṃ kiṃśukaṃ kubjamallikā \|*  
*pāṭalābjakadaṃbaṃ ca tagaraṃ droṇamālatī \|\| 22 \|\|*

*etānyuktakrameṇaiva māseṣu dvādaśasvapi \|*  
*bhaktyā yojyāni rājendra śivayostuṣṭihetave \|\| 23 \|\|*

*vatsarāṃte vitānaṃ ca dhūpotkṣepaṃ saghaṃṭikam \|*  
*dhvajaṃ dīpaṃ vastrayugaṃ śaṅkarāya nivedayet \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. Similarly, the oleander flowers, wood apple leaves, Butea frondosa, jasmine, red lotus flowers, Kadamba, Agara, Dronamalati lowers can be used for the worship of Siva and Siva during the twelve months. O Rajendra, pleasing both Siva and Siva with devotion, at the end of the year, a canopy, incense, pitcher, a lamp, flag and four costumes should be offered.

## \|\| 3.22.25-27 \|\|

*snāpayitvā ca liptvā ca sauvarṇaṃ mūrdhni paṅkajam \|*  
*pūpayugmaṃ ca purataḥ śālipiṣṭamayaṃ nyaset \|\| 25 \|\|*

*naivedyaṃ śaktito datvā nattvā ca vidhivacchivam \|*  
*kuryānnīrājanaṃ śambhostato gacchetsvakaṃ gṛham \|\| 26 \|\|*

*tatra gatvā trikoṇaśca caturasraṃ ca kārayet \|*  
*trikoṇe brāhmaṇī bhojyā caturasre dvijottamāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. Bathing them both, their bodies should be plastered. A golden lotus should be placed over the head. The fried cakes and other eatables should be served in an appropriate manner. Offering salutation to both of them, the arati should be performed. Thereafter, returning home, one should draw a triangle and quadrangle, over which the wife of the Brahmana and the Brahmana should be seated respectively.

## \|\| 3.22.28-30 \|\|

*vratino bhojayetpaścādvādaśaiva dvijottamān \|*  
*mithunāni ca tāvaṃti śaktyā bhaktyā ca pāṇḍava \|\| 28 \|\|*

*umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ kārayitvā suśobhanam \|*  
*mauktikāni catuḥṣaṣṭistāvato'pi pravālakāḥ \|*  
*tāvaṃti puṣparāgāṇi tāmrapātropari nyaset \|\| 29 \|\|*

*vastreṇa veṣṭayitvā ca gandhairdhūpaistathārcayet \|*  
*etatsaṃbhārasaṃyuktamācāryāya nivedayet \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. Both of them together with twelve other Brahmanas should be served the food. O Pandavas, according to one’s means, the Brahmana couple should be given the gold, images of Uma-Mahesvara studded with sixty four beads, sixty four corals with an equal number of flowers, and covered with the cloth and consecrated over the copper sheet. The fragrant flowers, incense should be offered to them. After worshipping the figures, they should be handed over to the Acarya.

## \|\| 3.22.31-34 \|\|

*vratināṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca dampatīnāṃ ca bhārata \|*  
*dattvā hiraṇyavāsāṃsi kṣamayetpraṇipatya ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

*catvāriṃśattathāṣṭau ca kumbhāṃcchatramupānahau \|*  
*sahiraṇyākṣatānsarvāndadyātpuṣpodakānvitān \|\| 32 \|\|*

*dīnāndhaduḥkhitānāṃ ca taddine vā nivāritam \|*  
*kalpayedannadānaṃ cālocayañchaktimātmanaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*nyūnādhikaṃ ca kartavyaṃ svavittapari māṇataḥ \|*  
*saṃpūrayetkalpanayā vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet \|\| 34 \|\|*

31-34. Then one should beg forgiveness from the Brahmana couple. At that point of time, forty eight pitchers, umbrella, shoes, gold, flowers and unbroken rice should be given to the Brahmanas, according to one’s means. Besides, one should also give as per his means, charities to destitute, poor, blind and the people who are suffering, the food as well as the clothings as per one’s means. The scales prescribed above can be increased or decreased according to one’s capacity.

## \|\| 3.22.35 \|\|

*aviyogakaraṃ caitadrūpasaubhāgyavittadam \|*  
*āyuḥputrapradaṃ svargyaṃ śivalokapradāyakam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. But wickedness of riches should not be resorted to when enough of wealth is available with a person. In case the vrata is so performed, one achieves fortunes, wealth, sons, heavenly pleasures and the place of Siva.

## \|\| 3.22.36 \|\|

*samyakpurāṇapatitaṃ vratacaryametattattvaṃ carācaragurorhṛdayaṃgamāyāḥ \|*  
*pūjāṃ vidhāya vidhivanna viyogameti sādhvīsvabhartṛsutabandhujanairdhanaiśca \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. While performing this vrata, when Siva who is lord of mobile and immobile, the preceptor of the entire universe besides his beloved Parvati, are worshipped in an appropriate manner, then a woman who does so who is devoted to her husband, never gets separated from her husband, sons, relatives and wealth.

## Chapter 23. Uma-Mahesvara Vrata

## \|\| 3.23.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kena dharmeṇa nārīṇāṃ vratena niyamena ca \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ jāyate'tīva putrāśca bahavaḥ śubhāḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca vastrāṇi vividhāni ca \|*  
*aviyogaṃ ca satataṃ labhate putrapautrayoḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- By practicing which dharma or the vrata, the ladies accomplish the height of virtues, fortunes, several sons, wealth, cereals, gold, several types of costumes and constant company of their husbands?

## \|\| 3.23.3-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu pārtha pravakṣyāmi vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam \|*  
*yatkṛtvā subhagā nārī bahvapatyā ca jāyate \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca dāsīdāsādikaṃ vahu \|*  
*utpadyate gṛhe yena tadvata kathayāmi te \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Sri Krsna said- I am going to tell you the excellent vrata with the performing of which a woman achieves enough of progeny and her home remains filled with wealth, cereals, gold, male and female servants always.

## \|\| 3.23.5-7 \|\|

*umāmaheśvaraṃ nāma apsarobhiḥ purā kṛtam \|*  
*vidyādharaiḥ kinnaraiśca ṛṣikanyābhireva ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

*rūpiṇyā raṃbhayā caiva sītayā'halyayā tathā \|*  
*rohiṇyā damayaṃtyā ca taptayā cānasūyayā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*etābhiścaritaṃ pārtha vrataṃ sarvavratottamam \|*  
*saubhāgyārogyaphaladaṃ dāridryavyādhināśanam \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. O Partha, the Uma-Mahesvara vrata has been said to be the best of all the vratas, which was initially performed by the Apsaras (denizens) followed by the daughters of Vidyadharas, Kinnaras, Rsis, Rupini, Rambha, Sita, Ahalya, Rohini, Damayanti and Tara. This vrata bestows Saubhagya, freedom from disease and removes poverty as well as the disease.

## \|\| 3.23.8-10 \|\|

*martyaloke striyo yāśca durbhagārūpavarjitāḥ \|*  
*aputrā nirdhanāścaiva sarvabhogavivarjitāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tāsāṃ hitārthaṃ pārvatyā umāmaheśvaraṃ vratam \|*  
*avatāritaṃ purā pārtha na jānaṃtyadhamāḥ striyaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*pūrvaṃ mārgaśire māsi nārī dharmaparāyaṇā \|*  
*śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā jitendriyā \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. All the women of the universe, who are unfortunate, ugly, poor and are deprived of the sexual life, for all of them Parvati had prescribed this vrata for the welfare of the same, which came to be known as Uma-Mahesvara vrata.
