On the third bright moon day of the month of Margasirsa, remaining religious minded, the woman, controlling all the senses, should firmly resolve to perform the vrata.

## \|\| 3.23.11 \|\|

*snātvā saṃpūjya lalitāṃ harakāyārdhavāsinīm \|*  
*punaḥ prabhātasamaye snānaṃ cākṛtrime jale \|*  
*kṛtvā devīstarpayitvā idaṃ vākyamudīrayet \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Then after taking her bath, she should worship the goddess Lalita - the spouse of the lord. Thereafter, she should take her bath in a tank or a river and then worship the goddess.

## \|\| 3.23.12-14 \|\|

*namo namaste deveśa umādehārddhadhāraka \|*  
*mahādevi namaste'stu harakāyārddhavāsini \|\| 12 \|\|*

*hṛdi kṛtvā śivaṃ devīṃ japedyāvadgṛhaṃ gatā \|*  
*pūjayeddevamīśānaṃ puṣpaiḥ kālodbhavaistataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*vāmapārśve umāṃ devīṃ dakṣiṇe tu maheśvaram \|*  
*dhūpaṃ vā gugguluṃ vāpi dahetpaścātsubhāvitā \|*  
*naivedyaṃ tu yathāśakti ghṛtapakvaṃ nivedayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. She should then offer prayer to her, saying- “O goddess Uma, you hold half the body of Siva. O lord of gods, salutation to you again and again.” Reaching home, then she should keep on reciting the name of Siva and Uma. Reaching home, she should adore Siva and Parvati, where Parvati is lodged to the left of Siva. Thereafter, the guggulu incense besides the eatables should be offered to them both.

## \|\| 3.23.15-17 \|\|

*kārayedvaiśvadevaṃ tu tilājyena susaṃskṛtam \|*  
*pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ prāśya ātmakāyaviśodhanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*evaṃ dvādaśamāsāṃstu pūjayitvā maheśvaram \|*  
*udyāpanaṃ tataḥ kuryātprahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*śivaṃ rūpyamayaṃ kṛtvā umāṃ haimamayīṃ tathā \|*  
*ārūḍhau vṛṣabhe raupye sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitau \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. Then the offerings should be made of sesamum soaked in ghi as for Vaisvadeva. Thereafter, consuming pancagavya, the fast should be broken purifying his body at the same time. In this way, Uma-Mahesvara should be worshipped for a full one year. Ultimately, getting delighted, the concluding ceremony of the vrata should be performed. The image of Siva should be made in silver, while that of Uma should be made in gold and both the figures should be lodged over the bull Nandi, the figure of which should be made in silver, quite beautifully. All the figures should be well decorated with ornaments.

## \|\| 3.23.18-19 \|\|

*candanena śivaṃ carcya kuṃkumena ca pārvatīm \|*  
*arcayetkusumaiḥ paścātsugandhaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*veṣṭayecchuklavastreṇa śivaṃ raktena pārvatīm \|*  
*paścāddhūpaṃ dahennārī bhaktibhāvena bhāvitā \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Lord Siva should then be worshipped offering the sandal paste, while the image of Uma should be offered the vermilion. At the time of adoration, red cloth should be offered to the goddess Uma, while the white cloth should be offered to Siva with devotion. Thereafter, the incense should also be offered to both of them.

## \|\| 3.23.20-21 \|\|

*bhojayecchivabhaktāṃśca brāhmaṇānvedapāragān \|*  
*bhaktebhyo dakṣiṇā deyā bhaktyā śāṭhyavivarjitā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya idamuccārayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*umāmaheśvarau devau sarvalokapitāmahau \|*  
*vratenānena suprītau bhavetāṃ mama sarvadā \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Subsequently, food should be served to Vedic Brahmanas, giving daksina as per one’s means. Thereafter, doing circumambulation, one should beg forgiveness, saying- “0 goddess Uma and lord Mahesvara, both of you are the grace parents of the universe, you kindly always remain happy with performing of this vrata.”

## \|\| 3.23.22 \|\|

*evamuktvā jitakrodhe brāhmaṇe vedapārage \|*  
*vrataṃ nivedayedbhaktyā vācake vā guṇānvite \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Thus speaking, the lady performing the vrata should summon a learned Brahmana and the vrata should be revealed to him.

## \|\| 3.23.23-24 \|\|

*idaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī maheśārpitamānasā \|*  
*prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śivaloke vasettāvadyāvadindrāścaturddaśa \|*  
*apsarobhiḥ parivṛtā kinnarībhistathaiva ca \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. With the performing of this vrata, the lady who does so, goes on to the abode of Siva, where she stays for a period of fourteen Indras and is served there by the Apsaras as well the Kinnaras, pretty well.

## \|\| 3.23.25-26 \|\|

*yadā mānuṣyamāyāti jāyate vimale kule \|*  
*rūpayauvanasaṃpannā bahuputrā pativratā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*dhanadhānyasamāyukte suvarṇamaṇimaṃḍite \|*  
*yāvajjīvaṃ gṛhe ramye tiṣṭhatyavyāhatendriyā \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. After a long time, in the abode of Siva, when she becomes desirous of getting reborn in a high human race, she is reborn on earth in a high family. Possessing a youthful and a beautiful body, the chaste woman gets many sons, wealth and cereals, living in a house of gold. Throughout her life, she enjoys all the pleasures.

## \|\| 3.23.27 \|\|

*viyogaṃ naiva sā paśyedbhartṛmitrasutādikaiḥ \|*  
*mṛtā śivapuraṃ yāti śivagaurīprasādataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. She is never separated from her husband and sons. By the grace of Siva and Gauri, after her death, she again proceeds on to the abode of Siva.

## \|\| 3.23.28 \|\|

*haimīmumāṃ rajatapiṇḍamayaṃ maheśaṃ raupye surūpavṛṣabhe ca samāsthitau tau \|*  
*sampūjya raktasitavastrayugāvagūḍhau nārī bhavatyavidhavā sutasaukhyayuktā \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. A woman, who making a figure of Uma in gold and the figures of Siva and Nandi bull in silver and covering them with white and red costumes worships them both, such a woman always lives with her husband and enjoys all the comforts.

## Chapter 24. Rambha Trtiya Vrata

## \|\| 3.24.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*raṃbhātṛtīyāṃ vakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm \|*  
*putrasaubhāgyaphaladāṃ sarvāmayanivāriṇīm \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sarvaduṣṭaharāṃ puṇyāṃ sarvasaukhyapradāṃ tathā \|*  
*sapatnīdarpadalanāṃ tathaiśvaryaṃ karīṃ śivām \|\| 2 \|\|*

*śaṃkareṇa purā proktā pārvatyāḥ priyakāmyayā \|*  
*tāmimāṃ śṛṇu bhūpāla sarvabhūtahitāya vai \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Sri Krsna said- At the same time, I am speaking about the Rambha-trtiya vrata, which removes all the sins and bestowing the fortunes, removes all the ailments. It also makes all the wicked people to vanish. It bestows all the comforts, shatters the pride of the co-wife and causes the fortunes and welfare. O king, because of the auspicious desire of Parvati, lord Siva had in earlier times discussed about the same. The welfare of all the living beings is enshrined in the same, which I am going to speak out. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.24.4-5 \|\|

*mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi tṛtī yāyāṃ narādhipa \|*  
*śuklāyāṃ prātarutthāya daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam \|*  
*upavāsasya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyādbhaktibhāvitā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*devi saṃvatsaraṃ yāvattṛtīyāyāmupo ṣitā \|*  
*pratimāsaṃ kariṣyāmi pāraṇaṃ cāpare'hani \|*  
*tadavighnena me yātu prasādāttava pārvati \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. O lord of the people, on the bright third moon day of the month of Margasirsa, one should get up early in the morning, should clean his teeth with devotion and then take a firm resolve for fasting. Then he should offer the goddess a prayer, saying- “O goddess, upto the end of the year, on each third day of the moon in a month, I shall observe a fast which shall be broken on the next day. Therefore, O Parvati, I request, that this vrata of mine should be completed without any obstruction.”

## \|\| 3.24.6-8 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃkalpya vidhivatkauṃteya kṛtaniścayaḥ \|*  
*bhaktyā naro vā nārī vā snānaṃ kuryādataṃdritaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*nadyāṃ taḍāge vāpyāṃ vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān \|*  
*pūjayetpārvatīṃ nāma rātrau prāśya kuśodakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*prabhāte bhojayedvidvāñchivabhaktānviśeṣataḥ \|*  
*hiraṇyaṃ lavaṇaṃ caiva teṣāṃ dadyāttu dakṣiṇām \|*  
*gaurīśvaraṃ yathāśakti bhojayetprayatā satī \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. On son of Kunti, thus offering samkalpa appropriately, a man or a woman, discarding laziness, should take a bath with devotion in a river, a tank, a step-well or even in his own home, and then perform puja for the goddess Parvati. Taking the water of kusa grass during the night, then in the next morning he should feed the Brahmanas, who are devoted to lord Siva. He should then offer the daksina of gold and salt. Then a chaste wife should be served with the food as Gauri, besides as Mahesa (to a Brahmana).

## \|\| 3.24.9-11 \|\|

*anena vidhinā rājanyaḥ kuryānmāsi pauṣake \|*  
*gomūtraṃ prāśayedrātrau prabhāte bhojayeddvijān \|\| 9 \|\|*

*hiraṇyaṃ jīrakaṃ caiva svaśaktyā dāpayettataḥ \|*  
*kaḍuhuṃḍaṃ ca kanakaṃ tebhyo dattvā visarjayet \|\| 10 \|\|*

*vājapeyātirātrābhyāṃ phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ \|*  
*śakraloke vasetkalpaṃ tataḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. О king, by this process, in the month of Pausa on the third moon day, a woman should complete the vrata sipping cow’s urine during the night to break the fast, and should serve food to the Brahmanas in the next morning. Besides the gold and cumin seeds should be offered. When a lady gives a vase and thorn apple and consigns the same in the water, she earns the merits of performing the Vajapeya and Atiratra yajnas. At the time of death, after enjoying all the comforts of the heaven, she reaches the abode of Siva.

## \|\| 3.24.12-13 \|\|

*māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ sudevīṃ nāma pūjayet \|*  
*gomayaṃ prāśayedrātrau tataścaikākinī svapet \|\| 12 \|\|*

*prātaḥ kusuṃbhaṃ kanakaṃ dadyā cchaktyā dvijātiṣu \|*  
*viṣṇuloke ciraṃ sthitvā prāpnoti śivasāmyatām \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. On the third moon day of the month of Magha, the goddess Sudevi should be worshipped during the night and the fast should be broken with the eating of cowdung. Then she should sleep alone. Thereafter, in the morning, the Brahmanas should be served with food and then given away gold with flowers by the lady, and when she does so, she lives in the heaven for a long time, after which she reaches the 3ivaloka and achieves the moksa which is similar to the form of Siva.

## \|\| 3.24.14-15 \|\|

*gaurīti phālgune nāma gokṣīraṃ prāśayenniśi \|*  
*prabhāte bhojayedvidvāñchivabhaktānsuvāsinīḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kaḍuhuṃḍaṃ sakanakaṃ tebhyo dattvā visarjayet \|*  
*vājapeyātirātrābhyāṃ phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. During the month of Phalguna, the goddess Gauri should be worshipped and the fast should be broken at night consuming the milk of cows. At dawn, the Brahmanas who are devoted to lord Siva should be invited, gold should be offered to the Brahmanas with kuduhunda and then they should be sent off. A woman, who does so, achieves the merits of performing a Vajapeya and the Atiratra sacrifices. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.24.16 \|\|

*caitre māsi viśālākṣīṃ pūjayedbhaktitatparā \|*  
*dadhi prāśya svapetprātardadyāddhema sakuṃkumam \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti viśālākṣyāḥ prasādataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. During the month of Caitra, the goddess named VisalaksI should be worshipped and the fast should be broken with the taking of the curd. Again in the next morning, when a lady gives away in charity various things to the Brahmanas, then by the grace of the goddess Visalaksi, she earns enormous fortunes.

## \|\| 3.24.17 \|\|

*vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ śrīmukhīṃ nāma pūjayet \|*  
*ghṛtaṃ ca prāśayedrātrau tataścaikākinī svapet \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Similarly, on the third moon day of the month of Vaisakha, the goddess Srimukhi should be worshipped and the fast should be ended at night consuming the ghi. She should sleep alone at night.

## \|\| 3.24.18 \|\|

*śivabhaktāndvijānprātarbhojayitvā yathepsitam \|*  
*tāṃbūla lavaṇaṃ dattvā praṇipatya visarjayet \|*  
*anena vidhinā dattvā putrānāpnoti śobhanān \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. In the morning, the Brahmanas devoted to Siva should be served with food of their liking and then they should be given salt besides the betel. They should then be sent off with humility. A chaste woman, who does so, achieves a number of beautiful sons.

## \|\| 3.24.19 \|\|

*āṣāḍhe mādhavīṃ natvā prāśnīyācca tilodakam \|*  
*prabhāte bhojayedviprāndakṣiṇāyāṃ guḍaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*sakāṃcanaḥ śubhāṃllokānprāpnoti hi na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. On the third moon day of the month of Asadha, the goddess Madhavi should be adored. Then during the night, the fast should be broken with sesamum mixed with water. During the next morning, the BrAhmanas should be served with food. Then, the sugarcane balls with gold should be given to them in charity. A lady, who does so, achieves the best of heaven.

## \|\| 3.24.20 \|\|

*śrāvaṇe tu śriyaṃ pūjya pibedgośṛṃgajaṃ jalam \|*  
*śivabhaktāṃśca saṃpūjya dayāddhemaphalaiḥ saha \|*  
*sarvalokeśvaro bhūtvā sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. During the month of Sravana, the goddess Sri should be worshipped. During the night, the fast should be broken by taking the srngodaka (water) and then go to sleep. In the early morning, the BrAhmanas devoted to Siva should be served with food and then offered gold and fruit in daksina. A woman, who does so, achieves all the riches and grace. Besides all her desires get fulfilled.

## \|\| 3.24.21 \|\|

*bhādre caiva tṛtīyāyāṃ haratālīti pūja yet \|*  
*māhiṣaṃ ca pibeddugdhaṃ saubhāgyamatulaṃ labhet \|*  
*iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā cāṃte śivapuraṃ brajet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. On the third moon day of the month of Bhadrapada, the goddess Haratali should be worshipped. The fast should then be broken at night consuming the buffalo milk and by so doing, a lady achieves enormous fortunes. Enjoying all the pleasures in the world, at the end of her life, she reaches the abode of Siva,

## \|\| 3.24.22-23 \|\|

*āśvine tu tṛtīyāyāṃ giriputrīti pūjayet \|*  
*saṃprāśya taṇḍulajalaṃ prātarviprāṃśca pūjayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇā cāpi nirdiṣṭā kanakaṃ ca sacandanam \|*  
*sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya gaurīloke mahī yate \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. During the third moon day of the month of Asvina, the daughter of the mountain has to be worshipped. The fast should be broken with the consuming of the rice water at night. The next morning, the BrAhmanas should be served with food and should be given sandal paste and daksina. A woman, who does so, she earns the merit of performing all the yajnas and is ultimately well established in the Gaurlioka.

## \|\| 3.24.24-25 \|\|

*padmodbhavā kārtike ca pañcagavyaṃ pibettataḥ \|*  
*rātrau prajāgaraṃ kuryātprabhāte bhojayeddvijān \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sapatnīkāñchubhācārānmālyavastra vibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*pūjayecchivabhaktāṃśca kumārīścaiva bhojayet \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. Similarly, during the month of KArtika, on the third moon day, the goddess Padmodbhava (born out of lotus) is to adored. The fast has to be broken at night consuming pancagavya and one should remain awake during the whole night. During the next morning, the Brahmanas with their wives should be served the food. They should be sent off after giving costumes, garlands and ornaments. Thereafter, the maiden girls should be served the good.

## \|\| 3.24.26-28 \|\|

*umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ samāpte kārayennṛpa \|*  
*yathāvibhavasāreṇa vitānaṃ pañcavarṇakam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*aśanaṃ ca śubhaṃ dadyācchvetacchatraṃ kamaṃḍalum \|*  
*pādukopānahau divyairvastrayugmaiśca pāṃḍava \|\| 27 \|\|*

*pītayajñopavītaiśca dīpanetraiḥ samujjvalaiḥ \|*  
*śaṃkhaśuktisamopetairddarpaṇaiśca suśobhitaiḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. When the vrata is thus completed, one should make the images of Uma and Mahesvara as per her means, then canopies of five colours, auspicious food, white sandal paste, kamandalu, wooden sandals, shoes, couple of divine costumes, yellow yajnopavita, lamps and conch should be given, and decorating their eyes, beautiful mirrors should also be given.

## \|\| 3.24.29-31 \|\|

*umāmaheśvaraṃ sthāpya pūjayitvā yathāvidhi \|*  
*nānāvidhaiḥ sugandhaiśca patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaistathā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*ghṛtapakvaiśca naivedyairdīpamālābhireva ca \|*  
*śarkarānālikeraiśca dāḍimairbījapūrakaiḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*jīrakairlavaṇaiścaiva kusumbhaiḥ kuṃkumaistathā \|*  
*satāmrabhājanairdivyodakai rasasaṃyutaiḥ \|*  
*pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ kṣamayettadanaṃtaram \|\| 31 \|\|*

29-31. Both of them should be worshipped appropriately with several types of fragrant leaves, flowers, fruits, fried sweets and eatables, garland of lamps, sugar, coconut, pomegranate, myrobalan, lemon, cumin seeds, salt, flowers, vermilion, copper case, besides the divine sweet balls should be given after adoring Siva - the god of gods. Thereafter, he should beg forgiveness.

## \|\| 3.24.32-35 \|\|

*śaṃkhavāditranirghoṣairvedadhvanisamanvitaiḥ \|*  
*evaṃ kṛte phalaṃ yatsyāttanna śakyaṃ mayoditum \|\| 32 \|\|*

*pūrvoktaphalabhāgī syātsarvadevaiśca pūjyate \|*  
*kalpakoṭiśataṃ yāvatsarvakāmānavāpnuyāt \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tadaṃte śivasāyujyaṃ prāpnotīha na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*puraitadraṃbhayā cīrṇaṃ tena raṃbhāvrataṃ smṛtam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*yo'haṃ sā ca smṛtā gaurī yā gaurī sa maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*iti matvā mahārāja śaraṇaṃ vraja pārvatīm \|\| 35 \|\|*

32-35. At that point of time, the sound of the reciting of the Vedas and the conches, accompanied with music, should be generated. O Pandava, when the goddess is so worshipped, the merits earned by a devotee cannot be described by me. The devotee, achieving all the aforesaid merits, is respected by all the gods, gets all his desires fulfilled for crores of kalpas, enjoys all the comforts and ultimately, such a devotee attains the moksa which is equated with Siva. There is no doubt about it. Since this vrata was initially performed by Rambha, therefore, this came to be known as Rambha-vrata. “I am Gauri and Gauri is Mahesvara,” thus thinking, one should take refuge with Parvati.

## \|\| 3.24.36 \|\|

*eṣā himādriduhiturdayitā tṛtīyā raṃbhāvidhānamalabhadbhuvi tatkṛteti \|*  
*satprāśitairuditanāmayutāmupoṣya prāpnoti vāṃchitaphalānyabalā bahūni \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. When a woman on earth, performs the vrata which emerged because of the desire of the daughter of Himalaya and is known as Rambha-vrata, in an appropriate manner during each month and break the fast during each night, worshipping the goddess while fasting, the devoted damsel reaps all the excellent rewards on earth.

## Chapter 25. Saubhagyastaka described

## \|\| 3.25.1 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*tathaivānyatpravakṣyāmi sarvakāmaphalapradam \|*  
*saubhāgyaśayanaṃ nāma yatpurāṇavido viduḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sri Krsna said - I am going to speak to you another type of vrata, which fulfills all the desires and has been described as the Saubhagya-vrata by the learned people.

## \|\| 3.25.2-4 \|\|

*purā dagdheṣu lokeṣu bhūrbhuvaḥsvarmahādiṣu \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ sarvalokānāmekasthamabhavattadā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tacca vaikuṇṭhamāsādya viṣṇorvakṣasthale sthitam \|*  
*tataḥ kālena mahatā punaḥ sargavidhau nṛpa \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ahaṃkārāvṛte loke pradhānapuruṣānvite \|*  
*sparddhāyāṃ ca pravṛttāyāṃ kamalāsanakṛṣṇayoḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. In earlier times, the voices of bhur, bhuvah, svara and maha lokas disappeared in the talk of the people. Then the Saubhagya or fortunes of all the people became one, which is safely lodged in the chest of lord Visnu -the dweller of Vaikuntha. O king, with the passing of great or enormous times and at the time of the creation of the universe, when the Pradhana Purusa of the universe, with arrogance, is spread almost everywhere, then, starts a terrific competition between Brahma and Sri Krsna.

## \|\| 3.25.5-7 \|\|

*piṃgākārā samudbhūtā jvālā vakṣasthalī tadā \|*  
*tayābhitaptasya harervakṣasastadviniḥsṛtam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*yadvakṣasthalamāśritya viṣṇoḥ saubhāgyamāsthitam \|*  
*rasarūpatayā tāvatprāpnoti vasudhātalam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*utkṣiptamantarikṣasthaṃ brahmaputreṇa dhīmatā \|*  
*dakṣeṇa pītamātraṃ tu rūpalāvaṇyakāraṇam \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. Then, suddenly a dreadful flame of tawny colour emerged out of the chest of lord Visnu. Suffering from the said flame, the same lustre emerging out of the chest of Visnu in the form of rasa and beauty, it moved towards the nether world, when Daksa, getting fascinated with his beauty caught it, threw it in the sky and then consumed the same.

## \|\| 3.25.8-9 \|\|

*balaṃ tejo mahajjātaṃ dakṣasya parameṣṭhinaḥ \|*  
*śeṣaṃ yadapatadbhūmāvaṣṭadhā tadajāyata \|\| 8 \|\|*

*ikṣavastavarājaṃ ca niṣpāvājājidhānyakam \|*  
*vikāravacca gokṣīraṃ kusumbhaṃ kuṃkumaṃ tathā \|*  
*lavaṇaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ tatra saubhāgyāṣṭakamucyate \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. As a result of this, Daksa became immensely illustrious. The rest of the lustre was divided into eight parts known by the names of Iksa, Svaraja, Nispapa, Jajidhanya, Goksira, Kusuma, Kunkuma as well as the Lavana. Popular among the people with these names, they are known as Saubhagyastaka.

## \|\| 3.25.10-12 \|\|

*pītaṃ yadbrahmaputreṇa yogajñānavidā tathā \|*  
*duhitāsyābhavattasmādyā satītyabhidhīyate \|*  
*lokānatītya lālityāllalitā tena cocyate \|\| 10 \|\|*

*trailokyasuṃdarīmenāmupayeme pinākadhṛk \|*  
*triviśvasaubhāgyamayī bhukti muktiphalapradā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ārādhya tāmumāṃ bhaktyā strī rājankinna vindati \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. The learned Daksa, who was well-versed in yogic knowledge, had slept over the same. Because of the same, Sati was born as his daughter and earned the glory in the world. Because of her being the most beautiful in the world, she came to be known as Lalita. The same beauty of the three worlds was married to lord Siva who happens to be the fortune of the three worlds and bestow the devotion as well as salvation. Therefore, O king! A damsel, who with devotion, worships the lord (and his Sakti), what is the type of reward which she fails to get, or otherwise, she achieves all the pleasures.

## \|\| 3.25.13 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kathamārādhanaṃ tasyā jagaddhātryā janārdana \|*  
*yadvidhānaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ jagannātha vadasva me \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Yudhisthira said- О Janardana, О Jagannatha, how could the universal mother be adored? You kindly explain the whole process exhaustively.

## \|\| 3.25.14-21 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*vasaṃtamāsamāsādya tṛtīyāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*śuklapakṣasya pūrvāhne tilaiḥ snānaṃ samācaret \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tasminnahani sā devī kila viśvātmanā satī \|*  
*pāṇigrahaṇakairmantrairudvāhyā varavarṇinī \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tathā sahaiva deveśaṃ tṛtīyāyāmathārcayet \|*  
*phalairnānāvidhairdhūpadīpanaivedyasaṃyutaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*pañcagavyenānumāsaṃ tathā gaṃdhodakena ca \|*  
*snapayitvā rcayedgaurīminduśekharasaṃyutām \|\| 17 \|\|*

*pāṭalāṃ śaṃbhusahitāṃ pādayostu prapūjayet \|*  
*triyugāṃ śivasaṃyuktāṃ gulphayorubhayorapi \|\| 18 \|\|*

*bhadreśvareṇa sahitāṃ vijayāṃ jānunoryuge \|*  
*īśānīṃ harikeśaṃ ca kaṭyāṃ saṃpūjayedbudhaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*koṭanīṃ śūlinaṃ kukṣau maṃgalāṃ śarvasaṃyutām \|*  
*udare pūjayedrāja nnumāṃ rudraṃ kucadvaye \|\| 20 \|\|*

*anaṃtāṃ tripuraghraṃ ca pūjayetkarasaṃpuṭe \|*  
*kaṃṭhe bhavaṃ bhavānīṃ ca mukhe gaurīṃ haraṃ tathā \|\| 21 \|\|*

14-21.Sri Krsna said-During the spring season, on the bright third moon day of the month of Caitra, in the forenoon, one should take bath with the water in which sesamum seeds are mixed. The goddess Sati should be married on the same day because she happened to be the soul of the universe. Then, £iva and Sati, both should be worshipped. While worshipping both 6iva and Sati, red cloth should be offered at the feet of £iva. Then, Triyuga Devi should also be worshipped with Siva. At the thighs, the goddess VijayS should be adored; at the waist, IIarikc.

## \|\| 3.25.22 \|\|

*sarvātmanā ca sahitāṃ lalitāṃ mastakopari \|*  
*oṃkārapūrvakairetairnnamaskārāṃtayojitaiḥ \|*  
*pūjayedbhaktisahito gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Thereafter, a passage of Откarа ending with salutation should be recited. Getting filled with devotion and faith, the fragrance, garland and sandal paste should be offered while worshipping the lord.

## \|\| 3.25.23-24 \|\|

*evamabhyarcya vidhivatsaubhāgyāṣṭakamagrataḥ \|*  
*sthāpayetsvinnaniṣpāvānkusuṃbhaṃ kṣīrajīrakam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tavarājekṣulavaṇaṃ kuṃkumaṃ ca tathāṣṭamam \|*  
*dattaṃ saubhāgyakaṃ yasmātsaubhāgyāṣṭa kamucyate \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Then, the Saubhagyastaka should be consecrated before him, which should be sinless and saffron-coloured.. Milk, cumin seeds, tavaraja, sugarcane, salt and vermilion should be offered. By offering these items, one achieves the good luck. Therefore, they are known by the name of Saubhagyastaka.

## \|\| 3.25.25-27 \|\|

*evaṃ nivedya tatsarvaṃ śivayoḥ prīyatāmiti \|*  
*caitre śṛṃgodakaṃ prāśya svapyādbhūmāvariṃdama \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtaprāṇa jayaḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjya dvijadāṃpatyaṃ mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*saubhāgyāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ sauvarṇacaraṇadvayam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*prīyatāmatra lalitā brāhmaṇāya nive dayet \|*  
*evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvattṛtīyāyāṃ sadā nṛpa \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. О Arindama, on the third moon day of the month of Caitra, the lord should be adored in a proper way and the devotee should pray-“Both 3iva and 3iv3 be pleased.” By begging forgiveness in this way, the fast should be broken consuming srngodaka, at night. After sleeping, one should get up early in the morning and getting free from the routine activities, a Brahmana couple should be adored offeringrosary, costumes and ornaments. Then Saubhagyastaka with gold should be placed at their feet and pray- “Let the goddess Lalita be pleased.” The entire stuff should be given over to the Brahmana. This process should be repeated throughout the year, on the third moon day of every month.

## \|\| 3.25.28-30 \|\|

*prāśane nāmamaṃtre ca viśeṣo'yaṃ nibodha me \|*  
*gośṛṃgodakamādye syādvaiśākhe gomayaṃ punaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*jyeṣṭhe maṃdārapuṣpaṃ ca bilvapatraṃ śucau smṛṃtam \|*  
*śrāvaṇe dadhi saṃprāśyaṃ nabhasye ca kuśodakam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*kṣīramāśvayuje tadvatkārtike pṛṣa dājyakam \|*  
*mṛgottamāṃge gomūtraṃ pauṣe saṃprāśayedghṛtam \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. The method of breaking the fasts and their names are being spelt out by me individually. You please listen to the same. During the month of Caitra, it should be Gosrngodaka, during the month of Jyestha there should be Mandara flowers and wood apple leaves in the month of Asasdha; curd during the month of Havana; Kusodaka in the month of Bhadrapada; the milk in the month of Asvina; Prsadajya in the month of Kartika; cow’s urine in the month of Margasirsa; ghi in the month of Pausa; black sesamum in the month of Magha; and pancagavya in the month of Phalguna should be used for the breaking of the fast.

## \|\| 3.25.31-34 \|\|

*māghe kṛṣṇatilāṃstadvatpañcagavyaṃ ca phālgune \|*  
*lalitā vijayā bhadrā bhavānī kumudā śritā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*vāsudevī tathā gaurī maṅgalā kamalā satī \|*  
*umā ca dānakāle tu prīyatāmiti kīrtayet \|\| 32 \|\|*

*mallikāśokakamalakadaṃbotpalamālati \|*  
*kuḍmalaṃ karavīraṃ ca bāṇamamlānakuṃkumam \|*  
*siṃduvāraṃ ca māseṣu sarveṣu kramaśaḥ smṛtam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*japākusuṃbhakusumaṃ mālatī śatapatrikā \|*  
*yathālābhaṃ pradeyāni karavīraṃ ca sarvadā \|\| 34 \|\|*

31-34. Then, uttering the names of Lalita, Vijaya, Bhadra, Bhavani, Kumuda, Vasudevi, Gauri, Mangala, Kamala, Sati, Uma and other goddesses, at the time of giving the charities, one should also add- “for the pleasure of the goddess.” Similarly, every month, the flowers of jasmine, Asoka, lotus, Kadamba, Kudmala, oleander, B ana, saffron, Sinduvara, Japa, Kusuma, Malati and Satapatrika should be used respectively. However, the ever beneficial oleander flowers can always be used.

## \|\| 3.25.35 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvadupoṣya vidhivannaraḥ \|*  
*strī nakte tu kumārī vā śivāmabhyarcya śaktitaḥ \|*  
*vratāṃte śayanaṃ dadyātsarvopaskarasaṃyutam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Thus, observing the fast for a full one year, the deities should be worshipped appropriately. Or alternatively, in the vrata of maiden Siva, one should make the goddess sleep with all the articles of worship.

## \|\| 3.25.36-37 \|\|

*umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ ca gavā saha \|*  
*sthāpayitvā tu śayane brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 36 \|\|*

*anyānyapi yathāśakti midhunānyaṃbarādibhiḥ \|*  
*dhānyālaṃkaraṇairdānairanyaiśca dhanasaṃcayaiḥ \|*  
*vittaśāṭhyena rahitaḥ pūjayedgatavismayaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Making the figures of Uma and Mahesvara in gold etc., they should be placed over the decorated bed. The pair of costumes, cereals, ornaments and gol etc. should also be given. Thereafter, the prayer should be offered to please them.. At each and every time of worship, special attention should be made for Vitta-Satha dosa.

## \|\| 3.25.38 \|\|

*evaṃ karoti yaḥ samyaksaubhāmyaśayanavratam \|*  
*sarvānkāmānavāpnoti padaṃ cānantyamaśnute \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Thus, a woman who performs this Saubhagya-Sayana vrata in an appropriate manner, all her desires are completely fulfilled and she finally achieves the unlimited (high) position.

## \|\| 3.25.39 \|\|

*saubhāgyārogyarūpāyurvastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*na viyukto bhavedrājanvarṣāyutaśatatrayam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. O king, the performer of the Saubhagya vrata achieves good health, beauty, long life, costumes, ornaments and the means for enjoying pleasure for three hundred years continuously.

## \|\| 3.25.40 \|\|

*yastu dvādaśa varṣāṇi saubhāgyaśayanaṃ vratam \|*  
*karoti sapta cāṣṭau vā śrīkaṇṭhabhuvaneśvaraiḥ \|*  
*pūjyamāno bhavetsamya gyāvatkalpāyutatrayam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The one who performs the Saubhagya vrata for seven, eight or twelve years continuously or who do so (in future), they are honoured by Visnu and Siva for thirty thousand kalpas.

## \|\| 3.25.41 \|\|

*nārī vā kurute yā tu kumārī vā nareśvara \|*  
*sāpi tatphalamāpnoti devyanugrahalālitā \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O Naresvara, when a man or a woman, performs this vrata by the grace of the goddess, all the above mentioned rewards are achieved by him or her.

## \|\| 3.25.42 \|\|

*śṛṇuyādapi yaścaitatpradadyādatha vā matim \|*  
*so'pi vidyādharo bhūtvā svargaloke ciraṃ vaset \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Those who listen to the glory of this vrata or support the same, they also, attaining the position of Vidyadharas, live in the heaven.

## \|\| 3.25.43-44 \|\|

*idamiha madanena pūrvamiṣṭaṃ caritamidaṃ śaśabiṃdunā vrataṃ vai \|*  
*surapatidhanadeśavāyusomaiścaritadidaṃ karuṇena baṃdinā ca \|\| 43 \|\|*

*yānīha dattāni purā nareṃdrairdānāni dharmārthayaśaskarāṇi \|*  
*nirmālyavaṃti pratimāni tāni sa nāma sādhuḥ punarādadānaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. This vrata was initially performed by Madana, Indra, Kubera, Isa, Vayu, Soma and Varuna. Such of the kings, who in order to achieve dharma, artha and glory, had worshipped the excellent images and had given over to the Brahmanas, their names being praiseworthy, are being accepted by all (the people in the world).

## Chapter 26. Rasa-Kalyani-Vrata described

## \|\| 3.26.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*saubhāgyārogyaphaladaṃ vipakṣakṣayakārakam \|*  
*bhuktimuktipradaṃ kiñcidvrataṃ brūhi janārdana \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O Janardana, you kindly speak out about a vrata by performing which one could achieve fortune, good health, defeat of the enemy, besides the devotion and salvation.

## \|\| 3.26.2-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*yadumāyai purā deva uvācāsurasūdanaḥ \|*  
*kathāsu saṃpravṛttāsu lalitārādhanaṃ prati \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tadidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuktimukti phalapradam \|*  
*narāṇāmatha nārīṇāmārādhanamanuttamam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|*  
*nabhasye vātha vaiśākhe punarmārgaśire'tha vā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*śuklapakṣatṛtīyāyāṃ snātaḥ sadgaurasarṣapaiḥ \|*  
*gorocanasugomūtramustāgośakṛtaṃ tathā \|*  
*dadhicaṃdanasaṃmiśraṃ lalāṭe tilakaṃ nyaset \|\| 5 \|\|*

2-5. Sri Krsna said- In earlier times, lord Siva - the destroyer of Asuras, while discussing about the worship of Lalita Devi, whatever was spoken by him, I am going to repeat the same. By the completion of the said vrata, one surely achieves pleasures and the salvation. Besides all the sins also get destroyed. Therefore, you listen to me attentively. On the bright third moon day of the month of Sravana, Vaisakha or Margasirsa, one should take bath and then plaster his forehead with the paste made of white mustard, yellow pigment of cow, cow’s urine, musta, cowdung besides the sandal paste.

## \|\| 3.26.6-7 \|\|

*saubhāgyārogyakṛdyatsyātsadā ca lalitāpriyam \|*  
*pratipakṣaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ baddhvā vā pītavāsasī \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dhārayedatha vā raktapītāni kusumāni ca \|*  
*vidhavāpyanuraktāni kumārī śuklavāsasī \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. It yields fortunes and good health and is quite dear to the goddess Lalita. On the third moon day of each fortnight, the goddess should be decorated with yellow costumes, besides the things of red and yellow colours. The widow woman should clad herself in red costumes and unmarried girls should be clad in white clothes.

## \|\| 3.26.8-10 \|\|

*devyarcāṃ paṃcagavyena tataḥ kṣīreṇa kevalam \|*  
*snapayenmadhunā tadvatpuṣpagandhodakena ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*pūjayecchuklapuṣpaiśca phalairnānāvidhairapi \|*  
*dhānyakājājilavaṇaguḍakṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*śuklākṣataistilairarcyāṃ lalitāṃ yaḥ sadārcayet \|*  
*āpādādyarcanaṃ kuryādgauryāḥ samyaksamāsataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. Then, with the use of pancagavya, payasam, honey, flowers and scented water, the goddess should be made to take bath, Thereafter, the flowers, various types of fruits, cereals, salt, payasam, ghi, white unbroken rice and sesamum should be offered to the goddess Lalita, while worshipping her appropriately. At that point of time each and every limb of the goddess Lalita should be adored, calling the name of each and every limb.

## \|\| 3.26.11-14 \|\|

*varadāyai namaḥ pādau tathā gulphau śriye namaḥ \|*  
*aśokāyai namo jaṃghe bhavānyai jānunī tathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ūrū māṃgalyakāriṇyai kāmadevyai tathā kaṭim \|*  
*padmodbhavāyai jaṭharamuraḥ kāmapriye namaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*karau saubhāgyavāsinyai bāhū śaśimukhaśriyai \|*  
*mukhaṃ kaṃdarpavāsinyai pārvatyai tu smitaṃ tathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*gauryyai namastathā nāsāṃ sunetrāyai ca locane \|*  
*tuṣṭyai lalāṭaphalakaṃ kātyāyanyai śirastathā \|\| 14 \|\|*

11-14. Uttering Varadayai namah, one should touch the feet; by Sriye namah one should touch the ankle bones; by uttering Asokayai namah, the thighs should be touched; by uttering Mangalyakarinyai, the thigh joints; by Kamadevyai waist or buttocks; belly should be touched uttering the word Padmodbhavayai. The heart should he touched saying Kamapriye; the hands should be touched saying Saubhagyavsinyai namah. Saying Sasimukhasriyai the arms should be touched; by saying Kandarpavdsinyai the face should be touched; the cheeks should be touched by saying Parvatyai namah; by saying Gauryyai namah nose is to be touched; by saying Sunetrayai namah the eyes should be touched; by saying Tustyai namah the forehead should be touched, and saying Katyayanyai namah, the head should be touched and worshipped.

## \|\| 3.26.15-16 \|\|

*namo gauryai namaḥ sṛṣṭyai namaḥ kāṃtyai namaḥ śriyai \|*  
*raṃbhāyai lalitāyai ca vāsudevyai namonamaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadagrataḥ padma mālikhet \|*  
*patrairdvādaśabhiryuktaṃ kuṃkumena sakarṇikam \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. By uttering the words Gauryai namah, Srstyai namah, Kantyai namah and Rambhayai Lalitayai and Vasudevyai namah, one should beg the forgiveness. Thereafter, the future lotus should be made. Making use of the twelve leaves and vermilion, the pericarp should be made.

## \|\| 3.26.17-19 \|\|

*pūrveṇa vinyasedgaurīmaparṇāṃ ca tataḥ param \|*  
*bhavānīṃ dakṣiṇe tadvadrudrāṇīṃ ca tataḥ param \|\| 17 \|\|*

*vinyasetpaścime saumyāṃ tato madanavāsinīm \|*  
*vāyavyāṃ pāṭalāvāsāmuttareṇa tato hyumām \|\| 18 \|\|*

*lakṣmīṃ svāhāṃ svadhāṃ tuṣṭiṃ maṃgalāṃ kumudāṃ satīm \|*  
*rudrāṇīṃ madhyataḥ sthāpya lalitāṃ karṇikopari \|*  
*kusumairakṣataiḥ śubhrairnamaskāreṇa vinyaset \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. Then, Gauri should be placed towards the east, besides Aparna and Bhavani. Rudrani should be placed to the south, while Saumya has to be lodged towards the west. Then, Saumya and Madanavasini should be placed towards the north-west, and on the north should be placed Uma, Laksmi, Svaha, Svadha, Tusti, Mangala, Kumuda and Sati. RudranI should be placed in the centre. Lalita should then be placed above the pericarp with the use of unbroken rice and flowers, offering the salutation at the same time.

## \|\| 3.26.20-21 \|\|

*gītamaṃgalaghoṣaṃ ca kārayitvā suvāsinīḥ \|*  
*pūjayedraktavāsobhī raktamālyānulepanaiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*siṃdūraṃ snānacūrṇaṃ ca tāsāṃ śirasi pātayet \|*  
*siṃdūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ snānamiṣṭaṃ satyāḥ sadā yataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Then playing on the welfare music, singing, offering the red flowers and red rosary, the goddess Suvasini should be worshipped, offering vermilion powder to all the goddesses over their heads. Because saffron and vermilion is always liked by the goddess Sati.

## \|\| 3.26.22-26 \|\|

*nabhasye pūjayedgaurīmutpalairasitaistathā \|*  
*bandhujīvairāśvayuje kārtike śatapatrakaiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*kundapuṣpairmārgaśire pauṣe vai kuṃkumena ca \|*  
*māghe tu pūjayeddevīṃ siṃduvāreṇa bhaktitaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*jātyā tu phālgune pūjyā pārvatī pāṃḍunaṃdana \|*  
*caitre ca mallikāśokairvaiśākhe gaṃdha pāṭalaiḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*jyeṣṭhe kamalamaṃdārairāṣāḍhe caṃpakāṃbujaiḥ \|*  
*kadaṃbairatha mālatyā śrāvaṇe pūjayedumām \|\| 25 \|\|*

*gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśo dakam \|*  
*bilvapatrārkapuṣpaṃ ca gavāṃ śṛṃgodaka tathā \|*  
*paṃcagavyaṃ tathā bilvaṃ prāśayetkramaśaḥ sadā \|\| 26 \|\|*

22-26. During the month of Sravana, the goddess Gauri should be worshipped with blue lotus and in the month of Asvina, the goddess Gauri should be worshipped with the flowers of Bandhujiva. During the month of Kartika, she las to be adored with lotus; during the month of Margasirsa with the jasmine flowers; during the month of Pau§a with vermilion; during Magha with Sinduvara; during the month of Phalguna with jasmine. During the month of Caitra, Mallikasoka should be used; during Vaisakha the Gandhapatala should be used; lotus in the month of Jye§tha and Mandara in Asadha; Kadamba and jasmine in the month of Sravana should be offered to the goddess Uma. While so worshipping the goddess in each month, cow’s urine, cowdung, payasam, curd, ghi, kusa water, wood apple leaves, swallow-wart, srhgodaka, pancagavya as well as the wood apple leaves respectively, should be used for the breaking of the fast.

## \|\| 3.26.27-30 \|\|

*etadbhādrapadādyaṃ tu prāśanaṃ samudāhṛtam \|*  
*pratipakṣaṃ dvitīyāyāṃ mayā proktaṃ varānane \|\| 27 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇaṃ brāhmaṇīṃ caiva śivaṃ gaurīṃ prakalpya ca \|*  
*bhojayitvārcayedbhaktyā vastramālyānulepanaiḥ \|*  
*puṃse pītāṃbare dattvā striyai kausuṃbhavāsasī \|\| 28 \|\|*

*niṣpāvājājilavaṇamikṣudaṃḍaṃ guṇānvitam \|*  
*striyai dadyātphalaṃ puṃse suvarṇotpalasaṃyutam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*yathā na devadeveśastvāṃ parityajya gacchati \|*  
*tathā māṃ saṃparityajya patirnānyatra gacchatu \|\| 30 \|\|*

27-30. On the second moon day of each fortnight, conceiving a Br&hmana couple to be Siva and Gauri, they should be offered with devotion the costumes, rosary and the paste. The Brahmana couple should then be worshipped. The Brahmana should then be given a yellow lower garment and the damsel should be adored by giving flowery costumes. Thereafter, the lady should also be given the cereals, white cumin seeds, salt, sugarcane, while the fruits should be given to the Brahmana, as well as the gold. Then the house wife should beg forgiveness, saying- “As the lord of gods does not make you suffer from separation, similarly, let my own husband should not leave me alone.”

## \|\| 3.26.31-32 \|\|

*kumudā vimalānaṃtā bhavānī vasudhā śivā \|*  
*lalitā kamalā gaurī satī raṃbhātha pārvatī \|\| 31 \|\|*

*nabhasyādiṣu māseṣu prīyatāmityudīrayet \|*  
*vratāṃte śayanaṃ dadyātsuvarṇaṃ kamalānvitam \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Thereafter, all the goddesses like Kumuda, Vimala, Ananta, Bhavani, Vasudha, Siva, Lalita, Kamala, Gauri, Sat, Rambha and Parvati, in each one of the months like Sravana and others, should be individually worshipped, after which one should say- “Be pleased”, and then vrata should be concluded. At the time of the conclusion of the vrata, a well decorated bed together with gold should be given over to the Brahmana couple.

## \|\| 3.26.33-34 \|\|

*mithunāni caturviṃśattadarddhaṃ sakṛdarccayet \|*  
*aṣṭāvaṣṭāvatha punaścāturmāsye samarcayet \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tathopadeṣṭāramapi pūjayedyatnato gurum \|*  
*na pūjyate gururyatra sarvāstatrāphalāḥ kriyāḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. The worship should be carried out twenty four times, or twelve times or even once. Or it can be performed eight times at a time, thrice carrying the number to twenty four together with Upadevas (semi-gods) besides the preceptor, making all the efforts. A vrata in which the preceptor is not worshipped inthe beginning, his effort becomes useless.

## \|\| 3.26.35-36 \|\|

*uktānaṃtatṛtīyaiṣā sadānaṃtaphalapradā \|*  
*sarvapāpaharā devī saubhāgyārogya vardhinī \|\| 35 \|\|*

*na caināṃ vittaśāṭhyena kadācidapi laṃghayet \|*  
*naro vā yadi vā nārī vittaśāṭhyātpatatyadhaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. This particular day is known by the name of Ananta Trtiya because it bestows bliss, besides being quite rewarding. On that particular day, the goddess must be worshipped because removing all the sins, the goddess enhances the fortunes and good health of the lady who performs the vrata. No trtiya should be neglected, because of the sin of financial blemish, both the man and the woman are sure to fall.

## \|\| 3.26.37-38 \|\|

*garbhiṇī sūtikā naktaṃ kumārī cātha rogayuk \|*  
*yadā śraddhā tadānyena kriyamāṇaṃ tu kārayet \|\| 37 \|\|*

*imāmanaṃtaphaladāṃ tṛtīyāṃ yaḥ samācaret \|*  
*kalpakoṭi śataṃ sāgraṃ śivaloke sa pūjyate \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Thus, the pregnant woman, the one who has just given birth to a child, an unmarried girl and an ailing woman must perform this vrata. They should develop faith in this vrata particularly, because on the day of trtiya which bestows enormous reward when a vrata is concluded, he or she earns his living in the abode of Siva for a hundred crores of years.

## \|\| 3.26.39 \|\|

*vittahīno'pi kurvīta varṣatrayamupoṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*puṣpapatravidhānena sopi tatphalamāpnuyāt \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. A poor person can also perform this vrata using flowers and leaves for three years. On him, the goddess Gauri gets pleased as well, and he gets the reward by her grace.

## \|\| 3.26.40 \|\|

*nārī vā kurute yā tu kumārī vidhavā tathā \|*  
*sā'pi tatphalamāpnoti gauryanugrahabhāvitā \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Whether she be a woman, or a girl, or a widow, when she performs this vrata, she achieves all the merits with the grace of goddess Gauri.

## \|\| 3.26.41 \|\|

*iti paṭhati śṛṇoti vā ya itthaṃ giritanayāvratamiṃdulokasaṃsthaḥ \|*  
*matimapi ca dadāti so'pi devairamaravadhūjanakiṃnaraiśca pūjyaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Thus, a person who studies or listens to the story of the goddess who is known by the name of the daughter of Himalaya, she, besides the orator, the gods, the spouse and the relatives, are always served well.

## \|\| 3.26.42-44 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*anyāmapi pravakṣyāmi tṛtīyāṃ pāpanāśinīm \|*  
*rasakalyāṇinīṃ nāma purā kalpavido viduḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*māghamāse tu saṃprāpya tṛtīyāṃ śuklapākṣikīm \|*  
*prātargavyena payasā tilaiḥ snānaṃ samācaret \|\| 43 \|\|*

*snāpayenmadhunā devīṃ tathaivekṣurasena ca \|*  
*punaḥ pūjā prakartavyā jātyā vā kuṃkumena vā \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. Sri Krsna said- I am speaking about the trtiya which is the remover of the sins and the learned people of the kalpa call it Rasakalyani. On the bright third day of the month of Magha, one should take bath with water mixed with milk and sesamum. Then using the honey and sugarcane juice, the goddess should be bathed. Then the jasmine flowers and the vermilion should be offered to the goddess, while worshipping her.

## \|\| 3.26.45-47 \|\|

*dakṣiṇāṃgāni saṃpūjya tato vāmāni pūjayet \|*  
*lalitāyai namaḥ pādau gulphaṃ tadvadathārcayet \|\| 45 \|\|*

*jaṃghe jānū tathā satyai tathoraśca śriyai namaḥ \|*  
*madanālasāyai tu kaṭiṃ madanāyai tathodaram \|\| 46 \|\|*

*stanau madanavāsinyai kumudāyai ca kaṃdharam \|*  
*bhujānbhujāgraṃ mādhavyai kamalāyai hyupasthakam \|\| 47 \|\|*

45-47. First of all, her right part should be adored and thereafter, the left limbs should be adored. Uttering the words Lalitayai namah, one should touch the ankles and feet of the goddess, besides the thighs and knees. Then uttering Sriye namah the legs should be touched; saying Madanalasayai namah one should touch the buttocks. The breast should be touched saying Madanavasinyai namah.. The shoulders should be touched saying Kumudayai namah. Saying Madhavyai namah. the arms should be touched. Saying Kamalayai namah the hands should be touched.

## \|\| 3.26.48 \|\|

*bhrūlalāṭe ca rudrāṇyai śaṃkarāyai tathālakān \|*  
*mukuṭaṃ viśvavāsinyai punaḥ kāṃtyai tathālakān \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Saying Rudranyai namah the eye brows should be touched along with forehead. Saying Sankarayai namah the right side hair of the head should be touched. Saying Visvavasinyai namah the crown should be touched. Saying Kantyai namah the left side hair of the head should be touched.

## \|\| 3.26.49 \|\|

*netraṃ cakrāvadhāriṇyai puṣṭyai ca vadanaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*utkaṃṭhinyai namaḥ kaṃṭhamanaṃtāyai tu kaṃdharām \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. The eyes should be touched saying Cakravadharinyai namah. The face or mouth should be touched saying Pustyai naah. The neck should be touched by saying Utkanthayi namah. The shoulder should be touched saying Anantayai namah.

## \|\| 3.26.50 \|\|

*raṃbhāyai vāmabāhuṃ ca viśokāyai namaḥ param \|*  
*hṛdayaṃ manmathādityai pāṭalāyai namonamaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. The left arm should be touched saying Rambhayai namah. Saying Visokayai namah the right arm should be touched. Saying Manmathadityai namah the heart should be touched. Thereafter, the prayer should be offered uttering Patalayai namah.

## \|\| 3.26.51 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivaddvijadāṃpatyamarcayet \|*  
*bhojayitvānnadānena madhureṇa vimatsaraḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Thus worshipping the goddess in an appropriate manner, the Brahmana couple should be worshipped. Thereafter, the food should be given in charity in a sweet manner.

## \|\| 3.26.52-53 \|\|

*salaḍḍukaṃ vārikuṃbhaṃ śuklāṃbarayugaṃ tatam \|*  
*dattvā suvarṇakalaśaṃ gaṃdhamālyairathārcayet \|\| 52 \|\|*

*prīyatāmatra kumudā gṛhṇīyāllavaṇavratam \|*  
*anena vidhinā devīṃ māsimāsi samarcayet \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. Thereafter, a pitcher filled with water and the sweet balls, four white clothes, golden pitcher, fragrance and a garland should be presented to the Brahmana at the time of worship and the performer should say- “Let the goddess Kumuda be pleased, after accepting the saltish vrata.” Thus begging forgiveness, he should continue to worship the goddess every month.

## \|\| 3.26.54-55 \|\|

*lavaṇaṃ varjayenmāghe phālgune ca guḍaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*tavarājaṃ tathā caitre varjyaṃ ca madhu mādhave \|\| 54 \|\|*

*yārakaṃ jyeṣṭhamāse tu āṣāḍhe jīrakaṃ tathā \|*  
*śrāvaṇe varjayetkṣīraṃ dadhi bhādrapade tathā \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. At that point of time, salt may be given in the month of Magha; sugarcane balls in the month of Phalguna; Tavaraja in the month of Caitra; honey in the month of Vaisakha; Paraka in the month of Jyestha; cumin seeds in the month of Asadha; Payasam in Sravana and the curd in the month of Bhadrapada.

## \|\| 3.26.56 \|\|

*ghṛtamaśvayuje tadvadvarjayedyā ca majjikā \|*  
*dhānyakaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu pauṣe varjyā tu śarkarā \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. During Asvina, ghi should be given; Majjika in the month of Kartika; coriander seeds in Margasirsa; in Pausa month, sugar should be discarded and the vrata should be concluded.

## \|\| 3.26.57-61 \|\|

*vratāṃte karakā pūrṇā eteṣāṃ māsimāsi ca \|*  
*dayādvikālavelāyāṃ bhakṣapātreṇa saṃyutān \|\| 57 \|\|*

*taṃḍulāñchvetavarṇāṃśca saṃyāvamadhupūrikāḥ \|*  
*ghārikā ghṛtapūrāṃśca maṃḍa kānkṣīraśākakam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*dadhyannaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ caiva bhiṃḍayaḥ śākavartikāḥ \|*  
*māghādau kramaśo dadyādetāni karakopari \|\| 59 \|\|*

*kumudā mādhavī gaurī raṃbhā bhadrā jayā śivā \|*  
*umā śacī satī tadvanmaṃgalā ratilālasā \|\| 60 \|\|*

*kramānmāghādi sarvatra prīyatāmiti kīrtayet \|*  
*carvaṃtaṃ paṃcagavyaṃ ca prāśanaṃ samudāhṛtam \|\| 61 \|\|*

57-61. After concluding the vrata, an earthen vase filled with white rice should be given in charity. At that point of time, pudding, honey, fried cakes, ghi, buttermilk, payasam, vegetables, food cooked in curd of six types, beside the cooked lady finger, should also be placed over the neck of the earthen vase and should be offered every month to Kumuda, Madhavi, Gauri, Rambha, Bhadra, Jaya, Siva, Uma, Saci, Sati, Mangala and the goddess Ratilalasa, saying - “Let the goddess be pleased with me.” These words should be humbly repeated in each month. He should always observe the fast and break it with the consuming of earn and pancagavya.

## \|\| 3.26.62-64 \|\|

*upavāsī bhavennityamaśakto dakṣiṇe kare \|*  
*punarmāghe tu saṃprāpya śarkarāṃ karakopari \|\| 62 \|\|*

*kṛtvā tu kāṃcanīṃ godhāṃ paṃcaratnasamanvitām \|*  
*umāmaṃguṣṭhamātrāṃ ca sudhāsūtre kamaṃḍalum \|\| 63 \|\|*

*tadvadgomithunaṃ sarvaṃ suvarṇāsyaṃ sitaṃ param \|*  
*savastrabhājanaṃ dattvā bhavānī prīyatāmiti \|\| 64 \|\|*

62-64. But when he is unable to do so, only a slight quantity of the same should be taken in the right palm and consumed. Thus, perfoming the vrata in an appropriate manner, again in the month of Magha, the earthen vase should be placed over the raw sugar. Then, a figure of Uma of the size of a thumb, made of gold, should be placed over it. With Sudha-sutra, kamandalu and gomithuna, with their faces made of gold and the body of white colour, should be offered the food in utensils and the fast observer should say- “Let the goddess Bhavani be pleased with me.” Then he should beg forgiveness.

## \|\| 3.26.65-66 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yaśca rasakalyāṇinīvratam \|*  
*kuryātsa sarvapāpebhyastatkṣaṇādeva mucyate \|\| 65 \|\|*

*bhavārbudasahasraṃ tu na duḥkhī jāyate kvacit \|*  
*agniṣṭomasahasreṇa yatphalaṃ tadavāpnuyāt \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. A person who thus concludes the Kalyani-vrata, he atonce is freed from all the sins. Thereafter, for a hundred, thousand and million years, he does not have to face the worldly miseries. To the contrary, he earns the merit of performing a thousand Agnistoma sacrifices.

## \|\| 3.26.67-68 \|\|

*nārī vā kurute yā tu kumārī vā yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*vidhavā vā varākī vā sāpi tatphalabhāginī \|*  
*saubhāgyārogyasaṃpannā gaurīloke mahīyate \|\| 67 \|\|*

*iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti prasaṃgātsakalakaluṣamuktaḥ pārvatīlokameti \|*  
*matimapi ca narāṇāṃ yo dadāti priyārthaṃ vipulamatijanānāṃ nāyakaḥ syādamogham \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. O Yudhisthira! Similarly, a woman, irrespective of her being a maiden, widow or a destitute who performs this vrata, or the one who reads or listens to the procedure of this vrata, she also attains the same merit. Achieving the fortunes and good health besides all the comforts in this world, at the time of her death getting relieved of all the sins, she achieves the abode of Parvati. Such of the people, who contribute to the performing of this vrata, become the leaders of the intelligent people.

## Chapter 27. Ardranandakari-Vrata described

## \|\| 3.27.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*tathā cānyāṃ pravakṣyāmi tṛtīyāṃ pāpanāśinīm \|*  
*lokeṣu nāmnā vikhyātāmārdrānaṃdakarīmimām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*yadā śuklatṛtīyāyāmāṣāḍharkṣaṃ bhavetkvacit \|*  
*brahmarkṣaṃ cātha mārgaṃ vā vrataṃ grāhyaṃ tadā śubham \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sri Krsna said - I am now discussing about the Trtiya which is the remover of all the sins and is known in the world as Ardranandakari, which has to be observed on the bright third day of the moon, Uttarasadha constellation, Brahma constellation or during the Mrgasira constellation. This vrata should be started on that particular time.

## \|\| 3.27.3 \|\|

*darbhagaṃdhodakaiḥ snānaṃ tadā samyaksamācaret \|*  
*śuklamālyāṃbaradharaḥ śuklagaṃdhānulepanaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. At that point of time, the performer of the vrata should take bath with water of kusa grass, should clad himself in the white costumes and plaster his body with the white paste (sandal paste).

## \|\| 3.27.4 \|\|

*bhavānīmarcayedbhaktyā śuklapuṣpaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ \|*  
*mahādevena sahitāmupaviṣṭāṃ varāsane \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Thereafter, he should offer with devotion fragrant white flowers to lord Mahadeva and the goddess Bhavani, who both should be seated over the excellent seat.

## \|\| 3.27.5 \|\|

*vāsudevyai namaḥ pādau śaṃkarāya namo hareḥ \|*  
*jaṃghe śokavināśinyāyānandāya namaḥ prabho \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Siva should be adored with the uttering of the mantra Vasudevyai namah, while uttering the mantra Sokavinasinyai anandayai namah the feet of the lord and the thigh of both of them should be touched.

## \|\| 3.27.6 \|\|

*raṃbhāyai pūjayedūrū śivāya ca pinākinaḥ \|*  
*ādityai ca kaṭiṃ pūjyā śūlinaḥ śūlapāṇaye \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Then uttering Rambhayai namah, the thighs should be touched; uttering Adityai Sulapanaye namah, the waist should be touched.

## \|\| 3.27.7 \|\|

*mādhavyai ca tathā nābhimatha śaṃbhorbhavāya vai \|*  
*stanāvānaṃdakāriṇyai śaṃkarāyeṃdudhāriṇe \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Then saying Madhavyai Bhavayai namah the navel should be touched; saying Anandakarinyai Sankarayendu namah the breast should be touched.

## \|\| 3.27.8 \|\|

*utkaṃṭhinyai namaḥ kaṃṭhaṃ nīlakaṃṭhāya vai hareḥ \|*  
*karāvutpaladhāriṇyai rudrāya jagatīpateḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Saying Utkanthinyai Nilakanthaya namah the neck is to be touched. Saying Utpaladharinyai Rudraya namah the hands should be touched.

## \|\| 3.27.9 \|\|

*bāhuṃ ca pariraṃbhiṇyai nṛtyaśīlāya vai hareḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. With Parirambhinyai nrtyasilaya namah, the arms should be touched. Saying Vilasinyai Vrsesaya namah, the mouth should be touched.

## \|\| 3.27.10-11 \|\|

*devyā mukhaṃ vilāsinyai vṛṣeśāya punarvibhoḥ \|*  
*smitaṃ sasmaraśīlāyai viśvavaktrāya vai vibhoḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*netraṃ madanavāsinyai viśvadhāmne triśūline \|*  
*bhruvau ratipriyāyai ca tāṃḍaveśāya vai vibhoḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Saying Sasma, asilayai Visvavaktraya namah and Madanavdsinyai Visvadhdmne namah, the eyes should be touched. Saying Ratipriyayai Tandavesaya namah, the eyebrows should be touched.

## \|\| 3.27.12 \|\|

*devyai lalāṭamiṃdrāṇyai havyavāhāya vai vibhoḥ \|*  
*svāhāyai mukuṭaṃ devyā vibhoḥ pañcaśarāya vai \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Then saying Indranyai Havyavahaya namah, the forehead should be touched. And by saying Svahayai Pancasaraya namah, the crown is to be touched and adored.

## \|\| 3.27.13 \|\|

*viśvakāyai viśvamukhyai viśvapādakarau śivau \|*  
*prasannavadanau vaṃde pārvatīparameśvarau \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thereafter, one should beg forgiveness saying- “O lord, having a body of the universal form, you are the foremost of the world. You are the form of the feet and the hands. You are the form of Siva and Siva. You have a delightful face, you are the lord of Parvati. I offer my salutation to you."

## \|\| 3.27.14-17 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadagrataḥ śivayoḥ punaḥ \|*  
*padmotpalāni ca tathā nānāvarṇāni kārayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*śaṅkhacakre sakaṭake svastikaṃ varddha mānakam \|*  
*gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*śṛṃgodakaṃ bilvapatraṃ vāri kuṃbhānvitaṃ tathā \|*  
*uśīranīraṃ tadvacca yavacūrṇodakaṃ tataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tilodakaṃ ca saṃprāpya svapyānmārgaśirādiṣu \|*  
*pratipakṣadvitīyāyāṃ prāśanaṃ samudāhṛtam \|\| 17 \|\|*

14-17. Thus concluding the worship appropriately, several types of red lotus and blue lotus flowers should be offered. Then, he should be decorated with conch, disc, bracelet, bangles, Svastika symbol and other means. Then, the cow’s urine, cowdung, curd, ghi, kusa water, horn’s water, wood apple leaves, a pitcher filled with water, fragrant water of khas with Jaya powder and water mixed with sesamum seeds should be offered during the months of Margasirsa and other months regularly. These have been prescribed on the second moon day of each month for the braking of the fast.

## \|\| 3.27.18-19 \|\|

*sarvatra śuklapuṣpāṇi praśastāni śivārcane \|*  
*dānakāleṣu sarveṣu maṃtrametamudīrayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

*gaurī me prīyatāṃ nityamaghanāśāya maṃgalā \|*  
*saubhāgyāyāstu lalitā bhavānī sarvasiddhaye \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Only the white flowers are considered to be more auspicious in the worship of lord Siva. At the time of giving away the charities, the mantra which should be recited would be as follows : “Let the goddess Gauri always remain happy with me. Similarly, the goddess Mangala, the goddess Lalita for fortunes and Bhavani be pleased with me for all the success.”

## \|\| 3.27.20-21 \|\|

*saṃvatsarāṃte lavaṇaṃ guḍakuṃbhaṃ samarjitam \|*  
*candanaṃ netrapaṭṭaṃ ca sitavastrayugānvitam \|*  
*umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ tadvadikṣuphalairyutam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*prastarāvaraṇaṃ śayyāṃ saviśrāmāṃ nivedayet \|*  
*sapatnīkāya viprāya gaurī me prīyatāmiti \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. At the end of the year, the salt, pitcher filled with sugarcane balls, sandal paste, fine cloth and four white costumes should be offered to the gold images of Uma and Mahesvara. Besides, they should be made to rest over a well arranged bed, which should ultimately be given over to a Brahmana. One should say- “Let the goddess Gauri be pleased with me.”

## \|\| 3.27.22-23 \|\|

*ārdrānandakarī nāma tṛtīyaiṣā sanātanī \|*  
*yāmupoṣya naro yāti śaṃbhostatparamaṃ padam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*iha loke yamānaṃdaṃ prāpnoti dhanasaṃcayāt \|*  
*āyurārogyasaṃpanno na kiñcicchokamāpnuyāt \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. The Sanatani Trtiya is considered to be the blissful one, during which while fasting, a person achieves the auspicious place of Siva. Besides, earning the enough of riches, he feels delighted throughout the life and free of ailments. During his life, such a person does not have to suffer from any grief.

## \|\| 3.27.24 \|\|

*nārī vā kurute yā tu kumārī vidhavā tathā \|*  
*sāpi tatphalamāpnoti devyanugrahalālitā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. A woman, irrespective of her being married, a widow or an unwed girl, with the performing of this vrata, with the grace of the goddess, gets all the merits.

## \|\| 3.27.25-26 \|\|

*pratipakṣamupoṣyaivaṃ maṃtrārcanavidhānataḥ \|*  
*rudrāṇīlokamāpnoti punarāvṛttivarjitam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayedvāpi mānavaḥ \|*  
*śakraloke sagaṃdharvaiḥ pūjyate'bdaśatatrayam \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Similarly, in each fortnight, while fasting, when the vrata is performed with the reciting of the mantras, the performer achieves the abode of Rudrani where after one’s arrival, he does not have to drink the water. Such of the person who listens or recites the story of this vrata, he lives in Indraloka for three hundred years, getting worshipped by the Gandharvas as well as the Apsaras.

## \|\| 3.27.27 \|\|

*ānaṃdadāṃ sakaladuḥkhaharāṃ tṛtīyāṃ yā strī karoti vidhivatsadhavādhavā ca \|*  
*sā sve gṛhe sukhaśatānyanubhūya bhūyo gaurīpuraṃ sadayitā muditā prayāti \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. This trtiya is blissful and relieves one of all the miseries and a woman who performs the vrata in a proper manner, she achieves all the comforts in her house. At the time of her death, she delightfully proceeds to the abode of Gauri.

## Chapter 28. Description of the months of Caitra, Bhadrapada and Magha

## \|\| 3.28.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*caitre bhādrapade māghe rūpasaubhāgya putradam \|*  
*tṛtīyātrayametanme kṛṣṇa kasmānna kīrtitam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kimahaṃ bhaktirahitastrayīmārgātigo naraḥ \|*  
*suprasiddhaṃ jagatyetadgopitaṃ kena hetunā \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- There are three trtiyas of the months of Caitra, Bhadrapada and Magha, which are said to be quite auspicious and bestower of the sons. They have not been described by you. Have you thought me to be a person who moves contrary to the path of the Vedas, devoid of devotion and the one who moves in an adverse way? In case, it is not so, then you according to my understanding, are favourable to all, besides being the omniscient. Therefore, you kindly tell me as to how the trtiya became so famous in the world?

## \|\| 3.28.3-4 \|\|

*bhavānsarvārthānukūlaḥ sarvajña iti me matiḥ \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*vrataṃ caitajjagatkhyātaṃ nākhyātaṃ tena te mayā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*yadyasti śravaṇe buddhiḥ śrūyatāṃ pāṇḍunandana \|*  
*ko'nyaḥ śrotā jagatyasminbhavatā sadṛśo bhuvi \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Sri Krsna said- This vrata is quite well known in the world. Therefore, I did not describe it. In case, you are desirous of listening to the same, then I am going to narrate the same. You please listen. Because in this world, there is no listener better than you.

## \|\| 3.28.5-6 \|\|

*jayā ca vijayā caiva umāyāḥ paricārike \|*  
*āgatya munikanyābhiḥ pṛṣṭebhīṣṭaphalecchayā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*bhavatyau sarvadā devyāścittavṛttividau kila \|*  
*kena vratopacāreṇa kasminnahani pārvatī \|*  
*pūjitā tuṣṭimabhyeti maṃtrai kaiśca varānane \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Once Jaya and Vijaya, the two attendants of the goddess Uma asked the daughters of the sages- “O damsels, we wish to get our desires fulfilled. You are aware of the mental condition of both the goddesses. Therefore, you kindly tell me, with the performing of which one of the vrata or worshipping and on which day, the goddess Parvati gets pleased and grants the desired wish. Besides which one is the related mantra to be recited for this purpose?”

## \|\| 3.28.7 \|\|

*tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jayā provāca sādaram \|*  
*śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi sarvakāmaphalapradam \|*  
*vratamutsavasaṃyuktaṃ naranārī manoramam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Listening to the words of the daughters of Rsis, Jaya spoke to them with respect- “I am going to speak out about the vrata, which when performed with festivities, fulfills all the desire of the man and woman. This is quite pleasant as well.”

## \|\| 3.28.8 \|\|

*caitre sitatṛtīyāyāṃ dantadhāvanapūrvakam \|*  
*upavāsasya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyādbhaktibhāvitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. On the bright third moon day of the month of Caitra, one should clean his teeth with tooth stick and after doing so, a person should start following the rules for the performing of the vrata.

## \|\| 3.28.9-15 \|\|

*sakuṃkumaṃ satāṃbūlaṃ sindūraṃ raktavāsasī \|*  
*vidhavā sopavāsāpyavaidhavyakaraṇaṃ param \|\| 9 \|\|*

*vidhavā yāti mārgeṇa kumārī tu yadṛcchayā \|*  
*kuryādabhyarcanavidhiṃ śrūyatāṃ maṃtravikramaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*netrapaṭṭapaṭīvastrairvastramaṇḍapikāṃ śubhām \|*  
*kārayetkusumāmodadivyābharaṇabhūṣitām \|\| 11 \|\|*

*pravālalaṃbitavrātāmaṃtardivyavitānikām \|*  
*vinyastapūrṇakalaśāṃ satpīṭhasthāpitadvijām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*purataḥ kārayetkuṇḍaṃ hastamātraṃ samekhalam \|*  
*tataḥ snātānuliptāṃ ca paridhāya suvāsasī \|\| 13 \|\|*

*devānpitṝnsamabhyarcya tato devīgṛhaṃ vrajet \|*  
*nāmāṣṭakena saṃpūjyā gaurī gopativallabhā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tatkālaprabhavaiḥ puṣpairgandhāli bakulākulaiḥ \|*  
*kuṃkumena samālabhya karpūrāgurucandanaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

9-15. Thereafter, getting free from the bath and other daily routines, offering vermilion, betel, saffron and two red costumes, the goddess should be worshipped. A widow should also worship the goddess like the married ladies. You listen. I shall also speak out the process for the use of the mantras. Initially, a fine cloth and four other costumes should be set apart for the worship of the goddess. The goddess should then be lodged over a beautiful pedestal in a mandala which should be decorated with coral on all the sides. A divine canopy should also be provided inside, which should be decorated with a pitcher filled with water. The figures of Siva and Siva should be placed over a lion throne. The fragrant flowers and divine ornaments should be offered to both of them. A kunda of a cubit in size should be made in front of them, which should be decorated with the chains. Thereafter, the performer should take bath and after performing all the essential duties, should complete the worship of the gods and the pitrs. Then he should wear the auspicious and clean costumes and then present himself for the service of the goddess. With a stable mind, he should appear before lord Siva’s beloved who should be worshipped offering the fragrance, bunches of flowers of bakula, saffron, camphor, agaru and sandal paste.

## \|\| 3.28.16 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatsaddhūpenādhivāsayet \|*  
*pārvatī lalitā gaurī gāṃdhārī śāṅkarī śivā \|*  
*umā satī samuddiṣṭaṃ nāmāṣṭakamidaṃ mayā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. She should then be worshipped appropriately. Offering the incense, their adhivasana should be done. At the time of worship, the eight names of the goddess, viz., Parvati, Lalita, Gauri, Gandhari, Lankan, Siva, Uma and Sati should be uttered.

## \|\| 3.28.17-18 \|\|

*laḍḍukaiḥ khaṇḍaveṣṭaiśca guḍakaiḥ siṃhakesaraiḥ \|*  
*somālakaiḥ kokasaraiḥ khaṇḍakhādyakaraṃbakaiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*ghṛtapakvairbahuvidhaiḥ supakvaphalakalpitaiḥ \|*  
*dṛṣṭiprāṇaharairhṛdyairnnaivedyaiḥ prīṇayedumām \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Then sweet balls, sweets made in jaggery, Simhakesara, Somala, Kokasara, saffron, Karambaka and the ripe fruits should be offered, besides preparations in ghi for the purpose of food should be offered. These should be so sweet that with the mere sight of them one gets confused. These should then be offered to Uma.

## \|\| 3.28.19-22 \|\|

*kaṭukhaṃḍaṃ jīrakaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ lavaṇārdrakam \|*  
*ikṣudaṃḍānaikṣavaṃ ca haridrārdrānpuro nyaset \|\| 19 \|\|*

*nārikelānāmalakānmātuluṃgānsadāḍimān \|*  
*kūṣmāṇḍakarkaṭīvṛṃtanāraṅgapanasādikān \|\| 20 \|\|*

*kālodbhavāni cānyāni phalāni vinivedayet \|*  
*gṛhādyulūkhalaśilāśūrpānpraṇatibhiḥ saha \|\| 21 \|\|*

*netrāṃjanaśalākāśca nakhare canakāni ca \|*  
*darpaṇaṃ vaṃśapātrāṇi bhavānyai vinivedayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. Thereafter, Katu-khanda, cumin seeds, saffron and the stuff soaked with salt, besides the stuff soaked with turmeric powder, sugarcane and its balls, in addition to the myrobalan, citron, lemon, pomegranate, pumpkin, gourd, orange, jack fruit and other fruits of the season, should be offered to the Siva and Siva with respect. The mortar and pestle, sesamum seeds, collyrium stick and the things for the painting of the nails, the mirror and the vases of the bamboos for collection of flowers (like baskets), all these items should be offered to lord Siva and Siva, after making salutation to the Sungod.

## \|\| 3.28.23-25 \|\|

*śaṃkhatūryaninādena gītamaṅgalanisvanaiḥ \|*  
*bhaktyā saṃpūjayeddevīṃ svaśaktyā śivavallabhām \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tato'stasamaye bhānoḥ kumāryaḥ karakairnavaiḥ \|*  
*snānaṃ kuryurmudā yuktāḥ saubhāgyārogyavṛddhaye \|\| 24 \|\|*

*yāmeyāme gate snānaṃ devīpūjanameva ca \|*  
*taireva nāmabhirhomastilājyena praśasyate \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. With one’s mind having been filled with devotion, according to one’s own means, at the time of the worship of the goddess Parvati, the conch, trumpet or bugle, should be sounded besides singing and producing other auspicious sounds. After the sunset, the unwedded girls, for the increase of their fortunes and good health, should take bath and with the break of a prahara, the worship of the goddess should be done. Thereafter, the homa with ghi and sesamum seeds should be performed uttering the same names of the goddesses (as pointed out above).

## \|\| 3.28.26 \|\|

*padmāsanasthitā sādhvī tenaivārdreṇa vāsasā \|*  
*gaurīmukhekṣaṇaparā tāṃ rātrimativāhayet \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The chaste woman, wearing the wet clothes, should be seated cross-legged in padmasana, fixing her gaze at the face of Gauri for the whole night, which is said to be quite beneficial.

## \|\| 3.28.27-29 \|\|

*kāścidvādyaṃti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ kāścinnṛtyaṃti harṣitāḥ \|*  
*kathayaṃti kathāḥ kāściddevyāstatra mahotsave \|\| 27 \|\|*

*gītatālānu saṃbaddhamanuddhatamanākulam \|*  
*nṛtyaṃti sma pure devyāḥ kāścidullasitabhruvaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*nṛtyena hṛṣyati haro gaurī gītena tuṣyati \|*  
*sadbhāvenātha vā sarve gacchaṃti paramāṃ mudam \|\| 29 \|\|*

27-29. During that particular night, on the eve of the festivities, a woman should delightfully play on musical instruments, or dance and the others can recite their sacred stories. The tune and sound of the songs should be peaceful and stable at the start. Some of the damsels can also dance with music before the goddess displaying various poses of dance, because dancing and singing is extremely liked by Siva and Gauri. At the same time, because of the good will, remaining awake is also preferred.

## \|\| 3.28.30-31 \|\|

*suvāsinībhyastāṃbūlaṃ kuṃkumaṃ kusumāni ca \|*  
*pradeyaṃ jāgaravatyā cānyeṣāmapi kiṃcana \|\| 30 \|\|*

*naṭairviṭairbhaṭaiścaiva tathā prekṣaṇakotsavaiḥ \|*  
*sakhibhiḥ sahitā rātriṃ gāyanṛtyanhitāṃ nayet \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. It would also be proper to distribute betel, vermilion and excellent flowers to the ladies with fortunes (having their husbands alive), besides the other unmarried girls. The actors, gestures, warriors and other people, besides the maids could join the dance and music and songs, which could continue for the whole night.

## \|\| 3.28.32 \|\|

*evaṃ prabhātasamaye snātvā saṃpūjya pārvatīm \|*  
*tato vai sā samārohedvastrālaṃkṛtatoraṇam \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The next morning, after taking the bath, the goddess Parvati should be duly worshipped placing her image fully decorated over a scat decorated with a torana.

## \|\| 3.28.33-35 \|\|

*tolayetsā tathāsīnaṃ guḍena lavaṇena ca \|*  
*kuṃkumenātha vā śaktyā karpūrāgarucaṃdanaiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*parvatānāmapicchedaiḥ kecidicchaṃti sūrayaḥ \|*  
*kuṃḍamaṃḍapasaṃbhārairmaṃtraistatraiva śobhayet \|\| 34 \|\|*

*lavaṇena sahātmā hi tolyate ca guḍena vā \|*  
*kayāpi bhaktiparayā saubhāgyamatulīkṛtam \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. Thereafter, with the salt, sugarcane balls, vermilion, camphor, agaru, sandal paste, she should be weighed in a scale. Some learned people have prescribed to weigh the goddess with the pieces of stone of the mountains. The decorated kunda and the canopy should be decorated with reciting of the mantras and the weighing should be done with salt or the sugarcane balls. Some of the ladies, who are the best among the devotees, weigh themselves with the above articles or with the Saubhagyastaka.

## \|\| 3.28.36-37 \|\|

*evaṃ devīṃ praṇamyāryāṃ kṣamāpya gṛhamāviśet \|*  
*āmaṃtrya śāstrakuśalānācāravidhipāragān \|\| 36 \|\|*

*annaṃ ca madhuraprāyaṃ bhojayitvā suvāsinīḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ bhuṃjīta sahasā jñātījanabudhaiḥ svakaiḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Thus offering salutation to the Arya Devi, one should beg forgiveness. Thereafter, reaching one’s home, the sweet dishes should be served to the fortunate ladies (whose husbands are alive). They should be fully satisfied. Then she should take food with relatives.

## \|\| 3.28.38-39 \|\|

*yacca devyāḥ puro dattaṃ naive dyādi tadicchayā \|*  
*gṛhaṃ pratinayetsarvaṃ vibhajyābhrāṃtimānasā \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tato dadyādgṛhasthebhyaḥ kṛtakṛtyā bhavettadā \|*  
*vidhirbhādrapade'pyeṣa susaundaryapradāyakaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Such of the objects which are offered to the goddess, should be carried home and should then be divided and distributed to all the householders, with a purified mind. By so doing, the lady who does so, becomes fully successful. During the vrata of Bhadrapada, this beautiful process has been prescribed.

## \|\| 3.28.40 \|\|

*saptadhānyasvarūpāṃ ca śūrpe saṃpūjayedumām \|*  
*gomūtraprāśanaṃ hyatra tena gomūtrasaṃjñitā \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. In this process, the figure of Uma in seven cereals is placed in a winnowing basket and is then required to be worshipped. After the conclusion of the vrata, the fast is to be broken with the use of cow’s urine.

## \|\| 3.28.41-42 \|\|

*māghamāsatṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣaḥ śrūyatāmiti \|*  
*pūrvoktaṃ sakalaṃ kṛtvā prabhāte yavasaṃstaram \|*  
*tolayitvā kuṃdapuṣpaiḥ pūjayettatsutāmiti \|\| 41 \|\|*

*etena kāraṇenoktā caturthī kundasaṃjñayā \|*  
*tṛtīyākhyaṃ mayaitatte kathitaṃ sarvakāraṇam \|*  
*jayayā munikanyānāṃ yatpurā samudāhṛtam \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. I am now highlighting the special nature of the month of Magha. After completing all the aforesaid activities, she should be weighted with barley and then offering the lily flowers, the goddess Gauri should be worshipped. Because of this, the fourth moon day has been termed as kunda or lily. In this way, for the daughters of the sages, I have revealed all the details spoken by Jaya.

## \|\| 3.28.43-45 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*āsīdvidarbhanagare veśyā sarvāṃgasuṃdarī \|*  
*tayā brāhmaṇavākyena sarvametatkṛtaṃ purā \|\| 43 \|\|*

*bhuktvā bhogānmahīpṛṣṭhe dattvā dānaṃ yathepsayā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*kālena samanuprāptā maraṇaṃ manujeśvara \|*  
*acintyā rājaduhitā sā babhūvātiśobhanā \|*  
*avaṃtisundarī nāma devānāmapi sundarī \|\| 45 \|\|*

43-45. Sri Krsna said- In the city of Vidarbha, there once lived a beautiful whore, obeying to the command of a Brahmana and observing this vrata in an appropriate manner. O lord of the people, giving the desired charities on the earth, she enjoyed all the pleasures. On her death in due course of time, she was bom as an extremely beautiful princess. She was even more beautiful than the gods. Her name was known as Av antisundarl.

## \|\| 3.28.46-47 \|\|

*yadi vaktrasahasrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ syātkathaṃcana \|*  
*tathāpi nirvarṇayitumaśakyā sā sulocanā \|\| 46 \|\|*

*caitratṛtīyāmāhātmyātsā babhūva prabhāvatī \|*  
*mātāpitroratipreṣṭhā śiṣṭā nyajanavallabhā \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. No one was in a position to describe about her beauty. So much so, that in case the thousand headed serpent Siva could get another thousand hoods, even then he would be unable to describe the beauty of the princess with beautiful eyes. By processing the anusthana of the trtiya of the month of Caitra, she possessed the enormous lustre. For her parents, she was the living image of love. She was equally loveable for the other people as well.

## \|\| 3.28.48 \|\|

*labdhābdhisaṃbhavā yadvatkṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā \|*  
*tataḥ sā bubhuje bhogānbhartrā sārddhaṃ mudā satī \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. As Laksmi - the daughter of the ocean, after achieving Sri Krsna as her spouse, had enjoyed all the pleasures, similarly, that princess enjoyed all the pleasures with her husband.

## \|\| 3.28.49-50 \|\|

*yadadādbrāhmaṇebhyaḥ sā bhūṣaṇaṃ kaṭakādikam \|*  
*tatprabhāveṇa sā lebhe saubhāgyaṃ kiṃ tataḥ param \|\| 49 \|\|*

*putrāṃśca janayāmāsa viṣṇuśakraparākramān \|*  
*sarvāstraśastrakuśalā nvedoktavidhipāragān \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. She had given over all her ornaments to the Brahmanas in charity, with the influence of which she gave birth to powerful sons, who were strong like Visnu and Indra and who were well-versed in the use of all the weapons and the provisions of the Vedas.

## \|\| 3.28.51 \|\|

*evaṃ rūpaṃ mahatprāpya saubhāgyaṃ putrasaṃpadam \|*  
*bhartrā sahaiva maraṇamaṃte prāpya pativratā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Thus, she had beauty beyond limit, great fortunes, several sons and after making use of the entire treasures, she met with a timely death with her husband in due time.

## \|\| 3.28.52 \|\|

*śakrādilokapā lānāṃ bhavaneṣu yathākramam \|*  
*ākramya brahmalokaṃ ca jagāma śivasātmatām \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Thereafter, living in the abodes of the Lokapalas like Indra and others, she finally achieved Brahmaloka and ultimately achieved the moksa of Siva.

## \|\| 3.28.53 \|\|

*evaṃ yānyāpi kurute nārī vratamidaṃ śubham \|*  
*sā rūpasaubhāgyasutānprāpya svarge mahīyate \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Similarly, any other woman who performs this auspicious vrata, she also achieves beauty, fortunes and sons on earth and great glory in the heaven.

## \|\| 3.28.54-55 \|\|

*na durbhagā kule tasyāḥ kācidbhavati kanyakā \|*  
*na durvinītaśca suto na bhṛtyo'priyakṛdbhavet \|\| 54 \|\|*

*na dāridryaṃ gṛhe tasminna vyādhirupajāyate \|*  
*yatra sā ramate sādhvī dhmātacāmīkaraprabhā \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. No unfortunate daughter is bom in her race, nor an undisciplined son. She also does not have a servant with a foul tongue. The poverty cannot live in her house, nor can a disease enter her house. No one attracts illness in her family. The palace in which the chaste lady lives, has the lustre of molten gold.

## \|\| 3.28.56-57 \|\|

*anyāśca yāścariṣyaṃti brāhmaṇānumate vratam \|*  
*saṃpūjya vācakaṃ bhaktyā bhūṣaṇācchādanādibhiḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*tāḥ sarvasukhasaṃpannā avipannamanorathāḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyaṃti kuruśreṣṭha tasyai devi namostu te \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. The woman, who accepting the words of the Brahmanas, performs this vrata with devotion and also gives away the orator the gold ornaments and costumes, she becomes successful, enjoying all the pleasures. Salutation to such a lady again and again.

## \|\| 3.28.58 \|\|

*māghe mahārghyamaṇimaṃḍitapādapīṭhāṃ caitre vicitrakusumotkaracarcitāṃgīm \|*  
*śūrpaprarūḍhanavasasyamayīṃ nabhasye saṃpūjya śaṃbhudayitāṃ prabhavaṃti nāryaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Thus, the goddess during the month of Magha, adorned with all the ornaments, is seated over the throne studded with precious gems. Then adorned with flowers and scents during the month of Bhadrapada, the form of growing of the fresh cereals is taken by the goddess. Such a spouse of Siva, in case is adored in the aforesaid manner, it proves to be extremely beneficial.

## Chapter 29. Anantarya Trtiya Vrata

## \|\| 3.29.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*śuklapakṣatṛtīyāstu bahavaḥ samudāhṛtāḥ \|*  
*ānantaryavrataṃ brūhi tṛtīyobhayasaṃyutam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*hitāya sarvabhūtānāṃ lalanānāṃ viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*nāma prāśananaivedyairmāsimāsi pṛthakpṛthaka \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- You have mentioned about several vratas relating to the trtiya of the bright fortnight, but now you enlighten me about the Anantarya vrata, which is performed in a combined manner on the second and the third moon days and benefits all the living beings, particularly the ladies. It’s names during each one of the months and the mode of the breaking of the fast during each month may also kindly be stated, besides the eatables to be offered on each one of the occasions.

## \|\| 3.29.3-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyairyathoktaṃ surasattamaiḥ \|*  
*apūrvaṃ sarvamaṃtrāṇāmānaṃtaryavrataṃ śṛṇu \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ādau mārgaśire māsi vratametatsamācaret \|*  
*naktaṃ kuryāddvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmupoṣitā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*umāṃ devīṃ samabhyarcya puṣpagaṃdhādibhiḥ kramāt \|*  
*śarkarāputrikāṃ śaktyā praṇipatya nivedayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Sri Krsna said- The manner in which the excellent gods like Brahma, Visnu and Mahesvara have described vrata, which is also unprecedented with the use of various mantras, I am going to describe the same Anantarya vrata. You please listen to the same attentively. At the start of the month of Margasirsa, this vrata should be started. On the second moon day, one should keep a fast during the night. The fast should be observed on the third moon day as well and the flowers, fragrance should be offered to the goddess Uma, while worshipping her. Her image of sugar should be made. Then the salutation should be offered to her.

## \|\| 3.29.6 \|\|

*saṃprāśya dadhi rātrau ca svapyādvigatamatsarā \|*  
*prabhāte vidhivadbhaktyā mithunaṃ bhojayetsudhīḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Then prayer should be offered to the goddess and the vrata should be broken by consuming the curd. Thereafter, the devotee should sleep peacefully during the night. On the next morning, a Brahmana couple should be invited and served with delicious food.

## \|\| 3.29.7-8 \|\|

*aśvamedhamavāpnoti samagraṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā jitendriyā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*japetkātyāyanīṃ nāma nāli keraṃ nivedayet \|*  
*svapyātprāśya payo rātrau kāmakrodhavivarjitā \|*  
*dāṃpatyaṃ subhagaṃ bhojyaṃ gomedhaphalamāpnuyāt \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. The person who does so earns the merit of the Asvamedha sacrifice, there is no doubt about it. Similarly, on the black third day of the moon, one should perform the vrata by controlling all his senses and the goddess Katyayani should be worshipped, performing the japam.
