Then offering the coconut, the fast should been broken at night by consuming the payasam. Thereafter, freeing himself of passions and anger, one should go to sleep. Subsequently, in the early morning, the most fortunate Brahmana couple should be served with tasty food and a person who does so, he earns the merit of a Gomedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.29.9 \|\|

*pauṣasyāditṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā jitendriyā \|*  
*gaurīṃ nāma tu saṃpūjya laḍḍukānvinivedayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. At the start of the month of Pausa on the third moon day, one should observe the vrata controlling all the senses. Then after worshipping the goddess Gauri, the sweet balls should be offered to her.

## \|\| 3.29.10-11 \|\|

*svapyātprāśya ghṛtaṃ rātrau tyaktvā kāmaṃ tadagrataḥ \|*  
*prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ naramedhaphalaṃ bhavet \|\| 10 \|\|*

*evaṃ kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ pārvatīmiti pūjayet \|*  
*nivedayānnaṃ śaṣkulyo gomayaṃ prāśayenniśi \|*  
*dāṃpatyaṃ vividhaṃ bhojyama śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. During the night, he should break the fast by eating the ghi. Thereafter, freeing himself of all the passions, he should sleep before the image of the goddess on the floor. On the dark third moon day of the month of Pausa, after worshipping the goddess Parvati, the fried cake should be offered to the couple. He should spend the night by tasting the cowdung. Again in the morning, the excellent couple should be served the food to their liking and one who does so earns the merit of performing the Asvamedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.29.12 \|\|

*māghasya śuklapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyāmupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*suranāyikāṃ ca saṃpūjya khaṇḍabilvaṃ nivedayet \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. On the bright third moon day of the month of Magha, one should observe the fast and should worship the goddess named Suranayika. To her, the sweet part of the wood apple fruit should be offered.

## \|\| 3.29.13 \|\|

*tataḥ kuśodakaṃ prāśya svapyādbhūmau jitendriyā \|*  
*prabhāte madhurānnena mithunaṃ bhojya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*kṣamāpyāṃte namaskṛtya iti svarṇaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The fast should then be broken with the kusa water. Then controlling all the sense organs, one should sleep over the floor before the goddess. During the next morning, an auspicious Brahmana couple should be served with sweet food with devotion pleasing them at the same time. Then begging forgiveness, salutation should be offered to both of them. A person who does so achieves the gold as reward.

## \|\| 3.29.14-15 \|\|

*punaretattato māghe kṛṣṇapakṣe śucivratā \|*  
*āryāṃ nāmnā prapūjyātha khādyakāni nivedayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*madhu prāśya svapedrātrau kāmakrodhavivarjitā \|*  
*mithunaṃ bhojayitvā tu vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Then on the dark third moon day of the month of Magha, getting purified and observing the vrata, the goddess Arya should be worshipped. Thereafter, the extremely tasteful eatables should be presented before the goddess and the fast should be broken by consuming the honey. During the night, he should sleep disowning passions and the anger. During the next morning, a Brahmana couple should be served food, pleasing them at the same time and one who does so, he earns the merit of performing a Vajapeya sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.29.16 \|\|

*evaṃ vai phālgune māsi sopavāsā śucivratā \|*  
*bhadrīṃ nāma prapūjyātha kāsāraṃ vinivedayet \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Similarly, during the month of Phalguna, one should perform the fast with purity and the goddess Bhadri should be worshipped and served with the wheat meal fried with ghi and mixed with sugar (kan sara).

## \|\| 3.29.17 \|\|

*suprāśya śarkarāṃ cātha svapyādrātrau vimatsarā \|*  
*prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ sautrāmaṇiphalaṃ labheta \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Then the fast should be broken by consuming the sugar. Then he should sleep during the night with comfort. During the next morning, he should serve food to a Brahmana couple. A person, who does so, earns the merit of performing the Sautramani sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.29.18 \|\|

*punaḥ kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ phālgunasyaiva bhārata \|*  
*viśālākṣīṃ samabhyarcya pūrikā vinivedayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О Bharata, on the third black moon day of the month of Phalguna, the goddess VisalaksI should be worshipped, after which the fried cakes should be offered to her.

## \|\| 3.29.19 \|\|

*sodakāṃstaṃḍulāndattvā svapyādbhūmau manasvinī \|*  
*bhojayenmithunaṃ prātaragniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Thereafter, the water and the unbroken rice should be given in charity and then the strong minded lady should go to sleep and spend the night. In the early morning, a Brahmana couple should be served with food and the one who does so achieves the merit of performing the Agnistoma sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.29.20-21 \|\|

*caitrasyāditṛtīyāyāṃ śucirbhūtā jitendriyā \|*  
*śriyaṃ devīṃ yajedbhaktyā vaṭakānvinivedayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

*bilvapatraṃ tataḥ prāśya svapyāddhyāna parāyaṇā \|*  
*prātarutthāya madbhaktyā mithunaṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ \|*  
*praṇipatya kṣamāpyaivaṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. During the bright third moon day of the month of (Caitra, with all the purity and controlling all the senses, the goddess 3rl should be worshipped with devotion and the fruit of the Indian fig tree should be offered with worship. During the night, the fast should be broken eating wood apple leaves and then she should go to sleep during the night. On next morning, with one’s mind devoted to me, a Brahmana couple should be worshipped, after finishing the food and offering salutation, one should beg forgiveness and by so doing, a person earns the merit of Rajasuya sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.29.22-23 \|\|

*punaḥ kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ caitre samyagupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*kālīṃ nāma samabhyarcya piṣṭaṃ prāśya svapenniśi \|\| 22 \|\|*

*pūpakāni nivedyātha kuryādrātrau prajāgaram \|*  
*mithunāni ca saṃbhojya atirātraphalaṃ bhavet \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Similarly, on the dark third moon day of the month of Caitra, worshipping the goddess Kali, she should perform the fast properly. The fast should be broken at night by consuming the pudding. During the night, sweet cakes should be offered to the goddess. On the next morning, a Brahmana couple should be served with food, which yields the merit of the performing of the Atiratra sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.29.24-25 \|\|

*evaṃ vaiśākhamāse tu sopavāsā jitendriyā \|*  
*pūjayeccaṇḍikāṃ devīṃ madhukāni nivedayet \|\| 24 \|\|*

*śrīkhaṃḍaṃ caṃdanaṃ liptvā svapyāddevyagrato bhuvi \|*  
*bhojayitvā ca dāṃpatyaṃ cāṃdrāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. While fasting in the month of Vaisakha, a person, controlling all his sense organs, should worship the goddess Candika. He should then offer her sweets and honey. Then he should apply the sandal paste over his body and should sleep on the ground before her during the whole night. During the next morning, a Brahmana couple should be served with food and by so doing, the performer achieves the merit of performing the Candrayana vrata.

## \|\| 3.29.26-27 \|\|

*tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā vimatsarā \|*  
*pūjayetkālarātriṃ tu gandhapuṣpaiḥ sadīpakaiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*surājyaṃ yāvakaṃ dattvā tilānbhuṃjansvapenniśi \|*  
*prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyama tikṛcchraphalaṃ labhet \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. On the black third moon day of the month of Vaisakha, observing the fast with a pure mind, the goddess Kalaratri has to be worshipped with pure mind, offering fragrant flowers, incense, lamp, cumin seeds, drinks and ghi. The fast during the night should be broken consuming the sesamum and observing self control, one should then go to sleep. Again in the morning time, a Brahmana couple should be served with food. By so doing, one gets the merit of performing the Krcchra Candrayana vrata.

## \|\| 3.29.28 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhe sitatṛtīyāyāṃ hyupavāsakṛtāṃ varā \|*  
*śubhāṃ devīṃ samabhyarcya āmrāṇi vinivedayet \|*  
*saṃprāśyāmalakaṃ rātrau gaurīṃ dhyātvā sukhaṃ svapet \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. On the bright third day of the moon in the month of Jyestha, one should observe the fast and worship the goddess Subha. Then the mangoes should be offered to her. The fast should be broken at night by consuming of myrobalan fruit. Thereafter, devoting one’s mind towards the goddess Gauri, the night should be spent with comfort.

## \|\| 3.29.29 \|\|

*tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya daṃpatī rūpaśālinau \|*  
*bhojayitvā vidhānena tīrthayātrāphalaṃ labhet \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Subsequently in the morning, a beautiful Brahmana couple should be invited and adored. The food should then be served to both of them in a proper manner and by so doing, one achieves the merit of visiting a place of pilgrimage.

## \|\| 3.29.30-31 \|\|

*punaḥ kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā suvāsinī \|*  
*skandamāteti saṃpūjya iḍāyai vinivedayet \|\| 30 \|\|*

*prāśayetpaṃcagavyañca svapyāddevyagratastataḥ \|*  
*prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ kanyādānaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. Again on the dark third moon day of the same month, observing the fast, the mother of Skanda should be worshipped. The fast shall then be broken with the consuming of pancagavya and the devotee should sleep in front of the image of the goddess. Again in the morning, a Brahmana couple should be served the food and by so doing, one achieves the reward of giving away his daughter in marriage.

## \|\| 3.29.32 \|\|

*āṣāḍhamāse saṃprāpte pūjayecca yaśodhanam \|*  
*karaṃjakaṃ ca naivedyaṃ gośṛṃgāṃbhaḥ pibenniśi \|*  
*prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ kanyādānaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. On the third moon day of the month of Asadha, the goddess named Yasodha should be worshipped, offering her the fruits of karanja tree. Then the fast may be broken with the water of the hom and then spend the night Then in the morning, when the food is served to a Brahmana couple, one earns the merit of giving away a daughter in marriage.

## \|\| 3.29.33-34 \|\|

*tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ kūṣmāṃḍīṃ śaktito yajet \|*  
*saktūnguḍājyasaṃmuktānpurato vinivedayet \|\| 33 \|\|*

*kuśodakaṃ ca saṃprāśya svapyādrātrau jitendriyā \|*  
*prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ gosahasraphalaṃ labhet \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. Similarly, on the black third moon day, one should adore the goddess Kusmanda as per his means, offering her the powder of parched grain, sugarcane balls and ghi. The fast should be broken with the water of kusa grass. Then he should sleep controlling all the senses, during the night. In the next morning, a Brahmana couple should be served with food, which would yield him the merit of donating a thousand cows.

## \|\| 3.29.35-36 \|\|

*śrāvaṇe sopavāsā ca caṃḍāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ prapūjayet \|*  
*kulmāṣāstatra naivedyaṃ pibetpuṣpodakaṃ punaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*prabhāte śaktito dadyādbhojanaṃ mithunasya tu \|*  
*prāpnotyabhayadānasya phalaṃ naivātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. On the third bright moon day of the month of Sravana, the goddess Canda with a bell held in her hand, should be worshipped. Besides other eatables, the black gram should also be offered to the goddess. During the night, the fast should be broken with the offer of flowers. Then one should go to the bed. Thereafter, in the morning, he should serve food to the Brahmana as per his means, and he receives the boon of protection. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.29.37-38 \|\|

*tadvatkṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ rudrāṇīṃ nāmabhiryajet \|*  
*siddhapiṃḍāni divyāni naivedyaṃ dāpayettathā \|\| 37 \|\|*

*piṇyākaṃ prāśa yitvā tu svapyādrātrau vimatsarā \|*  
*saṃpūjya dvijadāṃpatyamiṣṭāpūrtaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Similarly, during the dark third moon day of the same month, the goddess Rudrani should be worshipped offering the siddha-pinda as the eatables. The fast should be broken with the solid drops of oil seeds and she should spend the night time, with the auspicious feelings. In the next morning, the Brahmana couple should be well served with the delicious food and by so doing, one achieves the desired reward.

## \|\| 3.29.39-40 \|\|

*bhādre śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ pūjayeta himādrijām \|*  
*godhūmānnaṃ nivedyaiva prāśayeccandanaṃ sitam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*gandhodakaṃ tataḥ prāśya sakhībhiḥ sahitā svapet \|*  
*prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ mārgapālīśataṃ labhet \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. On the bright third moon day of Bhadrapada, Parvati - the daughter of Himalaya should be worshipped and eatables prepared in wheat should be offered to her. The fast should be broken with the consuming of sandal paste or the scented water. Then the lady should sleep before the goddess with her handmaids. During the next morning, if a Brahmana couple is well feed; the performer earns the merit of having a pillar.

## \|\| 3.29.41-42 \|\|

*tadvatkṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ durgāṃ daivīṃ samarcayet \|*  
*dadyātpiṣṭaphalāndivyānguḍājyaparipūritān \|\| 41 \|\|*

*prāśayitvā tu gomūtraṃ svapyācchāṃtena cetasā \|*  
*prātastu mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ sadāsatraphalaṃ labhet \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Similarly, on the black third moon day, the goddess Uma should be worshipped and the divine preparations made of ghi and sugarcane balls should be offered to the goddess. The fast should then be broken using the cow’s urine. Thereafter, she should sleep peacefully during the night. In the early next morning, a Brahmana couple should be served with food and by so doing, the merit of performing of a Satra yajna is achieved by the performer.

## \|\| 3.29.43-44 \|\|

*māsi cāśvayuje bhaktyā devīṃ nārāyaṇīṃ yajet \|*  
*sopavāsā khaṇḍapūpānnaivedyaṃ parikalpayet \|\| 43 \|\|*

*prāśayeccaṃdanaṃ raktaṃ svapyācca gatamatsarā \|*  
*prabhāte bhojyaṃ dāṃpatyamagnihotraphalaṃ labhet \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. On the bright third moon day of the month of Asvina, the goddess Narayani should be worshipped with devotion. She should then be adored and offered with sugar. Then during the night, the fast should break with the pure red sandal paste, and then she should go to sleep. The next morning, the Brahmana couple should serve the food well and by so doing, one achieves the merit of performing the Agnihotra.

## \|\| 3.29.45-46 \|\|

*tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ svasti nāma prapūja yet \|*  
*śālyodanaṃ guḍopetaṃ naivedyaṃ nirvapettataḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*kusuṃbhabījānsaṃprāśya tyaktvā kāmaṃ svapenniśi \|*  
*saṃbhojya mithunaṃ prātargavāhnikaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. On the dark third moon day of the same month, the goddess Svasti should he worshipped and the Sati rice mixed with sugarcane balls and other sweet dishes should be offered to her. Thereafter, consuming the flower seeds, the fast should be broken and then she should go to sleep, discarding other household works. During the next morning, a Brahmana couple should be served with food, and by so doing, one achieves the merit for the daily food given in charity.

## \|\| 3.29.47-48 \|\|

*kārtikasya tṛtīyāyāṃ svāhānāmnīṃ prapūjayet \|*  
*kṣīraṃ khaṇḍaghṛtopetaṃ naivedyaṃ dāpayecca tām \|\| 47 \|\|*

*svapyādrātrau jitakrodhā prāśya kuṃkumakeśarān \|*  
*prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyamekabhaktaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. On the bright third moon day of the month of Kartika, the goddess Svaha has to be served offering her the eatables of payasam, sugar and the eatables prepared in ghi. The fast should be broken consuming the saffron. Then, one should sleep shedding the anger. Thereafter, on the next day in the morning, by serving food to a Brahmana couple, one gets the reward of a devotee.

## \|\| 3.29.49-50 \|\|

*tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ svadhānāmnīṃ prapūjayet \|*  
*mudgaudanaṃ nivedyātha ghṛtaṃ prāśya svapenniśi \|\| 49 \|\|*

*prātaḥ saṃbhojya mithunaṃ naktavrataphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā muktapāpā śucirbhavet \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. Similarly, on the dark third moon day, the goddess Svadha should be adored, offering the sweet balls of green gram. The fast should then be broken with the tasting of the ghi. Then the night should be spent while sleeping. During the next morning, the Brahmana couple should be well served with the food and by so doing, one achieves the merit of fasting at night. In this way, when the vrata is performed throughout the year, the performer gets free from all the sins.

## \|\| 3.29.51-53 \|\|

*śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā nirāmayā \|*  
*vijñāya ca drutaṃ bhaktyā umāṃ śāstrārthabodhakaiḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*maṃḍalaṃ ca tato likhya navanābhaṃ varapradam \|*  
*sauvarṇaṃ kārayeddevamumayā sahitaṃ prabhum \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tābhyāṃ netreṣu dātavyaṃ mauktikaṃ nīlameva ca \|*  
*pravālamoṣṭhayordadyātkarṇayo ratnakuṇḍale \|\| 53 \|\|*

51-53. During the bright fortnight on the third moon day, one should adopt the rule of fasting without going to sleep and keeping the same with the faith and devotion, a mandala of nine square should be created. The image of Uma and Mahesvara should then be consecrated in the same. In the eyes of both the deities, the gems sapphire or beads should be studded. The lips should be made of cord. In the ears, the kundalas of gems should be adorned.

## \|\| 3.29.54-55 \|\|

*upavītaṃ tu devasya devyā hāraṃ tatho rasi \|*  
*raktavastradharāṃ devīṃ sitavastraṃ maheśvaram \|\| 54 \|\|*

*catuḥsamena vālabhya puṣpairdhūpairathārccayet \|*  
*maṃḍale pūjayitvā ca homaṃ kuryāttato'guroḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. There should be a yajnopavita over the chest of lord Siva and the breast of Uma should be decorated with a garland. The goddess should be clad in red costumes, while Mahesvara should be clad in white garments. Both of them should be decorated with flowers. Then worshipping both of them with incense, adoring both of them in the centre, the homa should be started.

## \|\| 3.29.56-59 \|\|

*tato'parājitāṃ nāma devīṃ tatraiva pujayet \|*  
*mṛtsnāṃ saṃprāśayitvā ca rātrau kuryātprajāgaram \|\| 56 \|\|*

*gītavādyotsavairhṛdyairvīṇāmaṃgalapāṭhakaiḥ \|*  
*rātrimeva japedbhaktyā yāvadudgacchate raviḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*tūlīgaṃḍakasaṃyukte paryaṃketyaṃtaśobhite \|*  
*uddhṛtya maṇḍalāddevaṃ paryaṃkopari vinyaset \|\| 58 \|\|*

*vitānadhvajamālālikiṃkiṇīdarppaṇānvitam \|*  
*puṣpamaṇḍapikācchannaṃ dhūpagugguluvāsitam \|\| 59 \|\|*

56-59. Thereafter, worshipping the goddess Aparajita (one who cannot be defeated by anyone), the fast should be broken with sanctified clay. Thereafter, the singing with playing of the musical instruments, like vina and welfare recitation should be resorted to or otherwise other festivities should be arranged, remaining awake during the night. At the sunrise, the pillows of thick mattress and thick quilts should decorate the bed and the god should be lifted in a circle and then consecrated, which should be decorated with a canopy, flags, garlands and small glasses with flowers spreading even where, with enough of fragrance of incense and guggulu.

## \|\| 3.29.60-61 \|\|

*tasyāgre bhojayedbhaktyā svaśaktyā mithunāni ca \|*  
*prīṇayedbhakṣyabhojyaiśca pakvānnairmadhuraiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*tato dattvā'kṣatānhaste tāṃbūlaṃ vinivedayet \|*  
*prīyatāṃ me umākāṃtaḥ pārvatyā sahitaḥ śivaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. Then in front of both Siva and Parvati, both the Brahmana couple should be made to be seated for taking food, in which sweet dishes of high quality should be served, which should please them. Then handing over the unbroken rice with betel, one should beg forgiveness- “Let Umakanta Siva together with Parvati, be pleased with me.”

## \|\| 3.29.62-63 \|\|

*ucchiṣṭaṃ śodhayitvā tu punaḥ prokṣya samantataḥ \|*  
*raktavarṇāṃ suśīlāṃ ca surūpāṃ supayasvinīm \|\| 62 \|\|*

*śṛṃgābhyāṃ dattakanakāṃ rājatakhurasaṃyutām \|*  
*kāṃsyadohanakopetāṃ raktavastrāvaguṃṭhitām \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. Thereafter, the left over seats should be purified from all the sides, a red cow should be brought before Mahadeva and Uma, which should be quite docile and capable of yielding enough of milk. Her horns should be decorated with gold and the hoofs should be decorated with silver. All her limbs should be covered with the red cloth.

## \|\| 3.29.64 \|\|

*ghaṇṭābharaṇaśobhāḍhyāṃ devadevyagrasaṃsthitām \|*  
*pādukopānahacchatrabhojyabhājanasaṃyutām \|*  
*tridhā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya guroḥ sarvaṃ nivedayet \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Her neck should be decorated with a huge bell as an ornament. A milk pot should be placed besides her, which should be made of bronze. Besides the wooden sandals, shoes, umbrella, cooking vases should be placed besides the cows. Thereafter, circumambulating the cow with the utensils etc., all the things along with the cow should be given over to the preceptor.

## \|\| 3.29.65 \|\|

*umāmaheśvaraṃ devamaviyogaṃ surārcitam \|*  
*avyavacchedabhūtaṃ ca suprītaṃ tadihāstu me \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. The performer with his hands folded, should pray before the preceptor- “As both Uma and Mahesvara, who are worshipped by the gods, could never be separated and live the life with comfort, similarly, I should never be separated from my wife.”

## \|\| 3.29.66 \|\|

*praṇamya śirasā bhūmau kṣamasveti guruṃ vadet \|*  
*evaṃ samāpyate devyāṃ ānaṃtaryavratodyamam \|*  
*yaḥ prakuryātpumānstrī vā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Thus speaking, he should place his head over the earth in pose of offering salutation and he should beg forgiveness from the preceptor saying- “You kindly forgive me.” A man or a woman who performs the Anantarya vrata appropriately, the merit that is earned by both of them, I am going to speak about the same. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.29.67-70 \|\|

*gandharvayakṣalokāṃśca vidyādharamahoragān \|*  
*ṛṣisiddhāmaraṃ brāhmaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ sanātanam \|\| 67 \|\|*

*bhuktvā bhogānaśeṣāṃśca ekaviṃśatkulānvitaḥ \|*  
*ratnayāne samārūḍho guhyāpsarasasaṃvṛtaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*devavidyādharairyakṣairvṛto yāti śivālayam \|*  
*tatra bhuktvā mahābhogānsa bhuṃkte śivavadbahūn \|\| 69 \|\|*

*bhuktvā bhogānyadā bhūtaḥ kadācittapasaḥ kṣayāta \|*  
*pṛthivyāṃ tu samāgamya bhavetsakalabhūmipaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

67-70. After enjoying all the pleasures in the abode of the Vidyadharas, Serpents, Rsis, Siddhas, Devas, Brahma, Visnu and other eternal Iokas, upto the twenty one generations, boarding a plane with wings studded with gems and served by the Guhyakas, Apsaras, Devas and Vidyadharas, he achieves the place of Siva. Reaching there, he enjoys all the pleasures like lord Siva and after the decline of his tapas, he is reborn on earth and becomes an emperor.

## \|\| 3.29.71-73 \|\|

*strī vā samācaredyā tu mahādevī tu jāyate \|*  
*ānaṃtaryavyavacchinnānbhogāndevī umā yathā \|*  
*trailokyapatirudreṇasā bhuṃkte sahitā tathā \|\| 71 \|\|*

*manurddevyā yathāmahyā śacyā śakro yathāsukham \|*  
*nairaṃtaryaṃ yathā saukhyaṃ sā bhuṃkte patinā saha \|\| 72 \|\|*

*muneraruṃdhatī yadvadviṣṇorlakṣmīrhṛdi sthitā \|*  
*tathā tayormahatsaukhyaṃ nairaṃtaryaṃ hi jāyate \|\| 73 \|\|*

71-73. A damsel who performs this vrata, she becomes a great goddess like Uma, enjoying all the comforts in the abode of Siva - the lord of the three worlds. When she is reborn on earth, then as Manu enjoys with the earth goddess and Indra with IndranI, similarly, she enjoys all the pleasures with her husband on earth. Similarly, as Vasistha is attached with Arundhati and Laksmi is lodged in the heart of Visnu, both the husband and wife always have unfading love.

## \|\| 3.29.74 \|\|

*sāvitrī brahmaṇo yadvadgaṃgā toyanidheryathā \|*  
*avyavacchinnayoḥ prītistathā janmanijanmani \|\| 74 \|\|*

74\. As the auspicious love of Savitri and Brahma, which is as auspicious as the water of the Ganga, similarly, the love of both of them always remains firm. With the influence of this vrata, the damsel always has the same person as her husband and she enjoys all the pleasures with him.

## \|\| 3.29.75 \|\|

*atha janmanyahonyasminvratametatkṛtaṃ bhavet \|*  
*tenaiva patinā sārddhaṃ na viyogamupaiti sā \|*  
*yojanāyutasāhasre surūpā maṇḍale bhavet \|*  
*arghāḍhyā subhagā sādhvī putrapautrairalaṃkṛtā \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. In the radius of ten thousand yojanas, her beauty is known as unique. Getting adorned with all the ornaments, the chaste lady has enough of sons and grandsons and her fortunes never fade out.

## \|\| 3.29.76 \|\|

*ettate nikhilaṃ proktamānaṃtaryavrataṃ mayā \|*  
*bhaktāya suvinītāya kathitavyaṃ na cānyathā \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. Thus, I have spoken to you the glory of the Anantarya-vrata in an appropriate way, which could be revealed before a humble devotee and not to others.

## \|\| 3.29.77 \|\|

*eṣā viśeṣavihitābhihitā tṛtīyā yānaṃtarītya vidhavābhirudīritoccaiḥ \|*  
*etāmupoṣya vidhivatpratipakṣayogānnaivāṃtaraṃ sutasuhṛtsvajanairupaiti \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. A lady, who performs the Anantarya vrata, observing fast on each and even fortnight in an appropriate way, then together with all her sons and other relatives, she enjoys all the comforts for long.

## Chapter 30. Aksaya Trtiya Vrata

## \|\| 3.30.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*bahunātra kimuktena kiṃ bahvakṣaramālayā \|*  
*vaiśākhasya sitāmekāṃ tṛtīyāṃ śṛṇu pāṇḍava \|\| 1 \|\|*

*snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam \|*  
*yadasyāṃ kriyate kiñcitsarvaṃ syāttadihākṣa yam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ādau kṛtayugasyeyaṃ yugādistena kathyate \|*  
*sarvapāpapraśamanī sarvasaukhyapradāyinī \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Sri Krsna said- Instead of describing in detail other Trtiyas in which the taking of bath, giving of charities, performing of japam, homa, studies and offering oblation to the pitrs in addition to the other methods that are to be adopted and with the performing of which all the sins get destroyed and one gains enormous comforts, let us now discuss about the Vaisakha- Trtiya.

## \|\| 3.30.4 \|\|

*śākale nagare kaściddharmanāmābhavadvaṇik \|*  
*priyaṃvadaḥ satyarato devabrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. In the city of Sakala, there once lived a Vaisya named Dharma, who always spoke pleasant and truthful words. He always adored the Brahmanas and the gods.

## \|\| 3.30.5-11 \|\|

*tena śrutaṃ vācyamānaṃ tṛtīyā rohiṇī purā \|*  
*yadā syādbudhasaṃyuktā tadā sāca mahāphalā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tasyāṃ yaddīyate kiṃñcittatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet \|*  
*iti śrutvā sa gaṃgāyāṃ santarpya pitṛdevatāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*gṛhamāgatya karakānsānnānudakasaṃyutān \|*  
*aṃbupūrṇāngṛhe kuṃbhānkramānniḥśeṣatastadā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*yavagodhūmacaṇakasaktudadhyaudanaṃ tathā \|*  
*ikṣukṣīravikārāṃśca sahiraṇyāṃśca śaktitaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*śuciḥ śuddhena manasā brāhmaṇebhyo dadau vaṇik \|*  
*bhāryayā vāryamāṇopi kuṭuṃbāsaktaciṃtayā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tāvatsa ca sthitaḥ sattve matvā sarvaṃ vinaśvaram \|*  
*dharmārthakāma śaktastu kālena bahunā tataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*jagāma pañcatvamasau vāsudevaṃ smaranmuhuḥ \|*  
*tataḥ sa kṣatriyo jātaḥ kuśāvatyāṃ nareśvaraḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

5-11. He had heard from the orator of ancient lores that when the trtiya falls on Wednesday during the Rohini constellation, it yields the best results and whatever little charities are given on that particular day, they become everlasting. After taking a bath in the Ganga, offering oblation to the pitrs, and after returning to one’s home, a pitcher filled with water, barley, wheat, grams powder, curd, rise, sugarcane balls, ghi besides gold, as per one’s means, should be offered. At that point of time, even when his wife remained fully occupied in the household works, considering the other things to be of the nature of short existence, he continued to give away the charities. The Vaisya who got absorbed in the performing of dharma, artha and kama, met with his end after a long time. In due course of time, he was born as the ruler of Kus^vati city.

## \|\| 3.30.12-13 \|\|

*babhūva cā kṣayā tasya samṛddhirdharmanirjitā \|*  
*iyāja sa mahāyajñaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*dadau gobhūhiraṇyādi dānānyasyāmaharniśam \|*  
*bubhuje kāmato bhogāndīnārtāṃstarpayañjanān \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. With the influence of the vrata of the earlier birth, he possessed enormous riches, using which he performed several yajnas and at the beginning of each one of them, he gave away cows, land, gold in charity. He also gave food to the poors. He therefore, enjoyed all types of pleasures for long.

## \|\| 3.30.14-18 \|\|

*tathāpyakṣayamevāsya kṣayaṃ yāti na taddhanam \|*  
*śraddhāpūrvaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ yaddattaṃ vibhavaṃ vinā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*etadvrataṃ mayākhyātaṃ śrūyatāmatra yo vidhiḥ \|*  
*udakuṃbhānsakarakātsnānasarvarasairyutān \|\| 15 \|\|*

*graiṣmikaṃ sarvamevātra sasyadānaṃ praśasyate \|*  
*chatropānatpradānaṃ ca gobhūkāṃcanavāsasām \|\| 16 \|\|*

*yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ cānyattaddeyamaviśaṃkayā \|*  
*etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi \|\| 17 \|\|*

*anākhyeyaṃ na me kiñcidasti svastyastu te'nagha \|\| 18 \|\|*

14-18. Since he had given charities on the Aksaya Trtiya day, they became everlasting. Thus, I have spoken to you about this vrata. I am now narrating the method for doing so. You please listen. The pitcher and a vase should be filled with water, for taking bath. All the juices should be dropped in the same. The giving of charities are said to be the best in the summer season. Therefore, one should give away the umbrella, shoes, cows, land, gold and other desired articles in charity without any hesitation. 0 sinless one, I have narrated this to you. Now, what else do you want to listen from me? Because I do not intend to keep anything secret from you. Let you meet with welfare.

## \|\| 3.30.19 \|\|

*asyāṃ tithau kṣayamupaiti hutaṃ na dattaṃ tenākṣayā ca munibhiḥ kathitā tṛtīyā \|*  
*uddiśya yatsurapitṝnkriyate manuṣyaistaccākṣayaṃ bhavati bhārata sarvameva \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. O Bharata, with the performing of homa on this particular day or by the giving away of the charities, it never decreases. Because of this reason, the sages have called it as the Aksayatrtiya or the everlasting moon day. All the rites performed on this particular day for the sake of the gods and the pitrs become everlasting.

## Chapter 31. Angaraka Vrata

## \|\| 3.31.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*rūpasaubhāgyasukhadaṃ naranārījanapriyam \|*  
*pāpāpahaṃ bahuphalaṃ sukaraṃ sūpavāsakam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*ṛddhibuddhikaraṃ svargyaṃ yaśasyaṃ sarvakāmadam \|*  
*tanme vada vrataṃ kiñcidyadi tuṣṭo'si mādhava \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- O Yadava, in case you are immensely pleased with me, you then, speak out to me about a vrata, by observing which one could achieve the beauty, fortunes, comforts, which should be the favourite of both the men and the ladies alike, besides being the remover of the sins and extremely rewarding and by performing it with the observing of the fast, one achieves prosperity, enhancement, heaven, in addition to fulfilling of all the desires easily.

## \|\| 3.31.3-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu pārtha paraṃ guhyaṃ yanmayā kathitaṃ na ca \|*  
*purā tava vanasthasya tadadya pravadāmyaham \|\| 3 \|\|*

*śivayoratisaṃharṣādraktabiṃduścyutaḥ kṣitau \|*  
*medinyā sa prayatnena vidhṛto dhṛtiyuktayā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tasmājjātaḥ kumāro'sau rakto raktasamudbhavaḥ \|*  
*aṃgaṃ prasiddhamevehāṃgārako vega ucyate \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Sri Krsna said - O Partha, there is a secret vrata which I did not reveal to you at the time of your exile in the forest, the same is now being revealed by me before you. At the time of the love sports of Siva and Parvati, the blood drop which fell on earth, the goddess earth received it making all the efforts and as a result of which, Kumara of red complexion was born. The word Arigaraka stands for the force.

## \|\| 3.31.6-8 \|\|

*śivāṃgādrabhasā jāta stenāṃgāraka ucyate \|*  
*agasthoṃ'gārakāṃtiśca aṃgapratyaṅgasaṃbhavaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*saubhāgyārogyakṛdyasmāttasmādaṃgārakaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*bhaktyā caturthyāṃ naktena yastu śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*taṃ pūjayati yatnena nārī vā'nanyamānasā \|*  
*tasya tuṣṭaḥ prayacchetsa yattvayā samudāhṛtam \|*  
*rūpaṃ saubhāgyasaṃpannaṃ naranārīmanoharam \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. With the rapid emerging of the same from the body of lord Siva due to its lustre at the time of taking birth, he was called as Angaraka. With utmost faith and devotion, on the fourth moon day, one should observe fast during the night. Those men or women who adore him, he getting pleased bestows all the aforesaid rewards to his devotee. They achieving the beauty and fortunes and also become favourite of the men and women.

## \|\| 3.31.9 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*etanme vada deveśa aṃgārakavidhiṃ śubham \|*  
*sahomamaṃtrasaṃsthānaṃ sādhivāsavidhānataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Yudhisthira said- O lord of gods, you kindly tell me the auspicious method of performing this vrata, the homa and the adhivasa related to it.

## \|\| 3.31.10-11 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*pūrvaṃ tu kṛtasaṃkalpaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā bahirjale \|*  
*snānārthaṃ mṛttikāṃ maṃtrairgṛhṇīyādaṃbhasi sthitaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tvaṃ mṛde vaṃditā pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇenoddharatā kila \|*  
*tena me daha pāpaughaṃ yanmayā pūrvasaṃcitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Sri Krsna said- First of all the samkalpa (vow) should be performed. Then standing in the water, for the purpose of taking the bath, reciting the mantras, one should pick up the clay and say- “O clay, at the time of redemption, lord Krsna had first of all adored you. Therefore, you kindly remove all my sins. I have collected all my sins, committed earlier.”

## \|\| 3.31.12-13 \|\|

*imaṃ maṃtraṃ paṭhanpārtha ādityāya pradarśayet \|*  
*ādityaraśmisaṃtaptāṃ gaṃgājalakaṇokṣitām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tāṃ mṛdaṃ śirasi prārthya pūrvaṃ dattvāṃgasaṃdhiṣu \|*  
*tataḥ snānaṃ prakurvīta maṃtreṇāntarjale punaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. With the reciting of this mantra, the clay should be displayed before the Sungod and then, it should be plastered over the head as well as the other limbs of the body. Thereafter, he should take his bath with the water of the Ganga exposing himself to the sun rays.

## \|\| 3.31.14-16 \|\|

*tvamāpo yoniḥ sarveṣāṃ daityadānavarakṣasām \|*  
*svedajodbhijjayonīnāṃ rasānāṃ pataye namaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*snāto'haṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvaprasravaṇeṣu ca \|*  
*nadīṣu devakhāteṣu snānaṃ teṣu ca me bhavet \|\| 15 \|\|*

*dhyāyandhvanimimaṃ maṃtraṃ tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret \|*  
*tataḥ snātvā śucirbhūtvā gṛhamāgatya na spṛśet \|*  
*na jalpecca na vīkṣeta kvacitpāpiṣṭhameva hi \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. He should then recite the mantra- “You are the producer of al the Daityas, Danavas, Raksasas and others. Besides you are the lord of all the rasas (juices) and those born of eggs, emerging from the earth. Salutation to you. I am taking my bath in you. Therefore, this bath should yield me the merit of all the holy places, springs, rivers and the divine kundas.” Thus speaking, after taking bath, one should reach home and without speaking or touching anyone, he should first observe whether there is any sinner present there or not.

## \|\| 3.31.17-18 \|\|

*dūrvāśvatthau śamīṃ spṛṣṭvā māṃ ca maṃtreṇa maṃtravit \|*  
*dūrvāmapyasya maṃtreṇa yutena samupasthitām \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tvaṃ dūrve'mṛtajanmāsi sarvadevaiśca vaṃditā \|*  
*vaṃditā daha tatsarvaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Thereafter, reciting the Krsna mantra, he should touch the durva grass, pipala and sami trees. Then, the durva grass should be touched saying- “О durva grass, you were born of the nectar and you arc adored by all the gods. I also adore you. You kindly bum out all my sins.

## \|\| 3.31.19 \|\|

*pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ tvaṃ kāśyapī paṭhyase śrutau \|*  
*śamī śamaya tatpāpaṃ yanmayā duranuṣṭhi tam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Then, one should go to the Sami tree and should speak like this- “You are extremely auspicious and have been termed as Kasyapi in the Vedas. Therefore, О Sami tree, you better destroy all my sins.

## \|\| 3.31.20 \|\|

*aśvatthamaṃgaṃ labhate maṃtrametaṃ nibodha me \|*  
*akṣispaṃdaṃ bhujaspaṃdaṃ duḥsvapnaṃ durviciṃtitam \|*  
*śatrūṇāṃ ca samutthānamaśvattha śamayasva me \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Reaching before the Asvattha (pipala) tree, he should say with folded hands- “O Asvattha, you pacify the evil effect of the fluttering of the eyes, arms, witnessing of the evil dream, besides the place of the origin of the enemies.

## \|\| 3.31.21-22 \|\|

*gāṃ dadyāttu tato devīṃ savatsāṃ sapradakṣiṇām \|*  
*samālabhya tu maṃtreṇa maṃtrametamudīrayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

*sarvadevamaye devi daivataistvaṃ supūjitā \|*  
*tasmātspṛśāmi vaṃdāmi vaṃditā pāpahā bhava \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Similarly, one should go before a cow which has just been given in charity and beg forgiveness from her.” О goddess, you represent all the gods, all the gods have adored you. Therefore, I also touch you and offer prayer to you. You better remove all my sins.

## \|\| 3.31.23-24 \|\|

*evaṃ maṃtraṃ paṭhanpārtha bhaktibhāvena bhāvitaḥ \|*  
*pradakṣiṇāṃ yaḥ kurute gāṃ dṛṣṭvā varavarṇinīm \|\| 23 \|\|*

*pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ maunena cāgatya vaṃdyānvaṃdya gṛhaṃ vrajet \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. О Partha, thus getting influenced with the great devotion, one who circumambulates the auspicious cow, that actually equate with the going round of the entire earth. There is no doubt about it. Thereafter, keeping silence, one should adore the adorable ones.

## \|\| 3.31.25-26 \|\|

*prakṣālya ca mṛdā pādau āhitā'gnigṛhaṃ viśet \|*  
*homaṃ tatra prakurvīta ebhirmaṃtraiḥ padairvaraiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*śarvāya śarvaputrāya pārvatyā goḥ sutāya ca \|*  
*kujāya lohitāṃgāya graheśāṃgārakāya ca \|*  
*bhūyobhūyoyamāhutyā hutvāhutvā juhoti vai \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Then purifying the hand and feet with dust, he should reach the chamber where the fire stands ignited and consecrated. Then, the homa should be started reciting the mantras-“I make the offering\*s for the sake \*of Mangala who is the form of Sarva, son of Sarva and is also known as the son of Parvati and the cow. His limbs are red and he has been known as Grahesa as well as Angaraka. The offering is made for him again and again.”

One should make the offerings for a hundred and eight times or half of that number or still half of the same, according to one's means The catechu stick should be dropped in (he fire flames with ghi, sesamum seeds, milk, barley and several other eatables should also be dropped in the fire. Otherwise, the gold or silver vases should be used with vermilion and saffron. Besides this, the deity should be worshipped with red flowers, the flowers of the season, besides the gems, etc.

*oṃ aṃgārakāya namaḥ śirasi \|*

34-36.Placing some red flowers in the earthen or the copper vases, saffron and vermillion should be offered. The people should then recite Arigarakaya namah touching the head. By saying Om Kujaya namah the mouth should be touched; saying Om Bhaumaya namah the shoulders should be touched. Uttering Om Mangalya namah the arms should be touched; saying Om Raktaya namah the belly should be touched. Saying Om Lohitangaye namah the waist should be touched; saying Om Araya namah the thigh should be touched. By saying Om Mahidharaya namah, the feet should be touched, and thus the worship of the deity is completed. Then making a human size image, it should be consecrated in a vase. Thereafter, uttering an eight Puspa mantra of Kuja, the figure should be adored in an appropriate manner. At the time of worship, ghi, black agaru with guggulu or an excellent type of incense should be offered. Thereafter, the person sitting in meditation should worship using the aforesaid mantra and performing the homa, the same deity shoid then be given over to a Brahmana.

Thereafter, being silent, keeping the plate for food over the earth, he should take his food uttering this mantra- “Being fragrant with juices of all the ausadhis, О goddess you bestow all the things at all the times. О goddess Earth, I intend to take food (placing the food plate over you). Therefore, you infuse nectar in the eatables placed before me.”

For the purpose of the poor people achieving he riches, the process of each one of the caturthi (fourth day of the moon) is going to be spoken by me. You please listen.

No vase of weight lesser than this should be made.

At that point of time, uttering the mantra the image should be presented to the Brahmana “As has been heard from the Sastras and as has my wisdom guided me, with devotion and after fasting, I have worshipped you as per my strength and means, Therefore, O Bhaumadeva born of Siva, be happy with me. My charity should be accepted.” The Brahmana receiving the charity should also recite the mantra- “This image of the planet Mangala is being accepted by me, therefore, both of us, the giver and the receiver should meet with welfare and both of us should remain healthy.”

He would then surely meet with success. Even a poor person, on the day of Angaraka caturthi, should regularly observe fast and offer costumes and sesamum seeds to Kuja in a bronze vase and worship him in a proper manner and by so doing, he earns all the merits.

56-61. In this world, together with all their sons and grandsons, after enjoying all the pleasures, at the time of death, they (both husband and wife), with the divine lustre, travel to the heaven and reaching there, they enjoy all the delights with other gods spending thirty six Caturdasis. In due course of time, he is reborn on earth in a high family possessing beauty, wealthy, giver of charities and compassionate. He becomes a king. A lady who performs this vrata, also achieves beauty, fortunes, birth in a high race, besides enough of sons and grandsons. She enjoys all the comforts with her husband for long. After her death, she again achieves the heaven. Thus, O king, I have revealed the importance of Angaraka Caturthi with all the secrets, which is beyond the reach of the gods even, then what to speak of the humans.

62\. О son of the Kuru race, let you meet with welfare. The fourth moon day of the bright fortnight is always associated with Angaraka. It is considered to be quite auspicious at the time of death and for the offering of the pindas to pitrs. Therefore, those who worship Mangala (Mars) on that particular day, they surely achieve welfare on earth.

## Chapter 32. Vinayaka Caturthi Vrata

## \|\| 3.32.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- I intend to know, О Madhava, even the activities started by the excellent people do not meet with success some times and remain unfinished. What is the reason for the same? You kindly tell me.

*kāṣāyavāsasaścaiva kravyādāṃścādhirohati \|*

*vrajamānastathātmānaṃ manyate tu gataṃ paraiḥ \|*

*yātudhānāśritaṃ yānaṃ śmaśānasyāṃtikaṃ nṛpa \|*

*tailārdramātraṃ svaṃ dehaṃ karavīravibhūṣitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tenopasṛṣṭo labhate na rājyaṃ rājanaṃdanaḥ \|*

*ācāryatvaṃ śrotriyaśca na śiṣyo'dhyayanaṃ tathā \|*

2-9.Sri Кrsnа said- For the artha-siddhi of the world, Brahma and Siva once consecrated Ganapati Vinayaka. He told the universe that by worshipping of Ganapati, the symptoms which appear in the dream, the same are being revealed by me, which are quite auspicious. You please listen. Immersion in the vast ocean of water, a shaven ascetic clad in saffron coloured \*robes, riding over a Raksasa, to join with a Sudra or with donkeys and camels while walking, when one finds himself at a place other than where he intended to go and visiting a cremation ground etc. when witnessed by a person in a dream, then the efforts of a person become unsuccessful and one has to bear the pain with a fallen face. A sinful person and a person without the shadow have a fallen face. О lion of the race of Kuru, to see an elephant calf, to mount a male buffalo or a donkey, touch of the blood of a Raksasa, visit to a creation ground and plastering of oil over the body, getting decorated with the oleander flower,when witnessed by a prnce in dream, then he becomes a ruler, an unmarried girl gets a husband, a married lady gets a son, the student of the Vedas becomes an Асarуа, a disciple gets devoted to the studies, Vaisya achieves profit, but a farmer cannot achieve a good harvest.

## \|\| 3.32.10-11 \|\|

*snapanaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ puṇye'hni vidhipūrvakam \|*

O king, the white mustard seeds and the tensed solid herbs should be applied over the body. Then covering the body with a cloth, the paste of ausadhis and fragrance should be applied over the head, on the bright fourth day of the moon.

*puṣye ca vīranakṣatre tasyaiva purato nṛpa \|*

## \|\| 3.32.13-17 \|\|

13-17. A Brahmana, well-versed in Rgveda, Yajurveda and Samaveda besides the Atharvaveda, should be made to worship Siva, Parvati and Mangala (Mars), Krsna, Laksmi and Rahu holding a sword. After worshipping them, the sand of the stables of horses, elephants, anthill and confluence of rivers gorocana, guggulu and gems should be collected and placed in four pitchers with water, which should of one and the same colour and well decorated. These pitchers should be placed over the hide of a red bull. They should be beautifully decorated. The pitchers should be consecrated and then bathed reciting the following mantras- “The hundreds of streams which were made as thousand eyed ones, purifying them at the same time, the same water of Satadharas is being used for bathing you. Getting extremely purified, you purify me as well.

## \|\| 3.32.23-27 \|\|

*bhojayedbrāhmaṇāndadyādvastrayugmaṃ gurorapi \|\| 27 \|\|*

23-27. Then reciting the mantras, the ripe or unripe rice, meat, cooked or raw fish, fragrant flowers, several types of drinks, radish, fried cakes, sweet cakes, garland of beads, curd, food, payasam, sweet balls, sugarcane balls and pudding should be used in making of the offerings. Thereafter, one should go before Ambika - the mother of Vinayaka and offer her the durva grass, mustard seeds, bunch of flowers, and beg forgiveness from her with folded hands, saying- “O Goddess Bhagavati, you kindly bestow on me beauty, lustre, sons and the wealth and fulfill all my desires. О Goddess, you make me a famous valorous person.” Thereafter, getting clad in white garments, applying sandal paste over the body, he should serve food to the Brahmanas. Thereafter, he should present a couple of garments to the preceptor.

## \|\| 3.32.28 \|\|

*evaṃ vināyakaṃ pūjya grahāṃścaiva vidhānataḥ \|*  
*karmaṇāṃ phalamāpnoti śriyaṃ prāpnotyanuttamām \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Thus performing the worship of Vinayaka, the planets should be adored by which the rewards of the earlier deeds as well as the excellent wealth are achieved.

## \|\| 3.32.29 \|\|

*ādityasya sadā pūjāṃ tilakaṃ svāminastathā \|*  
*mahāgaṇapateścaiva kurvansiddhimavāpnuyāt \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Along with Ganapati, the Sungod should be worshipped daily with the application of tilakam, which yields sure success.

## \|\| 3.32.30 \|\|

*vaināyakaṃ vinayasattvavatāṃ narāṇāṃ snānaṃ praśastamiha vighnavināśakāri \|*  
*kurvaṃti ye vidhivadatra bhavaṃti teṣāṃ kāryāṇyabhīṣṭaphaladāni na saṃśayo'tra \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Thus, for the humble and the docile people, the method of worship of Vinayaka -the remover of the obstructions, has been spelt one. By performing this in an appropriate manner, one achieves the desired success. There is no doubt about it.

## Chapter 33. Vinayaka Caturthi Vrata

## \|\| 3.33.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athāvighnakaraṃ rājankathayāmi vrataṃ tava \|*  
*yena samyakṛteneha na vighnamupajāyate \|\| 1 \|\|*

*caturthyāṃ phālgune māsi gṛhītavyaṃ vrataṃ tvidam \|*  
*naktāhāreṇa rājendra tilānnaṃ pāraṇaṃ smṛtam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tadeva vahnau hotavyaṃ brāhmaṇāya ca tadbhavet \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Sri Krsna said- О king, I am also narrating to you the story of the rem over of the obstructions, which when observed in a proper manner, then one has never to face any obstructions. O Rajendra, on the bright fourth moon day of the month of PhAlguna, this vrata should be observed in a proper manner. The homa by the sesamum seeds and serving food to a Brahmana is also prescribed.

## \|\| 3.33.4-6 \|\|

*śūrāya vīrāya gajānanāya laṃbodarāyaikaradāya caiva \|*  
*evaṃ tu saṃpūjya punaśca homaṃ kuryādvratī vighnavināśahetoḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*cāturmāsyāṃ vrataṃ caiva kṛtvetthaṃ pañcame tathā \|*  
*sauvarṇaṃ gajavaktraṃ tu kṛtvā viprāya dāpayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tāmrapātraiḥ pāyasabhṛtaiścaturbhiḥ sahitaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*pañcamena tilaiḥ sārddhaṃ gaṇeśādhiṣṭhitena ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. Reciting the names like Sura, Vira, Gajanana, Lambodara, Ekadanta, the god Vinayaka should be worshipped lovingly. On the fifth month, the image of Vinayaka tusk should be made in gold and then given over to the Brahmanas with devotion. For four months, the payasam should be given in a copper vase, worshipping him at the same time. During the fifth month, the worship of Ganesa should be performed with sesamum seeds.

## \|\| 3.33.7 \|\|

*mṛnmayānyapi pātrāṇi vittahīnastu kārayet \|*  
*heraṃbaṃ rājataṃ tadvadvidhinānena dāpayet \|*  
*itthaṃ vratamidaṃ kṛtvā sarvavipraiḥ pramucyate \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. A poor person can use other vases or the earthen vase. For Heramba Ganesa, the gold and silver should be given as per one’s means to a Brahmana. By performing this vrata, a person is freed from all the obstructions.

## \|\| 3.33.8-9 \|\|

*hayamedhasya vighne tu saṃjāte sagaraḥ purā \|*  
*etadeva vrataṃ cīrtvā punaraśvaṃ pralabdhavān \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tathā rudreṇa devena tripuraṃ nighnatā purā \|*  
*etadeva kṛtaṃ yasmāttripurastena ghātitaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Because in earlier times, while performing the Asvamedha sacrifice, when an obstruction was caused, the king Sagara had got back the sacrificial horse for the completion of the sacrifice. Similarly, at the time of the killing of Tripurasura, Rudra had performed this vrata first, as a result of which Tripurasura was killed.

## \|\| 3.33.10 \|\|

*mayā samudraṃ viśatāṃ etadeva vrataṃ kṛtam \|*  
*tenādridrumasaṃyuktā pṛthivī punaruddhṛtā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. At the time of the entry in the ocean, I had also observed this vrata. As a result of which, I could rejuvenate the earth with the trees and the mountains, together with the earth.

## \|\| 3.33.11-12 \|\|

*anyairapi mahīpālairetadeva kṛtaṃ purā \|*  
*tapo'rthibhiryajña siddhyai nirvighnaṃ syātparaṃtapa \|\| 11 \|\|*

*anena kṛtamātreṇa sarvavipraiḥ pramucyate \|*  
*mṛto rudrapuraṃ yāti varāhavacanaṃ yathā \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. The kings and the ascetics, all have their tasks fulfilled with the performing of this yajna. With the start of this vrata, a person is simply freed from all the obstructions and after his death, as per the words of Varaha, he achieves a place in the city of Rudra.

## \|\| 3.33.13 \|\|

*vighnāni tasya na bhavaṃti gṛhe kadāciddharmārthakāmasukhasiddhivighātakāni \|*  
*yaḥ saptamīnduśakalākṛtikāṃ tadaṃtaṃ vighneśamarcayati naktakṛtī caturthyām \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. In this way, a person, who is adorned with the lustre of the moon of the seventh moon day, besides having a beautiful elephant tusk, observes vrata on the day of caturthi taking food at night and then breaks the fast by consuming the sesamum seeds, he always achieves success in household, dharma, artha, kama besides all the comforts, without any obstruction at any time.

## Chapter 34. Description of Santi Vrata

## \|\| 3.34.1-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śāṃtivrataṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvekamanādhunā \|*  
*yena cīrṇena śāṃtiḥ syātsarvadā gṛhamedhinām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya kārtike māsi pārthiva \|*  
*ārabhya varṣamekaṃ tu hyaśnīyādamlavarjitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*naktaṃ devaṃ ca saṃpūjya hariṃ śeṣoparisthitam \|*  
*anaṃtāyeti pādau tu dhṛtarāṣṭrāya vai kaṭim \|\| 3 \|\|*

*udaraṃ takṣakāyeti1 uraḥ karkoṭakāya ca \|*  
*padmāya karṇau saṃpūjya mahāpadmāya doryugam \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Sri Krsna said- I am now going to speak you about the performing of the Santi vrata, with the performing of which, a householder always enjoy people in his life. You please listen to me attentively. O Partha, starting from the bright fifth moon day of the month of Kartika till the end of the year, one should take food discarding the fruit of myrobalan. At the time of night, lord Visnu, who sleeps over the bed of serpents, should be worshipped saying-Anantaya namah and one should touch the feet. Then, saying Dhrtarastraya namah, the arms should be touched; by saying Taksakaya namah, the belly should be touched; saying Karkotkaya namah, the heart should be touched; saying Padmaya namah, the ears should be touched and by saying Mahapadmaya namah, the arms should be touched.

## \|\| 3.34.5-6 \|\|

*śaṃkhapālāya vakṣastu kulikāyeti vai śiraḥ \|*  
*evaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvagataṃ pṛthageva prapūjayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ kuryāddharimuddiśya vāgyataḥ \|*  
*tadagre homayetkṣīraṃ tilaiḥ saha vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Uttering Sankhapalaya namah, the chest should be touched; by saying Kulikaya namah the head should be touched. Similarly, the entire body of Visnu should be adored separately starting from the worship of the head. Then maintaining silence for the sake of Visnu, one should bathe with milk, the homa should be performed before lord Visnu, with the payasam as well as the sesamum seeds.

## \|\| 3.34.7-8 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte kuryādbrāhmaṇabhojanam \|*  
*acyutaṃ kāṃcanaṃ kṛtvā suvarṇaṃ tu vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*gāṃ savatsāṃ vastrayugaṃ kāṃsyapātraṃ sapāyasam \|*  
*hiraṇyaṃ ca yathāśakti brāhmaṇāyopapādayet \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. At the end of the year, the vrata should be completed serving food to the Brahmanas. Thereafter, the gold image of lord Visnu, a cow with calf, four costumes, vases of bronze, payasam as well as the gold, as per one’s means, should be given over to the Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.34.9 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā vratametannarādhipa \|*  
*tasya śāṃtirbhavennityaṃ nāgānāmabhayaṃ tathā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O king, when this vrata is so completed with devotion, the performer always remains peaceful and he has not to be afraid of the serpents.

## \|\| 3.34.10 \|\|

*śeṣāhibhogaśayanasthamayogasūtiṃ saṃpūjya yajñapuruṣaṃ patageṃdranātham \|*  
*ye pūjayaṃti madhuraiḥ sitapañcamīṣu teṣāṃ na nāgajanitaṃ bhayamabhyupaiti \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Thus, the Sesasahi Visnu, who has also been known as the Yajha-Purusa and Patagendranatha, is adored with sweet dishes on the bright fifth moon day. Those who do so, they enjoy all the comforts and do not have to be afraid of the Nagas.

## Chapter 35. Sarasvata Vrata described

## \|\| 3.35.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*madhurā bhāratī kena vratena madhusūdana \|*  
*tathaiva janasaubhāgyamatividyāsu kauśalam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*abhedaścāpi daṃpatyostathā baṃdhujanena ca \|*  
*āyuśca vipulaṃ puṃsāṃ jāyate kena keśava \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- О Madhusudana, by performing which one of the vrata, a person achieves sweet voice, fortunes, enormous learnings, efficiency, extreme love in the couples, which would be inseparable, not to separate from the relatives, besides giver of the long life.

## \|\| 3.35.3-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*samyakpṛṣṭastvayā rājañchṛṇu sārasvataṃ vratam \|*  
*yasya saṃkīrtanādeva tuṣyatīha sarasvatī \|\| 3 \|\|*

*yo'yaṃ bhaktaḥ pumānkuryādetadvratamanuttamam \|*  
*tadvatsarādau saṃpūjya vipreṇa taṃ samācaret \|\| 4 \|\|*

*atha cādityavāreṇa grahatārābalena ca \|*  
*pāyasaṃ bhojayitvā ca kuryādbrāhmaṇavācanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Sri Krsna said- О king, you have put up an excellent question. Therefore, I am going to describe the Sarasvata vrata with the performing of which, the goddess Sarasvati gets extremely pleased. You therefore listen to me attentively. Whenever, a devotee starts to perform this vrata, then at the start of the year, he should get a command from a Brahmana for the purpose. He should examine his stars as well as the planets. Then, on a Sunday, he should serve the payasam to the Brahmana and please him with the same.

## \|\| 3.35.6-9 \|\|

*śuklavastrāṇi dadyācca sahiraṇyāni śaktitaḥ \|*  
*gāyatrīṃ pūjayedbhaktyā śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ \|*  
*ebhirmaṃtrapadaiḥ paścātpūrvaṃ kṛtvā kṛtāñjaliḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*yathā tu devi bhagavānbrahmā lokapitā mahaḥ \|*  
*tvāṃ parityajya no tiṣṭhettathā bhava varapradā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*vedaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi nṛtyagītādikaṃ ca yat \|*  
*vāhitaṃ yattvayā devi tathā me saṃtu siddhayaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*lakṣmīrmedhā varāriṣṭirgorī tuṣṭiḥ prabhā matiḥ \|*  
*etābhiḥ pāhi tanubhiraṣṭābhirmāṃ sarasvati \|\| 9 \|\|*

6-9. Then he should make the recitation of the welfare mantras as per one’s means, he should give away to a Brahmana the white clothes and the gold. Thereafter, with the offering of a white rosary, fragrance and paste, he should worship the goddess Sarasvati with devotion, reciting the mantras. Thereafter, with his hands folded, he should beg forgiveness from the goddess saying- “O goddess, as Brahma -the creator of the universe, cannot go anywhere leaving you, you do the same to me. О goddess, whatever the treasure of knowledge of Vedas, Sastras, dance and music etc. is available with you, all such Siddhis should be possessed by me as well. О goddess Sarasvati, you kindly protect me with your associates like LaksmI, Medha, Vara, Risti, Gauri, Tusti, Prabha, Mati and other Vibhutis.

## \|\| 3.35.10-12 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya gāyatrīṃ vīṇākṣamaṇidhāriṇīm \|*  
*śuklapakṣe'kṣatairbhaktyā sakamaṃḍalupustakām \|\| 10 \|\|*

*maunavratena bhuñjīta sāyaṃ prātaśca dharmavit \|*  
*pañcamyāṃ pratipakṣe ca pūjayitvā suvāsinīḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tilaiśca taṃḍulaprasthaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam \|*  
*kṣīraṃ tathā hiraṇyaṃ ca gāyatrī prīyatāmiti \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. The goddess Gayatri carrying a book in her hand, should be worshipped with devotion. The religious minded performer of the vrata should serve the food in the morning, remaining peaceful. On the fifth moon day of each one of the fortnights, a married woman (with her husband being alive), should be adored and one should speak with folded hands- “Let the goddess Gayatri be pleased with me.” Thus saying, he should beg forgiveness with folded hands.

## \|\| 3.35.13-14 \|\|

*saṃdhyāyāṃ ca tato maunaṃ tadvrata tu samācaret \|*  
*nāṃtarā bhojanaṃ kuryādyāvanmāsāstrayodaśa \|\| 13 \|\|*

*samāpte tu vrate dadyādbhojanaṃ śuklataṃḍulaiḥ \|*  
*pūrṇaṃ suvastrayugmaṃ ca gāṃ ca viprāya bhojanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Similarly, during the evening time, observing silence, the goddess should be worshipped. Thus continuing the daily worship for thirteen months and at the end of the same, a vase with white rice, a couple of costumes and a cow should be given over to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.35.15-16 \|\|

*devyai vitānaṃ ghaṃṭāṃ ca sitanetraṃ paṭānvitam \|*  
*candanaṃ vastrayugmaṃ ca dadhyannaṃ śikharairyutam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tathopadeṣṭāramapi bhaktyā saṃpūjayedgurum \|*  
*vittaśāṭhyena rahito vastramālyānulepanaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. For the goddess, a canopy, a bell, sandal paste, pair of clothes, food with curd and sikhara should be given. Thereafter, the performer’s preceptor should also be given costumes, rosary, paste etc., as per one’s means and then worshipped. At the time of giving away the charity, one should not be miserly. This aspect has to be especially kept in mind.

## \|\| 3.35.17-18 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yastu kuryātsārasvataṃ vratam \|*  
*vidyāvānarthayuktaśca raktakaṃṭhaśca jāyate \|\| 17 \|\|*

*sarasvatyāḥ prasādena vyāsavattu kavirbhavet \|*  
*nārī vā kurute yā tu sāpi tatphalabhāginī \|*  
*brahmaloke vasettāvadyāvatkalpāyutatrayam \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. A person, who performs the Sarasvata-vrata in this way, becomes learned, wealthy and red throated. By the grace of the goddess Sarasvati, he becomes a great poet like Vyasa. The woman who so performs this vrata, also achieves the aforesaid reward. For thirty thousand kalpas, she is respected in the Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 3.35.19 \|\|

*sārasvataṃ vrataṃ yastu śṛṇuyādapi yaḥ paṭhet \|*  
*vidyādharapure so'pi vasetkalpāyutatrayam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. By performing the Sarasvata-vrata and those who listen about its glory, enjoy in Vidyadhara loka for thirty thousand kalpas.

## \|\| 3.35.20 \|\|

*saṃvatsaraṃ vratavareṇa sarasvatīṃ ye saṃpūjayaṃti jagato jananīṃ janitrīm \|*  
*madhurasvarāste rūpānvitā vahukalākuśalā bhavaṃti \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Therefore, those who perform the vrata and adore the goddess Sarasvati for the whole year, they became highly learned, auspicious, having pure mind, possessing sweet voice and excellent beauty and have mastery in all the arts.

## Chapter 36. Description of Naga Pancami Vrata

## \|\| 3.36.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*paṃcamī dayitā rājannāgānaṃdavivarddhanī \|*  
*pañcamyāṃ kila nāgānāṃ bhavatītyutsavo mahān \|\| 1 \|\|*

*vāsukistakṣakaścaiva kāliko māṇibhadrakaḥ \|*  
*dhṛtarāṣṭro raivataśca karkoṭakadhanaṃjayau \|*  
*ete prayacchaṃtyabhayaṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇajīvinām \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sri Krsna said- О king, the fifth moon day of the month is quite favourite for the serpents and on the same day, great festivities are observed by the Nagas. Vasuki, Tak$aka, Kaliya, Manibhadra, Dhrtarastra, Raivata, Karkotaka and Dhananjaya are the Nagas, which bestow protection to the people.

## \|\| 3.36.3-4 \|\|

*pañcamyāṃ snapayaṃtīha nāgānkṣī reṇa ye narāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ kule prayacchaṃti abhayaṃ prāṇināṃ sadā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*śaptā nāgā yadā mātrā dahyamānā divāniśam \|*  
*nirvāpitā gavāṃ kṣīraistataḥ prabhṛti vallabhāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. On the day of pancam, a perron who senses the Nagas with milk and make them bathe with the same, his entire race is made fearless by the Nagas. By earning a curse from their own mother, when the serpents were suffering the most, during that period on the same pancami day, their suffering was removed by serving them with the milk of the cows. Because of that, the same pancami is quite favourable for them.

## \|\| 3.36.5 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*mātrā śaptāḥ kathaṃ nāgāḥ kimuddiśya ca kāraṇam \|*  
*kathaṃ vā tasya śāpasya vināśo' bhūjjanārdana \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Yudhisthira said- О Janardana, why were the serpents cursed by their own mother? What was the purpose for it? How was the curse neutralised? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 3.36.6-7 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*uccaiḥśravāśvarājaśca śvetavarṇo'mṛtodbhavaḥ \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvā cābravītkadrūrnāgānāṃ jananī svasām \|\| 6 \|\|*

*aśvaratnamidaṃ śvetaṃ paśyapaśyāmṛtodbhavam \|*  
*kṛṣṇāṃśca vīkṣyase bālānsarvaśvetānutādya vai \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Sri Krsna said- Once Uccaisrava - the foremost of the horses, was seen by Kadru -the mother of the serpents, which was born with the nectar and was quite white in colour. Then, Kadru said to her own sister Vinata-“look at the gem of the horses, which is said to have been bom of the nectar. Are you witnessing its beautiful black hair? Or do you lind white hair alone over its body?

## \|\| 3.36.8 \|\|

*vinatovāca \|*  
*sarvaśveto hayavaro nāyaṃ kṛṣṇo na lohitaḥ \|*  
*kathaṃ tvaṃ vīkṣase kṛṣṇaṃ vinatovāca tāṃ svasām \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Vinata said- О Kadru, this is the best of the horses and is of pure white colour. Its colour is neither black nor red. How do you find it to be of black colour? Vinata spoke like that.

## \|\| 3.36.9 \|\|

*kadrūruvāca \|*  
*vīkṣe'hamekanayanā kṛṣṇabāla samanvitam \|*  
*dvinetrā ca tvaṃ vinate na paśyasi paṇaṃ kuru \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Kadru said- I have a single eye and I find it with black hair. You have two eyes and you do not see it well. Let us put a wager.

## \|\| 3.36.10-15 \|\|

*vinatovāca \|*  
*ahaṃ dāsī bhavitrī te kṛṣṇakeśe pradarśite \|*  
*na ceddarśayase kadru mama dāsī bhaviṣyasi \|\| 10 \|\|*

*evaṃ te vipaṇaṃ kṛtvā gate krodhasamanvite \|*  
*suṣupte prājyadoṣe tu kadrūrjihmamaciṃtayat \|\| 11 \|\|*

*āhūya putrān provāca bālā bhūtvā hayottame \|*  
*tiṣṭhadhvaṃ vipaṇau jeṣye vinatāṃ jayagṛddhinīm \|\| 12 \|\|*

*procuste jihmabuddhiṃ tāṃ nāgāḥ kadrūṃ vigṛhya ca \|*  
*adharma eṣa tu mahānkariṣyāmo na te vacaḥ \|*  
*aśapadruṣitā kadrūḥ pāvako vaḥ pradhakṣyati \|\| 13 \|\|*

*gate bahutithe kāle pāṃḍavo janamejayaḥ \|*  
*sarpasatraṃ sa kartā vai bhūmāvanyaiḥ suduṣkaram \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tasminsatre ca tigmāṃśuḥ pāvako bhakṣayiṣyati \|*  
*evaṃ śaptvā tadā kadrūḥ pratyuvāca na kiṃcana \|\| 15 \|\|*

10-15. Vinata said- “In case the black hair are found over the body of the horse, then I shall be your slave for life and О Kadru, in case I am able to show the white hair, then you will have to be my slave for life.” Thus both of them in anger made a wager. Then they went to their bedroom for sleep. But, Kadru thought of playing some trick. She called for her sons and said to them- “All of you should convert yourselves in a subtle form and enter the limbs of the excellent horse, by which I could be able to defeat Vinata who is full of pride for her victory.” The Nagas realizing her deceitful ways, said to her- “This would be an extremely sinful act. Therefore, we shall not obey your command at all.” On hearing this, Kadru pronounced a curse on them- “The fire would reduce you all to ashes. After the lapse of many days, Janamejaya - a ruler of the race of Pandavas, would organize a serpent yajna on the earth, which is beyond the reach of the other people. In the flaming fire of the yajna the fire would burn you to ashes.” Thus pronouncing a curse on the serpents, Kadru spoke nothing thereafter.

## \|\| 3.36.16-22 \|\|

*mātrā śaptastadā nāgaḥ kartavyaṃ nānvapadyata \|*  
*vāsukirduḥkhasaṃtaptaḥ papāta bhuvi mūrcchitaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*vāsukiṃ duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā provāca sāṃtvayan \|*  
*mā śuco vāsuke'tyarthaṃ śṛṇu madvacanaṃ param \|\| 17 \|\|*

*yāyāvarakule jāto jaratkāruriti dvijaḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyati mahātejāstasminkāle taponidhiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*bhaginīṃ ca jaratkāruṃ tasya tvaṃ pratidāsyasi \|*  
*bhavitā tasya putro'sāvastīka iti viśrutaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*sa tatsatraṃ pravṛddhaṃ vai nāgānāṃ bhayadaṃ mahat \|*  
*niṣedhayiṣyati munirvāgbhiḥ saṃpūjya pārthivam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tadiyaṃ bhaginī nāga rūpaudāryaguṇānvitā \|*  
*jaratkārurjaratkāroḥ pradeyā hyavi cārataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*yadāsau prārthyate'raṇye yatkiñcitpravadiṣyati \|*  
*tatkartavyamaśeṣeṇa icchecchreyastathātmanaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

16-22. With the pronouncing of the curse by the mother, the serpent Vasuki suffering from the mental pain, fainted and fell down on earth. Brahma then, finding Vasuki so grieved, said to him “O Vasuki, don’t worry like this and listen to my words carefully.” In the Yayavara country, an ascetic named Caratkaru would be born as a Brahmana. At that point of time, you give away in marriage to him your own sister known by the name of Jaratkaru. In due course of time, a son named Astika would be bom to them. At the start of the terrific yajna for the destruction of the serpents, their son Astika, pleasing the king, shall get the serpent sacrifice concluded. Therefore, your sister known by the name of Jaratkaru who possesses enormous beauty and virtues, should be given over to the Brahmana Caratkaru. There would be no reason to think further about it. By meeting a Brahmana Caratkaru in the forest, you better obey to all his commands for the sake of your own welfare.”

## \|\| 3.36.23 \|\|

*pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā vāsukiṃ praṇipatya ca \|*  
*tathākarodyathā coktaṃ yatnaṃ paramamāsthitaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Listening to the words of Brahma, the serpent Vasuki humbly accepted the words of Brahma and started making all the efforts for the same.

## \|\| 3.36.24-30 \|\|

*tacchrutvā pannagāḥ sarve praharṣotphullalocanāḥ \|*  
*punarjātamivātmānaṃ menire bhujagottamāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*aplave tu nimagnānāṃ ghore yajñāgnisāgare \|*  
*āstīkastatra bhavitā plavabhūto'bhayapradaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*śrutvā sa cāgnirājānamṛtvijastadanaṃtaram \|*  
*nivartayiṣyati yāgaṃ nāgānāṃ mohanaṃ param \|\| 26 \|\|*

*pañcamyāṃ tacca bhavitā brahmā provāca lelihān \|*  
*tasmādiyaṃ mahārāja pañcamī dayitā śubhā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*nāgānāṃ harṣajananī dattā vai brahmaṇā purā \|*  
*dattvā tu bhojanaṃ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu kāmataḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*visṛjya nāgāḥ prīyaṃtāṃ ye kecitpṛthivītale \|*  
*himācale ye vasanti yeṃ'tarikṣe divisthitāḥ \|*  
*ye nadīṣu mahānāgā ye saraḥsvabhigāminaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*ye vāpīṣu taḍāgeṣu teṣu sarveṣu vai namaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

24-30. On hearing these words, the eyes of all the serpents blossomed with delight. On that particular day, they felt as if they were reborn. It became a talk with everyone that at the start of the sacrifice of the ocean of fire, only Astika would serve as a boat to redeem the serpents. Astika on his part, on hearing all this, because of his attachment with the Nagas, started making efforts to get the sacrifice postponed and approached the fire god, the king and the performer of yajna or the priests. With all his humility. He said- “Brahma has told the Nagas that all this would happen on the day of pancami. O king, the fifth moon day of the month is quite favourite with the serpents, which is the cause of delight and was initially granted by lord Brahma to Nagas. Therefore, on that particular day, the Brahmanas should be served food of their liking and the performer should say- “Let the serpents be pleased with me. Thus saying, some people on earth should send them off. O king, I also offer my salutation to the Nagas living in Himalaya, space, heaven, rivers, lakes, step-wells and tanks besides other places.”

## \|\| 3.36.31-32 \|\|

*nāgānviprāṃśca saṃpūjya visṛjya ca yathārthataḥ \|*  
*tataḥ paścācca bhuñjīyātsaha bhṛtyairnnarādhipa \|\| 31 \|\|*

*pūrvaṃ madhuramaśnīyātsvecchayā tadanaṃta ram \|*  
*evaṃ niyamayuktasya yatphalaṃ tannibodha me \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. In this way, both the Nagas and Brahmanas should be sent off gracefully. Thereafter, the performer of the vrata should take food with all the relatives. It should start from the sweet dish, thereafter, the desired food should be taken, observing all the rules. The relevant merit which is earned by so doing, is being narrated by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.36.33-35 \|\|

*mṛto nāgapuraṃ yāti pūjyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ \|*  
*vimānavaramārūḍho ramate kālamīpsitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*iha cāgatya rājāsau sarvarājavaro bhavet \|*  
*sarvaratnasamṛddhaśca vāhanāḍhyaśca jāyate \|\| 34 \|\|*

*pañcajanmanyasau rājā dvāparedvāpare bhavet \|*  
*ādhivyādhivinirmuktaḥ patnīputrasahāyavān \|*  
*tasmātpūjyāśca nāgāśca ghṛtakṣīrādinā sadā \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. After his death, the performer of the vrata, getting comfortably seated over an excellent plane, achieves a place in the Nagaloka and is served by the Apsaras there. After enjoying all the comforts there, he is reborn on earth as a king possessing all the gems, vehicles and other fortunes. He rules as a king for five births. Remaining free from all the diseases, he enjoys all the bliss with his wife and sons. Therefore, the Nagas should always be pleased by offering milk to them.

## \|\| 3.36.36 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*daśaṃti yaṃ naraṃ kṛṣṇa nāgāḥ krodhasamanvitāḥ \|*  
*bhavetkiṃ tasya daṣṭasya vistarādbrūhi māṃ hare \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Yudhisthira said- When a snake bites someone in anger, what happens to him? You kindly tell me in detail.

## \|\| 3.36.37 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*nāgadaṣṭo naro rājanprāpya mṛtyuṃ vrajatyadhaḥ \|*  
*adho gatvā bhavetsarpo nirviṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Sri Krsna said- When a person dies of a snake bite, he reaches patala and is reborn there as a serpent without poison.

## \|\| 3.36.38-39 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*nāgadaṣṭaḥ pitā yasya bhrātā mātā suhṛtsutaḥ \|*  
*svasā vā duhitā bhāryā kiṃ kartavyaṃ vadasva me \|\| 38 \|\|*

*mokṣāya tasya govinda dānaṃ vratamupoṣitam \|*  
*brūhi me yaduśārdūla yena svargatimāpnuyāt \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Yudhisthira said- When someone is bitten by a Naga or a Cobra, then what would be the duty of his parents, the friend, the son, the sister, the daughter and finally the wife? O Govinda and the lion of the race of Yadus, what type of charities should be given over or the fast to be observed for his sake? You kindly tell us about the same, by observing which the deceased achieves the heaven.

## \|\| 3.36.40 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*upoṣyā pañcamī rājannāgānāṃ puṣṭivarddhinī \|*  
*varṣamekaṃ tu rājendra vidhānaṃ śṛṇu yādṛśam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Sri Krsna said- O king, for the redemption of such a person, fasting should be done on the same pancami tithi appropriately, which is quite supportive for the Nagas. O king, I am going to speak about the process for the same, which should be performed for a year at a stretch. You listen to me carefully.

## \|\| 3.36.41 \|\|

*māse bhādrapade yā tu śuklapakṣe mahīpate \|*  
*sā ca puṇyatamā proktā grāhyā sadgatikāmyayā \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. O lord of the earth, the bright fifth moon day of the month of Bhadrapada is extremely auspicious and bestows emancipation to a person and is said to be quite praiseworthy for the purpose.

## \|\| 3.36.42-45 \|\|

*jñeyā dvādaśa varṣāṃte pañcamyo bharatarṣabha \|*  
*caturthyāmekabhaktaṃ tu tasyāṃ naktaṃ prakīrtitam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*bhūricandramayaṃ nāgamathavā kaladhautajam \|*  
*kṛtvā dārumayaṃ cāpi utāho mṛnmayaṃ nṛpa \|\| 43 \|\|*

*pañcamyāmarcayedbhaktyā nāgaṃ pañcaphaṇaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*karavīraistathā padmairjātīpuṣpaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*gandhapuṣpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pūjya pannagasattamam \|*  
*brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścād ghṛtapāyasamodakaiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

42-45. It has to be performed for twelve years continuously. Then, for the conclusion of the same vrata, the devotee should take food on the night of the fourth moon day. On the fifth moon day, the image of the female serpent made of gold, silver, wood or clay, should be prepared making all the efforts and decorated with five types of fruits. Then, fragrant flowers like those of oleander, lotus, jasmine and other flowers, besides the eatables should be offered at the time of worship. The ghi, payasam and sweet balls should be offered to a Brahmana as a food. He should be fully pleased with the food offered.

## \|\| 3.36.46-47 \|\|

*nārāyaṇabaliḥ kāryaḥ sarpadaṣṭasya dehinaḥ \|*  
*dāne piṃḍapradāne ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpayet \|\| 46 \|\|*

*vṛṣotsargastu kartavyo gate saṃvatsare nṛpa \|*  
*snānaṃ kṛtvodakaṃ dadyātkṛṣṇo'tra prīyatāmiti \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. For the redemption of the person from the snake bite, the rite of Narayana-bali should be performed. At the time of pinda-dana, the Brahmanas should be fully satisfied. At the end of the year, a sacrifice known as Vrsotsarga should also be performed. After taking bath, at the time of offering oblation with water, one should say- “Let lord Krsna be pleased.”

## \|\| 3.36.48-49 \|\|

*anaṃto vāsukiḥ śeṣaḥ padmaḥ kambala eva ca \|*  
*tathā takṣaka nāgaśca nāgaścāśvataro nṛpa \|\| 48 \|\|*

*dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ śaṃkhapālaḥ kāliyastakṣakastathā \|*  
*piṃgalaśca mahānāgo māsimāsi prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*vatsarāṃte pāraṇaṃ syānmahābrāhmaṇabhojanam \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. Then at the end of each month, Ananta, Vasuki, Sesa, Padma, Kambala, Taksaka, Asvatara, Dhrtarastra, Sahkhapala, Kaliya, Pihgala and names of the others great Nagas should be uttered and at the end of a year, the great Brahmanas should be served with the food after which the fast should be broken.

## \|\| 3.36.50-52 \|\|

*itihāsavide nāgaḥ kāṃcanena kṛto nṛpa \|*  
*tathārjunī pradātavyā savatsā kāṃsyadohanā \|\| 50 \|\|*

*eṣa pāraṇake pārtha vidhiḥ prokto vicakṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*kṛte vratavare tasminsadgatiṃ yāṃti bāndhavāḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*ye dandaśūkaradanairdaṣṭāḥ prāptā hyadhogatim \|*  
*varṣamekaṃ cari ṣyaṃti bhaktyā ye vratamuttamam \|*  
*dāṃṣṭrikaṃ mokṣyate teṣāṃ śubhaṃ sthānamavāpsyati \|\| 52 \|\|*

50-52. Those who are experts in history, summon the Brahmana and give away in charity to him the gold figure of a cow with calf, milk pot made of bronze. O Partha, for the breaking of the fast, this is the process as has been prescribed by the learned people. By performing of the vrata by the relatives in this way, the person meets with welfare. When a person dies of the snake bite, he attains the lower regions. But a person who performs the above rites for his sake, the diseased person surely achieves the auspicious place besides salvation.

## \|\| 3.36.53 \|\|

*yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhedbhaktyā samanvitaḥ \|*  
*na vai kuṭumbe nāgebhyo bhayaṃ bhavati kutracit \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Thus, with faith and devotion, when a person listens about it or studies it, the entire family is relieved of the danger of the snake bite.

## \|\| 3.36.54-55 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*tadvadbhādrapade māsi pañcamyāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ \|*  
*yastvālikhya naro nāgānkṛ ṣṇavarṇādivarṇakaiḥ \|*  
*pūjayedgandhapuṣpaistu sarpirgguggulupāyasaiḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*tasya tuṣṭiṃ samāyāṃti pannagāstakṣakādayaḥ \|*  
*āsaptamātkulāttasya na bhayaṃ nāgato bhavet \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. On the fifth moon day of the month of Bhadrapada, a person, who making the black figure of a serpent, worships him by offering fragrant flowers, ghi, guggulu and payasam, then the serpents like Taksaka and others remain extremely happy with him. His next seven generations are freed from the danger of the serpents.

## \|\| 3.36.56-58 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena nāgānsaṃpūjayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*tathā cāśvayuje māsi pañcamyāṃ kurunaṃdana \|\| 56 \|\|*

*kṛtvā kuśamayānnāgāniṃdrāṇyā saha pūjayet \|*  
*ghṛtodakābhyāṃ payasā snapayitvā viśāṃpate \|\| 57 \|\|*

*godhūmaiḥ payasā svinnairbhakṣyaiśca vividhaistathā \|*  
*yastvasyāṃ vividhānnāgāñchucirbhaktyā samanvitaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. O son of the Kuru race, therefore, for the worship of the Nagas, one should always make efforts. Similarly, in the month of Asvina, on the fifth moon day of the month, making a figure of the Naga with kusa grass, it should be consecrated with Indrani and should be bathed with water and milk, and wheat flour, payasam, besides ghi should be offered to them with other dishes. He should then please them with devotion and faith.

## \|\| 3.36.59-61 \|\|

*pūjayetkuruśārdūla tasya śeṣādayo nṛpa \|*  
*nāgāḥ prītā bhavantīha śāṃtiṃ prāpnoti śobhanām \|*  
*sa śāṃtilokamāsādya modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*ityetatkathitaṃ vīra pañcamīvratamuttamam \|*  
*tatrāyamucyate maṃtraḥ sarvadoṣaniṣedhakaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*bhaktena bhaktisahitāḥ śatapañcamīṣu ye pūjayaṃti bhujagānkusumopahāraiḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ gṛheṣvabhayadā hi sadaiva sarpāḥ śaśvatpramodaparamā rucayo bhavaṃti \|\| 61 \|\|*

59-61. One who does so, all the Nagas including Sesa remain delighted with him and bestow peace. After the death, he achieves the loka of peace for many years. O valorous one, thus I have described the glory of this excellent pancami in which, for the removal of all the blemishes, the mantra- "Om kuru-kulle hum phat svaha” has been prescribed. With the feeling of devotion, one should perform a hundred pancami vratas offering flowers and worship the serpents in his house. Thereby, the comforts and fearlessness are always bestowed on him by the Nagas.

## Chapter 37. Sri Pancami described

## \|\| 3.37.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kathamāsādyate lakṣmīrdurllabhā bhuvanatraye \|*  
*dānena tapasā vāpi vratena niyamena vā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*japahomanamaskāraiḥ saṃskārairvā pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|*  
*etadvada yaduśreṣṭha sarvavittvaṃ mato mama \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- O best of the race of Yadus, you are well aware of my feelings, therefore, you kindly tell me as to how a person could attain the wealth, which is beyond the reach of people in the three worlds. What type of charities, tapas, vratas, regulations, homa, salutation etc. is to be made for the purpose?

## \|\| 3.37.3-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhṛgoḥ khyātyāṃ samutpannā pūrvaṃ śrīḥ śrūyate śubhā \|*  
*vāsudevāya sā dattā muninā mānavṛddhaye \|\| 3 \|\|*

*vāsudevo'pi tāṃ prāpya pīnonnatapayodharām \|*  
*padmapatraviśālākṣīṃ pūrṇacandranibhāna nām \|\| 4 \|\|*

*bhābhāsitadigābhogāṃ sākṣādbhānoḥ prabhāmiva \|*  
*nitaṃbāḍaṃbaravatīṃ mattamātaṃgagāminīm \|*  
*reme saha tayā rājanbibhramodbhrāṃtacittayā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sā ca viṣṇuṃ jagajjiṣṇuṃ patiṃ trijagatāṃ patim \|*  
*prāpya kṛtārthamātmānaṃ mene mānayaśodhanā \|\| 6 \|\|*

3-6. Sri Krsna said— Initially, goddess Sri had emerged in the hermitage of the Rsi Bhrgu. The same Rsi offered the same goddess for the increase of his grace to lord Vasudeva. Vasudeva then received Laksmi, having the large or corpulent breasts, the eyes resembling the lotus leaves, the face resembling the moon, with charming limbs, and was duly received by him.
