The same Laksmi having the lustre of the Sun which illuminates all the directions with the shine of the solar disc, having vast and charming buttocks and the shoulders, walking like an intoxicated elephant, started enjoying the company of lord Visnu. She cast her glance here or there, like a confused person. He was the best conqueror of the v/orld, besides being the lord of the three worlds and getting him as her husband, the glorious and proudy Laksmi thought herself to have achieved a great success.

## \|\| 3.37.7-9 \|\|

*hṛṣṭaṃ puṣṭaṃ jagatsarvamabhavadbhā vitaṃ tayā \|*  
*lakṣmyā nirīkṣitaṃ caiva sānaṃdaṃ hi mahītalam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kṣemaṃ subhikṣamārogyamanākrandamanākulam \|*  
*jagadāsīdanudbhrāntaṃ praśāṃtopadravaṃ tathā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*divi devā mumudire dānavā daityamāgatāḥ \|*  
*visphāritaphaṇābhogā nāgāścaiva rasātale \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. With the compassionate glance of the goddess Laksmi, the entire universe was filled with delight. Everywhere, there was protection besides delight, good health, comforts and peace. At that point of time, there had been no misery, painful quarrels and disturbance to be seen. The gods in the heaven, Danavas and the Daityas were happily lodged in the nether world, the serpents enjoyed themselves in the Nagaloka spreading their hoods.

## \|\| 3.37.10-11 \|\|

*hṛdaye brāhmaṇairvahnau bhujyate tridivairhaviḥ \|*  
*cāturvarṇyamasaṃkīrṇaṃ pālyate pārtha pārthivaiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*virocanaprabhṛtibhirdṛṣṭvaivaṃ daityasattamaiḥ \|*  
*tapastaptumathārabdhamagnimāśritya saṃyataiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. The gods received the offerings made by the Brahmanas in the fire were totally absorbed in the bliss. The people of the earth were being well taken care off by the people of the race of Prthu. Observing that, Virocana and other Daityas, controlling all there senses, started performing homas with sacrifices.

## \|\| 3.37.12-13 \|\|

*somasaṃsthāhaviḥsaṃsthāpākasaṃkhyādibhirmakhaiḥ \|*  
*sadācāraiḥ samārabdhamiṣṭaṃ sveṣṭābhilāṣibhiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*evaṃ dharmapradhānaistairvedavādaratātmabhi \|*  
*jagadāsītsamākrāṃtaṃ vikrameṇa krameṇa tu \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Making use of Soma, havi and eatables, they performed several type of yajnas as well, because they intended to fulfill their desires by following noble means. In a few days, because of their (the demons) reciting of the Vedas and the performing of the religious activities, the entire universe got agitated.

## \|\| 3.37.14-17 \|\|

*lakṣmīvilāsaprabhavo devānāmabhavanmadaḥ \|*  
*madācchīlaṃ ca śaucaṃ ca satyaṃ sadyo vyanīnaśan \|\| 14 \|\|*

*satyaśaucavihīnāṃstāndevānsaṃtyajya cañcalān \|*  
*jagāma dānavakulaṃ kuladevānurāgataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*lakṣmyā bhāvitadehaistaiḥ punaruddhatamānasaiḥ \|*  
*vyavahartuṃ samārabdhamanyāyena madoddhataiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*vayaṃ vedā vayaṃ yajñā vayaṃ vidyā vaya jagat \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇuśaṃkarādyā vayaṃ sarve divaukasaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

14-17. The gods, because of the presence of Laksmi with them, became intoxicated. Because of that arrogance, they were deprived of humility, purity and truthfulness which were lost at the same time. Then the gods, having been deprived of truth and purity etc., became unstable. Then Lak§ml, disowning the gods, proceeded on to the race of Danavas. Getting attracted towards Laksmi and feeling intoxicated, the arrogant Danavas too started behaving in an unjustified manner. They declared that they alone represented the Vedas, yajnas, the learnings, the universe, Brahma, Visnu, Siva and all the gods.

## \|\| 3.37.18-22 \|\|

*ahaṃkāravimūḍhāṃstāñjñātvā dānavasattamān \|*  
*sāgaraṃ sā viveśātha bhrāṃtacittā bhṛgoḥ sutā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*kṣīrābdhimadhyagatayā lakṣmyā kṣīṇārthasaṃcayam \|*  
*nirānandagataśrīkamabhavadbhuvanatrayam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*gataśrīkamathātmānaṃ matvā śaṃbarasūdanaḥ \|*  
*papacchāṃgirasaṃ vipraṃ brūhi kiñcidvrataṃ mama \|\| 20 \|\|*

*yena saṃprāpyate lakṣmīrlabdhā na calate punaḥ \|*  
*niścalāpi suhṛnmitrairbhogyā bhavati sā mune \|\| 21 \|\|*

*na sā śrītyabhimantavyā kanyā sā pālyate gṛhe \|*  
*parārthaṃ yā suhṛnmitrabhṛtyairnaivopabhujyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

18-22. When the Daityas were thus been filled with arrogance, Laksmi - the daughter of Rsi Bhrgu, feeling painful at heart, entered the oceanic waters. When the goddess Laksmi so entered the ocean of milk, the accumulation of riches started declining everywhere. In a few days, the delight of Sri completely faded out from all the three worlds. At that point of time, Indra - the destroyer of Sambara, finding himself so decimated, said to Brhaspati— “O son of Angira, O Brahmana, you point out to me a vrata, by observing which one would be able to receive such a type of Laksmi, which should not be moveable and always remain stable. When it is stable, it could be well used by close friends and one could be able to well utilize the same. One should consider the wealth like one’s own daughter and well preserve the same. When the same is with another person, the relatives, friends and the servants should not be able to use it.”

## \|\| 3.37.23-24 \|\|

*śakrasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ \|*  
*kathayāmāsa saṃciṃtya śubhaṃ śrīpañcamīvratam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*yatpurā kasyacitproktaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam \|*  
*tadasmai kathayāmāsa sarahasyamaśeṣataḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. On hearing the words of Indra, Brhaspati the liberal one, said- “For the sake of Laksmi, the best Sripancami-vrata should be performed. This is the excellent vrata which in earlier times, had been spoken for the sake of someone else. I am going to reveal the same secret to you.”

## \|\| 3.37.25-26 \|\|

*tacchrutvā kartumārabdhaṃ sureśena suraistathā \|*  
*daityadānavagaṃdharvairyakṣaiḥ prakṣīṇakalmaṣaiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*siddhaiḥ prasiddhacaritairviṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā \|*  
*brāhmaṇairbrahmatattvajñaiḥ samarthaiḥ pārthivaiḥ saha \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. On hearing this, Indra performed the same vrata appropriately and similarly, the Daityas, Danavas, Gandharvas, the sinless Yaksas, Siddhas, the highly influential Visnu, with other rulers, performed the same at the advice of the learned Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.37.27 \|\|

*kaiścitsāttvikabhāvena rājasenāparairapi \|*  
*tāmasena tathā kaiścitkṛtaṃ vratamidaṃ tathā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. But because of their Sattvika intentions some had done so, while some had done so with the Rajasika and Tamasika intentions as well.

## \|\| 3.37.28-30 \|\|

*vrate samāpte bhūyiṣṭhe niṣṭhayā parayā prabho \|*  
*devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca yuddhamāsīdathoddhatam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*nirmathya bhujavīryeṇa sāgaraṃ saritāṃ patim \|*  
*samāharāmo hyamṛtaṃ hitāya tridivaukasām \|\| 29 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ samayaṃ kṛtvā mamaṃthurvaruṇālayam \|*  
*maṃthānaṃ maṃdaraṃ kṛtvā netraṃ kṛtvā tu vāsukim \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. At the end of the vrata, both the Gods and the Danavas fought a horrible battle. In the meantime, Visnu decided with the gods that for the benefit of the Gods, Sagara - the husband of the rivers, should be churned with the hands and the extracting of the nectar is essential. Thus thinking, he started churning of the ocean with all others, issuing Mandaracala as the churning rod, the serpent Vasuki as the churning rope.

## \|\| 3.37.31-33 \|\|

*mathyamānajalājjātaścandraḥ śītāṃśurujjvalaḥ \|*  
*anaṃtaraṃ samutpannā lakṣmīḥ kṣīrābdhimadhyataḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tayā vilokitāḥ sarve daityadānavasattamāḥ \|*  
*ālokya sā jagāmāśu viṣṇorvakṣaḥsthalaṃ śubham \|\| 32 \|\|*

*vidhinā viṣṇunā cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ tenābdhisaṃbhavā \|*  
*śarīrasthā babhūvāsya vibhramodbhrāṃtalocanā \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. First of all, while churning the ocean, a bright Moon with cool rays was born. Thereafter, from the middle of the ocean of milk emerged Laksmi, who was looked at by all the gods and the best of the Danavas, but she took refuge over the chest of lord Visnu, who had performed the related vrata in a proper way. Having the intoxicated eyes, Laksmi appropriated the body of Visnu.

## \|\| 3.37.34 \|\|

*kiṃ ca rājasabhāvena śakreṇaitatkṛtaṃ yataḥ \|*  
*tatastribhuvanaiśvaryaṃ prāptaṃ tena maharddhikam \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. On the other hand, Indra had performed the vrata with a Rajasika mind, as a result of which he got the enormous fortunes of the three worlds.

## \|\| 3.37.35-36 \|\|

*tamasāvṛtacittaistu saṃcīrṇaṃ daityadānavaiḥ \|*  
*tena teṣāmathaiśvaryaṃ dṛṣṭanaṣṭamabhūtkila \|\| 35 \|\|*

*evaṃ saśrīkamabhavatsadevāsuramānuṣam \|*  
*jaracca jagatāṃ śreṣṭha vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. The Daityas and Danavas had performed the vrata with Tamasika intentions, therefore they achieved the fortunes, no doubt, but were destroyed in full view all those present there. Since that time, the gods, asuras and humans started doing Srivrata.

## \|\| 3.37.37 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kathametadvrataṃ kṛṣṇa kriyate manujaiḥ kadā \|*  
*prārabhyate pāryate ca sarvaṃ vada yadūttama \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Yudhisthira said- О Krsna the best of the race of Yadus, when should a person perform this vrata and in which way, should it be done? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 3.37.38-40 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe paṃcamyāṃ patagodaye \|*  
*upavāsasya niyamaṃ kuryādāśu suhṛddhṛdi \|\| 38 \|\|*

*svarṇaraupyārakūṭotthā tāmramṛtkāṣṭhajātha vā \|*  
*citrapaṭṭagatāṃ devīṃ lakṣmīṃ kṣmāpāla kārayet \|\| 39 \|\|*

*padmahastāṃ padmavarṇāṃ padmāṃ padmadalekṣaṇām \|*  
*diggajendraiḥ snāpyamānāṃ kāṃcanaiḥ kalaśottamaiḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

38-40. Sri Krsna said- On the bright fifth day of the month of Margaslr§a, at the time of the sunrise, the performing of the vrata should be started observing its rules. An image of LaksmI should be made of gold, silver, brass, copper or the wood, v/hich should be quite beautiful. She should have the complexion of a lotus, holding a lotus in her hand. Her eyes should be quite vast blossoming like the lotus petals. The two •elephants of the directions should be shown as bathing her holding the gold pitchers in their trunks.

## \|\| 3.37.41-42 \|\|

*tato yāmatraye jāte nimnagāyāṃ gṛhe'tha vā \|*  
*snānaṃ kuryādasaṃbhrātaṃ śakravadupacārataḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*devānpitṝṃśca saṃtarpya tato devagṛhaṃ vrajet \|*  
*tatrasthāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ puṣpai statkālasaṃbhavaiḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Then, during the third prahara of the day of the spring season, one should himself take bath in a house or at a river bank like Indra. After adoring the Devas as well as the Pitrs and finishing other routines, he should enter the temple of the deity and should worship her offering the flowers.

## \|\| 3.37.43-46 \|\|

*capalāyai namaḥ pādau caṃcalāyai ca jānunī \|*  
*kaṭiṃ kamalavāsinyai nābhiṃ khyātyai namonamaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*stanau manmathavāsinyai lalitāyai bhujadvayam \|*  
*utkaṃṭhitāyai kaṇṭhaṃ ca mādhavyai mukhamaṇḍalam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*namaḥ śriyai śiraḥ pūjya dadyānnaivedyamādarāt \|*  
*phalāni ca yathālābhaṃ virūḍhāndhānyasaṃcayān \|\| 45 \|\|*

*tataḥ suvāsinī pūjyā kusumaiḥ kuṃkumena ca \|*  
*bhojayenmadhurānnena praṇipatya visarjayet \|\| 46 \|\|*

43-46. Не should adore her feet saying Capalayai namah; the knees saying Cahcalayai namah; the arms saying Kamalavasinyai namah; the waist saying Khyatyai namah; the naval uttering Manmathavasinyai namah; the breasts saying Lalitayai namah; the tongue with Utkanthitayai namah; the neck saying Madhavyai namah; and saying Sriyai namah, the head should be worshipped. Thereafter, she should be offered the flowers, saffron and a married woman with her husband alive, should be worshipped and then served with the delicious food. Then she should be sent off, by offering the prayer.

## \|\| 3.37.47-48 \|\|

*tatastu taṃḍulaprasthaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam \|*  
*brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ śrīśaḥ saṃprīyatāmiti \|\| 47 \|\|*

*nirvartya tadaśeṣeṇa tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|*  
*māsānumāsaṃ kartavyaṃ vidhinānena bhārata \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. Thereafter, ghi, fruits and rice should be given to a Brahmana saying- “Let lord Visnu be pleased.” Thereafter, the performer should take food silently with all his relatives. Similarly, there are separate regulations for each month to be observed by a person, О Bharata!

## \|\| 3.37.49-51 \|\|

*śrīrlakṣmīḥ kamalā saṃpadumā nārāyaṇī tadā \|*  
*padmā dhṛtiḥ sthitiḥ puṣṭirṛddhiḥ siddhiryathākramam \|*  
*māsānumāsa rājendra prīyatāmiti kīrtayet \|\| 49 \|\|*

*tataśca dvādaśe māsi saṃprāpte paṃcame dine \|*  
*vastramaṃḍapikāṃ kṛtvā puṣpagandhādhivāsitām \|\| 50 \|\|*

*śayyāyāṃ sthāpayellakṣmīṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutām \|*  
*mauktikāṣṭakasaṃyuktāṃ netrapaṭṭāvṛtastanīm \|\| 51 \|\|*

49-51. The singing with music should be carried out reciting the names of Sri, Laksmi, Kamala Sampaduma, Uma, Narayani, Padma, Dhrti, Sthiti, Pusti, Rddhi and Siddhi, while performing the worship at the same time. On each fifth moon day of the twelfth month, a beautiful mandapa should be made with fragrance and flowers, together with a fine cloth in which a beautiful bed should be arranged. After Adhivasana, the image of LaksmI should be placed over the bed. Her hair should be decorated with eight beads, the breast with fine cloth and she should be clad in a sari.

## \|\| 3.37.52 \|\|

*saptadhānyasamopetāṃ rasadhātusamanvitām \|*  
*pādukopānahacchatrabhājanāsanasatkṛtām \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. Thereafter, the seven types of cereals, juices, paddy, wood sandal, shoes, umbrella, eatables, costumes, and an asana should be offered.

## \|\| 3.37.53-54 \|\|

*dadyātsaṃpūjya vidhivadbrāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine \|*  
*vyāsāya vedaviduṣe yasya vā rocate svayam \|*  
*sopaskarāṃ savatsāṃ ca dhenuṃ dattvā kṣamāpayet \|\| 53 \|\|*

*kṣīrābdhimathanodbhūte viṣṇorvakṣaḥsthalālaye \|*  
*sarvakāmaprade devi ṛddhiṃ yaccha namo'stu te \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. After the worship, a Brahmana with family, who is well-versed in the Vedas like Vyasa, or whosoever is liked by the donor, should be given a cow with a calf with a vase for the milking of the cow. He should then beg forgiveness- “O goddess, you were born of the churning of the ocean and fulfill all the desires. You bestow on me the desired prosperity. I offer my salutation to you.”

## \|\| 3.37.55 \|\|

*tataḥ suvāsinīḥ pūjya vastrairābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*bhojayitvā svayaṃ paścādbhuñjīta saha bandhubhiḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Thereafter, a woman whose husband is alive, should be worshipped offering the costumes and ornaments to her to please her. Thereafter, he should take his food with his relatives.

## \|\| 3.37.56 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha bhaktyā śrīpañcamīvratam \|*  
*tasya śrīrbhavane bhāti kulānāmekaviṃśatiḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. O Partha, a person who performs this vrata with devotion, in the house of such a person, LaksmI resides for twenty-one generations.

## \|\| 3.37.57 \|\|

*nārī vā kurute yā tu prāpyānujñāṃ svabhartṛtaḥ \|*  
*subhagā darśanīyā ca bahuputrā ca jāyate \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Also a woman who performs this vrata with the help of her husband, she always enjoy all the fortunes, excellent beauty and gets many sons.

## \|\| 3.37.58 \|\|

*śrīpañcamīvratamidaṃ dayitaṃ murārerbhaktyā samācarati pūjyabhṛgostanūjām \|*  
*rājyaṃ nijaṃ sa bhuvi bhavyajanopabhogānbhuktvā prayāti bhuvanaṃ madhusūdanasya \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. This pancami vrata is immensely favoruite to lord Visnu and while performing this vrata, one who worships Laksmi - the daughter of Bhrgu, such a person, enjoying kingship on earth, enjoys enormous comforts, and at the time of death, always achieves Visnuloka.

## Chapter 38. Visoka Sastht described

## \|\| 3.38.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhīvidhānamadhunā kathayasva janārdana \|*  
*sarvavyādhipraśamanaṃ sarvakarmaphalapradam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*śrutaṃ mayā pūjyamāno bhānuḥ sarvaṃ prayacchati \|*  
*divākarārādhanaṃ me tasmātkathaya keśava \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- Presently, you kindly reveal to me the processing of the Sasthi-vrata, which results in the removal of all the diseases and one achieves success in all the desires. О Kesava, I have heard that with worship of the Sungod, one achieves all the pleasures. Therefore, you kindly tell me the method of the worship of the Sun.

## \|\| 3.38.3-7 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*viśoka ṣaṣṭhīmatulāṃ vakṣyāmi manujottama \|*  
*yāmupoṣya naraḥ śokaṃ na kadācidiha jāyate \|\| 3 \|\|*

*māghe kṛṣṇatilaiḥ snātaḥ pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ \|*  
*kṛtāhāraḥ kṛśasyā daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*upavāsavrataṃ kṛtvā brahmacārī bhavenniśi \|*  
*tataḥ prabhāte cotthāya kṛtasnānastataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kṛtvā tu kāñcanaṃ padmamarko'yamiti pūjayet \|*  
*karavīreṇa raktena raktavastrayugena ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*yathā viśokaṃ bhavanaṃ tvayaivādityasarvadā \|*  
*tathā viśokatāṃ me syāttvadbhaktirjanmajanmani \|\| 7 \|\|*

3-7. Sri Krsna said- I am going to narrate to you about the excellent Visoka Sasthi in which in case a fast is observed, one is totally relieved of all the grief. During the month of Magha on the dark fifth moon day, one should bathe himself with water mixed with black sesamum seeds. He should then eat rice mixed with pulse and during the night, should observe the Brahmacarya vrata. In the morning, he should clean his teeth with a tooth stick and then observe all the regulations for the fast,. He should then have a purifying bath and conceive the eight petalled lotus made of gold as the Sun and offer the oleander flowers and the red cloth while adoring it. He should then beg forgiveness, saying- “O Sungod, by your grace, the grief of all the people is subsided. Therefore, you kindly relieve one of grief for all times to come and bestow me your devotion in each one of my birth.”

## \|\| 3.38.8-9 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu śaktyā saṃpūjayeddvijān \|*  
*suptvā saṃprāśya gomūtramutthāya kṛtaniścayaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya vipramaṃtreṇa guḍapātrasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*susūkṣmavastrayugalaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. On the sixth moon day of the fortnight, the Sungod should be thus adored together with the Brahmanas, and one should consume the cow’s urine and spend the night while in sleep. Then on the day of Saptami, getting free from ail the essentials, observing all the regulations, the Brahmana should be given the sugarcane balls, a vase besides two fine cloths after adoring him.

## \|\| 3.38.10 \|\|

*atailalavaṇaṃ bhuktvā saptamyāṃ maunasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ purāṇaśravaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. He should discard oil and salt, and keep silent after taking food. Therefore, for the purpose of gaining riches, he should listen to the stories from the Puranas.

## \|\| 3.38.11-12 \|\|

*anena vidhinā sarvamubhayorapi pakṣayoḥ \|*  
*kuryādyāvatpunarmāghaśuklapakṣasya saptamī \|\| 11 \|\|*

*vratāṃte kalaśaṃ dadyātsuvarṇakamalānvitam \|*  
*śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ tadvatkapilāṃ ca payasvinīm \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. By following this process, on both the sixth moon day of the two fortnights, one should perform the vrata on the bright seventh moon day of the month of Magha, and the golden lotus with well arranged bed, a water vase and a milk giving white cow, should be given away in charity while concluding the vrata.

## \|\| 3.38.13 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yastu vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*viśokaṣaṣṭhīṃ kurute sa yāti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. By following this procedure, a person, who becoming careful of his miserly nature, performs the Visoka-Sasthi vrata, he achieves the supreme position.

## \|\| 3.38.14 \|\|

*yāvajjanmasahasrāṇāṃ sāgrakoṭiśataṃ bhavet \|*  
*tāvanna śokamabhyeti rogadaurgatyavarjitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. For a hundred cores of births, he remains free from disease, misfortune, grief and achieves all the pleasures.

## \|\| 3.38.15 \|\|

*yaṃyaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ taṃtaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam \|*  
*niṣkāmaṃ kurute yastu sa paraṃ brahma gacchati \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Whatever things are desired by him, his surely meets with success. A person, who getting free from desires, performs this vrata, he achieves Brahman.

## \|\| 3.38.16 \|\|

*yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi ṣaṣṭhīṃ śokavināśinīm \|*  
*sopīṃdralokamāpnoti na duḥkhī jāyate kvacit \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. A person who performs vrata of this sasthi for the removal of grief or reads its story or recite it to others, he also reaches the place of Indra and never faces miseries in his life.

## \|\| 3.38.17 \|\|

*ye bhāskaraṃ dinakaraṃ karavīrapuṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayaṃtyabhinamaṃti kṛtopavāsā \|*  
*te duḥkhaśokarahitāḥ sahitāḥ suhṛdbhirbhūmau vihṛtya ravilokamavāpnuvaṃti \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. While fasting, a person should offer the oleander flowers and salutation to the Sun. Thereby, he gets freedom from all the sufferings, enjoys all the comforts with his friends on earth and then he achieves Suryaloka.

## Chapter 39. Vrata of Padma Sasthi

## \|\| 3.39.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*anyāmapi pravakṣyāmi padmaṣaṣṭhī śubhāṃ tathā \|*  
*yāmupoṣya naraḥ pāpavimuktaḥ svargabhāgbhavet \|\| 1 \|\|*

*mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi pañcamyāṃ niyatavrataḥ \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhīmupoṣya kamalaṃ kārayitvā sukāñcanam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sri Krsna said- I am going to narrate to you another vrata known as the Padma-Sasthi vrata, in which a person, while observing the fast, getting relieved of the sin, attains the heaven. During the month of Margasir§a fortnight, a person should perform this vrata observing all the regulations and during the sixth moon day, should adore the lord with the golden lotus flowers.

## \|\| 3.39.3-4 \|\|

*śarkarāsaṃyutaṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine \|*  
*rūpaṃ ca kāṃcanaṃ kṛtvā phalasyaikasya dharmavit \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dadyātprātaḥ kṛtasnāno bhānurme prīyatāmiti \|*  
*bhaktyā tu viprānsaṃpūjya saptamyāṃ kṣīrabhojanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Then together with the sugar, he should give it away to a Brahmana couple along with a fruit made of silver or gold. After taking bath, he should also give away a fruit to the Brahmana and say- “Let the Sungod be pleased with me.” On the seventh moon day, he should serve payasam to the Brahmana, while ending the fast.

## \|\| 3.39.5-7 \|\|

*kṛtvā kuryātphalatyāgaṃ yā ca syātkṛṣṇasaptamī \|*  
*etāmupoṣya vidhivadanenaiva krameṇa tu \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tadvai haimaṃ phalaṃ dattvā suvarṇa kamalānvitam \|*  
*śarkarāpātrasaṃyuktaṃ vastramālāsamanvitam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭhyorubhayormahārāja yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ tataḥ \|*  
*upoṣya dadyātkramaśaḥ sūryamaṃtrānudīrayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. In the same sequence, observing fast on the dark seventh day of the moon, discarding the reward, the charity should he performed giving a flower and the fruit of gold. Besides, the sugar, costumes and rosary should also be given to a Brahmana. О lord, thus on the sasthi tithis of both the fortnights, fast should be performed for a year and in each month, the mantras of the Sungod should be recited.

## \|\| 3.39.8-10 \|\|

*bhānurarko ravirbrahmā sūryaḥ śukro hariḥ śivaḥ \|*  
*śrīmānvibhāvasustvaṣṭā varuṇaḥ prīyatāmiti \|\| 8 \|\|*

*pratimāsaṃ ca saptamyāmekaikaṃ nāma kīrtayet \|*  
*pratipakṣaṃ phalatyāgametatkurvansamācaret \|\| 9 \|\|*

*vratāṃte vipramithunaṃ pūjayedvastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*śarkarākalaśaṃ dadyāddhaimapadmaphalānvitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. The names of Bhanu, Arka, Ravi, Brahma, Surya, Sakra, Hari, Siva, Sriman, Vibhavasu, Tvasta and Varuna should be respectively recited in each one of the month during the seventh moon day. Then the performer should say- “Let the Sungod be pleased with me.” Thus speaking, he should give away the gold. Again at the time of the conclusion of the vrata, the Brahmana couple should be given the costumes, ornaments, sugar, vase and a lotus of gold.

## \|\| 3.39.11-12 \|\|

*yathā phalakaro māsastvadbhaktānāṃ sadā rave \|*  
*tathānaṃtaphalāvāptirastu janmanijanmani \|\| 11 \|\|*

*imāmanaṃtaphaladāṃ phalaṣaṣṭhīṃ karoti yaḥ \|*  
*sa sarvapāpanirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. After performing the puja, one should beg forgiveness saying- “O Ravi, as your months had been giving fruits, similarly, I should also get fruits in each one of my future births.” Thus, a person who performes the vrata of the rewarding sasthi in a proper manner, he getting relived of all the sins, is respected in the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 3.39.13 \|\|

*surāpānādikaṃ kiñcidyadatrāmutra vā kṛtam \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Whenever drinks are consumed in the world and the other world, he earns his stay in the Suryaloka for the removal of the sins.

## \|\| 3.39.14-15 \|\|

*bhūtānbhavyāṃśca puruṣāṃstārayedekaviṃśatim \|*  
*śṛṇuyādyaḥ paṭhedvāpi sopi kalyāṇabhāgbhavet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*haimaṃ phalaṃ sakamalaṃ kalaśaṃ sitāyā ṣaṣṭhīmupoṣya vidhivaddvijapuṃgavāya \|*  
*dadyātsurāsuraśiromaṇighṛṣṭapādaṃ bhānuṃ praṇamya phalasiddhimupaiti martyaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. He also redeems his past as well as the future generations. Thus, by narrating the importance of this bright sasthi and the related fasting, giving lotus of gold, vase and fruit in charity to a woman or a Brahmana, besides decorating the crowns of the Gods and the Asuras with gems and worshipping the Sungod with devotion, the devotee attains the desired success in due time.

## Chapter 40. Mandara Sasthi Vrata

## \|\| 3.40.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm \|*  
*sarvakāmapradāṃ puṇyāṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ mandārasaṃjñitām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*māghasyāmalapakṣe tu pañcamyāṃ laghubhuṅnaraḥ \|*  
*daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā ṣaṣṭhīmupavasedbudhaḥ \|*  
*viprānsaṃpūjya vidhivanmaṃdāraṃ prāśayenniśi \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sri Krsna said- Now I am going to state the vrata of Mandara-Sasthi, which is the destroyer of all the sins, is auspicious and grants all the desires. On the bright fifth moon day of the month of Magha, taking light refreshments in the morning of the sixth moon day, one should brush his teeth with took stick and then all the prescribed methods of observing the vrata should be done. Then adoring a Brahmana, one should break his fast with fruit of Mandara (swallow wart) and then go to sleep.

## \|\| 3.40.3-4 \|\|

*tataḥ prabhāte cotthāya kṛtasnānaḥ punardvijān \|*  
*bhojayecchaktitaḥ kṛtvā maṃdārakusumāṣṭakam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*sauvarṇaṃ puruṣaṃ tadvatpadmahastaṃ suśobhanam \|*  
*padmaṃ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kṛtvā tāmrapātre'ṣṭapatrakam \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Then on the seventh moon day, one should take bath in the early morning and finishing other routines, should serve food to the Brahmana as per his means and also give away eight flowers of swallow wart, made in gold. He should also make the human figure of gold decorated with the golden flower of lotus. Then the lotus flower with eight petals, having the pericarp of the black sesamum seed, should be consecrated over the copper plate.

## \|\| 3.40.5-8 \|\|

*pūjya maṃdārakusumairbhāskarāyeti pūrvataḥ \|*  
*namaskāreṇa tadvacca sūryāyetyanale dale \|\| 5 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇe tadvadarkāya tathāryamṇe ca nairṛte \|*  
*paścime vasudhātre ca vāyavye caṇḍabhānave \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pūṣṇe hyuttarataḥ pūjya ānaṃdāyetyataḥ param \|*  
*karṇikāyāṃ tu puruṣaḥ pūjyaḥ sarvātmaneti ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

*śuklavastraiḥ samāveṣṭya bhakṣyairmālyaphalādibhiḥ \|*  
*evamabhyarcya tatsarvaṃ dadyādvedavide punaḥ \|*  
*bhuṃjītātailalavaṇaṃ vāgyataḥ prāṅmukho gṛhī \|\| 8 \|\|*

5-8. Then using the Mandara flowers, he should recite the following mantras- with Bhaskaraya namah to the east; with Suryaya namah in the south-east; with Arkaya namah in the south; with Aryamne namah in the south-west; with Vayavye namah in the northwest; with Vasudhaye namah in the west; with Pusne namah in the north; and with Anandaye namah in the north-east, the Sungod should be worshipped. The gold lotus should be wrapped with a white cloth and placed over the pericarp. Then offering a rosary and the eatables, he should worship the same with great devotion. In this way, by performing the worship in an appropriate manner, he should also place the excellent fruit and conclude the worship with devotion. After thus performing the puja in an appropriate manner, he should make the offering to a Brahmana, who is well-versed in the Vedas. Then discarding the use of oil and the salt, he should take his food sitting and facing the east.

## \|\| 3.40.9 \|\|

*anena vidhinā sarvaṃ saptamyāṃ māsimāsi ca \|*  
*kuryātsaṃvatsaraṃ yāvadvittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In the same way, on each seventh day of the month, he should continue the worship for a full one year as per his means, distributing charities at the same time.

## \|\| 3.40.10-11 \|\|

*etadeva vratāṃte tu nidhāya kalaśopari \|*  
*gobhirvibhavataḥ sārddhaṃ dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*namo maṃdāranāthāya maṃdārabhavanāya ca \|*  
*tvaṃ ca vai tārayasvāsmānasmātsaṃsārakardamāt \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Then at the end of the vrata, the aforesaid articles should be placed over a pitcher and for his own welfare, money, cow etc. should be given away, begging forgiveness at the same time- “O Mandaranatha! I humbly offer my salutation to the vrata of Mandara. You kindly redeem me from the mud of the universe.”

## \|\| 3.40.12 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yastu kuryānmaṃdārakaṃ vratam \|*  
*vipāpmā sa sukhī martyaḥ kalpaṃ ca divi modate \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Thus, with the performing of the Mandara vrata in an appropriate manner, the performer is freed of all the sins, enjoys all the pleasures in the world and after his death, he enjoys all the pleasures in the heaven for a kalpa.

## \|\| 3.40.13-15 \|\|

*imāmaghaughapaṭaladhvāṃtasadvartidīpikām \|*  
*gacchanpragṛhya saṃsāraśarvaryāṃ na skhalennaraḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*maṃdāraṣaṣṭhīṃ vikhyātāmīpsitārthaphalapradām \|*  
*yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sopi pāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 14 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭhīmupoṣya tilapaṅkajakarṇikāyāṃ saṃpūjya bhāskaramaho suravṛkṣapuṣpaiḥ \|*  
*yatprāpnuvaṃti puruṣā na hi tatkadācidgobhūhiraṇyatiladāḥ padamāpnuvanti \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. This Sasthi vrata serves as a burning wick for the destruction of the sins. Holding it in his hand and without suffering any pain, during the night of the earth, he travels to the heaven with comfort. Mandara Sasthi vrata is quite auspicious and a person who reads or listens about the same is also relieved of the sins. On the day of this sasthi, one should observe a fast when the Sungod is to be worshipped in the pericarp of the lotus flowers, the merit one earns, can not be earned by giving away in charity the cow, land and the sesamum seeds.

## Chapter 41. Lalita Sasthi Vrata

## \|\| 3.41.1-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhadra bhādrapade māsi śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*yoṣitsuveṣā subhagā sarvalokamanoharā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*prātaḥ snānaṃ mahānadyāṃ kṛtvā saṃgṛhya vālukām \|*  
*nave vaṃśamaye pātre yāyādgṛhamataṃdritā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sopavāsā prayatnena devīṃ tatra prapūjayet \|*  
*kṛtvā vastragṛhaṃ ramyaṃ dīpanetrapaṭāvṛtam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tatra saṃsthāpya tāṃ devīṃ puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayennavaiḥ \|*  
*dhyātvā lalitikāṃ gaurīṃ tapovananivāsinīm \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Sri Krsna said - O noble Yudhisthira, on the bright sasthi of the month of Bhadrapada, the married woman (with husband alive) should beautify herself with costumes and ornaments, should take bath in a river in the early morning and while returning after bath, she should carry the river sand in a bamboo basket. Reaching home, she should observe fast and make an image of the goddess with sand and decorate the same with five cloths. The image should then be consecrated in a well decorated mandapa and offering flowers to the image, she should meditate upon the goddess Lalita - the dweller of the forest. Then the goddess should be worshipped in an appropriate manner.

## \|\| 3.41.5 \|\|

*maṃtreṇānena kusumaiścaṃpakasya suśobhanaiḥ \|*  
*caṃpakaṃ karavīraṃ ca nemāliṃ mālatīṃ tathā \|*  
*nīlotpalaṃ ketakīṃ ca saṃgṛhya tagaraṃ tathā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. With the reciting of mantras, the campaka flowers should be used in the worship of the goddess, or alternatively, oleander, nemali, jasmine, blue lotus, ketaki and tagara can also be used.

## \|\| 3.41.6-8 \|\|

*ekaikasya tvaṣṭaśatamaṣṭāviṃśatireva vā \|*  
*akṣataiḥ kalikā grāhyāstaistu devīṃ samarcayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*gaṃgādvāre kuśāvarte bilvake nīlaparvate \|*  
*snātvā kanakhale tīrthe haraṃ labdhavatī vrajet \|\| 7 \|\|*

*lalite lalite devi saukhyasaubhāgyadāyini \|*  
*yā saubhāgyasamutpannā tasyai devyai namonamaḥ \|*  
*evamabhyarcya vidhinā naivedyaṃ purato nyaset \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. The number of flowers should be eight hundred or twenty eight, or the uninjured buds can also be used for the worship of the goddess. At the time of the worship, one should say- “The goddess, who is lodged over the blue mountain at Haridvara which is filled with the kusa grass as well as the wood apple trees, who rested only after achieving lord Siva, after bathing at the river Ganga at kanakhala who bestows fortunes and comforts, О goddess Lalita, you are bom of fortunes. Therefore, I offer my salutation to you again and again.” She should recite like this. The naivedya (eatables) should be placed before her.

## \|\| 3.41.9-10 \|\|

*kūṣmāṃḍaiḥ karkaṭīvṛṃtaiḥ karkoṭaiḥ kāravellakaiḥ \|*  
*vṛtāṃkairakṣatairaṅgairdīpadhūpādyalaktakaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*sārddhaṃ saguḍakairdhūpaiḥ sohālakakaraṃbakaiḥ \|*  
*guḍapuṣpaiḥ karṇaveṣṭairmodakairmukhamodakaiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Thereafter, the melon, gourd, walnut, bitter gourd, unbroken rice, papaya fruit, incense, lamp, red colour (for feet), sohalaka, karambaka, Bassica latifolia flowers, earrings and sweet balls should be offered to her, worshipping her in a proper manner.

## \|\| 3.41.11-12 \|\|

*evamabhyarcya vidhivadrātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*gītavādyanaṭacchatraprekṣaṇīyaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ \|*  
*sakhībhiḥ sahitā sādhvī tāṃ rātrīṃ praśamannayet \|\| 11 \|\|*

*na ca sammīlayennetre nārī yāmacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*durbhagā durgatā vaṃdhyā netrasaṃmīlanādbha vet \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. During the night, there should be an arrangment of dance and music with her handmaids. The night should be spent remaining awake. During the first prahara of the night, she should not be overpowered by sleep, because with the closing of the eyes on such a occasion, a woman attracts misfortunes besides being barren as well.

## \|\| 3.41.13-14 \|\|

*evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā saptamyāṃ saritaṃ nayet \|*  
*gandhapuṣpairathābhyarcya gītavādyapuraḥsaram \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tacca dadyāddvijeṃdrāya naivadyādi narottama \|*  
*snātvā gṛhamupāgamya hutvā vaiśvānaraṃ kramāt \|*  
*devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca pūjayitvā suvāsinīm \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Then on the day of SaptamI, in the early morning, the goddess should be worshipped with flowers and the image should be taken in a procession with dance and music to a river and it should be consigned in the river water. The offerings which were made to the goddess, should be given over to an excellent Brahmana. Then she should return home, after taking a bath in the river. At home, the homa should be performed, offering oblation to the gods and the manes. Thereafter, a virtuous woman (whose husband is alive) should be worshipped.

## \|\| 3.41.15 \|\|

*kumārikā bhojanīyā brāhmaṇā daśapaṃca ca \|*  
*bhakṣyabhojyairbahuvidhairdeyā tebhyaḥ sudakṣiṇā \|*  
*lalitā prītiyuktā'stu ityuktvā tānvisarjayet \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The food should be served to the unmarried maid girls. Besides ten or five Brahmanas should be served with food and daksina should also be given to them. Then, she should say- “Let the goddess Lalita be immensely pleased with me.” Thus speaking, the goddess should be sent off.

## \|\| 3.41.16 \|\|

*yaḥ kaścidācaredetadbhaktyā lalitikāvratam \|*  
*naro vā yadi vā nārī tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. When a man or a woman worships the goddess Lalita in this way. he or she earns enormous merit which is being stated by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.41.17 \|\|

*tannāsti mānuṣe loke tasya yannopapadyate \|*  
*sukhasaubhāgyasaṃyuktā gaurīlokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. He or she attains enormous comforts and fortunes, and for such people, nothing remains beyond their reach in this world. At the time of death, they achieve the place of Gauri.

## \|\| 3.41.18 \|\|

*ṣaṣṭhyāṃ jalāṃtaragatā varavaṃśapātre saṃgṛhya pūjayati yā sikatāḥ krameṇa \|*  
*naktaṃ ca jāgaramanuddhatagītanṛtyaiḥ kṛtvā hyasau tribhuvane laliteva bhāti \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Thus, on the sixth moon day of a fortnight, after taking bath, one should carry the sand in a basket and make a beautiful image of the same, which should be duly worshipped displaying the dance and music, remaining awake for the whole night. A woman who does so, she becomes famous in the three worlds and graceful like the goddess Lalita.

## Chapter 42. Worship of Kartikeya

## \|\| 3.42.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*yeyaṃ mārgaśire māsi ṣaṣṭhī bharatasattama \|*  
*puṇyā pāpaharā dhanyā śivā śāntā gṛhapriyā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*nihatya tārakaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ guhastārakarājavat \|*  
*rarāja tena dayitā kārttikeśasya sā tithiḥ \|*  
*snānadānādikaṃ karma tasyāmakṣayamucyate \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sri Krsna said O excellent Bharata, the sixth moon day of the month of Margasirsa is extremely auspicious, remover of the sins, glorious, bestower of welfare, peaceful and is the favourite of the household. On this particular day of sasthi, Kartikeya gained enormous glory by killing the asura Tarakasura. All the activities including taking of bath and giving of charities etc. performed on this particular day, bestow unlimited merits.

## \|\| 3.42.3 \|\|

*yasyāṃ paśyaṃti gāṃgeyaṃ dakṣiṇāpathamāśritam \|*  
*brahmahatyādipāpaiste mucyaṃte nātra saṃśaya \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. On this particular day, the people who have an audience of Kumara — the son of Gangs, over the Daksinapatha, all their sins including those like Brahmahatya, get destroyed. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.42.4-5 \|\|

*tasmādasyāṃ sopavāsaḥ kumāraṃ svarṇasaṃbhavam \|*  
*rājataṃ vā mahārāja mṛnmayaṃ vāpi kārayet \|\| 4 \|\|*

*aparāhṇe tataḥ snātvā samācamya yatavratī \|*  
*padmāsanastho gāṅgeyaṃ dhyāyaṃstiṣṭhetsamādhinā \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. O great king, because of that, on this particular moon day, making the figure of Kumara in gold, silver or of clay, a Brahmana, taking bath in the forenoon, performing all his daily routines and sitting in padmasana (cross legged), should meditate on Skanda - the son of Ganga.

## \|\| 3.42.6-9 \|\|

*brāhmaṇastu tato vidvāngṛhītvā karakaṃ navam \|*  
*pātayettasya śirasi dhārāṃ vai dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*candramaṇḍalabhūtānāṃ bhavabhūtipavitritā \|*  
*gaṃgākumāradhāreyaṃ patitā tava mastake \|\| 7 \|\|*

*evaṃ snātvā samabhyarcya bhāskaraṃ bhuvanādhipa \|*  
*puṣpadhūpādinā paścātpūjayetkṛttikāsutam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*deva senāpate skanda kārttikeya bhavodbhava \|*  
*kumāra guha gāṃgeya śaktihasta namo'stu te \|\| 9 \|\|*

6-9. Such a learned Brahmana should be seated facing the south and should place a new vase of pottery and pour water over the head of lord. At that point of time, one should say- “O son of Ganga, like the majesty of Siva, this is the auspicious stream of water which is falling over your head like the crescent moon.” О lord of the universe, thus bathing him, the son of Krttika should then be worshipped sayingsalutation to the commander of the army of the gods, Kartikeya - the son of Bhava, Kumara, Guha, Gangeya and holder of Sakti.”

## \|\| 3.42.10-11 \|\|

*ebhirnnāmapadaiḥ pūjya naivedyaṃ vinivedayet \|*  
*phalāni dakṣiṇānnāni candanaṃ malayodbhavam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*pārśvasthau pūjayecchāgakukkuṭau svāmivallabhau \|*  
*sakalāpaṃ mayūraṃ ca pratyakṣāṃ himajāṃ tathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Thus speaking, one should offer eatables, daksina with fruit, sandal paste, Malaya sandal and the fragrant things should be presented with grace. Subsequently, at his back, with the female goat, cock and a peacock with plume, the goddess Parvati should be adored.

## \|\| 3.42.12 \|\|

*kṛttikākaṭakaṃ pārśve saṃpūjya skandavallabham \|*  
*tenaiva nāmabhirhomaḥ kāryaḥ sājyaistilaistathā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Skanda Standing beside her, Krttika should also be worshipped. Then uttering their names, the homa with the offerings of ghi and sesamum should be offered in fire.

## \|\| 3.42.13-16 \|\|

*evaṃ nirvartya vidhivatphalamevaṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*bhakṣayitvā svapedbhūmau svāstṛte darbhasaṃstare \|\| 13 \|\|*

*nālikeraṃ mātuluṃgaṃ nāriṃgaṃ panasaṃ tathā \|*  
*jaṃbīraṃ dāḍimaṃ drākṣāṃ hṛdyānyāmraphalāni ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

*śrīphalāmalakaṃ tadvattrapusaṃ kadalīphalam \|*  
*krameṇa bhakṣayedrājansaṃyato niyatavratī \|*  
*alābhe kalakālaughaphalamadyādataṃdritaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*pratyakṣo hemaghaṭitaśchāgo vā kukkuṭo'thavā \|*  
*prātardadyāddvijāyaitatsenānīḥ prīyatāmiti \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-16. Thereafter, consuming the fruit, one should sleep on the floor, spreading the kusa grass. Then, the coconut, myrobalan, orange, jack fruit, sour lemon, pomegranate, grapes, sriphala, cucumber, banana etc. are the fruits which can be consumed by the performer of the vrata. Then he should make gold im age for the following and give away to a Brahmana:-For profit gaining he should make the gold image of a goat. For obtaining merit of the vrata, the figure of a she goat or a cock is to be made, or otherwise figure of anyone should be made and should be given over to a Brahmana after the completion of the worship. Then saying- “Let the commander be pleased with me,” he should then be sent off.

## \|\| 3.42.17-18 \|\|

*senāyāṃ sa ca saṃbhūtaḥ krauñcāriḥ ṣaṇmukho guhaḥ \|*  
*gāṃgeyaḥ kārttikeyaśca svāmī bālagrahāgraṇīḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*chāgapriyaśśaktidharo dvāro dvādaśamaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*prīyatāmiti sarveṣu kramānmāseṣu kīrtayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Then uttering the names of Senani, Krauncari, Sanmukha, Guha,Gangeyaa Karttiekya, Svami, Balagraha, Grani, Chagapriya, Saktidhara and Sakrtadeva are the twelve names which should be uttered respectively in each one of the months.

## \|\| 3.42.19-21 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānbhojayitvādau paścādbhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|*  
*evaṃ saṃvatsarasyānte kārttike māsi śobhane \|\| 19 \|\|*

*kārttikeyaṃ samabhyarcya vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*gāṃgeyaḥ kārtikeyaśca sakṛdevaivamācaret \|\| 20 \|\|*

*saṃvatsaravidhiṃ kṛtvā japaṃ homapuraskṛtam \|*  
*dadyādviprāya rājendra vācakāya viśeṣataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. After serving food to the Brahmanas, he should himself take the food. At the end of the year, in the best of the month of Karttika, the god Kartikeya - the son of Ganga, should be worshipped according to the prescribed procedure, besides homa and japam. Thereafter, the Brahmana orator should be gracefully worshipped.

## \|\| 3.42.22-23 \|\|

*ete viprāḥ smṛtā divyā bhaumāstvanye dvijātayaḥ \|*  
*pālite'sminvrate pārtha tīrṇaḥ syādbhavasāgarāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

*evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā naro yoṣidathāpi vā \|*  
*sa prāpyeha śubhaṃ kāmaṃ gacchatīndrasalokatām \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. The divine and the Bhauma Brahmanas are said to be adorable, who help in the crossing of the ocean of the universe. A person who performs the vrata with devotion, irrespective of being a man or a woman, has all his desires successfully fulfilled and ultimately reach Indraloka.

## \|\| 3.42.24-26 \|\|

*sadaiva pūjanīyastu kārtikeyo mahīpate \|*  
*kārttikeyādṛte nānyo rājñāṃ pūjyaḥ pravakṣyate \|\| 24 \|\|*

*saṃgrāmaṃ gacchamāno yaḥ pūjayetkṛttikāsutam \|*  
*sa sarvaṃ jayate vīro yathendro dānavānraṇe \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjayecchaṃkarātmajam \|*  
*pūjyamānastu sadbhaktyā sarvānkāmānprayacchati \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. O lord of the earth, therefore, the god Kartikeya should always be worshipped. Except Kartikeya, no other god is to be worshipped by the rulers. A person who is anxious for the waging of a war, if he proceeds on to the battleground after worshipping Krttika, then like Indra defeated the Danavas, he also gains victory. Therefore, for worshipping the son of Siva, one should always make his efforts and after so doing with devotion, one achieves success in all the desires.

## \|\| 3.42.27 \|\|

*yastu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naro naktaṃ kuryādbhāratasattama \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmukto gāṃgeyasya sadā vrajet \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. O excellent Bharata, thus a person, who performs the night vrata of sasthi, he getting free from all the sins, attains the Kumaraloka.

## \|\| 3.42.28-29 \|\|

*śrutvaivaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ māsaṃ gatvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*pūjayed devadeveśaṃ sa gatvā śivamaṃdiram \|\| 28 \|\|*

*skandaṃ guhaṃ śaravaṇodbhavamādidevaṃ śambhoḥ sutaṃ sadayitaṃ girirājaputryāḥ \|*  
*svarge nirargalasukhānyanubhūyate na senāpatirbhavati rājyadhuraṃdhuro'sau \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Learning about those who have taken refuge in the Daksinapatha, he should go to the temple of Siva and should worship Skanda, who is lodged over position of the commander of the army of gods and is also known by the names of Skanda, Guha, Saravanodbhava and others in a proper manner. Thereby, he becoming a great king, enjoying all the pleasures on earth, is established as an army commander in the heaven.

## Chapter 43. Vijay a Saptami Vrata

## \|\| 3.43.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*saptamī ca yadā deva kena kālena pūjyate \|*  
*kiṃphalā niyamaḥ kaścidvada devakinandana \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O son of Devaki, on which Saptami and at which time, the gods should be adored? What is the reward one achieves so and what are the regulations for the same? You please tell me.

## \|\| 3.43.2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ yadādityadinaṃ bhavet \|*  
*saptamī vijayā nāma tatra dattaṃ mahā phalam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Sri Krsna said- When the bright moon day of a month falls on sunday, that particular day is known as Vijaya-Saptami day. By giving away of the charities on that day, one gets great merit.

## \|\| 3.43.3-4 \|\|

*snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homa upavāsastathaiva ca \|*  
*sarvaṃ vijayasaptamyāṃ mahāpātakanāśanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*pradakṣiṇāṃ yaḥ kurute phalaiḥ puṣpai rdivākaram \|*  
*sa sarvaguṇasaṃpannaṃ putraṃ prānotyanuttamam \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. When the bath, charity, japam and homa besides the fasting is observed on that day, the terrific sins get washed out. On that particular day, a person, who offers flowers and fruits to the Sungod and then circumambulates his image, he achieves a son possessing all the virtues.

## \|\| 3.43.5-6 \|\|

*prathamā nālikeraistu dvitīyā raktanāgaraiḥ \|*  
*tṛtīyā mātuluṃgaiśca caturthī kadalīphalaiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*pañcamī varakūṣmāṇḍaiḥ ṣaṣṭhī pakvaistu teṃdukaiḥ \|*  
*vṛntākaiḥ saptamī deyā aṣṭottaraśatena ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. One should go round the Sun, seven times. First time, he should go round with a coconut; with a red fruit the second time; with a myrobalan the third time; with a banana at the fourth time; with a water melon the fifth time; with the rice the sixth time; carrying a hundred eight papaya pieces for the seventh time; and with other things on the eighth round, the circumambulation should be performed on the seventh moon day.

## \|\| 3.43.7 \|\|

*mauktikaiḥ padmarāgaiśca nīlaiḥ karketanaistathā \|*  
*gomedairvajravaiḍūryaiḥ śatenāṣṭādhikena tu \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Similarly, offering of the beads, ruby, sapphire or the blue gem, Karketana, zircon, vajra and lapiz lazuli etc. should be hundred and eight in number.

## \|\| 3.43.8-9 \|\|

*akṣoṭairbadarairbilvaiḥ karamardaiḥ sabarbaraiḥ \|*  
*āmrāmrātakajaṃbīrairjaṃbukarkoṭikāphalaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*puṣpairdhūpaiḥ phalaiḥ patrairmodakairguṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*ebhirvijayasaptamyāṃ bhānoḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇām \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Besides offering walnuts, jujube, wood apple, karmarda, barbara, mango, myrobalan, bitter orange, rose apple, besides kotika fruit together with flowers, fruits and leaves, excellent sweet balls are also offered on the Surya saptami day, while circumambulating the image of Surya.

## \|\| 3.43.10-11 \|\|

*anyaiḥ phalaiśca kāmyaiśca aikṣavairgraṃthivarjitaiḥ \|*  
*raveḥ pradakṣiṇā deyā phalena phalamādiśet \|\| 10 \|\|*

*na viśenna ca saṃjalpenna ca kaścidvadedapi \|*  
*ekacittatayā bhānuścintanāya prayacchati \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. In addition to the above, other fruits besides the sugarcane without the knots should be offered and one must go round the image of the Sungod. One gets the merit on the basis of the fruit offered to the Sungod. At the time of the adoration of the Sungod, the visiting of the house of others and talking (uselessly) with others is strictly prohibited. Therefore, at that point of time, one should absorb himself in adoration alone.

## \|\| 3.43.12 \|\|

*vasordhārāpradātavyā bhānorgavyena sarpiṣā \|*  
*candrātapatraṃ badhnīyājjayaṃ kiṃkiṇikāyutam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. At the time of the performing of homa, a vase of cow’s ghi and the silver umbrella decorated with small balls should be given.

## \|\| 3.43.13-14 \|\|

*kuṃkumena samālabhya puṣpadhūpaiśca pūjayet \|*  
*śubhaṃ nivedya naivedyaṃ tataḥ paścātkṣamāpayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

*bhāno bhrāskaramārtaṇḍa caṇḍaraśme divākara \|*  
*ārogyamāyurvijayaṃ putraṃ dehi namo'stu te \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. The vermilion should be applied (over the body) offering the flowers and incense. Thereafter, excellent eatables should be served to the lord. Then one should beg forgiveness from him- “O Bhanu, you are also known as Bhaskara, Martanda, Candarasmi and Divakara, be pleased with me and grant me good health, long life, victory and sons. I offer my salutation to you.”

## \|\| 3.43.15-16 \|\|

*upavāsena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca \|*  
*kṛtā niyamayuktena yā tviyaṃ jayasaptamī \|\| 15 \|\|*

*rogī vimucyate rogāddaridraḥ śriyamāpnuyāt \|*  
*aputro labhate putraṃ vidyā vidyārthino bhavet \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Thus observing fast, during the night, the performer should take the food which is given without asking, observing all the regulations. This is the vrata of Jaya-saptami performed by a person and the one who does so, he is freed from all the ailments, the poor achieves the riches, the childless person gets the son and a student becomes proficient in learnings.

## \|\| 3.43.17-18 \|\|

*śuklapakṣe yadā pārtha sādityasaptamī bhavet \|*  
*tadā naktena mudgāśī kṣapayetsapta saptamī \|\| 17 \|\|*

*bhūmau palāśapatreṣu snātvā hutvā yathāvidhi \|*  
*samāpte tu vrate dadyātsauvarṇaṃ mudgamiśritam \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. O Partha, if on a bright sunday the saptami tithi appears, then during the night fast, only green gram is to be taken as the food. Then on all the seven saptamis, one should sleep on the floor, taking food over a palasa leaf. One should take bath and perform homa the next morning. At the conclusion of the vrata, the orator should be offered the sweet balls of green gram with gold.

## \|\| 3.43.19-22 \|\|

*mudgaṃ śreṣṭhāya viprāya vācakāya viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*saptamyāṃ saptisaṃyukta ādityena narottama \|\| 19 \|\|*

*upoṣya vidhinānena mantraprāśanapūjaneḥ \|*  
*ṣaḍakṣareṇa mantreṇa sarvaṃ kāryaṃ vijānatā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*arcanaṃ vahnikāryaṃ ca śatamaṣṭottaraṃ naraḥ \|*  
*samāpte tu vrate paścātsuvarṇena ghaṭāpitam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*sauvarṇaṃ bhāskaraṃ pārtha rukmapātragataṃ śubham \|*  
*raktāṃbaraṃ ca kāṣāyaṃ gandhaṃ dadyātsadakṣiṇam \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. O best of the humans, on all the seven saptamis of the Sun, it is necessary to observe the fast, reciting of the mantras, breaking of the fast and after so doing, the performer of the vrata should recite the six-lettered mantra of Surya. Then performing the homa, a hundred and eight offerings should be made by the performer in the fire. O Partha, at the time of the completion of the vrata, an image of Surya should be consecrated in a gold or silver vase and decorated with the red silken cloth, besides daksina and other things like fragrance, etc. should be given over to the Brahmana (orator).

## \|\| 3.43.23-26 \|\|

*mantreṇānena viprāya karmasiddhyai dvijātaye \|*  
*oṃ bhāskarāya sudevāya namastubhya yaśaskara \|\| 23 \|\|*

*mamādya samīhitārthaprado bhava namonamaḥ \|*  
*dānāni ca pradeyāni gṛhāṇi śayanāni ca \|\| 24 \|\|*

*śrāddhāni pitṛdevānāṃ śāśvatīṃ tṛptimicchatā \|*  
*yātrā praśastā yātṝṇāṃ rājñāṃ ca jayamicchatām \|\| 25 \|\|*

*vijayo jāyate'vaśyaṃ yatīnāṃ ca nṛṇāṃ tadā \|*  
*atorthaṃ viśrutā loke sadā vijayasaptamī \|\| 26 \|\|*

23-26. Thereafter, one should beg forgiveness saying- “O glorious and excellent lord Bhaskara, I offer my salutation to you. Kindly fulfill my desire today.” This should be followed by different types of charities, like house, bed etc., which should satisfy the Brahmanas. The manes too, should be satisfied with the performing of Sraddhas. The kings who intend to proceed on victory march and other people who are always on travel, should perform this vrata and by so doing, they always become victorious.

## \|\| 3.43.27 \|\|

*evameṣā tithiḥ pārtha iha kāmapradā nṛṇām \|*  
*paratra sukhadā saumyā sūryalokapradāyinī \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. O Partha, therefore, the Vijaya Saptami vrata is quite popular in this world which bestows all the comforts. Then reaching the other lokas, he finally reaches the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 3.43.28 \|\|

*dātā bhogī ca caturo dīrghāyurnīrujaḥ sukhī \|*  
*ihāgatya bhavedrājā hastyaśvadhanaratnavān \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. At the time of rebirth, one becomes a donor, clever one, possessing long life, good health and all the comforts. He becomes a ruler possessing the elephants, horses and enormous treasure.

## \|\| 3.43.29 \|\|

*nārī vā kurute yā tu sāpi tatpuṇyabhāginī \|*  
*bhavatyatra na saṃdehaḥ kāryaḥ pārtha tvayā kvacit \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. O Partha, a lady who performs this vrata, earns enormous merit as detailed above. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.43.30 \|\|

*svargyā samīhitasukhārthaphalapradā ca yā mṛgyate munivaraiḥ pravarā tithīnām \|*  
*sā bhānupādakamalārcanaciṃtakānāṃ puṃsāṃ sadaiva vijayā vijayaṃ dadāti \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Thus, one achieves the heaven, all the comforts and all the desires of a devotee are fulfilled. This Vijaya Saptami is best of all the tithis. The great Rsis always remain anxious to patronize the same. A person who on that particular day worships the feet of the Sungod, he is always victorious in the world.

## Chapter 44. Adityamadala Vidhi

## \|\| 3.44.1 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athānyadapi te vacmi dānaṃ śreyaskaraṃ param \|*  
*ādityamaṃḍalaṃ nāma sarvāśubhavināśanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sri Krsna said- I am going to describe about another charity which is quite rewarding and is the destroyer of the sins of all the people.

## \|\| 3.44.2-3 \|\|

*yavacūrṇena śubhreṇa kuryādgodhūmajena vā \|*  
*supakvaṃ bhānubiṃbābhaṃ guḍagavyājyapūritam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya bhāskaraṃ bhaktyā tadagre maṃḍalaṃ śubham \|*  
*raktacandanajaṃ kuryātkuṃkumaṃ vā viśeṣataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. The wheat or the barley flour should be mixed with raw sugar and the ghi of a cow. The image of the Sun should be made out of the same, making it quite solid and worshipped as the Sungod. The red sandal paste or vermilion should be used making an orb of the same.

## \|\| 3.44.4-7 \|\|

*maṇḍalaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya raktavastraiḥ supūjitam \|*  
*brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ maṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava \|\| 4 \|\|*

*ādityatejasotpannaṃ rājataṃ vidhinirmitam \|*  
*śreyase mama vipra tvaṃ pratigṛhṇedamuttamam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kāmadaṃ dhanadaṃ dharmyaṃ putradaṃ sukhadaṃ tava \|*  
*ādityaprītaye dattaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi maṃḍalam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*evaṃ dattvā naro rājansūryavaddivi rājate \|*  
*sarvakāmasamṛddhārtho maṃḍalādhipatirbhavet \|\| 7 \|\|*

4-7. The image should then be covered with a red cloth and handed over to a Brahmana reciting the mantras. At the time of giving over the image to a Brahmana, the mantra should be uttered as- “O Brahmana, the silver had emerged out of the lustre of Sun. This image has been made appropriately. You kindly accept it.” Then addressing the image, one should speak out- “You kindly accept the orb of the Sun which was created for his pleasure. You kindly accept it for my welfare.” The receiver should also speak thus- “The image has been given for the pleasure of the Sungod who bestows dharma, artha, sons as well as the comforts." A person who gives away such a type of charity, he becomes graceful in the heaven. Then getting all his desires fulfilled, he becomes the lord of the region.

## \|\| 3.44.8 \|\|

*dātavyaṃ jayasaptamyāṃ tadārabhya dinedine \|*  
*bhāskarasya mahārāja śaktyā bhāvena bhāvitaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Starting from the same day, with the inspiration of the Sungod, on the Jaya Saptami day, one should make an orb of the Sun, as per one’s means. The Sun-orbs should be given away in charity.

## \|\| 3.44.9 \|\|

*godhūmacūrṇajanitaṃ yavacūrṇajaṃ vā ādityamaṃḍalamakhaṇḍaguḍādyapūrṇam \|*  
*kṛtvā dvijāya vidhivatpratipādayedyo bhūmau bhavatyamitamaṃḍalamaṃḍito'sau \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Making use of the barley or wheat flour, mixed with raw sugar as well as ghi, a Sun image should be created and then cooked. The same orb should be given over to a Brahmana in an appropriate way. A person who does so, he is established as the ruler of the region.

## Chapter 45. Trayodasa-Varjya Saptami Vrata

## \|\| 3.45.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*yāmupoṣya naraḥ kāmānprāpnoti manasepsitān \|*  
*tāmekāṃ vada me deva saptamīṃ dhanasaukhyadām \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O Deva, you kindly speak to me about the Saptami vrata by observing which all the desires of a person are fulfilled, besides earning all the riches and the comforts.

## \|\| 3.45.2-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhānordine site pakṣe atīte cottarāyaṇe \|*  
*punnāmāhvaya nakṣatre gṛhṇīyātsaptamīvratam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*savrīhikānyavatilānsaha māṣamudgairgodhūmamāṃsamadhumaithunakāṃsyapātram \|*  
*abhyaṃjanāṃjana śilātalacūrṇitāni ṣaṣṭhyāṃ paraṃ pariharedahani prasiddhyai \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Sri Krsna said- When the Sun is towards the north pole and when the day of bright saptami falls on sunday during the Punarvasu constellation, the vrata should be started. On the earlier sixth moon day, one should stop taking of barley, sesamum seeds, black gram, green gram, wheat, meat, honey, indulging in sex acts, use of bronze vase, collyrium, black slab and powder.

## \|\| 3.45.4 \|\|

*devānmunīnpitṛgaṇānsajalāñjalībhiḥ saṃtarpya pūjya gaganāṃgaṇahastabhuktān \|*  
*hutvānale tilayavānbahuśo ghṛtāktānbhūmau svapeddhṛdi nidhāya hi taṃ savitram \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Then on the day of saptami in the early morning, oblations should be offered to the Devas and the Pitrs. Thereafter, one should worship the Sungod who moves in the courtyard of the sky, and using ghi with sesamum seeds, the homa should be performed. During the night, one should sleep over the ground, devoting his mind to the Sungod.

## \|\| 3.45.5 \|\|

*yāni trayodaśa janairiha varjitāni dravyāṇi tāni parihṛtya paridviṣaṣṭyā \|*  
*saṃprāśya varṣamekaṃ prāpnoti bhārata sukhaṃ manasepsitaṃ ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. О Bharata, the aforesaid thirteen things should be discarded along with all the liquids like wine, juices etc., and following good conduct the period of one year should be completed. The one who does so, he earns the desired comforts.

## Chapter 46. Kukkuti-markata Vrata

## \|\| 3.46.1-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*lomaśo nāma viprarṣirmathurāyāṃ gataḥ purā \|*  
*sorcito vasudevena devakyā ca yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 1 \|\|*

*upaviṣṭaḥ kathāḥ puṇyāḥ kathayitvā manoharāḥ \|*  
*tataḥ kathayituṃ bhūyaḥ kathāmetāṃ praca krame \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kaṃse hate mṛtāḥ putrāḥ putrā jātāḥ puna. punaḥ \|*  
*mṛtavatsā devaki tvaṃ putraduḥkhena duḥkhitā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*yathā candramukhī dīptirbabhūva mṛtaputrikā \|*  
*paścāccīrṇavratā saiva babhūvākṣatavatsakā \|*  
*tvameva devaki tathā bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Sri Кrsnа said- Once Maharsi Lomasa arrived in Mathura, who was adored both by Devaki as well as Vasudeva. Thereafter, in the narration, the Maharsi said- “O Devaki, after the death of Kamsa, you had several other sons, but unfortunately they could not survive. Therefore, feeling grieved for the loss of your sons, you feel having lost your sons. The queen Candramukhi had also lost many children and felt extremely painful. Therefore, she performed this vrata and then enjoyed the delight of having many children. You will also enjoy the same type of delight. There is no doubt about it.”

## \|\| 3.46.5-6 \|\|

*devakyuvāca \|*  
*kā sā candramukhī brahmanbabhūva bahu putrikā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*caritaṃ kiṃ vratavaraṃ bahusaṃtatikārakam \|*  
*satāṃ sadarthakaraṇaṃ saubhāgyārogyavarddhanam \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Devaki said- Who is the queen Candramukhi, who could enjoy the pleasure of having many sons? Which is the vrata which saves the children after their birth and increases fortunes as well as good health and how did she perform the same?

## \|\| 3.46.7-14 \|\|

*lomaśa uvāca \|*  
*ayodhyāyāṃ purā rājā nuhuṣo nāma viśrutaḥ \|*  
*tasya rājño mahādevī nāmnā candramukhī purā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*purohitasya tasyaiva patnyāsīnmānamānikā \|*  
*tayorāsīddṛḍhā prītiḥ spṛhaṇīyā parasparam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*athāpi tepi mitriṇyau snānārthaṃ sarayūjale \|*  
*prāpte prāptāśca tatraiva bahvyaśca nagarāṅganāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*snātvā tu maṃḍala cakruḥ svapatervyaktarūpiṇaḥ \|*  
*lekhayitvā śivaṃ śāṃtamumayā saha śaṃkaram \|\| 10 \|\|*

*gandhapuṣpākṣatairbhaktyā pūjayitvā yathāvidhi \|*  
*praṇamya gaṃtukāmāstāḥ pṛṣṭāstābhyāṃ narastriyaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tā ūcuḥ śaṅkaro'smābhiḥ pārvatyā saha pūjitaḥ \|*  
*svarṇasūtramayastaṃtuḥ śivāyātmā nive ditaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*dhārāmayamidaṃ tāvadyāvatprāṇāvadhāraṇam \|*  
*tāsāṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā mitriṇyau te'pi bhārata \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tasyaiva samayaṃ tatra baddhvā dorbhyāṃ tu dorakaiḥ \|*  
*tatastāḥ svagṛhāñjagmuḥ svasakhībhiḥ samāvṛtāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

7-14. Lomasa said- In earlier times, Nahuыa was I the ruler of Ayodhya, whose chief queen was known as Candramukhi. She was quite friendly v/ith the wife of the sage Lomasa, who was known by the name of Manamanika. Once both \|of them went to take a bath in the river Sarayu. There they met with several other beautiful women. After taking bath, the ladies made the figures of Siva and Uma, besides the orb of the husband and worshipped them offering them fragrant flowers, incense, rice etc. Both Siva and UmA were worshipped with utmost devotion. When they were about to depart, the chief queen with the wife of sage Lomasa asked the reason for worshipping the images of Siva and Parvati? When they were so asked, the ladies said- “All of us have worshipped the images of Siva and Parvati. Besides we have bound the golden cord to their hands and have entrusted the care of our soul to them. Let them always remain with us on the earth.” O Bharata, listening to the words of the damsels, both the friendly ladies also bound the golden cord over the hand of lord Siva and then left for their abode with their handmaids.

## \|\| 3.46.15-17 \|\|

*kālena mahatā yātaṃ tasyā vai tadvrata nṛpa \|*  
*caṃdravatyāḥ pramattāyā vismṛtaḥ sa tu dorakaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*mṛtā kaiścidahorātraiḥ sā babhūva plavaṅgamī \|*  
*mānī ca kukkuṭī jātā prāyaḥ saṃnikaṭañcare \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tathaiva jāte mitriṇyau pūrvajātismare tathā \|*  
*saṃbhūya bhūpasamayaṃ prāgbhūtaṃ cakratuḥ punaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. A longtime passed and Candramukhi getting intoxicated, forgot the incident of binding the golden cord to Siva and after sometime, she died and was reborn as a female monkey. The wife of the priest Lomasa was also reborn as a hen. But because of their retaining the earlier memories, both of them started living close to each other, while spending their lives.

## \|\| 3.46.18-20 \|\|

*taddine tatra saṃprāpte punaḥ kāle na te mṛte \|*  
*tatraiva mātrake deśe jāte gokulasaṃyute \|\| 18 \|\|*

*rājño jāyā babhūvātha pṛdhvīnāthasya vā punaḥ \|*  
*īśvarī nāma vikhyātā rājñī rājeṃdravallabhā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*agnimīlā dvijasyābhūdbhāryā bhūṣaṇanāmikā \|*  
*purohitasya kālena kukkuṭī bahuputriṇī \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. In due course of time, the queen Candramukhi was reborn in her parental house in Gokula as the wife of the king Prthvinatha, who was famous by the name of Isvari. The wife of the priest with many sons, who was earlier born as a hen, came to be known as Bhusana, the wife of a Brahmana Agnimila.

## \|\| 3.46.21-24 \|\|

*jātismarā padmahastā aṣṭaputrā mṛtaprajā \|*  
*punarnirantarā prītirbabhūvātha tayornṛpa \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tatreśvarī putramekaṃ prasūtā caiva rogiṇam \|*  
*navavarṣastu pañcatvamagātsa ca yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tatastāṃ bhūṣaṇāṃ draṣṭumathaiṣā putraduḥkhitā \|*  
*sakhībhāvādatisnehātsarvaputrasamanvitā \|*  
*amuktābharaṇā nityaṃ svabhāvenaiva bhūṣitā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā putriṇīṃ bhavyāṃ prajajvāleśvarī ruṣā \|*  
*tato gṛhaṃ preṣya ca tāṃ sakhīṃ vai tīvramatsarā \|\| 24 \|\|*

21-24. She remembered the events of her earlier births, enjoyed all the comforts like Laksmi and even after the death of her eight sons, her other sons were alive. Both of them again became great friends. At that point of time, Isvari had given birth to an ailing son, who died at the age of nine years. O Yudhisthira, at that point of time, Isvari who was grieved for the loss of her son, out of the bond of friendship, went to Bhusana to meet her. Getting adorned with all the ornaments together with all her sons, Bhusana entered the royal palace. Isvari finding Bhusana arriving with her sons and adorned with all the ornaments, got enraged and looked like burning in anger. She developed such a great jealousy that she sent off her handmaid friend.

## \|\| 3.46.25-27 \|\|

*cintayāmāsa sā rātryāṃ tasyāḥ putravadhaṃ prati \|*  
*hatāhatāśca tatputrā punarjīvantyanāmayāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*kadācidāhūya sakhīṃ bhūṣaṇāṃ purataḥ sthitām \|*  
*īśvarī prāha kimidaṃ sakhi puṇyaṃ tvayā kṛtam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*yena te nihatāḥ putrāḥ punarjīvanti no bhayam \|*  
*bahuputrā jīvavatsā amuktābharaṇā katham \|*  
*śobhase'bhyadhikaṃ bhadre vidyutsaudāminīva hi \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. But at the same time, she thought of planning to kill all the sons of Bhusana. Thereafter, she killed many of her sons. But all of them regained their lives and remained healthy. After a long time, she summoned her handmaid Bhusana again and Isvari said to her- “O handmaid, what type of noble deeds have been performed by you, by which your died sons, regain their lives even after death. Thus getting so many sons, you look shining like lightning even without wearing ornaments?”

## \|\| 3.46.28-32 \|\|

*bhūṣaṇovāca \|*  
*bhadre bhādrapade māsi saptamyāṃ salilāśaye \|*  
*snātvā śivamaṃḍalake lekhayitvā sahāṃbikam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*bhaktyā saṃpūjya samayaṃ kuryādbaddhvā kare guṇam \|*  
*yāvajjīvaṃ mayā tāvacchivasyātmā niveditaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ samayaṃ kṛtvā tataḥprabhṛti dorakam \|*  
*svarṇaraupyamayaṃ vāpi karaśākhāsu dhārayet \|\| 30 \|\|*

*maṃḍakaṃ veṣṭikāṃ dayācchvaśrūpakṣe dvije tu vā \|*  
*svayaṃ ca tā na bhoktavyā vratabhaṃgabhayātsakhi \|\| 31 \|\|*

*parito mudrikā raupyā sauvarṇīṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*tāmrapātropari sthāpya brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 32 \|\|*

28-32. Bhusana said- On the day of saptami of Bhadrapada, after taking bath in a lake, making the orb of Siva and Ambika, they should be worshipped with devotion. Then binding a golden cord at his hand, one should have a solemn pledge- “I have given over my soul to you. Thereafter, gold or silver rings over the fingers of the hands, the orb as well the costumes, should be given over to a Brahmana from the father-in-law’s side. Apprehensive of the break of the vrata, she should take food herself. O Yudhisthira, these rings of gold or silver should be placed in a copper vase and should be given over to a Brahmana, serving fried cooked food.

## \|\| 3.46.33-37 \|\|

*sohālakāni kāṃsāraṃ dadyādbhuñjīta ca svayam \|*  
*maṇḍalaṃ sadma vittaṃ ca śivaṃ śaktisamanvitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sampūjya sakhi duṣprāpyaṃ trailokye'pi na vidyate \|*  
*tadevaṃ samayaḥ pūrvaṃ tvayā saha mayā kṛtaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*sa mayā pālito bhaktyā tato'haṃ susthitā sakhi \|*  
*tvayā sa bhagnaḥ samayo darpāttyaktaḥ śarīrayoḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*tena santativicchinnā rājyepi sati duḥkhitā \|*  
*eṣa prabhāvaḥ kathito vratasyāsya mayā tava \|\| 36 \|\|*

*arddhaṃ tava pradāsyāmi tasya dharmasya suvrate \|*  
*sakhībhāvātpratīccha tvaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 37 \|\|*

33-37. The performer of the vrata should take her food thereafter. O friend, by making the orb and adoring Siva and ^akti as per one’s means, there is nothing in the world which remains beyond the reach of the performer of the vrata. O friend, this pledge was taken by me with you during earlier times. I followed it with devotion, but out of arrogance, you discarded it and faced also the end of your body. Because of this sin, even after achieving the kingdom, you had to suffer for the separation from your children. Thus, I have narrated to you the influence of (his vrata. O noble one, I am giving over half of my dharma to you and being a friend, you should not refuse to own it.”

## \|\| 3.46.38-40 \|\|

*ityuktvā pratijagrāha vratadānaphalaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*babhūva suprajāḥ sādhvī mokṣaṃ prāpa sureśvarī \|\| 38 \|\|*

*vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa saputrā tvaṃ ca devaki \|*  
*bhaviṣyasi trilokeśaṃ putraṃ ca janayiṣyasi \|\| 39 \|\|*

*ityevaṃ kathayitvāsyai lomaśo munipuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*jagāma nabhasā pārtha mayā'pyetattavoditam \|\| 40 \|\|*

38-40. At these words of her friend, the queen accepted the donation of the vrata as a result of which, she too achieved many sons. Ultimately, she attained mok^a. Therefore, O DevakI, with the influence of this vrata, inspite of your having many sons, you shall also give birth to the lord of the three worlds.” O Partha, thus speaking, Lomasa — the best of the sages, returned by the sky way.

## \|\| 3.46.41-42 \|\|

*ye cariṣyaṃti manujā vratametadyudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*kṛkavākuprasaṅgākhyaṃ devakyā caritaṃ śubham \|\| 41 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ santativicchedo na kadācidbhaviṣyati \|*  
*striyaśca yāścariṣyaṃti vratametatsutapradam \|*  
*martyaloke sukhaṃ sthitvā yāsyaṃti śivamaṃdiram \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. O Yudhisthira, this particular vrata which was performed by DevakI is quite well known in several other contexts. When performed by a person, he never gets separated from his sons. A lady who performs this vrata, gets a son and after enjoying all the comforts of the world, finally achieves the place of Siva.

## \|\| 3.46.43 \|\|

*yaḥ kukkuṭīvratavaraṃ plavagīsametaṃ cakre carācaraguruṃ hṛdaye nidhāya \|*  
*tadvyākaroti kaluṣaughavighātarakṣāṃ sā strī yuvāṃ bhavati śobhanagītavatsā \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. This excellent vrata which relates to a female monkey as well as the hen, when a person performs it with devotion, his all the blemishes of the age of Kali are removed, and he gets all the pleasures and comforts. A woman by following this vrata produces beautiful children.

## Chapter 47. Ubhaya Saptami Vrata

## \|\| 3.47.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi saptamīkalpamuttamam \|*  
*māghamāsātsamārabhya śuklapakṣe yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 1 \|\|*

*saptamyāṃ kuru saṃkalpamahorātre vrate nṛpa \|*  
*varuṇetyarcayitvā tu brahmakūrcaṃ tu kārayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sri Krsna said- I am speaking out to you about another method of performing the Saptami vrata. You please listen. On the bright seventh moon day of the month of Magha, one should observe fast and then adore Varunadeva. Thereafter, Brahmakuca should be performed.

## \|\| 3.47.3 \|\|

*aṣṭamyāṃ bhojayedviprāṃstilapiṣṭaṃ guḍaudanam \|*  
*agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. On the day of astami - the eighth day of the moon, a Brahmana should be satisfied with the serving of the food together with sesamum seeds mixed with raw sugar. One who does so, he achieves the Agnistoma yajna's merit.

## \|\| 3.47.4 \|\|

*saptamyāṃ phālgune māsi sūryamityabhipūjayet \|*  
*vājapeyasya yajñasya yathoktaṃ labhate phalam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. On the day of the saptami of the month of Phalguna, one should worship the Sungod. By so doing, one gets the merit of performing the Vajapeya yajna.

## \|\| 3.47.5 \|\|

*saptamyāṃ caitramāse tu vedāṃśumabhipūjayet \|*  
*ukthādhvarasamaṃ puṇyaṃ naraḥ prāpnoti bhaktimān \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. During the saptami of the month of Caitra, the Sungod should be worshipped in the form of Vedamsu and one who does so, such a devoted person earns the merit of performing the Uktha-yajna.

## \|\| 3.47.6 \|\|

*vaiśākhasya tu saptamyāṃ dhātāramabhipūjayet \|*  
*paśubaṃdhvadhvare puṇyaṃ samyakprāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. On the saptami of the month of Vaisakha, the Sungod has to be adored in the form of Dhata and by so doing, one attains the merit of performing Pasubandhana yajna.

## \|\| 3.47.7 \|\|

*saptamyāṃ jyeṣṭhamāsasya indra ityabhipūjayet \|*  
*vājapeyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti durllabham \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. On the saptami of the month of Jyestha, the Sungod has to be worshipped in the form of Indra and one who does so, he earns the merit of performing the Vajapeya sacrifice, which is quite difficult to achieve.

## \|\| 3.47.8 \|\|

*āṣāḍhamāse saptamyāṃ pūjayitvā divākaram \|*  
*bahuvarṇasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. During the month of Asadha, on the day of saptami the Sungod has to be adored in the form of Divakara and one who does so, he earns the merit of performing Bahuvarna sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.47.9 \|\|

*saptamyāṃ śrāvaṇe māsi mātāpi nāma pūjayet \|*  
*sautrāmaṇiphalaṃ samyakprāpnoti puruṣaḥ śubham \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. During the saptami of the month of Sravana, the Sungod has to be adored in the form of Matapi, which yields the merit of performing the Sautramani sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.47.10 \|\|

*raviṃ prauṣṭhapade māse saptamyāmarcayecchuciḥ \|*  
*tulāpuruṣadānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. During the saptami of the month of Bhadapada, the Sungod has to be worshipped in the form of Ravi, which earns the merit of weighing a person in a scale.

## \|\| 3.47.11 \|\|

*āśvayukchuklasaptamyāṃ savitāraṃ prapūjya ca \|*  
*gosahasrapradānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. During the bright saptami of the month of Asvina, the Sungod has to be worshipped as Savita which yields the merit of giving away a thousand cows in charity.

## \|\| 3.47.12 \|\|

*kārtike śuklasaptamyāṃ dineśaṃ saptavāha nam \|*  
*yo'bhyarcayati puṇyātmā pauṃḍarīkaṃ sa vindati \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. During the bright saptami of the month of Kartika, Sungod has to be worshipped as Saptavahana, which yields the merit of Paundarika yajna.

## \|\| 3.47.13 \|\|

*bhānuṃ mārgasite pakṣe pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*rājasūyasya yajñasya phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ bhajet \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. During the day of saptami of the month of Margasirsa, the Sungod should be worshipped as Bhanu and by so doing, a person earns ten times more merit of performing the Rajasuya sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.47.14 \|\|

*bhāskaraṃ pauṣamāse tu pūjayitvā yathāvidhi \|*  
*narameghasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Similarly, in the month of Pausa, the Sungod has to be adored as Bhaskara and by so doing, a person earns the merit of performing a Naramedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.47.15 \|\|

*tadeva kṛṣṇasaptamyāṃ nāma saṃpūjayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*sopavāsaḥ prayatnena varṣamekaṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*paścātsamāpte niyame sūryayāgaṃ samācaret \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The adoration of the Sungod should also be done on the dark saptami. O Yudhisthira, thus observing the vrata while fasting for one year, the Surya-yajna should be performed in a proper manner.

## \|\| 3.47.16 \|\|

*śucirbhūmau same deśe lepayedraktaca ndanaiḥ \|*  
*ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā caturhastamathāpi vā \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. For this purpose, the red sandal paste should be spread over an auspicious piece of land. A beautiful mandapa of one, two or four cubits should be made.

## \|\| 3.47.17 \|\|

*siṃdūragairikābhyāṃ ca sūryamaṇḍalamālikhet \|*  
*raktapuṣpaiḥ sapadmaiśca dhūpaiḥ kundurakādibhiḥ \|*  
*sampūjya dadyānnaivedyaṃ vicitraṃ ghṛtapācitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. The solar orb should be decorated with vermilion or red ochre powder. Then the lotus and red flowers, besides the incense, kundura (a kind of grass), should be offered while performing the worship. Thereafter, the eatables prepared of ghi should also be offered.

## \|\| 3.47.18-19 \|\|

*purataḥ sthāpayetkumbhānsahiṇyānnasaṃyutān \|*  
*agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryātsamabhyukṣya hutāśanam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*ākṛṣṇeneti maṃtreṇa samidbhiścārkasaṃbhavaiḥ \|*  
*tilairājyaguḍopeterdadyāddaśaśatāhutīḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Then a pitcher (filled with water) and gold should be placed. Thereafter, the homa should be started by the process of kusa-kundika. Initially, before the start of homa, the mantra-Akrsneti, in the burning twig of mandara tree, I the sesamum seeds, ghi and raw sugar should be dropped in the fire in the form of ten offerings.

## \|\| 3.47.20 \|\|

*tatastu dakṣiṇā deyā brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*bhojayitvā raktavastraiḥ śuklānyapi pidhāpayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Thereafter, the Brahmanas should be given the red costumes as well as the white clothes, which should be worn by them and then the food should be served to them, giving daksina as per one’s means.

## \|\| 3.47.21 \|\|

*dvādaśātra praśaṃsaṃti gāvo vastrānvitāḥ śubhāḥ \|*  
*chatropānahayugmaṃ ca ekaikāya pradāpayet \|*  
*evaṃ visṛjya tānviprānsvayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. For the purpose of daksina, the twelve things are said to be quite praiseworthy. They are- cow, costumes, umbrella, shoes etc. There are many items and one out of them should be distributed. Thus, the Brahmana should be sent off with respect, after which the performer of the vrata should take his food, keeping silent.

## \|\| 3.47.22 \|\|

*ya evaṃ kurute pārtha saptamīvratamuttamam \|*  
*nīrujo rūpavānvāggmī dīrghāyuścaiva jāyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. O Partha, when this Saptami vrata is performed by a person, he becomes healthy, gains beauty and truthfulness, besides enjoys a long life.

## \|\| 3.47.23 \|\|

*saptamyāṃ sopavāsastu bhānoḥ paśyaṃti ye mukham \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ sūryalokamavāpnuyuḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. The people, who fasting on the day of saptami have a glance at the Sungod, they get relieved of all the sins, and then achieve the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 3.47.24 \|\|

*vratametanmahārāja sarvāśubhavināśanam \|*  
*sarvaduṣṭapraśamanaṃ śarīrārogyakārakam \|*  
*sūryalokapradaṃ cāṃte prāhaivaṃ nārado muniḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. O great king, this particular vrata which destroys the sins and the evil people, bestows I good health and ultimately, bestows the place of the Sungod. It was narrated by Narada as well verbatim.

## \|\| 3.47.25 \|\|

*ye saptamīmupavasaṃti sitāsitāṃ ca nāmākṣarairahimadīdhitimarcayaṃti \|*  
*te sarvarogarahitāḥ sukhinaḥ sadaiva bhūtvā raveranucarāḥ suciraṃ bhavaṃti \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Similarly, on the dark saptami day, while fasting, one should recite the name of Surya besides adoring him with devotion. Those who do so, then enjoying all the pleasures and becoming free from ailments, they become the attendants of Surya.

## Chapter 48. Kalyana Saptami Vrata

## \|\| 3.48.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*bhagavandurgasaṃsārasāgarottārakārakam \|*  
*kiñcidvrataṃ samācakṣva svargārogyasukhapradam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- In order to cross the horrible ocean of the universe, you speak out to me about the performing of a vrata, by which one could achieve heaven, good health, and all the pleasures.

## \|\| 3.48.2-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*yadā tu śuklasaptamyāmādi tyasya dinaṃ bhavet \|*  
*tadā sā tu mahāpuṇyā vijayā tu nigadyate \|\| 2 \|\|*

*prātargavyena payasā snānamasyāṃ samācaret \|*  
*śuklāṃbaradharaḥ padmamakṣataiḥ parika lpayet \|\| 3 \|\|*

*prāṅmukhoṣṭadalaṃ madhye tadvicitrāṃ ca karṇikām \|*  
*sarveṣvapi daleṣveva vinyasetpūrvataḥ kramāt \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Sri Krsna said- When the bright saptami falls on a sunday, it is known as the extremely auspicious Vijaya-Saptami. One should get up early in the morning and bathe with the water mixed with milk. He should then clad himself in white costumes. Then, one eight petalled lotus should be formed with unbroken rice over the white cloth with a pericarp. Then reciting the name of the Sungod, all the eight petals should be worshipped in a serial order.

## \|\| 3.48.5-6 \|\|

*pūrveṇa tapanāyeti mārtaṇḍāyeti vai namaḥ \|*
