*yāmye divākarāyeti vidhātre nairṛtena ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

*paścime varuṇāyeti bhāskarāyeti vānile \|*  
*saumye ca varuṇāyeti ravayetya'ṣṭame dale \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. While worshipping the petal on the east one should utter Tapana namah; in the southeast, one should utter Martandaye namah; in the south, he should utter Divakaraye namah; in the south-west, he should utter Vidhatre namah: in the west he should utter Varunaye namah; in the north-west he should utter Bhaskaraye namah; in the north, he should utter Varunaye namah; in the north-east he should utter Ravaye namah.

## \|\| 3.48.7-9 \|\|

*ādāvaṃte ca tanmadhye namo'stu paramātmane \|*  
*maṃtrairevaṃ samabhyarcya namaskārāṃtadīpitaiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*śuklavastraphalairbhakṣyairdhūpamālyānulepanaiḥ \|*  
*sthaṃḍile pūjayedbhaktyā guḍena lavaṇena ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tato vyāhṛtihomena vibhajya dvijapuṅgavān \|*  
*śaktitastarpayedbhaktyā guḍakṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. Then in the beginning, middle and at the end, one should utter namah Paramatmane and the invocation should be made. Thereafter, the puja with utmost devotion should be performed offering the white cloth, ripe fruits, incense, rosary, paste, and the lotus as well as the fire altar should be worshipped appropriately. Then homa should be performed using raw sugar and salt. As per one’s means, the excellent one should be given away raw sugar, milk, ghi etc. besides the food with sweet dishes pleasing him immensely.

## \|\| 3.48.10-11 \|\|

*tilapātraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca gurave ca nivedayet \|*  
*evaṃ niyamakṛtsnātvā prātarutthāya mānavaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kṛtasnānajapo vipraiḥ sahaiva ghṛtapāyasam \|*  
*bhuktvā ca vedavidvadbhirbaiḍālavratava rjitaiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Thereafter, a gold vase filled with sesamum seeds should be given over to the preceptor. In the morning, the person performing the vrata should take his bath and then perform the japam. Thereafter, he should take food with the learned Brahmanas (who should not be deceitful), which should comprise of the payasam.

## \|\| 3.48.12-13 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte kṛtvaitadakhilaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*udyāpayedyathāśakti bhāskaraṃ saṃsmaranhṛdi \|\| 12 \|\|*

*ghṛtapātraṃ sakarakaṃ sodakumbhaṃ niveda yet \|*  
*vastrālaṃkārasaṃyuktāṃ suvarṇāsyāṃ payasvinīm \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. At the end of the year, with his mind devoted to the Sungod, a pottery vase filled with ghi, a pitcher filled with water, costumes and ornaments decorating a milk giving cow and getting relieved of the jealousy, one should give away the charity as per his means, even in the poverty conditions.

## \|\| 3.48.14-16 \|\|

*ekāmapi pradadyādgāṃ vittahīno vimatsaraḥ \|*  
*vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta tato mohātpata tyadhaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā yastu kuryātkalyāṇasaptamīm \|*  
*śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvāpi so'pi pāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

*yaścāṣṭapatrakamalodarakarṇikāyāṃ saṃpūjayetkusumadhūpavilepanāyaiḥ \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhyāḥ parehani navārtiharaṃ dineśaṃ kalyāṇabhājanamasau bhavate hi jaṃtuḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. One who acts miserly even when he is rich, he has to face a fall. This is the method of performing the Kalyana Saptami, who so ever performs the same or listens to or reads it, he is freed from all the sins. Similarly, a person who worships the Sungod with an eight petalled lotus with a pericarp and reciting the name of the Sungod offers to him the flowers, incense and the paste, he gets entitled to the seven kalyanas.

## Chapter 49. Sarkara-Saptami

## \|\| 3.49.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śarkarāsaptamīṃ vakṣye sarvakalmaṣanāśinīm \|*  
*āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ yayānaṃtaṃ prajāyate \|\| 1 \|\|*

*mādhavasya site pakṣe saptamyāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ \|*  
*prātaḥ snātvā tilaiḥ śuddhaiḥ śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sthaṃḍile padmamālikhya kuṃkumena sakarṇikam \|*  
*tasminnamaḥ savitreti gandhapuṣpaṃ nivedayet \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Sri Krsna said- Now, I am going to speak before you the process of performing the Sarkara-Saptami with the performing of which, all the sins get destroyed and the performer achieves justice, good health, bliss and enormous wealth. You please listen. On the bright saptami day of the month of Vaisakha, one should take the bath in the early morning, prepare a pedestal which should be decorated with vermilion, eight petalled lotus with a pericarp. Thereafter, uttering Savitre namah, the fragrant paste and the flowers should be offered.

## \|\| 3.49.4 \|\|

*sthāpayedudakuṃbhaṃ ca śarkarāpātrasaṃyutam \|*  
*raktavastraiḥ svalaṃkṛtya śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Then, a pitcher filled with water and a vase full of raw sugar should be consecrated. It should then be decorated with red cloth, white rosary and the white paste.

## \|\| 3.49.5-7 \|\|

*suvarṇāśvasamāyuktaṃ maṃtreṇānena pūjayet \|*  
*viśvedevamayo yasmādvedavādīti paṭhyate \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tvamevāmṛtasarvasvamataḥ pāhi sanātana \|*  
*saurasūktaṃ japaṃstiṣṭhetpurāṇaśravaṇena vā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ahorātre gate paścādaṣṭamyāṃ kṛtanityakaḥ \|*  
*sarvaṃ ca vedaviduṣe brāhmaṇāyopapādayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. Then, a gold horse should be placed there and reciting the mantras, the worship should be made appropriately. O Deva, the learned people well-versed in the Vedas, describe you as nectar like universal lord. Therefore, O eternal one, you protect me. Thereafter, the recitation of Saura-sukta (of the Vedas) or listening to the Surya Purana, the night has to be spent. Then on the day of saptami, getting free from the daily routine, the same should be given over to a learned Brahmana. Thereafter, raw sugar, payasam with ghi, should be given over to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.49.8-14 \|\|

*bhojayecchaktito viprāñcharkarāghṛtapāyasaiḥ \|*  
*bhuñjīta tailalavaṇaṃ svayamapyatha vāgyataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā sarvaṃ māsimāsi samācaret \|*  
*vatsarāṃte punardadyādbrāhmaṇāya samāhitaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*śayanaṃ vastrasaṃvītaṃ śarkarākalaśānvitam \|*  
*sarvopaskarasaṃyuktaṃ tathaikāṃ gāṃ payasvinīm \|\| 10 \|\|*

*gṛhaṃ ca śaktito dadyātsamastopaskarānvitam \|*  
*sahasreṇāpi niṣkāṇāṃ kṛtvā dadyācchatena vā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*daśabhirdvitribhirniṣkaistadardhenāpi bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*suvarṇāśvaḥ pradātavyaḥ pūrvavanmaṃtravācanam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta kurvandoṣānsa maśnute \|*  
*amṛtaṃ pibato vaktrātsūryasyāmṛtabindavaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*nipetureta utthāya śālimudgekṣavaḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*śarkarā ca paraṃ tasmādikṣurasodbhavā matā \|\| 14 \|\|*

8-14. Then discarding taking of salt and oil, the performer should himself take food. Following the same process, each saptami vrata in a month should be observed. At the end of vratas, the Brahmana should again be given a well arranged bed, raw sugar and a pitcher with all other requirements. Besides, a mulching cow and a furnished house in the absence of which a thousand cows and a horse made of gold should be given to a Brahmana. While giving away charity, one should keep in mind the blemish of conducting himself miserly when enough of wealth is available with the donor. Because by non following this aspect, a person has to earn blemish. While consuming the nectar, two drops of the same fell on earth, which were the cause of the growth of Sali rice, green gram and the sugarcane. Then the raw sugar emerged out of the sugarcane juice, therefore it is liked by the Sungod.

## \|\| 3.49.15-17 \|\|

*iṣṭā raverataḥ puṇyā śarkarā havyakavyayoḥ \|*  
*śarkarāsaptamī caiṣā vājimedhaphalapradā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sarve hyupaśamaṃ yāṃti punaḥ saṃtativarddhinī \|*  
*yaḥ kuryātparayā bhaktyā sa paraṃ brahma gacchati \|\| 16 \|\|*

*kalpamekaṃ vasetsvarge tato yāti paraṃ padam \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. Because of this, this is included in the havya and kavya (offerings). This Sarkara Saptami bestows the merit of performing Asvamedha sacrifice. Therefore, a person who performs this vrata, all his disturbances gets subsided, besides there is growth in the progeny. Finally, he achieves the supreme Brahman. The performer of this vrata, after enjoying all the comforts in the heaven for a kalpa, gains the supreme stage.

## \|\| 3.49.18 \|\|

*idamanagha śṛṇoti yaḥ smaredvā paripaṭhatīha sureśvarasya loke \|*  
*matimapi ca dadāti yo janānāmamaravadhūjanakinnaraiḥ sa pūjyaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. O sinless one, thus listening to the method of the performing of this vrata or reading about it or to support for the same, a person, on reaching the heaven, is adored by the divine damsels, besides the kinnaras.

## Chapter 50. Kamala-Saptami Vrata

## \|\| 3.50.1-7 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ataḥparaṃ pravakṣyāmi tadvatkamalasaptamīm \|*  
*yasyāḥ saṃkīrtanādeva tuṣyatīha divākaraḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*vasaṃte'malasaptamyāṃ snātaḥ sangaurasarṣapaiḥ \|*  
*tilapātre ca sauvarṇaṃ nidhāya kamalaṃ śubham \|\| 2 \|\|*

*vastrayugmavṛtaṃ kṛtvā gaṃdhapuṣpairathārcayet \|*  
*namaste padmahastāya namaste viśvadhāriṇe \|\| 3 \|\|*

*divākara namastubhyaṃ prabhākara namo'stu te \|*  
*tato dvikālavelāyāmudakuṃbhasamanvitam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*viprāya dadyātsaṃpūjya vastramālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*ahorātre gate paścādaṣṭamyāṃ bhojayeddvijān \|\| 5 \|\|*

*yathāśaktyātha bhuñjīta vimāṃsaṃ tailavarjitam \|*  
*anena vidhinā śuklasaptamyāṃ māsimāsi ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sarvaṃ samācaredbhaktyā vitta śāṭhyavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*vratāṃte śayanaṃ dadyātsuvarṇakamalānvitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

1-7. Sri Krsna said - I am now telling you about the Kamala Saptami with the mention of whose name by devotion, the lord Divakara gets pleased. During the month of spring season, on the day of the bright saptami, taking bath in the morning, a lotus should be made in gold and placed in a vase filled with the seeds of yellow mustard. Then it should be covered with two clothes. The fragrant flowers should be offered while worshipping the lotus in a proper manner. Then one should say- “O Divakara - the sustainer of the universe, you are known as Prabhakara as well. Salutation to you.” Then one should beg forgiveness saying- "Salutation to you again and again. Then, the pitcher filled with water, a cloth, a rosary and ornaments should be given to an excellent Brahmana, after the completion of the puja. Thus spending a day and a night, on the day of astami, as per one’s means, he should offer food to a Brahmana without oil and meat, which should be sweet. Similarly, on the bright saptami of each one of the months, performing the vrata and at the end of it, consecrating a golden lotus, it should be placed over the well arranged bed and should be worshipped.

## \|\| 3.50.8 \|\|

*gāvaṃ sa dadyācchaktyā tu suvarṇāḍhyāṃ payasvinīm \|*  
*bhājanāsanadīpādīndadyādiṣṭānupaskarān \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Then a mulching cow, vase for taking food, a seat, a lamp and all the amenities for the use of the Brahmanas, should be respectfully given to them.

## \|\| 3.50.9 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yastu kuryātkamalasaptamīm \|*  
*lakṣmīmanantāmabhyetya sūryaloke ca modate \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. A person who thus performs the vrata of Kamala Saptami, he enjoys all the pleasures in the Suryaloka.

## \|\| 3.50.10 \|\|

*kalpekalpe tathā lokānsapta gatvā pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*apsarobhiḥ parivṛtastato yāti parāṅgatim \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. He stays for a kalpa in each one of the Iokas and is served by Apsaras and achieves the best position.

## \|\| 3.50.11 \|\|

*yaḥ paśyatīdaṃ śṛṇuyānmuhūrtaṃ paṭhecca bhaktyā sumatiṃ dadāti \|*  
*so'pyatra lakṣmīmacalāmavāpya gandharvavidyādharalokameti \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. A person, who observes, listens or reads even for a short while, or recites it, achieves the stable Laksmi and reaches the places of Gandharvas and Vidyadharas.

## Chapter 51. Subha-Saptami Vrata

## \|\| 3.51.1-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*anyāmapi pravakṣyāmi śobhanāṃ śubhasaptamīm \|*  
*yāmupoṣya naro rogācchokaduḥkhātpramucyate \|\| 1 \|\|*

*puṇya āśvayuje māsi kṛtasnānaḥ payaḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*vācayeta tato viprānārabhecchubhasaptamīm \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kapilāṃ pūjayedbhaktyā gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ \|*  
*namāmi sūryasaṃbhūtāmaśeṣabhuvanālayām \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tvāmahaṃ śubhakalyāṇaśarīrāṃ sarvasiddhaye \|*  
*athāhṛtya tilaprasthaṃ tāmrapātreṇa saṃyutam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kāñcanaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ tadvadvastramālyaguḍānvitam \|*  
*dadyādvikālavelāyāmaryamā prīyatāmiti \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Sri Krsna said - I am going to tell you about another auspicious as well as handsome Saptami and the method of performing its vrata. By observing fast during this saptami, a person is relieved of all the miseries, sufferings and grief. During the auspicious month of Kartika on the day of saptami, taking a bath known as Yamaputa, the process of the vrata of the auspicious Saptami should be started. At that time, the fragrance and paste should be used while worshipping of a white cow and then beg forgiveness, saying- “You are born of the Sungod, the base of all the Bhuvanas, you are the auspicious image of auspiciousness and welfare. Therefore, I offer my salutation to you.” Thereafter, putting 930 grams of sesamum seeds, the gold image of a bull should be placed over it, decorated with garlands and raw sugar at the evening times saying- “Let Aryama be pleased,” and should be given over to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.51.6 \|\|

*pañcagavyaṃ ca saṃprāśya svapyādbhūmau vimatsaraḥ \|*  
*tataḥ prabhāte saṃjāte bhaktyā saṃtarpayeddvijān \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. During the night, he should break his fast consuming the pancagavya and sleep on floor during the night. In the early morning, he should please a Brahmana, by giving food to his satisfaction.

## \|\| 3.51.7 \|\|

*anena vidhinā dadyānmāsimāsi sadā naraḥ \|*  
*vāsasī vṛṣabhaṃ haimaṃ tadvaddhenostu pūjanam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Following the same process, during each month, cloth, figure of a bull in gold, besides worshipping the cow, the vrata should be continued for a year.

## \|\| 3.51.8-11 \|\|

*saṃvatsarāṃte śayanamikṣudaṇḍaguḍānvitam \|*  
*sopadhānakaviśrāmaṃ bhājanāsanasaṃyutam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tāmrapātraṃ tilaprasthaṃ sauvarṇavṛṣasaṃyutam \|*  
*dadyādvedavide sarvaṃ viśvātmā prīyatāmiti \|\| 9 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā rājankuryādyaḥ śubhasaptamīm \|*  
*tasya śrīrvimalā kīrtirbha vejanmanijanmani \|\| 10 \|\|*

*apsarogaṇagandharvaiḥ pūjyamānaḥ surālaye \|*  
*vasedgaṇādhipo bhūtvā yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam \|\| 11 \|\|*

8-11. At the end of the year, a well arranged bed, sugarcane, raw sugar, vase for taking food, copper plate, sesamum seeds, the gold image of a bull and other things should be given over to a Brahmana, saying- “Let the universal soul be pleased.” O king, with the following of this method, a person who performs the vrata of this Saptami, he earns the spotless glory at the end of each life, and getting honoured by the Apsaras and the Gandharvas, is established in the heaven as the leader of the ganas.

## \|\| 3.51.12-14 \|\|

*sa kalpādavatīrṇastu saptadvīpādhipo bhavet \|*  
*brahmahatyāsahasrasya bhrūṇahatyāśatasya ca \|\| 12 \|\|*

*nāśaṅkaroti puṇyeyaṃ kṛtā vai śubhasaptamī \|\| 13 \|\|*

*imāṃ paṭhedyaḥ śṛṇuyā nmuhūrtaṃ vīkṣeta saṃgādapi dīyamānam \|*  
*so'pyatra saṃbādhya vimuktadehaḥ prāpnoti vidyādharanāyakatvam \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. Again at the stall of the creation, he becomes the lord of all the seven islands. With the celebrating of this auspicious saptami, one is relieved of a thousand Brahmahatyas and a hundred fetuses. Whosoever reads, listens or has a look at this sacred work even for a record, he is established as the leader of the Vidyadharas.

## Chapter 52. Snapana-Saptami Vrata

## \|\| 3.52.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kimudvegādbhavetkṛtyamalakṣmīḥ kena hanyate \|*  
*mṛtavatsādikāryeṣu duḥsvapne ca kimiṣyate \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- How could the restlessness, misfortune and other miseries of the people be removed? What are the means to get rid of the blemishes like death of sons and witnessing of the bad dreams? You kind tell me the process for getting relieved of all these evils.

## \|\| 3.52.2-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*purā kṛtāni pāpāni phalaṃtyatra yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*rogardaurgatyarūpeṇa tathaiveṣṭavighātanaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tadvighātāya vakṣyāmi sadā kalyāṇasaptamīm \|*  
*saptamīsnapanaṃ nāma vyādhipīḍāvināśanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*bālānāṃ maraṇaṃ yatra kṣīrapānaṃ praśasyate \|*  
*tadvadvṛddhāturāṇāṃ ca yauvane vāpi vartatām \|\| 4 \|\|*

*śāntaye tatra vakṣyāmi mṛtavatsādike ca yat \|*  
*etadevādbhutodvegaciṃtāvibhramamānasam \|\| 5 \|\|*

2-5. Sri Krsna said O Yudhisthira, because of the sins committed in the past births, the people suffer from ailments, misfortunes and are deprived of the near and dear ones. Therefore, in order to get rid of them, I am going to speak about the Kalyana-Saptami Vrata. You please listen. By taking a bath on the day of saptami, various types of ailments and pains are removed. At the demise of the children, like the consuming of the praiseworthy payasam, for the old people and the destitute, besides for the removal of the blemishes and for the death of sons, vrata of this very saptami should be observed. This is also prescribed for the people who are old, shattered and restless people as well.

## \|\| 3.52.6-9 \|\|

*varāhakalpe saṃprāpte manorvaivasvateṃ'tare \|*  
*kṛte yuge mahārāja haihayo rūpavarddhanaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*āsīnnṛpottamaḥ pūrvaṃ kṛtavīryaḥ pratāpavān \|*  
*sa saptadvīpamakhilaṃ pālayāmāsa bhūtalam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*yāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi saptasaptati bhārata \|*  
*jātamātraṃ ca tasyātha śubhaṃ putraśataṃ kila \|\| 8 \|\|*

*yavanasya tu śāpena vināśamagamatpurā \|*  
*kṛtavīryaḥ samārādhya sahasrāṃśuṃ divākaram \|\| 9 \|\|*

6-9. During the Varaha-kalpa of the Vaivasvata Manvantara, in the period of Krta-yuga, there had been a glorious king known by the name of Krtavirya who ruled the country. He was the lord of all the seven islands on earth. After the lapse of seventy seven thousand years, he got a hundred beautiful sons. But due to the curse of a Yavana, all of them met with their end, soon after their birth. Thereafter, by fasting, observing vratas, as well as the reciting of the divine Vedic Suktas, he worshipped lord Divakara, who is also known as Sahasramsu, the Sungod himself appeared before Krtavirya.

## \|\| 3.52.10-11 \|\|

*upavāsavratairdivyairvedasūktaiśca bhārata \|*  
*darśayāmāsa cātmānaṃ kṛtavīryasya bhānumat \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kṛtavīryeṇa vai pṛṣṭaḥ provācedaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*atikleśena mahatā putrastava narādhipa \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. On an enquiry by Krtavirya, Brhaspati (the Sungod) said to him- “O king, after suffering severe pain, you would be able to get a child who would have long life. But first of all, you organize an anusthana for the Saptami, for the destruction of your sins.

## \|\| 3.52.12-14 \|\|

*bhaviṣyati ciraṃjīvī kiṃ tu kalmaṣanāśanam \|*  
*saptamīsnapanaṃ vāpyāṃ kuru pāpavinaṣṭaye \|\| 12 \|\|*

*jātasya mṛtavatsāyāḥ saptame māsi bhūpate \|*  
*gṛhatārābalaṃ labdhvā kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*bālasya janmanakṣatraṃ varjayettāṃ tithiṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*sadvṛddhāturagāṇāṃ tu kṛtaṃ syāditi teṣu ca \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. O king, when you get a son on the seventh month, for the removal of the blemish from the queen, for having given birth to a dead child, observing the movements of the planets, a Brahmana should be made to recite the welfare mantras leaving aside the date and constellation of the time of the birth of the child. Then, at a place which should be plastered with the cowdung and purified, the image of the Sungod should be made by the Sali rice and Varuna-ksira.

## \|\| 3.52.15-19 \|\|

*gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmāvekāgracittavān \|*  
*taṃḍulai raktaśāleyairvaruṇākṣīrasaṃyutam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*nirvapetsūryamudgābhyāṃ mātṛbhyopi vidhānataḥ \|*  
*kīrtayetsūryadaivatyaṃ saptārciṣi ghṛtāhutīḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*juhuyādrudrasūktena tadvadrudrāya bhārata \|*  
*hotavyāḥ samidhaścātra tatra vārkapalāśajāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*yavakṛṣṇatilairhomaḥ kartavyoṣṭaśataṃ punaḥ \|*  
*hutvā snānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ madhye gāṃgena dhīmatā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*vipreṇa vedaviduṣā vidhivaddarbhapāṇinā \|*  
*sthāpayitvā catuṣkoṇe catuṣkuṃbhānpraśobhanān \|\| 19 \|\|*

15-19. It should then be worshipped properly, after which the offerings of ghi should be poured into the fire flames. In order to please the Sungod, who is the form of Siva, the Brahmanas, reciting the hymns from Rudra-Sukta, should pour barley and black sesamum seeds, a hundred and eight times. At noon, he should take his bath in the river Ganga, holding kusa grass in his hand, and the Vedic Brahmanas should consecrate four kalasas on the four corners.

## \|\| 3.52.20-24 \|\|

*pañcamaṃ ca punarmadhye cākṣatena vibhūṣitam \|*  
*sthāpayeddarpaṇākrāṃtaṃ saptarṣiṇābhimaṃtritam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*saureṇa tīrthatoyena pūrṇacandramalānvitam \|*  
*sarvānsarvauṣadhiyutānpañcabhaṃgajalānvitān \|\| 21 \|\|*

*paṃcaratnaphalairyuktāñchākhābhirapi veṣṭitān \|*  
*gajāśvarathyārājadvārvalmīkāddhradagokulāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

*suśuddhāṃ mṛdamānīya sarveṣveva vinikṣipet \|*  
*caturṣvapi ca kuṃbheṣu ratnagarbheṣu madhyamam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*gṛhītvā brāhmaṇaṃ cātra saurānmantrānudīrayet \|*  
*nārībhiḥ saptasaṃkhyābhī rathāṅgāṅābhiratra ca \|\| 24 \|\|*

20-24. A fifth kalasa should be lodged in the centre, which should be decorated with a mirror. It should be sanctified by the Saptarsis as well. The kalasas should be filled with the water of all the solar tirthas, camphor, all the ausadhis, five tender shoots, five gems and fruits. They should be covered with cloth. Thereafter, the dust from elephant stable, horse stable, royal bed, entrance gate of king’s palace, white ant hill, a river and cow-pen should be poured in the pitchers. After the puja is over, the Brahmana and seven ladies should be served with food using the water of the central pitcher gold and gems, besides the ghi mixed payasam should be served to the Brahmanas as food. I hey should eat to their satisfaction, thereafter, the preceptor should be worshipped, who getting overjoyed with the food, blesses- ‘This infant should have long life. He should remain free from ailments upto the age of twelve years. All his evils should get destroyed in fire. Brahma, Rudra, Visnu, Skanda, Vayu, Indra, Agni and other gods should protect the child from all the dangers and should always be glorious and kind to him and bestow their blessings on the child in the form of reciting of the welfare mantras. Thereafter, as per one’s means, a duly decorated white cow should be given in charity. Then he should send off the deities, offering his salutation to them.

## \|\| 3.52.25-28 \|\|

*bhojitābhiryathāśakti mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*saviprābhiśca kartavyaṃ mṛtavatsābhiṣecanam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*dīrghāyurastu bālo'yaṃ jīvaputrā ca bhāvinī \|*  
*ādityacandramāsārdhaṃ grahanakṣatramaṇḍalam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*śakraḥ salokapālo vai brahmā viṣṇurmaheśvaraḥ \|*  
*ete cānye ca vai devāḥ sadā pāṃtu kumārakam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*māśanirmā sa hutabhuṅmā ca bālagrahā kvacit \|*  
*pīḍāṃ kurvaṃtu bālasya mā mātṛjanakasya vai \|\| 28 \|\|*

25-28. Thereafter, the garlands, costumes and ornaments should be used for decorating the woman whose children had died, who should then be consecrated, saying that- “This son should have a long life and this woman should hereafter be known as the one having her son alive The Sun, Moon, all the planets, constellations, orb, Lokapalas, besides, Indra, Brahma, Visnu, Mahesvara and all the Gods should always save the life of the infant. The planets who are consumers of meat and those who are not, should never torture the child or his parents.”

## \|\| 3.52.29-33 \|\|

*tataḥ śuklāmbaradharāḥ kumāraṃ patisaṃyutāḥ \|*  
*saptakaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā puṣpairgandhaiḥ phalaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*kāñcanīṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā tilapātropari sthitām \|*  
*pratimāṃ dharmarājasya gurave vinivedayet \|\| 30 \|\|*

*vastrakāñcanaratnaughairbhakṣyaiḥ saghṛtapāyasaiḥ \|*  
*pūjayedbrāhmaṇāstadvadvittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet \|*  
*bhuktvā ca guruṇā ceyamuccāryā maṃtrasaṃtatiḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*dīrghāyurastu bālo'yaṃ yāvadvarṣaśataṃ sukhī \|*  
*yatkiñcidasya duritaṃ tatkṣiptaṃ vaḍa vāmukhe \|\| 32 \|\|*

*brahmā rudro viṣṇuḥ skando vāyuḥ śakro hutāśanaḥ \|*  
*rakṣaṃtu sarve duṣṭebhyo varadā yāṃtu sarvadā \|\| 33 \|\|*

29-33. I hus performing the abhiseka, the husband should be clad in white clothes, together with other seven women, offering flowers, fragrance and auspicious fruits, and the infant should be adored. The image of Dharmaraja who is consecrated in the vase filled with sesamum seeds, should be given over to the preceptor, keeping in mind the blemish of being miserly, and the costumes.

## \|\| 3.52.34-38 \|\|

*evamādīni cānyāni vadataḥ pūjayedgurūn \|*  
*śaktitaḥ kapilāṃ dattvā praṇipatya visarjayet \|\| 34 \|\|*

*caruṃ ca putrasahitā praṇamya raviśaṃkarau \|*  
*hutaśeṣaṃ tadānīyādādityāya namo'stu te \|\| 35 \|\|*

*ayamevādbhutaṃ yogo hyadbhuteṣu ca śasyate \|*  
*karturjanmani vṛkṣāṇāṃ devāntsaṃpūjayettadā \|*  
*śāṃtyarthaṃ śuklasaptamyāmetatkurvanna sīdati \|\| 36 \|\|*

*puṇyaṃ pavitramāyuṣyaṃ saptamīsnapanaṃ raviḥ \|*  
*kathayitvā naraśreṣṭha tatraivāṃtaradhīyata \|\| 37 \|\|*

*sa cānena vidhānena kārtavīryo'rjuno nṛpaḥ \|*  
*saṃvatsarāṇāmayutaṃ śaśāsa pṛthivīmimām \|\| 38 \|\|*

34-38. Thereafter, the woman with her son, offering salutation to the Sungod and lord Siva, should consume the leftover of the payasam, saying- “We are offering our salutation to the Sungod.” Thus saying, both should beg forgiveness. This is the astonishing type of yoga, which has been prescribed for the suppressing of the disturbances. A person, who performs the vrata-anusthana relating to the birth of a son as well as the death of the newly born children, never has to face the misery in his life. O best of humans, thus describing the merits of taking a bath etc. on this auspicious saptami which bestows long life, the Sungod suddenly disappeared from the scene. By performing the vrata during this auspicious saptami, the son of Krtavirya-Sahasrarjuna lived on earth for ten thousand years, while ruling it.

## \|\| 3.52.39 \|\|

*ārogyaṃ bhāskārādiccheddhanamiccheddhutāśanāt \|*  
*śaṃkarājjñānamicchettu gatimicchejjanārdanāt \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The people achieve good health from Surya, riches from fire, knowledge from lord Siva and excellent place in heaven from lord Janardana.

## \|\| 3.52.40 \|\|

*etanmahāpātakanāśanaṃ syādapyakṣayaṃ vedavidaḥ paṭhaṃti \|*  
*śṛṇoti yaścainamananyacetāstasyāpi siddhiṃ munayo vadaṃti \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. With the performing of the anusthana of this saptami, the learned people, well-versed in the Vedas have stated that it destroys the terrific sins. With a dedicated mind those who listen to it, also attain success. This has been ordained by the learned people.

## Chapter 53. Acala-Saptami Vrata

## \|\| 3.53.1-3 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*adhruveṇa śarīreṇa supakvenāpi kiṃ phalam \|*  
*māghasnānavihīnena yattyaktaṃ yadunandana \|\| 1 \|\|*

*prātaḥsnānāsamarthānāṃ śarīraṃ paśya dehinām \|*  
*kiṃ tena vada kartavyaṃ māghe saṃsārabhīruṇā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kāyakleśasahā nāryo na bhavaṃti yadūttama \|*  
*saukumāryaṃ śarīrasya acalatvāttathaiva ca \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Yudhisthira said- O son of the race of Yadus, by getting this perishable body, in case a person is deprived of a bath in the month of Magha, then what reward shall he get upto the old age? Besides those who fail to perform a bath in the early morning in the month of Magha, you speak about their duties. 0 best of the race of Yadus, because of the tenderness of their bodies, the ladies are unable to bear the pain of the body.

## \|\| 3.53.4 \|\|

*kathaṃ ca tāḥ surūpāḥ syuḥ subhagāḥ suprajāstathā \|*  
*sukṛtasyeha puṇyasya sarvametatphalaṃ yataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. But how do they achieve the best of fortunes, the beauty and lovely children? All these pleasant rewards could be achieved only by noble deeds performed during the earlier births.

## \|\| 3.53.5 \|\|

*alpāyāsena sumahadyena puṇyamavāpyate \|*  
*strībhirmāghe mama brūhi snānaṃ tattvaṃ ramādhava \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. O noble Madhava, by making the small efforts, how can a person get enormous merits as also at to how the ladies can take a bath in the month of Magha?

## \|\| 3.53.6-10 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śrūyatāṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha rahasyamṛṣibhāṣitam \|*  
*yanmayā kasyacinnoktamacalāsaptamīvratam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*veśyā cendumatī nāma rūpaudāryaguṇānvitā \|*  
*āsītkurukulaśreṣṭha magadhasya vilāsinī \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tanumadhyā sujaghanā pīnonnatapayodharā \|*  
*samyagvibhaktāvayavā pūrṇacandranibhānanā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sauṃdaryaṃ saukumāryaṃ ca tasyāḥ kāmena gīyate \|*  
*yasyāḥ saṃdarśanādeva kāmaḥ kāmāturo bhavet \|\| 9 \|\|*

*mūrtiḥ śaśadharasyeva nayanānandakāriṇī \|*  
*vaśīkaraṇavidyeva sarvalokamanoharā \|\| 10 \|\|*

6-10. Sri Krsna said- O best of the Pandavas, the secret procedure for the performing of the vrata of Acala Saptami has been spelt out by the Rsis, which has not been disclosed by me to anyone else. I am telling you the same, which you please listen. A prostitute named Indumati. having enough of charms, beauty and loveliness, once lived in the city of Magadha. She was the most flirt woman in Magadha, whose waist was quite thin, charming thighs and well developed breasts. All the limbs of the most beautiful woman were quite charming. Her beauty and tenderness of limbs were praised himself by the lord Manamatha himself, very much, because by the mere sight of her, he himself used to become passionate. Like the moon rays, she satisfied the eyes. As a glamorous woman, she was well known in the world.

## \|\| 3.53.11-16 \|\|

*ekasmindivase prātaḥ sumukhasthitayā tayā \|*  
*ciṃtitā hṛdaye rājantsaṃsārasyānavasthitiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*sannimajya jagadidaṃ viṣaye kāyasāgare \|*  
*janmamṛtyujarāgrāhaṃ na kaścidavabuddhyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

*apāko bhūtabhāṇḍānāṃ dhātṛśilpivinirmitam \|*  
*svakarmeṃdhanasaṃvītaṃ pacyate bālavahninā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ye yāṃti divasāḥ puṃsāṃ dharmakāmārthavarjitāḥ \|*  
*na te punarihāyāṃti harabhaktā narā yathā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam \|*  
*yasmindine na kriyate vṛthā sa divaso nṛṇām \|\| 15 \|\|*

*putrāṇāṃ dāragṛhakasamāsaktaṃ hi mānasam \|*  
*vṛkīvoraṇamāsādya mṛtyurdvārāya gacchati \|\| 16 \|\|*

11-16. O king, once the woman with a charming face, started thinking about the perishable nature of the world. She thought- “That the entire universe, getting absorbed in ocean of passions in the form of the human body, remains unmindful of these horrible crocodiles. Brahma as an architect, created this body, which is to be eaten by bhutas or goblins. One’s own deeds serve as the fuel which ignite the fire. Such of the days of the people which are deprived of dharma, artha and kama, get wasted. Like the people who are devoted to Siva, they do not return. When a person does not take bath, give charities, perform tapas, make studies, give oblation to pitrs or by resorting to other means of earning merits, that particular day in fact gets wasted. The mind of a person gets so absorbed in sons, wife and other household affairs that he like a wolf, unmindfully reaches a battleground and faces death without its wanting for the same.”

## \|\| 3.53.17-18 \|\|

*ityevaṃ ciṃtayitvā tu veśyā cendumatī tataḥ \|*  
*vaśiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ jagāma gajagāminī \|\| 17 \|\|*

*vaśiṣṭhamṛṣimāsīnaṃ praṇamya vinayāttataḥ \|*  
*kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Thus thinking, the whore Indumati proceeded towards the auspicious hermitage of the sage Vasistha. Reaching there, she offered her salutation to the great Rsi who was comfortably seated in his abode. Then with all humility, she started speaking to the Maharsi with her hands folded in reverence.

## \|\| 3.53.19-20 \|\|

*indumatyuvāca \|*  
*daśasūnāsamaścakrī daśacakrisamo dhvajaḥ \|*  
*daśadhvajasamā veśyā daśaveśyāsamo nṛpaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*mayā na dattaṃ na hutaṃ nopavāso vrataṃ kṛtam \|*  
*bhaktyā na pūjitaḥ śambhuḥ śrito naiko dhanī naraḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. Indumati said- “It is said that ten types of slaughter make a cakri or the wielder of a disc. Ten cakris make a dhvaja or a banner. Four banners make a prostitute and a king is equated with ten prostitutes. Therefore, O Deva, I have performed no charities or undergone any type of fasting. I have also performed no vratas. Taking refuge with Siva, I have also not meditated on him.

## \|\| 3.53.21 \|\|

*sāṃprataṃ vartamānāyā vrataṃ kiṃcidvadasva me \|*  
*yena duḥkhāṃbupāpaughāduttarāmi bhavārṇavāt \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Therefore, at this stage of my life, you kindly point out a vrata for me, by performing which, I could be able to redeem myself from the ocean of the universe.”

## \|\| 3.53.22 \|\|

*etadasyāḥ subahuśaḥ śrutvā dharmaṃ paraṃtapaḥ \|*  
*vaśiṣṭhaḥ kathayāmāsa mahākāruṇiko muniḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Listening to several other religious words, the great Rsi Vasistha was filled with compassion and started delivering a discourse to her.

## \|\| 3.53.23-25 \|\|

*vaśiṣṭha uvāca \|*  
*māghasya sitasaptamyāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam \|*  
*tapaḥsaubhāgyajananaṃ snānaṃ tava varānane \|\| 23 \|\|*

*kṛtvā ṣaṣṭhyāmekabhaktaṃ saptamyāṃ niścalaṃ jalam \|*  
*rātryaṃte cālayethāstvaṃ dattvā śirasi dīpakam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*māghasya sitasaptamyāmacalaṃ cālitaṃ mayā \|*  
*jalāmalānāṃ sarveṣāṃ kṛtaṃ na calanaṃ tathā \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. Vasistha said- O beautiful woman, you must take bath on the bright saptami of the month of Magha, because for the fulfillment of all the desires, it is quite a fortunate day. During the last prahara of the night, one should donate a lamp and then take a bath at the calm water of a lake, saying- “On the day of the bright saptami of the month of Magha, when the water of the lake is calm and clear, this calm water has been touched by me.”

## \|\| 3.53.26-27 \|\|

*vaśiṣṭhavacanaṃ śrutvā tasminnahani bhūpate \|*  
*sarvaṃ cakārendumatī snānaṃ dānaṃ yathāvidhi \|\| 26 \|\|*

*tryahasnānaprabhāveṇa bhuktvā bhogyānyathepsitān \|*  
*indralokepsaraḥsaṃghe nāyikātvamavāpa sā \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. O king, listening to the words of the Maharsi Vasistha, the whore Indumati performed the process of taking bath etc. in an appropriate manner. As a result of the bath taken by her, after enjoying all the pleasures in the world, she attained the leadership of all the Apsaras of the heaven of Indra.

## \|\| 3.53.28 \|\|

*acalāsaptamīsnānaṃ kathitaṃ ca viśāṃpate \|*  
*sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sukhasaubhāgyavarddhanam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Thus, I have spoken to you the glory of Acala Saptami which destroys all the sins and bestows pleasures and all the comforts.

## \|\| 3.53.29 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*saptamīsnānamāhātmyaṃ śrutaṃ na ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*sāṃprataṃ śrotumicchāmi vidhimaṃtrasamanvitam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Yudhisthira said- I have heard the importance of the bath to be taken on the day of saptami, but presently, I would like to listen to its processing with the use of the mantras.

## \|\| 3.53.30-32 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ekabhaktena saṃtiṣṭhetṣaṣṭhyāṃ saṃpūjya bhāskaram \|*  
*saptamyāṃ tu vrajetprātaḥ sugaṃbhīraṃ jalāśayam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*saritsaṃgaṃ taḍāgaṃ ca devakhātamathāpi vā \|*  
*sukhāvagāhasalilaṃ duṣṭasattvairadūṣitam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*paśubhiḥ pakṣibhiścaiva jalajairmatsyakacchapaiḥ \|*  
*na jalaṃ cālyate yāvattāvatsnānaṃ samācaret \|\| 32 \|\|*

30-32. Sri Krsna said- On the sixth moon day, after performing the puja, taking food once a day, the night should be spent. On the seventh moon day or saptami, one should go to a river, a tank, a devakunda, or a lake and reaching there at the time when the water had not been disturbed by an animal, bird, a tortoise, a fish or any other visible creatures, he should take his bath at that particular time.

## \|\| 3.53.33-34 \|\|

*namaste rudrarūpāya rasānāṃ pataye namaḥ \|*  
*varuṇāya namaste'stu harivāsa namo'stu te \|\| 33 \|\|*

*yāvajjanma kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ mayā janmasu saptasu \|*  
*tanme rogaṃ ca śokaṃ ca mākarī haṃtu saptamī \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. Then he should offer prayer- “Salutation to the lord of all the rasas (juices), the form of Rudra and Varunadeva. Lord Visnu himself lives in water. Let all my sins committed in the past seven births, the ailments, grief etc. besides the sufferings, be removed rapidly by the saptami of Makara.

## \|\| 3.53.35 \|\|

*jananī sarvabhūtānāṃ saptamī saptasaptike \|*  
*sarvavyādhihare devi namaste ravimaṃḍale \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. O goddess, you had taken to forty nine forms and are the mother of all the creatures, you are the form of the solar disc, therefore you remove all my ailments. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 3.53.36-40 \|\|

*jaloparitaraṃ dīpaṃ snātvā saṃtarpya devatāḥ \|*  
*caṃdanena likhetpadmamaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*madhye śarvaṃ sapatnīkaṃ praṇavena tu pūjayet \|*  
*bhānuṃ śakre dale pūjya raviṃ vaiśvānare dale \|\| 37 \|\|*

*yāmye vivasvānnairṛtye bhāskarasyeti pūjayet \|*  
*paścime savitā pūjyaḥ pūjyorko vāyunā jale \|\| 38 \|\|*

*saumye sahasrakiraṇaḥ śeṣe sarvātmaneti ca \|*  
*pūjyāḥ praṇavapūrvāstu namaskārāṃtayojitāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*puṣpaiḥ sugandhadhūpaiśca vastreṇācchādya bhāskaram \|*  
*visarjayettataḥ paścātsvasthānaṃ gamyatāmiti \|\| 40 \|\|*

36-40. Thereafter, a lamp should be made to float over the surface of the water. This should be followed with offering of oblations. Then making use of the sandal paste, a beautiful eight petalled lotus with a pericarp should be made. Siva and Parvati should be lodged in the centre with Omkara. thereafter, for performing the puja, Bhanu should be lodged m the east; Ravi in the south-east; Vivasvan in the south; Bhaskara in the south-west; Savita in the west; Arka in the north-west; Sahasrakirana in the north; and Sarvatma should be lodged in the north-east. Then, uttering their respective names, one should invoke them all. Finally, they should be sent off. While performing the puja starting with Omkara and ending with salutation, the corresponding mantras should be recited.

## \|\| 3.53.41-43 \|\|

*tāmrapātre suvistīrṇe mṛnmaye vā yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*sthāpayettilacūrṇaṃ ca saghṛtaṃ saguḍaṃ tathā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*kāñcanaṃ tālakaṃ kṛtvā hyasiktastilacūrṇakam \|*  
*saṃsthāpya raktavastraistu puṣpairdhūpaistathārcayet \|\| 42 \|\|*

*tatastaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyāddattvā maṃtreṇa tālakam \|*  
*ādityasya prasādena prātaḥ snānaphalaṃ bhajet \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. O Yudhisthira, in a big copper vase or a pottery vase, a palm tree should be made with the sesamum powder and should be mixed with ghi and raw sugar. Covering it with a cloth, it should be worshipped with flowers, incense and then handed over to a learned Brahmana. By so doing, the Sungod, getting pleased with him, bestow him the merit of taking the bath.

## \|\| 3.53.44-47 \|\|

*duṣṭadaurbhāgyaduḥkhebhyo mayā dattaṃ tu tālakam \|*  
*tatastattālakaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāyopapādayet \|\| 44 \|\|*

*saputrapaśubhṛtyāya me'rkoyaṃ prīyatāmiti \|*  
*tato vratopadeṣṭāraṃ pūjayedvastragotilaiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*viprānanyānyathāśaktyā pūjayitvā gṛhaṃ vrajet \|*  
*etatte kathitaṃ kāryaṃ rūpasaubhāgyakārakam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*acalāsaptamīsnānaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam \|\| 47 \|\|*

44-47. He should then offer a prayer saying - “For getting myself relieved of the miseries of the evil planets and misfortunes, I have handover the palm tree to a Brahmana. Let the lord Surya be happy with me, besides the animals, sons, the servants and others.” Thereafter, the preceptor of the vrata and other Brahmanas should be given over the costumes, cows and sesamum seeds. Thereafter, he should enter his house. This Acala Saptami bestows beauty and fortunes.

## \|\| 3.53.48 \|\|

*iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti prasaṃgātkalikaluṣaharaṃ vai sapta mīsnānametat \|*  
*matimapi nayanānāṃ yo dadāti prasaṃgātsurabhavanagato'sau pūjyate devasaṃghaiḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The process of taking bath (during the saptami) has been spoken by me. Thus a person, who reads the glory of this saptami vrata or listens to it, he getting served by the gods, achieves the heaven.

## Chapter 54. Budhastami Vrata

## \|\| 3.54.1-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*budhāṣṭamīvrataṃ bhūyo bravīmi śṛṇu pāṃḍava \|*  
*yena cīrṇena narakaṃ naraḥ paśyati na kvacit \|\| 1 \|\|*

*purā kṛtayugasyādau ilo rājā babhūva ha \|*  
*bahubhṛtyasuhṛnmitramaṃtribhiḥ parivāritaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*jagāma himavatpārśve mahādevena vāritaḥ \|*  
*yo'nyaḥ praviśate bhūmau sā strī bhavati niścitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*sa rājā mṛgasaṃgena prāviśattadumāvane \|*  
*ekākī turagopetaḥ kṣaṇātstrītvaṃ jagāma ha \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Sri Krsna said- O Pandava, the eighth moon day falling on Wednesday represents the vrata observing which, a person does not have to fear of the hell. I am going to talk before you about the same. You listen to me attentively. In earlier times of Krtayuga when I had been the lord of the earth, a king together with his servants, friends, went on tour to the region close to the Himalaya mountain. Inspite of the warning from lord Mahadeva that any other male, except he himself, who would venture the region he shall surely be turned into a woman, discarding the words of lord Siva, neglecting the hunting sport, the king riding over a horse, alone reached the prohibited forest. At once, he was turned as a woman while the horse was turned as a mare.

## \|\| 3.54.5-9 \|\|

*sā babhrāma vane śūnye pīnonnatapayodharā \|*  
*kuto'hamāgatetyevaṃ na tvabudhyata kiṃcana \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tāṃ dadarśa budhaḥ saumyāṃ rūpaudāryaguṇānvitām \|*  
*aṣṭamyāṃ budhavāreṇa tasyāstuṣṭo budho grahaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dadhau garbhaṃ tadudare ilāyā rūpatoṣitaḥ \|*  
*putramutpādayāmāsa yo'sau khyātaḥ purūravāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*caṃdravaṃśakaro rājā ādyaḥ sarvamahīkṣitām \|*  
*tataḥ prabhṛti pūjyeyamaṣṭamī budhasaṃyutā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sarvapāpapraśamanī sarvopadravanāśinī \|*  
*athānyadapi te vacmi dharmarāja kathānakam \|\| 9 \|\|*

5-9. She was bestowed with developed breasts. While wandering in the forest, she thought-“How and where have I arrived?” Unable to know anything, at the same time, she accidently met Budha. Finding him mounted over a charming chariot which was well decorated, on that particular day which happened to be Wednesday combined with astami. Budha was attracted towards her form and beauty and he united with her. As a result of which a son named Pururava was born to them and happened to be the first king of the lunar dynasty. From that day onwards, the moon day (astami) falling on Wednesday was treated as auspicious and the related worship started, which could remove all the sins, besides the disturbances. О Dharmaraja, I am going to repeat to you another story. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.54.10-11 \|\|

*āsīdrājā videhānāṃ mithilāyāṃ sa vairibhiḥ \|*  
*saṃgrāme nihato vīrastasya bhāryā daridriṇī \|\| 10 \|\|*

*ūrmilā nāma babhrāma mahīṃ bālakasaṃyutā \|*  
*avaṃtī viṣayaṃ prāptā brāhmaṇasya niveśane \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Once, the king of Videha country was injured in a war with his enemies. His queen fall on evil days and facing the miseries, the queen Urmila with her children became a destitute and left her home. Wandering here and there, she reached a town named Avanti and took refuge with a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.54.12-13 \|\|

*cakārodarapūrtyarthaṃ nityaṃ kaṃḍanapeṣaṇe \|*  
*hṛtvā sā stokagodhūmāndadau bālakayostadā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*kāruṇyānmātṛvātsalyātkṣudhāsaṃpīḍyamānayoḥ \|*  
*kālena bahunā sādhvī pañcatvamagamacchubhā \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. She attended to all the domestic works and managed her livelihood. At the same time, she took some grains and gave them to her children to subside their hunger, who were feeling extremely hungry at that time. She felt quite painful for her deplorable condition, could not tolerate the misery any longer and ultimately, she met with her end.

## \|\| 3.54.14-15 \|\|

*putrastasyā videhāyāṃ gatvā svapiturāsane \|*  
*upaviṣṭaḥ sattvayogādbubhuje gāmanākulaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*anviṣya dharmarājño vai sā kanyā mithivaṃśajā \|*  
*vivāhitā hitā bhartuḥ sā mahānāyikā'bhavat \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. On the other hand, her son returned to the city of Videha and took over the control of his ancestral home. Getting care free, he started spending his time. But his sister married Dharmaraja and attained the position of the most loveable wife of her husband.

## \|\| 3.54.16-18 \|\|

*śyāmalā nāma cārvaṃgī prasiddhā śrūyate śrutau \|*  
*tāmuvāca varārohāṃ dharmarājaḥ svayaṃ priyām \|\| 16 \|\|*

*vahasva sarvavyāpāraṃ śyāmale tvaṃ gṛhe mama \|*  
*kuru svajanabhṛtyānāṃ dānakṣepaṃ yathepsitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kiṃ tvete paṃjarāḥ sapta kīlakairatiyaṃtritāḥ \|*  
*kadācidapi noddhāṭyāstvayā vaidehanaṃdini \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. She was known by the name of Syamala, who attained excellent glory. Once Dharmaraja said to her beloved- “0 dear Syamala, you are taking this house of mine to be your own, take up the burden for maintaining it. You take care of the family as weil as the monetary dealings. But you never open the seven iron cages, which have been tightly secured with the iron nails. 0 daughter of Videha, never try to open these cages. Syamala said- “Be it so” and accepted the words of her husband. She put all her energy in attending to the household jobs.

## \|\| 3.54.19 \|\|

*evamastviti sāpyuktā nijaṃ karma cakāra ha \|*  
*kadācidvyākulībhūte dharmarāje videhajā \|*  
*uddhāṭayitvā prathamaṃ dadarśa jananīṃ svakām \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Once when Dharmaraja was extremely busy in royal affairs, Syamala - the daughter of Videha, opened the first cage in which she could have a look at her own mother.

## \|\| 3.54.20-21 \|\|

*sā pacyamānā kraṃdaṃtī bhīṣaṇairyamakiṃkaraiḥ \|*  
*helayā kṣipyate baddhvā taptataile punaḥpunaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tathaiva tālakaṃ dattvā vrīḍitā sā manasvinī \|*  
*dvitīye paṃjare tadvatsā tāmevaṃ dadarśa ha \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. She saw that her mother was being cooked by the messengers of Yama in the hells and was crying pathetically. The messengers of Yama were throwing her in the boiling pans again and again, Syamala felt shameful on seeing the sight. Ultimately, she closed it in the same way (in which she had opened it). On opening the second cage, she again found her own mother there who was being covered with the walls of bricks and stones.

## \|\| 3.54.22-23 \|\|

*sudhāvallipyamānāṃ tāṃ śilātalpeṣṭakena tu \|*  
*tṛtīyapañjare tadvattāṃ dadarśa svamātaram \|*  
*krakacaiḥ pāṭyate mūrdhni ghaṇṭāyuktaiḥ karolbaṇaiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*caturthe pañjare sthāne bhīṣaṇairdāruṇānanaiḥ \|*  
*bhakṣyamāṇāṃ śvāpadaiśca kraṃdaṃtīṃ tāṃ punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. In the third cage, she saw that the messengers of Yama were cutting her into two with the use of a big saw from the head. In the fourth cage, the dogs with terrific fangs were cutting the flesh out of her body and eating it. She was crying as had been seen earlier.

## \|\| 3.54.24-25 \|\|

*pañcame nihitā bhūmau kaṇṭhe pādena pīḍitā \|*  
*saṃdaṃśairvanaghātaiśca vidīrṇā kriyate ruṣā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭhe cekṣuyantragatāṃ mastake mudgarāhatām \|*  
*saṃpīḍyamānāmaniśaṃ sudṛḍhāmikṣukhaṃḍavat \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. In the fifth cage, she saw that making her lay down over the ground, the hyenas were devouring her neck as well as the body. In the sixth cage, she was seen being grinded in pieces in an oil mill. The messengers of Yama were striking her head with clubs.

## \|\| 3.54.26-27 \|\|

*saptame pañjare cīrṇasvanāṃ pūtikagaṃdhinīm \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā tathā gatāṃ tāṃ tu mātaraṃ duḥkhakarṣitā \|*  
*śyāmalā mlānavadanā kiṃcinnovāca bhāminī \|\| 26 \|\|*

*athāgataṃ yamaṃ prāha saroṣā śyāmalā patim \|*  
*kiṃ tavāpahṛtaṃ rājanmama mātrā sudāruṇam \|*  
*yeneyaṃ vividhairghātairvadhyate bahudhā tvayā \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. In the seventh cage, she saw her having been thrown in the pit filled with filth and dirt. Thus finding her mother to be so badly suffering from torture, the chaste Syamala's face fell and she could do nothing else. But on the return of Dharmaraja, the damsel spoke to her husband in pitiable voice- "What wrong had my mother done to you, that you are torturing her in horrible ways.

## \|\| 3.54.28-31 \|\|

*yamaḥ prāha priyāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhadre hyudghāṭitāstvayā \|*  
*ete pañjarakāḥ sapta niṣiddhā tvaṃ mayā purā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*tava mātrā sutasnehādgodhūmā ye hṛtāḥ kila \|*  
*kiṃ na jānāsi tadbhadre yena ruṣṭā mamopari \|\| 29 \|\|*

*brahmasvaṃ praṇayādbhuktaṃ dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam \|*  
*tadeva cauryarūpeṇa dahatyācaṃdratārakam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*godhūmāsta ime bhūtāḥ kṛmirūpāḥ sudāruṇāḥ \|*  
*ye purā brāhmaṇagṛhe hṛtāstava kṛte'nayā \|\| 31 \|\|*

28-31. Looking at his beloved, Yama said- “0 noble one, I had earlier prohibited you from opening the cages. But when you are asking me the cause of torture to your mother, then I am going to reveal the facts before you. 0 noble one, your mother had stolen the grains of the Brahmanas, for the sake of the love for her children. Are you not aware of it then why are you getting angry with me? Because of her attachment towards her children, when the wealth of a Brahmana is stolen, it destroys the seven future generations. The theft destroys even the moon with stars. The grain which was stolen by her from the house of a Brahmana, the same grain has turned into worms and are causing pain to her.

## \|\| 3.54.32-34 \|\|

*śyāmalovāca \|*  
*jānāmi tadahaṃ sarvaṃ yanme mātrā kṛtaṃ purā \|*  
*tathāpi tvāṃ samāsādya sā ca jāmātaraṃ śubham \|*  
*mucyate kṛmirāśitvādyathā tadadhunā kuru \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tacchrutvā cintayāviṣṭaściraṃ sthitvā jagāda tām \|*  
*dharmarājaḥ sahāsīnāṃ priyāṃ prāṇadhaneśvarīm \|\| 33 \|\|*

*itaśca saptame'tīte janmani brāhmaṇī śubhā \|*  
*āsīstasmiṃstvayā saṃgātsakhīnāṃ paryupāsitā \|*  
*budhāṣṭamī susaṃpūrṇā yathoktaphaladāyinī \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. Syamala said- Whatever had been done by my mother earlier is quite well known to me. But after getting such a son-in-law, who is the form of welfare, in case she has to face the same precarious condition, it would not be proper. You therefore, do something to relieve her from the pain of the worms, urgently. On hearing these words, Dharmaraja thought seriously for a while. Quite seriously, because she was the goddess of all the wealth as well as the life of Dharmaraja, and said to his beloved- “0 dear, in your seventh birth earlier, you were bom in a Brahmana family and with your handmaids, you had performed a vrata of astami falling on Wednesday, observing all the regulations. This vrata bestows all the merits. In case, you give away the merit of that vrata to your mother in my presence, then your mother would surely be relieved of all the miseries of the hell.”

## \|\| 3.54.35 \|\|

*tacchrutvā tvaritaṃ snātvā dadau puṇyaṃ svakaṃ kṛtam \|*  
*svamātuḥ śyāmalā tuṣṭā tena mokṣaṃ jagāma sā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. On hearing these words, Syamala atonce took a bath and uttering a samkalpa (a vow) gave away the merit for her mother. As a result of this, her mother was atonce freed from the miseries of the hell.

## \|\| 3.54.36-37 \|\|

*ūrmilā rūpasaṃpannā divyadehadharā śubhā \|*  
*vimānavaramārūḍhā divyamālyāṃbarāvṛtā \|\| 36 \|\|*

*bhartuḥ samīpe svargasthā dṛśyate'dyāpi sā janaiḥ \|*  
*budhasya pārśve nabhasi mithirājasamīpataḥ \|*  
*visphuraṃtī mahārāja budhāṣṭamyāḥ prabhāvataḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. Then Urmila taking to a divine form, possessing the highest charm and beauty, clad in the divine costumes, garland and ornaments, atonce proceeded to the heaven in a divine plane where she could be seen even now, with her husband. О great king, with the influence of the Budha-Astami vrata, close to the country of Mithila and on the back of Budha, she is found shining even today.

## \|\| 3.54.38 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*yadyevaṃ pravarā kṛṣṇa sā tithirvai budhāṣṭamī \|*  
*tasyā eva vidhiṃ brūhi yadi tuṣṭosi me prabho \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Yudhisthira said- О Krsna, in case the Budhastami is so auspicious, then you may please speak out the method to be followed for the performing the said vrata.

## \|\| 3.54.39-40 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu pāṃḍava yatnena budhāṣṭamyā vidhiṃ śubham \|*  
*yadāyadā sitāṣṭamyāṃ budhavāro bhavedyadi \|*  
*tadātadā ca sā grāhyā ekabhaktāśanairnṛbhiḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*snātvā nadyāṃ tu pūrvāhne gṛhītvā kalaśaṃ navam \|*  
*jalapūrṇaṃ tu sadravyaṃ pūrṇapātrasamanvitam \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. Sri Krsna said- О Pandava, when astami falls on Wednesday, I am going to reveal the process of performing of this vrata. You please listen. Whenever the eighth bright moon day falls on Wednesday, then taking the meal once a day on the seventh moon day, the vrata should be completed on the day of astami. On that particular day, one should take his bath in a river. The new pitcher should be tilled with water, which should then be decorated with all the things. After the puja is completed, it should be given away in charity.

## \|\| 3.54.41-47 \|\|

*aṣṭavārānprakartavyā vidhānaistu pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*prathamā modakaiḥ kāryā dvitīyā pheṇakaistathā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tṛtīyā ghṛtapūpaiśca caturthī vaṭakairnṛpa \|*  
*pañcamī śubhrakāraiśca ṣaṣṭhī sohālakaistathā \|\| 42 \|\|*

*aśokavartibhiḥ śubhraiḥ saptamī khaṃḍasaṃyutaiḥ \|*  
*aṣṭamī phalapuṣpaiśca kevalākhaṇḍapheṇikaiḥ \|*  
*evaṃ krameṇa kartavyā suhṛtsvajanabāṃdhavaiḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*saha kṛtvā sthitairbhojyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ svasthamānasaiḥ \|*  
*upoṣyāṇāmidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kathayadbhiḥ śanaiḥśanaiḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*śrutvāṣṭamī budhasyāpi māhātmyaṃ bhojanaṃ tyajet \|*  
*tāvadeva na bhoktavyaṃ kathā yāvatsamāpyate \|\| 45 \|\|*

*tathā bhuktvā budhasyāgre ācamya ca punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*viprāya vedaviduṣe taṃ bruvanpratipādayet \|\| 46 \|\|*

*sākṣataṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca jātarūpamayaṃ śubham \|*  
*arcitaṃ vividhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

41-47. Thus by performing this vrata eight times on the day of astami, individually on the first occasion, the vrata should be completed with the offering of the sweet balls. The second time it should be completed with butter milk; on third occasion, it should be completed by giving away sweet cakes; on the fourth time it should be completed after giving away the lump of vata which is baked in the open fire. During the fifth time, it should be completed by white substance. During the sixth time Sohala or auspicious things; on the seventh occasion, Asoka should be given; on the eighth occasion, the flowers; and on the eight occasion, vermicelli or (pheni) should be given. After completing the vrata, the performer should pleasantly take food with his relatives. Food should not be taken by the fasting performer of the vrata, while reciting or listening to the recitation. Because it has been stated that till such time the recitation from scriptures is on, one should not take food. Thereafter, rinsing his mouth, one should clean his mouth.After purifying his mouth, he should give away the gold figure of Budha, which should have been beautifully made.Several types of flowers, incense and fragrance should be offered to the image.

## \|\| 3.54.48 \|\|

*pītavastraiḥ samācchannaṃ budhaṃ somātmajākṛtim \|*  
*māṣakeṇa suvarṇena tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The image should be clad with a pitambara (lower garment). The image should be made by a masa of gold, or half of it or still one fourth of the same and should be presented quite gracefully.

## \|\| 3.54.49-51 \|\|

*oṃ budhāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ somātmajāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ durbuddhināśanāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ subuddhipradāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ tārājātāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ saumyagrahāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ sarvasaukhyapradāya namaḥ \|*  
*ete pūjāmantrāḥ \|*  
*aṣṭamī tu yadā pūrṇā tadā rājarṣisattama \|*  
*brāhmaṇānbhojayedaṣṭau gāṃ dadyācca savatsikām \|\| 49 \|\|*

*vastrālaṃkaraṇaiḥ sarvairbhūṣaṇairvividhairapi \|*  
*sapatnīkaṃ samabhyarcya karṇamātrāṃgulīyakaiḥ \|*  
*mantreṇānena kauṃteya dadyādevaṃ samācaran \|\| 50 \|\|*

*budho'yaṃ pratigṛhṇātu dravyastho'yaṃ budhaḥ svayam \|*  
*dīyate budharājāya tuṣyatāṃ ca budho mama \|\| 51 \|\|*

49-51. At the time of worship, one should recite-“Om Budhaya namah, Om Somatmajaya namah, Om Durbuddhinasanaya namah, Om Subuddhipradaya namah, Om Tarajataya namah, Om Saumyagrahaya namah and Om Sarvasaukhyapradaya namah.'' These mantras should be recited. O great Rajarsi, on the conclusion of the astami vrata, food should be served to eight Brahmanas. Thereafter, a cow with calf, the costumes and ornaments should be given in charity to a Brahmana couple, whose fingers should be adorned with finger rings. O son of Kunti, at that point of time, he should say- “Budhadeva himself accepts the offering, being present there. 1 am presenting all this to Buddha himself. Let him be happy with me.”

## \|\| 3.54.52-58 \|\|

*budhaḥ saumyastārakeyo rājaputra ilāpatiḥ \|*  
*kumāro dvijarājasya yaḥ purūravasaḥ pitā \|\| 52 \|\|*

*durbuddhibādhajanitaṃ nāśayitvā ca me budhaḥ \|*  
*saukhyaṃ ca saumanasyaṃ ca karotu śaśinaṃdanaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*ityuccārya gṛhītvā tu dadyānmaṃtrapuraḥsaram \|*  
*saptajanmani rājendra jāto jātismaro bhavet \|\| 54 \|\|*

*dhanadhānyasamāyuktaḥ. putrapautrapravarddhanaḥ \|*  
*dīrṣāyurvipulānbhogānbhuktvā caiva mahītalaṃ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*tataḥ sutīrthe maraṇaṃ dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ vibhum \|*  
*mṛto'sau svargamāpnoti purandarasamo naraḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*vasate yāvadāsṛṣṭeḥ punarābhūtasaṃplavam \|*  
*evametanmayā khyātaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*eṣaivaṃ ca mayākhyātā guhyā pārtha budhāṣṭamī \|*  
*yāṃ śrutvā brahmahā goghnaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 58 \|\|*

52-58.Thus speaking, the charities should be given, and the one who receives the same should be conceived as Budha in pleasant form, who is the son of Tara, husband of prince Ila, the son of the moon, besides being the father of Pururava. Then, the Brahmana should receive the donations. Then the prayer should be offered, saying- “O Budhadeva, you are the son of the Moon, you kindly remove my evil wisdom and bestow welfare on me and keep me always delightful.” Thus reciting the mantras, whatever is given or taken, one keeps in his memory for the past seven births. He enjoys long life on earth and enjoying all the pleasures, his life comes to an end at a holy place, devoting his mind towards lord Narayana. Thereafter, reaching in the heaven, he enjoys all the comforts like Indra, upto the time of the dissolution of the earth. O Partha, thus I have spoken out the glory of Budhastami vrata which happens to be the best of all the vratas. By listening about this vrata, a person is relieved of all the sins including that of Brahmahatya.

## \|\| 3.54.59 \|\|

*yaścāṣṭamīṃ budhayutāṃ samavāpya bhaktyā sampūjayedvidhusutaṃ kanapṛṣṭhasaṃ stham \|*  
*pakvānnapātrasahitaiḥ sahiṇyavastraiḥ paśyedasau yamapuraṃ na kadācideva \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. One who performs the Budhastami vrata and gives away the gold image of Budha with excellent food, gold and costumes, he is never frightened by the god of death.

## Chapter 55. Janmastami Vrata

## \|\| 3.55.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*janmāṣṭamīvrataṃ brūhi vistareṇa mamācyuta \|*  
*kasminkāle samutpannaṃ kiṃ puṇyaṃ ko vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O Acyuta, you kindly speak out the glory of the Janmastami vrata. How was this vrata started and by observing this vrata what type of merit is earned by a person? You also tell me the method of observing this vrata.

## \|\| 3.55.2-7 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*hate kaṃsāsure duṣṭe mathurāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*devakī māṃ pariṣvajya kṛtvotsaṃge ruroda ha \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tatraiva raṃgavāḍhena maṃcārūḍhajanotsave \|*  
*mallayuddhe purāvṛtte samete kukurā'ndhake \|\| 3 \|\|*

*svajanairbaṃdhubhiḥ snigdhaiḥ sastrībhiḥ samāvṛte \|*  
*vasudevo'pi tatraiva vātsalyātpraruroda ha \|\| 4 \|\|*

*samākṛṣya pariṣvajya putraputretyuvāca ha \|*  
*sagadgadasvaro dīno vāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*balabhadraṃ ca māṃ caiva pariṣvajya mudā punaḥ \|*  
*adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ yatsujīvitam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*yadubhābhyāṃ supu trābhyāṃ samudbhūtaḥ samāgamaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ varṣeṇa dāṃpatye hṛṣṭaṃ puṣṭaṃ tathā hyabhūt \|\| 7 \|\|*

2-7. Sri Krsna said- O Yudhisthira, after the killing of the wicked king Kamsa, Devaki holding me in her lap, started crying. At that point of time, thousands of visitors seated over the raised platforms, had collected there. It was the place, where we had fought a fight with the Raksasas. Out of affection, Vasudeva also started sobbing, finding the ladies in chain. Crying as child, he took me in his lap and with a choked voice, with eyes filled with tears like a pitiable person, with excess of delight, embracing me and Balabhadra, he said- “My birth has been successful today, besides being purposeful, because, I have been able to meet both my sons today.” Because of his delight, he became so healthy as one becomes in a year.

## \|\| 3.55.8-10 \|\|

*praṇipatya janāḥ sarve babhūvuste praharṣitāḥ \|*  
*evaṃ mahotsavaṃ dṛṣṭvā māmāha sakalo janaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ nātha lokasyāsya prasādataḥ \|*  
*yasmindine jagannātha devakī tvāmajījanat \|\| 9 \|\|*

*taddine dehi vaikuṃṭhaṃ kurmastetra namonamaḥ \|*  
*samyagbhaktiprapannānāṃ prasādaṃ kuru keśava \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. The people present there, were also feeling fully delighted. The public present there having a look at me, were also feeling delighted, since all the people had been invited for the festivities. The crowd of the people, finding me there, said “O Master, you delight the vast crowd of people by owning them. 0 Jagannatha, the day on which the goddess Devaki had given birth to you, you kindly display before the people the scene of Vaikuntha. All of us offer our salutation to you again and again. O Kesava, you display before your devotees the same scene, in future as well.”

## \|\| 3.55.11-13 \|\|

*evamukte janaughena vasudevo'tivismitaḥ \|*  
*vilokya balabhadraṃ ca māṃ ca kṛtvā ruroda ha \|*  
*evamastviti lokānāṃ kathayasva yathā tathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tataśca piturādeśāttathā janmāṣṭamīvratam \|*  
*mathurāyāṃ janaughāgre pārtha samyakprakāśitam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*paurajanā janmadinaṃ varṣevarṣe mamoditam \|*  
*punarjanmāṣṭamīṃ loke kurvaṃtu brāhmaṇādayaḥ \|*  
*kṣatriyā vaiśyajātīyāḥ śūdrā yenye'pi dhārmikāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. At these words of the huge gathering, feeling surprised, glancing at me as well as Balabhadra, Vasudeva started weeping. Somehow, I spoke- “It will be done,” assured those people and with the permission of my father, I described the glory of Janmastami before the huge gathering. O Partha, according to this vrata, the people of the town of Mathura, on the day of my birth, started celebrating festivities. The Brahmanas on the other hand, besides the Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and the Sudras, could celebrate the vrata on the Janmastami day. Because of this 1 had analyzed it fully.

## \|\| 3.55.14-16 \|\|

*siṃharāśigate sūrye gagane jaladākule \|*  
*māsi bhādrapade'ṣṭamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe'rdharātrake \|*  
*vṛṣarāśisthite candre nakṣatre rohiṇīyute \|\| 14 \|\|*

*vasudevena devakyāmahaṃ jāto janāḥ svayam \|*  
*evametatsamākhyātaṃ loke janmāṣṭamīvratam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*bhagavatpārśvato rājanbahurūpaṃ mahotsavam \|*  
*mathurāyāstataḥ paścālloke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati \|*  
*śāṃtirastu sukhaṃ cāstu lokāḥ santu nirāmayāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. O people at large, when the Sun moves to the leo zodiac symbol, at midnight in the month of Bhadrapada, with the combination of the Moon and the Rohini constellation and when the sky is overcast with clouds, I was born as a son to Vasudeva and Devaki. O king, in this way, the Janmastami vrata became popular with the people. Thereafter, this festival shall take to many forms in Mathura, before the lord. Let the people enjoy all the comforts and peace and let all the people be free from ailments.

## \|\| 3.55.17-18 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*tatkīdṛśaṃ vrataṃ deva lokaiḥ sarvairanuṣṭhitam \|*  
*janmāṣṭamīvrataṃ nāma pavitraṃ puruṣottama \|\| 17 \|\|*

*yena tvaṃ tuṣṭimāyāsi lokānāṃ prabhura vyayaḥ \|*  
*etanme bhagavanbrūhi prasādānmadhusūdana \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Yudhisthira said- O best of the humans, bow did the people celebrate this vrata, which became popular as Janmastami? It is extremely auspicious. O lord Madhusudan, by performing this vrata, you get extremely pleased. Therefore, you kindly explain the same.

## \|\| 3.55.19-21 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*pārtha taddivase prāpte daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam \|*  
*upavāsasya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyādbhaktibhāvitaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ekenaivopavāsena kṛtena kurunaṃdana \|*  
*sarvajanmakṛtaiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*upāvṛttasya pāpebhyo yastu vāso guṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. Sri Krsna said- O Partha, on that particular day, getting absorbed in devotion, the fast should start with the brushing of the teeth with the tooth stick. O son of the race of Kuru, with the performing of a single fast, all the sins of that particular life get destroyed. I here is no doubt about it. Actually the fasting is meant for the relieving of a person from the sins, besides discarding all the wordily pleasures and embracing the Sattvika virtues to spend that particular time. This is known as fasting.

## \|\| 3.55.22-25 \|\|

*tataḥ snātvā ca madhyāhne nadyādau vimale jale \|*  
*devyāḥ suśobhanaṃ kuryāddevakyāḥ sūtikāgṛham \|\| 22 \|\|*

*padmarāgaiḥ patranetrairmaṃḍitaṃ carcitaṃ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*ramyaṃ tu vanamālābhī rakṣāmaṇivibhūṣitam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*sarvaṃ gokulavatkāryaṃ gopījanasamākulam \|*  
*ghaṇṭāmardalasaṅgītamāṅgalyakalaśānvitam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*yavārdhaṃ svastikā kuḍyaiḥ śaṃkhavāditrasaṃkulam \|*  
*vaddhvāsurā lohakhaḍgaiḥ priyacchāgasamanvitam \|\| 25 \|\|*

22-25. During the noon, one should take a bath at the clean water of a river or a lake, the labour room of Devaki should be decorated with gems etc. in a beautiful manner. The entire appearance of the place should resemble that of Gokula. There should be beautifully attired milk maids, the bell, cymbals and other musical instruments. The welfare kalasa, the barley, Svastika, conch should be blown, and Asuras in bondages, iron, sword and a female goat should be displayed there.

## \|\| 3.55.26-31 \|\|

*dhānye vinyasya musalaṃ rakṣitaṃ rakṣapālakaiḥ \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhyā devyā ca saṃpūrṇairnaivedyairvividhaiḥ kṛtaiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*evamādi yathāśeṣaṃ kartavyaṃ sūtikāgṛham \|*  
*etanmadhye pratiṣṭhāpyā sā cāpyaṣṭavidhā smṛtā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*kāṃcanī rājatī tāmrī paittalī mṛnmayī tathā \|*  
*dārvī maṇimayī caiva karṇikā likhitātha vā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*sarvalakṣaṇasampannā paryaṃke cārddhasuptikā \|*  
*prataptakāṃcanābhāsā mayā saha tapasvinī \|\| 29 \|\|*

*prastutā ca prasūtā ca tatkṣaṇācca praharṣitā \|*  
*māṃ cāpi bālakaṃ suptaṃ paryaṃke stanapāyinam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*śrīvatsavakṣasaṃ pūrṇaṃ nīlotpaladala cchavim \|*  
*yaśodā cāpi tatraiva prasūtā varakanyakām \|\| 31 \|\|*

26-31. The paddy should be spread over the ground. The Ksetrapalas should be put on guard duty and several types of sweet refreshments should be placed in the labour room. In the centre of that room, an image of Devaki made in gold, silver, copper, brass, pottery, wood or pearls or a painting, which display all the symptoms, should be placed over a decorated bed. Over half of the bed, the image of Devaki in gold etc. should be placed for my pleasure, who should be shown as about to give birth to a child. At the same time, besides the delightful mother, I should also be shown as having been born as a child and I should also be placed besides her, sucking the milk from the breast of the mother. The child should have a Srivatsa mark over his chest and his complexion should resemble the blue lotus flower. Yasoda should also be shown there with her daughter.

## \|\| 3.55.32-33 \|\|

*tatra devagṛhaṃ nāgā yakṣavidyādharā narāḥ \|*  
*praṇatāḥ puṣpamālāgravyagrahastāḥ surāsurāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*saṃcaraṃta ivākāśe prākārairuditoditaiḥ \|*  
*vasudevo'pi tatraiva khaḍgacarmadharaḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. In the delivery room of the lord, the Nagas, the Yaksas, Vidyadharas and humans should be standing with all humility. They should be shown in such a way as if they were moving in the sky here and there, with anxiety displayed large on their faces. The image of Vasudeva holding a sword and a shield, should also be shown there.

## \|\| 3.55.34-35 \|\|

*kaśyapo vasudevoyamaditi ścāpi devakī \|*  
*balabhadraḥ śeṣanāgo yaśodādityajāyata \|\| 34 \|\|*

*nandaḥ prajāpatirdakṣo gargaścāpi caturmukhaḥ \|*  
*eṣovatāro rājendra kaṃso'yaṃ kālanemijaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. Besides Kasyapa should appear as Vasudeva and Aditi as Devaki. Then Sesa -the serpent, Balabhadra, Diti, Yasoda, Prajapati Daksa as Nanda and four-faced Brahma should be shown as having incarnated as the sage Garga.

## \|\| 3.55.36-41 \|\|

*tatra kaṃsaniyuktā ye dānavā vividhāyudhāḥ \|*  
*te ca prāhārikāḥ sarve suptā nidrāvimohitāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*godhenukuñjarāścāsya dānavāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ \|*  
*nṛtyaṃtyapsaraso hṛṣṭā gaṃdharvā gītatatparāḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*lekhanīyaśca tatraiva kāliyo yamunāhrade \|*  
*ramyamevaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā devakīṃ navasūtikām \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tāṃ pārtha pūjayedbhaktyā gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ phalaiḥ \|*  
*kūṣmāṇḍairnālikeraiśca kharjūrairdāḍimīphalaiḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*bījapūraiḥ pūgaphalairllakucaistrapusaistathā \|*  
*kāladeśodbhavairmuṣṭaiḥ puṣpaiścāpi yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 40 \|\|*

*dhyātvāvatāraṃ prāguktaṃ maṃtreṇānena pūjayet \|\| 41 \|\|*

36-41. Similarly, Kamsa was the son of Kalanemi. At that time of my birth, Kamsa had deputed all the Danavas at the gates of the delivery room and were equipped with all the weapons. Besides attendants were guarding the place carefully. All of them became drowsy. The dancing Apsaras sang delightfully, besides Kaliya serpent living in a kunda in the river Yamuna, should also be shown in an image. O Partha, thus, while creating the delivery room of Devaki. the fragrance, flowers, unbroken rice, fruit, pumpkin, coconut, date palm, pomegranate, myrobalan, betel nut, the seasonal fruits as well payasam and flowers should be offered and while adoring her, the related mantras should be recited.

## \|\| 3.55.42-43 \|\|

*gāyadbhiḥ kinnarādyaiḥ satataparivṛtā veṇuvīṇāninādairbhṛṅgārādarśakumbhapramarakṛtakaraiḥ sevyamānā munīndraiḥ \|*  
*paryaṃke svāstṛte yā muditataramanāḥ putriṇī samyagāste sā devī devamātā jayati suvadanā devakī kāṃtarūpā \|\| 42 \|\|*

*pādāvabhyaṃjayaṃtīṃ śrīrdevakyāścaraṇāṃtike \|*  
*niṣaṇṇā paṅkaje pūjyā namo devyai ca maṃtrataḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. O Yudhisthira, victory to the lady with beautiful form and having charming face known as Devaki - the mother of the gods. Victory’ to her always. She, with an infant like me, feeling delightfill, had slept over the well arranged bed. The Kinnaras playing on the vina and other musical instruments are surrounded by the Rsis like Agastya and others. Devaki is serving their feet adoring them variously. At that point of time, Namo Devyai mantra should be recited.

## \|\| 3.55.44-45 \|\|

*oṃ devakyai namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ vasudevāya namaḥ \|*  
*oṃ balabhadrāya namaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*vidhyaṃtaramapīcchaṃti kecidatra dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*candrodaye śaśāṅkāya arghyaṃ dadyāddhariṃ smaret \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. Besides, the mantra- Om Daivakyai namah, Om Vasudevaya namah, Om Balabhadraya namah, Om Srikrsnaya namah, Om Subhadraya namah, Om Nandaya namah, Om Yasodayai namah, and other such mantras should be recited and the worship should be performed separately by the Brahmanas, K$atriyas and Vaisyas. The ladies and the Sudras should perform the worship without the reciting of the mantras. There is some difference of opinion among the learned people about the performing of the adoration. At the time of the rise of the Moon, an arghya should be offered to the Moon.

## \|\| 3.55.46-50 \|\|

*anaghaṃ vāmanaṃ śauriṃ vaikuṃṭhaṃ puruṣottamam \|*  
*vāsudevaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ mādhavaṃ madhusūdanam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*vārāhaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ brāhmaṇapriyam \|*  
*dāmodaraṃ padmanābhaṃ keśavaṃ garuḍadhvajam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*govindamacyutaṃ kṛṣṇamanaṃtamaparājitam \|*  
*adhokṣajaṃ jagadbījaṃ sargasthityaṃtakāraṇam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*anādinidhanaṃ viṣṇuṃ trailokyeśaṃ trivikramam \|*  
*nārāyaṇaṃ caturbāhuṃ śaṃkha cakragadādharam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*pītāṃbaradharaṃ nityaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam \|*  
*śrīvatsāṅkaṃ jagatsetuṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīpatiṃ harim \|\| 50 \|\|*

46-50. O sinless one, the salutation should be offered to Vamana, Sauri, Vaikuntha, Purusottama, Vasudeva, Hrsikesa, Madhava, Madhusudana, Varsha, Pundankaksa, Nrsimha, Brahmanapriya, Damodara, Padmanabha, Kesava, Garudadhvaja, Govinda, Acyuta, Krsna, Ananta, Aparajita, Adhoksaja, Visnu - the lord of the three lokas, who pervades the world and preserves it, the world is his own creation and he is also the destroyer. He is beyond beginning or end, besides being the lord of the three worlds, Trivikrama, Jagatsetu (bridge of the universe), four armed, holding a conch, disc and the club. He is always decorated with the long garland of flowers, adorned with a Srivatsa mark over the chest, Sridhara, Srlpati, Hari, Yog;esvara, Yogesa, Hara, Bhava, Yogapati and Govinda. Salutation to him. By reciting these names, one should take the bath.

## \|\| 3.55.51-52 \|\|

*yogeśvarāya yogeśabhavāya yogapataye govindāya namonamaḥ \|*  
*yajñeśvarāya yajñasaṃbhavāya yajñapataye govindāya namonamaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*ityanulepanārghyādyarcanadhūpamaṃtraḥ \|*  
*viśvāya viśveśvarāya viśvasaṃbhavāya viśvapataye govindāya namonamaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. Yajnesvara - bom of the yajna, Yajnapati, and Govinda should be offered the salutation again and again. Reciting these words, the paste, arghya and incense should be offered, besides adoring the same. Salutation to the universal form, Visvesvara, Visvasambhavaya, Visvapati and Govinda. Reciting these mantras, the eatables should be offered.

## \|\| 3.55.53-56 \|\|

*dharmeśvarāya dharmapataye dharmasaṃbhavāya govindāya namonamaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūta atrinetrasamudbhava \|*  
*gṛhāṇārghyaṃ śaśāṃkendo rohiṇyā sahito mama \|\| 54 \|\|*

*sthaṃḍile sthāpayeddevaṃ sacandrāṃ rohiṇīṃ tathā \|*  
*devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca yaśodāṃ nandameva ca \|\| 55 \|\|*

*baladevaṃ tathā pūjya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|*  
*arddharātre vasorddhārāṃ pātayedguḍasarpiṣā \|\| 56 \|\|*

53-56. O Dharmesvara, Dharmapati, Dharmitma, Dharmasambhavaya and Govinda, salutation to all of you. Thus reciting the mantras, the lamp, the seat, similarly, the moon who emerged out of the ocean and also from the eyes of the sage A tri, should accept the arghya with Rohini. Then Krsna, moon with Rohini, DevakI and Vasudeva, Yasoda and Nanda, besides Baladeva should be worshipped and by so doing, a person is freed from all the sins. At the dead of night, the mixture of raw sugar, ghi etc. should be offered.

## \|\| 3.55.57-63 \|\|

*tato varddhāpanaṃ ṣaṣṭhīnāmādikaraṇaṃ mama \|*  
*kartavyaṃ tatkṣaṇādrātrau prabhāte navamīdine \|\| 57 \|\|*

*yathā mama tathā kāryo bhagavatyā mahotsavaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇānbhojayecchaktyā tebhyo dadyācca dakṣiṇām \|\| 58 \|\|*

*hiraṇyaṃ kāñcanaṃ gāvo vāsāṃsi kusumāni ca \|*  
*yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ tattatkṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti \|\| 59 \|\|*

*yamevaṃ devakī devī vasudevādajījanat \|*  
*bhaumasya brahmaṇo guptyai tasmai brahmātmane namaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*sujanmavāsudevāya gobrāhmaṇahitāya ca \|*  
*śāntirastu śivaṃ cāstu ityuktvā tu visarjayet \|\| 61 \|\|*

*evaṃ yaḥ kurute devyā devakyāḥ sumahotsavam \|*  
*varṣevarṣe bhagavato madbhakto dharmanandana \|\| 62 \|\|*

*naro vā yadi vā nārī yathoktaphalamāpnuyāt \|\| 63 \|\|*

57-63. During Varddhapana and Sasthi, the rite of name giving ceremony should be performed at the same time. On the next morning, during the ninth moon day, the celebrations of Bhagavati should be performed as had been done in my case. Then giving food to the Brahmanas, they should also be given the appropriate amount of daksina as per one’s means, the gold, the cow, costumes and flowers should also be given with respect, saying- “The things which are liked by the lord are being offered by me, let lord Krsna be happy with me. Both Vasudeva and Devaki have produced lord Krsna for the sake of the protection of Brahma. Therefore salutation to Brahmatma. Subsequently, for the protection of Vasudeva and Brahmana, let them bestow peace and welfare.” Thus speaking, they should be sent off. O son of Dharma, in this way, every year, a person who performs festivities for my sake as well as for Devaki, he with his wife, enjoys all the merits stated above.

## \|\| 3.55.64-68 \|\|

*putrasaṃtānamārogyaṃ dhanadhānyādisadgṛham \|*  
*śālīkṣuyavasaṃpūrṇamaṇḍalaṃ sumanoharam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*tasminrāṣṭre prabhurbhuṃkte dīrghāyurmanasepsitān \|*  
*paracakrabhayaṃ nāsti tasmi nrājye'pi pāṇḍava \|\| 65 \|\|*

*parjanyaḥ kāmavarṣī syādītibhyo na bhayaṃ bhavet \|*  
*yasmingṛhe pāṃḍuputra kriyate devakīvratam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*na tatra mṛta niṣkrāṃtirna garbhapatanaṃ tathā \|*  
*na ca vyādhibhayaṃ tatra bhavediti matirmama \|\| 67 \|\|*

*na vaidyajanasaṃyogo na cāpi kalaho gṛhe \|*  
*saṃparkeṇāpi yaḥ kaścitkuryājjanmāṣṭamīvratam \|*  
*viṣṇulokamavāpnoti so'pi pārtha na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

64-68. Then he is reborn quite healthy in a country with enough of wealth, cereals, excellent house, paddy, sugarcane, and barley etc. and enjoys long life there, enjoying all the pleasures. O Pandava, the house in which the vrata of Devaki is performed, in that house no death of a child is caused at birth and abortion, nor any disease enters that place. This is what I have to say. The physicians are never needed there. No cause of dispute can arise there. O Partha, a person who performs this Janmastmi vrata through someone else, he also achieves Visnuloka. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.55.69 \|\|

*janmāṣṭamī janamanonayanābhirāmā pāpāpahā sapadi naṃditanaṃdagopā \|*  
*yo devakīṃ sadayitāṃ yajatīha tasyāṃ putrānavāpya samupaiti padaṃ sa viṣṇoḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. The Janmastami vrata delights the people and their minds, and removes the sins. Those who perform this vrata and worship Devaki with the maids, they get sons and the place of Visnu.

## Chapter 56. Durvastami Vrata

## \|\| 3.56.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śukle bhādrapadasyaiva pakṣe'ṣṭamyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*dūrvāṣṭamīvrataṃ puṇyaṃ yaḥ kuryācchraddhayānvitaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*na tasya kṣayamāpnoti saṃtānaṃ saptaṣauruṣam \|*  
*naṃdate varddhate nityaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ tathā kulam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sri Krsna said- O Yudhisthira, on the bright eighth day of the month of Bhadrapada, there is a provision of Durvastami vrata, which is quite auspicious. A person who performs the same, he does not has to face separation from his children as well as the strength for the coming seven generations, and he always remains delightful.

## \|\| 3.56.3 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kuta eṣā samutpannā dūrvā kasmāccirāyuṣā \|*  
*kasmācca sā pavitrā ca lokanātha bravīhi me \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Yudhisthira said- O lord of the lokas, how did this Durvastami became popular and how was it caused? Why is it so great and auspicious, you kindly tell me.

## \|\| 3.56.4-19 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*kṣīrodasāgare pūrvaṃ mathyamāne'mṛtārthinā \|*  
*viṣṇunā bāhujaṃghābhyāṃ yaddhṛto mandaro giriḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*bhramito vai sa vegena romaṇyuddharṣitāni vai \|*  
*tānyetāni jalormībhirutkṣiptāni tadarṇavāt \|\| 5 \|\|*

*ajāyata śubhā dūrvā ramyā haritaśādvalā \|*  
*evameṣā samutpannā dūrvā vidhu tanūruhā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tasyāścopari vinyastaṃ mathitāmṛtamuttamam \|*  
*devadānavagandharvairyakṣavidyādharaistathā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tatrāpyamṛtakuṃbhasya peturnniṣyaṃdabiṃdavaḥ \|*  
*tairiyaṃ spṛṣṭamātrābhūddūrvā rasyā'jarā'marā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*vaṃdyā pavitrā devaistu vaṃditābhyarcitā purā \|*  
*aṣṭamyāṃ phalapuṣpaistu kharjūrairnnālikerakaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*drākṣākṣoṭakapitthaiśca barbarairlakucaistathā \|*  
*nāriṃgairjaṃbukairāmrairbījapūraiśca dāḍimaiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*dadhyakṣataiḥ supuṣpaiśca dhūpanaivedyadīpakaiḥ \|*  
*maṃtreṇānena rājendra śṛṇu ṣvāvahitena ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tvaṃ dūrve'mṛtajanmāsi vaṃditā ca surāsuraiḥ \|*  
*saubhāgyaṃ saṃtatiṃ kṛtvā sarvakāryakarī bhava \|\| 12 \|\|*
