The children had surrounded her from all the sides and they made a fun of her. At the same time, the mother of the king of Cedi spotted the lady in distress. She had been surrounded by the people from all the sides. She had fallen on the earth, she looked like the digit of the moon, which spreads light everywhere. She atonce summoned Damayanti in her palace and asked her- “O beautiful one, who are you and what do you want?” Feeling shy, she said, “I am a maid servant and I perform the same job. But I shall not wash the feet nor shall I consume the leftover food. Besides, whosoever misbehaves with me, should be punished then and there. I shall accept to work in your palace on these conditions alone.” The royal mother said- “Be it so”, and she accepted the words of Damayanti. Thus she, getting clad in half the garments, lived in the royal palace for some time. Subsequently, on gaining the news, her father Bhima called her in his palace, through a Brahmana. Reaching with her parents, she was served well by her parents and brothers quite well. Still Damayanti felt extremely painful in separation from Nala.

## \|\| 3.64.15 \|\|

*provāca vimanāhūya vrataṃ dānamathāpi vā \|*  
*kathayadhvaṃ yathā me syādiṣṭena saha saṃgamaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. With a painful heart, she said to the Brahmana “You kindly tell me the way by which, I could be able to unite with Nala.”

## \|\| 3.64.16-18 \|\|

*tatretihāsakuśalo vipraḥ provāca buddhimān \|*  
*bhadre tvamāśādaśamīṃ kuruṣvepsitasiddhidām \|\| 16 \|\|*

*cakāra sarvaṃ tanvaṃgī yatpurāṇavidā tadā \|*  
*khyātamākhyānaviduṣā damanena purodhasā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa damayaṃtyā narottama \|*  
*saṃjātaḥ sukhado'tyarthaṃ bharttrā saha samāgamaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. On hearing this, the Brahmana, who was well-versed in history, said to her- “O chaste lady, you better start the performing of vrata of Asadasami in a proper manner.” Thereafter, Damayanti did whatever was told by that Brahmana who was the knower of Puranas. With the influence of the said vrata Damayanti got pleasantly united with her husband Nala.

## \|\| 3.64.19 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kathamāśādaśamyeṣā govinda kriyate kadā \|*  
*sarvametatsamācakṣva māṃ sarvajñosi yādava \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Yudhisthira said- O Govinda, O Yadava, you are the leader of the months, therefore, you kindly tell me as to how the vrata of Asadasami is performed? You please tell me.

## \|\| 3.64.20-24 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*rājyāśayā rājaputraḥ kṛṣyarthaṃ tu kṛṣīvalaḥ \|*  
*bhāryārthaṃ tu vaṇikputraḥ putrārthe gurviṇī tathā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*dharmārthakāmasaṃsiddhayai lokakanyā varārthinī \|*  
*yaṣṭukāmo dvijavaro rogī rogāpanuttaye \|\| 21 \|\|*

*cirapravāsite kāṃte kālena dhṛtipaṃḍitā \|*  
*eteṣvanyeṣu kartavyamāśāvratamidaṃ sadā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*yadā yasya bhavedārtaṃ kāryate hi tadā vratam \|*  
*śuklapakṣe daśamyāṃ tu snātvā saṃpūjya devatāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*naktaṃ tadāśāḥ saṃpūjyāḥ puṣpālaktakacandanaiḥ \|*  
*gṛhāṅgaṇe lekhayitvā yavaiḥ piṣṭātakena vā \|*  
*dattvā ghṛtāktaṃ naivedyaṃ punaḥ kāryaṃ nivedayet \|\| 24 \|\|*

20-24. Sri Krsna said- The vrata of Asadakami should be observed by a prince for the sake of gaining kingship; the farmer for the sake of good harvest; the son of a Vaisya for the sake of a wife; a pregnant woman for the sake of the birth of a son; the people in general for the sake of achieving dharma, artha and kama; the girls for getting a suitable husband; the Brahmanas for the successful completion of a sacrifice; an ailing person for the removal of the disease; a chaste wife for ending the period of separation from her husband; and for the fulfillment of the other desires of the people, the vrata of the Asadasami should be performed. Besides, whenever a person faces any type of misery, then for the removal of such a misfortune, this vrata should be performed. On the bright tenth moon day of the month, after finishing the bath and the adoration of the gods, in the courtyard of the house, a beautiful image of the goddess Asa with powder of pulses should be prepared. Then the flowers, red colour and sandal paste should be offered to her. After worshipping the goddess, the eatable mixed with ghi should be offered to the goddess.

## \|\| 3.64.25-32 \|\|

*āśāścāśāḥ sadā saṃtu vidyaṃtāṃ ca manorathāḥ \|*  
*bhavatīnāṃ prasādena sadā kalyāṇamastviti \|\| 25 \|\|*

*evaṃ saṃpūjya bhuñjīta dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām \|*  
*anena kramayogena māsimāsi samācaret \|\| 26 \|\|*

*yāvanmanorathaḥ pūrṇastataḥ paścātsamudyamāt \|*  
*māsi pūrṇe ca ṣaṇmāse varṣe varṣadvaye gate \|\| 27 \|\|*

*sauvarṇāḥ kārayedāśā raupyapiṣṭātakena vā \|*  
*jñātibaṃdhujanaiḥ sārddhaṃ snātaḥ samyagalaṃkṛtaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*pūjayenmaṃtrasaṃdarbhairebhirdhyātvā gṛhāṃgaṇe \|*  
*tava saṃnihitaḥ śakraḥ surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ \|*  
*pūrvā candreṇa sahitā aindrīdigdevate namaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*agneḥ parigrahādārye tvamāgneyīti paṭhyase \|*  
*tejomayī parā śaktirāgneyī varadā bhava \|\| 30 \|\|*

*devarājaṃ samāsādya lokaḥ saṃyamayatyasau \|*  
*tena saṃyamanī yāsi yāmye kāmapradā bhava \|\| 31 \|\|*

*khaḍgaṃsahātivikṛtā nairṛtistvamupābhṛtā \|*  
*tena nairṛtanāmnītvaṃ kṛtavānmaghavā sadā \|\| 32 \|\|*

25-32. The performer should then pray- “0 goddess (of hope), you are the form of all the hopes and shall always remain so. After gracing me with the success of my task, you always bestow welfare on me.” Thereafter, the Brahmana should be pleased with the giving of the food and daksina. The same procedure should be adopted on the bright tenth moon day of each month, performing the vrata. The vrata has to be completed after two and a half years, after which, the image of Asadevi in gold, silver or using the fragrant powder should be made. Then he should take bath with his relatives and reciting the mantras, the goddess should be worshipped, saying- “I offer my salutation to the earlier deity who is adored by the god as well as the asuras and remains in contact with Indra. She is adorned with a crescent moon. O Arya, because of your association with Agni, you are also known as Agneyi. You are highly illustrious besides being the Para sakti, therefore, you bestow a boon to me. O Yamya, after achieving Indra, you discipline the world and because of that, you are adored by the people as Samyami. Therefore, you kindly grant my wishes. Being the holder of a sword, you are also Vikrta as well Nairrti. Because of this, Managhava (Indra) has popularized you in the name of Nairrti.

## \|\| 3.64.33-34 \|\|

*tvayyāste bhavanādhāravaruṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ \|*  
*iṣṭakāmārthasiddhyarthaṃ vāruṇiprabhavā bhava \|\| 33 \|\|*

*adhiśritāsi yasmāttvaṃ vāyunā jagadāyunā \|*  
*vāyavye tvamataḥ śāntiṃ nityaṃ yaccha namonamaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. You happen to be the base of the abode of Varuna who is the lord of oceans as well as the aquatic creatures. Therefore, you bestow the desired success on me. You have been known as Vayavya because you are dependent on the wind, which happens to be the life of the earth. You kindly bestow peace on me. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 3.64.35 \|\|

*kuberavāsataḥ saumyā prakhyātā tvamathottarā \|*  
*aiśānī jagadīśena śaṃbhunā tvamalaṃkṛtā \|*  
*atastvaṃ śivasānnidhyaṃ devi dehi śive namaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. O beautiful goddess, since you have been influenced by Kubera, therefore, you are also called as Uttara by the people. O goddess Aisani, you have always been adorned by lord Siva, therefore, O goddess Siva, you also help me in achieving the closeness of Siva. I offer my salutation to you.

## \|\| 3.64.36 \|\|

*sarpāṣṭakakulena tvaṃ sevitāsi tathāpyadhaḥ \|*  
*nāgāṃganābhiḥ sahitā hitā naḥ sarvadā bhava \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The eight generations of the king of the serpents have served you, but you still patronized the earth. Therefore, O eternal goddess, you always get ready to help me, with the damsels of the serpents.

## \|\| 3.64.37 \|\|

*saptalokaiḥ parigatā sarvadā tvaṃ śivā yataḥ \|*  
*sanakādyaiḥ parivṛtā brāhmī jihmānapākuru \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Inspite of your pervading the entire universe of seven Iokas, you are the treasure of the welfare, therefore, getting surrounded by Sanakas and other Rsis, always bestow welfares on me.

## \|\| 3.64.38-39 \|\|

*nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvāṇi grahāstārāgrahāstathā \|*  
*nakṣatramātaro ye ca bhūtapretavināyakāḥ \|*  
*sarve mameṣṭasiddhyarthe bhavaṃtu praṇatāḥ sadā \|\| 38 \|\|*

*ebhirmaṃtraiḥ samabhyarcya puṣpadhūpādinā tataḥ \|*  
*vāsobhirabhisaṃsthāpya phalāni vinivedayet \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Besides let all the planets, constellations, stars, Matrkas, goblins, Pretas, Pisacas and Vinayaka besides other gods, should remain docile for the accomplishment of my task. With the uttering of these mantras, the goddess should be decorated offering flowers, incense, costumes, etc. After performing the worship, the fruits should be offered.

## \|\| 3.64.40 \|\|

*tattūryadhvanighoṣeṇa gatimaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ \|*  
*nṛtyatībhirvarastrībhistāṃ rātrimativāhayet \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The musical instruments like trumpets should be played upon and the welfare songs, dancing by the damsels should be arranged, during the whole night.

## \|\| 3.64.41 \|\|

*kuṃkumakṣodatīvreṇa dānamānādibhiḥ sukham \|*  
*prabhāte vedaviduṣe sarvaṃ tatpratipādayet \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Thereafter, the vermilion, eatables, charities and respect should be extended to them pleasing them at the same time. In the early morning, the entire material should be given over to a Brahmana, well versed in Vedas.

## \|\| 3.64.42 \|\|

*anena vidhinā sarvaṃ kṣamayanpraṇipatya ca \|*  
*bhuñjīta mitrasahitaḥ suhṛdbaṃdhujanairapi \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. By completing the vrata with this process, one should beg forgiveness, after which, the performer of the vrata should take food with his relatives.

## \|\| 3.64.43-45 \|\|

*ya evaṃ kurute pārtha daśamīvratamādarāt \|*  
*sa sarvakāmamāpnoti manasābhīpsitaṃ naraḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*strībhirviśeṣataḥ kāryaṃ vratametadyudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*laghucittā yato nāryaḥ sadā kāmaparāyaṇāḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam \|*  
*kathitaṃ te mahārāja mayā vratamanuttamam \|\| 45 \|\|*

43-45. Thus by performing the vrata of dasami in a proper manner, all the desires of a person are fulfilled. O Yudhisthira, this vrata should particularly be performed by the ladies, because they have a deliberate mind and always remain passionate. O great king, in this way, I have narrated the process of performing the vrata, which yields grace, glory, long life, besides fulfilling all the desires.

## \|\| 3.64.46 \|\|

*ye mānavā manujapuṅgava kāmakāmāḥ saṃpūjayaṃti daśamīṣu sadā daśāśāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ viśeṣanihitā hṛdaye prakāmamāśāḥ phalaṃtyalamalaṃ bahunoditena \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The people who perform this vrata on the day of dasami, they always remain hopeful, their hearts get enlightened and they achieve many rewards.

## Chapter 65. Taraka Dvadasi

## \|\| 3.65.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*ahaṃ tvāgaskaraḥ pāpaḥ pṛthivīkṣayakārakaḥ \|*  
*paripṛcchāmi govinda tvāṃ namaskṛtya pādayoḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*guhyādguhyataraṃ brūhi vrataṃ kiṃcidanuttamam \|*  
*tarāmi yena pāpaughaṃ bhīṣmadroṇavadhārṇavam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- O Govinda, I am the destroyer of the earth, besides being sinful and a great defaulter. Therefore, while offering my salutation at your feet, I beg to ask from you about a vrata which should be quite secret, the best and by which, I could be able to cross the ocean of universe which is full of sins, which I earned by the killing of Bhisma and Drona.

## \|\| 3.65.3-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*āsītpurottaro nāmnā vidarbhāyāṃ kuśadhvajaḥ \|*  
*sāṃtaḥpurasuto yaśca cakre rājyamataṃdritaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*jaghāna tāpasaṃ so'tha pramādānmṛgayāṃ gataḥ \|*  
*mṛgaṃ matvā mahāraṇye brāhmaṇaṃ daivamohitaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tena karmavipākena dehāṃte narakaṃ gataḥ \|*  
*tatrāsau yātanā ghorā anubhūyātipīḍitaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Sri Krsna said- In earlier times, Kusadhvaja was the king of Vidarbha, who together with his son and wife, was always engaged in serving the people. Once he went to the forest for hunting, while wandering in the forest with great arrogance, because of the move of the destiny, the king getting confused, by mistake considered a Brahmana ascetic couple to be the animals and killed them. As a result of which, he had to go to the hell. He had bitter experience of the torture in the hell.

## \|\| 3.65.6-12 \|\|

*tasmādihāgato martye raudro viṣadharo'bhavat \|*  
*adaśatso'pi rājendra brāhmaṇaṃ caraṇe ruṣā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*labdhvā saha ca paṃcatvaṃ jagāma dvijasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*vipannastu tataḥ siṃho dvitīye'bhūtsudāruṇaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*vidāritamukho hiṃsro nānāsattvabhayaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*jaghānāsau punaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ rājanyaṃ mṛgayā gatam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tato'pi bahubhiḥ śastrai rājalokairnipātitaḥ \|*  
*punarvyāghro babhūvāsau tṛtīye'pi bhavāṃtare \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tīkṣṇapādanakhāghātavyāpāditamṛgānvayaḥ \|*  
*tenāpi vaiśyo nidhanaṃ nītaḥ kiñcidvanāṃtaram \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sa nītaḥ kṛmirāśitvaṃ lokaiḥ khātanipātanāt \|*  
*saṃjātastu mahānṛkṣo nakharāhatajaṃturuk \|\| 11 \|\|*

*jaghāna bālaṃ caṇḍālādasau mṛtyumavāpnuyāt \|*  
*pañcame makaro jātaḥ samudre' tibhayaṃkaraḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

6-12.Thereafter, he was reborn on earth as a poisonous serpent.As a serpent also,he once getting enraged,bit a Brahmana over his foot,as a result of which the Brahmana as well as the serpent both died. In the next birth, he became a terrific lion with a vast face. Being a terrific lion,he was a danger tc the other wild animals of the forest. Once a king who arrived in the forest for hunting, was killed by the lion. But the warriors of the king also killed the lion. During the third birth, he was born as a horrible tiger, who always killed the wild forest animals with his sharp nails. In due course of time, he killed a Vaisya who had arrived in the forest. Then several people assembled and drove out the tiger from the forest. While so moving, he fell in a pit as a result of which innumerable worms were grown in his body. The terrific pain so caused by the worms, ultimately killed the tiger. Thereafter, he was reborn as a bear, who always tortured the wild animals with his nails. Once, when he killed a child, a Candala killed the bear as well. Then, he was reborn as a crocodile.

## \|\| 3.65.13-14 \|\|

*striyaṃ jaghāna taruṇīṃ snātukāmāmathāgatām \|*  
*prabhāte śaṅkarasyāgre śaśāṅkagrahaṇe niśi \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tatrāpi baḍiśaṃ dattvā janaiḥ prāṇairviyojitaḥ \|*  
*punaḥ ṣaṣṭhe bhave jātaḥ piśācaḥ piśitāśanaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. Once, after the lunar eclipse, after the night, (people assembled) besides a Siva temple in the morning. The wild crocodile swallowed a beautiful young woman, killing her. But the people present there at the seashore, at once caught hold of the crocodile and killed it. Again in the sixth birth, he became a man eating Pisaca.

## \|\| 3.65.15-17 \|\|

*krūraśchidraparaḥ kṣudro naraprāṇaviyojakaḥ \|*  
*so'vatīrṇo narasyāṃgaṃ karṣayāmāsa kasyacit \|\| 15 \|\|*

*maṃtreṇāhūya siddhena vātikena vyasuḥ kṛtaḥ \|*  
*saptame sa punarjāto durnirīkṣyavapurbhṛśam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*krūradaṃṣdraḥ karālāsyo māṃsaśoṇitabhojanaḥ \|*  
*digvāsā marubhūmīṣu vāśiṣṭho brahmarākṣasaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. He was extremely cruel, faults finding, besides being the killer of the humans. When once he tried to scratch a Siddha Tantrika, he killed the Pisaca in return. During his seventh birth, he became a horrible Brahmaraksasa. He was quite awful with protruding fangs. He was the consumer of flesh and blood, wandered naked and lived on, besides being the killer of people like the family of Vasistha. extremely terrific demon in Pancala country He had the raised hair, red eyes, strong but short body, a sinful person, the incantation of adharma. and always used to war over the leftover garlands. He always held the weapons like a rod and a noose and lived over a tree trunk.

## \|\| 3.65.18-22 \|\|

*sa rāṣṭraṃ jarjaraṃ śūnyaṃ sarvaṃ cakre viṣādiṣu \|*  
*ākramya bhīmadāsena rājñā rākṣasaśatruṇā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*samāropya dhanuḥ saṃkhye brahmāstreṇa nipātitaḥ \|*  
*bhūyo'bhavadvyāghrasamaḥ svajanmanyaṣṭame bhuvi \|\| 19 \|\|*

*vanecarāṇāṃ kruddhāṅgo brāhmaṇānnidhanaṃ gataḥ \|*  
*tato hastī ca bhallūko mātaṃgena dhanuṣmatā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*ekādaśe'pi pāñcālo bhavamadhye'pi bhīṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*ūrdhvakeśoti raktākṣo jāto hrasvatanurdṛḍhaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*pāpo dharmadhvajo rakṣo devatojjhitamālyadhṛka \|*  
*sa daṇḍapāśikenaiva vṛkṣāgre hyavalaṃbitaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

18-22. Finding the entire country injured and a deserted place made by the Brahmaraksasa, then the king of the place known as Bhimadasa who was an enemy of the Brahmaraksasa, making use of Brahmastra over his bow, killed the Raksasa. During his eighth birth, he was again born as another wild animal. For the forest dwellers, he was the death incarnate. After having been killed by a Brahmana, he was born as an elephant, then a bear. After having been killed with the bow and arrow by a Kirata, he reappeared as an

## \|\| 3.65.23-25 \|\|

*dvādaśe sa punarjātaḥ puṣkalakleśabhājanaḥ \|*  
*bhakṣyalobhādbilagato vyādhena vinipātitaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tena cāsītkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tārakadvādaśīvratam \|*  
*tasya prabhāvājāto'pi duṣṭayonau punaḥpunaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*avāpa śīghraṃ paṃcatvaṃ saṃsārabhavasāgare \|*  
*punarevābhavadrājā vidarbhāyāṃ sudhārmikaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. During his twelfth birth, he was born as a serpent and this birth was quite painful for him. For the greed of his food, he entered a snake hole in the ground and while doing so, he was injured by a tiger. In earlier times, he had observed vrata on the Taraka Dvadasi in an appropriate manner, as a result of which, inspite of his having been born as wicked creatures, his life had been of quite a short span. Consequently, he became the king of Vidarbha country and was a great reformer.

## \|\| 3.65.26-27 \|\|

*bhūyaścopoṣitā tena tārakadvādaśī śubhā \|*  
*dṛśyatāṃ vratamāhātmyaṃ jātojātaḥ punaḥpunaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*vrataprabhāvādbhuvane bhuktvā rājyamakaṇṭakam \|*  
*prāpa viṣṇupure sthānaṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. He again performed vrata of the Taraka-Dvadasi, as result of which he became a great king on earth and enjoyed the thornless rule of his country. At the time of great dissolution, he achieved an uninterrupted stay in the place of Visnu.

## \|\| 3.65.28 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kathametadvrataṃ kṛṣṇa kartavyaṃ puruṣottamaiḥ \|*  
*strībhirvā bhartṛvākyena snānadānajapādikam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Yudhisthira said O Krsna, how should the excellent people perform this vrata? Besides, how the chaste women, getting permission from their husbands, should take bath, give charities, undertake japam and how should the vrata be concluded by them?

## \|\| 3.65.29-35 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe gṛhītvā dvādaśīvratam \|*  
*akṛtrime jale snānamaparāhṇe samācaret \|\| 29 \|\|*

*praṇamya bhāskarāyātha kṛtvā devārcanaṃ tathā \|*  
*homaśca tāvatsthātavyo yāvadastamito raviḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*tato bhuktvā phalaiḥ puṣpairgandhadhūpa vilepanaiḥ \|*  
*sajalaṃ sākṣataṃ kṛtvā sahiraṇyaṃ śubhaiḥ phalaiḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*ramye tāmramaye pātre jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gataḥ \|*  
*pūrvāmukhaḥ pradoṣāgre mūrdhni kṛtvārghyabhājanam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*bhūmau tu maṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā gomayena satārakam \|*  
*caṃdanena samālikhya dhruvaṃ hi gaganonmukhaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sahasraśīrṣāmaṃtreṇa bhūmau śaktyā śanaiḥ svayam \|*  
*tārakāṇāṃ kuruśreṣṭha dadyādarghyamataṃdritaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*paryukṣya dhūmamutkṣipya dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇām \|*  
*krameṇa sarvaṃ nirvartya bhojyaṃ bhojyaṃ niśāgame \|\| 35 \|\|*

29-35. Sri Krsna said- During the month of Margasirsa, on the day of the bright dvadasi in the early morning, one should take bath in a river or a natural lake and then offer salutation to the gods. Then at the time of sunset, the homa should be performed. After finishing his meals in the evening time, offering the fruits, flowers, fragrance, incense, paste, unbroken rice, water and gold in a copper plate, he should kneel down facing the east, over an orb created by plastering the ground with cowdung mixed with sandal paste. The figures of stars should be made looking towards the sky and one should recite the mantra- “Sahasra-sirsa”, and the arghya should be offered slowly. Then offering the incense, all the things should be handed over to a Brahmana with daksina. After completion of the entire performance, the food should be served to a Brahmana, after which he should himself take his food.

## \|\| 3.65.36-38 \|\|

*mārgaśīrṣe khaṃḍakhādyaṃ pauṣe sohālakaṃ tathā \|*  
*tilataṃḍulakaṃ māghe guḍāpūpaṃ ca phālgune \|\| 36 \|\|*

*modakāṃścaitramāse tu vaiśākhe khaṃḍaveṣṭakam \|*  
*jyeṣṭhe saktubhṛtaiḥ pātrairāṣāḍhe guḍapūrikaiḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*śrāvaṇe madhuśīrṣeṇa nabhasye pāyasena ca \|*  
*ghṛtaparṇaiścāśvayuje kāṃsāraiḥ kārttike kramān \|\| 38 \|\|*

36-38. This process should be repeated every month, the raw sugar should be given in the month of Margasirsa; Sohala in the month of Pausa; sweet balls of sesamum in the month of Magha; during Phalguna the fried cakes with raw sugar; the sweet balls in the month of Caitra; the raw sugar in the month of Vaisakha; during the month of Jyestha, barley powder with other essential materials filled in a vase; during the month of Asadha, fried cakes with raw sugar; during the month of Sravana, eatables mixed with honey; during Bhadrapada, payasam is to be given; during Asvina, some liquid cooked in ghi and in the month of Kartika, kamsara should be given for the purpose of food.

## \|\| 3.65.39 \|\|

*ebhirdvādaśabhirvarṣairbhojayitvā dvijānsvayam \|*  
*bhuñjīta bhaktyā rājendra paścāddevaṃ kṣamāpayet \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. This vrata has to be performed for twelve years, one should take food only after serving the same to the Brahmanas. Thereafter, with devotion, he should beg forgiveness.

## \|\| 3.65.40 \|\|

*samāpte tu vrate kṛtvā rājataṃ tārakāgaṇam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā vā pūrvavidhinā pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. After the conclusion of the vrata, the figure of stars should be made in silver, which should be worshipped as indicated above, in an appropriate manner. The performer should then beg forgiveness.

## \|\| 3.65.41-42 \|\|

*kumbhā dvādaśa dātavyāḥ sodakā modakāśritāḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇyāṃ paridhānaṃ ca padmarāgaḥ sakuṃcakaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇe valgulallāṭaṃ lakṣapuṣpopaśobhitam \|*  
*cālakenopavītaṃ ca puṣpaṃ dattvā kṣamāpayet \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Then, twelve pitchers filled with water and the sweet balls should be given. The wife of Brahmana should be given a sari, upper garment and ornaments of ruby. The Brahmana should be given a turban, besides the Vpavita (sacred thread) and flowers should be given. Then he should beg forgiveness.

## \|\| 3.65.43-45 \|\|

*anena vidhinā rājanyaḥ karoti vrataṃ naraḥ \|*  
*nārī vā bharataśreṣṭha bhaktibhāvapuraḥsarā \|\| 43 \|\|*

*nakṣatralokaṃ vrajati vimānenārkavarcasā \|*  
*apsarogaṇagandharvayakṣavidyādharāmaraiḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*sahasrabharttā svarloke pūjyamāno divākaraiḥ \|*  
*vasetkalpāyutaṃ yāvatpunarviṣṇupuraṃ vrajet \|\| 45 \|\|*

43-45. O best of the race of Bharata, a woman or a man, who performs this vrata in the aforesaid manner, will board the plane shining like a Sun and is served by Apsaras, Gandharvas, Yaksas and Vidyadharas. He or she is also respected by the Sungod, and they reach the abode of constellations. They enjoy all the comforts for ten thousand kalpas, and thereafter, they reach Visnuloka.

## \|\| 3.65.46-49 \|\|

*etadvrataṃ purā cīrṇaṃ śacyā rājñyā śriyomayā \|*  
*sītayā damayaṃtyā ca rukmiṇyā satyabhāmayā \|\| 46 \|\|*

*menayā raṃbhayā svarge urvaśyā devadattayā \|*  
*anyābhirapi nārībhiḥ puruṣaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*cīrṇametadvrataṃ pārtha sarvapāpabhayāpaham \|\| 48 \|\|*

*janmāṃtareṣvapi kṛtāni haratyaghāni yā saṃdahatyaharahaḥ sukṛtopayogāt \|*  
*sā dvādaśī jagati tārakanāmadheyā tannāsti yanna vidadhāti kṛtā manuṣyaiḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

46-49. O Partha, in earlier times, Indra with Indrani, Laksmi with Visnu, Sita, Damayanti, Rukmini, Satyabhama, Mena, UrvasI and Devadatta, besides ether men and women, individually perfomed this vrata, which removes danger. By the grace of the noble deeds, this vrata removes the sins of several past births, besides subsiding the sins committed daily. This is known as the Taraka-Dvadasi in the world. Therefore, all the people should perform this vrata lovingly.

## Chapter 66. Aranya Dvadasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.66.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*bhagavanbrūhi me samyagaraṇyadvādaśīvratam \|*  
*saprāśanaṃ sopavāsaṃ sarahasyaṃ samantrakam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- You kindly tell me about the performance, the performing and breaking of the fast, besides the secret mantra of the same.

## \|\| 3.66.2-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*kauṃteya yatpurā cīrṇaṃ sītayā vanasaṃsthayā \|*  
*vrataṃ rāghavavākyena praśastaṃ doṣavarjitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*lopāmu्drālaye sādhvyo munipatnyo bahuprajāḥ \|*  
*bhojitāstarpitāḥ sarvairāhāraiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*padminīpatravistīrṇe sopadaṃśai ryathā navaiḥ \|*  
*bhakṣyabhojyaistathā lehyaiścoṣyaiścāpi yadṛcchayā \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Sri Krsna said- At the time of proceeding to the forest with her husband Raghava,

## \|\| 3.66.5-6 \|\|

*tāmihaikamanāḥ pārthaḥ śṛṇuṣvāraṇyadvādaśīm \|*  
*mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe ekādaśyāṃ dinodaye \|\| 5 \|\|*

*snātvā naraḥ sopavāsaḥ kṛtvā pūjāṃ janārdane \|*  
*gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatairdhūpairdīpairjāgaraṇairniśām \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. O Partha, I am now telling you the process of performing the vrata of the Aranya Dvadasi. You better listen to me with apt attention. On the eleventh bright mocn day of the month of Margasirsa, taking bath at sunrise, the vow for the fast should be undertaken. Then offering the fragrar.ee, flowers, unbroken rice, incense and lamp, lord Janardana should be worshipped and one should remain awake during the night. accepting his command, Sita had performed this vrata. Similarly, Lopamudra the wife of Agastya Rsi, in company with other women of the asrama, preparing all the best type of eatables, served the Brahmanas as their food, while performing this vrata. They pleased the Brahmanas, serving, several types of dishes, who felt satisfied with the same.

## \|\| 3.66.7 \|\|

*nītvā prabhāte gatvā ca vane vedāṅgapāragān \|*  
*bhojayitvā phalaprāyaṃ svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Then at dawn, one should go to a forest, food should be served to the Brahmanas well-versed in the Vedas. Thereafter, the performer of vrata should himself take fruit, keeping silent.

## \|\| 3.66.8-11 \|\|

*pañcagavyaṃ prāśayitvā pūrvamevātha taddine \|*  
*varṣamekaṃ śubhaṃ pūrṇa pārayitvā yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 8 \|\|*

*śrāvaṇe kārttike māghe caitre vātha samarcite \|*  
*sopadaṃśaiḥ patraśākaistilaśaṣkulikādibhiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*apūpaiḥ khaṇḍaveṣṭaiśca marīcaiḥ siṃhakesaraiḥ \|*  
*dhūlīmukhai ramṛtaphalaiḥ svādukokarasaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*śītalaistarpayedvidvānarkapuṣpaiḥ sumālakaiḥ \|*  
*dadhikṣīrājyapāṇijyaiścāturjātakaraṃjitaiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

8-11. In the earlier day and night, he should break his fast with pancagavya. O Yudhisthira, this vrata should be performed for a year. At the conclusion of the same, during the months of Sravana, Kartika or Caitra, after performing the worship of the lord, the leftover of the same, besides vegetables, the sweet made of the sesamum seeds, mixed with raw sugar and pepper, should be used in the worship of the lord including Nagakesara and other fragrant materials. Fried cakes, tasteful, juicy and pleasant eatables and nectar like items, as well as the tasteful water should be served to a learned Brahmana. He should be offered a flower garland as well. In addition to the above, curd, payasam and the stuff made in ghi, besides the jack fruit with the fragrance of camphor and other fruits should also be offered.

## \|\| 3.66.12-14 \|\|

*karpūranakha viddhaiśca madhuraiḥ panasottamaiḥ \|*  
*bahuvṛkṣaṃ vanaṃ gatvā susvādusalilaṃ śivam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sukhāsanopaviṣṭāṃśca prāgudaṅmukhavacchucīn \|*  
*bhojayeddaśa ca dvau vā munīnāraṇyavāsinaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ekadaṃḍīstridaṃḍīśca gṛhasthāṃścāpi suvratān \|*  
*brāhmaṇīrvividhāḥ sapta ekapatnīḥ pativratāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. Thereafter, in a thick forest having large number of trees, twelve Brahmanas should be seated in Bhadrasana facing the east or the north and the aforesaid items should be served to be consumed by them. Among them should be a Dandi as well as a Tridandi sanyasi. While performing the vrata, the household should also join them. At the same time, food should also be served to seven Brahmana wives, who should be chaste and the only wife of her husband.

## \|\| 3.66.15 \|\|

*cārvaṃgyaścārcitāḥ snātāḥ sarvāvayamaśobhanāḥ \|*  
*suvastrāḥ kukumāktāṅgāḥ sugaṃdhakusumāṃcitāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. After their bath, those beautiful women should he decorated with paste, fragrance, vermilion, costumes, scents etc.

## \|\| 3.66.16-17 \|\|

*aṃgairvā bhojanīyāstāstāścādityasya devatāḥ \|*  
*vāsudevajanārdanadāmodaramadhusūdanāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*padmanābhakṛṣṇaviṣṇugovarddhanatrivikramāḥ \|*  
*śrīdharaśca hṛṣīkeśaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣa ādivārāhāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. All their limbs should be well decorated and food should be served to them. Thereafter, salutation should be offered to Vasudeva, Janardana, Damodara, Madhusudana, Krsna, Visnu, Govardhana, Trivikrama, Sridhara, Hrsikesa, Pundarikaksa and Adi-Varaha with folded hands.

## \|\| 3.66.18 \|\|

*ebhirdvādaśabhirmantrairnamaskārāṃtayojitaiḥ \|*  
*gaṃdhacandanasaṃvastraṃ dhūpaṃ dattvā pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The namaskara pada should be added at the end of all the names. The fragrance sandal paste, costumes and incense should be offered to all them individually.

## \|\| 3.66.19-20 \|\|

*bhojayitvā śubhānnāni dadyāttābhyaḥ sudakṣiṇām \|*  
*praṇamya prārthayedbhaktyā viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tato bhuñjīta sahito bhṛtyaiḥ preṣyajanena ca \|*  
*āgatābhyāgatairlokaiḥ suhṛtsaṃbaṃdhibaṃdhubhiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. Then all the Brahmanas and others should be pleased with the giving away of the daksina. After salutation, the performer should beg forgiveness, saying- “O lord Visnu, be pleased with me.” Thus in this way, the puja should be completed. The performer should then take food with servants, messengers, guests, friends and the relatives.

## \|\| 3.66.21-22 \|\|

*evaṃ kauṃteya kurute yo'raṇyadvādaśīṃ naraḥ \|*  
*sa dehāṃte vimānastho divyakanyāsamāvṛtaḥ \|*  
*yāti jñātisamāyuktaḥ śvetadvīpaṃ hareḥ puram \|\| 21 \|\|*

*yatra lokāḥ pītavastrāḥ śyāmadehāścaturbhujāḥ \|*  
*śaṃkhacakragadāpadmacāruhastāḥ sakaustubhāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. O son of Kunti, a person, who performs the vrata of Aranva Dvadasi, at the time of his death, boarding a plane, getting served by the girls, he proceeds to the the place of Visnu-The dweller of that place is clad in yellow robes, having dark complexion of the body, with four arms, holding a conch, a disc, a club and a lotus, besides getting decorated with the kaustubha gem.

## \|\| 3.66.23-26 \|\|

*garuḍāsanāḥ sābharaṇā mukuṭotkaṭa kuṃḍalāḥ \|*  
*nīlotpaloddāmapadmamālayālaṃkṛtorasaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*lakṣmīdharā meghavarṇāḥ kūrparāṅgadabhūṣaṇāḥ \|*  
*tiṣṭhaṃti viṣṇusāmānye yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*tasmādetya mahātejāḥ pṛthivyāṃ nṛpapūjitāḥ \|*  
*martyaloke kīrtimaṃtaḥ saṃbhavaṃti narottamāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tato yāṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ mokṣamārgaṃ śivaṃ śubham \|*  
*yatra gatvā na śocaṃti na saṃsāre bhramaṃti ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

23-26. He also has Garuda as his vehicle, is adorned with all the ornaments, crown, earrings, besides the garland of blue lotus flowers around his neck. All the people of the white continent have LaksmI with them, have blue complexion, are adorned with all the ornaments and look like Visnu himself. Upto the time of dissolution, they enjoy all the pleasures there. When they are reborn on earth, they are respected by the illustrious kings and attain enormous glory. After their death, by the grace of Siva, they attain the moksa, after which they have not to face any grief, or get in the cycle of birth and death.

## \|\| 3.66.27 \|\|

*ye dvādaśīmupavasaṃti sitāmaraṇyanāmnīṃ vane dvijavarānatha bhojayaṃti \|*  
*sādhvyaḥ striyaḥ sucaritābharaṇāśca tāsāṃ viṣṇuḥ prasādamupayāti dadāti mokṣam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Thus performing fast on the day of dvadasi, which includes living in a forest. serving food to the Brahmanas as well as the chaste women, offering them costumes and ornaments, one who does so with all the delight, lord Visnu bestows moksa to him.

## Chapter 67. Rohini-Candra Vrata

## \|\| 3.67.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*ghanāvṛte vare deve varṣākāle hyupasthite \|*  
*mayūrakekākulite dardurārāvapūrite \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kulastriyaḥ prayacchaṃti kasyānnaṃ kā'tra devatā \|*  
*kiṃ vrataṃ kṛṣṇa vikhyātamannaṃ kasyāṃ tithau bhavet \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- O Krsna, during the time of the rainy season, observing the sky overcast with clouds, peacocks and frogs create their sounds. During that time, which one is the family deity adored by the ladies? What type of food is offered by them? What is the name of that vrata? What is its name, 0 Krsna, by which it has become popular?

## \|\| 3.67.3-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*pravṛtte śrāvaṇe māsi kṛṣṇapakṣe hyupasthite \|*  
*ekādaśyāṃ śucirbhūtvā sarvauṣadhijalaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*māṣacūrṇena rājendra kuryādiṃdurikāśanam \|*  
*modakāṃśca tathā paṃca ghṛtapakvānsunirmalān \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Sri Krsna said- O Rajendra, on the dark eleventh day of the month of Sravana, one should get purified with the water mixed with ausadhis or the medicinal plants. The sweet balls should be made of the powder of black gram, which should be mixed with ghi. and ghi. When these as well as the other sweet dishes are consumed by Indra and other gods, it is believed to be the main cause for the same as has been told (by the learned people).

## \|\| 3.67.5-8 \|\|

*naramekaikamuddiśya tato gatvā jalāśayam \|*  
*duṣṭayādovirahitaṃ satoyaṃ jalajairyutam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tasyaiva puline ramye juṣṭānne gomayādinā \|*  
*kṛtvā maṃḍalakaṃ vṛttaṃ piṣṭakādibhirarcitam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*carcitaṃ gaṃdhakusumairdhūpa dīpākṣatojjvalam \|*  
*tatra caṃdraṃ likhedeva rohiṇyā sahitaṃ vibhum \|*  
*arcayecca sabhāryo vai mantreṇānena bhāvitaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*somarāja namastubhyaṃ rohiṇyai te namonamaḥ \|*  
*mahāsati mahādevi saṃpādaya mamepsitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

5-8. Enough of sweet balls should be prepared so that all people can eat them. Then, the deovtee should go to a lake or a river bank, where the land should be plastered with cowdung and then decorate it with powder etc. Thereafter, the fragrance, incense and lamp should be offered, while worshipping the same. While so doing, a beautiful figure of the moon with Rohini should be made and worshipped reciting the m antra- “Salutation to Somaraja. I also offer my salutation again and again to the chaste RohinI. Both of you should grant my wish in no time.”

## \|\| 3.67.9 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya tasyāgre naivedyaṃ deyamarcitam \|*  
*tatraiva brāhmaṇe dadyātsomo me prīyatā miti \|*  
*prīyatāmiti me devī rohiṇī sahitapriyā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Thus worshipping with devotion, the eatables should be offered. At the same time all those eatables should be given over to a Brahmana and one should say—“Let the Moon god with Rohini, be pleased with me.”

## \|\| 3.67.10-12 \|\|

*evamuccārya dattvā ca tatoṃ'tarjalamāviśet \|*  
*kaṃṭhāṃtaṃ kaṭimātraṃ vā gulphāṃtaṃ vā jalā śaye \|\| 10 \|\|*

*dhyāyecca manasā somaṃ rohiṇīsahitaṃ tadā \|*  
*yāvatsamastaṃ tadbhuktaṃ bhuktvā cāṃtastaṭe sthitaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*niyamya vasatāṃ cānye tato viprāya bhojanam \|*  
*dakṣiṇāsahitaṃ deyaṃ niścayaṃ vāci kalpayet \|*  
*bhaktyā śaktyā yathācittaṃ yathāvittaṃ tathā tathā \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. Thus speaking, the performer of the vrata should enter the neck, waist or ankle deep water, devoting his mind over Rohini and the Moon, and should consume the eatables. After finishing it, he should stand erect there and then offer food and daksina to the Brahmanas, pleasing them at the same time. Then he should take a firm oath that—“With utmost devotion, I shall mentally keep on performing this vrata, as per my means.”

## \|\| 3.67.13-16 \|\|

*yaḥ karoti naro rājannārī vātha kumārikā \|*  
*varṣevarṣe vidhānena pārthedaṃ rohiṇīvratam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*iha loke ciraṃ sthitvā dhanadhānyasamākule \|*  
*gṛhāśrame śubhāṃ labdhvā putrapautrādisaṃtatim \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tataḥ sutīrthe maraṇaṃ tato brahmapuraṃ vrajet \|*  
*tasmādviṣṇupuraṃ pārtha tato rudrapuraṃ śubham \|\| 15 \|\|*

*khe rohiṇī śaśadharābhimatā hitā ca kiṃ kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu narendra nivedayāmi \|*  
*saṃpiṣṭamāṣaraciteṃdurikāśituṃ yadbhuktaṃ jale guḍaghṛtena phalaṃ tadetat \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-16. A boy or a girl, who thus performs the Rohini-vrata, achieves enough of wealth, sons and grandsons on earth, besides the cereals, as a householder (or as a house wife) and enjoys all the pleasures on earth. The devoted person meets with his end at a sacred place, and finally achieves the Brahmaloka. О Partha, he in turn, also achieves Visnuloka as well as Rudraloka respectively. Similarly, О king! I shall tell you also the reason for Rohini and the Moon getting pleased on a person. You please listen. At the time of the performing of this vrata, entering the water, the powder of black gram should be mixed with raw sugar

## Chapter 68. Aviyoga Vrata

## \|\| 3.68.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*aviyogavrataṃ brūhi mama yādavanaṃdana \|*  
*vidhānaṃ tasya kīdṛkca kiṃ puṇyaṃ kā'tra devatā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O son of the race of Yadavas, you speak out to me about the process of the performing of Aviyoga vrata. Who is the chief god for the same?

## \|\| 3.68.2-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu pāṃḍava yatnena kathyamānaṃ yathākhilam \|*  
*aviyogavrataṃ nāma vratānāmuttamottamam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*prauṣṭhapade śuklapakṣe dvādaśyāṃ prātarutthitaḥ \|*  
*yastu śuklāṃbaradharaḥ snātvā pūrvaṃ jalāśaye \|\| 3 \|\|*

*hṛdye ramye saudhataṭe hariṃ likhyeta maṇḍale \|*  
*godhūmacūrṇapiṣṭena lakṣmī tatpārśvavartinīm \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tatraiva ca haraṃ gaurīṃ sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇā saha \|*  
*rājñīsahitaṃ ca raviṃ trailokyodyotakārakam \|\| 5 \|\|*

2-5. Sri Krsna said- O Pandava, of all the vratas, the Aviyoga-vrata is the best and I am going to speak out the details about it. You please listen with apt attention. On the bright twelfth day of the moon falling in the month of Bhadrapada, one should get up early in the morning and have a bath in a reservoir or a river. Then getting free from the daily routine, on the charming sand of the some reservoir or the river, one should prepare the figures of Visnu and Laksmi with wheat flour, besides those of Hara-Gauri, Brahma-Savitri, Surya, the creator of the universe as well as Rajni, in a beautiful way.

## \|\| 3.68.6-11 \|\|

*gaṃdhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpairnaivedyairarcayedyathāśaktyā \|*  
*aviyogavratacārī maṃtreṇānena rājendra \|\| 6 \|\|*

*nārī vā puruṣo vā aviyogamatiṃ dṛḍhāṃ kṛtvā \|*  
*bhaktyā dhyānī maunī dāṃpatyaṃ pūjayeddevam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sahasramūrddhā puruṣaḥ padmanābho janārdanaḥ \|*  
*vyāso'pi kapilācāryo bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇo madhuliho viṣṇurdāmoharo hariḥ \|*  
*mahāvarāho goviṃdaḥ keśavo garuḍadhvajaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*śrīdharaḥ puṃḍarīkākṣo viśvarūpastrivikramaḥ \|*  
*upendro vāmano rāmo vaikuṃṭho mādhavo dhruvaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*vāsudevo hṛṣīkeśaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sakarṣaṇo'cyutaḥ \|*

6-11. Thereafter, as per one’s means, he should offer scent, flowers, incense, lamps and eatables. Then reciting the mantras with devotion, all the deities should be worshipped with devotion. At the same time, the couple (the man and wife) devoting their mind over the above deities, should worship the divine couples. The human couple should then beg forgiveness with the mantras starting from-“Sahasramurdha purusah..............varadah sada” should be recited. These include all the gods like the Purusa with a thousand heads, also known as Padmanabha, Janardana, Vyasa, Kapilacarya, Purusottama, Narayana, Madhulika, Visnu, Damodara, Hari, Mahavaraha, Govinda, Kesava, Garudadhvaja, Sridhara, Pundarikaksa, Visvarupa, Trivikrama, Upendra, Vamana, Rama, Vaikuntha, Madhava, Dhruva, Vasudeva, Hrsikesa, Krsna, Sankarsana, Acyuta, Aniruddha, Mahayogi, Pradyumna and Nanda.

## \|\| 3.68.12-14 \|\|

*nityaṃ sa me śubhaḥ prītaḥ saśrīkaḥ keśaśūlinaḥ \|*

12-14. Let all of them with Sri, bestow welfare on me and get immensely pleased with me. Siva — the lord of Uma is graced with a trident, then Nilakantha, Sthanu, Sambhu, Bhagaksiha, Isana, Bhairava, Soli, Trayambaka, Tripurantaka, Kapardi, Isa, Mahalingi, Mahakala, Vrsadhvaja, Siva, Sarva, Mabadeva, Rudra, Mahesvara and Siva with Parvati, should always bestow welfare on me.

## \|\| 3.68.15-16 \|\|

*brahmā śaṃbhuḥ prabhuḥ sraṣṭā puṣkarī prapitāmahaḥ \|*

*caturmukhaḥ sṛṣṭikartā svayaṃbhūḥ kamalāsanaḥ \|*

15-16. Besides, Brahma, Sambhu, Prabhu, Srasta, Puskari, Prapitamaha, Hiranyagarbha, Vedajna, Paramesthi, Prajapati, Caturmukha, Vedajna, Srstikarta, Svayumbhu, Kamalasana, Viranci and Padmayoni, should always bestow boons on me.

## \|\| 3.68.17-19 \|\|

*ādityo bhāskaro bhānuḥ sūryorkaḥ savitā raviḥ \|*  
*mārtaṃḍo maṃḍalajyetiragniraśmirjaneśvaraḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*prabhākaraḥ saptasaptistaraṇiḥ saraṇiḥ khagaḥ \|*

*padmaprabodhanaḥ pūṣā kiraṇī merubhūṣaṇaḥ \|*

17-19. Similarly, let Aditya, Bhaskara, Bhanu, Surya, Arka, Ravi, Martanda, Mandalajyoti, Agnirasmi, Janesvara, Prabhakara, Saptasapti, Tarani, Sarani, Khaga, Divakara, Dinakara, Sahasrarh.4u, Marlciman, Padmaprabodhana, Pusa, Kirani, Merubhusana, Nikumbha and Varnabha be pleased with me.

## \|\| 3.68.20-21 \|\|

*lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ saṃpadā padmā mā vibhūtirharipriyā \|*

*gāyatrī prakṛtiḥ sṛṣṭiḥ sāvitrī vedhaso matā \|*  
*rājñī bhānumatī saṃjñā nityabhā bhāskarapriyā \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21.Then, let Laksmi, Sri, Sampada, Padma, Мa, Vibhuti, Haripriya, Parvati, Lalita, Gauri, Uma, Sankaravallabha, Gayatri, Akrti, Srsti, Savitri, Brahmapriya, Rajni, Bhanumati, Samjna, Nityabha and Bhaskarapriya, besides other goddesses with their respective husbands, be pleased with me always.

## \|\| 3.68.22-25 \|\|

*iti padmanābhaśaṃkarapitāmahārkkādīnsapriyānpūjya \|*  
*dattvādattvā dānaṃ bhuktvā cāṃte vrajedveśma \|\| 22 \|\|*

*dvādaśyāṃ carati naro vratametadbhaktibhāvito loke \|*  
*bhavati yaśodhanabhāgī saṃtatimānvigatasaṃtāpaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*hariharahiraṇyagarbhaprabhākarāṇāṃ krameṇa lokeṣu \|*  
*bhuktvā bhogānvipulānatha yogī nirvṛto bhavati \|\| 24 \|\|*

*strīpuṃsoryadi yugmaṃ puruṣo vā yadi samācarati kaścit \|*  
*nārī vā vratametaccīrtvā yātyālayaṃ viṣṇoḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

22-25. In this way, Padmanabha (Visnu), Sankara, Pitamaha, besides Surya and other gods, should be worshipped individually. After serving food to the Brahmanas, the performer should himself take his food and then should return to his home. Thus, on the twelfth day of the moon, with one’s mind filled with devotion, this vrata should be performed and one who does so, he earns glory, wealth, fortunes and the progeny. He is freed from all the grief. Thereafter, enjoying all the pleasures in the abodes of Visnu, Siva, Brahma and Surya, he attains beatitude like a Mahayogi. When men or women worship the above gods with their wives in an appropriate manner, they all achieve the Visnuloka.

## Chapter 69. Govatsa Dvadasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.69.1-3 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*akṣauhiṇyo daśāṣṭau ca madrājyārthe kṣayaṃ gatāḥ \|*  
*tena pāpena me citte jugupsātīva vartate \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tatra brāhmaṇarājanyavaiśyaśūdrādayo hatāḥ \|*  
*bhīṣmadroṇakaliṃgādikarṇaśalyasuyodhanāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ vadhena yatpāpaṃ tanme marmāṇi kṛṃtati \|*  
*pāpaprakṣālanaṃ kañciddharmaṃ brūhi jagatpate \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Yudhisthira said- О lord of the universe, in order to enable me to achieve my kingship, eighteen Aksauhinyas of warriors had been killed. Because of that sin, I feel disturbed in my mind. In the battle, whether being a Brahmana, a Ksatriya or a Sudra, several warriors had been killed. Bhisma, Drona, Kama of Kalinga, 6alya and Suyodhana were killed and the sin of their killing is on my head and tearing out my sensitive spot, therefore, you kindly deliver some religious discourse, in order to get me relieved of those sins.

## \|\| 3.69.4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*sumahatpuṇyajananaṃ govatsadvādaśīvratam \|*  
*asti pārtha mahābāho pāṃḍavānāṃ dhuraṃdhara \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Sri Krsna said- О Partha, the greatest of the Pandavas, I am now speaking about the extremely auspicious vrata of the Govatsa-Dvadasi.

## \|\| 3.69.5-6 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*keyaṃ godvādaśī nāma vidhānaṃ tatra kīdṛśam \|*  
*kathameṣā samutpannā kasminkāle janārdana \|\| 5 \|\|*

*etatsarvaṃ hare brūhi pāhi māṃ narakārṇavāt \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Yudhisthira said- What is meant by Govatsa-Dvadasi? What is its method? How did it start? You kindly speak out to me in detail and save me from falling in the hell.

## \|\| 3.69.7-10 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*purā kṛtayuge pārtha munikoṭiḥ samāgatā \|*  
*tapaścacāra vipulaṃ nāmavratadharā girau \|\| 7 \|\|*

*harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭā daivadarśanakāṃkṣayā \|*  
*jaṃbūmārge mahāpuṇye nāmatīrthavibhūṣite \|\| 8 \|\|*

*pāriyātre siddhapātre ramye taṃdulikāśrame \|*  
*ṭaṃṭāviriti vikhyāte uttame śikhare nṛpa \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tāpasāraṇyamatulaṃ divyakānanamaṃḍitam \|*  
*vaśiṣṭhaśukrāṃgirasakratudakṣādibhirvṛtam \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. Sri Krsna said- In earlier times, a crore of ascetics, in order to have an audience with the lord, delightfully performing several vratas, started performing severe tapas over a mountain peak, which was known as Tanduli and was located on the way of the Jambudvipa. It was an excellent place and had many sacred places including the one known as Маhapuуа. The hermitage there was known as Tanduliksrama, which was located in the vicinity of Soma mountain and other siddha or auspicious places. О king, the forest was spread in a vast region and possessed excellent beauty. The Rsis known as- Vasistha, Sukra - son of Angiras, Kratu, Dak§a and others lived there, spreading on all the four sides.

## \|\| 3.69.11-15 \|\|

*valkalājinasaṃvīterbhṛgorāśramamaṃḍalam \|*  
*nānāmṛgagaṇairjuṣṭaṃ śākhāmṛgagaṇairyutam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*praśāṃtasiṃhahariṇaṃ sarvavastugatadrumam \|*  
*gahanaṃ nirṛtaṃ ramyaṃ latāsaṃtānasaṃkulam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*siṃhavyāghragajairbhinnaṃ hariṇaiḥ śabaraiḥ śaśaiḥ \|*  
*varāhairurubhiścitraiḥ samaṃtādupaśobhitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tapasyatā tatra teṣāṃ munīnāṃ darśanārthinām \|*  
*vyājaṃ cakre mahīnātha dvādaśārdhārdhalocanaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*babhūva brāhmaṇo vṛddho jarāpāṃḍuramūrddhajaḥ \|*  
*ślathaccarmatanuḥ kubjo yaṣṭipāṇiḥ savepathuḥ \|*  
*umāpi cakre gorūpaṃ śṛṇu tatpārtha yādṛśam \|\| 15 \|\|*

11-15. The hermitage of Bhrgu was also there, which was decorated with a mandala. All the wild animals of the forest lived there pleasantly. The monkeys could be seen quite often there. The lions and the deer appeared quite peaceful. All the things and all types of trees were found there. The asrama there was filled with thick forest trees, which were quite beautiful and several types of creepers climbed those tree. In the land of that hermitage, the lions, tigers, elephants, deer, hyena, rabbits, boars and several other types of deer, freely roamed about without any obstruction. Observing the ausepious ascetics in the hermitage, lord Siva who has three eyes, developed fifteen eyes (turning himself as a five-faced Sadasiva) and started living there, by changing his form. Taking to the form of an old Brahmana having extremely gray hair, the skin and the flesh becoming feeble weak, he appeared there. The flesh of the body was hanging down at place. He had a hunch at the back and he had been walking shakingly, olding a stick in his hands. O Partha, the goddess Uma on the other hand, took the form of a cow. The entire episode is going to be related by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.69.16-20 \|\|

*kṣīrodatoyasaṃbhūtā yāḥ purāmṛtamaṃthane \|*  
*pañca gāvaḥ śubhāḥ pārtha pañcalokasya mātaraḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*nandā subhadrā surabhī suśīlā bahulā iti \|*  
*etā lokopakārāya devānāṃ tarpaṇāya ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

*jamadagnibhāradvājavaśiṣṭhāsitagautamāḥ \|*  
*jagṛhuḥ kāmadāḥ pañca gāvo dattāḥ suraistataḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*gomayaṃ rocanā mūtraṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ gavām \|*  
*ṣaḍaṃgāni pavitrāṇi saṃśuddhikaraṇāni ca \|\| 19 \|\|*

*gomayādutthitaḥ śrīmānbilvavṛkṣaḥ śivapriyaḥ \|*  
*tatrāste padmahastā śrīḥ śrīvṛkṣastena sa smṛtaḥ \|*  
*bījānyutpalapadmānāṃ punarjātāni gomayāt \|\| 20 \|\|*

16-20. In earlier times, at the time of the churning of the ocean of milk, five auspicious cows emerged out of the same, who are known as the mothers of the universe. They were known by the names of- Nanda, Subhadra, Surabhi, Susila and Bahula. They came to be known in the world by the above names for causing good to the gods as well as the people. When these divines cows were respectfully given over by the gods to Jamadagni, Rsis like Bharadvaja, Vasistha, Asita and Gautama accepted them with grace and delight. The six padarthas of the cows, viz., cowdung, urine, milk, curd, ghi and yellow pigment are said to be extremely auspicious and have the purificatory effects. The wood apple trees, which grows from the cowdung, is believed to have great purificatory qualities and is therefore liked by Siva. The goddess Laksmi, who is seated over a lotus, is always lodged over the tree; therefore the wood apple tree is also known as Sri-vrksa. The blue lotus also emerged out of the cowdung.

## \|\| 3.69.21 \|\|

*gorocanā ca māṃgalyā pavitrā sarvasādhikā \|*  
*gomūtrādguggulurjātaḥ sugaṃdhiḥ priyadarśanaḥ \|*  
*āhāraḥ sarvadevānāṃ śivasya ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The Gorocana or the yellow pigment is extremely fragrant and auspicious and makes a person successful. Cow’s urine is quite fragrant and the guggulu emerged out of it, which is the food for all the gods, besides that of lord Siva.

## \|\| 3.69.22 \|\|

*yadbījaṃ jagataḥ kiñcittajjñeyaṃ kṣīrasaṃbhavam \|*  
*dadhuḥ sarvāṇi jātāni maṅgalānyarthasiddhaye \|*  
*ghṛtādamṛtamutpannaṃ devānāṃ tṛptikāraṇam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Whatsoever is the basic element of the world had emerged out of the cow’s milk. It has been described as an essential item for the performing of the welfare traditions. The nectar has said to have emerged out of the cow’s ghi, by offering which the gods are fully satisfied.

## \|\| 3.69.23-24 \|\|

*brāhmaṇāścaiva gāvaśca kulamekaṃ dvidhā kṛtam \|*  
*ekatra mantrāstiṣṭhaṃti haviranyatra tiṣṭhati \|\| 23 \|\|*

*goṣu yajñāḥ pravartaṃte goṣu devāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ \|*  
*goṣu vedāḥ samutkīrṇāḥ saṣa ḍaṃgapadakramāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Therefore, the ancestry of the Brahmana and the cows is the same, but has been divided into two parts. The mantras have been collected at one place and the havi at a different place. Elsewhere, the yajna of the cows as well as the related gods are well established. Besides the Vedas with their six parts etc. are included therein.

## \|\| 3.69.25-26 \|\|

*śṛṅgamūle gavāṃ nityaṃ brahmā viṣṇuśca saṃsthitau \|*  
*śṛṅgāgre sarvatīrthāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

*śivo madhye mahādevaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam \|*  
*salāṭe saṃsthitā gaurī nāsāvaṃśe ca ṣaṇmukhaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. At the end of the horns of the cows, lives Brahma and Visnu. At the foreparts of the horns are lodged all the sacred places, besides the mobiles as well as the immobiles. In the middle of the horns is lodged lord £iva, who is the cause of all the causes. The goddess Gauri is lodged over the forehead of the cow, in the nostrils is lodged the six-faced Karttikeya.

## \|\| 3.69.27-31 \|\|

*kaṃbalāśvatarau nāgau nāsāpuṭasamāśritau \|*  
*karṇayoraśvinau devau cakṣurbhyāṃ śaśibhāskarau \|\| 27 \|\|*

*daṃteṣu vasavaḥ sarve jihvāyāṃ varuṇaḥ sthitaḥ \|*  
*sarasvatī ca kuhare yamayakṣau ca gaṇḍayoḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*saṃdhyādvayaṃ tatheṣṭābhyāṃ grīvāyāṃ ca puraṃdaraḥ \|*  
*rakṣāṃsi kakude dyauśca pārṣṇikāye vyavasthitā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*catuṣpātsakalo dharmo nityaṃ jaṃghāsu tiṣṭhati \|*  
*khuramadhyeṣu gandharvāḥ khurāgreṣu ca pannagāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*khurāṇāṃ paścime bhāge rākṣasāḥ saṃpratiṣṭhitāḥ \|*  
*rudrā ekādaśa pṛṣṭhe varuṇaḥ sarvasandhiṣu \|\| 31 \|\|*

27-31. At the end of both the nostrils, the serpents Kambala and Asvatara are lodged. Asvinikumaras are lodged in the ears; the Moon and Sun are in the eyes; all the Vasus are in the teeth; Varuna is lodged in the tongue; Sarasvati in the ear-holes; Yak§as in the temples; Purandara in the neck; Raksoganas in hump; the sky and earth in the heels, besides Dharma with four feet resides in her hoofs. The Gandharvas are lodged in the middle of the hoofs; the serpents in the forepart, besides Raksasas are lodged at the back of the hoofs. The eleven Rudras are lodged at her back and Varuna finds place in all the joints.

## \|\| 3.69.32 \|\|

*śroṇītaṭasthāḥ pitaraḥ kapoleṣu ca mānavāḥ \|*  
*śrīrapāne gavāṃ nityaṃ svāhālaṃkāramāśritāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The Pitrs are lodged at Sroni, humans in the cheeks, Svaha at the Srt-sthana and lives there always.

## \|\| 3.69.33 \|\|

*ādityā raśmayo vālāḥ piṇḍībhūtā vyavasthitāḥ \|*  
*sākṣādgaṃgā ca gomūtre gomaye yamunā sthitā \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The rays of the rising Sun are spread in the entire body. Ganga is lodged in cow’s urine, while Yamuna is lodged in the cowdung.

## \|\| 3.69.34-35 \|\|

*trayastriṃśaddevakoṭyo romakūpe vyavasthitāḥ \|*  
*udare pṛthivī sarvā saśailavanakānanā \|\| 34 \|\|*

*catvāraḥ sāgarāḥ proktā gavāṃ ye tu payodharāḥ \|*  
*parjanyaḥ kṣīradhārāsu meghā biṃduvyavasthitāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. The thirty crores of the gods dwell in her hair-pits. All the mountains are lodged in her belly together with forest, the land and (he oceans. In the streams of her milk. Parjanya and other clouds reside.

## \|\| 3.69.36-39 \|\|

*jaṭhare gārhapatyo'gnirdakṣiṇāgnirhṛdisthitaḥ \|*  
*kaṇṭhe āhavanīyo'gniḥ sabhyo'gnistāluni sthitaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*asthivyavasthitāḥ śailā majjāsu kratavaḥ sthitāḥ \|*  
*ṛgvedo'tharvavedaśca sāmavedo yaju stathā \|\| 37 \|\|*

*suraktapītakṛṣṇādau gavāṃ varṇe vyavasthitāḥ \|*  
*tāsāṃ rūpamumā smṛtvā surabhīṇāṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 38 \|\|*

*saṃsmṛtya tatkṣaṇādgaurī iyeṣa sadṛśīṃ tanum \|*  
*ātmānaṃ vidadhe devī dharmarāja śṛṇuṣva tām \|\| 39 \|\|*

36-39. In her womb, the fire of Gorhapatya the southern fire in the heart; in the neck, there is the Ahavantya fire; the Samyagni in the palate; the mountains in the bones; and Kratu in marrow is lodged. When the cows are of red, yellow and of black colour, then the Rgveda, Yajurveda and Samaveda are believed to dwell in them. O Yudhisthira, recalling the forms of Surabhi, the goddess Gauri took to the form of a cow. O Dharmaraja, the way the goddess took to the form of a cow, I am going to reveal the same.

## \|\| 3.69.40-44 \|\|

*ṣaḍunnatāṃ pañcanimnāṃ maṃḍūkākṣīṃ suvāladhim \|*  
*tāmrastanīṃ raupyakaṭiṃ sukhurīṃ sumukhī sitām \|\| 40 \|\|*

*suśīlāṃ ca sutasnehāṃ sukṣīrāṃ supayodharām \|*  
*gorūpiṇīmumāṃ spṛṣṭvā svāminīṃ tāṃ savatsikām \|\| 41 \|\|*

*caryayā prataranhṛṣṭo mahādevaḥ svacetasi \|*  
*śanaiḥśanairyayau pārtha viprarūpī mahāśramam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*dattvā kulapateḥ pārśvaṃ bhṛgostāṃ gāṃ nyavedayat \|*  
*tapasvināṃ mahātejāstāṃ ca sarveṣu pāṃḍava \|\| 43 \|\|*

*nyāsarūpāṃ dadau dhenuṃ rakṣitvā tāṃ dinadvayam \|*  
*yāvatsnātvā itastīrtvā jaṃbūmārgaṃ viyāmyaham \|\| 44 \|\|*

40-44. The limbs of her body were quite developed, five of them were of low type. The eyes resembled (he frogs, the tail had beautiful hair. Her udder was of red colour like the copper, the waist was white, the hoofs were beautiful, and the face was quite charming. Observing the form of Uma as a cow with a calf, she was quite docile, having beautiful milk Observing her beautiful form, lord Siva followed her slowly Reaching the hermitage of Bhrgu, lord Siva who was in the form of an old Brahmana and standing besides Maharsi Bhrgu, spoke to all the ascetics present there O Pandava, he said- “This cow is being left by me as a trust with you. After having a bath in the path Jambu, I shall return in a couple of days. All of you may kindly take care of the cow till then.”

## \|\| 3.69.45-47 \|\|

*rakṣiṣyāmaḥ pratijñāte munibhiḥ surabhīmimām \|*  
*antarddhimagamaddevaḥ punarvyāghro babhūva ha \|\| 45 \|\|*

*vajracakranakho devīṃ jvalatpiṃgalalocanaḥ \|*  
*jihvā karālavadano jihvālāṃgūladāruṇaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*saṃprāyādāśramapadaṃ tāṃ ca dhenuṃ savatsikām \|*  
*trāsayāmāsa tāṃ deva munīnāṃ dikṣvavasthitaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

45-47. The Rsis said- “All of us shall surely protect this cow. When thus assured by the ascetics, Mahadeva disappeared from the place. After sometime, taking to the form of a tiger having sharp nails like vajra, he had a long and sharp tongue like a dagger, the eyes were burning like the coal, horrible and awful face, besides a terribly long tail. Appearing in an awful form, Lord Siva started frightening the sages, who started crying.

## \|\| 3.69.48-51 \|\|

*ṛṣayo'pi samākrāṃtā ārtanādaṃ pracakrire \|*  
*hāhetyuccaiḥ kecidūcurhuṃhuṃkāraistathāpare \|\| 48 \|\|*

*tālāsphoṭāndaduḥ kecidvyāghraṃ dṛṣṭvātibhairavam \|*  
*sāpi haṃbhāravāṃścakre gaurutplutya savatsikā \|\| 49 \|\|*

*tasyā vyāghrabhayārtāyāḥ kapilāyā yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*palāyaṃtyā śilāmadhye kṣaṇaṃ khuracatuṣṭayam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*vyāghravatsakayostatra vaṃditaṃ surakinnaraiḥ \|*  
*dṛśyate'tīva suvyaktaṃ tadadyāpi catuṣṭayam \|\| 51 \|\|*

48-51. Someone was crying aloud in a pathetic way. Someone on sighing the tiger was clapping his hands. The cow together with calf started bellowing in a pathetic way. She tried to flee from the place. Frightened from the tiger, when the cow fled from that place, the signs of the hoofs of the cow and the calf could be visible on all the sides. Those hoofs which were worshipped even by the kinnaras, are still clearly visible even today.

## \|\| 3.69.52-53 \|\|

*sajalaṃ śivaliṃgaṃ ca śambhostīrthaṃ taduttamam \|*  
*yassaṃspṛśati rājendra sa govadhyāṃ vyapohati \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tatra snātvā mahātīrthe jaṃbūmārge narādhipa \|*  
*brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. The Sivalinga of lord Siva is still known as a sacred holy place, by touching which a person is absolved of the sin of Gohatya in no time. O lord of the humans, by taking a bath at the Jambu tirtha, a person is surely relieved of the sin of Brahmahatya. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.69.54 \|\|

*tataste munayaḥ kruddhā brahmadattāṃ mahāsvanām \|*  
*jaghnurghaṃṭāṃ surairdattāṃ girikandarapūraṇīm \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Thereafter, all the ascetics, getting enraged, struck the bell which produced the terrific sound that had been bestowed by the gods. With the spreading of the terrific sound, it started echoing from the mountain caves.

## \|\| 3.69.55 \|\|

*śabdena tena vyāghro'pi muktvā gāvaṃ sava tsikām \|*  
*vipraistatra kṛtaṃ nāma ḍhuṇḍhāgiririti śrutiḥ \|*  
*taṃ prapaśyaṃti ye pārtha te rudrā nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. As a result of this, the tiger left both the cow and the calf. The Brahmanas then gave that place the name of Dhundhagiri. One who has a look at the same, he surely becomes the form of Rudra. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.69.56-60 \|\|

*atha pratyakṣatāṃ śreṣṭhasteṣāṃ devo maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*śūlapāṇistripurahā kāmaghno vṛṣabhe sthitaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*umāsahāyo varadaḥ sasvāmī savināyakaḥ \|*  
*sanaṃdiḥ samahākālaḥ saśṛṅgī samano haraḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*vīrabhadrā ca cāmuṃḍā ghaṃṭākarṇādibhirvṛtā \|*  
*mātṛbhirbhūtasaṃghātairyakṣarākṣasaguhyakaiḥ \|*  
*devadānavagandharvamunividyādharoragaiḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*praṇamya devadevāya patnībhiḥ sahitairumā \|*  
*gorūpiṇī savatsā ca pūjitā brahmacāribhiḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*kārtike śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśyāṃ naṃdinīvratam \|*  
*tataḥ prabhṛti rājendra avatīrṇaṃ mahītale \|\| 60 \|\|*

56-60. Lord Siva then appeared before the Rsis, in an extremely pleasant form. Siva - the killer of Tripura and the destroyer of the god of love, holding a trident in his hand, together with Uma, was mounted over the bull Nandi. Kartika, Vinayaka, Nandi, Mahakala, Bhrngi, Virabhadra, Camunda, Ghantakarna and others, accompanied him. All the Matrkas, the goblins, Yaksas, Raksasas, Devas, Danavas, Sages, Vidyadharas, Nagas, besides the Brahmacarins offered their salutation to Siva, the god of gods, and worshipped the goddess Uma in the form of a cow with calf in the month of Karttika on the bright dvadasi (twelfth moon day). O Rajendra, at the same time, this vrata was patronized by the people.

## \|\| 3.69.61-67 \|\|

*uttānapādena tathā vrataṃ cīrṇamidaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*uttānapādanāmāsītkṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīpate \|\| 61 \|\|*

*tasya bhāryā dvayaṃ cāsīdruciśughnīti viśrutam \|*  
*śughnījāto dhruvaḥ putro vāmapādadharo'lasaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*rucyāḥ samarpitaḥ śughnyā dhruvo'yaṃ rakṣyatāṃ sakhi \|*  
*ahaṃ kariṣye śuśrūṣāṃ bhartustāvatsadā svayam \|\| 63 \|\|*

*rucī rasavatīṃ nityaṃ pratyahaṃ kurute gṛhe \|*  
*akarodbhartṛśuśrūṣāṃ śughnī nityaṃ pativratā \|\| 64 \|\|*

*kadācitkrodhamātsaryātsāpatnyaṃ darśitaṃ tayā \|*  
*svayaṃ rucyā nihatyāsau śiśuḥ khaṃḍalaśaḥ kṛtaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*tāpikāyāṃ tathā sthālyāṃ pakvasiddhaḥ susaṃ skṛtaḥ \|*  
*annabhojanavelāyāṃ dadāti nṛpabhājane \|\| 66 \|\|*

*taṃ vai bhakṣayituṃ duṣṭā sāmiṣaṃ bhojanaṃ kila \|*  
*atha bhojanavelāyāṃ vavre jīvitamāptavān \|\| 67 \|\|*

61-67. О king, this vrata had also been performed by the king Uttanapada in a proper manner. I am going to speak about the same to you. You please listen. О lord of the earth, there had been (in the ancient times) a Ksatriya king known as Uttanapada, who had two wives named Ruci and SughnI. Dhruva -the son of Sughni was quite a beautiful child since birth. Sughni gave over the child to the co-wife and said- “O handmaid, you better look after the child Dhruva. I infact, intend to serve my husband, therefore, I have no time to bring up this child. SughnI always made food for husband daily and served him pretty well. Once, because of the jealousy of the cowife, Ruci cut off Dhruva - the son of SughnI, into pieces and keeping it in a vase of food, placed it over the burning fire. At the time of meals, the vase containing the flesh of the child was also placed before the king. But at the time of taking food, the child became alive and was seen smiling in the lap of his mother.

## \|\| 3.69.68-72 \|\|

*tathaiva prahasanbālo māturutsaṃgajo'bhavat \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ rucī papraccha vismitā \|\| 68 \|\|*

*kimetadbrūhi vṛttāṃtaṃ kasyeyaṃ vyuṣṭiruttamā \|*  
*kiṃ tvayācaritaṃ kiñcidvrataṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ tathā \|\| 69 \|\|*

*satyaṃsatyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ yena jīvati te sutaḥ \|*  
*mamāyaṃ sapta vārāṃstu viśalyaśakalī kṛtaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*pakvaḥ svayaṃ kṛtaḥ sthālyāṃ vyañjanaiḥ saha bhojanaiḥ \|*  
*pariviṣyamāṇaḥ sa punaḥ kathaṃ jīvitamāptavān \|\| 71 \|\|*

*kiṃ te siddhā mahāvidyā mṛtasañjīvanī śubhā \|*  
*ratnaṃ maṇirmahāratnaṃ yogāñjanamahauṣadham \|\| 72 \|\|*

68-72. Ruci was extremely surprised at the sight and she asked Sughni- “You tell me the story of which noble deed, this happens to be the reward? Which is the type of vrata, which had been performed by you, or what type of chanties have been given by you, besides performing of homa, which is true and is the total truth. I myself had cut this boy’s body into pieces and then cooked the same. I had also mixed the flesh in other vegetables as well. Still how could be regain his life? Are you aware of the Siddha and Sanjivani lore or do you'have a gem or a mani or the collyrium With yogic powers, or some other great medicine?”

## \|\| 3.69.73-74 \|\|

*kathayasva mahābhāge satyaṃsatyaṃ bhaginyasi \|*  
*evamukte rucistasyai vyācakhyau vatsagovratam \|\| 73 \|\|*

*kārttike caiva dvādaśyāṃ yathā cānuṣṭhitaṃ purā \|*  
*vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa punarjīvati me sutaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. You tell me the truth about it, because, you happen to be my sister. When Ruci so spoke, SughnI spoke to her about the Govatsa vrata saying- “In earlier times, on the bright dvadasi of the month of Karttika, I had performed this vrata in an appropriate manner, by the grace of which my son could regain his life.

## \|\| 3.69.75-76 \|\|

*vatso me vatsavelāyāṃ mṛto'rthaṃ labhate punaḥ \|*  
*samāgamaśca bhavati vrataiḥ pravasitairapi \|\| 75 \|\|*

*yathārthametadvyākhyātaṃ te ca godvādaśīvratam \|*  
*tavāpi ruci tatsarvaṃ bhaviṣyati śubhaṃ priyam \|\| 76 \|\|*

75-76. This is the vatsa-vela time for. me, received nectar during the morning and evening time. Even if I am in foreign land, then also I can meet the same. Thus, I have spoken about the glory of Godvadasi. Therefore, О Rudra goddess, your desire shall also be fulfilled by observing the same vrata."

## \|\| 3.69.77 \|\|

*evamuktaṃ vrataṃ cīrṇaṃ rucyā putrāḥ sukhaṃ dhanam \|*  
*saṃprāptā jīvitāṃte ca dhruvasthāne niveśitāḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. Thus listening to the words of Sughni, Ruci also performed the same vrata and enjoying all the pleasures on earth, she finally gained excellent place in the abode of Dhruva.

## \|\| 3.69.78 \|\|

*brahmaṇā sṛṣṭikāreṇa rucirbhartrā sahāsitā \|*  
*daśanakṣatrasaṃyukto dhruvaḥ sodyāpi dṛśyate \|*  
*dhuvarkṣe ca yadā dṛṣṭe lokaḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 78 \|\|*

78\. Hereafter, Ruci always was gracefully with her husband. Dhruva is still visible together with the ten constellations in the sky. By viewing Dhruva on the day of his constellation, all the sins of a person are washed out.

## \|\| 3.69.79 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kīdṛśaṃ tadvidhānaṃ ca tanme brūhi janārdana \|*  
*yatkṛtaṃ śughnivacanādrucyā yadukulodbhava \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Yudhisthira said- О Janardana - bom in the race of Yadus, you please tell me the method of performing this vrata, by which Ruci had performed at the advice of Sughni.

## \|\| 3.69.80-83 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*saṃprāpte kārtike māsi śuklapakṣe kurūttama \|*  
*dvādaśyāṃ snātvā puṇye jalāśaye \|*  
*naro vā yadi vā nārī ekabhaktaṃ prakalpayet \|\| 80 \|\|*

*tato madhyāhnasamaye dṛṣṭvā dhenuṃ savatsikām \|*  
*suśīlāṃ vatsalāṃ śvetāṃ kapilāṃ raktarūpiṇīm \|\| 81 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ strījaneśvara \|*  
*yathākrameṇa pūjyaināṃ gaṃdhapuppajalākṣataiḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

*kuṃkumālaktakairdīpairmāṣānnavaṭakaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*kusumairvatsakaṃ cāpi maṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava \|\| 83 \|\|*

80-83. Sri Krsna said- On the bright twelfth moon day of the month of Kartika, one should take bath in an auspicious lake. The man or the woman should be alone at the time of performing the samkalpa for the vrata. Thereafter, at the time of noon, one should see a cow and a calf, who should be quite docile. Accordingly, the K§atriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras should worship white, reddish, brown or tawny coloured cow respectively. The cow should be worshipped offering the scent, water, unbroken rice, vermilion, red colour, as well as lamp and the powder of the black gram. Both the cow with the calf should be worshipped.

## \|\| 3.69.84-88 \|\|

*oṃ mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasādityānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ \|*  
*pranuvocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa namo namaḥ svāhā \|\| 84 \|\|*

*itthaṃ saṃpūjya gāṃ pṛṣṭvā paścāttāṃ ca kṣamāpayet \|*  
*oṃ sarvadevamaye devi lokānāṃ śubhanaṃdini \|*  
*mātarmamābhilaṣitaṃ saphalaṃ kuru naṃdini \|\| 85 \|\|*

*evamabhyarcayedekāṃ gāmetaddhi gavāhnikam \|*  
*paryukṣya vāriṇā bhaktyā praṇamya surabhīṃ tataḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*taddine tāpikāpakvaṃ sthālīpākaṃ ca varjayet \|*  
*bhūmau svayaṃ brahmacārī śayīta phalamāpnuyāt \|\| 87 \|\|*

*yāvaṃti gātre romāṇi gavāṃ kauravanaṃdana \|*  
*tāvatkālaṃ sa vasati goloke nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

84-88. Reciting the mantras like- “От Мata Rudranam Duhita Vasunam Svasaditya-namamrtasya nabhih" and others, the worship of the cow and calf should be performed. Thereafter, the prayer should be offered to her saying- “O cow, you represent all the gods and you bestow welfare on all the human beings and daughter of Kurus, you kindly fulfill my desire.” Thus worshipping, begging forgiveness from her, all the things should be soaked in water. Thereafter, the cow Surabhi should be offered the salutation with devotion. On that particular day, the fried food has to be discarded and one should sleep on the ground. The merit one earns, by performing such worship, is going to be revealed by me. You please listen with apt attention. О son of Kauravas, the number of hair that are there over the body of the cow, the performer lives in the Golaka for an equivalent number of years. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.69.89-90 \|\|

*meroḥ puryaṣṭakaṃ ramyamiṃdrāgniyamarakṣasām \|*  
*varuṇānilayakṣāṇāṃ rudrasya ca yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*tāsāmupari golokastatra yāti sa govratī \|\| 89 \|\|*

*ūrje site dvidaśame'hani gāṃ savatsāṃ yāḥ pūjayaṃti kusumairvaṭakaiśca hṛdyaiḥ \|*  
*tāḥ sarvakāmasukhabhogavibhūtibhājo martye vasaṃti suciraṃ bahujīvavatsāḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

89-90. Indra who dwells over the Meru mountain, besides the cities of Agni, Yama, Raksasas, Yama, Vayu, Yaksas and Rudras, are the eight cities there. But Goloka is lodged above all of them. О Yudhisthira, in this way, on the bright twelfth moon day of the month of Kartika, one who adores the cow with a calf, he departs to Goloka, after enjoying all the comforts on earth for long, with his family.

## Chapter 70. Discussion between Sri Krsna and Yudhisthira

## \|\| 3.70.1 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu pārtha pravakṣyāmi govindaśayanaṃ vratam \|*  
*kaṭadānaṃ samutthānaṃ cāturmāsyavratakramam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sri Krsna said- I am going to reveal before you the method of performing Govindasayana vrata in which the sequence of Kata-dana, Bhagavankara-Utthana and the method of performing the vrata for four months, is being discussed. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.70.2-3 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kiṃ devaśayanaṃ nāma devassvapiti cāpyasau \|*  
*devaḥ kimarthaṃ svapiti kiṃ vidhānaṃ sadā vada \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ke maṃtrāḥ ke ca niyamā vratānyatha kriyā ca kā \|*  
*kiṃ grāhyaṃ kiṃ ca bhoktavyaṃ supte deve janārdane \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Yudhisthira said- О Deva, what is meani by Sayana, does the lord also sleep? What for is his sleep? Therefore, you speak out the method for so doing, besides the mantras, regulations, vrata and the performance. After lord Janardana goes to sleep, what types of the eatables are to be used and what are to be discarded? You tell me the whole of it.

## \|\| 3.70.4-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*mithunasthe sahasrāṃśau sthāpayenmadhusūdanam \|*  
*tulārāśigate tasminpunarutthāpayedvratam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*adhimāse ca patite eṣa eva vidhikramaḥ \|*  
*nānyathā sthāpayeddevaṃ na caivotthāpayeddharim \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Sri Krsna said- When the sun is in the gemini - the third sign of zodiac, lord Madhusudana should be consecrated and on the first day of the month in libra zodiac, the awakening has to be done. At that point of time, in case there is an intercalary month, the same process has been prescribed. But the process of his going to sleep is a bit changed.

## \|\| 3.70.6-9 \|\|

*āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*sthāpayedbhaktimānviṣṇuṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pītāṃbaradharaṃ saumyaṃ paryaṃke svāstṛte śubhe \|*  
*śuklavastrasamācchanne sopadhāne yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 7 \|\|*

*itihāsapurāṇajño viṣṇubhaktopi yaḥ pumān \|*  
*snāpayitvā dadhikṣīraghṛtakṣaudrajalaistathā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*samālabhya śubhairgaṃdhairdhūpairva strairalaṃkṛtam \|*  
*pūjayitvā kuṃkumādyairmaṃtreṇānena pāṇḍava \|\| 9 \|\|*

6-9. The process of awakening should not be resorted to on the bright eleventh moon day of the month of Asadha. Observing the fast, the white garments and the bed should be arranged with white pillows and the image of Visnu holding conch, cakra, gada and the lotus, with the wearing of the pitambara, should be placed on the bed for sleeping. The person, who is well-versed in history and the Puranas, should offer curd, milk and honey. Thereafter, the image should be washed with water. The scent should be applied over the body of the image and then after decorating with incense, costumes and ornaments, the vermilion should also be offered. O Pandava, the worship of the image should be completed reciting the mantra.

## \|\| 3.70.10-12 \|\|

*supte tvayi jagannātha jagatsuptaṃ bhavedidam \|*  
*vibuddhe tvayi budhyeta jagatsarvaṃ carācaram \|\| 10 \|\|*

*evaṃ tāṃ pratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ sthāpayitvā yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*tasyaivāgre svayaṃ vācaṃ gṛhṇīyānniyamāṃstataḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*caturo vārṣikānmāsāndevasyotthāpanāvadhi \|*  
*strī vā naro vā madbhakto dharmārthaṃ sudṛḍhavrataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. Then he should pray to the lord saying-“O Jagannatha, when you sleep, the entire world sleeps with you and when you rise up again, the entire world is awakened." Thus offering the prayer, the image of Visnu should be placed over the bed. In the presence of the image of Visnu, the devotee, irrespective of being man or woman, should take a vow to perform the vrata for four months. O Yudhisthira, till the period of rising up of lord Visnu, the rules which are to be observed for four months, should be strictly followed by the devotee, besides those who are devoted to me. and for the sake of dharma, the devotee should undertake a solid vow.

## \|\| 3.70.13 \|\|

*gṛhṇīyānniyamānetāndaṃtadhāvanapūrvakam \|*  
*teṣāṃ phalāni vakṣyāmi tatkartṝṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Then cleaning the teeth daily, the devotee should start following all the rules. I am going to relate the merits of the activities separately. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.70.14-15 \|\|

*madhurasvaro bhavedrājā puruṣo guḍavarjanāt \|*  
*tailasya varjanātpārtha sundarāṃgaḥ prajāyate \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kaṭutailaparityāgācchatrukṣayamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*madhūkatailatyāgena saubhāgyamatulaṃ bhavet \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. At the time of accepting the vow, in case the raw sugar is discarded, the devotee becomes a king having a sweet tongue. 0 Partha, with the discarding of the oil, the devotee achieves a beautiful body; with the discarding of the sour oil, the enemies are defeated; and with the discarding of Madhuka (Basia latifolia), one gets enormous fortunes and grace.

## \|\| 3.70.16-17 \|\|

*puṣpādibhogatyāgena svarge vidyādharo bhavet \|*  
*yogābhyāsī bhavedyastu sa brahmapadamāpnuyāt \|\| 16 \|\|*

*kaṭukāmlatiktamadhurakṣārakāṣāyameva ca \|*  
*yo varjayetsa vairūpyaṃ daurgatyaṃ nāpnuyātkvacit \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Similarly, by discarding the flowers and other pleasures, the Vidyadharas serve him in the heaven; with the performing of the yogic practices, one achieves the Brahmapada. By discarding of pungent, sweat, saltish and alkaline things, the body never gets deformed and one never has to face misfortunes.

## \|\| 3.70.18-23 \|\|

*tāṃbūlavarjanādbhogī raktakaṇṭhaśca jāyate \|*  
*ghṛtatyāgātsulāvaṇyaṃ sarvasiddhiḥ punarbhavet \|\| 18 \|\|*

*phalatyāgācca matimānbahuputraśca jāyate \|*  
*śākapatrāśanādrogī apakvādo'malo bhavet \|\| 19 \|\|*

*pādābhyaṃgaparityāgācchirobhyaṃgācca pārthiva \|*  
*dīptimān dīptakaraṇo yakṣo dravyapatirbhavet \|\| 20 \|\|*

*dadhidugdha takraniyamādgolokaṃ labhate naraḥ \|*  
*indrātithitvamāpnoti sthālīpākavivarjitāt \|\| 21 \|\|*

*labheta saṃtatiṃ dīrghāṃ tāpapakvasya bhakṣaṇāt \|*  
*bhūmāvastaraśāyī ca viṣṇoranucaro bhavet \|\| 22 \|\|*

*nirvyādhirnīrujaujasvī surāmadyavivarjanāt \|\| 23 \|\|*

18-23. By discarding the betel, the ailment of the neck is removed. By discarding ghi, one attains beauty and ail success. By discarding the fruit, the devotee gets several sons. By taking vegetarian food, the ailment is removed. By taking half cooked food, the devotee’s mind is purified. By discarding the smearing of the oil over the body, one becomes illustrious and the lord of riches. О Parthiva, one who discards curd, milk, buttermilk, he earns to stay in Goloka, and disowning the cooked good makes one becoming a guest like Indra. In case one takes food cooked by steam, he achieves uninterrupted progeny; by sleeping on the ground, one sleeps like Visnu; by discarding honey and meat, one always becomes a sage or a yog?; by discarding the wine, one is relieved of all the ailments.

One who always eats sitting on earth, becomes the king, but one could achieve the high position only by reciting the mantra- “От Namo-Nфrayandya”.

One who adores the lord offering the flower garlands to him, he also achieves Visnuloka.

32-35. One who takes his bath daily also earns the merit. By making observation or looking at Visnu daily, one earns the kingdom through the Apsaras. By taking food from an unknown person, one has to return and with the construction of a well, one earns the fruit. By taking food in the sixth period, one achieves permanent stay in the heaven. By taking food in a tree leaf, one earns the merit of visiting Kuruksetra and when a person takes food over a stone slab, he earns permanent stay in the heaven or a bath at the holy place of Prayaga. By discarding water in the second prahara, one never suffers from ailments.

36-38. О Partha, by performing this vrata appropriately, I feel immensely pleased, О Bharata, after going to sleep of Garud&dhvaja, Kesava and Jagannatha, all the activities of all the four varies like marriages, vratas, bhuta- samskaras, diksa (initiation), yajnas, entry into the houses, which can be performed with the association of the yogas, besides all the auspicious deeds are prohibited.

39-40. Similarly, in a month without a Samkranti or adhikamasa, all the activities relating to the gods and the pitrs should be postponed. On the bright eleventh moon day of the month of Bhadrapada, to donate hair to Vi§nu stands for a great puja.

41-49. О Partha,now I am speaking out the cause of Visnu’s going to sleep at this particular time. You please listen. The goddess Yoganidra in earlier times, pleased lord Visnu with the performing of her tapas and had prayed to him to stay in her limbs. Observing this at that time, the god, at the instance of Lak$mt, cordoned off my place. On the other hand, Garuda obstructed the conch, the disc as well as the club, besides the arms. The navel and the chest were also obstructed by Garuda. Similarly the crown, the earrings and the head besides the ears were obstructed. Still I getting satisfied, lodged Yogamaya in my eyes gracefully and said- “During the four months of this year, this shall be my position.” On hearing my words, Yoganidra, since that time, is lodged in my eyes. During that period, sleeping over the serpent Se$a, I too extend grace to the yogis and ascetics. After going to bed over the serpent Se§a in the ocean of milk, LaksmI always serves me with her lotus like bands. Therefore, О Pandava, performing vrtas and observing the regulations, I spent that time. My devotees with the firm resolve, stay in Visnuloka for a kalpa. There is no doubt about it.”

50\. Subsequently, on the day of bright Ekadasi in the month of Kartika, lord Visnu - the holder of conch, discus and mace, when rises from the sleep, the relevant procedure is being narrated by me. You please listen.

51-52. O Rajendra, reciting the mantra- “Idam Visnurvicakrame” etc., he has to be awakened, because О king, to make him rise up from the sleep, all the religious activities have to be started. The king at that point of time, placing him over a decorated chariot, accompanied with several musical instruments, creating huge sound, should be taken round (the city).

## \|\| 3.70.53-57 \|\|

*homayeddhavyavāhaṃ ca havyadravyairghṛtādibhiḥ \|*
