53-57. The people should provide light, singing and dancing on the way, and there should be huge crowd. At that point of time, lord Visnu getting awaken, inspects certain things on earth, being Damodara, they are considered graceful even in the heaven. At night, during the Ekadasi when lord Visnu wakes up at night, on the morning of Dvadasi, one should lovingly worship him. The material for performing homa like sesamum seeds, rice, barley mixed with ghi should be collected and the offerings should be made in the burning flames of fire. Thereafter, the Br&hmana should be served food with many dishes, which should include ghi, curd, honey, raw sugar and the sweet balls. The performer, discarding the jokes, should devote himself in the service of the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.70.58-66 \|\|

*ekādaśa daśāṣṭau vā paṃca dvau vā kurūttama \|*

*avasāne tu rājendra vāsudevapurīṃ vrajet \|*

*sa bhavetkṛtakṛtyastu na punarmātṛko bhavet \|*  
*yo devaśayanaṃ pārtha māsaṃmāsaṃ samācareta \|\| 64 \|\|*

*utthānaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇasya sa harerlokamāpnuyāt \|*

*dugdhābdhibhogaśayane bhagavānananto yasmindine svapiti yatra vibudhyate vā \|*

58-66. О best of the race of Kurus, before serving the meals, eleven, ten, eight, five or two Brahmanas should be worshipped. With faith and devotion, the fortunate performer should also serve food to the five yatis as well. Thereafter, whatever is possible or the desired things like fruits, flowers, etc. should be given after performing a samkalpa. Thus during the four months, whatever is resolved initially, the same should be given over to the Brahmanas with daksina and then gracefully send them off. Subsequently, the performer should himself take his food. By offering other things, one during the four months, other things should also be given in charity. Thus a person, who performs this vrata in an appropriate manner, he achieves the enormous dharma. After his demise, he achieves Indraloka. A person, whose Caturmasa's vrata is successfully completed without any obstruction, he becoming successful, does not have to re-enter the womb of the mother. О Partha, the vrata of Visnu, relating to his sleep and awakening, when observed every year during the four months, then the performer surely achieves Visnuloka. О Partha, a person, who listens and reads or recites to others, about the vrata, besides giving charities for the same purpose, he achieves the highest devotion of Visnu. In this way, lord Visnu sleeps in the ocean of milk and then wakes up, but a person who performs the related vratas on the day of his sleep and awakening, he is bestowed the best of position by lord Visnu.

## Chapter 71. Nirajana Dvadasi Vrata

1-8. Sri Krsna said- In earlier times, a Rajar§I known by the name of Ajapala, used to rule his country. The people of his country prayed to him for the removal of their miseries, saying-“We are suffering from many ailments, you kindly do something to get us relieved from this ailments.” At the request of the people, the king Ajapala meditated for a long time and then freed fte people from all the ailments. He also looked after to their wellbeing as well. The peace efforts of the king Ajapala proved excellent and beneficial for the people and came to be known as NMjana. Its symptoms are being spoken by me. You please listen. Accompanied with the priests, the king should perform the anusthdna. By about the same time, Ravana - the lord of Lanka, while living there, had entrusted different jobs to different gods in his kingdom. The Moon held his umbrella, Indra became the commander of the army, the Wind god was to broom the palaces, Varuna was to attend the old people, Kubera looked after the treasure, Yama controlled the enemies, Manu acted as a minister, while the plastering of the trees in lines, was looked after by the AjapMa. The Rajar$is were engaged in the reciting of the welfare mantras under the leadership ofBrahma.

## \|\| 3.71.9-11 \|\|

*yāmikā madhyakakṣāyāṃ gandharvā gītatatparāḥ \|*  
*prekṣaṇīye'psarovṛṃdaṃ bāhye vidyādharā vṛtāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ pāne gārhapatye hutāśanaḥ \|*

9-11. In the central place of the southern region, the Gandharvas were singing. The places which required to be observed were occupied by the Apsaras; the Vidydaharas were deputed in the outer region. The Ganga and other rivers were entrusted with the responsibility of the supply of water; Agni looked after the household, while the greenary as well as the store house was looked after by Vidvarkarma. Yama attended to the work of artisans. The servants were serving gods getting adorned them with ornaments.

## \|\| 3.71.12-14 \|\|

*saṃdṛśya rāvaṇaḥ prāha praśastaṃ pratihārakam \|*

*sa uvāca praṇamyāgre daṃḍapāṇirniśācaraḥ \|*

12-14. At that point of time, Ravana said to Prasasta - his messenger- “Who is present here to serve me? You tell me at once. The Raksasa holding a staff in his hand, said-“Here are Kukutstha, Mandhata, Dhundhumara, Nala, Atjuna, Yayati, Nahusa, Bhima and Viduratha - the ruler of Raghuvamsa. Besides, many other rulers are also present here.

## \|\| 3.71.15-17 \|\|

*meghākārāstava sthāne nājapāla ihāgataḥ \|*

*ityukte prahito dūto dhūmrākṣo nāma rākṣasaḥ \|*

15-17. The king Ajapala is also serving as a ram.” On hearing this, the king Ravana, getting extremely enraged, at once sent a messenger to the king Ajapala. He said to the messenger named Dhumraksa “O Dhumraksa, at my command, you go to the king Ajapala. Since Kabandha is his ruler, therefore, he should come and serve me, otherwise, using the sword Candrahasa, I shall cut off your head.

## \|\| 3.71.18-26 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭamanāḥ prāha dhūmrākṣo rāvaṇoditam \|*

*niyuktastvajapālena jvaro rājañjagāma ha \|\| 24 \|\|*

*provāca tiṣṭhatu nṛpastena me na prayojanam \|*

18-26. At these words of Ravana, Dhumraksa reached the beautiful city with the speed of Garuda and found the king Ajapala in his court, who had been surrounded by the female goats. His hair and armpits had been dishevelled. Placing a clock over his shoulder, who was suffering from some disease with his family, he considered his enemy king to be unarmed. O destroyer of the disturbances and the enemies, he used to write down the names of the enemies and then killed them. This was the duty of Ajapala. Getting free from the bath and meditation like a sage, he delightfully occupied the throne, observing the dance and music. Observing everything there, Dhumraksa conveyed the message of Ravana to him. The king Ajapala proudly replied to Dhumraksa and sent him back. Thereafter, the king Ajapala started action against Ravana. The king called for the Jvara- “You reach Lanka and contacting Ravana, deal with him suitably.” O king, when the Jvara was so deputed by Ajapala, Jvara reached there and made Ravana to shake with all his relatives. Finding the fever to be quite terrific, Ravana said to his messenger- “Leave Ajapala, because I need him no more.” Thereafter, Ravana was freed from the fever.

## \|\| 3.71.27-36 \|\|

*tenaiṣā nirmitā śāṃtirajapālena dhīmatā \|*  
*sarvarogapraśamanī sarvopadravanāśinī \|\| 27 \|\|*

*kārtike śuklapakṣasya dvādaśyāṃ rajanīmukhe \|*  
*samutthite vinidre tu deve dāmodare tadā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*vedyaṃte ratnamālābhī ramye mālānuraṃjite \|*  
*janayitvā navaṃ viṣṇuṃ hutvā maṃtrairdvijottamaiḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*varddhamānatarūtthābhirdīpikābhirhutāśanam \|*  
*kṛtvā mahājanaḥ sarvairhariṃ nīrājayecchanaiḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*puṣpairabhyarcitaṃ devaṃ samālabdhaṃ ca candanaiḥ \|*  
*badaraiḥ karburaiścaiva trapusairikṣubhistathā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*gandhaiḥ puṣpairaṃlakārairvastrai ratnaiśca pūjitaiḥ \|*  
*tasyaivānumatā lakṣmīṃ brahmāṇaṃ caṃḍikāṃ tathā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*ādityaṃ śaṃkaraṃ gaurīṃ yakṣaṃ gaṇapatiṃ grahān \|*  
*mātaraṃ pitaraṃ nāgānsarvānnīrājayettataḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*gavāṃ nīrājanaṃ kuryānmahiṣyādeśca maṃḍalam \|*  
*bhrāmayettrāsayecchardighaṃṭāvādanachādanaiḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*tā gāvaḥ prasutā yāṃti svāpīḍāstabakāṃgadāḥ \|*  
*sindūrakṛtaśṛṃgāgrāḥ saṃbhāravaśavatsakāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*anuyāṃti sagopālāḥ kālayaṃto dhanāni te \|*  
*chedānuliptaraktāṅgā raktapītasitāṃbarāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

27-36. The same intelligent Ajapala had produced the Santi, which is the remover of all the ill and the disturbances. On the bright twelfth moon day of the month of Kartika, in the evening time, at the awakening of the lord Damodara. a mandapa decorated with flower garlands as well as the garlands of gems, should be made for celebrating the day of birth of lord Visnu. For that purpose, the Brahmanas should illumine the place with the recitation of sacred mantras. Thereafter, the arati of the lord should be performed. At that point of time, the flowers, sandal paste, jujube, tinfoil, sugarcane, scent, flowers, costumes, ornaments and gems should be offered during the time of worship. The images of Brahma, Candika, Sun, Siva, Gauri, Yaksa, Ganapati, planets, the parents and others should be adored. Thereafter, their arati should be performed together with the cows. Thereafter, a mandala of Mahisi (or queen) should be made. The sound should be created with the striking of the bells, which should be made to roam about in the city and by so doing, they look quite graceful. When the tips of the horns are decorated with the peacock feathers and painted with vermilion, and their bodies covered with clothes, they yield more milk. The cowherds should also follow them getting fully decorated.

## \|\| 3.71.37-39 \|\|

*evaṃ kolāhale vṛtte gavāṃ nīrājanotsave \|*  
*turagāṃllakṣaṇairyuktāndviradāṃśca supūjitān \|\| 37 \|\|*

*rājacihnāni sarvāṇi uddhṛtya svagṛhāṃgaṇe \|*  
*rājā purohitaiḥ sārddhaṃ maṃtribhṛtyapuraḥsaraḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*siṃhāsanopaviṣṭaśca śaṃkhatūryādinisvanaiḥ \|*  
*pūjayedgandhakusumairvastradīpavilepanaiḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

37-39. Thus, at the time of tumultuous performing of the arati, the horses and elephants of high breed should be decorated with royal insignia and should be placed in the courtyard of the house. The king, his family, the courtiers as well as the relatives should reach their themselves. The king should grace the thorns, the conches and trumpets should be sounded. The worship should then be performed offering the flowers, costumes, lamp and the paste to the king.

## \|\| 3.71.40-41 \|\|

*tataḥ strīlakṣaṇairyuktā veśyā vātha kulāṅganā \|*  
*śīrṣopari narendrasya bhrābhayeddārupātrikām \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śāṃtirastu samṛddhiśca dvijaiśca svajanena ca \|*  
*tato nīrājayetsaumyaṃ hastyaśvarathasaṃkulam \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. The concubines and the ladies of the household should move a wooden vase round the head of the king. The Brahmanas and the relatives should recite the welfare mantras. The king’s arati should then be performed with his elephants, chariots, besides the noble people.

## \|\| 3.71.42-43 \|\|

*evameṣā mahāśāṃtiḥ khyātā nīrājane jane \|*  
*yeṣāṃ rāṣṭre pure grāme kriyate pāṃḍunandana \|\| 42 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ rogāḥ kṣayaṃ yāṃti subhikṣaṃ varddhate tadā \|*  
*śāṃtinīrājanālloke sarvānrogānvyapohati \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. O son of Pandu, thus, for the benefit of the people, the great Santi was created. Therefore, in which so ever kingdom, city or the village, this rite is performed, all the ailments of that palace are removed and the country has the cereals in plenty. This rite of Santi or peace removes all the diseases from that place.

## \|\| 3.71.44-46 \|\|

*lokānāvarddhayitvā tu ajapālavaro yathā \|*  
*eṣāṃ rogādipīḍāsu jaṃtūnāṃ hitamicchatā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*varṣevarṣe prayoktavyā śāṃtirnīrājanā iti \|\| 45 \|\|*

*nīrājayaṃti navameghanibhaṃ hariṃ ye gobrāhmaṇānrathagajāṃśca nareśacihnān \|*  
*te sarvarogarahitāśca nutā narendrairiṃdraprabhā bhuvi bhavaṃtyajapālavākyāt \|\| 46 \|\|*

44-46. As per the words of Ajapala, for the benefit of the villagers and for the removal of the disease, this rite has to be observed, which results in the increase of riches or (Aja-vrddhi). Therefore, it should be performed with arati every year. With the words of Ajapala, it is clear that like the fresh water, when the arati of the blue cornplexioned lord Visnu is performed with Brahmana, chariots, elephants and royal insignia, all the diseases are removed and the people on earth turn beautiful and healthy like the people of Indra viz, the gods.

## Chapter 72. Bhisma-Pancaka Vrata

## \|\| 3.72.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*yadetadatulaṃ puṇyaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam \|*  
*kartavyaṃ kārttike māsi prayatnādbhīṣmapañcakam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*vidhānaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tasya phalaṃ ca yadusattama \|*  
*kathayasva prasādānme munīnāṃ hitamicchatām \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- O best of the race of Kuru, you have said that the performing of the Bhisma-Pancaka vrata is essential. Therefore, you kindly enlighten me on the relative merit one earns, out of the performing of the said vrata. You kindly tell me the method of performing the said vrata for the sake of the Rsis.

## \|\| 3.72.3-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*pravakṣyāmi vrataṃ puṇyaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam \|*  
*yathāvidhi ca kartavyaṃ phalaṃ cāsya yathoditam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*mayāpi bhṛgave proktaṃ bhṛguścośanase dadau \|*  
*uśanāpi hi viprebhyaḥ prahlādāya ca dhīmate \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Sri Krsna said I am going to reveal before you the process of performing this auspicious vrata, besides the merit one earns with the performing of the same, which has be highlighted in the scriptures. Initially, I had revealed the same to Manu, who passed it on to Bhrgu. The Maharsi Bhrgu passed it on to Sukra, who spoke about it to the Brahmanas as well as Prahlada.

## \|\| 3.72.5-7 \|\|

*tejasvināṃ yathā vahniḥ pavanaḥ śīghragāminām \|*  
*vipro yathā ca pūjyānāṃ dānānāṃ kāñcanaṃ yathā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*bhūlokaḥ sarvalokānāṃ tīrthānāṃ jāhnavī yathā \|*  
*yathāśvamedho yajñānāṃ mathurā muktikāṃkṣiṇām \|\| 6 \|\|*

*vedo yathaiva śāstrāṇāṃ devānāmacyuto yathā \|*  
*tathā sarvavratānāṃ tu varoktaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. As Agni is the foremost among the illustrious people, the Wind god is the foremost of all those who move with force, the Brahmanas among those who are adorable, gold is foremost of the articles given in charity, Bhuloka among the Iokas, the Ganga is the most auspicious among the holy places on the rivers, the Asvamedha sacrifice is the foremost of all the yajnas, the city of Mathura for those desirous of achieving salvations, while Acyuta is the most important of all the gods, similarly, among all the vratas, Bhisma-Pancaka vrata is extremely difficult fast to be achieved.

## \|\| 3.72.8 \|\|

*duṣkaraṃ bhīṣmamityāhurna śakyaṃ tadihocyate \|*  
*yastatkaroti rājendra tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. This is what has been stated by the noble people. Therefore, it is impossible to narrate its glory. Because, O Rajendra, whosoever has performed this vrata, he has in fact performed all the noble deeds.

## \|\| 3.72.9 \|\|

*vaśiṣṭhabhṛgubhargādyaiścīrṇaṃ kṛtayugādiṣu \|*  
*nābhāgāṃgāṃbarīṣādyaiścīrṇaṃ tretāyugādiṣu \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In the Krtayuga, this vrata was performed by Vasistha, Bhrgu, Garga and other Rsis During the Tretayuga. this vrata was performed by Nabhaga, Ambarisa and others.

## \|\| 3.72.10-11 \|\|

*sīrabhadrādibhirvaiśyaiḥ śūdrairanyaiḥ kalau yuge \|*  
*dināni paṃca pūjyāni cīrṇametanmahāvratam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇairbrahmacaryeṇa japahomakriyādibhiḥ \|*  
*kṣatriyaiśca tathā śaktyā śaucavrataparāyaṇaiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. In the age of Kali, Vaisya, Sirabhadra and other Sudras performed this vrata. Observing Brahmacarya, performing homa etc. and after completion of the vrata, the Brahmanas have to be given sumptuous food with purity by the Ksatriyas as per their capacity. This vrata has to be completed in five days.

## \|\| 3.72.12-13 \|\|

*parādhiḥ parihartavyo brahmacaryeṇa niṣṭhayā \|*  
*madyaṃ māṃsaṃ parityajya maithunaṃ pāpabhāṣaṇam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*śākāhāraparaiścaiva kṛṣṇārcanaparairnaraiḥ \|*  
*strībhirvā bhartṛvākyena kartavyaṃ sukhavarddhanam \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. While performing this vrata, one has to observe Brahmacarya, one does not have to cause mental agony to anyone. This aspect has to be specifically kept in mind. The consuming of meat or wine, enjoying of sex and speaking of the sinful words are strictly prohibited. During the time of vrata, lord Krsna should be worshipped and only vegetarian food should be consumed. A married lady with her husband alive should perform this vrata, with the permission of her husband, for the increase of comforts in the married life.

## \|\| 3.72.14 \|\|

*vidhavābhiśca kartavyaṃ putrapautrādibruddhaye \|*  
*sarvakāmasamṛddhyarthaṃ mokṣārthamapi pāṃḍava \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. O Pandava, the widowed women can also perform this vrata, for the rise of their sons and grandsons, besides the fulfillment of all the desires as well as for the achieving of moksa.

## \|\| 3.72.15-20 \|\|

*nityaṃ snānena dānena kārttikī yāvadeva tu \|*  
*prātaḥ snātvā vidhānena madhyāhne ca tathā vratī \|\| 15 \|\|*

*nadya nirjharagarte vā samālabhya ca gomayam \|*  
*yavavrīhitilaiḥ samyaktarpayecca prayatnataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*devānṛṣīnpitṝṃścaiva tatonyānkāmacāriṇaḥ \|*  
*snānaṃ maunaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā dhautavāsā dṛḍhavrataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tato'nupūjayeddevaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ harim \|*  
*snāpayeccācyutaṃ bhaktyā madhukṣīraghṛtena ca \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tatraiva pañcagavyena gaṃdhacaṃdanavāriṇā \|*  
*candanena sugaṃdhena kuṃkumenātha keśavam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*karpūrośīra miśreṇa lepayedgaruḍadhvajam \|*  
*arcayedruciraiḥ puṣpairgaṃdhadhūpasamanvitaiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

15-20. While daily taking bath and giving away the charities in the month of Kartika, the performer of the vrata should go to a river, a spring or a lake and plastering the cowdung over the body, should take a bath silently. Then he should perform oblation for gods, pitrs, divine rsis and (bathing fully), he should clad himself in purified garments and perform a samkalpa. He should then start the worship of Visnu - the remover of all the sins. Lord Acyuta should be adored by offering him honey, milk, ghi and pancagavya. Then he should be bathed. The fragrant sandal paste, vermilion and camphor should be offered, while worshipping him.

## \|\| 3.72.21 \|\|

*gugguluṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ dahetkṛṣṇāya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*dīpakaṃ ca divā rātrau dadyātpaṃcadināni tu \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. At that point of time, guggulu mixed with ghi and incense must be offered. The lamp should be burnt for five days without interruption.

## \|\| 3.72.22-23 \|\|

*naivedyaṃ devadevasya paramānnaṃ nivedayet \|*  
*oṃ namo vāsudevāyeti japedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*juhuyācca ghṛtāktāṃśca tilavrīhīṃstato vratī \|*  
*ṣaḍakṣareṇa maṃtreṇa svāhākārānvitena ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Thereafter, offering the eatables to the god of gods along with sesamum seeds and clarified butter, the performer should recite the six-lettered mantra- Om Name Vasudevaya a hundred and eight times, adding the word Svaha at the end.

## \|\| 3.72.24 \|\|

*upāsya paścimāṃ saṃdhyāṃ praṇamya garuḍadhvajam \|*  
*japitvā pūrvavanmaṃtraṃ kṣitiśāyī bhavennaraḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. During the evening time, after performing Sandhya, salutation should be offered to lord Garudadhvaja and the same mantra should be muttered, and one should sleep on the ground.

## \|\| 3.72.25-26 \|\|

*sarvametadvidhānaṃ ca kāryaṃ paṃcadineṣu hi \|*  
*saṃviśetkaṃbale cāsminpadapūrvaṃ śṛṇuṣva me \|\| 25 \|\|*

*prathame'hni hareḥ pādau pūjayetkamalairnaraḥ \|*  
*dvitīye bilvapatreṇa jānudeśaṃ samarcayet \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. The same process should be followed by the performer for five days continuously. On the first day making use of a blanket, a lotus flower should be offered at the feet of the lord. On the second day, he should touch the thigh of the lord with a leaf.

## \|\| 3.72.27-30 \|\|

*pūjayecca tṛtīye'hni nābhiṃ bhṛṅgarasena ca \|*  
*madhye bilvajayābhiśca tataḥ skaṃdhau prapūjayet \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tato'nupūjayecchīrṣaṃ mālatyāḥ kusumairnavaiḥ \|*  
*kārttikyāṃ devadevasya bhaktyā tadgatamānasaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*arcayitvā hṛṣīkeśamekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ \|*  
*saṃprāśya gomayaṃ samyaṅ maṃtravatsamupāvaset \|\| 29 \|\|*

*gomūtraṃ maṃtravatkṛtvā dvādaśyāṃ prāśayedvratī \|*  
*kṣīraṃ tatra trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ tathā dadhi \|\| 30 \|\|*

27-30. On the third day his navel should be touched with the leaf of a medicinal plant. The middle part should be touched by wood apple leaf as well as japa flower. After worshipping skandha (shoulder), the head should be worshipped offering the jasmine flowers. During the month of Kartika, the Deva form of lord Visnu should be adored, and on the day of Ekadasi, he should be adored as Hrsikesa. Thereafter, the sanctified cowdung should be consumed. On the day of Dvadasi, the urine of the cow should be taken. On the day of Trayodasi, the milk should be taken. On the Caturdasi day one should take the curd, for the breaking the fast.

## \|\| 3.72.31-39 \|\|

*saṃprāśya kāyaśuddhyarthaṃ laṃghayeta caturdinam \|*  
*paṃcame tu dine snātvā vidhivatpūjya keśavam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*bhojayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā tebhyo dadyācca dakṣiṇām \|*  
*tathopadeṣṭāramapi pūjayedvastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tato naktaṃ samaśnīyātpañcagavyapuraḥsaram \|*  
*evaṃ samāpayetsamyagyathoktaṃ vratamuttamam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ prakhyātaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam \|*  
*madyapo yastyajenmadyaṃ janmano maraṇāṃtikam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*tadbhīṣmapañcakaṃ tyaktvā prāpnotbhyayadhikaṃ phalam \|*  
*brahmacaryaṃ naraścīrtvā sughoraṃ naiṣṭhikaṃ vratam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*yatprāpnoti mahatpuṇyaṃ tatkṛtvā bhīṣmapaṃcakam \|*  
*gātrā bhyaṃgaṃ śiro'bhyaṃgaṃ madhu māṃsaṃ ca maithunam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*brahmalokamavāpnoti tyaktvaikaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam \|*  
*saṃvatsareṇa yatpuṇyaṃ kārttikena ca yadbhavet \|\| 37 \|\|*

*yatphalaṃ kārttikenoktaṃ bhavettadbhīṣmapañcake \|*  
*vratametatsuraiḥ siddhaiḥ kinnarairnāgaguhyakaiḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*phalaṃ samīhitaṃ prāpya kṛtvābhyarcya janārdanam \|*  
*pāpasya pratimā kāryā raudravaktrātibhīṣaṇā \|\| 39 \|\|*

31-39. Thus purifying the body for four days, lord Kesava should be worshipped on the fifth day. The Brahmanas should be served with food with devotion. During the night, first consuming pancagavya, the food should be taken thereafter at night and the vrata should be concluded, which happens to be the best of all the vratas, besides being auspicious and is known by the name of Bhisma-Pancaka. A drunkard, who discards drinking on the day of Bhisma-Pancaka, he achieves the greater reward. Performing an awful vrata, observing chastity and Brahmacarya with a religions faith a person eanis a great merit, but the same merit could easily be achieved with the performing of the Bhisma-Pahcaka vrata. With the performing of the Bhisma-Pancaka vrata. discarding meat, drinks and sex, one achieves Brahmaloka. The performer of this vrata also achieves the merit specified for the month of Kartika. With the performing of this vrata with devotion, the Gods, Siddhas, Kinnaras, Guhyakas and the Nagas have achieved the desired success. O king, the image of the sin should be prepared in a terrific form, holding a sword in his hand.

## \|\| 3.72.40 \|\|

*khaḍgahastātivikṛtā sarvalokamayī nṛpa \|*  
*tilaprasthopari sthāpyā kṛṣṇavastrābhiveṣṭitā \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The body should be awful and deformed. It should be covered with a black cloth and consecrated over the black sesamum seeds.

## \|\| 3.72.41 \|\|

*karavīrakusumāpīḍā calatkāñcanakuṃḍalā \|*  
*brāhmaṇāya pradātavyā kṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. It should be decorated with the oleander flowers, peacock feathers, besides the gold kundalas in the ear should be shown. Saying that- “Let the black-faced lord be pleased with me,” the same should be given over to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.72.42-45 \|\|

*anyeṣāmapi dātavyaṃ yatkṛtvā vasu vāṃchitam \|*  
*kṛtakṛtyaḥ sthiro bhūtvā viraktaḥ saṃyato bhavet \|\| 42 \|\|*

*śāṃtacetā nirābādhaḥ paraṃ padamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*nīlotpaladalaśyāmaścaturdaṃṣṭraścaturbhujaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*aṣṭaṣaṣṭhaikanayanaḥ śaṃkukarṇo mahāsvanaḥ \|*  
*jaṭī dvijihvastāmasyo mṛgarājatanucchadaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*ciṃtanīyo mahādevo yasya rūpaṃ na vidyate \|*  
*idaṃ bhīṣmeṇa kathitaṃ śaratalpagatena me \|\| 45 \|\|*

42-45. The same could be given to someone else as well. By so doing, a person achieves the desired riches besides the success in his efforts. He becomes a detached saintly person, who finally achieves the supreme position. Thereafter, lord Mahadeva should be adored in the form having the body with blue complexion, resembling the blue lotus flowers, four fangs, four arms, five heads, fifteen eyes, uttering loud voice, decorated with locks of hair, using the serpents as ornaments, the face having the colour of copper. He should be clad in the tiger skin. Such type of the form of lord Mahadeva should be meditated upon. This has been told by Bhisma - the Grandsire, while lying over the bed of arrows.

## \|\| 3.72.46-51 \|\|

*tadeva te samākhyātaṃ duṣkaraṃ bhīṣmapaṃcakam \|*  
*vrataṃ ca rājaśārdūla pravaraṃ bhīṣmapañcakam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*yastasmiṃstoṣayedbhaktyā tasmai muktiprado'cyutaḥ \|*  
*brahmacārī gṛhastho vā vānaprastho'thavā yatiḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*prāpnoti vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ satkṛtvā bhīṣmapañcakam \|*  
*brahmahā madyapaḥ steyī gurugāmī sadākṛtī \|\| 48 \|\|*

*mucyate pātakātsamyakkṛtvaikaṃ bhīṣmapañcakam \|*  
*nāsmādvratātpuṇyatamaṃ vaiṣṇavebhyo yato vratam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*athāsmiṃstoṣito viṣṇurnṛṇāṃ muktiprado bhavet \|*  
*śrutvaitatpaṭhyamānaṃ tu pavitraṃ bhīṣmapaṃcakam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*mucyate pātakebhyo vā pāṭhako viṣṇulokabhāk \|*  
*dhanyaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ yudhiṣṭhira mahāvratam \|\| 51 \|\|*

46-51. O lion among the kings, thus, I have spoken to you about the Bhisma-Pancaka vrata. In the performing of the said vrata, when lord Acyuta gets pleased, he surely bestows salvation. When a Brahmacarl, a householder, forest dweller or an ascetic, or a recluse performs the Bhisma-Pancaka vrata, or reads or listens to its procedure, he surely achieves the abode of Visnu. This vrata is the granter of emancipation from this world. Therefore, O Yudhisthira, this vrata is surely auspicious and the remover of sins.

## \|\| 3.72.52 \|\|

*yadbhīṣmapañcakamiti prathitaṃ pṛthivyāmekādaśīprabhṛtipañcadaśīniruddham \|*  
*annasya bhojananivṛttivaśādamuṣminniṣṭaṃ phalaṃ diśati pāṃḍava śārṅgadhanvā \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. O Pandava, leaving aside all other types of food, the vrata should be started from the day of Ekadasi, this vrata should be continued upto the full moon day. Those who perform this vrata accordingly, they please lord Visnu - the holder of the Sarnga bow in his hand, who surely grants the desired wish.

## Chapter 73. Malla-Dvadasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.73.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇe śrīvatsa garuḍāsana \|*  
*brūhi me malladvādaśyā vidhānaṃ devakīsuta \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- О son of DevakI, holder of conch, disc and the club, with a Sri Vatsa mark over the chest, having Garuda as the vehicle, you kindly tell me about Malla-Dvadasi vrata.

## \|\| 3.73.2-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*yadā bhāṃḍīranyagrodhe vasāmi yamunātaṭe \|*  
*gopālamadhye govatsairaṣṭavarṣosmi līlayā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kaṃsāsuravadhārthāya mathuropavane tadā \|*  
*ābālo bālarūpeṇa gopamallairbalotkaṭaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*sametya mallagopasya balena saha kānane \|*  
*āsphoṭayaṃti nṛtyaṃti tridaśe tridaśā iva \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Sri Krsna said- While sporting in the Bhandira forest over the bank of Yamuna, under a Banyan tree, in the company of the milkmaids or cowherds, I used to perform various types of games. For the killing of Kamsa in the orchard of Mathura, I had a chance of having a wrestling fight with cowherd boys who had been physically very strong. Balabhadra was always with me in those dual fights. All of them patted their thighs, danced and remained like gods at all the three times.

## \|\| 3.73.5-7 \|\|

*surabhadro maṃḍalīkayogavarddhanayogadāḥ \|*  
*yakṣeṃdrabhadra ityādi teṣāṃ nāmāni gokule \|\| 5 \|\|*

*gopīnāmapi nāmāni prādhānyena nibodha me \|*  
*gopālī pālikā dhanyā viśākhā dhyānaniṣṭhikā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ilvānugandhā subhagā tārakā daśamī tathā \|*  
*ityevamādibhirahaṃ sūpaviṣṭo varāsane \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. These were known by the names of-Surabhadra, Mandalika, Yogavardhana,-Yogada and Yaksendrabhadra. Besides these, all the milkmaids of Gokula were also there whose names were- Gopali, Palika, Dhanya, Visakha, Dhyananisthika, Ilva, Anugandha, Subhaga, Taraka, DasamI and several others. Together with all these milkmaids, I used to be comfortably seated over a beautiful seat.

## \|\| 3.73.8-10 \|\|

*pūjito'smi suraiḥ puṣpairdadhidugdhākṣataistathā \|*  
*śatāni trīṇi ṣaṣṭiśca mallānāṃ pūjayaṃti mām \|\| 8 \|\|*

*mallinyaśca surāmāṃsairaṃgajāgaranarttanaiḥ \|*  
*mallayuddhairbahuvidhairbāhyairmallabhaṭaiḥ sphuṭaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*bhakṣyairbhojyaistathā pānairdadhidugdhaghṛtāsavaiḥ \|*  
*godānairvṛṣadānaiśca śraddhayā viprapūjanaiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. They worshipped me offering flowers, curd, milk and unbroken rice. Even today, I am worshipped by the three hundred wrestlers, both male and female, who remain awake during the night and resort to the dancing, while adoring me, offering drinks, meat etc. Many of the wrestlers from other places display their strength there. The eatables, curd, payasam, ghi and juices arc served, besides the cows or bulls are also given in charity with great devotion to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.73.11-12 \|\|

*goṣṭhīprabhūtairvadhūnāṃ snehasaṃbhāṣaṇairmithaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ dvādaśa dvādaśyo grahītavyā yathecchayā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*saṃbaṃdhibhiḥ krameṇaiva mallānāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*pūjayaṃti krameṇaiva māsimāsi tanuṃ mama \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. There are discussions among the noble people, while the relatives enter into lovely talks and with pleasant discourses, they serve me. Similarly, on the other twelve dvadasis, this vrata has to be completed. Like the aforesaid cowherds, all the relatives should also worship me individually, every month.

## \|\| 3.73.13-14 \|\|

*māsādikārtikāṃtaṃ ca bhaktyā dvādaśanāmabhiḥ \|*  
*pāraṇepāraṇe dadyānmallakāni dvijātaye \|\| 13 \|\|*

*keśavanārāyaṇamādhavagovindaviṣṇumadhusūdanatrivikramavāmanaśrīdharahṛṣīkeśapadmanābhadāmodarāṇāṃ namonama iti \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. At the start of the month of Margasirsa and upto the month of Kartika, one should recite the mantras which mean, salutation to Kesava, Narayana, Madhava, Govinda, Visnu, Madhusudana, Trivikrama, Vamana, Sridhara, Hrsikesa and Damodara. This should be done in each month and while doing so, the fast should be broken. In each one of the breaking of the fast, a Malla should be presented to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.73.15 \|\|

*gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpairjāgaraṇairniśi \|*  
*gītavādyaiśca nṛtyaiśca mallakṣveḍāṃgayuddhakaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Lord Visnu should be adored offering fragrance, incense, flowers, lamp etc Remaining awake during the night, the dancing and singing should be arranged, accompanied with music. Uttering the names of each one of the limbs, the wrestling should be continued.

## \|\| 3.73.16-17 \|\|

*ghṛtadānaiḥ kṣīradānaiḥ kṛṣṇo me prīyatā miti \|*  
*evameṣa vidhiḥ prokto māsairdvādaśabhirnṛpa \|\| 16 \|\|*

*dvādaśī yā mamādyāpi manasaḥ prītivarddhanī \|*  
*mallaiḥ pravartitā yasmādato'rthaṃ malladvādaśī \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Thereafter, ghi, riches and milk should be given in charity and one should pray- “Let lord Krsna be pleased with me.” Thus speaking, the devotee should send him off. In this way, I have explained the methods of performing vratas of the twelve Ekadasis. The same Dvadasi is enhancing my love (for my devotee). Since it had been started by the Mallas or wrestlers, it came to be known as the Malla-Dvadasi.

## \|\| 3.73.18-20 \|\|

*teṣāṃ paramamallānāṃ teṣāṃ jñāna yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*goṣṭhe babhūva suprājyaṃ gomahiṣyādyajāvikam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*matprasādāddharmaputra balaṃ kīrtiryaśo dhanam \|*  
*evamanye'pi puruṣā hyabalā malladvādaśīm \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ye kariṣyaṃti madbhaktāsteṣāṃ dāsyāmi hṛdgatam \|*  
*ārogyaṃ balamaiśvarya viṣṇulokaṃ ca śāśvatam \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. With the performing of this vrata, the discussion of the Mallas (wrestlers) become successful. They also achieve the knowledge about the rearing up of cows, buffaloes, goats and the sheep. Besides their strength, popularity, glory and the riches are increased. O Dharmaputra, similarly, other men and women, whosoever perform the vrata of Malla-Dvadasi appropriately, I grant the desires of all making them successful. I also bestow on them the good health, strength, riches, besides the everlasting stay in the abode of Visnu.

## \|\| 3.73.21 \|\|

*bhāṃḍīrapādapatale militairmahadbhirmallairanākulitabāhubalairbaliṣṭhaiḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjitaḥ sapadi yatra tithau tataśca sā dvādaśī suviditā vrata malla saṃjñā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Several of the strong wrestlers of various races perform this vrata under the shade of the banyan tree in the Bhandira forest on the Dvadasi day. Because of their adoring me, it has been come to be known as Malla-Dvadasi.

## Chapter 74. Bhima-Dvadasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.74.1-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*vidarbhādhipatiḥ śrīmānāsītpūrvaṃ sudhārmikaḥ \|*  
*damayaṃtyāḥ pitā pūrvaṃ nalasya śvaśuro bhuvi \|\| 1 \|\|*

*satyavādanaśīlaśca prajāpālanatatparaḥ \|*  
*kṣatradharmarataḥ śrīmānsaṃgrāmeṣvaparājitaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tasyāpi kurvato rājyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā \|*  
*ājagāma mahābhāgaḥ pulastyo brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*sarvajñānanidhiḥ śrīmāṃstīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ \|*  
*tamāgatamatho dṛṣṭvā brahmayonimakalmaṣam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*utthāya pradadau rājā svamāsanamabhīpsitam \|*  
*arghaṃ pādyaṃ ca yatkiñcittattasmai pradadau svayam \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Sri Krsna said- In earlier times, the king of NareSvara known as Bhima, was an extremely religious minded person. He was the father of DamayantI and the father-in-law of Nala. He was quite truthful and looked after the people quite well. Once the sage Pulastya - the son of a Ksatriya, reached at his place. Pulastya was endowed with all the divine knowledge and possessed the Brahmateja. In the sequence of his pilgrimage, he was the unblemished son of Brahma and on his arrival in the court, the king suddenly got up and offered him padya and arghya. Then he served him appropriately.

## \|\| 3.74.6-7 \|\|

*rājyaṃ caivātmanā sārddhaṃ nivedya sa kṛtāṃjaliḥ \|*  
*tena caivābhyanujñāto niṣasāda varāsane \|\| 6 \|\|*

*papraccha kuśalapraśnaṃ tapasyadhyayane tathā \|*  
*tatheti coktvā sa munistaṃ rājānamabhāṣata \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Thereafter, holding both his hands in anjali posture, he offered his entire kingdom to the Mahar$i. Thereafter, with the permission of the sage, he occupied his throne and enquired of the sage about the progress of his studies, welfare and the tapas. The Maharsi, giving the appropriate reply to the enquiry of the king, further said.

## \|\| 3.74.8 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*kaccitte kuśalaṃ rājankośe janapade pure \|*  
*dharme ca te matirnityaṃ kaccitpārthiva vartate \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Pulastya said- О king, are your treasures and the people quite well? Do you maintain your firm faith in the Dharma?

## \|\| 3.74.9-10 \|\|

*bhīma uvāca \|*  
*sarvatra kuśalaṃ brahmanyeṣāṃ kuśalamicchasi \|*  
*tava cāgamanenāhaṃ pāvitaḥ saṃgavāriṇā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*evaṃ tau saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā saṃbhāṣyātha parasparam \|*  
*remāte pūrvavṛttāṃtaiḥ kathābhiritaretaram \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Bhima said- О Brahman, those for whose welfare is being enquired by you, are all comfortable.” Thus both of them enquiring about the mutual welfare, discussed about other things quite pleasantly.

## \|\| 3.74.11-16 \|\|

*tataḥ kathāṃte rājendra pulastyaṃ jātavismayaḥ \|*  
*papraccha sarvalokasya hitāya jagataḥ patiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*bhagavanprāṇinaḥ sarve saṃsārārṇavamadhyagāḥ \|*  
*dṛśyaṃte vividhairduḥkhaiḥ pīḍyamānā divāniśam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*narake garbhavāse ca vyādhibhirjanmanā tathā \|*  
*tathā kaṣṭaviyogā diduḥkhairdaurgatyasaṃbhavaiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*lālapyamānā bahavaḥ parapīḍopajīvinaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ vidhānyanekāni duḥkhāni munipuṅgava \|\| 14 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvaiva tāni tānyeva bhṛśaṃ me vyādhitaṃ manaḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ duḥkhāni bhūtānāṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi mānada \|\| 15 \|\|*

*upakārakaraṃ brūhi mamānugrahakāmyayā \|*  
*svalpāyāsena bhagavañjāyate sumahatphalam \|\| 16 \|\|*

11-16. O Rajendra, at the close of the discussion, the king Bhima enquired of the excellent Maharsi- “O lord, all the people of the world are drowning in the ocean of the universe. They seem to be suffering from various ailments, like falling in hell, stay in womb, suffering from ailments, separation from one another, suffering from miseries etc. Some of the people who are competent to well look after others, still suffer for the pains of others. Besides, there are other grace sufferings in the world. 0 lion among the Rsis, by observing these sufferings, I feel mentally agonized. Therefore, 0 MSnava, being merciful on me, for the benefit of the people on earth, you tell me about some vrata or so, observing which, even by the slightest way, one could achieve a happy or a pleasant reward.”

## \|\| 3.74.17-18 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam \|*  
*yadupoṣya na duḥkhānāṃ bhājano jāyate janaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*māghamāse site pakṣe dvādaśī pāvanī smṛtā \|*  
*tasyāṃ jalārdravasana upoṣya sukhabhāgbhavet \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Pulasya said- O king, I am going to speak to you about a vrata in which, by fasting, a person does not have to suffer (you listen to me carefully). On the bright twelfth day of the month of Magha, which is said to be extremely auspicious, in case a man observes a fast, he attains enormous comfort.

## \|\| 3.74.19 \|\|

*bhīma uvāca \|*  
*kathaṃ sā muniśārdūla upoṣyā dvādaśī bhavet \|*  
*vidhinā kena viprendra tanme brūhi yathākramam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Bhima said- O lion among the Rsis, what is the method of performing vrata of the said Dvadasi? You kindly speak out all the details about him.

## \|\| 3.74.20-24 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu rājannavahito vrataṃ pāpapraṇāśanam \|*  
*tava śuśrūṣaṇādvācyaṃ mamāpyetanna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*adīkṣitāya no deyā nāśiṣyāya kadācana \|*  
*viṣṇubhaktāya śāṃtāya dharmaniṣṭhāya caiva hi \|\| 21 \|\|*

*vācyametanmahārāja bhavatānyasya na kvacit \|*  
*brahmahā gurughātī ca bālastrīghātakastathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*kṛtaghno mitradhrukcauraḥ kṣudro bhagnavratastathā \|*  
*mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairvratenānena bhūpate \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śuddhe tithau muhūrte ca maṃḍapaṃ kārayettataḥ \|*  
*daśahastapramāṇena daśapūrvottare plave \|\| 24 \|\|*

20-24. Pulastya said- O king, I am extremely satisfied with the way you have so well served me. There is no doubt about it. Therefore, I am revealing before you the process of performing the Dvadasi vrata, which is the remover of the sins. You please listen with apt attention. O great king, this method of the performing of the vrata should not be revealed before a disciple, who is yet to be initiated, or any other person. It is only the devotee of Visnu, who is entitled to receive it, besides those who are totally devoted to dharma and those of the peaceful nature. O king, with the performing of this vrata, the sin of Brahmahatya is removed, besides the killer of the preceptor and others, sins of the ungrateful person, one who had became a thief in the form of friend, a degraded one and others killers, are also relieved with the performing of this vrata. On the day of that particular dvadasi, at the auspicious time, a mandapa of ten cubits should be made, facing the east or the north, over a slope.

## \|\| 3.74.25-32 \|\|

*tanmadhye pañcahastāṃ tu vedikāṃ parikalpayet \|*  
*śuklāṃ sukuṭṭimāṃ bhūmiṃ vedyāṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*vilikhenmaṃḍalaṃ tatra paṃcavarṇairvidhānataḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇo vedasaṃpanno viṣṇubhakto jitendriyaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*pañcaviṃśatitattvajñaḥ svācārābhiratastathā \|*  
*kuṃḍāni kalpayettatra aṣṭau catvāri vā punaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇāṃsteṣu yuṃjīta cātuścaraṇikāñchubhān \|*  
*madhye ca maṃḍalasyātha karṇikāyāṃ janārdanam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*pratyaṅmukhaṃ nyaseddevaṃ caturbāhumariṃdama \|*  
*pūjayettaṃ vidhānena śāstroktena vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairnaivedyairvividhairapi \|*  
*evaṃ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha deśikaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*nyasetstaṃbhadvayaṃ paścāttiṣṭhankāṣṭhasamanvitam \|*  
*devasyābhimukhaṃ tatra pīṭhaṃ tu parikalpayet \|\| 31 \|\|*

*ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ caturasraṃ samaṃtataḥ \|*  
*tatra śikyaṃ samālaṃbya suvṛttaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ navam \|\| 32 \|\|*

25-32. A pedestal of five cubits should be made. A mandala of five colours should be made over the pedestal by the disciplined Brahmanas or those who are well-versed in the Vedas or those who are devoted to Visnu. Thereafter, the fire altars should be made. Then the four or eight Brahmanas, who are well-versed in twenty-five tattvas, well disciplined, laborious, besides being the reciters of the Vedas, should be lodged in the mandala. In the pericarp, the image of four armed Janardana should be consecrated facing west. The offering of fragrance, flowers, incense and several types of eatables should be made, while adoring the same image. Then the local Brahmanas should be lodged in the cubical on the western side, with wooden pillars. Thereafter, a pithasana of square shape of thirty-six fingers in width should be made. Then a circular solid should be seated with a robe.

## \|\| 3.74.33-35 \|\|

*āropayeddhaṭaṃ tatra yādṛśaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva me \|*  
*kaladhautaṃ tathā raupyaṃ tāmraṃ vāpyatha mṛnmayam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ dṛḍhaṃ vyaṃgavivarjitam \|*  
*tatsahasraṃ śataṃ kuryādekacchidramathāpi vā \|\| 34 \|\|*

*kuśalatvānurūpeṇa pāśaikacchidrameva vā \|*  
*sannidhāne tataḥ kuryātsalilaṃ vastrapāvanam \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. The way in which the house is be shaped, is going to be spoken by me. A beautiful house, comprising of the material like the gold, silver, copper and mud, with all the auspicious symptoms, should be made and beautifully decorated. It should have a thousand, a hundred or a single hole in it. It should have the string or kusa. With the erecting of this house, the water and costumes should also be provided in the same.

## \|\| 3.74.36-39 \|\|

*homārthaṃ kalpayeccāpi pālāśyaḥ samidhaḥ śubhāḥ \|*  
*tilā ghṛtaṃ tathā kṣīraṃ śamīpatrāṇi caiva hi \|\| 36 \|\|*

*vedyāḥ pūrvottare bhāge grahapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet \|*  
*tatra pūjyā grahāḥ sarve graha yajñavidhānataḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*pūrvasyāṃ diśi śakrasya pūjāṃ kurvīta yatnataḥ \|*  
*dakṣiṇasyāṃ yamasyātha pratīcyāṃ varuṇasya ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

*kuberasya tathodīcyāṃ baliṃ kuryātphalākṣataiḥ \|*  
*evaṃ saṃbhṛtya saṃbhāraṃ śuklāṃbaradharastathā \|\| 39 \|\|*

36-39. For the perfoming of homa, the twigs of Beautea frondasa (palasa) should be used with sesamum seeds, milk and the silken cloth should be used. Towards the north-east of the pedestal, the adorable planets should be worshipped over the pedestal. Indra should be lodged towards the east. Yama should be lodged in the south, Varuna in the west; while Kubera should be worshipped in the north, offering the fruit, unbroken rice etc Then offering the white costumes, the sandal paste should be applied

## \|\| 3.74.40-42 \|\|

*samālabhya śubhairgaṃdhairddarbhapāṇirataṃdritaḥ \|*  
*pīṭhamāropayeyuste yajamānaṃ dvijottamāḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*yajamāno'pi devasya saṃmukhaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*upaviśya paṭhenmaṃtraṃ purāṇoktamidaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 41 \|\|*

*namaste devadeveśa namaste bhuvane śvara \|*  
*vratenānena māṃ pāhi paramātmannamostu te \|\| 42 \|\|*

40-42. Then holding kusa grass in his hand, the yajamana should be made to be seated over the mandapa by the Brahmanas. The yajamana also, at the same time, should be seated before the lord, reciting verses from the Puranas, saying- “I offer my salutation to the lord of the universe as well as the gods. O supreme soul, with the performing of this vrata, you kindly protect me. I offer my salutation to you again and again.”

## \|\| 3.74.43-45 \|\|

*tatodakasya dhārāstāḥ pratyaṃgaṣu samanvitāḥ \|*  
*śirasā dhārayettūṣṇīṃ tadgatenāṃtarātmanā \|\| 43 \|\|*

*homaṃ kuryustato viprā dikṣu sarvāsu tatparāḥ \|*  
*paṭheyuḥ śāṃtikādhyāyaṃ viṣṇusaṃjñāni yāni vai \|\| 44 \|\|*

*vāditraistāḍyamānaiśca śaṃkhageya svanaistathā \|*  
*puṇyāhajayaśabdaiśca vedasvanavimiśritaiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

43-45. Thereafter, he shall have the stream of milk flown over his head and the homa should be performed. Thereafter, the Brahmanas who are lodged in ail the directions, should be made to recite the chapters for welfare and peace accompanied with the sound of conches, singing, dance and music. Then the slogans of victory should be raised in high tone.

## \|\| 3.74.46-53 \|\|

*maṃgalaiḥ stutisaṃyuktaiḥ kārayettanmahotsavam \|*  
*devadevasya caritaṃ keśavasya mahācmanaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*harivaṃśādikaṃ sarvaṃ śrāvayedbrāhmaṇo varaḥ \|*  
*soparṇikamathākhyānaṃ bhāratākhyānameva ca \|\| 47 \|\|*

*vyākhyānakuśalāḥ kecicchrāvayeyurataṃdritāḥ \|*  
*anena vidhinā sarvāṃ tāṃ rātriṃ prītivarddhinīm \|\| 48 \|\|*

*yajamāno nayeddhīmānyāvatsūryodayo bhavet \|*  
*brāhmaṇāścāpi tāṃ rātrīṃ juhvato jātavedasam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*maṃtraistu vaiṣṇavairdivyaiḥ kṣapayeyurmahīpate \|*  
*vāsudevasya śirasi vasorddhārāṃ prapātayet \|\| 50 \|\|*

*kṣīreṇājyena vā rājansarvasiddhi pradāyinīm \|*  
*tataḥ prabhātasamaye yajamāno dvijaiḥ saha \|\| 51 \|\|*

*snānaṃ kuryānnṛpaśreṣṭha nadyāṃ sarasi vā punaḥ \|*  
*atha vā śaktihīnastu yajamānoṣṇa vāriṇā \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tataḥ śuklāni vastrāṇi paridhāya yatavrataḥ \|*  
*arghyaṃ dattvā bhāskarāya savidhānaṃ prasannadhīḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

46-53. Thereafter, the welfare hymns of the Vedas should be recited, while concluding the vrata. The Harivamsa of lord Visnu - the god of gods should be recited by the Brahmanas, besides the stories of Sauparnika and other religious stories should also be narrated by the Brahmanas and listened to by the devotees during the night which keeps on increasing the love among the people. The whole might should thus be spent. During the night, the Vaisnava Brahmanas should please the fire god by pouring offerings in the fire and reciting the Vedic mantras. At the sunrise, the yajamana should pour ghi or milk over the head of lord Visnu - Vasudeva. 0 lord of earth, this type of performance bestows all round success. O king, then at dawn, the yajamana should take his bath at a river or lake with the Brahmanas and should clad in white costumes. Then he should delightfully offer arghya to the Sungod. A yajamana, who is unable to go to the river side, should purify himself with the warm water at home itself.

## \|\| 3.74.54-55 \|\|

*puṣpairdhūpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pūjayetpu ruṣottamam \|*  
*hutvā hutāśanaṃ bhaktyā dattvā pūrṇahutiṃ tataḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*pūjayedbrāhmaṇānsarvānhotāro yajñakalpitāḥ \|*  
*śayyābhojanagodānairvastrairābharaṇaistathā \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. Thereafter, with a devoted mind, he should offer flowers, milk and eatables to lord Purusottama. Then he should make the final offering in the fire. Thereafter, all the Brahmanas who are invited in the yajna, should be given over the beds, food, cows, costumes, ornaments, with respect.

## \|\| 3.74.56-58 \|\|

*ācāryaḥ pūjanīyo'tra sarvasvenāpi bhārata \|*  
*yena vā tasya saṃtuṣṭirdevatulyo gururyataḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*vittaśāṭhyavihīnastu bhaktiśaktisamanvitaḥ \|*  
*dīnānāthaviśiṣṭāśca baṃdinaśca samāgatāḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*teṣāmannaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca dadyācchuddhena cetasā \|*  
*evaṃ saṃpūjya viprāya bhojayitvā yathepsitam \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. Then presenting everything to the Acarya, he should be worshipped. О Bharata, he should give to the Brahmanas, the things which please them the maximum, because, the preceptor has been equated with the god. Discarding miserliness, with a devoted mind, as per one’s means, one should give away charities to the poor, destitutes, orphans, the prisoners, beggars and Sudras with a spotless mind. By performing the worship accordingly, the sumptuous food should be served to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.74.59-60 \|\|

*yathāvibhavasāreṇa paścādbhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ \|*  
*haviṣyamannaṃ yajñena haviṣyā satilāstathā \|\| 59 \|\|*

*evaṃ yajño mahārājaścoktaste saṃprakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*pāpiṣṭhāḥ sarvapāpebhyo mucyaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. The leftover havisya food should be taken himself by the yajamana silently. О king, I have thus narrated to you the method of performing the worship of Visnu. With this performing, even the awful sinner is relieved of all the sins. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.74.61 \|\|

*vājapeyātirātrābhyāṃ ye yajaṃti śataṃ samāḥ \|*  
*sarve te viṣṇuyāgasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. The merit one earns with the performing of the Vajapeya and Atiratra yajnas, a hundred times all the collected merits so achieved by a person cannot be equated with even one sixteenth part of the Visnu yajna.

## \|\| 3.74.62-63 \|\|

*sapta janmāni saubhāgyamāyurārogyasaṃpadaḥ \|*  
*prāpnoti dvādaśīmetāṃ tāmupoṣya vidhānataḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*mṛto viṣṇupuraṃ yāti viṣṇunā saha modate \|*  
*caturyugāni dvātriṃśadviṣṇurūpadharaḥ sthitaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

62-63. With the performing of the vrata of this Dvadasi, a person achieves fortunes, long life, good health for seven future births and after his demise, he spends happy time with lord Visnu. He stays in Visnuloka for a period of thirty two caturyugas and is honoured there as Visnu himself.

## \|\| 3.74.64 \|\|

*rudraloke tathā rājanyugāni dvādaśaiva tu \|*  
*brahmaloke tathā trīṇi sūryaloke yugāni ca \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Thereafter he lives for twelve caturyugas in Rudraloka; for three yugas, he stays in Brahmaloka; while in Suryaloka, he stays fora single yuga.

## \|\| 3.74.65-68 \|\|

*puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*pṛthivyadhipatiḥ śrīmānvijitāriḥ pratāpavān \|\| 65 \|\|*

*vratametatpurā cīrṇaṃ sagareṇa mahātmanā \|*  
*ajena dhuṃdhumāreṇa dilīpena yayātinā \|\| 66 \|\|*

*anyaiśca pṛthivīpālaiḥ pālitāśeṣabhūtalaiḥ \|*  
*strībhirvaiśyaistathā śūdrairdharmakāmaiḥ sadā nṛpa \|\| 67 \|\|*

*bhṛgvādyairmunibhiḥ sarvairbrāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ \|*  
*tvayā ca pṛṣṭena mayā kathitaṃ te narādhipa \|\| 68 \|\|*

65-68. After the decline of the merits, he is reborn on earth as a victor, glorious, religious minded and graceful king. In earlier times, Sagara, Aja, Dhundhumara, Dilipa, Yayati and other rulers, the ladies, Vaisyas, Madras inclined towards dharma, Bhrgu and other Rsis, and the Brahmanas well-versed in the Vedas, had performed this vrata. О king, I have thus replied to your question in an appropriate way.

## \|\| 3.74.69-72 \|\|

*adyaprabhṛti caiveyaṃ khyātiṃ yāsyati bhūtale \|*  
*bhīmākhyā dvādaśī ceti kṛtakṛtyā ca bhārata \|\| 69 \|\|*

*eṣā pulastyamuninā kathitā kurunaṃdana \|*  
*yaścaināṃ kathitāṃ dhyātvā kuryādvā bhaktibhāvataḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate \|*  
*daridraścāpi bhoḥ pārtha vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet \|*  
*viṣṇubhaktena kartavyā saṃsārabhayabhīruṇā \|\| 71 \|\|*

*bhīmena yā kila purā samupoṣitā ca rātrau ghaṭasthirasuśatilavāridhārā \|*  
*tāṃ dvādaśī daśamu khārimukhācchrutāṃ ca samyagvratī carati yāti sa viṣṇuloke \|\| 72 \|\|*

69-72. O Bharata, the Bhima-Dvadasi is always successful, and shall be quite popular on earth from today onwards. О son of the race of Kuru, this is how, the sage Pulastya had described it to the king. By getting free from all the sins, with the performing of this vrata, the devotee is honoured in the Visnuloka. О Partha, even a poor person, shedding away the miserliness, should perform this vrata. The devotee of lord Visnu, who is afraid of the world, must perform this vrata. The dvadasi day on which the king Bhima, after fasting, had consecrated the pitcher at night and also poured the cool stream of water, the Dvadasi vrata was performed by Rama - the killer of Ravana, By listening to the glory of the same vrata, one surely achieves the place of Visnu.

## Chapter 75. Sravana-Dvadasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.75.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*upavāsāsamarthānāṃ sadaiva puruṣottama \|*  
*ekā yā dvādaśī puṇyā tāṃ vadasva mamānagha \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- О sinless Puru§ottama, you kindly tell me the glory of a Dvadasi which is quite auspicious for those who are able to observe the vratas.

## \|\| 3.75.2-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*māsi bhādrapade śuklā dvādaśī śravaṇānvitā \|*  
*sarvakāmapradā puṇyā copavāse mahāphalā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*saṃgame saritāṃ snātvā dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*ayatnātsamavāpnoti dvādaśadvādaśīphalam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*budhaśravaṇadvādaśyāmevaṃ vai saṃyato bhavet \|*  
*atīva mahatī tasyāṃ kṛtaṃ sarvamathākṣayam \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Sri Krsna said- The bright dvadasi of the month of Bhadrapada, falling in the Sravana constellation, makes all the desires successful. On the day of dvadasi, one should take bath at the confluence of rivers, if a person observes a fast without his seeking for the merits, he achieves the same. On Wednesday, observing the fast appropriately, one achieves great merit. All the activities performed during that time become everlasting.

## \|\| 3.75.5 \|\|

*dvādaśī śravaṇopetā yadā bhavati bhārata \|*  
*saṃgame saritāṃ snātvā gaṃgādisnānajaṃ phalam \|*  
*sopavāsaḥ samāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. О Bharata, on the twelfth moon day falling during the Sravana constellation, in case a bath is taken at the confluence of rivers, then one achieves the merit of having a bath in the Gangs. During that time, one should observe the fast.

## \|\| 3.75.6-7 \|\|

*jalapūrṇe tathā kuṃbhe sthāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*paṃcaratnasamopetaṃ sopavītaṃ supūji tam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tasya skaṃdhe sughaṭitaṃ sthāpayitvā janārdanam \|*  
*yathāśakti svarṇamayaṃ śaṃkhaśārṅgavibhūṣitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Thereafter, a pitcher filled with water should be consecrated. The figure of Janardana should be established at its neck. A vajnopavita and five jewels should be offered to the same. A gold bow should then be offered as per one’s means.

## \|\| 3.75.8-11 \|\|

*snāpayitvā vidhānena sitacaṃdana carcitam \|*  
*sitavastrayugacchannaṃ chatropānadyugānvitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*oṃ namo vāsudevāyeti śiraḥ saṃpūjayaddhareḥ \|*  
*śrīdharāya mukhaṃ tadvatkaṃṭha kṛṣṇāya vai punaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*oṃ namaḥ śrīmate vakṣo bhujau sarvāstradhāriṇe \|*  
*vyāpakāya namaḥ kukṣī keśavāyodaraṃ namaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*trailokyajanakāyeti evaṃ saṃpūjayeddharim \|*  
*sarvādhipataye jaṃghe pādau sarvātmane namaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

8-11. The image should then be bathed, plastering the white sandal paste to the figure. Two white costumes should be offered to the image, besides an umbrella and a pair of shoes, reciting the mantra- Om Namo-bhagavate vasudevaya, his head should be touched. Then uttering the verse, Sridharaya namah, base should be touched. Saying Krsnaya namah the neck; saying Srimate namah chest; uttering Sarvastradharine namah, the arms; uttering Vyapakaya namah, the lap; by Kesavaya namah the belly and saying Trailokyajanakaye namah, the whole body should be touched. Then uttering Sarvadhipataye namah, the thighs should be touched; the feet should be touched uttering Sarvatmane namah.

## \|\| 3.75.12-15 \|\|

*anena vidhinā rājanpuṣpairdhūpaiḥ samarcayet \|*  
*tatastasyāgrato deyaṃ naivedyaṃ ghṛtapācitam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sodakāṃśca navānkuṃbhāñchaktyā dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ saṃpūjya gorvidaṃ jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

*prabhāte vimale snātvā saṃpūjya garuḍadhvajam \|*  
*puṣpadhūpādinaivedyaiḥ phalairvastraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ \|*  
*tataḥ puṣpāṃjaliṃ baddhvā maṃtrametamudīrayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*namo namaste govinda budhaśravaṇa saṃjñaka \|*  
*aghaughasaṃkṣayaṃ kṛtvā sarvasaukhyaprado bhava \|\| 15 \|\|*

12-15. O king, by this way, the flowers, incense etc. should be offered to him in order to please him. Then ghi eatables should also be given as per one’s means. Thus worshipping the god Govinda, one should keep himself awake during the night. Lord Visnu should then be offered the flowers, incense, lamp, eatables, fruits and excellent costumes. Then flowers held in both the hands should be placed before him and he should then beg forgiveness, saying- “O Govinda, with the association of Wednesday as well as Sravana constellation, salutation to you again and again. You destroy ali my sins and bestow comforts on me.”

## \|\| 3.75.16-17 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya goviṃda brāhmaṇaṃ pūjayettataḥ \|*  
*anaṃtaraṃ brāhmaṇe vai vedavedāṃtapārage \|*  
*purāṇajñe viśeṣeṇa vidhivatsaṃpradāpayet \|\| 16 \|\|*

*dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇe yukte aśeṣāhaskarānvite \|*  
*karakaṃ saṃgame snātvā prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. After thus worshipping Govinda, one should worship the Brahmana, who should be well-versed in the Vedas as well as the Puranas, and all the articles of worship should be handed over to him. On the bright twelfth moon day falling in the Sravana constellation and on Wednesday, the aforesaid Brahmana should be bathed with kamandalu and should say- “Let lord Janardana be pleased with me.”

## \|\| 3.75.18-21 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*atrāpyudāharaṃtīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam \|*  
*mahatyaraṇye yadvṛttaṃ bhūmipāla śṛṇuṣva tat \|\| 18 \|\|*

*deśo daśārṇako nāma tasya bhāge tu paścime \|*  
*asti kaścinmarudeśaḥ sarvasattvabhayaṃkaraḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*sutaptasikatā bhūmiryatra duṣṭā mahoragāḥ \|*  
*alpacchāyadrumākīrṇo mṛtaprāṇi samākulaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*śamīkhadirapālāśakarīraiḥ pīlubhiḥ saha \|*  
*tatra bhīmā drumāḥ pārtha kaṃṭakaiḥ śabalā dṛḍhaiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

18-21. Sri Krsna said- O king, in this regard, there is an ancient story that relates to a thick forest. Whatever happened in that lonely forest, I am going to reveal the same to you. You please listen. In the Dasarna country’s western region, there is a vast desert in which all the living beings have to suffer enormously. The land is covered with sand and is always hot. Several wicked serpents can be seen there. The trees with little shade are always surrounded by the dead bodies. The trees of catechu, bamboos and thorny trees are found in a abundance there. The gigantic trees of the place are filled with thorns. One can find a large number of the burnt bodies there. But the Raksasas are unable to find food and water to drink. Some birds are found flying there occasionally.

## \|\| 3.75.22-24 \|\|

*dagdhaprāṇigaṇākīrṇā yatra bhūrddṛśyate kvacit \|*  
*annodakaṃ no labhaṃte rājaṃstatra balāhakāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*kadācidapi dṛśyaṃte bhrāmyanto hi vihagamāḥ \|*  
*vṛkṣāṃtaragatairnityaṃ śiśubhistṛṣitaiḥ samam \|*  
*utkṛttajīvitā rājandṛśyaṃte vihagottamāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tṛṣāturāśca sahasā mṛgāḥ saikatamāgatāḥ \|*  
*saikateṣveva naśyaṃti jalaṃ saikatasetuvat \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. The birds of that place took care of their young ones, in the hollows of the tree. When their young ones felt thirsty, the birds ended their lives. This had been a common sight. The householders also feeling thirsty, together with deer, got confused and wandered here and there in the sand in search of water at the place where the sand look like the time of dissolution, (which is misconceived as water) and everything gets destroyed.

## \|\| 3.75.25-27 \|\|

*tasmiṃstathāvidhe deśe kaściddaivavaśādvaṇik \|*  
*nijasārthaparibhraṣṭaḥ praviṣṭo marujāṃgale \|\| 25 \|\|*

*piśācānmalināṃstīkṣṇānnirmāṃsānbhīmadarśanān \|*  
*itastataḥ saṃcarato dadarśa vaṇiguttamaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*babhrāmodbhrāṃtahṛdayaḥ kṣuttṛṣābhramakarṣitaḥ \|*  
*kva grāmaḥ kva jalaṃ kvāhaṃ yāsyāmi na bubodha saḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. In such a type of the terrible desert, once a Vaisya, getting separated from his troopes, reached there while wandering in search of water. He looked dirty and his body was devoid of flesh and had a terrific form. He was mentally disturbed, wandered about freely in search of water and food. Because he could not get anything to eat or drink, he could not remain composed and kept on wandering here and there. He was ignorant of the presence of water in the region, besides he lost the sense of his direction even.

## \|\| 3.75.28-33 \|\|

*atha pretāndadarśāsau tṛṣṇāvyākuliteṃdriyān \|*  
*snāyubaddhāsthicaraṇānprekṣamāṇānitastataḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*pretaskaṃdhasamārūḍhamekaṃ pretaṃ dadarśa ha \|*  
*apaśyadbahubhiḥ pretaiḥ samaṃtātparivāritam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*āgacchantaṃ tamavyagraṃ srutuśabdapuraḥsaram \|*  
*pretaskaṃdhānmahīṃ gatvā tasyāṃtikamupāgamat \|\| 30 \|\|*

*sa dṛṣṭvātha vaṇikchreṣṭhamidaṃ vacanamabravīt \|*  
*asminvai nirjale deśe gamanaṃ bhavataḥ katham \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tamuvāca vaṇigdhīmānsārthabhraṣṭasya caiva me \|*  
*praveśo daivayogena pūrvakarmakṛtena tu \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tṛṣṇā māṃ bādhate'tyarthaṃ kṣuddunoti bhṛśaṃ tathā \|*  
*prāṇāḥ kaṃṭhamanuprāptā vacanaṃ naśyatīva me \|*  
*atropāyaṃ na paśyāmi jīveyaṃ yena kenacit \|\| 33 \|\|*

28-33. While suffering from hunger and fhirst, his limbs also started getting inactive. Getting confused and helpless, he found the pretas (goblins) who had been moving here and there. He found that one single preta was lying over the shoulders of another preta. Those pretas surrounded him from all the sides, creating strange sounds and were coming towards him. Getting down from the shoulder of the preta, the preta went close to the Vaisya and said to him- “How have you arrived here?” The intelligent Vaisya said- “As a move of the destiny, I have been separated from my companions, besides with the effect of mirage, I have reached here. I am badly suffering from hunger and thirst. My throat has dried up and I arn unable to speak. But no sign of survival is visible here.”

## \|\| 3.75.34-37 \|\|

*kṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ityevamukte pretastaṃ vaṇijaṃ vākyamabravīt \|*  
*puṃnāgamimamāśritya pratīkṣasva muhūrtakam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*kṛtātithyo yathālābhaṃ gamiṣyasi yathāsukham \|*  
*evamuktastathā cakre sa vaṇiktṛṣṇayārditaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*madhyāhnasamaye prāpte tatastaṃ deśamāgataḥ \|*  
*punnāgavṛkṣātkarako vāridhārāmanoramaḥ \|*  
*dadhyodanasamāyukto vardhamānena saṃyutaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*āgate karake tasminprādādatithaye tadā \|*  
*bhuktvānnaṃ ca jalaṃ pītvā vaṇiktuṣṭimupāgataḥ \|*  
*vitṛṣṇo vijvaraścaiva kṣaṇena samapadyata \|\| 37 \|\|*

34-37. Sri Krsna said- At these words of the Vaidya, the preta said- “You wait here under the shade of Punnaga tree. I shall just return. By me thus serving a guest, when accepted by you, then you can return to your desired place with comfort.” At these words of the preta, the Vaisya acted accordingly. He had arrived there in the noon. Under the shade of the tree, he received water in a kamandalu, besides the cooked rice with the curd, which kept on increasing as per the desire. The preta then offered the water and the cooked rice to the Vaisya. After taking food and water, Vaisya was extremely pleased. His fever resulting from hunger and thirst disappeared atonce.

## \|\| 3.75.38-47 \|\|

*tatastu pretasaṃghasya bhoktukāmasya vai dadau \|*  
*dadhyodadanaṃ sapānīyaṃ pretāstṛptiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*atithiṃ tarpayitvā ca pretalokaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ svayaṃ sa bubhuje bhuktaśeṣaṃ yathāsukham \|\| 39 \|\|*

*tasya bhuktavataścānnaṃ pānīyaṃ ca kṣayaṃ yayau \|*  
*pretādhipaṃ tatastṛpto vaṇigvacanamabravīt \|\| 40 \|\|*

*āścaryametatparamaṃ vane'sminpratibhāti me \|*  
*annapānasya samprāptiḥ paramasya kutastava \|\| 41 \|\|*

*stokena ca tathānnena bibharṣi subahūnpṛthak \|*  
*tṛptāḥ paraṃ kathaṃ tvete nirmāṃsā bhinnaku kṣayaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*aparaṃ ca kathaṃ ceha mama pāpaparikṣayaḥ \|*  
*hastāvalaṃbanakastvaṃ samprāpto nirjane vane \|*  
*tṛptaścāsi kathaṃ grāsamātreṇa ca śubhavrata \|\| 43 \|\|*

*kastvamasyāṃ sughorāyāmaṭavyāṃ tu kṛtālayaḥ \|*  
*tametaṃ saṃśayaṃ chiṃdhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama \|\| 44 \|\|*

*evamuktaḥ sa vāṇijyā preto vacanamabravīta \|*  
*śṛṇu bhadra pravakṣyāmi duṣkṛtaṃ karma cātmanaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*śākale nagare ramye ahamāsaṃ sudurmatiḥ \|*  
*vāṇijyāsaktitaḥ pūrvaṃ kālo nīto mayānagha \|\| 46 \|\|*

*dhanalobhānmayā tatra kadācicca pramādinā \|*  
*na dattā bhikṣave bhikṣā tṛṣṇayā pīḍitāya ca \|\| 47 \|\|*

38-47.Thereafter, the preta served the boiled rice as well as curd with water to the other pretas, which satisfied them as well. Thereafter, the chief of the pretas, after serving food to all the other pretas, himself took his food. Feeling extremely satisfied, the Vaisya said to the leader of the pretas- “I feel extremely surprised as to how could you procure, such a tasteful food in this desert and from the same small quantity of food, you could satisfy the hunger of all the pretas individually, besides protecting them. How these pretax with different types of bellies could be satisfied? In this lonely desert, how could my sins be removed, as a result of which I could achieve your help? Who are you and where from have you arrived here? How could you be satisfied with a single morsel of the cooked rice? Who are you, living in this awful land? You kindly remove all my doubts, because I am quite anxious to know about the same.” When so enquired by the Vaisya, the preta said- “O noble one, I am revealing before you my misdeeds. O sinless one, in my earlier birth, I lived in the city of Sakala. My evil mind was always engaged in my business. Thus earning my livelihood, I had been quite greedy for earning more and more.

## \|\| 3.75.48-49 \|\|

*prativeśe ca tatrāsīdbrāhmaṇo guṇavānmama \|*  
*śravaṇadvādaśīyoge māsi bhādrapade tathā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*sa kadācinmayā sārdhaṃ toṣāṃ nāma nadīṃ yayau \|*  
*tasyāśca saṃgamaḥ puṇyo yatrāsīccandrabhāgayā \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. But a learned Brahmana, living in my neighborhood, on dvadasi of the month of Bhadrapada falling in the Sravana constellation, once went on pilgrimage to the river Tosa, where there is the pleasant confluence of the river Tosa and Candrabhaga.

## \|\| 3.75.50-54 \|\|

*caṃdrabhāgā somasutā toṣā caivārkanaṃdinī \|*  
*tayoḥ śītoṣṇasalilasaṃgamaḥ sumanoharaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*tattīrthavaramāsādya prātiveśyaḥ sa ca dvijaḥ \|*  
*śravaṇadvādaśīyoge snātaścaivamupoṣitaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*caṃdrabhāgātoṣayośca vāridhānyairnavairdṛḍhaiḥ \|*  
*dadhyodanayutaiḥ sārdhaṃ sampūrṇairvardhamānakaiḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*chatropānadyugaṃ vastraṃ pratimāṃ vidhivaddhareḥ \|*  
*caṃdrabhāgājīvanena dadhyodanayutaṃ tadā \|\| 53 \|\|*

*etatkṛtvā gṛhaṃ prāptastataḥ kālena kenacit \|*  
*pañcatvamahamāsādya nāstikyātpretatāṃ gataḥ \|*  
*asyāmaṭavyāṃ ghorāyāṃ yathā dṛṣṭastvayānagha \|\| 54 \|\|*

50-54. Candrabhaga was the daughter of Soma, while the river Tosa was the daughter of the Sun god. At the confluence of both the river, the water is warm as well as cool. The Brahmana reached the place of pilgrimage, took his bath at the confluence of the rivers, observed all the regulations of the vrata and then gave away the best of rice and the curd, besides the shoes and the costumes, while adoring the beautiful image of Visnu there, worshipping it at the same time. Then with the water of the river Candrabhaga, he took cooked rice and curd which save the life, and returned to his abode. In due course of time, I met with my end. Because of my being an atheist, I achieved the position of a preta. 0 sinless one, I am wandering in the forest since my death, as you find me now.

## \|\| 3.75.55-56 \|\|

*brahmasvahāriṇastvete pāpāḥ pretatvamāgatāḥ \|*  
*paradāraratāḥ kecitsvāmidroharatāḥ pare \|\| 55 \|\|*

*mitradroharatāḥ keciddeśe'smiṃstu sudāruṇe \|*  
*mamaite bhṛtyatāṃ yātā annapānakṛtena ca \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56.These sinful souls, who stole the belongings of the Brahmanas, also achieved the position of pretas. Among them are those, who enjoyed the wives of other, some have cheated their masters, or others had betrayed their friends. As a result of this, they are dwelling in this region. Since I serve them with food and drinks, they have become my servants.

## \|\| 3.75.57-59 \|\|

*akṣayyo bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ \|*  
*yaddīyate tamuddiśya akṣayyaṃ tatprakīrtitam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*mayā vihīnāḥ kiṃ tvete vane'sminbhṛśadāruṇe \|*  
*pīḍāmanubhaviṣyaṃti dāruṇāṃ karmayonijām \|\| 58 \|\|*

*eteṣāṃ tvaṃ mahābhāga mamānugrahakāmyayā \|*  
*anekanāmagotrāṇi gṛhāṇa lekhanena ca \|\| 59 \|\|*

57-59. Krsna - the supreme soul, is imperishable, eternal and everlasting. Whatever is given for his sake, it also becomes everlasting. In this terrific desert, all the pretas shall feel miserable without me. О excellent one, by being graceful on me, you mention several names and gotras.

## \|\| 3.75.60-61 \|\|

*astu kakṣāgatā caiva tava saṃpuṭikā śubhā \|*  
*himavatyāṃ tathāsādya tatra tvaṃ lapsyase nidhim \|\| 60 \|\|*

*gayāśīrṣe tato gatvā śrāddhaṃ kuru mahāmate \|*  
*ekamekamathoddiśya pretaṃpretaṃ yathāsukham \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. Then reaching the region of Himalaya, you shall achieve enormous treasure. О great soul, reaching the holy place of Gaya, you perform Sraddha in favour of each one of the pretas, uttering their individual names and the gotras.”

## \|\| 3.75.62 \|\|

*evaṃ sambhāṣamāṇo'sau taptajāṃbūnadaprabhaḥ \|*  
*vimānavaramāruhya svargalokamito gataḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. The leader of the pretas while he was so talking with Vaisya, the body of the former, turned pleasant like the gold. Suddenly, he mounted over an excellent plane and proceeded on to the heaven.

## \|\| 3.75.63-66 \|\|

*svargate pretanāthe tu prabhāvātsa vaṇikpumān \|*  
*nāmagotrāṇi saṃgṛhya prayātaḥ sa himācalam \|\| 63 \|\|*

*tatra prāpya nidhiṃ gatvā vinikṣipya svake gṛhe \|*  
*dhanabhāgamupādāya gayāśīrṣavaṭaṃ yayau \|*  
*pretānāṃ kramaśastatra cakre śrāddhaṃ dinedine \|\| 64 \|\|*

*yasyayasya gayāśrāddhaṃ sa karoti dine vaṇik \|*  
*sa ca tasya sadā svapne darśayatyātmanastanum \|\| 65 \|\|*

*bravīti ca mahābhāga prasādena tavānagha \|*  
*pretabhāvo mayā tyaktaḥ prāptosmi paramāṃ gatim \|\| 66 \|\|*

63-66. After departure of the pretaraja to the heaven, the Vaisya was immensely impressed with the same. The Vaisya went to Gaya and offered p indas in favour of all the pretas, uttering the names and gotras of each one of them. Then he proceeded on to the Himalaya, where he found the enormous treasure, which was securely placed by him in his house. He again went to Gaya and reaching there, he started performing Sraddha for each one of the pretas daily. The Vaisya, whenever performed Sraddha, the related preta used to appear before him displaying the divine body he had received after his preta body and used to say-“O excellent sinless one, by you grace, getting relieved of the position of a preta, I have now achieved an excellent position.”

## \|\| 3.75.67-71 \|\|

*sa kṛtvā dhanalobhācca pretānāṃ satkṛtiṃ vaṇik \|*  
*jagāma svagṛhaṃ tatra māsi bhādrapade tathā \|\| 67 \|\|*

*śravaṇadvādaśīyoge pūjayitvā janārdanam \|*  
*dānaṃ ca dattvā viprebhyaḥ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*mahānadīsaṃgameṣu prativarṣaṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*cakāra vidhivaddānaṃ tato diṣṭāṃtamāgataḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*avāpa paramaṃ sthānaṃ durlabhaṃ cātra mānavaiḥ \|*  
*yatra kāmaphalā vṛkṣā nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ \|*  
*śītalāmalapānīyāḥ puṣkariṇyo manoharāḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*taṃ deśamāsādya vaṇiṅ mahātmā sutaptajāṃbūnadabhūṣitāṃgaḥ \|*  
*kalpaṃ samagraṃ saha sundarībhiḥ svarge sa reme muditaḥ sadaiva \|\| 71 \|\|*

67-71. Thus, the Vaisya made all the pretas to achieve the excellent position, and then proceeded on to his house. О Yudhi$(hira, every year on the dvadasi of the month of Bhadrapada, at the confluence of the river Mahanadi, Vaisya used to take his bath appropriately in the Sravana constellation and observed fast. Thereafter, he worshipped lord Janardana in an appropriate manner and charities were given to the Brahmanas. One who does so regularly, he achieves such a high position which is beyond the reach of a human being. There are trees which grant all his wishes. There are rivers filled with payasam, the step-wells are filled with cool water and cool breeze always blows there. Reaching the excellent place, the noble Vaisya enjoyed sports with the beautiful damsels, adorned with the ornaments of the best of gold.

## Chapter 76. Vijaya Sravana Dvadasi

## \|\| 3.76.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*dvādaśyāste vidhiḥ proktaḥ śrāvaṇe yo yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*sarvapāpapraśamanaḥ sarvasaukhyapradāyakaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*ekādaśī yadā sā syācchravaṇena samanvitā \|*  
*vijayā sā tithiḥ proktā bhaktānāṃ vijayapradā \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sri Krsna said- When the vrata of Sravana Dvadasi is observed in an appropriate manner, it results in the destruction of all the sins and it bestows enormous pleasures on earth. Similarly, the Ekadasi vrata also bestows the victory over the devotees, and is called as Vijaya tithi (the moon day of victory).

## \|\| 3.76.3-4 \|\|

*balavānajito daityo balirnāmā mahābalaḥ \|*  
*tena devagaṇāḥ sarve tyājitāḥ suramaṃdiram \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tato devā mahāviṣṇuṃ gatvā vacanamūcire \|*  
*tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvadevānāṃ śīghraṃ kaṣṭātsamuddhara \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. The gods having been defeated by the valorous daitya king Bali, left their abodes and went to lord Mahavisnu and said to him “O strong armed one, you are the real movement of the gods like us, therefore, you relieve us from the state of misery in which we have fallen. O destroyer of Bali, the killing of Bali -the king of daityas should take place urgently.”

## \|\| 3.76.5-9 \|\|

*jahi daityaṃ mahābāho baliṃ balaniṣūdana \|*  
*śrutvā viṣṇustadā vākyaṃ devānāṃ karuṇodayam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*uvāca vākyaṃ kālajño devānāṃ hitakāmyayā \|*  
*jāne vairocaniṃ daityaṃ baliṃ trailokyakaṇṭakam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tapasā bhāvitātmānaṃ śāntaṃ dāntaṃ jitendriyam \|*  
*madbhaktaṃ madgataprāṇaṃ satyasandhaṃ mahābalam \|*  
*tapasontaḥ subahunā kāle nāsya bhaviṣyati \|\| 7 \|\|*

*yadā vinayasampannaṃ jñāsye kālena kenacit \|*  
*samāhṛtya priyaṃ tasya tadā dāsye divaukasām \|\| 8 \|\|*

*aditirmāṃ prapannā vai putrārthe putralobhinī \|*  
*tasyāmatihitaṃ devāḥ kariṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

5-9. Listening to the pathetic words of the gods, lord Visnu, who is aware of all the times, spoke for the welfare of the gods- “I am well aware of Virocana - the king of the daityas. He happens to be a great thorn of the universe. With the performing of the great tapas, he has made himself quite peaceful, sanctified, truthful, having enormous strength. He happens to be a great devotee of mine, who remains absolved in my devotion alone. Therefore, all the learned people are interested in the decline of his tapas. I shall therefore, work out a method. With a humble approach, I shall usurp all his favorite things and then give them over to the gods. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.76.10 \|\|

*taddevānāṃ hitaṃ sarve cāhitaṃ tu suradviṣām \|*  
*tadgacchadhvaṃ nirudvignāḥ kālaḥ kaścitpratīkṣyatām \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. In my move, the welfare of the gods would be hidden and decline for the Raksasas - the enemies of the gods. Therefore, you come along, without being restless and wait for the opportune time.” At these words of lord Visnu, the gods departed from that place.

## \|\| 3.76.11 \|\|

*evamuktā gatā devāḥ kāryaṃ viṣṇuraciṃtayat \|*  
*sā cintayitvā suciraṃ devyā garbhāvatāraṇam \|*  
*aditirvarayāmāsa vāṃchitaṃ me bhaviṣyati \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. But lord Visnu started thinking about the performing of the task of the gods. Then he thought of entering the womb of the mother Aditi. It came to his mind that Aditi had desired to have him as her son. The task of the gods could be established then. This is what he resolved.

## \|\| 3.76.12-14 \|\|

*atha kāle bahutithe gate sā garbhiṇī hyabhūt \|*  
*suṣuve navame māsi putraṃ sā vāmanaṃ harim \|\| 12 \|\|*

*hrasvapādaṃ hrasvakāyaṃ mahacchirasamarbhakam \|*  
*pāṇipādodarakṛśaṃ svayaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim \|\| 13 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā tu vāmanaṃ jātaṃ yadi sā vaktumudyatā \|*  
*niruddhavākyā hyabhavadvaktuṃ kiṃcinna pāritam \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. After the passing of considerable time, Aditi conceived on the ninth month and gave birth to the form of the lord, which had short feet and the body, great head, thin hands and feet, while the belly was decorated. Giving birth to the lord in a dwarf form, Aditi wanted to speak something to the child, but because of her choked throat, she could speak nothing.

## \|\| 3.76.15-18 \|\|

*ekādaśyāṃ bhādrapade śravaṇena narottama \|*  
*saṃcacāla mahī jāte vāmane tu trivikrame \|\| 15 \|\|*

*bhayaṃ babhūva daityānāṃ devānāṃ toṣa ābhavat \|*  
*jātakarmādikāṃstasya saṃskārānsvayameva hi \|\| 16 \|\|*

*cakāra kaśyapo dhīmānprajāpatiranudyataḥ \|*  
*ābaddhamekhalo daṃḍī dhṛtvā yajñopavītakam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kuśasvacchodakadharaḥ kamaṃḍaluvibhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*balerbalavato yajñaṃ jagāma bahuvistaram \|\| 18 \|\|*

15-18. O best of humans, on the day of Ekadasi in the month of Bhadrapada falling in the Sravana constellation, Trivikrama-Vamana incarnated on earth, there had been an earthquake that time and the daityas were frightened, while the gods were delighted. Prajapati Kasyapa the graceful one, himself performed his name giving ceremony in an appropriate way. Binding him with a chain, he made him wear a yajnopavita. He is decorated with kusa and kamandalu in his hands. Lord Vamana then proceeded towards the place of yajna of daityaraja Bali just for an audience.

## \|\| 3.76.19-21 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā balimathovāca vāmano'bhyetya tatkṣaṇam \|*  
*atha cāha yajñapate dīyatāṃ mama medinī \|\| 19 \|\|*

*pādatrayapramāṇena paṭhanārthe sthito hyasi \|*  
*dattādattā tava mayā baliḥ prāha dvijottamam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tato varddhitumārabdho vāmano'naṃtavikramaḥ \|*  
*pādau bhūmau pratiṣṭhāpya śirasāvṛtya rodasī \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. Reaching there, he atonce said to Bali- “0 master of the yajna, you grant me a land of the length of my three feet, because you are about to pronounce a charity.” On hearing these words, Bali said to the Brahmana- “I shall delightfully give over to you the land desired by you. Thereafter, Vamana Deva, possessing the enormous strength, suddenly expanded his body. His both the feet were on earth, but the head touched the sky.

## \|\| 3.76.22-23 \|\|

*tābhyāmiṃdrādikāṃllokāṃllalāṭe brahmaṇaḥ padam \|*  
*na tṛtīya padaṃ lebhe tato nedurdivaukasaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ siddhā devarṣayastathā \|*  
*sādhusādhviti deveśaṃ praśaśaṃsurmudānvitāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Then terrifying even the abode of Indra, Brahma was lodged over the forehead. Thus, when he could not get the land for his third foot, the gods started playing on the musical instruments. The Siddhas and Devarsis were extremely surprised at this event. All of them delightfully uttered “Well done,” “Well done”, praising him at the same time.

## \|\| 3.76.24-28 \|\|

*tato daityagaṇānsarvāñjitvā tribhuvanaṃ vaśī \|*  
*balimāha tato gaccha sutalaṃ svabalānugaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*tatra tvamīpsitānbhogānbhuktvā madbāhupālitaḥ \|*  
*asyeṃdrasyāvasāne tu tvamevendro bhaviṣyasi \|\| 25 \|\|*

*evamukto baliḥ prāyānnamaskṛtya narottamam \|*  
*visṛjyemaṃ baliṃ devānsakalānsa uvāca ha \|\| 26 \|\|*

*svāni dhiṣṇyāni gacchadhvaṃ tiṣṭhadhvaṃ vigata jvarāḥ \|*  
*devenoktā gatā devā hṛṣṭāḥ saṃpūjya vāmanam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*devaḥ kṛtvā jagatkāryaṃ tatraivāṃtarddhimāgamat \|*  
*etatsarvaṃ samabhavadekādaśyāṃ narādhipa \|*  
*teneṣṭā devadevasya sarvadā vijayā tithiḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

24-28. Then gaining control of all the three Iokas, the disciplined Vamana Deva defeated the daityas and said to Bali- “You better live with your people in the nether world, where the present Indra is killed at my hands. You would achieve the position of Indra.” Bali accepted the command of Vamana. Thereafter, Yamana Deva said to the gods- “You go to your respective abodes and be comfortable there. At these words of the lord, the gods worshipped Vamana Deva with delight and then disappeared from the place. O best of the humans, the entire event happened on the day of ekadasi, therefore this particular moon day (tithi) is highly favourite of the gods.

## \|\| 3.76.29-36 \|\|

*eṣā vai phālgune māsi puṣyeṇa sahitā nṛpa \|*
