*vijayā procyate sadbhiḥ koṭikoṭiguṇottarā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*ekādaśyāṃ sopavāso rātrau saṃpūjayeddharim \|*  
*raupye sauvarṇapātre vā dāruvaṃśamaye'pi vā \|\| 30 \|\|*

*kuṃḍikāṃ sthāpayetpārśve chatraṃ vai pāduke tathā \|*  
*śubhāṃ ca vaiṣṇavīṃ yaṣṭiṃ tathā sūtrakamaḍalū \|\| 31 \|\|*

*ācchādya pātraṃ vāsobhiḥ phalaiścāpi suśobhanaiḥ \|*  
*mārgacārmaṇagandhaiśca bhaktyā vā mṛgacarmaṇā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tilāḍhakena vittāḍhyaḥ prasthena kuḍavena vā \|*  
*vrīhibhirvātha godhūmaiḥ phalaiḥ śuklatilairbhavet \|\| 33 \|\|*

*puṣpairgaṃdhairdhūpadīpaiḥ pakvānnai rarcayeddharim \|*  
*nānāvidhaiśca naivedyairbhakṣyabhojyairguḍaudanaiḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*svasvavittānusāreṇa sahiraṇyaṃ ca kārayet \|*  
*maṃtraiḥ śataguṇaṃ caiva bhaktyā lakṣa guṇottaram \|*  
*bhaktimāṃśca guṇopetaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇottaram \|\| 35 \|\|*

*ebhirmaṃtrapadaistatra pūjayedgaruḍadhvajam \|*  
*upahārairnaraśreṣṭha śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

29-36. O long, the tithi in the month of Phalguna at the time of Pusya constellation is also called as the Vijaya-tithi, which in due course of time bestows crore times more merit. Keeping a fast on the day of ekadasi, lord Visnu should be consecrated in gold, silver, wood or the bamboo vase, beautifully. Besides the image, an umbrella, wooden sandals, a beautiful Vaisnavi stick, a yajnopavita and a kamandalu should be placed covered with cloth, the best of fruits, musk-deer or the deer skin, a vase filled with sesamum seeds, cereals or the wheat, white sesamum, flower, scent, incense, lamp, fried food, several types of eatables, sweet boiled rice and gold as per one’s means, should be given away in charity. Then lord Visnu should be worshipped with utmost faith and devotion, reciting the Sataguna etc. mantras. By so doing, one achieves a hundred times, or a lakh of times or crores of times more merits. The lord having the vehicle of Garuda, should be graced by offering several other presents.

## \|\| 3.76.37-38 \|\|

*oṃ jalajopamadehāya jalajāsyāya śaṃkhine \|*  
*jalarāśisvarūpāya namaste puruṣottama \|\| 37 \|\|*

*namaḥ kamalanābhāya namaste jala śāyine \|*  
*namaste keśavānaṃta vāsudeva namo'stu te \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Meditating with purity, one should devote himself to the lord, having lotus like body and face, who is holder of conch and disc, the form of water, lord Purusottama, also known as Kesava, Ananta and Vesudeva and should be offered salutation again and again reciting the above menioned mantras.

## \|\| 3.76.39 \|\|

*malayeṣu samutpannaṃ gandhāḍhayaṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*mayā niveditaṃ tubhyaṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvara \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Then a mantra should be uttered, which means- “I bow in reverence to the lord offering the sandal paste which was made in the Gandhadhya country. О Paramesvara, you kindly accept the same.”

## \|\| 3.76.40 \|\|

*vanaspatisamutpannaṃ gandhāḍhyaṃ sumanoharam \|*  
*mayā niveditaṃ puṣpaṃ gṛhāṇa puruṣottama \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. After offering the sandal paste, the devotee should say- “O Puru$ottama! I am offering the fragrant flowers”, and the garland of flowers should be offered.

## \|\| 3.76.41 \|\|

*namaḥ kamalakiṃjalkapītanirmalavāsase \|*  
*manoharavapuḥskandhadhṛtacakrāya śārṅgiṇe \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Salutation to the lord who is clad in yellow garments, resembling the saffron, having a charming body and the shoulders, holder of a Cakra and Sarnga bow. This is the mantra for the puja.

## \|\| 3.76.42-43 \|\|

*matsyaḥ kūrmo varā haśca nārasiṃhaśca vāmanaḥ \|*  
*rāmo rāmaśca kṛṣṇaśca nāmabhirvāmanāya te \|*  
*pādādyaikaikāṃgasya pūjanaṃ śīrṣagaṃ tataḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*dhūpo'yaṃ devadeveśa śaṃkhacakragadādhara \|*  
*acyutānaṃta govinda vāsudeva namo'stu te \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. Then uttering the names of Matsya, Kurma, Varaha, Narasimha, Vamana, Rama, Parasurama, Krsna, all the limbs of the body, from head to foot should be adored, saying-“O god of gods, holder of 3arikha, Cakra, Gada, also known as Acyuta, Ananta, Govinda and Vasudeva, salutation to you.”

## \|\| 3.76.44 \|\|

*tvameva pṛthivī jyotirvāyurākāśameva ca \|*  
*tvameva jyotiṣāṃ jyotirdīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Then reciting- Prthivi, Jyoti, Vayu, Akasa, one should offer a lamp and say- “You are the light of all the jyotisa. You kindly accept this lamp.

## \|\| 3.76.45-48 \|\|

*annaṃ caturvidhaṃ svādu rasaiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ samanvitam \|*  
*bhakṣyabhojyasamāyuktaṃ prasīda parameśvara \|\| 45 \|\|*

*annaṃ prajāpatirviṣṇū rudreṃdraśaśibhāskarāḥ \|*  
*annaṃ tvaṣṭā yamo'gniśca pāpaṃ haratu me'vyayaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*jagadādirjagadūpamanādirjagadaṃtakṛt \|*  
*jalāśayo jagadyoniḥ prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*anekakarmanirbaṃdhadhvaṃsinaṃ jala śāyinam \|*  
*nato'smi mathurāvāsaṃ mādhavaṃ madhusūdanam \|\| 48 \|\|*

45-48. Besides, I am also offering the tasteful food with six types of rasas (juices) to the lord. Let the Paramesvara be pleased with me. Let Prajapati, Visnu, Rudra, Indra, Sasi, Bhaskara, Tvasta, Yama, Agni and all other gods, besides lord Janardana who is the саше of the universe, who is source of all waters, be pleased with me. Salutation to the destroyer of several of the bondages of the deeds, who sleeps in the ocean of milk, dweller of Mathura and Madhusudana.

## \|\| 3.76.49-52 \|\|

*namo vāmanarūpāya namaste'stu trivikrama \|*  
*namaste maṇibandhāya vāsudeva namo'stu te \|\| 49 \|\|*

*namo namaste govinda vāmaneśa trivikrama \|\| 50 \|\|*

*aghaughasaṃkṣayaṃ kṛtvā sarvakāmaprado bhava \|\| 51 \|\|*

*sarvagaḥ sarvadeveśaḥ śrīdharaḥ śrīniketanaḥ \|*  
*viśveśvaraśca viṣṇuśca śrīśāyī ca namonamaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

49-52. Salutation also to Trivikrama form of Vamana. Salutation to Vasudeva, bound with the bondage of Manibandha. Let him kindly grant me all my wishes, destroying all my sins. Thus begging forgiveness, one should also offer salutation to the all pervading lord of all, Sridhara, Sriniketana, Visvesvara, Visnu and Srisayi.

## \|\| 3.76.53-55 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya yo rātrāvekādaśyāṃ nṛpottama \|*  
*jāgaraṃ tatra kurvīta gītavāditranisvanaiḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*yā ca śravaṇasaṃyuktā dvādaśī paramā tithiḥ \|*  
*tasyāṃ ca saṃgame snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 54 \|\|*

*evaṃ saṃpūjya yatnena prabhāte vimale sati \|*  
*pradeyaṃ śāstraviduṣe brāhmaṇāya ca maṃtrataḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

53-55. Thus uttering the mantra, the image should be made to sleep. О best of the humans, thus on the night of ekadasi, worship of the lord should be performed throughout the night, by singing and dancing in company with the music. At the time of dvadasi, one should take bath at the confluence of rivers, whereby he gets relieved of all the sins. During the morning, the white costumes should be given over to the Brahmanas, with the reciting of the mantras.

## \|\| 3.76.56-57 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaścāpi mantreṇa pratigṛhṇīta maṃtravat \|*  
*vāmano'sya pratigrāhī vāmanāya namonamaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*oṃ guhye \|*  
*oṃ śirasi \|*  
*oṃ pādayoḥ \|*  
*oṃ nābhau \|*  
*oṃ bhujayoḥ \|*  
*oṃ sarvāṃge \|*  
*sarvātmane namaḥ \|*  
*puṣpaṃ phalaṃ ca naivedyaṃ sarvametadyathāvidhi \|*  
*naro dadyādupoṣyaivamekādaśyāṃ samaṃtrakam \|\| 57 \|\|*

56-57. The Brahmanas should also receive the same, with the chanting of the mantras. Salutation to the receiver who is the form of Vamana. Chanting Omkara, then one should touch his private parts, head, feet, navel, arms besides all other limbs and say- “Salutation to the universal soul. Thus chanting, the flowers, fruit, sandal paste and eatables should be offered. Then observing fast on the day of ekadasi, the lord should be worshipped, reciting the mantras.

## \|\| 3.76.58 \|\|

*pūrvoktavidhinā prātarbhojanaṃ pṛṣadājyakam \|*  
*pūrvaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paścādbhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. In the early morning, the Brahmanas should, first of all, be served with food mixed with ghi. The devotee should take his food thereafter the beauty and fortunes, enjoying long life, free from ailments. He has enough of sons and lives upto the age of a hundred years.

## \|\| 3.76.59 \|\|

*bhūyobhūyo'pi rājeṃdra sarvatraivaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*samāpte tu vrate rājanyatpuṇyaṃ tannibodha me \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. О Rajendra, the worship of the lord Sarvesa should be performed accordingly. Thus at the end of the vrata, the merit one earns, is going to be spoken by me.

## \|\| 3.76.60-62 \|\|

*caturyugāni rājeṃdra ekasaptatisaṃkhyayā \|*  
*prāpya viṣṇupure rājankrīḍate kālamakṣayam \|\| 60 \|\|*

*ihāgatya bhavedrājā pratipakṣakṣayaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*hastyaśvarathapattīnāṃ dātā bhoktā vimatsarī \|\| 61 \|\|*

*rūpasaubhāgyasaṃpanno dīrghāyurnīrujo bhavet \|*  
*putraiḥ parivṛto jīvo jīvecca śaradaḥ śatam \|\| 62 \|\|*

60-62. О best of humans, the performer of the vrata enjoys delightful sports for a period equivalent to seventy one caturyugas in the Visnuloka and after enjoying all the comforts there, he becomes a terrific king on earth, who is the destroyer of the enemies. He possesses the elephants, horses, chariots, foot soldiers, besides being the giver of charities, enjoys all the comforts, free from jealousy, possessing

## \|\| 3.76.63-65 \|\|

*etasyāḥ phalamākhyātamekādaśyā mayā tava \|*  
*pūrvameva samākhyātā dvādaśī śravaṇānvitā \|\| 63 \|\|*

*upoṣyaikādaśīṃ paścāddvādaśīmapyupoṣayet \|*  
*na cātra vidhilopaḥ syādubhayordevatā hariḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

*budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā dvādaśī saṃgamodakam \|*  
*dānaṃ dadhyodanaṃ satyamupavāsaḥ paro vidhiḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

63-65. Thus, I have spoken to you everything about this Dvadasi vrata and for its doing, there is no procedural blemish. For performing the vrata of ekadasi, one should keep fast on the earlier day and without breaking it, he should observe another fast on the next day, then there occurs no blemish at all, because, the god in both the cases is the same i.e. lord Visnu. There is an idea of Eka-vrata-dvaya-siddhi, which means that for the performing of the same vrata by fasting in the earlier day, when another fast is undertaken on the next day, without breaking the earlier fast, no blemish is attracted, when the related god is the same. Therefore, on the day of dvadasi falling on Wednesday in the Havana constellation, one should take bath in the water at the confluence of the river, and truthfully give away the cooked rice and curd in charity, which is said to be the best.

## \|\| 3.76.66 \|\|

*sagareṇa kakutsthena dhuṃdhumāreṇa gādhinā \|*  
*etaiścānyaiśca rājeṃdra kṛtaṃ vai dvādaśīvratam \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. O Rajendra, the kings known by the names of Sagara, Kakutstha, Dhundhumara and Gadhi had performed the vrata of Dvadasi.

## \|\| 3.76.67 \|\|

*sā dvādaśī budhayutā śravaṇena sākaṃ syādvai jayāya kathitā ṛṣibhirnabhasye \|*  
*tāmādareṇa samupoṣya naro'maratvaṃ prāpnoti pārtha aṇimādiguṇopapannam \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. O Partha, during the month of Bhadrapada the bright dvadasi falling in Havana constellation on Wednesday, on that particular day when a person observes a fast, he achieves all the Siddhis, becomes eternal, because the Rsis have declared it as a victorious Moon day or tithi.

## Chapter 77. Samprapti-Dvadasi-Vrata

## \|\| 3.77.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*kṛṣṇapakṣe tu pauṣasya saṃprāptaṃ dvādaśīvratam \|*  
*pauṣādipāraṇaṃ māsaiḥ ṣaḍbhirjyeṣṭhāṃtikaṃ smṛtam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*prathamaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ nāma kṛṣṇasya gīyate \|*  
*dvitīyaṃ mādhavākhyaṃ tu viśvarūpaṃ tu phālgune \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sri Krsna said- On the twelfth dark moon day of the month of Patina, the vrata should be started and continued upto the month of Jyestha. I am going to narrate the method of the breaking of the fast during these months. During the first month, the fast should be broken with the chanting of the name of Pumjarikaksa. During the second month, the name of Madhava has to the recited. During Phalguna, the name Visvarupa should he uttered.

## \|\| 3.77.3 \|\|

*puruṣottamākhyaṃ tu tataḥ paṃcame'cyutasaṃjñakam \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhe jayeti deveśa guhyanāma prakīrtitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. During the fourth month of Caitra, Purusottama should be recited; during the fifth month. Ananta should be recited and in the sixth month, Devesa should be recited.

## \|\| 3.77.4-6 \|\|

*pūrvokteṣu ca māseṣu snānaprāśana yostilāḥ \|*  
*āṣāḍhādiṣu māseṣu paṃcagavyamudāhṛtam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*snānaṃ ca prāśanaṃ caiva paṃcagavyaṃ sadeṣyate \|*  
*pūjayetpuṃḍarīkākṣaṃ testaireva ca nāmabhiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*pratimāsaṃ ca deveśa kṛtvā pūjāṃ yathāvidhi \|*  
*viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyācchraddadhānaśca bhaktitaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. As described earlier, one should take bath with the water in which the sesamum seeds are mixed. During the month of Asadha, one should break the fast using pancagavya and also have bath with the water mixed with the same. By reciting the names of the lord, his worship should be performed appropriately in each month, giving food and daksina to the Brahmanas, begging forgiveness at the same time.

## \|\| 3.77.7-8 \|\|

*pāraṇaṃ caiva deveśa prīṇanaṃ bhaktipūrvakam \|*  
*kurvīta bhaktyā goviṃdasadbhāvenārcanaṃ yataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*naktaṃ bhuṃjīta satataṃ tailakṣāravivarjitam \|*  
*ekādaśyāmupoṣyaivaṃ dvādaśyāmatha vā dine \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Thus adoring Govinda appropriately with all devotion, one should take food during the night, without oil or salt. While performing this vrata, fast should be observed on ekadasi as well as dvadasi.

## \|\| 3.77.9-10 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte yadabhipretamātmanaḥ \|*  
*dhanaṃ vasu hiraṇyaṃ ca dhānyaṃ bhājanamāsanam \|*  
*śayyāṃ vā brāhmaṇe dadyātkeśavaḥ pratigṛhyatām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*etāmupoṣya vidhinā viṣṇuprītau ca tatparaḥ \|*  
*sarvānkāmānavāpnoti yadyadicchati cetasā \|*  
*tato lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ saṃprāptaṃ dvādaśīti vai \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Thus, at the end of the year, one should give away in charity gold, silver, cereals, vases, seats and bed to the Brihmanas, and should also recite “Let lord Kesava accept the same.” By doing worship of lord Visnu with this procedure on dvadasi, all the desires of his mind would be fulfilled and he earns glory in the world.

## \|\| 3.77.11-12 \|\|

*kṛtābhilaṣitā dṛṣṭā prārabdhā dharmatatparaiḥ \|*  
*pūrayedakhilānkāmānsaṃsmṛtā vā dinedine \|\| 11 \|\|*

*saṃprāptikāmupavasaṃti samīhitārthā ye mānavā manu japuṃgava viṣṇubhaktāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ samīhitaphalāni dadāti śaśvadvāsaḥ sureśabhavane bhagavatprasādāt \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. A person who is follower of dharma achieves all the desired results and his glory increases day by day. O best of humans, in case, a person performs the vrata of Samprapti-Dvadasi, by the grace of the lord, he achieves the desired success, besides stay in the abode of Indra forever.

## Chapter 78. Govinda Dvadasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.78.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*tathānyāmapi te vacmi goviṃda dvādaśīṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*tasyāḥ samyaganuṣṭhānātprāpnotyabhimataṃ phalam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*pauṣe māse site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*samyaksaṃpūjya govindaṃ nāmnā devamadhokṣajam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sri Krsna said- I am now going to speak to you about the process of performing the Govinda Dvadasi. You please listen to the same, with the appropriate completion of which, a person achieves whatever he desires. During the bright dvadasi of the month of Pausa, one should observe the fast. The figure of lord Govinda then should be made out of the sweet eatables. Then one should recite the name of Govinda with a concentrated mind.

## \|\| 3.78.3-4 \|\|

*dhūpapuṣpopacāraiśca naivedyaiśca samāhitaḥ \|*  
*goviṃdeti japennāma punastadgatamānasaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyathāśaktyā narādhipa \|*  
*svayaṃ vibuddhastulito goviṃdeti ca kīrtayet \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. O king, after offering naivedya along with flowers and incence to the lord and performing japam of Govinda, one should give away charities to the Brahmana as per one’s means and the name of Govinda should be recited with devotion.

## \|\| 3.78.5-6 \|\|

*pākhaṃḍibhirvikarmasthairālāpāṃśca vivarjayet \|*  
*gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ vāpi dadhi kṣīrama thāpi vā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*godohataḥ samudbhūtaṃ prāśnīyādātmaśuddhaye \|*  
*dvitīye'hni punaḥ snānaṃ tathaivābhyarcya keśavam \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. He should stop contact with the deplorable and the crafty people. On the first day, one should take the curd, milk, or milk foam which appears at the time of milking of the cow. Otherwise cow’s urine or cowdung should be used for the breaking of the fast and for the purification of the body.

## \|\| 3.78.7-8 \|\|

*tenaiva nāmnā saṃpūjya dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām \|*  
*tato bhuñjīta godohaṃ saṃbhūtena samudbhavam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*evamevākhilānmāsānupoṣya prayataḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*dadyādgavāhnikaṃ vidvānpratimāsaṃ tu śaktitaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. On the next day, reciting the same name, the same mantra should be recited. Lord Kesava should then be bathed, worshipped and the daksina should be given to a Brahmana. At the time of milking of a cow, the product made of cow’s milk should not be taken. In this way, one should fast on the dvadasi of every month and should worship Govinda.

## \|\| 3.78.9-10 \|\|

*pārite ca punarvaṣe govindaṃ padmayā saha \|*  
*govindaḥ prītimāyātu vratenānena me sadā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*viśeṣataḥ punardadyāttasminnahni gavāhnikam \|*  
*bhaktyā paramayā rājañchṛṇu yatphalamāpnuyāt \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. After the completion of one year, one should worship Laksmi and Govinda and then beg forgiveness- “With the performing of this vrata, let lord Govinda be always pleased with me.” O king, on that particular day, one should give away a cow in charity. By so doing, the merit he earns is being stated by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.78.11-12 \|\|

*svarṇaśṛṃgaṃ raupyakhuraṃ gośatairvṛṣabhaṃ varam \|*  
*iti māsaṃ dvijātibhyo dattvā yatphalamaśnute \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tadāpnotyakhilaṃ samyagvratametadupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*taṃ ca lokamavāpnoti govindo yatra tiṣṭhati \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. He earns the merit of giving away a hundred cows with their horns decorated with gold and the hoofs coated with silver. Enjoying all the pleasures on earth, he achieves the place of lord Govinda.

## \|\| 3.78.13 \|\|

*govindadvādaśīmetāṃ samupoṣya vidhānataḥ \|*  
*vidyotamānā dṛśyaṃte lokedyāpi śaśāṃkavat \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. With the performing of the vrata of Govinda-Dvadasi, the devotee is found shining like a god issuing lustre.

## \|\| 3.78.14 \|\|

*govindamarcayati gorasabhojanastu gā vai vinodayati tadvadgavāhnikaśca \|*  
*yo dvādaśīṣu kururāja kṛtopavāsaḥ prāpnotyasau surabhilokamapetaśokam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. O king of the Kuru race, on the day of dvadasi, observing the fast, Govinda should be worshipped. The food cooked in milk should be taken. One who creates pleasure for the cows and gives away the cows in charity, is relieved of all the grief and finally achieves the place of Surabhi.

## Chapter 79. Akhanda Dvadasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.79.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*upavāsavratānāṃ tu vaikalyaṃ yanmahāmate \|*  
*dānadharme kṛtaṃ yasya vipākaṃ vada yādṛśaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O immensely intelligent one, with the break of the vrata or the giving up of charities, what type of reward has to be faced by a person, you kindly tell me.

## \|\| 3.79.2-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*yajñānāmupavāsānāṃ vratānāṃ ca nareśvara \|*  
*vaikalyātphalavaikalyaṃ yādṛśa tacchṛṇuṣva me \|\| 2 \|\|*

*upavāsānvinā khaṇḍaṃ prāpnuvaṃtyeva tāñchṛṇu \|*  
*bhraṣṭaiśvaryā nirddhanāśca vasaṃti puruṣāḥ punaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*rūpaṃ tathottaraṃ prāpya vratavaikalyadoṣataḥ \|*  
*kāṇāḥ kubjāśca ṣaṇḍāśca bhavaṃtyaṃdhāśca mānavāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. When the system of the vratas, yajnas or their alternative is broken, the evil effects one has to face, are being spoken by me. You please listen. First of all, I shall speak about the painful effect of performing a vrata without fasting, because of the blemish of having the alternative to vrata, the riches of a person are lost and he becomes poor or is deprived of one eye, hunch-back, impotent or blind.

## \|\| 3.79.5 \|\|

*upavāsī naraḥ patnīṃ nārīṃ prāpya tathā patim \|*  
*viyogaṃ vratavaikalye durbhagatvamavāpnuyāt \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Such people have their wives like them, while the wives have the husbands like them. Both are separated from each other, fall from the performing of the vrata and become unfortunate.

## \|\| 3.79.6 \|\|

*ye dravye satyadātārastathānne satyanagnayaḥ \|*  
*kule vasaṃti duḥśīlā duṣkulāḥ śīlaniścaye \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Those who are miserly in giving charities inspite of their being rich or inspite of having enough of cereals and do not make offerings of cereals in fire, they are born shameless in auspicious families and noble in the inauspicious families.

## \|\| 3.79.7-8 \|\|

*vastrānulepanairhīnā bhūṣaṇaiścātirūpiṇaḥ \|*  
*virūparūpāśca tathā prasādhakaguṇānvitāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*te sarve vratavaikalyātphala vaikalyamāgatāḥ \|*  
*tasmāttadvratavaikalyaṃ yajñavaikalyameva ca \|*  
*upavāsena kartavyaṃ vaikalyādvikalaṃ phalam \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. They are devoid of clothes or paste and have the beauty with ornaments, besides being deformed. All the people who are virtuous and devoted, with shattering of the vrata, they have to face evil results. Therefore, one should perform vrata with devotion, otherwise, it results in evil effect, which surely has to be faced by a person.

## \|\| 3.79.9 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kathaṃcidyadi vaikalyamupavāsādike bhavet \|*  
*kiṃ tatra vada kartavyamacchidraṃ yena jāyate \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Yudhisthira said- When there is some obstruction in the performing of a vrata, what should be done at that time, by which no short coming or deficiency is left out? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 3.79.10-12 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*akhaṃḍadvādaśī hyeṣā samasteṣveva karmasu \|\| 10 \|\|*

*vaikalyaṃ praśamaṃ yāti śṛṇuṣva gadato mama \|*  
*mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*kṛtopavāso deveśaṃ samabhyarcya janārdanam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*snāto nārāyaṇaṃ brūyādbhuñjannārāyaṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*gacchannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ svapannārāyaṇaṃ punaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. Sri Krsna said- This Akhanda Dvadasi removes all the blemishes caused by various reasons. I am going to speak about the same. You please listen. On the bright dvadasi of the month of Margasirsa, one should purify himself completely and while fasting, should worship Devesa Janardana offering him the bath, and then offer food and go round, and then go to sleep. During all the time, the name of Narayana-Deva should be continuously recited.

## \|\| 3.79.13-16 \|\|

*pañcagavyajalasnāto viśuddhātmā jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*yavavrīhimayaṃ pātraṃ dattvā viprāya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*idamuccārayetpaścāddevasya purato hareḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*saptajanmani yatkiñcinmayā khaṇḍavrataṃ kṛtam \|*  
*bhagavaṃstvatprasādena tadakhaṃḍamihāstu me \|\| 14 \|\|*

*yathākhaṃḍaṃ jagatsarvaṃ tvameva puruṣottama \|*  
*tathākhilānyakhaṃḍāni vratāni mama saṃtu vai \|\| 15 \|\|*

*caturbhirapi māsaistu pāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*prīṇanaṃ ca hareḥ kuryātpārite pāraṇe tataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-16. Getting purified with the water mixed with pancagavya, the Brahmanas should be given vases filled with barley and the cereals. Thereafter, one should beg forgiveness from the lord, saying- “O lord, all the broken vratas of last seven births should stand completed, by your grace.” In the processing of this vrata, the breaking of the fast is said to be done after four months. Thereafter, pleasing lord Visnu, the vratas should be completed during the rest of the months.

## \|\| 3.79.17-18 \|\|

*caitrādiṣu ca māseṣu caturguṇyaṃ tu pāraṇam \|*  
*tatrāpi saktupātrāṇi dadyācchraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*śrāvaṇādiṣu māseṣu kārttikāṃteṣu pāraṇam \|*  
*tatrāpi ghṛtapātrāṇi dadyādviprāya dakṣiṇāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. The breaking of the fast in the months of Caitra and others is said to be of four types. During that month also, a vase filled with ghi should be given with devotion. Starting from the month of Sravana to the month of Kartika, the worship should be made and a vase filled with ghi should be given to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.79.19-21 \|\|

*sauvarṇaṃ raupyaṃ tāmraṃ ca mṛnmayaṃ pātramiṣyate \|*  
*svaśaktyapekṣayā rājanpālāśaṃ vāpi kārayet \|\| 19 \|\|*

*evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte brāhmaṇānsa jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*dvādaśāmantrya viprāṃśca bhojayeddhṛtapāyasaiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*vastrābharaṇadānaiśca praṇipatya kṣamāpayet \|*  
*upadeṣṭāramapyatra pūjayedvidhivadgurum \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. O king, making use of the gold, silver, copper, clay or the tree leaf, a vase may be made. At the end of the year, controlling all the senses, twelve Brahmanas should be invited and they should be served with food and payasam mixed with ghi. After serving food to them, they should be pleased with the giving away of costumes, ornaments and then beg forgiveness from them in an appropriate way.

## \|\| 3.79.22-25 \|\|

*evaṃ samyagyathānyāyyamakhaṃḍadvādaśīṃ naraḥ \|*  
*samupoṣya akhaṃḍasya vratasya phalamaśnute \|\| 22 \|\|*

*saptajanmasu vaikalyaṃ yadvratasya kvacitkṛtam \|*  
*karotyavikalaṃ sarvamakhaṃḍadvādaśī tu tat \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tasmādeṣā prayatnena naraiḥ strībhiśca suvrata \|*  
*akhaṃḍadvādaśī samyagupoṣyā phalakāṃkṣayā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*ye dvādaśīvratamakhaṃḍamiti prasiddhaṃ mārgottamāṅgamadhikṛtya kṛtena yena \|*  
*khaṃḍavratāni puruṣaiḥ sukṛtāni yāni saṃpūrṇatāṃ samupayānti hareḥ prasādāt \|\| 25 \|\|*

22-25. Similarly, during the Akhanda-Dvadasi, the appropriate fasting should be observed. A person who observes the vrata for the completion of the incomplete vratas of the last seven births, (he is well rewarded). Therefore, the people should made all the efforts for fasting on the Akhanda-Dvadasi vrata. A man or a woman who completes the Akhanda-Dvadasi vrata in an appropriate way, all the incomplete vratas of the past seven births are deemed completed by the grace of lord Visnu.

## Chapter 80. Manoratha Dvadasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.80.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*phālgunemalapakṣasya ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*naro vā yadi vā nārī samabhyarcya jagatpatim \|\| 1 \|\|*

*harernāma vadanbhaktyā bhāvayukto yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*uttiṣṭhanprasvapaṃścaiva harimevānukīrtayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sri Krsna said- O Yudhisthira, On the day of bright ekadasi in the month of Phalguna, all the men and women should worship Visnu -the lord of the universe, with utmost devotion, while sleeping or awake, and should recite the name of the lord.

## \|\| 3.80.3-11 \|\|

*tatonyasmindine prāpte drādaśyāṃ niyato harim \|*  
*snātvā samyaksamabhyarcya dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām \|\| 3 \|\|*

*harimuddiśya caivāgnau ghṛtahomakṛtakriyaḥ \|*  
*praṇipatya jagannāthamiti vāṇīmudīrayeta \|\| 4 \|\|*

*pātālasaṃsthāṃ vasudhāṃ yāṃ prasādya manorathā \|*  
*avāpa vāsudevosau pradadyāttu manorathān \|\| 5 \|\|*

*yamabhyarcya divi prāptaḥ sakalāṃśca manorathān \|*  
*bhraṣṭarājyaśca devendro yamabhyarcya jagatpatim \|\| 6 \|\|*

*manorathānabhinavānprāptavāṃśca manoharān \|*  
*evamabhyarcya pūjāṃ ca niṣpādya ca harestataḥ \|*  
*bhuñjīta prayataḥ samyaghaviṣyaṃ pāṃḍunandana \|\| 7 \|\|*

*phālgune caitre vaiśākhe jyeṣṭhe māsi ca sattama \|*  
*caturbhiḥ pāraṇaṃ māsairebhirniṣpāditaṃ bhavet \|\| 8 \|\|*

*raktapuṣpaiśca caturo māsā nkurvīta cārcanam \|*  
*dahettu gugguluṃ prāśya gośṛṃgakṣālanaṃ jalam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*haviṣyānnaṃ ca naivedyamātmanaścāpi bhojanam \|*  
*tataśca śrūyatāṃ pārtha āṣāḍhādau tu yā kriyā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*jātīpuṣpāṇi dhūpaśca śastaḥ sārjaraso nṛpa \|*  
*prāśya darbhodakaṃ cāsya śālyannaṃ ca nivedanam \|\| 11 \|\|*

3-11. On the next day, a person, after taking his bath at the time of dvadasi should worship lord Visnu. For the sake of lord Hari, the offerings of the ghi should be made in the fire and charities should be given away to the Brahmanas. Thereafter, he should beg forgiveness humbly from the lord, saying- “0 lord Vasudeva, while dwelling in the nether world, you achieves (or secured the earth) and got your desire fulfilled. O lord Vasudeva, you fulfill my desire as well, as Indra had adored the lord of the universe and got his kingdom and fortunes back. Therefore, O son of Pandu, thus adoring lord Visnu with devotion, he should himself take the leftover of havisya food. O excellent one, during the months of Phalguna, Caitra, Vaisakha and Jyestha, the fast should be broken after performing the puja. During all the four months, the adoration should be made with the offering of the red flowers. The guggulu should be offered as incense. Then water purified with cow’s horn, the havisya food and eatables should be offered to the lord, after which the performer of the vrata should take the same food for himself. O Partha, during the month of Asadha and other months, the offering of jasmine flowers, juice of the Sarja tree and incense are said to be quite beneficial. Besides the food of the Sali rice should be served. The fast should be broken with the kusa water.

## \|\| 3.80.12-13 \|\|

*svayaṃ tadeva cāśnīyāccheṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret \|*  
*kārtikādiṣu māseṣu gomūtraṃ kāyaśodhanam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sugaṃdhiścecchayā dhūpaṃ pūjā bhṛṃgārakena ca \|*  
*kāṃsāraṃ cātra naivedyamaśnīyāttacca vai svayam \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. During the month of Kartika, the urine of cow should be used for the purification of and the breaking of the fast. Then the fragrance, incense, gold vase filled with water and the eatables of mixed cereals powder should be offered. Then the food should be taken.

## \|\| 3.80.14-15 \|\|

*pratimāsaṃ ca viprāya dātavyā dakṣiṇā tathā \|*  
*pāraṇaṃ cecchayā viṣṇoḥ pāraṇe pāvane mate \|\| 14 \|\|*

*yathāśaktyā yathāprītyā vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet \|*  
*sadbhāvenaiva goviṃdaḥ pūjitaḥ prīyate yataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Every month, a Brahmana should be given the daksina and the favourite food should be offered to lord Visnu, as per one’s means, discarding the miserliness. Because after having been adored gracefully, lord Govinda gets pleased.

## \|\| 3.80.16-18 \|\|

*pāraṇāṃte yathāśakti snāpitaḥ pūjito hariḥ \|*  
*prīṇitaścepsitānkāmāṃstāndadātyavyayān nṛpa \|\| 16 \|\|*

*varṣāṃte pratimāmiṣṭāṃ kārayitvā suśobhanām \|*  
*svarṇakena yathā śaktyā śaṃkhaśārṅgavibhūṣitām \|\| 17 \|\|*

*puṣpavastrayugacchannāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|*  
*dvādaśa brāhmaṇāṃstatra bhojayitvā kṣamāpayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. O king, after the breaking of the fast, one should offer water for a bath, whereby lord Visnu gets pleased and bestows the desired reward. At the end of the year, a gold image of Visnu should be made, adorning it with conch and the Sarnga bow, and flowers and a pair of costumes should be given over to a Brahmana. The food should then be served to a dozen Brahmanas, begging forgiveness from them at the same time.

## \|\| 3.80.19 \|\|

*dvādaśātra pradātavyāḥ kuṃbhāḥ sānnajalākṣatāḥ \|*  
*chatropānadyugaiḥ sārddhaṃ dakṣiṇābhiśca bhārata \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Each one of them should be given a pitcher filled with water, umbrella, the shoes as well as the daksina, respecting them.

## \|\| 3.80.20-21 \|\|

*eṣā puṇyā pāpaharā dvādaśī phalamicchatām \|*  
*yathābhilaṣitānkāmāndadāti nṛpasattama \|\| 20 \|\|*

*pūrayatyakhilānbhaktyā yataścaiṣāṃ manorathān \|*  
*manorathā dvādaśīyaṃ tato lokeṣu viśrutā \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. With the performing of this Dvadasi which is the remover of the sins, in a proper manner, all the desires of a person get fulfilled. O best of the kings, when this vrata is performed with devotion, the desires of a person are surely fulfilled and because of this, it has been popularly known as the Manoratha-Dvadasi in the world.

## \|\| 3.80.22-24 \|\|

*upoṣyaitāṃ tribhuvanaṃ labdhamindreṇa vai purā \|*  
*ādityāśceṣṭitāḥ putrā dhanamauśanasā tathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*dhaumyenādhyayanaṃ prāptamanyaiścābhimataṃ phalam \|*  
*rājarṣibhistathā vipraiḥ strīviṭśūdraiśca bhūtale \|\| 23 \|\|*

*yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya vratametadupoṣitam \|*  
*tattadāpnotyasaṃdigdhaṃ viṣṇorārādhanodyataḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. In ancient times, with the performing of this vrata, Indra achieved the kingdom of three worlds, Dhaumya gained the studies, besides others also got their desires fulfilled. Adilya achieved the son of his liking, Sakra achieved the riches, as well. Similarly, the Rajarsis, the Brahmanas. the Vaisyas and the Sodras performed the vrata with whichever desire, that became fulfilled by the grace of Visnu and became successful, there is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.80.25 \|\|

*aputro labhate putramadhano labhate dhanam \|*  
*rogābhibhūtaścārogyaṃ kanyā prāpnoti satpatim \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The childless person gets a son, a pauper achieves enormous riches and an ailing person is relieved of his ailment, while the girls achieve excellent husbands.

## \|\| 3.80.26-29 \|\|

*samāgamaṃ pravasanairupoṣyaitāmavāpyate \|*  
*sarvānkāmānavāpnoti mṛtaḥ svarge ca modate \|\| 26 \|\|*

*nāputro nādhano jyeṣṭho viyogī na ca nirguṇaḥ \|*  
*upoṣyaitadvrataṃ martyaḥ strīśūdro vāpi jāyate \|\| 27 \|\|*

*svargaloke sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāmayutāni ca \|*  
*bhogānabhimatānbhuktvā tatratatra yathecchayā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*iha puṇyavatāṃ nṝṇāṃ dhanināṃ laghuśālinām \|*  
*gṛhe prajāyate rājansarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

26-29. With the performing of this vrata, a person, inspite of his being a Sudra, never remains without a son, and never becomes a pauper separated from family, or worthless. O king, spending ten thousand years in the heaven, enjoying all the pleasures there, they are reborn on earth in rich and affluent families, always remain healthy and do not attract any ailments.

## \|\| 3.80.30 \|\|

*na dvādaśīmupavasanti manorathākhyāṃ naivārcayaṃti puruṣottamamādidevam \|*  
*gobrāhmaṇāṃśca na namaṃti na pūjayaṃti ye te manobhilaṣitaṃ kathamāpnuvaṃti \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The people who fast on the day of Manoratha-Dvadasi, but do not worship lord Purusottama and the Brahmanas, then how could their desires be fulfilled?

## Chapter 81. Tila-Dvadasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.81.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*alpāyāsena bhagavandhanenālpena vā vibho \|*  
*pāpaṃ praśamamāyāti yena tadvaktumarhasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O excellent lord, you kindly speak about a vrata, with the performing of it with limited means, the sins could be removed.

## \|\| 3.81.2-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu pārtha parāṃ puṇyāṃ dvādaśīṃ pāpanāśinīm \|*  
*yāmupoṣya paraṃ puṇyamāpnuyācchraddhayānvitaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*māghamāse ca saṃprāpte āṣāḍharkṣaṃ bhavedyadi \|*  
*mūlaṃ vā kṛṣṇapakṣasya dvādaśyāṃ niyatavrataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Sri Krsna said- I am speaking about the auspicious vrata of Dvadasi which is the remover of all sins, and when this vrata is performed with devotion and faith, one achieves enormous merit. On the dark twelfth day of the month of Magha falling in the Asadha constellation, this vrata has to be performed, controlling all the sense organs.

## \|\| 3.81.4-6 \|\|

*gṛhṇīyātpuṇyaphaladaṃ vidhānaṃ tasya me śṛṇu \|*  
*devadevaṃ samabhyarcya susnātaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇanāmnā ca saṃpūjya ekādaśyāṃ mahāmate \|*  
*upoṣito dvitīyehni punaḥ saṃpūjya keśavam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*saṃstūya nāmnā tenaiva kṛṣṇākhyena punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*dadyāttilāṃśca viprāya kṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. When one does so, the reward one achieves is being spoken by me. You please listen. O immensely intelligent one, on the day of ekadasi, one should purify himself with the taking of the bath, and Krsna - another name of Visnu, should be recited. With the continuous recitation, the night should be spent. Then on the day of dvadasi, one should observe fast, the name of Krsna should be recited and lord Kesava should be worshipped. Then he should pray “Let lord Krsna be pleased with me.”

## \|\| 3.81.7-10 \|\|

*tataśca prāśayecchastāṃstathā kṛṣṇatilānnṛpa \|*  
*viṣṇuprīṇanamaṃtrokte samāpte varṣapāraṇe \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇakuṃbhāṃstilaiḥ sārddhaṃ pakvānnena ca saṃyutāḥ \|*  
*chatropānadyugairvastraiḥ sahitā annagarbhiṇaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradeyāste yathāvanmāsasaṃkhyayā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tilaprarohājjāyaṃte yāvatsaṃkhyāstilā nṛpa \|*  
*tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate \|*  
*arogo jāyate nityaṃ naro janmanijanmani \|\| 9 \|\|*

*aṃdho na badhiraścaiva na kuṣṭhī na ca kutsitaḥ \|*  
*bhavatyetāmuṣitvā tu tilākhyāṃ dvādaśīṃ naraḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. Thus speaking, the sesamum seeds should be given to a Brahmana. Thereafter, he should also consume the same seeds. In this way, reciting the name of Visnu with the mantras, at the end of the month, the fried food with sesamum, black pitcher, umbrella, four costumes and sweets as eatables should be given in the number of twelve each to the Brahmanas with respect. The performer enjoys all the comforts in the heaven for as many years as the collective number of seeds were given away in charity. With the performing of the vrata for the Tila-dvadasi, a person does not have to suffer from blindness, deafness,leprosy, or being a degraded one.

## \|\| 3.81.11-12 \|\|

*anena pārtha vidhinā tiladātā na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairanāyāsena mānavaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*dānaṃ vidhistathā śrāddhaṃ sarvapātakaśāṃtaye \|*  
*nārthaḥ prabhūto nāyāsaḥ śarīre nṛpasattama \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. O Partha, by giving away of the sesamum seeds in charity, the giver is surely freed of all the sins. For the destruction of ail the sins, one who performs this vrata with devotion, he is relieved of all the sins. O excellent king, for the removal of all the sins, with the performing of this vrata in an appropriate way. much of the charities or the wealth is not required, nor the physical labour.

## \|\| 3.81.13 \|\|

*sarvopabhoganiratohni pare daśamyāṃ snānaṃ tilaistilanivedanakṛttilāśī \|*  
*dattvā tilāndvijavarāya virājaketu saṃpūjya viṣṇupadavīṃ samupaiti martyaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thus on the day of dasami, discarding all the pleasures, one should take bath with sesamum seeds. One who offers food and charities to the Brihmanas, besides worshipping Hari, he surely achieves the Visnuloka.

## Chapter 82. Sukrta Dvadasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.82.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*yanna tāpāya vai puṃsāṃ bhavatyāmuṣmikaṃ kṛtam \|*  
*tadapāpāya bhavati tadācakṣva yadūttama \|\| 1 \|\|*

*upavāsaprabhāvaṃ vai kṛṣṇārādhanakāṃkṣiṇām \|*  
*kathayeha mahābāho naiva tṛpyāmi jalpataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said O best of the race, of Yadus, you kindly tell me about such of the worldly deeds from which a person docs not derive any satisfaction, but nevertheless he earns great merit from the same. O strong armed one. you kindly mention about the fast for those who worship lord Krsna. because I do not achieve satisfaction front the stories being told by you.

## \|\| 3.82.3-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śrūyatāṃ pārtha yatpṛṣṭāḥ kautukādbhavatā vayam \|*  
*āmuṣmikaṃ na tāpāya pratāpāya ca jāyate \|\| 3 \|\|*

*upoṣitaprabhāvaṃ ca kṛṣṇārādhanakāṃkṣiṇām \|*  
*kathayāmi yathāvṛttaṃ pūrvameva narottama \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Sri Krsna said- O Partha, the question which has been asked by you in your joyous mood that the worldly deeds of the people sometimes create glory without granting satisfaction, that is because of the effect of the worship of Krsna by his devotees. I am going to reveal the same before you, please listen.

## \|\| 3.82.5-7 \|\|

*vaidiśaṃ nāma nagaraṃ prakhyātaṃ nṛpasattama \|*  
*tatra vaiśyo'bhavatpūrvaṃ sīrabhadra iti śrutaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*bhāryayā mātṛduhitā putrapautraiḥ samanvitaḥ \|*  
*prabhūta bhṛtyavargaśca bahuvyāpārakārakaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*putrapautrādibharaṇe vyāsaktirmatireva ca \|*  
*paralokaṃ prati matistasya nāsītkadācana \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. O best of kings, once upon a time, a famous Vaisya known by the name of Sirabhadra used to live in the town of Vidisa with his wife, mother, all the sons and the grandsons in a joint family. He also had a large number of servants and his trade was flourishing. Throughout the day and night, he remained in bringing up of his sons and grandsons Therefore, he never thought of Paraloka or the life after death.

## \|\| 3.82.8-10 \|\|

*cakārānudinaṃ so'tha nyāyānyāyairddhanārjanam \|*  
*sarvatrānyatra niḥsnehaḥ putrasnehapariplutaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*na juhotyudite kāle na dadātyatitṛṣṇayā \|*  
*babhūva codyamastasya putrādibharaṇe paraḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*nityanaimittikānāṃ ca hāniṃ cakre svakarmaṇā \|*  
*tṛṣṇābhibhūto rājendra svavargabharaṇojjhitaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. He always earned riches by noble or judicious means. He was extremely affectionate to his sons always. He was absolved in the earning of wealth and he never performed any homa, nor did he ever think of giving away riches or food in charity. All his efforts were centered around the bringing up of his sons and grandsons. In this way, because of his greed for earning the wealth, he himself committed enormous loss to his casual and everlasting activities.

## \|\| 3.82.11-12 \|\|

*kālenāgacchatāso'tha mṛto viṃdhyāṭavītaṭe \|*  
*yātanādehabhṛtpreto grīṣmakāle'bhavannṛpa \|\| 11 \|\|*

*taṃ dadarśa mahābhāgo divyayānasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*vedavedāṅgavidveṣī vipīto nāma vai dvijaḥ \|*  
*bhāskarasyāśubhirddīptairdahaṃtamatidāruṇaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. In this way, the whole time passed. After his death, he attained the form of preta in the forest of the Vindhya mountain. During the terrific heat of the rainy season, he badly suffered from the heart and faced a bitter experience. At the same time, he was spotted by a Brahmana named Vipita, who had a divine plane, but was anxious of the Vedic literature. He badly suffered from the immensely hot sun rays and the burning sand.

## \|\| 3.82.13-14 \|\|

*prataptavālukāmadhye tṛṣārtaṃ cātipīḍitam \|*  
*kṣutkṣāmakaṃṭhaṃ śuṣkāsyaṃ tathodvṛttavilocanam \|*  
*niṣkrāṃtajihvamaṃgeṣu visphoṭaiḥ sarvataścitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*niśvāsāyāsakhedena vihvalaṃ pīḍitodaram \|*  
*nijena karmaṇā baddhamasamarthaṃ prasarpaṇe \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. He felt extremely thirsty. Suffering from the heat, his neck was dried up, the face too was dry and the eyes were bulging out. The tongue was protruding out of the mouth and the boils had grown over all the limbs of the body. He was thus breathing quite heavily at that time with long breath. He felt pain in the belly and because of his having been bound with his own deeds, he was unable to move.

## \|\| 3.82.15-16 \|\|

*tathādṛśamatho dṛṣṭvā gardabheyo mahānṛṣiḥ \|*  
*vipītaḥ prāha rājendra kāruṇyabharitaṃ vacaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*jānannapi yathāprāptaṃ tasyānuṣṭhānajaṃ phalam \|*  
*jaṃtostasyopakārāya sarvato hlādayanniva \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Looking at the goblin, the Maharsi spoke with a pathetic voice. Though he was aware of the cause of his suffering, still in order to do good to the Jiva, he started talking to him, as if trying to cover him or protect him from all the sides.

## \|\| 3.82.17-19 \|\|

*vipīta uvāca \|*  
*adhaḥ sūryāṃśubhistaptairbahubhiḥ pathi pāṃśubhiḥ \|*  
*uparyarkakaraistīkṣṇaistṛṣāvātanipīḍitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*anyastatrāṇakairghorairaviṣahyaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ \|*  
*kathayeha yathātattvamekākī dahyase katham \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tasyaitadvacanaṃ śrutvā vipītasya savedanaḥ \|*  
*vedanārta uvācedaṃ kṛcchrāducchusya maṃdakam \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. Vipita said- Under the rays of the burning sun and heat along with dust storm and the scorching wind, why are you getting burnt here alone? You tell me the primary reason for the same. On hearing the words of Vipita, badly suffering from pain, while breathing heavily, Sirabhadra started speaking with great difficulty.

## \|\| 3.82.20-26 \|\|

*sīrabhadra uvāca \|*  
*brahmannālocitaṃ pūrvaṃ kathamaṃte bhaviṣyati \|*  
*aśāśvate śāśvatadhīstena dahyāmi durmatiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*idaṃ kariṣyāmyaparaṃ tvidaṃ kṛtvā tvidaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*itīcchā śatamārūḍhastena dahyāmi durmatiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*śītoṣṇavarṣādibhavaṃ lobhātsoḍhaṃ mayā'śubham \|*  
*tadeva hi na dharmārthaṃ tena dahyāmi durmatiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*pitṛdevamanupyāṇāmadattvā yāpitā hi ye \|*  
*te gatā nāpi vartaṃta dahyāmyeko'tra durmatiḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*putrakṣetrakalatreṣu mamatvāhṛtacetasā \|*  
*bahvasādhu kṛtaṃ karma tena dahyāmi durmatiḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*mṛte mayi dhane tasminnanyāyopārjite sadā \|*  
*rūpavaṃto'bhivartaṃte dahyāmyekotra durmatiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*na mayā pūjitā gehānnirgatā dvijasattamāḥ \|*  
*svavargamiha kāmena tena dahyāmyahaṃmatiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

20-26. Sirabhadra said- O Brahmana, I always remained unconcerned about my performance on earth. What shall be the result of the same? I always thought about this impermanent world to be permanent and everlasting. Because of that, I have to face this misery. After performing this task, I shall attend to others, thus I had been engrossed in several of the desires. Out of greed, I tolerated the terrible cold of the cold climate, the scorching heat of the summer season, besides the terrific storms of the rainy season. But I could do nothing for the sake of dharma. Because of this, I have to face the present miserable condition. I never gave anything for the sake of the pitrs, the beggars and the other people. I always engaged myself in serving my wife and the family, but they didn’t suffer and I have to suffer here alone. Because of my blind attachment for the sons, fields and others, I committed several sins as well. After my death, the enormous wealth which I earned by fair and foul means, is being enjoyed by all the people of the household. I never respected a guest arriving at my place and all of them returned getting disappointed. I served only my own kiths and kins.

## \|\| 3.82.27-33 \|\|

*yanme na pūjitā devāḥ kuṭuṃbaṃ poṣitaṃ param \|*  
*ekākī tatra dahyāmi ye sutāste'nyato gatāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*nityaṃ naimittikaṃ karma pūrveṣāṃ caiva no kṛtam \|*  
*ekākī tena dahyāmi gataste phalabhoginaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*dārāḥ putrāśca bhṛtyāśca pāpabuddhyā mayā bhṛtāḥ \|*  
*ekākī tena dahyāmi gatāste phalabhoginaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*dārāḥ putrāśca bhṛtyārthe mayā nyāyārthasaṃcayaḥ \|*  
*kṛtastenātra dahyāmi ye bhuktāste'nyato gatāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*kṣatapāpaṃ mayā bhuktamanyaistatkarma saṃcitam \|*  
*dahyāmyeko'hamatyaṃtaṃ gatāste phalabhoginaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*yanmamatvābhibhūtena mayā pāpamupārjitam \|*  
*na tadanyasya kasyāpi kevalaṃ mama duṣkatam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*aṃtarduḥkhena dagdho'haṃ bahirdahyāmi bhāvayan \|*  
*tāvadduḥkhaṃ navābhaṃ tu pāpamekaṃ dvidhāsthitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

27-33. Instead of adoring the gods, I served my family alone. All those comforts have disappeared, while I am burning with pain here. I have never attended to the momentary or everlasting deeds. I always served my wife and the sons with devotion. But all of them are no more with me, I am alone suffering for my failings. I earned riches for the sake of my sons and servants by fair or foul means, making use of which all have dispersed here and there. All of them enjoyed the reward for their own deeds and I have to suffer for my evil deeds. Because of my egoism, the sins which were committed by me, all represent my evil deeds and not of anyone else. Because of that, I am badly suffering internally as well as externally with misery, which represents the sides of myself.

## \|\| 3.82.34 \|\|

*kuru tasmātsamuddhāraṃ paśyasyamṛtasāgaram \|*  
*tava yenāhamāhlādaṃ prāpnuyāṃ munisattama \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. O best of the sages, the ocean of nectar is surely visible to you. Therefore, you kindly redeem me, by which I could be able to have some respite from my sufferings.

## \|\| 3.82.35-38 \|\|

*vipīta uvāca \|*  
*alpakālika uddhāre tava paśyāmi saṃśayam \|*  
*prakṣīṇaṃ pāpametāvatsuvṛttaṃ cāsti te param \|\| 35 \|\|*

*pratīte daśame janmanyacyutārādhanecchayā \|*  
*sukarmajayadā bhadradvādaśīṃ samupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*na ca tasyāḥ prasādena pāpamatyantadurjayam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*alpairahobhiḥ saṃkṣīṇamāmapātre yathā jalam \|*  
*gataṃ pāpamayaṃ hyasyāḥ prabhāvo'tyantadurllabhaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*nāśaṃ pāpasya kurute jayaṃ sukṛtakarmaṇaḥ \|*  
*sakṛtkarmapradā hyeṣā tato vai dvādaśī smṛtā \|\| 38 \|\|*

35-38. Vipita said- I am quite doubtful about your temporary redemption, because when such a terrific sin is committed, it would disappear, but much of it still remains. After the tenth birth from today, with the intention of worshipping lord Acyuta, I performed japam and also observed the vrata of Sukrta-Dvadasi, because there is no sin invincible after performing the same. Because of its forceful effect, all the sins get destroyed in no time as the water filled in the pitcher of mud, gets destroyed in no time. With those noble deeds, the sins get destroyed. Because of the bestowing of the noble deeds, it came to be known as Sukrta Dvadasi.

## \|\| 3.82.39-40 \|\|

*yathaitadvadatārtena bhavatā paridevitam \|*  
*tamuvācātra saṃdeho mama tāpāya deva kim \|\| 39 \|\|*

*pāpamatra kṛtaṃ pretya bhadra tāpāya jāyate \|*  
*āhlādāya tathā puṇyamiha puṇyakṛtāṃ nṛṇām \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. At this, the preta said- “O lord, you have sympathized with me for my sufferings. Therefore, you tell me also the method of performing that vrata. Initially, you expressed some doubt, which made me painful somewhat But with the committing of the sins on this earth, one has to suffer and with the performing of the noble deeds, one enjoys delight.”

## \|\| 3.82.41-43 \|\|

*sīrabhadraṃ samāśvāsya yayāvitthaṃ mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*sopyalpenaiva kālena tato mokṣamavāptavān \|\| 41 \|\|*

*upavāsaprabhāvaśca kathitaste narottama \|*  
*yenālpaireva divasairbhūri pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*tasmānnareṇa puṇyāya yatitavyaṃ na pātakam \|*  
*upavāsāśca kartavyāḥ sadaivātmahitaiṣiṇā \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. Thereafter, the great sage spoke to the preta Sirabhadra all the details about the vrata to him. Then assuring him variously, he proceeded on to his pilgrimage. Sirabhadra on the other hand, performed the vrata and in short duration, he was relieved of all the sins. O king, thus I have spoken all the details of the same. Therefore, the people should always make efforts to earn the merits keeping in view the welfare of self and should also perform this vrata.

## \|\| 3.82.44 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*athaitatkaṣṭapāpānāṃ vipāko narakasthitaiḥ \|*  
*puruṣairbhujyate śaśvattaṃ mokṣaṃ vada sattama \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. Yudhisthira said- O excellent one, the people performing the evil deeds have always to face the evil effects of the same. Therefore, you kindly reveal the way out for them.

## \|\| 3.82.45-47 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*jayāsametāḥ puruṣāḥ sadā sukṛtakarmaṇaḥ \|*  
*jayā sā dvādaśī śastā nṛṇāṃ sukṛtakarmaṇām \|\| 45 \|\|*

*phālgunāmalapakṣasya ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*dvādaśyāṃ tu dvijaśreṣṭha pūjayenmadhusūdanam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*ekādaśyāṃ samuttiṣṭhanviṣṇornāmānukīrtayan \|*  
*pūjāyāṃ vāsudevasya bhuñjīta susamāhitaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

45-47. Sri Krsna said- For the people who perform the noble deeds, Jaya-Dvadasi, which gains victory for the people, is the best (because it destroys the sins and is quite praiseworthy). O best of the Brahmanas, on the bright ekadadi of the month of Phalguna, one should observe a fast. On the day of dvadasi, one should worship the lord Madhusudana. Rising up early in the morning on the day of ekadasi, the samkirtana of lord Visnu should be started and the worship of the lord should be performed in an appropriate manner. After worship of lord Vasudeva, the food should take collectively.

## \|\| 3.82.48-50 \|\|

*kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca madaṃ mohaṃ ca varjayet \|*  
*drohādīnvarjayeddoṣānsarvāndhanamadodbhavān \|\| 48 \|\|*

*bhāyayedviṣṇubhaktaśca saṃsāre'sāratāṃ tathā \|*  
*evaṃ bhāvitacittena prāṇināṃ hitamicchatā \|\| 49 \|\|*

*namo nārāyaṇāyeti vaktavyaṃ svapatā niśi \|*  
*tathaiva kuryāddvādaśyāṃ nāmnā kṣutpāraṇaṃ nṛpa \|\| 50 \|\|*

48-50. At that point of time, all the ills emerging out of (excess of) riches, wealth, passion, anger, greed, arrogance, confusion, malice or hatred should be discarded by the devotee of Visnu, keeping in mind the perishable nature of the world. Thus purifying one’s mind, for the welfare of the people, while going to sleep at night, one should utter- “Om Namo Narayana". O king, on the day of dvadasi, the fast should be broken reciting the name of Narayana.

## \|\| 3.82.51-53 \|\|

*sauvarṇatāmrapātrāṇi mṛnmayānyapi pāṃḍava \|*  
*yavapātrāṇi pūrvaṃ tu dadyānmāsacatuṣṭayam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*āṣāḍhādidvitīyaṃ tu pārayecca mahāmate \|*  
*tatrāpi ghṛtapātrāṇi dadyācchraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*kārttikādiṣu māseṣu māghāṃteṣu tathā tilān \|*  
*viprāya dadyātpātraṃ tu pratimāsamupoṣitaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

51-53. O Pandava, during the initial four months, the vases of gold, copper or of baked clay, filled with barley should be offered. O intelligent one, during the second caturmasa of the Asadha and other months, ghi and betel; and during the months of Kartika to Magha, the vase filled with sesamum seeds should be given away to the Brahmana regularly.

## \|\| 3.82.54-56 \|\|

*nāmatrayamaśeṣeṇa māsimāsi dinadvayam \|*  
*tathaivoccārayandadyānmāsimāsi yavādikam \|*  
*praṇamya ca hṛṣīkeśaṃ kṛtapūjaḥ prasādayet \|\| 54 \|\|*

*viṣṇo namaste jagatī prasotre śrīvāsudevāya namo namaste \|*  
*nārāyaṇākhyaḥ praṇatairviciṃtyaḥ karotu māṃ śāśvatapuṇyarāśim \|\| 55 \|\|*

*prasīda puṇyaṃ jayameti viṣṇo śrīvāsudevarddhimupaitu puṇyam \|*  
*prayātu vāśeṣamatho vināśaṃ mā teṃ'ghripadmāditaratra me matiḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

54-56. On both the day of ekadasi and dvadasi, uttering the particular names of the lord, a vase filled with fried food should be given to the Brahmana in every month. At the same time, the worship of lord Hrsikesa should be performed, praying for forgiveness at the same time, saying- “O cause of the universe, salutation to you, salutation to Vasudeva. The face of lord Narayana, which is always meditated upon by the noble people, should turn me as an auspicious soul. O lord Visnu, you kindly be pleased. I should achieve the auspicious devotion of lord Vasudeva or let it be destroyed, but my mind should always remain devoted in you. O Visnu, let my merits rise and the remaining sins should be destroyed. O Narayana, my mind should be devoted to dharma and the sins should get destroyed.

## \|\| 3.82.57-61 \|\|

*viṣṇo puṇyodbhavo mestu vāsudevāstu me śubham \|*  
*nārāyaṇostu dharmo jahi pāpamaśeṣataḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*aneka janmajanitaṃ bālyayauvanavārddhake \|*  
*puṇyaṃ vivṛddhimāyātu yātu pāpaṃ ca saṃkṣayam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*ākāśādiṣu śabdādau śrotrādau mahadādiṣu \|*  
*prakṛtau puruṣe caiva brahmaṇyapi ca sa prabhuḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*yathaika eva dharmātmā vāsudevo vyavasthitaḥ \|*  
*tena satyena pāpaṃ me narakārtipradaṃ kṣayam \|\| 60 \|\|*

*prayātu sukṛtasyāstu mamānudivasañjayaḥ \|*  
*pāpasya hāniḥ puṇyasya vṛddhirmestūttamottamā \|\| 61 \|\|*

57-61. Similarly, during my past several births, the merits I had earned during childhood, youthful age or old age, should keep on increasing with the destruction of the sins at the same time. The five tattvas including the sky, the five matters like sabda, sparsa, rupa, rasa and gandha, five organs of hearing, besides mahat etc., the sixteen vikaras or deficiencies, Dharmtma Vasudeva who remains stable on the Prakrti and Purusa, should destroy all my sins, which could lead me to the hell and increase my noble deeds daily.”

## \|\| 3.82.62-66 \|\|

*evamuccārya viprāya dadyādyatkathitaṃ tava \|*  
*bhuñjīta kṛtakṛtyastu pāraṇepāraṇe gate \|\| 62 \|\|*

*pāraṇāṃte tu deveśa prīṇanaṃ śaktito nṛpa \|*  
*kurvītākhilapākhaṇḍairālāpaṃ ca vivarjayet \|\| 63 \|\|*

*evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte kāṃcanīṃ pratimāṃ hareḥ \|*  
*pūjayitvā vastrapuṣpairghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutaiḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

*gāṃ savatsāṃ ca viprāya dadyācchraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*vilaṃbitaṃ ca yatpūrvaṃ devānanyānbhajedyadi \|\| 65 \|\|*

*tasminnahani dātavyaṃ bhojane cānivāritam \|*  
*ityeṣā kathitā puṇyā sukṛtasya jayāvahā \|*  
*dvādaśī narakaṃ pārtha yāmupoṣya na paśyati \|\| 66 \|\|*

62-66. Thus praying, the charities should be given over to the Brahmanas and getting successful, he should break his fast. After the breaking of the fast, discarding all the useless exercise, at the end of the year, a gold image of lord Visnu should be made and should be worshipped in an appropriate manner. The costumes, flowers, a vase filled with ghi, a cow with a calf, should be given over to the Brahmana with utmost devotion. Inspite of getting late or attending to the worship of another god, the food must be served to the Brahmana on that particular day. О Partha, thus I have spoken to you about the auspicious Vijay-Dvadasi. After observing the fast on this day, a person does not have to fall in the hell.

## \|\| 3.82.67 \|\|

*nāgnayo na ca śastrāṇi na ca lohamukhāḥ khagāḥ \|*  
*nārakāstaṃ prabādhante matiryasya janārdane \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. By worshipping -lord Janardana intelligently and wholeheartedly by the people, they get free from the danger of fire, weapons the pain caused by a bird named Lohmukha, and of the miseries of the hell.

## \|\| 3.82.68 \|\|

*nāmoccāraṇamātreṇa viṣṇoḥ kṣīṇāghasaṃcayaḥ \|*  
*bhavatyagha vināśaśca narake patanaṃ kutaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. With the mere reciting of the name of lord Visnu, enormous sins get washed away, and there is no possibility of falling in the hell.

## \|\| 3.82.69-70 \|\|

*namo nārāyaṇa hare vāsudeveti kīrtayan \|*  
*na yāti narakaṃ martyaḥ saṃkṣīṇāśeṣapātakaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*tasmātpākhaṃḍisaṃsargamakurvandvādaśīmimām \|*  
*upoṣya puṇyopacaye na yāti narakaṃ naraḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

69-70. By reciting the names of Narayana, Hari and Vasudeva, one gets relieved of all the sins. Therefore, the question of his fall in the hell does not arise. Therefore, discarding of the cheatings, when a person performs a fast on the day of Sukrta Dvadasi day, he does not have to fall in the netherworld.

## \|\| 3.82.71 \|\|

*pāpaṃ kṣiṇoti sukṛtasya karoti vṛddhiṃ vṛddhiṃ prayacchati niyacchati sarvadoṣān \|*  
*yaddvādaśīha sukṛtātihitā ca loke kasmānna tāmupavasaṃti vimūḍhacittāḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. By performing fast on the day which becomes popular by the name of Sukrta Dvadasi, the sins of the performer are destroyed and he gains noble wisdom, which goes on increasing day by day. All his blemishes get removed. Therefore, why should a person not perform this vrata?

## Chapter 83. Dharani Vrata

## \|\| 3.83.1-4 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*yadetatparamaṃ guhyaṃ sarvavedeṣu paṭhyate \|*  
*sa devaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo hariḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sa yajñairvividhairiṣṭairvrataiśca yadusattama \|*  
*prāpyate paramo devaḥ sanātanaḥ kathañcana \|\| 2 \|\|*

*bahuvittena bhagavannṛtvigbhirvedapāragaiḥ \|*  
*prāpyante susahāyaiśca kvacittyaktāḥ suduṣkarāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*vittena ca vinā dānaṃ dātuṃ kṛṣṇa na śakyate \|*  
*vidyamāne'pi na matiḥ kuṭuṃbāsaktacetasaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Yudhisthira said- О best of the race of Yadus, all the Vedas describe Pundarikaksa, Narayana and Visnu, as extremely secret. The lord can be achieved with the performing of Kamya vratas. You tell some other means for the purpose. О Krsna, in case the lord could be achieved with great difficulty, in which the guidance of the Brahmanas well-versed in the Vedas is essential or could he be achieved by difficult renunciation or without giving away of the charities? When a person has enough of riches and he remains engrossed throughout the day and night in the bringing up of the family, his mind never thinks of lord Visnu.

## \|\| 3.83.5 \|\|

*tasya mokṣaḥ kathaṃ kṛṣṇa sarvathā durllabho hariḥ \|*  
*alpāyāsena labhate yena devaḥ sanātanaḥ \|*  
*tanme sāmānyato brūhi sarvavarṇeṣu yadbhavet \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Therefore, O Krsna! How could such a person achieve moksa, because the lord is difficult to be achieved. You kindly tell me the way out by which the lord could be achieved by a person of all varnas making a slight effort.

## \|\| 3.83.6-9 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*kathayāmi paraṃ guhyaṃ rahasyaṃ devanirmitam \|*  
*dharaṇyā yatkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ majjantyā vasudhātale \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pṛthivyāḥ pārthiva purā saṃjātaḥ saṃgamo'mbubhiḥ \|*  
*tasminsalilasaṃlagne mahī prāyādrasātalam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sā bhūtadhātrī dharaṇī rasātalagatā śubhā \|*  
*ārādhayāmāsa vibhuṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ param \|\| 8 \|\|*

*upavāsavratairdevī niyamaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|*  
*kālena mahatā tasyāḥ prasanno garuḍadhvajaḥ \|*  
*ujjahāra sthitau cemāṃ sthāpayāmāsa cācyutaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

6-9. Sri Krsna said- In this connection, I am going to reveal before you a highly secret way which was performed by the goddess earth herself. At the time, when the entire universe was overcome with deluge, at that point of time, the earth, which happens to be the abode of all, submerged in water. Then the same earth adored lord Narayana in an appropriate manner, observing the vrata. After the lapse of a long period, lord Garudadhvaja getting pleased, redeemed her and re-established her over the water.

## \|\| 3.83.10-13 \|\|

*prāpte mārgaśire māse daśamyāṃ niyatātmavān \|*  
*snātvā devārcanaṃ kṛtvā agnikāryaṃ yathāvidhi \|\| 10 \|\|*

*śucivāsāḥ prasannātmā hyatyalpānna susaṃskṛtam \|*  
*bhuktvā pañcapadaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ śaucaṃ ca pādayoḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kṛtvāṣṭāṃgulamātraṃ tu kṣīravṛkṣasamudbhavam \|*  
*bhakṣayeddantakāṣṭhaṃ tu tataścācamya yatnataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*spṛṣṭvā nyasyānyakarmāṇi ciraṃ dhyātvā janārdanam \|*  
*śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ pītāmbarasamāvṛtam \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. On the bright tenth moon day of the month of Margasirsa, one should take bath in the early morning. Adoring the gods in an appropriate way, he should put on white clothes. Then he should pleasantly take the fried food. Thereafter, washing his feet, brushing his teeth with the tooth stick of eight angula length, then he should rinse the mouth. Then taking his bath, he should perform anganyasa (touching of the limbs). Subsequent to it, he should worship the image of lord Janardana holding the conch, disc and a club. The image should wear a pitambara.

## \|\| 3.83.14-15 \|\|

*evamuccārayedvācaṃ tasminkāle mahādyute \|*  
*ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sthitvāhamaparehani \|*  
*saṃbhokṣye puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇaṃ me bhavācyuta \|\| 14 \|\|*

*evamuktvā tato deva devadevasya sannidhau \|*  
*japennārāyaṇāyeti rūpe tatra vidhānataḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. He should meditate upon lord Janardana for a long time, after which he should offer prayer to him— “O Pundarikaksa, after completely fasting on the day of ekadasi, I shall take my food on the next day. O Acyuta, you are my refuge.” Thereafter, he should perform japam before the lord.

## \|\| 3.83.16-18 \|\|

*tataḥ prabhāte vimale nadīṃ gatvā samudragām \|*  
*itarāṃ vā taḍāgaṃ vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān \|\| 16 \|\|*

*ānīya mṛttikāṃ śuddhāṃ maṃtreṇānena mānavaḥ \|*  
*dhāraṇaṃ poṣaṇaṃ tvatto bhūtānāṃ devi sarvadā \|*  
*tena sattvena māṃ pāhi pāpānmocaya suvrate \|\| 17 \|\|*

*iti mṛttikāmantraḥ \|*  
*brahmāṇḍodaratīrthāni karaiḥ spṛṣṭāni te raveḥ \|*  
*bhavaṃti bhūtāni satāṃ mṛttikāmālabhetpunaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. Again in the early morning, he should go to a river bank (which falls in to the ocean), a tank, or the well of the house, apply the sand over his body, reciting the mantras - “O goddess, I have been brought up by you alone, therefore, on the strength of the same, you protect time. O excellent one, you get me raised from the sins. Then after the reciting of the mantras, he should sight the Sungod saying- “All the holy places here on earth are touching the sun rays, as a result of which all the living beings get created.”

## \|\| 3.83.19-25 \|\|

*ityadityādarśanamantraḥ \|*  
*evaṃ mṛdaṃ raveragre kṛtvāthātmānamā labhet \|*  
*triḥkṛtvāśeṣamṛdayā kuṇḍamālikhya vai jale \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tataḥ snātvā naraḥ samyakcakravartyupacārakaḥ \|*  
*ācamyāvaśyakaṃ kṛtvā punardeva gṛhaṃ vrajet \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tamārādhya mahāyogaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum \|*  
*keśavāya namaḥ pādau kaṭiṃ dāmodarāya ca \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ūruyugmaṃ nṛsiṃhāya uraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe \|*  
*kaṇṭhaṃ kaustubhanāthāya vakṣaḥ śrīpataye tathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*trailokyavijayāyeti bāhu sarvātmane śiraḥ \|*  
*rathāṃgadhāriṇe cakraṃ śaṃkarāyeti cāṃbujam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*gambhīrāyeti ca gadāmabhayaṃ śāṃtamūrtaye \|*  
*evamabhyarcya deveśaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum \|\| 24 \|\|*

*punastasyāgrataḥ kumbhāṃścaturaḥ sthāpayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*jalapūrṇānsamālyāṃśca sitacandanacarcitān \|\| 25 \|\|*

19-25. Thus displaying the dust of the earth before the Sungod, he should apply the same over his entire body. Then making a circle with the same dust, he should take his bath. The sipping of the water is quite essential after that. Thereafter, he should go to the temple and worship the lord there, saying- Kesavaya namah and he should touch his feet; saying Damodaraya namah the waist should be touched; by saying Nrsimhaya namah both the shoulders should be touched; saying Srivatsadharine namah the thighs should be touched; saying Kaustubhaya namah the neck should be touched; saying Sripataye namah the chest should be touched; saying Trailokya-vijayd namah the arms should be touched; saying Sarvatmane namah the head should be touched; with Ratharigadharine namah the cakra should be touched; saying Sahkaraya namah the lotus should be touched; saying Gambhiraya namah the club should be touched. Then uttering Santamurtye namah, the mace should be touched. Thus worshipping lord Narayana - the god of gods, four lotus flowers should be consecrated in four different water vases before him, which should be decorated with garlands and the sandal paste should be applied to them.

## \|\| 3.83.26-27 \|\|

*caturbhistilapātraiśca sthagitānratnasaṃyutān \|*  
*catvāraste samudrāstu kalaśāḥ parikīrtitāḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ madhye tu saṃpīṭhaṃ sthāpayedvastrasaṃvṛtam \|*  
*tasminsauvarṇaṃ raupyaṃ vā tāmraṃ vā dāravaṃ tathā \|*  
*pātraṃ toyabhṛtaṃ kṛtvā tasya madhye tato nyaset \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Close to them four vases filled with sesamum seeds and a gem in each one of them, should also be placed besides the other vases. The four pitchers represent the four oceans. A beautiful pedestal should be made and covered with cloth, and a vase of gold, silver, copper or of wood should be placed over the same.

## \|\| 3.83.28 \|\|

*sauvarṇaṃ mātsyarūpeṇa kṛtvā devaṃ janārdanam \|*  
*vedavedāṃgasaṃyuktaṃ śrutismṛti vibhūṣitam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. In the water of the kalasa, a beautiful figure of Matsya (fish) should be placed. This figure should be made according to the provisions of the Vedas as well as the Puranas.

## \|\| 3.83.29-31 \|\|

*bhakṣyairbahuvidhai rājanphalaiḥ puṣpaiśca śobhitam \|*  
*gandhairdhūpairmaṃtravarairarcayitvā yathāvidhi \|\| 29 \|\|*

*rasātalagatā vedā yathā deva tvayāhṛtāḥ \|*  
*matsyarūpeṇa tadvanmāṃ bhavāduddhara keśava \|\| 30 \|\|*

*evamuccārya tasyāgre jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet \|*  
*yathāvibhavasāreṇa prabhā te'pi punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*caturṇāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu caturo dāpayeddhaṭān \|\| 31 \|\|*

29-31. Thereafter, one should worship the same and offer a prayer saying- “O Kesava, as you taking to the form of Matsya had redeemed the Vedas from the nether world, similarly you, kindly redeem me as well.” Thus praying, one should remain awake before that pedestal. Then in the morning, according to one’s own capacity, he should give away the kalasas (with daksina) to four clever (well-versed in scriptures) Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.83.32-36 \|\|

*pūrvaṃ tu bahvṛce dayācchaṃdoge dakṣiṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*yajuḥśākhānvite dadyātpaścimaṃ ghaṭamuttamam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*uttaraṃ kāmato dadyāddeśa eva vidhikramāt \|*  
*ṛgvedaḥ prīyatāṃ pūrvaṃ sāmavedaśca dakṣiṇaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*yajuṣaḥ paścimo nāmnā ātharvāyottaraṃ tathā \|*  
*pūrṇapātraistu satilaiḥ sthagitānkārayeddhaṭān \|\| 34 \|\|*

*tatastaṃ jalapātrasthaṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine \|*  
*dadyādevaṃ mahābhāga tataḥ paścāttu bhojayet \|\| 35 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇānpāyasānnena tataḥ paścātsvayaṃ gṛhī \|*  
*bhuñjīta bhṛtyasahito vāgyataḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

32-36. According to the procedure (laid down in the scriptures), the pitcher of the northern direction should be given to a Brahmana who is well-versed in the Rgveda; the southern pitcher should be given to a Chandagi or Samavedi Brahmana; the western kalasa should be given over to a Yajurvedi Brahmana; while the northern kalasa should be given to an Atharvavedi Brahmana of the choice of the giver. The pitcher filled with sesamum seeds should be given to a Brahmana having a family. The Brahmanas shall then be served with the food of payasam. Thereafter, the performer, together with his family and friends or relatives, should take his food.

## \|\| 3.83.37-39 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yastu dvādaśīṃ kṣapayennaraḥ \|*  
*tasya puṇyaphalaṃ rājañchṛṇu satyavatāṃ vara \|\| 37 \|\|*

*yadi vaktrasahasrāṇi bhavaṃti hi yugeyuge \|*  
*āyuśca brahmaṇastulyaṃ bhavedyadi mahāmate \|*  
*tadasya phalasaṃkhyānaṃ kartuṃ śakyaṃ na dhārayet \|\| 38 \|\|*

*yaḥ kṛṣṇadvādaśīmetāmanena vidhinā nṛpa \|*  
*karoti brahmalokaṃ sa samāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

37-39. O king, you are the incarnation of truth. A person who performs the vrata of this dvadasi, he earns enormous merit for a number of years, which is being told by me. You please listen. 0 most intelligent one, in case some one having long life like Brahma possessing a thousand faces, tries to narrate the glory of this vrata of the dark Dvadasi, then he surely achieves the Brahmaloka. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.83.40 \|\|

*brahmahatyādipāpāni janmāṃtarakṛtānyapi \|*  
*akāmataḥ kāmato vā praṇaśyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The sin of Brahmahatya committed knowingly or innocently, besides the blind heaps of sins vanish and the person becomes spotless with the performing of this vrata.

## \|\| 3.83.41-43 \|\|

*tathaiva pauṣamāsena amṛtaṃ mathitaṃ suraiḥ \|*  
*tacca kūrmobhavaddevaḥ svayameva janārdanaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tasyeyaṃ tithiruddiṣṭā harervai kūrmarūpiṇaḥ \|*  
*pauṣamāsaṃ samāsādya dvādaśīṃ śuklasaṃyutām \|\| 42 \|\|*

*tasyāṃ prāgvatsaṃkalpaḥ prātaḥsnānādikāḥ kriyāḥ \|*  
*nirvartyārādhayedrātryāmekādaśyāṃ janārdanam \|*  
*prīyamaṃtrairnṛpaśreṣṭha devadevaṃ jagadgurum \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. Similarly, in the month of Pausa, at the time of the churning, of the ocean, lord Janardana himself took to the form of a tortoise. Therefore, the said tirtha is quite desirable for lord Visnu, who took to the form of tortoise. On the bright dvadasi of the month of Pausa, one should take his bath in the early morning and free himself from the other routines. On the day of ekadasi, the image of lord Janardana should be worshipped who is the god of gods, besides being the preceptor of the world reciting the mantras.

## \|\| 3.83.44-48 \|\|

*kūrmāya pādau prathamaṃ supūjya nārāṇāyeti kaṭiṃ harestu \|*  
*saṅkarṣaṇāyetyudaraṃ viśodhetpurobhavāyeti ca kaṃṭhapīṭham \|\| 44 \|\|*

*subāhavetyeva bhujau śiraśca sarvātmane pāṃḍava pūjanīyau \|*  
*svanāmamaṃtreṇa ca śaṃkhacakre gadāṃ namaskārapareṇa caiva \|\| 45 \|\|*

*ebhirmantraiḥ puṣpasugandhadhūpairnaive dyadīpairvividhaiḥ phalaiśca \|*  
*abhyarcya devaṃ kalaśaṃ tadagre saṃsthāpayenmālyavilepanādyam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*taṃ ratnagarbhaṃ susugaṃdhatoyaṃ kṛtvā tato hemamayaṃ svaśa ktyā \|*  
*samaṃdaraṃ kūrmatanuṃ sureśaṃ saṃsthāpayeccātra śubhe ca pātre \|\| 47 \|\|*

*ghṛtaiśca pūrṇe kalaśā'grasaṃsthaṃ saṃpūjayejjāgaranṛtyagītaiḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjya viprānghṛtapāyasena nivedya pūrvaṃ dvijapuṅgavāya \|*  
*nirvartya sarvaṃ vidhivattataśca bhuñjīta saṃtuṣṭamanāḥ sabhṛtyaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

44-48. Then following mantras should be recited- “Kurmaya namah and the feet should be touched; saying Narayanaya namah the waist should be touched; the belly should be touched saying Sankarsanaya namah, saying Purobhavdya namah, the back and the neck should be touched; saying Subhahave namah the arms should be touched; saying Sarvatmane namah all the limbs should be touched.” The lord should thus be worshipped. Uttering one’s own name, with mantras the flowers, scent, incense, eatables, lamp and several types of fruits should be offered at the time of worship. Thereafter, a pitcher filled with water and decorated with sandal paste as well as the flower garlands should be consecrated, which should be filled with yellow coloured gems, scent and sweet water (collected from various sources). The golden idol of tortoise keeping it in a vase, should be placed over the kalasa along with ghi. It should then be adored. During night, the singing and dancing should be resorted to, remaining awake. After performing the worship, the Brahmana should be pleased by serving him the payasam, mixed with ghi.

## \|\| 3.83.49-51 \|\|

*evaṃ kṛte kalpayugāṃtarāṇi svarge vasetsarvasamṛddhakāmaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*saṃsāracakraṃ sa vihāya śīghramāpnoti loke tu hareḥ purāṇe \|*  
*prayāṃti pāpāni vināśamāśu śriyā yuto jāyati satyadharma \|\| 50 \|\|*

*anekajanmārjitasaṃyutāni naśyaṃti pāpāni narasya bhaktyā \|*  
*prāguktarūpaṃ ca phalaṃ labheta nārāyaṇaṃ vastumupaiti sadyaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

49-51. After completing all the formalities, one should remain delightful and the performer should himself take his food with others. By observing this vrata, the performer after his death, while reaching the heaven, enjoys all the comforts there for a period of a kalpa. Thereafter, travelling through the various Iokas, he finally reaches the Visnuloka. With the destruction of all the sins, be becomes the form of truth, A person who perforins this vrata with devotion, all the sins of his past births get destroyed and he finally attains the Narayana-loka.

## \|\| 3.83.52-54 \|\|

*evaṃ māghe site pakṣe dvādaśīṃ dharaṇīdhara \|*  
*varāhasya śṛṇuṣvānyāṃ rājanparamadhārmika \|\| 52 \|\|*

*prāguktena vidhānena snānaṃ saṃkalpameva ca \|*  
*kṛtvā devaṃ samabhyarcya ekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*dhūpanaivedyagaṃdhaistu arcayitvā punarnaraḥ \|*  
*paścāttasyāgrataḥ kuṃbhaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ tu vinyaset \|\| 54 \|\|*

52-54. Similarly, O lord of the earth, on the day of the bright dvadasi of the month of Magha, the image of the VarSha incarnation of Visnu should be worshipped. Following the aforesaid procedure, the immensely religious minded person should devotedly perform the worship of VarSha form of Visnu, offering incense, eatables and fragrance. Then a vase filled with water should be consecrated.

## \|\| 3.83.55-58 \|\|

*varāhāyeti pādau tu mādhavāyeti vai kaṭim \|*  
*kṣetrajñāyeti jaṭharaṃ viśvarūpetyuro hareḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*pūrvatrāyeti kaṃṭhaṃ tu prajānāṃ pataye śiraḥ \|*  
*pradyumnāyeti ca bhujau divyāstrā ya sudarśanam \|\| 56 \|\|*

*amṛtodbhavāya śaṃkhaṃ tu gadine ca gadāṃ tathā \|*  
*evamabhyarcya medhāvī tasminkuṃbhe'pi vinyaset \|\| 57 \|\|*

*sauvarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ tāmraṃ vā pātraṃ vibhavaśaktitaḥ \|*  
*sarvabījaistu saṃpūrṇaṃ sthāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

55-58. Then uttering the mantra- Varahaya namah, the feet should be touched; saying Madhavaya namah, the waist is to be touched; saying Ksetrajnaya namah the belly should be touched; saying Visvarupaya namah, the stomach should be touched; saying Purvatraya namah the neck should be touched; saying Prajanamam pataye namah the head should be touched; saying Pradyumn(iya namah the arms should be touched; saying Divyastraya namah the sudarsana cakra should be touched; saying Amrtodbhavaya namah the conch should be touched; and uttering Gadine namah the club should be touched and worshipped. The performer should then consecrate the image of Varaha over the kalasa, which should be made of gold, silver, copper or of any other metal. The image of Varaha should be consecrated with all the seeds.

## \|\| 3.83.59-61 \|\|

*tatra śaktyā ca sauvarṇaṃ vārāhaṃ kārayettataḥ \|*  
*daṃṣṭrāgreṇoddharanpṛthvīṃ saparvatavanadrumām \|\| 59 \|\|*

*mādhavaṃ madhuhaṃtāraṃ vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitam \|*  
*sarvabījabhṛtaiḥ pātrai ratnagarbhaghaṭopari \|\| 60 \|\|*

*sthāpayetparamaṃ devaṃ jātarūpamayaṃ harim \|*  
*sitavastrayugacchannaṃ tāmrābhāve tu vaiṇave \|\| 61 \|\|*

59-61. The image of Varaha should be placed in a vase and should be in gold. He was the killer of the demon Madhu, and the image of his Varaha form should be made in such a way, in which he (Varaha) should be carrying the earth over the tip of his tusk. The earth should be full of trees and forests. The Varaha should be shown as rescuing her. The gold image of Varaha should be placed over the kalasa covered with white branches, and should be consecrated in a copper vase or in the absence of the same, a vase of copper should be made and the image should be placed over the same.

## \|\| 3.83.62 \|\|

*sthāpyārcayedgandhapuṣpairnaivedyairvividhaiḥ phalaiḥ \|*  
*puṣpamaṃḍapikāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. The fragrant flowers, incense and various types of fruits should be offered while worshipping the lord. After performing the worship, the singing and dancing should be carried out during the night in the flower mandapa.

## \|\| 3.83.63-66 \|\|

*prādurbhāvaṃ harerdivyaṃ vācayedgāpayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ saniyamasyāsya prabhāte udite ravau \|\| 63 \|\|*

*vedavedāṅgaviduṣe sādhuvṛttāya dhīmate \|*  
*viṣṇubhaktāya rājendra viśeṣeṇa pradāpayet \|\| 64 \|\|*

*evaṃ sakuṃbhaṃ dattvā ca hariṃ vārāharūpiṇam \|*  
*brāhmaṇāya bhavedyadvatphalaṃ tanme niśāmaya \|\| 65 \|\|*

*iha janmani saubhāgyaṃ śrīkāntī puṣṭimeva ca \|*  
*prāpnoti puruṣo rājanyadyadicchati kiṃcana \|\| 66 \|\|*

63-66. The birthday of the lord should be observed at the same place. Thus observing all the rules at dawn, to a Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas besides being humble and the devotee of Vi$nu, the kalasa together with the image of VarSha should be gracefully given over to him and by so doing, the merit one earns, is going to be spoken out by me. You please listen. During the present birth, such a devotee enjoys all the fortunes, wealth, lustre and progress, besides all his desires are completed.

## \|\| 3.83.67-68 \|\|

*ekā'pi vidhinopāstā dadātyamṛtamuttamam \|*  
*kiṃpunarvarṣamekaṃ ca karoti kurunaṃdana \|\| 67 \|\|*

*eṣā ca phālgune māsi śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśī \|*  
*upoṣyā pūrvavidhinā harimārādhayetsudhīḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. О son of Kuru race, a person who performs this vrata appropriately even once, he achieves the excellent nectar. On the other hand, a person who performs this vrata for the whole one year, what could be said about him? On the bright dvadasi of the month of Phalguna, observing the fast, the learned people should worship the lord in an appropriate way.

## \|\| 3.83.69-71 \|\|

*narasiṃhāya pādau tu goviṃdāyodaraṃ tathā \|*  
*kaṭiṃ viśvasṛje pūjya aniruddhetyuro hareḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

*kaṃṭhaṃ tu śitikaṃṭhāya vainateyāya vai śiraḥ \|*  
*asuradhvaṃsanāyeti vaktraṃ toyātmane namaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*śaṃkhamityeva saṃpūjya gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ phalaistathā \|*  
*tadagre tu ghaṭaṃ sthāpya sitavastrayugānvitam \|\| 71 \|\|*

69-71. Again uttering Narasimhaya namah the feet are to be touched; saying Govindaye namah the belly is to be touched; saying Vidvasrje namah the waist should be touched; saying Aniruddhdye namah the thighs should be touched; saying Sitikanthaye namah the neck is to be touched; saying Vainteyaya namah the head is to be touched; saying Asuradhvamsaye namah the mouth is to be touched; saying Toyatmane namah, the conch is to be touched. All of them should then be worshipped offering flagrant flowers and fruits. After performing all these rites, four pitchers covered with cloth should be consecrated before the god.

## \|\| 3.83.72-74 \|\|

*tasyopari nṛsiṃhaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ tāmrabhājane \|*  
*haime ca śaktitaḥ kṛtvā dāruvaṃśamaye'pi vā \|\| 72 \|\|*

*ratnagarbhamaye sthāpya bhaktyā saṃpūjya mānavaḥ \|*  
*dvādaśyāṃ vedaviduṣe brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 73 \|\|*

*eṣā vaṃdyā pāpaharā dvādaśī bhavate mayā \|*  
*kathitā ca prayatnena śrutā ca bhavatepsitā \|\| 74 \|\|*

72-74. Lord Narasimha whose image is made in gold, copper or as per one’s means in wood or bamboo, should be consecrated over the pitcher filled with gems and then worshipped. Subsequently, on the day of dvadasi, the same image should be given over to a learned Brahmana with respect. Thus, I have explained to you the performing the adorable dvadasi, which is the remover of the sins. You on your part have also heard about it with devotion.

## \|\| 3.83.75 \|\|
