*evamenāṃ naravyāghra caitre saṃkalpya dvādaśīm \|*  
*upoṣyārādhayetpaścāddevadevaṃ janārdanam \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. О best of monarchs, similarly, on the bright dvadasi of the month of Caitra, one should observe the fast and lord Janardana should be worshipped.

## \|\| 3.83.76 \|\|

*kuṇḍikāṃ sthāpayetpārśve chatrikāṃ pāduke tathā \|*  
*amalaṃ vāmanaṃ sthāpya bṛsīṃ kāṃsaparicchadām \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. A small shallow pottery vase should be established at the same time to the west of the figure. Thereafter, the wooden sandals, umbrella and the image of Vamana should be placed over the seat of kusa.

## \|\| 3.83.77-78 \|\|

*phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sugandhaiśca prabhāte saddvijātaye \|*  
*dāpayetprīyatāṃ viṣṇurhrasvarūpītyudīrayet \|\| 77 \|\|*

*māsanāmnātra saṃyuktaṃ prādurbhāvaṃ vidhānataḥ \|*  
*prīyatāmiti sarvatra vidhireva prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

77-78. The flowers, fruits, scent etc. should be offered at the time of performing the puja. On the next day at dawn, all the things should be given to a chaste Brahmana with respect. Similarly, the same process has to be repeated during all the months of the year in order to please the lord with different names. This process has been commanded by all.

## \|\| 3.83.79 \|\|

*aputro labhate putramadhano dhanamāpnuyāt \|*  
*bhraṣṭarājyo labhedrājyaṃ mṛto viṣṇupuraṃ vrajet \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. It bestows son to the childless person, the pauper gets enormous riches, the king who had fallen from the kingship gets back his kingdom and after his death, he achieves the place of Visnu.

## \|\| 3.83.80 \|\|

*krīḍitvā suciraṃ kālamiha martyamupāgataḥ \|*  
*cakravartī bhaveddhīmānyayātiriti nāhuṣaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. After sporting there for a long time, he is reborn as a cakravarti king in the race of Nahusa or Yayati.

## \|\| 3.83.81-84 \|\|

*vaiśākhe'pyevamevaṃ tu saṃkalpya vidhivannaraḥ \|*  
*tadvatsnānaṃ mṛdā tadvattato devālayaṃ vrajet \|\| 81 \|\|*

*tatrārādhya hariṃ bhaktyā ebhirmantrairvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*jāmadagnyāya pādau tu udaraṃ sarvadhāriṇe \|\| 82 \|\|*

*madhusūdanāyeti kaṭimuraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe \|*  
*kṣatrāṃtakāya ca bhujau maṇikaṇṭhāya kaṇṭhakam \|\| 83 \|\|*

*pūjayenniyato bhūtvā surūpāyeti vai mukham \|*  
*svanāmnā śaṃkhacakre ca śiro brahmāṃḍadhāriṇe \|\| 84 \|\|*

81-84. During the month of Vaisakha, the devotee should take his bath with the sand and visit a Deva temple where he should utter these mantras and should worship lord Vi§nu, saying- Jamadagnye namah and should touch the feet; saying Sarvadharine namah the belly should be touched; saying Madhusudanaya namah the waist should be touched; saying Srivatsadharine namah, the thighs should be touched; saying K?atrdntakdya namah, the arms should be touched; then saying Manikanthaya namah the neck should be touched; saying Surupaya namah, the face is to be touched; then with the uttering of own name the conch and disc should be touched. Then saying Brahmandadharine namah, the head should be adored.

## \|\| 3.83.85 \|\|

*evamabhyarcya medhāvī prāgvaṃśasyāgrato ghaṭam \|*  
*vinyasyetpuṣpavastrāḍhyaṃ sitacandanacarcitam \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. Thereafter, a pitcher decorated with sandal paste and the flower garland, should be consecrated, covering it at the same time with cloth.

## \|\| 3.83.86-88 \|\|

*vaiṇave'bhinave pātre sthāpayenmadhusūdanam \|*  
*jāmadagnyena rūpeṇa kṛtvā sauvarṇamagrataḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇe paraśuṃ haste tasya devasya kārayet \|*  
*sarvagandhaistu saṃpūjya puṣpairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

*tatastasyāgrataḥ kuryājjāgaraṃ bhaktimānnaraḥ \|*  
*prabhāte vimale sūrye brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 88 \|\|*

86-88. After so establishing the pitcher, lord Madhusudana should be worshipped in the form of golden image of Janardana. The gold image of Parasurama should then be installed in the pitcher. The image should have a battle axe in the right hand. The image should then be worshipped and the devotee should remain awake throughout the night. In the early morning on the next day, at dawn, the image should be gracefully given over to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.83.89 \|\|

*evaṃ niyamayuktasya yatphalaṃ tannibodha me \|*  
*kāśyape brahmaṇo loke coṣitvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ \|*  
*sthitvā bhaute ca sṛṣṭau ca cakravartī bhaveddhruvam \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. Thus by performing the vrata in an appropriate manner, the merit earned by a person, is being revealed by me. You listen to the same. He enjoys the company of Apsaras in Brahmaloka for long with comforts. Then on bis rebirth on earth, he becomes a cakravarti king.

## \|\| 3.83.90 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhe māse'pyevameva saṃkalpya vidhivannaraḥ \|*  
*arcayetparamaṃ devaṃ puṣpairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. Similarly, in the month of Jyestha, the worship of the lord should be performed with a firm resolve, offering the pleasant flowers.

## \|\| 3.83.91-92 \|\|

*namo dāmodarāyeti pādau pūrvaṃ samarcayet \|*  
*trivikramāyeti kaṭiṃ dhṛtaviśvāya codaram \|\| 91 \|\|*

*uraḥ saṃvartakāyeti kaṇṭhaṃ saṃvatsarāya ca \|*  
*sarvāsudhāriṇe bāhuṃ svanāmnābjarathāṃgake \|\| 92 \|\|*

91-92. Initially speaking, Damodaraya namah, the feet should be touched. Saying Trivikramaya namah the waist should be touched; saying Dhrtavisvaya namah, the belly is to be touched; saying Samvartakaya namah, the knee should be touched; saying Samvatsaraya namah, the neck should be touched; saying Sarvasudharine namah the arms should be touched. Salutation should then be made to the lotus, cakra.

## \|\| 3.83.93-94 \|\|

*sahasraśirase'bhyarcya śirastasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*evamabhyarcya vidhivatprāguktavidhivannyaset \|\| 93 \|\|*

*prāgvadvastrasugandhaiśca sauvarṇau rāmalakṣmaṇau \|*  
*arcayitvā vidhānena prabhāte brāhmaṇāya tau \|*  
*dātavyau manasā kāmamīhatā puruṣeṇa tu \|\| 94 \|\|*

93-94. Then he should say Sahasrasirse namah. Thus saying, the head of the image should be adored. Thus performing the adoration with devotion as already stated earlier, the offering of sandal paste, flowers and costumes should be made. The pitcher should be covered with cloth and then the images of Sri Rama and Laksmana should be placed over the pitcher and the same may be adored. Again in the early morning at dawn, all the things of worship should be given over to a Brahmana. A person who does so, bis desires for having a son or the earning of merits become successful.

## \|\| 3.83.95-97 \|\|

*aputreṇa purā pṛṣṭo rājñā daśarathena tu \|*  
*putrakāmena yajatā vaśiṣṭhaḥ paramārcitaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

*idameva vidhānaṃ tu kathayāmāsa vai dvijaḥ \|*  
*sarahasyaṃ viditvātra sa rājā kṛtavāni dam \|\| 96 \|\|*

*tasya putraḥ svayaṃ jajñe rāmo nāma mahābalaḥ \|*  
*caturddhā so'vyayo viṣṇuḥ paritoṣādajāyata \|*  
*etadevaṃ mayākhyātaṃ paraloke sukhapra dam \|\| 97 \|\|*

95-97. Because in earlier time, the issueless king Dasaratha who discussed his problem with the sage Vasistha, then he prescribed the same process for the king, who performed this vrata with all prescribed procedures and then lord Visnu incarnated on earth in the form of Rama. Since the lord was immensely pleased with the performance of the vrata by Dasaratha, the lord took to four forms and graced the house of Dasaratha.

## \|\| 3.83.98-100 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*āṣāḍhe'pyevameva tu saṃkalpya vidhinā naraḥ \|*  
*arcayetparamaṃ devaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ samāhitaḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

*vāsudevāya pādau tu kaṭiṃ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca \|*  
*pradyumnāyeti jaṭharamaniruddhāya vai namaḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

*cakrapāṇiṃ bhujau kaṃṭhaṃ mukhaṃ bhūpataye tathā \|*  
*svanāmnā śaṃkhacakre tu puruṣāyeti vai śiraḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

98-100. Sri Krsna said Similarly, in the month of Asadha, after performing samkalpa, lord ViSnu should be worshipped in an appropriate manner offering fragrance and flowers. Then saying Vasudevaya namah, the feet should be touched; saying Sahkarsanya namah, the waist should be touched; saying Pradyumnaya namah, the stomach and saying Aniruddhaya namah, the arms and neck should be touched saying Cakrapani namah; saying Bhupataye namah, the face; uttering one’s own name, the conch and disc; saying Purusaya namah, the head should be adored.

## \|\| 3.83.101-102 \|\|

*evamabhyarcya medhāvī prāgvattasyāgrato ghaṭam \|*  
*vinyasya vastrasaṃyuktaṃ tasyopari tato nyaset \|*  
*kāṃcanaṃ vāsudeveti cakrabāhuṃ sanātanam \|\| 101 \|\|*

*tamabhyarcya vidhānena gaṃdhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt \|*  
*prāgvattadbrāhmaṇe dadyādvedavādini suvrate \|\| 102 \|\|*

101-102. After performing the worship quite well as has been done earlier, the intelligent person should place a pitcher covered with white cloth there and the image of eternal lord Cankrapani Vasudeva should be consecrated in a proper way, offering fragrant flowers etc. After worshipping the image, all the materials as well as the image should be given over to the learned Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.83.103-104 \|\|

*eṣā hyupoṣitā rājanvidyāṃ vipre prayacchati \|*  
*rājyaṃ ca bhraṣṭarājyānāmaputrāṇāṃ sutānbahūn \|\| 103 \|\|*

*mṛto viṣṇupure ramye krīḍate kālamakṣayam \|\| 104 \|\|*

103-104. O king, thus observing the fast, the vrata should be humbly completed and all the things should be given over to a Brahmana. By so doing, the king, who has fallen from the throne, gets back the same. An issueless person gets a son and after his death, he lovingly achieves Visnuloka where he enjoys all the sports for a long time.

## \|\| 3.83.105 \|\|

*manvaṃtarāṇi ṣaṭtriṃśattataḥ kālātyaye punaḥ \|*  
*iha loke bhavedrājā saptajanmani mānavaḥ \|*  
*dātā yaśaḥkṣamāyuktastato nirvāṇamāpnuyāt \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. After the lapse of many Manvantaras, he is reborn on earth where he achieves riches and glory immensely, becoming a virtuous king. After he becomes a king and after his death, he achieves salvation.

## \|\| 3.83.106 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*evamevaṃ śrāvaṇe tu māsi saṃkalpya dvādaśīm \|*  
*arcayetparamaṃ devaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpanivedanaiḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. Sri Krsna said- Similarly, on the dvadasi of the month of Sravana, performing the samkalpa and offering the fragrant flowers and begging forgiveness, the worship of lord Visnu should be performed.

## \|\| 3.83.107-110 \|\|

*budhāya pādau saṃpūjya śrīdharāyeti vai kaṭim \|*  
*padmodbhavāya jaṭharamuraḥ saṃvatsarāya ca \|\| 107 \|\|*

*sugrīvāyeti vai kaṇṭhaṃ bhujau vai citrabāhave \|*  
*prāgvadastrāṇi saṃpūjya brāhma ṇāya nivedayet \|\| 108 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā sarvāṃ dvādaśīṃ samupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*śudaudanena tasyābhūtsvayaṃ putro janārdanaḥ \|\| 109 \|\|*

*mahatīṃ ca śriyaṃ prāpya putrapautrasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*bhuktvā rājyaśriyaṃ sotha gataḥ paramikāṃ gatim \|\| 110 \|\|*

107-110. Saying Budhaya namah the feet should be touched; saying Sridharaya namah the navel should be touched; the belly should be touched saying Padmodbhavaya namah; saying Samvatsaraya namah, the neck should be touched; saying Citrabahave namah the arms should be touched. The worship should be performed thereafter. Then the pitcher covered with cloth should be consecrated tighter with the image as has been done in earlier cases. All these things should be given over to the Brahmana as before. Following the same process and observing the fast, lord Janardana incarnate in his home as Buddha and he achieves the sons, grandsons besides the Rajyalaksmi. After his death, he achieves the excellent position.

## \|\| 3.83.111 \|\|

*eṣa te vidhiruddiṣṭaḥ śrāvaṇe māsi sattama \|*  
*ekaikopoṣitāpyastu rājyamekaiva yacchati \|*  
*kiṃ punardvādaśaivātra dadyuraindraṃ mahatpadam \|\| 111 \|\|*

111\. Thus, I have spoken to you about the performance of the vrata in the month of Sravana. The performing of a single fast of dvadasi only once also bestows the kingship. Then the person who performs vratas of all the dvadasi in the year, what to speak of him? One’s so doing, achieves the position of Indra for him.

## \|\| 3.83.112 \|\|

*tadvadbhādrapade māsi śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśīm \|*  
*saṃkalpya vidhinā devamarcayetparameśvaram \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. Similarly, on the bright dvadasi of the month of Bhadrapada, one should worship lord Visnu, vowing a samkalpa.

## \|\| 3.83.113-114 \|\|

*namo'stu kalkine pādau hṛṣīkeśāya vai kaṭim \|*  
*mlecchapradhvaṃsanāyeti jaganmūrte tathodaram \|\| 113 \|\|*

*śitikaṇṭhāya kaṇṭhaṃ tu khaḍgapāṇīti vai bhujau \|*  
*śaṃkhacakre svanāmnātra viśvamūrte tathāsitaḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

113-114. Saying Kalkeya namah the feet should be touched, saying Hrsikesaya namah waist should be touched; saying Mleccha-pradhvamsaya namah and Jaganmurte namah, the chest should be touched; saying Sitikanthaya namah, the neck should be touched; saying Khadgapanite namah, the arms should be touched. Then reciting one’s own name, the conch and disc should be touched. Saying Visvamurte namah the head should be touched.

## \|\| 3.83.115-116 \|\|

*evamabhyarcya medhāvī prāgvattasyāgrato ghaṭam \|*  
*vinyasya kalkinaṃ devaṃ sauvarṇaṃ tatra kārayet \|\| 115 \|\|*

*sitavastrayugacchannaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpopaśobhitam \|*  
*kṛtvā prabhāte viprāya pradeyaḥ śāstravittame \|\| 116 \|\|*

115-116. Thereafter, the decorated pitcher, as already stated, should be consecrated. The gold image of Kalki should then be placed over the same, covering it with the white cloth. Offering the fragrant flowers, the lord should then be worshipped. After performing the worship of the image, it should be handed over to a learned Brahmana with humility.

## \|\| 3.83.117-118 \|\|

*evaṃ kṛte bhavedyattu tannibodha nṛpottama \|*  
*daśāvatāradānena pūjane caiva tatphalam \|\| 117 \|\|*

*pūjyate matsyarūpeṇa sarvajñatvamabhīpsubhiḥ \|*  
*svavaṃśabharaṇāyātha kūrmarūpī tu pūjyate \|\| 118 \|\|*

117-118. With the performing of the worship of the image, the reward one achieves is going to be spoken by me. You please listen. With the worship of the image, one achieves the merit of performing the worship of the ten incarnations of Visnu, which have been specified thus. For the desire to become omniscient, one has an audience with Matsya incarnation of Visnu. For worshipping the lord with the desire of keeping up the entire family, one should worship the Kurma form of Visnu.

## \|\| 3.83.119-121 \|\|

*bhavodadhinimagnaistu vārāhaḥ pūjyate hariḥ \|*  
*nṛsiṃhanavarūpeṇa tadvatpāpabhayānnaraḥ \|\| 119 \|\|*

*vāmanaṃ mohanāśāya vittārthe jamadagnijam \|*  
*krūraśatruvināśāya yajeddāśarathiṃ budhaḥ \|\| 120 \|\|*

*balakṛṣṇau yajeddhīmānputrakāmo na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*rūpakāmo yajedbuddhaṃ kalkinaṃ śatrughātane \|*  
*sarvāṃ dattvā vidhānena pūjāṃ prāpnoti vāṃchitam \|\| 121 \|\|*

119-121. For the crossing of the ocean of the universe the image of Varaha has to be adored. To get relieved of the sins, one has to adore the image of Nrsimha; for the removal of confusion or illusion, lord Vamana has to be adored; for achieving of the wealth, lord Jamdagni has to be worshipped, lord Rama has to be adored for the destruction of the terrible enemies. For having the desire of a son to be fulfilled, Balarama has to be adored. For the increase of one’s beauty, lord Krsna and Buddha have to be adored, while Kalki has to be adored for the destruction of the enemies. After performing the worship of all the gods, the charities so given become successful.

## \|\| 3.83.122 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*tadvadāśvayuje māsi śuklapakṣe tu dvādaśīm \|*  
*saṃkalpyābhyarcayeddevaṃ padmanābhaṃ sanātanam \|\| 122 \|\|*

122\. Srikrsna said- On the day of the bright twelfth moon day of the month of Asvina, one should vow a samkalpa, and then should worship lord Padmanabha. Saying Padmanabhaya namah the feet should be touched; saying Padmanyonaye namah waist; saying Sarvadevaya namah the belly should be touched. Saying Puskaraya namah, the chest should be touched.

## \|\| 3.83.123-124 \|\|

*padmanābhāya pādau tu kaṭiṃ vai padmayonaye \|*  
*udaraṃ sarvadevāya puṣkarākṣāya vā uraḥ \|*  
*avyayāya tathā śīrṣaṃ prāgvadastrāṇi pūjayet \|\| 123 \|\|*

*tatastasyāgrataḥ kuṃbhaṃ mālyavastrasamanvitam \|*  
*yathāśaktyā kāñcanena padmanābheti bhūṣitam \|\| 124 \|\|*

123-124. Saying Avyayaya namah, the head should be touched. All the weapons should then be adored. Thereafter, a pitcher decorated with the garland and cloth should be consecrated. The image of lord Padmanabha should then be made in gold and placed over the pitcher.

## \|\| 3.83.125-126 \|\|

*rātrau tu jāgaraṃ kṛtvā prabhāte vimale tataḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇe tatpradātavyaṃ saṃsārabhayabhīruṇā \|\| 125 \|\|*

*evaṃ kṛte tu yatpuṇyaṃ tadvaktuṃ śakyate katham \|*  
*brahmahatyādipāpāni kiṃ tu paṃcaiva bhārata \|*  
*naśyaṃti kṛtapuṇyasya viṣṇornāmānukīrtanāt \|\| 126 \|\|*

125-126. One should remain awake during the night and at next dawn, the performer of the vrata should give away all the aforesaid things to a learned Brahmana. The merit which a person earns, who performs the vrata in the above said manner, is beyond the power of my description. O Bharata, only this much would be enough to be stated about it, that the performer is relieved of the five types of the grave sins including the Brahmahatya, and all sins vanish with the reciting of merely the name of Visnu.

## \|\| 3.83.127-129 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu rājanmahābāho kārtike māsi dvādaśīm \|*  
*upoṣya vidhinā yena yathāsyāḥ prāpyate phalam \|\| 127 \|\|*

*prāgvidhānena saṃkalpya vāsudevaṃ prapūjayet \|*  
*anulomena deveśaṃ pūjayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*namo dāmodarāyeti sarvāṅgaṃ pūjayeddharim \|\| 128 \|\|*

*evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā tasyāśca caturo ghaṭān \|*  
*sthāpayedratnagarbhāśca sitacandanacarcitān \|\| 129 \|\|*

127-129. Srikrsna said- 0 long armed one, on the bright dvadasi of the month of Kartika, when a fast is undertaken and then worshipping the lord the merit which is earned by so doing, is being spoken by me, you please listen. As per the process laid down earlier, the worship of lord Vasudeva should be done. Starting from his feet, the head, the weapons and all the limbs should be worshipped in the descending order. Then saying Damodaraya namah, all the limbs of Visnu should be worshipped. Thus performing the worship in an appropriate manner, four decorated pitchers filled with gems should be consecrated before the lord. The sandal paste should be applied to these pitchers.

## \|\| 3.83.130-132 \|\|

*sragdāmālaṃbitagrīvānsitavastraiśca guṇṭhitān \|*  
*sthagitāṃstāmrapātre tu tilapūrṇaiḥ sakāṃcanaiḥ \|\| 130 \|\|*

*catvāraḥ sāgarāste ca kathitā rājasattama \|*  
*tanmadhye prāgvidhānena sauvarṇaṃ sthāpayeddharim \|\| 131 \|\|*

*yogeśvaramaṃganidhiṃ viraktaṃ pītavāsasam \|*  
*tadvaddeyaṃ ca saṃpūjya jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet \|\| 132 \|\|*

130-132. The pitchers should be decorated with the flower garlands, falling down from the neck. The pitchers should be covered with cloth. In a copper vase, the gold with sesamum flowers should be placed. O best of the kings, these four pitchers are equated with the four oceans. In the middle of these pitchers, the gold images of the god in the form of Yogesvara should be consecrated, clad in a pitambara. After adoring it, the performer should remain awake throughout the night.

## \|\| 3.83.133-137 \|\|

*kṛtvā tu vaiṣṇavaṃ yogaṃ yajedyogeśvaraṃ harim \|*  
*ṣoḍaśe vai rathāṃgeṣu rajobhirbahubhiḥ kṛte \|\| 133 \|\|*

*evaṃ kṛtvā prabhāte tu brāhmaṇānpañca bhojayet \|*  
*catvāraḥ kalaśā deyāścaturṇāṃ pañcamasya hi \|\| 134 \|\|*

*yogeśvaraṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ dāpayetprayataḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇāya samaṃ dattaṃ dviguṇaṃ vedavādine \|\| 135 \|\|*

*vedavedāṃgaviduṣe sahasraguṇitaṃ bhavet \|*  
*paṃcamasya rahasyaṃ tu sasamaṃ copapādayet \|\| 136 \|\|*

*vidhānaṃ tasya paṃcaiva dattvā koṭiguṇottaram \|*  
*itihāsapurāṇajñe dattaṃ caivākṣayaṃ bhavet \|\| 137 \|\|*

133-137. The worship of lord Visnu should be done as Yogesvara and the relevant mantra should be recited. His cakra should be more clearly visible and for this purpose, the worship should be performed by sixteen means. Early in the morning, the five Brahmanas should be served with food. Out of these five Brahmanas, four should be given a pitcher each, while the fifth Brahmana should be given the gold image of Yogesvara. By givingaway the pitcher to an ordinary Brahmana, the usual merit is earned, but by giving the same to a learned Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas, one earns a thousand times more merits. When the gold image is given over to the fifth Brahmana, the merit earned is quite simple, but when the same is given over to a Brahmana who is well-versed in the Vedas as well as the Puranas, one achieves the everlasting reward.

## \|\| 3.83.138 \|\|

*pañcadattvā vidhānena dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇumarcya ca \|*  
*viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ dayādyathāśaktyā sadakṣiṇam \|*  
*dīnānāthādikānsarvānpūjayecchaktito nṛpa \|\| 138 \|\|*

138\. Thus by giving away charities to all the five Brahmanas after worshipping lord Visnu on the eve of dvadasi and giving them the daksina as per one’s means, besides serving the food to the poor and the destitute, one earns full merit.

## \|\| 3.83.139 \|\|

*dharaṇīvratametattu purā kṛtvā prajāpatiḥ \|*  
*prajāṃ lebhe tato muktirbrahmaṇā viṣṇave śubhe \|\| 139 \|\|*

139\. O king, Prajapati had performed this Dharani-vrata and achieved the people (or the progeny), besides gaining salvation.

## \|\| 3.83.140 \|\|

*yuvanāśvo hi rājarṣiranena vidhinā purā \|*  
*māndhātāraṃ sutaṃ lebhe paraṃ brahma ca śāśvatam \|\| 140 \|\|*

140\. Yuvanasva - the royal Rsi, following the same process, performed the same vrata and had achieved the eternal Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 3.83.141-143 \|\|

*tathā haihayadāyādaḥ kṛtavīryo narādhipaḥ \|*  
*cakravartisutaṃ lebhe sahasrārjunamūrjitam \|\| 141 \|\|*

*śakuṃtalāpyevameva vrataṃ cīrtvā narottamam \|*  
*lebhe śākuntalaṃ putraṃ duṣyaṃtaścakravartinam \|\| 142 \|\|*

*tathā purāṇarājāno vedoktāścakravartinaḥ \|*  
*anena vidhinā prāptāścakravartitvamuttamam \|\| 143 \|\|*

141-143. Similarly, Krtavirya of the Haihaya race achieved a cakravarti son named Sahasrarjuna, while Dusyanta and Sakuntala when performed this vrata, they got a son named Bharata. Similarly, several of the kings mentioned in the Vedas performed this vrata with devotion in an appropriate manner, finally achieving the position of cakravarti rulers.

## \|\| 3.83.144 \|\|

*dharaṇyā api pātāle magnayācaritaṃ purā \|*  
*vratametattato nāmrā dharaṇīvratamucyate \|\| 144 \|\|*

144\. Initially, getting consigned in the water, the earth goddess observed this vrata as a result of which, it came to be known as Dharani vrata.

## \|\| 3.83.145 \|\|

*samāpte'smiṃstadā devī hariṇā kroḍarūpiṇā \|*  
*uddhṛtā daśanāgreṇa sthāpitā naurivāṃbhasi \|\| 145 \|\|*

145\. At the conclusion of the vrata, the image of Varaha should be made carrying the earth over the tip of his tuck like a boat floating in the water, while lord Varaha should be shown redeeming the earth.

## \|\| 3.83.146 \|\|

*dharaṇīvratametatte kathitaṃ pāṃḍunandana \|*  
*ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā yaśca kuryānnarottama \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇusāyujyamāvrajet \|\| 146 \|\|*

146\. Thus I have revealed the details of the Dharani-vrata to you. A person who listens to this story with devotion, he getting relieved of all the sins, achieves the Sayujjya devotion of lord Visnu.

## \|\| 3.83.147 \|\|

*cīrṇaṃ rasātalatale gatayā dharaṇyā tena prasiddhimagamaddharaṇīvrateti \|*  
*sadyaḥ samācarati dharmaratirddharitryāmuddhṛtya sapta puruṣānsa paraṃ prayāti \|\| 147 \|\|*

147\. On reaching the nether world, Dharani -the earth, appropriately performed this vrata, and thereby it came to be known as the Dharani-vrata. Therefore, on this earth, when this vrata is performed, the devoted person’s seven generations achieve the heaven.

## Chapter 84. Visoka Dvadasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.84.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kimabhīṣṭaviyogaśokasaṃghāllaghu iha samupoṣatāṃ vrataṃ vā \|*  
*vibhavodbhavakāri bhūtale'sminbhavati vibho bhayasūdanaṃ ca puṃsām \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- О magnanimous one, you kindly speak about some short vratas, by which the people could get their desires fulfilled, besides enhancement of their riches and removal of the danger.

## \|\| 3.84.2-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*paripṛṣṭamidaṃ jagatpriyaṃ te vibudhānāmapi durllabhaṃ mahattvāt \|*  
*tava bhaktimatastathāpi vakṣye vratamindrāsuradānaveṣu guhyam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*puṇyamāśvayuje māsi viśokadvādaśīvratam \|*  
*daśamyāṃ laghubhugvidvānārabhenniyamena tu \|\| 3 \|\|*

*udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam \|*  
*ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samyagabhyarcya keśavam \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Sri Krsna said- For the benefit of the world and keeping in view your devotion, I am answering your question, relating to a vrata which is quite important, besides being secret from the Gods, Danavas and the Raksasas. During the bright tenth moon day of the month, one should take light food and perform the auspicious vrata of Visoka Dvadasi in an appropriate way. The vrata should be started by brushing the teeth with tooth stick facing east or north-east. On the day of ekadasi, one should observe fast and should worship lord Kesava in an appropriate manner.

## \|\| 3.84.5-6 \|\|

*vidhivattvāṃ samabhyarcya bhokṣyāmi apare'hani \|*  
*evaṃ niyamakṛtsuptvā prātarutthāya mānavaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*snānaṃ sarvauṣadhaiḥ kuryātpañcagavyajalena tu \|*  
*śuklamālyāṃbarastadvatpūjayecchrīśamutpalaiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Then he should take a vow- “I shall take my food the next day.” With this resolve, he should go to sleep. At dawn, he should collect all the herbs and pancagavya should be mixed in water and should take his bath with the same water and then should clad himself in white garments and the garland. He should then worship Visnu - the lord of Laksmi.

## \|\| 3.84.7-9 \|\|

*viśokāya namaḥ pādau jaṃghe ca varadāya vai \|*  
*śrīśāya jānunī tadvadūrū ca jalaśāyine \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kaṃdarpāya namo guhye mādhavāya namaḥ kaṭim \|*  
*dāmodarāyetyudaraṃ pārśve ca vipulāya vai \|\| 8 \|\|*

*nābhiṃ ca padmanābhāya hṛdayaṃ manmathāya vai \|*  
*śrīdharāya vibhorvakṣaḥ karau madhubhide namaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. Then uttering the mantra- Visokaya namah, he should touch the feet; saying Varadaya namah, the thighs should be touched; saying Srisaya namah, the knees should be touched; saying Jalasayine namah, the waist should be touched; uttering Kandarpaye namah and Madhavaya namah the shoulders should be touched; then saying Damodaraya namah, the belly should be touched; saying Vipulaya namah, the back has to be touched; saying Padmanabhaya namah, the navel should be touched; saying Manmathaya namah, the heart is to be touched; uttering Sridharaya namah the chest should be touched; saying Madhubhide namah the hands should be touched.

## \|\| 3.84.10-11 \|\|

*cakriṇe nāma bāhuṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ gadine namaḥ \|*  
*vaikuṇṭhāya namaḥ kaṇṭhamāsyaṃ yajñamukhāya vai \|\| 10 \|\|*

*nāsāmaśokanidhaye vāsudevāya cākṣiṇī \|*  
*lalāṭaṃ vāmanāyeti kirīṭaṃ viśvarūpiṇe \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Then saying Cakrine namah the left arm has to be touched; saying Gadine namah, the right arm is to be touched; saying Vaikunthiya namah, the neck is to be touched; saying Yajnamukhaya namah the face is to be touched; saying Asokanidhaye namah, the nose is to be touched; saying Vasudevaya namah both the eyes are to be touched; saying Vamanaya namah the forehead should be touched; saying Visvarupaya namah the crown has to be touched.

## \|\| 3.84.12 \|\|

*namaḥ sarvātmane tadvacchira ityabhipūjayet \|*  
*evaṃ saṃpūjya goviṃdaṃ phalamālyānulepanaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Uttering Sarvatmane namah, the head of Govinda should be adored. The puja should then be performed offering fruit, flower garlands, as well as the paste.

## \|\| 3.84.13 \|\|

*tatastasyāgrato bhavyaṃ sthaṃḍilaṃ kārayenmṛdā \|*  
*caturasraṃ samaṃtāccāratnimātramudagbhavam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thereafter, a beautiful Vedi or pedestal should be made in mud which should be square in shape and should be having a slope towards the north.

## \|\| 3.84.14 \|\|

*nadīvālukayā pūrṇaṃ lakṣmyākṛtiṃ kṛtī nyaset \|*  
*sthaṃḍile sūryamāropya lakṣmīmityarcayedbudhaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Covered with the layer of the river sand, the image of Laksmi should be placed over it, then the Sungod should be invoked and worshipped. Finally, the prayer for forgiveness should be made.

## \|\| 3.84.15-16 \|\|

*namo devyai namaḥ śāṃtyai namo lakṣmyai namaḥ śriye \|*  
*namaḥ puṣṭyai namastuṣṭyai namo dṛṣṭyai namonamaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*viśokā duḥkhanāśāya viśokā varadāstu me \|*  
*viśokā vāstu saṃtatyai viśokā sarvasiddhaye \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Then invoking the goddesses, he should say “Salutation to the goddess Santi, I.aksmi, Sri Pusti. Tusti and Drsti, salutation to all of you Destroying the grief and miseries, you bestow a boon on me and bestow me the continuous progeny. Let the goddess Visoka bestow' full success on me.”

## \|\| 3.84.17-22 \|\|

*tataḥ śuklāṃbaradharo śūrpaṃ saṃveṣṭya pūjayet \|*  
*bhakṣyairnānāvidhaistadvatsuvarṇakamalena ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

*rajanīṣu ca sarvāsu pibeddarbhodakaṃ vratī \|*  
*tatastu nṛtyagītādi kārayetsarvarātrakam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*yāmatraye vyatīte tu suptvā svasthopamānasaḥ \|*  
*abhigamya ca viprāṇāṃ mithunāni sadārcayet \|\| 19 \|\|*

*śaktitastrīṇi caikaṃ vā vastramālyānulepanaiḥ \|*  
*śayanāsthāni pūjyāni namo'stu jalaśāyine \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tatastu gītavādyādyai rātrau jāgaraṇe kṛte \|*  
*prabhāte vimale snānaṃ kṛtvā dāṃpatyamarcayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

*bhojanaṃ ca yathāśaktyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*bhuktvā śrutvā purāṇāni taddinaṃ tvativāhayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

17-22. The person should clad himself in white clothes and decorate winnowing basket in which several types of eatables should be placed, together with the lotus flowers and then the god should be worshipped. During the night, the fast should be broken consuming the water of kusa grass. The sleeping place of the lord should be worshipped saying- “Salutation to the lord who sleeps in the watery bed.” The relevant mantra is- Namo’stu jalasayine. Thus with dancing and singing companied with music, the night should be spent while remaining awake. Then in the morning, one should take his bath and adore the Brahmana couple Then the daksina should be given discarding the miserliness The food should be also served to the Brahmanas, satisfying them completely He should take his food thereafter Then, he should listen to the recitation of the Puranas during the whole day.

## \|\| 3.84.23-25 \|\|

*anena vidhinā sarvaṃ māsimāsi samācaret \|*  
*vratāṃte śayanaṃ dadyādguḍadhenusamanvitam \|*  
*sopadhānakaviśrāmamāstarāvaraṇaṃ śubham \|\| 23 \|\|*

*yathā na lakṣmīrdeveśa tvāṃ parityajya gacchati \|*  
*tathā kuru yathāyogyamaśokaṃ cāstu me sadā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*yathā devena rahitā na lakṣyīrjāyate kvacit \|*  
*tathā viśokatā me'stu bhakti ramyā ca keśave \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. This vrata should be performed during each month, following the same process. At the end, the raw sugar, cow, bed with bed sheet and pillows should be given to a Brahmana. Thereafter, one should beg forgiveness, saying- “O lord of the Devas, as Laksmi can never desert you, similarly, you kindly make me free from grief in future. As Laksmi never leaves without the lord, therefore relieving me of the grief, bestow on me the excellent devotion of Kesava.”

## \|\| 3.84.26-27 \|\|

*maṃtreṇānena dhyātvā tu guḍadhenusamanvitam \|*  
*śūrpaṃ ca lakṣmyā sahitaṃ dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā \|\| 26 \|\|*

*utpātaṃ karavīraṃ ca bāṇamamlāna kuṃḍalam \|*  
*kesaraṃ siṃduvāraṃ ca mallikāgaṃdhapāṭalam \|*  
*kādaṃbaiḥ kuṃkumairjātyā tathānyairapi pūjayet \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Keeping this mantra is mind, for the sake of achieving enormous riches, the raw sugar, the cow and the winnowing basket with the image of Laksmi should be given in charity. The goddess should always be offered flowers of oleander, saffron, jasmine, fragrant patala, kadamba and several other flowers.

## \|\| 3.84.28 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*guḍadhenuvidhānaṃ me tvamācakṣva jagatpate \|*  
*kiṃrūpā kena maṃtreṇa dātavyā tadihocyatām \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Yudhisthira said- O lord of the universe, you kindly tell me the method of charity of the raw sugar and the cow. What is its form and what is the mantra, which is related to that charity.

## \|\| 3.84.29-33 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*guḍadhenuvidhānaṃ ca yadrūmiha yatphalam \|*  
*tadidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇājinaṃ caturhastaṃ prāgevaṃ vinyasedbhuvi \|*  
*gomayenānuliptāyāṃ darbhānāstīrya sarvataḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*labdhena kāṃcanaṃ tadvadvatsaṃ ca parikalpayet \|*  
*prāṅmukhīṃ kalpayeddhenumudakpādāṃ savatsikām \|\| 31 \|\|*

*uttamā guḍadhenuḥ syātsadā bhāra catuṣṭayā \|*  
*vatsaṃ bhāreṇa kurvīta dvābhyāṃ vai madhyamā smṛtā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*arddhabhāreṇa vatsaḥ syātkaniṣṭhā bhārakeṇa tu \|*  
*caturthāṃśena vatsaḥ syādgṛhavittā nusārataḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

29-33. Sri Krsna said- I am speaking about the Gudadhenu vrata, its form and the related merit, which removes all the sins over the four cubits of earth which should be plastered with the cowdung. The deer skin of four cubits size should be placed over it. Then kusa grass should be spread around the same. A cow with a calf should be conceived as standing with her face to the north. The cow of raw sugar of four parts is considered to be the best. The calf should be made of a bhara of raw sugar. The cow should be made of two parts, and half of it’s should be used for making a calf. The mediocre type of cow is conceived of a single bhara of guda or raw sugar. The fourth part of it is to be meant for making a calf.

## \|\| 3.84.34-41 \|\|

*dhenuvatsau kṛtāvetau sitasūkṣmāṃbarāvṛtau \|*  
*śuktikarṇāvikṣupādau śuktimuktāphalekṣaṇau \|\| 34 \|\|*

*sitasūtraśirālau tu sitakaṃbala kaṃbalau \|*  
*tāmragallakapṛṣṭau tau sitacāmararomakau \|\| 35 \|\|*

*vidrumabhrūyugāvetau navanītastanānvitau \|*  
*kṣaumapucchau kāṃsyadohāvindranīlakatārakau \|\| 36 \|\|*

*suvarṇaśṛṃgābharaṇau rājatakhurasaṃyutau \|*  
*nānāphalasamāyuktau ghrāṇagaṃdhakaraṃḍakau \|*  
*ityevaṃ racayitvā tu dhūpadīpairathārcayet \|\| 37 \|\|*

*yā lakṣmīḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yā ca deve vyavasthitā \|*  
*dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu \|\| 38 \|\|*

*viṣṇorvakṣasi yā lakṣmīḥ svāhāyāṃ ca vibhāvasau \|*  
*caṃdrārkaśakraśaktiryā dhenurūpāstu sā śriye \|\| 39 \|\|*

*caturmukhasya yā lakṣmīryā lakṣmīrdhanadasya ca \|*  
*yā lakṣmīrlokapālānāṃ sā dhenurvaradāstu me \|\| 40 \|\|*

*svadhā tvaṃ pitṛmukhyānāṃ svāhā yajñabhujāṃ punaḥ \|*  
*sarvapāpahare dheno tasmādbhūtiṃ prayaccha me \|\| 41 \|\|*

34-41. Thus making a cow with calf of raw sugar, it should be covered with few cloths. The ears should be made of shell or mother of pearls, the hoofs should be made of sugarcane, the eyes should be of pearls, the blood vessels should be of white cotton thread, the neck should be of blankets, the back should be made of copper sheet, the hair should be of fiywhisk, the eyebrows should be of coral, the udder should be of butter, the tail should be of silk yarn, the milk pot should be made of bronze, the eyes retina should be of sapphire, the horns should be made of gold. The hoofs should be of silver. The nostrils should be made with the use of fruits. Thus making the cow, one should worship her offering incense and lamp. Thereafter, one should beg forgiveness.

## \|\| 3.84.42-43 \|\|

*evamāmaṃtrya tāṃ dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya nive dayet \|*  
*vidhānametaddhenūnāṃ sarvāsāmiha paṭhyate \|\| 42 \|\|*

*yāstu pāpavināśinyaḥ śrūyate daśa dhenavaḥ \|*  
*tāsāṃ svarūpaṃ vakṣyāmi nāmāni ca narā dhipa \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. The cow should thus be created in the aforesaid manner. The same process has been prescribed for the donating of the cow. O great king. I am now speaking about the ten cows, which have been declared to be the remover of the sins.

## \|\| 3.84.44-45 \|\|

*prathamā guḍadhenuḥ syād ghṛtadhenurathāparā \|*  
*tiladhenustṛtīyā syāccaturthī madhudhenukā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*jaladhenuḥ paṃcamī tu ṣaṣṭhī tu kṣīrasaṃbhavā \|*  
*saptamī śarkarādhenurdadhidhenurathāṣṭamī \|*  
*rasadhenuśca navamī daśamī syātsvarūpataḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. First of all is said to be the cow made of guda or raw sugar. The second one is known as ghrta-dhenu made of ghi; the third is tila-dhenu made of sesamum seeds; the fourth one is madhu-dhenu made of honey; the fifth one is jala-dhenu made of water; the sixth one is ksira-dhenu made of milk; the seventh one is sarkara-dhenu made of raw sugar; the eighth one is dadhi-dhenu made of curd; the ninth is the rasa-dhenu made of juices; and the tenth one is a living cow. These are the ten types of cows which have been defined in the texts.

## \|\| 3.84.46-47 \|\|

*kuṃbhā syurdaśadhenūnāmitarāsāṃ tu rāśayaḥ \|*  
*suvarṇadhenumapyatra kecidicchaṃti mānavāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*navanītena ratnaiśca tathāpyanye maharṣayaḥ \|*  
*etadeva vidhānaṃ syātta evopaskarāḥ smṛtāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. Some of the learned people are of the opinion that for nine cows, the pitchers should be conceived and for the tenth one a heap (of fodder) is conceived. There is another cow which is different from all, which is made of gold. In the opinion of other Maharsis, the cow is formed of the butter and the pearls. But the process of worshipping of all of them is the same.

## \|\| 3.84.48-50 \|\|

*maṃtrāvāhanasaṃyuktāṃ sadā parvaṇiparvaṇi \|*  
*yathāśraddhaṃ pradātavyā bhuktimuktiphalapradā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*guḍadhenuprasaṃgena sarvāstava mayoditāḥ \|*  
*aśeṣayajña phaladāḥ sarvapāpaharāḥ śubhāḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*vratānāmuttamaṃ yatsyādviśokadvādaśīvratam \|*  
*tadaṃgatvena caivaiṣā guḍadhenuḥ praśasyate \|\| 50 \|\|*

48-50. On the occasion of each one of the festivities, the devotees must give away the cows as stated above with the recitation of related mantras. Thus, in the context of ths Guda-dhenu, I have mentioned about all the cows to you, which yield the merit of all the sacrifices, besides removing of all the sins, being auspicious at the same time. This Visoka-Dvadasi vrata has been said to be the best of all the vratas and in the same context, the giving away of Guda-dhenu is said to be quite praiseworthy.

## \|\| 3.84.51-52 \|\|

*ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte'tha vā punaḥ \|*  
*guḍadhenvādayo deyā uparāgādiparvasu \|\| 51 \|\|*

*viśokadvādaśī caiṣā sarvapāpaharā śubhā \|*  
*yāmupoṣya naro yāti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam \|\| 52 \|\|*

51-52. Both the ayanas (tropics), equinox, auspicious time, vyatipata-yoga or at the time of solar or lunar eclipses, when Guda-dhenu is donated, (it yields extra merit). (Therefore, the Guda-dhenu must be given on these occasions.) This Visoka-Dvadasi removes all the sins besides being quite auspicious, in which a person, while fasting, achieves the supreme place of Visnu.

## \|\| 3.84.53-54 \|\|

*iha loke tu saubhāgyamāyurārogyameva ca \|*  
*vaiṣṇavaṃ padamāpnoti maraṇe sadgatirbhavet \|\| 53 \|\|*

*bhavārbudasahasrāṇi daśa cāṣṭau ca dharmavit \|*  
*na śokaduḥkhadaurgatyaṃ tasya saṃjāyate nṛpa \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. The devotee enjoys all the fortunes, long life and good health on earth. After his death, he reaches the Visnuloka. O king, with the performing of this vrata, the devotee is relieved of all the grief for eighteen thousand million of years and has never to face miseries.

## \|\| 3.84.55 \|\|

*nārī vā kurute yā tu viśokadvādaśīmi mām \|*  
*nṛtyagītaparā nityaṃ sāpi tatphalamāpnuyāt \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. When a woman performs the vrata of Vidoka Dvadasi by remaining awake and dancing and singing (on the eve of the vrata). she achieves all the aforesaid merits.

## \|\| 3.84.56 \|\|

*iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ yaḥ śṛṇotīha samyaṅ madhupuranarakārerarcanaṃ yaśca paśyet \|*  
*matimapi ca janānāṃ yo dadātīndraloke vasati sa vibudhādyaiḥ pūjyamānaḥ sadaiva \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Thus, with the performing of this vrata as well as listening to (the glory of) the same, the destroyer of Madhu bestows the noble wisdom on such devotees. Getting respected in Indraloka, they enjoy all the comforts.

## Chapter 85. Vibhuti Dvadasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.85.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu bhūpāla vakṣyāmi viṣṇuvratamanuttamam \|*  
*vibhūtidvādaśīṃ nāma sarvāmaranamaskṛtam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kārttike vātha vaiśākhe mārgaśīrṣe ca phālgune \|*  
*āṣāḍhe vā daśamyāṃ ca śuklāyāṃ laghubhuṅnaraḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kṛtvā sāyaṃtanīṃ saṃdhyāṃ gṛhṇīyānniyamaṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya janārdanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Sri Krsna said - I am now highlighting the observing of the Vibhuti Dvadasi, which is considered to be the foremost of all the vratas of Visnu and is adorable by all the gods. You listen to me attentively. During the months of Kartika, Vaisakha and Margasirsa, besides Phalguna or the month of Asadha, on the bright dasami day, after light food and after performing the Sandhya-vandana in the evening, the following rules of the vrata should be followed. О excellent one, on the day of ekadasi, one should observe complete fast and lord Janardana should be worshipped.

## \|\| 3.85.4-5 \|\|

*dvādaśyāṃ dvijasaṃyuktaḥ kariṣye bhojanaṃ vibho \|*  
*tadavighnena me yātu sāphalyaṃ madhūsūdana \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tataḥ prabhāta utthāya kṛtasnānajapaḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*pūjayetpuṇḍarīkākṣaṃ śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Then he should take food on the day of dvadasi in the company of the Brahmanas. He should pray- “Let my vrata be completed without any obstruction. Let my vrata be successful.” With this resolve, he should go to sleep. During the next morning, he should purify himself after taking a bath. He should then worship the lord offering the garland of white flowers, paste and other materials.

## \|\| 3.85.6-8 \|\|

*bhūtidāya namaḥ pādau viśokāya ca jānunī \|*  
*namaḥ śivāyetyūrū ca viśvamūrte namaḥ kaṭim \|\| 6 \|\|*

*kaṃdarpāya namo meḍhramādityāya namaḥ karau \|*  
*dāmodarāyetyudaraṃ vāsudevāya ca stanau \|\| 7 \|\|*

*mādhavāyeti hṛdayaṃ kaṃṭhaṃ vaikuṃṭhine namaḥ \|*  
*śrīdharāya mukhaṃ keśānkeśavāyeti pāṃḍava \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. He should offer prayer to him, sayingSalutation to the one who bestows riches, and after saying this, he should touch both the feet of the lord. He should then offer salutation to lord Siva and touch the thighs. Saying Visvamurte namah, the waist should be touched. Saying salutation to Kandarpa, the linga and Aditya should be adored. Saying salutation to Damodara, the belly should be touched; saying salutation to Vasudeva, the chest should be touched; offering salutation to Madhava, the heart should be touched. Saying Vaikunthine namah, the neck should be touched. Saying salutation to Sridhara, the mouth should be touched; saying Kesavaya namah, the hair should be touched.

## \|\| 3.85.9-10 \|\|

*pṛṣṭhaṃ śārṅgadharāyeti śravaṇau varadāya vai \|*  
*svanāmnā śaṃkhacakrāsigadāparaśupāṇaye \|\| 9 \|\|*

*sarvātmane śiro rājannama ityabhipūjayet \|*  
*daśāvatārarūpāṇi pratimāsaṃ kramānnṛpa \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Saying Sarangadharaya namah, the back should be touched. Saying Varadaya namah both the ears should be touched. Saying salutation to the holder of a battle axe, the conch, disc, club and sword should be touched. Saying salutation to Sarvatama or the universal soul, the head should be touched. The lord should be worshipped in this way with all the ten incarnations, offering worship every month.

## \|\| 3.85.11-12 \|\|

*dattātreyaṃ yathā vyāsamutpalena samanvitam \|*  
*dadyādanena vidhinā pākhaṃḍānapi varjayet \|\| 11 \|\|*

*samāpyaivaṃ yathāśaktyā dvādaśa dvādaśīrnaraḥ \|*  
*saṃvatsarāṃte lavaṇaparvatena saha prabho \|*  
*śayyāṃ dadyānmuniśreṣṭha gurave rasasaṃyutām \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. Besides the images of Dattatreya and Vyasa should also be worshiped following the same process. The images should then be given over to the Brahmanas, discarding all the fallacies or confusion. After performing the vratas of all twelve dvadasis, at the time of the conclusion of the vrata, a heap of salt and a bed for Vi$nu should be given over to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.85.13 \|\|

*grāmaṃ ca śaktimāndadyātkṣetraṃ vā bhavanānvitam \|*  
*guruṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadvadvastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The powerful person should also give away a village or a decorated house should be given over to his preceptor. The preceptor should thereafter be worshipped, offering the costumes and ornaments in a proper manner.

## \|\| 3.85.14-15 \|\|

*anyānapi yathāśaktyā bhojayitvā dvijottamān \|*  
*tarpayedvastragodānairanyatra dhanasaṃcayāt \|\| 14 \|\|*

*alpavitto yathāśaktyā stokaṃstokaṃ samācaret \|*  
*yaścātiniḥsvaḥ puruṣo bhaktimānmādhavaṃ prati \|*  
*puppārcanavidhānena sa kuryādvatsaratrayam \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Thereafter, all other Brahmanas should also be satisfied giving the food and daksina of cows or riches or both as per one’s capacity. The people with limited means should perform the vrata by spending small amounts. A person who is quite poor but devoted to lord Furusottama, should perform this vrata offering flowers alone for three years.

## \|\| 3.85.16-17 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yastu vibhūtidvādaśīvratam \|*  
*kuryātsa pāpanirmuktaḥ pitṝṇāṃ tārayecchatam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*janmanāṃ śatasāhasraṃ na śokaphalabhāgbhavet \|*  
*na ca vyādhirbhavettasya na dāridyaṃ na bandhanam \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. A person, who following the correct process, when performs this Vibhuti Dvadasi vrata, he getting relieved of all the sins, redeems a hundred generations of his ancestors. For hundreds and thousands of years, he is never overpowered by grief. He neither attracts any ailment nor poverty. He also remains free from all the bondages.

## \|\| 3.85.18 \|\|

*vaiṣṇavo vātha śaivo vā bhavejanmanijanmani \|*  
*yāvadyugasahasrāṇāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ bhavet \|*  
*tāvatsvarge vasedrājanbhūpatiśca punarbhavet \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. During each birth, he remains a devotee of Visnu or Siva and enjoys all the comforts in the heaven for a hundred and eight thousand years and ultimately, again becomes a king on earth after his rebirth.

## \|\| 3.85.19 \|\|

*purā rathaṃtare kalpe rājāsītpuṣpavāhanaḥ \|*  
*nāmnā lokeṣu vikhyātastejasā sūryasannibhaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. During the Rathantara-kalpa in earlier times, there ruled a king known by the name of Puspavahana, who had been quite popular on earth and was illustrious like the Sun.

## \|\| 3.85.20-22 \|\|

*tapasā tasya tuṣṭena caturvaktreṇa bhārata \|*  
*kamalaṃ kāñcanaṃ dattaṃ yathākāmagatiḥ sadā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*samastabhṛtyasahitaḥ sāṃtaḥpuraparisthitaḥ \|*  
*dvīpāni suralokaṃ ca yatheṣṭaṃ vicaratyasau \|\| 21 \|\|*

*kalpādau saptame dvīpe tena puṣkaravāsinaḥ \|*  
*loke saṃpūjitā yasmātpuṣkaradvīpa ucyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. The four-faced Brahma getting pleased with his tapas, gave him a golden lotus, which granted all the wishes. Because of the grace of that lotus, he used to move at will with his wives and servants in all the continents. At the start of the kalpa, he was granted the seventh continents by Brahma. The people of that place were adored by the world, therefore, they were known as Puskaras or the dwellers of the Puskara continent.

## \|\| 3.85.23 \|\|

*tadaiva brahmaṇā dattaṃ yānamasya yato nṛpa \|*  
*puṣpavāhanamityāhustasmāttaṃ devadānavāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Brahma had given that king the island. He became adorable by the people of the land. Therefore, the gods and daityas popularized him by the name of Puspa-Vahana.

## \|\| 3.85.24 \|\|

*nāgasya tasyāsya jagattrayepi brahmāṃbujasthasya tapo'nubhāvāt \|*  
*patnī ca tasyāpratimā narendra nārīsahasrairabhito'bhinaṃdyā \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. О Indra among the humans, with the influence of the tapas, the wife of the excellent king who had received a golden lotus from Brahma, also had a unique personality, who was always adored by thousands of women.

## \|\| 3.85.25 \|\|

*nāmnā ca lāvaṇyavatī babhūva yā pārvatīveṣṭatamā bhavasya \|*  
*tasyātmajānāmayutaṃ babhūva dharmātmanāmagryadhanurddharāṇām \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The queen who was an exquisite beauty like Parvati - the spouse of lord Siva, was immensely favourite of the king, her husband. She gave birth to a son, who had the strength of ten thousand archers.

## \|\| 3.85.26-27 \|\|

*tadātmanaḥ sarvamavekṣya rājā muhurmuhurvismayamāsasāda \|*  
*sobhyāgataṃ pūjya munipravīraṃ pracetasaṃ vācamimāṃ babhāṣe \|\| 26 \|\|*

*kasmādvibhūtiramalā mama martyapūjyā jāyā ca sarvavijitāmarasundarī yā \|*  
*bhāryā tvanalpatapasā vasutoṣitena dattaṃ mamāṃbujagṛhaṃ paramaprasādāt \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. The king observing his enormous fortunes, a wife with unique beauty and an unparallel son, felt extremely surprised. Once Maharsi Pracetas arrived at the king’s place, who gave him an excellent welcome and then said to the Maharsi- “O Deva, this spotless fortune of mine, besides my wife who is adorable by all the humans and who is the best of all the ladies in beauty, what was the noble deed performed by me in the past to posses the same presently? This could not be the result of petty merits. Lord Brahma, getting extremely pleased with me, granted me the lotus house.

## \|\| 3.85.28-29 \|\|

*yasminpraviṣṭamapi koṭiśataṃ nṛpāṇāṃ sāmātyakujaranarāśvaghanāvṛtānām \|*  
*nālakṣya sambādhatayā hi bādhastārāgaṇairapi surāsuralokapālaiḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*tasmātkimanyajananījaṭharodbhavena dharmādikaṃ kṛtamaśeṣajanātigaṃ syāt \|*  
*samyaṅmayātha tanayairanayā maharṣe māhāryayā tadakhilaṃ kathaya pracetaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. This house can accommodate crores of rulers and their ministers. Even with their steeds also, this place will not look crowded as the boat in the lokapala like stars cannot be visible in the sky. Therefore, you kindly tell me that who was my mother, from whose womb I took my birth, what was the dharma followed by me by which I achieved such eminence, superiority and such a virtuous wife. O Pracetas, you kindly answer all my questions.”

## \|\| 3.85.30-32 \|\|

*tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhyānenā vekṣya cākhilam \|*  
*pracetāstamuvācātha śṛṇu bhūpa purātanam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*lubdhakastvaṃ purā rājansarvasattvabhayaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*āsīdasādhucaritaḥ suhṛnmitravi varjitaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*yatamadhyo hrasvakeśaḥ kṛṣṇāṃgo raktalocanaḥ \|*  
*dhanuṣpāṇirvanagataḥ kṛtāṃtakasamo bhavān \|\| 32 \|\|*

30-32. On hearing the words of the king, Maharsi Precetas then came to know about his past, by meditating for a while and then replied to the king. I am narrating the ancient stories, you please listen. In your earlier birth, you had been a terrific hunter. Because of your misconduct, ycu had no friends. You had a medium height, small hair, black complexion and red eyes. Holding a bow in your hand, you wandered in the thick forest like Yama.

## \|\| 3.85.33-35 \|\|

*abhūdanāvṛṣṭiratīva raudrā kadāci dāhāranimittaroṣaḥ \|*  
*padmānyathādāya tato bahūni gataṃ puraṃ vaidiśanāmadheyam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*unmūlya lobhācca puraṃ samastaṃ bhrāṃtaṃ tvayāśeṣamahattadā sīt \|*  
*kretā na kaścitkamaleṣu jātastoke bhṛśaṃ kṣutparipīḍitaśca \|\| 34 \|\|*

*upaviṣṭastvamekasminsabhāryo bhavanāṃgaṇe \|*  
*atha maṃgalaśabdastu tvayā rātrau tathā śrutaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. Once there had been no rainfall, you could not get food and therefore, you got enraged. Instead of carrying a hunted animal, out of greed you plucked the lotus flowers and carried them with you, which surprised the people immensely. No one was prepared to purchase those lotus flowers at any cost. Then suffering from hunger, you with your wife were seated in the courtyard of someone and you both were spending the night, while sitting there, when you suddenly heard the sound of devotional music.

## \|\| 3.85.36-39 \|\|

*samāpya māghamāsasya dvādaśyāṃ lavaṇācalam \|*  
*nivedayaṃtī gurave śayyāṃ copaskarānvitām \|\| 36 \|\|*

*alaṃkṛtya hṛṣīkeśaṃ sīvarṇaṃ paramaṃ padam \|*  
*sātha dṛṣṭā tatastābhyāmidaṃ cittevadhāritam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*kimebhiḥ kamalaiḥ kāryaṃ varaṃ viṣṇuralaṃkṛtaḥ \|*  
*iti bhaktistadā jātā dāmpatyasya nareśvara \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tatprasaṃgātsamabhyarcya keśavaṃ lavaṇācalam \|*  
*śayyā ca puṣpaprakaraiḥ pūjitābhūcca sarvadā \|\| 39 \|\|*

36-39. Then following the direction from which the sound was coming, you came across a lady who at the end of the vrata of the month of Magha dvadasi, was going to offer the gold image of Hrsikesa decorated with ornaments and costumes together with the heap of salt, along with the well made bed to her preceptor. Observing that, both of you developed a desire that why not to decorate the image of lord Visnu with those lotus flowers possessed by you. When such a type of devotion was inculcated in the mind of the hunter couple, they also arranged for the heap of salt and made a beautiful bed for Kesava, which was decorated with flowers. Then they worshipped the lord.

## \|\| 3.85.40-43 \|\|

*athānaṃgavatī tuṣṭā tayorhonaśatatrayam \|*  
*prādādgṛhītaṃ tābhyāṃ ca na tatsarvāvalaṃbanāt \|\| 40 \|\|*

*anaṃgavatī ca punastayorannaṃ caturvidham \|*  
*ānāyyopahṛtaṃ kṛtvā bhujyatāmiti bhūpate \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tābhyāṃ tu tadapi tyaktaṃ bhojyāvaḥ śvo varānane \|*  
*prasaṃgāccopavāsena tavādyāstu sukhāvahaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*janmaprabhṛti pāpiṣṭhāvāvāṃ devi dṛḍhavrate \|*  
*satprasaṃgāddhanurmadhye dharmalābhastu cāvayoḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

40-43. Thereafter, Anangavati feeling delightful, gave over to them three hundred gold coins. But both of them did not accept anything from her. Anangavati again brought four types of eatables and tried to give them the same. With the request to take the food, the hunter couple discarded that food also at that point of time, saying- “O adorable one, I shall eat this food in the morning.” As a matter of chance, both of you had fasted on that particular day, as a result of which you have achieved the pleasant reward in this birth. At that point of time, you said to the lady- “O damsel, you perform this vrata with a firm mind, we had started committing sins since our births. Therefore, we are the grave sinners. But as a move of the destiny, we have met with the noble company as a result of which we have earned the noble dharma a little.”

## \|\| 3.85.44-45 \|\|

*iti jāgaraṇaṃ tābhyāṃ prasaṃgāttadanuṣṭhitam \|*  
*prabhāte ca tayā dattā śayyā salavaṇācalā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*grāmaśca gurave bhaktyā viprebhyo dvādaśaiva hi \|*  
*vastrālaṃkārayuktāṃgā gāvaśca kanakāṃcitāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. While talking in this way, they spent the night. In the early morning, the chaste damsel Anangavati gave over to her preceptor with devotion a decorated bed with a heap of salt. She also gave the food, costumes, ornaments and cows decorated with gold to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.85.46-49 \|\|

*bhojanaṃ ca suhṛnmitradīnāṃdhakṛpaṇaiḥ samam \|*  
*tattu lubdhakadāṃpatyaṃ pūjayitvā visarjitam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*bhavāṃstu lubdhako jātaḥ sapatnīko nareśvaraḥ \|*  
*puṣpāṇāṃ prakare tasmātkeśavasya prapūjanam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*prāptaṃ sudurllabhaṃ vīra tvayā puṣkaramandiram \|*  
*tasya sarvasya māhātmyādalaṃ na tapasā nṛpa \|\| 48 \|\|*

*yathā kāmagataṃ dakṣaṃ padmayoniṃ viriṃcinā \|*  
*saṃtuṣṭastasya rājendra brahmarūpī janārdanaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

46-49. Thereafter, the hunter couple was also honored by her. The same hunter couple has presently become the ruler and his queen. You had worshipped lord Kesava with lotus flowers as a result of which you have achieved the Puskara temple (or Puskara continent). This is the glory of all your past performance and lord Brahma has bestowed a golden lotus to you. Janardana, in the form of Brahma, is particularly please with a person who performs it with devotion.

## \|\| 3.85.50-51 \|\|

*śayyānaṃgavatī veśyā kāmadeśasya sāṃpratam \|*  
*patnī sapatnī saṃjātā ratyā prītiriti śrutā \|\| 50 \|\|*

*lokeṣvānaṃdajananī sakalāmarapūjitā \|*  
*tadapyutsṛjya rājendra nirvāṇaṃ samavāpsyasi \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. Therefore, the whore Anangavati has been reborn as the co-wife of Rati - the wife of Kamadeva, who bestows the bliss to the people in the world and is adorable even by the gods. O Rajendra, discarding this wife, you achieve nirvana (salvation).

## \|\| 3.85.52-53 \|\|

*ityuktvā sa muniḥ sarvaṃ tatraivāṃtarhitobhavat \|*  
*rājā yathoktaṃ ca punaḥ sa cakre puṣpavāhanaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*imāmācarato brahmannakhaṇḍavratamācaret \|*  
*yathākathaṃcitkālena dvādaśa dvādaśīrmune \|*  
*kartavyāḥ śaktito deyā viprebhyo dakṣiṇā nṛpa \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. Thus speaking to the king, the Maharsi, the king Puspavahana following dharma observed the full vrata of this dvadasi. It would be appropriate for others that performing the twelve vratas of this dvadasi, they should give away daksina to Brahmanas as per their means. This dvadasi vrata should be performed with devotion and one who does so or listens to the same, he enjoys comforts in the heaven for a hundred years.

## Chapter 86. Madana Dvadasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.86.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*śrotumicchāmi bhagavanmadanadvādaśīvratam \|*  
*sutānekonapaṃcāśadyena lebhe ditiḥ purā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said—О lord, I am desirous of hearing about the Madana-Dvadasi vrata, what is the procedure for the same? With the performing of this vrata, Diti produced forty-nine sons, it is said.

## \|\| 3.86.2-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*tadvaśiṣṭhādibhiḥ proktamityekā tithiruttamā \|*  
*vistareṇa tadevedaṃ matsakāśānnivodhata \|\| 2 \|\|*

*caitre māse site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ niyatavrataḥ \|*  
*sthāpayedavraṇaṃ kuṃbhaṃ sitataṃḍulapūritam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*nānāphalayutaṃ tadvadikṣudaṇḍasamanvitam \|*  
*sitavastrayugacchannaṃ sitacandana carcitam \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Sri Krsna said- The Mahar$is like Vasistha and others have said that this is the excellent moon day or tithi. I am speaking about the same, in sufficient details. You please listen to it with attention. On the twelfth bright moon day of the month of Caitra, observing all the conditions, one should consecrate a pitcher filled with white rice. It should be surrounded by various types of fruits, sugarcane and covered with white cloth. The white sandal paste from Malayagiri should be plastered over the pitcher.

## \|\| 3.86.5-7 \|\|

*nānābhakṣyasamopetaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca śaktitaḥ \|*  
*tāmrapātraṃ guḍopetaṃ tasyopari nivedayeta \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tasyopari tathā kāmaṃ kadalīdala saṃsthitam \|*  
*kuryāccharkarayopetamiti tasya samīpataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*gaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ tathā dadyādgītaṃ vādyaṃ ca kārayet \|*  
*tadalābhe kathāṃ kuryātkāmakeśavayo rnaraḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. Various types of eatables as well as the gold as per one’s means should also be placed there. Filling a copper vase filled with raw sugar, the banana trunk as well as the sugar should also be placed. The image of lord Visnu should be duly worshipped with fragrant flowers and the sandal paste, and should also be placed over it. Then the songs accompanied with music should be sung. With the influence of the same, the stories of Kesava should be recited.

## \|\| 3.86.8 \|\|

*kāmaṃ nāmnā harerarcāṃ snāpayedgaṃdhavāriṇā \|*  
*śuklapuṣpākṣatatilairarcayenmadhusūdanam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The names of the lord should be recited and then the images of Madhusudana and Kama (god of love) should be worshipped and offered the fragrant water, white flowers, unbroken rice as well as the sesamum seeds.

## \|\| 3.86.9 \|\|

*kāmāya pādau saṃpūjya jaṃghe saubhāgyadāya ca \|*  
*manmathāya tathā meḍhraṃ mādhavāya kaṭiṃ namaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Then offering salutation to Kamadeva, his both the feet should be touched; saying salutation to the one who bestows fortunes, the thighs should be touched; saying salutation to Manmatha, the waist should be touched.

## \|\| 3.86.10-11 \|\|

*śāṃtodarāyetyudaramanaṃgāyetyuro hareḥ \|*  
*mukhaṃ padmamukhāyeti bāhuṃ pañcaśarāya vai \|\| 10 \|\|*

*namaḥ sarvātmane maulimarcayediti keśavam \|*  
*tataḥ prabhāte kuṃbhaṃ ca brāhmaṇāya nivedayeta \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Saying salutation to Santodara, the belly should be touched; saying salutation to Ananga, the chest should be touched; saying salutation to the lotus-faced one, the face should be touched. Saying salutation to Pahcaksara the arms should be touched; and saying salutation to the universal soul, his head should be touched and adored. Similarly, the lord Kesava should also be worshipped. During the next morning, the same pitcher should be given over to a Brahmana with all humility.

## \|\| 3.86.12-13 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānbhojayedbhaktyā svayaṃ ca lavaṇādṛte \|*  
*bhaktyātha dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādimaṃ maṃtramudīrayet \|\| 12 \|\|*

*prīyatāmatra bhagavānkāmarūpī janārdanaḥ \|*  
*hṛdaye sarvabhūtānāṃ yathā vedo'bhidhīyate \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. The Brahmana should then be served the food with devotion and the daksina should be given as per one’s means, satisfying him at the same time. Thereafter, the devotee should beg forgiveness, saying- “O lord Janardana - the form of Kama, with the performing of this vrata, you kindly get pleased with me in the same way as the Vedas remain lodged in the hearts of all the people.” Thereafter, he should take the food without salt, while concluding the vrata.

## \|\| 3.86.14 \|\|

*anena vidhinā sarvaṃ māsimāsi samācaret \|*  
*phalamāmalakaṃ prāśya dvādaśyāṃ bhūtale svapet \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. After performing the same vrata during each month on the said dvadasi day, the performer should break his fast consuming the myrobalan fruit and should sleep on the floor.

## \|\| 3.86.15-18 \|\|

*tatastrayodaśe māsi ghṛtadhenusamanvitām \|*  
*śayyāṃ dadyāddvijendrāya sarvopaskarasaṃyutām \|\| 15 \|\|*

*kāñcanaṃ kāmadevaṃ ca śuklāṃ gāṃ ca payasvinīm \|*  
*vāsobhirdvijadāṃpatyaṃ pūjya śaktyā vibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*homaḥ śuklatilaiḥ kāryaḥ kāmanāmāni kīrtayet \|*  
*gavyena sarpiṣā tatra pāyasena ca dharmavit \|\| 17 \|\|*

*viprebhyo bhojanaṃ dadyādvitta śāṭhyaṃvivarjayet \|*  
*ikṣudaṃḍānnaro dadyātpuṣpamālāṃ ca śaktitaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

15-18. Thereafter, during the thirteenth month, at the time of the conclusion of the vrata, the ghrta-dhenu (cow made of ghi) and a well decorated bed should be respectfully given over to a Brahmana who should be quite learned. Thereafter, the gold image of Kamadeva, with white mulching cow, together with costumes and ornaments, should be given over to a Brahmana couple. Then reciting the various names of Kamadeva, the homa of the white sesamum seeds should be performed. Thereafter, the performer should serve payasam to the Brahmanas, which should be mixed with ghi satisfying them at the same time. The miserly tendency should be discarded. According to the means of the performer, the Brahmanas should also be given garlands and dandas and then send them off, giving them the daksina.

## \|\| 3.86.19 \|\|

*yaḥ kuryādvidhinānena madanadvādaśīmimām \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. By performing the Madana-Dvadasi in this way, all the sins get vanished and the performer attains the supreme position.

## \|\| 3.86.20-23 \|\|

*iha loke varānputrānsaubhāgyaṃ sukhamaśnute \|*  
*kaśyapo vratamāhātmyādāgatya parayā mudā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*cakārākarkaśāṃ bhūyo rūpalāvaṇyasaṃyutām \|*  
*vareṇa cchandayāmāsa yā ca vavre varaṃ varam \|*  
*putraṃ śatruvadhārthāya samarthamamitaujasam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*prārthayāmi mahābhāgyaṃ sarvāmaraniṣūdanam \|*  
*kaśyapaḥ prāha tāṃ bhadre evamastu suśobhane \|\| 22 \|\|*

*saṃvatsaraśataṃ tvekaṃ garbho dhāryaḥ sukhepsayā \|*  
*saṃdhyāyāṃ naiva bhoktavyaṃ garbhiṇyā varavarṇini \|\| 23 \|\|*

20-23. He earns all the comforts and pleasures during this birth, besides several sons. Getting pleased with the performing of this vrata, Maharsi Kasyapa reached the charming wife Diti and asked her to seek for a boon. The beautiful damsel then replied- “O great sage, you bestow such an illustrious son to me, who should be able to destroy all the gods.” On hearing these words, Kasyapa said- “0 noble one, it will be done, but O beautiful one, for the fulfillment of your desires, you shall have to carry the pregnancy for a hundred years. Taking of meals in the evenings is prohibited for a pregnant woman.

## \|\| 3.86.24-28 \|\|

*na sthātavyaṃ na gaṃtavyaṃ vṛkṣamūleṣu sarvadā \|*  
*nopaskare bhuvi viśenmusalolūkhalādiṣu \|\| 24 \|\|*

*jalaṃ na cāvagāheta śūnyāgāraṃ vivarjayet \|*  
*varjayetkalahaṃ gehe gātrabhaṃgaṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

*muktakeśī na tiṣṭheta nāśuciḥ syātkathaṃcana \|*  
*na śayītonnataśirā na cāpyārdraśirāḥ kvacit \|\| 26 \|\|*

*na vastuhīnā nodvignā nārdrapādā na bhūtale \|*  
*nāmaṃgalyāṃ vadedvācaṃ na ca hāsyaparā bhavet \|\| 27 \|\|*

*kuryācca guruśuśrūṣāṃ nityaṃ maṃgalatatparā \|*  
*sarvauṣadhībhiḥ koṣṇena vāriṇā snānamācaret \|\| 28 \|\|*

24-28. One should neither climb a tree nor should one sit under its shade. Similarly, sitting over a mortar or pestle on the ground is prohibited. A pregnant woman should also not enter in the river water or that of a lake and take a bath there is forbidden. She should not live in a lonely house, should avoid quarrel in the house, besides the gotra should not be shattered. She should not have a dry appearance, not should she remain unclean or impure. To sleep raising the head, to sleep with wet head, to remain unstable and to walk on floor after washing the feet are prohibited (for a pregnant woman). She should not speak inauspicious words and should worship the preceptor. She should take bath with warm water mixed with medicinal plants, which is essential.

## \|\| 3.86.29-31 \|\|

*kustriyo nābhibhāṣeta vastravātaṃ vivarjayet \|*  
*mṛtavatsādi saṃsargaṃ paragehe ca suṃdari \|\| 29 \|\|*

*na śīghraṃ mārgamākrāmellaṃghayenna mahānadīm \|*  
*na ca bībhatsakaṃ kiṃcinna ca vīkṣedbhayānakam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*guru vātulamāhāramajīrṇaṃ na samācaret \|*  
*saṃpūrṇagarbhiṇyāyāmaṃ vyāyāmaṃ vā vivarjayet \|\| 31 \|\|*

29-31. She should not mix up with the evil minded women and should not found herself without cloth. The company of the women whose children got aborted, going to other’s homes or walking rapidly on roads, crossing of the great river or swimming are strictly prohibited (for a pregnant woman). The awful scenes should not be witnessed, heavy food or the food which creates wind and indigestion should not be taken. A pregnant woman should not do any hard labour or resort to physical exercise.

## \|\| 3.86.32-33 \|\|

*garbho rakṣyaḥ sadauṣadhyā hṛdi dhāryo na matsaraḥ \|*  
*anena vidhinā sādhvi śobhanaṃ putramāpnuyāt \|\| 32 \|\|*

*anyathā garbhapatanaṃ staṃbhanaṃ vā pravartate \|*  
*tasmāttvamanayā vṛttyā garbhesmiṃśca samācareḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyati śubhaḥ putraḥ sarvāvayavasuṃdaraḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. She should always take care to preserve the pregnancy and should never develop jealous in her mind. O noble ascetic, by observing all these precautions, a woman gives birth to an excellent son, otherwise, there is always the danger of miscarriage. Therefore, observing all the aforesaid precautions, you preserve the pregnancy and by so doing, you will produce an extremely beautiful son who would be quite auspicious.”

## \|\| 3.86.34-35 \|\|

*svastyastu te gamiṣyāmi tathetyuktastayā ca saḥ \|*  
*paśyatāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tatraivāṃtarhitobhavat \|\| 34 \|\|*

*tataḥ sā kaśyapoktena vidhinā samatiṣṭhata \|*  
*athāpa putrānpaṃcāśadekonānpāṃḍunaṃdana \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. Thereafter saying- “Welfare to you”, in full view of all those present there, the Maharsi disappeared from the scene. Diti on her part, accepted all the words spoken by the Maharsi and she then started following all the instructions. О son of Pandu, by following the instructions given by the Maharsi, Diti attained forty-nine sons.

## \|\| 3.86.36 \|\|

*evamanyāpi yā nārī madanadvādaśīmi mām \|*  
*karoti putrānāpnoti saha bhartrā sukhī bhavet \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Similarly, other women, with the performing of the Madana Dvadasi vrata, can achieve the sons and remain happy with their respective husbands.

## \|\| 3.86.37 \|\|

*ekonamarddhaśatamāpa ditiḥ sutānāṃ yena vratena balavīryasamanvitānām \|*  
*martyaḥ samācarati putradhanābhilāṣī tatsarvamatra saphalaṃ bhavatīha puṃsaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. With the performing of this vrata, Diti achieved forty-nine strong and powerful sons. Therefore, the people desirous of having sons, should successfully perform this vrata.

## Chapter 87. Avadhaka Vrata

## \|\| 3.87.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvācaḥ \|*  
*kāṃtāravanadurgeṣu suprasannāṭavīṣu ca \|*  
*samudrataraṇe dāne saṃgrāme taskarārdane \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kāṃ devatāṃ smaretkṛṣṇa paritrāṇakarīmiha \|*  
*kathaṃ ca devaḥ puruṣaḥ paritrāṇaṃ smṛto janaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- Who is the protecting god to be remembered in the awful forest, a fort, the desert land as well as the thick forest, when carried away by the oceanic waves during war and during the disturbances by the thieves, and how have the people recognized the said god to redeem them?

## \|\| 3.87.3-7 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyāṃ durgāṃ bhagavatīmimām \|*  
*nāpnoti duḥkhaṃ puruṣaḥ saṃsmaransarvamaṅgalām \|\| 3 \|\|*

*bhayaṃ samavāpnoti puruṣaḥ pārtha kutracit \|\| 4 \|\|*

*yadā tāṃ pratijijñāsuravaṃtyāmahamāgataḥ \|*  
*purā saṃdīpaniḥ pārtha balena saha bhārata \|\| 5 \|\|*

*prāptavidyena ca mayā pratijñātāsya dakṣiṇā \|*  
*divyaṃ stavaṃ viditvā me tenāhaṃ yācitaḥ prabho \|\| 6 \|\|*

*prabhāsatīrthe putro me gataḥ kenāpyasau hataḥ \|*  
*tamānaya mahābāho satyaṃ kuru vaco mama \|\| 7 \|\|*

3-7. Sri Krsna said- With the remembering of the goddess Durga who is the form of welfare and is well known for the performing of the auspicious deeds, no one suffers painful situation. О Partha, with the mere remembering of the goddess Sarvamangala who cannot be sighted by the people but still she bestows all the welfare to the people (under her care), the people do not have to face any danger. О Bharata, in the city of Avanti, in the house of the the Brahmana Sandipani, I was there with Balabhadra. At the end of our studies, when we took a vow to offer to the preceptor the desired Gurudak$ina, having been inspired with the divine feelings, he said to me- “O lord, my son in the Prabhasa tirtha had been injured by someone. Therefore, I desire that making my words to be true, you would surely bring him back.”

## \|\| 3.87.8-10 \|\|

*upādhyāyasya vacanādvaivasvatapure mayā \|*  
*prāptaḥ saṃdīpaneḥ putraḥ samānītaḥ kṣaṇādasau \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāṃ tāmudāhṛtya prasthitau punarāgatau \|*  
*sthānametatsvapādāṃkaṃ kṛtvāvāṃ gṛhamāgatau \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tataḥprabhṛti putrārthāḥ pūjayaṃti janāḥ sadā \|*  
*māṃ caiva balabhadraṃ ca madhyasthāṃ sarvamaṃgalām \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. Listening to the words of my teacher, I atonce went to the place of Yama and quickly brought back the son of the Brahmana and gave him back to the preceptor as his daksina. Thereafter, both of us (brothers) went to the same place and then returned to our place. Since that time, all the people adore me, Balabhadra as well as the goddess Sarvamangala.

## \|\| 3.87.11-15 \|\|

*vāme nārāyaṇo haṃsa evameva ca ke bhavet \|*  
*abādhakaṃ yorcayate tṛtīyaṃ kuṃtinadana \|\| 11 \|\|*

*trayodaśyāṃ site pakṣe māsimāsi yatavrataḥ \|*  
*naktenaivopavāsena ekabhaktena vā punaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*gandhapuṣpaiśca madhubhiḥ sīdhubhiśca surāsavaiḥ \|*  
*mṛnmayīṃ kāṃcanīṃ vāpi kṛtvā pratikṛtiṃ tu yaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*yakṣagandhabalikṣepaiḥ palalaudanasaṃsṛjaiḥ \|*  
*yo'bhbhyarcayati rājendra sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 14 \|\|*

*bhartṛsahitā svargaloke mahīyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

11-15. On the bright day of trayodasi, Kunti should be made to stand to the left, Narayana, Balabhadra and myself should also be there. The devotee should control all the senses, observe the fast during the night, fasting and take light food. The gold image of the goddess should be worshipped offering fragrance, flowers, honey, sugarcane and asavas. The boiled rice should be offered to the goddess. One who does so, all his awful sins get vanished. When a woman too performs this vrata, she is honoured in the heaven with her husband.

## \|\| 3.87.16 \|\|

*aṃbāṃbike dvidaśame'hni site sadaiva yaḥ pūjayetkusumamāṃsasuropahāraiḥ \|*  
*naśyaṃti tasya bhavaneṣvatibhīṣaṇāni caurāgnirājanitāni bhayāni sadyaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Thus on the day of bright trayodasi, the goddess known as Amba or Ambika should be worshipped, offering the flowers etc. and offering sacrifices as well and when it is so done, all the dangers of the house from thieves, fire, the ailments like epilepsy etc. or the blemishes from the royal court, get destroyed.

## Chapter 88. Mandara Nimbarka Vrata

## \|\| 3.88.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*brūhi me yaduśārdūla vrataṃ gandhavināśanam \|*  
*kaṭutiktāmladehotthadaurbhāgyaśamanaṃ tathā \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- О lion among the race of Yadus, you please tell me about a vrata, with the observing of which, the pungent, bitter, sourness, sweating or odour of the body could be removed.

## \|\| 3.88.2-7 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*imaṃ praśnaṃ purā pārtha jātūkarṇyo mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*pṛṣṭo rājñyā viṣṇubhaktyā kālanaṃdanajātayā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*kathayāmāsa saṃpṛṣṭā sūpaviṣṭā śṛṇoti sā \|*  
*devī kṛtāñjalipuṭā jātūkarṇyovadadvratam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe trayodaśyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*snātvā puṇyanadītoye pūjayecchubhadeśajam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*śvetamaṃdāramarkaṃ vā karavīraṃ ca raktakam \|*  
*niṃbaṃ ca sūryadevasya vallabhaṃ durlabhaṃ tathā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*puṣpairnaivedyadhūpādyairmaṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava \|*  
*nirīkṣya gagane sūryaṃ dhyātvā hṛdi samuccaret \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sūryaṃ śvetāramaṃdāraśvetārkāsyasaṃśayam \|*  
*karavīra namastubhyaṃ niṃbavṛkṣa namo'stu te \|\| 7 \|\|*

2-7. Sri Krsna said- O Partha, in earlier times, the same question was put by the queen of the Kalanandana caste, who was immensely devoted to lord Visnu and to the Maharsi Jajukarnya. When so asked by the queen, Jajukarnya started saying while the queen listened to him with folded hands. O Yudhisthira, the Maharsi said that on the bright trayodasi of the month of Jyestha, one should take bath in the auspicious water of the river. Then collecting the flowers of the trees like coral tree, swallow wart, oleander of red colour or the nima tree leaves which are the favourite of the Sungod but are difficult to be achieved by others, they should be offered to the Sungod, together with other flowers, incense etc., with the uttering of the mantras. Then looking at the Sun in the sky, devoting the mind towards the Sun, one should say-“Salutation to the white coral tree, white swallow wart tree and the oleander tree.”

## \|\| 3.88.8 \|\|

*itthaṃ yorkapaterbhaktyā varṣevarṣe pṛthaṅ naraḥ \|*  
*mūlamaṃtreṇa nṛśreṣṭha nārī vā bhaktisaṃyutā \|*  
*tasyāḥ śarīradaurgandhyaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ vā ajāvikam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Thus saying, the adoration should be concluded. This process should be repeated every year with devotion, reciting the mantras and worshipping the Sungod at the same time. A person who does so, the odour of the body, besides the misfortunes would disappear.

## \|\| 3.88.9 \|\|

*niṃbaṃ navārkakaravīralatāṃ supuṣpāṃ yāḥ pūjayaṃti kusumākṣatadhūpadīpaiḥ \|*  
*tāḥ sarvakāmasukhabhogasamṛddhibhājo daurbhāgyadoṣarahitāḥ subhagā bhavaṃti \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Similarly, the nima tree, white swallow wart, white coral tree and oleander creepers should also be worshipped, offering the flowers, unbroken rice, incense and lamp. A man or a woman who does so, the odour of his/her body disappears and enjoying all the pleasures in the world, he or she achieves great fortunes.

## Chapter 89. Trayodasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.89.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*yamasyārādhanaṃ brūhi śrīvatsa puruṣottama \|*  
*kathaṃ na gamyate kṛṣṇa narakaṃ narakesarin \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O Srivatsa, Purusottama as well as Narakesari! You please tell me the method of the adoration of Yama. What are the means to avoid fall in the hell?

## \|\| 3.89.2-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*dvāravatyāṃ purā pārtha snāto'haṃ lavaṇāmbhasi \|*  
*dṛṣṭavānmunimāyāṃtaṃ mudgalaṃ nāma pārthiva \|\| 2 \|\|*

*prajvalaṃtamivādityaṃ tapasā dyotitāntaram \|*  
*taṃ praṇamyārghyasatkāraiḥ papracchāhaṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 3 \|\|*

*yamādarśananāmaitadvrataṃ jantubhayāpaham \|*  
*kathayāmāsa sakalaṃ mudgalo vismayānvitaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Sri Krsna said- О Partha, in earlier time, while staying in the city of Dvarika, I was taking my bath in the salt water of the ocean. At the same time, I found the Maharsi Mudgala also arriving there, having the lustre of fire or the Sun. I welcomed him and extending due respect to him, I asked him something. The Maharsi was surprised at my treatment extended to him and then asked him about the vrata. Feeling surprised, Maharsi Mudgala started speaking about the story of the vrata, when all the living beings get destroyed.

## \|\| 3.89.5-7 \|\|

*mudgala uvāca \|*  
*akasmātkṛṣṇa mūrcchā me patito'smi dharātale \|*  
*paśyāmi daṃḍapuruṣairmaddehātprajvalanniva \|\| 5 \|\|*

*aṃguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣo baladākṛṣya roṣitaḥ \|*  
*baddho yamabhaṭairgāḍhaṃ nīyate vedavādibhiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*kṣaṇātsabhāyāṃ paśyāmi yamaṃ piṃgalalocanam \|*  
*kṛṣṇāvadātaṃ raudrāsyaṃ mṛtyuṃ vyādhiśatānvitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. Mudgala said- О Krsna, once I suddenly fainted, as a result of which I fall down on earth. At that point of time, I observed that the messengers of Yama, holding staff in their hands, who are also known as the believers of the Vedas, extracted a figure of the size of a thumb out of my body and put it in bondage In a moment, I reached in the court of Yama, who had red eyes, black complexion and was surrounded by hundreds of officers of death.

## \|\| 3.89.8-12 \|\|

*vātapittamahāśleṣmairmūrtimadbhirupāsitam \|*  
*kāsaśophajvarātaṃkasphoṭikālūtamāribhiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*jvaragardabhaśīrṣādibhagaṃdaramalakṣayaiḥ \|*  
*gaṃḍamālākṣirogaiśca mūtrakṛcchrarahovraṇaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*vedanābhiḥ pramehaiśca piṭakairgaṃḍabudbudaiḥ \|*  
*viṣūcikāgalagrāhadaridrābhūtataskaraiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*itthaṃ bahuvidhai raudrairnānārūpabhayaṃkaraiḥ \|*  
*karālaśastrahastaiśca saṃgrāmairnarakaistathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*rākṣasairdānavairugrairupaviṣṭaiḥ puraḥsthitaiḥ \|*  
*dharmādhikaraṇasthaiśca citraguptādilekhakaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

8-12. All of them turning themselves as wind, biles, mucus etc., adored the god of death in a physical form. The cough, cathartocarpus, tumor, boil, blister, epilepsy, Gardabha-Sirsa, fever, fistula, goiter, eye ailments, strangury, hovrana, pain, urinary disease, boil, Gada-budabudha, scrofula, cholera, disaster, poverty, bhuta-taskara, etc. had awful and terrific forms. The battles with horrible weapons, the hells, Danavas, besides the officers of Dharma like Citragupta and others were carrying the writing materials with them.

## \|\| 3.89.13-15 \|\|

*siṃhairvyāghrairvarāhaiśca tarakṣaiścānujaṃtukaiḥ \|*  
*vṛścikairdaṃśa maśakaiḥ śivāsarpaiḥ saḍuṃḍubhaiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*gṛdhrairulūkairbahubhirmatkuṇairḍākinīgrahaiḥ \|*  
*apasmārasmaronmādavṛddhikārevatīgrahaiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*piśācairyakṣakūṣmāṃḍaiḥ pāśakhaḍgadhanurddharaiḥ \|*  
*muktakeśaistrāsakarairbhṛkuṭīkuṭilānanaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. The lions, tigers, boars, carnivorous, beasts, jackals, scorpions, insects, mosquitoes, Sivasarpa, pigs, poison, vultures, bugs, Dakinis, planets, epilepsy, Smaronamada, Vrddhika, house of Revati, Pisacas, Yaksas, Kusmandas and the noose, besides the messengers of Yama with disshelved hair, holding the sword bow, were showing flesh in their hands.

## \|\| 3.89.16-17 \|\|

*bṛhatkāyairnārakīyaiḥ pāpiṣṭhānāṃ niyāmakaiḥ \|*  
*asipatravanāṃgāraiḥ kṣāragartāṇḍadāyakaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*asibhaṃgāmiṣacchedarudhirasrāvakādibhiḥ \|*  
*āsthāne saṃbhṛto bhāti yamo mṛtyūpamopamaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. They were the messengers of the hell who control the sinful persons. Besides the Asipatra, Vanangara and Ksaragartas, who punish the sinners were also present there. They severed the limbs of the sinners in the hell, making the blood to flow.

## \|\| 3.89.18-19 \|\|

*sa āha kiṃkarānsarvāndharmarājo janārdana \|*  
*kimayaṃ munirānīto yuṣmābhirbhrāṃtanāmabhiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*mudgalo nāma kauḍinye nagare bhīṣmakātmajaḥ \|*  
*kṣatriyo'sti sa āneyaḥ kṣīṇāyustyajyatāṃ muniḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*
