18-19. O Janardana, Dharmaraja then said to his people- “Out of confusion, why have you presented this great Rsi here? I had desired you to bring here Mudgala of the Kaudinya city who had been bom in a Ksatriya race, in the race of Bhisma. Therefore, you release this saint and you bring here the correct person.”

## \|\| 3.89.20-21 \|\|

*ityuktāste gatāstasmādāyātāḥ punareva te \|*  
*ūcuryamabhaṭāḥ prahvā dharmarājaṃ savismayāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*asmābhistatra kṣīṇāyurna dehī lakṣito gataiḥ \|*  
*na jānīmo bhānusūno kathaṃcidbhrāṃtamānasāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. At these words of Yama, his messengers went there and returned again, with the surprise appearing on their faces. They said to Dharmaraja- “O son of Bhanu, getting confused, even after our arrival there we could not spot the person with a shattered body. We are unaware of the secret behind it.”

## \|\| 3.89.22-23 \|\|

*yamarāja uvāca \|*  
*prāyeṇa te na dṛśyaṃte puruṣairyamakiṃkaraiḥ \|*  
*kṛtā trayodaśī yaistu narakārtivināśinī \|\| 22 \|\|*

*ujjayinyāṃ prayāge vā bhairave vātha ye mṛtāḥ \|*  
*tilānnagohiraṇyādi dattaṃ yaiśca gavāhnikam \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Yama said- O servants, you people cannot yourself spot such people, who had performed the vrata of trayodasi, which is the destroyer of the sins. It is impossible for you to spot a person who had offered sesamum seeds, cow and the gold given in charity at Ujjaini. Prayaga or the place of Bhairava.

## \|\| 3.89.24 \|\|

*dūta uvāca \|*  
*dṛśaṃ tadvrataṃ svāmiñchaṃsa no bhāskarātmaja \|*  
*kiṃ tatra vada kartavyaṃ puruṣaistava tuṣṭidam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. The messengers said- O master, how is the vrata for the son of Bhaskara performed and in this vrata what is required to be done by the people to please you? You kindly tell us.

## \|\| 3.89.25-33 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*pūrvāhne mārgaśīrṣādau varṣamekaṃ nirantaram \|*  
*trayodaśyāṃ saumyadine sūryāṃgārakavarjitaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*mama nāmnā dvijānaṣṭau paṃca caiva samāhvayet \|*  
*vedāṃtagāñjātiśuddhāñchāṃtacittānsuśobhanān \|\| 26 \|\|*

*vācakaścāpi tanmadhye sadā bhāskaravallabhān \|*  
*dinasya prathame yāme śucau deśe samāsthitān \|\| 27 \|\|*

*aṃtarvāsovṛtānbhaktānsaupadiṣṭadigunmukhān \|*  
*abhyaṃgayecchirodeśāttilatailena marddayet \|\| 28 \|\|*

*snāpayedgandhakāṣāyaiḥ sukhoṣṇāṃbubhireva ca \|*  
*pṛthakpṛthaksnāpayitvā sarvāneva dvijottamān \|\| 29 \|\|*

*śucirbhūtvā tathācāṃto vratī bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ saṃbhṛtya śuśruṣāṃ teṣāṃ kṛtvā narottama \|\| 30 \|\|*

*prāṅmukhānupaviṣṭāṃśca trayodaśa pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*bhojayecchālimudgādyaṃ guḍapūpānsukhocitān \|\| 31 \|\|*

*suvyañjanaṃ supakvānnaṃ bhūyobhūyo nivedayet \|*  
*śucirbhūtvā tathācāṃto hyarcayettilataṃḍulaiḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*prasthamātrairathaikaikaṃ tāmrapātrasamanvitaiḥ \|*  
*sadakṣiṇaiḥ sacchatraiśca jalakumbhaiḥ pavitrakaiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

25-33. Yamaraja said- Starting from the month of Margasirsa on a monday falling on the day of trayodasi and during the forenoon, thirteen Brahmanas should be invited who should be spiritual, competent, extremely auspicious with a peaceful mind, besides being graceful. Out of them, the one who is devoted to the Sungod, should be made an orator. During the first part of the day taking an auspicious bath, the Brahmana who should be wearing a langoti and the oil should be rubbed over his head and other limbs, and then he should be made to take his bath with a little warm water. Thereafter, the devotee as well as the performer of the vrata should himself serve the Brahmana. Then segregating the Brahmana from others, he should be seated facing east and should be worshipped offering him rice (boiled), green gram, raw sugar and fried cakes, satisfying him at the same time. Several types of food should be offered to him with various dishes. He should then be made to rinse his mouth. He should then be offered sesamum seeds in a copper vase, besides rice, umbrella, a vase filled with water, woolen robes with daksina. All the learned Brahmanas should be adored individually and while so doing, the position of the line should be kept in mind. The orator should also be similarly honoured.

## \|\| 3.89.34-37 \|\|

*carmaprāvaraṇaiḥ śreṣṭhaisteṣāṃ dattvā visarjayet \|*  
*maṃtreṇānena rājendra arcayettānpṛthaksudhīḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇānvācakaṃ vāpi paṃktibhedaṃ na kārayet \|\| 34 \|\|*

*oṃ namaḥ śanaiścaro mṛtyurdaṃḍahasto vināśakaḥ \|*  
*abhāvaḥ pralayaḥ saurirduḥkhaghnaḥ śamanoṃ'takaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*lokapālo hyatikrūro raudro ghorānanaḥ śivaḥ \|*  
*yamaḥ prasannamānasko dadyānme'bhayadakṣiṇām \|\| 36 \|\|*

*ityuktvā saṃprayacchecca deyaṃ dattvā vratī punaḥ \|*  
*dvijāṃścānuvrajetṛptāngṛhāṃścārcitacarcitān \|\| 37 \|\|*

34-37. While giving away the charities to them, one should say- “Salutation to Sanideva, you are the form of death, carrying a danda, destroyer of dissolution and grief, who is the son of Surya, besides being Lokapala, extremely cruel, terrible, besides being the form of welfare. Salutation to Yama - the son of Surya. You getting pleased, grant me the daksina of total protection.” Thus speaking, the Brahmanas should be given over the charity and after so doing, the performer of the vrata should see them off with humility. Then he should go to his home.

## \|\| 3.89.38-39 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścitsakṛdvratamidaṃ caret \|*  
*sa mṛto'pi naro martyo nāyāti mama maṃdiram \|\| 38 \|\|*

*adṛṣṭo mama māyābhirvimānenārkamaṃḍalam \|*  
*sa cāyāti purīṃ viṣṇostataḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. By following this procedure, the performer, after his death, does not have to visit the abode of Yama, but due to my illusion, becoming invisible, mounting over the decorated planes, reaches the place of Visnu via the abode of Surya and then to Kailasa.

## \|\| 3.89.40 \|\|

*kṛtaṃ cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ tena mudgalena mamoditam \|*  
*tena nāyātyasau loke mama kṣatriyapuṅgavaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Mudgala indeed has followed the path prescribed by me. Because of this, the best of the Ksatriyas is not reaching my place.

## \|\| 3.89.41 \|\|

*iti kālavacaḥ śrutvā te'pi dūtā gatāstu me \|*  
*ahaṃ punaḥ samāpannastūrṇaṃ kālairvisarjitaḥ \|*  
*svaśarīraṃ punaḥ prāpya nīrogaḥ punarutthitaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. Listening to the words of Yama, leaving me there his messengers then went away. I too, having been disowned by Yama, reentered in my own body again and feeling quite healthy, got up again.

## \|\| 3.89.42-43 \|\|

*tvāṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ proktametadvṛttaṃ mayā tava \|*  
*ityuktvā mudgalo rājanprayātaḥ svagṛhaṃ prati \|\| 42 \|\|*

*idaṃ kuruṣva kauṃteya tvamapyatra mahītale \|*  
*tato yāsyasyasaṃdigdhaṃ vaṃcayitvā yamaṃ mṛtaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. Thereafter, in order to have an audience with you, I have arrived here and narrated to you my own experience.” Thus speaking, Maharsi Mudgala returned to his abode. O son of Kaunti, you also perform this vrata on earth, because of which, after death, you may deprive Yama of your visit to his place. You may surely achieve the place of Visnu.

## \|\| 3.89.44-46 \|\|

*evaṃ yenye'pi puruṣāḥ striyo vāpi yudhi ṣṭhira \|*  
*trayodaśyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ ye cariṣyaṃti bhūtale \|\| 44 \|\|*

*ekabhaktena naktena upavāsena vā punaḥ \|*  
*yamadarśanamākhyātaṃ gataṃ sarvavratottamam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*sarvapāpavinirmuktā divyayānaṃ samāśritāḥ \|*  
*yāsyantīndrapuraṃ hṛṣṭā apsarogaṇasaṃvṛtāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

44-46. O Yudhisthira, similarly a man or a woman, while living on this earth, when observe vrata on each and every trayodasi of his life, also known as Yama-darsana vrata, he or she gets relieved of all the sins and proceeds to the heaven, mounting over the planes served by the Apsaras.

## \|\| 3.89.47 \|\|

*dodhūyamānāścamaraiḥ stūyamānāḥ surāsuraiḥ \|*  
*gandharvatūryanādena cchatrapaṃktivirājitāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. O Yudhisthira, at that point of time, the Gods and the Asuras honour him, moving the flywhisks over them, while the Gandharvas, play on music to please him.

## \|\| 3.89.48 \|\|

*adṛṣṭo ghorarūpāsyairyamadūtairyudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*anardito vyādhigaṇairadṛṣṭo yamakiṅkaraiḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The messengers of Yama with awful and gigantic bodies are unable to spot him. He does not face any ailment and remains always invisible to the servants of Yama.

## \|\| 3.89.49-50 \|\|

*adārito mahāraudrairnānāpraharaṇottamaiḥ \|*  
*yamadṛṣṭipathānmuktāḥ sarvasaukhyasamanvitāḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*sarvasaukhyasamāyuktāḥ śivavatsaumyadarśanāḥ \|*  
*svarge vasaṃti suciraṃ bhāvitāḥ svena karmaṇā \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. He is never wounded by the terrible weapons. Enjoying all the comforts, he remains free from the path of Yama. He enjoys all the pleasures, has the divine appearance like Siva and dwells in the heaven for long.

## \|\| 3.89.51 \|\|

*snāpya trayodaśa munīnghṛtapāyasena saṃpūjya pūjyatilataṇḍulavastradānaiḥ \|*  
*kurvaṃti ye vratamidaṃ tridaśehni pūtāḥ paśyaṃti te yamamukhaṃ na kadācideva \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. Thus on the day of trayodasi, after taking bath, with the offering of payasam mixed with ghi and sesamum seeds, the sages should be worshipped offering the costumes as well to them. This vrata should always be observed. Those who do so, they do not have to get an audience with Yama.

## Chapter 90. Ananga Trayodasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.90.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*bhagavanbhūtabhavyeśa saṃsārārṇavatāraka \|*  
*vrataṃ kathaya kiñcinme rūpasaubhāgyadāyakam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O lord, you are the benefactor of all the living beings and redeem them out of the ocean of the universe. Therefore, you kindly tell me about a vrata which could bestow beauty and the fortunes.

## \|\| 3.90.2-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*kiṃ kṛtairbahubhiḥ pārtha vratairunmattaceṣṭitaiḥ \|*  
*kāyakleśakaraiḥ krūrairasāraiḥ phala sādhanaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*varamekāpi varadā kṛtānaṃgatrayodaśī \|*  
*prasiddhiṃ samanuprāptā martye kāmapradāyinī \|\| 3 \|\|*

*saubhāgyārogyajayadā sarvātaṃkanivāriṇī \|*  
*sarvaduṣṭopaśamanī sarvamaṃgalavardhanī \|\| 4 \|\|*

*śṛṇuṣva tāṃ mahābāho kathayāmi savistaram \|*  
*purā dagdhena kāmena trinetranayanāgninā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*bhasmībhūtena lokānāṃ saṃkalpitā purānagha \|*  
*anaṃgena kathā hyeṣā tenānaṃgatrayodaśī \|\| 6 \|\|*

2-6. Sri Krsna said- Making efforts like an insane person, what is the use of performing such vratas, which are painful besides being not rewarding? It is no use performing other such vratas, when the vrata of trayodasi when performed even once, a person earns enormous glory and all his desires gets fulfilled. This is called Ananga Trayodasi which bestows good health, besides victory and relieves a person of all the sins. It also subsides all the wicked people. It increase all the mandalas. O excellent one, I am going to explain about it in detail, you please listen. O sinless one, in earlier times, when Kamadeva was reduced to ashes with the opening of the third eye of lord Siva, the people conceived of this Ananga Trayodasi with the story of Ananga.

## \|\| 3.90.7-9 \|\|

*hemaṃte samanuprāpte māsi mārgaśire śubhe \|*  
*śuklapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ sopavāso jitendriyaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*snānaṃ nadyāṃ taḍāge ca gṛhe vā niyatātmavān \|*  
*kṛtvā samabhyarcya vibhuṃ vidhinā śaśiśekharam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dhūpadīpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kālodbhavaistathā \|*  
*śaṃbhunāmānyathoccārya homaḥ kāryastilākṣataiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. During the month of Margasirsa on the day of bright trayodasi, one should observe fast and should take bath in a river, tank or the well in the house. Then, he should worship lord Siva also known as Candracuda. The incense, lamp, eatables as well as the seasonal fruits and flowers should be offered to lord Siva. Thereafter, the homa with sesamum seeds and unbroken rice should be performed.

## \|\| 3.90.10-12 \|\|

*anaṃganāmnā saṃpūjya madhu prāśya svapenniśi \|*  
*naivedyairmadhurairdivyaiḥ susvādairghṛtapācitaiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*dhūpaṃ sugaṃdhiṃ dadyācca raktapuṣpaistu pūjanam \|*  
*raṃbhātulyā bhavetsā tu rūpayauvanaśālinī \|\| 11 \|\|*

*madhuvatsyātsamadhuraḥ kāmarūpadharastathā \|*  
*daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. The names of Ananga (Kamadeva) should be recited and worshipped. The fast should be broken at night by consuming the honey. The sweet and extremely tasteful eatables should be offered besides fragrant incense, red flowers. A lady who does so becomes a beautiful damsel like Rambha, and when a man performs the same vrata, he becomes sweet tongued, becomes beautiful like Kamadeva, at the same time earning the merit of performing ten Asvamedha sacrifices.

## \|\| 3.90.13-16 \|\|

*puṣyamāsasya caivoktaṃ caṃdanaṃ prāśayanniśi \|*  
*yogeśvaraṃ tu saṃpūjya mālatīkusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*naivedyaṃ ghṛtapūrāśca damaśāntāstu tāḥ striyaḥ \|*  
*saumyaśītasugandhāśca candanaprāśanodbhavaiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*rājasūyasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam \|*  
*māghe naṭeśvaraṃ nāma pūjayetpaṃkajena tu \|\| 15 \|\|*

*naivedyaṃ kṣīrakhaṇḍādyairmauktikaṃ prāśayenniśi \|*  
*bahuputrā bhavetsā tu dhanaṃ saubhāgyamuttamam \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-16. During the month of Pausa, with the same procedure, Siva should be worshipped. The fast should be broken consuming the sandal paste and then the observer should go to sleep at night. Yogesvara Siva should be worshipped offering the beautiful jasmine flowers and the eatable mixed with ghi. He should break the fast with cool sandal paste. The ladies who do so earn the merit of performing Rajasuya sacrifice. During the month of Magha, Natesvara Siva should be worshipped offering the lotus flowers, eatables or payasam. A lady who breaks her fast during the night, gets enough of sons, riches and excellent fortunes.

## \|\| 3.90.17-18 \|\|

*muktācūrṇanibhairnetrairyadvā syāttadvadeva hi \|*  
*gaurītulyā bhavetsā tu komalāṃgī prajāyate \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tapta jāṃbūnadābhāso bhaveddivyatanurmahān \|*  
*gomedhasya sahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Her eyes glitter like the gems. Such a lady has tender limbs resembling those of the goddess Gauri. Similarly, the man also gains the lustre of the molten gold and the divine body. In addition, he attains the merit of performing a thousand Gomedha sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.90.19-22 \|\|

*phālgune māsi saṃpūjya devadevaṃ hareśvaram \|*  
*karṇikārasya puṣpāṇi naivedye bījapūrakam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*kaṃkolaṃ prāśayedrātrau sauṃdaryamatulaṃ labhet \|*  
*caitre surūpakaṃ nāma pūjayeddamanena tu \|\| 20 \|\|*

*naivedyaṃ dhūpakaṃ dadyādghṛtakhaṇḍavipācitam \|*  
*karpūraṃ prāśayedrātrau saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnuyāt \|\| 21 \|\|*

*candraśca candrakāṃtiśca candravartyaharāvṛte \|*  
*naramedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti śobhanam \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. During the month of Phalguna, the flowers of oleander and eatables should be offered to lord Нага - the god of gods. He should break his fast with lemon or gourd and by so doing, he gains unparallel beauty. During the month of Caitra, controlling all the senses, one should offer incense, eatables made of sugar and ghi, to lord Siva as the form of Surupa. The fast should be broken at night consuming the camphor. By so doing, he achieves enormous riches and looks like Siva with the digit of the moon. He has the shine of the moon. He attains the merit of Naramedha sacrifice, which is the best of all.

## \|\| 3.90.23-24 \|\|

*vaiśākhe ca mahārūpaṃ puṣpairnaumālikārcanam \|*  
*kāraṃbakaistu naivedyaṃ dātavyaṃ cātiśobhanam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*jātīphalaṃ tu saṃprāśya jātimāpnotyanuttamām \|*  
*saphalāstasya sarvāśā bhavaṃti bhuvi bhārata \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. In the month of Vaisakha, using the flowers and with name recitation, Siva should be adored. Then the sweet and excellent eatables should be offered to him. The fast should be broken and by so doing, one is born in a high race. О Bharata! All his desires are also fulfilled on earth.

## \|\| 3.90.25-27 \|\|

*gosahasraphalaṃ prāpya brahmaloke mahīyate \|*  
*jyeṣṭhe māse tu pradyumnaṃ pūjayenmallikāsumaiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*naivedyaṃ khaṇḍavartiṃ ca lavaṃgaṃ prāśayenniśi \|*  
*jyeṣṭhaṃ padamavāpnoti tathā lakṣmīṃ janārdanāt \|\| 26 \|\|*

*sarva saukhyasamopetaḥ sthitvā bhuvi śataṃ samāḥ \|*  
*vājapeyasya yajñasya śatamaṣṭaguṇottaram \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. He achieves the merit of giving a thousand cows in charity. Thereafter, he is honoured in the Brahmaloka. During the month of Jyestha, a garland of Malati flowers and the eatables including the raw sugar should be offered to Pradyumna. Then the fast should be broken during the night with the consuming of cloves. One who does so earns the high position, besides enormous riches. He enjoys all the pleasures on earth for hundreds of years and earns the merit of hundred and eight times of performing the Vajapeya sacrifice.

## \|\| 3.90.28-29 \|\|

*āṣāḍhe caiva saṃprāpte umābhartāramarcayet \|*  
*puṣpa dhūpādinaivedyaiḥ prāśnīyācca tilodakam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*tilottamā rūpadharā sukhī syāccharadaḥ śatam \|*  
*śrāvaṇe umāpatiṃ nāma tilapuṣpaistu pūjayet \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. During the month of Asadha, offering the flowers, incense and the eatables,. Siva - the lord of Uma, should be adored. She should break her fast consuming sesamum seeds with water. The damsel who performs this vrata attains the beauty comparable with Tilottama and she enjoys life for a hundred years.

## \|\| 3.90.30-32 \|\|

*naivedyaṃ laḍḍukāndadyātkṛṣṇāṃśca prāśayettilān \|*  
*pauṃḍarīkasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyanākulam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*tadaṃte rājarājaḥ syācchatrupakṣa kṣayaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*sadyojātaṃ bhādrapade pūjya kuṃkumakeśaraiḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*naivedyaṃ solikāṃ dadyātprāśayedaguruṃ niśi \|*  
*aguruṃ prāśayitvā tu gururbhavati bhūtale \|\| 32 \|\|*

30-32. The lord of Uma should be worshipped during the month of Havana, offering sesamum seeds, flowers and sweet balls as the food. In case the fast is broken with the consuming of the black sesamum seeds, the performer earns the merit of performing Paundarika yajna or Visnu sacrifice. He also becomes a king who is the destroyer of the enemies. During the month of Bhadrapada, lord Sadasiva should be worshipped using the saffron, offering the cold naivedya. The fast should be broken during the night consuming agaru and one who does so, he becomes a preceptor on earth.

## \|\| 3.90.33-35 \|\|

*putrapautraiḥ parivṛto bhuktvā bhogānmano'nugān \|*  
*uktayajñaphalaṃ prāpya viṣṇuloke mahīyate \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tridaśādhipatimaśvayuji pūjya sindūrakavrajaiḥ \|*  
*svarṇādikaṃ tu saṃprāśya svarṇavarṇaḥ prajāyate \|\| 34 \|\|*

*rūpavānsubhago vāgmī bhuktvā bhogānmahītale \|*  
*suvarṇakoṭidānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. He also enjoys all the pleasures on earth with his sons and grandsons, and earns the merit of performing an excellent sacrifice. He is ultimately honoured in the Visnuloka. During the month of Asvina, a person should worship Siva - the leader of the gods. The fast should be broken with use of gold. One who does so, has the body with the lustre of gold. He attains excellent beauty, truthfulness and enjoys all the comforts, besides achieving the merit of donating a crore of gold (coins).

## \|\| 3.90.36-37 \|\|

*viśveśvaraṃ kārttike tu sarvapuṣpaistu pūjayet \|*  
*damanasya phalaṃ prāśya damanena pumānbhavet \|\| 36 \|\|*

*damanonmādakartā ca sarvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*bhavedbhujabalopetastataḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. During the month of Kartika, lord Visvesvara should be worshipped offering all the flowers. The fast should be broken by consuming the damana fruit, one who does so he earns the quality of being an oppressive and becomes the lord of the universe. With the enormous strength of his arms and after enjoying all the comforts on earth, he finally attains the place of Siva.

## \|\| 3.90.38-41 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte pārite'sminvratottame \|*  
*yatkartavyaṃ tadadhunā śrūyatāṃ kurunaṃdana \|\| 38 \|\|*

*vrate vidhno yadā ca syādaśaktyā sūtakena vā \|*  
*upoṣyamevopavasettadā drumapuraḥ punaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*pūrvoktamevaṃ nirvartya sauvarṇaṃ kārayecchivam \|*  
*tāmrapātre tu saṃsthāpya kalaśopari vinyaset \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śuklavastreṇa saṃchādya puṣpanaivedyapūjitam \|*  
*brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ śivabhaktāya suvrata \|\| 41 \|\|*

38-41. O son of the race of Yadus, similarly, at the end of the year, the duties of a person for the performing of the vrata are being spoken by me. You please listen. When at the time of the performing of the vrata, some obstruction or impurity due to the birth of a child arises, one should fast in an orchard and all the procedures should be followed there. The golden image of lord Siva should be placed in a copper vase, which should be placed over the pitcher, covering it with cloth. The image should then be offered flowers and eatables in an appropriate manner. Thereafter, he should invite a learned Brahmana, who should be devoted to lord Siva and handover the image (with other things) to the Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.90.42-43 \|\|

*śaktimāñchayanaṃ dadyādgāṃ savatsāṃ payasvinīm \|*  
*chatropānatpradātavyaṃ kalaśāḥ sodakāstathā \|\| 42 \|\|*

*śāṃtāśca kecidicchaṃti śaktyā dadyācca dakṣiṇām \|*  
*pañcāmṛtena snānaṃ ca tasminnahani kārayet \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. The performer, possessing excellent power, should also give away a decorated bed, a mulching cow with calf, umbrella, the shoes and the pitcher filled with water to the Brahmana in charity. Some learned persons with peaceful mind have also prescribed that besides other things daksina should also be given to the Brahmana, as per one’s means. O Rajendra, it has also been prescribed that the image of Siva should also be bathed with pancamrta.

## \|\| 3.90.44-46 \|\|

*devadevasya rājendra puṣpadīpānnasaṃyutam \|*  
*bhojanaṃ ca yathā śaktyā ṣaḍrasaṃ madhurottaram \|\| 44 \|\|*

*pradadyācchivabhaktebhyo viśuddhenāṃtarātmanā \|*  
*evaṃ nirvartya vidhivatkṛtakṛtyaḥ pumānbhavet \|\| 45 \|\|*

*nārī vā bharataśreṣṭha kumārī vā yatavratā \|*  
*pārite tu vrate paścātkuryācca sumahotsavam \|\| 46 \|\|*

44-46. The adoration should be made offering flowers, lamps etc. Thereafter, the Brahmanas should be given the food with six dishes besides the devotees of Siva as per the means of the performer of the vrata and a person who does so, he becomes successful. A woman or an unmarried girl, who performs this vrata, should organize festivities at the end of the vrata.

## \|\| 3.90.47-48 \|\|

*anena vidhinā kuryādyastvanaṃgatrayodaśīm \|*  
*sa rājyaṃ nihatāmitraṃ kīrtimāyuryaśo balam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti yāvajjanmaśataṃ nṛpa \|*  
*tato nirvāṇamāyāti śivalokaṃ ca gacchati \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. By following this process, a person who performs vrata of Ananga Trayodasi, he achieves a kingdom free from the enemies, glory, strength and enormous fortunes for the future hundred births and ultimately attains nirvana, besides the abode of Siva.

## \|\| 3.90.49 \|\|

*kāmena yā kila purā samupoṣitāsīcchubhrā tithistridaśamī suśubhāṃgahetoḥ \|*  
*tāṃ prāśanairuditanāmayutairupetā kṛtvā prayāti paramaṃ padamiṃdumauleḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. In order to regain his beauty, Kamadeva too had fast on the day of trayodasi and worshipped lord Siva. Therefore, by following the means for breaking the fast every month on the prescribed day and by worshiping Siva having the digit of moon over his heads, one achieves the supreme position with Siva.

## Chapter 91. Pali Vrata

## \|\| 3.91.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*ambupūrṇataḍāgeṣu mahātoyāśayeṣu ca \|*  
*kasyārthaṃ samprayacchaṃti kṛṣṇaitāḥ kulayoṣitaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O Krsna, what for the housewives offer oblations in the great rivers or lakes? You please tell me.

## \|\| 3.91.2-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*māsi bhādrapade prāpte śukle bhūtatithau nṛpa \|*  
*taḍāgapālyāṃ dātavyaṃ varuṇāyārghyamuttamam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiḥ strībhistathaiva ca \|*  
*tasmindine bhaktinamrairdeyādarghyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 3 \|\|*

*puṣpaiḥ phalaistathā vastrairdīpālaktakacandanaiḥ \|*  
*anagnipākosiddhānnaistilataṇḍulamiśrakaiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kharjūrairnālikeraiśca bījapūrṇārakaistathā \|*  
*drākṣādāḍimapūgaiśca trapusaiścāpi pūjayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

2-5. Sri Krsna said- In the month of Bhadrapada, on the day of bright caturdasi, following the Tadaga (tank) or Pali vrata, the offering of the oblations by the ladies has been prescribed in the scriptures. O Yudhi$thira, on that particular day, the men and women of Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Audras should offer oblation in which the flowers, fruits, costumes, lamp, red paste (for feet), sandal paste, cooked food, eatables, sesamum seeds, food mixed with rice, date palm, coconut, myrobalan, grapes, pomegranate, betel nuts and the cucumber should be included.

## \|\| 3.91.6-8 \|\|

*ālikhya maṇḍale devaṃ varuṇaṃ vāruṇīyutam \|*  
*maṃtreṇānena rājendra pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*varuṇāya namastubhyaṃ namaste yādasāṃpate \|*  
*apāṃpate namaste'stu rasānāṃpataye namaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*mā kledaṃ mā ca daurgaṃdhyaṃ virasyaṃ mā mukhe'stu me \|*  
*varuṇo vāruṇībhartā varado'stu sadā mama \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. O Rajendra, the image of Varuna couple should be established in a mandala which should be worshipped reciting a mantra-“Salutation to Varuna, the treasure of water, the lord of waters, the lord of juice. O lord, there should be no miseries, misfortunes, odour, dryness in my mouth. Let lord Varuna with his spouse Varuni always bestow boons on me.”

## \|\| 3.91.9-12 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ pūjayedbhaktyā varuṇaṃ varuṇālayam \|*  
*madhyāhne sarasi snātvā nagnipākī vratī nṛpa \|\| 9 \|\|*

*cāturvarṇyatha vai nārī vratenānena pāṃḍava \|*  
*naivedyaṃ brāhmaṇe deyaṃ yannaivedye prakalpitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha pālīvratamuttamam \|*  
*tatkṣaṇātsarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*saṃruddhaśuddhasalilātibalāṃ viśālāṃ pālīmupetya bahubhistarubhiḥ kṛtālīm \|*  
*ye pūjayaṃti varuṇaṃ sahitaṃ samudraisteṣāṃ gṛhe bhavati bhūtiralabdhanāśā \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-12. O king, following this process, at noon, people should take bath in a lake and purifying themselves, all the men and women of all the four varnas should then offer food to the Brahmanas. Thus a person, who performs this excellent Pali vrata, is relieved of all the sins. There is no doubt about it. The reservoir which forcefully obstructs the flow of water being quite vast, one should reach there, which is decorated with several trees. When the adoration of Varuna couple along with ocean is performed there in a proper manner, the performer achieves the immobile earth.

## Chapter 92. Rambha Vrata

## \|\| 3.92.1-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*asminneva dine pārtha śṛṇu brahmasabhātale \|*  
*devalena purā gītaṃ devarṣigaṇasannidhau \|\| 1 \|\|*

*apsarogaṇagaṃdharvairdevaiḥ sarvaiḥ samarcitam \|*  
*saṃsārāsāratāṃ dṛṣṭvā tatrasthakadalīdrume \|*  
*śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ māsi bhādrapade nṛpa \|\| 2 \|\|*

*dattamarghyaṃ varastrībhiḥ phalairnānāvidhaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*virūḍhaiḥ saptadhānyaiśca dīpālaktakacandanaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dadhidūrvākṣatairvastrairnaivedyairghṛtapācitaiḥ \|*  
*jātīphalairlavaṅgaiśca tathailālavalīphalaiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kadalaiḥ kandarabhaṭairmocā sātra nigadyate \|*  
*tasminnahani dātavyaṃ strībhiḥ sarvābhirapyalam \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Sri Krsna said O Partha, in earlier times, Maharsi Devala had spoken in the court of Brahma in the presence of other Rsis. Taking into consideration the perishable nature of the world, the Apsaras, Gandharvas, besides the Gods worshipped under the banana tree in the same way and with the same spirit. I am going to speak about the same. O king, on the bright fourteenth moon day of the month of Bhadrapada, all the ladies collecting several types of fruits, seven cereals, lamp, colour prepared from lac, sandal paste, curd, durva grass, unbroken rice, costumes, ghi, eatables mixed with ghi, nutmeg, banana and other fruits etc. should be offered with arghya (oblation).

## \|\| 3.92.6-10 \|\|

*maṃtre ṇānena caivārghyaṃ śṛṇuṣva ca narādhipa \|*  
*cityā tvaṃ kandaladalaiḥ kadale kāmadāyini \|*  
*śarīrārogyalāvaṇyaṃ dehi devi namo'stu te \|\| 6 \|\|*

*itthaṃ yaḥ pūjayedrājā puruṣo bhaktimānnṛpa \|*  
*nārī vānagnipākāṃtā cāturvarṇyā yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tasyāḥ kule na bhavati kvacinnārī kulāṭanī \|*  
*durgatā durbhagā vaṃdhyā svairiṇī pāpakāriṇī \|\| 8 \|\|*

*vilāsinī vā vṛṣalī punarbhūḥ punaretasī \|*  
*gaṇikā svairiṇī voḍhā mūlyakarmakarī khalā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*bhartṛ vratātpracalitā na kadācitprajāyate \|*  
*bhavetsaubhāgyasaukhyāḍhyā putrapautraistathāvṛtā \|*  
*āyuṣmatī kīrtimatī ramedvarṣaśatairbhuvi \|\| 10 \|\|*

6-10. O best of the humans, thereafter, the performer should beg forgiveness from the goddess who is bestower of fruits and lives at the root of the banana tree. With the offering of the banana flowers, she shines like the fire. I offer my salutation to her. Let her grace me with good health, beauty and charm. Thus, when a king, a devoted person or a woman performs this vrata, then no evil woman is born in her race or faces miseries. She never becomes unfortunate or the one having a loose character, nor is there any sinful woman, evil woman or Sudri, a virgin widow, the one depending on others, adulteress, harlot, independent, or a slave girl. And she never falls from the devotion or fidelity towards her husband. She enjoys enormous happiness with her sons and grandsons, enjoys long life and remains graceful, and enjoys the company of her husband for hundreds of years.

## \|\| 3.92.11-13 \|\|

*ekaṃ raṃbhā vrataṃ cīrṇaṃ gāyatryā svargasaṃsthayā \|*  
*tathā gauryā ca kailāsa indrāṇyā naṃdane vane \|\| 11 \|\|*

*śvetadvīpe tathā lakṣmyā rājñyā ca ravimaṃḍale \|*  
*arundhatyā dāruvane svāhayā meruparvate \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sītādevyā tvayodhyāyāṃ vedavatyā himācale \|*  
*bhānumatyā nāgapure vratametadanuṣṭhitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. While remaining in the heaven, Gauri at Kailasa, Indrani in the Nandanavana, Laksmi in the Svetadvipa, Rajhi in the solar disc, Arundhati in Daruvana, Svaha at the Meru mountain, Sita in Ayodhya, Vedavati in the Himalayas and Bhanumati at Nagapuri, they all had performed this Rambha-vrata appropriately.

## \|\| 3.92.14 \|\|

*etadvrataṃ pārthivendra māsi bhādrapade site \|*  
*yā karoti na sā duḥkhaiḥ kadācidapi pīḍyate \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. O king! A woman who does not perform this vrata on the bright fourteenth moon day of the month of Bhadrapada, has to face many troubles.

## \|\| 3.92.15 \|\|

*saṃbhinnakandakadalī ca manojñarūpāṃ yāḥ pūjayaṃti kusumākṣatadhūpadīpaiḥ \|*  
*tāsāṃ gṛheṣu na bhavaṃti kadācideva nāryastvanāryacaritā vidhavā virūpāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Thus, developing some noble feelings at the root of a banana tree, the goddess should be adored offering the flowers, unbroken rice, incense and lamp, in an appropriate manner. A lady who performs this vrata, no woman in her family becomes evil minded, widow or ugly.

## Chapter 93. Agneya Caturdasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.93.1 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*caturdaśī mahārāja hutabhugdayitā śubhā \|*  
*naṣṭastadā havyavāhaḥ punarastitvamāptavān \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sri Krsna said- О great king, the fourteenth day of the Moon is the favourite of the god of fire, because he gained existence even after destruction.

## \|\| 3.93.2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kathamagniḥ purā naṣṭo devakāryepyupasthitaḥ \|*  
*kenāgnitvaṃ kṛtaṃ tatra kathaṃ hi vidito'nalaḥ \|*  
*etadvadasva deveśa sarvaṃ hi viditaṃ tava \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Yudhisthira said- О Devesa, in earlier times, inspite of his remaining busy for the divine cause, the fire god was once lost completely, then how could he achieve the position of Ananta or unending and became famous as such? You are quite aware of the related secret. Kindly enlighten me on the subject.

## \|\| 3.93.3-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*purā surā mahārāja tārakeṇa parājitāḥ \|*  
*apṛcchanviśvakartāraṃ tārakaṃ ko vadhiṣyati \|\| 3 \|\|*

*uvācāsau ciraṃ dhyātvā rudromāśukrasambhavaḥ \|*  
*gaṃgāsvāhāgnitejojaḥ śiśurdaityaṃ vadhiṣyati \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Sri Krsna said- In earlier times, the gods, having been defeated in war with Taraka, went to Brahma - the creator of the universe and asked him- “Who would kill the daitya Taraka?” Then Brahma, while brooding for a long time, said to them- “A son, who would be bom of the lustre of Siva and Uma, in which the lustre of Ganga, Svaha and the fire god shall also be added, then the son so born shall kill the daitya named Taraka.”

## \|\| 3.93.5 \|\|

*evaṃ śrutvā gatā devā yatra śambhuḥ sahomayā \|*  
*praṇamya te tamūcurhi yaduktaṃ brahmaṇā tadā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. On hearing these words, the gods went to Uma and Siva’s place and apprised him of the talk they had with Brahma.

## \|\| 3.93.6-7 \|\|

*pratipannaṃ ca rudreṇa umayā sahitena tat \|*  
*prayatnamakarottaṃ ca ya uktomarasattamaiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ gataḥ kālo'tha maithune \|*  
*na cāpyuparamastatra tayorāsītkathañcana \|*  
*bhayaṃ ca sumahatteṣāṃ devānāṃ samajāyata \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Thereafter, at the advice of the gods, Rudra with Uma started to make efforts in this regard. After uniting with each other, when they could not produce a child even after hundred years, then the gods started getting frightened.

## \|\| 3.93.8-11 \|\|

*sa rudrasambhavo yo vai bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ \|*  
*sa daityāndānavagaṇānvadhiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*kena kālena bhavati raterviratiretayoḥ \|*  
*etadvicintya prahitau devaistatrānilānalau \|\| 9 \|\|*

*gatau tau comayā dṛṣṭau samasthau viṣamasthayā \|*  
*śaśāpa ca ruṣā devī devāngarbhavivarjitā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yasmāttairjanito vighno me'patyārthe divaukasām \|*  
*tasmātte sveṣu dāreṣu janayiṣyanti na prajāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

8-11. “The child bora of Rudra must be quite a powerful one, besides being competent to kill the daityas and danavas, but when would their sexual exercise come to an end?” Thus thinking, the gods sent a Brahmana and Agni to that place. Both of them went to the place of Siva and I observed that both of them had been caught in a complex situation. Goddess Uma had not conceived. Therefore, getting annoyed with the gods, she pronounced a curse on them saying- “You have caused an obstruction in the producing of a son by the lord (Siva), therefore, your wives shall be, henceforth not be able to produce a child.”

## \|\| 3.93.12-21 \|\|

*athovāca tadā devo devānsarvagaṇāñchanaiḥ \|*  
*agnirgṛhṇātu vīryaṃ me saṃbhṛtaṃ suciraṃ hi yat \|\| 12 \|\|*

*evamukto'tha rudreṇa naṣṭo'gnirdevasaṃkulāt \|*  
*na svastho na bhuvistho vā na sūryastho na bhūtale \|\| 13 \|\|*

*devā anveṣaṇe yatnamakurvannagnidarśane \|*  
*kṛmikīṭapataṃgāśca aṣṭau ca tridivaukasaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*haṃsāḥ kekāḥ śukā vahniḥ śīghraṃ śaravaṇaṃ gatāḥ \|*  
*śaśāpāgnirgajā jihvā dviguṇo vā bhaviṣyati \|\| 15 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvātha vibudhāḥ sarve pakṣiṇaṃ pakṣiṇāṃ varam \|*  
*jīvaṃ jīvakanāmānaṃ bhobhoḥ satyaṃ vadasva naḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*kaccidṛṣṭastvayā vahnirvane'sminnaṭatā sadā \|*  
*nābhadraṃ nāpi bhadraṃ vā kiñcideva vaco'bravīt \|\| 17 \|\|*

*bhūyobhūyastu pṛṣṭo'pi na gāmuccārayecciram \|*  
*tuṣṭastasyābravīdvahnirjīvaṃ jīva vadāmi te \|\| 18 \|\|*

*yasmānna kiñciduktaṃ te tasmāccitra tanūruhāḥ \|*  
*jīva jīva punarjīva yāvadicchā tathāyuṣaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*dvitīyaṃ te varaṃ dadmo jīvajīvaka śobhanam \|*  
*vyaktā te mānuṣī vācā spaṣṭārthā ca bhaviṣyati \|\| 20 \|\|*

*kaścidyadi tavādhasthādbudhaḥ snānaṃ kariṣyati \|*  
*vaṃdhyā vā ṣoḍaśābdīyā kṣaṇādbālo bhaviṣyati \|\| 21 \|\|*

12-21.Lord Siva then said to all the gods. The semen of mine which had collected since long, should be accepted by the fire god. Thus speaking, the semen of lord Siva was carried by Agni, who was completely destroyed. He could not be found on earth, sky or in the solar disc. The god on the other hand, tried their best to trace out Agni everywhere. They traced him among worms, insects, wasps, the eight types of gods, swans, peacocks, parrots and other creatures. The efforts so made were of no avail. Agni on the other hand, reached the forest of reeds. A curse was pronounced on Agni, that he would have double the tongue like an elephant. The gods then came across a Jivaka bird and said to him- “You tell us truthfully, while wandering in this forest, have you come across Agni - the god of fire?” Thereafter, the bird spoke nothing inspite of repeated questioning to him. On observing this, Agni said to Jiva-Jivaka bird, “I am pleased with you and grant you a boon. You shall remain alive as per your own sweet will. I grant you another boon, your speech would reveal the correct interpretation like the human beings. In case, a barren woman or a learned person or the boys of sixteen years of age would take bath under you, they would be turned as children.

## \|\| 3.93.22-23 \|\|

*māsaṃ yaśca tṛtīyaṃ vai bhakṣayiṣyatyaniṃditam \|*  
*ajaraḥ so'maraścaiva sarvakālaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 22 \|\|*

*idaṃ dattvā varāṃstasya vahnitvamatha āptavān \|*  
*vibudhā api tatraiva tamadṛśyaṃta vaṃśagam \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Even a person consuming the degraded type of meat or flesh shall become everlasting.” Thus granting a boon in this way, he got back his original form of Agni. The gods also then found Agni in his original form.

## \|\| 3.93.24-27 \|\|

*ūṣmayā jātakalmāṣaṃ jñātvā saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭā vaṃśamathocuste devāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*ūṣmayā kalmaṣībhūya hyagnirgarbhaṃ dhariṣyati \|*  
*yo gṛhī vaiṇavīṃ yaṣṭiṃ brahmacārī ca naiṣṭhikaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*paṃḍāgnipālane puṇyaṃ yaddṛṣṭaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ \|*  
*vadaṃtaṃ kalmaṣīyaṣṭistaṃ prāpnoti dvijottamam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*vaṃśasyānugrahaṃ kṛtvā devyāhṛtimathābruvan \|*  
*gṛhṇīta śukraṃ bhadrasya tava putro bhaviṣyati \|\| 27 \|\|*

24-27. With the heat of Agni emerging in the form of smoke, the gods expressed their happiness. The lord of the three worlds then spoke in praise of the fire god- “Because of his heat, let him produce smoke, let Agni develop pregnancy.” The merit which is said to be earned by a householder or the Brahmacari with religious faith, with the holding of the bamboo stick and the one which has been described by the lighting of pandagni by the people enlightened in Brahman, the same bamboo is also achieved by the performer. The goddess Parvati also becoming graceful over her family, said- “The semen of Siva - the form of welfare, should be held by you, which would surely produce a son for your sake.”

## \|\| 3.93.28 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*yadāgnirnaṣṭo devānāṃ kenāgnitvaṃ tadā kṛtam \|*  
*bhūyo'pi kena kālena agniragnitvamāptavān \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Yudhisthira said- For the establishment of the task of the gods, when Agni was present there, who killed him? By what means could he achieve again the foremost position? How could he attain his original form of Agni?

## \|\| 3.93.29-33 \|\|

*kṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu rājanpranaṣṭe'gnau yenāgnitvaṃ kadācana \|*  
*yasminkāle tithī yasyā punaragnitvamāptavān \|\| 29 \|\|*

*utathyāṅgirasoḥ pūrvamāsīdvyatikaro mahān \|*  
*ahaṃ vidyātapobhyāṃ vai tava jyāyāñchrutena ca \|*  
*utathyenaivamuktastu aṅgirāḥ prāha taṃ munim \|\| 30 \|\|*

*gacchāvo brahmasadanaṃ marīcipramukhairdvijaiḥ \|*  
*upetaṃ cānyamunibhirbrahmarājarṣisattamaiḥ \|*  
*utathyaḥ prāha sadbrahmanṛṣīṃstānstabdhamānasaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*jyāyānvā katamosmākamiti naḥ kathyatāṃ sphuṭam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*athovāca munirbrahmā tāvubhau kuddhamānasau \|*  
*ānayadhvaṃ drutaṃ gatvā vibudhānbhuvaneśvarān \|\| 33 \|\|*

29-33. Sri Krsna said- O king, I am going to speak out as to how Agni was destroyed, how did he get back his original position? You please listen. Once in earlier times, a great controversy developed between the Maharsis known by the names of Utathya as well as Angiras. Both of them claimed that they were superior to each other. Utathya said that— “In the study of the Vedas and other learnings as well as in the tapas, I am indeed the best.” At these words of Utathya, Angiras said to him-“Let us take a decision in the company of Marici and other Rsis besides the prominent Brahmanas.” Reaching the abode of Brahma, Maharsi Utathya accompanied with those Rsis and Brahmarsis, spoke in presence of all- “All of you kindly speak out clearly, as to who is the best Rsi out of both of us.” Thereafter, Brahma said to both the Rsis - “First of all, both of you should rapidly go and get the gods as well as the lords of all the Bhuvanas.

## \|\| 3.93.34-36 \|\|

*tato vivādaṃ paśyāmi bhavatāṃ taiḥ sametya ca \|*  
*tatastau sahitau natvā'ninyatuśca ṛṣīṃstadā \|\| 34 \|\|*

*lokapālānmaheṃdrādīnsayamānvāruṇānilān \|*  
*sādhyānmarudgaṇānviṣvānṛṣīnbhṛgvagnināradān \|\| 35 \|\|*

*gaṃdharvānvittarakṣoghnānrākṣasāndaityadānavān \|*  
*nāyātastatra tigmāṃśuḥ sarve cānye samāgatāḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. The decision about the controversy would be taken in the presence of all of them. On hearing this, both of them invited all the Rsis, besides Mahendra - the Lokapala and other gods, besides Yama, Varuna, Vayu, Sadhyas, Marudganas, Visvavasu, Bhrgu, Agni, Narada, Kubera, Gandharvas, Rak§asas, Daityas and Danavas also arrived there. But the Sungod, with sharp rays could not reach there.

## \|\| 3.93.37-38 \|\|

*dṛṣṭvā tu vibudhānsarvānbrahmā provāca tānṛṣīn \|*  
*ānayadhvamitaḥ sūryaṃ sāmnā daṃḍena vā punaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*evamukto gatastāvadutathyaḥ sūryamaṃḍalam \|*  
*sa gatvā prāha mārtaṇḍaṃ śīghramehyeva saṃvidam \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Then Brahma finding that the R$is and all others had been present there, said to them-“The Sungod should be brought here, by all means.” At these words of Brahma, Utathya proceeded on to solar region. Utathya said-“You kindly reach before Brahma urgently. This is the news (carried by me).”

## \|\| 3.93.39-40 \|\|

*sa utathyamathovāca kathaṃ brahmanvrajāmyaham \|*  
*evamuktvā gataḥ sūryo bhuvane mayi nirgate \|\| 39 \|\|*

*evamukto muniḥ prāyātsarva devasamāgamam \|*  
*ācacakṣe ca yatproktaṃ bhāsvatā tapanaṃ prati \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. At these words of the sage Utathya, the Sungod said- “O Brahman, how can I move?” Thus speaking, the Sungod went to the palace of mine which was no more being used by me. Utathya on his part, went back and revealed his talk with the Sungod to the gods and the Rsis besides others, whatever the Sungod had spoken to him.

## \|\| 3.93.41 \|\|

*uvācāṅgirasaṃ brahmā śīghramenaṃ tvamānaya \|*  
*sa tathokto gatastatra yatrāsau tapate raviḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. On hearing this, Brahma said to Angiras-“You go and get him here quickly.” Accepting the command of Brahma, Angiras went to the Sungod again, to the place where he had been spreading his lustre.

## \|\| 3.93.42-44 \|\|

*ehyehi bhagavansūrya tapyate bhavatānvaham \|*  
*evamukto gataḥ sūryo yatra devāḥ samāgatāḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*sthitvā muhūrtaṃ provāca kiṃ vā kāryamupasthitam \|*  
*pṛcchantameva mārtaṃrḍaṃ brahmā provāca sādaram \|\| 43 \|\|*

*gaccha śīghraṃ na dahate bhuvanaṃ yāvadaṃgirāḥ \|*  
*labdhaprāyaṃ tu golokaṃ vartate kṛṣṇapiṃgalam \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. Angiras said to the Sungod- “You always remain with heat like this. Come on, with me.” On hearing these words, the Sungod atonce accompanied the sage. Reaching the assembly of the gods, the Sungod spoke to the audience- “What is the task suitable for me to be attended.” When so enquired by Martanda, Brahma gracefully said- “The sage Angiras intends to bum himself, therefore, О Sungod, you reach there atonce. Because, whatever blood of the world has left out, it has been turned out to be black. The new blood is seen as greenish-red. His white complexion has been completely destroyed.

## \|\| 3.93.45-46 \|\|

*pāṭalo haritaḥ śoṇaḥ śveto varṇaḥ praṇāśitaḥ \|*  
*śākadvīpaṃ kuśadvīpaṃ krauñcadvīpaṃ sapannagam \|*  
*dagdhamaṅgirasā sarvaṃ bhūyo'pi pradahiṣyati \|\| 45 \|\|*

*yāvacca dahate sarvaṃ bhuvanaṃ tapasāṃgirāḥ \|*  
*gaccha tāvaditaḥ śīghraṃ svasthāne tapa bhāskara \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. Angiras has reduced to ashes the Sakadvipa, Kusadvipa, besides the Krauncadvipa and other places. He is further desirous of destroying others. О Bhaskara, before Angiras is able to bum out all the Mas, you depart from here, before he destroys all the universe and take your place.”

## \|\| 3.93.47-55 \|\|

*evamuktaḥ sa vibhunā svasthānamadhirūḍhavān \|*  
*visṛṣṭavānaṃgirasaṃ sakāśamamṛtāśinām \|\| 47 \|\|*

*gatvāṅgirā uvācedaṃ gataḥ kiṃ karavāṇyaham \|*  
*devā aṃgirasaṃ prāhustaporāśimakalmaṣam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*saṃpraśasyocuragnitvaṃ kuru tāvanmahītale \|*  
*pūrvaṃ yathāgniḥ kṛtavāṃstathā tvamapi sattama \|\| 49 \|\|*

*yāvadagniṃ prapaśyāmaḥ kvāsau naṣṭaḥ kva tiṣṭhati \|*  
*evamuktaḥ sa devaistu agnitvaṃ kṛtavāṃstadā \|\| 50 \|\|*

*devairdṛṣṭo yathā hyagnistatte sarvaṃ niveditam \|*  
*devakārye kṛte tasmindevā vahni mathābruvan \|\| 51 \|\|*

*agne'gnitvaṃ kuruṣva tvamaṃgirāstu yathā purā \|*  
*evamuktaḥ surairvahniścintayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*ko me'pahṛtaṃ tejaḥ kenāgnitvaṃ kṛtaṃ tviha \|*  
*dṛṣṭvāthāgniraṅgirasaṃ tejorāśimakalmaṣam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*uvāca muñca matsthānaṃ vacastoṣakaraṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*ahaṃ te tanayaśceṣṭo bhaviṣye prathame śubhe \|\| 54 \|\|*

*bṛhaspatīti nāmā vai tathānye bahavaḥ sutāḥ \|*  
*evamukto munistuṣṭo bahūṃścājanayatsutān \|\| 55 \|\|*

47-55. At these words of Brahma, the Sungod occupied his place. With the departure of Angiras from that place along with the gods, he reached the gods and asked them “What is the suitable task for me?” On hearing these words, praising Angiras, the gods said to him-“O excellent one, you establish the fire here, in the same way in which the fire was established in earlier times. Upto that time, all of us shall wonder as to where has he been concealed and where is he living presently.” At these words of the gods, he consecrated the fire. Thus, I have spoken to you the way by which Agni could not be found. After performing the divine task, the gods said to the fire god-“Angira has established Agni during earlier times. You also do similarly.” At these words of the gods, the fire god got worried and expressed his grief by saying- “I know not, who has removed my lustre and who has established the fire-hood here? The fire god then spotting the sage Angira who was unblemished, said to him- “You better leave my place. I am speaking to you the words of extreme patience. I shall be your first son favourable for the Brahmanas. I shall be known as Brhaspati. You will have several other sons.” At the words of the fire god, the sage was delighted and he produce many sons. On the other hand, Agni also produced several sons and grandsons.

## \|\| 3.93.56-58 \|\|

*vahniṃ saṃjanayāmāsa putrānpautrāṃstadāṃgirāḥ \|*  
*avāpa punaragnitvamagnistasyāṃ tithau nṛpa \|\| 56 \|\|*

*sarvameva caturdaśyāṃ saṃjātaṃ havyavāhanam \|*  
*havyavāhana devānāṃ bhūtānāṃ guhyacāritam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*tato'ṣṭapatipatve ca rudreṇa pratipāditam \|*  
*pūjiteyaṃ tithirdevairdivisthaiśca nṛpairapi \|\| 58 \|\|*

56-58. O king, on the same day of caturdasi, Agni again regained his lustre. The Havya-vahana Agni, because of his birth, is considered to be the secret agent of the gods. Lord Rudra also made him the leader of the Dikpalas. Therefore, this particular tithi or the moon day, became adorable by all the gods of the heaven, the rulers, besides the Rsis like Paila, Jabala and others, besides the kings.

## \|\| 3.93.59-62 \|\|

*pailajābālimanvādyairanyaiśca nahuṣādibhiḥ \|*  
*viṣaśastrahatānāṃ ca saṃgrāmenyatra te kvacit \|\| 59 \|\|*

*ajñātāvṛṣapāpaiśca vyālairye vyāpya hiṃsitāḥ \|*  
*nadīpravāha patitaḥ samudre parvate'dhvani \|\| 60 \|\|*

*patitāḥ parvatebhyaśca toyāgnidahane mṛtāḥ \|*  
*udadhyā pātitā ye ca ye ke cātmahano janāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ śastaṃ caturdaśyāṃ śrāddhaṃ svargasukhapradam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*śrāddhāni caiva dattāni dānāni sulaghūnyapi \|*  
*prasūnaphalabhojyāni upatiṣṭhaṃti tānnarān \|\| 62 \|\|*

59-62. For the redemption of a person who dies by consuming the poison or with the strike of the weapon, or getting injured in a war, or by dying anywhere else, unknown death, or by committing terrible sin, snake bite, drowning in the water current, by falling in the ocean, to fall from the mountain, getting burnt in fire, by jumping from above, and for the redemption of the people killed by other ways or those who commit suicide, the performing of the sraddha on the day of caturdasi or by giving even a small thing for the sake of the dead on that particular day, bestows the comforts of the heaven to the diseased. Whatever flowers or fruit is given on that day, surely reaches the diseased.

## \|\| 3.93.63-68 \|\|

*evaṃ tithiriyaṃ rājannāgneyī procyate janaiḥ \|*  
*raudrīṃ ca kecidityāhū rudrogniḥ sa ca paṭhyate \|\| 63 \|\|*

*yasyāṃ manorathaṃ yaṃyaṃ samuddiśya hyupoṣati \|*  
*dadāti tasya tadvahniḥ sāgre saṃvatsare gate \|\| 64 \|\|*

*caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya trilocanam \|*  
*puṣpadhūpādinaivedyai rātrau jāgaraṇānnaraḥ \|*  
*pañcagavyaṃ niśi prāśya svapyādbhūmau vimatsaraḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*śyāmākamatha vā bhuktvā tailakṣāravivarjitam \|*  
*homaḥ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryaḥ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ nṛpa \|\| 66 \|\|*

*agnaye havyavāhanāya somāyāṃgirase namaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ prabhāte vimale snāpya paṃcāmṛtaiḥ śivam \|\| 67 \|\|*

*pūjayitvā vidhānena homaṃ kṛtvā tathaiva ca \|*  
*udīrayenmantrametaṃ kṛtvā śirasi cāṃjalim \|\| 68 \|\|*

63-68. O king, therefore some people call it also Agneyi or the favourite of the fire god, and some call it the favourite of Rudra. When a person on this day fasts for any particular purpose, the fire god makes him successful. On the day of caturdasi at the start of a year, one should observe fast and offer flowers, incense, eatables etc. to the three-eyed Siva, worshipping him at the same time, remaining awake during the night, break his fast by consuming pancagavya and should sleep on floor, with the mind free of any attraction, discarding oil and salt, a hundred and eight offerings of the wild rice should be poured in the fire of homa in favour of the fire, who is carrier of havya and salutation should be offered to Agni, Soma and Angira. Then during the spotless early morning, lord Siva should be worshipped in an appropriate manner as prescribed earlier, and the homa should also be performed. The performer should offer his salutation to the lord, lowering his head, besides begging forgiveness.

## \|\| 3.93.69-72 \|\|

*namastrimūrtaye tubhyaṃ namaḥ sūryāgnirūpiṇe \|*  
*putrānyaccha sukhaṃ yaccha mokṣaṃ yaccha namo'stu te \|\| 69 \|\|*

*nīrājanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā paścādbhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ \|*  
*evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte kṛtvā sarvaṃ yathoditam \|\| 70 \|\|*

*sauvarṇaṃ kārayeddevaṃ trinetraṃ śūlapāṇinam \|*  
*vṛṣaskaṃdhagataṃ saumyaṃ sitavastrayugānvitam \|\| 71 \|\|*

*candanenānuliptāṅgaṃ sitamālyopaśobhitam \|*  
*sthāpayitvā tāmrapātre brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|*  
*sarvakālikametatte kathitaṃ vratamuttamam \|\| 72 \|\|*

69-72. He should say- “Salutation to Trimurti form of Siva, salutation to the form of Agni and Surya. I am offering salutation to you again and again. You bestow several sons to me. At the time of my death, bestow salvation for me. The arati should then be performed. Then he should take food maintaining silence. Similarly, on the caturthi tithi (fourteenth moon day) of each month, the fast should be undertaken in an appropriate manner. At the end of the year, the performance should be done as stated earlier. On that particular day, a gold image of the carrier of trident riding over a bull should be placed in a copper vase. It should be covered by four white clothes and the sandal paste as well as the flower garlands should decorate the same. The image should be consecrated. After worshipping the same, the image with copper vase should be given over to a Brahmana. I have thus narrated the details of this all time vrata which is indeed the best.

## \|\| 3.93.73-74 \|\|

*saṃvatsaraṃ samāptaṃ hi vratasya tu yadā bhavet \|*  
*kāle gate bahutithe tīrthasya śaraṇaṃ bhavet \|*  
*mṛtasya deho divyastho divyālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*divyanārīgaṇavṛto vimānavaramāsthitaḥ \|*  
*devadaivaiḥ samaḥ śaṃbhoḥ krīḍati tripure ciram \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. At the end of the year, with the performing of this vrata, the performer has a chance of visiting a holy place and in case of his death there, he attains a divine body and is adorned with the divine ornaments. He boards an excellent plane with enough of Apsaras to serve him. Then he sports in the place of Siva for long.

## \|\| 3.93.75-76 \|\|

*iha cāgatya kālāṃte jātaḥ sa ca nṛpo bhavet \|*  
*dātā yajvā dhanī dakṣo brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇapriyaḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

*śrīmānvāgmī kṛtī dhīmānputrapautrasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*patnīgaṇasamrāyuktaściraṃ bhadrāṇi paśyati \|\| 76 \|\|*

75-76. At the time of his return on earth, he is born in the race of the performer of the yajna and becomes a king of a Brahmana race. He then possesses all the fortunes, is truthful, successful, intelligent and such a king, with his wife, sons and grandsons lives a comfortable life.

## \|\| 3.93.77 \|\|

*ye durllabhā bhuvi suroragamānavānāṃ kāmā hyanuttamaguṇena yutāḥ sadaiva \|*  
*tānā pnuvaṃti sitabhūtatithau sureśaṃ saṃpūjya somatilakaṃ vidhivanmanuṣyāḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

77\. When a person worships lord Siva as per prescribed rituals, who is the deity of all the successful people, on the day of bright fourteenth day of the moon, he surely achieves success.

## Chapter 94. Ananta Caturdasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.94.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*1 anaṃtavratamastyanyatsarvapāpaharaṃ śivam \|*  
*sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ strīṇāṃ caiva yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 1 \|\|*

*śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ māsi bhādrapade śubhe \|*  
*tasyānuṣṭhānamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Sri Krsna said- The Ananta vrata which is the remover of all the sins, is the form of welfare and fulfills all the desires of the people. On the bright fourteenth moon day of the month of Bhadrapada, when this vrata is performed, one is relieved of all the sins and he achieves salvation.

## \|\| 3.94.3-4 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kṛṣṇa ko'yaṃ tvayākhyāto hyanaṃta iti viśrutaḥ \|*  
*kiṃ śeṣanāga āhosvidanaṃtastakṣakaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*paramātmātha vānaṃta utāho brahma ucyate \|*  
*ka eṣo'naṃtasaṃjño vai tathyaṃ brūhi keśava \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Yudhisthira said- You have first mentioned the name of Ananta, who is this Ananta? Is he Sesanaga or Taksaka? Is he the supreme soul or the Brahman? 0 Kesava, you tell me the factual position of the soul, who is known as Ananta?

## \|\| 3.94.5-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*anaṃta ityahaṃ pārtha mama nāma nibodhaya \|*  
*ādityādiṣu vāreṣu yaḥ kāla upapadyate \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kalākāṣṭhāmuhūrtādi dinarātriśarīravān \|*  
*pakṣamāsartuvarṣādi yugakalpavyavasthayā \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. Sri Krsna said- O Partha, you know it clearly that I am known as Ananta as well, all the time who appears on sundays and the other days including kalas, kashas, muhurtas etc., besides the days, nights, fortnights, months, seasons, the years etc., besides the one who has established the yugas and the kalpas, (he is the same).

## \|\| 3.94.7-9 \|\|

*yo'yaṃ kālo mayākhyātastava dharmabhṛtāṃ vara \|*  
*so'haṃ kālo'vatīrṇo'tra bhuvo bhārāvatāraṇāt \|\| 7 \|\|*

*dānavānāṃ vināśāya vasudevakulodbhavam \|*  
*māṃ viddhyanaṃtaṃ pārtha tvaṃ viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ haraṃ śivam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*brahmāṇaṃ bhāskaraṃ śeṣaṃ sarvavyāpinamīśvaram \|*  
*viśvarūpaṃ mahātmānaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakam \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. O religious-minded one, whosoever is known as kala in the above terminology and the one who emerges to relieve the earth of her burden, (is none else) but myself alone. I incarnate on earth. O Partha, for the destruction of the Danavas, I am born in the race of Vasudeva and am known as Ananta, Visnu, Jisnu, Hara, Siva, Brahma, Bhaskara, Sesa, all pervading Isvara, having universal form, Mahatma - the great soul or the destroyer of the universe. I should be known accordingly. O Partha, there is no doubt that for your satisfaction, I have spoken on this subject exhaustively.

## \|\| 3.94.10-11 \|\|

*pratyayārthaṃ mayākhyātaṃ so'haṃ pārtha na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*anantavratamāhātmyavidhiṃ vada vidāṃ vara \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kiṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ cāsya hyanuṣṭhānavatāṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*kena vādau purā cīrṇaṃ martye kena prakāśitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Yudhisthira said- O excellent one, you tell me about the details of Ananta-vrata, besides the method of performing the same and the related glory. By performing this vrata, what type of merit is achieved by a person and who on this earth had performed this vrata? You kindly speak on the subject exhaustively, highlighting the glory of Ananta vrata which relates to lord Visnu.

## \|\| 3.94.12-14 \|\|

*evaṃ samastaṃ vistārya brūhyanaṃtavrataṃ hare \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*āsītpurā kṛtayuge sumaṃto nāma vai dvijaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vaśiṣṭhagotre cotpannaḥ surūpaśca bhṛgoḥ sutām \|*  
*dīkṣāṃ nāmopayeme tāṃ vedoktavidhinā tataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tasyāḥ kālena saṃjātā duhitānaṃtalakṣaṇā \|*  
*2 śīlā nāma suśīlā sā vardhate pitṛsadmani \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. Sri Krsna said- In earlier times of Satyayuga, there lived a Brahmana known by the name of Sumanta, who was bom in the Vasistha gotra. He was quite beautiful. He appropriately married Diksa - the daughter of Bhrgu. After sometime, Diksa produced a daughter who was known by the name of Sill who possessed innumerable symptoms, besides being of an extremely noble nature. In her father’s house, she kept on growing like the moon digit.

## \|\| 3.94.15-18 \|\|

*mātā ca tasyāḥ kālena haradāhena pīḍitā \|*  
*vinanāśa nadītīre mṛtā svargapuraṃ yayau \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sumaṃtopi tatonyāṃ vai dharmapuṃsaḥ sutāṃ punaḥ \|*  
*upayeme vidhānena karkaśāṃ nāma nāmataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*duḥśīlāṃ karkaśāṃ caṃḍīṃ nityaṃ kalahakāriṇīm \|*  
*sāpi śīlā piturgehe gṛhārcanaratā vibho \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kuḍyastaṃbhatulādhāradehalītoraṇādiṣu \|*  
*cāturvarṇakaraṃ vaiśyanīlapītasitāsitaiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

15-18. At the same time, her mother died of a disease at the river bank and proceeded on to heaven. Thereafter, Sumanta married another woman, who was extremely shrewish and was known as Karkasa. She was quite harsh, devoid of nobility, besides being quarrelsome. Sila on the other hand, while staying in her parented home, put in extra labour to keep the house neat and clean. She decorated the walls, pillars with zodiac signs, the entrance gate and the arches with several colours like blue, white, yellow and black.

## \|\| 3.94.19 \|\|

*svastikaiḥ śaṃkhapadmaiśca arcayantī punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*pitrā dṛṣṭā sumantena strīcihnā yauvane sthitā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. She drew the sketches of conches, lotus, etc. The father then felt that she had attained the marriageable age, because all the symptoms of youthful age were visible in her.

## \|\| 3.94.20 \|\|

*kasmai deyā mayā śīlā vicāryaivaṃ suduḥkhitaḥ \|*  
*pitā dadau munīndrāya kauṃḍinyāya śubhe dine \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Then he thought, “whom to give this girl in marriage?” He felt concerned for the same. Thereafter, with the consent of all, he gave away his daughter to sage Kaundinya.

## \|\| 3.94.21-23 \|\|

*smṛtyuktaśāstravidhinā vivāhamakarottadā \|*  
*nivartyodvāhikaṃ sarvaṃ proktavānkarkaśāṃ dvijaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*kiñcidāyādikaṃ deyaṃ jāmātuḥ pāritoṣikam \|*  
*tacchrutvā karkaśā kruddhā proddhṛtya gṛhamaṇḍapam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*kapāṭe susthiraṃ kṛtvā gamyatāmityuvāca ha \|*  
*bhojyāvaśiṣṭacūrṇena pātheyaṃ ca cakāra sā \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. According to the rules prescribed in the sacred scriptures, the marriage was performed. Sumanta then said to his quarrelsome wife-“The son-in-law is departing, therefore, he should be honoured by giving something.” On hearing this, the enraged and the quarrelsome woman placed all the things of the marriage mandapa (pavilion) behind the door and said-“You go away, (there is nothing there).” Only leftovers of the food had been left, which was given over by her to them, to be consumed on the way.

## \|\| 3.94.24-25 \|\|

*kauṃḍinyopi vivāhyaināṃ pathi gacchañchanaiḥśanaiḥ \|*  
*śīlāṃ suśīlāmādāya navoḍhāṃ gorathena hi \|\| 24 \|\|*

*madhyāhne bhojyavelāyāṃ samuttīrya sarittaṭe \|*  
*dadarśa śīlā sā strīṇāṃ samūhaṃ raktavāsasām \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. After the marriage, Kaundinya was seated in the bullock-cart with his newly married wife Sila and they proceeded slowly towards his abode. They crossed the river at noon and at the time of food, Sila found that at the river bank, some ladies clad in red costumes had assembled there.

## \|\| 3.94.26-28 \|\|

*caturdaśyāmarcayantaṃ bhaktyā devaṃ pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*upagamya śanaiḥ śīlā papraccha strīkadaṃbakam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*nāryaḥ kimetanme brūta kiṃnāma vratamīdṛśam \|*  
*tā ūcuryoṣitaḥ sarvā ananto nāma viśrutaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*sābravīdahamapyevaṃ kariṣye vratamuttamam \|*  
*vidhānaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tatra kiṃ dānaṃ kasya pūjanam \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. Each one of the lady there was individually performing the worship of the god there, on the day of caturdasi. Sila slowly went there and asked the ladies- “What type of vrata are you performing here? You kindly tell me about it.” On hearing these words, all the ladies present there said- “The one who is known by the name of Ananta, (we are worshipping the same).” Then Sila said- “I shall also observe this vrata. But what is the procedure for doing so and also the charities to be given for the same? Who is to be worshipped?” You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 3.94.29-32 \|\|

*striya ūcuḥ \|*  
*śīle pakvānnaprasthasya punnāmnaḥ sukṛtasya tu \|*  
*arddhaṃ viprāya dātavyamarddhamātmani bhojanam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*kartavyaṃ tu sarittīre kathāṃ śrutvā harerimām \|*  
*anaṃtānaṃtamabhyarcya maṃḍale gaṃdhadīpakaiḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*dhūpaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pītālaktaiścatuḥśataiḥ \|*  
*tasyāgrato dṛḍhaṃ sūtraṃ kuṃkumāktaṃ sudorakam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*caturdaśagraṃthiyutaṃ vāme strī dakṣiṇe pumān \|*  
*maṃtreṇānena rājendra yāvadvarṣaṃ samāpyate \|\| 32 \|\|*

29-32. The ladies said- О Sila, one seer (950 grams) of rice should be cooked, half of which should be given to the Brahmana. The rest of it should be kept for yourself or thus present in the vicinity. The related story should be heard with devotion. Anantadeva should be consecrated in a manala and should be worshipped offering the flowers, fragrance, lamp and using four hundred yellow Alaktaka (the colour used by the ladies to decorate the face, which is made of lac). The worship should be carried out in a proper way. Thereafter, beautiful coloured strings of cotton soaked in vermilion, having fourteen knots in it, should be placed before the deity, after completion of the worship. The ladies should bind the string with knots over the left hand and the men should do so on the right hand, till the end of the year.

## \|\| 3.94.33 \|\|

*anaṃta saṃsāramahāsamudre magnānsamabhyuddhara vāsudeva \|*  
*anaṃtarūpe viniyojitātmā hyanaṃtarūpāya namonamaste \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. While binding the knotted string over the arm, one should beg forgiveness thus- “O Vasudeva, О Ananta, you kindly redeem the people of the lower strata of the society. I have absorbed the form of Ananta in my soul, salutation to Ananta again and again.

## \|\| 3.94.34-36 \|\|

*anena dorakaṃ baddhvā bhoktavyaṃ svasthamānasaiḥ \|*  
*dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devamanaṃtaṃ viśvarūpiṇam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*bhuktvā cāṃte vrajedveśma hīdaṃ proktaṃ vrataṃ tava \|*  
*sāpi śrutvā vrataṃ cakre śīlā baddhvā sudorakam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*bhartā tasyāḥ samāgatya tāṃ dadarśa mahādhanām \|*  
*pātheyaśeṣaṃ viprāya dattvā bhuktvā tathaiva ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. After tying the knotted string, with her mind devoted to Narayana in universal form as Ananta, one should take his food and then return lovingly to her abode. Thus, this vrata's procedure for its performance has been spoken by me. &ld also, listening to the same, observed the vrata appropriately, and tied a knotted string over her arm. Her husband then suddenly arrived there and found heaps of riches there in the house. Sila kept some riches for the journey and distributed the rest among the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.94.37-39 \|\|

*punarjagāma sā hṛṣṭā gorathena svamāśramam \|*  
*bhartrā sahaiva śanakaiḥ pratyakṣaṃ tatkṣaṇādabhūt \|*  
*tenānaṃtaprabhāveṇa śubhagodhanasaṃkulaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*gṛhāśramaḥ śriyā yukto dhanadhānyasamāyutaḥ \|*  
*ākulo vyākulo ramyaḥ sarvatrātithipūjanaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*sāpi māṇikyakāñcībhirmuktāhāravibhūṣitā \|*  
*divyāṃgavastrasaṃchannā sāvitrīpratimābhavat \|\| 39 \|\|*

37-39. After taking food, she felt delightful and using the bullock cart, she reached her asrama or hermitage. Reaching there, she found that in the hermitage, besides her husband, because of the effect of the Ananta vrata performed by her, a herd of cows had arrived. Her entire house seemed to have been filled with enough of cereals and riches. From her side, all the people were engaged in serving the guests. At that point of time, Slid was also decorated with ornaments and garland of pearls and clad in the best of clothes. She appeared like the image of Savitri.

## \|\| 3.94.40-41 \|\|

*kadācidupaviṣṭena dṛṣṭaṃ baddhaṃ sudorakam \|*  
*śīlāyā hastamūle tu sākṣepaṃ troṭitaṃ ruṣā \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tena karmavipākeṇa tasya sā śrīḥ kṣayaṃ gatā \|*  
*godhanaṃ taskarairnītaṃ gṛhaṃ cāgnividāhitam \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. Enjoying the immense pleasure, she got seated with her husband, who spotted the string of Ananta bound over the hand of Sila Getting annoyed and casting a sarcasm, he broke the string with knots from the hand of Slid and threw it away. Because of the evil effect of the said deed, his entire grace was lost. The cows were stolen by the thieves and the performer of homa (Agni) deserted from that place.

## \|\| 3.94.42-44 \|\|

*yadyadevāgataṃ gehe tatra tatraiva naśyati \|*  
*svajanaiḥ kalaho mitrairvacanaṃ na janaistathā \|\| 42 \|\|*

*anaṃtākṣepadoṣeṇa dāridryaṃ patitaṃ gṛhe \|*  
*na kaścidvadate lokastena sārddhaṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 43 \|\|*

*tato jagāma kauṃḍinyo nirvedādvanagahvaram \|*  
*manasā dhyāyatenaṃtaṃ kadā drakṣyāmi keśavam \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. In other words, ail the riches returned to the same sources from where they had arrived. Everything got destroyed in no time. The relatives started quarrelling. The friend stopped talking because of the insult of lord, the poverty dominated in the house in all respects. Because of this, no one was prepared to talk with them. Getting overpowered with miseries, Kaundinya then proceeded to the thick forest in disgust. He had only one thing in mind, how could I meet lord Ananta and at which place? How can I see him?

## \|\| 3.94.45-48 \|\|

*vrataṃ niraśanaṃ gṛhya brahmacaryaṃ japanharim \|*  
*vihvalaḥ prayayau pārtha araṇyaṃ janavarjitam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*tatrāpaśyanmahāvṛkṣaṃ phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ tathā \|*  
*tamapṛcchattvayānaṃtaḥ kaccidṛṣṭo mahādruma \|*  
*tadbrūhi sopyuvācedaṃ nānaṃtaṃ vedmyahaṃ dvija \|\| 46 \|\|*

*evaṃ nirīkṣitastena gāṃ dadarśa savatsakām \|*  
*tṛṇamadhye pradhāvantīmitaścetaśca pāṃḍava \|\| 47 \|\|*

*sobravīddhenuke brūhi yadyanaṃtastvayekṣitaḥ \|*  
*gauruvācātha kauṃḍinya nānaṃtaṃ vedmyahaṃ vibho \|\| 48 \|\|*

45-48. Observing Brahmacarya, Kaundinya became upset and anxious to meet Ananta. He then entered into the deep and lonely forest. Reaching there, he came across a huge tree, laden with flowers and fruits. Finding it, he said to the same- “Have you seen Ananta somewhere?” The tree replied- “I am unaware of Ananta.” Thus wandering in all the directions, he was moving when he met with a cow with a calf. She was running over the green grass. Kaundinya said to the cow- “You tell me, have you seen Ananta? The cow replied “O Kaundinya, I am unaware of Ananta.”

## \|\| 3.94.49-55 \|\|

*tato jagāmātha vane govṛṣaṃ śādvale sthitam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā papraccha gosvāminnanaṃto lakṣitastvayā \|\| 49 \|\|*

*govṛṣastamuvācātha nānanto vīkṣito mayā \|*  
*tato vrajandadarśāgre ramyaṃ puṣkariṇīdvayam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*anyonyajalakallolavīcibhiḥ pariśobhitam \|*  
*channaṃ kumudakahlāraiḥ kumudotpalamaṃḍitam \|\| 51 \|\|*

*sevitaṃ bhramarairhaṃsaiścakraiḥ kāraṃḍavairbakaiḥ \|*  
*te apṛcchaṃ dvijonanto bhavadbhyāṃ nopalakṣitaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*ūcatuḥ puṣkariṇyau taṃ nānaṃtaṃ vidvahe dvija \|*  
*tato brahmandadarśāgre gardabhaṃ kuñjaraṃ tathā \|\| 53 \|\|*

*tāvapyuktau sumaṃtena tasyāpi viniveditam \|*  
*nāvābhyāṃ vīkṣitonaṃtastacchrutvā niṣasāda ha \|\| 54 \|\|*

*tasminkṣaṇe munivare kauṃḍinye brāhmaṇottame \|*  
*kṛpayānaṃtadevopi pratyakṣaḥ samajāyata \|\| 55 \|\|*

49-55. Thereafter, while wandering in the forest, he found a bull grazing the green grass. He asked the bull- “Have you seen Ananta somewhere?” The bull also declined to have seen Ananta. Moving forward, he came across two beautiful lakes which had beautiful waves in the water and looked charming. They were covered with the lotus buds and the black wasps were hovering over the lotus flowers. The birds like partridge, ducks and the skylarks added to the beauty of the lakes. The Brahmana asked the lakes whether they have seen Ananta, who also declined. Then moving forward, he came across a donkey and an elephant, on an enquiry about Ananta, both of them declined to have met him. He then seated himself there. At the same time, lord Ananta, showering his grace on the Brahmana Kaundinya, appeared before him in person.

## \|\| 3.94.56-61 \|\|

*vṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpeṇa ita ehītyuvāca tam \|*  
*praveśayitvā svagṛhaṃ gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare \|\| 56 \|\|*

*tāṃ purīṃ darśayāmāsa divyanārīnarairyutām \|*  
*tasyāṃ niviṣṭamātmānaṃ varasiṃhāsane nṛpa \|\| 57 \|\|*

*pārśvasthaśaṃkhacakrāsigadāgaruḍaśobhitam \|*  
*darśayāmāsa viprāya pūrvoktaṃ viśvarūpiṇam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*vibhūtibhedaiścānantamanantaṃ parameśvaram \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu dvijonantamuvāca parayā mudā \|\| 59 \|\|*

*pāpohaṃ pāpakarmāhaṃ pāpātmā pāpasambhavaḥ \|*  
*pāhi māṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa sarvapāpaharo bhava \|\| 60 \|\|*

*adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam \|*  
*cūtavṛkṣo vṛṣaḥ kastu kā gauḥ puṣkariṇīdvayam \|*  
*gardabhaṃ kuñjaraṃ caiva deva me brūhi tattvataḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

56-61.He appeared before Kaundinya as an old Brahmana and said to him- “You come here, you come here. Holding the right hand of Kaundinya, he took him in his city with all his associates, where the duplicate of Ananta was seated on the throne, holding a conch, cakra, a sword and the club. He was accompanied with Garuda and adorned with all the ornaments. Then the old Brahmana displayed his universal form (to Kaundinya) with all the Vibhutis, because of which his endlessness could be visualized. Then Kaundinya - the Brahmana, finding the lord Anantadeva before him, expressed his extreme delight and begged forgiveness from him, saying- “O lotus eyed one, I am myself the form of sin, performed the evil deeds, have the sinful soul and have been born of sin. Therefore, kindly removing all my sins, you kindly save me. My birth has been successful today besides the life has become graceful. O lord, you kindly tell me about the huge tree, the bull, the cow, the lakes,the donkey as well as the elephants, who were tey?

## \|\| 3.94.62-64 \|\|

*anaṃta uvāca \|*  
*cūtavṛkṣo hi viprosau vidvānyo vedagarvitaḥ \|*  
*vidyādānaṃ nopakurvañchiṣyebhyastarutāṃ gataḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*sā gaurvasundharā dṛṣṭā niṣphalā yā tvayekṣitā \|*  
*sa harṣo vṛṣabho dṛṣṭo lābhārthaṃ yastvayā vṛtaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*dharmādharmavyavasthānaṃ tacca puṣkariṇīdvayam \|*  
*kharaḥ krodhastvayā dṛṣṭaḥ kuṃjaro dharmadūṣakaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇosāvanaṃtohaṃ guhāsaṃsāragahvare \|\| 64 \|\|*

62-64. Ananta said— “The mango tree represented a person who got blind because of the knowledge of the Vedas possessed by him and never tought his students. Therefore, he had to be grown as a tree. The cow represented the barren land, which had been observed by you. The delightful bull which had been seen by you is the same, who had been owned by you out of greed. The two lakes represented the dharma and adharma. The donkey you met with represented the rage, while the elephant stood for an infidel. In the cave of the world full of darkness, I am the only Brahmana known as Ananta.

## \|\| 3.94.65-67 \|\|

*ityuktaṃ te mayā sarvaṃ vipra gaccha punargṛham \|\| 65 \|\|*

*carānaṃtavrataṃ tattvaṃ nava varṣāṇi paṃca ca \|*  
*tatastuṣṭaḥ pradāsyāmi nakṣatrasthānamuttamam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*bhuktvā ca vipulānbhogānsarvānkāmānyathepsitān \|*  
*putrapautraiḥ parivṛtastato mokṣamavāpsyasi \|\| 67 \|\|*

65-67. Thus, I have revealed everything before you. You should return home and worship Ananta-vrata tattva for nine years. Thereafter, getting pleased with you, I shall grant you the place of a planet. Enjoying all the pleasures as per your desire, you with all your sons and grandsons, will live comfortably. At the time of death, you would attain beatitude.”

## \|\| 3.94.68-70 \|\|

*iti dattvā varaṃ devastatraivāṃtarhito'bhavat \|*  
*kauṃḍinyopyāgato gehaṃ cacārānaṃtasadvratam \|\| 68 \|\|*

*śīlayā saha dharmātmā bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān \|*  
*aṃte jagāma ca svargaṃ nakṣatraṃ ca punarvasum \|\| 69 \|\|*

*kalpasthānī ca saṃbhūto dṛśyatedyāpi sa jvalan \|*  
*anaṃtavratadharmeṇa samyakcīṇeṃna kaurava \|\| 70 \|\|*

68-70. Thus granting the boon on Kaundinya, Anantadeva disappeared from the same place. The religious Kaundinya also, after returning home, performed the excellent Ananta-vrata. As a result of this, enjoying all the pleasures with Sila, at the time of death he achieved the place of Punarvasu constellation who would remain there for a kalpa. Because of the performing of the Ananta-vrata, even today, he shines in the sky.

## \|\| 3.94.71 \|\|

*etatte kathitaṃ pārtha vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam \|*  
*yatkṛtvā sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

71\. O Partha, thus I have explained to you the glory of an excellent vrata, with the performing of which, a person is relieved of all the sins. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.94.72 \|\|

*ye ca śṛṇvaṃti satataṃ vācyamānaṃ narottama \|*  
*te sarve pāpanirmuktā yāsyaṃti paramāṃ gatim \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. O best of humans, those who listen to the glory of the same, they getting relieved of all the sins, achieve the final beatitude.

## \|\| 3.94.73 \|\|

*saṃsārasāgaraguhāṃ susukhaṃ vihartuṃ vāṃchaṃti ye kurukulodbhava śuddhasattvāḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjya te tribhuvaneśamanaṃtadevaṃ badhnaṃti dakṣiṇakare varadorakaṃ me \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. O ornament of the Kuru race, with the desire to lead a comfortable life and for the purification of the heart in the cave of the ocean of the universe, one should adore Ananta - the lord of the three worlds. The knotted string should be tied in the right arm.

## Chapter 95. Sravanika Vrata

## \|\| 3.95.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*loke prasiddhāḥ śrūyaṃte śrāvaṇyo nāma devatāḥ \|*  
*etāḥ kāḥ kiṃ ca kurvaṃti dharmaṃ cāsāṃ bravīhi me \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- Who are the well known Sravani gods? Their names are often heard. What do they do? What is their dharma? You kindly enlighten me about them.

## \|\| 3.95.2-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*vidyaṃte devatāḥ puṇyāḥ śrāvaṇyo nāma pāṃḍava \|*  
*brahmaṇā prathamaṃ sṛṣṭā niyogaśca jane kṛtaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*yo yadvadati lokesmiñchubhaṃ vāpyatha vā'śubham \|*  
*śrāvayaṃti hi tacchīghraṃ brāhmaṇyaḥ karmagocaram \|\| 3 \|\|*

*jātāstriloke pūjyāstu niyamena prajāpate \|*  
*dūrācchravaṇavijñānaṃ dūrāddarśanagocaram \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Sri Krsna said- The auspicious Sravani gods were created by Brahma at the start of the universe as the watchers of the activities of the human beings. Therefore, whatever good or bad is done by a person on earth, the same is atonce reported by them to Brahma. Therefore, they are adorable by the three worlds. They are bestowed with science of hearing and science of audience from a distance.

## \|\| 3.95.5-7 \|\|

*tāsāmastīha sā śaktiracintyā tarkahetubhiḥ \|*  
*naraistuṣṭaiśca yatproktaṃ kāryākāryasya kāraṇāt \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tacchṛṇvaṃti yataḥ pārtha naikā śrāvaṇikā matāḥ \|*  
*yathā devā yathā daityā yathā vidyādharā narāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*yathā hi siddhagaṃdharvā nāgāḥ kiṃpuruṣāḥ khagāḥ \|*  
*rākṣasāśca piśācāśca devānāmaṣṭayonayaḥ \|*  
*tathaitāḥ puṇyanāmāno vaṃdyāḥ śrāvaṇikāḥ smṛtāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. There scope for reasoning is not supposable. O Partha, according to their own sense of performance and duty, they listen and observe all the dirty things of the humans. As the Devas, Daityas, Vidyadharas, Siddhas, Gandharvas, Serpents, Kinnaras, Nagas, Raksasas and Pisacas, besides the eight types of gods have been defined, similarly, the auspicious and adorable Sravanikas are also there.

## \|\| 3.95.8-9 \|\|

*tā samuddiśya kartavyastaṃ nārīnarairiha \|*  
*kiṃ tu tāsāṃ mahograṃ tu vrataṃ saṃyamanaṃ tadā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*āghrāya dhūpaṃ pakvānnaṃ jalaṃ cāgandha meva ca \|*  
*dātavyā punaranyāsāṃ nārīṇāṃ bhojyapāraṇā \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. For their sake too, the men and women of the earth should perform the vratas, but their excellent vrata should be performed observing the total discipline, offering incense, water and fragrance. These articles should also be given to the ladies while breaking the fast.

## \|\| 3.95.10-11 \|\|

*adattvā yadi mṛtyuḥ syādaṃtarālepi pāṃḍava \|*  
*tadā lagnagrahairgrastā lagnā hyuparikāraṭam \|*  
*saphenilairmukhai raudrairbhriyaṃte nīcaduḥkhitāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*śrūyaṃte hi purā pārtha pṛthivyāṃ nahuṣo nṛpaḥ \|*  
*tasya bhāryā mahādevī jayaśrīrnāma bhārata \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. O Pandava, in case a person, while giving away the aforesaid items dies and when the person who dies, the foam emerges out of his mouth, then the person meets with a painful death O Partha, in earlier times, the lord of the earth was the king known as Nahusa. Jayasri was the name of his chief queen, O Bharata.

## \|\| 3.95.12-13 \|\|

*pratyakṣarūpasaṃpannā darśanīyatarā śubhā \|*  
*pīvarorustanā śyāmā mṛdukuñcitamūrddhajā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*śabdagadgadasaṃbhāṣā mattamātaṃgagāminī \|*  
*yathārūpā tathā śīlā satī ceṣṭā mahītale \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Because of her beauty and charm, she was worth seeing, besides being the form of welfare. Her breasts, vagina was solid, she had a tender and soft body, had the dark complexion, the hair of the head were very soft. Her speech was quite pleasant and impressive, besides being attractive in conversation. She walked like the intoxicated elephant. She possessed the beauty and humility on earth, besides being extremely chaste.

## \|\| 3.95.14 \|\|

*sā kadācidgatā snātuṃ gaṃgāyāṃ cāśrame muneḥ \|*  
*vaśiṣṭhasya dadarśātha satīṃ bhāryāmaruṃdhatīm \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Once while going for a bath in the Ganga, she also visited the hermitage of the sage Vasistha and had an audience with his chaste wife known as Arundhati.

## \|\| 3.95.15-16 \|\|

*bhojayaṃtī munīnāṃ tu patnīrnānānnabhojanaiḥ \|*  
*tayā ca praṇipatyātha pṛṣṭā devyā mahāsatī \|\| 15 \|\|*

*pūjyaṃ bhagavati brūhi kimetadvratamucyate \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. At that point of time, Arundhati - the wife of the sage Vasistha, was serving food to the other wives of the sages of the hermitage. A the same time, the extremely chaste Jayasri very humbly placed a question before Arundhati- “O virtuous one, what type of the auspicious vrata is today, which you are so performing with great satisfaction? You kindly tell me.”

## \|\| 3.95.17-18 \|\|

*arundhatyuvāca \|*  
*jayaśriye śṛṇuṣva tvaṃ nāmnā śrāvaṇikāvratam \|*  
*etadbhartrā samākhyātaṃ vaśiṣṭhena maharṣiṇā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*gūḍhaṃ bahmarṣisarvasvaṃ supativratakaṃ śubham \|*  
*gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā rājñi tavātidhyaṃ karomyaham \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Arundhati said- “O Jayasri, I am going to speak to you about the chastity of the Sravanika vrata. You listen to me attentively. Its glory had been revealed to me by Maharsi Vasistha - my husband. This is quite secretive, everything for Brahmacarya and is the extremely auspicious vrata to be performed by the ladies for the sake of their husbands. O queen, in case you want to go, then you can go, otherwise you can stay and and accept my hospitality.”

## \|\| 3.95.19-23 \|\|
