*evamuktā jayaśrīstu bhojye tasminyadṛcchayā \|*  
*bubhuje sāpi tatraiva aruṃdhatyā kṛtā darā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*bhuktvācamya jagāmātha svapuraṃ parameśvaram \|*  
*kālena vismṛtaṃ tasyāstadvrataṃ tasya bhojanam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tatastu samaye pūrṇe mriyamāṇā mahāsatī \|*  
*jayaśrīrghargharaṃ gaṃtuṃ kurvāṇā kaṃṭhagadgadam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*phenaṃ lālāvilādvaktrādudgiraṃtī muhurmuhuḥ \|*  
*sthitā paṃcadaśāhāni bībhatsā dāruṇānanā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tataḥ ṣoḍaśake prāpte dine svayamaruṃdhatī \|*  
*praviśyābhyaṃtaraṃ pūrṇaṃ tāṃ rājñīmavalokya ca \|*  
*nahuṣāya samācakhyau yaduktaṃ śrāvaṇī vrate \|\| 23 \|\|*

19-23. At these words of Arundhati, Jayasri delightfully participated and accepted the hospitality of Arundhati. After finishing the food, she returned to the excellent place of Ayodhya. By so doing, the highly chaste Jayasri, at the time of her death, staying at the bank of the river, scented her throat. But her mouth was repeatedly issuing the foam. After staying there for a fortnight, her face became awful and ugly. Hearing about her painful situation, Arundhati herself arrived there. She observed the condition of the queen and apprised the king about her ailment and also narrated the importance of Sravanika vrata.

## \|\| 3.95.24-26 \|\|

*tacchutvā nahuṣo rājā drutaṃ bhojyaṃ pracakrame \|*  
*yathoktaṃ tadaruṃdhatyā yacca yāvadabhīpsitam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*datvā ca karakānaṣṭau tāmuddiśya jayaśriyam \|*  
*kṣaṇājjagāma pañcatvaṃ karakāṇāṃ pradānataḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*jagāma śakralokaṃ sā vimānenārkavarcasā \|*  
*dodhūyamānā camaraiḥ stūyamānā surā suraiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. Learning about the cause of queen’s ailment, as per the advice of Arundhati, Nahusa started giving in charity the desired things and eatables. For the sake of the queen Jayasri, he also gave away eighteen pottery vases in charity. Soon after the giving away of the pottery vases, the queen Jayasri met with her end. She boarded a plane sent by Indra for her in which the flywhisks were moved over her and she reached the place of Indra.0

## \|\| 3.95.27-30 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu dvādaśasvapi pāṃḍava \|*  
*dravyaprāptiśca bhaktiśca dānakāle praśasyate \|\| 27 \|\|*

*bhuktvā yajñe caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ vā yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*vratī snātvā tu pūrvāhṇe nadyādau vimale jale \|\| 28 \|\|*

*āmaṃtrayeddaśaikaikā nārīrgaurīsvarūpiṇīḥ \|*  
*yatācārāḥ suveṣāśca brāhmaṇīrvā svagotrajāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*dvādaśa brāhmaṇāṃstatra vedavedāṃgapāragān \|*  
*maṃtrajñānitihāsajñānupaśāṃtāñjitendriyān \|\| 30 \|\|*

27-30. Sri Krsna said- O Pandava, during Margasirsa or other months, at the time of the giving away of the charities, the receiving of riches and devotion are both said to be praiseworthy. On the days of caturdasi and astami, the performer of the vrata should take food in the yajna and should take bath in the spotless water of a river or a tank and invite ten women for taking food. All of them should be good natured and should look like the goddess Gauri. They should be of the same gotra as well. Thereafter, twelve Brahmanas, who should be well-versed in the Vedas and other religious literatures, should be invited.

## \|\| 3.95.31-35 \|\|

*sarvaṃ dadyādvidhānena pādakṣālanapūrvakam \|*  
*caṃdanena sugandhena puṣpadhūpādinā tathā \|\| 31 \|\|*

*grīvāsūtrakasiṃdūrakuṃkumena ca bhūṣayet \|*  
*tāsāmagre pradātavyā varddhanyo dvādaśaiva tu \|\| 32 \|\|*

*acchidrā jalapūrṇāstu suvṛttāḥ sūtraveṣṭitāḥ \|*  
*sohālakādibhiścchannāḥ puṣpamālāvibhūṣitāḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*caṃdanena samālabdhāḥ sahiraṇyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*tanmadhye varddhanīṃ caikāṃ svake śīrṣe niveśayet \|\| 34 \|\|*

*sthitvā maṇḍalake madhye yajamānaḥ svayaṃ tadā \|*  
*yadbālye yacca kaumāre vārddhake vāpi yatkṛtam \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyātu pitṛdevarṣiṇāṃ nṛṇām \|\| 35 \|\|*

31-35. Initially, their feet should be washed. Then, with the offering of the sandal paste, scent, incense, all of them should be worshipped. The ladies should then be given the kantha-sutra and vermilion. Thereafter, the twelve vases should be laced before them, which should be filled with water, with no holes in them. These pots should be round and cotton cord should be placed around their necks. They should be further decorated with garlands and each one of them should be pasted with the sandal paste. All of them should be established separately. After worshipping them, the performer of the vrata should be lodged in the centre of the mandala and touching the small pitcher with his head, should say- “Whatever sins have been committed by me during my childhood, youthful age or the old age, should get destroyed with the oblation offered to the Devas, Pitrs and Humans. All these pitchers at the time of my death should redeem me from the ocean of the universe. I intend to achieve the excellent place of Visnu.

## \|\| 3.95.36-39 \|\|

*imā me samayaṃ svarṇaṃ tārayasva bhavārṇavāt \|*  
*adyāhaṃ gantumicchāmi viṣṇoḥ padamanuttamam \|*  
*evamastviti tā brūyuḥ striyaḥ sarvā yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 36 \|\|*

*tato brāhmaṇamāhūya yajamāna idaṃ vadet \|*  
*brūhi brāhmaṇa yanme tvamaghaṃ yena kṣayaṃ vrajet \|\| 37 \|\|*

*uttīrya śrāvaṇaṃ māsaṃ samuttāraya sāṃpratam \|*  
*uttārayeta maṃtreṇa brāhmaṇo vardhanī ca tām \|\| 38 \|\|*

*upoṣya śiraso devyāḥ samuttīrya ruhadrumān \|*  
*kaṭukaṃ niṃbavṛkṣaṃ vā tato madhukamāruha \|*  
*tato gaccha mahādevaṃ śravaṇe śravaṇottame \|\| 39 \|\|*

36-39. O Yudhisthira, at that point of time, all the ladies should say- “Be it so.” Thereafter, the performer should address the Brahmanas and should say- “O Brahmanas, the means by which I could get my sins destroyed, you please tell me the way out and also remove the pot from my head.” At that point of time, the Brahmanas should remove the pot from the head of the performer, reciting the mantras and while doing so, they should say- “While fasting, getting removed from the head of the goddess, you dwell over the Nima trees or the Madhuka trees. Thereafter, you shall achieve Sravanottama-Mahadeva.”

## \|\| 3.95.40-41 \|\|

*iti vardhanikottāraṇamantraḥ \|*  
*evaṃ tāḥ samayaṃ procya dattvāśīrvacanāni ca \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tāṃ varddhanikāmekānte viprāya pratipādayet \|*  
*gṛhītvā karakānnāryyo vrajeyuḥ sveṣu veśmasu \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. Thus speaking, as affirm resolve, the Brahmanas should give their blessings to hint Then the pitcher should be given away to a Brahmana in seclusion. The ladies then receiving the pottery vases, should return to their respective homes.

## \|\| 3.95.42-44 \|\|

*yajamāno'pi yātāsu yatheṣṭaṃ kāmamācaret \|*  
*evamācarate pārtha śrāvaṇīvrata mādarāt \|\| 42 \|\|*

*tasya kāle tu saṃprāpte sukhaṃ mṛtyuḥ prajāyate \|*  
*nirvyādhirnīrujo bhogī sthitvāsthitvā śataṃ sukham \|\| 43 \|\|*

*putrapautrasamṛddhyādau bhuktvā martyasukhāni ca \|*  
*rudralokamavāpnoti somalokaṃ sa gacchati \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. After the departure of the ladies, the performer should start his normal work. In case this Sravani-vrata is performed in an appropriate manner, a person has a comfortable death. He leads comfortable life without any ailments with his sons and grandsons, and after his death he achieves Rudraloka as well as Candraloka.

## \|\| 3.95.45-46 \|\|

*strīṇāṃ tulyaṃ sa hīno'pi vratī vrataphalaṃ vrajet \|*  
*gaurībhojyeṣu datteṣu ekādaśasu yatphalam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*tadekenāpi labhate pārtha śrāvaṇikāvrate \|*  
*bhaktyā gacchaṃti te lokānvihṛtya sukhamādarāt \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. Even when the performer of the vrata has no living wife, he earns the merit as if his wife was alive. О Partha, in the feast of Gauri during the performance of Sravani-vrata, instead of the eleven fruits, in case a person offers only a flower with devotion, he also finally attains moksa.

## Chapter 96. Dialogue between Sri Krsna and Yudhisthira

## \|\| 3.96.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*atha naktopavāsasya vidhānaṃ śṛṇu pāṃḍava \|*  
*yena vijñātamātreṇa naro mokṣamavāpnuyāt \|\| 1 \|\|*

*yeṣu teṣu ca māseṣu śuklapakṣe caturdaśīm \|*  
*brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayitvā tu prārabheta tato vratam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*māsimāsi bhavaṃti dvāvaṣṭamyau ca caturdaśī \|*  
*śivārcanarato bhūtvā śivadhyānaikamānasaḥ \|*  
*vasudhābhājanaṃ kṛtvā bhuñjīyānnaktabhojanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Sri Krsna said- I am going to tell you the best method of observing a fast, with the mere knowledge of which, the people achieve moksa or salvation. You please listen to me attentively. On the bright fourteenth moon day of a month, one should serve food to the Brahmana, before the start of the vrata. On both the days of astami (eighth moon day) as well as caturdasi (fourteenth moon day) of the months, lord Siva should be adored with a concentrated mind, and concentrate his mind on him. Thereafter, serving food to the Brahmanas and others, he should take food himself at night.

## \|\| 3.96.4-5 \|\|

*upavāsātparaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ bhaikṣyātparamayācitam \|*  
*ayācitātparaṃ naktaṃ tasmānnaktena bhojayet \|\| 4 \|\|*

*devaiśca bhuktaṃ pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne munibhistathā \|*  
*aparāhṇe ca pitṛbhiḥ sandhyāyāṃ guhyakādibhiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. During fasting, eating the food received by begging is considered to be the best at night. The Devos take their food in forenoon, the Rsis do so at noon, the Pitrs in the afternoon, while the Guhyakas consume food in the evening.

## \|\| 3.96.6-7 \|\|

*sarvalokānatikramya naktabhojī sadā bhavet \|*  
*haviṣya bhojanaṃ snānaṃ satyamāhāralāghavam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*agnikāryo hyadhaḥśayyo naktabhojī sadā bhavet \|*  
*evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte vratapūrṇasya sarpiṣā \|*  
*pūrṇakumbhoparisthāpya pūjayecca suśobhane \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Therefore, without overlapping, the people should take food at night. One should take bath daily, consume the leftover of the havisya as the light food. Those who sleep on floor at night, should take their food at night. With the completion of the vrata with ghi, after the end of the year, a beautiful pitcher filled with water should be consecrated.

## \|\| 3.96.8-10 \|\|

*kapilāpañcagavyena sthāpayenmṛnmayaṃ śivam \|*  
*phalaṃ puṣpaṃ yavakṣīraṃ dadhi dūrvāṃkurāṃstathā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tatkumbhānāṃ jalonmiśramarghamaṣṭāṃgamucyate \|*  
*śirasā dhārayitvā tu jānū kṛtvā mahītale \|\| 9 \|\|*

*mahādevāya dātavyaṃ gandhapuṣpaṃ yathākramam \|*  
*bhakṣyodenairbaliṃ kṛtvā praṇamya parameśvarīm \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. At that point of time, lord Siva’s image should be consecrated using pancagavya of the kapila cow. Thereafter, the arghya should be offered with fruits, flowers, barley, milk, curd and the pitcher filled with water. At the time of offering the arghya, the pitcher should be touched with the head, while kneeling over the earth. Thereafter, the kalasa of arghya should be offered to lord Siva. Then, the boiled rice should be offered to Paramesvari.

## \|\| 3.96.11-13 \|\|

*dhenuṃ vā dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādvṛṣaṃ vāpi dhuraṃdharam \|*  
*śrotriyāya daridrāya kalpavratavidāya ca \|*  
*yo dadāti śive bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 11 \|\|*

*vimānamarkapratimaṃ haṃsayuktamalaṃkṛtam \|*  
*ārūḍho'psarasāṃ gītairyāti rudrālaye sukham \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sthitvā rudrasya bhavane varṣakoṭiśatatrayam \|*  
*iha loke nṛpaśreṣṭha grāmalakṣeśvaro bhavet \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. The Srotriya of the vrata should be offered a cow, a bull and daksina. By offering the aforesaid things to lord Siva, the merit one earns, is going to be stated by me. You please listen. He (after death) is made to board a plane having the lustre of the Sun, which is driven by the swans and is decorated fully. While getting served by the Apsaras, he reaches the Rudraloka, where he enjoys all the comforts for three hundred crores of years. He is reborn on earth to become a king of a lakh of villages.

## \|\| 3.96.14 \|\|

*yaścāṣṭamīṣu ca śivāsu caturdaśīṣu naktaṃ samācarati śāstravidhāna dṛṣṭam \|*  
*svargāṃganākalaravākulitaṃ vimānamāruhya yāti sa sukhena sureśalokam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Therefore, on the days of astami and caturdasi, one who performs the vrata at night, he gets seated over the plane in which he is honoured by the Apsaras and achieves the place of Indra with comfort.

## Chapter 97. Siva Caturdasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.97.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājanvakṣye māheśvaraṃ vratam \|*  
*triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ nāmnā śivacaturdaśī \|\| 1 \|\|*

*mārgaśīrṣatrayodaśyāṃ sitāyāmekabhuṅnaraḥ \|*  
*māseṣvanyeṣu vā rājanpārtha evaṃ na kārayet \|\| 2 \|\|*

*caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ samabhyarcya maheśvaram \|*  
*sauvarṇaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ dattvā bhakṣyāmi ca pare'hani \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Sri Krsna said- O king, I am going to speak to you about a vrata, which is known in the three worlds as Siva Caturdasi vrata. You listen about it with attention. On the bright trayodasi of the month of Margasirsa, one should observe Ekavrata, the performance of which has been prohibited in any other month of the year. On the day of caturdasi, while fasting, Siva should be worshipped. On the next day, the gold image of a bull should be given in charity.

## \|\| 3.97.4-6 \|\|

*evaṃ niyamakṛtsuptvā prātarutthāya mānavaḥ \|*  
*kṛtasnānajapaḥ paścādumayā saha śaṃkaram \|*  
*pūjayetkusumaiḥ śuklairgaṃdhadhūpānulepanaiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*pādau namaḥ śivāyeti śiraḥ sarvātmane namaḥ \|*  
*lalāṭaṃ tu trinetrāya netrāṇi haraye namaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*mukhamindumukhāyeti tatheśānāya codaram \|*  
*pārśve cānaṃtadharmāya jñānarūpāya vai kaṭim \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. Thus observing the procedure, the devotee should get up in the early morning and take his bath and then worship Uma and Mahesvara, offering the white flowers, fragrance, incense, sandal paste etc. Then he should start prayer, saying- “Salutation to Siva, and the feet of the image should be touched; salutation to the soul of the universe, the head should be touched. Saying salutation to Trinetra eyes should be touched; uttering salutation to Hair, the forehead should be touched. Saying salutation to the Moon-faced one, the mouth should be touched. Saying salutation to the Tsana, the belly should be touched; saying salutation to Anantadharma, both the back sides should be touched. Saying salutation to the form of the divine knowledge, the waist should be touched.

## \|\| 3.97.7-8 \|\|

*ūrū cānantyavairāgyaṃ jānunī cārcayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*pradhānāya namo jaṃghe gulphau vyomātmane namaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*vyomavyomātmarūpāya pṛṣṭhamabhyarcayennaraḥ \|*  
*namaḥ sṛṣṭyai namastuṣṭyai pārvatīṃ cāpi pūjayet \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Saying salutation to Ananta-vairagya, the thighs should be touched. Saying salutation to Pradhana, the knees should be touched. Saying salutation to Vyomatma and Vyoma, the ankles should be touched and the back should be adored. Then saying salutation to the universe and Tu?ti, the goddess Parvati should be adored.

## \|\| 3.97.9 \|\|

*tataśca vṛṣabhaṃ haimamudakumbhasamanvitam \|*  
*śuklamālyāṃbarayutaṃ pañcaratnavibhūṣitam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Thereafter, a gold image of bull and a kalasa plastered with the sandal paste and decorated with five gems, besides several items of food should be given over to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.97.10-13 \|\|

*bhakṣyairnānāvidhairyuktaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|*  
*prīyatāṃ devadevo'tra sadyojātaḥ pinākadhṛk \|\| 10 \|\|*

*pṛṣadājyaṃ ca saṃprāśya svapyādbhūmāvudaṅmukhaḥ \|*  
*pañcadaśyāṃ tataḥ prātaḥ sarvametatsamācaret \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tarpayitvā tatonnena brāhmaṇāñchaktitaḥ śubhān \|*  
*suhṛtpadātisahitaḥ paścādbhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tataḥ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāmetatsarvaṃ samācaret \|*  
*caturdaśīṣu sarvāsu kuryātpūrvavadarcanam \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. Then saying- “With this performance, let lord Siva - the holder of Pinaka and god of gods, be pleased with me,” and give away the above objects as donations. Then breaking the fast with ghi, the performer should sleep on floor facing north. Thereafter, on the full moon day, completing all the formalities in the morning as stated above, the auspicious Brahmanas should be served with food, as per one’s means, pleasing them at the same time. Thereafter, together with the servants and the relatives, the devotee keeping silent, should take his food. On the day of dark caturdasi, following the same procedure, the adoration should be performed.

## \|\| 3.97.14-17 \|\|

*ye ca māse viśeṣāḥ syustānnibodha kramādiha \|*  
*mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu svapannetānudīrayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*śaṃkarāya namastubhyaṃ namaste karavīraka \|*  
*tryaṃbakāya namastubhyaṃ maheśvaramataḥ param \|\| 15 \|\|*

*namaste'stu mahādeva sthāṇave ca tataḥ param \|*  
*namaḥ paśupate nātha namaste śaṃbhave namaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*namaste paramānaṃda namaḥ somārddhadhāriṇe \|*  
*namo bhīmāya cogrāya tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

14-17. Whatever has to be done during the month, the same is going to be spoken by me. You please listen. During the month of Margasirsa, one should speak like that, while going to sleep. He should say- “Salutation to Trayambaka, salutation to Mahesvara, salutation to Mahadeva, salutation to Sthanu, salutation to Pasupati, salutation to Sambhu, salutation to the all blissful one, salutation to Ardhanarisvara, salutation to Bhimadeva. O Ugradeva, I have arrived here to take refuge with you.

## \|\| 3.97.18-27 \|\|

*gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhisarpiḥ kuśodakam \|*  
*paṃcagavyaṃ tathā bilvaṃ yavāgūkṣīravārijam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tilāṃśca kṛṣṇānvidhivatprāśnīyātsamudāhṛtān \|*  
*pratimāsaṃ caturdaśyāmekaikaṃ prāśanaṃ smṛtam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*maṃdārairmālatībhiśca tathā dhattūkairapi \|*  
*siṃduvārairaśokaiśca mallikākubjapāṭalaiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*arkapuṣpaiḥ kadaṃbaiśca śatapatraistathotpalaiḥ \|*  
*karavīraiśca rājendra tathā pūjyo maheśvaraḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ekaikena caturdaśyāmarcayetpārvatīpatim \|*  
*punaśca kārttike māsi saṃprāpte tarpayeddvijān \|\| 22 \|\|*

*annairnānāvidhairbhakṣyairvastrairmālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā nīlaṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ śrutyuktavidhinā naraḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ ca gavā saha \|*  
*muktāphalāṣṭakayutaṃ sitanetrapaṭāvṛtam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sarvopaskarayuktāyāṃ śayyāyāṃ vinivedayet \|*  
*udakuṃbhayutaṃ tadvacchālitaṃdulasaṃyutam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sthāpya viprāya śāṃtāya vedavrataparāya ca \|*  
*jyeṣṭhasāmavide deyaṃ na ca kurvaṃti te kvacit \|\| 26 \|\|*

*avyaṃgāya ca saumyāya sadākalyāṇakāriṇe \|*  
*sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*na vittaśāṭhyaṃ kurvīta kurvaṃllobhātpatatyadhaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

18-27.It has been prescribed that the fast should be broken with the consuming of cow’s urine,cowdung, milk, curd, ghi, kusa water, pancagavya, paste of wood apple, milk, lotus stalk and black sesamum seeds, during each one of the months of the year respectively. The lord of Parvati should be offered the flowers of swallow wart jasmine, thorn apple tree, Sinduvara, Asoka, jasmine, lotus or a medicinal plant, trumpet flower, Neulea orientalis, lotus and oleander, while offering the prayer. At the conclusion of the vrata during the month of Kartika, the Brahmana should be pleased with the offering of several types of cereals, eatables, costumes, garlands,, besides the ornaments. Then according to the Vedic practices, the image of Uma-Mahesvara besides the cow with the bull with eight beads serving as the eyes, with the bell adorning their necks and covered with cloth, in addition to a decorated bed with all the requisites should be given over to the Brahmana. In addition to these, a kalasa filled with Sali rice should be placed over a lotus, and should be given over to a peaceful Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas, with respect. This Brahmana should be a singer of Samaveda besides the one who bestow welfare on all and should have his wife alive. They should be given the costumes and adorned with the ornaments. The couple should be given the aforesaid things respectively. At that point of time, the performer of the vrata should not be miserly in spending, because by so doing one has to fall.

## \|\| 3.97.28-29 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yastu kuryācchivacaturdaśīm \|*  
*so'śvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ yadatrāmutra vā kṛtam \|*  
*pitṛbhirmātṛbhirvāpi tatsarvaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Thus following this method, the vrata of Siva Caturdasi should be concluded. A person who does so, achieves the merit of performing a thousand Asvamdha sacrifices. Even the grave sins committed by his parents are washed out.

## \|\| 3.97.30-31 \|\|

*dīrghāyurārogyakulābhivṛddhiratrākṣayānyatra caturbhujatvam \|*  
*gaṇādhipatyaṃ divi kalpakoṭī svarge uṣitvā padameti śaṃbhoḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*na bṛhaspatirapyatmannarasya phalamiṃdro na pitāmaho'pi vaktum \|*  
*na ca siddhaguṇora'pyalaṃ na vāhaṃ yadi jihvāyutakoṭyapīha vaktre \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. By performing this vrata, one earns long life, good health, noble and everlasting race, expansion of the family. He enjoys all the pleasures on earth for crores of years. After his death, he achieves a position in the heaven, which could not be specified by the Siddhas, Brhaspati and Brahma with even ten thousand tongues.

## \|\| 3.97.32 \|\|

*bhavatyamaravallabhaḥ paṭhati yaḥ smaredvā sadā śṛṇotyapi vimatsaraḥ sakalapāpanirmocanīm \|*  
*imāṃ śivacaturdaśīmamarakāminīkoṭayaḥ stuvaṃti divi naṃditā kimu samācaredyaḥ sadā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Shedding away all the jealousy by reciting or remembering this vrata, one is relieved of all the sins. The Apsaras always serve him. The one who performs this Siva Caturdasi vrata, what more could be said about him?

## \|\| 3.97.33 \|\|

*yā pārtha nārī kurute'tibhaktyā bharttāramāpṛcchya śubhaṃ guruṃ vā \|*  
*sāpi prasādātparameśvarasya paraṃ padaṃ yāti pinākapāṇeḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. О Partha, getting permission from the preceptor, the husband or the other religious minded people, a lady when performs this vrata, then she can also achieve the place of lord Siva - the carrier of Pinaka bow.

## Chapter 98. Phalatyaga Caturdasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.98.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*tathā sarvaphalatyāgamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu bhārata \|*  
*yadakṣayaṃ pare loke sarvakāmaphalapradam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi caturdaśyāṃ dhṛtavrataḥ \|*  
*āraṃbhe śuklapakṣasya kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*anyeṣvapi tu māseṣu aṣṭamyāṃ narasattama \|*  
*sadakṣiṇāpāyasena śaktitaḥ pūjayeddvijān \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Sri Krsna said- О Bharata, I shall speak out to you the importance of renouncing of the merit of (a noble deed done), fulfilling all the desires, making them imperishable in the other world. You please listen to the same, attentively. On the bright caturdasi of the month of Margasirsa, observing all the conditions of the vrata, the related story should be heard from a Brahmana. О best of the humans, on the day of astami falling in other months, the payasam food should be served to the Brahmanas, after adoring them.

## \|\| 3.98.4 \|\|

*aṣṭādaśānāṃ dhānyānāmanyatra phalamūlakam \|*  
*varjayedabdamekaṃ tu vidhinauṣadhakārakam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. By following the conditions of this vrata for a year, eighteen types of cereals, besides the fruits and roots should not be consumed. But some of them could be taken as the medicine.

## \|\| 3.98.5-12 \|\|

*tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca \|*  
*aśaktaśca vrataṃ kartuṃ sahasaiva pramucyate \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sauvarṇaṃ kārayedrudraṃ dharmarājaṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*kūṣmāṇḍaṃ mātuluṃgaṃ ca vṛṃtākaṃ panasaṃ tathā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*āmrāmrātakapitthaṃ ca kaliṃgaṃ servavārukam \|*  
*śrīphalaṃ savaṭāśvatthaṃ jaṃbīraṃ kadalīphalam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*badaraṃ dāḍimaṃ śaktyā kāryāṇyetāni ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*mūlakāmalakaṃ jaṃbūpuṣkaraṃ karamardakam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*uduṃbaraṃ nālikeraṃ drākṣā ca bṛhatīdvayam \|*  
*kaṃkālī kākatuṃḍīraṃ karīrakuṭajaṃ śamī \|\| 9 \|\|*

*raupyāṇi kārayecchaktyā phalānīmāni ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*tāmraṃ tālaphalaṃ kuryādagastyaphalameva vā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*piṃḍīrakaṃ ca kharjūraṃ tathā sūraṇa kaṃdakam \|*  
*panasaṃ lakucaṃ caiva karkaṭaṃ tiṃtiḍiṃ tathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*citrāvallīphalaṃ tadvatkūṭaśālmalikāphalam \|*  
*madhūkaṃ kāravellaṃ ca vallīṃ gudapaṭola kam \|\| 12 \|\|*

5-12. At the end of the year, on the days of caturdasi and astami when a person is unable to observe the fast, he should make the gold images of Rudra, Yama, Kusmanda, myrobalan, lemon, Vrmtaka, jack fruit, mango, pomegranate, Feronea elephantum, Echites untedysenterica (Kutaja), Varuka, wood apple, banyan, pipala, lemon, banana, jujube and pomegranate fruits. Similarly, radish, myrobalan, silk cotton fruit, lotus, Karmardaka, fig tree, coconut, Kakatundi, grapes, Karira-kutaja, Kankali etc., all the sixteen fruits should be made of silver. The palm fruit, Pindiraka, date palm, Surana-kanda, Jack fruit, Arto carpus lauche, cucumber, tamarind, Citravalli, Kuta, Salphala, Bassia latifolia, Karvela, creeper and gudapatola are the fruits which should be made of copper.

## \|\| 3.98.13-14 \|\|

*kārayecchaktito dhīmānphalānyetāni ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*udakuṃbhadvayaṃ kuryādānyopari savāsasam \|*  
*pakṣapātradvayopetaṃ yamarudrasamanvitam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*dhenvā sahaiva śāṃtāya viprāyātha kuṭuṃbine \|*  
*sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya puṇyehani nivedayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. The cereals should be covered with the cloth and two water pitchers should be consecrated with images of Rudra and Yama. After the worship is over, a Brahmana, who has a family, shall be handed over these things for earning the merit. Thereafter, one should beg forgiveness from them.

## \|\| 3.98.15 \|\|

*yathā phaleṣu sarveṣu vasaṃtyamarakoṭayaḥ \|*  
*tathā sarvaphalatyāgācchive bhaktiḥ sadāstu me \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. As the crores of gods live in the fruits, therefore, by discarding all the fruits, similarly, I should always remain devoted to Siva.

## \|\| 3.98.16 \|\|

*yathā śivaśca dharmaśca sadānantaphalapradau \|*  
*tadyuktaphaladānena tau syātāṃ me varapradau \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. It is believed that Siva and Dharmaraja bestow enormous merits. Similarly, with the giving away of the above fruits, lord Siva should always bestow boons to me.

## \|\| 3.98.17 \|\|

*yathā phalānāṃ kāmasya śivabhaktasya sarvadā \|*  
*yathānaṃtaphalāvāptirastu janmanijanmani \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. As the devotee of Siva always gets the desired rewards, similarly, I too, should get innumerable merits in all my births.

## \|\| 3.98.18 \|\|

*yathā bhedaṃ na paśyāmi śivaviṣṇvarkapadmajām \|*  
*tathā mamāstu viśvātmā śaṅkaraḥ śaṃkaraḥ sadā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. I should never have any doubt in Laksmi and for this purpose, lord Siva, who is the soul of the universe, should always bestow welfare on me.

## \|\| 3.98.19 \|\|

*ityuccārya ca tatsarvamalaṃkṛtya vibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*śaktaścecchayanaṃ dadyātsarvopaskarasaṃyutam \|*  
*aśaktastu phalānyeva yathoktāni vidhānataḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Thus speaking, the images adorned with ornaments should be given away in charity. When a person is worthy enough, he should give away the well arranged bed as well. In case a person is unable to do so, the aforesaid fruits should be given away by him in an appropriate manner.

## \|\| 3.98.20 \|\|

*tathodakuṃbhasahitau śivadharmau ca kāṃcanau \|*  
*viprāya dattvā bhuñjīta tailakṣāravivarjitam \|*  
*anyānapi yathā śaktyā bhojayeddvijapuṅgavān \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. After giving away in charity the images of Siva as well as Dharmaraja, one should take food which is devoid of oil and salt. As per one’s means, the other Brahmanas should be satisfied by serving the food.

## \|\| 3.98.21-26 \|\|

*na śaknoti vihātuṃ cetsarvāṇyapi phalānyuta \|*  
*ekameva parityajya taditthaṃ pratipādayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

*etattyāgavratānāṃ tu gave vaiṣṇavayoginām \|*  
*śastaṃ sarvaphalatyāgaṃ vrataṃ vedavido viduḥ \|*  
*nārībhiśca yathāśaktyā kartavyaṃ rājasattama \|\| 22 \|\|*

*naitasmādaparaṃ kiñcidiha loke paratra ca \|*  
*vratamasti muniśreṣṭha yadannaṃ tatphalapradam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*sauvarṇaraupyatāmreṣu yāvaṃtaḥ paramāṇavaḥ \|*  
*bhavaṃti cūryamāṇeṣu phaleṣu nṛpasattama \|*  
*tāvadyugasahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyate \|\| 24 \|\|*

*etatsamastakaluṣāpaharaṃ janānāmājīvanāya manujeśvara sarvadā syāt \|*  
*janmāntareṣvapi na putrakalatraduḥkhamāpnoti dhāma sa puraṃdarajuṣṭameva \|\| 25 \|\|*

*yo vā śṛṇoti puruṣolpadhano naro vā yo brāhmaṇastu bhavaneṣu ca dhārmikāṇām \|*  
*pāpairvimuktaśca paratra puraṃ murārerānaṃdakṛtparamupaiti narendra sopi \|\| 26 \|\|*

21-26. In case he is unable to discard all the fruits, he should give away a cow. The learned people say that the giving away of a cow can be equated with the discarding of the fruits. By giving away the fruits of gold, silver and copper in charity to a Brahmana couple according to his capacity, the donor is honoured in the Rudraloka for thousands of years. Thus with the performing of the vrata of Mahesvara, which is the remover of all the sins, the performer of the vrata leads a comfortable life. In due course of time, he docs not face any trouble from his family and sons, and finally achieves the place of Indra. The people who arc not so inclined towards dharma but who listen to this episode in a temple, the irreligious people, the Brahmanas and the one who listens to the same, getting relieved of all the sins, achieves the abode of Krsna also known as Murari.

## Chapter 99. Paurnamasi Vrata

## \|\| 3.99.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*paurṇamāsī mahārāja somasya dayitā tithiḥ \|*  
*pūrṇamāso bhavedyasyāṃ paurṇamāsī tataḥ smṛtā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*paurṇamāsyāṃ ca saṃjātaḥ saṃgrāmo jayalakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*somasyāribudhaiḥ sārddhaṃ sarvasattvabhayaṃkaram \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tārāyāṃ candramāḥ saktastasyā bhartā bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*tayorabhūnmahāyuddhaṃ bhāryākṛtyeṣu vai purā \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Sri Krsna said- O great king, the full moon day is quite favourite of the Moongod as well as auspicious, because the full moon day occurs at the completion of the month. On the same full moon day, the Moongod had a fight with the gods which was terrific for all the living beings. In earlier times, because of his getting attracted towards Tara (the wife of Brhaspati), there had been a great war between the Moongod and Brhaspati.

## \|\| 3.99.4 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*tārā kasya sutā kasmātsa kruddhaḥ sasurārihā \|*  
*somena saha saṃgrāmaṃ cakre cakragadādhara \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Yudhisthira said- О lord - carrier of the disc and the club, who was the father of Tara? Why Brhaspati, together with the gods, getting enraged with Moon, started a war with the Moongod?

## \|\| 3.99.5-8 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*prajāpaterabhūtkanyā tārā vṛtrasya cānujā \|*  
*tāṃ bṛhaspataye prādātpṛthivyāmekasuṃdarīm \|\| 5 \|\|*

*devācāryāya sā bhāryā tvanirdeśyā tathāvidhā \|*  
*rūpeṇābhyāṃ rūpavatī sā nirdhūya vyavasthitā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*bṛhaspatiṃ paryacaradyathā cānyāḥ striyaḥ kvacit \|*  
*tāṃ dadarśāyatāpāṃgīṃ tanvaṃgīṃ cāruhāsinīm \|\| 7 \|\|*

*śītāṃśurdarśanādeva kāmasya vaśamīyivān \|*  
*ābabhāṣe ca madhuraṃ tāre ehyehi mā ciram \|\| 8 \|\|*

5-8. Sri Krsna said- The daughter of Prajapati Brahma, who is the younger sister of Vrtrasura is known by the name of Tara. She was a beauty of the three worlds, and was given over to Brhaspati in marriage, in an appropriate way. Though Brhaspati was extremely attracted towards Tara because of her beauty and the charm she possessed, but she remained busy in the household work, like other ladies of the hermitage and served Brhaspati as well. With the mere looking at the broad eyed damsel who was an incarnation of beauty, the Moongod become passionate and fall for her beauty. With an indication, he called her and said to her- “Come on, О Tara, don’t delay.”

## \|\| 3.99.9-15 \|\|

*iṃgitākārakuśalā tārā somasya ceṣṭitam \|*  
*buddhvā śuddhimatho tanvī prāhedaṃ madhurākṣaram \|\| 9 \|\|*

*muneraṃgirasaḥ putrastvaṃ ca saumyo'si somarāṭ \|*  
*aṃgiraso munervīra snuṣāhamucitaṃ na te \|*  
*saha saumyena yo yogastava siddho' dbhuto mahān \|\| 10 \|\|*

*aṃgirāstvāṃ kila purā sasurāsurarākṣasaiḥ \|*  
*rājatve sthāpayāmāsa naitatsmarasi kiṃ vidho \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kathamadya niśānātha hyanaṃgenāsi pīḍitaḥ \|*  
*tasmādbravīmi siddhiṃ te rocaye ghaṭitaṃ kuru \|*  
*paravatyasmi bhadraṃ te na gamyāsmi budhottama \|\| 12 \|\|*

*evamuktastathā cāsau na caitatkṛtavāṃstataḥ \|*  
*gṛhītvākarṣayāmāsa somo'naṃgavaśīkṛtaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*bṛhaspatistu tāṃ jñātvā sa taṃ somamagarhayat \|*  
*preṣayiṣyati me bhāryāṃ svayameva mamāṃtikam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*evaṃ cireṇa vijñāya bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ \|*  
*nāsasāda svakāṃ bhāryāṃ roṣātprasphuritādharaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

9-15.Observing the desire of the Moon, Tara,who was well aware of the indications, with a pure mind, said to him in sweet words- “0 valorous one, you are the son of the sage Angira, you are the foremost of the beautiful person. I am also the daughter-in-law of the same sage Angira. Therefore, you should not make such type of approach towards me. You are great because of your nobility and have achieved success in yoga. Maharsi Angira has established the royal seat for the sake of the Gods, Raksasas and Asuras. Are you not aware of this even? О lord of the nights, why are you getting so passionate today? Therefore, I say that your desire would not be successful. Therefore, you do as you like, but, О best of the gods, I now belong to someone else. Therefore, it would not be proper for me to accompany you. At these words of Тай, because of his becoming lustful, he did not listen to her and forcibly dragged her to himself. Observing this, Brhaspati denounced the Moon very much. Thereafter, for many days, Brhaspati believed that the Moon would himself return his wife. But after waiting for a long time, his wife did not return. So, out of rage, his lips started fluttering.

## \|\| 3.99.16-18 \|\|

*ācakhyau sarvamindrāya somasyedaṃ viceṣṭitam \|*  
*iṃdraḥ samāhvayāmāsa devānṛṣigaṇāṃstathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*na somo gaṇayāmāsa tato'budhyata devarāṭ \|*  
*ākāryaṃ tridaśānsarvānācakhyau candraceṣṭitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tacchrutvā devagaṃdharvāḥ krodhāndhāḥ kṣubdhamānasāḥ \|*  
*pragṛhītapraharaṇā rathānāruruhuḥ svakān \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. Brhaspati then narrated the activities of the Moon to Indra, on hearing which Indra invited all the gods and the Rsis at his place. But it took no time for Indra to realize that the Moon had disobeyed his command. Indra then openly narrated the misdeed of the Moon before the gods, which enraged all the gods and Gandharvas. Feeling disgusted, mounted on their chariots filled with weapons, they marched on for waging the war.

## \|\| 3.99.19 \|\|

*somo'pi devānsodyogāñjñātvā sukṛtaniścayān \|*  
*daityadānavarakṣāṃsi samānīya vyavasthitaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The Moongod also clearly understood the intention of the gods and he invited all the Daityas, Danavas and Raksasas on his side and prepared himself for the waging of the war.

## \|\| 3.99.20-22 \|\|

*āruhya ca rathaśreṣṭhaṃ yuddhāyaiva mano dadhe \|*  
*pravṛttaṃ sumahadyuddhaṃ śaratomarakaṃpanaiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*kauṇapaiḥ kṣmāsuraiḥ śūlairdevadānavadāraṇam \|*  
*sa teṣāṃ sumahadyuddhaṃ dattvā tārāgaṇādhipaḥ \|*  
*babhaṃja devānsendrāṃśca hemavṛṣṭyā kṣapākaraḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*sa jitvā devagandharvānsomo rājanyasattama \|*  
*śriyā paramayā yukto yathā nānyo havirbhujām \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. Mounted over an excellent chariot, he reached the battle ground and started the war. Moon - the lord of the stars, making use of the weapons of Devas and Danavas, like arrows, tomaras and tridents, started the war and faced the Gods with courage. Then making use of his divine sight, he defeated all the Gods and the Gandharvas and after doing so, like the fire god the consumer of Havi, he became superior to all.

## \|\| 3.99.23-24 \|\|

*devāśca nirjitāstena somenāmitatejasā \|*  
*ājagmuḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ śaraṇyaṃ svargavāsinām \|\| 23 \|\|*

*indraḥ sarvaṃ samācakhyau somasyedṛgviceṣṭitam \|*  
*śrutvā kruddho hṛṣīkeśa āruhya garuḍaṃ ruṣā \|*  
*gṛhītvā cāyudhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yuddhāyaiva mano dadhe \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Having been injured by the lustre of the Moon, all the dwellers of the heaven then went to Visnu and they took refuge with him, apprising him at the same time about the audacity of the Moongod. Indra also spoke on the subject quite clearly, hearing which the lord Hrsikesa started mounting over his vehicle Garuda. Then for waging a terrific war, accompanied with the gods, he reached the battleground.

## \|\| 3.99.25-27 \|\|

*prakartuṃ sumahadyuddhaṃ cakraśārṅgagadā dharaḥ \|*  
*jagāma vibudhaiḥ sārdhaṃ somasyopari roṣitaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*viṣṇuṃ viditvā saṃprāptaṃ somo daityagaṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*yuddhāya samarāmarṣī sthitaḥ pradhmāya vārijam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*sa jitvā devasaṃghātaṃ seṃdraṃ vāyupurassaram \|*  
*viṣṇunā saha saṃyuktaḥ śastrāstrairasubhojanaiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. Finding the presence of Visnu - the holder of discus, conch and mace in the battleground, the Moongod also, accompanied with the Daityas, reached the battleground and blowing the conch, he indicated to the gods about his arrival. With the weapon which consumed the lives of others, he defeated Indra, Vayu and other prominent gods. Then he thought of fighting with Visnu. Therefore, he appeared before him.

## \|\| 3.99.28-30 \|\|

*yadā nāsāvuparamedyuddhāya saha viṣṇunā \|*  
*tadā'dade ruṣā viṣṇuścakaṃ krodhasamanvitaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*athāha brahmā deveśamajitaṃ viṣṇumavyayam \|*  
*yo'sau meghaprapuṣṭāṃgaṃ yattvāṃ vacmi nibodha tat \|\| 29 \|\|*

*nāsti vadhyaṃ tribhuvane cakrasyāsya tavānagha \|*  
*somo dvijādhipatye ca mayā samabhiṣecitaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. Observing that the Moongod was not prepared to stop the war, getting enraged, lord Visnu lifted up his cakra in order to attack him. Observing lord Visnu in utter rage, lord Brahma said to invincible lord Visnu- “O sinless lord, you have the hard limbs like the clouds and make use of the cakra for the protection of the world. Therefore, you kindly give a deep thought over my requet, I have established the Moon as the lord of the Brahmanas, Ksatriyas and the Vaisyas.

## \|\| 3.99.31-32 \|\|

*tasmādyadyujyate devakārye'smiṃstadvidhīyatām \|*  
*athāha bhagavānviṣṇuḥ surabrahmarṣisannidhau \|\| 31 \|\|*

*sinīvālī kuhūrnāma tasyāṃ naṣṭaḥ kṣapākaraḥ \|*  
*vinaṣṭo'pi punarjanma prāpsyatīti na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Since you have arrived here for the purpose of the performing of the task of gods, therefore, you should stop this action of yours.” On hearing these words, lord Visnu spoke in presence of the Brahmanas and the Brahmarsis. On the moonless day known as Sinivan and Kuhu, the Moongod known as the lord of nights, would get destroyed. Then after destruction, he would regain his name. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.99.33 \|\|

*rākāṃ cānumatiṃ prāpya vṛddhirasya bhaviṣyati \|*  
*āpyāyitaśca śrutyuktaiḥ pitṛpiṇḍaiḥ samaṃtrakaiḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇairhavyakavyāni devebhyaḥ prāpayiṣyati \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. He would regain his full form on the day of Raka (purnima) and regain increase. Then reciting the mantras, the pindas offered by the Brahmana would be received by the pitrs, while the gods would receive the havya and kavya.

## \|\| 3.99.34-35 \|\|

*vṛddhiḥ kṛṣṇena caivāsya na ca jātasya bhūyasī \|*  
*evameva vidhirdṛṣṭastasyāpyāya nameva me \|\| 34 \|\|*

*amoghasya na moghatvaṃ bhaviṣyati kadācana \|*  
*śaptaśca somo dakṣeṇa sa cāvaśyaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. After his re-emerging, he would not increase in the black fortnight. Thus, only in the visible fortnight, he would increase accordingly. My invincible weapons have never been proved to be unsuccessful. But because of the curse of Daksa, it’s reward has to be reaped.

## \|\| 3.99.36-41 \|\|

*sudarśanasya ca prītirevameva bhaviṣyati \|*  
*evamastviti deveśa yadbhavānprabravīti vai \|\| 36 \|\|*

*brahmā provāca somaṃ tu vinītavadupasthitam \|*  
*arpayasva gurorbhāryāṃ na kāryaṃ punarīdṛśam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*sa tathoktaḥ samānīya dadau tārāṃ bṛhaspateḥ \|*  
*punarūce śaśī spaṣṭaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tridivaukasām \|\| 38 \|\|*

*asyāṃ garbho madīyo'yaṃ yadapatyaṃ mamaiva tat \|*  
*bṛhaspatirathovāca mayā garbhaḥ samāhitaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*kṣetre madīye cotpannastasmātsa mama putrakaḥ \|*  
*uktaṃ ca vedaśāstrajñairṣibhirddharmadarśibhiḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*uptaṃ vātāhṛtaṃ bījaṃ yasya kṣetre prarohati \|*  
*kṣetriṇastasya tadbījaṃ na bījī phalabhāgbhavet \|\| 41 \|\|*

36-41. Therefore, his love for the Sudarsana-cakra would continue to remain as before. At these words spoken by lord Visnu, Brahma said- “O lord of the gods, whatever has been spoken by you is correct and the best.” Thereafter, he spoke to the Moongod who stood there quite humbly- “You better return the wife of Brhaspati - the preceptor of the gods and never commit such a crime in future. The Moongod then replied- “Be it so,” and then gave over Tara to the preceptor Brhaspati. Then he spoke clearly in presence of all the gods - “The pregnancy with Tara belongs to me. Therefore, after the birth, the child would belong to me.” On hearing this, Brhaspati said- “The pregnancy is with my wife. Therefore, the son born in my field should belong to me. This is what has been spoken by the Rsis who are well-versed in the Vedic and post Vedic literature. The seed is carried by the Windgod, but in whichever field it is dropped, on its sprouting it belongs to the person who happens to be the owner of the field and not the person by whom the seed is sown.”

## \|\| 3.99.42-45 \|\|

*samyaguktaṃ na bhavatā śaśāṃkaḥ prāha tattvavit \|*  
*mātā bhastrā pituḥ putro yena jātaḥ sa eva saḥ \|*  
*iti paurāṇikāḥ prāhurmunayo nayacakṣuṣaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*vivadaṃtau nivāryātha brahmā provāca tāṃ vadhūm \|*  
*śanairekāṃtamānīya garbhoyaṃ kasya śaṃsa me \|\| 43 \|\|*

*evamuktā tu sā tārā hriyā novāca kiṃcana \|*  
*utsasarja kṣaṇādgarbhaṃ bhābhāsitasurālayam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*tamuvāca tato brahmā putra kasya suto bhavān \|*  
*somasyāhaṃ suto brahmanniti tathyaṃ mayoditam \|\| 45 \|\|*

42-45. On hearing this, the Moongod, who was well aware of the tattvas said- “Your words have not been thoughtfully spoken, because the intelligent rulers as well as the Munis well-versed in the Puranas have said that the mother of the son is like a pitcher. Therefore, the son bom out of it should belong to the father.” On listening to the controversy between both of them and in order to solve the issue, Brahma took Tara at a secluded place and asked her slowly- “You tell me to whom does this pregnancy belong?” At these words of Brahma, lowering her mouth with shyness, she could say nothing, but she displayed the lustrous pregnancy before Brahma. Then Brahma asked- “O son, who is your father?” Then came the reply- “I am the son of the Moongod.” I have spoken this truthfully.

## \|\| 3.99.46-47 \|\|

*budho'yaṃ vibudhāḥ prāhuḥ sarvajñānavidāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*gṛhītvā putrakaṃ somo jagāma svaṃ niveśanam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*gururgṛhītvā svāṃ bhāryāṃ jagāma bhavanaṃ śanaiḥ \|*  
*somo'pi tanayaṃ labdhvā harṣavyākulamānasaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. Then the gods said- “This the best effort by the learned one. Therefore, he should be known as Budha. Thereafter, the Moongod received his son and Brhaspati got back his wife. Both of then went back to their respective abodes. The Moongod was extremely delighted by getting a son.

## \|\| 3.99.48-50 \|\|

*paurṇamāsī samākhyātā prāptapūrṇamanorathā \|*  
*prāptaḥ putro mayā hyasyāṃ labdhaśca vi jayastathā \|\| 48 \|\|*

*tasmādenāmupāsiṣye vidhinā vratatatparaḥ \|*  
*evamanyo'pi pūrṇārthaḥ pūrṇāṃśaḥ pūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*yo māmakyāṃ tithau bhaktyā vidhivatpūjayiṣyati \|*  
*tasya prasādābhimukhaḥ sarvakāmaprado hyaham \|\| 50 \|\|*

48-50. Then he said that the full moon day is quite an auspicious one, because I have achieved both victory and my son on the same day. Therefore, for performing a vrata appropriately, I shall observe a fast. Though there are some other vratas as well which fulfill one’s desire, but on my favourite tithis when a person adores me appropriately and worships me, I feeling delighted, shall make all his desires successful.

## \|\| 3.99.51-54 \|\|

*evameṣā tithiḥ pārtha somasya dayitā śubhā \|*  
*paurṇamāsī samākhyātā pūrṇo māso bhavedyathā \|\| 51 \|\|*

*tadasyāṃ srotasi snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ \|*  
*ālikhya maṃḍale somaṃ nakṣatraiḥ sahitaṃ vibhum \|\| 52 \|\|*

*pūjayetkusumairhṛdyairnaivedyairghṛtapācitaiḥ \|*  
*śuklākṣataiḥ śuklavastraiḥ pūjayitvā kṣamāpayet \|*  
*śākāharaṇamunyannairnaktaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*vasaṃtabāṃdhava vidho śītāṃśo svasti naḥ kuru \|*  
*gaganārṇavamāṇikya candra dākṣāyaṇīpate \|\| 54 \|\|*

51-54. Since this tithi is my favourite and I have termed it as Paurnamasi or the full moon day, which could be completed in a month, therefore, after taking a bath in a river, offering oblations to the gods as well as the pitrs, one should draw a mandala in which Soma together with constellations should be lodged and worshipped offering the flowers, eatables soaked in ghi, white unbroken rice and white cloth. Then one should eat vegetarian food and keep silence during the night. Then one should beg forgiveness- “O kins of spring season, having cool rays, you bestow us a tradition of welfare. Make us beholden to you for the same. You are the master of the excellent Ravi, Candra and Daksayani.

## \|\| 3.99.55-56 \|\|

*pakṣepakṣe paurṇamāsyāṃ vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇapakṣe'pi yaḥ kaścicchraddhāvānvai vratī bhavet \|\| 55 \|\|*

*tasyāpyeṣa vidhiḥ proktaḥ sarvasaukhyapradāyakaḥ \|*  
*āmāvāsyā tithiriyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dayitā sadā \|*  
*asyāṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ bhavet \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. This process should be adopted on the foil moon day of each month’s vrata as has been prescribed. During the dark fortnight also, in case one intends to perform the vrata, for him also the same procedure has been prescribed. Because of its auspiciousness, this tithi of foil moon is the favourite of the pitrs. The donation given on this particular day becomes imperishable.

## \|\| 3.99.57-60 \|\|

*amāvāsyā mahārāja prayatnairyairupoṣitā \|*  
*tairakṣayyaṃ bhaveddattaṃ pitṛbhyastīrthamuttamam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*yaḥ kaścitkurute tasminpitṛpiṇḍodakakriyām \|*  
*sa tārayati puṇyātmā puruṣānekaviṃśatim \|\| 58 \|\|*

*bhaveyurakṣayāstasya lokāḥ pitṛniṣevitāḥ \|*  
*yadā tu iha kālāṃte tasyātrāgamanaṃ bhavet \|\| 59 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇaḥ pitṛbhaktaśca sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ janmani rājendra bhaveddhanasamanvitaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

57-60. While observing the fast, the food given in the name of the pitrs becomes everlasting. On that particular day of Amavasya, a person who performs the pindodaka rite, he actually edeems twenty one generations of his family, besides his stay in the pitrloka becomes everlasting. О Rajendra, on his arrival

## \|\| 3.99.61-62 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte haimaṃ kṛtvā suśobhanam \|*  
*somaṃ nakṣatrasahitaṃ viprāya pratipādayet \|\| 61 \|\|*

*upadeśaṃ prayacchedyastasmai vratakṛte naraḥ \|*  
*saṃpūjya vastrābharaṇairmaṃtreṇetthaṃ nivedayet \|*  
*māsemāse vidhirayaṃ vratasyāsya narādhipa \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. At the end of the year, a gold image of the Moongod with the constellations should be made and offered to the Brahmana, after worshipping it. In reality, as a part of the vrata, one should adorn the image with costumes and ornaments, and the same should thereafter be given over to the Brahmana. 0 best of the humans, this vrata should be observed in each one of the months, and the same procedure has been prescribed.

## \|\| 3.99.63 \|\|

*yo na śaknoti vā kartuṃ pakṣaṃ vātha niraṃtaram \|*  
*sa ekāmapyupoṣyaiva kuryādudyāpanaṃ sudhīḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. A person, who is unable to observe this vrata in each month, he should complete only one vrata by observing the fast and perform the Udyapana or concluding ceremony.

## \|\| 3.99.64-65 \|\|

*yaścaitatkurute pārtha paurṇamāsīvrataṃ naraḥ \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmuktaścandravaddivi rājate \|\| 64 \|\|*

*putrapautradhanopeto yajvā dātā priyaṃvadaḥ \|*  
*saṃtatiṃ vipulāṃ prāpya prayāge maraṇaṃ bhajet \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. О Partha, one who performs the vrata of Paurnamasi, then getting free from all the sins, he shines in the heaven like the Moon. Again on his rebirth on earth, he becomes wealthy, comfortable with sons and grandsons, a great donor, besides being a soft spoken person. He has enough of progeny and enormous pleasures. in this world, he is bom in a Brahmana family, becoming devoted to his parents, besides being wealthy, glorious and well-versed in all the lores.

## \|\| 3.99.66 \|\|

*tataścaivākṣayāṃllokānprāpnoti surasevitān \|*  
*sevyamānaḥ sa gandharvaiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ \|*  
*āste saṃpūrṇasarvāṃgo yāvatkalpāyutatrayam \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. He ultimately meets with his end at Prayaga and finally achieves the eternal place, where he is served by Gandharvas and respected by the gods as well as the Daityas. He leads a comfortable life there for thirty thousand kalpas.

## \|\| 3.99.67 \|\|

*abhyarcayaṃti sitapañcadaśīṣu somaṃ kṛṣṇāsu ye pitṛgaṇaṃ jalapiṃḍadānaiḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ gṛhāṇi dhana dhānyasutādisaṃpatpūrṇāni pārthiva bhavaṃti vidhervidhānāt \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. O Partha, thus during the moon day of the bright fortnight as well as during the dark fortnight, dark pindas should be offered to the pitrs while adoring them and one who does so, he attains enough of sons, wealth, cereals and the complete household.

## Chapter 100. Vratas of Vaisakhi, Kartiki and Maghi

## \|\| 3.100.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*saṃvatsare ca yāḥ kāścittithayaḥ puṇyalakṣaṇāḥ \|*  
*tā me vada yaduśreṣṭha snāne dāne mahāphalāḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O best of the race of Yadus, you kindly tell me about the auspicious moon day in which, while taking bath, one earns great merit.

## \|\| 3.100.2-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*vaiśākhī kārtikī māghī tithayo'tīva pūjitāḥ \|*  
*snānadānavihīnaistā na neyāḥ pāṃḍunandana \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tīrthasnānaṃ tadā śastaṃ dānaṃ vittānurūpataḥ \|*  
*vaiśākhyāṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha śreṣṭhā dyotanikā matā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kārttikyāṃ puṣkarāraṇyaṃ māghyāṃ vārāṇasī smṛtā \|*  
*snānenodakadānena tārayatyapi duṣkṛtīn \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kuṃbhānsvachāṃbhasaḥ pūrṇānsahiraṇyānnasaṃyutān \|*  
*vaiśākhyāṃ brāhmaṇo dattvā na śocati kṛte vrate \|\| 5 \|\|*

2-5. Sri Krsna said- О son of Pandu, the days of Vaisakha, Kartika and Magha are said to be extremely auspicious. One should not neglect taking bath and the giving of the charities on these days, which earn enormous merit On the days of Vaisakha, the bath at a holy place and giving of charities as per one’s means are said to be beneficial to the people, as has been ordained by the great Rsis. Similarly, a visit to Puskara has been said to be praiseworthy in the month of Kartika and a visit to Varanasi in the month of Magha along with taking bath and performing of oblations. On the day of Vaisakha, one should observe the vrata and when the pitcher filled with water and decorated with gold and cereals is given away in charity, the person is totally freed of all the worries.

## \|\| 3.100.6-10 \|\|

*madhurānnarasaiḥ pūrṇānbhājanānkanakojjvalān \|*  
*gobhūhiraṇyavāsāṃsi vidhivatpratipādayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*māghyāṃ maghāsu ca tathā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ \|*  
*tilapātrāṇi deyāni tilāṃśca palalaudanam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kārpāsadānamatraiva tiladānaṃ ca śasyate \|*  
*kaṃbalājinaratnāni mocakau pāpamocakau \|\| 8 \|\|*

*upānaddānamatraiva kathitaṃ sarvakāmadam \|*  
*yatra vā tatra vā snānaṃ dānaṃ vittānurūpataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*kalikālodbhavaṃ sarvaṃ śasyate pāṃḍunandana \|*  
*kārtikyāṃ tu vṛṣotsargo vivāhaḥ puṇyalakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*kāryaṃ kurukulaśreṣṭha harernīrājanaṃ tathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

6-10. On that particular day, the food placed in a vase which should have the shine of gold, besides a cow, the land, gold and costumes should be given in charity. Similarly, in the Magha constellation of the month of Magha, after offering oblations to the pitrs, a vase filled with sesamum seeds, boiled rice, cotton, when given in charity, are said to be quite praiseworthy. The giving away of the blankets of deer-skin and gems are said to be remover of the sins, besides the giving away of the shoes which grants all the desires, should also be given during the month itself. O son of Pandu, one can take his bath anywhere he likes, but one should give away the charities as per one’s means, which are quite praiseworthy in the present age of Kali. O best of the race of Kuru, on the day of the Kartika-purnima, the freeing of a bull, auspicious marriage and the arati of Visnu should be performed.

## \|\| 3.100.11-13 \|\|

*gajāśvarathadānaṃ ca ghṛtadhenvādayastathā \|*  
*pradeyāḥ puṇyakṛdbhiśca tāstāḥ saṃkalpya devatāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*phalāni yāni vidyaṃte sugandhimadhurāṇi ca \|*  
*jātīphalaṃ ca kaṃkolaṃ lavaṃgaṃ lavalīphalam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*kharjūrīṃ nālikerāṃśca kadalyāśca phalāni ca \|*  
*dāḍimānmātuluṃgāṃśca karkoṭāṃstrapusāṃstathā \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. The noble souls should give away for their particular god the elephant, horse, chariot, ghi and cow, besides the fragrant flowers and fruits like nutmeg, cloves, the gourd, scour fruit, date, palm, coconut, banana, pomegranate, myrobalan, bad tree fruit, trapusa, pumpkin and other fruits should also be given.

## \|\| 3.100.14 \|\|

*vṛṃtākānkāravellāṃśca biṃbānkūṣmāṃḍakarburān \|*  
*apradānena yeṣāṃ tu tithayo yāṃti bhārata \|*  
*te vyādhitā daridrāśca jāyaṃte bhuvi mānavāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. One who is deprived of giving away of charities on these days, attracts ailments on earth and suffers from poverty.

## \|\| 3.100.15 \|\|

*na kevalaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ dānaṃ sarvasya śasyate \|*  
*bhaginībhāgineyānāṃ mātulānāṃ pitṛṣvasuḥ \|*  
*daridrāṇāṃ ca baṃdhūnāṃ dānaṃ koṭiguṇotta ram \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The aforesaid types of charities are not supposed to be given to the Brahmanas, but should be given to sisters, sister’s son and sister of maternal uncle or of the father or their progeny, besides the poor relatives. When it is so done, one achieves crore times more merit.

## \|\| 3.100.16 \|\|

*mitraṃ kulīnaścāpanno vadhurdāridryaduḥkhitaḥ \|*  
*āśayābhyāgato dūrātsotithiḥ svargasaṃkramaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The giving away of such charity to a friend, a noble person in distress, a poor relative or a beggar who arrives from a distance with a hope, amounts to the climbing of the stairs of the heaven.

## \|\| 3.100.17 \|\|

*vanaṃ prasthāpite rāme sasīte saha lakṣmaṇe \|*  
*mātāmahakulādetya viśuddhenāṃtarātmanā \|*  
*sā sarveḥ śrāvitānekaiḥ kośalyā bharatena vai \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. After the departure of Rama with Sita and Laksmana to the forest, when Bharata returned from the place of his maternal grandparents in order to prove himself innocent before Kausalya, he took many others.

## \|\| 3.100.18-20 \|\|

*yadā na pratyayaṃ yāti kathaṃcitkośalātmajā \|*  
*tadā viśuddhabhāvena tithayaḥ śrāvitāḥ punaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*vaiśākhī kārtikī māghī tithayomarapūjitāḥ \|*  
*apradānavato yāṃti yasyāryyonumate gataḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*etacchrutvā tu kauśalyā sahasā pratyayaṃ gatā \|*  
*aṃkamānīya bharataṃ sāṃtvayāmāsa duḥkhitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. But Kausalya - the daughter of Kausala, still remained unimpressed. Ultimately, Bharata said- “Vaisakhi, Kartiki and Maghi (Purnima) as the moon days which are adored even by the gods, should not be fruitful for him. On hearing these words, Kausalya felt assured and atonce took Bharata in her lap and started consoling him in order to relieve him of his grief.

## \|\| 3.100.21-22 \|\|

*etattithīnāṃ māhātmyamākhyātaṃ bahuvistaram \|*  
*bhūyastu kiṃ pravakṣyāmi tava rājanmahāmate \|\| 21 \|\|*

*vaiśākhakārtikamaghāsahitātha māghe yā pūrṇimā bhavati pūrṇaśaśāṃkacihnā \|*  
*tasyāṃ jalānnakanakāṃbaramātapatraṃ dattvā prayāti puruṣaḥ puruhūtalokam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Krsna said- “O intelligent one, I have narrated the importance of these tithis to you in detail. In case you intend to know something else, you tell me. During the month of Vaisakha, Kartika and foil moon day of the month of Magha combined with Magha constellation and with the rays of the moon, the water, food, gold, costumes and umbrella given away in charity, bestows Indraloka.

## Chapter 101. Glory of Yugadi tithi

## \|\| 3.101.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*punarme brūhi deveśa tvadbhaktyā bhāvitātmanaḥ \|*  
*kathyamānamihecchāmi śubhadharmapadaṃ mahat \|\| 1 \|\|*

*yatrāṇvapi narairddattaṃ japtaṃ vā sumahadbhavet \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- О lord of gods, being an auspicious soul because of your devotion, I always have a desire that you should keep on speaking something or the other. Therefore, you kindly speak about a great vrata by which the people giving away the small charities, should earn enormous merit.

## \|\| 3.101.3-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu pāṃḍava te vacmi rahasyaṃ devanirmitam \|*  
*yanmayā kasyacinnoktaṃ supriyasyāpi bhārata \|\| 3 \|\|*

*vaiśākhamāsasya tu yā tṛtīyā navamyasau kārtikaśuklapakṣe \|*  
*nabhasya māsasya tu kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśīṃ pañcadaśīṃ ca māghe \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Sri Krsna said- I am going to reveal before you a divine secret, which has never been told by me to anyone else. О Bharata, the third moon day of the month of Vaisakha, the bright fifth moon day of the month of Kartika, trayodasi (dark) of the month of Bhadrapada and the moonless night of the month of Magha, are said to be the originators of the yugas.

## \|\| 3.101.5-6 \|\|

*vaiśākhasya tṛtīyā tu samā kṛtayutena tu \|*  
*navamī kārtike yā tu tretāyugasamāgatā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*trayodaśī nabhasye tu dvāpareṇa samāgatā \|*  
*māghe pañcadaśī rājankalikālādirucyate \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. On the bright third moon day of the month of Vaisakha, Krtayuga was originated. On the bright ninth moon day of the month of Kartika, Tretayuga originated. On the trayodasi of the month of Bhadrapada, emerged Dvapara, while Kaliyuga started on the moonless night.

## \|\| 3.101.7 \|\|

*etāścatasro rājendra yugānāṃ prabhavādyathā \|*  
*yugādayaśca kathyaṃte tathaitā sarvasūribhiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. О Rajendra, all'the four tithis are the originators of the yugas and with the permission of the learned people, they are called as Yugadi-tithis or the days on which the ugas started.

## \|\| 3.101.8 \|\|

*upavāsastapo dānaṃ japahomakriyāstathā \|*  
*yadyattu kriyate kiṃcitsarvaṃkoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Therefore, during these tithis (or moon days), the tapas, charities, japam and homa or any other religious exercise when performed, its merit multiplies to crores of times.

## \|\| 3.101.9 \|\|

*vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ śrīsametaṃ jagadgurum \|*  
*nārāyaṇaṃ pūjayethāḥ puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ \|*  
*vastrālaṃkārasaṃbhārainaivedyai rvividhaistathā \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. On the third moon day of the month of Vaisakha, Narayana — the preceptor of the universe, should be worshipped, offering to him the flowers, incense, paste, costumes, ornaments and various type of sweet dishes with devotion.

## \|\| 3.101.10-11 \|\|

*tatastasyāgrato dhenurlavaṇasyāḍhakena tu \|*  
*kāryā kurukulaśreṣṭha caturbhāgeṇa vatsakaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*avicarmopari sthāpya kalpayitvā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*śāstroktakramayogena brāhmaṇāyopapādayet \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. Thereafter, nearly eight kilograms of salt should be placed before him in the form of a cow and one fourth of the same weight should be used for a calf. Both of them should be placed over the sheep skin. Thereafter, worshipping both the cow and a calf of salt, the same should be given over to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.101.12 \|\|

*śrīdharaḥ śrīpatiḥ śrīmāñchrīśaḥ saṃprīyatāmiti \|*  
*anena vidhinā dattvā dhenuṃ viprāya bhārata \|*  
*gosahasraṃ daśaguṇaṃ prāpnotīha na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. At that point of time, the donor should say- “O Sridhara, Sripati, Sriman and lord of Sri, you kindly be pleased with me. By giving away the cow and calf of salt, the donor surely earns the merit of giving away ten thousand cows in reality. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.101.13-15 \|\|

*tathaiva kārtike māsi navamyāṃ naktabhuṅnaraḥ \|*  
*snātvā nadītaḍāgeṣu devakhāteṣu vā punaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*umāsahāyaṃ varadaṃ nīlakaṃṭhamathārcayet \|*  
*puṣpadhūpādinaivedyairaniṃdyaiḥ śaṃkaraṃ śivam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ dadyātpurāṇo ktavidhānataḥ \|*  
*aṣṭamūrtirnīlakaṃṭhaḥ prīyatāmiti ciṃtayet \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. Similarly, on the bright navami of the month of Kartika, the man should take food during the night and should take his bath at a river, a devakunda, a tank or a lake and then worship the lord of Uma and the lord Nilakantha (bine-throated one) offering the excellent flowers, incense and the eatables. After the worship of lord Siva who is the form of welfare, a cow made of sesamum seeds should be given away in charity and one should say- “Let the Astamurti lord Nilakantha be pleased with me.”

## \|\| 3.101.16 \|\|

*yadatra prāpyate puṇyaṃ pārtha tatkena varṇyate \|*  
*dattvā tilamayīṃ dhenuṃ śivalokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. O Partha, with the performing of this vrata and giving away of the charities, the merits so earned is difficult to be described. By giving away in charity a cow made of sesamum seeds, a person achieves the place of Siva.

## \|\| 3.101.17 \|\|

*trayodaśī nabhasi yā kṛṣṇamasyāṃ samarcayet \|*  
*pitṝnpāyasadānena madhunā ca ghṛtena tu \|*  
*bhojayedbrāhmaṇānbhaktyā vedavedāṅgapāragān \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. On the dark trayodasi of the month of Bhadrapada, the manes should be pleased with the offering of the payasam and the Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas as well as the related literature, should be served with food.

## \|\| 3.101.18-19 \|\|

*pitṝnuddiśya dātavyā savatsā kāṃsyadohanī \|*  
*pratyakṣā gaurmahārāja taruṇī supayasvinī \|\| 18 \|\|*

*pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ \|*  
*prīyatāṃ gopradānena iti dattvā visarjayet \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Further in order to please the manes, a cow with a calf besides a milk pot of bronze, should also be given. At the time of giving away in charity a young milk giving cow, one should say- “Let my father, grandfather and the great grandfather, be pleased with me with the giving away of the cow.” Thereafter, he should send them off.

## \|\| 3.101.20 \|\|

*kṛtenānena rājendra yatpuṇyaṃ prāpyate nṛbhiḥ \|*  
*tatkena varṇituṃ yāti varṣakoṭiśatairapi \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. O Rajendra, the merit one earns with the giving away of the cow, cannot be described in a hundred crores of years.

## \|\| 3.101.21 \|\|

*putrānpautrānprapautrāṃśca dhanaṃ ca mahadīpsitam \|*  
*iha cāpnoti puruṣaḥ paratra ca śubhāṃ gatim \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. The performer achieves many sons and the grandsons in this world, besides the desired riches, and he finally achieves the beautitude.

## \|\| 3.101.22 \|\|

*pañcadaśyāṃ ca māghasya pūjayitvā pitāmaham \|*  
*gāyatryā sahitaṃ devaṃ vedavedāṅgabhūṣitam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Similarly, on the moonless day of the month of Magha, reciting the Gayatri, Vedas as well as the Vedangas, Brahma should be worshipped.

## \|\| 3.101.23 \|\|

*navanītamayīṃ dhenuṃ phalairnānāvidhairyutām \|*  
*sahiraṇyāṃ savatsāṃ ca brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|*  
*kīrtayetprīyatāmatra padmayoniḥ pitāmahaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Thereafter, a cow with calf made in butter, besides several of seasonal fruits should be handed over to the Brahmana with respect and the performer should say- “Let Padmayoni Brahma be pleased with my action.”

## \|\| 3.101.24 \|\|

*yatsvarge yacca pātāle yacca martye sudurlabham \|*  
*tadavāpnotyasaṃdigdhaṃ padmayoni prasādataḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Whatever is achieved by the performer in the heaven, earth and the nether world, it is because of the grace of Brahma only, there is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.101.25 \|\|

*yāni cānyāni dānāni dattāni subahūnyapi \|*  
*yugādiṣu mahārāja akṣayāni bhavaṃti hi \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. O great king, on the days of the origination of the yugas, when the other things are given in charity, they also become everlasting.

## \|\| 3.101.26-29 \|\|

*alpamalpaṃ hi yaḥ kaścitpradadyānnirddhanopi san \|*  
*tadakṣayaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ yugādiṣu na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*vittānusāraṃ svaṃ jñātvā vittavānpārthivopi vā \|*  
*anusāreṇa vittasya asādhyena samādhinā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*bhūrhiraṇyaṃ gṛhaṃ vāsaḥ śayanānyāsanāni ca \|*  
*chatropānatsuyugmāni pradeyāni dvijātiṣu \|\| 28 \|\|*

*evaṃ dattvā yathāśaktyā bhojayitvā dvijānapi \|*  
*paścādbhuñjīta sumanā vāgyataḥ svajanaiḥ saha \|\| 29 \|\|*

26-29. When a poor person gives away even a smallest amount in charity, it becomes everlasting. Therefore, one should give away land, gold, house, costumes, bed sheets, umbrella and the shoes in charity to the Brahmanas, as per one’s financial capacity. Thereafter, the Brahmanas should be served with food as per the means of a person, then the performer, observing silence should also take his food with his kins.

## \|\| 3.101.30 \|\|

*yatkiñcinmānasaṃ pāpaṃ kāyikaṃ vācikaṃ tathā \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti yugāditithipūjanāt \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. By worshipping the tithis of the start of the yugas, all the sins committed by a person with his speech, mind and body, automatically get destroyed.

## \|\| 3.101.31 \|\|

*udgīyamāno gandharvaiḥ stūyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ \|*  
*ramate cākṣayaṃ kālaṃ svargaloke na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The Gandharvas sing about their glory, while the gods and the asuras always adore them. And the performer roams about in the heaven with comfort for a long time. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.101.32 \|\|

*yaddīyate kimapi koṭiguṇaṃ tadāhuḥ snānaṃ japoniyamamakṣayameva sarvam \|*  
*syādakṣayāsu yugapūrvatithīṣu rājanvyāsādayo munivarāḥ samudāharaṃti \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. According to the sages like Vyasa and others, taking of bath, performing of the Japam, giving away of charities, in whatever manner are given, the related merit is multiplied by a crore of times.

## Chapter 102. Vata-Savitri Vrata

## \|\| 3.102.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*smarayāmi hṛṣīkeśa yannoktaṃ bhavatā kvacit \|*  
*tatsāvitrīvrataṃ brūhi mamopari dayāṃ kuru \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- O Hrsikesa, being compassionate on me, you kindly enlighten me about the Savitri vrata, about which you have not so far spoken to me.

## \|\| 3.102.2-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*kathayāmi kulastrīṇāṃ mahābhāgyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*yathā cīrṇaṃ vratavaraṃ sāvitryā rājakanyayā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*āsīnmadreṣu dharmātmā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ \|*  
*pārthivośvapatirnāma paurajānapadapriyaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kṣamāvāṃśca kṣitipatiḥ satyavāṃśca jitendriyaḥ \|*  
*sa sabhāryo vratamidaṃ cacāra nṛpatiḥ svayam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*sāvitrīvratasiddhaṃ tatsarvakāmapradāyakam \|*  
*tasya tuṣṭābhavadrājansāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*bhūrbhuvaḥsvaritītyeṣā sākṣānmūrtimatī sthitā \|*  
*kamaṃḍaludharā devī prasannavadanekṣaṇā \|\| 6 \|\|*

2-6. Sri Krsna said- They say that the most beautiful girl like Savitri and others performed this vrata, I am going to speak about rhe extremely auspicious vrata which is full of fortunes. In the Madra country, these had been a king known by the name of Asvapati. He was quite religious minded, besides being the well-wisher of the people. He was quite favourite of the people at large. The Siddha-Savitri vrata, which granted all the desires, was performed with his queen. O king, Savitri - the beloved of Brahma, getting extremely pleased, appeared herself before the king, who appeared to be the image of Bhur, Bhuvah, Svah. She carried a kamandalu in her hand, had a smiling face and developed eyes.

## \|\| 3.102.7-8 \|\|

*uvāca duhitā hyekā tava rājanbhaviṣyati \|*  
*ityevamuktvā sāvitrī jagāmādarśanaṃ punaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kālena sā tathā rājanduhitā devarūpiṇī \|*  
*sāvitryā prītayā dattā sāvitryā japtayā tadā \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. She spoke to the king “O son, you would get a daughter.” Thus speaking, she disappeared from the scene. Since the king was immensely devoted to Savitri and adored her regularly, in due course of time, the king got a daughter, who looked like a goddess.

## \|\| 3.102.9-10 \|\|

*sāvitrītyeva nāmāsyāścakrurviprāstathā pitā \|*  
*sā gṛhavatī saśrīrvyavarddhata nṛpātmajā \|*  
*sāvitrī sukumārāṅgī yauvanasthā babhūva ha \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tāṃ sumadhyāṃ pṛthuśroṇīṃ pratimāṃ kāñcanīmiva \|*  
*prāpteva devakanyeti dṛṣṭvā tāmitare janāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. O Brahmanas, her father gave the name of Savitri to the girl. The infant girl gradually went on growing with her beauty. In short time, she became quite youthful who had a slender waist. She appeared like a golden image. Her pelvic region was plump and the people of the city took her to be a divine girl.

## \|\| 3.102.11 \|\|

*sā tu padmapalāśākṣī prajvalaṃtīva tejasā \|*  
*cacāra sā ca sāvitrīvrataṃ yadbhṛguṇoditam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Her eyes resembled the lotus flowers and were shining. At the advice of the sage Bhrgu. the girl Savitri performed the Savitri vrata in an appropriate manner.

## \|\| 3.102.12-14 \|\|

*athopoṣya śiraḥsnātā devatāmabhigamya sā \|*  
*hutvāgniṃ vidhivadviprānvācayitveṃduparvaṇi \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tebhyaḥ sumanasaḥ śeṣāḥ pratigṛhya nṛpātmajā \|*  
*sādhvī pativratābhyetya devaśrīriva rūpiṇī \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sobhivādya pituḥ pādau śeṣānpūrvaṃ nivedya ca \|*  
*kṛtāṃjalirvarārohā nṛpateḥ pārśvataḥ sthitā \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. On the day of the moon festival initially, the princess observed the fast. She took her bath starting with her head. Then she adored the gods and poured offering in the fire. Then she listened to the narrations by the Brahmanas and received the flowers, unbroken rice as the prasada of the puja. The chaste Savitri, who actually looked like the image of Laksmi, once reached before her father and lowered her head in salutation with folded hands, at his feet. Thereafter, the damsel took her seat besides the king.

## \|\| 3.102.15-19 \|\|

*tāṃ dṛṣṭvā yauvanaṃ prāptāṃ svacchāṃ tāṃ devarūpiṇīm \|*  
*uvāca rājā saṃmaṃtrya smṛtyarthaṃ saha maṃtribhiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*yuktaḥ pradānakālo'syāstena kaścidvṛṇotvimām \|*  
*vicārayitvā paśyāmi varaṃ tulyaṃ mahātmanaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*devādīnāṃ yathā vācyo na labdheyaṃ tathā kuru \|*  
*boddhayamānā mayā putri dharmaśāstreṣu gaccha tam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*piturgṛhe tu yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyatyasaṃskṛtā \|*  
*brahmahatyā pitustatra sā kanyā vṛṣalī smṛtā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*atorthaṃ preṣayāmīti kuru putri svayaṃvaram \|*  
*vṛddhairamātyaiḥ sahitā śīghraṃ gaccha vidhāraya \|\| 19 \|\|*

15-19. Finding that her daughter had grown quite youthful, the king in consultation with his courtiers, said to her- “By timely as well as with united mutual consultations with the courtiers, the people are deciding on the matters relating to your marriage. Therefore, initially you tell me your views, whether there is someone in your mind. According to my own wisdom, I have come to a conclusion that in case the marriage takes place with an influential person, it would be better. As far as I should not be the subject to the ridicule of the gods. You should act accordingly. 0 my daughter, I have put you a question in consultation with the dharmasastra that your marriage must be performed, because a girl without marriage develops puberty in her parent’s home, the father earns the sin of Brahmahatya and the girl also becomes polluted. Therefore, 0 daughter, I am sending you with some courtiers to enable you to search your own husband. You should be quick for the future and keep my words in mind.”

## \|\| 3.102.20-23 \|\|

*evamastviti sāvitrī proktā tasmādviniryayau \|*  
*tapovanāni ramyāṇi rājarṣīṇāṃ jagāma sā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*mānyānāmatra vṛddhānāṃ kṛtvā pādābhiṣecanam \|*  
*tatobhigamya tīrthāni sarvāṇyevāśrayāṇi ca \|\| 21 \|\|*

*ājagāma punarveśma sāvitrī saha maṃtribhiḥ \|*  
*tatrāpaśyacca devarṣiṃ nāradaṃ purataḥ pituḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*āsīnamāsane vipraṃ praṇamya smitabhāṣiṇī \|*  
*kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ yathā vṛtaṃ vane'bhavat \|\| 23 \|\|*

20-23. Accepting the words of her father, the chaste lady Savitri departed for the beautiful hermitages of the Rsis in tapovana. Reaching there, she kissed the feet of the elderly saints there and adoring them, she visited all the excellent holy places and then returned to her place of father with the courtiers. After her return, she found the sage Narada seated over an excellent seat with her father. With a serene smile over her face, she offered her salutation to the Devarsi. She narrated the entire situation of the forest.

## \|\| 3.102.24 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*āsītsālveṣu dharmātmā kṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ \|*  
*dyumatsena iti khyāto devadatto babhūva saḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Savitri said- There had been a Ksatriya king in the Salva country, who is quite religious minded and graced by the destiny. On hearing this, Varada said.

## \|\| 3.102.25-28 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*aho bata mahatkaṣṭaṃ sāvitryā nṛpateḥ kṛtam \|*  
*bālyabhāvādyadanayā na kṛtaḥ satyavānnṛpaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*satyaṃ vadatyasya pitā satyaṃ mātā prabhāṣate \|*  
*upeto'sti guṇaiḥ sarvairdyumatsenasuto balī \|\| 26 \|\|*

*eko doṣo'sti nānyo'sya so'dyaprabhṛti satyavāk \|*  
*saṃvatsareṇa hīnāyurdeha tyāgaṃ kariṣyati \|\| 27 \|\|*

*nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā tanayāṃ prāha pārthivaḥ \|*  
*putri sāvitri gaccha tvamanyaṃ varaya satpatim \|*  
*saṃvatsareṇa solpāyurdehatyāgaṃ kariṣyati \|\| 28 \|\|*

25-28. Narada said- “It is quite pity and surprising that because of her childish nature, Savitri has selected Satyavan for her marriage with him and by so doing, she has created a grave problem for her father. Though Satyavan, who is the son of Dyumatsena, is valorous and possesses all the virtues, but there is a great blemish in him that he shall meet with his end within a month. But it would not be due to his personal fault, because he had always been truthful till now.” On hearing the words of Narada, the king said to his daughter- “O daughter, you better go again and search for another husband quickly, because Satyavan has a short life and shall meet with his end during this year itself.”

## \|\| 3.102.29-31 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*sakṛjjalpaṃti rājānaḥ sakṛjjalpaṃti paṃḍitāḥ \|*  
*sakṛtpradīyate kanyā trīṇyetāni sakṛtsakṛt \|\| 29 \|\|*

*dīrghāyuratha vālpāyuḥ saguṇo nirguṇo'pi vā \|*  
*sakṛdvṛtomayā bhartā na dvitīyaṃ vṛṇomyaham \|\| 30 \|\|*

*manasā niścayaṃ kṛtvā tato vācā'bhidhīyate \|*  
*kriyate karmaṇā paścātpramāṇaṃ me manaḥ sadā \|\| 31 \|\|*

29-31. Savitri said- The kings and the learned persons speak only once and the marriage of a girl takes place only once. Therefore,irrespective of his having a long or short life, or whether he is virtuous or a fool, whatever he might be, I have accepted him as my husband and shall not have a second man in his place. Because whatever has to be done is initially decided mentally and then it is expressed by the tongue or speech. Thereafter, the activity starts. Therefore, my mind is quite firm about it.

## \|\| 3.102.32-34 \|\|

*nārada uvāca \|*  
*yadyetadiṣṭaṃ duhitustataḥ śīghraṃ vidhīyatām \|*  
*avighnamagre sāvitryāḥ pradāne duhitustava \|\| 32 \|\|*

*evamuktvā samutpatya nāradastridivaṃ gataḥ \|*  
*rājā ca duhituḥ sarvaṃ vaivāhikamathākarot \|*  
*śubhe muhūrte pārśvasthairbrāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sāvitryapi varaṃ labdhvā bhartāraṃ manasepsitam \|*  
*mumude'tīva tanvaṃgī svargaṃ prāpyeva puṇyakṛt \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. Narada said- “In case, this is the decision of your daughter, then accomplish this task atonce. When you shall perform the kanyadana (giving away of the daughter), no evil is going to befall over your daughter.” Thus speaking, Narada proceeded on to the heaven. The king also on his part, got the marriage ceremony performed from an eminent Brahmana. By getting the husband of her own choice, the slim Savitri became delightful like an auspicious soul.

## \|\| 3.102.35-38 \|\|

*evaṃ tatrāśrame teṣāṃ vasatāṃ prītipūrvakam \|*  
*kālastapasyatāṃ kaścidaticakrāma bhārata \|\| 35 \|\|*

*sāvitryāstapyamānāyāstiṣṭhaṃtyāśca divāniśam \|*  
*nāradena yaduktaṃ tadvākyaṃ manasi vartate \|\| 36 \|\|*

*tataḥ kāle bahutithe vyatikrāṃte kadācana \|*  
*saprāptakālo mriyeta iti saṃciṃtya bhāminī \|*  
*proṣṭhapade site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ rajanīmukhe \|\| 37 \|\|*

*gaṇayantī ca sāvitrī nāradoktaṃ vaco hṛdi \|*  
*vrataṃ trirātramuddiśya divārātraṃ vinābhavat \|\| 38 \|\|*

35-38. O Bharata, accordingly, both of them spent happy days in the asrama for sometime, but Savitri kept in her mind the words spoken by Narada and started performing severe tapas throughout the day and night. After the passing of many days, Savitri thought that the death of Satyavan was certain. Therefore, on the bright dvadasi of the month of Bhadrapada, recalling the words of Narada, she started performing the Triratra vrata.

## \|\| 3.102.39-40 \|\|

*tatastrirātraṃ nirvartya snātvā saṃtarpya devatāḥ \|*  
*caturthe'hani martavyamiti saṃciṃtya bhāminī \|*  
*śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ pādau vavaṃde cāruhāsinī \|\| 39 \|\|*

*atha pratasthe paraśuṃ gṛhītvā satyavānvanam \|*  
*sāvitryapi ca bhartāraṃ gacchataḥ pṛṣṭhato'nvagāt \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. Getting free from Triratra vrata, she took her bath and worshipped the deities. The damsel was thinking- “The death is certain after four days. Therefore, for the welfare of her husband, she adored the feet of her parent-in-law. At the same time, holding an axe, Satyavan started towards the forest. Finding that her husband was moving to the forest, she also followed him.

## \|\| 3.102.41-45 \|\|

*tato'vadatsa bhartā tāṃ pṛcchasva śvaśurau nijau \|*  
*tathetyuktvā hi papraccha natvā śvaśrūpadāni sā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*śvaśurāvavadatāṃ ca na gaṃtavyaṃ tvayānaghe \|*  
*bāle tvaṃ paramaṃ bhīruḥ kathaṃ gacchasi kānanam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*bhūyo bhāvena sā proce draṣṭavyaṃ kānanaṃ mayā \|*  
*gaccheti tāṃ tadocāte śvaśurau cāruhāsinīm \|\| 43 \|\|*

*tato gṛhītvā tarasā phalapuṣpasamitkuśān \|*  
*yathā śuṣkāṇi vādāya kāṣṭhabhāramakalpayat \|\| 44 \|\|*

*atha pāṭayataḥ kāṣṭhaṃ jātā śirasi vedanā \|*  
*vyathā māṃ bādhate bāle svaptumicchāmi suṃdari \|\| 45 \|\|*

41-45. Finding that Savitri was following him, Satyavan said to her- “You should come with the permission of the parent-in-law.” She accepted the command of her husband, went to her parent-in-law and begged for permission to follow her husband. But they said to her- “O sinless one, you don’t go to the forest. You are quite a shy damsel, how can you go to the forest?” She replied with humility- “I am very much interested for visiting the forest.” On hearing these words, both the elders permitted her to go to the forest. Then walking swiftly, she collected a burden of dry wood, flowers and fruits besides the twigs. On the other hand, while cutting the wood, Satyavan developed headache. He said to her- “O damsel, I am feeling acute headacne. Therefore, I am going to sleep.”

## \|\| 3.102.46-47 \|\|

*viśramasva mahābāho sāvitrī prāha duḥkhitā \|*  
*paścādupagamiṣyāmi svāśramaṃ śramanāśanam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*yāvadutsaṃgake kṛtvā śira āste mahītale \|*  
*tāvaddadarśa sāvitrī puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇapiṃgalam \|*  
*kirīṭinaṃ pītavastraṃ sākṣātsūryamivoditam \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. Feeling painful for him, she said- “You kindly have some rest. We shall return to the asrama after sometime. As soon as Savitri placed his head in her lap, she found a black complexioned person there, who was adorned with a kirita crown and yellow garments, and appeared like the Sungod.

## \|\| 3.102.48-49 \|\|

*tamuvācātha sāvitrī praṇamya madhupiṃgalam \|*  
*kastvaṃ devo'tha vā daityo māṃ dharṣayitumāgataḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*na cāhaṃ kenacicchakyā svadharmādavaropitum \|*  
*spraṣṭuṃ vā puruṣaśreṣṭha dīptā vahniśikhā yathā \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. Offering her salutation to him, Savitri said to him- “Are you a god or a daitya, having arrived here for damaging me? О best of the humans, no one can make me fall from my dharma, nor can anyone touch me like the fire flame.”

## \|\| 3.102.50-53 \|\|

*yama uvāca \|*  
*yamaḥ saṃyamanaścāsmi sarvalokabhayaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*kṣīṇāyureṣa te bhartā taṃ nayāmi pativrate \|*  
*na śakyaḥ kiṃkarairnetumato'haṃ svayamāgataḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*evamuktvā satyavataḥ śarīrātpāśasaṃcayaiḥ \|*  
*aṃguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ niścakarṣa yamo balāt \|*  
*atha prayātumārebhe paṃthānaṃ pitṛsevitam \|\| 51 \|\|*
