*sāvitryapi varārohā pṛṣṭhato' nujagāma ha \|*  
*pativratāṃ tathā śrāṃtāṃ tāmuvāca yamastadā \|\| 52 \|\|*

*nivarta gaccha sāvitri svagṛhe tvamihāgatā \|*  
*eṣa mārgo viśālākṣi na kenāpyanugamyate \|\| 53 \|\|*

50-53. Yama said- “O chaste lady, I happen to be the awful controller of the sinful people and am known as Yama. The age of your husband Satyavan has come to an end. Therefore, I have arrived here to carry him to Yamapuri. My messengers were unable to carry him. Therefore, I have arrived here myself.” Thus speaking and applying his force, Yama took out a figure of the size of a thumb out of the body of Satyavan. Thereafter, following the path of manes, he got ready to move ahead. But the chaste Savitri followed him. Finding the chaste lady quite peaceful, Yama said to her- “O Savitri with vast eyes, you better return to your abode. Why are you following me? No one else can travel by this way.”

## \|\| 3.102.54-56 \|\|

*sāvitryuvāca \|*  
*na śramo na ca me glāniḥ kadācidapi jāyate \|*  
*bhartāramanugacchaṃti yāstāsāṃ na śramādayaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*satāṃ saṃto gatirnānyā strīṇāṃ bhartā sadā gatiḥ \|*  
*vedo varṇāśramāṇāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāṃ ca gatirguruḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*sarveṣāmeva jaṃtūnāṃ sthānamasti mahītalam \|*  
*bhartāra eva manujastrīṇāṃ nānyaḥ samāśrayaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

54-56. Savitri said-1 am neither confused nordo I feel repentant, because when a wife follows her husband, she can neither gets confused nor painful. The noble people follow the noble people, while the husband is the only resort for the ladies, As the Vedas are the refuge for the people of all the various, the preceptor for the disciples, and the place for all the living beings is the earth, therefore, husband is the only refuge for the wife and none else.

## \|\| 3.102.57-58 \|\|

*evamanyaiśca vividhairvākyairddharmārthasaṃhitaiḥ \|*  
*tutoṣa sūryatanayaḥ sāvitrīṃ ceda mabravīt \|\| 57 \|\|*

*tuṣṭo'smi tava bhadraṃ te varaṃ varaya bhāmini \|*  
*sāvitryapi varānvavre vinayāvanatānanā \|\| 58 \|\|*

57-58. Hearing her talk on Dharma and Arlha, Yama felt extremely pleased and he said to Savitri- “0 damsel, welfare on to you. I am extremely pleased with your talk, therefore you ask for a boon. Then she desired for a boon with all humility.

## \|\| 3.102.59-60 \|\|

*cakṣuḥprāptistathā rājyaṃ śvasu rasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*pituḥ putraśataṃ caiva putrāṇāṃ śatamātmanaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*jīvitaṃ ca tathā bhartudharmasiddhiśca śāśvatī \|*  
*dharmarājo varāndattvā preṣayāmāsa tāṃ tataḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. She said- “My parent-in-law should regain his eyesight, with his kingdom. He should have a hundred sons and those sons should also have a hundred sons each. My husband should also get back his life and should always remain devoted to dharma. Dharmaraja then granted her the desired boon and sent her back to her abode.

## \|\| 3.102.61-62 \|\|

*atha bhartāramāsādya sāvitrī hṛṣṭamānasā \|*  
*jagāma sāśramapadaṃ saha bhartrā nirākulā \|\| 61 \|\|*

*bhādrasya paurṇamāsyāṃ tu yathā cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ tvidam \|*  
*māhātmyamasya nṛpate kathitaṃ sakalaṃ mayā \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. Savitri was extremely pleased by getting her husband back. Thereafter, together with her husband, she proceeded on to her asrama. Thus, О king, on the full moon day of the month of Bhadrapada, this vrata has to be performed, the details of which have been spoken by me.

## \|\| 3.102.63-64 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kīdṛśaṃ tadvrataṃ deva sāvitryā yadanuṣṭhitam \|*  
*tasminbhādrapade māsi siddhānnaṃ tasya kīdṛśam \|\| 63 \|\|*

*kā devatā vrate tasminbrūhi kāmaṃ prati prabho \|*  
*savistaraṃ hṛṣīkeśa brūhi dharmaṃ sanātanam \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. Yudhisthira said- О lord, the vrata, which had been performed by Savitri in the month of Bhadrapada, what is the form of the same? What type of the food is taken in that vrata? О lord, О Hrsikesa, in order to get one’s desire fulfilled, which one of the god is adored during the vrata? You kindly tell me about the eternal dharma.

## \|\| 3.102.65-67 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śrūyatāṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha sāvitrīvratamādarāt \|*  
*kathayāmi kathaṃ cīrṇaṃ tayā satyā yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 65 \|\|*

*trayodaśyāṃ bhādrapade daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam \|*  
*trirātraṃ niyamaḥ kāryaṃ upavāsasya bhārata \|\| 66 \|\|*

*aśaktyā tu trayodaśyāṃ naktaṃ kuryājjitendriyaḥ \|*  
*ayācitaṃ caturdaśyāmupavāsena pūrṇimām \|\| 67 \|\|*

65-67. Sri Krsna said- О best of the Pandava race, О Yudhi?thira, I am respectful of revealing the method in which Savitri had performed the vrata. You listen to me quite carefully. О Bharata, on the bright trayodasi, the thirteenth moon day of the month of Bhadrapada, right from the brushing of the teeth with tooth stick, the procedure of vrata for three nights has to be followed. In case the fasting is not possible, the food should be taken on the day of trayodasi alone at night On the day of caturdasi (fourteenth moon day), the food of cereals should be taken.

## \|\| 3.102.68 \|\|

*nityaṃ snātvā mahānadyāṃ taḍāge cātha nirjhare \|*  
*viśeṣaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu snānaṃ sarṣapamṛjjalaiḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. One should daily take bath (during the vrata) in a river, a lake or a spring and on the full moon day, special bath should be taken with clay mixed with mustard seeds.

## \|\| 3.102.69-71 \|\|

*gṛhītvā tilakānpātre prasthamātraṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*atha vā dhānyamādāya yavaśālitilādikam \|\| 69 \|\|*

*tato vaṃśamaye pātre vastrayugmena veṣṭayet \|*  
*sāvitrīpratimāṃ kṛtvā sarvāvayavaśobhanām \|\| 70 \|\|*

*sauvarṇī mṛnmayīṃ vāpi svaśaktyā raupyanirmitām \|*  
*raktavastrayugaṃ dadyātsāvitryai brahmaṇe tathā \|\| 71 \|\|*

69-71. Sesamum seeds, cereals, barley or the Sal! (or wild) rice should be offered, which should be covered with the cloth. Or keeping the Sail rice, it should be covered with two pieces of clothes. Thereafter, as per one’s means, an image of Savitri should be made in gold, silver or pottery, which should be quite beautiful. It should be duly consecrated. Brahma and Savitri should be placed there, covered with the red cloth.

## \|\| 3.102.72 \|\|

*sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇā sārddhamevaṃ bhaktyā prapūjayet \|*  
*gaṃdhaiḥ sugaṃdhipuṣpaiśca dhūpanaivedyadīpakaiḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Then both Brahma and Savitri should be worshipped, offering with devotion the fragrant flowers, incense, lamp and eatables.

## \|\| 3.102.73-75 \|\|

*pūrṇaiḥ kośātakairbhakṣyaiḥ kūṣmāṃḍaiḥ karkaṭīphalaiḥ \|*  
*nālikeraiśca kharjūraiḥ kapisthairdāḍimīphalaiḥ \|\| 73 \|\|*

*jaṃbūjaṃbīranāraṃgaiḥ karkaṭaiḥ panasaistathā \|*  
*jīrakaiḥ kaṭukhaṃḍaiśca guḍena lavaṇena ca \|\| 74 \|\|*

*virūḍhaiḥ saptadhānyaiśca vaṃśapātre prakalpitaiḥ \|*  
*rājanyā sūtrakaṃṭaiśca śubhaiḥ kuṃkumakeśaraiḥ \|\| 75 \|\|*

73-75. All the eatables of Kosataki like pumpkin, gourd, coconut, date palm, Kapittha, pomegranate, rose apple, lemon, orange, jack fruit, cumin seeds, Katukhanda, raw sugar and salt, besides the eatables should be served. The flesh sprouts of the cereals, rajanya, sutrakanta, besides the auspicious vermilion and saffron should be used in decorating the bamboo vase.

## \|\| 3.102.76-77 \|\|

*avatāravatītyevaṃ sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā \|*  
*tāmarcayeta maṃtreṇa sāvitrīṃ brāhmaṇaḥ svayam \|*  
*itareṣāṃ purāṇoktamaṃtro'tra samudāhṛtaḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

*oṃkārapūrvake devi vīṇāpustaka dhāriṇi \|*  
*vedamātarnamastubhyamavaidhavyaṃ prayaccha me \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. The goddess Savitri should be consecrated therein. Savitri - the incarnated goddess - the beloved of Brahma, should be worshipped with the reciting of the Vedic hymns by the Brahmana themselves. The other people should adore her with the reciting of the Pauranic mantra singing- “I offer my salutation to the goddess Savitri with Omkara. She carries in her hand a vina, a book and destroys the widowhood. She is said to be the mother of the Vedas.”

## \|\| 3.102.78-80 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivajjāgaraṃ kārayettataḥ \|*  
*gītavāditraśabdena hyaṣṭatārīkadaṃbakaiḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

*nṛtyahāsairnayedrātriṃ pṛṣṭhataśca kathānakaiḥ \|*  
*sāvitryākhyānakaṃ vāpi vācayeddvijasattamam \|*  
*yāvatprabhātasamayaṃ gītyā bhāvarasaiḥ samam \|\| 79 \|\|*

*tataḥ prabhāte vimala uṣaḥkāle hyupasthite \|*  
*brāhmaṇe vedaviduṣi sāvitrīṃ vinivedayet \|\| 80 \|\|*

78-80. Thus performing the worship of Savitri in a proper manner, the night should be spent, while remaining awake by singing and dancing with music. During the night, the related stories should be listened to. Soon learned Brahmana should be engaged to narrate the episode of Savitri. On the next morning, the image of Savitri should be given over to a learned Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas.

## \|\| 3.102.81 \|\|

*yathā sāvitrakalpajñe sāvitryākhyānavācake \|*  
*daivajña uṃcchavṛttau ca daridre cāgnihotriṇi \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. The way the Brahmanas possessing knowledge of the Savitri-kalpa or the reciter of the story of Savitri are honoured, similarly, the astrologer who earns his living from the collecting of seeds from the fields and the poor Agnihotri should also be similarly honoured.

## \|\| 3.102.82-83 \|\|

*maṃtreṇānena kauṃteya praṇamya vidhipūrvakam \|*  
*darbhākṣatatilairmiśrā pūrvāśābhimukhāsthitā \|*  
*sudhī vipravaro vipra oṃkārasvastipūrvake \|\| 82 \|\|*

*sāvitrīyaṃ mayā dattā sahiraṇyā mahāsatī \|*  
*brahmaṇaḥ prīṇanārthāya brāhmaṇa pratigṛhyatām \|\| 83 \|\|*

82-83. О son of Kunti, reciting the mantras, the image of Savitri should be given over to a learned Brahmana. Besides that, the Ый, unbroken rice and the sesamum seeds are spread, which are placed over a seat where the image of the goddess should be placed facing the east. While giving over the image to the Brahmana, one should say- “O Brahmana, reciting Svasti with Omkara, you accept this image for the pleasure of Brahma.”

## \|\| 3.102.84 \|\|

*evaṃ dattvā dvijeṃdrāya sāvitrīṃ tāṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*naivedyādi ca tatsarvaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ svagṛhaṃ nayet \|*  
*svayaṃ daśapadaṃ gacchetsvaveśma punarāviśet \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. O Yudhisthira, when the image of Savitri is given over to a Brahmana, he should cany the same to his house together with the eatables and other things. At that point of time, the yajamana (the performer) should walk upto ten feet at least with the Brahmana, in his honour and then return to his own place.

## \|\| 3.102.85-87 \|\|

*tatra bhuktvā haviṣyānnaṃ brāhmaṇairbāṃdhavaiḥ saha \|*  
*visarjayettato viprānsāvitrī prīyatāmiti \|\| 85 \|\|*

*paṃcadaśyāṃ tathā jyeṣṭhe vaṭake ca mahāsatī \|*  
*trirātropoṣitā nārī vidhinānena pūjayet \|\| 86 \|\|*

*sārddhaṃ satyavatā sādhvī phalanaivedyadīpakaiḥ \|*  
*paṭṭāvalaṃbanaṃ kṛtvā kāṣṭhabhāraṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 87 \|\|*

85-87. Thereafter, all the Brahmanas should be sent off, saying- “Let the goddess Savitri be pleased.” O Yudhisthira, on the full moon day of the month of Jyestha, a lady should perform this vrata, under the shade of a banyan tree. Behind the curtain, a bunch of wood as Satyavan with Savitri should be worshipped, offering eatables, fruit, lamp and other things.

## \|\| 3.102.88 \|\|

*rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā nṛtyagītapurassaraiḥ \|*  
*prabhāte vidhinā pūrvaṃ pūrvoktena narottamaḥ \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyātpraṇipatya kṣamāpayet \|\| 88 \|\|*

88\. After completing the worship, the night should be spent while singing and dancing and in the early morning, the image etc. should be given over to the Brahmanas with respect and then beg forgiveness.

## \|\| 3.102.89 \|\|

*etattu te vratamidaṃ kathitaṃ vidhivanmayā \|*  
*yāścariṣyaṃti lokesminputrapautrasamanvitāḥ \|*  
*bhuktvā bhogāṃściraṃ bhūmau yāsyaṃti brahmaṇaḥ padam \|\| 89 \|\|*

89\. Thus, I have narrated the performing of the vrata in an appropriate manner. Such of the ladies who perform the Triratra vrata, they enjoy all the comforts with their sons and the grandsons for long and finally, achieve Brahmapada.

## \|\| 3.102.90 \|\|

*etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam \|*  
*japatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sāvitrīvratamādarāt \|\| 90 \|\|*

90\. A person who listens to or do japam duirng this Savitri vrata, all his sins and the evil dreams get destroyed and he earns auspicious merit.

## \|\| 3.102.91 \|\|

*smṛtyarthavedajananīṃ sahaśaṃbhujāyāṃ saṃpūjayediha trirātrakṛtopavāsā \|*  
*sāvitrivatpitṛkulaṃ ca tathā svabharturuddhārayecca vibhunakti ciraṃ sukhāni \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. In case, Savitri, who is the mother of the Vedas and Sastras is worshipped with Parvati, all of them redeem the races of the parents as well as that of the husband, and the performer enjoys all the comforts for long.

## Chapter 103. Kirti-Krttika Vrata

## \|\| 3.103.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*pūrvamāsītkṛtayuge kṣatriṇī bahuputriṇī \|*  
*nāmnā kaliṃgabhadreti rūpalāvaṇyasaṃyutā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tuṃgastanī padmanetrā haṃsanāgendragāminī \|*  
*saubhāgyaguṇasaṃpūrṇā caṃdrabiṃbanibhānanā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*dhanaratnaiśca saṃpūrṇā madhyadeśe vṛṣasthale \|*  
*rājñaḥ patnī tu sā devī dilīpasya mahātmanaḥ \|*  
*kaliṅgabhadrā lalitā mahādevī guṇānvitā \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Sri Krsna said- In earlier times, there had been a queen known by the name of Kalingabhadra, having a number of sons. She was quite charming and beautiful. She had raised breasts, the eyes resembling the lotus flowers and she walked like the king of elephants as well as the swan. She was virtuous and possessed all the qualities of great fortunes. The lotus faced queen was the wife of the king Dilipa of Vrsasthala in Madhyadesa, whose treasure was filled with wealth as well as the gems. The virtuous queen besides being a paragon of beauty, was also highly chaste and devoted to her husband.

## \|\| 3.103.4-5 \|\|

*mahāprasādaṃ manvānā bahumānapurassaram \|*  
*brāhmaṇebhyaśca dānāni prayacchati mahāsatī \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tyāgasaṃbhogasaubhāgye dvitīyā naiva tādṛśī \|*  
*nārīṇāṃ tu naraśreṣṭha dilīpasya yathā vidhā \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. She gave away huge charities to the Brahmanas like Mahaprasada. Kalingabhadra - the beloved of the king Dilipa, had no parallel woman in the world in the field of enjoying the conjugal pleasures, detachment and fortunes.

## \|\| 3.103.6-7 \|\|

*yathā ca kārttike māsi gṛhītaṃ kṣattrayāvratam \|*  
*ṣaṇmāsena vrataṃ yāvadidaṃ saṃcintya cetasi \|*  
*pāritaṃ ca tayā sarvaṃ kiṃcinmātraṃ tu vartate \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pāraṇepāraṇe vāpi purāṇajñe dvijottame \|*  
*udyāpanaṃ prayacchaṃtī kālaṃ nayati sundarī \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Thinking that the vrata would be completed in six months, she started the Ksatrika vrata in the month of Kartika. But even after completing the major part of the vrata, a part of it was left out. At each time of the breaking of the fast, the paragon of beauty gave away the Brahmanas the charities in Udyapana, while honouring them.

## \|\| 3.103.8 \|\|

*kadācidardharātre tu suptā bhartrā sahaiva sā \|*  
*daṣṭā sarpeṇa raudreṇa jagāma nidhanaṃ kṣaṇāt \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Thus spending quite a comfortable life she was once sleeping with her husband, when she met with her death with a snake bite. As a result of this, the said paragon of beauty had to be reborn as a female goat.

## \|\| 3.103.9-11 \|\|

*tena doṣeṇa sā bālā ajāyonau hyajāyata \|*  
*vanecarī dharmaparā pūrvajātismarā dṛḍhā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva gṛhītaṃ kṛttikāvratam \|*  
*vyastā yūthaparibhraṣṭā upavāsaparisthitā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*parakṣetreṇa gacchaṃtī ajā sasyāvamarddanī \|*  
*kārttikyāṃ galake baddhvā grāmyakeṇa cirāgatā \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. As a female goat, she kept on wandering in the forest. Because of her old noble deeds, she could retain her past memories. Therefore, she started performing the Krttika, vrata. She separated herself from her herd and started fasting. She stopped grazing in the fields of others. And on the same day of the full moon, she reached in his house.

## \|\| 3.103.12-14 \|\|

*dṛṣṭātriṇā mahābhāgā pūrvajātismareṇa sā \|*  
*kāraṇaṃ budhya tāṃ buddhvā sahakāliṃdabhadrikām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*mokṣitā badarībaddhā caraṃtī kṛttikāvratam \|*  
*gopālabaṃdhanātsādhvī anirvedaparā tu sā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*saṃprāpya badarīpatraṃ pītvā puṣkariṇī payaḥ \|*  
*mametyuktvā hyasaṃbhrāṃtā pārayāmāsa tadvratam \|*  
*tasyai yogaṃ tato dattvā jagāmātristapovanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. After a long time, the sage Atri passed by that way and spotted the goat, who also recognized the Maharsi, because of her earlier memory. She also indicated to him, being in bondage. The Maharsi also realizing that the goat was none else than Kalingabhadra of the earlier birth, he freed her from the bondage under the jujube tree. The chaste queen having been kept in bondage by a cowherd, felt painful because of her unfinished vrata. Getting free from the bondage, she ate the leaf of Jujube tree and drank water at a lake of lotus flowers. Then saying- “This is mine,” with a confused mind, she completed the unfinished vrata. Then the Maharsi Atri enlightened her on the yogic practices and then retired to tapovana.

## \|\| 3.103.15 \|\|

*sāpi yogeśvarī bhūtvā niṃditvā janma cātmanaḥ \|*  
*tatyāja yogātsvānprāṇānprasthitā gautamasya hi \|*  
*ṛṣerbabhūva duhitā hyahalyāgarbhasundarī \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Becoming Yogesvari by following the yogic practices, she denounced her earlier birth and then ended her life by means of the yogic practices. In due course of time, she was reborn as Ahalya - the wife of Gautama. A beautiful daughter was bom from the womb of Ahalya.

## \|\| 3.103.16-18 \|\|

*yogalakṣmīti nāmnā sā kanyā guṇagaṇairyutā \|*  
*vidyeva dattā sā pitrā śāṃḍilyāya maharṣaye \|*  
*tapodhanāya dāṃtāya nityaṃ sahacarī babhau \|\| 16 \|\|*

*brāhmalakṣmyā dīpyamānā sākṣādvedasmṛtiryathā \|*  
*sarasvatī ca svāhā ca śacī cārundhatī yathā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*gaurī rājñī tathā lakṣmīrgāyatrī cottamā satī \|*  
*mahālakṣmīstathā rājañchāṇḍilyasya gṛhe babhau \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. The newly born daughter was given the name of Yogalaksmi. The girl who possessed all the virtues was given over to Maharsi Sandilya as his wife. Like the female companion of the Vedas, she became illustrious. Like Brahmalaksmi, she started living with Maharsi Sandilya as his wife. She became Mahalaksmi in the abode of Sandilya like Sarasvati, Svaha, Saci, Arundhati, Gauri, Rajni - the wife of the Sun and the extremely chaste Gayatri.

## \|\| 3.103.19-21 \|\|

*pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ nityaṃ śuśrūṣaṇe ratā \|*  
*atha tenātriṇā dṛṣṭā punargarbhavatī gṛhe \|\| 19 \|\|*

*bhaktyā bhikṣāṃ prayacchaṃtī brāhmaṇānāmaniṃditā \|*  
*yogādviditvā tāmūce bhagavānpūrvavacchanaiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*yogalakṣmi mahābhāge vartaṃte kati kṛttikāḥ \|*  
*sāpi jātismarā prāha bhagavaṃtaṃ mahāsatī \|*  
*ṣaḍvartaṃte mahāyoginnekā paravaśe sthitā \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. She served the manes, gods and guests regularly. When she was pregnant, she once again met with Maharsi Atri, when she was giving away charities to the Brahmanas with devotion. Maharsi Atri atonce recognized her and asked her slowly- “O excellent Yogalaksmi, how many Krttikas have passed?” She also recalled the events of her earlier birth and said- “O lord, O Mahayogi, there are six at present and one of them is under the influence of others.”

## \|\| 3.103.22-23 \|\|

*tacchrutvāsyai bhagavatā sakāruṇyena cetasā \|*  
*dattaṃ vrataṃ tathā mantro yena svargaṃ jagāma sā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*iha bhuktvā ciraṃ bhogānputrapautraśriyā vṛtā \|*  
*tataḥ sā tatpadaṃ prāptā punarāvṛttidurlabham \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. On hearing these words, lord Atri became filled with compassion. Therafter, completing her vrata and enjoying all the pleasures with her sons and grandsons for a long time, she then reached the place from where no one returns.

## \|\| 3.103.24 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kīdṛśaṃ tadvrataṃ kṛṣṇa maṃtraścāpi janārdana \|*  
*vidhānaṃ kṛttikānāṃ ca taṃ ca kālaṃ vadasva me \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Yudhisthira said- O Krsna, O Janardana, you kindly tell me exhaustively about the Krttika vrata and how is it performed?

## \|\| 3.103.25-26 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*kṛttikāsu svayaṃ somaḥ kṛttikāsu bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*yadā syātsomavāreṇa sā mahākārtikī smṛtā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*īdṛśī bahubhirvarṣairbahupuṇyaiśca labhyate \|*  
*tathā sā na vṛthā neyā yadīcchecchreya ātmanaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Sri Krsna said- The Moon and Brhaspati both dwell in the Krttikas. When a Krttika falls on monday, she is said to be Mahakarttiki, which can be achieved only with merits earned for many years. Therefore, a person, who is desirous of his own welfare, should not allow it to be wasted.

## \|\| 3.103.27-31 \|\|

*anyāpi kārtikī pārtha samupoṣya vidhānataḥ \|*  
*tasyā vidhānaṃ rājendra śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhava \|\| 27 \|\|*

*kārttike śuklapakṣasya pūrṇamāsyāṃ dinodaye \|*  
*naktāya niyamaṃ kuryāddantadhāvanapūrvakam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*upavāsasya vā śaktyā tataḥ snātvā jalāśaye \|*  
*kurukṣetre prayāge vā puṣkare naimiṣe tathā \|\| 29 \|\|*

*śālagrāme kuśāvarte mūlasthāne sakuntale \|*  
*gokarṇe vārbude puṇye'tha vāpyamarakaṃṭake \|\| 30 \|\|*

*pure vā nagare vāpi grāme ghoṣe'tha pattane \|*  
*yatra vā tatra vā snāyānnaro yoṣidathāpi vā \|*  
*devarṣipitṛpūjāṃ ca kṛtvā homaṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 31 \|\|*

27-31. O Partha, the second method of Kartika's performance is being narrated by me, which you please listen with attention. On the full moon day of the month of Kartika, one should brush his teeth in the early morning and all the procedures upto the night should be followed, by oath. In case a person is unable to observe the fast, one should take bath at Kuruksetra, Prayaga, Puskara, Naimisa, Salagram, Kusavarta, Sakuntala, Mulasthana, Gokarna, Arbuda or the auspicious Amarkantaka or any other lake or river in the city or in one’s own home. Thereafter, the man or the woman should worship the gods, rsis, the manes, performing the homa at the same time.

## \|\| 3.103.32 \|\|

*tato'stasamaye prāpte pātraṃ gavyasya sarpiṣaḥ \|*  
*kṣīrasya vā susaṃpūrṇaṃ kṛtvā guḍaphalānvitam \|*  
*ṣaṭpramāṇaṃ yathā vyomni kṛttikāśakaṭaṃ nyaset \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Then at the time of the sunset, cow’s ghi or the milk with raw sugar, besides the fruits, should be placed in a vase and divided in six parts, and should be offered to the Krttikasakata in the sky.

## \|\| 3.103.33-34 \|\|

*ṣaṭkṛttikānāṃ biṃbāni svarṇaraupyamayāni ca \|*  
*ratnagarbhāṇi kuryācca svaśaktyā pāṇḍunandana \|\| 33 \|\|*

*prathamā svarṇaniṣpannā dvitīyā raupyakīkṛtā \|*  
*tṛtīyā ratnaghaṭitā caturthī navanītajā \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. O son of the race of Pandu, six figures of Krttikas should be made in gold or silver studded with gems. As per one’s means, the first figure should be of gold, the second should be of silver, the third of gems and the fourth one should be of butter.

## \|\| 3.103.35-36 \|\|

*pañcamī kaṇikānyūnā ṣaṣṭhī piṣṭamayī kṛtā \|*  
*ṣaṭ kṛttikāḥ kṛtabiṃbāḥ kṛtvālaktakasūtrikāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*ratnagarbhāḥ kuṃkumāktāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ stabakānvitāḥ \|*  
*siṃdūracandanābhyaktā jātīpuṣpai supūjitāḥ \|*  
*maṃtreṇānena rājendra dvijāya pratipādayet \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. The fifth should be of wheat-flour and the sixth should be of pudding. All of them should be studded with gems and decorated with vermilion or the red paint. Their back sides should be decorated with the bunch of flowers. O Rajendra, the vermilion, sandal paste and the jasmine flowers should be offered while worshipping the deity and the same should be given over to an excellent Brahmana. At the time of offering the image, the following mantra should be recited.

## \|\| 3.103.37-39 \|\|

*oṃ saptarṣidārā hyanalasya vallabhā yā brahmaṇā rakṣitayeti yuktāḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭāḥ kumārasya yathārthamātaro mamāpi suprītatarā bhavaṃtusvāhā \|\| 37 \|\|*

*evamuccārya viprāya pradeyāḥ kṛttikā nṛpa \|*  
*brāhmaṇopi pratīccheta maṃtreṇāneva pāṃḍava \|\| 38 \|\|*

*dharmadāḥ kāmakāḥ saṃtu imā nakṣatramātaraḥ \|*  
*kṛttikā durgasaṃsārāttārayaṃtvāvayoḥ kulam \|\| 39 \|\|*

37-39. “O mothers, you were pleased with Kumara Karttikeya, the wives of the seven Rsis and the beloved of Agni. You are protected by Brahma, you may kindly be pleased with me similarly.” This mantra should start with Omkara and end with the word Svaha. Similarly, the Atigrahi Brahmana, at the time of the receiving of the images, should say- “The Krttikas who made the dharma and the desires successful, who are the creators of the constellations, let them redeem both our families from the ocean of the universe.”

## \|\| 3.103.40 \|\|

*anena vidhinā dattvā dṛṣṭvā caivāṃbare sthitāḥ \|*  
*visṛjya brāhmaṇānbhaktyā cānuvrajya padāni ṣaṭ \|*  
*nivartya ca kathārthaṃ tu śṛṇuyātphalamāpnuyāt \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. By giving away the images in this way, one should look at the sky to spot them. The Brahmana should then be sent off. At the same time, in order to honour them, one should walk with them for six steps. On returning home, the merit one earns on recalling the true episodes related to the vrata, I am going to speak out the same. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.103.41-42 \|\|

*vimānenārkavarṇena gatvā nakṣatramaṃḍalam \|*  
*divyena vapuṣā yuktaḥ srakcaṃdanavibhūṣitaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*divyanārīgaṇavṛtaḥ sukhaṃ bhuṃkte hyanāmayam \|*  
*dodhūyamānaścamarai ratnapaṃktyā virājitaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Boarding the plane having the lustre of the Sun, the performer moves through the constellations. At that point of time, he possess a divine body adorned with the garland and decorated with sandal paste and enjoys the best of comforts, when served by the divine damsels. The flywhisks are moved one both his sides and heaps of gems are found with him.

## \|\| 3.103.43-44 \|\|

*pārijātakamaṃdārapuṣpabhāropaśobhitaḥ \|*  
*kṛtārthaḥ paripūrṇāśastiṣṭhedābhūtasaṃplavam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*tārāḥ kṛtvā vratāṃte vā gatvā svargaṃ sabhartṛkā \|*  
*ramate nirbhayā sādhvī sarvabhogasamanvitā \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. He has the garland of Parijata and Mandara (swallow-wart) flowers adorning his body and he remains with delight having all his desires fulfilled, upto the time of the grave dissolution. At the end of the vrata, if the figures of constellations are given away in charity, all of them with their husbands reach the heaven and like the auspicious and chaste women, enjoy all the comforts.

## \|\| 3.103.45-46 \|\|

*yaścaitackṛṇuyātpārtha bhaktiyuktaḥ samādhinā \|*  
*nārī vā puruṣo vāpi mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*sauvarṇaraupyamaṇigonavanītasiddhāḥ ṣaṭ kṛttikāḥ kaṇikapiṣṭamayīśca kṛtvā \|*  
*pātre nidhāya kusumākṣatadhūpadīpaiḥ saṃpūjya janmagahanaṃ na viśaṃti martyāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. О Partha, with a concentrated mind, they are freed from all the sins. Thus, the figures of the Krttikas in gold, silver, gems, the cow’s butter, wheat flour or the pudding should be made and placed in individual vases. Then the flowers, unbroken rice, incense and lamp should be offered while worshipping them. The people who do so, they do not have to face the painful situation of rebirth.

## Chapter 104. Purna-manoratha Vrata

## \|\| 3.104.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*pañcadaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe phālgunasya narottama \|*  
*pākhaṃḍānpatitāṃścaiva tathaivāntyāvasāyinaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*nāstikānbhinnavṛttāṃśca pāpino naiva cālapet \|*  
*nārāyaṇe gatamanāḥ puruṣo hi jitendriyaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tiṣṭhanvrajanpraskhalanvā bhuṃjānopi janārdanam \|*  
*kīrtayecca kriyākāle saptakṛtvo mahīpate \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Sri Krsna said- O best of the humans, on the full moon day of the month of Phalguna, a cheat, a fallen man, a Sudra, an atheist and one who earns living by means not permitted by his own caste, or the sinful persons, should not be encouraged for talk. Controlling all the sense organs, devoting his mind with devotion in Narayana while studying, walking, falling and getting up, sitting or eating and drinking and while engaged in performing the other activities, one should recite the name of Narayana. Thus performing the kirtana during seven praharas. Lord Janardana should be mentally worshipped.

## \|\| 3.104.4-6 \|\|

*lakṣmyā samanvitaṃ devamarcayecca janārdanam \|*  
*saṃdhyādyuparame candrasvarūpaṃ harimīśvaram \|*  
*rātrau ca lakṣmīṃ saṃcintya samyagargheṇa pūjayeta \|\| 4 \|\|*

*śrīniśākararūpastvaṃ vāsudeva jagatpate \|*  
*manobhilaṣitaṃ deva pūrayasva namonamaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*maṃtreṇānena dattvārghaṃ devadevasya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*naktaṃ bhuñjīta na svairaṃ tailakṣāravivarjitam \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. After performing the Sandhya-vandana, devoting one’s mind to lord Visnu with a moon like face, he should be worshipped attentively. During the night, one should devote his mind in Laksmi and the arghya should be offered reciting this mantra “0 Vasudeva, O lord of the universe, you have the face resembling the Moon who is the lord of night. Therefore, O lord, you fulfill my desire. I offer my salutation to you again and again.” Thus offering the arghya to lord Visnu who is the god of gods, he should take light food at night which should be free from oil.

## \|\| 3.104.7-8 \|\|

*tathaiva caitre vaiśākhe jyeṣṭhe ca nṛpasattama \|*  
*arcayecca yathāproktaṃ māsimāsi ca taddine \|\| 7 \|\|*

*niṣpāditaṃ bhavedekaṃ pāraṇaṃ pārtha śaktitaḥ \|*  
*dvitīyaṃ cāpi vakṣyāmi pāraṇaṃ te narottama \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. O excellent king, similarly, in the months of Caitra, Vaisakha and Jyestha, on the full moon day, after worshiping lord Visnu in the aforesaid manner, at the end of the third month, one should break his fast in the manner already prescribed. Thus, this happens to the first breaking of the fast. Now I am speaking about the second one. You please listen. not permitted by his own caste, or the sinful persons, should not be encouraged for talk. Controlling all the sense organs, devoting his mind with devotion in Narayana while studying, walking, falling and getting up, sitting or eating and drinking and while engaged in performing the other activities, one should recite the name of Narayana. Thus performing the kirtana during seven praharas. Lord Janardana should be mentally worshipped.

## \|\| 3.104.9 \|\|

*āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe māsi prāpte bhādrapade tathā \|*  
*tathaivāśvayujebhyarcya śrīdharaṃ priyayā saha \|*  
*arghaṃ candramase dattvā bhuñjātātha yathāvidhi \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. During the months of Asadha, Sravana, Bhadrapada, Sravana and the Asvina months, lord Sridhara should be worshipped with Laksmi, offering arghya (oblation) to the Moon. Thereafter, he should break his fast and take food thereafter. Thus the second breaking of the fast has been spoken out. Now I am speaking about the third parana. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.104.10-11 \|\|

*dvitīyametadākhyātaṃ tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*kārtikādiṣu māseṣu tathaivābhyarcya keśavam \|*  
*bhūtyā samanvitaṃ dadyācchaśāṃkāya tathā niśi \|\| 10 \|\|*

*bhuñjīta ca yathākhyātaṃ tṛtīyaṃ pāraṇaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*pratipūjya tato dadyādbrāhmaṇebhyaśca dakṣiṇām \|*  
*pratimāsaṃ ca vakṣyāmi prāśanaṃ kāyaśuddhaye \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. During the four months like Kartika and others, lord Kesava has to be adored. During the night, arghya should be offered to the Moon. Thereafter, he should break his fast. After telling about the performing of the parana (breaking of the fast), I am now speaking about the things to be used for the breaking of the fast. You please listen. Initially, after worshipping lord Visnu and giving away daksina to the Brahmanas, one should consume the things prescribed by me for the purification of the body.

## \|\| 3.104.12 \|\|

*caturaḥ prathamānmāsānpañcagavyamudāhṛtam \|*  
*kuśodakaṃ tathaivānyaduktaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. During the group of four months starting from Phalguna, pancagavya has to be used for parana; during the second group of four months, kusa water should be used.

## \|\| 3.104.13 \|\|

*sūryāṃśutaptaṃ tadvacca jalaṃ kāyaviśodhanam \|*  
*gītavādyādikaṃ rātrau tathā kṛṣṇakathāṃ śubhām \|*  
*kārayeccaiva devasya pāraṇepāraṇe gate \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. During the third group of four months, the water over which the Sun rays have fallen, should be used for the purpose of the parana for the purification of the body. During each one of the parana, the programme of singing and music should be held. Thereafter, the auspicious stories of Sri Kr§na should be heard.

## \|\| 3.104.14 \|\|

*janārdanaṃ sapatnīkamarcayetprathamaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*saśrīkaṃ śrīdharaṃ tadvattṛtīye bhūtikeśavau \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. During the months of the first parana, lord Janardana with Laksmi should be worshipped. During the second parana months, lord Sridhara should be worshipped with the goddess Sri. During the months of the third parana, Kesava should be worshipped with Bhuti.

## \|\| 3.104.15 \|\|

*pratimāsaṃ tu nāmāni kṛṣṇasyaitāni bhārata \|*  
*kṛtopavāsaḥ susnātaḥ pūjayitvā janārdanam \|*  
*uccārayannaro yāti yathālokaṃ yathāsukham \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The samkirtana of three names of Sri Krsna should be performed and while fasting, the worship of lord Janardana should be done. One who, after worshipping the lord Janardana, perform samkirtana of his name, he achieves the best of the lokas and all his desires are fulfilled.

## \|\| 3.104.16 \|\|

*tato viprāya vai dadyādudakuṃbhaṃ sadakṣiṇam \|*  
*upānadvastrayugmaṃ ca cchatraṃ kanakameva ca \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. At the conclusion of the vrata, a pitcher filled with water, shoes, four costumes, the umbrella, the shoes as well as the gold should be given over to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.104.17-18 \|\|

*yadvai māsagataṃ nāma prīyatāmiti kīrtayet \|*  
*keśavaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu pauṣe nārāyaṇaṃ tathā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*mādhavaṃ māghamāse tu govindamapi phālgune \|*  
*caitramāse tathā viṣṇuṃ vaiśākhe madhusūdanam \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Then he should recite the name of the same lord, who is worshipped earlier. During the month of Margasirsa, Kesava is to be adored; during the month of Pausa, Narayana is to be adored; during the month of Magha, Madhava is to be adored; during the month of Phalguna, Govinda is to be adored. During the month of Caitra, lord Visnu is to be adored; during Vaisakha, Madhusudana is to be adored.

## \|\| 3.104.19-20 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhe trivikramo jñeyastathāṣāḍhe ca vāmanaḥ \|*  
*śrīdharaḥ śrāvaṇe tadvaddhṛṣīkeśeti cāparam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*rāmo bhādrapade māsi gīyate puṇyakāṃkṣibhiḥ \|*  
*padmanābhamāśvayuji dāmodaramataḥ param \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. During the month of Jyestha, Trivikrama is to be adored; during the month of Asadha, Vamana is to be adored. Sridhara is to be adored in the month of Sravana; Hrsikesa in the Bhadrapada; Padmanabha in Alvina besides Damodara.

## \|\| 3.104.21 \|\|

*kārtike devadeveśaṃ stuvaṃstarati durgatim \|*  
*evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte pratimāse kramoditam \|*  
*yadi dātuṃ na śaknoti dadyāccaivaikahelayā \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. During the month of Kartika, Devadevesa has to be adored. One he does so, then misfortunes never befall on him. Thus I have narrated the names of the gods, who are to be adored in each one of the months of the year. In case, a person is unable to give away the aforesaid types of the charities, then he can give up anyone of the above things.

## \|\| 3.104.22-24 \|\|

*viśeṣaścātra kathitaścandraṃ kṛtvā hiraṇmayam \|*  
*pūjayitvā phalairvastrairbrāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

*stuvannevaṃ vidhānena pāraṇe'bhyarcayetprabhum \|*  
*tāvaṃti janmānyasukhaṃ nāpnotīṣṭaviyogajam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*ihaiva svasthatāṃ prāpya maraṇe smaraṇaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*sthānaṃ tu mama saṃprāpya svargaloke mahīyate \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. I am also speaking about the special donations as well. You please listen. Getting a gold image of the Moon made, together with fruits and costumes, following the same process when a person donates the same, he enjoying all the comforts for many births, is never separated from his beloved. He remains quite hale and hearty during his present birth and ultimately enjoys all the comforts in the heaven, where also he is honoured as well.

## \|\| 3.104.25 \|\|

*tato mānuṣyamāsādya nirātaṃko gatajvaraḥ \|*  
*dhanadhānyavati sphīte janma sādhukulerhati \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. He is again bom as a human being in a high race and remains always free form worries, enjoying enough of wealth and cereals.

## \|\| 3.104.26 \|\|

*śrīśarvarī madhuni hā bhagavāñchaśāṃkaḥ saṃkalpya candanatilākṣatapuṣpamiśram \|*  
*yacchaṃti ye'rghamanayā nṛpa pūrṇimāyāṃ nūnaṃ bhavaṃti paripūrṇamanorathāste \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. On the full moon day, a samkalpa should be made in favour of the Moon god, offering him the sandal paste, sesamum seeds, unbroken rice with arghya of water mixed with flowers. The people who do so, they always have their desires fulfilled.

## Chapter 105. Visoka Purnima Vrata

## \|\| 3.105.1-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*aśokapūrṇimāṃ cānyāṃ śṛṇuṣva gadato mama \|*  
*yāmupoṣya narāḥ śokaṃ nāpnuvaṃti kadācana \|\| 1 \|\|*

*phālgunāmalapakṣasya paurṇamāsyāṃ narottama \|*  
*mṛjjalena naraḥ snātvā dattvā śirasi vai mṛdam \|*  
*mṛtprāśanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kṛtvā ca sthaṃḍilaṃ mṛdā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*puṣpaiḥ patraistathābhyarcya bhūdharaṃ nāma nāmataḥ \|*  
*dharaṇīṃ ca tathā devīmaśoketyabhikīrtayet \|\| 3 \|\|*

*yathā viśokāṃ dharaṇe kṛtavāṃstvāṃ janārdanaḥ \|*  
*tathā māṃ sarvaśokebhyo mocayāśeṣadhāriṇi \|\| 4 \|\|*

*yathā samastabhūtānāmādhārattvaṃ vyavasthitā \|*  
*tathā viśokaṃ kuru māṃ sakalecchāvibhūtibhiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*dhyānamātre yathā viṣṇoḥ svāsthyaṃ jānāsi medini \|*  
*tathā manaḥ svasthatāṃ me kuru tvaṃ bhūtadhāriṇi \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Sri Krsna said - I am going to speak to you about the Asoka Purnima during which, when a fast is observed, a person does not has to undergo any grief of any type at any time. О best of humans, on the full moon day of the month of Phalguna, one should take a bath applying clay over his body and tasting the mud, should adore lord Bhudhara offering him flowers and leaves. Then he should offer prayer to the goddess- “O goddess, you maintain the entire universe, as lord Janardana has relieved you of all the griefs, let me also be relieved of all the griefs. As you have been made to be the base of all the living beings, similarly, relieving me of all the grief, granting me all my desires, O goddess earth, you accommodate me too as all the living beings. Let lord Visnu makes my mind healthy with my mere meditation for him.”

## \|\| 3.105.7 \|\|

*evaṃ stutvā tathābhyarcya candrāyārghyaṃ nivedya ca \|*  
*upoṣitavyaṃ naktaṃ vā bhoktavyaṃ tailavarjitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Thus one should offer the prayer, perform worship and then offer arghya for the Moon. Thereafter, while fasting for the night, he should eat food which should be devoid of oil and salt.

## \|\| 3.105.8-10 \|\|

*anenaiva prakāreṇa catvāraḥ phālgunādayaḥ \|*  
*upoṣyā nṛpate māsāḥ prathamaṃ pāraṇaṃ smṛtam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*āṣāḍhādiṣu māseṣu tadvatsnānaṃ mṛdaṃbunā \|*  
*tathaiva prāśanaṃ pūjā tadvadiṃdostathārhaṇam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*caturṣvanyeṣu caivoktaṃ kārtikādiṣu pāraṇam \|*  
*pāraṇatritaye caiva cāturmāsikamucyate \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. Following the same process of the system of performing puja in the month of Phalguna and others, he should ultimately break his fast. Similarly, during the months of Asadha and others, taking bath with clay, the second parana (breaking of the fast) should be done. Finally in the four months of Kartika and others, one should perform the vrata and the puja in the same manner, besides the awakening during the nights. Then the third parana (breaking of the fast) should be carried out.

## \|\| 3.105.11-12 \|\|

*viśeṣapūjā dānaṃ ca tathā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi \|*  
*viśeṣeṇaiva kartavyaṃ pāraṇepāraṇe gate \|\| 11 \|\|*

*prathame dharaṇī nāma tubhyaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*dvitīye medinī vācyā tṛtīye ca vasundharā \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. During these four months and their parana, special puja, giving of charities and awakening during the nights should always be performed. During the first four months, the name of Dharani; during the second group of four month, Medini and during the third group of four month, Vasudhara should be used for the samkirtana (singing).

## \|\| 3.105.13-14 \|\|

*pāraṇepāraṇe pārtha yugmānevārccayeddvijān \|*  
*dharaṇīṃ deva devaṃ ca tattatsthānena keśavam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*vastrābhāve ca sūtreṇa pūjayeddharaṇīṃ tathā \|*  
*ghṛtābhāve tathā kṣīraṃ śastaṃ vā salilaṃ hareḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. O Partha, thereafter, four Brahmanas should be adored. While worshipping Dharani and Kesava in the absence of the costumes, the curd can be offered at that time. In the absence of ghi, the image of the lord should be bathed with ksira alone.

## \|\| 3.105.15-19 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte gauḥ savatsā dvijātaye \|*  
*pradeyā dharaṇī devī vastrālaṃkārasaṃyutā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*pātālasaṃsthayā devyā cīrṇametanmahāvratam \|*  
*dharaṇyā keśava prītyai tataḥ prāptā samunnatiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*devena coktā dharaṇī varāhavapuṣā purā \|*  
*upavāsavrataparā samuddhṛtya rasātalāt \|\| 17 \|\|*

*vratenānena kalyāṇi tvayāhaṃ paritoṣitaḥ \|*  
*tasmātprasādamatulaṃ karomi tava suvate \|\| 18 \|\|*

*yathaiva kuruṣe bhaktyā pūjāṃ mama suśobhanām \|*  
*tathaiva tava kalyāṇi praṇato yaḥ kariṣyati \|\| 19 \|\|*

15-19. Thus at the end of the year, the lord should be worshipped with milk or the water. At the end of the year, a cow with a calf, besides the goddess earth, decorated with costumes and ornaments should be given over to a Brahmana. While her stay in the nether world, the earth goddess had performed the vrata and getting pleased with her devotion, the goddess earth uplifted the earth. At that point of time, taking to the form of a boar, Lord Kesava redeemed the goddess earth from the oceanic water who had been performing the vrata. He said to her- “O performer of the noble vrata, I am extremely pleased with the vrata being performed by you. Therefore, I shall bestow on you a beautiful and pleasure delight.

## \|\| 3.105.20 \|\|

*vratametadupāśritya pāraṇaṃ ca yathāvidhi \|*  
*sarvabādhāvinirmukto janmajanmāṃtarāṇyapi \|*  
*viśokaḥ sarvakalyāṇabhājanaṃ syānna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. The way you worshipped me with devotion, in case, other people also perform this vrata with the same devotion, then they would get rid of all the obstructions relating to many births. Then getting free from all the miseries, they would always face welfare. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.105.21-23 \|\|

*yathā tvameva vasudhe saṃprāptā nirvṛteḥ padam \|*  
*tathā sa paramaṃlloke sukhaṃ prāpsyati mānavaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*evametanmahāpuṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraśāṃtidam \|*  
*viśokākhyaṃ vratavaraṃ tatkuruṣva mahāvratam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*samyagviśokakaraṇī nṛpapūrṇimā te khyātā mayā manumahendrasamānakīrte \|*  
*evaṃ karoti kurupuṃgava yaḥ prayatnācchoko na tasya bhavatīha kulepi puṃsaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. O Vasudha, the way you have achieved the supreme position, similarly, a person who performs the same vrata, would also achieve the best of the Iokas, shall enjoy all the comforts. A person who performs the Visoka vrata with devotion, he earns enormous merits and gets all his sins removed. You should also perform this vrata. Like Manu and Mahendra, O king, you have already achieved the glory. O best of the race of Kuru, the vrata of the full moon day, has been described by me pretty well. A person who performs this vrata making all the efforts, no grief of any kind occurs in his family.

## Chapter 106. Ananta Vrata

## \|\| 3.106.1-4 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*sarvakāmānavāpnoti samārādhya janārdanam \|*  
*prakārairbahubhiḥ kṛṣṇa yānyānicchati cetasā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*nṛṇāṃ strīṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ nānyacchokasya kāraṇam \|*  
*apatyādadhikaṃ kiṃcidvidyate hyatra janmani \|\| 2 \|\|*

*aputratā mahāduḥkhamatiduḥkhaṃ kuputratā \|*  
*suputraḥ sarvasaukhyānāṃ hetubhūto mato mama \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dhanyāste ye sutaṃ prāptāḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitam \|*  
*śaktaṃ praśāṃtaṃ balinaṃ parāṃ nirvṛtimāgatam \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Yudhisthira said- O Krsna, whatever be the desire of someone, it can be fulfilled with the worship of lord Narayana appropriately. In the present life, there is no cause of grief for a husband and a wife, except the one relating to one’s own progeny. Therefore, I believe that a noble son is the cause of all the comforts. Graceful are the couple who achieve a valorous son, who is free from grief and is calm and peaceful. Such people alone have enormous peace.

## \|\| 3.106.5-7 \|\|

*svakarmābhirataṃ nityaṃ devadvijaparāyaṇam \|*  
*śāstrajñaṃ sarvadharmajñaṃ dīnānāthānukaṃpinam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vinirjitārisarvasvaṃ manohṛdayanandanam \|*  
*devānukūlatāyuktaṃ yuktaṃ samyagguṇena ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*mitrasvajanasanmānalabdhaṃ nirvāṇamuttamam \|*  
*yaḥ prāpnoti sutaṃ tasmānnānyo dhanyataro bhuvi \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. The people who keep themselves busy in their’s own occupation, who always adore the gods as well as the Brahmanas well-versed with tire scriptures as well as the dharma, who are compassionate on the poor and the downtrodden, possess the divine fortunes and virtues, they are respected by their own kiths and kins and those who achieve the extremely peaceful son, are quite graceful on earth, but not the others.

## \|\| 3.106.8 \|\|

*so'hamevaṃvidhaṃ śrotuṃ karmecchāmi mahāmate \|*  
*yenedṛglakṣaṇaḥ putraḥ prāpyate bhuvi mānavaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. O immensely intelligent one, therefore, I would like to know about a method with the performing of which one can achieve a son on the earth with the aforesaid qualities.

## \|\| 3.106.9-14 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*evametanmahābhāga putrāputrasamudbhavam \|*  
*duḥkhaṃ prayātyupaśamaṃ tanayānneha kenacit \|\| 9 \|\|*

*atrāpi śrūyatāṃ vṛttaṃ yatpūrvamabhavanmune \|*  
*utpattau kārtavīryasya haihayasya mahātmanaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kṛtavīryo mahīpālo haihayo nāma vai purā \|*  
*tasya śīladhanā nāma babhūva varavarṇinī \|\| 11 \|\|*

*patnī sahasrapravarā mahiṣī śīlamaṇḍanā \|*  
*sā tvaputrā mahābhāgā maitreyīṃ paryapṛcchata \|\| 12 \|\|*

*guṇavatputralābhāya kṛtāsanaparigraham \|*  
*tayā pṛṣṭātha sā samyaṅmaitreyī brahmavādinī \|\| 13 \|\|*

*kathayāmāsa paramaṃ nāmnānantavrataṃ mahat \|*  
*sarvakāmaphalāvāptikāraṇaṃ pāpanāśanam \|*  
*tasyāḥ suputralābhāya rājaputryāstapasvinī \|\| 14 \|\|*

9-14. Sri Krsna said You arc talking about the good or a bad son, and the pain and pleasure derived from them. The things arc exactly like that because (one’s problems or miseries) get solved by the son, no one else can do so. O king, I am going to relate to you an earlier story on the subject. The king Kartavirya had been born in the Haihaya race and the story about his birth is like this. His best of the queens was known as Siladhana. She was the chief queen and the best of all the queens. She represented the chastity of all the queens. Once she went to Maitreyi and asked her the way, by which one could have the best of a son. When so asked by the chief queen, Maitreyi explained to her the method of performing the Ananta vrata in an appropriate manner, besides its glory, which is bestower of all the success and is the remover of the sins. Thus the female ascetic explained all the mothers about the getting of an excellent son.

## \|\| 3.106.15-19 \|\|

*maitreyyuvāca \|*  
*yo yamicchennaraḥ kāmaṃ nārī vā varavarṇinī \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sa taṃ samārādhya vibhuṃ samāpnoti janārdanāt \|*  
*mārgaśīrṣe mṛgaśiro bhīmo yasmindine'bhavat \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tasminsaṃprāśya gomūtraṃ snāto niyatamānasaḥ \|*  
*puṣpairdhūpaistathā gandhairupavāsaiśca bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*vāmapādamanaṃtasya pūjayedvaravarṇini \|\| 17 \|\|*

*anaṃtaḥ sarvakāmānāmanaṃtaṃ bhagavānphalam \|*  
*dadātvanantaṃ ca punastadevānyatra janmani \|\| 18 \|\|*

*anaṃtapuṇyopacayamanantaṃ tu mahāvratam \|*  
*yathābhilaṣitāvāptiṃ kuru me puruṣottama \|\| 19 \|\|*

15-19. Maitreyi said- Whatever is desired by a person, after worshipping lord Janardana, she achieves the same. O lady with the best of limbs, during the Mrgasiri constellation falling on the full moon day, breaking the fast with the urine of the cow, one should take the bath. Then lord Ananta should be worshipped offering the flowers, incense, fragrance etc. Then observing the fast, he should perform the fast, saying- “O Purusottama, let lord Ananta bestow the unlimited reward of all my wish (during this birth) and in the next birth also, let me get limited reward and the fortune of performing a great vrata of all vratas. Thus let all my desires be fulfilled.”

## \|\| 3.106.20-21 \|\|

*ityuccāryābhipūjyainaṃ yathāvadvidhinā naraḥ \|*  
*samāhitamanā bhūtvā praṇipātapurassaram \|\| 20 \|\|*

*viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādanaṃtaḥ prīyatāmiti \|*  
*samuccārya tato naktaṃ bhuñjītatailavarjitam \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. After carefully performing the worship of lord Ananta, one should humbly pray- “Let lord Ananta be pleased with me, who is the compliment for the Brahmanas.” Thus speaking, he should take his food without oil and salt, and as per the tradition, listen to recitation from a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.106.22-23 \|\|

*tataśca pauṣe puṣyarkṣe tathaiva bhagavatkaṭim \|*  
*vāmāmabhyarccayedbhaktyā gomūtraprāśanaṃ tataḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*anaṃtaḥ sarvakāmānā miti coccārayetpunaḥ \|*  
*bhojayeta tathā viprānvācayitvā yathāvidhi \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Then, during the Pusya constellation falling on the full moon day of the month of Pausa, the loin of lord Anantadeva who is the fulfiller of all wishes, should be worshipped. The fast should be broken with the urine of the cow. On the completion of the vrata, the Brahmanas should be given away with food and daksina.

## \|\| 3.106.24-25 \|\|

*māghe maghāsu tadvacca bāhuṃ devasya pūjayet \|*  
*skandhau ca mama phālgunyoḥ phālgune māsi bhāmini \|\| 24 \|\|*

*caturṣveteṣu gomūtraṃ prāśayennṛpanaṃdini \|*  
*brāhmaṇāya tathā dadyāttilānkanakameva ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. О princess, during the month of Magha, when the Magha constellation falls on the full moon day, the arms of lord Ananta and in the month of Phalguna in the Phalguni constellation his shoulders should be worshipped. In all the four months, the fast should be broken with cow’s urine. After performing the puja, a Brahmana should be given over gold as well as the sesamum seeds.

## \|\| 3.106.26 \|\|

*devasya dakṣiṇaṃ skandhaṃ caitre citrāsu pūjayet \|*  
*tathaiva prāśanaṃ cātra pañcagavyamudāhṛtam \|*  
*vipre pravācake dadyādyavānmāsacatuṣṭayam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Similarly, during the Citra constellation falling on the full moon day of the month of Caitra, the right shoulder of lord Anantadeva should be worshipped. The fast should be broken with the use of pancagavya. On the completion of the recitation of four months, the barley should be given in daksina.

## \|\| 3.106.27 \|\|

*vaiśākhe ca viśākhāsu bāhuṃ sampūjya dakṣiṇam \|*  
*tathaivoktānyavāndadyānnaktaṃ kuryādbhujikriyām \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. When the full moon day falls in the Visakha constellation in the month of Vaisakha, the right arm of the lord should be worshipped and the barley should be given in charity as stated earlier. The food should be taken at night.

## \|\| 3.106.28-30 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhāsu kaṭipūjāṃ ca jyeṣṭhamāsi śubhavrate \|*  
*āṣāḍhāsu tathāṣāḍhe kuryātpādārcanaṃ śubhe \|\| 28 \|\|*

*pādadvayaṃ tu śravaṇe śrāvaṇe māsi pūjayet \|*  
*ghṛtaṃ viprāya dātavyaṃ prāśanīyaṃ yathāvidhi \|\| 29 \|\|*

*śrāvaṇādiṣu māseṣu prāśanaṃ dānameva ca \|*  
*etadevaṃ samākhyātaṃ devāṃstadvacca pūjayet \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. When the frill moon day in the month of Jyestha falls in Jyestha constellation, the waist of the lord should be adored. During the full moon day falling in the Asadha constellation in the month of Asadha, the foot of the lord should be worshipped. During the full moon day falling in the Sravana constellation of the month of Sravapa. both the feet of the lord should be worshipped. Thereafter, as per the set procedure, he should break his fast consuming the ghi He should give away the charities which have been prescribed in the scriptures. The other gods should be worshipped accordingly.

## \|\| 3.106.31-32 \|\|

*guhyaṃ proṣṭhapadāyoge māsi bhādrapade'rcayet \|*  
*tadvadāśvayuje pūjyaṃ hṛdayaṃ cāśvinīṣu ca \|\| 31 \|\|*

*kuryātsamāhitamanāḥ snānaṃ prāśanamarcanam \|*  
*anantaśirasaḥ pūjāṃ kārttike kṛttikāsu ca \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. On the full moon day of the month of Bhadrapada in the Bhadra constellation, the secret parts should the adored. While in the month of Asvina when the Asvani constellation falling on the full moon day, the heart of the lord should be adored carefully. Similarly, during the month of Kartika, when the full moon day falls during the Krttika constellation, the head of lord Ananta should be adored.

## \|\| 3.106.33-35 \|\|

*yasminyasmindine pūjā tatratatra tadā dine \|*  
*nāmānaṃtasya japtavyaṃ kṣutapraskhalitādiṣu \|\| 33 \|\|*

*ghṛtenānaṃtamuddiśya pūrvaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*kurvīta homaṃ caitrādau śālinā kulanaṃdini \|\| 34 \|\|*

*kṣīreṇa śrāvaṇādau ca homo māsacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*praśastaṃ sarvamāseṣu haviṣyānnena bhojanam \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. Whichever deity is thought to be worshipped on a particular day, the name of the same deity should be uttered while eating, drinking and all the time. O delight of the race, during the initial four months starting from Margasirsa, the homa should be performed in the name of Ananta, pouring the ghi into the fire. During the four months starting from Caitra and others, the homa should be performed with the Sali rice During all the months, one should take the prescribed food of havisyanna.

## \|\| 3.106.36-38 \|\|

*evaṃ dvādaśabhirmāsaiḥ pāraṇātritayaṃ śubhe \|*  
*vratāvasāne cānantaṃ sauvarṇaṃ kārayecchubham \|\| 36 \|\|*

*rājataṃ musalaṃ caiva halaṃ pārśveṣu vinyaset \|*  
*puṣpadhūpādinaivedyaiḥ pūjā kāryā yathāvidhi \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tāmrapīṭhopari harermantrairebhiryathākramam \|*  
*namo'stvanaṃtāya śiraḥ pādau sarvātmane namaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

36-38. At the time of the completion of the three paranas in twelve months, during the concluding ceremony, the gold image of lord Ananta should be made, the plough and musala made of silver should be placed on each one of his right and left hand. The lord should be consecrated over the copper seat. He should then be offered, flowers, incense and the eatables. All his limbs should be worshipped reciting the mantras- “Salutation to Ananta, salutation to his head, who is the universal soul.” Saying this, he should touch his feet.

## \|\| 3.106.39 \|\|

*śeṣāya jānuyugalaṃ kāmāyeti kaṭiṃ namaḥ \|*  
*namostu vāsudevāya pārśvaṃ saṃpūjayeddhareḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Saying salutation to Sesa, both his knees should be touched. Saying salutation to Kamadeva, his waist should be touched. Saying salutation to Vasudeva, both the parts of the back should be touched.

## \|\| 3.106.40-41 \|\|

*saṃkarṣaṇāyetyudaraṃ bhujaṃ sarvāsudhāriṇe \|*  
*kaṇṭhaṃ śrīkaṇṭhanāthāya mukhamiṃdumukhāya ca \|\| 40 \|\|*

*halaṃ ca musalaṃ caiva svanāmnā pūjayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ sampūjya govindaṃ sitavastravibhūṣitam \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. Saying salutation to Sankarsana, the belly should be touched. Saying you are the protector of all the living beings, both the arms should be touched. Saying salutation to Sri Kanthanatha, the throat should be touched. Saying salutation to Indramukha, the face should be touched, besides the plough and the masala. Thus he should perform the worship with the reciting of the mantras.

## \|\| 3.106.42 \|\|

*chatropānatsusaṃyuktaṃ sragdāmālaṃkṛtaṃ tathā \|*  
*nakṣatradevatāḥ pūjyā nakṣatrāṇi ca sarvaśaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Thus Govindadeva’s image should be decorated with white costumes and a garland of white flowers. Thereafter, one should worship the lord of the constellations as well as the constellations themselves.

## \|\| 3.106.43 \|\|

*somo nakṣatrarājaśca māsaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ tathā \|*  
*dvādaśātra ghaṭānkuryātsa toyāṃścānnasaṃyutān \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Thereafter, worshipping the Moon - the king of all constellations, the months and the years, the pitcher filled with water and cereals should be given away in charity.

## \|\| 3.106.44-46 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivaddevadevaṃ janārdanam \|*  
*brāhmaṇaṃ pūjayitvā ca vastrairābharaṇaistathā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*karṇāṃgulaiḥ pavitraiśca śāṃtaṃ dāṃtaṃ jitendriyam \|*  
*purāṇajñaṃ dharmanityamavyaṃgaṃ supriyaṃvadam \|\| 45 \|\|*

*tasmai deyaṃ samastaṃ tadanantaḥ prīyatāmiti \|*  
*anyeṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca deyaṃ śaktyā yathepsitam \|\| 46 \|\|*

44-46. Then adoring lord Janardana, the costumes, ornaments, earrings, finger-ring and pavitri (of kusa) should be given to the Brahmana who recites the Puranas with a peaceful mind, should have sweet tongue, has controlled all his sense organs, should be the form of dharma, unblemished with sweet temperament, saying- “Let lord Ananta be happy with me.” Thus speaking, all the articles should be handed over to him. Thereafter, all other Brahmanas should also be given the things desired by them with grace.

## \|\| 3.106.47-50 \|\|

*anena vidhinā pārtha vrataṃ caitatsamāpyate \|*  
*pārite ca samāpnoti sarvāneva manorathān \|\| 47 \|\|*

*putrārthibhirvittakāmairbhṛtyadārānabhīpsubhiḥ \|*  
*prārthayadbhiśca martye'sminnārogyaphalasampadaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*etadvrataṃ mahābhāge puṇyaṃ svastyayanapradam \|*  
*anaṃtavratasaṃjñaṃ vai sarva pāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*tatkuruṣvaiva devi tvaṃ vrataṃ śīladhane param \|*  
*variṣṭhaṃ sarvalokasya yadi putramabhīpsasi \|\| 50 \|\|*

47-50. The vrata is thus performed in this manner. On its completion, all the desires are fulfilled. In this world, when a person performs this vrata for the sake of the son, wealth, servants and the wife, besides good health, all his desires get fulfilled. О excellent one, in case you are desirous of an excellent son, then you must perform this vrata, which is auspicious, bestower of welfare and remover of all the sins.

## \|\| 3.106.51-53 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*iti śīladhanā śrutvā maitreyīvacanaṃ śubham \|*  
*cakāraitadvratavaraṃ sā viṣṇvāhitamānasā \|\| 51 \|\|*

*putrārthinyāstatastasmādvratenānena suvrata \|*  
*viṣṇustutoṣa tuṣṭe ca viṣṇau sā suṣuve sutam \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tasya vai jātamātrasya pravavau cānilaḥ śubham \|*  
*nīrajaskamabhūdvyoma mudaṃ prāpākhilaṃ jagat \|\| 53 \|\|*

51-53. Sri Krsna said- Listening to the auspicious words of Maitreyi, the queen Siladhana devoted her mind in lord Visnu and completed the vrata with the birth of a son. Lord Visnu was pleased with her vrata and the beneficial air started blowing. The sky became spotless and the entire universe got delighted.

## \|\| 3.106.54 \|\|

*devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca \|*  
*prajagurdevagaṃdharvā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. The gods played on big drums, while showering the rain of flowers. The Devas and Gandharvas started singing, while the Apsaras kept on dancing.

## \|\| 3.106.55-58 \|\|

*dharme manaḥ samastasya pārtha lokasya cābhavat \|*  
*tasya nāma pitā cakre tanayasyārjuneti vai \|\| 55 \|\|*

*kṛtavīryasutatvācca kārtavīryo babhūva saḥ \|*  
*tenāpi bhagavānviṣṇurdattātreyasvarūpavān \|*  
*ārādhito'timahatā tapasā pārtha bhūbhṛtā \|\| 56 \|\|*

*tasya tuṣṭo jagannāthaścakravartitvamuttamam \|*  
*dadau śauryadhane cāpi sakalānyāyudhāni ca \|*  
*sa vavre ca vadho deva mama tvatto bhavediti \|\| 57 \|\|*

*paraṃ tu smaraṇaṃ jñānaṃ bhītānāmārtināśanam \|*  
*smaraṇādupakārittvaṃ jagato'sya jagatpate \|\| 58 \|\|*

55-58. At that point of time, the people got devoted towards dharma. The father Krtavirya gave the name of Kartavirya to the son. The son Kartavirya worshipped lord Visnu in the form known as Dattatreya, who getting pleased with him, granted him the position of a cakravarti monarch, besides the enormous I strength and all the weapons. Then he said-“0 Deva, you alone should be instrumental in my death. But, О lord of the world, I should always do well to the world and this aspect should always remain in my mind. I should remain more interested in removing the sufferings of others.”

## \|\| 3.106.59-61 \|\|

*tamāha devadeveśaḥ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*sarvametanmahābhāga tava bhūyo bhaviṣyati \|\| 59 \|\|*

*yaśca prabhāte rātrau ca tvāṃ naraḥ kīrtayiṣyati \|*  
*namo'stu kārtavīryāyetyabhidhāsyati caiva yaḥ \|*  
*tilaprasthapradānasya naraḥ puṇyamavāpsyati \|\| 60 \|\|*

*anaṣṭadravyatā caiva tava nāmānukīrtane \|*  
*bhaviṣyati mahīpāletyuktvā taṃ prayayau hariḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

59-61. At this, the lotus eyed god said— “O excellent one, you shall possess all this enormously. A person who would recite your name in the morning and shall give away sesamum seeds, he shall earn enormous merit. With the reciting of your name, the wealth shall always go on increasing.” Thus speaking, lord Vi§nu disappeared from the scene.

## \|\| 3.106.62 \|\|

*sa cāpi varamāsādya prasannādgaruḍadhvajāt \|*  
*pālayāmāsa bhūpālaḥ saptadvīpāṃ vasuṃdharām \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. By the grace of lord Garudadhvaja, achieving the boon, the king started ruling the country with seven continents.

## \|\| 3.106.63-64 \|\|

*teneṣṭaṃ vividhairyajñaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ \|*  
*jitvārivargamakhilaṃ dharmataḥ pālitāḥ prajāḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*anaṃtavratamāhātmyādāsādya tanayaṃ ca tam \|*  
*pituḥ putrodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsītsvalpamapi prabho \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. He performed a large number of excellent sacrifices, giving enormous daksina in each one of them. He overpowered all the enemies and exercised the religious control over the people because of the glory of Ananta vrata. The son so born, could not earn and blemish.

## \|\| 3.106.65-66 \|\|

*evametatsamākhyātamanaṃtākhyaṃ vrataṃ tava \|*  
*yatkṛtvā rājapatnī sā kārtavīryamasūyata \|\| 65 \|\|*

*yaścaitacchṛṇuyājjanma kārtavīryasya mānavaḥ \|*  
*strī vā duḥkhamapatyotthaṃ saptajanmasu nāśnute \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. Thus I have explained in detail about the glory of the Ananta vrata. With the performing of this vrata, the queen produced a son named Kartavirya who does not have to face misery relating to the birth of a son in future seven births.

## \|\| 3.106.67 \|\|

*aiśvaryamapratihataṃ paramaṃ vivekaṃ putrānamitrahṛdayārtikarānbahūṃśca \|*  
*kṛtvā tvanaṃta iti yadvrata nāmadheyaṃ prāpnotyanaṃtavibhavasya vibhoḥ prasādāt \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. With the performing of this Ananta vrata, I by the grace of the lord, a person gets enormous wealth, high knowledge, sons, good friends, victory over the enemies and enormous riches.

## Chapter 107. Sambharayani Vrata

## \|\| 3.107.1-3 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*aprāptairna tathā duḥkhamaiśvaryādyairnarottama \|*  
*yathā manorathaiḥ svaiḥ svairnānāduḥkhaṃ bhavennṛṇām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*yathā manorathairlabdhairna syādduḥkhabhayaṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*aiśvaryādvicyuto vāpi saṃtaterdevalokataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*abhīṣṭādanyato vāpi yadāghena viniṣkṛtim \|*  
*prāpnoti puruṣo vātha nārī vā puṇyasaṃcayāt \|*  
*tanmamācakṣva bhagavanyena nābhyeti vicyutim \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Yudhisthira said- О best of humans, a person does not feel so grieved by not getting enormous wealth or fortunes, as he is unable to achieve the desired wealth. A people do not feel painful by getting their desires fulfilled. Similarly, with the loss of the fortunes, the sons and daughters, besides the heaven, or by falling from the desired lokas, the people feel more painful when inspite of the accumulation of merits, one suffers because of the sins committed by him. Therefore, you kindly speak out to me a way out, by which the aforesaid sufferings could also be avoided.

## \|\| 3.107.4-7 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*satyametanmahābhāga duḥkhaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*aiśvaryodayacittasya baṃdhuvargasukhasya ca \|*  
*tadetacchrūyatāṃ pārtha yathā neṣṭātparicyutiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*svargāderjāyate samyagupavāsavatāṃ satām \|*  
*dvādaśarkṣāṇi rājendra pratimāsaṃ tu yāni vai \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tannāmnā cācyutaṃ teṣu samyaksaṃpūjayennṛpa \|*  
*puṣpairdhūpaistathāṃbhobhirabhīṣṭairaparairapi \|\| 7 \|\|*

4-7. Sri Krsna said- It is true that inspite of enormity of the wealth and the comfortable condition of the kins, somehow or the other the painful sufferings or ugly situations would arise, therefore, I am going to speak out a remedy of observing a fast, which when performed by the people, they are never separated from their desired goal. О Rajendra, during the twelve constellations representing the twelve months, the vrata should be celebrated, mantras should be recited and lord Acyuta should be worshipped, offering the flowers, incense and the sacred water from the holy places.

## \|\| 3.107.8 \|\|

*āditaḥ kṛttikāṃ kṛtvā kārttike nṛpasattama \|*  
*kṛśarāmatra naivedyaṃ pūrvaṃ māsa catuṣṭayam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. О best of the rulers, on the full moon day of the month of Kartika falling in the Krttika constellation, the vrata should be started extending upto four months and the рйгапа should be made with the articles described here under. During the first four months, the cooked mixed cereals and the sweet balls should be used.

## \|\| 3.107.9 \|\|

*nivedayetphālgunādi saṃyāvaṃ ca tataḥ param \|*  
*āṣāḍhādiṣu devāya pāyasaṃ vinivedayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. During the group of four months starting from Phalguna, the fast should be broken with the consuming of the butter milk, while during the four months starting from the month of Asadha, the fast is to be broken with the consuming of payasam.

## \|\| 3.107.10-14 \|\|

*tenaivānnena rājendra brāhmaṇānbhojayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*pañcagavyajalasnānaṃ tasyaiva prāśanācchuciḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*samyaksaṃpūjya rājendra tameva puruṣottamam \|*  
*praṇamya prārthayedviṣṇuṃ śuciḥ snāto yathāvidhi \|\| 11 \|\|*

*namonamaste'cyuta me kṣayostu pāpasya vṛddhiṃ samupaitu puṇyam \|*  
*aiśvaryavittādi tathā'kṣayaṃ mekṣayaṃ ca mā saṃtatirabhyupaitu \|\| 12 \|\|*

*yathācyutastvaṃ parataḥ parasmātsa brahmabhūtaḥ parataḥ parātmā \|*  
*tathācyutaṃ me kuru vāṃchitaṃ tvaṃ harasva pāpaṃ ca tathāprameya \|\| 13 \|\|*

*acyutānaṃta govinda prasīda yadabhīpsitam \|*  
*tadakṣayamameyātmankuruṣva puruṣottama \|\| 14 \|\|*

10-14. During the days on each one of the three group of months, the stuff used for the breaking of the fast should also be served to the Brahmanas. He should also take bath with the water in which pancagavya is mixed. Then using the same for the purification of the body, lord Purusottama should be worshipped in an appropriate manner and then pray to lord Visnu saying- О Acyuta, you kindly remove all my sins and bestow merits on me. All my riches and wealth should be everlasting. О limitless one, О Acyuta, as you are the supreme Brahman and the supreme soul, beyond all, therefore, you kindly grant me the highest success, removing all my sins at the same time. О Acyuta, О Ananta, О Govinda and Purusottama, you kindly be pleased with me and grace my efforts to be all rewarding.” The lord should thus be worshipped.

## \|\| 3.107.15 \|\|

*evamevaṃ samabhyarcya prārthayitvā tathā śivam \|*  
*naivedyaṃ svayamaśnīyānnaktaṃ saṃpūjitecyute \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Thereafter, lord Siva should be worshipped during the day and during the night, lord Acyuta should be worshipped, after which the eatable should be offered.

## \|\| 3.107.16-19 \|\|

*tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte sukhasuptotthite'cyute \|*  
*ghṛtapūrṇaṃ tāmrapātraṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 16 \|\|*

*śaktito dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādacyutaḥ prīyatāmiti \|*  
*tatastu saptame varṣe kuryādudyāpanaṃ budhaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kāryā caivācyutasyārcā śaktyā svarṇamayī nṛpa \|*  
*tadagre brāhmaṇī sthāpyā sthavirā sāṃbharāyaṇī \|\| 18 \|\|*

*mahāsatī raupyamayī samānārhā sadevatā \|*  
*tatastau pūjayitvā ca mālyavastravilepanaiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

16-19. After this, the performer of the vrata should take his food at night. When lord Acyuta wakes up at the end of the year, a copper vase filled with ghi should be given over to a Brahmana with daksina. During the seventh year, following this process, the rite of Udyapana should be performed and for that purpose, a gold image of lord Acyuta and that of a Brahman! should be consecrated in silver since she is highly chaste goddess and is adored like a god. Both of them should be adored in a proper way offering garlands, costumes and paste.

## \|\| 3.107.20 \|\|

*maṃtreṇānena rājendra praṇipatya vidhānataḥ \|*  
*prativarṣaṃ ca dattaṃ cettāmraṃ pātraṃ dvijātaye \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Thereafter, offering salutation with the recitation of mantras, a copper vase should be given over to the Brahmana every year.

## \|\| 3.107.21 \|\|

*tadevahelayā dadyātsahiraṇyāśvasaṃyutam \|*  
*gāśca pradadyātsaṃ pūjya savatsāḥ kāṃsyadohanāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Then a horse with gold, a cow with calf together with a milk pot of bronze should also be given over to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.107.22-24 \|\|

*ekāṃ vā śaktito dadyādbhaktyā tuṣyati keśavaḥ \|*  
*ghaṭāḥ satpātranirdiṣṭāḥ sānnāḥ pūrṇajalojjvalāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*chatropānadyugaiḥ sārdhamevaṃ dattvā visarjayet \|*  
*śayyāṃ satūlikāṃ dadyādgṛhaṃ copaskaraiḥ saha \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śriyā ca saha viṣṇuṃ ca pūjayedbhūṣayetprabhum \|*  
*vastrairābharaṇaiścaiva praṇipatya kṣamāpayet \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. When a person gives away in charity even a single cow, it pleases lord Kesava. A pitcher filled with water and the cereals, an umbrella, a pair of shoes, a bed with cushions of cotton and fully decorated, should be given over to a Brahmana, who is quite worthy and should then be sent off with respect. The worship of lord Visnu and Laksmi should be performed, offering the costumes and ornaments. Then making a humble prayer, he should beg forgiveness.

## \|\| 3.107.25 \|\|

*kṛtenānena rājendra cyutiṃ nāpnoti mānavaḥ \|*  
*saṃtateḥ svargavittāderaiśvaryasya tathaiva ca \|*  
*yadvābhimatamanyacca tato na cyavate naraḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. O Rajendra, one who does so, he never has to face the separation from his near and dear ones. He also does not have to feel scarcity of progeny, heaven, wealth, fortunes, etc. He also does not need to find his desired things as well.

## \|\| 3.107.26 \|\|

*tasmātsarvaprayatnena māsanakṣatrapūjanaiḥ \|*  
*yajetākṣayakāmastu sadaiva puruṣottamam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Therefore, making all the efforts, for the fulfillment of his everlasting desires, one must worship lord Purusottama with months and constellations.

## \|\| 3.107.27 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*atrāpi śrūyate kācitsiddhā svarge mahāvratā \|*  
*nārī tapodhanā bhūtvā prakhyātā sāṃbharāyaṇī \|*  
*samastasaṃdehaharā sadāsvargau kasāṃ hi sā \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. I am going to speak out a story. There had been a famous Siddha known by the name of Sambharayani, who performed the great vratas and was a great female ascetic. She could remove all the doubts of the gods.

## \|\| 3.107.28-29 \|\|

*kasyacittvatha kālasya devarājaḥ śatakratuḥ \|*  
*pūrvendracaritaṃ rājanpapracchedaṃ bṛhaspatim \|\| 28 \|\|*

*pūrvendrātparataḥ pūrve ye babhūvuḥ sureśvarāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ caritamicchāmi śrotumaṃgirasāṃ vara \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Once Devaraja Indra enquired form Brhaspati about the stories of the ancestor Indras saying- “O foremost of the Angirasa gotra, I have a desire to learn about the ancestral Indras, which you kindly care to narrate.”

## \|\| 3.107.30-33 \|\|

*evamuktastadā tena devendreṇāmaladyutiḥ \|*  
*prāha dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ paramarṣirbṛhaspatiḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*nāhaṃ ciraṃtanānvedmi devarāja sureśvarān \|*  
*ātmanaḥ samakālīnamavehi ca sureśvara \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tataḥ papraccha devendraḥ kosmābhirmunipuṃgavaḥ \|*  
*praṣṭavyo'tra mahābhāga kṛtādivasatirdivi \|\| 32 \|\|*

*bṛhaspatiściraṃ dhyātvā tataḥ prāha śacīpatim \|*  
*tapasvinīṃ mahābhāgāṃ pṛcchaitāṃ sāṃbharāyaṇīm \|\| 33 \|\|*

30-33. At the words so spoken by Indra, possessing the highest lustre, the best of the religious ascetics Brhaspati said to Indra- “O Devaraja, I am not aware of the stories of the ancient Indras. You take me of the same age as you have, then who is an excellent person in heaven, from whom we could know about the earlier dwellers of the heaven?” Thus hearing these words, Brhaspati meditated for a long time and then spoke to Indra - the lord of Saci. “You better ask this question from the immensely auspicious Sambharayani who is the form of tapas”

## \|\| 3.107.34 \|\|

*ityuktastena devendraḥ kautūhalasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*yayau yatra mahābhāgā samyagāste tapasvinī \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. At these words of Brhaspati, out of great curiosity, Indra departed for the place of Sambharayani - the performer of the great tapas.

## \|\| 3.107.35-37 \|\|

*sā tau dṛṣṭvā samāyāṃtau devarājabṛhaspatī \|*  
*samyagarghyeṇa saṃpūjya praṇipatyāha suvratā \|\| 35 \|\|*

*namo'stu devarājāya tathaivāṅgirase namaḥ \|*  
*yadvāṃ kāryaṃ mahābhāgau sakalaṃ tadihocyatām \|\| 36 \|\|*

*yadi kartuṃ mayā śakyaṃ tatkariṣye vimṛśya ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

35-37. Finding the arrival of Indra - the god of gods to her place besides Brhaspati, she welcomed them offering the arghya and worshipped them appropriately. Thereafter, she spoke with all humility- “I bow in reverence to Devaraja Indra as well as Brhaspati - the foremost of the Angirasa race. 0 excellent ones, what brings both of you here? You kindly tell me. In case, I be worthy of doing so, then I would surely do my best to accomplish the task in consultation with you.”

## \|\| 3.107.38-39 \|\|

*bṛhaspatiruvāca \|*  
*āvāmabhyāgatau praṣṭuṃ tvāmatrātivivekinīm \|*  
*yacca kāryaṃ mahābhāge pṛṣṭaṃ tatkathayasva naḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*yadi smarasi kalyāṇi pūrvendracaritāni vai \|*  
*tadākhyāhi mahābhāge devendrasya kutūhalam \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Brhaspati said- “O excellent one, we both have arrived here to enquire something of the noble wisdom. Therefore, you kindly tell us the truth about the matter, which we intend to discuss with you. O auspicious lady, we intend to know about the ancient conduct of the earlier Indras. We are quite anxious to know about the same. In case you can enlighten us on the subject, you kindly do so.”

## \|\| 3.107.40-42 \|\|

*sāṃbharāyaṇyuvāca \|*  
*yo vai pūrvaṃ sureṃdrasya tataśca prathamo hi yaḥ \|*  
*tasmātpūrvataro yasya tasyāpi prathamaśca yaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ pūrvatarā ye ca vedmi tānakhilānaham \|*  
*teṣāṃ ca caritaṃ kṛtsnaṃ jānāmyagirasāṃ vara \|\| 41 \|\|*

*manvaṃtarāṇyanekāni sṛṣṭīśca tridivaukasām \|*  
*saptarṣīnsubahūnvedmi manūnāṃ ca sutānnṛpān \|\| 42 \|\|*

40-42. Sambharayani said- “Indras of the present Indra and those who were still earlier to them, the life stories of all of them are well known to me. O son of Angira, I am well aware of the several of the Manvantaras, the creations of gods, the birth of sons of the seven Rsis and Manus, besides his sons are quite well known to me.”

## \|\| 3.107.43-47 \|\|

*evamuktvā tatastābhyāṃ suhṛṣṭā sāṃbharāyaṇī \|*  
*yathāvadācaṣṭa tayoḥ pūrvendracaritaṃ mahat \|\| 43 \|\|*

*svāyaṃbhuve yastu manau manau svārociṣe ca yaḥ \|*  
*uttame tāmase caiva raivate cākṣuṣe tathā \|\| 44 \|\|*

*ye babhūvurhi devendrāstasya tasya tapasvinī \|*  
*tadā jagāda caritaṃ yathāvatsāṃbharāyaṇī \|\| 45 \|\|*

*kathayāmāsa cāścaryaṃ taccāpi kathayāmi te \|\| 46 \|\|*

*śaṃkukarṇastadā daityo babhūvātyaṃtadurjayaḥ \|*  
*sa lokapālānsamare vijitya saha daivataiḥ \|*  
*indrasyāsādya bhavanaṃ praviveśa sunirbhayaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

43-47. Thus speaking to both of them, she quite delightfully narrated the great stories of the past Indras, besides those of Svayambhuva, Svarocisa, Uttama, Tamasa, Raivata as well Caksus Manus. At the same time, she told us an astonishing tale, which is going to be revealed by me. During the time of some earlier Indra, there had been a daitya named Sankukarna, who was totally invincible. He defeated had the Gods and Lokapalas in the battlefield. Then after exercising control over them, he fearlessly entered the palace of Indra.

## \|\| 3.107.48-49 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā prāptaṃ śakraḥ śayyātale'luṭhat \|*  
*jugopa sahasātmānaṃ śaṃkukarṇabhayārditaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*dānavaḥ śakraśayane tasminnupaviveśa ha \|*  
*indrāṇyapi tathā bhītā gatā vācaspatergṛham \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. Knowing about the sudden arrival of Sankukarna, Indra lay down over the bed and concealed himself into his body. The Danava also sat over the bed of Indra. In panic, Indrani at once left for the place of Brhaspati.

## \|\| 3.107.50-52 \|\|

*atha devāḥ samājagmurbhayāddraṣṭuṃ suradviṣam \|*  
*āsīnaṃ śakraśayane praṇipātapurassarāḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*vāsudevo'pi tatrāgāttaṃ draṣṭuṃ devakaṃṭakam \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇamanuprāptaṃ dānavaḥ prāha harṣitaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyohaṃ yasya me garuḍadhvajaḥ \|*  
*śakraśayyāsanasthasya draṣṭumabhyeti keśavaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

50-52. Thereafter, the Devas also getting frightened, in order to have a look at the Daityas, went to the place of Indra. Even lord Vasudeva arrived there to have a look at Sankukarna - the enemy of gods. The Danava was delighted at the arrival of Sri Krsna and said to him- “I feel successful that in order to look at me, sitting over the bed of Indra, Kesava himself, having the vehicle of Garuda, has also arrived here.”

## \|\| 3.107.53-54 \|\|

*tataḥ kare samālaṃbya śayanābhyāśamānayat \|*  
*cakāra kaṃṭhagrahaṇaṃ bāṃdhavasyeva harṣita \|\| 53 \|\|*

*tataḥ kṛṣṇastu sahasā gṛhya dorbhyāṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ \|*  
*pīḍayāmāsa vihasannadaṃtaṃ bhairavānravān \|*  
*mamāra dānavendro'sau balādbhagnāsthipañjaraḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

53-54. Thus speaking, the daitya per force desired Krsna also to be seated over the same bed. At the same time, Sri Krsna pretending to having been pleased to meet him like meeting with a close relative, delightfully held his throat in his hands with a smile over his face. Then he pressed his throat with both his hands slowly. Suddenly Sri Krsna pressed the grip so tightly, that all his bones were broken and he died while crying.

## \|\| 3.107.55-56 \|\|

*nirjagāma tataḥ śakraḥ śayyāmūlādavākchirāḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭāva harimāsīnaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam \|\| 55 \|\|*

*etaddṛṣṭaṃ mayā śakra vasaṃtyā surasadmani \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. Thereafter, Indra emerged out of the end of the bed, lowering his head with shame. Then he started praising lord Visnu - the carrier of sankha and cakra. O Indra, all this event had been witnessed by me myself while staying in the city of Indra.”

## \|\| 3.107.57 \|\|

*tataḥ kutūhalaparo devarāṭ tāṃ tapasvinīm \|*  
*uvāca jānāsi kathaṃ tvametānsāṃbharāyaṇi \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. On hearing this episode, out of curiosity Devaraja Indra said to the said female ascetic-“O Sambharayani, how do you know it?”

## \|\| 3.107.58 \|\|

*sāṃbharāyaṇyuvāca \|*  
*sarva eva hi devendrāḥ svargasthā yemareśvarāḥ \|*  
*babhūvurete caritameteṣāṃ vedmi tena vai \|*  
*caritaṃ ca mayā teṣāṃ śrutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Sambharayani said- All the Indras of this heaven and the events relating to them are known to me, by my staying here pretty well, some of which have been witnessed by me myself and some of them I have heard from others.

## \|\| 3.107.59-60 \|\|

*indra uvāca \|*  
*kiṃ kṛtaṃ vada dharmajñe tvayā yeneyamakṣayā \|*  
*svarloke vasatiḥ prāptā yathā nānyena kenacit \|\| 59 \|\|*

*aho sarvavratānāṃ tu hyupoṣitamathādbhutam \|*  
*pradhānataramatyaṃtaṃ svargavāsapradaṃ matam \|\| 60 \|\|*

59-60. Indra said- “O lady, well-versed in dharma, what type of efforts have you made, by which you earned the privilege of staying in the heaven for all times to come, which could not be earned by any other women in the world? Out of all, which one of them has been specifically been patronized by you, which according to my own opinion, bestows the eternal stay in the heaven?”

## \|\| 3.107.61-62 \|\|

*evamuktā tatastena devendreṇa tapasvinīṃ \|*  
*pratyuvāca mahābhāgā yathāvatsāṃbharāyaṇī \|\| 61 \|\|*

*māsarkṣe hyacyuto devaḥ pratimāsaṃ sureśvara \|*  
*yathoktavratayā samyaksaptavarṣāṇi pūjitaḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

61-62. At these words of Indra, the great lady Sambharayani defined the vrata in detail. She said- “O Suresvara, with the performing of the above vrata, reciting the name of the related constellation, one should worship lord Acyuta every month. This process has to be continued for a period of seven years.

## \|\| 3.107.63-64 \|\|

*tasyeyaṃ karmaṇo vyuṣṭiracyutārādhanasya me \|*  
*devalokādabhimatā devarājapadacyutiḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

*svargendravibhavaiśvaryaṃ saṃtatiṃ yāti cācyutim \|*
