*naro vāñchati tenetthaṃ toṣaṇīyastataḥ prabhuḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. I have achieved this place in the heaven with the performing of the same vrata, by which I achieved an infallible position in the heaven, where even Indra also falls from his seat A person who is desirous of gaining of the same positive, it is his duty to please the lord.

## \|\| 3.107.65-66 \|\|

*etatte pūrvadevendracaritaṃ sakalaṃ mayā \|*  
*svargavāsākṣayatvaṃ ca māsarkṣācyutapūjanāt \|*  
*yathāvatkathitaṃ deva pṛcchatastridaśeśvara \|\| 65 \|\|*

*dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca vāñchitā vibudhādhipa \|*  
*viṣṇorārādhanādanyatparamaṃ siddhikāraṇam \|\| 66 \|\|*

65-66. O Deva, O lord of the three directions, at your asking, I have spoken to you about the stories of the eastern gates, besides the mental recitations of various constellations, the worship of lord Acyuta and the achieving of the everlasting stay in the heaven, as a result of which a person achieves the desired success. Besides the success of kama and moksa is enshrined therein. This is also the cause of supreme success besides adoration of lord Visnu.”

## \|\| 3.107.67-68 \|\|

*tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā devarājabṛhaspatī \|*  
*tattathetyūcatuḥ sādhvīṃ ceratuścāpi tadvratam \|\| 67 \|\|*

*tasmātpārtha prayatnena pratimāsaṃ samāhitaḥ \|*  
*māsarkṣācyutapūjāyāṃ bhavethāstanmanāḥ sadā \|\| 68 \|\|*

67-68. Listening to her words, Indra and Brhaspati, supporting the words of the female ascetic, performed that vrata appropriately Therefore, during each month’s constellation the worship of lord Acyuta should be performed making ail the efforts. This is essential.

## \|\| 3.107.69 \|\|

*ye sāṃbharāyaṇikathācaritavratesminvarṣāṇi sapta vidhinā sudhiyo nayaṃti \|*  
*te svagarlokamabhigamya kṛtādhivāsāḥ kalpāyutāyutaśatairapi na cyavaṃte \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. According to the words of Sambharayani, the vrata has to be performed for a period of seven years in an appropriate manner. The learned people who do so, they achieve the stay in the heaven which is everlasting. They do not have to fall for a hundred and twenty thousand kalpas.

## Chapter 108. Naksatra Purusa Vrata

## \|\| 3.108.1-7 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*surūpatā manuṣyāṇāṃ strīṇāṃ ca yadusattama \|*  
*karmaṇā jāyate kena tanmamākhyātumarhasi \|\| 1 \|\|*

*surūpāṇāṃ sugātrāṇāṃ suveṣāṇāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*nyūnaṃ tathādhikaṃ cāpi yathā nāṅgaṃ prajāyate \|\| 2 \|\|*

*samastaiḥ śobhanairaṃgairnarāḥ kecidyadūttama \|*  
*kāṇāḥ kubjāṃśca jāyaṃte truṭitaśravaṇāstathā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ caiva samastāṅgaḥ surūpatā \|*  
*karmaṇā yena bhavati tatpūrvaṃ kathayāmala \|\| 4 \|\|*

*lāvaṇyagativākyāni sati rūpe mahāmate \|*  
*kurvaṃtyabhyadhikāṃ śobhāṃ samastāḥ paramā guṇāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vākyalāvaṇyasaṃskāravilāsalalitā gatiḥ \|*  
*viḍaṃbanā kurūpāṇāṃ kevalā sā hi jāyate \|\| 6 \|\|*

*rūpakāraṇabhūtāya karmaṇā prayato bhavet \|*  
*tasmāttanme samācakṣva karma yaccāru rūpadam \|\| 7 \|\|*

1-7. Yudhisthira said- О foremost of the race of Yadus, by performing which deed, do the men and women achieve the excellent beauty? You kindly tell me. Some people inspite of being beautiful and getting clad in the best of garments, but still there is no possibility of their having the loss of a limb or having an excess limb. Some people are extremely beautiful, but are blind of one eye, lance, having broken ears. О spotless one, О highly learned one, therefore, you kindly tell me about the means by which the men and women can achieve the height of beauty. Because inspite of a person being not beautiful, in case his way of walking and the speech both are excellent, his importance gets increased. When a beautiful person has an equally nice speech, excellent conduct, besides the excellent way of walking, the others would seem to be their impersonations alone. Therefore, you kindly reveal an activity with the performing of which, one should always make efforts to achieve the high class beauty. You kindly tell he related vrata for the purpose.

## \|\| 3.108.8-10 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*samyakpṛṣṭaṃ tvayā hīdamupavāsāśritaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*kathayāmi yathāproktaṃ variṣṭhena mahātmanā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*vaśiṣṭhamṛṣimāsīnaṃ saptarṣipravaraṃ dvijam \|*  
*papracchārundhatī pṛṣṭā yadetadbhavatā vayam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tasyāstu paripṛcchantyā jagāda munisattamaḥ \|*  
*yattacchṛṇuṣva kauṃteya mamedaṃ vadato'khilam \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. Sri Krsna said- You have raised an excellent question relating to an activity which has to be concerned with a vrata. The great Maharsi Vasistha had spoken on this subject earlier and the same ideas which were revealed by him, are being repeated by me. You please listen. О son of Kunti, once Vasistha - the foremost of the Saptarsis, when he was seated comfortably, his wife Arundhati asked him. At the asking of Arundhati, whatever was spoken by Vasistha, the same is going to be repeated by me.

## \|\| 3.108.11-14 \|\|

*vaśiṣṭha uvāca \|*  
*śrūyatāṃ yadahaṃ pṛṣṭastvayaitadvaravarṇini \|*  
*surūpatā nṛṇāṃ yena yoṣitāṃ copajāyate \|\| 11 \|\|*

*anabhyarcya tu goviṃdamanārādhya ca keśavam \|*  
*rūpādikā guṇāḥ kena prāpyaṃte'nyena karmaṇā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tasmādārādhanīyo'gre viṣṇureva yaśasvini \|*  
*pāratryaṃ prāptukāmena rūpasaṃpatsutādikam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*yastu vāñchati dharmajñe rūpaṃ sarvāṃgasundaram \|*  
*nakṣatrapuruṣaṃ bhadre jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

11-14. Vasistha said- You listen as to how the men and the women achieve the height of beauty. I am also narrating to you the activity about which you have asked me. You have asked as to whether one can achieve beauty without adoring lord Kesava or Govinda. In reply, I have to say that it cannot be achieved by any other means. Therefore, it is lord Visnu who should be adored first, who besides bestowing the beauty, wealth, sons etc., also bestow the comforts beyond the life. O glorious and religious minded one, the people, who are desirous of having beauty over the whole body, they shedding the anger, controlling all the sense organs, should worship the lord who is also known as the Naksatra Purusa or the lord of the constellations.

## \|\| 3.108.15-16 \|\|

*susnātaḥ prayatāhāraḥ saṃpūjayati yo'cyutam \|*  
*bhaktyā yoṣinnaro vāpi surūpāṃgaḥ prajāyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

*yoṣitā hi paraṃ rūpamicchantyā jagataḥ patiḥ \|*  
*sa evārādhanīyo'gre nakṣatrāṃgo janārdanaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. After taking the bath appropriately, when a man or a woman worships lord Acyuta with utmost devotion, his or her entire body is beautified. A lady, who aspires to achieve excellent beauty and good husband, should initially worship lord Janardana.

## \|\| 3.108.17 \|\|

*arundhatyuvāca \|*  
*nakṣatrarūpī bhagavānpūjyate puruṣottamaḥ \|*  
*mune yena vidhānena tanmamākhyātumarhasi \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Arundhati said- You please tell the method by which lord Janardana has to be worshipped.

## \|\| 3.108.18-19 \|\|

*vaśiṣṭha uvāca \|*  
*caitramāsātsamārabhya viṣṇoḥ pādābhipūjanam \|*  
*yathā kurvīta rūpārthaṃ tanniśāmaya tattvataḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*nakṣatramekamekaṃ vai snātaḥ samyagupoṣitaḥ \|*  
*nakṣatrapuruṣasyāṃgaṃ pūjayecca vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Vasistha said- By achieving the height of beauty, the feet of lord Visnu are worshipped in the month of Caitra. I am speaking about the related method, you please listen. Observing the fast, one should take a bath. Thereafter, the constellations relating to each one of the limbs of the human body, should be worshipped by the learned people.

## \|\| 3.108.20-21 \|\|

*mūle pādau tathā jaṃghe rohiṇyāmarcayecchubhe \|*  
*jānunī cāśvinīyoge āṣāḍhe corusaṃjñite \|\| 20 \|\|*

*phālgunīdvitaye guhyaṃ kṛttikāsu tathā kaṭim \|*  
*pārśve bhādrapadā gulphe dve kukṣī revatīṣu ca \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. During the Mula constellation, his feet should be adored; during the Rohini constellation his thighs should be adored; during the Asvini constellation his knee should be adored; during the Аsadhа constellation, his chest should be adored; during the Phalguna constellation his back part should be adored; during the Revati constellation his heels should be adored, besides both the laps.

## \|\| 3.108.22-28 \|\|

*anurādhāsūraḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ dhaniṣṭhāsvabhipūjayet \|*  
*bhujayugmaṃ viśākhāsu haste caiva karadvayam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*punarvasāvaṃgulīśca āśleṣāsu tathā nakhān \|*  
*jyeṣṭhāyāṃ pūjayedgrīvāṃ śravaṇe śravaṇe tathā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*puṣye mukhaṃ tathā svātau daśanānabhipūjayet \|*  
*āsyaṃ śatabhiṣagyoge maghāyoge ca nāsikām \|\| 24 \|\|*

*mṛgottamāṃge nayane pūjayedbhaktitaḥ śubhe \|*  
*citrāyoge lalāṭaṃ ca bharaṇīṣu tathā śiraḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*saṃpūjanīyā vidvadbhirārdrāyāṃ ca śiroruhāḥ \|*  
*upoṣito naro bhadre snānamabhyaṃgapūrvakam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*varjanīyaṃ prayatnena rūpaghnaṃ tadvinirdiśet \|*  
*pūjayettacca nakṣatraṃ nakṣatrasya ca daivatam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*somaṃ nakṣatrarājānaṃ svamantrairarcayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*pratinakṣatrayoge ca bhojanīyā dvijottamāḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

22-28. During the Anuradha constellation his hind parts (back) should be adored. During the Visakha constellation, both the hands with fingers should be adored. During the Asle$a constellation the nails; during Jyestha constellation neck; during Sravana the ears; during Pusya the face; the teeth in Svati constellation; the cheeks in the Satabhi$a constellation; the nose in Magha constellation; the eyes in Mrgasira constellation; the forehead in Citra constellation; the head in Bharani constellation and the hair of the head should be worshipped with devotion in Ardra constellation. О excellent one, while observing the fast, one should not smear oil over the body, because by doing so, one has to face the loss of beauty. A learned person should worship the related constellation as well as the moon in an appropriate manner. During each one of the constellation, the Moon who is the king of the constellations, should be worshipped appropriately. The best of the Brahmanas should be served with food, besides giving charities for the god of the constellations.

## \|\| 3.108.29-32 \|\|

*nakṣatrajñāya viprāya dānaṃ dadyācca śaktitaḥ \|*  
*antarāye samutpanne sūtakāśaucakārite \|\| 29 \|\|*

*upoṣya vācopa viśennakṣatramaparaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ māghāvasāne tu vratapāraḥ samāpyate \|\| 30 \|\|*

*samāpte tu vrate dadyācchaktyā sopaskarānvitam \|*  
*nakṣatrapuruṣaṃ haimaṃ pūjaye ttatra śaktitaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇaṃ brāhmaṇīṃ caiva vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*śayyāyāṃ tu samāsannaṃ gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

29-32. In case an obstruction is created, the devotee should worship during the next constellation, observing the fast. In this way, the vrata is concluded during the month of Magha. At the time of the conclusion, as per one’s means, he should make a figure of the Moongod in gold, which should be worshipped and then given over to a Brahmana couple, besides a well made bed with costumes and ornaments.

## \|\| 3.108.33-35 \|\|

*saptadhānyaṃ yathālābhaṃ gāṃ savatsāṃ payasvinīm \|*  
*chatropānadyugaṃ caiva ghṛtapātraṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

*maṃtreṇānena viprāya suśīlāya nivedayet \|*  
*yathā na viṣṇubhaktānāṃ vṛjinaṃ jāyate kvacita \|*  
*tathā surūpatārogya sukhasaṃpadihāstu me \|\| 34 \|\|*

*yathā na lakṣmyā śayanaṃ tava śūnyaṃ janārdana \|*  
*śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā janmani janmani \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. Thereafter, making use of the flowers, garlands and paste, the same should he worshipped and the seven types of grains, a cow with calf, an umbrella, shoes, besides a vase full of ghi should be given over to a Brahmana with the reciting of a mantra, saying “O Janardana, as the devotees of Visnu never meet a failure, or are never unsuccessful in their efforts, therefore, you kindly bestow beauty, good health, comforts and the wealth. You never go to sleep without Laksmi, similarly, my bed should never be vacant in all the births.”

## \|\| 3.108.36-39 \|\|

*evaṃ nivedya tatsarvaṃ praṇipatya kṣamāpayet \|*  
*śaktihīnastu gāṃ dadyād ghṛtapātrasamanvitām \|\| 36 \|\|*

*nakṣatrapuruṣākhyo'yaṃ yathāvatkathitastava \|*  
*pāpāpanodaṃ kurute samyakchraddhāvatāṃ satām \|\| 37 \|\|*

*aṅgopāṅgāni caivāsya pādādīni yaśasvini \|*  
*surūpāṇyabhijāyaṃte sadā janmāntarāṇi ve \|\| 38 \|\|*

*gātrāṇi caiva bhadrāṇi śarīrārogyamuttamam \|*  
*saṃtatiṃ manasaḥ prītiṃ rūpaṃ cātīva śobhanam \|\| 39 \|\|*

36-39. Thus speaking, all the things should be offered to the lord with all humility and then she should ask for forgiveness. Due to lack of resources, one should give away a vase full of ghi, besides a cow and a calf. Then I have narrated to you the story of Naksatra Purusa as has been heard earlier, it helps the devotees to free from all the sins. By performing this vrata, the devotee achieves all beautiful limbs and magnanimous beauty till his or her death. There are no physical or mental ailments and the body looks always attractive.

## \|\| 3.108.40-42 \|\|

*vāṅmādhuryaṃ tathā kāṃtiṃ yaccānyadapi vāṃchitam \|*  
*dadāti nakṣatrapumānpūjitaśca janārdanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*vaśiṣṭhena yathākhyātaṃ sarvaṃ tatte niveditam \|*  
*nakṣatrapuruṣaṃ nāma vratānāmuttamottamam \|\| 41 \|\|*

*hṛdbāhujānunayanorunitaṃbabhāgaṃ dakṣaiḥ prakalpya sutanuṃ puruṣottamasya \|*  
*ye pūjayaṃti jitakopamanovikārāḥ kauṃteya te nanu bhavaṃti surūpadehā \|\| 42 \|\|*

40-42. O glorious one, lord Janardana is the well known Naksaktra Purusa. The vrata which had been revealed by the sage Vasistha for him, I have repeated the same to you. O son of Kunti, thus creating a beautiful image of lord Purusottama - the Naksatra Purusa, with excellent heart, arms, knees, belly, eyes and buttocks, besides the other parts of the body and getting the mind free from malice and anger, then the performer should perform the puja. A person who does so, he or she surely attains the extremely beautiful body.

## Chapter 109. Naksatra Vrata

## \|\| 3.109.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*upavāseṣvaśaktasya tadaiva phalamicchataḥ \|*  
*anabhyāsena yogādvā kimiṣṭaṃ vratamucyate \|\| 1 \|\|*

*śivasyopari yasya syādbhaktiḥ sūryasya saṃbhavet \|*  
*nakṣatrākhyaṃ vrataṃ tena kathaṃ kāryaṃ vadasva me \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- A person, who is unable to perform the vrata, but is desirous of the rewards mentioned above and is also unable to resort to the yogic practices, then by which method the devotee of Siva as well Surya should perform the vrata for the constellations or the Naksatras? You kindly speak out.

## \|\| 3.109.3-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*upavāseṣvaśaktānāṃ naktaṃ bhojanamiṣyate \|*  
*asminvrate tadapyatra śrūyatāmakṣayaṃ mahat \|\| 3 \|\|*

*śivanakṣatrapuruṣaṃ śivabhaktipradāyakam \|*  
*yasminnakṣatrayoge tu purāṇajñāḥ pracakṣate \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Sri Krsna said- While observing this vrata, a person who is unable to observe the fast, should take food at night. I am also revealing the other beneficial methods as well. You please listen. Whatever the people well-versed in the Puranas say about the constellation in which one achieves the unfailing devotion for Siva as Naksatra Purusa, the same is being told by me.

## \|\| 3.109.5 \|\|

*phālgunasyāmale pakṣe yadā hastaḥ prajāyate \|*  
*tadā grāhyaṃ vrataṃ caiva naktena śivapūjanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. During the bright fortnight of the month of Phalguna and the arrival of Hasta constellation, the vrata should be started from the same date. Lord Siva should be adored at night.

## \|\| 3.109.6-7 \|\|

*śivā yeti ca hastena pādau pūjyatamau smṛtau \|*  
*śaṃkarāya namo gulphau pūjyau citrāsu pāṃḍava \|\| 6 \|\|*

*bhīmāyeti ca svātīṣu pūjayetpuruṣarṣabha \|*  
*ūru ddvayaṃ viśākhāsu trinetrāyati pūjayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. O Pandava, saying salutation to Siva, the feet of the lord should be worshipped in the Hasta constellation. Saying salutation to Sankara in Citra constellation, his heels should be adored; and saying salutation to Bhima during the Svati constellation, his knees should be adored. Then saying salutation to Trinetra in the Visakha constellation, the thighs should be adored.

## \|\| 3.109.8-9 \|\|

*meḍhraṃ caivānurādhāsu anaṅgāṅgaharāya ca \|*  
*kaṭiṃ jyeṣṭhāsu ca tathā surajyeṣṭheti cārcayet \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dānākhyāya namo nābhiḥ pūjyā mūlena śūlinaḥ \|*  
*pūrvottarāṣāḍhayuge pārśve vai pārvatīpatiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. During the Anuradha constellation, saying salutation to the best of the gods known a Нага, the linga should be adored. During the Jyestha constellation, offering salutation to Surajyestha, the waist should be adored. During the Mula constellation, the navel of Siva should be adored. By offering salutation to the carrier of the trident during the Purva and Uttarasadha constellation, the back of Siva - the lord of Parvati should be adored.

## \|\| 3.109.10 \|\|

*śravaṇena tathā kukṣī pūjye kapālineti ca \|*  
*vakṣaḥsthalaṃ dhaniṣṭhāsu sadyojāteti nāma ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Then offering salutation to Kapali during the Sravana constellation, both the laps should be adored. By offering salutation to Sadyojata during the Dhanistha constellation, the chest should be adored.

## \|\| 3.109.11 \|\|

*vāmeti pūjayetpārtha hṛdayaṃ śatabhiṣāsu ca \|*  
*pūrvottarāyuge bāhū namaḥ khaṭvāṃgadhāriṇe \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Then offering salutation to Vamadeva in the Satabhisa constellation, the heart should be adored. Offering salutation to the holder of a sword during the Purva and Uttага (Phalguni) constellation, both the arms should be adored.

## \|\| 3.109.12 \|\|

*pūjyaṃ rudrāya ca tathā revatīṣu karadvayam \|*  
*nakhaḥ pūjyo'śvinīyoge namaḥ khaṇḍendudhāriṇe \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Offering salutation to Rudra in the Revati constellation, both the hands should be adored. Offering salutation to Khandendu holder in the Asvini constellation, the nails should be adored.

## \|\| 3.109.13 \|\|

*bharaṇīṣu tataḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ vṛṣāṃkāya namo'stu te \|*  
*kṛttivāsāya ca tathā kṛttikāsu kṛkāṭikām \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Offering salutation to Vrsanka in Bharani constellation, the back has to be adored. Then offering salutation to the lord clad with deer skin in Krttika constellation, his neck should be adored.

## \|\| 3.109.14 \|\|

*vākpūjyā rohiṇīyoge namo vācaspateti ca \|*  
*mṛgottamāṃge daśanānbhairavāyeti vai namaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Offering salutation to the lord of speech the speech should be adored in the Mini constellation. Offering salutation to Bhairava during the Mrgasira constellation, the teeth should be adored.

## \|\| 3.109.15 \|\|

*ārdrāsu pūjyāvadharau sthāṇaveti yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*nāsā punarvasau pūjyā pūṣadaṃtavināśine \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Offering salutation to Sthanu during the Ardra constellation, the lower lip has to be worshipped. О Yudhi§thira, offering salutation to the Dantavinasaka during the Punarvasu constellation, the nose should be adored.

## \|\| 3.109.16 \|\|

*puṣye netratrayaṃ pūjyaṃ namaste sarvadarśine \|*  
*āśleṣāyāṃ lalāṭaṃ ca tryambakāya namonamaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Offering salutation to Sarvadarsin, one should adore the eyes in Pusya constellation Offering salutation to Trayambaka in the Aslesa constellation, the forehead is to be adored.

## \|\| 3.109.17 \|\|

*maghāsu ca jaṭājūṭaṃ pūjayedaṃdhakāraye \|*  
*pūrvāphālgunikāyugme śravaṇe somadhāriṇe \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Offering salutation to Andhakara during Magha constellation, the matted locks of hair are to be adored. Offering salutation to the lord decorated with the digit of the moon during the Purva Phalguni constellation, both the ears are to be adored.

## \|\| 3.109.18 \|\|

*namo'stu pāśāṃkuśapadmaśūlakapālasarpendudhanurddharāya \|*  
*gajāsurānaṃgadhurāṃdhakādivināśamūlāya namaḥ śivāya \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Adoring the one carrying the noose, the goad, spear, skull, the sun, the moon and the bow, and the killer of Gajasura, Kamadeva, Andhaka and other demons should be worshipped.

## \|\| 3.109.19 \|\|

*śiraḥ sampūjayeddadyāttato dhūpavilepanam \|*  
*tatastu rātrau bhoktavyaṃ tailakṣāravivarjitam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Adoring his head, the incense and paste should be offered to him. Thereafter, during the night, he should take food in which the salt and oil are not to be used.

## \|\| 3.109.20-21 \|\|

*śālitaṇḍulakaprasthaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam \|*  
*dadyātsarveṣu nakteṣu brāhmaṇāya nṛpottama \|\| 20 \|\|*

*śaktyabhāve na doṣaḥ syādadhike cādhikaṃ phalam \|*  
*nakṣatrayugale prāpte naktayugmaṃ samācaret \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. О best of the rulers, at the time of taking food at night, the performer should offer a tandula (950 grams) of the Sail rice to a Brahmana with ghi and he should continue to do so in future as well. There will be no blemish in case this is done appropriately and there will be growth in the merits. However, with the combination of the twin constellations, double the food should be taken during the night, because with the giving of the huge charities, the merit earned thereof would also be enormous.

## \|\| 3.109.22 \|\|

*sūtakāśaucadoṣe tu punaranyadupoṣayet \|*  
*evaṃ krameṇa saṃprāpte pāraṇe pāṃḍavādike \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. О Pandava, with the appearing of some obstructions or impurities like Sutaka, the fast should be observed at some other time.

## \|\| 3.109.23-26 \|\|

*brāhmaṇānbhojayedbhaktyā guḍakṣīra ghṛtādibhiḥ \|*  
*kāṃcanaṃ kārayeddevamumayā saha śaṃkaram \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śayyāṃ sulakṣaṇāṃ kṛtvā viruddhagraṃthivarjitām \|*  
*sopadhānakaviśrāmāṃ svāstarāvaraṇāṃ śubhām \|\| 24 \|\|*

*bhājanopānahacchatracāmarāsanadarpaṇaiḥ \|*  
*bhūṣaṇairapi saṃyuktāṃ phalavastrānulepanaiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tasyāṃ nidhāya taṃ devamalaṃkṛtya guṇānvitam \|*  
*kapilāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ śuciśīlāṃ payasvinīm \|\| 26 \|\|*

23-26. Then, a Brahmana should be offered food made of jaggery, rice mixed with milk, ghi etc. Thus continuing the adoration in a proper manner, the images of Siva and Parvati made in gold should be decorated beautifully and should be established over the bed without the knots and then worshipped. After the worship is completed, the vases for taking food, the shoes, the umbrella, flywhisks, seat, the mirror, ornaments, costumes, fruits, pastes etc. together with a milk giving cow with calf, should also be given.

## \|\| 3.109.27-28 \|\|

*suvarṇaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohanām \|*  
*dadyānmaṃtreṇa pūrvāhne na kālamabhilaṃghayet \|\| 27 \|\|*

*yathā na devaśayanaṃ tava parvatajātayā \|*  
*śūnyaṃ vṛttyātha saṃtatyā tathā me saṃtu siddhayaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. The cow’s horns should be decorated with gold and the hoofs should be decorated with the silver. A bronze milk pot should also be given during the forenoon time. One should beg forgiveness thereafter, saying- "O lord, as you have never been deprived of your sons and Parvati, similarly, all the success should be bestowed on me.”

## \|\| 3.109.29-30 \|\|

*yathā deva na śreyo'rthastvadanyo vidyate kvacit \|*  
*tathā māmuddharāśeṣaduḥkhasaṃsārasāgarāt \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇipatya visarjayet \|*  
*śayyāgavāditatsarvaṃ dvijasya bhavanaṃ nayet \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. As no welfare is possible without you, therefore, you kindly redeem me out of the ocean of the universe. After thus begging forgiveness, one should circumambulate. He should offer salutation with all humility and should send off the Brahmana with bed and other articles to his home.

## \|\| 3.109.31 \|\|

*naitadviśīlāya na dāṃbhikāya kutarkaduṣṭāya viniṃdakāya \|*  
*prakāśanīyaṃ vratamindumauleryaścāpi lobhopahatāṃtarātmā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Those who are neither compassionate nor noble in their deeds, those who are sinners busy in denouncing others and those who present incorrect arguments, for all of them the performance of this vrata lightens their soul filled with pride.

## \|\| 3.109.32 \|\|

*bhaktāya dāṃtāya guṇānvitāya pradeyametacchivabhaktiyuktaiḥ \|*  
*idaṃ mahāpātakakṛnnarāṇāmapyakṣayaṃ vedavido vadaṃti \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. This vrata should be observed by the devotees, auspicious and virtuous people, besides the devotees of Siva alone. The Vedic scholars are of the opinion that this vrata redeems even the notorious sinners.

## \|\| 3.109.33-34 \|\|

*yā vātha nārī kurute'tibhaktyā bhartāramāśritya śubhaṃ guruṃ vā \|*  
*na baṃdhuputrairna dhanairviyogamāpnoti duḥkhaṃ na suhṛtsamuttham \|\| 33 \|\|*

*idaṃ vaśiṣṭhena purā'rjunena kṛtaṃ kubereṇa puraṃdareṇa \|*  
*yatkīrtanādapyakhilānyaghāni vighnaṃ samāyāṃti na saṃśayotra \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. A woman, who follows her husband and the preceptor, she does not have to face any type of separation from the kiths and kins, besides the miseries. This vrata was initially observed by Vasistha, Arjuna, Kubera and Indra, as a result of which all the obstructions faced by them were removed and the sins were washed out. There is no doubt about the same.

## \|\| 3.109.35 \|\|

*iti paṭhati śṛṇoti vā ya itthaṃ śivapuruṣaṃ puruhūtavallabhaḥ syāt \|*  
*api narakagatānpitṝnaśeṣāñcchivabhavanaṃ nayatīha yaḥ karoti \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. A person, who performs the Sivapurusa vrata in an appropriate manner and completes the same, he earns the favour of Indra and transports all his manes suffering in the hell to the place of Indra.

## Chapter 110. All the Vratas described

## \|\| 3.110.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*yadi kartuṃ na śaknoti vrataṃ nakṣatrapauruṣam \|*  
*gṛhītaṃ rabhasā kṛṣṇa hyanyadvā vratamuttamam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*saṃpūrṇaṃ jāyate yena yadacīrṇaṃ purā sthitam \|*  
*kuru prasādaṃ guhyārthametanme vaktumarhasi \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- In case a person is unable to perform the Naksatra Paurusa vrata, then you tell me about another vrata, with the performing of which one could achieve the complete success, you kindly tell me about such a type of vrata.

## \|\| 3.110.3-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*sādhusādhu mahābāho kururāja yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*rahasyānāṃ rahasyaṃ te kathayāmi vratottamam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*sampūrṇaṃ nāma taccāpi vrataṃ samyakphalapradam \|*  
*yaccīrṇaṃ naranārībhirbhavetsaṃpūrṇakārakam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*avaśyaṃ tacca kartavyamakṣīṇaphalakāṃkṣibhiḥ \|*  
*kiñcidbhagnaṃ pramādena yadgataṃ vratināṃ sthitam \|*  
*tatsaṃpūrṇaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ vratenānena pāṇḍava \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. Sri Krsna said- Excellent, excellent, 0 valorous one, O Yudhisthira - the lord of the race of Kuru, I am now speaking to you about a vrata, which is quite secretive. One achieves the complete merit after performing this vrata. It bestows the entire and complete success. It is known as the Sampurna vrata and should be observed by all the men and women alike. A person who is desirous of achieving the everlasting merit, should always observe the said vrata. O Pandava, when the vrata of an arrogant person is broken somehow, with the performing of this vrata one achieves merit for even the incomplete vrata.

## \|\| 3.110.6 \|\|

*upadravairbahuvidhairmadānmohācca pārthiva \|*  
*yadbhagnaṃ kiñcideva syādvrataṃ vipravināyakaiḥ \|*  
*tatsaṃpūrṇaṃ bhavetpārtha satyaṃsatyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. O Parthiva, at the start of the vrata, various types of obstructions, disturbances, confusions and arrogances crop up, which force the vrata to be broken, but still by the grace of the lord who is the destroyer of the obstructions, it gets completed truthfully. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.110.7-8 \|\|

*kāṃcanaṃ raupyakaṃ rūpaṃ śilpinā taddhaṭāpayet \|*  
*bhagnavrate tu yo devastatsvarūpaṃ sunirmitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*rūpaṃ strīpuṃsayorvāpi prārabdhaṃ yadvrate kila \|*  
*navaniṣpāditaṃ kiñciddaivātsarvaṃ tathotthitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. O Partha, after the start of the vrata, if it is broken, then the performer of the vrata should get the image of the presiding goddess in silver by an artisan or the silver smith, irrespective of it’s being the figure of a male or a female deity. The image should be made in a traditional way though some new element could be added to the same.

## \|\| 3.110.9-10 \|\|

*dvibhujaṃ paṅkajārūḍhaṃ saumyaprahasitānanam \|*  
*niṣpāditaṃ śilpabhāvāttasminneva dinedine \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tanmāse ca punaḥ prāpte brāhmaṇo vidhinā gṛhe \|*  
*snāpayetpayasā dadhnā ghṛtakṣīrarasāṃbubhiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. It should have two arms and lodged over a lotus flower. It should be pleasant to look at with a smiling face. The image should be made during those days alone in a pleasant way. Again, on the arrival of the same month, one should invite a Brahmana to his house and the said deity should be worshipped in the house offering the milk, curd, ghi, payasam besides the water.

## \|\| 3.110.11-12 \|\|

*gaṃdhacaṃdanapuṣpaiśca carcayetkuṃkumādinā \|*  
*toyapūrṇasya kumbhasya pṛthvyāṃ vinyasya caṃdanaiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*dhūpadīpākṣatairvastrai ratnairapyupahārakaiḥ \|*  
*arghyaṃ dadyācca tannāmnā maṃtreṇānena pāṃḍava \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. The image should be properly bathed and then the scent, flowers, sandalpaste and vermilion should be offered to the deity. О Pandava, a pitcher filled with water should be consecrated on earth, followed by offering of incense, lamp, costumes, gems and other gifts. Then the oblation of water should be made over it with the chanting of mantras.

## \|\| 3.110.13-16 \|\|

*upasannasya dīnasya prāyaścittakṛtāñjaleḥ \|*  
*śaraṇaṃ ca prapannasya kuruṣvādya dayāṃ prabho \|\| 13 \|\|*

*paratra bhayabhītasya bhagnakhaṇḍavratasya ca \|*  
*kuru prasādaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ vrataṃ saṃpūrṇamastu me \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tapaśchidraṃ vratacchidraṃ yacchidraṃ bhagnake vrate \|*  
*tava prasādāddeveśa sarvamacchidramastu naḥ svāhā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*pūrvato dakṣiṇataḥ paścimata uttarataḥ \|*  
*vidikṣu coparyyadhastāddikpālebhyo namonamaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-16. Thereafter, he should beg forgiveness thus- “O lord, I am a destitute person who have arrived before you with folded hands and have taken refuge with you, you be kind to me. Because of the breaking of the vrata, I am apprehensive about my future world. Therefore, you be graceful on me and grant me the privilege of having all my broken vratas to be completed today itself. О lord of the gods, let all the parts of my broken vratas be completed, salutation to the related deity. Salutation to the deities of the eastern, southern, western and northern directions, besides the Tsana (north-east), Agneya (southeast), Nairrtya (south-west) and Vayavya (north-west) directions, the sky and the earth.

## \|\| 3.110.17-19 \|\|

*idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ naivedyaṃ te namonamaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ procya tataḥ pādau jānunī kaṭiśīrṣake \|\| 17 \|\|*

*vakṣaḥkukṣidṛṣṭipṛṣṭhabāhvaṃsāṃkaśiroruhān \|*  
*pūjayettasya devasya tataḥ paścātkṣamāpayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

*pūjitastvaṃ yathāśaktyā namaste'stu surottama \|*  
*aihikāmuṣmikīṃ nātha kāryasiddhiṃ diśasva me \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. Arghya and eatables are offered to all of you. I am offering salutation to you again and again.” Thus, after begging forgiveness, the deity’s feet, knees, waist, head, chest, lap, eyes, back, arms, shoulders and the hair should be worshipped. Thereafter, he should again beg forgiveness saying- “O lord of the Devas, I have worshipped you appropriately according to my means, therefore, you kindly bestow success on me, salutation to you.”

## \|\| 3.110.20-22 \|\|

*evaṃ kṣamāpayitvā tu devarūpaṃ vidhānataḥ \|*  
*tato dvijasya kaunteya vidhijñasyopapādayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

*sthitvā pūrvamukho vipro gṛhṇīyāddarbhapāṇinā \|*  
*viprasya haste yacchecca dātā vai cottarāmukhaḥ \|*  
*maṃtreṇānena kauṃteya sopavāsaḥ prayatnataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*idaṃ vrataṃ mayā khaṃḍaṃ kṛtamāsītpurā dvija \|*  
*bhagavaṃstvaprasādena saṃpūrṇaṃ tadihāstu me \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. О son of Kunti, thus begging forgiveness in an appropriate manner, the entire offered material should be given over to a learned Brahmana. At the time of giving and taking, the giver should face the north, while the Brahmana holding kusa should face the east. While giving away the articles during the fasting period, one should offer prayer thus-“O Brahmana, I had started this vrata earlier as well, but was left broken and incomplete. Therefore, I pray while performing this vrata that the deficiency of the earlier should get supplied and completed.”

## \|\| 3.110.23-24 \|\|

*brāhmaṇo'pi pratīcchettu maṃtreṇānena tadvratam \|*  
*vāksaṃpūrṇaṃ manaḥpūrṇaṃ pūrṇaṃ kāyavratena te \|*  
*saṃpūrṇasya prasādena bhava pūrṇamanorathaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇā yatprabhāṣaṃte hyanumodaṃti devatāḥ \|*  
*sarvadevamayā viprā naitadvacanamanyathā \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. While receiving the articles, the Brahmana should also recite the mantras, saying- “The vrata has been bodily performed by you with speech and mind, therefore, the desire of your mind, which prompted you to perform this vrata should be fulfilled. The words of Brahmanas are always supported by the gods, because they could never be untrue.

## \|\| 3.110.25-26 \|\|

*jaladhiḥ kṣāratāṃ nītaḥ pāvakaḥ sarvabhakṣatām \|*  
*sahasranetraḥ śakro'pi kṛto viprairmahātmabhiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇānāṃ tu vacanādbrahmahatyā praṇaśyati \|*  
*aśvamedhaphalaṃ sāgraṃ prāpyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. It is the Brahmana alone who had established Indra with a thousand eyes and the god of ocean over their respective places. With the words of the Brahmana, the notorious sin of the Brahmahatya is also washed out, besides one earns the merit of performing the Asvamedha sacrifice. There is no doubt about it

## \|\| 3.110.27 \|\|

*vyāsavālmīkivacanādbrāhmaṇavacanācca gargagautama parāśaradhaumyāṃgirasavāṣṭhināradādimunivacanātsaṃpūrṇaṃ bhavatu te vratam \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. With the words of the great Rsis like Vyasa, Valmiki, Garga, Gautama, Parasara, Dhaumya, Angirasa, Vasi$tha, Narada and others, let your vrata be completed.”

## \|\| 3.110.28 \|\|

*evaṃvidhavidhānena gṛhītvā brāhmaṇo vrajet \|*  
*taddānaṃ preṣayetsa brāhmaṇasya gṛhe svayam \|*  
*tataḥ paṃca mahāyajñānnirvapedbhojanādi ca \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Following this process, the Brahmanas should accept the articles so given to them. The performer should arrange for sending all the articles given to the Brahmana to his place. After performing all the five Mahayajnas, the eatables should be consumed.

## \|\| 3.110.29-31 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā vratametatsakṛttathā \|*  
*tasya saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti tadvrataṃ yatpurā sthitam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*khaṃḍaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti prasanne vratadaivate \|*  
*saṃpūrṇaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā saṃpūrṇāṃgo bhavedvratī \|\| 30 \|\|*

*bhogī bhavyo lasatkīrtiḥ sva saṃpūrṇamanorathaḥ \|*  
*sthitvā varṣaśataṃ martye tataḥ svarge'maro bhavet \|\| 31 \|\|*

29-31. When a performer with his mind filled with devotion performs this vrata even once, the earlier incomplete vrata also gets completed by the grace of the lord. He enjoys all the pleasures, glory, fame and gets all his desires fulfilled. He enjoys comfortable life for a hundred years on earth and attains an everlasting position in the heaven after death.

## \|\| 3.110.32 \|\|

*yatheṣṭaceṣṭācārī ca brahmaviṣṇvindrapūjitaḥ \|*  
*svargaloke ciraṃ sthitvā punarmokṣamavāpnuyāt \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. He is honoured there by Visnu and Indra and moves there at will. Thus spending a long time in the heaven, finally he achieves moksa.

## \|\| 3.110.33-34 \|\|

*prāyaścittamidaṃ proktaṃ purā gargeṇa me prabho \|*  
*gokule gokulākīrṇe mayā bālye'pyupoṣitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*evaṃ tvamapi kauṃteya cara saṃpūrṇakaṃ vratam \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. The form of this repentance was initially revealed to me by the sage Garga, while I was living in Gokula with the cowherds. I performed this vrata during my childhood, myself. O son of Kunti, therefore, you should complete this entire vrata.

## \|\| 3.110.35 \|\|

*bhagnāni yāni madamohavaśādgṛhītvā janmāntareṣvapi nareṇa samatsareṇa \|*  
*saṃpūrṇapūjanaparasya puro bhavaṃti sarvavratāni paripūrṇaphalapradāni \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Even the incomplete vratas because of greed, attachment etc. performed in the earlier births, get completed with the performing of this vrata. With the glory of this vrata, all the incomplete earlier vratas become fruitful.

## Chapter 111. Kamadeva Vaisya Vrata

## \|\| 3.111.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*varṇāśramāṇāṃ prabhavaḥ purāṇeṣu mayā śrutaḥ \|*  
*paṇyastrīṇāṃ samācāraṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kā hyāsāṃ devatā kṛṣṇa kiṃ vrataṃ kimupoṣitam \|*  
*kena dharmeṇa caivetāḥ svargamāpsyaṃtyanuttamam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said- O Krsna, I have learnt about the genesis and evolution of the four varnas as highlighted in the Puranas. Presently, I would like to know about the conduct and dharma of the Vaisyas (slave girls), and who happens to be their god? What are the vratas prescribed for them? How should they observe the fast? With the following of which one of the dharma, can they achieve the best of heaven?

## \|\| 3.111.3-12 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*mama patnīsahasrāṇi saṃti pāṃḍava ṣoḍaśa \|*  
*rūpaudāryaguṇopetā manmathāyatanāḥ śubhāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tābhirvasaṃtasamaye kokilālikulākule \|*  
*puṣpitopavanotphullakahlārasarasastaṭe \|*  
*nirbharāpānagoṣṭhīṣu prasaktābhiralaṃkṛte \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kuraṃganayanaḥ śrīmānmālatīkṛtaśekharaḥ \|*  
*gacchansamīpe mārgeṇa sāṃbaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sākṣātkaṃdarparūpeṇa sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*anaṃgaśarataptābhiḥ sābhilāṣamavekṣitaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pravṛddho manmathastāsāṃ sarvāṅgakṣobhadāyakaḥ \|*  
*nirīkṣya tamahaṃ sarvaṃ vikāraṃ jñānacakṣuṣā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*aśeṣe ruṣitaḥ sarvā hariṣyaṃtīha dasyavaḥ \|*  
*mayi svargamanuprāpte bhavatīḥ kāmamohitāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*etadvākyamupaśrutya bāṣparyākulekṣaṇāḥ \|*  
*māmūcurvada govinda kathametadbhaviṣyati \|\| 9 \|\|*

*bhartāraṃ jagatāmīśaṃ bhavaṃtamaparā jitam \|*  
*divyānubhāvāṃ ca purīṃ ratnavaṃti gṛhāṇi ca \|\| 10 \|\|*

*dvārikāvāsinaḥ sarvāndevarūpānkumārakān \|*  
*bhagavansarvalokasya kathaṃ bhogyā bhavāmahe \|\| 11 \|\|*

*dāsabhāvamanuprāpya bhaviṣyāmaḥ kathaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*ko dharmaḥ kaḥ samācāraḥ kathaṃ vṛttirbhaviṣyati \|\| 12 \|\|*

3-12. Sri Krsna said- O Pandava! I have sixteen thousand queens each one of whom possesses exceptional beauty and because of this, they are termed as the temples of Kamadeva or cupid. Once during the spring season, there was a lake over the bank of which bees were hovering over the flowers to suck nectar out of the flowers. The beautiful damsels (my wives) were taking their bath in the lake. At the same time. Samba (my son) passed by that way, where the damsels were taking their bath. They had doe like eyes and their heads decorated with the jasmine flowers could overpower even the enemies. Finding my son Samba there, all my wives became lustful and started looking at him with lustful eyes. Getting extremely lustful, the limbs of all the damsels started itching At that point of time, observing their conduct with my divine sight and realizing the blemish of their hearts, I got filled with rage and pronounced a curse on them - “All of you would be carried away by the decoits. After my departure for heaven, you would suffer from the lustful pain.' On hearing the curse, the damsels with tears in then eyes, prayed to Sri Krsna “O Govinda how could it be possible?” After having you as the controller of the universe as a husband, after living in the city comparable with the place of Indra which is quite divine and leading a chaste life in Dvarika shall we have to be used by one and all? How shall we be able to serve as the slave girls? What shall be the means of our livelihood?”

## \|\| 3.111.13-16 \|\|

*tathā lālapyamānāstā vāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇāḥ \|*  
*mayā proktā yuvatyastāḥ saṃtāpastyajyatāmayam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*jalakrīḍāvihāreṣu purā sarasi mānase \|*  
*bhavatīnāṃ sagarvāṇāṃ nārado'bhyāśamāgataḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*hutāśanasutāḥ sarvā bhavatyo'psarasaḥ purā \|*  
*apraṇamyāvalepena paripṛṣṭaḥ sa yogavit \|\| 15 \|\|*

*kathaṃ nārā yaṇo'smākaṃ bhartā syādityupādiśa \|*  
*tasmādvratapradānaṃ ca śāpadānamabhūtpurā \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-16. With their eyes filled with tears when the damsels spoke such pathetic words, I spoke to them “O damsels, stop grieving now, because in earlier times, while enjoying the water sport in the Manasarovara lake, once Narada had reached there. At that point of time, all of you had been born of Agni as Apsaras. Out of arrogance, all of you asked the sage Narada-“How shall we get Narayana as our husband? You kindly tell us.” He advised you for the observing of a vrata but at the same time, also pronounced a curse on all of you.

## \|\| 3.111.17-18 \|\|

*śayyādvayapradānena madhumādhavamāsayoḥ \|*  
*suvarṇopaskarotsargāddvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣataḥ \|*  
*bhartā nārāyaṇo nūnaṃ bhaviṣyatyanyajanmani \|\| 17 \|\|*

*na kṛto yatpraṇāmo me rūpasaubhāgyamatsarāt \|*  
*paraṃ pṛṣṭo'smi tenāśu viyogo vo bhaviṣyati \|*  
*caurairapahṛtāḥ sarvā veśyātvaṃ samavāpsyatha \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. During both the months of the spring season, on the bright dvadasi day, by giving away two well arranged beds with gold, you would surely get Narayana as your husband. But, because of your being arrogant, you have asked me a question without initially offering me the customary salutation, therefore, you would surely achieve Visnu as your husband, but you would be stolen by the dacoits and shall then have to live as concubines.”

## \|\| 3.111.19 \|\|

*evaṃ nāradaśāpena macchāpena ca sāṃpratam \|*  
*na kāryaḥ saṃbhramaḥ kaściddāsītvaṃ vo bhaviṣyati \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Thus, because of the earlier curse of Narada and presently my curse, you shall have to serve as slave girls. Therefore, there is no need for confusion any further.

## \|\| 3.111.20-22 \|\|

*idānīmapi yadvakṣye tacchraṇudhvaṃ varānanāḥ \|*  
*purā devāsure yuddhe hateṣu śataśaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*dānavāsurasainyeṣu rākṣaseṣu tatastataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ nārīsahasrāṇi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ \|*  
*pariṇītāni yāni syurbalādbhuktāni yāni vai \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tāni sarvāṇi deveśaḥ provāca vadatāṃ varaḥ \|*  
*veśyādharmeṇa vartadhvamadhunā nṛpamaṃdire \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. Besides this, whatever is going to be spoken by me, you please listen. In earlier time, a terrific war was fought between the gods and the demons. Hundreds of their women were forcibly made use of, inspite of their having been married as well as unmarried ones. At that point of time, the lord had ordained that they should live in the temples as the slave girls.

## \|\| 3.111.23-24 \|\|

*bhaktimatyo varārohāstadā devakuleṣu ca \|*  
*rājānaḥ svāminaḥ stutyā brāhmaṇāśca bahuśrutāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ gṛheṣu tiṣṭhadhvaṃ sūtakaṃ cāpi tatsamam \|*  
*bhaviṣyati ca saubhāgyaṃ sarvāsāmapi śaktitaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Living in the temples, you should therefore sing the glory of the Brahmanas. By living in their homes, you shall have the impurities comparable to the household ladies. You would also earn fortunes according to the means of the householder.

## \|\| 3.111.25-27 \|\|

*na caikasminratiḥ kāryā puruṣe dhanavarjite \|*  
*anumānyaḥ prasādyaśca śulkado devavatsadā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*surūpo vā virūpo vā dravyaṃ tatra prayojanam \|*  
*na tadvyatikramaḥ kāryo brahmahatyāmavāpnuyāt \|*  
*na cāpi madyapābhiśca bhāvyaṃ kauṭilyabuddhibhiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*yaḥ kaścicchulkamādāya gṛhameṣyati vaḥ sadā \|*  
*niśchadmanaivāpahāryaṃ tatsarvaṃ daṃbhavarjitam \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. While living there, you should never have sex with the poor people. You should please the person like a lord who paid you the fee, irrespective of his being beautiful or ugly. Don’t do anything otherwise. In case, one does so, she earns the sin of Brahmahatya. You should only be concerned with the riches you receive. Don’t indulge into misconduct after consuming intoxicants, whosoever comes to your house with money, you should serve him without deceit. Don’t extend misconduct against such a person.

## \|\| 3.111.28-32 \|\|

*vyabhicāro na kartavyaḥ svāminā saha karhicit \|*  
*rūpayauvanadarpeṇa dhanalobhena vā punaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*dāsī bhūtvā ca yā kācidvyabhicāraṃ karoti ca \|*  
*patinā saha pāpiṣṭhā pāpiṣṭhāṃ yātyadhogatim \|\| 29 \|\|*

*devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca puṇye'hni samupasthite \|*  
*gobhūhiraṇyadhānyāni pradeyāni ca śaktitaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*yadā sūryadine prāpte puṣyo vā sa punarvasuḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*avicāreṇa sarvābhiranuṣṭheyaṃ ca tatpunaḥ \|*  
*saṃsārottāraṇāyālametadvedavido viduḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

28-32. Don’t misbehave with the visitors. Because of youthful age or because of her riches, a concubine when misbehaves with a person, she surely achieves the lowest position. On the arrival of the day which is auspicious for the gods as well as the manes, a whore should give away in charity the cow, gold, land, food grains etc. to the Brahmanas. She should obey their commands. Besides the above, the secret of whichever vrata is revealed by them, the same should be followed by you without a second thought, because in order to cross the ocean of the universe, the Vedic seers have claimed them to be competent to do so.

## \|\| 3.111.33-36 \|\|

*bhavetsarvauṣadhisnānaṃ samyaṅnārī samācaret \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tadā pañcaśarasyāpi saṃnidhātṛtvameṣyati \|*  
*arcayetpuṇḍarīkākṣamanaṅgasyāpi kīrtanam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*kāmāya pādau saṃpūjya jaṃghe vai mohakāriṇe \|*  
*meḍhraṃ kadarpanidhaye kaṭiṃ prītiyuje namaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*nābhiṃ saukhyasamudrāya vāmanāya tathodaram \|*  
*hṛdayaṃ hṛdayeśāya stanāvāhlādakāriṇe \|\| 36 \|\|*

33-36. When the Pusya or Punarvasu constellations fall on sundays, a woman should take a bath cleaning all her limbs. Then the lord Pundarikaksa should be worshipped appropriately, saying- “Adoration to lord Kamadeva, salutation to the treasure of Kandarpa. Salutation to the one who extends devotion and linga is to be adored. Saying salutation to Pritiyuje, the waist should be adored. Saying salutation to the ocean of pleasure, the navel should be adored. Saying salutation to Vamana, the belly is to be adored; saying salutation to the one who lives in the heart, the heart is to be adored; saying salutation to the bestower of delight, the chest is to be adored.

## \|\| 3.111.37-38 \|\|

*utkaṃṭhāyeti vai kaṃṭhamāsyamānandajāya ca \|*  
*vāmāṃsaṃ puṣpacāpāya puṣpabāṇāya dakṣiṇam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*namo'nantāya vai mauliṃ vilolāyeti ca dhvajam \|*  
*sarvātmane śirastadvaddevasya pūjayet \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Saying salutation to Utkantha, the neck is to be adored. Saying salutation to the one with blissful birth, the face is to be adored. Saying salutation to Puspabana, the right shoulder is to be adored. Saying salutation to Ananta, the forehead has to be adored. Offering salutation to Vilola, the flag should be adored. Saying salutation to Sarvatma (or the universal soul), the head is to be adored

## \|\| 3.111.39-40 \|\|

*namaḥ śrīpataye tārkṣyadhvajāṃkuśadharāya ca \|*  
*gadine pītavastrāya śaṃkhine cakriṇe namaḥ \|*  
*namo nārāyaṇāyeti kāmadevātmane namaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*namaḥ śāṃtyai namaḥ prītyai namo ratyai namaḥ śriye \|*  
*namaḥ puṣṭyai namastuṣṭyai namaḥ sarvārthadāya ca \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. Offering salutation to Garudadhvaja and carrier of Ankusa, salutation to the one who is clad in Pitambara, who is the holder of club and cakra. Salutation to Kamadevatma. Salutation to Santi, salutation to Priti, Rati and Sri. Salutation to Pusti and the one who is aware of all the meanings.

## \|\| 3.111.41-42 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya govindamanaṃgātmakamīśvaram \|*  
*gaṃdhairmālyaistathā dhūpairnaivedyaiścaiva bhāminī \|\| 41 \|\|*

*atra cāhūya dharmajñaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam \|*  
*avyaṃgāvayavaṃ pūjya gaṃdhapuṣpādibhistathā \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. In this way, after worshipping the deity with garlands, incense and eatables, the damsel should worship such a type of Brahmana who should be well-versed in dharma, the Vedas, besides being quite a learned one and should be possessing the excellent limbs.

## \|\| 3.111.43-46 \|\|

*śāleyataṃḍulaprasthaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam \|*  
*tasmai viprāya sā dadyān mādhavaḥ prīyatāmiti \|\| 43 \|\|*

*yatheṣṭāhārabhuktaṃ ca tameva dvijasattamam \|*  
*ratyarthaṃ kāmadevo'yamiti citte'vadhārya ca \|\| 44 \|\|*

*yadyadicchati viprendrastattatkuryādvilāsinī \|*  
*sarvabhāvena cātmānamarpayetsmitabhāṣiṇī \|\| 45 \|\|*

*evamādityavāreṇa sadā tadvratamācaret \|*  
*taṃḍulaprasthadānaṃ ca yāvanmāsāṃstu dvādaśa \|\| 46 \|\|*

43-46. Thereafter, a vase filled with ghi and a tandula (950 grains) of Sali rice should also be given over to a Brahmana, besides the charities and at the time of giving over the same, she should say- “Let lord Madhava be pleased.’’ When the Brahmana is served with the food of his liking and satisfaction, the damsel should keep in her mind the feeling that he is like her husband besides being the cupid. Wearing a serene smile over her face and dedicating herself towards him, then she should fulfill all his desires. Thus on each dvadasi, a tandula of rice should be given in charity, completing the vrata.

## \|\| 3.111.47-51 \|\|

*tatastrayodaśe māsi saṃprāpte tasya bhāminī \|*  
*viprasyopaskarairyuktāṃ śayyāṃ dadyādvilakṣaṇām \|\| 47 \|\|*

*sopadhānakaviśrāmāṃ svāstarāvaraṇāṃ śubhām \|*  
*dīpikopānahacchatrapādukāsanasaṃyutām \|\| 48 \|\|*

*sapatnīkamalaṃkṛtya hemasūtrāṅgulīyakaiḥ \|*  
*sūkṣmavastraiḥ sakaṭakairdhūpamālyānulepanaiḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*kāmadevaṃ sapatnīkaṃ guḍakuṃbhopari sthitam \|*  
*tāmrapātrāsanagataṃ haimanetrapaṭāvṛtam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*sakāṃsyabhājanopetamikṣudaṇḍasamanvitam \|*  
*dadyādetena maṃtreṇa tathaikāṃ gāṃ payasvinīm \|\| 51 \|\|*

47-51. Subsequently, on the trayodasi, a well decorated bed should be given in charity, together with pillows, cushions and a beautiful bed sheet. In addition, a lamp, a pair of shoes, an umbrella and sandals should also given in charity. The Brahmana couple should be adored with the offering of a yajnopavita of gold, minor clothes, incense, flower necklace and sandalpaste. Then, the image of Kamadeva along with his wife stationed in a pitcher filled with raw sugar, besides a finger ring, five costumes and a duly decorated vase should also be given to the Brahmana. The kalasa should be of copper and should be decorated with golden eyes and a costume 1 here should also be a bronze vase and a staff, besides a cow should also be given in charity.

## \|\| 3.111.52-54 \|\|

*yathāṃtaraṃ na paśyāmi kāmakeśavayoḥ sadā \|*  
*tathaiva sarvakāmāptirastu viṣṇo sadā mama \|\| 52 \|\|*

*yathā na kāminīdehātprayāti tava keśava \|*  
*tathāpi mama deveśa śarīrasthaṃ patiṃ kuru \|*  
*tathaiva kāñcanaṃ devaṃ prati gṛhṇandvijottamaḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

*ka idaṃ ko'dātkasmā adātkāmaḥ kāmāyādātkāmo dātā kāmaḥ pratigrahītā kāmaṃ samudramāviśamaitattaiti vaidikamantramīrayet \|*  
*ko'dāditi paṭhenmantraṃ dhyāyaṃścetasi mādhavam \|*  
*tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya visṛjeddvijapuṅgavam \|*  
*śayyāsanādikaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇasya gṛhaṃ nayet \|\| 54 \|\|*

52-54. Thereafter, the performer of vrata should thus offer the prayer- “O lord Visnu, let me never observe any difference between Kamadeva as well as Kesava and all my desires should always get fulfilled. O god of gods, as Laksmi never gets separated from your body, similarly, let my husband gets absorbed in my body. Then, while receiving the gold image, a Brahmana should utter the mantra- ka idam ko 'datkasma........ Thereafter, devoting one’s mind towards Madhava, the Brahmana should be sent off and all the articles relating to the bed, should be arranged to be sent to the place of the Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.111.55-56 \|\|

*tataḥprabhṛti yo'nyopi ratyarthaṃ gṛhamāgataḥ \|*  
*sa samyaksūryavāreṇa samaṃ pūjyo yathecchayā \|\| 55 \|\|*

*evamekaṃ dvijaṃ śāṃtaṃ purāṇajñaṃ vicakṣaṇam \|*  
*tamarcayeta ca sadā aparaṃ vā tadājñayā \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. From that day onwards, whosoever arrives to her place for the purpose of having a physical relation with the concubine, she should adore him, as stated earlier. She should always speak about a Brahmana, who is well-versed in the Puranas, while any other acts should be done with his permission only.

## \|\| 3.111.57-60 \|\|

*na prāpnoti tadā vighnaṃ garbhasūtakajaṃ kvacit \|*  
*daivaṃ vā mānuṣaṃ vā syāduparāgeṇa vā tataḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*sādhāranaṣṭapaśuvadyathāśaktyā samāpayet \|*  
*etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ veśyādharmamaśeṣataḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*puruhūtena yatproktaṃ dānuvīṣu tato mayā \|*  
*tadidaṃ ca vrataṃ sarvaṃ bhavatīṣu prakāśitam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*sarvapāpapraśamanamanaṃtaphaladāyakam \|*  
*kalyāṇinīnāṃ kathitaṃ kurudhvaṃ tadvarānanāḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

57-60. By so doing, she would not earn any impurity of her activity or the child birth or that of an eclipse. Because she lives like a lost animals, she should adore the new comer as per her means. This is what has been told by me to you, or Indra told to the Danavas. O damsels, therefore, follow this Vaisya-dharma. It destroys all the sins and bestows the enormous merit, which is the form of welfare for such women.

## \|\| 3.111.61 \|\|

*etatpārtha mayā pūrvaṃ gopīnāṃ tu prakāśitam \|*  
*purāṇaṃ dharmasarvasvaṃ veśyājanasukhapradam \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. O Partha, this dharma as mentioned in the Puranas, which pleases the concubines, had been told by me to the milkmaids.

## \|\| 3.111.62 \|\|

*karoti yā'śeṣamakhaṇḍametatkalyāṇinī mādhavalokasaṃsthā \|*  
*sā pūjitā devagaṇairaśeṣairānandakṛtsthānamupaiti viṣṇoḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. A damsel who performs this vrata completely, such a damsel, getting honoured by the gods, achieves the graceful place of Visnu.

## Chapter 112. Vrmtaka Vrata

## \|\| 3.112.1 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athāto vṛṃtākavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ \|*  
*saṃvatsaraṃ ca ṣaṇmāsāṃstrīnmāsānvā na bhakṣayet \|*  
*atha bharaṇyāṃ maghāyāṃ vā ekarātropavāsaṃ kṛtvā sthaṃḍile devānāhūya gaṃdhadhūpapuṣpanaivedyadīpādinā pūjayet \|*  
*darbhapāṇirgaṃdhodakenāvāhayet \|*  
*yamarājānamāvāhayāmi kālamāvāhayāmi \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Sri Krsna said- I am going to reveal to you the Vrmtaka vidhi, which prescribes fasting without food for a full one year or six months or three months. On the day of Bharani or Magha constellation, observing the fast, a pedestal on land should be made over which the gods should be invoked and worshipped offering the fragrance, flowers, eatables, lamp and other things. Then carrying the kusa grass in his hand, he should think that he is invoking the lord of Yama, invoking Kala, invokingNila, invoking Vaivasvata, invoking the death and invoking Paramesthin. Thus invoking all the gods, the fire should be worshipped. Offering the sesamum seeds mixed with ghi, the word Svaha should be added after the names of Yamaraja, Kila, Nila, Citragupta, Vaivasvata, Mrtyu and Parame$thi, and the ofterings should be made thereafter. Then reciting the mantra- Agnirmurdhe..., eight hundred offerings should be made. Thereafter, Svistakrta and the repentance homas should be performed. The entire process should be completed by he Brahmana himself or the Acarya of some other community. Thereafter, the gold image of Vrmtaka, together with the figures of a cow and a black bull should be made, fully decorated with the ornaments, and should be given over to a Brahmana. Then after serving food to the Brahmanas, he should earn the blessings. A person who performs this vrata earns the merit of the performing of Paundarika vrata or Asvamedha vrata. He is honoured in the heaven for a period of seven thousand crores of years and for seven births thereafter, he does not have to visit the place of Yama. This has been ordained by the great Rsi Baudhayana. In this way, by offering the gold, ghi and butter milk, the Vrmtaka vrata with unlimited prowess has to be performed for a year or a month and the one who does so, he will not have to visit the abode of Yama.

## Chapter 113. The Planets and Constellations

## \|\| 3.113.1-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ hyetaduttamam \|*  
*yena lakṣmīnirvṛtistu puṣṭiścaivopajāyate \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sarve grahāḥ sadā saumyā jāyaṃte yena pāṃḍava \|*  
*ādityavāre hastena pūrvaṃ gṛhya vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*naktoktavidhinā sarvaṃ kuryātpūjāṃ tathā raveḥ \|*  
*pratyakṣaṃ sapta naktāni kṛtvā bhaktiparo naraḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tatastu saptame prāpte kuryādbrāhmaṇavācanam \|*  
*bhāskaraṃ sarvasauvarṇaṃ kṛtvā yatnena mānavaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tāmrapātre sthāpayitvā raktapuṣpaiḥ prapūjya ca \|*  
*raktavastrayugacchannaṃ chatropānadyugānvitam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*ghṛtena snapanaṃ kṛtvā laḍḍukānvinivedya ca \|*  
*maṃtreṇānena viduṣe brāhmaṇāyopapādayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Sri Krsna said- O Pandava, I am going to reveal a great secret before you, with the performing of which one earns the enormous wealth, great development and all the planets become favourable. Therefore, when Hasta constellation falls on sunday, following the aforesaid process of the Nakta vrata, a learned person should worship the Sungod. In case the same Nakta vratas are observed seven times, then the last Nakta vrata should be got completed through the learned Brahmana. Initially, a golden image of Surya should be prepared and consecrated in a copper vase where red flowers, red costumes and umbrella should also be placed. It should be bathed with ghi. The sweet balls should then be offered as food to the same. Every things should be given over to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.113.7 \|\|

*ādideva namastubhyaṃ saptasapte divākara \|*  
*tvaṃ rave tārayasvāsmāna'smātsaṃsārasāgarāt \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Then the performer should pray “O Sungod, moving over the chariot driven by seven horses, salutation to you. You kindly let me cross the ocean of the universe.”

## \|\| 3.113.8 \|\|

*kṛtenānena rājendra bhavedārogyamuttamam \|*  
*dravyasaṃpatsutaprāptiriti paurāṇikā viduḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. O Rajendra, with the completion of the vrata like this, one earns the good health, the riches, property etc. in abundance. This is what has been ordained in the Puranas.

## \|\| 3.113.9-12 \|\|

*avisaṃvādinī ceyaṃ śāntipuṣṭipradā nṛṇām \|*  
*tadvaccitrāsu saṃgṛhya somavāraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*saptame ca tataḥ prāpte dattvā brāhmaṇabhojanam \|*  
*kāṃsyabhājanasaṃsthaṃ vā rājataṃ rājate'tha vā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*pātre kṛtvā somarājaṃ śvetavastrāvaguṃṭhitam \|*  
*pādukopānahacchatrabhājanāsanasaṃyutam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*dadhyannaśikharaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|*  
*maṃtreṇānena rājendra taṃ śṛṇuṣva vadāmi te \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-12. This vrata grants everlasting peace and growth to the performer. When Citra constellation falls on monday, the Moongod should be worshipped. On the occasion of the seventh vrata, the silver image of the Moongod or the silver plate of the Moongod or the one made in copper should be consecrated in a bronze vase and then it should be covered with a white cloth. After its worship, the wooden sandals, a turban, an umbrella and vases for eating, besides the food cooked in curd, should be heaped up like a hill and should then be given over to a Brahmana reciting a mantra which is going to be spoken by me.

## \|\| 3.113.13-14 \|\|

*śrīmahādevajāvallī puṣpagokṣīrapāṃḍura \|*  
*soma saumyo bhavāsmākaṃ sarvadā hyuttamottama \|\| 13 \|\|*

*evaṃ kṛte mahārāja somastuṣṭiprado bhavet \|*  
*bhavaṃti tuṣṭe'trisute sarve sānugrahā grahāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. “O Somadeva the creeper grown by lord Siva, you look like the colour of payasam or the milk, you kindly extend your grace on me.” When the Moongod is so eulogized, the lord gets pleased. When the Moongod is pleased, all other constellations get pleased.

## \|\| 3.113.15-17 \|\|

*svātyāmaṃgārakaṃ gṛhya kṣapayennaktabhojanaḥ \|*  
*saptame tvatha saṃprāpte sthāpitaṃ tāmrabhājane \|\| 15 \|\|*

*raktavastrayugacchannaṃ kuṃkumenānulepanam \|*  
*naivedyaṃ haṃtakāraṃ ca pūjya dhūpākṣatādibhiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*maṃtreṇānena taṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine \|*  
*kujanmaprabhavo'pi tvaṃ maṃgalaḥ paṭhyase budhaiḥ \|*  
*amaṃgalaṃ nihatyāśu sarvadā yaccha maṃgalam \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. When the Svati constellation falls on tuesday, the Mars planet should be worshipped and the process of taking food at night should be continued. Then during the performing of the seventh vrata, the figure of Mars should be covered with the red cloth and consecrated in the copper vase plastering it with saffron. Thereafter, the eatables, incense, unbroken rice etc. should be offered to the deity having many faces. Thereafter, he should pray- “O Mangaladeva, because of your deplorable birth, you bestow welfare always. Therefore, removing all my misfortunes, you bestow welfare on me.”

## \|\| 3.113.18-20 \|\|

*viśākhāsu budhaṃ gṛhya sapta naktānyathācaret \|*  
*budhaṃ hemamayaṃ kṛtvā sthāpitaṃ kāṃsyabhājane \|\| 18 \|\|*

*śuklavastrayugacchannaṃ śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ \|*  
*guḍaudanopahāraṃ tu brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 19 \|\|*

*budhaḥ sadbuddhijanano bodhadaḥ sarvadā nṛṇām \|*  
*tattvāvabodhaṃ kuru me rājaputra namonamaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. When the Visakha constellation falls on Wednesday, Budha should be worshipped on that particular day and a gold figure of Budha should be made and consecrated in a copper vase, covered with a white cloth. It should then be decorated with white flower garland and then worshipped. The sweet boiled rice should be offered to the Brahmanas. Then he should say- “The planet Budha bestows the people with the noble wisdom, besides the education and knowledge. Therefore, you kindly enlighten me over the tattvas. I offer my salutation to you again and again.”

## \|\| 3.113.21-23 \|\|

*anurādhāsvathācāryaṃ devānāṃ pūjya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*pūrvoktakramayogena sapta naktānyathācaret \|\| 21 \|\|*

*haimaṃ hemamaye pātre sthāpayitvā bṛhaspatim \|*  
*pītāṃbarayugacchannaṃ pītayajñopavītinam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*pādukācchatrasahitaṃ sadaṃḍaṃ sakamaṇḍalum \|*  
*saṃpūjya puṣpanikarairdīpadhūpākṣatādibhiḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. When Anuradha constellation falls on thursday, then Acarya Brhaspati - the preceptor of the gods, should be worshipped with devotion. On the occasion of the seventh Nakta-vrata, the gold image of Brhaspati should be worshipped offering yellow flowers, garments as well as a yajnopavita, besides the wooden sandals, an umbrella, a staff and a kamandalu should be offered together with the flowers, incense, unbroken rice etc. Then he should be worshipped.

## \|\| 3.113.24 \|\|

*khaṇḍakhādyopahāraiśca dvijāya pratipādayet \|*  
*dharmaśāstrārthaśāstrajña jñānavijñānapāraga \|*  
*agādhabuddhigāṃbhīrya devācārya namo'stu te \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Then a gift of some eatables should be given over to the Brahmanas and then beg forgiveness thus- “O Acarya of the Vedas, you are well-versed in all the scriptures as well as the religious scriptures, having achieved excellence in all types of knowledge. Salutation to you.”

## \|\| 3.113.25-30 \|\|

*śukraṃ jyeṣṭhāsu saṃgṛhya kṣapayennaktabhojanaiḥ \|*  
*pūrvoktakramayogena dvijasaṃtarpaṇena ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

*saptame tvatha saṃprāpte sauvarṇaṃ kārayecchubham \|*  
*raupye vā vaṃśapātre vā sthāpayitvā bhṛgoḥ sutam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā śvetavastravilepanaiḥ \|*  
*agre tasya pradātavyaṃ pāyasaṃ ghṛta saṃyutam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*dadyādanena maṃtreṇa brāhmaṇāya vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*bhārgavo bhṛguputro'si śukra kramaviśārada \|\| 28 \|\|*

*hatvā grahakṛtāndoṣānāyurārogyado bhava \|*  
*mūlena sūryatanayaṃ gṛhītvā bharatarṣabha \|\| 29 \|\|*

*tasmindine pūjanīyaṃ grahatritayamādarāt \|*  
*śanaiścaraśca rāhuśca ketuśceti kramānnṛpa \|\| 30 \|\|*

25-30. Thereafter, on friday, following the Nakta vrata, offering food to Sukra or Venus, the food should then be served to the Brahmanas. On the seventh day of the vrata, a gold or silver image of Venus should be made and placed in a bamboo basket. Thereafter, with his mind filled with devotion, the white costumes and paste should be offered, while adoring the planet. The food of payasam mixed with ghi should be offered to Sukra with the reciting of the mantras, saying- “O Deva, you are known as Bhargava or the son of Bhrgu, and are known as quite a learned one. Therefore, removing the blemishes relating to the planets, bestow on me the long life and good health.” O king among the constellations, among the planets, Sani - the son of Surya, besides Rahu and Ketu should be worshipped on Saturdays.

## \|\| 3.113.31-32 \|\|

*homaṃ tilaghṛtaiḥ kuryādgṛhanāmnā tu maṃtravit \|*  
*arkaḥ palāśakhadirau hyapāmārgotha pippalaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*uduṃbaraśamīdūrvākuśāśca samidhaḥ kramāt \|*  
*ekaikasya tvaṣṭaśatamaṣṭāviṃśatireva vā \|\| 32 \|\|*

31-32. Thereafter, the offering of ghi should be poured in the homa, besides the sesamum seeds. The twigs of the trees like Arka (swallow wart), Palasa, catechu, snake gourd, Pipala or holy fig tree, wild fig tree, all types of durva grass and kusa grass should be collected for making eight or twenty eight offerings in the fire.

## \|\| 3.113.33-36 \|\|

*hotavyaṃ madhusarpibhyāṃ dadhnā vā pāyasena vā \|*  
*saptame tvatha saṃprāpte naktaṃ sūryasutasya tu \|\| 33 \|\|*

*grahāstrayo'pi kartavyā rājaṃllohamayāḥ śubhāḥ \|*  
*vratāṃte sarvataścaitānsauvarṇānvātha kārayet \|\| 34 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇavastrayugaṃ dadyādekaikasya kramānnṛpa \|*  
*mṛganābhyā samālabhya kṛśarānvinivedya ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

*homāvasāne sarvaṃ tadbrāhmaṇāyopapādayet \|*  
*śanaiścara namaste'stu namo'stu rāhave tathā \|\| 36 \|\|*

33-36. The ghi, honey or curd should also be used for the purpose. Performing the Nakta-vrata in this way, on the day of the seventh vrata, the iron images of three planets decorated with gold should be wrapped in black cloth and decorated with the musk deer, and should be worshipped. The cooked mixed grains should then be offered. After the completion of homa, the Brahmanas should be served with food and then the performer should beg forgiveness, saying- “O Sanideva, О Rahu, salutation to you again and again.

## \|\| 3.113.37 \|\|

*ketave ca namastubhyaṃ sarvaśāṃtiprado bhava \|*  
*evaṃ kṛte bhavedyastu tannibodha nareśvara \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. I offer my salutation to Ketu, who should bestow complete peace on me.” О king, thus completing the vrata, the merit one earns, is going to be narrated by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.113.38-39 \|\|

*yadi bhaumo ravisuto bhāskaro rāhuṇā saha \|*  
*ketuśca mūrdhni tiṣṭhaṃti sarve pīḍākarā grahāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*anena kṛtamātreṇa sarve śāmyaṃtyupadravāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. In case, Bhauma (Mars), Sani (Saturn), Surya (Sun) Rahu and Ketu are lodged in the head, then all the planets cause pain to the person. But after performing the aforesaid vrata in a proper manner, all the obstructions get lost.

## \|\| 3.113.40 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ kurute rājansadābhaktisamanvitaḥ \|*  
*tasya sānugrahā sarve yacchanti vijayaṃ sukham \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. In case, the vrata is performed with devotion, all the planets turn favourable and bestow comforts as well as peace.

## \|\| 3.113.41 \|\|

*yaścaitacchraṇuyātkalpaṃ grahāṇāṃ paṭhate'pi vā \|*  
*tasya sānugrahā sarve śāṃtiṃ yacchaṃti nānyathā \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. With the listening to or the recitation of this kalpa, all the planets become favourable and bestow peace, which cannot be possible otherwise.

## \|\| 3.113.42-43 \|\|

*śanaiścaraṃ rāhuketū lohapātreṣu vinyaset \|*  
*kṛṣṇāgaruḥ smṛto dhūpo dakṣiṇā cātmaśaktitaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*sūryaṃ vidhuṃ kuja budhau guruśukrasaurīnhastādikarkṣasahitānuditakrameṇa \|*  
*saṃpūjya hemaghaṭitāndvijapuṅgavāya dattvā pumāngrahagaṇena na pīḍyate'tra \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. At the time of worship, the images of Sani, Rahu and Ketu should be made in gold and after worshipping them with black agaru and incense, they should be given over to the Brahmanas along with suitable daksina. By worshipping the gold images of Sun and all other planets appropriately with the above mentioned procedure, the performer do not suffers any pain due to the evil effects of any planet.

## Chapter 114. Vrata of Śani

## \|\| 3.114.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*purā tretāyuge pārtha nāvarṣatpākaśāsanaḥ \|*  
*kathaṃcidanayādrājñastasya rāṣṭre samaṃtataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tato rāṣṭraṃ kṣudhāviṣṭaṃ babhūvātīva dāruṇam \|*  
*pataṃgamūṣikākīrṇaṃ coravyālabhayākulam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tasminghorākule kāle sapatnīkaḥ sabālakaḥ \|*  
*kauśikaḥ svagṛhaṃ tyaktvā pararāṣṭramagācchanaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – Once during the Tretāyuga, Indra did not pour rain in a particular country and the entire region had to face a horrible draught, as a result of which all the birds, the rats, the thieves and the serpents caused enormous misery on earth. During such an awful draught, Ṛṣi Kauśika, together with his children, migrated to some other country.

## \|\| 3.114.4-7 \|\|

*mārge'tha gacchatā tena kauśikena maharṣiṇā \|*  
*tyaktaḥ sa bālako hyeko durbharaṃ ca kuṭumbakam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tasminkāle viśeṣeṇa kṣīṇennauṣadhi saṃcaye \|*  
*kṛtvātinirghṛṇaṃ karma gato'sau kauśiko muniḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*so'pi bālo rudandīno diśo vīkṣya sthitaḥ pathi \|*  
*utthāya pippalasyādhaḥ phalānyattuṃ pracakrame \|\| 6 \|\|*

*kūpe jalaṃ papau nityaṃ tatraivāśramamaṃḍale \|*  
*kṛtvā samyak sthito raudraṃ tepe ca vipulaṃ tapaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

4-7. While travelling slowly during the journey, the great Ṛṣi Kauśika, when unable to feed the family, he dropped one of his sons under a tree. When the collected food as well as the vegetables were exhausted, the Ṛṣi perforce did some degraded deeds and somehow crossed the path of the journey. The child who was abandoned mid way, somehow survived, in spite of his miserable dress and having no foods. He went on crying looking towards all the directions and went to a pīpala tree and ate the fruits which were dropped from the tree. He ate the fruits and drank water from the well. Thus, the boy, in spite of his being in a miserable condition, somehow spent days. Then living in a hermitage, he performed hard tapas.

## \|\| 3.114.8-9 \|\|

*athājagāma bhagavānnārado vedapāragaḥ \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvā dīnavadanaṃ kṣudhārtaṃ dvijapotakam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dayayā tasya saṃskāraṃ cakre mauṃjyādibaṃdhanam \|*  
*vedānadhyāpayāmāsa sarahasyapadakramān \|*  
*dadau ca vaiṣṇavaṃ maṃtraṃ dvādaśākṣaramityuta \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. In due course of time, Nārada, who was well-versed in the Vedas, once arrived in the same forest and found the Brāhmaṇa boy who was suffering from hunger. Out of compassion, the sage performed the yajñopavīta ceremony of the boy and taught him all the Vedas with the deep mysteries thereof. Thereafter, he also taught him the twelve-lettered Vaiṣṇava mantra.

## \|\| 3.114.10-11 \|\|

*vedābhyāsaratasyāsya viṣṇudhyānaparasya ca \|*  
*pratyahaṃ pippalādasya viṣṇuḥ pratyakṣatāṃ yayau \|\| 10 \|\|*

*vainateyasamārūḍho nīlotpaladalacchaviḥ \|*  
*caturbhujaḥ pītavāsāḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. The boy who was always busy in the study of the Vedas as well as in the devotion of lord Viṣṇu, started having an audience with lord Viṣṇu daily, who emerged out of the pīpala tree. Lord Viṣṇu appeared before the boy seated over Garuḍa, had a complexion of blue lotus flower, had four arms, was clad in yellow lower garment and held in hands the conch, disc and club as attributes.

## \|\| 3.114.12-13 \|\|

*sa uvāca tadā tuṣṭo varaṃ brūhi yami cchasi \|*  
*tacchrutvā nāradamukhaṃ samālokya śiśustadā \|*  
*nāradenāpyanujñāto jñānavidyāmayācata \|\| 12 \|\|*

*dattvā jñānaṃ sopadeśaṃ yogābhyāsaṃ ca nirmalam \|*  
*nāgārigamano viṣṇustatraivāntarhitobhavat \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Then lord Viṣṇu, getting immensely pleased with the boy, said to him - “You ask for a boon you desire.” The boy looked at the face of Narada and with his permission, sought for the spiritual knowledge (adhyatma-vidya). Thereafter, lord Viṣṇu bestowed the spotless knowledge of yoga and the yogic practices on the boy. Thereafter, he disappeared from the same place.

## \|\| 3.114.14-18 \|\|

*tato rājanmahājñānī maharṣiḥ sa śiśustadā \|*  
*nāradaṃ paripapraccha kenāhaṃ pīḍito mune \|\| 14 \|\|*

*graheṇāgrahabhūtena bālarūpo'pi duḥkhita \|*  
*na me pitā na me mātā jīvitosmyatipīḍayā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇyaṃ bhavatā dattaṃ daivānmama dvijottama \|*  
*etacchrutvā śiśorvākyaṃ kathayāmāsa nāradaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*śanaiścareṇa krūreṇa graheṇa tvaṃ hi pīḍitaḥ \|*  
*pīḍitaśca samasto'pi deśoyaṃ maṃdacāriṇā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tenaitatte phalaṃ prāptaṃ saiṣaḥ sauriḥ śanaiścaraḥ \|*  
*prajvalannatidarpeṇa sphuratīva nabhastale \|\| 18 \|\|*

14-18. О king, in due course of time, the boy became a great Ṛṣi, possessing the divine knowledge. When the boy himself became a great Ṛṣi, he once asked Narada - “O sage, by whom had I been tortured? Why was I so tortured in my infancy or childhood? When my parents were not there, then how inspite of my great sufferings, I could survive? О best of the Brahmanas, the Brahmanahood had been so kindly bestowed by you on me. (Otherwise I could have deprived of the same).” On hearing the words of the boy, Narada said - “Because of the harsh planets like Saturn, you had to suffer together with the entire country. It was the planet who bestowed on you such a type of reward. The same planet Śani is shining as a star in the sky.”

## \|\| 3.114.19-21 \|\|

*evamuktaḥ śiśuḥ krodhātprajajvāleva pāvakaḥ \|*  
*ālokya gaganādbhūmau pātayāmāsa vai śanim \|*  
*patamāno gireḥ śṛṃgādbhagnaḥ khaṃjo babhūva ha \|\| 19 \|\|*

*dharaṇyāṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāskarātmajamāturam \|*  
*narīnarti bhujakṣepairnārado hṛṣṭamānasaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*harṣāddevānathāhūya darśayāmāsa taṃ śanim \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. At these words of Narada, the innocent boy, getting enraged like the fire in flames, looked at the sky as a result of which Śanideva fell down on the ground. At the fall of Śani by the son of the Sungod, Narada felt delighted at heart and started dancing moving his arms here and there. Thereafter, Narada summoned all the gods and showed them the miserable condition in which Saturn had been placed.

## \|\| 3.114.22-24 \|\|

*atha devāstathā prāptā brahmarudrendrapāvakāḥ \|*  
*śanaiḥ saṃśamayāsurūcuścedamṛṣiṃ ca tam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*svasti te'stu mahābhāga pippalāda mahāmune \|*  
*bhadraṃ te'tra kṛtaṃ nāma nāradena maharṣiṇā \|*  
*anvarthayuktaṃ viprendra jīvitaṃ piplādanāt \|\| 23 \|\|*

*bhagavanpippalānyattvā jīvito'si yato mune \|*  
*tataśca pippalādeti khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyasi \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. The gods like Brahma, Indra, Rudra and others consoled Śanideva slowly. The Ṛṣi was then addressed by them thus- “O great Pippalada, О great sage, the Brahmarṣi Narada has done enormous good to you. О sage, by consuming the fruits of the pīpala tree you remained alive and this aspect has been added to your name pretty well. Because of the same, you would be known as Pippalada in the world.

## \|\| 3.114.25-26 \|\|

*ye ca tvāṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti snātvā puṣpairmahāṛṣim \|\| 25 \|\|*

*ihāśrame samabhyetya rūpesminbhaktibhāvitāḥ \|*  
*saptajanmāntaraṃ yāvatputrapautrānugāminaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Whosoever arriving in this asrama, shall worship the great Ṛṣi with devotion and with the offering of the flowers after having his bath, he shall enjoy the stay in heaven along with his sons and grandsons for seven births.

## \|\| 3.114.27 \|\|

*na teṣāṃ bādhikā satyaṃ grahapīḍā bhaviṣyati \|*  
*smariṣyaṃtīha ye ca tvāṃ pippalādeti nāmataḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Besides that, the evil effects of the planets shall never cause any obstructions for him, much less of the planet Saturn.”

## \|\| 3.114.28-34 \|\|

*teṣāṃ śanaiścara kṛtā pīḍā na prabhaviṣyati \|*  
*kṣamasvāsya mahābhāga nirdoṣo'yaṃ grahāgraṇīḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*caranvṛkṣaṃ śanaireṣa śubhāśubhaphalapradaḥ \|*  
*hatasādhyā grahāścaite na bhavaṃti kadācana \|\| 29 \|\|*

*balihomanamaskāraiḥ śāṃtiṃ yacchaṃti pūjitāḥ \|*  
*ato'rthamasya divase snānamabhyaṃgapūrvakam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*kāryaṃ deyaṃ ca viprāṇāṃ tailamabhyaṃgahetave \|*  
*yastu saṃvatsaraṃ yāvatprāpte śanidine naraḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tailaṃ dadāti viprāṇāṃ svaśaktyānyajanepi ca \|*  
*tatassaṃvatsarasyāṃte prāpte tasya dinaṃ punaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*lohaissaṃghaṭitaṃ sauriṃ tailamadhye vinikṣipet \|*  
*lohabhāṃḍakamadhyasthaṃ kṛṣṇavastrayugacchadam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇagodakṣiṇāyuktaṃ kṛṣṇakaṃbala śāyinam \|*  
*tilatailena ca snānaṃ kṛṣṇapuṣpaiḥ supūjitam \|\| 34 \|\|*

28-34. Therefore, you kindly forgive the great planet Sani, who bestows fruits to the trees. All the planets become favourable and docile when they are properly adored making offerings to them, besides the salutations to them. The homas should also be offered to them. For the purpose of appeasing the planet Śani on Saturday, one should take bath and apply oil over the body, the oil should then be given over to a Brahmana. A person should give away the oil on each Saturday regularly for a year as per his means, to a Brahmana or some other person and at the end of an year, the image of Sani should be made in iron and given over to someone placing it in an iron vase soaked in oil, together with a black cow, black clothes and black blanket. The image should be bathed with the sesamum oil along with the offering of black flowers.

## \|\| 3.114.35-37 \|\|

*kṛṣṇagaṃdhaiḥ kṛṣṇadhūpaiḥ kṛśarānnaistilaudanaiḥ \|*  
*pūjayitvā sūryaputraṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 35 \|\|*

*maṃtreṇānena brahmarṣe śannodevīti bhaktimān \|*  
*itareṣāṃ tu varṇānāṃ śṛṇu mantraṃ dvijottama \|\| 36 \|\|*

*krūrāvalokanavaśādbhuvanaṃ nāśayiṣyati yo graho ruṣṭaḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭo dhanakanakasukhaṃ dadāti sauriḥ śanaiścaraḥ pātu \|\| 37 \|\|*

35-37. Black fragrance, black incense and black mixed food should be offered to Saturn, uttering the verse — “Sanno deviti”. The figure should then be given over to a Brahmana. О best of the Brahmana, I am now speaking about the way in which the image should, be given over to a suitable Brahmana. You please listen - “O Śanideva — the son of Surya, with your evil eye the world gets destroyed, but with your pleasant eye you bestow gold and all the comforts. You are the son of Surya, protect me.

## \|\| 3.114.38-39 \|\|

*yatpurā naṣṭarājyāya nalāya pradadau kila \|*  
*svapne saurirnijaṃ mantraṃ śṛṇu kāmaphalapradam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*kroḍaṃ nīlāñjanaprakhyaṃ nīlavarṇasamasrajama \|*  
*chāyāmārtaṃḍasaṃbhūtaṃ namasyāmi śanaiścaram \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. The son of Surya had revealed his own mantra in dream to Nala when he was in distress, by which all his desires get fulfilled. You have the body like the blue mountain or the mountain of collyrium. You are adorned with a garland of blue beads. You are born of the spouse of the Sungod. I offer my salutation to the same Śanideva.

## \|\| 3.114.40 \|\|

*namo'rkaputrāya śanaiścarāya nīhāravarṇāṃjanamecakāya \|*  
*śrutvā rahasyaṃ bhavakāmadaśca phalaprado me bhava sūryaputra \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. О son of Suryadeva, I am offering my salutation to the same son of Arka or Surya, who is of dark complexion. He fulfills all the desires listening to his secret mantra.

## \|\| 3.114.41 \|\|

*namo'stu pretarājāya kṛṣṇadehāya vai namaḥ \|*  
*śanaiścarāya krūrāya śuddhabuddhipradāyine \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. О Pretaraja, I am offering my salutation to Śanideva who is of dark complexion. О cruel Śani, you are the bestower of pure intellect.

## \|\| 3.114.42 \|\|

*ya ebhirnāmabhiḥ stauti tasya tuṣṭo bhavāmyaham \|*  
*madīyaṃ tu bhayaṃ tasya svapne'pi na bhaviṣyati \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. A person who adores me with the reciting of my names, I remain extremely happy with him and he does not get frightened from me even in a dream.

## \|\| 3.114.43-44 \|\|

*evamūce śaniḥ pūrvamatastaṃ brāhmaṇe dadet \|*  
*evametadvrataṃ vipra ye cariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*sthāvaresthāvare prāpte vatsaraṃ yāvadeva tu \|*  
*teṣāṃ śānaiścarī pīḍā deśe'pi na bhaviṣyati \|\| 44 \|\|*

43-44. 0 Brahmana, this is what had been told to me by Śanideva himself. Thus speaking, he should hand over the image to a Brahmana. The people who perform this vrata for one year completely, they would never suffer from an ailment for the same period.”

## \|\| 3.114.45 \|\|

*evamuktvā surāḥ sarve pratijagmuryathāgatam \|*  
*śanaiścaro'pi svasthāne grahāṃte khe pratiṣṭhitaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Thus speaking, all the gods returned to their respective abodes by the same way by which they had arrived. On the other hand, Śanideva too was again lodged in the sky.

## \|\| 3.114.46-47 \|\|

*pippalādo'pi brahmajño brahmājñāṃ pratipālayan \|*  
*śanaiścaraṃ tu saṃpūjya tuṣṭāva racitāñjaliḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*
