*koṇasthaḥ piṅgalo babhruḥ kṛṣṇo raudro'ntako yamaḥ \|*  
*sauriḥ śanaiścaro modaḥ prīyatāṃ me grahottamaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. Then Ṛṣi Pippalada, who was well-versed in the knowledge of Brahman, accepting the command of Brahma, adored Śanideva with his folded hands and begged forgiveness from him, saying - “One who is lodged in a comer, having the black complexion, with terrific form, who kills like Yama, who is the son of Surya, who is the best of the planets and who walks slowly, be pleased with me.”

## \|\| 3.114.48 \|\|

*śanaiścaramiti stutvā pippalādo mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*khe prajvalanvimānastho dṛśyate'dyāpi mānavaiḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Thus, offering prayer to Śanideva, the great Ṛṣi Pippalada seated in a plane is visible in the sky even today to the people.

## \|\| 3.114.49 \|\|

*idaṃ śanaiścarākhyānaṃ ye śroṣyanti samāhitāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ kuruvaraśreṣṭha śaniḥ pīḍāṃ na dāsyati \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. A person who carefully listens to this story of Śanideva does not suffer from the pain caused by Śanideva.

## \|\| 3.114.50 \|\|

*kṛṣṇāyasena ghaṭitāṃ graharājamūrtiṃ lohe nidhāya kalaśe tilatailapūrṇe \|*  
*yo brāhmaṇāya ravijaṃ pradadāti bhaktyā pīḍā śanaiścarakṛtā na hi bādhate tam \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. Thus, a person, who with devotion, gives away an iron figure of Śanideva with oil and sesamum seeds in an iron vase to a Brahmana after worshipping it, he is freed from the pain caused by Śanideva and is adored by the gods.

## Chapter 115. Fasting night on the day of the Sun

## \|\| 3.115.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*yadārogyakaraṃ puṃsāṃ yadanaṃtaphalapradam \|*  
*vrataṃ tadbrūhi govinda sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said - О Govinda, you kindly tell me about a vrata which bestows good health and enormous merits, besides the removal of all the sins.

## \|\| 3.115.2-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*yattadviśvātmano dhāma paraṃ brahma sanātanam \|*  
*sūryāgnicandrarūpeṇa tattridhā jagati sthitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tamārādhya pumānkiṃ na prāpnoti kurunandana \|*  
*tasmādādityavāreṇa sadā naktāśano bhavet \|\| 3 \|\|*

*utpadyate yadā bhaktirbhānorupari śāśvatī \|*  
*tadārabhya sadā kāryaṃ naktamādityavāsare \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said - О son of the race of Kuru, the eternal and supreme Brahman and the universal soul is the abode for him. He alone represents Surya, Agni and the Moon in the world. What is there in the world, which cannot be achieved by worshipping him? When the everlasting devotion for the Sungod develops in the mind of a person, starting from the same time, one should have food at night on Sundays.

## \|\| 3.115.5-7 \|\|

*pūrvoktavidhinā caiva pūjayitvā dvijottamān \|*  
*tato'stasamaye bhāno raktacandanapaṅkajam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vilikhya dvādaśadalaṃ pūjya sūryeti pūrvataḥ \|*  
*divākaraṃ tathāgneye vivasvatamataḥ param \|\| 6 \|\|*

*bhagaṃ tu nairṛte devaṃ varuṇaṃ paścime dale \|*  
*mahendraṃ mārutadale ādityaṃ tu tathottare \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. By the same process, the Brahmanas should be worshipped. Then after the sunset, a twelve petalled lotus for the Moon should be drawn on earth with red sandal paste. Then salutation to Surya should be written on the east of it. Salutation to Divakara should be written on the north-west. Salutation to Vivasvan should be written towards the south. Salutation to Bhaga should be written on south-west side. Salutation to Varuna should be written on the west. Salutation to Mahendra should be written on north-west. Salutation to Aditya should be written on the north.

## \|\| 3.115.8 \|\|

*śāṃtamīśānabhāge tu namaskāreṇa vinyaset \|*  
*karṇikāpūrvapatre tu sūryasya turagānnyaset \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Salutation to the peaceful one should be written on the north-east. The god should then be consecrated towards the east of the pericarp and the horses of the Sungod should be established.

## \|\| 3.115.9-11 \|\|

*dakṣiṇe yamanāmānaṃ mārtaṃḍaṃ paścime dale \|*  
*uttareṇa raviṃ devaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu bhāskaram \|\| 9 \|\|*

*arghyaṃ dadyāttataḥ pārtha satilāruṇacaṃdanam \|*  
*phalākṣatayutaṃ tadvadimaṃ maṃtramudīrayet \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kālātmā sarvabhūtātmā vedātmā viśvatomukhaḥ \|*  
*yasmādagnīṃdurūpastvamataḥ pāhi prabhākara \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. On the southern petal, Yama should be lodged. On the western petal Martanda has to be lodged; on the northern petal, Ravi is to be lodged. In the pericap, Bhaskara should be adored offering sesamum seeds, red sandal paste, fruit and unbroken rice. Thereafter, arghya should be offered, while reciting the mantra - “O Prabhakara, you are the soul of the time, the soul of the Sungod, soul of the Vedas. You have the universal face, besides being fire and the form of the Moon. Therefore, you kindly protect me.

## \|\| 3.115.12-13 \|\|

*agnimīle namastubhyamiṣe tvorje ca bhāskare \|*  
*agna āyāhi varada namaste jyotiṣāṃ pate \|\| 12 \|\|*

*arghyaṃ dattvā visarjyātha niśi tailavivarjitam \|*  
*bhuñjīta bhāvitamanā bhāskaraṃ saṃsmaranmuhuḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Salutation to Agni and Isetvorje Bhaskara. You are the bestower of the boon. Therefore, be kind enough to be present here. I offer my salutation to the lord of Jyotiṣ or the rays. Thus, giving the arghya, one should send off the deity. Thereafter, he should take food in the night which should be without oil or the salt. Then, he should keep on fondly reciting the name of Bhaskara.

## \|\| 3.115.14-16 \|\|

*prāktane'hni śanau caiva tailābhyaṃgaṃ vivarjayet \|*  
*vatsarāṃte kārayitvā kāñcanaṃ kamalottamam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*puruṣaṃ ca yathāśaktyā kārayeddvibhujaṃ tathā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*suvarṇaśṛṃgīṃ kapilāṃ mahārghyāṃ raupyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ savatsām \|*  
*pūrṇe guḍasyopari tāmrapātre nidhāya padmaṃ ca tato nidadhyāt \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. Prior to that, on Saturday, one should not apply oil over the body. Again at the end of the year, he should make an image of a human with two arms in gold together with a white cow with a calf and decorating her with gold and silver, with a milking pot of the bronze metal as per one’s means, which should be given to a Brahmana. Besides a copper vase filled with the raw sugar and a lotus placed over it, should be given as well.

## \|\| 3.115.17 \|\|

*gāṃ kalpayitvā puruṣaṃ sapadmaṃ dadyādanekavratanāyakāya \|*  
*avyaṃgarūpāya jitendriyāya kuṭuṃbine śuddhamanuddhatāya \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. After completion of the worship, all the things including cow should be given over to a Brahmana who should be the performer of several vratas, quite noble, having controlled all the sense organs, be with family, quite auspicious, besides being the image of peace.

## \|\| 3.115.18 \|\|

*namo'stu ṛksāmayajurvidhātre padmaprabodhāya jagatsavitre \|*  
*trayīmayāya triguṇātmane ca trilokanāthāya namonamaste \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Thereafter he should ask for forgiveness thus - “O creator of Ṛgveda, Yajurveda and Samaveda, you make the lotuses to blossom, you are Savita for the entire world, the form of the three Vedas, possessing all the three gunas and are Surya - the lord of the three worlds. Salutation to you again and again.

## \|\| 3.115.19 \|\|

*ityanena vidhānena varṣamekaṃ tu yo naraḥ \|*  
*naktamādityavāreṇa kuryātsa nīrujo bhavet \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. By following this process, one who performs this vrata for one year and by taking food at night on each Sunday, the person always remains free from ailments.

## \|\| 3.115.20 \|\|

*dhanadhānyasamāyuktaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*martye sthitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ sūryalokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Achieving the riches as well as the food grains in plenty, sons and grandsons, he enjoys all comforts on earth in abundance. Ultimately, such a person achieves the place of Surya.

## \|\| 3.115.21 \|\|

*karmasaṃkṣayamavāpya pārthivaḥ śokaduḥkhabhayarogavarjitaḥ \|*  
*syādamitrakulakālasaṃnibho dharmamūrtiramitaujasā yutaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. With the decline of the merits, he becomes a king on earth, who is free from pain, grief, miseries, fear, danger or ailments, becomes death for the enemies, figure of dharma and possesses enormous lustre.

## \|\| 3.115.22 \|\|

*yā ca bhartṛgurudevatatparā vedamūrtidinanaktamācarat \|*  
*sāpi lokamamareśapūjitā yāti kau rava ravernna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. О son of the race of Kauravas, a woman who remains devoted to her husband, her preceptor and gets engaged in the worship of the god, if performs vrata on the day of Surya at night, she is adored by Indra. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.115.23 \|\|

*yaḥ paṭhedatha śṛṇoti vā naraḥ paśyatītthamatha vānumodayet \|*  
*so'pi śakrabhavane divaukasaiḥ kalpakoṭiśatamekamīḍyate \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. A person who reads or listens to this story, witnesses or experience the same, he enjoys all the comforts in the place of Indra for crore of kalpas and is revered by the gods.

## Chapter 116. Saṁkrānti Udyāpana

## \|\| 3.116.1-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athānyadapi te vacmi saṃkrāṃtyudyāpane phalam \|*  
*yadakṣayaṃ paraṃ loke purāṇakavayo viduḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*viṣuve ayane vāpi saṃkrātivratamārabhet \|*  
*pūrvedyurekabhaktena daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*saṃkrāṃtivāsare prāpte tilaiḥ snānaṃ vidhīyate \|*  
*abhisaṃkramaṇaṃ bhūmau candanenāṣṭapatrakam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*padmaṃ sakarṇikaṃ kuryāttasminnāvāhayedravim \|*  
*karṇikāyāṃ nyasetsūryamādityaṃ pūrvatastataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*namaḥ saptārciṣe'gneye yāmye ruṅmaṇḍalāya ca \|*  
*namaḥ savitre nairṛtye varuṇaṃ vāruṇe yajet \|\| 5 \|\|*

*saptasaptiṃ ca vāyavye pūjayedbhāsvatāṃ patim \|*  
*mārtaṃḍamuttare viṣṇumīśāne vinyaseddale \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – Now I shall tell you about the merit of the completion of a Saṁkrānti vrata, which has been described by the poets of the Pauranic literature as indestructible and the best of all. At the time of equinox or the half year (Sun’s course - north or south), the Saṁkrānti vrata should be started taking single meal during the day. Then on the day next to Saṁkrānti, with the brushing of the teeth with tooth stick, observing the related procedure, he should take bath with sesamum seeds. Then a lotus with a pericarp should be painted on the ground with sandal paste. Thereafter, the Sungod Ravi should be invoked in the same, saying - “Salutation to Aditya in the eastern side; salutation to Saptarsi in south-east; salutation to the destroyer of the ailments in south-west; salutation to Varupa in the western direction; salutation to Saptasapti in north-west, salutation to Martanda towards the north and salutation to Viṣṇu, the invoking should be made towards the northeast.

## \|\| 3.116.7-8 \|\|

*gandhamālyaphalairbhakṣyaiḥ sthaṃḍile pūjayettataḥ \|*  
*candanodakapuṣpaistu dattvārghaṃ vinyasedbhuvi \|\| 7 \|\|*

*namaste viśvarūpāya viśvadhātre svayaṃbhuve \|*  
*namonamaste varada ṛksāmayajuṣāṃ pate \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Offering incense, rosary and fruits, lord should be adored. Then, arghya should be offered with sandal paste and flowers. Thereafter, the performer should recite - Salutation to Visvarupaya, Visvadhamne and Svayambhuva. Salutation to the reciter of Rk, Sama and Yajurveda.

## \|\| 3.116.9-11 \|\|

*anena vidhinā dattvā bhānave'rghyaṃ narottama \|*  
*dvijāya sodakaṃ kumbhaṃ ghṛtapātraṃ hiraṇmayam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*kamalaṃ ca yathāśaktyā kārayitvā nivedayeta \|*  
*vidhinānena kartavyaṃ māsi māsi narottama \|\| 10 \|\|*

*ekabhuktāśanaiḥ puṃbhiḥ sarvametadyathāvidhi \|*  
*ekasminnahni kartavyaṃ vatsarāṃtetha vā punaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. Thus performing worship with various procedures, the performer should offer a pitcher of gold filled with ghi, lotuses as per one’s means. The same process should be repeated during each month of the year. A devotee should again follow the same set of procedures of worship of Sungod in the next year on the day of Saṁkrānti.

## \|\| 3.116.12-13 \|\|

*kauṃteya tasminghṛtapāyasena saṃpūjya vahniṃ dvijapuṃgavāya \|*  
*kumbhānpunardvādaśadhenuyuktāndaurgatyayuktaḥ kuśalāmathaikām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*nivedayedbrāhmaṇapuṅgavāya haimīṃ ca dadyātpṛthivīṃ sasasyām \|*  
*śaktyātha raupyāmatha vāpi tāmrīṃ paiṣṭīmaśakto vasudhāṃ vidhāya \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. О son of Kunti, on that particular day, the fire of sacrifice should be satisfied with the dropping of the offering of payasam mixed with ghi. Thereafter, twelve pitchers, the same number of cows, and in case of poverty, a single cow decorated with gold and silver should be given over to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.116.14 \|\|

*sauvarṇasūryeṇa samaṃ pradadyānna vittaśāṭhyaṃ purupo'tra kuryāt \|*  
*kurvannadho yāti narendracandrayāvanmahendra pramukhāḥ sureśāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. О Narendra, miserliness should never be shown in the performing of worship of Sungod, otherwise, he would have to face the degraded position, till the time of Indra.

## \|\| 3.116.15 \|\|

*pṛthvī ca yāvatsakulācalā ca yāvacca sūryānilavahnicandrāḥ \|*  
*tāvatsa gandharvakulairaśeṣaiḥ saṃpūjyate bhārata nākapṛṣṭhe \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. О Bhārata, by performing the puja with a large heart, the land with mountains, Surya, Vayu, Agni and the Moon, besides the Gandharvas, shall continue to adore him.

## \|\| 3.116.16 \|\|

*tatastu karmakṣayamāpya saptadvīpādhipaḥ syātsukulaprasūtaḥ \|*  
*divyaiḥ mukhairyuktavapuḥ sabhāryaḥ prasūtaputrānvayabandhuvargaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. With the decline of his own karmas, he is reborn in a high race, becomes the lord of all the seven continents. Then he taking to the divine form together with his wife, sons as well as the kiths and kins, enjoy the divine pleasures.

## \|\| 3.116.17 \|\|

*iti paṭhati śṛṇoti yo'tibhaktyā vidhimakhilaṃ ravisaṃkrameṣu puṇyam \|*  
*matimapi ca dadāti so'pi devairamarapatipramukhairmṛtastu pūjyaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. A person who reads or recites this episode with devotion on the day of Saṁkrānti or supports the same, he is adored in the heaven by the great gods after his death.

## Chapter 117. Description of Viṣṭi Vrata

## \|\| 3.117.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kṛṣṇa keyaṃ janaiḥ sarvairviṣṭirbhadreti cocyate \|*  
*kasyātmajeyaṃ kiṃrūpā pūjyate ca kathaṃ janaiḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said - О Kṛṣṇa, the vrata which is called Viṣṭi or Bhadra, what is the nature of the same? What is its form and why is the same adored by all?

## \|\| 3.117.2-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*sutā mārtaṃḍadevasya chāyayā janitā purā \|*  
*śanaiścarasya sodaryā bhaginyatibhayaṃkarī \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sā jātamātrā bhuvanaṃ grastuṃ samupacakrame \|*  
*kṛṣṇā karālavadanā sitadaṃṣṭrordhvamūrddhajā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*niryāti yadi kāryeṇa kaścittasya puraḥ sthitā \|*  
*vighnaṃ karoti svapato bhuñjānasya sthitasya vā \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said - Viṣṭi or Bhadra was initially born of Chaya - the wife of the Sungod. She is the horrible sister of Śanideva. Soon after her birth, she became ready to devour all the three lokas into her body. She was of black complexion, having awful face and white teeth. The hair of her head were rising up. Whosoever starts for going out of his house, she stands before him and obstructs his path. She also creates obstructions while a person sleeps over the bed, takes his food, or sitting over his seat with comfort.

## \|\| 3.117.5 \|\|

*yajñavighnakarī raudrā samājotsavanāśinī \|*  
*nityodvegakarī raudrā vināśayati sā jagat \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Having a terrific form, she destroys the yajnas, the community celebrations. With her furious form, she creates enormous obstructions and destroys the world.

## \|\| 3.117.6-7 \|\|

*tāṃ tu durvinayāsaktāṃ dṛṣṭvā devo divākaraḥ \|*  
*ciṃtayāmāsa kasyāpi yacchāmyenāṃ sumadhyamām \|\| 6 \|\|*

*kanyādurvinayācceha pitā doṣeṇa gṛhyate \|*  
*yuvatyāstu tato bhartā tasmādbhartṛgṛhaṃ nayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Finding the horrible Bhadra, the Sungod became concerned about her marriage. Because, in case a daughter is indisciplined, the father is usually blamed. When she attains the youthful age, a husband is needed for her upkeep. Because of this, she is sent to the place of her husband.

## \|\| 3.117.8-11 \|\|

*viciṃtyaivaṃ sutāṃ bhadrāṃ yasyayasya prayacchati \|*  
*te namaṃti kṣaṇenaiva surarākṣasakinnarāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*maṇḍapaṃ maṇḍapārambhe bhaṃktvā bhīṣayate janam \|*  
*vivasvāṃścintayāviṣṭaḥ kasyeyaṃ pratipādyatām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*virūpā duṣṭahṛdayā svecchācāravihāriṇī \|*  
*dattāpyeṣā na doṣāya bhavatīha kathaṃcana \|\| 10 \|\|*

*vitarkayanyāvadevamāste devo divaspatiḥ \|*  
*tāvattayā jagatsarvaṃ duṣṭayā samabhidrutam \|\| 11 \|\|*

8-11. Thus thinking, to whomsoever the Sungod thought of giving away his daughter, the said Devas, Rākṣasas or Kinnaras did agree to accept her, offering their salutation to the Sungod, but with the start of the marriage rites, she used to destroy the mandapa or the pavilion of the marriage ceremony and frighten the groom and his companions. Therefore, the Sungod was extremely disturbed because of his daughter Bhadra. He then thoughts - “To whom should she be married then? Because she was quite ugly looking and moving at will. Even when she is given over to someone, I alone shall be blamed for her misconduct.” When the Sungod was so absorbed in his thought, at the same time, the furious girl terrified the entire universe.

## \|\| 3.117.12-13 \|\|

*athājagāma savituḥ pārśve brahmā'ṇḍasaṃbhavaḥ \|*  
*kāryaṃ nivedayāmāsa viṣṭerdauṣṭyamaśeṣataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*bhāskarastamuvācātha brahmāṇaṃ bhuvaneśvaram \|*  
*bhavānkartā ca hartā ca kasmādevaṃ prabhāṣase \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. Bhadra disturbed the entire universe. At the same time, Brahma born of the golden egg, went to the Sungod and narrated to him the tale of the misdeeds of the girl. On hearing the words of Brahma, Bhaskara said to Bhuvanesvara Brahma - “You are the creator as well as the destroyer. Therefore, what is all this being spoken by you?”

## \|\| 3.117.14-16 \|\|

*evamuktastadā brahmā bhāskareṇāmitadyutiḥ \|*  
*uvāca viṣṭimānāyya śṛṣu bhadre mayoditum \|\| 14 \|\|*

*karaṇaiḥ saha vartasva bavabālavakaulavaiḥ \|*  
*saptame'rdhadine prāpte yadabhīṣṭaṃ kuruṣva tat \|\| 15 \|\|*

*yātrāpraveśamāṃgalyakṛṣivāṇijyakāraṇāt \|*  
*bhakṣayasvābhimukhagānnarānunmārgagāminaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. At these words of the Sungod, Brahma called for Bhadra - the daughter of the Sungod and said to her - “O Bhadra, you listen to my words. You better live with the rays known as Bava, Balava and Kaulava. On the seventh half day alone, you can act as you like. Only such of the people should be devoured by you, who are on the wrong path. The people moving on journey, entering the house, performing the welfare rites or the farming or those who reach before their masters for the sake of business, should not be disturbed. You should only devour the people, who move on the wrong path.

## \|\| 3.117.17-18 \|\|

*udvejanīyo no hi jano bhavatyā divasatrayam \|*  
*pūjyā surāsurāṇāṃ tvaṃ divasārddhe bhaviṣyasi \|\| 17 \|\|*

*ullaṃghya ye pravartaṃte bhadre tvāṃ nirbhayā narāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ vināśayāśu tvaṃ kāryamārye sukhī bhava \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Do not disturb the people on three particular days. During half of the day, the gods and the asuras shall adore you. О Bhadra! A person, who becoming fearless, tries to overrule you, then you can destroy such a person. You remain comfortable always.”

## \|\| 3.117.19 \|\|

*evamuktvā gato brahmā bhadrāpi bhuvanatrayam \|*  
*babhrāmodbhrāṃtahṛdayā bhīṣayantī surāsurān \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Thus speaking, Brahma left the place. Then Bhadra also getting wonder struck, frightening the gods and the demons, wandered throughout the three worlds.

## \|\| 3.117.20-21 \|\|

*evameṣā samutpannā viṣṭiriṣṭavināśinī \|*  
*niveditā te kauṃteya tasmāttāṃ parivarjayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

*asitajaladavarṇā dīrghanāsogradaṃṣṭrā vipulahanukapālā piṃḍikodbaddhajaṃghā \|*  
*analaśatasahasraṃ codgiraṃtī samaṃtātpatati bhuvanamadhye kāryanāśāya viṣṭiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Thus, I have narrated the story of Iṣṭavināśinī Bhadra’s birth. Therefore, she has to be discarded. She keeps on vomiting fire on the people in the three worlds and destroys their noble deeds. She has the complexion of black clouds, long nose, sharp and protruding teeth, vast chin and cheeks. She looks as having grieves tied to the navel.

## \|\| 3.117.22 \|\|

*bhānoḥ sutā ketuśatāgrajātā kṛṣṇā kumūrtiḥ satataṃ kucelā \|*  
*devairniyuktā karaṇārthasaṃsthā viṣṭistu sarvatra vivarjanīyā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Of all the children of the Sungod like Ketu and others, she was born as the first child She is quite ugly and is the form of bad time. The gods had deputed Viṣṭi to live with Karana by which she was disowned always.

## \|\| 3.117.23-24 \|\|

*mukhe tu ghaṭikāḥ pañca dve kaṃṭhe tu sadā sthite \|*  
*hṛdi caikādaśa proktāścatasro nābhimaṃḍale \|\| 23 \|\|*

*kaṭyāṃ pañcaiva vijñeyāstisraḥ pucche jayāvahāḥ \|*  
*mukhe kāryavināśāya grīvāyāṃ dhananāśinī \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. She resides in the mouth for ten ghadis, always dwells in the throat for eleven ghadis; she lives in the heart for four ghadis; resides in the navel for five ghadis and lives in the tail of an elephant for three ghadis. From the month, she takes out the life.

## \|\| 3.117.25-26 \|\|

*hadi prāṇaharā jñeyā nābhyāṃ tu kalahāvahā \|*  
*kaṭyāmarthaparibhraṃśo viṣṭipucche dhruvo jayaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*pṛthivyāṃ yāni kāryāṇi suśubhānyaśubhāni ca \|*  
*tāni sarvāṇi siddhyaṃti viṣṭipucche na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. While staying in the navel, she creates quarrel; while living in waist, she destroys the riches; while living in the tail, she surely bestows victory. All the auspicious or inauspicious activities on earth get established when Viṣṭi is lodged in the tail. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.117.27-29 \|\|

*dhanyā dadhimukhī bhadrā mahāmārī kharānanā \|*  
*kālarātrirmahārudrā viṣṭiśca kulaputrikā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*bhairavī ca mahākālī asurāṇāṃ kṣayaṃkarī \|*  
*dvādaśaiva tu nāmāni prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭheta \|\| 28 \|\|*

*na ca vyādhirbhavettasya rogī rogātpramucyate \|*  
*grahāḥ sarve'nukūlāḥ syurna ca vighnādi jāyate \|\| 29 \|\|*

27-29. Dhanya, Dadhimukhi, Bhadra, Mahamari, Kharanana (donkey’s face), Kalaratri, Maharudra, Visti, Kulaputrika, Bhairavi, Mahakali and Ksayamkari — the destroyer of asuras, a person who recites the above twelve names in the morning while waking up, he does not attract any ailment and the patient gets relieved of his ailment. All the planets get favourable and cause no more obstructions.

## \|\| 3.117.30-31 \|\|

*raṇe rājakule dyūte sarvatra vijayī bhavet \|\| 30 \|\|*

*yaśca pūjayate nityaṃ śāstroktavidhinā naraḥ \|*  
*tasya sarvārthasiddhistu bhavatīha na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. In the battlefield, royal race or while gambling, he always achieves the victory. Therefore, a man who worships all these forms of the goddess according to the prescribed rules mentioned in Śāstras, his all works get accomplished without any doubt.

## \|\| 3.117.32-36 \|\|

*yenopavāsavidhinā vratena ca yaśasvinī \|*  
*pūjitā tuṣṭimabhyeti tadeva kathayāmi te \|\| 32 \|\|*

*yasmindine bhavedbhadrā tasminnahani bhārata \|*  
*upavāsasya niyamaṃ kuryā nnārī naro'tha vā \|\| 33 \|\|*

*yadi rātrau bhavedviṣṭirekabhuktaṃ dinadvayam \|*  
*kāryaṃ tenopavāsaḥ syāditi paurāṇikī śrutiḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*praharasyopari yadā syādviṣṭiḥ praharatrayam \|*  
*tatropavāsaḥ kartavya ekabhuktamatonyathā \|\| 35 \|\|*

*sarvauṣadhyudakasnānaṃ sugaṃdhāmalakairatha \|*  
*nadyāṃ taḍāge'tha gṛhe snānaṃ sarvatra śasyate \|\| 36 \|\|*

32-36. It is said that one who observes vrata appropriately, he surely becomes glorious. О Bhārata, therefore, a man should regularly observe fast on the mentioned days of a month without fail. If a person takes food in the night during the performance of vrata, he should observe fast for next two days as per the rules mentioned in the Puranas. If any obstruction arises during the performance of vrata at any of the three praharas, the performer should take meals just once in the night and observe the fast in the next prahara. In the morning, he should take bath in his home with the application of scent and oil over his body.

## \|\| 3.117.37-38 \|\|

*devānpitṝnprīṇayitvā tato darbhamayīṃ śubhām \|*  
*viṣṭiṃ kṛtvā puṣpadhūpairnaivedyena ca pūjayet \|\| 37 \|\|*

*homaṃ kṛtvā viṣṭināmairaṣṭottaraśataṃ tataḥ \|*  
*bhuñjīta dattvā viprāya tilānpāyasameva ca \|*  
*satilāṃ kṛśarāṃ bhuktvā paścādbhuñjīta kāmataḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. After taking a bath and offering oblations to the manes, a figure of Viṣṭi should be made in kuśā grass and flowers, incense, eatables etc. should be offered to her, after which she should be properly worshipped. After the offering of the sesamum seeds and payasam, the payasam should then be served to the Brahmanas. Thereafter, the mixed food grains with sesamum seeds should be consumed as the food and other favoured items of food.

## \|\| 3.117.39 \|\|

*chāyāsūryasute devi viṣṭiriṣṭārthadāyini \|*  
*pūjitā'si yathāśaktyā bhadre bhadrapradā bhava \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. Thereafter, one should beg forgiveness saying - “O daughter of Chaya and Surya, О goddess Viṣṭi, you bestow the desired success. I have performed worship for you as per my means. Therefore, you bestow welfare on me.”

## \|\| 3.117.40 \|\|

*upoṣpa vidhinānena daśa sapta yathākramam \|*  
*udyāpanaṃ tataḥ kuryātpūrvava tpūjya bhāminīm \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. With the following of the same process, seventeen fastings should be observed, one after the other. After so doing, the ceremony of the conclusion or udyapana should be performed.

## \|\| 3.117.41 \|\|

*sthāpayitvāyase pīṭhe kṛśarānnaṃ nivedya ca \|*  
*paridhāpya kṛṣṇayugaṃ stutvā maṃtreṇa tāṃ punaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. An image of Viṣṭi should be made in iron and placed over the seat wrapped in the four black clothes. Thereafter, the worship should be conducted, reciting the mantras.

## \|\| 3.117.42-45 \|\|

*brāhmaṇāya punardadyāllohaṃ tailaṃ tilāṃstathā \|*  
*kṛṣṇāṃ savatsāṃ gāmekāṃ tathaikaṃ kālakaṃbalam \|*  
*dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśaktyā dattvā bhadrāṃ visarjayet \|\| 42 \|\|*

*ya evaṃ kurute pārtha samyagbhadrāvrataṃ naraḥ \|*  
*vighno na jāyate tasya kāryāraṃbhe kadācana \|\| 43 \|\|*

*rākṣasāśca piśācā vā pūtanāśākinīgrahāḥ \|*  
*na pīḍayanti taṃ martyaṃ yo bhadrāvratamācaret \|\| 44 \|\|*

*na caiveṣṭaviyogaḥ syānna hānistasya jāyate \|*  
*dehāṃte yāti sadanaṃ bhāskarasya na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

42-45. Then the food of mixed grains, iron, sesamum seeds, black cow with calf, black blanket and daksina as per one’s means, should be given to the Brahmana with all other things used in worship. О Partha, a person who completes the Bhadra vrata appropriately, no obstruction is caused during the start of any of his activities. And the person who completes the vrata, is never frightened by the demons, Pisacas, Putana, Sakini, besides the planets. He also does not have to face separation from his near and dear ones. He also does not have to face any losses. At the time of death, he achieves the place of the Sungod. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.117.46 \|\|

*sūryātmajātidayitā bhaginī śaneryā martye bhramatyatirathā karaṇakrameṇa \|*  
*tāṃ kṛṣṇabhāsuramukhīṃ samupoṣya viṣṭimiṣṭārthasiddhimabudho'pi pumānupaiti \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Thus, Bhadra - the daughter of the Sungod as well as the sister of Śanideva, wanders on earth with rays of the Sun. She has a black shining face and wanders everywhere with such a face. When she is worshipped while fasting, even the foolish people attain success.

## Chapter 118. Description of Agastya Vrata

## \|\| 3.118.1 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*agastyavratamastyanyatsarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|*  
*tacchṛṇuṣva mahīpāla kathyamānaṃ mayānagha \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said - О great king and sinless one, another Agastya vrata is being talked about, which is said to be remover of all the sins. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.118.2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇomi brūhi me kṛṣṇa devarṣestasya ceṣṭitam \|*  
*janma caivārghadānaṃ ca kālamudgamanasya ca \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Yudhisthira said - О Kṛṣṇa, I am prepared to listen about the vrata of Devarsi, but you also tell me about his birth, the giving of arghya and about his departure as well.

## \|\| 3.118.3-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*mitraśca varuṇaścaiva pūrvametau surottamau \|*  
*maṃdarasya samīpe tu ceraturvipulaṃ tapaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tayoḥ saṃkṣobhaṇārthāya vāsavena varāpsarāḥ \|*  
*urvaśī preṣitā tatra rūpodāryaguṇānvitā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tasyāḥ saṃdarśanādeva kṣubhitau tau surottamau \|*  
*vikāraṃ manaso buddhvā kuṃbhe vīryaṃ sasarjatuḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*nimeḥ śāpāttatra jāto vaśiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ \|*  
*anaṃtaramagastyastu jāto divyastapodhanaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

3-6. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said - In earlier times, two excellent gods known by the names of Mitra and Varuna started performing tapas at the Mandaracala mountain. Observing their vast vratas, in order to disturb their tapas, Indra sent an excellent apsara Urvasi, who possessed enormous charm and beauty, besides all the virtues. At the very sight of Urvasi, the minds of both the ascetics got disturbed and both of them dropped their semen in a pitcher. Because of the curse of Nimi, Vasiṣṭha first emerged out of the pitcher. Thereafter, the sage Agastya was born out of the pitcher.

## \|\| 3.118.7-9 \|\|

*malayasyaikadeśe tu vaikhānasavidhānataḥ \|*  
*sabhāryaḥ saṃvṛto vipraistapastepe suduścaram \|\| 7 \|\|*

*āstāṃ daityau purā duṣṭāvādau kṛtayugasya tu \|*  
*nāmnā ilvalavātāpī devabrāhmaṇakaṃṭakau \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tayoreko'bhavanmeṣo dvitīyo bhojyadāyakaḥ \|*  
*śrāddhakrameṇa tenaivaṃ bahavo nāśitā dvijāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. Once the Brahmanas were performing tapas at the Malayacala mountain with a female companion. At that point of time, two wicked daityas known by the name of Ilavala and Vatapi arrived there. They were the thorns for the Devas as well as the Brahmanas. One of them was turned as a sheep and the other one killing the sheep, offered him as food in the śrāddha. By following this process of the performing of śrāddha, they destroyed several of the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.118.10-14 \|\|

*athānyasmindine daityo hyagastyaṃ saṃnyamantrayat \|*  
*bhojyārthaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ bhṛgugargakulodbhavaiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*agastyopyabhavacchrāddhe dhaureyo roṣadarpitaḥ \|*  
*so'pi hatvāpacadvahnau vātāpiṃ meṣarūpiṇam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*pariviṣyamāṇeṣu teṣu stimitaṃ prāha dānavam \|*  
*agastyo bhagavānkruddhaḥ sarvaṃ me dīyatāmiti \|\| 12 \|\|*

*maiṣaṃ māṃsaṃ tataḥ prādādilvalaḥ kupitastadā \|*  
*bhakṣayitvā'bhavatsvastho nirvikāro mahāmuniḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*śucirbabhau tataḥ prāha vātāpimilvalaḥ śanaiḥ \|*  
*niṣkramasva munerddehaṃ bhittvā kasmādvilaṃbase \|\| 14 \|\|*

10-14. Thereafter, one day, Ṛśi Agastya arrived there together with the Brahmanas of the race of Bhrigu, Garga and others. They reached the place of the daitya brothers. After reaching there, Ṛśi Agastya expressed his unhappiness. Ilavala then made Vatapi a sheep and killed him. He cooked the meat of the sheep in the fire and then served it to the Brahmanas as the food, who were seated in a circular manner. Then the sage Agastya said to the daitya - “Give me the entire meat.” Getting enraged, Ilavala too served the entire meat of the sheep to sage Agastya alone. The sage Agastya on his part, even after consuming the whole meat of one sheep, remained healthy as before. There was no deficiency to be found in his body. When the sage washed his hands clean, Ilavala said to Vatapi- “Tearing out the body of the sage, you come out, why are you delaying?”

## \|\| 3.118.15-21 \|\|

*tacchrutvāgastyavipro'pi udgāraṃ kṛtavāngurum \|*  
*kuto niṣkramaṇaṃ prāha bhakṣitaḥ sa mayā punaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*jīrṇo'yaṃ bhasmabhūto'yaṃ vātāpirbrahmakaṃṭakaḥ \|*  
*ilvalo'pi sphuratkrodhaḥ so'gastyena nirīkṣitaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*bhasmībhūtaḥ kṣaṇenaiva tataḥ śāṃtaṃ jagadbabhau \|*  
*tena vaireṇa te duṣṭā naṣṭaśeṣāstu dānavāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*saṃmaṃtrya niścayaṃ merau tato'gastyamupāgatāḥ \|*  
*vivarddhayiṣavastejo munerasya divaukasaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*te'gastyamāhurbrahmarṣe samudraṃ śoṣayasva vai \|*  
*tacchrutvāgastyavipro'pi āgneyīṃ dhāraṇāṃ dadhat \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tayā pītaḥ samudro'pi bhrāṃtamīnormikacchapaḥ \|*  
*pīte samudratoye'pi devaiḥ kruddhaistu dānavāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*kṣayaṃ nītāḥ kṣaṇātsarve krandamānāḥ punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*kṣemaṃ jagatyabhūtsarvamagastyarṣeḥ prasādataḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

15-21. On hearing Ilavala, the great Brahmana Agastya laughed aloud and said- “I have eaten him up, then how can he come out of my belly. Vatapi, who had been a thorn for the Brahmanas, has been digested in my belly.” On hearing these words, the lips of Ilavala started fluttering in anger. But with a mere glance of the sage Agastya, Ilavala too was reduced to ashes. As a result of this, the entire world became peaceful. Thereafter, all the remaining Danavas consulted among themselves and moved towards the Meru mountain. The gods then said to the sage Agastya- “О Brahmarsi, you better dry up the ocean with your Agneyi traditions.” On hearing these words, the sage patronizing the Agneyi tradition, drank up the entire ocean, which was the resting place for the fish, whirlpools and tortoises. Thereafter, the gods getting enraged, destroyed all the demons who had been crying in the ocean. By the grace of the sage Agastya, the entire universe became quite comfortable.

## \|\| 3.118.22 \|\|

*atha gaṃgānadītoyaiḥ saṃpūrṇe sāgare punaḥ \|*  
*maṃthānaṃ maṃdaraṃ kṛtvā netraṃ kṛtvā tu vāsukim \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. On the other hand, the holy river Ganga once again filled the ocean with water. Thereafter, the Daityas and Danavas, using Mandaracala mountain as the churning rod and Vasuki as the rope, started churning the ocean again.

## \|\| 3.118.23-26 \|\|

*mamaṃthuḥ sahitāḥ sarve samudraṃ daityadānavāḥ \|*  
*athotthitaṃ ratnasaṃghe some śrīkaustubhe gaje \|\| 23 \|\|*

*atilobhānmathyamāne sāgare payasāṃ nidhau \|*  
*athotthitaṃ jvaladraudraṃ kālakūṭaṃ mahāviṣam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*yenāsau surasaṃghāte āghūrṇitā ivābhavat \|*  
*sāgaraṃ saṃpraviṣṭāste rātrau rātrau viniryuyuḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*nirgamya ca vadhaṃ cakrurmunīnāmūrdhvaretasām \|*  
*babhaṃjuryajñapātrāṇi divā toye nililyire \|\| 26 \|\|*

23-26. While churning the ocean, the moon, Laksml, Kaustubha gem and the elephant Airavata emerged out of it, but because of the immense greed, they did not stop the churning of the ocean. Subsequently, when the burning poison Kalakuta emerged out of the ocean, all the daityas got fainted. But all the daityas then hid themselves in the oceanic water, who came out of the water during the night time only. In this way, the daityas coming out of the ocean during the night, killed the Ṛṣis and the ascetics. They broke their yajna vases and then hid themselves in water during the day.

## \|\| 3.118.27-28 \|\|

*samudramadhye na jñātvā brahmā nārāyaṇo haraḥ \|*  
*vāyuḥ kubero vasavaḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tato mantraiḥ śaṃkareṇa kiñcittatraiva bhakṣitam \|*  
*kṣaṇāddagdhaḥ sa maṃtropi nīlakaṃṭhīkṛto haraḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. The gods like Brahma, Viṣṇu, Siva, Vayu, Kubera, Vasus and Indra could not trace the demons in the ocean during the day time. Thereafter, lord Siva consumed same poison uttering a mantra. Even the mantra was reduced to ashes and the poison was lodged in his throat, which earned him the name of Nilakantha or the blue-throated lord.

## \|\| 3.118.29-30 \|\|

*brahmāpi cetanāṃ prāpya abrahmaṇyamuvāca ha \|*  
*nāsti kaścijagatyasminviṣamāpātumīśvara \|\| 29 \|\|*

*agastyo dakṣiṇāśāyāṃ laṅkāmūle mahāmuniḥ \|*  
*tadgacchadhvaṃ mahābhāgāḥ śaraṇaṃ sarvadā hyasau \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. Regaining his consciousness after sometime, Brahma said - “O Isvara, a great calamity has arisen. There is none in the world who could consume the poison. Therefore, О gods, in the southern direction close to island of Lanka, their lives a great sage Agastya. All of you should take refuge with him, because he always provokes refuge to the needy people.

## \|\| 3.118.31-36 \|\|

*evamuktā gatā devā agastyāśramadakṣiṇām \|*  
*devānvīkṣya ca tānharṣādagastyo munisattamaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*dhyānaṃ cakre viṣaṃ yena himādrau saṃpraveśitam \|*  
*kaṃṭhīsūtraṃ nikuṃjeṣu himaparvatasānuṣu \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tasminkāle viṣaṃ lagnaṃ kiñciccheṣaṃ drumādiṣu \|*  
*unmattakaravīrārkasthalabhūmi jalānile \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tadviṣaṃ cūrṇitaṃ tena kṣaṇātsaṃkocitaṃ tathā \|*  
*himavātena duṣṭena vahamānena pāṃḍava \|\| 34 \|\|*

*manuṣyāṇāṃ tu jāyaṃte rogā nānāvidhā bhuvi \|*  
*te ca māsatrayaṃ sārddhaṃ pravahaṃti viṣolbaṇāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*vṛṣasaṃkrātimārabhya siṃhāṃte śāmyate viṣam \|*  
*rogadoṣāpanodaśca bhavetpārtha prabhāvataḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

31-36. On hearing these words, all the gods then proceeded to the southern direction. At the arrival of the gods there with the sage Agastya, he recalled the event when the poison appeared in the Himalaya. With his divine sight, he found that all the peaks of Himalaya as well as the boars and trees were infested with the poison. A small portion of the same was poisoning the trees as well. The trees like the thorn apple, oleander etc., besides the land and water of the lake were all poisoned. О Pandava, with the blowing of the wind polluted with the poison, the people in the plains suffer badly. But when the same wind carrying the smell of the burnt poison, starting from the day of Vṛṣa Saṁkrānti blows for three months upto the Siṁha Saṁkrānti, then it becomes peaceful. As a result of this, all the ailments and blemishes get subsided.

## \|\| 3.118.37-40 \|\|

*evaṃ kālena mahatā nīruje vyādhivarjite \|*  
*jagatyasminpurā pārtha ghanībhūte prajāgaṇe \|\| 37 \|\|*

*niraṃtare martyaloke ūrdhvabāhu prasāriṇi \|*  
*balavāndhūmanirdeśānmṛtyurbhrāmyati mūrtimān \|\| 38 \|\|*

*prajā vyāpādayankālādājagāma mahāmuneḥ \|*  
*samīpaṃ mūrtimānkruddho mṛtyustena nirīkṣitaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*bhasmībabhūva paścācca brahmaṇaḥ sukhakāraṇāt \|*  
*vyādhivṛndasamopeto mṛtyuranyo vinirmitaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

37-40. О Partha, in earlier times, there had been an expansion of the population for a long duration when the people were without any ailments and were healthy. Finding the unchecked increase in the population on earth, the death, like the smoke turning itself in the form of a woman, went to the sage Agastya, who getting himself enraged, reduced her to ashes. But Brahma created another death together with a large number of diseases.

## \|\| 3.118.41-42 \|\|

*tathānyo daṃḍakāraṇye śveto nāma nṛpottamaḥ \|*  
*svamāṃsamaśnatā tena nirvedātprārthito muniḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*bhagavatsarvamevānyaddattaṃ rājyamadānmayā \|*  
*annaṃ jalaṃ vā śrāddhaṃ vā na dattaṃ pāpabuddhinā \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Once upon a time, king Śveta - the ruler of Dandakaranya, who after consuming his own flesh was living as a goblin and feeling grieved, he went to sage Agastya and prayed to him - “O lord, because of the height of the arrogance and out of sinful mind, I gave away everything in charity, but I did not give in charity the food, water, nor did I perform the sraddha. (Therefore, this is the reward which has been received by me.)

## \|\| 3.118.43 \|\|

*tato'gastyaḥ kāruṇyā ratnaiḥ śrāddhamakalpayat \|*  
*śrāddhe nivṛtte sahasā divyadehaḥ śriyā vṛtaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. On hearing the words of the preta (goblin), out of compassion, he performed a sraddha for him, with the offering of gems. With the completion of the sraddha, the preta achieved the divine body.

## \|\| 3.118.44-48 \|\|

*prāptaśca paramaṃ sthānamagastyarṣeḥ prasādataḥ \|*  
*atha vindhyo mahāśailaḥ sūryaroṣādvyavardhata \|\| 44 \|\|*

*kasmānmerumivāsau māṃ na karoti pradakṣiṇam \|*  
*varddhamānaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā tato devāḥ savāsavāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*ekībhūyāśramaṃ gatvā stutvā devarṣipuṅgavam \|*  
*agastyamūcurbhagavansūryamārganirodhinam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*viṃdhyaṃ nivāraya svainaṃ sthitau sthāpaya parvatam \|*  
*agastyopi drutaṃ gatvā prāhedaṃ vindhyaparvatam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*prasthitaṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ viddhi māmacalottama \|*  
*sthitau ca sthīyatāṃ tāvadyāvadāgamanaṃ mama \|\| 48 \|\|*

44-48. Once the mountain Vindhya, getting envious of the fact that the Sungod only respects the Meru mountain, while circumambulating the earth, started growing towards the sky. With the growing of the Vindhya mountain in this way, all the gods like Indra and others reached the hermitage of the sage Agastya and started offering prayer to him. They said - “O sage, you kindly stop the Vindhya mountain from so growing, because his activity obstructs the path of the Sungod. He should be made to remain in his proper position.” On hearing these words, Agastya at once went there and said to the Vindhya mountain - “O best of the mountains, I have started on pilgrimage. Therefore, you remain in your original position till my return.”

## \|\| 3.118.49 \|\|

*evamuktvā saṃprayāto nādyāpi vinivartate \|*  
*dṛśyate bhrājayannāśāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ gagane jvalan \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. Thus speaking, he left the place and has not returned till date. He shines in the southern direction in the sky.

## \|\| 3.118.50-53 \|\|

*trailokyavaṃdyacaraṇo lopāmudrāsahāyavān \|*  
*lopāmudrāpi taṃ prāha devarṣiṃ devapūjitam \|\| 50 \|\|*

*tatrāśramasthalikāyāmṛtukāle hyupasthite \|*  
*bhoktumicchāmi viṣayāṃstvayā saha sukheṣiṇī \|\| 51 \|\|*

*bhavedyadi gṛhaṃ ramyaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam \|*  
*gajai rathaiśca saṃpūrṇaṃ śayanaiḥ pravarāsanaiḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*dukūlapaṭṭanetraiśca vilāsairlalitairmune \|*  
*tvayā saha samāyogaṃ yāsye'haṃ kuru cintitam \|\| 53 \|\|*

50-53. Thereafter, Lopamudra - the spouse of the sage Agastya, after having a bath during the period, arrived before her husband and said to the sage - “O great sage, I intend to enjoy the conjugal pleasures with you becoming lustful. Therefore, there should be such a house, having all the precious gems, elephants and chariots, besides the excellent beds, the suitable costumes for daily use and the cosmetic materials. Therefore, in order to enjoy the conjugal pleasures with me, you kindly arrange to get me all these requirements.”

## \|\| 3.118.54-59 \|\|

*etacchutvā munihṛrṣṭaḥ prāhvayaddhanadaṃ kṣaṇāt \|*  
*kārayāmāsa bhavanaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ ratnarāśibhiḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*tatra reme sa bhagavānagastyaḥ svāśrame sukham \|*  
*tasyaivaṃ ceṣṭitasyarṣeḥ prayacchārghyaṃ yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 55 \|\|*

*āstikyabuddhyā bhaktyā ca dhanaṃ prāpsyasi pāṃḍava \|*  
*kanyāyāmāgate sūrye arvāgvai saptame dine \|\| 56 \|\|*

*kanyāyāṃ samanuprāpte sūrye yaḥ sannivartate \|*  
*pratyūṣasamaye vidvānkuryāvasyodaye niśi \|\| 57 \|\|*

*snānaṃ śuklatilaistadvacchuklamālyāmbaro gṛhī \|*  
*sthāpayedavraṇaṃ kuṃbhaṃ mālyavastravibhūṣitam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam \|*  
*nānābhakṣyasamopetaṃ saptadhānyasamanvitam \|\| 59 \|\|*

54-59. On hearing these words of Lopamudra, the sage Agastya at once summoned Kubera - the gods of wealth. He got the house built from him, as had been desired by Lopamudra. Thereafter, the sage Agastya enjoyed all the conjugal pleasures with Lopamudra quite comfortably. Therefore, О Yudhisthira, you should offer oblation to the sage Agastya with devotion. Because by so doing, you would gain faith and dharma. О Pandava, a week after the moving of the Sun on the zodiac symbol of Virgo, at the time of the sunrise, a learned person should take bath with the water mixed with sesamum seeds at an appropriate place and should establish a pitcher filled with water, well decorated with the garlands and covered with the cloth. It should then be worshipped with a vase filled with ghi. Besides several types of food items, seven types of grains should be offered.

## \|\| 3.118.60-62 \|\|

*kāñcanaṃ kārayitvā tu yathāśaktyā suśobhanam \|*  
*puruṣākṛtiṃ praśāntaṃ ca japamaṇḍaladhāriṇam \|\| 60 \|\|*

*kamaṇḍalukaraṃ śiṣyairmṛgaiśca paridhāritam \|*  
*mṛtyughnaṃ viṣahantāraṃ darbhākṣeṣṭakaraṃ munim \|\| 61 \|\|*

*tasminkrame samālagnaṃ candanena tato nyaset \|*  
*snāpitaṃ cānuliptaṃ ca candanena sugaṃdhinā \|\| 62 \|\|*

60-62. Thereafter, the life size image of gold of the sage Agastya should be consecrated and then worshipped, as per the means of a person. The image should be quite a pleasant one, with a peaceful look. A kamandalu should be held in one hand. He should be surrounded by his disciples as well as the wild animals. The great Ṛṣi is the destroyer of poison and draught, so while worshipping the sage, he should first be consecrated with the sandal paste and then bathed. The fragrant sandal paste should be plastered over the body.

## \|\| 3.118.63 \|\|

*pūjitaṃ cāpi kusumairhṛdyairdhūpaistu dhūpitam \|*  
*tataścārghaṃ pradātavyo yairdravyaistāni me śṛṇu \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Then offering him the fragrant flowers as well as the incense, the arghya should be offered, the formation of which is being spelt out by you. Please listen.

## \|\| 3.118.64-67 \|\|

*kharjūrairnālikeraiśca kūṣmāṃḍaistrapuṣairapi \|*  
*karkoṭakāravellaiśca karcūrairbījapūrakaiḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

*vṛṃtākairdāḍimaiścaiva nāraṃgaiḥ kadalīphalaiḥ \|*  
*dūrvāṃkuraiḥ kuśaiḥ kāśaiḥ padmainīlotpalaistathā \|\| 65 \|\|*

*nānāprakārairbhakṣyaiśca gobhirvastrai rasaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*virūḍhaiḥ saptadhānyaiśca vaṃśapātre nidhāpitaiḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*sauvarṇaraupyapātreṇa tāmravaṃśamayena ca \|*  
*mūrdhni sthitena namreṇa jānubhyāṃ pṛthivītale \|\| 67 \|\|*

64-67. The fruits like date palm, melon, wood apple, bitter gourd, karkotaka, pomegranate, orange, banana, tender durva grass, kuśā grass, long reed, blue lotus, several food items, a cow with cloth, green cereals, gold, silver and the vases of copper in the bamboo baskets should be arranged. After placing all these things around, the devotee should be seated over the ground in a half kneeling position. He should touch the vase with his body.

## \|\| 3.118.68-72 \|\|

*dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā hyarghyapādyādikaṃ ca yat \|*  
*śīlena cetasā bhaktyā dadyātkauravanandana \|\| 68 \|\|*

*kāśapuṣpapratīkāśa agnimārutasaṃbhava \|*  
*mitrāvaruṇayoḥ putra kuṃbhayone namo'stu te \|\| 69 \|\|*

*viṃdhyavṛddhikṣayakara meṣatoyaviṣāpaha \|*  
*rakto vallabhadevarṣe laṃkāvāsa namo'stu te \|\| 70 \|\|*

*vātāpirbhakṣito yena samudrāḥ śoṣitāḥ purā \|*  
*lopāmudrāpatiḥ śrīmānyo'sau tasmai namo'stu te \|\| 71 \|\|*

*yenoditena pāpāni pralayaṃ yāṃti vyādhayaḥ \|*  
*tasmai namo'stvagastyāya saśiṣyāya suputriṇe \|*  
*brāhmaṇo vedaṛcayā dadyādarghyaṃ namo'stu te \|\| 72 \|\|*

68-72. Facing south, with a smiling face, he should offer oblation to the sage Agastya. Thereafter, he should beg forgiveness from him, saying - “You have the white complexion like the white flowers. You are born out of the fire and the wind. You are the son of Mitra and Varuna. Salutation to such a sage born of kumbhayoni. You stopped the increase in the height of the Vindhya mountain, besides being the remover of sheep, water and the ocean. О sage, you have red complexion, О divine sage, the dweller of Lanka, salutation to you. You consumed Vatapi and drank the ocean. Salutation to the husband of Lopamudra. You remove all the ailments and the sins get vanished. Salutation to the sage Agastya with his sons and disciples. Salutation to the sage who offers oblation to Brahma with the reciting of the Vedic hymns.

## \|\| 3.118.73-74 \|\|

*agastyaḥ khanamānaśca nityaṃ prājāpatyaṃ balimicchamānaḥ \|*  
*ubhau varṇau vṛṣṭyanugrahārthamupoṣa satyādeṣvaśikho jagāma \|*  
*dattvaivamarghyaṃ kauṃteya pratipūjya ca puṣpakaiḥ \|*  
*visarjayitvāgastyaṃ taṃ viprāya pratipādayet \|\| 73 \|\|*

*daivajñavyāsarūpāya vedavedāṃgavādine \|*  
*evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā hyagastyapratipūjanam \|*  
*phalamekaṃ tathā dhānyaṃ kopaṃ vāsaṃ parityajet \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. You are lodged in the sky and are always desirous of the Prajapatya sacrifice. For the sake of the rainfall, Agastya having two varnas, travelled without the tuft. О son of Kunti, Agastya should be offered the oblation and worshipped offering the flowers and then sent off with grace. The image should then be given over to an astrologer, a Vyasa or a Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas and the related literature. A person who worships the image of the sage Agastya with devotion, should vow to disown a fruit, a food grain and the anger completely.

## \|\| 3.118.75 \|\|

*saṃpūrṇe ca tato varṣe punara nyadupakramet \|*  
*dattvārghyaṃ saptavarṣāṇi krameṇānena pāṃḍava \|*  
*pumānphalamavāpnoti tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. At the end of the year, the fast should again be started. О Pandava, the same process has to be completed for a period of seven years at a time. The merit one earns by so doing, you listen from me carefully.

## \|\| 3.118.76-77 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaścaturo vedānsarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ \|*  
*kṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ prāpnotyarṇavamekhalām \|\| 76 \|\|*

*vaiśyo'pyāyuṣyamāpnoti godhanaṃ cāpi naṃdati \|*  
*śūdrāṇāṃ dhanamārogyaṃ sanmānaścādhiko bhavet \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. A Brahmana achieves proficiency in the learning of the Vedas. A Ksatriya achieves the land with a part of the ocean; a Vaisya achieves long life and becomes the lord of several cows; while the Sudras achieve the wealth and good health for a long time.

## \|\| 3.118.78-79 \|\|

*strīṇāṃ putrāḥ prajāyaṃte saubhāgyaṃ vṛddhiṛddhimat \|*  
*vidhavānāṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ vardhate pāṃḍunandana \|\| 78 \|\|*

*kanyā bhartāramāpnoti vyādhermucyeta duḥkhitaḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

78-79. Similarly, the women get several sons, increase in devotion and the great fortunes. O son of Pandu, with the performing of this vrata, the widows earn enormous merit, a girl gets a fortunate husband and an ailing person is relieved of his disease.

## \|\| 3.118.80 \|\|

*yeṣu deśeṣvagastyarṣeḥ pūjanaṃ kriyate janaiḥ \|*  
*teṣu deśeṣu parjanyaḥ kāmavarṣī prajāyate \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. The dwellers of whichever country adore the sage Agastya with devotion, the clouds of those countries drop plenty of rains in that country.

## \|\| 3.118.81-82 \|\|

*ītayaḥ praśamaṃ yāṃti naśyaṃti vyādha yastathā \|*  
*paṭhaṃti ye tvagastyarṣeḥ khyānaṃ śṛṇvaṃti cāpare \|\| 81 \|\|*

*te sarve pāpanirmuktāściraṃ sthitvā mahītale \|*  
*haṃsayuktavimānena svargaṃ yāṃti narottama \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. О king, a person who reads the story of the sage Agastya or listens to it, he getting relieved of all the sins, lives on earth for long. At the time of his death, he is carried in a plane with swans to the heaven.

## \|\| 3.118.83 \|\|

*martyo yadīcchati gṛhaṃ paramarddhiyuktaṃ bhogaśarīramarujaṃ paśuputrapuṣṭim \|*  
*tatsarvavallabhamunerudaye mahārghyaṃ yacchenmahārghaphalavastradhanaiḥ sahānyaiḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. Не achieves the best of the house, excellent pleasures and the body without disease. Those who are desirous of having domestic animals and sons, should always praise on the rise of Agastya and should offer the arghya to him as stated above.

## Chapter 119. Abhinavacandra-arghya Vrata

## \|\| 3.119.1-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*pārtha pārthiva divyastrīmukhapaṃkajaseṃdave \|*  
*śṛṇuṣvābhinavasyeṃdorudaye'rghyavidhiṃ param \|\| 1 \|\|*

*ravirdvādaśabhirbhāgairvāruṇyāṃ dṛśyate yadi \|*  
*pradoṣasamaye pārtha arghyaṃ dadyāttadā vibhoḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*dvitīyāyāṃ site pakṣe saṃdhyākāle hyupasthite \|*  
*saṃsthāpyābhinavaṃ candraṃ sa bhūmyāṃ dṛśyate yadi \|\| 3 \|\|*

*gomayaṃ maṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā caṃdanena suśobhitam \|*  
*rohiṇyā sahitaṃ devaṃ kumudāmodasaṃbhavam \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О Partha, with the rising of the new Moon (on the second moon day), you listen to the type of arghya to be offered to the Moon on that particular day. When the Sun with his twelve wings is sighted on the west, the arghya should be offered during the time of sunset. On the second moon day of the bright fortnight when the moon is sighted, the new moon should be consecrated and for that purpose, the cowdung should be plastered over the ground in a circular way and then decorated with the sandal paste. Thereafter, the Moon with Rohini should be consecrated there, who is born of the lotus flowers.

## \|\| 3.119.5-6 \|\|

*puṣpacandanadhūpaiśca dīpākṣatajalaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*dūrvāṃkurai ratnavarairdadhnā vastraiśca pāṃḍuraiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*maṃtreṇānena rājendra kṣatriyaḥ sapurohitaḥ \|*  
*navonavo'si māsāṃte jāyamānaḥ puna. punaḥ \|*  
*āpyāyasva sametvevaṃ somarāja namonamaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. The offerings of sandal paste, flowers, lamp, auspicious unbroken rice, tender durva grass, the excellent gems, curd and white cloth should be made while worshipping him in an appropriate manner, reciting the mantras – “O Rajendra, О Somaraja, together with your priest, you become new or fresh every month. Let my fortunes also increase similarly. I offer my salutation to you.”

## \|\| 3.119.7-9 \|\|

*anenavidhinācāryaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam \|*  
*yaḥ prayacchati kauṃteya māsimāsi samāhitaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sa kīrtyā yaśasā kāṃtyā dhanyaśca bhuvi mānavaḥ \|*  
*putrapautraiḥ parivṛto godhānyadhanasaṃkulaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sthitvā varṣaśataṃ martye tataḥ somapuraṃ vrajet \|*  
*tatrāste divyavapuṣā bhogānbhuñjannṛpottama \|*  
*varastrībhiḥ sahātyarthaṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. О son of Kunti, with the following of this process, when a person concentrating his mind every month gives donations to the Moongod who fulfills all the desires, such a person on earth earns glory and fame. Becoming graceful, he gets five sons and grandsons, lives gracefully for a hundred years. After his death, he reaches the place of moon. Reaching there, he having a divine body, enjoys the company of the divine damsels upto the time of dissolution.

## \|\| 3.119.10 \|\|

*dharmaṃ samṛddhimatulāṃ yadi vāñchasi tvaṃ māsānumāsamiha madvacanaṃ kuruṣva \|*  
*somasya somakulanaṃdana dhūpapuṣpairarghaṃ prayaccha natajānu navoditasya \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О son of the lunar race, in case you are interested in the wealth of dharma, then accept my words and kneeling on earth, you should offer the arghya with devotion regularly to the new moon with incense and flowers.

## Chapter 120. Worship of Śukra Bṛhaspati

## \|\| 3.120.1-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athātaḥ śṛṇu bhūpāla pratiśukrapraśāṃtaye \|*  
*yātrāraṃbhe prayāṇe ca tathā śukrodayeṣviha \|\| 1 \|\|*

*śukrapūjā prakartavyā tāṃ niśāmaya sārataḥ \|*  
*rājate vā'tha sauvarṇe kāṃsyapātre'tha vā punaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*śuklapuṣpāṃbarayute sitataṃḍulapūrite \|*  
*nidhāya rājataṃ śukraṃ śuci muktāphalānvitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*saha tena savatsāṅgāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|*  
*namaste sarvadeveśa namaste bhṛgunandana \|*  
*kave sarvārthasiddhyarthaṃ gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dattvaivamarghyaṃ kaunteya praṇipatya visarjayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О lord of the earth, I am now revealing the process for the appearing of Śukra (Venus). You please listen. At the time of departure on a journey, as one adores Śukra at the time of the rising of this planet, I am going to speak out the gist for the same. A figure of Śukra should be consecrated in a golden, silver or a copper vase together with pure beads of gems. Then the same image should be worshiped. Thereafter, the same should be given over to a Brahmana with a cow and a calf. At the time of offering arghya, he should beg forgiveness saying- ‘You are the foremost of all the gods and son of Bhṛgu, salutation to you. О Kavi, fulfilling all my desires, you kindly accept the arghya. I offer my salutation to you.” О son of Kunti, after offering the arghya in this way, the performer should send him off, offering salutation to him.

## \|\| 3.120.6-7 \|\|

*yāvacchukrasya na kṛtā pūjā sohālakaiḥ śubhai \|*  
*vaṭakaiḥ pūrikābhiśca godhūmaiścaṇakairapi \|*  
*tāvanna dānaṃ dātavyaṃ strībhiḥ kāmārthasiddhaye \|\| 6 \|\|*

*evaṃ tasyodaye kurvanyātrādiṣu ca bhārata \|*  
*sarvasasyāgamaṃ caiva sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. For attaining of success in all the desires, Śukra should be adored appropriately and without so doing, the ladies should not be served with food. О Bhārata, at the time of the starting on a journey, the planet Śukra should be worshipped. One who does so, he receives all the grains and all his desires are fulfilled.

## \|\| 3.120.8-9 \|\|

*tadvadvācaspateḥ pūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*sauvarṇapātre sauvarṇamamareśapurohitam \|*  
*pītapuṣpāṃbarayutaṃ kṛtvā snātvātha sarṣapaiḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*pālāśāśvatthabhaṃgena pañcagavyajalena ca \|*  
*pītāṃgarāgavasanaṃ ghṛtahomaṃ tu kārayeta \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. O Yudhisthira, I am also telling you about the worship of Bṛhaspati. The gold image of Bṛhaspati - the priest of Indra, should be made in gold and decorated with yellow garments and yellow flowers. Then the image should be bathed, with water mixed with mustard seeds, palasa, plpala, bhanga and pancagavya. The yellow paste should be applied over his body. Then the homa should be performed with the offerings of ghi.

## \|\| 3.120.10-12 \|\|

*praṇamya ca gavā sārddhaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 10 \|\|*

*namaste'ṅgirasāṃ nātha vākpatetha bṛhaspate \|*  
*krūragrahaiḥ pīḍitānāmamṛtāya bhavasva naḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*evaṃ suraguruṃ pūjya praṇipatya kṣamāpayet \|*  
*saṃkrātāvudaye cāste sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. Thereafter, offering the salutation to the gold image, the same with a cow should be given over to a Brahmana, begging forgiveness at the same time thus- “O lord of the Angira gotra and Bṛhaspati - the lord of speech, you are being offered salutation by me. You kindly remove the obstructions caused by the harsh planets.” Thus during the time of Saṁkrānti or the first day of the month, when Bṛhaspati is adored offering salutation to him, then all the desires of the performer are fulfilled.

## \|\| 3.120.13-14 \|\|

*atha vā mauktikānyeva suvṛttāni bṛhaṃti ca \|*  
*bhārgavāṃgirasau ciṃtya tānyeva pratipādayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

*bhaktyā mauktikadānena dattena kurunandana \|*  
*virūpatā dṛśoḥ puṃsāṃ yātrāsvabhyudayeṣu ca \|*  
*kurvanbṛhaspateḥ pūjāṃ na kadācitprajāyate \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. O son of the Kuru race, the images of both Śukra and Bṛhaspati should be decorated with beautiful beads, and thereafter, both of them should be prayed with grace and devotion. With the giving away of beads at the time of one’s departure on journey or at the time of one’s rise, no deficiency of any type can crop up.

## \|\| 3.120.15 \|\|

*ye bhārgavodayamavāpya savastrapuṣpāṃ kurvaṃtyananya manaso'ṅgirase ca pūjām \|*  
*teṣāṃ gṛhe praviśatāṃ pratiśukrajātaṃ vighnaṃ na saṃbhavati bhārata puṇyabhājām \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. О Bharata, at the time of the rise of the planet Śukra, the image of Bṛhaspati should be adored with the offering of clothes and flowers and those who do so, they become entitled to achieving great merit, besides they do not have to face any obstruction.

## Chapter 121. Eighty-five Vratas described

## \|\| 3.121.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu bhārata vakṣyāmi pañcāśītivratāni ca \|*  
*noktāni yāni kasyāpi munibhirdharmadarśibhiḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*bhaviṣyamatsyamārtaṃḍapurāṇeṣu ca varṇitam \|*  
*vārāhaṃ caiva saṃgṛhya kathyaṃte tāni pāṃḍava \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О Bhārata, I am now going to speak to you about eighty-five vratas, the details of which have not so far been disclosed by the religious minded Ṛṣis to anyone. О Pāndava, I am going to reveal the same to you. The Bhavisya, Matsya, Martanda and Varaha Puranas provide an exhaustive discussion on them. I am going to speak out the provisions on the subject in these Puranas.

## \|\| 3.121.3 \|\|

*yadabhīṣṭaṃ sumitrāya śiṣyāya ca sutāya ca \|*  
*na kathyate dharmajātaṃ kiṃ tenodaravartinā \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. In case, the important issues are not revealed to a good friend, a disciple or the son, then what is the use of possessing such knowledge?

## \|\| 3.121.4 \|\|

*śrutismṛtipurāṇebhyo yanmayā hyavadhāritam \|*  
*tatte vacmi kuruśreṣṭha kasyānyasyopadiśyate \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. O best of the race of Kuru, therefore, whatever the knowledge had been gained by me from the study of the ancient traditions Vedas and scriptures on the subject, the same is going to be revealed by me to you.

## \|\| 3.121.5 \|\|

*snātvā prabhātasaṃdhyāyāmupagṛhya ca pippalam \|*  
*tilapātrāṇi yo dadyānna sa śoceta tatkṛte \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. Taking a bath in the early morning, person who gives away a vase filled with sesamum seeds in charity, he never attracts any worries.

## \|\| 3.121.6 \|\|

*vratānāmuttamaṃ hyetatsarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|*  
*pātravratamiti khyātaṃ nākhyātaṃ kasyacinmayā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. This is said to be the best of vratas which is the destroyer of all the sins and is known by the name of Patra vrata. I have never talked about it to anyone.

## \|\| 3.121.7-8 \|\|

*suśuddhasya suvarṇasya suvarṇaṃ yaḥ prayacchati \|*  
*puṇye'hni viprakathite prītyā pītayugānvitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*vrataṃ vācaspateretadbalabuddhipradāyakam \|*  
*vṛtraghnasya purākhyātaṃ guruṇā sarvakāmadam \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. On an auspicious day, the gold as well as the pitayuga should be given over to Brahmana. This vrata bestows the strength on the performer and was revealed by Vacaspati. Bṛhaspati - the preceptor had enlightened Indra - the killer of Vritrasura, about this vrata, which bestows the fulfillment of all the desires.

## \|\| 3.121.9-10 \|\|

*lavaṇaṃ kaṭutiktaṃ ca jīrakaṃ maricāni ca \|*  
*hiṃguśuṃṭhisamāyuktaṃ sarvaṃ paricayaṃ tathā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*caturthyā mekabhaktāśī sakṛddattvā kuṭuṃbine \|*  
*gṛheṣu saptasu sadā śilāyuktāni bhārata \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. О Bhārata, with the giving away in charity the articles like salt, bitter stuff, cumin seeds, chilly, asafetida, ginger and a stone slab with grinder on the fourth day o f the moon, taking food only once a day with a family of seven people, this vrata yields enormous riches and is known by the name of Śilā-vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.11-14 \|\|

*etacchilāvrataṃ nāma lakṣmīlokapradāyakam \|*  
*kartavyamiha yatnena mukhapāṭavakārakam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*naktamannaṃ caritvā tu gavā sārddhaṃ kuṭuṃbine \|*  
*haimaṃ cakraṃ triśūlaṃ ca dadyādviprāya vāsasī \|\| 12 \|\|*

*praṇamya bhaktyā deveśau prīyetāṃ śivakeśavau \|*  
*etadevavrataṃ nāma mahāpātakanāśanam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*kṛtvaikabhuktaṃ varṣāṃte śaktyā haimavṛṣānvitām \|*  
*dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ dadyātsarvo paskaraṇairyutām \|\| 14 \|\|*

11-14. Being an intelligent person, taking food only in night, one should give away in charity a wheel and a trident made of gold with two costumes to lord Viṣṇu and Śiva. Again at the end of the year, one should take food once a day. This vrata is known as the great destroyer one. The salutation should also be offered to both the gods while giving an image of a bull made of gold, besides a well decorated cow made of the sesamum seeds should be given over to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.121.15 \|\|

*etadrudravrataṃ nāma pāpaśokapraṇāśanam \|*  
*yaḥ karoti pumānrājansa padaṃ yāti śāṃkaram \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. This is the Rudra vrata which is the remover of all the sins, and one who performs the same, he surely achieves the place of Śiva.

## \|\| 3.121.16-18 \|\|

*sarvauṣadhyudakasnātaḥ pañcamyāṃ pūjya paṃcakam \|*  
*saptopaskaradānaṃ ca yaḥ karoti gṛhāśramī \|\| 16 \|\|*

*gṛhādyulūkhalaṃ śūrpaḥ śilā sthālī ca pañcamī \|*  
*udakuṃbhaśca cullī ca eteṣāmanukiñcana \|\| 17 \|\|*

*etāni gṛhiṇāṃ gehe prasthāpya puruṣottamam \|*  
*upaskaroti yā nārī na sīdati kadācana \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. On the fifth day of the moon, one should take bath with all the herbs mixed in it. All the five gods should then be worshipped. Then the seven items like a house, mortar, winnowing basket, stone slab with a grinder, a water vase, a pitcher besides a stove should be given in the name of Puruṣottama, reciting the prayer in devotion to him. By so doing, the householder does not have to face any calamity,

## \|\| 3.121.19 \|\|

*etadgṛhavrataṃ nāma sarva saukhyapradāyakam \|*  
*atriṇā hyanasūyāyāḥ kathitaṃ pāṇḍunandana \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. О son of Pandu, this is the vrata which bestows all the comforts and had been revealed by the sage Atri to Anasuya – his own wife.

## \|\| 3.121.20-21 \|\|

*yastu nīlotpalaṃ haimaṃ śarkarāpātrasaṃyutam \|*  
*dadāti śraddhayopeto brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine \|\| 20 \|\|*

*sa vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yāti līlāvratamidaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*āṣāḍhādicaturmāsamabhyaṃgaṃ varjayennaraḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. In case a Brahmana with a family is given with devotion a blue lotus placed in the vase filled with raw sugar, the donor achieves he place of Viṣṇu. This is known as Lila-vrata. During the group of four months like Asadha and others, the performer should discard the application of oil over the body.

## \|\| 3.121.22 \|\|

*pārite ca punardadyāttilatailaghaṭaṃ navam \|*  
*bhojanaṃ pāyasājyaṃ ca sa yāti bhavanaṃ hareḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Then at the end of the four months, a Brahmana should be given over the sesamum seeds, oil, new pitcher, payasam mixed with ghi, one who does so, achieves the place of Viṣṇu.

## \|\| 3.121.23-24 \|\|

*lokaprītikaraṃ caitatprītivratamihocyate \|*  
*varjayitvā madhau yastu dadhikṣīraghṛtaikṣavam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*dadyādvastrayugaṃ sūkṣmaṃ rasapātraiśca saṃyutam \|*  
*saṃpūjya vipramithunaṃ gaurī me prīyatāmiti \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Because of its loving nature, this vrata is called Priti vrata. During the month of Caitra, a person, while discarding curd, payasam, ghi and raw sugar, should give away four or five clothes to a Brahmana couple, after performing the puja. At the time of the giving away of the above articles, the donor should say- “Let goddess Gauri be pleased.”

## \|\| 3.121.25-27 \|\|

*etadgaurīvrataṃ nāma bhavānīloka dāyakam \|*  
*puruṣo yastrayodaśyāṃ kṛtvā naktamatho punaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*saṃvatsarāṃte tasminvā divase vighnavarjitam \|*  
*aśokakāṃcanaṃ dadyātsadvastrayugasaṃśritam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*viprāya vasusaṃyuktaṃ pradyumnaḥ prīyatāmiti \|*  
*kalpaṃ viṣṇupade sthitvā viśokaḥ syātpunarnṛpa \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. This vrata is known as Bhavaniloka-dayakam and also known as Gauri vrata. On the day of trayodasi taking food at night, then at the end of the year on the same day of trayodasi, the gold image of Asoka tree together with the riches should be given over to a Brahmana and while so doing, the devotee should say- “Let Pradyumna be pleased.” О king, after thus performing, the devotee enjoys all the comforts in the abode of Viṣṇu.

## \|\| 3.121.28-30 \|\|

*etatkāmavrataṃnāma sarvaśokavināśanam \|*  
*āṣāḍhādicaturmāsaṃ varjayennakhakartanam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*vṛṃtākabhakṣaṇaṃ caiva madhusarpirghaṭānvitam \|*  
*kārtikyāṃ tu punarhaimaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 29 \|\|*

*rudralokamavāpnoti śivavratamidaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*evaṃ pañcadaśīṃ smṛtvā ekabhaktena mānavaḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. He also gets freed from all the grief. Because of its being the destroyer of all the grief, it is known as the Sarvasokavinasanam-vrata. One should not cut the nails in the month of Asadha as well as the group of four months and should consume Vrntaka and honey in the month of Kartika. Then he should give away a gold image of Śiva to a Brahmana. One who performs this Śiva vrata appropriately on the day of full moon, he achieves Rudraloka.

## \|\| 3.121.31-33 \|\|

*saṃpūjya pūrṇimāṃ devīṃ likhitvā candanādinā \|*  
*tataḥ pañcaghaṭānpūrṇānpayodadhighṛtena ca \|*  
*madhunā sitakhaṇḍena brāhmaṇāyopapādayet \|\| 31 \|\|*

*manorathānpūrayasva saṃpūrṇānpūrṇimā hyasi \|*  
*pañcakumbhapradānena bhūtānāṃ tuṣṭirastu me \|*  
*dvijānevaṃ namaskṛtya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt \|\| 32 \|\|*

*etatpaṃcaghaṭaṃ nāma vrataṃ puṣṭipradāyakam \|*  
*varjayedyastu puṣpāṇi hemaṃtaśiśirāvratam \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. Similarly, on the full moon day, taking one meal a day, the image of the goddess Purnima should be made of the sandal wood. Then the pitchers filled with milk, curd, ghi, honey, etc. besides the raw sugar should be given to the Brahmanas with respect. Then he should beg forgiveness saying – “With the donation of these five pitchers, the living beings get satisfied and I should also get satisfied similarly.” By thus offering salutation to the Brahmanas and by so doing, all his efforts get successful. This vrata bestows development and is known by the name of Pancaghata vrata. During the months of cold and autumn seasons, offering of flowers should be discarded.

## \|\| 3.121.34-35 \|\|

*puṣpatrayaṃ ca phālgunyāṃ kṛtvā śaktyātha kāñcanam \|*  
*dadyādvai kālavelāyāṃ prīyetāṃ śivakeśavau \|\| 34 \|\|*

*śiraḥsaugandhajananaṃ sadānandakaraṃ nṛṇām \|*  
*kṛtvā parapadaṃ yāti saugandhyavratamuttamam \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. On the foil moon day of the month of Phalguna, a gold image with three flowers should be made and during the evening time, one should present the same to a Brahmana, saying – “Let Śiva and Kesava be pleased.” With the performing of this vrata, the head of a person achieves fragrance from Śiva, besides being blissful. Besides that, the performer achieves the best of the lokas. This is called the Saugandha vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.36-37 \|\|

*phālgunāditṛtīyāyāṃ lavaṇaṃ yastu varjayet \|*  
*samāpte śayanaṃ dayādgṛhe copaskarānvitam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya vipramithunaṃ bhavānī prīyatāmiti \|*  
*gaurīloke vasetkalpaṃ saubhāgyavratamutta mam \|\| 37 \|\|*

36-37. On the third moon day at the start of the month of Phalguna, the consuming of the salt should be discarded. A Brahmana couple should then be adored, a well arranged bed should be given over to a Brahmana and while so doing, he should say – “Let the goddess Bhavani be pleased.” The one who performs this Saubhagya vrata, he earns his stay in the place of Gauri for a kalpa.

## \|\| 3.121.38-39 \|\|

*saṃdhyāmaunaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā samāpte ghṛtakuṃbhadaḥ \|*  
*vastrayugmaṃ ca ghaṃṭāṃ ca brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 38 \|\|*

*sārasvataṃ padaṃ yāti punarāvṛtti durlabham \|*  
*etatsārasvataṃ nāma rūpavidyāpradāyakam \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Maintaining silence during the evening, at the time of conclusion, a pitcher filled with ghi, two garments and a bell should be given to a Brahmana, by which one achieves the position of a Sarasvata reaching which one does not have to return. Because this vrata bestows the beauty and the learnings, it is called as Sarasvata vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.40 \|\|

*lakṣmīmadhye'tha pañcamyāmupavāsī bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*samāpte hemakamalaṃ dadyāddhenusamanvitam \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. On the fifth moon day, one should observe fast and should worship Laksmi during the night. At the conclusion of the vrata, a gold image of Laksmi together with a cow should be given over in charity.

## \|\| 3.121.41 \|\|

*sa vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yāti lakṣmīḥ syājjanmajanmani \|*  
*etallakṣmīvrataṃ nāma duḥkhaśokavināśanam \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. One who does so, he achieves the place of Viṣṇu. During each one of the birth of the performer, Laksmi always stays with him. This vrata is called Laksmi vrata, because it removes grief and misery.

## \|\| 3.121.42 \|\|

*yā tu nārī pibettoyaṃ jaladhārāṃ prapātayet \|*  
*samāptaghṛtasaṃpūrṇāṃ dadyādvadvaṃtikāṃ navām \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. Consuming water as well as pouring the water at the time of the conclusion of the vrata, a new vase filled with ghi should be given to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.121.43 \|\|

*etaddhārāvrataṃ nāma sarvarogaharaṃ param \|*  
*kāṃtisaubhāgyajananaṃ sapatnīdarpanāśanam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. This vrata is known as Sarvarogaharam vrata. It removes all the ailments and the performing lady gains lustre and fortunes. Besides the pride of her co-wife is shattered.

## \|\| 3.121.44-46 \|\|

*gaurīsamanvitaṃ rudraṃ lakṣmyā saha janārdanam \|*  
*rājñīsamanvitaṃ sūryaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi \|\| 44 \|\|*

*dhūpākṣepeṇasahitāṃ sughaṃṭāṃ pātrasaṃyutām \|*  
*yo dadāti dvijendrāṇāṃ puṣpairabhyarcya pāṃḍuraiḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāsahitāṃ kṛtvā praṇamya ca visarjayet \|*  
*etaddevavrataṃ nāma divyadehapradāyakam \|\| 46 \|\|*

44-46. О son of Pandu, one should appropriately worship Gauri with Śiva, Laksmi with Janardana, besides Rajni with the Sungod, and then he should adore a Brahmana offering a bell and the yellow flowers with daksina, and then should send him off, offering salutation to him. This vrata is called the Divyadeha-pradayaka vrata which provides with the divine body.

## \|\| 3.121.47-48 \|\|

*kṛtvopalepanaṃ śaṃbhoragrataḥ keśavasya ca \|*  
*yāvadvrataṃ samāpyaitaddhenuṃ ca sajalānvitām \|\| 47 \|\|*

*janmāyutaṃ sa rājā syāttataḥ śivapuraṃ vaset \|*  
*etacchrutvā vrataṃ nāma bahukalyāṇakārakam \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. Then offering paste to Śiva and Kesava (Viṣṇu) at the time of the conclusion of the vrata, the cow should be given in charity with water. One who does so, he becomes a king for ten crores of years and after his death, he attains the place of Śiva. Therefore, this vrata is known by the name of Bahukalyanakaraka vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.49-51 \|\|

*aśvatthaṃ bhāskaraṃ gaṃgāṃ praṇamyaiva ca vāgyataḥ \|*  
*ekabhuktaṃ naraḥ kuryādaṣṭa caikaṃ vimatsaraḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*vratāṃte vipramithunaṃ pūjya dhenutrayānvitam \|*  
*vṛkṣaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ dadyātsośvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|\| 50 \|\|*

*divi divyavimānasthaḥ sevyate'psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ \|*  
*etatkīrtivrataṃ nāma bhūtikīrtiphalapradam \|\| 51 \|\|*

49-51. The pipala tree, the Sun and Ganga should be adored at the conclusion of the vrata, keeping silence. Then, at the end of the vrata, the performer should adore a Brahmana couple and donate three cows with gold, and one who does so, he earns the merit of performing an Asvamedha sacrifice. Ultimately, boarding a divine plane, he is served by the Apsaras. This vrata, which bestows grace and riches, is known as Kirti vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.52-54 \|\|

*ghṛtena snapanaṃ kṛtvā śaṃbhorvā keśavasya ca \|*  
*brāhmaṇo bhāskarasyāpi gauryā laṃbodarasya vā \|\| 52 \|\|*

*akṣataistu samaṃ kuryātpadmaṃ gomayamaṇḍale \|*  
*samāpya hemakamalaṃ tiladhenusamanvitam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*śuddhamaṣṭāṅgulaṃ dayācchivaloke mahīyate \|*  
*sāmagāyanataścaitatsāmavratamihocyate \|\| 54 \|\|*

52-54. The ground should be plastered with cow dung in a circular manner and the beautiful images of Śiva, Viṣṇu, Brahma, Surya, Gauri and Ganesh should be lodged. A beautiful lotus should be drawn over that circular space. Bathing the images with ghi along with sesamum seeds, when a lotus of gold is offered, one achieves stay in Śivaloka. The reciters of the Samaveda call it as Sama-vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.55-56 \|\|

*navamyāmekabhuktaṃ tu kṛtvā kanyāśca śaktitaḥ \|*  
*bhojayitvā samādadyāddhaimakaṃcukavāsasī \|\| 55 \|\|*

*haimaṃ ca siṃhaṃ viprāya dattvā śivapuraṃ vrajet \|*  
*bhavārbudaṃ surūpaśca śatrubhiścāparājitaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

55-56. Taking food once on the day of Navami, a girl should be served with the food as per one’s means. She should be offered a sari besides an image decorated with gold on the conclusion of the vrata. The image of a lion should be made in gold and should be given over to a Brahmana. One who does so, he achieves the place in the abode of Śiva. He remains comfortable for ten crores of births and shall be invincible by the enemies.

## \|\| 3.121.57-59 \|\|

*etadvīravrataṃ nāma nārīṇāṃ ca sukhapradam \|*  
*yāvatsamārabhedyastu pañcadaśyāṃ payovrataḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*samāpte śraddhayā dayadgāśca pañca payasvinīḥ \|*  
*vāsāṃsi ca piśaṃgāni jalakuṃbhayutāni ca \|\| 58 \|\|*

*sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tārayecchatam \|*  
*kalpāṃte rājarājaḥ syātpitṛvratamidaṃ smṛtam \|\| 59 \|\|*

57-59. This is called as Vira-vrata and makes the ladies especially comfortable. On the full moon day when one starts the vrata and at the conclusion of the same, if he gives away with devotion a cow, the yellow lower garment, a pitcher filled with water of five sacred rivers, then he leads hundreds of his manes to the heaven and himself becomes an emperor at the end of the kalpa. This is called Pitṛ-vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.60-62 \|\|

*tāṃbūlaṃ samaye nityaṃ gaurīputraṃ dadāti yā \|*  
*pūgacūrṇasamāyuktaṃ nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā \|\| 60 \|\|*

*varṣasyāṃte tu sauvarṇaṃ kārayitvā phalānvitam \|*  
*muktāphalamayaṃ cūrṇatritayaṃ yā prayacchati \|\| 61 \|\|*

*na sā prāpnoti daurbhāgyaṃ na daurgandhyaṃ mukhasya ca \|*  
*etatpatravrataṃ nāma saugandhyajananaṃ param \|\| 62 \|\|*

60-62. Offering a betel leaf to Ganesa daily on the third moon day, at the end o f a year, a gold betel leaf decorated with the dust of gems should be offered to Ganesa. A person who does so, he has never to face misfortune in his life, nor does develop any bad odour in his mouth. A man or a woman who does so, never faces misfortune. This is called the Patra vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.63-65 \|\|

*caitrādicaturo māsāñjalaṃ kuryādayācitam \|*  
*jyeṣṭhāṣāḍhe ca vā māsaṃ pakṣaṃ vā pāṃḍunaṃdana \|\| 63 \|\|*

*vratāṃte maṇikaṃ dadyādannavastrasamanvitam \|*  
*ghṛtena sahitaṃ tadvatsaptadhānyasamanvitam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*tilapātraṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca brahmaloke mahīyate \|*  
*kalpāṃte rājarājaḥ syādvārivratamihocyate \|\| 65 \|\|*

63-65. О son of Pandu, during the month of Caitra, one who arranges for the free supply of water to the people, continue it during the months of Jyestha and Asadha, and at the end of the vrata if he gives away in charity the food, costumes, a pitcher filled with water, besides ghi, sesamum seeds, seven grains, together with gold to a Brahmana, he is worshipped in Brahmaloka. At the end of the kalpa, he becomes an emperor or the king of kings. This vrata is known as Vari vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.66-67 \|\|

*pañcāmṛtena snapanaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇoḥ śivasya ca \|*  
*vatsarāṃte punardadyāddhenuṃ pañcāmṛtairyutām \|\| 66 \|\|*

*viprāya kanakaṃ śaṃkhaṃ sa padaṃ yāti śāṃkaram \|*  
*rājā bhavati kalpāṃte vṛttivratamihocyate \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. Śiva and Viṣṇu should be bathed with pancamrita and at the end of the year, a cow with pancamrita and a conch of gold should be given over to a Brahmana. By doing so, one achieves the place of Śiva and at the end of the kalpa, be becomes a king. Therefore, it is called the Vrtti vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.68-69 \|\|

*yo hiṃsāṃ varjayitvā tu māsaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ tathā \|*  
*vratāṃte hemahariṇaṃ kṛtvā śaktyā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*tadvatsavatsāṃ gāṃ dadyātso'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*ahiṃsāvratamityetatsarvaśāṃtipradaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. While performing a vrata, violence should be discarded and at the end of a month or a year, a deer made in gold, as per one’s means, besides a cow with calf, if given in charity to a learned person, then the performer achieves the merit of performing an Ashvamedha sacrifice. For bestowing peace on the people, this is known as Ahimsa vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.70-71 \|\|

*māghamāsyuṣasi snānaṃ kṛtvā dāṃpatyamarcayet \|*  
*bhojayitvā yathāśaktyā mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti śarīrārogyamuttamam \|*  
*sūryaloke vasetkalpaṃ sūryavratamidaṃ smṛtam \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. During the month of Magha and at the time of the sunrise, one should take bath and then adore a Brahmana couple offering food, garland, costumes and the ornaments as per one’s means. By doing so, one achieves great, fortunes, besides the excellent health. Finally, such a person settles in the Suryaloka, this is called the Surya vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.72-73 \|\|

*āṣāḍhādicaturmāsaṃ prātaḥsnāyī bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*viprāya bhojanaṃ dadyātkārtikyāṃ goprado bhavet \|\| 72 \|\|*

*ghṛtakuṃbhaṃ tato dattvā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt \|*  
*vaiṣṇavavratamityuktaṃ viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 73 \|\|*

72-73. During the Caturmasa in the month of Asadha, one should take bath in the early morning and should then adore a Brahmana offering food, cow and a pitcher filled with ghi. By doing so, all the wishes of the performer are fulfilled. Finally, such a person settles in the Viṣṇuloka, this is called the Vaiṣṇava vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.74-75 \|\|

*ayanādayanaṃ yāvadvarjayenmadhusarpiṣī \|*  
*tadaṃte puṇyadānāni ghṛtadhenvā sahaiva tu \|\| 74 \|\|*

*dattvā śivapadaṃ yāti dattvā tu ghṛtapāyasam \|*  
*etacchīlavrataṃ nāma śīlārogyaphalapradam \|\| 75 \|\|*

74-75. During the time of Ayanas, one should avoid drinking of wine and should give away in charity a cow along with ghi. By offering of payasam mixed with ghi, a person achieves the Sivaloka, and this vrata is called as the Sila vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.76-77 \|\|
