*saṃdhyādīpaprado yastu māṃsaṃ tailaṃ vivarjayet \|*  
*samāpte dīpakaṃ dadyāccakraśūle ca kāñcane \|\| 76 \|\|*

*vastrayugmaṃ ca viprāya sa tejasvī bhaveddṛḍham \|*  
*etaddīpavrataṃ nāma sadā kāṃtipradāyakam \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. During the time of Sandhya, one should avoid eating of meat and oil, and should give away a lamp, a discuss and sula of gold along with a couple of clothes to a Brahmana. By doing so, he becomes splendid and firm-minded. This vrata is the bestower of luminance and is called as the Dipa vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.78-80 \|\|

*ekabhaktena saptāhaṃ gaurīṃ vā yastu pūjayet \|*  
*saṃpūjya pārvatīṃ bhaktyā gandhapuṣpavilepanaiḥ \|\| 78 \|\|*

*tataḥ suvāsinībhyāṃ tu kuṃkumena vilepayet \|*  
*puṣpairvilepayeccaināṃ karpūrāgarucandanaiḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*tāṃbūlaṃ śobhanaṃ dattvā nārikelaphalaṃ tathā \|*  
*prīyatāṃ kumudā devī praṇipatya visarjayet \|\| 80 \|\|*

78-80. For a week, the devotee should worship the goddess Gauri with the offering of incense, flowers and paste. Then, vermilion should be applied over the image of goddess Parvati and she should be adored with flowers, sandal paste, camphor and agaru. The performer should end his vrata with the giving away of the image of the goddess to a Brahmana along with betel leaves and coconut.

## \|\| 3.121.81-84 \|\|

*ekaikāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ saptāhaṃ yāvadeva tu \|*  
*punastu saptame pūrṇe tāḥ saptaiva nimaṃtrayet \|\| 81 \|\|*

*ṣaḍrasaṃ bhojayitvā tu yathāśaktyā vibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*bhūṣayitvā mālyavastraiḥ karṇaveṣṭāṃgulīyakaiḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

*kumudā mādhavī gaurī bhavānī pārvatī umā \|*  
*kālī ca darpaṇaṃ haste pratyekaṃ vinivedayet \|\| 83 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇaṃ pṛjayitvaikaṃ vācyaḥ saṃpamannamastu te \|*  
*saptasundarakaṃ nāma vrataṃ caitadyudhiṣṭhira \|\| 84 \|\|*

81-84. In a week, each one of the goddesses like Kumuda, Madhavi, Gauri, Bhavani, Parvati, Uma and Kali should be worshipped, offering to each one of them a mirror in her hand. All the seven of them should be invoked and each one of them should be given sixteen types of dishes of food, ornaments as per one’s means, costumes, earrings and finger-rings. Then a Brahmana should be adored with a prayer – “You kindly make my vrata to get completed. I am offering my salutation to you.” О Yudhisthira, this is known as Sapta Sundaraka vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.85-88 \|\|

*karoti sundaraṃ dehaṃ saubhāgyaṃ yacchate param \|*  
*varjayeccaiva māse tu yastu gandhānulepanam \|\| 85 \|\|*

*śuktiṃ gaṃdhabhṛtāṃ dattvā viprāya sitavāsasī \|*  
*śaktyā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsarvānkāmānsamaśnute \|\| 86 \|\|*

*vāruṇaṃ ca padaṃ yāti tadetadvaruṇavratam \|*  
*vaiśākhamāse lavaṇaṃ varjayitvā yatavrataḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

*māsāṃte'tha tato dadyātsavatsāṃ gāṃ dvijātaye \|*  
*sthitvā viṣṇupade kalpaṃ tato rājā bhavediha \|\| 88 \|\|*

85-88. When this is vrata completed by a person, he gets an excellent body and excellent fortunes. During the month of Caitra, discarding the use of fragrant paste, a conch shell with fragrance, two white costumes, besides daksina as per one’s means when given in charity to a Brahmana, all the desires of the donor get fulfilled and he achieves the position of Varuna. Therefore, this is called as Varuna-vrata. A person, who controlling all his sense organs, discards the taking of salt, and at the end of the month gives away in charity a cow with a calf to a Brahmana, he lives in Viṣṇuloka for a kalpa, after which he becomes a king.

## \|\| 3.121.89-92 \|\|

*etatkāṃtivrataṃ nāma kāṃtikīrtipradāyakam \|*  
*brahmāṇḍaṃ kāṃcanaṃ kṛtvā tiladroṇopari sthitam \|\| 89 \|\|*

*tryahaṃ tilavratī bhūtvā vahniṃ saṃtarpayeddvijam \|*  
*saṃpūjya vipradāṃpatyaṃ mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

*śaktitastripalādūrdhvaṃ viśvātmā prīyatāmiti \|*  
*puṇye'hni dadyātsa paraṃ brahma yātyapunarbhavam \|\| 91 \|\|*

*etadbrahmavrataṃ nāma nirvāṇaphaladaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 92 \|\|*

89-92. Since this vrata bestows lustre and glory, it is called Kanti vrata. A figure of globe should be placed over the heap of sesamum seeds weighing a drona, after which it should be adored. Thereafter, oblations may be made in the fire and a Brahmana should be served with food. Then, a Brahmana couple should be worshipped and as per one’s means, the couple should be given three gems with gold and while so doing, the donor should say – “Let the soul of the universe be pleased.” Thus, in case this vrata gets completed on an auspicious day, one achieves Brahman, as a result of which one does not have to be reborn and a person achieves complete liberation. It is therefore called as Brahma-vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.93-95 \|\|

*yaścobhayamukhīṃ dadyātprabhūtakanakānvitām \|*  
*dinaṃ payovrataṃ tiṣṭhetsa yāti paramaṃ padam \|\| 93 \|\|*

*tryahaṃ payovrataḥ sthitvā kāñcanaṃ kalpapādapam \|*  
*palādūrdhvaṃ yathā śaktyā taṃḍulaṃ rūpasaṃyutam \|\| 94 \|\|*

*chāditaṃ varavāsobhiḥ puṣpamālāvibhūṣitam \|*  
*dattvā svarge vasetkalpaṃ kalpavratamidaṃ smṛtam \|\| 95 \|\|*

93-95. By giving away in charity a two-faced gold image and by taking only the liquid diet during the day time, and on the fourth day by giving away a kalpavriksha made of gold as per one’s means with leaves of the size of rice grain, besides decorated with excellent garland of flowers, one attains stay in the heaven for a kalpa.

## \|\| 3.121.96-98 \|\|

*yastu vatsatarīṃ bhavyāṃ kaṇṭhābharaṇabhūṣitām \|*  
*suparyāṇāṃ sukhaspṛṣṭāṃ khalīnālaṃkṛtā nanām \|\| 96 \|\|*

*modakodakapātreṇa tāṃbūlena samanvitām \|*  
*sthagitāṃ sthāpayetpṛṣṭhe śṛṃgāgreṣu himānvitām \|\| 97 \|\|*

*īdṛgvidhāṃ vyatīpāte grahaṇe cāyanadvaye \|*  
*ayācitena ca sthitvā tato dadyāddvijātaye \|\| 98 \|\|*

96-98. Thereafter, a small calf which should be beautiful one, well decorated with neck ornaments, covering its back with beautiful cloth, binding a rope like the rein of a horse, whose hoofs and horns should be decorated with silver, together with the betel leaves, should be given in charity during the Vyatipata yoga, eclipse and end of six months to a Brahmana who does not ask for them.

## \|\| 3.121.99-100 \|\|

*etadvāravrataṃ nāma mārgakhedavināśanam \|*  
*paralokārddhagamane klāṃtiśramaharaṃ param \|\| 99 \|\|*

*naktāśī tvaṣṭamīṣu syādvatsarāṃte'ṣṭagopradaḥ \|*  
*pauraṃdaraṃ padaṃ yāti sugativratamucyate \|\| 100 \|\|*

99-100. This vrata is known as Dvara-vrata, because it relieves one of the fatigue of the journey. The efforts one has to make for covering half the journey to the heaven and the fatigue one has to face, this vrata relieves him of the same. On the day of each eighth day of the moon, taking food during the night, at the end of every year, if eight cows are given in charity, one achieves the position of Indra. Therefore, it is called as Sugati vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.101-102 \|\|

*yaścendhanaprado rājanhemaṃtaśiśira vratam \|*  
*ghṛtadhenuṃ prayaccheta paraṃ brahma sa gacchati \|\| 101 \|\|*

*śarīrārogyajananaṃ dyutikāṃtipradāyakam \|*  
*vaiśvānaravrataṃ nāma sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 102 \|\|*

101-102. During the winter season, one who gives away the wood in charity, besides a cow made in ghi, he achieves Brahman. Since this vrata makes the body free of ailments, grants everlasting glory and removes all the sins, it is called Vasvanara vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.103-104 \|\|

*ekādaśyāṃ tu naktāśī yaścakraṃ vinivedayet \|*  
*tadvacchaṃkhaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ caitre citrāsu pāṃḍava \|\| 103 \|\|*

*ya etatkurute bhaktyā sa viṣṇoḥ padamāpnuyāt \|*  
*etadviṣṇuvrataṃ nāma kalpādau rājyalābhakṛt \|\| 104 \|\|*

103-104. О Pandava, on the eleventh moon day of the month of Caitra, a person who takes food at night and gives away a gold wheel on the full moon day during the Citra constellation besides a conch made of gold, with devotion, he achieves the place of Viṣṇu. Therefore, it is called as Viṣṇu vrata. It makes a person to gain kingship at the end of the kalpa.

## \|\| 3.121.105 \|\|

*payovratastu pañcamyāṃ vratāṃte goyugapradaḥ \|*  
*lakṣmīloke vasetkalpametaddevīvrataṃ smṛtam \|\| 105 \|\|*

105\. On the fifth day of the moon, consuming milk alone at the end of the vrata, when two cows are given away in charity, one earns stay in the place of Laksmi for a kalpa. Therefore, it is called Devi-vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.106 \|\|

*saptamyāṃ naktabhugdadyātsamāpte gāṃ payasvinīm \|*  
*so'rkalokamavāpnoti bhānuvratamihocyate \|\| 106 \|\|*

106\. While taking food at night on the seventh moon day and at the end of the vrata in case a cow is given in charity, one achieves the abode of the Sun. It is therefore called Bhanu vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.107 \|\|

*caturthyāṃ naktabhugdadyādaṣṭa gā homacāraṇam \|*  
*vrataṃ vaināyakaṃ nāma sarvavighnavināśanam \|\| 107 \|\|*

107\. On the fourth day of the moon, while taking food at night and at the conclusion of the vrata, if a person gives away eight cows in charity, performing homa at the same time, he gets all his obstructions removed. It is therefore called Vainayaka vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.108-109 \|\|

*mahāphalāni yastyaktvā cāturmāsaṃ dvijātaye \|*  
*haimāni kārttike dadyādgoyugena samaṃ naraḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

*sitaṃ vastrayugaṃ nāma saṃpūrṇādyaghaṭāni ca \|*  
*etatphalavrataṃ nāma phalāvāptikaraṃ sadā \|\| 109 \|\|*

108-109. While discarding taking of the prominent fruits during the four months, on the full moon day of Kartika one who gives away in charity two cows, gold, four fruit items, white garments and a pitcher filled with water, he earns excellent rewards. Therefore, it is called as the Phala vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.110-111 \|\|

*yaścopavāsī saptamyāṃ samāṃte hemapaṅkajam \|*  
*dhenūśca śaktito dadyātsavatsāḥ kāṃsyadohanāḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

*bhaktyā rājendra viprāya vācakāya nivedayet \|*  
*etatsauravrataṃ nāma sūryalokapradāyakam \|\| 111 \|\|*

110-111. О Rajendra, on the seventh day of the moon, if a person fasts with devotion and then concludes the vrata giving away in charity a gold lotus, a cow with calf and a milk pot of bronze to a Brahmana who recites scriptures, as per one’s means, he achieves stay in the solar region. This is called the Saura vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.112-113 \|\|

*dvādaśa dvādaśīryastu nāma prāśanasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*samupoṣya samāṃte tu savastrāḥ sodakā ghaṭāḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

*dvādaśātra pradeyāśca sarvakāmaprasiddhaye \|*  
*govindavratamityetadgovindapadadāyakam \|\| 113 \|\|*

112-113. Observing the fast on each day of dvadasi, at tile end of the year, if twelve pitchers filled with water are given by a person, all his desires get fulfilled. Since this vrata makes a person to achieve a place in the abode of Govinda, it is known as Govlnda vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.114 \|\|

*kārttikyāṃ yo vṛṣotsargaṃ kṛtvā naktaṃ samācaret \|*  
*sa golokamavāpnoti vṛṣavratamidaṃ smṛtam \|\| 114 \|\|*

114\. On the full moon day of the month of Kartika, performing the Vrsotsarga vrata (setting the bull free) and taking the food at night, one achieves Goloka. Therefore, it is called Vrsa vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.115 \|\|

*vratāṃte gauḥ pradātavyā bhojanaṃ śaktitaḥ param \|*  
*viprāṇāmatra kathitaṃ prājāpatyamidaṃ vratam \|\| 115 \|\|*

115\. While giving food to a Brahmana as per one’s means, while concluding the vrata, a cow should be given in charity. This is called Pradjapatya vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.116 \|\|

*caturdaśyāṃ tu naktāśī samāṃte goyugapradaḥ \|*  
*śaivaṃ padamavāpnoti jñeyaṃ ca tryaṃbakavratam \|\| 116 \|\|*

116\. On the fourteenth moon day, taking food during the night and at the end of the month, four cows should be given in charity, whereby one earns the place of Siva. Therefore, it is called the Trayambaka vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.117-118 \|\|

*saptarātroṣito dadyādghṛtakuṃbhaṃ dvijātaye \|*  
*brahmavratamidaṃ prāhurbrahmalokapradāyakam \|\| 117 \|\|*

*māsāṃte ca sa gāṃ dadyāddhenumaṃte payasvinīm \|*  
*śakraloke vasetkalpaṃ śakravratamidaṃ smṛtam \|\| 118 \|\|*

117-118. After fasting for seven nights, when a pitcher filled with ghi is given over to a Brahmana, the donor achieves Brahmaloka. Thus performing similar charities for a year and at the end of the year, if a cow is given away in charity, the donor lives in the abode of Indra for a kalpa. Therefore, it is called Sakra vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.119-126 \|\|

*kārttikasya site pakṣe caturdaśyāṃ narādhipa \|*  
*sopavāsaḥ pañcagavyaṃ pibedrātrau vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 119 \|\|*

*kapilāyāstu gomūtraṃ kṛṣṇāyā gomayaṃ tathā \|*  
*sitadhenvāstathā kṣīraṃ raktāyāstu tathā dadhi \|\| 120 \|\|*

*gṛhītvā karburāyāstu ghṛtamekatra melayet \|*  
*vedoktamantrai rājendra kuśodakasamanvitam \|\| 121 \|\|*

*tataḥ prabhātasamaye snātvā saṃtarpya devatāḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇānvācayitvā tu bhuñjīyādvāgyataḥ śuciḥ \|\| 122 \|\|*

*brahmakūrcavrataṃ hyetatsarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|*  
*yadbālye yacca kaumāre vārdhakye cāpi yatkṛtam \|*  
*brahmakūrcopavāsena tatsarvaṃ naśyati kṣaṇāt \|\| 123 \|\|*

*anagnipakvamaśnāti tṛtīyāyāṃ tu yo naraḥ \|*  
*gāṃ dattvā śivamabhyeti punarāvṛttivarjitam \|\| 124 \|\|*

*etaddṛṣivrataṃ nāma sarvamāṅgalyakārakam \|*  
*haimaṃ paladvayādūrdhvaṃ rathamaśvayugānvitam \|\| 125 \|\|*

*tilaprasthopari gataṃ sitamālyayugānvitam \|*  
*dattvā kṛtopavāsastu divi kalpaśataṃ vaset \|*  
*tadaṃte rājarājaḥ syādagnivratamidaṃ smṛtam \|\| 126 \|\|*

119-126. О foremost of the humans, on the dark fourteenth moon day of the month of Kartika, a person, while fasting during the day, should break his fest by consuming pancagayya in which the urine o f a white spotted cow, the cowdung of a black cow, the milk of white cow, the curd of red coloured cow and the ghi of a spotted cow should be added, along with the kusa water to it. Then recalling all the sins committed during the infancy, childhood, boyhood, youthful age and old age, at the time of the conclusion of the vrata, a cow should be given in charity. A person who does so, earns the place of Siva, while reaching there one does not have to be reborn. Since this vrata bestows all the welfare, therefore it is called Ṛṣi vrata. While performing the vrata, a chariot with a horse should be made in gold weighing more than two palas (a pala is the ancient time weight of four karsas). It should be placed over a tandula (950 grams) of sesamum seeds and then worshipped. The chariot should have the yoke of white flower garlands. A person who donates such a chariot, enjoys stay in the heaven for a hundred kalpas and ultimately achieves the position of an emperor. This vrata is known as Agni vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.127-128 \|\|

*kṛtvā paladvayādūrdhvaṃ śayyābhyāṃ saṃyutaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*haimaṃ rathavaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutam \|\| 127 \|\|*

*satyaloke vasetkalpaṃ sahasramatha bhūpatiḥ \|*  
*bhavedupoṣito dattvā karivratamidaṃ śubham \|\| 128 \|\|*

127-128. Then observing fast, a chariot weighing more than two palas should be made with all the equipments, besides a beautiful bed which should be given in charity and one who does so, he remains in the Satyaloka for a thousand kalpas and after this period, he becomes a king. This is known as Kari -vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.129 \|\|

*mukhavāsaṃ parityajya samāṃte goprado bhavet \|*  
*yakṣādhipaṃ samāpnoti sumukha vratamucyate \|\| 129 \|\|*

129\. Then discarding the chewing of a betel and at the end of a year in case a cow is given in charity one becomes the lord of the Yaksas. This is known as Sumukha vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.130 \|\|

*niśi kṛtvā jale vāsaṃ prabhāte goprado bhavet \|*  
*ruṇaṃ lokamāpnoti varuṇavratamucyate \|\| 130 \|\|*

130\. Spending the night in water and giving away a cow in charity in the morning, one achieves the place of Varuna. The corresponding vrata is known as Varuna vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.131 \|\|

*cāndrāyaṇaṃ ca yaḥ kuryāddhaimaṃ candraṃ nivedayet \|*  
*candravratamidaṃ proktaṃ candralokapradāyakam \|\| 131 \|\|*

131\. After performing the Cdndrayaria vrata, one achieves Candraloka or the place of the Moon. Therefore, this is known as Candra vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.132 \|\|

*jyeṣṭhe pañcatapāḥ sāyaṃ hemadhenuprado divam \|*  
*athāṣṭamīcaturdaśyau rudravratamidaṃ smṛtam \|\| 132 \|\|*

132\. On the eight and fourteenth days of the moon in the month of Jyestha, one should surround himself with five types of fires and during the evening, the golden cow should be given in charity. This is called Rudra vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.133 \|\|

*anulepanaṃ yaḥ kuryāttṛtīyāyāṃ śivālaye \|*  
*sa svargaṃ dhenudo yāti bhavānī vratamucyate \|\| 133 \|\|*

133\. While applying sandal paste over the Sivalinga in a temple on the third moon day, a cow should be given in charity on the conclusion of the vrata and one who does so, he enjoys peace in the heaven. This is known as the Bhavani vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.134 \|\|

*māghe niśyārdravāsāḥ syātsaptamyāṃ goprado bhaveta \|*  
*divi kalpaṃ vasitveha rājā syāttāpanaṃ vratam \|\| 134 \|\|*

134\. On the night falling on the seventh moon day of the month of Magha, one should clad himself in wet clothes. After thus spending the night, one earns stay in the heaven for a kalpa. After rebirth, one becomes a king. This is known as the Тaрапа vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.135 \|\|

*dattvā kṛtopavāsastu divi kalpaśataṃ vaset \|*  
*tadaṃte rājarājaḥ syādaśvavratamidaṃ smṛtam \|\| 135 \|\|*

135\. When a person gives away a horse in charity, he earns his stay in the heaven for a hundred kalpas, after which he becomes a king. This is called the Asva vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.136-139 \|\|

*tadvatkalpadvayādūrdhvaṃ karibhyāṃ saṃyutaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*haimaṃ rathaṃ naraśreṣṭha sarvopaskaraṇānvitam \|\| 136 \|\|*

*trirātropoṣito dadyātphālgunyāṃ bhavanaṃ śubham \|*  
*ādityalokamāpnoti pūjitaḥ sa surāsuraiḥ \|\| 137 \|\|*

*suralokamavāpnoti dhāma vratasamanvitam \|*  
*trisaṃdhyaṃ pūjya dāṃpatyamupavāsī vibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 138 \|\|*

*paurṇamāsyāmavāpnoti mokṣaminduvratādiha \|\| 139 \|\|*

136-139. О best of the humans, similarly, a person who gives away a chariot driven by two elephants equipped with all the requirements, then fasts for three nights continuously on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna, and then donates a beautiful house with the aforesaid chariot, he earns the stay in the Suryaloka. Then after having been adored by the Asuras as well as the Gods, he reaches the heaven. This is known as the Dhama vrata. Observing fast on the full moon day if a Brahmana couple is adored at three times, the performer achieves liberation or moksa. This is therefore called as Indu vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.140-141 \|\|

*dattvā sitadvitīyāyāmiṃdorlavaṇabhojanam \|*  
*kāṃsyaṃ savastraṃ rājendra dakṣiṇāsahitaṃ tathā \|\| 140 \|\|*

*samāṃte goprado yāti viprāya śivamaṃdiram \|*  
*kalpāṃte rājarājaḥ syātsomavratamidaṃ smṛtam \|\| 141 \|\|*

140-141. О Rajendra, on the dark second moon day, when the saltish food placed in the bronze vases together with the daksina are given away to a Brahmana at the end of the year along with a cow, one achieves the place of Siva. Again at the end of kalpa, he becomes the king of kings. This is called the Soma vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.142 \|\|

*pratipadyekabhaktāśī samāṃte kapilāpradaḥ \|*  
*vaiśvānarapuraṃ yāti āgneyavratamucyate \|\| 142 \|\|*

142\. Taking food once a day on the first day of the moon and at the end of the month by giving a tawny-coloured cow in charity, one earns his stay in the Agniloka. This is therefore called the Agneya vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.143-145 \|\|

*ekādaśyāṃ māghamāse caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca \|*  
*ekabhaktena yo dadyādbālakānyajināni ca \|\| 143 \|\|*

*upānahau kaṃbalāṃśca caitre chatrādikaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*karapatrādikaṃ cāpi yathā śaktyā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 144 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇānāṃ mahārāja so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*etatsaukhyavrataṃ nāma sarvasaukhyapradāyakam \|\| 145 \|\|*

143-145. О King, on the eleventh, eighth and fourteenth moon days of the month of Magha, a person, after having a single meal in a day, when gives vermilion, deer skin, shoes and a blanket to a Brahmana, besides during the month of Caitra when one gives an umbrella, water vase etc. to a Brahmana with respect, he earns the merit of performing the Asvamedha sacrifice. Since this vrata bestows all the comforts and the pleasures, it is known as Saukhya vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.146-147 \|\|

*daśamyāmekabhaktāśī samāṃte daśadhenudaḥ \|*  
*diśaśca kāñcanīrdadyānnārīrūpā yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 146 \|\|*

*tiladroṇoparigato brahmāṃḍādhipatirbhavet \|*  
*etadviśvavrataṃ nāma mahāpātakanāśanam \|\| 147 \|\|*

146-147. О Yudhisthira, on the tenth dark day of the moon, taking food once a day, ten cows and placing the images of ten directions made in gold, should be consecrated and then worshipped. A person who does so, he earns the universal position. Therefore, it has been known as the Visva vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.148-149 \|\|

*saṃpūjya sitasaptamyāṃ bhānudhānyāni sapta yaḥ \|*  
*dadāti naktabhugrājaṃllavaṇena samaṃ dvije \|\| 148 \|\|*

*sa tārayati saptāṣṭau kulānyātmānameva ca \|*  
*etaddhānyavrataṃ nāma dhanadhānyapradāyakam \|\| 149 \|\|*

148-149. О king, on the seventh dark day of the moon, after worshipping the Sungod, the seven grains should be given in charity. Taking food at night, one who performs this vrata, he redeems besides himself, fifteen generations of his race. Therefore, because of its bestowing enough of riches and the cereals, this vrata is known as the Dhanya vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.150 \|\|

*māsopavāsī yo dadyāddhenuṃ viprāya śobhanām \|*  
*sa vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yāti bhīmavratamidaṃ smṛtam \|\| 150 \|\|*

150\. After performing fast for a month, when a beautiful milk giving cow is given over to a Brahmana, one achieves the Viṣṇuloka. This is called the Bhima vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.151 \|\|

*pakṣopavāsī yo dadyādviprāya kapilādvayam \|*  
*sa brahmalokamāpnoti pūjitaḥ surasattamaiḥ \|\| 151 \|\|*

151\. After observing a fast for a fortnight, when a tawny coloured cow is given to a Brahmana, the donor is adored by the gods and finally achieves the Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 3.121.152-158 \|\|

*dadyāttriṃśatpalādūrdhvaṃ mahīṃ kṛtvā tu kāṃcanīm \|*  
*kulācalādrisahitāṃ tilavastrasamanvitām \|\| 152 \|\|*

*tiladroṇopari gatāṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine \|*  
*dinaṃ payovratastiṣṭhedrudraloke mahīyate \|\| 153 \|\|*

*etanmahīvrataṃ proktaṃ saptakalpānuvartakam \|*  
*māghamāse'tha caitre vā guḍadhenuprado bhavet \|\| 154 \|\|*

*guḍavratastṛtīyāyāṃ sarvopaskaraṇairyutaḥ \|*  
*gaurīlokamavāpnoti pūjyate'psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ \|\| 155 \|\|*

*umāvratamidaṃ proktaṃ satatānandadāyakam \|*  
*vatsaraṃ tvekabhaktāśī sabhakṣyajalakuṃbhadaḥ \|\| 156 \|\|*

*śivaloke vasetkalpaṃ prāptivratamidaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*kārttikāditṛtīyāyāṃ prāśya gomūtrayāvakam \|\| 157 \|\|*

*gaurīloke vasetkalpaṃ tato rājā bhavediha \|*  
*etadrudravrataṃ nāma mahākalyāṇakārakam \|\| 158 \|\|*

152-158. A heap of the sesamum seeds, the gold image of the earth goddess weighing over thirty palas, the Kulacala mountain, besides sesamum seeds and costumes should be given over to a Brahmana with family. During the fast, in case he takes milk during the night, the donor earns the place of Rudraloka. Since this vrata keeps on rewarding for seven kalpas, it is known as Mahi vrata. During the months of Magha and Caitra, a cow made of raw sugar should be given away in charity. On the third moon day, the Guda vrata should be completed with all the requirements and one who does so, he achieves the place of Gauri in the company of all the Apsaras. Because of the nature of the bestowing of welfare of this vrata, it is called the Uma vrata. By taking food for a year once a day and ultimately, if the eatables with the pitcher filled with water, when given in charity to a Brahmana, the donor earns his stay in Sivaloka for a kalpa. This is known as the Prapti-vrata. On the third starting moon day of the month of Kartika, by breaking the fast with the cow’s urine as well as maize, the performer reaches the place of Gauri, where he stays for a period of a kalpa and on his rebirth in due course of time, he becomes a king. This is the most beneficial vrata and is known by the name of Rudra vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.159-160 \|\|

*caitrī trirātraṃ naktāśī nadyāṃ snātvā dadāti yaḥ \|*  
*ajāḥ payasvinīḥ pañca brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine \|\| 159 \|\|*

*na jāyate punarasau jīvaloke kadācana \|*  
*etadbastavrataṃ proktaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam \|\| 160 \|\|*

159-160. During the month of Caitra, taking food only during the three consecutive nights, one should take bath in a stream and then give away in charity five female goats to a Brahmana. By doing so, the donor is never reborn in the world. Because this vrata removes all the ailments, it has been known as Vasta vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.161-162 \|\|

*kanyādānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādudvāhaṃ kārayecca yaḥ \|*  
*ekaviṃśatikulopeto brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati \|\| 161 \|\|*

*kanyādānātparaṃ dānaṃ na cāstyabhyadhikaṃ kvacit \|*  
*ye kariṣyaṃti nṛpate teṣāṃ loko'kṣayo divi \|\| 162 \|\|*

161-162. Those who perform капуadaпа as well as the marriage, they achieve Brahmaloka along with their twenty-one generations. О king, there is no other dana more meritorious than the dana of a girl or a daughter. Therefore, those who perform капуadaпа, they earn uninterrupted stay in the heaven.

## \|\| 3.121.163-165 \|\|

*tilapiṣṭamayaṃ kṛtvā gajaṃ hemavibhūṣitam \|*  
*kuryātkuśamayaṃ tadvadārohakasamanvitam \|\| 163 \|\|*

*nakṣatramālāsahitaṃ cāmarāpīḍadhāriṇam \|*  
*daśanāprabaddhanetraraktavastrayugānvitam \|\| 164 \|\|*

*tāmrapātryāṃ kuṇḍakaṃ vā kṛtaṃ dattvāgramodakam \|*  
*pradadyāddvijadāṃpatyaṃ pūjya mālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 165 \|\|*

163-165. Making an image of an elephant with the powder of sesamum seeds, then decorating the same with golden ornaments, kusa grass, garlands of constellations, flywhisk, besides the head-dress and eye, and at the top of the tusk a red cloth should be tied to it. Such an elephant should be placed in a copper vase and then worshipped. Thereafter, the sweet balls should be placed before it. A Brahmana couple should then be adored offering them the flower garlands, besides the ornaments.

## \|\| 3.121.166-167 \|\|

*kaṃṭhapramāṇamāviśya jalaṃ malavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*kāṃtārakāriṇā hyetatkathitaṃ tu yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 166 \|\|*

*kāṃtārakāridurgeṣu vārayatyapi duṣkṛtīn \|*  
*iha loke pare caiva nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 167 \|\|*

166-167. A pitcher filled with water should also be offered to the Brahmana couple, while standing. О Yudhisthira, this has been revealed by the thick forest dweller. It subjugates all the people well-versed in protecting the forts. Besides this, it makes life in the present as well as the future births more comfortable. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.121.168-169 \|\|

*ye kurvaṃti dine puṇye vrataṃ pauraṃdaraṃ narāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ pauraṃdaro loko bhavedābhūtasaṃplavam \|\| 168 \|\|*

*payovratastu pañcamyāṃ dattvā nāgaṃ dvijātaye \|*  
*sauvarṇaṃ sarpajanitaṃ bhayaṃ tebhyo na jāyate \|\| 169 \|\|*

168-169. With the performing of this vrata, the stay of a devotee becomes comfortable in the place of Indra everlasting. On the fifth moon day, the milk should be offered to the serpents and when a snake made of gold is offered in charity, one is relieved of the danger of a snake bite.

## \|\| 3.121.170-171 \|\|

*sitāṣṭamyāṃ sopavāso vṛṣabhaṃ yaḥ prayacchati \|*  
*sitavastrasamācchannaṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitam \|\| 170 \|\|*

*śivaloke vasetkalpaṃ tato rājā bhavediha \|*  
*vṛṣavratamidaṃ proktaṃ sarvadharmapradāyakam \|\| 171 \|\|*

170-171. On the eighth bright moon day, while fasting, a bull should be decorated with ornaments and covered with a cloth and given away in charity. When it is so done, the donor enjoys stay in Sivaloka for a kalpa. Thereafter, he becomes a king, because the activity in this vrata is dominated by dharma, it is called as Vrsa vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.172-173 \|\|

*uttare tvayane prāpte ghṛtaprasthena yo harim \|*  
*snāpayitvā brāhmaṇāya vaḍavāṃ yaḥ prayacchati \|\| 172 \|\|*

*sa sarvakāmasaṃyuktaḥ putrabhrātṛsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*sūryaloke vasedrājanrājñīvratamihocyate \|\| 173 \|\|*

172-173. О king, when the Sun is in Uttarayana (north pole), the image of Viṣṇu should be soaked in ghi, which should be given over to a Brahmana with a mare and one who does so, he remains delighted with his sons and brothers, has all his wishes fulfilled and finally achieves Suryaloka. It is therefore known as Rajni vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.174-175 \|\|

*sakṛnnavamyāṃ bhaktena pūjayedvindhyavāsinīm \|*  
*puṣpardhūpaistato dadyātpañjaraṃ śukaśobhitam \|\| 174 \|\|*

*haimaṃ viprāya śāṃtāya sa vāgmī jāyate naraḥ \|*  
*etadāgneyamityuktaṃ vratamagnipadapradam \|\| 175 \|\|*

174-175. Taking food once a day on the day of Navami, the goddess Vindhyavasini should be worshipped, and a cage and a parrot made of gold should be given over to a Brahmana. By doing this, the speech o f a person improves. This is called the Āgneya vrata because the person achieves Agniloka.

## \|\| 3.121.176-177 \|\|

*dvādaśyāṃ guhyakānāṃ ca palalaikṣavasaṃyutam \|*  
*viprāya bhojanaṃ dattvā yaḥ sa yāti hareḥ padam \|\| 176 \|\|*

*viṣkambhādiṣu yogeṣu ekamuktarato naraḥ \|*  
*etadāgneyamityuktaṃ vratamagnipadapradam \|\| 177 \|\|*

176-177. Those who provide meat and raw sugar to the twelve Guhyakas, besides the food to the Brahmanas, they achieve the place of Viṣṇu. On the twelfth day of Viskambha yoga, taking food once a day, one achieves the position of Agni. This is therefore called as the Āgneyā vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.178-181 \|\|

*yo dadāti kramādeṣu ghṛtatailaphalaikṣavam \|*  
*yavagodhūmacaṇakānniṣpāvāñchālitaṃḍulān \|\| 178 \|\|*

*lavaṇaṃ dadhi dugdhaṃ ca vastraṃ kanakameva ca \|*  
*kaṃbalaṃ gāṃ vṛṣaṃ chatramupānadyugalaṃ tathā \|\| 179 \|\|*

*karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva caṃdanaṃ kusumāni ca \|*  
*lohaṃ kanaka tāmraṃ ca raupyaṃ ceti yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 180 \|\|*

*snātaḥ svaśaktyā vidhivatsarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|*  
*na viyogamavāpnoti yogavratamidaṃ smṛtam \|\| 181 \|\|*

178-181. О Yudhisthira, during the time of these yogas, the ghi, oil, fruit, raw sugar, barley, wheat, grams, wild rice, salt, curd, milk, costumes, blanket, cow, bull, umbrella, shoes, camphor, vermilion, sandal paste, iron, gold, copper and silver should be given away in charity and after so doing, one should take his bath. When it is so done, all the sins are washed out and there is no separation from the near and dear ones. Therefore, it is called the Yoga vrata.

## \|\| 3.121.182-186 \|\|

*kārtikyāṃ naktabhugdadyānmeṣaṃ mārgaśire vṛṣam \|*  
*pauṣamāghādimāseṣu sauvarṇīḥ sarva eva hi \|\| 182 \|\|*

*krameṇa rāśayaḥ sarvā vastramālyairvibhūṣitāḥ \|*  
*paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ kauṃteya bahudakṣiṇām \|\| 183 \|\|*

*etadrāśivrataṃ nāma sarvopadravanāśanam \|*  
*sarvāśāpūrakaṃ tadvatsomalokapradāyakam \|\| 184 \|\|*

*pañcāśītirvratānāṃ te kathitā pāṃḍunaṃdana \|*  
*yāṃ śrutvā brahmahā goghnaḥ pitṛhā mātṛhā tathā \|\| 185 \|\|*

*mucyate tatkṣaṇādeva pātakaiḥ sopapātakaiḥ \|\| 186 \|\|*

182-186. О son of Kunti, starting from the month of Kartika, one should take a meal on the full moon day. During the month of Kartika, a male sheep; during the month of Margasirsa on full moon day, a bull; and during the remaining months of Pausa and Magha, besides others, the golden images of the respective zodiac signs should be made in gold and should be given over in charity with daksina. This is called as Rasi vrata. By doing this, all the disturbances are subsided. The relevant procedure has been spelt out, with the listening of which, the sins for the killing of a Brahmana, a cow, the father and mother, besides all other disturbances get subsided in a moment.

## \|\| 3.121.187 \|\|

*paṃcādhikā tava mayā kathitā vratānāṃ rājannaśītiratisaukhyadhanapradānām \|*  
*etāṃ samācarati yaḥ śṛṇuyātpaṭhedvā hastāgra lagna iva tasya sureśalokaḥ \|\| 187 \|\|*

187\. О king, these are the eighty five vratas, which have been described to you. They bestow comforts and riches. By hearing, reciting or performing them, the Indraloka is quite easily reachable to them.

## Chapter 122. Bath during the month of Magha

## \|\| 3.122.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*kṛtaṃ brahmayugaṃ proktaṃ tretā tu kṣatriyaṃ yugam \|*  
*vaiśyaṃ dvāparamityāhuḥ śūdraṃ kaliyugaṃ smṛtam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kalau rājanmanuṣyāṇāṃ śaithilyaṃ snānakarmaṇi \|*  
*tathāpi māghavyājena kathayiṣyāmi te śṛṇu \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – The Satya-yuga is Brahma-yuga, Tretd-yuga is Ksatriya-yuga, Dvapara-yuga is said to be Vaisya-yuga and the Kali-yuga has be termed as the Sudra- yuga. О king, though during the age of Kali, the activities like the taking of the sacred bath will be on the decline, still taking of bath during that month of Magha will be quite auspicious, I am highlighting about the importance of the same. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.122.3 \|\|

*yasya hastau ca pādau ca vāṅmanastu susaṃyatam \|*  
*vidyā tapaśca kīrtiśca sa tīrthaphalamaśnute \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. A person whose hands, feet, speech and mind are well under control, besides possessing the learnings, tapes and fame, he earns the merit for visiting a holy place.

## \|\| 3.122.4 \|\|

*aśraddadhānaḥ pāpātmā nāstiko'cchinnasaṃśayaḥ \|*  
*hetuniṣṭhāśca pañcaite na tīrthaphalabhāginaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. A person having no faith and who is the sinful soul, an atheist, a person o f doubtful nature, besides the one who performs (religious deeds) only for a particular motive, he is not entitled for earning a merit or visiting a holy place.

## \|\| 3.122.5 \|\|

*prayāgaṃ puṣkaraṃ prāpya kurukṣetramathāpi vā \|*  
*yatra vā tatra vā snāyānmāghe nityamiti śrutiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. It has been ordained that a person should always take bath at the holy places of Prayaga, Puskara, Kurukshetra or any other sacred place during the month of Magha.

## \|\| 3.122.6-7 \|\|

*trirātraphaladā nadyo yāḥ kāścidasamudragāḥ \|*  
*samudragāstu pakṣasya māsasya saritāṃ patiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*uṣaḥsamīpe yaḥ snānaṃ saṃdhyāyāmudite ravau \|*  
*prājāpatyena tattulyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Such of the streams or the rivers which do not reach the ocean and in case a person takes his bath in such a river, then he earns the merits for three nights. A person who takes his bath in rivers which join ocean, he earns the merit of having bathed for a fortnight and a person who takes bath in a great ocean, he earns the merit of taking bath for a month. One who takes bath during the time between the dawn as well as the morning, he earns the merit of Prajapatya vrata, besides his grave sins also disappear.

## \|\| 3.122.8-9 \|\|

*prātarutthāya yo vipraḥ prātaḥsnāyī sadā bhavet \|*  
*sa sarvapāpanirmuktaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati \|\| 8 \|\|*

*vṛthā coṣṇodakasnānaṃ vṛthā jāpyamavaidikam \|*  
*aśrotriye vṛthā śrāddhaṃ vṛthā bhuktamasākṣikam \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. A Brāhmaṇa who takes bath always in the early morning, then he getting relieved from all the sins, achieves the position of a supreme Brahman. Therefore, taking of bath with warm water, to recite the mantras other than the Vedic mantras, giving away of charities of food only and the performing of Sraddha for the divine beings by taking food alone is of no use.

## \|\| 3.122.10-11 \|\|

*snānaṃ caturvidhaṃ proktaṃ snānavidbhiryudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*vāyavyaṃ vāruṇaṃ brāhmaṃ divyaṃ ceti pṛthakśṛṇu \|\| 10 \|\|*

*vāyavyaṃ gorajaḥ snānaṃ vāruṇaṃ sāgarādiṣu \|*  
*brāhmaṃ brāhmaṇamaṃtroktaṃ divyaṃ meghāṃbubhāskaram \|*  
*sarveṣāmeva snānāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ tatra vāruṇam \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. О Yudhisthira, taking of bath is of four types such as- Vayavya, Varuna, Brahma and Divya. I am going to describe them individually, you please listen. To take bath with the dust produced by the cow’s hoofs, the bath by the wind, to bath in the ocean, bath undertaken with the reciting of the mantras, besides the bath taken in the rain water during the sunshine, are known to be auspicious baths. But out of all the types of aforesaid baths, the Varuna bath is indeed the best.

## \|\| 3.122.12-13 \|\|

*brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho'tha bhikṣukaḥ \|*  
*ete sarve praśaṃsaṃti sarvadā māghamajjanam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*bālāstaruṇakā vṛddhā naranārīnapuṃsakāḥ \|*  
*snātvā māghe śubhe tīrthe prāpnuvaṃtīpsitaṃ phalam \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. All the people like Brahmacari, the householder, the forest dwellers as well as the mendicants praise the bath undertaken during the month of Magha. All the children, young ones, elder ones or even any man or woman whosoever takes bath during the month of Magha, they achieve the merit of visiting various holy places.

## \|\| 3.122.14 \|\|

*brahmakṣatraviśāṃ caiva mantravatsnānamiṣyate \|*  
*tūṣṇīmeva hi śūdrasya strīṇāṃ ca kurunaṃdana \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. All the people including the Brahmanas, Ksatriyas and Vaisyas should take bath with the reciting of the mantras, while the Sudras and the ladies should complete their bath silently.

## \|\| 3.122.15-18 \|\|

*māghamāse raṭaṃtyāpaḥ kiñcidabhyudite ravau \|*  
*brahmaghraṃ vā surāpaṃ vā kaṃpaṃ taṃtaṃ punīmahe \|\| 15 \|\|*

*prāsādā yatra sauvarṇāḥ striyaścāpsarasopamāḥ \|*  
*dadhikulyavahā yatra nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ \|*  
*tatra te yāṃti majjaṃti ye māghe bhāskarodaye \|\| 16 \|\|*

*yativatpathi gaccheta maunī paiśunyavarjitaḥ \|*  
*yadīcchedvipulānbhogāṃścandrasūryopamāngṛhān \|\| 17 \|\|*

*pauṣaphālgunayormadhye prātaḥsnāyī bhavennaraḥ \|*  
*paurṇamāsyā hyamāvāsyāḥ prārabhya snānamācaret \|\| 18 \|\|*

15-18. О son of the race of Kuru, during the month of Magha, at the time of the sunrise the water keeps on flowing. A person having committed the sin of killing a Brahmana or the one who is in the habit of drinking and those who are always found shaken because of their grave sins, they all get purified when they take bath in the early morning during the month of Magha. They achieve the place with golden houses and have the company of the charming women as beautiful as the Apsaras, besides having the streams of curd and milk always flowing. While going for the taking of the bath, one should maintain silence like a mendicant, and should not indulge in denouncing others. He should get free from such types of blemish. In case a person is desirous of achieving the excellent pleasures and the house shining like the sun or the moon light, then during the month falling between the months of Pausa and Phalguna (i.e. Magha), one should surely take bath during the day. The process of these baths should start from the full moon or the moonless day.

## \|\| 3.122.19-20 \|\|

*triṃśaddināni puṇyāṇi makarasthe divākare \|*  
*tatra utthāya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyādvidhipūrvakam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*māghamāsamimaṃ pūrṇaṃ sthāpyehaṃ devamādhavam \|*  
*tīrthaṃ śītajale nityamiti saṃkalpya cetasā \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. When the sun reaches the zodiac symbol of Makara, the entire month is known as the auspicious period. During this period, one should rise early in the morning and should start following the rules while taking bath. While taking bath with the cool water in the month of Magha, he should mentally resolve – “I am adoring Madhavadeva.” With this mental resolve, the bath should be started.

## \|\| 3.122.21 \|\|

*aprāvṛtaśarīrastu yaḥ kaṣṭaṃ snānamācaret \|*  
*padepade'śvamedhasya phalaṃ prāptoti mā navaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. While walking with a bare body, when one takes a harsh bath, he achieves the merit of performing Ashvamedha sacrifice at every step.

## \|\| 3.122.22-24 \|\|

*tatra snātvā śubhe tīrthe dattvā śirasi vai mṛdam \|*  
*vedoktavidhinā rājansūryasyārghaṃ nivedayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

*pitṝnsaṃtarpya tatrastho hyavatīrya tato jalāt \|*  
*iṣṭadevaṃ namaskṛtya pūjayetpuruṣottamam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*śaṅkhacakradharaṃ devaṃ mādhavaṃ nāma pūjayet \|*  
*vahniṃ hutvā vidhānena tatastvekāśano bhavet \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. О king, while taking bath with the auspicious water of a holy place, applying mud over the head, an arghya should be offered to the Sungod according to Vedic rituals. Thereafter, while coming out of the water of the holy place, one should offer salutation to the pitrs as well as the family deity. Thereafter, lord Purusottama - the holder of the conch and wheel, as also the lord Madhava should be worshipped. Then, one should perform yajna taking food once a day.

## \|\| 3.122.25 \|\|

*bhūśayyābrahmacaryeṇa śaktaḥ snānaṃ samācaret \|*  
*aśaktasya dhanāḍhyasya svecchā sā tatra kathyate \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The performer should sleep on earth observing celibacy and then take a bath. A person who is not so strong and is quite a wealthy one, he can do as he likes.

## \|\| 3.122.26 \|\|

*avaśyamapi kartavyaṃ māghe snānamiti śrutiḥ \|*  
*īśvareṇa yathākāmaṃ balaṃ dharmo'nuvartate \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Therefore, according to the scriptures, one should surely take bath in the month of Magha. Isvara bestows the desired strength to him and fulfil all his works.

## \|\| 3.122.27 \|\|

*tilasnāyī tilodvartī tilabhoktā tilodakī \|*  
*tilahotā ca dātā ca ṣaṭtilo nāvasīdati \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. One should make use of sesamum seeds while taking a bath, apply its paste, consume the sesamum seeds and after taking bath with sesamum mixed water, he should perform hота with the same, besides giving away of the sesamum seeds in charity. The people, who make use of the sesamum in the above six ways, they have never to face any misery.

## \|\| 3.122.28-34 \|\|

*tailasyāmalakānāṃ ca tīrthe deyāni nityaśaḥ \|*  
*tathā prajvālayedvahniṃ nivātārthaṃ dvijanmanām \|\| 28 \|\|*

*evaṃ snānāvasāne tu bhojyaṃ deyamavāritam \|*  
*bhojayeddvijadāṃpatyaṃ bhūṣayedvastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*kaṃbalājinaratnāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca \|*  
*colakāni ca divyāni pracchādanapaṭīstathā \|\| 30 \|\|*

*upānahau tathā guptaṃ modakaiḥ pāpamocakaiḥ \|*  
*anena vidhinā dadyānmādhavaḥ prīyatāmiti \|\| 31 \|\|*

*agamyāgamanasteyapāpebhyaśca parigrahāt \|*  
*rahasyācaritādvāpi mucyate snānamācaret \|\| 32 \|\|*

*pitṛbhiḥ pitāmahaiḥ sārddhaṃ tathaiva prapitāmahaiḥ \|*  
*mātāmātāmahaiḥ sārddhaṃ vṛddhamātāmahaistathā \|\| 33 \|\|*

*ekaviṃśakulaiḥ sārddhaṃ bhogānbhuktvā yathepsitān \|*  
*māghamāsyuṣasi snātvā viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati \|\| 34 \|\|*

28-34. By giving away of the oil of myrobalan in charity, the fire in the houses of the Brahmanas should be ignited with the use of the same oil. At the end of the bath, the Brahmana couple should be worshipped with the offering of the costumes and ornaments, who should also be served with food, besides blankets, deer skin, gems and several types of costumes like upper garments, the shoes, besides sweet balls, which relieve one of the sins. After giving these things to the Brahmana, he should then be honoured with the following of this process. At the time of the giving away of the above items of charities, one should say- “Let lord Madhava be pleased.” One who does so, he gets freed from the sins of enjoying other’s wife, committing of theft and relief from other sacred sins. Therefore, this type of bath must be undertaken. During the month of Magha, in case a bath is taken with hot water, one redeems his twenty-one generations, including the father, the grandfather, the great grandfather, the mother, the grandmother, great grandmother and the great great grandmother. After enjoying all the excellent pleasures, he finally achieves Viṣṇuloka.

## \|\| 3.122.35 \|\|

*yo māghamāsyuṣasi sūryyakarābhitāmre snānaṃ samācarati cārunadīpravāhe \|*  
*uddhṛtya saptapuruṣānpitṛmātṛtaśca svargaṃ prayātyamaladehadharo naro'sau \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Thus, during the sunrise in the month of Magha when the sun rays spread redness in the water, one should take bath in the excellent flow of the water. Such a person achieving the spotless body, earns the heaven together with the seven generations from the side of his father and mother.

## Chapter 123. Method of taking bath daily

## \|\| 3.123.1-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*nairmalyaṃ bhāvaśuddhiśca vinā snānaṃ na yujyate \|*  
*tasmātkāyaviśuddhyarthaṃ snānamādau vidhīyate \|\| 1 \|\|*

*anuddhatairuddhatairvā jalaiḥ snānaṃ samācaret \|*  
*tīrthaṃ prakalpayedvidvānmūlamaṃtreṇa maṃtravit \|\| 2 \|\|*

*namo nārāyaṇāyeti mūlamantra udāhṛtaḥ \|*  
*darbhapāṇistu vidhinā svācāntaḥ prayataḥ sudhīḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*caturhastasamāyuktaṃ caturasraṃ samaṃtataḥ \|*  
*prakalpyāvāhayedgaṅgāmebhirmaṃtrairvicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*oṃ viṣṇupādaprasūtāsi vaiṣṇavī viṣṇudevatā \|*  
*pāhi nastvenasastasmādājanmamaraṇāṃtikāt \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tisraḥ koṭyo'rddhakoṭī ca tīrthānāṃ vāyurabravīt \|*  
*divi bhuvyaṃtarikṣe ca tāni te santi jāhnavi \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – Without taking a bath, one does not get purified mentally as w ell as physically. Therefore, for the purification of the body, the taking of bath has been prescribed. The taking of bath is essential with water drawn from a well or with the river water. The learned people well-versed in the mantras should establish a tirtha, saying – “Om Namo Narayanaya.” Initially, sipping the water and placing the kusa grass inside and outside, holding the same in hand, a pit of four cubit square should be filled with water. Then the water of the Ganga should be made to flow with the speaking of these mantras – “With the reciting of Omkara, the auspicious river which emerged out of the feet of Viṣṇu is known as Vaiṣṇavī or Ganga, till such time of my birth to death, you protect me from all the sins, because according to the words of Vayudeva, three and a half crores of gods, who pervade in sky and earth, are all under your control.”

## \|\| 3.123.7-9 \|\|

*naṃdinītyeva te nāma deveṣu nalinīti ca \|*  
*kṣamā pṛthvī ca vihagā viśvakāyā śivā smṛtā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*vidyādharā suprasannā tathā loka prasādinī \|*  
*kṣemyā tathā jāhnavī ca śāṃtā śāṃtipradāyinī \|\| 8 \|\|*

*etāni puṇyanāmāni snānakāle prakīrtayet \|*  
*bhavetsaṃnihitā tatra gaṅgā tripathagāminī \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. The names of Nandini, Nalini popularized by the gods, Ksama, Prthvi, Vihaga, Visvakaya, Siva, Vidyadhara, Lokaprasadini, Ksemya, Jahnavi, Santa and Santapradayani goddess should be recited at the time of taking the bath. With the reciting of these names, he should take bath in the river Ganga which moves in the three worlds.

## \|\| 3.123.10-11 \|\|

*saptavārābhijaptena karasaṃpuṭayojitam \|*  
*mūाrdhni kuryājjalaṃ bhūpa tricatuḥpañcasaptadhā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*snānaṃ kuryānmṛdā tadvadā maṃtrya ca vidhānataḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. О king, joining both the hands, the aforesaid names should be uttered seven times and the water should be touched with the head thrice, four or five times. Thereafter, the bath should be started with the recitation of prescribed mantras.

## \|\| 3.123.12-13 \|\|

*aśvakrāṃte rathakrāṃte viṣṇukrāṃte vasuṃdhare \|*  
*mṛttike hara me sarvaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*uddhṛtāsi varāheṇa kṛṣṇena śatabāhunā \|*  
*namaste sarvalokānāmasudhāriṇi suvrate \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. With the use of sanctified clay, the taking of bath has been prescribed. Saying – “O clay of the earth, you are made to rise up with the horses, chariots and lord Viṣṇu, you better remove all my misdeeds that are being done by me so far. О excellent one, you retain the lives of all the living beings, you had been rescued by a hundred armed Kṛṣṇa. I offer my salutation to you.”

## \|\| 3.123.14-16 \|\|

*evaṃ snātvā tataḥ paścādācamya ca vidhānataḥ \|*  
*utthāya vāsasī śukle sūkṣme tu paridhāya vai \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tatastu tarpaṇaṃ kuryāttrailokyāpyāyanāya tu \|*  
*devā yakṣāstathā nāgā gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ \|*  
*krūrāḥ sarvāḥ suparṇāśca tarakṣā vihagāḥ khagāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*vidyādharā jaladharāstathaivākāśagāminaḥ \|*  
*nirādhārāśca ye jīvāḥ pāpakarmaratāśca ye \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. Thus taking the bath and performing the sipping of water, one should be clad in fine white cloth and should perform oblation for the increase of the three worlds. Then he should resolve – “I am offering the oblation for the gratification of the Yaksas, Gandharvas, Nagas, Apsaras, cruel serpents, Suparnas, Taraksas, birds, Vidhyddharas, Jaladharas, those creatures who move in the sky and the sinful persons. For their satisfaction, the water is being given by me.”

## \|\| 3.123.17-19 \|\|

*teṣāmāpyāyanāyaitaddīyate salilaṃ mayā \|*  
*kṛtopavīto devebhyo nivītī ca bhavettataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*manuṣyāṃstarpayedbhaktyā brahmaputrānṛṣīṃstathā \|*  
*sanakaśca sanandaśca tṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*kapilaścāsuriścaiva voḍhuḥ pañcaśikhastathā \|*  
*sarve te tṛptimāyāṃtu maddattenāṃbunā sadā \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. Then placing the yajnopavita over the left shoulder and for the sake of the gods, it should be hung over the neck. Thereafter, the oblation should be made for the sake of humans as well as the Ṛṣis who were born of Brahma. He should say – “Let Sanaka, Sanandana, Sanatana, Kapila, Asuri, Vodhu and Pancasikha be satisfied with the oblation made by me with water.

## \|\| 3.123.20-21 \|\|

*marīcimatryaṅgirasau pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum \|*  
*pracetasaṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ ca bhṛguṃ nāradameva ca \|\| 20 \|\|*

*devabrahmaṛṣīnsarvāṃstarpayetākṣatodakaiḥ \|*  
*apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā savyaṃ jānu ca bhūtale \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. After making the oblation for the Ṛṣis – Marici, Agni, Angira, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Pracetasa, Vasistha, Bhrigu, Narada besides all the gods, Brahmanas and other Ṛṣis, the yajnopavita should be placed over the right shoulder. Then he should knee down on the right knee.

## \|\| 3.123.22-25 \|\|

*agniṣvāttā barhiṣado haviṣmaṃtastathoṣmapāḥ \|*  
*sukalitāstathā bhaumā ājyapāḥ somapāstathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tarpayecca pitṝnbhaktyā satilodakacandanaiḥ \|*  
*darbhapāṇistu vidhivattarpayennāmagotrataḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*pitrādīnnāmagotreṇa tathā mātāmahānapi \|*  
*saṃtarpya vidhivadbhaktyā imaṃ maṃtramudīrayet \|\| 24 \|\|*

*ye'bāndhavā bāndhavā vā ye'nyajanmani bāndhavāḥ \|*  
*te tṛptimakhilā yāṃtu yaścāsmatto'bhivāñchati \|\| 25 \|\|*

22-25. Making use of sandal paste and sesamum seeds, he should offer oblation with devotion to the manes known by the names of – Agnisvatta, Barhisad, Havisman, Usmapa, Sukalita, Bhauma, Ajyapa and Somapa, satisfying them at the same time. Then carrying kusa grass in his hand, the performer should recite his own name, his own gotra and the oblation should be made for the races of his father as well as the mother for their satisfaction. Thereafter, pressing the clothes, one should say – “Let all my kiths and kins as well as the relatives of my other births, be pleased with me, who are desirous of having satisfaction, with the giving away of oblation of water by me.”

## \|\| 3.123.26-31 \|\|

*tataścācamya vidhivadālikhetpadmamagrataḥ \|*  
*akṣataiḥ saha puṣpañca satilāruṇacandanaiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*arghaṃ dadyātprayatnena sūryanāmānukīrtanaiḥ \|*  
*namaste viśvarūpāya namo viṣṇusakhāya vai \|\| 27 \|\|*

*sahasraraśmaye nityaṃ namaste sarvatejase \|*  
*namaste sarvavapuṣe namaste sarvaśaktaye \|\| 28 \|\|*

*jagatsvāminnamaste'stu divyacaṃdanabhūṣita \|*  
*padmanābha namaste'stu kuṇḍalāṃgadadhāriṇe \|\| 29 \|\|*

*namaste sarvalokeśa sarvāsuranamaskṛta \|*  
*sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ caiva samyagjānāsi sarvadā \|\| 30 \|\|*

*satyadeva namastestu sarvadeva namo'stu te \|*  
*divākara namaste'stu trayīmaya namo'stu te \|\| 31 \|\|*

26-31. Thereafter, sipping the water, a lotus should be formed and the Sungod should be invoked and consecrated there. Then, reciting his different names, the unbroken rice, flowers, the sesamum seeds and red sandal paste should be used for offering oblation to them, saying – “Salutation to the universal form, salutation to the friend of Viṣṇu, salutation to the lord having a thousand rays, salutation to the lustre of the universe, salutation to the universal form, as well as the universal strength. The lord of the universe is adorned with the divine sandal paste, salutation to Padmanabha, salutation to the one who is adorned with the kundalas and armlets. He is the Isa of all the lokas and is adored by all the Asuras, salutation to him. You are well aware of my good as well as the evil deeds. Salutation to the god of truth. Salutation to the three Vedas.”

## \|\| 3.123.32-33 \|\|

*evaṃ sūryaṃ namaskṛtya triḥkṛtvā ca pradakṣiṇām \|*  
*dvijaṃ gāṃ kāñcanaṃ spṛṣṭvā tato viṣṇugṛhaṃ vrajet \|\| 32 \|\|*

*snānaṃ khalu pratidinaṃ kathitaṃ munīndraiḥ pāpāpahaṃ malaharaṃ sukhadaṃ sadaiva \|*  
*tasmānnadīṣvatha gṛheṣvatha vā taḍāge kartavyametadiha dharmadhiyā nareṇa \|\| 33 \|\|*

32-33. The Sungod should be offered the salutation thrice by circumambulating thrice. Thereafter, he should touch a Brahmana, a cow and gold. Then he should go to a Viṣṇu temple for having a look at the lord, after which, he should take his bath, which removes the sins and bestows the comforts. According to the words of the sages, I have told you enough. Therefore, a person with wisdom must take a bath in a river, a lake or a tank or in one’s own house.

## Chapter 124. Method of Rudra bath

## \|\| 3.124.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*rudrasnānavidhānaṃ me kathayasva janārdana \|*  
*sarvaduṣṭopaśamanaṃ sarvaśāṃtipradaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said – О Janardana, you kindly tell me about the Rudra-snana or the bath of Rudra, which subsides all the miseries and bestows complete peace on the humans.

## \|\| 3.124.2-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*devasenāpatiṃ skandaṃ rudraputraṃ durāsadam \|*  
*agastyo muniśārdūlaḥ sukhāsīnamuvāca ha \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sarvajño'si kumāra tvaṃ prasādācchaṅkarasya vai \|*  
*snānaṃ rudravidhānena brūhi kasya kathaṃ bhavet \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – Once the sage Agastya asked Skanda who is terrific besides being the son of Siva – “O Kumara, you have become all knowledgeable by the grace of lord Siva, therefore, you tell me about the Rudra-snana (or bath of Rudra).

## \|\| 3.124.4-6 \|\|

*rudra uvāca \|*  
*mṛtaprajā tu yā nārī durbhagā sutavarjitā \|*  
*yā sute duhitāṃ vaṃdhyā snānamāsāṃ vidhīyate \|\| 4 \|\|*

*aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāmupavāsaparāyaṇā \|*  
*ṛtau śuddhe caturthehni prāpte sūryadine'tha vā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*nadyostu saṅgame kuryānmahānadyorviśeṣataḥ \|*  
*śivālaye'tha vā goṣṭhe vivikte vā gṛhāṅgaṇe \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. Skanda said – A person whose children die soon after the birth, is without a son or who gets only the daughters, this type of bath is essential for him, besides those who are the barren ladies, for them this bath has been prescribed. After the bath of the period, on the fourth day, on the eighth or fourteenth moon day falling on a Sunday, one should take a bath at the confluence of a river. Particularly, the bath should be taken at the confluence of two great rivers, or a Siva temple or a cowpen or in the vast courtyard of a house.

## \|\| 3.124.7-9 \|\|

*āhitāgniṃ dvijaṃ śāṃtaṃ dharmajñaṃ satyaśīlinam \|*  
*snānārthaṃ prārthayeddevaṃ nipuṇaṃ raudrakarmaṇi \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tatastu maṃḍapaṃ kuryāccaturasramudaggatam \|*  
*baddhacandanamālaṃ tu gomaye nopalepitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tanmadhye śvetarajasā saṃpūrṇaṃ padmamālikhet \|*  
*madhye tasya mahādevaṃ sthāpayetkarṇikopari \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. The fragrance of such a sacred bath should be initiated by a Brahmana who performs the homa, is peaceful, religious minded, truthful besides being a divine personality. While starting the performance of this bath, one should first pray for a bath and a mandapa should be erected in the north, which should be decorated with the garland of sandal wood. Plastering the ground with cowdung, a lotus should be drawn with white and red powder. In the pericarp of the lotus, the image of lord Siva should be consecrated in an appropriate manner.

## \|\| 3.124.10-13 \|\|

*dadyāddaleṣu śaktyādīṃścaturthavidhipūrvakam \|*  
*indrādilokapālāṃśca daleṣvanyeṣu vinyaset \|\| 10 \|\|*

*devīṃ vināyakaṃ caiva sthāpayettasya pārśvataḥ \|*  
*dattvārghaṃ gandhapuṣpaṃ ca dhūpadīpaṃ guḍaudanam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*bhakṣyānnānāvidhāndadyātphalāni vividhāni ca \|*  
*catuṣkoṇeṣu bhṛṃgāramaśvatthadalabhūṣitam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*ekaikaṃ vinyasedbrahmansarvauṣadhisamanvitam \|*  
*caturdiśaṃ maṃḍapasya dadyādbhūtabaliṃ tataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. The goddess Sakti of Siva should be lodged over the lotus petal and Vinayaka should be lodged over the rear side with the goddess. After performing the worship, arghya should be offered, which should comprise of scents, flowers, incense, lamp, sweet boiled rice, several other eatables and several types of fruits should also have to be given. The leaves of the pipala tree should be spread all round besides the herbs. Then a pitcher of gold filled with water should also be consecrated there. Bhutabali should then be offered in all the directions of the mandapa.

## \|\| 3.124.14 \|\|

*āgneyyāṃ diśi kartavyaṃ maṃḍapasya samīpataḥ \|*  
*agnikāryaṃ śubhe kuṇḍe puṣpapatrairalaṃkṛte \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. In the auspicious kunda that has been formed to the south-east of the mandapa decorated with the flower petals, the homa for the navagrahas or nine planets should be performed.

## \|\| 3.124.15 \|\|

*lavaṇaṃ sarṣapairyuktaṃ ghṛtena madhunā saha \|*  
*mānastokena juhuyātkṛtahome navagrahe \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Thereafter, making use of salt, mustard seeds, ghi and honey, the offerings should be made in the homa, uttering the Manastoka mantras.

## \|\| 3.124.16-17 \|\|

*dvitīyamagnikāryasya kartāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kuru \|*  
*rudrajāpakamācāryaṃ sitacandanacarcitam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sitavastraparīdhānaṃ sitamālādharaṃ śubham \|*  
*śobhitaṃ kaṃkaṇaiḥ kaṃṭhyaiḥ karṇaveṣṭāṃgulīyakaiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. During this performance, another Brahmapa who performs the fire rites, besides an Acarya engaged in reciting of the Rudra mantras should also be adored, offering the sandal paste, white costumes, armlets, necklaces, earrings and the finger rings.

## \|\| 3.124.18-20 \|\|

*maṃḍala sya samīpastho japedrudrānvimatsaraḥ \|*  
*yāvadekādaśa gatāḥ punareva japettu tān \|\| 18 \|\|*

*devamaṃḍalavatkāryaṃ dvitīyaṃ maṃḍalaṃ śubham \|*  
*tasya madhye tu sā nārī śvetapuṣpairalaṃkṛtā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*śvetavastraiśca saṃchannā śvetagaṃdhānulepitā \|*  
*sukhāsanopaviṣṭāyāmācāryo rudraciṃtakaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. Near the mandala, the japam should be performed. After performing the japam of Ekadasi Rudras in a mandala, another mandala has to be created whose middle area should be decorated with the white flowers and a lady should be lodged clad in white garments. The white paste should be applied over her body. She should be seated in Sukhasana, in quite an easy posture. She should remain devoted to Rudra.

## \|\| 3.124.21-25 \|\|

*abhiṣiṃcettataścaiva nāmarkapatrapuṭāṃbunā \|*  
*catuḥṣaṣṭividhenaiva rudreṇaikādaśena tu \|\| 21 \|\|*

*śatāni saptaparṇānāṃ caturbhiradhikāni tu \|*  
*acchidrāṇāṃ manūnāṃ ca snānārthaṃ viniyojayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

*aśvasthānādgajasthānādvalmīkātsaṃgamādhradāt \|*  
*veśyāgaṇādrājagṛhādgoṣṭhādānīya vai mṛdaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*sarvauṣadhiṃ rocanāṃ ca nadītīrthodakāni ca \|*  
*etānsaṃkṣipya kalaśe śivasaṃjñe supūjite \|\| 24 \|\|*

*āpādatalakeśaṃ ca kukṣī caiva viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*sarvāṃgaṃ lepayennāryāḥ suśīlā kācidaṅganā \|\| 25 \|\|*

21-25. Then in the cups of swallow wart, the sixty-four designs, eleven Rudras, a hundred and four leaves of Saptaparna trees and with reciting of the appropriate hymns, the abhiseka or consecration should be performed. After taking the bath, the dust form Siva temple, house of a whore, the king’s palace and from a cowpen should be collected together with all the herbs, red lotus, besides water from a river and the holy places should also be collected. Starting from the soles of the lady upto the head, particularly on the waist and all other limbs, the dust of various places should be applied by a beautiful damsel. Thereafter, she should be bathed as per the directions of the Acarya.

## \|\| 3.124.26-28 \|\|

*rudrābhijaptena tataḥ snāpayetkalaśena tām \|*  
*toyapūrṇāṣṭakalaśairaśvatthadalapūritaiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*sarvatodiksthitaiḥ paścātsnāpayetsaphalākṣataiḥ \|*  
*evaṃ snātā snāpakāya dadyādgāṃ kāṃcanaṃ tathā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*heturapyatra nirdiṣṭā dakṣiṇā gauḥ payasvinī \|*  
*brāhmaṇānāmathānyeṣāṃ svaśaktyā pāṃḍunaṃdana \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. Thereafter, the eight pitchers which were lodged in all the eight directions, should be washed offering the fruits, unbroken rice, with reciting of the mantras by the Acarya. After finishing the bath, one who gets the bath performed should be given a cow and gold. О son of Pandu, according to his means, the performer should give away daksina to the Acarya as well as the other Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.124.29 \|\|

*govatsakāñcanādīni dattvā sarvaṃ kṣamāpayet \|*  
*kṛtenānena rājendra rudrasnānena bhāminī \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. О Rajendra, thus by giving away the gold and a cow with calf, one should beg forgiveness.

## \|\| 3.124.30-31 \|\|

*subhagā sukhasaṃyuktā bahuputrā ca jāyate \|*  
*sarveṣvapi hi māseṣu brāhmaṇābhimate śubham \|\| 30 \|\|*

*tasmādavaśyaṃ kartavyaṃ putraśrīsukhamicchatā \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. With the performing of Rudra-snana, the lady becomes comfortable and mother of many sons. The ladies who are desirous of sons, fortunes and comforts, this bath must be performed by them after consulting a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.124.32 \|\|

*yā snānamācarati rudramiti prasiddhaṃ śraddhānvitā dvijavarānumatā'natāṅgī \|*  
*doṣānnihatya sakalānsvaśarīrabhāgādbhartuḥ priyā bhavati bhārata jīvavatsā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. О Bharata, thus the famous Rudra-snana should be performed in consultation with a learned Brahman. By doing so, one gets relieved of all the defeats or blemishes of her body and becomes the favorite and beloved wife of her husband.

## Chapter 125. Bath during the lunar or solar eclipse

## \|\| 3.125.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*candrādityoparāgeṣu yatsnānamabhidhīyate \|*  
*tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi dravyamannaṃ pradhānataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said – During the eclipses of the sun and the moon, the bath which is called as Dravya snana, I have a desire to learn about the same.

## \|\| 3.125.2-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*yasya rāśiṃ samāsādya bhavedgrahaṇasaṃplavaḥ \|*  
*tasya snānaṃ pravakṣyāmi maṃtrauṣadhisamanvitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*candroparāgaṃ saṃprāpya kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam \|*  
*saṃpūjya caturo viprāngandhamālyānulepanaiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

2-3. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – The zodiac symbol over which the eclipse falls, I am speaking out the related herbs and the bath. During the lunar eclipse, making the Brāhmaṇa to recite the Svastivacana or the welfare mantras, four Brāhmaṇas should be adored offering the fragrance, garland, paste.

## \|\| 3.125.4-5 \|\|

*pūrvamevoparāgasya samānīyauṣadhādikam \|*  
*sthāpayeccaturaḥ kumbhānagrataḥ sāgarāniti \|\| 4 \|\|*

*gajāśvarathyāvalmīkasaṅgamāddhradagokulāt \|*  
*rājadvārapradeśāttu mṛdamānīya prakṣipet \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. Before the start of the eclipse, the ghi and herbs should be mixed and put in four pitchers, which should be consecrated. In these pitchers, the dust from elephant stable, horse stable, chariot, white ant hill, confluence of rivers, tanks, cowpen and a royal gate should be dropped.

## \|\| 3.125.6-8 \|\|

*paṃcagavyaṃ ca kuṃbheṣu paṃcaratnāni caiva hi \|*  
*rocanā padmaśaṃkhau ca pañcabhaṅgasamanvitau \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sphaṭikaṃ candanaṃ śvetaṃ tīrthavārisasarṣapam \|*  
*gajadaṃtaṃ kuṃkumaṃ ca tathaivośīraguggulam \|*  
*etatsarvaṃ vinikṣipya kumbheṣvāvāhayetsurān \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sarve samudrāḥ saritastīrthāni jaladā hradāḥ \|*  
*āyāṃtu yajamānasya duritakṣayakārakāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. Besides that, pancagavya, gorocana, lotus, conch, water of five sacred rivers, crystal, white sandal paste, water of holy places, mustard seeds, ivory dust, vermilion, khasa and guggulu should also be placed in the pitchers. After putting all these things in the kalasas, the gods should be invoked in each one of them – “Let all the oceans, the rivers, holy places, the clouds and lakes should arrive here, for relieving the yajamana of all the sins.

## \|\| 3.125.9-10 \|\|

*yo'sau vajradharo deva ādityānāṃ prabhurmataḥ \|*  
*sahasranayanaścendraḥ pīḍāṃ me'tra vyapohatu \|\| 9 \|\|*

*rakṣogaṇādhipaḥ sākṣātpralayānilasaprabhaḥ \|*  
*khaḍgavyagro'ti bhīmaśca rakṣaḥpīḍāṃ vyapohatu \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. Indra with a thousand eyes, who is the lord of Adityas, should remove my pain. Let the Ganas of protection who are terrific like the wind of the time of dissolution and the Raksasas who hold a sword in their hands and look horrible, remove my pain.

## \|\| 3.125.11-12 \|\|

*yo'sau bindukaro binduḥ pinākī vṛṣavāhanaḥ \|*  
*candroparāgapāpāni sa nāśayatu śaṅkaraḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*trailokye yāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca \|*  
*brahmārkaviṣṇuyuktāni tāni pāpaṃ dahaṃtu vai \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. O lord Siva possessing the Pinaka bow besides a bull as a vehicle, you kindly destroy all my sins relating to the moon. Let lord Brahma, Surya and Viṣṇu destroying my own sins, also destroy the sins of all the mobile and immobile beings.”

## \|\| 3.125.13 \|\|

*evamāmaṃtritaiḥ kumbhairaṃbhoyuktairyugānvitaiḥ \|*  
*ṛgyajuḥ sāmamaṃtraiśca śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ \|*  
*pūjayedvastragodānairbrāhmaṇāniṣṭadevatāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Thus speaking, the gods should be invoked with the uttering of the hymns from the Ṛk, Yajuh and Sama Vedas. Thereafter, the pitchers should be adorned with the garlands, paste, costumes and the cows. Then, the family deity as well as the Brahmanas should be adored.

## \|\| 3.125.14-17 \|\|

*etāneva tato maṃtrānsaṃlikhya kanakānvitān \|*  
*yajamānasya śirasi uddhāryāste narottama \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kalaśāndravyasaṃyuktānprāpte grahaṇaparvaṇi \|*  
*candragrahe nivṛtte tu kṛtagodānamaṅgalaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*kṛtasnānaḥ śvetapaṭṭaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu sagrahaṃ snānamācaret \|\| 16 \|\|*

*na tasya grahapīḍā syānna ca baṃdhujanakṣayaḥ \|*  
*paramāṃ siddhimāpnoti punarāvṛttidurlabhām \|\| 17 \|\|*

14-17. O best of the kings, these mantras should be written in gold letters. The water of the pitcher should then be poured over the head of the yajamana. The water should be mixed with all the herbs. After taking the bath and after the eclipse is over, for the sake of welfare, a cow and a white scarf should be given over to a Brāhmaṇa with respect. By following this process, the pain of the eclipse is subsided and there occurs no loss of relatives or the kiths and kins. Besides, by doing so, one achieves such a great success in which no rebirth is possible.

## \|\| 3.125.18 \|\|

*sūryagrahe sūryanāma sadā maṃtreṣu kīrtayet \|*  
*dravyaistaireva kathitaṃ snānaṃ kurukulodvaha \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. О enemy of the race of Kuru, at the time of the solar eclipse, only the name of the Sungod has to be recited, besides the taking of bath as mentioned earlier.

## \|\| 3.125.19 \|\|

*ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayedvāpi mānavaḥ \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śakraloke mahīyate \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Those who listen to this story, they getting relieved of all the sins, are respected in the place of Indra.

## \|\| 3.125.20 \|\|

*candragrahe nṛpa ravigrahaṇe japanmāṃ maṃtrairimaiḥ samabhimaṃtrya śubhodakuṃbhāt \|*  
*snānaṃ karoti niyamena naraśca yaśca pīḍā na taṃ grahakṛtā ca punardunoti \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. At the time of the lunar or solar eclipse, while worshipping me, when a person takes bath with the sanctified water of the pitchers in an appropriate manner, he does not have to suffer from the pains in the family.

## Chapter 126. Sambharayani Vrata

## \|\| 3.126.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*gṛhastho maraṇe prāpte kathaṃ tyajati jīvitam \|*  
*etanme brūhi govinda paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said – О Govinda, at the time of eclipse, how should the householders lead their lives? I am quite anxious to know about the same. Therefore, you kindly speak about the same.

## \|\| 3.126.2-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*nānyaduṣkṛṣṭamuddiṣṭaṃ tajjñairanaśanātparam \|*  
*tasyāhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye yajjapyaṃ ca mumūrṣatā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*yādṛgrūpaśca bhagavāṃściṃtanīyo janārdanaḥ \|*  
*āsannamātmanaḥ kālaṃ jñātvā prājño yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 3 \|\|*

*nirdhūtamaladoṣaśca snāto niyatamānasaḥ \|*  
*samabhyarcya hṛṣīkeśaṃ puṣpadhūpādibhistataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*praṇipātaiḥ stavaiḥ puṇyairgaṃdhairdhūpaistu pūjayet \|*  
*dattvā dānaṃ ca viprebhyo vikalādibhya eva ca \|*  
*samarpya brāhmaṇebhyaśca devārcādyupayogi ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

2-5. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – The learned people feel that it is difficult for a person to practice fasting for long. There is no other vrata more difficult than this. Therefore, a person who is nearing his death, the performing of the japam and the fasting for him is being spoken by me. You please listen. Realizing that the time of the death of a person is nearing, the form in which he should adore lord Janardana, is being revealed by me. One should control his mind, he should have a clean bath and lord Hrishikesha should be adored with humility offering prayers, flowers and fragrance etc. Charities should also be given to the Brahmanas and the handicapped people. The Brahmanas should also be entrusted with the worship of the deities.

## \|\| 3.126.6-7 \|\|

*baṃdhu putrakalatreṣu kṣetradhānyadhanādiṣu \|*  
*mitravarge ca rājendra mamatvaṃ vinivartayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*mitrāṇyamitrānmadhyasthānparānsvāṃśca punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*atyarthamapakāreṇa nopakāreṇa cintayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. Then he should detract himself from brothers, sons and wife, land, property or fields and the food grains. The attachment towards the friends should also be discarded. He should completely forget about his kith and kins, besides the good or the bad deeds.

## \|\| 3.126.8 \|\|

*tataśca prayataḥ kuryādutsargaṃ sarvakarmaṇām \|*  
*śubhāśubhānāṃ rājendra vākyaṃ cedamudīrayet \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Then making all the efforts, he should get himself relieved of all the human activities. О Rajendra, then he should speak out the following noble words.

## \|\| 3.126.9-16 \|\|

*parityajāmyahaṃ bhogāṃstyajāmi suhṛdo'khilān \|*  
*bhojanaṃ hi mayotsṛṣṭamutsṛṣṭamanulepanam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*sragbhūṣaṇādikaṃ geyaṃ dānamāsanameva ca \|*  
*homādayaḥ parārthā ye ye ca nityakramāgatāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*naimittikāstathā kāmyāḥ śrāddhadharmādayojjhitāḥ \|*  
*tyaktāścāśramikā dharmā varṇadharmāstathojjhitāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ viharankurvāṇaḥ karma codvahan \|*  
*na pāpaṃ kasyacinnyāyyāḥ prāṇinaḥ saṃtu nirbhayāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*nabhasi prāṇino ye ca ye jale ye ca bhūtale \|*  
*kṣitervivaragā ye ca ye ca pāṣāṇasaṃpuṭe \|\| 13 \|\|*

*dhānyādiṣu ca vastreṣu śayaneṣvāsaneṣu ca \|*  
*te svayaṃ tu vibudhyaṃte dattaṃ tebhyo'bhayaṃ mayā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*na me'sti bāṃdhavaḥ kaścidviṣṇuṃ muktvā jagadgurum \|*  
*mitrapakṣe ca me viṣṇuradhaścordhvaṃ tathā punaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*pārśvato mūrdhni hṛdaye bāhubhyāṃ caiva cakṣuṣoḥ \|*  
*śrotrādiṣu ca sarveṣu mama viṣṇuḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

9-16. Не should speak out – “I am discarding all the pleasures as well as the food, besides use of the paste, garland, ornaments etc., the singing, giving of charities and seat, and all the daily routines like the performing of homa etc., the performing of sraddha, the religious and the worldly activities. I have also discarded the religious activities, besides those relating to my caste, which were done by me with my hands or the feet. Then committing sins by anyone would not be justified. Therefore, they should be free from danger. The living beings who are dwelling in the sky, water, ground, nether world, mountain, caves or the fields, the cremation ground, should well realize this aspect themselves that I have made them free from danger. There is none to look after me except lord Viṣṇu. Lord Viṣṇu is lodged everywhere above and below, at the back, over the head, the heart, the arms, eyes, ears etc.”

## \|\| 3.126.17-22 \|\|

*iti sarvaṃ samutsṛjya dhṛtvā sarveśamacyutam \|*  
*vāsudevetyavirataṃ nāma devasya kīrtayet \|\| 17 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu śete vai prākchirāstathā \|*  
*udakchirā vā rājeṃdra ciṃtayañjagataḥ patim \|\| 18 \|\|*

*viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ keśavaṃ madhusūdanam \|*  
*nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ śauriṃ vāsudevaṃ janārdanam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*vārāhaṃ yajñapuruṣaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣamacyutam \|*  
*vāmanaṃ śrīdharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nṛsiṃhamaparājitam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*padmanābhamajaṃ śrīśaṃ dāmodaramadhokṣajam \|*  
*sarveśvareśvaraṃ śuddhamanaṃtaṃ viśvarūpiṇam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*cakriṇaṃ gadinaṃ śāṃtaṃ śaṃkhinaṃ garuḍadhvajam \|*  
*kirīṭakaustubhadharaṃ praṇamāmyahamavyayam \|\| 22 \|\|*

17-22. Thus discarding everyone, leaving all and devoting the mind fully towards lord Acyuta, he should recite the name of Vāsudeva repeatedly. The feet should be on the southern side, the head should be placed in the north and one should sleep like lord Viṣṇu. О Rajendra, he should then say – “I offer my salutation to Viṣṇu, Hṛsikesa, Kesava, Madhusudana, Nara-Narayana, Sauri, Vāsudeva, Janardana, Varaha, Yajna-purusa, Pundarikaksa, Acyuta, Vamana, Sridhara, Kṛṣṇa, Nṛsimha, Aparajita, Padmanabha, Aja, Srisa, Damodara, Adhoksaja, Sarvesvara, Buddha, Ananta, Visvarupa, Cakri, Gadi, Santa, Garudadhvaja, possessor of Kaustubha gem and Avyaya.

## \|\| 3.126.23-24 \|\|

*ahamasmi jagannātha mayi vāsaṃ kuru drutam \|*  
*āvayoraṃtaraṃ māstu samīrākāśayoriva \|\| 23 \|\|*

*ayaṃ viṣṇurayaṃ śaurirayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ puro mama \|*  
*nīlotpaladalaśyāmaḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. O Jagannatha, let me get absorbed in you and you in me. There should be no difference between me and you, like the wind and the sky. Lord Viṣṇu and Kṛṣṇa are standing before me, having the complexion of the blue lotus and the eyes resembling the lotus flower.

## \|\| 3.126.25-26 \|\|

*eṣa paśyatu māmīśaḥ paśyāmyahamadhokṣajam \|*  
*itthaṃ japedekamanāḥ smaransarveśvaraṃ harim \|\| 25 \|\|*

*āsīta sukhaduḥkheṣu samo mitrāhiteṣu ca \|*  
*oṃ namo vāsudevāya ityetatsatataṃ japet \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. Let my lord Adhoksaja have a look at me. He is in my full view. Thus, lord Hari should be meditated upon with a concentrated mind, having the same feelings for the friend and foe, pleasure and pain. Then one should recite the mantra – “От Namo Bhagavate Vāsudevāya."

## \|\| 3.126.27-30 \|\|

*yathāyathā bhavetkāmastathā tannāmakīrtayet \|*  
*dhyāyecca devadeveśaṃ viṣṇo rūpaṃ manoramam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*prasannanetrabhrūcakraśaṃkhacakragadādharam \|*  
*śrīvakṣasaṃ sumanasaṃ caturvaktraṃ kirīṭinam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*pītāṃbaradharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cārukeyūradhāriṇam \|*  
*ciṃtayettu sadārūpaṃ manaḥ kṛtvaikaniścayam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*yādṛśe vā manaḥ sthairyaṃ rūpe badhnāti cakriṇaḥ \|*  
*tadeva ciṃtayedrūpaṃ vāsudeveti kīrtayet \|\| 30 \|\|*

27-30. This mantra should be recited repeatedly which should go on increasing, one should keep in mind the pleasant form of lord Viṣṇu. Thus with a firm resolve in the mind, he should keep in his heart the figure of the lord with developed eyes, curved brows resembling the conch, holding the conch, wheel and club, with Śrī Laksmi decorating the chest. He has spotless mind, four faces, adorned with a kirita crown, armlets and clad in a pitambara, devoting his mind in the form of lord Viṣṇu, in which the person has the full faith. The recitation of – “От Namo Bhagavate Vāsudevāya” should continue.

## \|\| 3.126.31-33 \|\|

*itthaṃ japansmarannityaṃ svarūpaṃ paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*aprāṇaparamodārastaccittastatparāyaṇaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*sarvapātakayukto'pi puruṣaḥ puruṣarṣabha \|*  
*prayāti devadeveśe layamīḍyatamecyute \|\| 32 \|\|*

*yathāgnistṛṇa jātāni dahatyanilasaṃgataḥ \|*  
*tathānaśanasaṃkalpaḥ puṃsāṃ pāpamasaṃśayam \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. Performing this japam taking a samkalpa and concentrating on this form of lord Viṣṇu upto the time of death, a person who does so. he getting relieved of all the grave sins with the burning of the same in the divine fire, attains the Sayujjya devotion of lord Acyuta. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.126.34-37 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*utkrāṃtikāle bhūtānāṃ muhyaṃti cittavṛttayaḥ \|*  
*jarāvyādhivihīnānāṃ kimuta vyādhidoṣiṇām \|\| 34 \|\|*

*atyaṃtavayasā dagdho vyādhinā copapīḍitaḥ \|*  
*yadi sthātuṃ na śaknoti kṣitistho darbhasaṃstare \|\| 35 \|\|*

*kimapyanyopyupāyo'sti na vānaśanakarmaṇi \|*  
*vaikalyaṃ yena nāpnoti tanme brūhi janārdana \|\| 36 \|\|*

*tvayoktaṃ bhagavandhyānaṃ tadbrūhi mama tattvataḥ \|*  
*dhyānasvarūpamakhilaṃ kathayasva janārdana \|\| 37 \|\|*

34-37. Yudhisthira said – At the time of the departing of the soul from the body, the mental state of some old and weak people becomes confused. Besides the persons suffering from diseases and old age who are unable to be seated over the kusa grass spread over the earth, is there any other method of their abstinence from food, by which one should not get disturbed? You kindly tell me. О Janardana, you have also discussed about meditation, what is the secret behind it? What is its form? You please tell me.

## \|\| 3.126.38-39 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*nātra bhūmirna ca kuśāḥ svāstarāśca na kāraṇam \|*  
*cittasyālaṃ vanībhūto viṣṇurevātra kāraṇam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tiṣṭhanbhuñjansvapangacchaṃstathā dhāvannitastataḥ \|*  
*utkrāṃtikāle govindaṃ saṃsmaraṃstanmayo bhavet \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – At the time of the departure of life from this body, lord Viṣṇu is the only refuge for the mind and the earth, kusa grass or the spreading of it has nothing to do with it. At that point of time, while seating, eating, sleeping, walking or running, the name of Govinda should be recited with devotion.

## \|\| 3.126.40-42 \|\|

*yaṃ yañcāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajanyante kalevaram \|*  
*taṃ tamevaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tasmātpradhānamaṃtroktaṃ vāsudevasya cintanam \|*  
*yadyatpṛṣṭaṃ tvayā dhyānaṃ tadeva kathayāmi te \|\| 41 \|\|*

*purā me kathitaṃ pārtha mārkaṃḍeyena dhīmatā \|\| 42 \|\|*

40-42. О son of Kunti, at the time of death, whatever thoughts overpower the mind of the person facing death, he achieves the same. Therefore, at the time of the departure of the soul from the body, one should think of lord Vasudeva alone. О Partha, whatever had been asked by you about meditation, I have spoken to you everything. In earlier times, Maharsi Markandeya had told me about the same.

## \|\| 3.126.43 \|\|

*rājyopabhogaśayanāsanavāhaneṣu strīgaṃdhamālyamaṇivastravibhūṣaṇeṣu \|*  
*icchābhilāṣamatimātramudeti mohāddhyānaṃ tadāttamiti saṃpravadaṃti tajjñāḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The mediation performing which a person develops a desire for getting asleep, the seat, a vehicle, a woman, scent, garland, gems, costumes and the ornaments, the same has been called as Moha-dhyana.

## \|\| 3.126.44 \|\|

*saṃchedanairdahanatāḍanapīḍanaiśca gātraprahāradamanairvinikartanaiśca \|*  
*yasyeha cetasi hi yāti na cānukaṃpā dhyānaṃ tu raudramiti tatpravadaṃti tajjñāḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. A person who develops a desire for cutting, burning, striking, to cause pain or torture, striking the body, suppression or making inactive like desires when develop in the mind but not the compassion, it is called Raudra-dhyana.

## \|\| 3.126.45 \|\|

*sūtrārthamārgaṇamahāvratabhāvanābhirbaṃdhapramokṣagatirāgatihetu cintā \|*  
*pañcendriyādyupaśamaśca śamaśca bhūterdhyānaṃ tu dharmyamiti tatpravadaṃti saṃtaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Searching for the meanings, the feelings of the learned people, to get redeemed from the worldly bondages and for the control of all the sense organs, such meditation is known as the Dharma-dhyana.

## \|\| 3.126.46 \|\|

*yasyendriyāṇi viṣayairna vivarjitāni saṅkalpanātmaja vikalpavikārayogaiḥ \|*  
*tatvekaniṣṭhahṛdayo nibhṛtāṃtarātmā dhyānaṃ tu śuklamiti tatpravadaṃti siddhāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. A person in meditation whose sense organs are freed from the worldly attractions, one who gets absorbed in vikara yoga or the one who is devoted to the tattva, such a state is known as Sukla-dhyana.

## \|\| 3.126.47 \|\|

*ādye tiryagadhogatiśca niyataṃ dhyāne tu raudre sadā dharmye devagatiḥ śubhaṃ phalamahośukle ca janmakṣayaḥ \|*  
*tasmājjanmarujāpahe hitatare saṃsāranirvāhake dhyāne śuklatare rajaḥpramathane kuryātprayatnaṃ budhaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\.
