29-30. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О son of Pandu, listening to the words of Maharsi Vasistha, the king Raghu, as per the advice of the sage, performed all the activities in an appropriate manner, as a result of which the demoness was killed. Since that time, she came to be known by the name of Adada.

## \|\| 3.132.31 \|\|

*sarvaduṣṭāpaho homaḥ sarvarogopaśāṃtidaḥ \|*  
*kriyate'syāṃ dvijaiḥ pārtha tena sā holikā matā \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. On the same full moon day, the Brahmanas perform homa for the removal of all the ailments and destruction of the wicked people. Because of this reason, she is also called as Holika.

## \|\| 3.132.32-34 \|\|

*sarvasārātiviśveyaṃ pūrvamāsīdyudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*sāratvātphalgurityeṣā paramānaṃdadāyinī \|\| 32 \|\|*

*asyāṃ niśāgame pārtha saṃrakṣyāḥ śiśavo gṛhe \|*  
*gomayenopasaṃlipte sacatuṣke gṛhāṃgaṇe \|\| 33 \|\|*

*ākārayecchiśuprāyānkhaḍgavyagra karānnarān \|*  
*te kāṣṭhakhaṇḍaiḥ saṃspṛśya gītairhāsyakaraiḥ śiśūn \|*  
*rakṣaṃti teṣāṃ dātavyaṃ guḍaṃ pakvānnameva ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. О Yudhisthira, in earlier times, because of the terrifying of the entire world, the entire essence was lodged in it. But in spite of having the gist of everything, it became infructuous, this bestows the supreme bliss. On that particular day in the evening time, it is essential to protect the children in the home. The courtyard of the house should be plastered with the cowdung, then the figure of a boy holding a sword should be placed over a pedestal, which should protect the boys with the mere touch of the pieces of wood. The boys should be served with jaggery and other eatables.

## \|\| 3.132.35 \|\|

*evaṃ ḍhauṃḍhitamātrasya sa doṣaḥ praśamaṃ vrajet \|*  
*bālānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tasyāttasminniśāgame \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. By so doing, the pain caused by the demoness Dhaundha is subsided. Therefore, the children must be protected on that particular day.

## \|\| 3.132.36 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*prabhāte kiñjanairdeva kartavyaṃ sukhamīpsubhiḥ \|*  
*pravṛtte mādhave māsi pratipadbhāskarodaye \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Yudhisthira said – О Madhava, on the first moon day of the month of Caitra, what should be done by the people desirous of the comforts?

## \|\| 3.132.37-46 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*kṛtvā cāvaśyakāryāṇi saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ \|*  
*vaṃdayeddholikābhūtiṃ sarvaduṣṭopaśāṃtaye \|\| 37 \|\|*

*maṃḍite carcite caiva upalipte gṛhājire \|*  
*catuṣkaṃ kārayecchreṣṭhaṃ varṇakaiścākṣataiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tanmadhye sthāpayetpīṭhaṃ śuklavastrottara cchadam \|*  
*agrataḥ pūrṇakalaśaṃ sthāpayetpallavairyutam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*sākṣataṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca sitacandanacarcitam \|*  
*kalaśasyāgrato deyā upānahavarāṃśukāḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*āsane copaviṣṭasya brahmaghoṣeṇa bhārata \|*  
*carcayeccandanaṃ nārī avyaṃgāṃgā sulakṣaṇā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*padmarāgottarapaṭā śreṣṭhāṃśukavibhūṣitā \|*  
*vasudhārāṃ śirogre ca dadhidūrvākṣatānvitām \|\| 42 \|\|*

*carcāpayitvā śrīkhaṃḍamāyurārogyavṛddhaye \|*  
*paścācca prāśayedvidvāṃścūtapuṣpaṃ sacaṃdanam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*manobhavasya sā pūjā ṛṣibhiḥ saṃpradarśitā \|*  
*ye pibaṃti vasaṃtādau cūtapuṣpaṃ sacandanam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*satyaṃ hṛdisthakāmasya tatpūrtirjāyateñjasā \|*  
*anaṃtaraṃ dvijendrāṇāṃ sūtamāgadhabaṃdinām \|\| 45 \|\|*

*dadyāddānaṃ yathāśaktyā kāmo me prīyatāmiti \|*  
*tato bhojanavelāyāṃ śṛtaṃ yatprāktane'hani \|\| 46 \|\|*

37-46. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – After performing of the oblation for the gods and the manes and getting relieved of all the essential works, for pacifying of the evil people the dust of Holika should be adored. Then a beautiful pedestal should be made in the middle of the courtyard dropping the unbroken rice over it. A pithasthana should be made in the middle of it. The ground should be covered with a white cloth. A pitcher with water should be placed over it. It should be adorned with gold, unbroken rice and white sandal paste. О Bharata, thereafter, in the front of the pitcher, along with the footwear as well as the five clothes, a beautiful lady possessing all the auspicious symbols, should apply sandal paste over the person seated there uttering the hymns of the Vedas. He should be adorned with the gems like lapiz lazuli and should be clad in red garments. Thereafter, the curd, durva grass and unbroken rice should be touched on the five parts of the head for the increase in health and the age. Srikhanda should also be used for the purpose. Thereafter, the mango shoots should be offered to a learned person, because according to the ascetics, it amounts to the worship of Kamadeva. According to them, at the start of the spring season, the mango shoots with the sandal paste when consumed by a person, the desires of his heart are certainly fulfilled. Saying – “Let the god of love be pleased with me, charities should be given over to Brahmanas, the Sutas, the bards as per one's means. At the time of taking food, one should take a little of it, which was cooked earlier in the day.

## \|\| 3.132.47-48 \|\|

*prāśnīyātprathamaṃ cānnaṃ tato bhuñjīta kāmataḥ \|*  
*ya evaṃ kurute pārtha śāstroktaṃ phālgunotsavam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*anāyāsena sidhyaṃti tasya sarve manorathāḥ \|*  
*ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva yāṃti nāśaṃ na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. Thereafter, one should take the food of one’s own liking. О Partha, the scriptural festival of the month of Phalguna when performed by a person, all his desires get fulfilled without much efforts. The physical and the mental agonies get removed. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.132.49-50 \|\|

*putrapautrasamāyuktaḥ sukhaṃ tiṣṭhati mānavaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*puṇyā pavitrā jayadā sarvavighravināśinī \|*  
*eṣā te kathitā pārtha tithīnāmuttamā tithiḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

49-50. The person (who performs this vrata), together with his sons and the grandsons, enjoys the life with comfort. О Partha, thus I have narrated to you the glory of the auspicious full moon day.

## \|\| 3.132.51 \|\|

*vṛtte tuṣārasamaye sitapañcadaśyāṃ prātarvasantasamaye samupasthite ca \|*  
*saṃprāśya cūtakusumaṃ saha candanena satyaṃ hi pārtha puruṣaḥ sa sukhī samāste \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. At the end of the winter season, on the arrival of the full moon day, on the occasion of Holi and on the day next to it, one who breaks the fast with curd and mango shoots, he always remains happy.

## Chapter 133. Enjoying swings of the cradle

## \|\| 3.133.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*saṃtyajyālikulālīḍhakusumāni mṛdūnyapi \|*  
*damanena kathaṃ lokaiḥ pūjyaṃte nākanāyakāḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*dolāṃdolanamāhātmyaṃ rathayātrāmahotsavam \|*  
*kathayasvāmalaṃ prājña yādavāṃbhojabhāskara \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said — О lotus of the Yadu race, О intelligent one, the black-wasps are always eager to suck the nectar of flowers, why do the people adore the leader of the heaven with flowers kept in leaf cups? What is the glory attached to the enjoying of the swing in cradle? What is the glory of the Ratha-yatra festival, you kindly let me know.

## \|\| 3.133.3-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*pārthārthijanasadvṛkṣa kṣāṃtidhāma dharāpate \|*  
*yadetadbhavatā pṛṣṭaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva vadāmi te \|\| 3 \|\|*

*purā surāṇāmāvāse maṃdare cārukaṃdare \|*  
*gandhādhārī kulālīḍho jāto damanakastaruḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tasya gaṃdhamanāghreyamāghrāya surayoṣitaḥ \|*  
*madanonmādavaśagā gāyaṃti ca hasaṃti ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

*ṛṣayo niyamāṃstyaktvā prādravaṃta gṛhānprati \|*  
*na vedādhyayane dhyāne ratisteṣāṃ babhūva ha \|\| 6 \|\|*

3-6. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О lord of the earth, whatever has been asked by you, I am going to reply the same, you please listen. In earlier times, in the ancient cave of the Mandaracala mountain which had been quite charming, a tree named Damana was grown, which is the prominent place for sucking the nectar from its flowers by the black-wasps. With smelling of the fragrance, the damsels of the gods become lustful and start singing and laughing. Discarding their own rules, the Ṛṣis started rushing towards their own abodes. At that point of time, they were neither inclined in the study of the Vedas nor in the meditation of the Supreme Being.

## \|\| 3.133.7-8 \|\|

*aparādhādvighaṭitaṃ yadbabhūva priye param \|*  
*mānasaṃ māninīnāṃ tu punargaṃdhena saṃdhitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*gaṃdhenākulitaṃ lokaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā tamabravīt \|*  
*śamanirmitayā vācā roṣātprasphuritādharaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. The damsels who had been detached from their own beloved ones forever, with the effect of the fragrance, the love for their husbands was again culminated in their minds. Finding that the entire universe had become restless' because of that fragrance, Brahma, though feeling enraged within, but spoke very cleverly.

## \|\| 3.133.9-13 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*jātastvaṃ lokadamanānnūnaṃ damanako mayā \|*  
*jagadvā ghūrṇase kasmātkarma naitattavocitam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*yatsaṃtastvanumanyaṃte sarvā tiśayavarjitam \|*  
*tatseveta naraḥ karma yatrodvego na dhīmatām \|\| 10 \|\|*

*ekasyāpyapakāraṃ yaḥ karoti sa narādhamaḥ \|*  
*bahūnāmapakārāya sapravṛtaḥ kimucyate \|\| 11 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭārthabādhakaṃ karma na kartavyaṃ kathaṃcana \|*  
*adṛṣṭaṃ prati saṃdehaḥ sosmābhiranumīyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tataḥ svayaṃ prabhajati daive pitrye ca karmaṇi \|*  
*bhogārthe ca tribhuvananirādeyo bhaviṣyati \|\| 13 \|\|*

9-13. Brahma said – You have been born of me simply to suppress the lokas. What for are you making the entire world to suffer? This type of activity would not be proper for you. Only such a person is respected by the noble people, who getting free from excellences, act in a way which suites the common man and his activity does not cause any disturbance to the learned people. This is because, a person who commits evil even once, he is known as a degraded person and a person who is engaged in doing evil of many people, what can be spoken of him? Therefore, one should not indulge into the useless activities. Similarly, one should not develop doubt against an unknown person, because this is acceptable to us in the same way. Therefore, from today onwards, you would be self-born and you would be despised in the spiritual and manes activities.

## \|\| 3.133.14-16 \|\|

*damanaka uvāca \|*  
*puruṣādevamārabdhaṃ na krodhānnārthakāra ṇāt \|*  
*svabhāva eṣa me brahmaṃstvayā sṛṣṭaḥ purā vibho \|\| 14 \|\|*

*yā yasya jaṃtoḥ prakṛtiḥ śubhā vā yadi vetarā \|*  
*sa tasyāmeva ramate duṣkṛte sukṛte tathā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tatsvabhāvapravṛttasya yadi śāpastvayā mama \|*  
*pradattaḥ kiṃ karomyetanna kṛtyamaparādhyati \|' \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. Damanaka said – О lord, I have done so because of my own efforts and not due to anger, because it is you, who made my nature like this. Whatever the good or bad qualities are possessed by a person, he acts accordingly. Therefore, according to my own nature, when I acted like this and have earned a curse from you, then what should be done by me? In this case, I am not at all to be blamed.

## \|\| 3.133.17-21 \|\|

*yuktiyuktaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā damanena samī ritam \|*  
*prītātmā padmajaḥ prāha karomi tava satpriyam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*vasaṃte sahakārotthamaṃjarīpiṃjare jane \|*  
*puṣpitāśokaśobhāḍhye vane puṃskokilā kule \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tasminkāle sureśānāṃ śirāṃsyākramya līlayā \|*  
*sthāsyasi tvaṃ dinaṃ caikaṃ yadyasya vihitaṃ hitam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ye tvāmāropayiṣyaṃti dānamānapurassarāḥ \|*  
*surāṇāṃ te bhaviṣyaṃti sadaiva sukhino narāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*sarvadaiva śivasyeṣṭā puṇyā pāpabhayāpahā \|*  
*prasiddhiṃ yāsyati madhau damanākhyā caturdaśī \|\| 21 \|\|*

17-21. Listening to the reasonable words of Damanaka which were quite convening, the lotus born Brahma said to him – “I am extremely pleased with you, therefore I am going to perform an excellent and favourite task for you. At the time of the spring season, when the mango trees develop the fresh shoots and when the fragrance of flowering Asoka trees will spread in the forests and when the cuckoo would issue sweet sound, at that time, you will do pleasure act at the palace of Indra. All people will worship lord Siva on the day of caturdasi in the month of Magha, which will be known by Damana caturdasi. By performing all acts of charity and respect, the perfomer shall enjoy everlasting pleasures in the loka of Devas.

## \|\| 3.133.22-23 \|\|

*evamuktvā yayau brahmā damano maṃdare girau \|*  
*uvāsa vāsitāśeṣabhuvano gaṃdhasampadā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*divye girau girisu tādayitādhivāse ratnāṃśukacchuritakāñcanabhūmibhāge \|*  
*śāpaṃ varaṃ ca hṛdaye viniveśya śaṃbhostatrāsthito damanako damitāṃtarātmā \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Thus speaking to Damanaka at Mandara mountain, Brahma went away from that place. Because of the curse as well as the boon granted by Brahma, while receiving all the flagrant riches of the three worlds, along with gems, gold and auspicious land, Damanaka still shines in the heart of lord Siva on the divine mountain of Mandardcala.

## \|\| 3.133.24-28 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*dharmarāja nibodhedamāṃdolakamahotsavam \|*  
*pravṛttanaranārīkaṃ pañcamoccārasundaram \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sānaṃdaṃ naṃdanavane ārdrayā sahito yathā \|*  
*vismayasmeranayano babhrāmodvāṃtasaurabhaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*unmādayanvane puṇye vidyādharagaṇānbahūn \|*  
*vasaṃtartau nṛtyamānānmurāsuraśatārcitaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*saṃtānapārijātotthāṃ baddhvā sa mādhavīlatām \|*  
*kaścidāṃdolanaṃ cakre samāliṃgya ghanastanīm \|\| 27 \|\|*

*gītamāṃdolakārūḍhastadgāyaṃtyamara striyaḥ \|*  
*yena cotpādayaṃti sma manmathasyāpi manmatham \|\| 28 \|\|*

24-28. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – I am going to speak to you about the Hindola festival, which is celebrated by both the men and women. It is being celebrated pleasantly along with Ardra in the Nandana forest, for enjoying the delight, visualizing with surprised eyes, spreading the fragrance like Dayanvana and roams about in all the four directions. You please listen. During the spring season, he is respected by most of the Vidyadharas, getting them intoxicated, making hundreds of demons and the gods to dance at the same time. The swing Hindola is bound with the branches of a Kalpavrksa with the Madhavi creeper. Someone sitting over the Hindola sing, embracing his spouse with stiff breasts and started swinging. Besides the divine damsels who had been seated over the swing, started singing the songs, hearing which even Kamadeva – the god of love, felt lustful at heart.

## \|\| 3.133.29-30 \|\|

*taṃ dṛṣṭvāṣṭāpadanibhā bhavānī prāha śaṃkaram \|*  
*kautukaṃ me samutpannaṃ paśyemāḥ śaṃkara prabho \|\| 29 \|\|*

*ādolakaṃ mama kṛte kārayasva svalaṃkṛtam \|*  
*tvayā sahāṃdolayeyaṃ yathā caite trilocana \|\| 30 \|\|*

29-30. Observing that, Parvati of golden complexion said to lord Siva- “O lord Sankara, look at these damsels. Looking at them, I also feel fascinated. Therefore, you kindly arrange for the making of a beautiful Hindola swing for my use, which should be well decorated. О lord with three eyes, I also intend to enjoy the ride of the swing like these damsels.”

## \|\| 3.133.31-33 \|\|

*tadgaurīvacanaṃ ramyaṃ śrutvā govṛṣabhadhvajaḥ \|*  
*saddolāṃ kārayāmāsa samāhūya mahāsurān \|\| 31 \|\|*

*staṃbhadvayaṃ ropayitvā iṣṭāpūrtamayaṃ dṛḍham \|*  
*satyaṃ caivoparitataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭhamakalpayat \|\| 32 \|\|*

*vāsukiṃ daṃḍakasthāne baddhvā tāṃtavasaprabham \|*  
*tatphaṇāmaṃtarāpīṭhaṃ kṛtavānmaṇimaṃḍitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. Listening to the words of Gauri, the bull-bannered Siva summoned the gods and got a beautiful swing made for the use of Parvati. Two poles were erected which were as hard as the bricks. Satya was used as the wood, while Vasuki was used as the rope and it was bound at the place of Dandaka. The hoods were made use of as the swings. It was decorated with the gems and the beads.

## \|\| 3.133.34-35 \|\|

*kṛmikārpāsakauśeyavastraiḥ saṃveṣṭitaṃ navaiḥ \|*  
*sragdāmālaṃbitaprāṃtamaṇimauktikaśekharam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*racayitvā vicitrāṃ tāṃ dolāṃ cailājinottarām \|*  
*sa siddhāṃ siddhagurave gauraveṇa nyavedayat \|\| 35 \|\|*

34-35. It was curtained with the cotton as well as the silken cloth. Both the parts of it were decorated with long garlands and the top of it was decorated with gems and beads. It was decorated with the deer skin. The unique swing or Hindola resembled the supreme siddhis, which was dedicated to Siva – the lord of the Siddhas.

## \|\| 3.133.36-39 \|\|

*tatrārūḍhastu yāvatsa saumyasomavibhūṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*maṃdaraṃ dolayāmāsa pārśvasthaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ saha \|\| 36 \|\|*

*vāmapārśve tu vijayā dakṣiṇena jayā bhavet \|*  
*cāmarākrāṃtabāhū te tenāśliṣṭe nyavījatām \|\| 37 \|\|*

*ādolayaṃtyā pārvatyā sahitaṃ sa gadākṣaram \|*  
*yena devāsurastraiṇamāsīdānaṃdanirbharam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*jagurgaṃdharvapatayo nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ \|*  
*ucchalattālavādyāni vādayaṃti sma cāraṇāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

36-39. As soon as lord Siva with his attendants were seated over it with comfort, it started moving in swings with Siva and Parvati. Parvati was seated to the left of Siva, while Vijaya was on the left and Jaya on the right holding the flywhisks in both the hands and served both of them. Lord Siva, who happens to be the creator of the gods and the asuras, while swinging with Parvati, felt extremely blissful. The Gandharvas started singing before them, while the Apsaras started dancing. The Caranas were clapping the hands with the musical tunes.

## \|\| 3.133.40-42 \|\|

*celuḥ kulācalāḥ sarve cukṣubhuḥ sapta sāgarāḥ \|*  
*vavurvātāḥ sanirghātā deve dolāṃ samāsthite \|\| 40 \|\|*

*ālokya vyākulaṃ lokaṃ devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ \|*  
*upetya praṇipatyocuḥ sarvapāpaharaṃ param \|\| 41 \|\|*

*upāramasva bhagavanbhavataḥ krīḍayānayā \|*  
*jagadvyāpadyate deve calitaḥ sāgaraśca yat \|\| 42 \|\|*

40-42. When lord Siva was so enjoying the swing, the mountains started shaking, the waves of the seven oceans started striking with one another. The ocean started overflowing rising in the sky with the wind and then again fell down on earth. The wind then started blowing with force. Finding that the world had been disturbed, all the gods stood before Siva and offered their salutation to him. Thereafter, they begged from lord Siva – “O lord, with your sport, the ocean has been in fermentation. The entire universe has become lifeless. Therefore, you kindly put a stop to it.”

## \|\| 3.133.43 \|\|

*gīrvāṇagīrbhiḥ saṃhṛṣṭaḥ śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*samutpapāta dolātaḥ praharṣotphullalocanaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. With the prayer offered by the gods in chaste speech, lord Siva getting pleased, expressed enormous delight with his vast eyes and got down from the swing.

## \|\| 3.133.44 \|\|

*uvāca vacanaṃ pārtha surasārthasya paśyataḥ \|*  
*sānukaṃpaṃ sulalitaṃ visphuṭārthapadākṣaram \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. О Partha, taking into consideration the welfare of the gods, lord Siva gracefully spoke to them in clear voice.

## \|\| 3.133.45-50 \|\|

*śrīmahādeva uvāca \|*  
*adya prabhṛti ye dolākrīḍāṃ puṣkariṇītaṭe \|*  
*vasaṃte kārayiṣyaṃti maṃḍite tridaśāṃgaṇe \|\| 45 \|\|*

*netrapaṭṭāpaṭacchannāṃ padmarāgavibhūṣi tām \|*  
*ātapatreṇa saṃyuktāṃ vinyastakanakāṃḍakām \|\| 46 \|\|*

*vicitrābharaṇābhābhirābhāsitadigaṃtarām \|*  
*tārakāśāṃtacitrāṃgapuṣpamālāmanora mām \|\| 47 \|\|*

*mālāṃ vidyādharākrātāṃ prāṃtaropitadarpaṇām \|*  
*chatracāmarasaṃchannāṃ yathā śaktyāpyalaṃkṛtām \|\| 48 \|\|*

*agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kṣiptvā caiva diśāṃ balim \|*  
*tasyāmāropayeddevamiṣṭahṛṣṭajanāvṛtaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*mūlamaṃtreṇa devānāṃ proktaṃ dolādhirohaṇam \|*  
*pārśvastho brāhmaṇo vidvānpaṭhedvā maṃtramuttamam \|\| 50 \|\|*

45-50. Lord Mahadeva said – From today onwards, in the courtyard of the temples located over the banks of the lotus tanks, the swing would be made with fine clothes, decorated with the gems like lapiz lazuli and the umbrella with rods of gold. It should further be decorated with surprising steps of ornaments, issuing the wavering lustre. The stars should also be shown therein, besides the garlands of red flowers. The images of Vidyadharas decorated with flowers should also be placed there in the swing. The umbrella and the flywhisks should also be placed therewith mirrors. Then homa offerings should be made to the Dikpalas, one should be seated over the swing with family and friends with the uttering of the Vedic hymns. The gods should also be placed in the swing. At that point of time, the Brāhmaṇas should engage themselves in the reciting of the Vedas.

## \|\| 3.133.51-54 \|\|

*gaṃbhīrāṃtaranirghoṣairlalanānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ \|*  
*stutimaṃgalaśabdaiśca puṣpadhūpādhivāsitām \|\| 51 \|\|*

*etasminnantare nārīṃ dohanāya nikuṭṭakām \|*  
*praveśayetkuṃkumāḍhyāṃ krīḍāvarṇapriyaiḥ saha \|\| 52 \|\|*

*suvarṇaśṛṃgiṇā proktaṃ smitadaṃtāṃśukarburam \|*  
*lagamānaṃ jalaṃ cāṃge kasya na syātsukhapradam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*jalasaṃklinnavasano raśanādāmamaṃḍitaḥ \|*  
*kambugrīvollasansarvo babhūva gaṇikāgaṇaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

51-54. Deep sounds should be produced from the playing of the musical instruments, the beautiful damsels should keep on singing, besides the offering of the prayers as well as the welfare songs should be sung. Thereafter, offering of the flowers and incenses should be used to make it fragrant, the images of the men and women should be decorated there, adorned with the vermilion. Suvarnashringi has said that at the smiling face of a damsel, the shine of the tooth covered with gold delighted all, when it fell over their limbs. All the concubines there should be clad in drenched clothes, with waistband and the necks like the conches.

## \|\| 3.133.55-58 \|\|

*kuṃkumakṣodatāṃbūlapuṣpa mālākulo janaḥ \|*  
*tāṃ vihāya jalakrīḍāṃ nānyasyāṃ vidadhe manaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*pītaśītajalāghāta tāḍito'pi janaḥ sukham \|*  
*manyate niyataḥ kopi prabhāvo'yamanaṃgajaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*evaṃ ye tu gamiṣyaṃti narā vartmatayā gatam \|*  
*nīrujaste bhaviṣyaṃti sukhitāḥ śaradāṃ śatam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*putrapautrasamā yuktā dhanadhānyasamāyutāḥ \|*  
*vihṛtya sukhasaṃpattau tato yāsyaṃti matpuram \|\| 58 \|\|*

55-58. Having been adorned with vermilion, walnut, betel and the flower garlands, the swings are used by men, the men would not be interested in anything else except the indulging in water sport. The strikes of the yellow cool water are enjoyed by the men most. This is the similar influence of Kamadeva. Therefore, those who travel over the traditional path, spend hundreds of comfortable life. Thereafter, with their sons and grandsons, enjoying all the pleasures and comforts, they reach my place.

## \|\| 3.133.59 \|\|

*prāpte vasaṃtasamaye surasattamānāmāndolanaṃ suravarānanukurvate ye \|*  
*te prāpnuvaṃti bhuvi janmataroḥ phalāni duḥkhārṇavātkulaśatānyapi tārayaṃti \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Thus during the spring season, a person who offers in charity a well decorated swing, makes his life successful on earth and redeem hundreds of his generations from the ocean of the universe.

## Chapter 134. The Ratha-yatra

## \|\| 3.134.1-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*rathayātrāvidhānaṃ te katha yāmi yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*sthiro bhūtvā nibodhedaṃ tvaṃ hi mūrtavidāṃ varaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*caitre trinetrasaṃbhūtamalayākhyamahāgirau \|*  
*pravahatpavanadhvānapreṃkholitalatācaye \|\| 2 \|\|*

*etasminneva kāle tu bhramamāṇo yadṛcchayā \|*  
*nāradaḥ śāradākāṃtācchivaloke samāyayau \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvāpūrvaṃ śivaṃ śāṃtaṃ sureśaiḥ sarvato vṛtam \|*  
*praṇamyopāviśadvipraḥ purataḥ keśaveśayoḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tamupāsīnamālakṣya bhagavānbhaganetrahā \|*  
*papracchācchāditamanāḥ kutaścāgamyate punaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О Yudhisthira, you are the excellent one, therefore, I am going to speak to you about the car festival or the Ratha-yatra. You listen to me quite carefully. During the month of Caitra over the Malayacala mountain created by lord Siva, there were a large number of creepers grown there. Listening to the pleasant sound of the blowing of the wind, they started sprouting. A t that point of time, in the abode of Viṣṇu — the lord of Sarada, while roaming about in the world, Narada arrived there. He found lord Siva extremely peaceful surrounded by the gods, where Viṣṇu was seated facing Siva. Finding both of them so seated, lord Siva asked in a casual manner to Narada – “Where from are you coming?”

## \|\| 3.134.6-9 \|\|

*śrīnārada uvāca \|*  
*śiva kāmaṃ ca taṃ viddhi dagdhaṃ mā vibudhottama \|*  
*vasaṃto nāma ko'pyeṣa kāmasya dayitaḥ sakhā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*malayānilayuktena tena viśvaṃ vaśīkṛtam \|*  
*sahakārakarīndrasthaṃ kṛtvā kokilaḍiṃḍimam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*poṣayāmāsa vijayaṃ manmathasya purepure \|*  
*śaśāṃkaśekharaḥ ko'yaṃ koyaṃ śaṃkhagadādharaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*koyaṃ ca ḍimbo vā brahmā kāmastrijagatāṃ prabhuḥ \|*  
*prāyaḥ krīḍāratirloko vasaṃtavacanātpunaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

6-9. Śrī Nārada said – О Siva, the best of the gods, don’t think that it has been finished by your burning it, because with his intimate friend the Windgod, the Malaya Maruta is exercising his control over the entire universe. Seated over the mango trees, serving him as the elephants, the cuckoo is making announcement in every city that Kamadeva has become victorious everywhere. Therefore, Siva with his head adorned with the crescent, Brahma as a child, while Viṣṇu carrying the cakra are therefore of no consequence. It is immaterial to know as to who lives where? Because Kamadeva has been exercising his control over all the three lokas. Again at the command of Vasanta, all the lokas are engaged in love sports.

## \|\| 3.134.10-13 \|\|

*ūrdhvabāhustu narnarti tāladattapadakramaḥ \|*  
*vyavasāyaṃ na gacchaṃti ye saṃhṛtya vanāṃtaram \|\| 10 \|\|*

*gāyaṃtaśca parīhṛṣṭāste cāpyāyāṃti yāṃti ca \|*  
*gopyasīmāṃtaragatāḥ kṣetrasthānasya rakṣiṇaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*te'pi gāyaṃti nṛtyaṃti hasaṃti smaratārakāḥ \|*  
*karasya tāḍane'tyarthaṃ murajo dhurdharāyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

*viṭaṃ paśyaṃti kulaṭāḥ prārabdhocitapaṇḍitāḥ \|*  
*sumanāṃsi susaṃgītanṛtyavādyasuvāditam \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. All the people raising their arms are clapping their hands, besides dancing raising their feet. Those who never indulged in any activity, they are also engaged in singing and are moving to and fro. The guards of the fields who always guarded the fields alone, they also are laughing and dancing, having been overpowered with lust. They getting beaten with palm are raising beautiful sound. By achieving adequate success in their jobs initially, the whores are looking towards the dancing people with passionate eyes, who delighted others with excellent dances.

## \|\| 3.134.14-15 \|\|

*evametattriloke'sminniti vyavasito janaḥ \|*  
*lalallambastanīṃ dṛṣṭvā jarā yoṣāpi nṛtyati \|\| 14 \|\|*

*vasaṃtasya prabhāvo'yaṃ ko'pyapūrvo vijṛṃbhate \|*  
*sarāṃsyadbhutapadmāni praphullā puṣpavāṭikāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Similarly, in all the three worlds, all the people have been overpowered with passion. Even the old ladies, with long breasts, are dancing finding the young damsels with developed breasts, getting engaged in dance. Thus the influence of the spring season is spreading everywhere. The lotus flowers of the tanks are blossoming, displaying themselves strangely. The orchards are looking charming with the blossoming flowers.

## \|\| 3.134.16-21 \|\|

*vṛkṣāḥ pakṣiśatākīrṇā vijighrāṇamukhāḥ surāḥ \|*  
*vikaṃpavasanāvālaḥ pavanastriguṇātmakaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*kṛtaḥ pratyakṣasumahānvasaṃto na jagattraye \|*  
*avajalpamukhā bālā vṛddhāstu vikaladvijāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*ubhāvapi pratapyete paśyedaṃ kāmaceṣṭitam \|*  
*pakṣiṇāṃ pakṣanikṣepairnadyastuṃgataraṃgakaiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*pādapāḥ pallavaśatairnṛtyaṃte ca praharṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ nāradasyenduśekharaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*kautukākulitaḥ śīghramāruroha rathaṃ svakam \|*  
*rathena kāñcanāṃgena patatrivaraketanaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*prayayau puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ \|*  
*pārāvatapratīkāśaṃ caturvedamayaṃ ratham \|\| 21 \|\|*

16-21. The trees are decorated with hundreds of birds, which are enjoying variously. The gods appear to be in search of fragrance, raising their heads. The wind possessing the fragrance, coolness and also moving, is flowing everywhere. Thus, the spring season has created a great disturbance in the three worlds. The damsels, becoming extremely lustful, are keeping silent. The boys are also keeping mum. The old people are becoming anxious. Therefore, because of the activities of Kamadeva, all are suffering. The birds are fluttering their wings. The high waves can be seen in the rivers. Fresh shoots are sprouting in the trees, delighting them at the same time. Listening to the words of Narada, Lord Siva mounting his chariot, in anxiety, accompanied with the lotus-eyed Viṣṇu - the carrier of the conch, disc and club who was mounted over the chariot with its flag embossed with Garuda which was shining like the gold, started together.

## \|\| 3.134.22-23 \|\|

*āsthāya prayayau hṛṣṭo brahmā brāhmaṇasaṃstutaḥ \|*  
*munibhiścāpsarobhiśca yakṣarakṣomahoragaiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vṛto rathena prayayau bhāskaro vāritaskaraḥ \|*  
*śailajorupatākena rathenādityavarcasā \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Brahma on the other hand was seated over his chariot resembling a pigeon, who was being praised (by the devotees) and performed the journey with delight. Bhaskara - the water thief, also travelled in his chariot filled with sages, Apsaras, Yaksas, Raksasas and the great serpents.

## \|\| 3.134.24-26 \|\|

*kātyāyanī pracalitā pañcavaktreṇa ketunā \|*  
*laṃbodaraḥ karaśatagṛhītakanakotpalaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*prayātaḥ svarathārūḍhaḥ kṛtakarṇakulākulaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ devaḥ parivṛto bhagavāngovṛṣadhvajaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*rathārūḍhairamūḍhātmā martyalokamavātarat \|*  
*yāvatpaśyati deveśastāvatsarvaṃ tadakṣaram \|\| 26 \|\|*

24-26. With her five-faced banner, Parvati was seated in her chariot as Katyayani, holding hundreds of lotus flowers in her hands, with Lambodara seated in her chariot. The sound so produced from the chariot disturbed the years. All of them then started the journey. Thus, lord Siva — the bull-bannered one, together with other gods, mounted over their respective chariots, reached on earth and glanced on all the sides, when the words spoken to him by Narada appeared as totally true. He came face to face with the reality.

## \|\| 3.134.27-31 \|\|

*nāradena yathaivoktastāvatsarvaṃ tadakṣaram \|*  
*nāradena yathaivoktaṃ jagadānandanirbharam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*devaiḥ sārddhaṃ paśupatiryāvatpaśyati vismitaḥ \|*  
*tāvattasyaiva hi gaṇāḥ parabrahmasamaṃjasam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*gāyaṃti kecitsotkaṃṭhaṃ luṭhaṃtyanye praharṣitāḥ \|*  
*vādayaṃtyapare tuṣṭā jahasuḥ kecidulbaṇam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*vādayaṃtyanyathā vādyaṃ gāyaṃtyanyenyathā gaṇāḥ \|*  
*anyenyathā pranṛtyaṃti citraṃ caitrasya ceṣṭitam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*nīlotpalābhanayanairvilasatprāṃtatārakaiḥ \|*  
*krīḍāratibhirārabdhamālāpaiśca surairapi \|\| 31 \|\|*

27-31. Narada had said that the entire world was feeling delightful observing lord Pasupati with all the gods. At the same time, the ganas of Siva were also overpowered with the blissful delight. Some one of them started singing getting overpowered with the bliss. Some one of them started rolling on the ground in delight, while others started laughing aloud. Overpowered with the spring season, all the ganas started singing in a reverse manner, besides dancing and playing on the musical instruments. On the other hand, the gods with their beautiful rolling blue eyes, were also engaged in the dancing and singing.

## \|\| 3.134.32-37 \|\|

*surāṇāṃ kṣobhamālakṣya bhagavāngovṛṣadhvajaḥ \|*  
*cintayāmāsa sumahānkāryayogo hyupasthitaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*anarthamutthitaṃ tadvattadvighātāya ye janāḥ \|*  
*nayaṃte ye'timūrkhatvādāpado'bhibhavaṃti tān \|\| 33 \|\|*

*vasaṃtaḥ svāmibhaktatvānmānyapuṣpākaraṃ yadā \|*  
*unmādāḍhyajano rakṣyaḥ kāryaṃ kāryadvayaṃ mama \|\| 34 \|\|*

*saṃciṃtyaivaṃ samānāyya vasaṃtaṃ prāha śaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*samānīto māsamekaṃ sthātavyaṃ bhavatā tviha \|\| 35 \|\|*

*sitapakṣaḥ sahāyo'yaṃ sarvabhūtasukhapradaḥ \|*  
*bhavatyatimahānando viśeṣeṇa divaukasām \|\| 36 \|\|*

*yo yathā rathamārūḍhaḥ samāyātaḥ samīkṣitum \|*  
*varṣevarṣe sa tenaiva saṃsthānenāgamiṣyati \|\| 37 \|\|*

32-37. Thus observing that even the gods were influenced by the spring season, the bull- bannered lord Siva, feeling concerned about the situation, thought that a unique situation had arisen. Because with the appearing of such an ugly situation, those who try to use force to overcome the said situation, they have to face the calamities due to foolishness, which ultimately uproot them. “Therefore, I have to face two situations presently. (I have to try that) firstly, the spring season should be filled with flowers and fragrance, while the intoxicated people should also be protected at the same time.” With this resolve, lord Siva summoned the spring season gracefully and said to her – “During the dark as well as the bright fortnights you will enjoy the same position. The bright fortnight which provides comforts to all, shall help you. The gods should particularly feel delighted in the same. Presently, all the gods, who have arrived here in their respective chariots, they would arrive every year and participate in this festival.

## \|\| 3.134.38-39 \|\|

*kārayiṣyanti ye martyā rathayātrāmahotsavam \|*  
*te divyabhogabhoktāro bhaviṣyanti nirāmayāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*evamābhāṣya bhagavānvasaṃtaṃ ca tataḥ suraiḥ \|*  
*saṃstuto'tha nataścāpi svasthānamagamattataḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Therefore, such of the people of the earth who would participate in this festival, they remaining healthy, shall always enjoy the divine pleasures.” Thus speaking to the spring season, lord Siva after getting adored by the gods with humility, along with all others retired to their respective places.

## \|\| 3.134.40 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*rathaḥ kimātmakaḥ kāryaḥ kāryā yātrā kathaṃ bhavet \|*  
*āropayetkathaṃ devānrathe vada jagatpate \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Yudhisthira said – What would be the material to be used in the making of the chariot? How should the yatra. be performed? How should the deity be lodged in the chariot? You kindly enlighten me on all these points.

## \|\| 3.134.41-43 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*suvicitraṃ citratanuṃ śreṣṭhakāṣṭhamayaṃ ratham \|*  
*sudṛḍhākṣaṃ dṛḍhābaṃdhaṃ sucakrarathakūbaram \|\| 41 \|\|*

*atha vā vaṃśavihitaṃ netrapaṭṭapaṭāvṛtam \|*  
*tārakāśatacitrāṃśaṃ puṣpamālāvibhūṣitam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*sitagoyugasaṃyuktaṃ pañcabāṇapatākinam \|*  
*chatracāmaraśobhāḍhyaṃ sthāpayedbhavanāṅgaṇe \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – The chariot should be made of an excellent tree, which should be quite charming, the axle of which should be quite strong. The wheels should be quite attractive. The yoke should be bent a little in the middle. It should be covered with the five clothes. It should be shining like the star and decorated with the flower garlands. Two bullocks of white colour should be yoked in it, besides five or the twelve flags. An umbrella and the flywhisks should also be placed in the chariot, which should be placed in the courtyard of the house.

## \|\| 3.134.44-45 \|\|

*vaiśvadevaṃ tataḥ kuryādgrahayajñavidhānataḥ \|*  
*catuścaraṇakairmaṃtrairvipra śāntikapauṣṭikaiḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*āropayedrathe devaṃ mūlamaṃtreṇa maṃtravit \|*  
*vedoktairathapaurāṇairgaṃdhadhūpādhivāsite \|\| 45 \|\|*

44-45. Thereafter, the homa should be performed, worshipping the nine planets. The Brāhmaṇa should be made to perform the welfare ceremonies. The deity should be placed over the chariot, reciting the hymns from the Vedas as well as the Puranas. The chariot should also be offered with scent and incense.

## \|\| 3.134.46-47 \|\|

*rathe tiṣṭhannayati vājinaḥ puro yatrayatra kāmayate suṣārathiḥ \|*  
*abhīṣūṇāṃ mahimānaṃ panāyata manuḥ paścādanuyacchanti raśmayaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*śaṃkhaduṃdubhinirghoṣaiḥ kāhalānāṃ ca niḥsvanaiḥ \|*  
*hastadīpaiḥ prajvalitaistālakolāhā lena ca \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. The competent charioteer should drive the horses towards the same path over which he wants to drive the chariot. Keeping in view the importance of the same, after moving ahead, the bits and other articles should be taken care off. At that point of time, the conches should be blown and drums should be beaten. The damaru should be played upon. During the night, the lamps should be carried in hands to provide light on the way. The musical instruments should always be played upon.

## \|\| 3.134.48-49 \|\|

*doṣāsukhena ramitaṃ preṣaṇīyapuraḥsaram \|*  
*mahatotsavabhāreṇa bhrāmayetparito ratham \|\| 48 \|\|*

*tāṃbūlāni rathe dadyātpuṣpamālāyutāni ca \|*  
*rathavoḍhraṃ pradadyāttu prekṣakebhyo'pyavāritam \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. Thus the festival should be started in the night in an appropriate manner, and the chariot should be made to move on all the sides. The people participating in the ratha-yatra should respectfully offer betel, flowers and eatables to the deity. The drivers of the chariot should also be honoured similarly.

## \|\| 3.134.50 \|\|

*yasyayasya gṛhebhyeti prerito rathinā rathaḥ \|*  
*tasya tasya bhavetpūjyaḥ puṣpadhūpākṣatādibhiḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. A person in the front of whose house the chariot passes, the people of that house on the arrival of the chariot, should offer the flowers, incense, unbroken rice and worship the deity accordingly.

## \|\| 3.134.51-55 \|\|

*itaro'pi bhavetpūjyaḥ saṃprāpte gṛhiṇāṃ gṛhe \|*  
*kiṃ punarjagatāṃ bhartā sarvalokamaheśvaraḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*kadācidakṣabhaṅgaḥ syāddhvajabhaṃgo'tha vā bhavet \|*  
*bhajyeta vā yugamadhye nahanaṃ truṭyate yadi \|\| 52 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇāṃstatra saṃpūjya homaḥ kāryo vijānatā \|*  
*tilairājyena payasā yena saṃpadyate sukham \|\| 53 \|\|*

*preraṇīprekṣaṇīyaiśca bhrāmayitvā rathottamam \|*  
*sthāpayennagarasyāṃtastatra kuryānmahotsavam \|\| 54 \|\|*

*dolāgrāhaiścakradolābhramairḍamarakaistathā \|*  
*vidyādharīṇāṃ caritamitarābhiḥ prakāśyate \|\| 55 \|\|*

51-55. Because with the arrival of the chariot in front of a householder, when even an ordinary person is respected, the what could be said when Mahesvara - the lord of the universe, himself arrives there? Therefore, he should be provided with special worship. In the yatra of the said festival, when the flag gets tampered or the yoke is broken, the Brahmanas should be worshipped. Besides homa should be performed using ghi, sesamum seeds and milk, for the warding off the evil and gaining comfort. The charioteer as well as the onlookers should take the chariot on all the sides. Thereafter, it should be established in the middle of the city, concluding the festival. The holders of the swings, when it moves in a circular way, display several acrobatic exercises.

## \|\| 3.134.56-64 \|\|

*evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha sukhadaṃ tu rathotsavam \|*  
*tathaiva pūjayetpārtha upavāsaparo naraḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*sarvavyādhivihīnaśca sukhī syāccharadāṃ śatam \|*  
*yaḥ kārayitvā sauvarṇaṃ raupyaṃ vā rathamuttamam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*varṇakaiścitritaṃ divyaṃ dārujaṃ vā suśobhanam \|*  
*svahastaracitaṃ yaśca bhāskarāya nivedayet \|\| 58 \|\|*

*sa martyaloke sucirātsukhāni ca samaśnute \|*  
*pūrvoktavidhinā bhānuṃ bhrāmayitvā rathe sthitam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*sthāpayetsarvabhāge tu geyaṃ vādyapuraḥsaram \|*  
*dakṣiṇe tu diśo bhāge dvitīye'hni nayedratham \|\| 60 \|\|*

*tatrāpi jāgaraṃ kuryādvādyagītasumaṃ galaiḥ \|*  
*aparāyāṃ tṛtīye'hni sthāpayedrathamuttamam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*prekṣaṇīyavinodena tāṃ rātrimativāhayet \|*  
*sthāpayeduttarasyāṃ tu caturthe divase ratham \|\| 62 \|\|*

*mahāyātrāṃ prakurvīta tatrāpyadbhutaceṣṭitam \|*  
*paṃcame divase prāpte nagarāṃtasthitaṃ ravim \|\| 63 \|\|*

*pūjayitvā vidhānena ṣaṣṭhe'hni bhavanaṃ nayet \|*  
*rathayātrāprasaṃgena kathitā rathasaptamī \|\| 64 \|\|*

56-64. The persons who perform the vrata are also equally honoured as those who participate in the ratha-yatra. Thereafter, they have the body free from ailments and lead a comfortable life. The beautiful chariot made of gold, silver or the chariot made of wood and suitably coloured, made with one’s own hands, when a person dedicates it to lord Bhaskara, the people enjoy happy life for a long time. Thus following the aforesaid method, the Sungod should be lodged over the chariot, it should be taken round accompanied with songs and music. On the next day, while moving the chariot towards the southern direction, one should keep himself awake during the night, sounding the welfare music. On the third day, the chariot should move on (he western side and the night should be spent with recitation by the people. On the fourth day, the great yatra should move towards the northern side and the night should be spent by recreations. The chariot on the fifth day should be moved in the middle of the city. On the sixth day, after worshipping the deity, it should be made to enter into the temple. Thus I have told you about the subject of ratha-yatra. I have also spoken about the auspicious Ratha-saptami, which removes the sins, besides the method of performing the same, as well as its glory.

## \|\| 3.134.65-69 \|\|

*sarvapāpaharā puṇyā kiñcidanyannibodha me \|*  
*gaurī pūjyā tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthyāṃ vighnanāyakaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*pañcamyāṃ paṃkajakarāṃ pūjayedvā sarasvatīm \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śaktidharaṃ skandaṃ saptamyāṃ tu divākaram \|\| 66 \|\|*

*aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ sampūjyaḥ śaśiśekharaḥ \|*  
*navamyāṃ pūjayeccaṇḍīṃ cāmuṇḍāṃ muṇḍamālinīm \|\| 67 \|\|*

*daśamyāmṛṣayaḥ śāṃtāḥ sarve vyāsapurassarāḥ \|*  
*ekādaśyāṃ cakrapāṇiṃ dvādaśyāṃ vā samarcayet \|\| 68 \|\|*

*trayodaśyāṃ trinetrotthavahninā śāṃtavigraham \|*  
*sādhāraṇī tu sarveṣāṃ paurṇamāsī tithiḥ smṛtā \|\| 69 \|\|*

65-69. I am now talking about some other subject. You please listen. On the third moon day, Gauri should be worshipped; on the fourth moon day, Ganapati - the remover of obstacles; on the fifth moon day, Laksmi - the holder of lotus has to be adored; on the sixth moon day, Skanda - the carrier of sakti has to be adored; on the seventh moon day, the Sungod should be adored. On the eighth and fourteenth days of the moon, lord Siva is to be adored on the Navami day, the goddess Camunda wearing the garland of skulls has to be adored, besides the goddess Candi. Similarly, on the tenth moon day, the sage Vyasa as well as the Ṛṣis should be adored. On the days of Ekadasi as well as Dvadasi, lord Viṣṇu should be adored. On the thirteenth moon day, Agni, who emerged out of the third eye of lord Siva, besides Kamadeva has to be adored. But on the last moon day, worship of all the gods can be done.

## \|\| 3.134.70-71 \|\|

*āṃdolake madanake rathayātrāsu caiva hi \|*  
*vyutkrameṇāpi kartavyā tithīnāṃ kāryagauravāt \|*  
*yātrā vāsaṃtikī ceyaṃ cittasvāsthyakarī parā \|\| 70 \|\|*

*samyaksudhādhavalite bhavane surāṇāmaṃtassuvastramaṇimauktikadānacitre \|*  
*tāṃbūlakakramukavāravilāsinībhiryātrāṃ vidhāya bhavatīha sa bhārateśaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. The procedure for the swing as well as Damanaka can also be initiated during this period. The ratha-yatra during spring season is quite pleasing for the mind and bestows health. Therefore, when a person performs ratha-yatra which starts from the white temples, the interior of which are decorated with the beautiful costumes, gems, beads and being served with betel and fragrance used by the whores, and then concludes the ratha-yatra, he achieves the supreme position in the land of Bharata.

## Chapter 135. Madana Mahotsava

## \|\| 3.135.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*gaurīṃ vivāhya jagrāha haraḥ pāśupataṃ vratam \|*  
*umāpatiḥ paśupatirdhyānāsakto babhūva ha \|\| 1 \|\|*

*brahmādibhiḥ samāmaṃtrya vibudhaiḥ putralabdhaye \|*  
*gauryā manobhilaṣitapūraṇāya praharṣitaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*prahitaḥ kṣobhaṇārthāya samartha iti manmathaḥ \|*  
*tato māraḥ smaraḥ kāmopyājagāma tamāśramam \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – At the time of the marriage of Parvati with Siva, lord Siva resolved to observe die Pasupata vrata with the observing of which lord Siva was absorbed in meditation. At the same time, Brahma and other gods, for the establishment of the task of Siva’s getting a son, entrusted the responsibility to the Kamadeva. It is because Kamadeva alone can disturb the mind. They had a firm belief in him. Thereafter, Kamadeva, who is also called Smara as well as Mara, reached the hermitage of lord Siva.

## \|\| 3.135.4-9 \|\|

*ratiprītimadonmādavasaṃtaśrīsahāyavān \|*  
*nidhānavāruṇīdarpaśṛṃgāraiḥ parivāritaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*āmrāśokavanottaṃso mālatīkṛtaśekharaḥ \|*  
*vīṇāmṛdaṃgasaṃgītakokilāśṛṃgadūtakaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*jhallarīvādyasaṃghuṣṭabhāṃḍāgārikalekhakaḥ \|*  
*pānamattāṅganārūḍho hindolāścaryamaṃtrimān \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇānilagaṃdhāḍhyaḥ kaṭākṣekṣitavarṣavān \|*  
*mahārājādhirājo vā smaraḥ prāpto harāṃtikam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*sa puṣpacāpamākṛṣya madanonmādanaṃ śaram \|*  
*cikṣepa tripuraghnāya samādherbhaṃgahetave \|\| 8 \|\|*

*buddhvā taṃ tasya saṃkalpaṃ rudraḥ krodhājjvalanruṣā \|*  
*lalāṭādvahnimasṛjattṛtīya nayanāddharaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

4-9. At that point of time, the spring season who could make Rati and Priti passionate, was also siding Kamadeva, Vidhana, Varuni (beverage), Darpa. The flowering forest of Asoka and mango trees, Malati (jasmine), Kirita, Vina, double drums, music, cuckoos, the horn (instrument) and cymbals started creating musical tunes. The Bhandagarika riding over the intoxicated woman with the courtier named Hindola (swing), the wind of the southern Malaya mountain and the rains served as the attendants to him equipped with all the paraphernalia. Thus getting fully equipped, in order to perform the task, Kama reached before Siva and indulged in passionate activities. He placed the arrow over the bow of flowers and armed it at the destroyer of Tripura, known as lord Siva for the purpose of disturbing his meditation. Realizing the firm resolve of Kamadeva - the god of love, lord Rudra was enormously enraged. Then in great rage, he opened his third eye and produced fire flames.

## \|\| 3.135.10-11 \|\|

*kāmo vilokitastena bhasmībhūtaśca tatkṣaṇāt \|*  
*dagdhaṃ dṛṣṭvā smaraṃ śokādratiprītī sthite sadā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*karuṇaṃ vilapaṃtyau te sarvamanyaddiśaṃ gatam \|*  
*tataḥ śokārtahṛdayā gaurī rudramuvāca ha \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. With the casting of his glance over Kamadeva, he was reduced to ashes in a moment. Finding Kama having been reduced to ashes, the grief stricken Rati and Priti started lamenting in grief, moving in the other direction. Expressing her sorrow, Parvati then spoke to lord Siva.

## \|\| 3.135.12-20 \|\|

*bhagavannasmadarthe taṃ kāmaṃ nirdagdhavānasi \|*  
*tenaite paśya nāryau te kāmasya ruditaḥ katham \|\| 12 \|\|*

*kuru prasādaṃ deveśa ratiprītye vṛṣadhvaja \|*  
*saṃjīvaya smaraṃ śaṃbho mūrtimaṃtaṃ punaḥ kuru \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tacchrutvā tu mahādevo hṛṣṭaḥ provāca pārvatīm \|*  
*upaplutaṃ jagatsarvaṃ manmathena śarīriṇā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*mayā dagdhasya kāmasya punarāgamanaṃ kutaḥ \|*  
*kiṃ tu te mānayanvākyaṃ karomi saphalaṃ priye \|\| 15 \|\|*

*asminvasaṃtasamaye śuklapakṣe trayodaśī \|*  
*asyāṃ manobhavo devi bhaviṣyati śarīravān \|\| 16 \|\|*

*etena bījabhūtena jagadvarṇiṣyate'khilam \|*  
*evaṃ varamimaṃ dattvā manmathāya yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 17 \|\|*

*jagāma himavacchṛṃgaṃ kailāsaṃ pārvatīpriyaḥ \|*  
*tadetatsarvamākhyātaṃ smarasya caritaṃ nṛpa \|\| 18 \|\|*

*pūjāvidhānamaparaṃ kathayāmi śṛṇuṇva tat \|*  
*asyāṃ snātvā trayodaśyāmaśokākhyaṃ nagaṃ likhet \|\| 19 \|\|*

*sindūrajanitairaṃgairatiprīti samanvitam \|*  
*kāmadevaṃ vasaṃtaṃ ca vājivaktraṃ jhaṣadhvajam \|\| 20 \|\|*

12-20. Parvati said- О lord! You reduced Kama to ashes for my sake. But you see, for that very reason, how the wives of Kama are crying and lamenting? О bull-bannered lord of the universe, o Sambhu, you be graceful on both Rati and Priti, and kindly bring Kama back to life. On hearing the words of Parvati, the delightful Siva said to Parvati – “This Manmatha has made the entire world to suffer because of his having a body. Therefore, he having been reduced into ashes by me, how could he get back his body? But О beloved, respecting your words, I shall surely honour them. О Goddess, on the bright thirteenth moon day of the spring season, Kama shall get back his body and in the same form of seed, he would be able to again rule the world. О Yudhisthira, thus granting a boon to Kama, lord Siva returned to Himalaya mountain. After narrating the entire story of Kama, I am now narrating to you the method of his worship. You please listen. On the bright moon day of trayodasi, the golden image of Kamadeva, Rati and Priti should be made, which should be horse faced with a flag embossed with a fish.

## \|\| 3.135.21-22 \|\|

*sauvarṇaṃ vā mahārāja vārkṣaṃ citramathāpi vā \|*  
*līlāvilāsagamanaṃ garvitaṃ sāpsa rogaṇam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*gandharvagītavāditraprekṣaṇīyasamākulam \|*  
*naṃdyāvartiratikrīḍāprītividyādharairyutam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. О great king, during the Citra constellation, displaying delightful sports while moving on, the intoxicated Apsaras, the songs and music of the Gandharvas, the viewers and creating the paintings of Vidyadharas, the people should offer the food with the reciting of the mantras, offering incense and flowers, besides the costumes to Nandyavarti Priti fond of love sport.

## \|\| 3.135.23-27 \|\|

*madhyāhne bhojayedbhaktyā bhakṣyairdhūpaiḥsragaṃbaraiḥ \|*  
*maṃtreṇānena kauṃteya naro nāryā samanvitaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*namo vāmāya kāmāya devadevāya mūrtaye \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇuśivendrāṇāṃ manaḥkṣobhakarāya vai \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kṛtvaivamarcayitvā tu devadevamanobhavam \|*  
*tatastasyāgrato deyā modakā mukhamodakāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*nānāprakārānbhakṣyāṃśca kāmo me prīyatāmiti \|*  
*tato visarjayedviprāndattvā yugmaṃ sadakṣiṇam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*svapatiṃ pūjayennārī vastramālāvibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*kāmo'yamiti saṃciṃtya prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā \|\| 27 \|\|*

23-27. They should all be worshipped and should be served food during noon as well. “O son of Kunti, the beautiful crooked one who could disturb the minds of the god of gods, Brahma, Viṣṇu and Siva, I offer my salutation to Kamadeva – the god of love.” Thus adoring Kama – the god of gods, the betel leaves should be offered to him, for the purification of the house. Thus speaking, the sweet balls should be offered to him. Then offering several types of eatables, the daksina should also be offered to the Brāhmaṇas. Besides the costumes, garland and ornaments, with the feeling that they are Kamadeva and for the damsels, all the things should also be given.

## \|\| 3.135.28-29 \|\|

*manmathāyatane tasminyajamānaḥ suhṛdvṛtaḥ \|*  
*rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātsukharātriryathā bhavet \|\| 28 \|\|*

*karpūrakuṃkumakṣodagaṃdhatāṃbūlasarjanaiḥ \|*  
*nānāprakārairbhakṣyaiśca kuryādrātrau mahotsavam \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. Thereafter, in the temple of Manmatha, together with his friends, the devotee should spend the night while remaining awake, with comfort. Offering camphor, vermilion mixed in water, scents along with betel, several types of eatables should be consumed.

## \|\| 3.135.30-31 \|\|

*dīpaprajvālanairnṛtyaiḥ prekṣaṇaiḥ prekṣaṇotsavaiḥ \|*  
*evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha varṣevarṣe mahotsavam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*vasaṃtasamaye prāpte hṛṣṭastuṣṭo nṛpaḥ pure \|*  
*tasya saṃvatsaraṃ yāvalloko rogairvimucyate \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. The lamps should be kept lighted throughout the night. The dancing and music should continue throughout the night with the audience. Thereafter, the festival should be brought to a close. The kings should perform this festival during the spring season every year.

## \|\| 3.135.32-35 \|\|

*subhikṣaṃ kṣemamārogyaṃ yaśaḥ śrīḥ saukhyamuttamam \|*  
*kāmavarṣī ca parjanyastasminrāṣṭre prajāyate \|\| 32 \|\|*

*tuṣyate tu bhṛśaṃ devo dvādaśārddhārddhalocanaḥ \|*  
*tathā kāmaśca viṣṇuśca vasaṃtaśca prajāpatiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*candrasūryādikā sarve grahā brahmarṣayastathā \|*  
*sarve'pi tasya tuṣyaṃti yakṣagaṃdharvadānavāḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*asurā yātudhānāśca suparṇāḥ patagā nagāḥ \|*  
*tuṣṭāḥ prayacchaṃti sukhaṃ tasya karturna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

32-35. The king who performs this festival, there is always plenty of grains in his kingdom and the rains fall as per requirement. Besides Kamadeva – the god of gods, Viṣṇu, Vasanta, Prajapati, Sun, Moon, the planets and the Brāhmaṇas always remain delighted. Similarly, the Yaksas, Gandharvas, Danavas, Asuras, Yatudhanas (demons), Suvarnas, Nagas, the mountains as well as the trees feel highly delighted. The performer of the festival earns all the comforts. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.135.36 \|\|

*caitrotsave sakalalokamanonivāsaṃ kāmaṃ vasaṃtamalayādrimarutsahāyam \|*  
*ratyā sahārcya puruṣaḥ pravarā ca yoṣitsaubhāgyarūpasutasaukhyayutā sadā syāt \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Thus in the month of Caitra, those who perform this festival during the spring season, they all are made comfortable by Kamadeva who dwells in the heart of one and all.

## Chapter 136. Festival of goddess Bhutamata

## \|\| 3.136.1-4 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*bhūtamāteti saṃhṛṣṭe grāmegrāme purepure \|*  
*gāyannṛtyanhasaṃllokaḥ sarvataḥ paridhāvati \|\| 1 \|\|*

*unmattavatpralapati kṣitau patati mattavat \|*  
*kruddhavaddhāvati purānmattavatkarṣate bahiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*mukhāṃgabhaṃgānkurute loke vātagṛhītavat \|*  
*bhūtavadbhasmagātraṃ tu kardamānavagāhate \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kimeṣa śāstranirdiṣṭo mārgaḥ kimuta laukikaḥ \|*  
*muhyate me manaḥ kṛṣṇa tvaṃ tu vaktumihārhasi \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Yudhisthira said- What is Bhutamata? For what purpose, the people perform worship of Bhutamata in every house of every village, delightfully singing and dancing? They look as running on all the sides and talk like intoxicated people. They fall on the ground like the mad people, run about in city and then brought out of the city or village. Like a blemished person, the performer then starts defacing the mouth and other limbs of the body. He then applies ashes over the body, falls in the mud like a mad man. Is the performance of this type supported by the scriptures? Or is it of local origin? О Kṛṣṇa, I feel confused with such types of the behaviour of the people. Therefore, you kindly enlighten me on this subject.

## \|\| 3.136.5-15 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu pārtha pravakṣyāmi yatte kiñcinmanogatam \|*  
*āstikaḥ śraddadhānaśca bhavatīti matirmama \|\| 5 \|\|*

*pārvatyā sahitaḥ pārtha mandare cārukandare \|*  
*krīḍannāste mudā yukto divyakrīḍanakairharaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*haṃsonnatagatiṃ cārukumbhabhrājikucadvayam \|*  
*siñjatsadraśanāṃ hṛṣṭāṃ dṛṣṭvā gaurīṃ jagadguruḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*dagdhakāmo'pi ca haraḥ saṃdīptamadano'bhavat \|*  
*niḥsṛtāṃ kāmayāmāsa mahārhaśayane śivaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*ratasthayostayorjātaṃ divyavarṣaśataṃ yadā \|*  
*tadā devīsamucchrāyanirodhānnirgatā bahiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*mūtrodakātsamuttasthau nārī nirdāritodarā \|*  
*kṛṣṇā karālavadanā piṃgākṣā muktamūrddhajā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kapālamālābharaṇā baddhapiṃḍordhvapiṃḍikā \|*  
*khaṭvāṅgakaṃ kāladharā mudrāṅkitakarā śivā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*vyāghracarmāṃbaradharā raṇatkiṃkiṇimekhalā \|*  
*ḍamaḍḍamaḍḍamarukā phūtkārāpūritāṃbarā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tasyāḥ pārśvānujāścānyā gītavādyalayānugāḥ \|*  
*uttālatālamabalā nṛtyaṃti ca hasaṃti ca \|\| 13 \|\|*

*kapālakhaṭvāṅgadharā gajacarmāvaguṇṭhitāḥ \|*  
*tathaiva śaṃkarājjātastadrūpābharaṇaḥ pumān \|\| 14 \|\|*

*anugamyamāno bahubhirbhūtairatibhayaṃkaraiḥ \|*  
*siṃhaśārdūlavadanai radanollikhitāṃbaraiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

5-15. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – I shall surely fulfill you desire. You please listen to me attentively. The devotees are filled with devotion. This is my firm opinion. О Partha, once lord Нага, with all the resources, was engaged in sport with Parvati in the caves of Mandaracala mountain. At the sight of the goddess Parvati who possessed the raised breasts like the swan’s feathers and was wearing a waistband which issued sweet dangling sound, lord Siva - the preceptor of the universe as well as the destroyer of Kama, could not control himself. He started suffering from the heat of passion and became lustful. Thereafter, Siva started love sport with Parvati over an excellent bed which had been beautifully made. Having been engaged in the love sport, both of them spent a hundred divine years. Since he did not drop the semen, the upper part of the same developed swelling. Parvati suddenly got up and went out of the chamber. Out of her urine, such women were created who were having tom out bellies, black bodies, awful faces, yellow eyes, dry hair decorated with garlands, thick veins, which bound the body. They held khatvanga in hands. They appeared like skeletons. They were clad in inauspicious costumes and used tiger’s skin as lower garment. They were adorned with waistbands which created sound. They kept on creating sound of various types of cries which disturbed even the sky. At the back of these awful women, their younger sisters were standing which were absorbed in the musical tunes. They were dancing, singing, raising their hands, clapping then at the same time and laughing. Those women also were carrying khatvanga, skulls, clad in the deer skins. Similarly, Siva also produced the male creatures of the same form, who were followed by innumerable Bhutamata – the goblins. They had the faces resembling the lions, tigers and the long teeth, which could touch the sky.

## \|\| 3.136.16 \|\|

*ekībhūtaiḥ kṣaṇenaiva tau bhavānībhavodbhavau \|*  
*dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭamanā devaḥ prāha devīṃ suvismitām \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. All the men and women, so created by the goddess Bhavani as well as Siva, mixing with one another, formed a force in a moment. Observing them, lord Mahadeva feeling surprised, said to Parvati.

## \|\| 3.136.17-21 \|\|

*kalyāṇi paśya paśyaitau mattvadaṅgasamudbhavau \|*  
*bībhatsādbhutaśṛṃgāravarāyudhavidhāriṇau \|\| 17 \|\|*

*bhrātṛbhāṃḍau yathā devi tadvadetau matau mama \|*  
*nṛnāryoraṃtaraṃ kiñcitsādṛśyātpratibhāsayet \|\| 18 \|\|*

*bhrātṛbhāṃḍā bhūtamātā tathaivodakasevikā \|*  
*saṃjñātrayaṃ tayoḥ kṛtvā tataḥ prādādvaraṃ haraḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*bhuktvārhopagatāṃ caitāṃ jarattarutale sthitām \|*  
*sevayiṣyaṃti ye bhaktyā jalasaṃpūrṇakaṃḍukaiḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*candanena samālabhya puṣpadhūpairathārcya tām \|*  
*bhojayetkṣiprayā caiva kṛśarāpūpapāyasaiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

17-21. “О lady bestowing welfare, look at the creatures which have been created out of your as well as my body, what astonishing type of figures they have, besides the weapons or attributes held by each one of them? О goddess, in my opinion, they all look like the blemished people.” Thereafter, lord Siva described them in three categories, viz., Bhartribhanda, Bhutamata and Udakasevika. Dividing them in these three categories, he bestowed a boon on them. After finishing of the food, these women should be worshipped under a shattered tree with a vase filled with water, sandal paste, the flowers and incense. Thereafter, the cooked mixed grains should be offered to them, besides the fried cakes and the payasam.

## \|\| 3.136.22-23 \|\|

*ya evaṃ kurute devi bhaktibhāvena bhāvitaḥ \|*  
*sa putrapaśuvṛddhiṃ ca śarīrārogyamāpnuyāt \|\| 22 \|\|*

*na śākinyo gṛhe tasya na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ \|*  
*pīḍāṃ kurvaṃti śiśavo yāṃti vṛddhiṃ nirāmayāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. O goddess, such of the people, who will adore them with devotion, they shall achieve sons, animals and the life without ailment. The Pisacas, Dakinis and the Raksasas can cause no harm to them. The children are freed from ailments and face a healthy growth.

## \|\| 3.136.24 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kadā pūjā prakartavyā bhūtamātuḥ sukhārthibhiḥ \|*  
*puruṣaiḥ puruṣavyāghra yattanme vaktumarhasi \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Yudhisthira said – О lion among the humans, when should the people desirous of comforts, worship Bhutamata?

## \|\| 3.136.25-30 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*sarvatraiṣā bhagavatī bālānāṃ hitakāriṇī \|*  
*nāmabhedaiḥ kriyābhedaiḥ kālabhedaiśca pūjyate \|\| 25 \|\|*

*pratipatprabhṛti jyeṣṭhe yāvatpaṃcadaśī tithiḥ \|*  
*tāvatpūjā prakartavyā preraṇaiḥ prekṣaṇīyakaiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*vikarmaphalanirdeśaḥ pāṃḍavānāṃ viḍaṃbanam \|*  
*pradṛśyaṃte hāsyaparairnarairadbhutaceṣṭitaiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*viśvāsyadhanalobhena saṃdhyāyāṃ nihataḥ pathi \|*  
*ārohaṇaṃ ca śūlāgre na paśyaṃtaṃ hi paśyati \|\| 28 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭo bhavadbhiḥ saṃhṛṣṭaḥ parapārāvamarśakaḥ \|*  
*chittvā svahastairyaddatto vibhunā mukhyamodakaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*śīrṇasūkṣmeṇa patreṇa bālā mālānumoditāḥ \|*  
*muṣkabhugrāsamārūḍho mukhaṃ kṛtvā ca paścime \|\| 30 \|\|*

25-30. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – The goddess who protects the children is worshipped as Bheda, Kriyabheda and Kalabheda. Starting from the first moon day of the month of Jyestha, upto the full moon day, all the people should worship her. It is useless to direct the Pandavas to indulge in blemished deeds. By performing the surprising type of activity, the people are found laughing at noble people. Those for achieving riches, with greed, (the evil people) bring an end to their lives at the evening time, on the way. They do not mind when a person is about to post to death. At places, some people say – “The master has himself given the broken pieces of sweet balls, but this man is feeling happy by criticizing him. All of you have absorbed him.” At places, the young girls making the garlands of lettered tree leaves, are feeling happy. At places, a person consuming the eggs, is riding over a donkey with his face at the back.

## \|\| 3.136.31-42 \|\|

*he janāḥ kiṃ na paśyadhvaṃ svāmidrohakaraṃ param \|*  
*karapatrairvidāryaṃtamucchalacchoṇitacchaṭam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*caraiḥ kilāsaiḥ saṃprāptaḥ sarvodvegakaraḥ param \|*  
*daṃḍaprahārābhihato nīyate daṃḍapāśikaiḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*prekṣakairveṣṭitaḥ steno raṭatyeṣa vimohitaḥ \|*  
*saṃyamya nīyateyaṃ tu mūrkhaḥ krauryāvilekṣaṇaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sitakeśaṃ sitaśmaśrusitāṃbaradharaṃ dvijam \|*  
*vaṭaceṣṭācapeṭābhirhanyamānaṃ na paśyata \|\| 34 \|\|*

*gṛhānniṣkramyatāṃ raṃḍā vṛddho bhūtvāpyasau striyāḥ \|*  
*svasyā asau na kurute mūḍho bharaṇapoṣaṇam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*bhairavābharaṇottālā vyālayajñopavītinaḥ \|*  
*pradattvātāṇḍavapadānpaśyadhvaṃ dhvāṃtadīpakān \|\| 36 \|\|*

*nirvedako'sya hṛdaye na kiṃcidapi tiṣṭhati \|*  
*gṛhītaṃ yadanenedaṃ bālenāpi mahāvratam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*raktadṛkkākakṛṣṇāṃgaṃ śabaraṃ kiṃ na paśyata \|*  
*tarukoṭarāṃtaragatāṃśchitvā ca śukaśāvakān \|\| 38 \|\|*

*bahubhiḥ koṣṭhakīkṛtya śaraughaiḥ śakalīkṛtam \|*  
*vimuktaḍhakkāhaṃkārasuprahāraṃ nirīkṣata \|\| 39 \|\|*

*imāṃ kṛṣṇārddhavadanāṃ gṛhītāṃ siṃdurārcitām \|*  
*vimuktakeśāṃ nṛtyaṃtīṃ paśyadhvaṃ yoginīmiva \|\| 40 \|\|*

*gaṃbhīratūryadhvaninā prabuddhāṃ vṛttatāṃḍavām \|*  
*evaṃ prekṣaṇakaṃ kṛtvā nayetvṛkṣatale ca tām \|\| 41 \|\|*

*evaṃ kṛte na dāridryaṃ na ca duḥkhaṃ bhavennṛṇām \|\| 42 \|\|*

31-42. At places, the people are thing – “Look at the person who has developed enmity with the master. The saw is cutting him into pieces as a result of which the stream of blood is flowing from his body.” At places, the royal messengers who indulge in deceitful ways, make the people restless. The messengers of Yama holding the rods as well as the nooses are striking the people. Some people have surrounded a thief who is indulging in loose talk. At places, the people are suffering for the committing of the evil deeds. A Brahmana with white beard and moustache is being slapped by someone at some place, like the young children. Are you not looking at him? At some place, a man is uttering – “Drive out the evil woman from the house, even in old age?” The foolish fellow is unable to provide food to his own wedded wife. At places, the people being quite fat are wearing thick yajnopavitas, which are quite thick like the serpents. Some of them extinguish the lamps with their tandava dance. A person who embraced the vrata during his childhood, the painful situation does not exist for him. The nomadic forest people who are totally of black complexion known as Sabaras, are taking out the young chicks of the birds from the hollow of the trees and heaping them up with the arrows. Look there are the people, who having discarded the small drums, are making use of humkara alone. Look at him, whose half of the body is black and the hair are of vermilion colour. They are like the yoginis with disheveled hair and are dancing. They appear like indulging in the tandava dance. At the time of the beating of the big drums, creating such a sight, the same should be carried under a tree and by so doing, the humans do not have to face poverty as well as misery.

## Chapter 137. Raksa-bandhana

## \|\| 3.137.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi balirakṣāvidhiṃ nṛpa \|*  
*taṃ śṛṇvekāgramanasā samāsādgaditaṃ mayā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*purā devāsure yuddhe dānavā suranirjitāḥ \|*  
*śukraṃ baliṃ puraḥ kṛtvā yayuḥ śukra uvāca tam \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О king, I am going to speak to you about the process of Raksa- bandhana. You please listen to the same quite attentively. In earlier times, during the war between the Devas and the Asuras, the latter were defeated. The Asuras, then making Bali to lead them, went to Sukra – their preceptor, who said to them.

## \|\| 3.137.3-7 \|\|

*śakra uvāca \|*  
*na viṣādastvayā kāryaḥ kāryāṇāṃ gatirīdṛśī \|*  
*daivādbhavaṃti bhūtānāṃ kāle jayaparājayāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*saṃdhānaṃ saha śakreṇa kriyatāmayanadvayama \|*  
*ajeyaḥ sarvaśatrūṇāṃ kṛtaḥ śacyā śacīpatiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*rakṣābaṃdhaprabhāvena dānavendro jito mahān \|*  
*varṣamekaṃ pratīkṣasva tataḥ śreyo bhaviṣyati \|\| 5 \|\|*

*bhārgaveṇaivamuktāste dānavā vigatajvarāḥ \|*  
*tasthuḥ kālaṃ pratīkṣanto yathoktaṃ guruṇā tathā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*eṣa prabhāvo rakṣāyāḥ kathitaste yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*jayadaḥ sukhadaścaiva putrārogyadhanapradaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

3-7. Surka said- You should not at all be upset at the moment, because the destiny moves like this. It is the destiny, which makes the people to win or lose the battles. You better compromise with Indra in all the matters during the period of both the ayanas (or six months), Saci - the wife of Indra, has made him invincible from the enemies. With the influence of the same Raksa-bandhanas, even the lord of Danavas has also been defeated. Therefore, you shall have to wait for another one year. Thereafter, you would achieve your welfare.” At these words of Sukra, the Danavas were relieved of their misery. Therefore, according to the words of their preceptor, they spent their time for one year, waiting for the opportunity. О Yudhisthira, I have told you about the influence of Raksa-bandhanas, which are always comforting and also bestow the riches.

## \|\| 3.137.8-9 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kriyate kena vidhinā rakṣābaṃdhaḥ surottama \|*  
*kasyāṃ tithau kadā deva etanme vaktumarhasi \|\| 8 \|\|*

*yathā yathā hi bhagavānvicitrāṇi prabhāṣate \|*  
*tathā tathā na me tṛptirbahvarthāḥ śṛṇvataḥ kathāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Yudhisthira said- What is the process of Raksa-bandhana, on which day it is performed and at what time? Kindly enlighten me on all the issues. The way lord speaks the astonishing words, which include several stories which fulfill the desires, but I don’t feel satisfied by listening to all of them.

## \|\| 3.137.10-21 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ghanāvṛte'mbare pārtha śādvale dharaṇītale \|*  
*saṃprāpte śrāvaṇe caiva paurṇamāsyāṃ dinodaye \|\| 10 \|\|*

*snānaṃ kurvīta matimāñśrutismṛtividhānata \|*  
*tato devānpitṝṃścaiva tarpayetparamāṃbhasā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*upākarmādivedoktamṛṣīṇāṃ caiva tarpaṇam \|*  
*kuryuśca brāhmaṇāḥ śrāddhaṃ devamuddiśya śaktitaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*śūdrāṇāṃ maṃtrasahitaṃ snānaṃ dānaṃ ca śasyate \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tatoparāhnasamaye rakṣāpoṭalikāḥ śubhāḥ \|*  
*kārayeccākṣataiḥ śastaiḥ siddhārthairhemabhūṣitāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*vastrairvicitraiḥ kārpāsaiḥ kṣaumairvā malavarjitaiḥ \|*  
*vicitratarairgrathitāḥ sthāpayedbhā janopari \|\| 15 \|\|*

*kāryā gṛhasya rakṣā gomayarahitaiḥ suvṛttakuṃḍūkaiḥ \|*  
*dūrvāvarṇakasahitaiḥ sakaladuṣkṛtopaśāṃtaye \|\| 16 \|\|*

*upaliptagṛhamadhye catuṣkopari nyasecchubhaṃ pīṭham \|*  
*tatropaviśedrājā sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ sasuhṛt \|\| 17 \|\|*

*veśyājanenasahito maṃgalaśabdaiḥ suhasitaiścihnaiḥ \|*  
*rakṣābaṃdhaḥ kāryaḥ śāṃtidhvaninā narendrasya \|\| 18 \|\|*

*devadvijātiśastā sustrīrarghyaiḥ samarcayetprathamam \|*  
*tadanu purodhā nṛpatiṃ rakṣāṃ badhnīta maṃtreṇa \|\| 19 \|\|*

*yena baddho balī rājā dānavendro mahābalaḥ \|*  
*tena tvāmabhibadhnāmi rakṣe mā cala mā cala \|\| 20 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiścānyaiśca mānavaiḥ \|*  
*kartavyo rakṣikābandho dvijānsampūjya bhaktitaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

10-21. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – When the earth is covered with greenery and the sky is covered with the clouds during the same month of Sravana, on the full moon day at the time of sunrise, one should take his bath appropriately. Then with the auspicious water, the oblation should be offered to gods and the manes, and all other religious rites should be performed. The Brahmanas should be given the daksina as per one’s means. Even the Sudras should take bath and give charities which are said to be praiseworthy. In the same afternoon, the unbroken rice and mustard seeds should be kept in a small package decorated with gold and made of fine cotton or the silken cloth, and should be placed in a vase. Thereafter, for the removal of all the evils, the courtyard of the house should then be plastered with cowdung. The durva grass should be placed in a vase for the protection of the house, in the courtyard over a pedestal. The king or the family priest should be then made to sit over the pedestal. Then a cord of Raksa-bandhana should be tied on the hand of the king. At that point of time, the gods and Brahmanas should be bound with the Raksa-bandhana, reciting the mantra - “Yena baddho baliraja danavendro mahabalah, tena tvamabhi- badhnabhi rakse ma cala ma cala” This means that with the truthful word when Bali - the king of the Raksasas was bound, I am also binding you with the same. You should never be slave and should always remain firm. Similarly, all the Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Madras should order the Brāhmaṇa. The Raksa-bandhana should be performed thereafter.

## \|\| 3.137.22 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yastu rakṣikābandhamācaret \|*  
*sa sarvadoṣarahitaḥ sukhī samvatsaraṃ bhavet \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. When this process of Raksa-bandhana is performed by a person, he getting relieved of all the sins, remains quite comfortable for a year.

## \|\| 3.137.23 \|\|

*yaḥ śrāvaṇe sravati śītajale narendra rakṣāvidhānavidhimācarate manuṣyaḥ \|*  
*āste sukhena parameṇa ca sarvamekaḥ putraprapautrasahitaḥ sasuhṛdvṛtaśca \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Thus, on the full moon day in the month of Havana when rain is falling continuously, with the process of the protection of Narendra while completing the Raksa-bandhana ceremony by a person, he enjoys all the comforts with his sons and grandsons.

## Chapter 138. Description of Mahanavami

## \|\| 3.138.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*puṇyā mahānavamyasti tithīnāṃ pravarā tithiḥ \|*  
*sānuṣṭheyā suraiḥ sarvaiḥ prajāpālairviśeṣataḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*bhavānutthāpayetpārtha samvatsarasukhāya vai \|*  
*bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ prītyarthaṃ cotsavāya vā \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – The auspicious day of Mahanavami is considered to be the best of all the moon days. Therefore, the rulers as well as the gods, (besides the humans) should perform die worship of the goddess Durga on that day. One should also perform the festivities for the whole year, celebrate the festival for removal of the troubles from the pretas and pisacas and to please them.

## \|\| 3.138.3-6 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kasmātkālātpravṛtteyaṃ navamī mahaśabdayuk \|*  
*kimādāvupapanno'sti bhagavannavamīvidhiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*yaśodāgarbhasambhūteruta yātrā pravartate \|*  
*utāho pūrvamevāsītkṛtatretāyugādiṣu \|\| 4 \|\|*

*yadasyāṃ prāṇinaḥ kecinmanyante ghātayanti ca \|*  
*hatānāṃ prāṇināṃ teṣāṃ kā gatiḥ pāralaukikī \|\| 5 \|\|*

*svayaṃ ghnatāṃ ghātayatāmanumodayatāṃ tathā \|*  
*etanme saṃśayaṃ pūrvaṃ vaktumarhasi keśava \|\| 6 \|\|*

3-6. Yudhisthira said- The celebration of the festival of the Navami is in vogue from the time immemorial or it relates goddess who emerged out of the womb of Yasoda and her travels, or it could relate to the Satyayuga itself. Whichever living being is killed on this particular day, what type of the situation has to be faced by the living being which is killed or the one who kills it and those who support the killing? What type of situation have they to face in the other world? You kindly remove my doubt in this connection.

## \|\| 3.138.7-9 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*pārtha yā paramā śaktiranantā lokaviśrutā \|*  
*ādyā sarvagatā śuddhā bhāvagamyā manoharā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ādyāṣṭamī kalākālī dvitīyā sarvamaṅgalā \|*  
*māyā kātyāyanī durgā cāmuṇḍā śaṅkarapriyā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dhyāyanti yāṃ yogaratāṃ sā devī parameśvarī \|*  
*rūpabhedairnāmabhedairbhavānī pūjyate śivā \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О Partha, the supreme Sakti is beyond limits, well known in the world, is known as eternal Bhagavati, whose lord is Siva. She is omnipresent, is known through devotion and omniscient, primordial goddess, Astami-kala, Kali, Sarvamangala, Maya, Katyayani, Durga, Camunda besides being the beloved of Siva. She is being worshipped by all these names. All the people adore always not only these forms, she is being worshipped in several other forms as well.

## \|\| 3.138.10-11 \|\|

*aṣṭamyāṃ tu navamyāṃ tu devadānavarākṣasaiḥ \|*  
*gandharvairuragairyajñaiḥ pūjyate kinnarairnaraiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*anyeṣvapi yugeṣvādau sṛṣṭeḥ pūrvaṃ pradarśitā \|*  
*pūjyateyaṃ purā devī tebhyaḥ pūrvataraiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. On the days of Astami as well as Navami, the Devas, Danavas, Raksasas, Gandharvas, Nagas, Kinnaras and Humans worship her with the performing of the yajnas. Similarly, at the start of other yugas, during the start of the creation, the goddess was similarly present on earth and since that time, she was being adored by the ancestors of those people by auspicious methods.

## \|\| 3.138.12 \|\|

*āśvayukchuklapakṣe ca yāṣṭamī mūlasaṃyutā \|*  
*sā mahānavamī nāma trailokye'pi sudurlabhā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. During the bright fortnight of the month of Asvina, in the Mula constellation on the day of Navami, it is known as Mahdnavami, which is said to be difficult to achieve in the three worlds.

## \|\| 3.138.13 \|\|

*kanyāgate savitari śuklapakṣe'ṣṭamī tu yā \|*  
*mūlanakṣatrasaṃyuktā sā mahānavamī smṛtā \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. During the moving of the Sun in the Virgo sign of Zodiac sign on the Mula constellation of the bright fortnight, Astami has been called as Mahanavami.

## \|\| 3.138.14-17 \|\|

*aṣṭamyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca jaganmātaramambikām \|*  
*pūjayityā'śvine māsi viśoko jayati dviṣaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*santarjayantī huṃkāraiḥ khaḍgādibhiraharniśam \|*  
*navamyāṃ pūjitā devī dadāti navamaṃ phalam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sā puṇyā sā pavitrā ca sā dharmasukhadāyinī \|*  
*tasmātsadā pūjanīyā cāmuṇḍāmuṇḍamālinī \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tasyāṃ yadyupayujyante prāṇino mahiṣādayaḥ \|*  
*sarve te svargatiṃ yānti ghnatāṃ pāpaṃ na vidyate \|\| 17 \|\|*

14-17. On the days of Astami and Navami in the month of Asvina, Bhagavati Ambika – the mother of the universe is when worshipped by a person, he fearlessly gains victory over his enemies. The enemies on the other hand are always burnt by the tall talk as well as the weapons. When the goddess is worshipped on the day of Navami, the goddess bestows the ninth merit as the most auspicious one, well purified and bestows dharma. Therefore, the goddess Camunda who is adorned with the garland of skulls, should always be worshipped. For the sake of the goddess Camunda, the Mahisa, which is to be offered as sacrifice and other animals at once reach the heaven. The performer of the homa also does not attract any sin.

## \|\| 3.138.18-19 \|\|

*na tathā balidānena puṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ \|*  
*yathā saṃtuṣyate loke mahiṣairvindhyavāsinī \|\| 18 \|\|*

*uddiśya durgāṃ hanyante vidhānādye'tra jantavaḥ \|*  
*svargaṃ te yānti kaunteya ghātayanto'pi bhaktitaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. The goddess Vindhyavasini (Kali) – Camunda is not so much pleased with the presenting of the flowers, incense, paste or other offerings, as she is pleased with the sacrifice of a Mahisa or a male buffalo. For the sake of Durga, with devotion, the Mahisa should be killed in an appropriate manner, by which the soul reaches the heaven.

## \|\| 3.138.20-26 \|\|

*bhavānīprāṅgaṇe prāṇā yeṣāṃ yātā yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*teṣāṃ svarge dhruvaṃ vāso varāste'psarasāṃ priyāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*manvantareṣu sarveṣu kalpeṣu kurunandana \|*  
*teṣu sarveṣu caivāsīnnavamīyaṃ purārcitā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*prasiddhānādinidhanā varṣevarṣe yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*bhūyobhūyo'vatāraiśca bhavānī pūjyate suraiḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*avatīrṇā bhuvi sadā nityaṃ daityanibarhiṇī \|*  
*svargapātālamartyeṣu karoti sthitipālanam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*punaścaiṣā mahādevī yaśodā garbhasaṃbhavā \|*  
*kaṃsāsurasyottamāṅge pādaṃ dattvā gatāyuṣaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*tataḥ prabhṛti lokeṣu yaśodānaṃdadāyinīm \|*  
*viṃdhyācale sthāpayitvā punaḥ pūjā pravartitā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*pūrvapravṛddho'pi punarbhaginyā mahimā kṛtaḥ \|*  
*bhuvi sarvopakārāya sarvopadravaśāṃtaye \|\| 26 \|\|*

20-26. О Yudhisthira, such of the living beings who are killed in the courtyard of the goddess Bhavani, they surely dwell in the heaven and become the favourites of Apsaras. О son of the race of Kuru, in earlier times, during the Manvantaras of all the kalpas, by the people of the contemporary period, this Navami day was always adored. During each divine year of the gods, the immensely famous Bhavani - the spouse of Siva, who is beyond the birth and death and incarnates on earth at the opportune moment, is worshipped by all the gods with respect. Vindhyavasini Durga incarnates on earth at the suitable time, creates and maintains the world. Then having been born out of the womb of Yasoda and placing her foot over the head of Kamsa, she then moved into the sky. Since that time, she was consecrated over the Vindhya mountain and her worship again started thereafter. She subsides all the disturbances on earth, her glory was enhanced by the goddess Bhavani further, for the benefit of the people.

## \|\| 3.138.27-33 \|\|

*evaṃ viṃdhyopavāsinyā navarātropavāsinaḥ \|*  
*ekarātreṇa naktena svaśaktyā'yācitena vā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*yajanairyājanairdevāḥ sthānesthāne purepure \|*  
*gṛhegṛhe bhaktipare grāmegrāme vanevane \|\| 28 \|\|*

*snātaiḥ pramuditairhṛṣṭairbrāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairnṛpaiḥ \|*  
*vaiśyaiḥ śūdrairbhakticitrairmlecchairanyaiśca mānavaiḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*strībhiśca kuruśārdūla tadvidhānamidaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*jayābhilāṣī nṛpatiḥ pratipatprabhṛtikramāt \|\| 30 \|\|*

*lohābhihārikaṃ karma kārayedyāvadaṣṭami \|*  
*prāgudakpravaṇe deśe patākābhiralaṃkṛtam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*maṇḍapaṃ kārayeddivyaṃ navasaptakaraṃ varam \|*  
*āgneyyāṃ kārayetkuṇḍaṃ hastamātraṃ suśobhanam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*mekhalātrayasaṃ yuktaṃ yonyaśvatthadalābhayā \|*  
*rājacihnāni sarvāṇi śastrāṇyastrāṇi yāni ca \|\| 33 \|\|*

27-33. О lion of the race of Kuru, thus the goddess Vindhyavasini’s vrata should be performed for a day or nine days as per one’s capacity, consuming the undesired food during the night, performing the sacrifice, officiating as priest for the humans as well as the gods. Such gods and the humans should perform the vrata at every place, cities, every house, village or forest, after taking bath. Thereafter, all the Brāhmaṇas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas, Sudras and the other people, besides the women should perform this vrata. I am going to spell out the method for the performing of the vrata. You please listen. A king desirous of victory should perform the vrata from the first to the eighth day of the moon, performing arati for the weapons to be used in the battle field. From the north-east side at its central place, a divine pavilion of sixteen cubits should be created, well decorated with the flags. In the south-east direction, a pavilion of a single cubit with an altar should be made, which should be decorated with three chains and the leaves of the pipala tree. As a symbol of the royalty, all the weapons should be brought and placed there.

## \|\| 3.138.34-36 \|\|
