*sarve kirīṭinaḥ kāryā grahā lokahitāvahāḥ \|*  
*svāṃgulenocchritāḥ sarve śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tadā \|\| 79 \|\|*

*grahasvarūpametatte vyākhyātaṃ pāṃḍunandana \|*  
*etajjñātvā prayatnena pūjā kāryā vicakṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

79-80. О son of Pandu, all the planets are favourable to the lokas and are adorned with the kirita crown. The height of each one of the planets is said to be a hundred and eight angulas as compared with the finger of each one of them. Thus, I have narrated to you the forms and shapes of the planets. Thus realizing, the intelligent people should worship the planets accordingly.

## \|\| 3.141.81-82 \|\|

*vidhinā grahapūjāṃ yonena tvārabhate naraḥ \|*  
*sarvānkāmānavāpnoti pretya svarge mahīyate \|\| 81 \|\|*

*yastu pīḍākaro nityaṃ mālyavittasya vā grahaḥ \|*  
*taṃ tu yatnena saṃpūjya śeṣānapyarcayedbudhaḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

81-82. A person, who worships in this way, all his desires get fulfilled and he ultimately reaches the heavens, where he is adored (with his arrival at the appropriate place). The planets, which cause pain, should be adored as per one’s means, by offering the garland and other items of worship. Thereafter, the other planets should also be worshipped.

## \|\| 3.141.83-85 \|\|

*grahā gāvo narendrāśca brāhmaṇāśca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*pūjitāḥ pūjayaṃtyete nirdahaṃtyavamānitāḥ \|\| 83 \|\|*

*tasmānna dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā \|*  
*saṃpūrṇāyāṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ yasmādeko'pi tuṣyati \|\| 84 \|\|*

*sadaivā'yutahomo'yaṃ navagrahamakhaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 85 \|\|*

83-85. Because, the planets, cow, Narendra and particularly the Brahmanas are when worshipped, make the worshipper respectable as well as adorable. Therefore, a person who is desirous of achieving fortunes, should not perform the yajna without giving daksina. With the giving away of the enough of daksina when a single planet is pleased, it is said to be equivalent to a Navagraha-yajna with ten thousand ahutis.

## \|\| 3.141.86 \|\|

*vivāhotsavayajñeṣu pratiṣṭhādiṣu karmasu \|*  
*nirvighnārthaṃ mahārāja tathodvegādbhuteṣu ca \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. During the performing of the marriage, some festival, a sacrifice besides the activities relating to the enhance of the prestige and on other occasions, for the achieving of the spotless success without obstruction, the homa must be performed.

## \|\| 3.141.87 \|\|

*kathito'yutahomo'yaṃ lakṣahomamataḥ śṛṇu \|*  
*sarvakāmāptaye yasmāllakṣa homaṃ vidurbudhāḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

87\. Besides this, I am explaining to you a yajna in which a lakh of offerings are to be made. You please listen. For achieving success in all the desires, the learned people have prescribed to essentially perform this homa for the achieving after success. This is known to be the Laksa-homa.

## \|\| 3.141.88-92 \|\|

*pitṝṇāṃ vallabho yasmādbhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ \|*  
*grahatārābalaṃ labdhvā kṛtvā brāhmaṇavācanam \|\| 88 \|\|*

*gṛhasyottarapūrveṇa maṇḍapaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*rudrāyatanabhūmau vā caturasramudaṅmukham \|\| 89 \|\|*

*daśahastamathāṣṭau vā hastānkuryādvidhānataḥ \|*  
*prāgudakpravaṇāṃ bhūmiṃ kārayedyatnato naraḥ \|\| 90 \|\|*

*prāguttaraṃ samāsādya pradeśaṃ maṃḍapasya tu \|*  
*śobhanaṃ kārayetkuṇḍaṃ yathāvallakṣaṇānvitam \|\| 91 \|\|*

*mānahīnaṃ cāpraśastamanekabhayadaṃ bhavet \|*  
*yasmāttasmātsusaṃpūrṇaṃ śāṃtikuṃḍaṃ vidhīyate \|\| 92 \|\|*

88-92. It is because, this yajna is quite favourite of the pitrs and bestows devotion as well as salvation. When the planets as well as the stars get favourable and strong, a Brahmana should have a pavilion made towards the north-east of the house, with the reciting of the Svastivacana or welfare mantras. The pavilion should be made or otherwise in the land of Rudra’s temple, a beautiful mandapa should be made. It should be square, facing north and built in an area of eight or ten cubits. The land of the pavilion should be sloping to the north. Towards the north of that place, an excellent altar or a kunda should be made because an altar without the proper size, causes several dangers. Therefore, an altar possessing all good characteristics known as santi-kunda should be made.

## \|\| 3.141.93-96 \|\|

*asmāddaśaguṇaḥ prokto lakṣahome svayaṃbhuvā \|*  
*āhutibhiḥ prayatnena dakṣiṇābhistathaiva ca \|\| 93 \|\|*

*dvihastavistṛtaṃ tadvaccaturhastāyataṃ punaḥ \|*  
*lakṣahome bhavetkuṇḍaṃ yonivaktraṃ trimekhalam \|\| 94 \|\|*

*saṃsthāpanāya devānāṃ vapratrayasamāvṛtam \|*  
*dviraṃgulocchrito vapraḥ prathamaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

*aṃgulocchrayasaṃyuktaṃ vapradvayamathopari \|*  
*dvyaṅgulastatra vistāraḥ sarveṣāṃ kathyate budhaiḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

93-96. The self-born lord Brahma has prescribed the size of Laksa-homa to be ten times greater in size. Such a type of altar along with excess number of the offerings yield excessive daksina. The yoni-mukha should be of the size of two or four cubits in length. It should be decorated with three chains around the altar. For the consecration of the gods, three stupas should be made. The first of these three should be two angulas in height, while the remaining two should have the height of an angula each. The learned people have described all the three of them to be spread in three angulas.

## \|\| 3.141.97-98 \|\|

*daśāṃgulocchritā bhittiḥ sthaṃḍilasya tathopari \|*  
*tasminnāvāhayeddevānpūrvavatpuṣpataṇḍulaiḥ \|\| 97 \|\|*

*ādityābhimukhāḥ sarvāḥ sthāpyāḥ pratyadhidevatāḥ \|*  
*sthāpanīyā muniśreṣṭhā nāṃtareṇa parāṅmukhāḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

97-98. The wall of the pedestal should be ten angulas in height, over which the deities are invoked by pouring the flowers and the unbroken rice as has been said earlier. О best of the sages, all the representative gods should be established in the presence of the Sungod and not at his back.

## \|\| 3.141.99 \|\|

*garutmānadhikastatra saṃpūjyaḥ śriyamicchatā \|*  
*samapīnaśarīrastu vāhanaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. Garuda should be adored by a person, desirous of achieving the fortunes. Because of his having the yellow body, he also serves as a vehicle to Brahma as a swan.

## \|\| 3.141.100-102 \|\|

*viṣapāpaharo nityamataḥ śāṃtiṃ prayaccha me \|*  
*pūrvavatkuṃbhamāmaṃtrya tadvaddhomaṃ samācaret \|\| 100 \|\|*

*sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ hutvā samitsaṃkhyādikaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*audumbarīmathārdrāṃ ca vakrakoṭaravarjitām \|\| 101 \|\|*

*bāhumātrāṃ srucaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ staṃbhadvayopari \|*  
*ghṛtadhārāṃ tathā samyagagnerupari pātayet \|\| 102 \|\|*

100-102. He should say – “O Garuda, you remove the sins as well as the poison, therefore you bestow peace on me.” As stated earlier, after consecrating the pitcher, a lakh of offerings should be made in the sacrificial vase of the wood of the wild tree known as the Audumbara, which should be deformed and with a hole in it, besides being a cubit in length and with a wide mouth. Offering both the sacrificial pastes, the stream of ghi should be poured in the fire.

## \|\| 3.141.103 \|\|

*pāṭhayetsūktamāgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ raudramaiṃdavam \|*  
*mahāvaiśvānaraṃ sāma jyeṣṭhasāma ca pāṭhayet \|\| 103 \|\|*

103\. At that point of time, Agni, Viṣṇu, Rudra and the Suktas of Candra, Mahavaisvanara, Sama and Jyestha-Sama should be recited.

## \|\| 3.141.104-106 \|\|

*snānaṃ tu yajamānasya pūrvavanmantravācanam \|*  
*dātavyā yajamānena pūrvavaddakṣiṇā pṛthak \|\| 104 \|\|*

*kāmakrodhavihīnena ṛtvigbhyaḥ śāṃtacetasaḥ \|*  
*navagraha makhe viprāścatvāro vedavedinaḥ \|\| 105 \|\|*

*atha vā ṛtvijau śāṃtau dvāveva tvatikovidau \|*  
*kāryāvayutahome tu na prasajyeta vistare \|\| 106 \|\|*

104-106. After taking bath and reciting the mantras, the yajamana getting free from kama and anger, should peacefully give away the daksina to the Rtvijas (the yajna priests) individually, as was given earlier. In the Navagraha sacrifice, there should be four Brahmanas who should be quite well-versed in the Vedas, otherwise there could be two Brahmanas with peaceful nature who should be established as the sacrificial priests. In the performing of homa. With ten thousand ahutis, there is no need to increase the number of sacrificial priests.

## \|\| 3.141.107-111 \|\|

*tadvacca daśa cāṣṭau vā lakṣahome'pi ṛtvijaḥ \|*  
*kartavyāḥ śaktitastadvaccatvāro vā vimatsarāḥ \|\| 107 \|\|*

*navagrahamakhe sarvaṃ lakṣahome daśottaram \|*  
*dadyācca pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha bhūṣaṇānyapi śaktitaḥ \|\| 108 \|\|*

*śayanāni ca vastrāṇi haimāni kaṭakāni ca \|*  
*karṇāṃgulīpavitrāṇi bhaktimānpratipādayet \|\| 109 \|\|*

*na kuryāddakṣiṇāhīnaṃ vittaśāṭhyena mānavaḥ \|*  
*adadallobhamohābhyāṃ kulakṣayamavāpnuyāt \|\| 110 \|\|*

*annadānaṃ yathā śaktyā dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā \|*  
*annahīnaṃ vrataṃ yasmāddurbhikṣaphaladaṃ bhavet \|\| 111 \|\|*

107-111. Similarly, in the yajna with a lakh of offerings, eight or ten Brahmanas should be established as the yajna priests or alternatively, only four of them should be engaged who should be free of arrogance and jealousy. This is the Navagraha yajna, one lakh and ten ahutis or offerings should be made in the fire. О best of Pandavas, the yajamana, as per his means, should give away in charity the costumes, gold, armlets, earrings and the finger rings. On such an occasion, a person should not behave miserly because in case, the suitable charities are not given due to greed or otherwise, there is a possibility of the destine in the race. One who is desirous of fortunes, should as per his means, give away the food in charity because vrata performed without giving away of the food, result in a draught in the country. This is opinion of the scriptures.

## \|\| 3.141.112 \|\|

*rāṣṭraṃ hanyādaṃgahīno maṃtrahīnastu ṛtvijaḥ \|*  
*adakṣiṇo yajamānaṃ nāsti yajñasamo ripuḥ \|\| 112 \|\|*

112\. The yajna performed without the angas results in the destruction of the country. In case, the yajna is devoid of mantras, the yajna priest vanishes and when the yajna is devoid of daksina, the yajamana has to face the end.

## \|\| 3.141.113-114 \|\|

*na cāpyalpadhanaḥ kuryāllakṣahomaṃ naraḥ kvacit \|*  
*tasmātpīḍākaro nityaṃ ya eva bhavati grahaḥ \|\| 113 \|\|*

*tameva pūjayedbhaktyā dvau vā trīnvā yathāvidhi \|*  
*ekamapyarcayedbhaktyā brāhmaṇaṃ veda pāragam \|\| 114 \|\|*

113-114. There is no other enemy greater than the yajna. A person with limited means should never perform the yajna with a lakh of ahutis. Therefore, only the hostile planets should be worshipped. Because of his incompetence, a person can adore two or three planets at a time. In the said yajna, only a single Brahmana, well-versed in the Vedas, should be engaged for the purpose.

## \|\| 3.141.115-116 \|\|

*dakṣiṇābhiḥ prayatnena bahū्nvā bahuvittavān \|*  
*lakṣahomastu kartavyo yadi vittaṃ gṛhe gṛhe \|\| 115 \|\|*

*yataḥ sarvānavāpnoti kurvankāmānvidhānataḥ \|*  
*pūjyate śivaloke ca vasvādityamarudgaṇaiḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

115-116. But a wealthy person should engage enough of Brahmanas and honour them adequately. When there is enough of wealth in the house, the householder must perform the yajna of a lakh of offerings, because when it is performed in a proper manner, all the desires of a person become successful. Besides, he is honoured in the Sivaloka by Vasus, Adityas, Marudganas and others.

## \|\| 3.141.117-119 \|\|

*yāvatkalpaśatānyaṣṭāvatha mokṣamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*sakāmo yastvimaṃ kuryāllakṣahomaṃ yathāvidhi \|\| 117 \|\|*

*sa taṃ kāmamavāpnoti padaṃ cānaṃtyamaśnute \|*  
*putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam \|\| 118 \|\|*

*bhāryārthī śobhanāṃ bhāryāṃ kumārī ca śubhaṃ patim \|*  
*bhraṣṭarājyastathā rājyaṃ śrīkāmaḥ śriyamāpnuyāt \|\| 119 \|\|*

117-119. Upto the period of eight hundred kalpas, he enjoys all the comforts and ultimately, attains moksa or liberation. When the Laksa-homa is performed with a particular desire in mind, he gets the desired success indeed, but ultimately, he achieves Viṣṇupada as well. A person desirous of a son, gets a son; a person desirous of riches, gets the riches; the one desirous of a spouse, gets a beautiful wife; while an unmarried girl gets a beautiful husband. A king having lost his kingship, gets back the kingdom and the royal treasure

## \|\| 3.141.120 \|\|

*yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ taṃ tamāpnoti puṣkalam \|*  
*niṣkāmaḥ kurute yastu paraṃ brahma sa gacchati \|\| 120 \|\|*

120\. Therefore, with whatever desires this vrata is performed, all those desires are My fulfilled. In case, a person performs this vrata with a detached mind, he achieves Brahman.

## \|\| 3.141.121 \|\|

*śāṃtiṃ navagrahamayīṃ duritopaśāṃtiṃ rājankaroti bahunā vidhivaddvijendraiḥ \|*  
*kṣemaṃ subhikṣamatulaṃ kulavṛddhisaṃpattatrāsti yatra kurute bata lakṣahomam \|\| 121 \|\|*

121\. A lakh of offerings destroys the sins. When the same is performed, the performer achieves tranquility, enough of cereals, increase of race, besides the enormous riches.

## Chapter 142. Performance of Koti-homa

## \|\| 3.142.1-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*rājā saṃvaraṇaḥ pūrvaṃ pratiṣṭhāne purottame \|*  
*babhūva sa mahābhāgaḥ śāstrārthakuśalo balī \|\| 1 \|\|*

*brahmaṇyaḥ pitṛbhaktaśca devabrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ \|*  
*tasyātha kurvato rājyaṃ samyakpālayataḥ prajāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ājagāma mahāyogī sanako brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*dattvā tasyāsanaṃ rājā praṇamya śirasā tathā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*pūjayitvārghyapādyādyairātmānaṃ vinivedya ca \|*  
*itihāsapurāṇoktāścakāra vividhāḥ kathāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇāṃ ca caritāni yathārthavit \|*  
*tataḥ kathāṃtare rājā kāryaṃ manasi saṃsthitam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*hitāya pṛthivīśānāṃ jagataścātmanastathā \|*  
*papraccha vinayopeto yogācāryaṃ mahāmatiḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – Once in the ancient times, there had been a king known by the name of Samvarana, who had been quite a noble soul. He was quite strong and was well-versed in the scriptures. He used to adore the gods and the Brahmanas, was devoted to the parents and also well looked after the people. Once the great yogi Sanaka reached his kingdom. The king offered his salutation to the yogi lowering his head and offered him a respectable seat. Thereafter, he provided the customary welcome to him, respect and honour. After engaging of his welfare, the king discussed with the great yogi about the ancient historical events, the great Rajarsis and their life events. Thereafter, the king, who was quite a righteous one, expressed his mental feelings before the yogi, which was beneficial for other rulers, the entire universe and for himself as well. Then the humble king asked the Yogacarya.

## \|\| 3.142.7-10 \|\|

*saṃvaraṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhagavanmahadutpātasaṃbhave bhūprakaṃpane \|*  
*nirghāte pāṃśuvarṣe ca gṛhabhaṃge tathaiva ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

*janmanakṣatrapīḍāsu anāvṛṣṭibhayeṣu ca \|*  
*jvareṣu grahapīḍāsu durbhikṣe rāṣṭravigrahe \|\| 8 \|\|*

*vyādhīnāṃ saṃbhave jāte śarīre cātipīḍite \|*  
*kleśe mahati cotpanne kiṃ kartavyaṃ narottamaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*svargasya sādhanaṃ yacca kīrtidaṃ dhanadaṃ tathā \|*  
*prabrūhi me dvijaśreṣṭha tathārogyapradaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. Samvarana said - What is the duty of the king at the time of great calamity, earthquakes, exodus, duststorm, destruction of the houses, causing of pain by the constellations, during the draught, loss of rainfall, suffering from fever, disturbance in the house, famine, disturbance in the country, start of epidemic, ailment in the body and the appearing of the great danger? О best of the Brahmanas, you kindly speak out some remedy, which could relieve the people of misery, being the source of achieving of the heaven, besides it should also provide the people enormous glory, good health and the heaven.

## \|\| 3.142.11-18 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇurājanpravakṣyāmi śāṃtikarma hyanuttamam \|*  
*koṭihomākhyamatulaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*brahmahatyādipāpāni yena naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt \|*  
*utpātā praśamaṃ yāṃti mahatsaṃpadyate sukham \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vidhānaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhava \|*  
*devāgāre nadītīre vane vā bhavane'pi vā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*parvate vāpi kurvīta ya icchetkṣemamātmanaḥ \|*  
*śubhanakṣatrayoge ca vāre pūrvaguṇānvite \|\| 14 \|\|*

*yajamānasyānukūlye koṭihomaṃ samācaret \|*  
*pūjayitvā prayatnena brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*vastrairvibhūṣaṇaiścaiva gaṃdhamālyānulepanaiḥ \|*  
*praṇamya vidhivattasmai ātmānaṃ vinivedayet \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tvaṃ no gatiḥ pitā mātā tvaṃ gatistvaṃ parāyaṇaḥ \|*  
*tvatprasādena viprarṣe sarvaṃ me syānmanogatam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*āpadvimokṣāya ca me kuru yajñamanuttamam \|*  
*koṭihomārthamatulaṃ śāṃtyarthaṃ sārvakāmikam \|\| 18 \|\|*

11-18. Sanatkumara said – I am speaking to you about the peace earning rite which is in the form of a homa, in which a crore of offerings are made. It is charming and fulfills all the desires. You please listen. With the performing of this vrata, all the sins like Brahmahatya vanish in a moment, the disturbances are subsided and one attains the enormous pleasure. I am going to reveal the process for the same. You listen to me attentively. A person, who is desirous of welfare, should perform the related ritualistic performance in a temple, river bank, forest, home or the mountain top during the auspicious constellation, auspicious day, when the planets are favourable. Thereafter, the yajamana should please a competent Brāhmaṇa by giving away the costumes, ornaments and fragrance who is well-versed in the Vedas. He should be worshipped appropriately saying- “You are my movement, my mother, my father, and the cause of the movement. О Brahmarsi, by your grace, let my mental desire be fulfilled. In order to relieve me of all the calamities, you kindly bestow your grace to get all the misfortunes removed, while performing the koti-homa with success.” It is said to fulfill all the desires besides bestowing peace on all the people.

## \|\| 3.142.19-26 \|\|

*purohitastataḥ prājñaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇairvedasaṃvṛttaiḥ puṇyairyuktaḥ samāhitaiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*bhūmibhāge same śuddhe prāgudakpravaṇe tathā \|*  
*puṇyāhaṃ vācayetpūrvaṃ kṛtvā viprānsupūjitān \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tatastu mahitairvipraḥ sūtrayenmaṇḍapaṃ śubham \|*  
*uttamaṃ śatahastaṃ tu tadardhena tu madhyamam \|*  
*jaghanyaṃ tu tadardhena śaktikālādyapekṣayā \|\| 21 \|\|*

*madhye tu maṇḍapasyāpi kuṃḍaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*aṣṭahastapramāṇena āyāmena tathaiva ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

*mekhalātritayaṃ tasya dvādaśāṃgulavistatam \|*  
*tatpramāṇāṃ tathā yoniṃ kurvīta susamāhitaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*kuṃḍasya pūrvabhāge tu vediṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*caturhastāṃ samāṃ caiva hastamātrocchritaḥ nṛpa \|\| 24 \|\|*

*sthānaṃ tatsarvabhūtānāṃ kuryādyatnena buddhimān \|\| 25 \|\|*

*udalipya tato bhūmiṃ maṃḍapasya samīpataḥ \|*  
*vinyasetkalaśāṃstatra jalapūrṇāṃścaturdaśa \|\| 26 \|\|*

19-26. Thereafter, a learned priest, clad in white garments, getting purified himself, together with other learned Brahmanas well-versed in the Vedas, should perform puja at same auspicious spot and worship the Brahmanas. Thereafter, with the use of the same set of Brahmanas, erecting of an excellent mandapa or a pavilion should be started, which should spread to a hundred cubits, because a pavilion of half of that size is considered to be the medium type. The pavilion of half of its size, (twenty five cubits in length) is said to be the degraded one. But according to the opportunity, anyone of these types could be made use of. A learned person should build an altar of eight cubits having the height of twelve angulas and decorated with three chains. The yoni of the same type should also be made with the kunda and a pedestal of four cubits length and one cubit in width should be made, where the deities should be established. To the close of the mandapa, a small piece of land should be plastered with the cowdung and four pitchers filled with water should be established over the same.

## \|\| 3.142.27-29 \|\|

*aśvatthaplakṣacūtādyaiḥ pallavairupaśobhitān \|*  
*vitānamupariṣṭācca maṃḍapasya prakalpayet \|\| 27 \|\|*

*sthāpayeddikṣu sarvāsu toraṇāni vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāraiḥ purodhāḥ susamāhitaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*puṇyāhajayaghoṣeṇa homakarma samārabhet \|*  
*sthāpayitvā surānvedyāṃ vakṣyamāṇānariṃdama \|\| 29 \|\|*

27-29. These pitchers should be covered with the tender shoots of the trees like holy fig tree, Mango, Ficus glomerata and Banyan trees. In the interior of the mandapa, a canopy should also be set up, decorating the same with four archers in the four sides. A large number of materials in huge quantities should be collected in the canopy and thereafter, the process of performing the yajna should be started. О destroyer of the enemies, after establishing the vedi, I am going to speak about the deities to be consecrated over the same.

## \|\| 3.142.30-31 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaṃ pūrvabhāge tu madhye devaṃ janārdanam \|*  
*paścime tu tathā rudraṃ vasūnuttaratastathā \|\| 30 \|\|*

*aiśānyāṃ ca grahānsarvānāgneyyāṃ marutastathā \|*  
*vāyuṃ saumyāṃ tathaiśānyāṃ lokapālānkrameṇa tu \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. To the east of the pedestal, Brahma is to be placed; Janardana is to be placed in the centre; Rudra is to be lodged in the west; while Vasus are to be lodged in the north. In the north-east, all the planets are to be lodged. In the south-east direction, the Windgod has to be lodged and in the north-east, the Lokapalas should be lodged.

## \|\| 3.142.32-35 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃsthāpya vibudhānyathāsthānaṃ nṛpottama \|*  
*pūjayedvidhivadvastragandhamālyānulepanaiḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*vedoktamaṃtraistalliṅgaiḥ purāṇoktaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak \|*  
*ādityā vasavo rudrā lokapālāstathā grahāḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*brahmā janārdanaścaiva śūlapāṇirbhagākṣihā \|*  
*atra saṃnihitāḥ sarve bhavaṃtu sukhabhāginaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*pūjāṃ gṛhṇaṃtu sarvetra mayā bhaktyopapāditām \|*  
*kurvaṃtu ca śubhaṃ sarve yajñakarma samāhitāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

32-35. After thus placing the gods in their proper positions, they should be offered the costumes, garlands and other things, individually to each one of them. Then reciting the mantras from Vedas and Puranas all of them should be adored. Then Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Lokapalas, all the planets, Brahma, Janardana, Siva – the holder of trident and other deities should be lodged each over the pedestal, and should accept the worship offered by me with devotion and should contribute to make my yajna a success.

## \|\| 3.142.36-40 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā tāndevānyatnena śuddhadhīḥ \|*  
*naivedyairvividhairbhakṣyaiḥ phalaiḥ patraistathaiva ca \|\| 36 \|\|*

*tatastu tairdvijaiḥ sārddhaṃ kuṃḍasya vidhipūrvakam \|*  
*kuryātsaṃskārakaraṇaṃ yathoktaṃ vedacintakaiḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tataḥ samāhvayedvahniṃ nāmnā khyātaṃ ghṛtārciṣam \|*  
*niyojayeddvijāṃstatra śatasaṃkhyānnṛpottama \|*  
*alābhe tu bahūnā ca yathālābhaṃ niyojayet \|\| 38 \|\|*

*vidyāvṛddhānvayovṛddhāngṛhasthānsaṃyatendriyān \|*  
*svakarmaniyatāñjñānaśīlāñchāntāndvijottamān \|\| 39 \|\|*

*ciṃtayettatra deveśaṃ paṃcāsyaṃ nṛpa pāvakam \|*  
*mukhāni tasya catvāri sapta jihvāśca pārthiva \|\| 40 \|\|*

36-40. Thus with a pure heart, the worship of the gods should be done, offering the naivedya, eatables etc. After thus performing the worship with a purified heart, the yajamana should perform the concluding rites of the yajna and then the fire named Gjtarci should be consecrated. О best of the rulers, when the Нота is thus performed in an appropriate manner, the yajamana earns the merit of performing a hundred Asvamedha sacrifice or other. Whosoever Brāhmaṇa one is able to find, he should be entrusted the task of performing the sacrifice. A learned Brāhmaṇa, whosoever is found, or an old householder, the one who has controlled all the sense organs, who is engaged in performing his own duty, highly learned and a peaceful Brāhmaṇa should be there. Thereafter, one should meditate upon five-faced Agni, besides the one with four faces and seven tongues.

## \|\| 3.142.41-42 \|\|

*ekajihvamathaikaṃ tu tatsmṛtaṃ sarvakāmadam \|*  
*dhūmāyamāne mana vṛthā hotavyaṃ jvalite nale \|\| 41 \|\|*

*ṛgbhiḥ pūrvāmukhairhomo yajurbhiścottarāmukhaiḥ \|*  
*sāmabhiḥ paścime kāryo'tharvabhirdakṣiṇāmukhaiḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. О Partha, only one of his tongue grants all file desires. The pouring of the offering in the burning fire with smoke is considered to be of no consequence. At the time of performing the homa, the Rgvedi Brāhmaṇa should face the east; Yajurvedi Brāhmaṇa should face the north; the Samavedi Brāhmaṇa should face the west; while Atharvavedi Brāhmaṇa should face the south, while making the offerings.

## \|\| 3.142.43-45 \|\|

*āghārāvājya bhāgau tu pūrvaṃ hutvā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*paritotha paristīrṇe kalpitai ca tathāsane \|\| 43 \|\|*

*brahmāṇaṃ pūrvamapyetatsarvaṃ paścātsamācaret \|*  
*homo vyāhṛtibhiścaiva sarvastatra vidhīyate \|\| 44 \|\|*

*praṇavādibhistalliṃgaiḥ svāhākārāṃtayojitaiḥ \|*  
*juhuyātsarvadevānāṃ vedyāṃ ye copakalpitāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

43-45. The offerings of Adhara-bhaga and the Ajya-bhaga should be poured in the altar. Thereafter, the offerings should be made for Brahma, who is supposed to be seated around the altar. Thereafter, making use of Omkara every time at the start of uttering each one of the mantras, the word Svaha should be added at the end in favour of all the gods who had been lodged over the pedestal.

## \|\| 3.142.46-47 \|\|

*evaṃ prakalpaye dyajñaṃ koṭihomākhyamuttamam \|*  
*tilāḥ kṛṣṇā ghṛtābhyaktāḥ kiñcidyavasamanvitāḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*hotavyāḥ koṭihome tu samidhaśca palāśajāḥ \|*  
*pūrṇe pūrṇesahasre tu dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ śubhām \|*  
*pañcame tanmukhe rājansarvakāmārthasiddhaye \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. Thus while performing the sacrifice, a crore of homas should be performed making use of the black sesamum seeds, a little quantity of barley, soaked in ghi. The twigs of palasa should be used while performing the homa. After completion of a thousand offerings, purnahuti should also be performed, О king, for the success of all the desires, all the purnahuti should be poured in the fifth mouth of the fire.

## \|\| 3.142.48-50 \|\|

*pūrṇāhutyaḥ samākhyātāḥ koṭihome narādhipa \|*  
*sahasrāṇi nṛpaśreṣṭha daśa śāstraviśāradaiḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*prāraṃbhadinamārabhya brāhmaṇairbrahmavādibhiḥ \|*  
*bhāvyaṃ sayajamānaistu athavā sapurohitaiḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*krodhalobhādayo doṣā varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ \|*  
*yajamānena rājendra savargakāmānabhīpsitā \|\| 50 \|\|*

48-50. О king, while organizing a koti-homa, ten thousand Brahmanas, who should be well- versed in the scriptures and devoted to Brahman, should be selected to officiate as the priests. At the start, after performing of the koti-homa, till the date of the conclusion of the yajha, all the Brahmanas with priests as well as the yajamdna should always distance themselves from the anger, greed, besides the other blemishes. In case this is faithfully done, only then the performer can have all his desires fulfilled.

## \|\| 3.142.51-53 \|\|

*saṃvaraṇa uvāca \|*  
*bahutvātkarmaṇo brahmankoṭi homaḥ suduṣkaraḥ \|*  
*kālena mahatā caiva śakyaḥ prāptuṃ kathaṃcana \|\| 51 \|\|*

*niyamādbrahmacaryādvā duṣkaro hīti me matiḥ \|*  
*nirodho'tra brāhmaṇānāṃ bhṛśayyādiṣu duṣkaraḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*kāryādgurutayā yasmātparvakālādyapekṣayā \|*  
*etadvijñāyate brahmanyadi śāstreṣu kathyate \|*  
*koṭihomasya saṃkṣepaṃ vada me brahma saṃbhava \|\| 53 \|\|*

51-53. Samvarana said – О Brahman, due to the enormous nature of the deeds which cover such a great person, how could the koti-homa be within the reach of all the people? Moreover, keeping in view the sleeping on the floor, observing of the Brahmacarya and other restrictions, I feel that koti-homa would be difficult to be performed during the festivals. Therefore, О Brahmana comparing with the great Brahman, it is apparently difficult to be performed. You kindly enlighten me on the scriptural provision of koti-homa.

## \|\| 3.142.54-60 \|\|

*sanatkumāra uvāca \|*  
*śatānano daśamukho dvimukhaikamukhastathā \|*  
*caturvidho mahārāja koṭihomo vidhīyate \|\| 54 \|\|*

*kāryasya gurutāṃ jñātvā naiva kuryādaparvaṇi \|*  
*yathā saṃkṣepataḥ kāryaḥ koṭihomastathā śṛṇu \|\| 55 \|\|*

*kṛtvā kuṃḍaśataṃ divyaṃ yathoktaṃ hasta saṃmitam \|*  
*ekaikasmiṃstataḥ kuṃḍe śataṃ viprānniyojayet \|\| 56 \|\|*

*sadyaḥ pakṣe tu viprāṇāṃ sahasraṃ parikīrtitam \|*  
*ekasthānapraṇītegnau sarvataḥ paribhāvite \|\| 57 \|\|*

*homaṃ kuryurdvijāḥ sarve kuṇḍe kuṇḍe yathoditam \|*  
*yathā kuṃḍabahutve'pi rājasūye mahākratau \|\| 58 \|\|*

*na ca vahnibahutvaṃ syāttatra yajñe vidhīyate \|*  
*tathā kuṃḍaśate'pyatra ghṛtārciṣi vitānite \|\| 59 \|\|*

*eka eva bhavedyajñaḥ koṭihomo na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ yatkriyate kṣipraṃ vyākulaiḥ kāryagauravāt \|*  
*śatānanaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ koṭihomo na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

54-60. Sanatkumara said – The koti-homa is said to be of four types, viz. Satamukha, Dasamukha, Dvimukha and Ekamukha. Because of the gravity of the task, it should not be started on any day except the festive occasion. I am going to narrate about the performing of it in brief. You please listen. The length and breadth of the divine kunda should be same as has been stated earlier. For each one of the fire altars, a hundred Brāhmaṇas have to be engaged. For the performance of the offering, a thousand Brāhmaṇas should be appointed at one place. After igniting the fire in one altar, the same should be carried to the other altars. All the Brahmana should perform homa in all the altars accordingly. This has the same pattern as we find in the Asvamedha sacrifice, when there is an excessive number of the altars, the fires are not multiplied. Therefore, in the koti-homa sacrifice, inspite of the number of the altars being a hundred or so, which remain ignited with the Grtaci fire, it is called as the koti-yajna. There is no doubt about it. Similarly, due to the gravity of the eagerness, one who performs expeditiously, he is known as the Satanana performer of the koti-homa.

## \|\| 3.142.61-65 \|\|

*svalpairahobhiḥ kāryaḥ syādvarṣākālādike'pi vā \|*  
*tadā daśaguṇaḥ kāryaḥ koṭihomo vijānatā \|\| 61 \|\|*

*viprāṇāṃ dve śate tatra suvibhajya niyojayet \|*  
*te'pi vijñānaśīlāḥ syurvratavaṃto jitendriyāḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*bhūpa kuṃḍadvayaṃ kṛtvā vibhajya ca vibhāvasum \|*  
*homaṃ kuryurdvijā bhūyaḥ saṃskṛtya vidhipūrvakam \|\| 63 \|\|*

*śataṃ tatra niyojyaṃ syādviprāṇāṃ pravibhajya vai \|*  
*māse vātha dvimāse vā yathākāle hyupasthite \|\| 64 \|\|*

*evaṃ ca dvimukhaṃ kāryaḥ koṭihomo vicakṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

61-65. In case, a person is desirous to perform the koti-homa in short duration or during the rainy season, then the person who is well-versed in the performing of the koti-homa sacrifice, should make the altars ten times more in number than those which are usually prescribed. Thereafter, two hundred Brāhmaṇas, who should be quite learned, having controlled all the sense organs, should be entrusted with the job. The place at which the two altars are made and the fire is divided in an appropriate manner, the homa should be performed at the same time. Then three hundred Brahmanas should be entrusted with the responsibility individually. They should be required to perform their assignments in a month or two. The homa thus performed is known as the Dvimukha koti-homa.

## \|\| 3.142.66-69 \|\|

*yadā tu svecchayā yajñaṃ yajamānaḥ samāpayet \|*  
*kālena bahudhā rājaṃstadā caikamukho bhavet \|\| 66 \|\|*

*ekakuṃḍasthito vahnirekacittaiḥ samāhitaiḥ \|*  
*yathālābha sthitairviprairjñānaśīlairvicakṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

*na saṃkhyāniyamaścātra brāhmaṇānāṃ narottama \|*  
*na kālaniyamaścaiva svecchāyajñaḥ sa ucyate \|\| 68 \|\|*

*āvṛttyā sarvakāmasya cāturmāsyānukarmavat \|*  
*tadaprasaktau kartavyo yajño'yaṃ sārvakālikaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

66-69. In case the yajamana intends to perform the yajna in a longer period, he becoming alert, should build a single altar and the fire should be consecrated in the same. The homa thus performed is known as the Ekamukha koti-homa. Whatever the number of Brahmanas could be found, should be deputed for the same task. Therefore, in such cases, there is no restriction of time as well as the number of the Brahmanas to be engaged. This is termed as Sveccha-yajna. Like the activities of four months, in this case also, all the formalities should be observed. Therefore, it should be completed in the shortest possible manner.

## \|\| 3.142.70-71 \|\|

*ayamekamukho rājankālena bahunā bhavet \|*  
*bahuvighnaśca kālena tasmātsaṃkṣepamācaret \|\| 70 \|\|*

*yato hi cittavittādyamāyuścaivāsthiraṃ sadā \|*  
*ataḥ saṃkṣepataḥ kāryaṃ dharmakāryaṃ praśasyate \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. Since the minds, financial positions, besides the age never remain stable, the religious activity should be completed in a short time. At the conclusion of the yajna, the festival should be celebrated blowing the conches, trumpets, besides the playing of the welfare music. Therefore, the slogans of victory should be shouted.

## \|\| 3.142.72-74 \|\|

*tataḥ samāpte yajñe tu kārayetsumahotsavam \|*  
*śaṃkhatūryaninādena brahmaghoṣasvanena ca \|\| 72 \|\|*

*tatastu dīkṣayedvinprānhotṝṃśca śraddhayānvitaḥ \|*  
*niṣkaiśca kaṃkaṇaiścaiva kuṇḍalairvividhairnṛpa \|\| 73 \|\|*

*gośataṃ caiva dātavyamaśvānāṃ ca śataṃ tadā \|*  
*sahasraṃ ca suvarṇasya sarveṣāmapi dāpayet \|\| 74 \|\|*

72-74. Thereafter, the yajna priests should be given the armlets of gold, besides the earrings, a hundred cows, a hundred horses, while a thousand gold coins should also be given to the Brahmanas. The yajna should then be concluded with the giving away of the villages, elephants, chariots, horses, clothes and the priests have to be adored.

## \|\| 3.142.75-78 \|\|

*grāmairgajai rathairaśvaiḥ pūjayecca purohitam \|*  
*dīnāndhakṛpaṇānsarvānvastrādyaiścāpi pūjayet \|\| 75 \|\|*

*tataścāvabhṛthaṃ snāyāttairghaṭaiḥ pūrvakalpitaiḥ \|*  
*lakṣahomoktamaṃtreṇa sadā vijayakāriṇā \|\| 76 \|\|*

*evaṃ samāpayedyastu koṭihomamakhaṃ śubham \|*  
*tasyārogyaṃ vittaputrarāṣṭravṛddhistathaiva ca \|\| 77 \|\|*

*sarvapāpakṣayaścaiva jāyate nṛpasattama \|*  
*anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ caiva utpātabhayameva ca \|\| 78 \|\|*

75-78. With chanting of the Laksa homa mantra, the king should be bathed with the sanctified water of the pitchers. A king who is desirous of victory, when completes the koti-homa yajna in this way, he achieves good health, enormous fortunes and expansion of the country. All his sins are removed and all the national problems get solved. This yajna is meritorious, remover of the sins, besides fulfill all the desires. This is what the Maharsi Sanatkumara had spoken to the king.

## \|\| 3.142.79 \|\|

*durbhikṣaṃ grahapīḍā ca praśamaṃ yāti bhūtale \|*  
*etatpuṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam \|*  
*sanatkumāramuninā pārthivāya niveditum \|\| 79 \|\|*

79\. Therefore, tor the removal of the disturbance in one’s places and other places, when the koti-homa yajna is performed in an appropriate manner, the auspicious people enjoying all the desired pleasures on earth, ultimately achieve the place of Indra.

## Chapter 143. Maha Santi-vidhi

## \|\| 3.143.1-9 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*mahāśāṃtiṃ pravakṣyāmi mahādevena bhāṣitām \|*  
*pārthivānāṃ hitārthāya mahādustaratāriṇīm \|\| 1 \|\|*

*nṛpābhiṣeke sā kāryā yātrākāle nṛpasya tu \|*  
*duḥsvapne durnimitte ca grahavaiguṇyasaṃbhave \|\| 2 \|\|*

*vidyudulkānipāte ca janmarkṣe grahadaivate \|*  
*ketūdaye'tha saṃjāte nirghāte kṣitikampane \|\| 3 \|\|*

*prasūtau mūlagaṇḍānte yamalasya tu saṃbhave \|*  
*chatrāṇāṃ ca dhvajānāṃ ca svasthānātpatane bhuvi \|*  
*kākolūkakapotānāṃ praveśe veśmanastathā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*krūragrahāṇāṃ vakratve janmādiṣu viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*janmani dvādaśe caiva caturthe vāṣṭame tathā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*yadā syurgurumandā'rāḥ sūryaścaiva viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*yuddhe grahāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ sūryaśītāṃśukīlake \|\| 6 \|\|*

*vastrāyudhagavāśveṣu maṇikeśavināśane \|*  
*yadyagre paridṛśyeta rātrāviṃdradhanustathā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*veśmanaśca tulābhaṃge garbheṣvaśvatarīṣu ca \|*  
*ravīndvoruparāgeṣu mahāśāṃtiḥ praśasyate \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sarvāṇi durnimittāni praśamaṃ yānti sarvathā \|*  
*tāṃ kuryurbrāhmaṇāḥ paṃca kulaśīlasamanvitāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

1-9. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – I am now speaking to you about the Maha-Santi, which was spoken by Mahadeva for the removal of the sufferings of the people and can save them from grave situations. This should be performed at the time of the crowing of the kings, at the victory of the kings, during the evil effects of the planets, fall of comets or lightnings, at the birth of a child (to remove the ill effects of the planets), at the time of the rise of the Ketu, hailstorm, earthquakes, birth of a child in Mula constellation, birth of twins, falling of the chatra (royal umbrella), flywhisks and the flag on the ground, at the entry of a crow, a pigeon or an owl in the house, when the hostile planets become opponent, when Brhaspati, Sani and Surya are lodged in the twelfth, fourth and the eighth house, when the Sun, Moon and other planets getting obstructed during the war, when the top gems of the costumes, weapons, horse or the hair of the head is lost, when the rainbow appears in the night and at the time of the destruction of the weighing balance as well as the living house, in all these situations the performing of the Maha-Santi rites are required to be performed and by so doing, all the evil situations get removed. The relevant rites should be performed by five Brāhmaṇas.

## \|\| 3.143.10-12 \|\|

*caturvedāstrivedāśca dvivedāścāpi pāṃḍava \|*  
*ātharvaṇā viśeṣeṇa bahvṛcā yajusaṃyutāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*śucayaḥ śrutasaṃpannā japahomaparāyaṇāḥ \|*  
*kṛcchrapārākanaktādyaiḥ kṛtakāya viśodhanāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*pūrvamārādhya maṃtraistu prārabheta kriyāṃ tataḥ \|*  
*daśadvādaśahastaṃ vā maṃḍapaṃ kārayecchubham \|\| 12 \|\|*

10-12. These Brāhmaṇas should be well-versed in the four Vedas or three Vedas or two Vedas or the Atharvaveda. Besides this, the Brahmanas should be auspicious souls, well-versed in the Yajurveda and several Rca’s of the other Vedas, besides being efficient in the performing of the homa and other scriptures. They should have purified their bodies with the performing of the night fasts. Initially, the deities should be invoked with the reciting of the mantras. A mandapa or a pavilion should be made of ten or twelve cubits, which should be well decorated.

## \|\| 3.143.13-15 \|\|

*tanmadhye vedikāṃ kuryāccaturhasta pramāṇataḥ \|*  
*āgneyyāṃ kārayetkuṃḍaṃ hastamātraṃ suśobhanam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*mekhalātrayasaṃyuktaṃ yonyā cāpi vibhūṣitam \|*  
*baddhacandanamālaṃ ca toraṇālaṃkṛtaṃ tathā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*gomayenopalipte ca maṃḍape tu dvijātayaḥ \|*  
*śuklāmbaradharaḥ snātāḥ śuklamālyānulepanāḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. A pedestal of four cubits square should be made therein. On its south-east, an altar of a cubit square should be made with three chains, besides the display of yoni-mudra. The mandapa should be further decorated with ashes. The interior of the mandapa should be plastered with the cow’s dung. The Brahmanas should take their bath and then clad themselves in the white garments plastering their bodies with the sandal paste. They should have a white rosary on their person, looking graceful.

## \|\| 3.143.16-17 \|\|

*tataśca pañca kalaśāṃstasyāṃ vedyāṃ niyojayet \|*  
*āgneyādiṣu koṇeṣu pañcamaṃ madhyatastathā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*aṣṭāsrālaṃkṛte padme cūtapallavaśobhite \|*  
*brahmakūrcavidhānena paṃcagavyaṃ tu kārayet \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. On the four comers of the pedestal, four pitchers filled with water should be placed. The fifth pitcher filled with water should be placed in the centre. These pitchers should be decorated with the tender shoots of the mango and other trees, besides the eight petalled lotus flowers. Thereafter, the pancagavya should be prepared on the basis of Brahmakurca method.

## \|\| 3.143.18-20 \|\|

*auṣadhīḥ pañcaratnāni rocanāṃ candanaṃ tathā \|*  
*siddhārthakāñchamīdūrvāḥ kuśānvrīhiryavāṃstathā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*apāmārgaṃ phalavatīṃ nyagrodhoduṃbarau tathā \|*  
*plakṣāśvatthakapitthāṃśca priyaṃgucūtapallavān \|\| 19 \|\|*

*hastidaṃtamṛdaṃ caiva koṇakumbheṣu nikṣipet \|*  
*puṇyatīrthodakānnaṃ ca dhānyaṃ gavyaṃ ca madhyame \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. All the herbs, the five gems, gorocana, sandal paste, mustard, acacia luma, durva grass, kusa grass, cereals, barley, fruits, snake gourd, banyan, ficus glamoreta, Indian Fig tree, pipala, feronia elephantum, black mustard and the tender mango shoots, ivory and the sand should be poured into the pitcher of water placed on comers. The water of the sacred places and the grains produced by the same water, besides the cereals should also be poured into the pitchers.

## \|\| 3.143.21-22 \|\|

*kūrcaṃ vācamitīdaṃ ca vahnikumbhābhimantraṇam \|*  
*āśuḥ śiśāno mantreṇa mantraṇaṃ vāyugocare \|\| 21 \|\|*

*īśāvāsyaṃ caturthasya kumbhasya cābhimaṃtraṇam \|*  
*madhyame japitavyāstu rudrakumbhe bhavodbhavāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Reciting the mantra – “Kurca vacamiti" the pitcher of the south-east comer should be sanctified. Then reciting the mantra – “Asuh Sisano,” the pitcher of the north-west side should be sanctified. Reciting the mantra- “Isavasyam" the kalasa of the north-west should be sanctified. Then uttering the mantra – “Rudrakumbhe bhavodbhavd," the pitcher in the centre should be sanctified.

## \|\| 3.143.23-24 \|\|

*gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatairvastrairnaivaidyairghṛtapācitaiḥ \|*  
*phalaiśca nārikelādyairdīpakaiḥ kuṃbhapūjanam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*svastivācanakaṃ caiva kārayettadanaṃtaram \|*  
*krameṇānena śanakairagnikāryaṃ prayojayet \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. Thereafter, offering the fragrance, unbroken rice, costumes, eatables mixed with ghi, fruit, coconut and lamp should be offered before the pitchers. Thereafter, the Svastivacana (reciting of the welfare mantras), should be uttered. The homa should be performed thereafter.

## \|\| 3.143.25-31 \|\|

*agniṃ dūtamiti hyagniṃ pūrvameva nidhāpayet \|*  
*hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samiti brahmāsananiyojanam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*kapotasupraṇītena maṃtreṇa viniśeṣayet \|*  
*kṛtvā cāvaraṇaṃ vahnerājyasaṃskārameva ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

*atha cāsādayeddravyaṃ yathāvatsaprayojanam \|*  
*tataḥ puruṣasūktena pāyasaśrapaṇaṃ bhavet \|\| 27 \|\|*

*abhighāryātha saṃsiddhaṃ tathā saṃsthāpayedbhuvi \|*  
*aṣṭādaśapramāṇedhmāndadyādatha śamīmayān \|\| 28 \|\|*

*pālāśī samidhaḥ sapta tathā sapteti dāpayet \|*  
*āghārāvājyabhāgau tu hutvā pūrvakrameṇa tu \|\| 29 \|\|*

*juhuyādāhutīḥ sapta jātavedasa ityṛcā \|*  
*sthālīpākasya juhuyātpunarvai jātavedasā \|\| 30 \|\|*

*taratsamaṃdī sūktena catasro juhuyāttataḥ \|*  
*yamāyeti ca saptānyāḥ svāhāṃtā juhuyāttataḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

25-31. Reciting the mantra – “Agnim dutamiti” initially, the fire should be ignited. Reciting the mantra – “Hiranyagarbhah,” the seat of Brahma should be purified and reciting the mantra – “Kapotasupranitena,” the fire should be consecrated. Thereafter, the rites of Avarana and Dravyasadana, with the use of Purusha-sukta should be done. Then, with the Abhidharya rite, the twigs should be placed on the earth. Out of the quantity of twigs, four should be of the acacia suma and fourteen should be of the beautia frondasa. The offerings of Aghara should be offered. Thereafter, reciting the Vedic rca – “Jatavedasa,” seven offerings should be poured in the fire. Then again reciting the mantra – “Jatavedasa,” the offerings should be poured. Then reciting – “Yamayeti,” another set of seven offerings should be poured.

## \|\| 3.143.32-40 \|\|

*idaṃ viṣṇustataḥ sapta juhuyādāhutīrnṛpa \|*  
*nakṣatrebhyastataḥ svāhā saptaviṃśada thāhutīḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*yatkarmaṇaiti juhuyāttataḥ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*grahahomastataḥ kāryastilairājyapariplutaiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*prāyaścittaṃ tato hutvā homakarma samāpayet \|*  
*tatastu tūryanirghoṣaiḥ kāhalāśaṃkhaniḥsvanaiḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*yajamānasya kartavyo hyabhiṣeko dvijottamaiḥ \|*  
*kāśmaryavṛkṣasaṃbhūte bhadre bhadrāsane sthitam \|\| 35 \|\|*

*vedimadhyagataṃ kṛtvā durnimittapraśāṃtaye \|*  
*paṃcabhiḥ kalaśaiḥ pūrṇairmaṃtrairebhiryathākramam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*sahasrākṣeṇa prathamaṃ tataścaiva śatā yuṣā \|*  
*sajoṣasā ca indreti viśvānītyṛgbhireva ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

*ṛtamastviti ca tataḥ snāpayeyuḥ samāhitāḥ \|*  
*tato diśāṃ baliṃ dadyādvicitrānna samāyutam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*namostu sarvabhūtebhya iti mantramudāharan \|*  
*snātasya brāhmaṇāḥ sarve paṭheyuḥ śāṃtimuttamām \|\| 39 \|\|*

*śāṃtitoyena dhārāṃ ca pātayitvā saṃmatataḥ \|*  
*puṇyāhavācanaṃ kṛtvā śāṃtikarma samāpayet \|\| 40 \|\|*

32-40. О king, then reciting the mantra – “Idam Viṣṇustata,” seven offerings are to be poured. Then twenty seven offerings should be poured for the sake of the constellations. Then reciting the mantra – “Yatkarmanaiti juhuyattatah svistakrta”, ahuti or offering should be made. Thereafter, the offering for the repentance homa should be offered, concluding the homa. Then producing the sound of conches, trumpets, small drums and other musical instruments on the bhadrapitha of the bulea frondosa tree, the consecration of the yajamana should be done for the purpose of peace. Taking water out of all the five kalasas or pitchers, reciting the mantra – “Sahasraksena” the water of the first pitcher should be dropped over the head of the yajamana. The water of the second pitcher should be dropped reciting the mantra – “Satayusa,” the water of the second pitcher; reciting the mantra – “Sajosasa ca Indreti” the water of the third pitcher; reciting the mantra – “Visakvani,” the water of the fourth pitcher and reciting the mantra – “Rtamastitvati,” the water of the fifth pitcher should be poured over the head of the yajamana. He should take a bath. Thereafter, reciting the mantra – “Namostu sarvabhutebhya," the offerings should be made in all the directions. After the yajamana takes his bath, the Brahmanas, while reciting the excellent Santipatha, should pour the water of peace on all the sides. Then performing the Punya ceremony, the Santi festival should be concluded.

## \|\| 3.143.41-42 \|\|

*kṣitiṃ hiraṇyaṃ vāsāṃsi śayanānyāsanāni ca \|*  
*viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādyathā śaktyā vimatsaraḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*dīnānāthaviśiṣṭebhyaḥ śrotriyebhyaśca dāpayet \|*  
*bhojanaṃ śobhanaṃ dattvā tataḥ sarvaṃ prasiddhyati \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Thereafter, the yajamana, as per his means, should give away in charity land, gold, costumes, bed, seat, etc., remaining unblemished. The poor, orphans and the Vedic Brahmanas should be served with the excellent food and by so doing, the giver attains the excellent things.

## \|\| 3.143.43-45 \|\|

*āyuśca labhate dīrghaṃ śatrūnvijayate kṣaṇāt \|*  
*durgāṇi cāsya sidyanti putrāṃśca labhate śubhān \|\| 43 \|\|*

*yathāśastraprahārāṇāṃ kavacaṃ vāraṇaṃ bhavet \|*  
*tathā daivopaghātānāṃ śāntirbhavati vāraṇam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*ahiṃsakasya dāṃtasya dharmārjitadhanasya ca \|*  
*dayādākṣiṇyayuktasya sarve sānugrahā grahāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

43-45. He achieves long life, immediate victory over the enemies, success in winning the fast, as well as the sons who stand for welfare. As the attack of the weapons is controlled by the coat of arms, similarly, the natural calamities are removed. All the people become friendly to a person who is non-violent, pure at heart, earns money by religious means, is compassionate as well as giver of charities or possess gentleness.

## \|\| 3.143.46 \|\|

*arthānsamarthayati varddhayate ca dharmaṃ kāmaṃ prasādhayati tasya pinaṣṭi pāpam \|*  
*yaḥ kārayetsakaladoṣaharīṃ samarthāṃ śāṃtiṃ praśāṃtahṛdayaḥ puruṣaḥ sadaiva \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Thus, this process is quite successful in the removal of blemishes. With the performing of this Santi-karma, a person with a disturbed mind has his fortunes, dharma always increases, besides having all his desires fulfilled, removing the sins at the same time.

## Chapter 144. Gananatha Santi-vidhi

## \|\| 3.144.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ kathaya deveśa gaṇanāthasya me vibho \|*  
*yāṃ kṛtvā sarvadurgāṇi tarate mānavo'khilaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said- О lord of the gods, you please tell me about the peace or Santi of Gananatha, as a result of which a human can cross impregnable forts.

## \|\| 3.144.2-7 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ vakṣyāmi rājendra gaṇanāthapriyāṃ parām \|*  
*yasyā ācaraṇenaiva sarvāriṣṭakṣayo bhavet \|\| 2 \|\|*

*vināyakaṃ karmāvighnasiddhyarthaṃ vinibodhata \|*  
*svapne'vagāhate'tyarthaṃ jalaṃ muṃḍāṃśca paśyati \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kāṣāyavāsasaścaiva kravyādānadhirohati \|*  
*apamūrdhaiḥ śave rudraiḥ sahaikatra ca tiṣṭhati \|\| 4 \|\|*

*vrajannapi tathātmānaṃ manyatenugataṃ paraiḥ \|*  
*vimanā viphalāraṃbhaḥ saṃsīdatyanimittataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tenopasṛṣṭo labhate na rājyaṃ rājanaṃdanaḥ \|*  
*kumārī na ca bhartāramapatyaṃ garbhiṇī tathā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ācāryatvaṃ śrotriyaśca na śiṣyo'dhyāpanaṃ tathā \|*  
*vaṇiglābhaṃ na cāpnoti na kṛṣiṃ ca kṛṣīvalaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

2-7. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – I am going to reveal before you the process of performing the Santi rites of Gananatha, with the completion of which all the evils get removed. For the accomplishment of the task without any obstruction, you listen about the Vinaya ceremony. With the incompletion of this ceremony, one finds huge storm in dream, appearing of a shaven head, a person clad in red ochre coloured garments, riding over a demon, living among the heads or trunks or the dead bodies, while walking for alms, developing a feeling of getting followed by some people, feeling depressed, all the efforts becoming unsuccessful, feeling painful without any cause, a princess fails to get a prince as a husband, pregnant generation, achieving the degree of a person well-versed in the reciting of the Vedas, failure of profit to a businessman and when a farmer becomes unsuccessful in farming.

## \|\| 3.144.8-10 \|\|

*snapanaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ puṇye'hni vidhipūrvakam \|*  
*gaurasarṣapakalkena sājyenotsāditasya tu \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sugandhakuṃkumāliptaśarīraśirasastathā \|*  
*bhadrāsanopaviṣṭasya svasti vācya dvijāñchubhān \|\| 9 \|\|*

*aśvasthānādgajasthānādvalmīkātsaṃgamāddhradāt \|*  
*mṛttikāṃ rocanāṃ gaṃdhānguggulaṃ cāpsu nikṣipet \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. Under these conditions, a person should take bath with water mixed with white mustard seeds and solid drags of the oil in an appropriate manner. The king who has been deprived of the kingship should apply fragrance, vermilion over the head and the body, and then get himself in a Bhadrasana. He should then make the Brahmanas who are the auspicious souls to recite the Svasti-vacana. He should arrange to collect the dust from the horse stable, elephant stable, white ant hill, confluence of rivers, tanks, besides gorocana, scent and guggulu.

## \|\| 3.144.11-14 \|\|

*yadā hṛtā hyekavaṇairmanubhiḥ kalaśairhradāt \|*  
*carmaṇyānaḍuhe rakte sthāpya bhadrāsanaṃ tathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*sahasrākṣaṃ śatadhāramṛṣiṇā vacanaṃ kṛtam \|*  
*tena tvāmabhiṣiṃcāmi pāvamānyaḥ punaṃtu te \|\| 12 \|\|*

*bhagaṃ te varuṇo rājā bhagaṃ sūryo bṛhaspatiḥ \|*  
*bhagamindraśca vāyuśca bhagaṃ saptarṣayo daduḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*yatte keśeṣu daurbhāgyaṃ sīmaṃte yacca mūrddhani \|*  
*lalāṭe karṇayorakṣṇorāpastadghnantu te sadā \|\| 14 \|\|*

11-14. All these should be poured into the pitchers filled with water. The king should be made to sit over an animal skin of red colour. Then the king should be bathed with water of the pitchers, accompanied with the reciting of the mantras which purified Indra in the form of a hundred or a thousand streams, making the words of the Ṛṣis to be true – “I am purifying you with the same water. Let the auspicious water purify your soul. Let the lord Varuna bestow lustre on you. Let Indra and the Windgod bestow grace on you. Let Surya and Brhaspati bestow lustre on you. Similarly, the seven sages should also bestow lustre on you. All the misfortunes lodged in your hair, forehead, head, ears and the eyes should get destroyed with the use of the auspicious water.”

## \|\| 3.144.15-17 \|\|

*snātasya sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ sruveṇaudumbareṇa ca \|*  
*juhuyānmūrddhani kuśānsavyena parigṛhya ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

*mitaśca samitaścaiva tathā sālakaṭaṃkaṭau \|*  
*kūṣmāṃḍo rājaputraśca aṃte svāhāsamanvitaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*nāmabhirbalimaṃtraiśca namaskārasamanvitaiḥ \|*  
*dadyāccatuṣpathe śūrpe kuśānāstīrya sarvaśaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. After the taking of the bath by the king, the mustard oil should be sprinkled over the head of the king, making use of the ladle of Udumbara tree, and while so doing, the king should be made to hold kusa grass in his hand. Then the offering should be made in Mita, Sammita, Sala tree, castor oil tree and pumpkin should be presented as the offering, reciting the mantra giving his name, adding Svaha at the end of the mantra. Then spreading kusa grass at the crossings, for the sake of an offering, a winnowing basket should be placed.

## \|\| 3.144.18-22 \|\|

*kṛtā kṛtāṃstaṃḍulāṃśca palalaudanameva ca \|*  
*matsyānpakvāṃstathaivāmānmāṃsametāvadeva tu \|\| 18 \|\|*

*puṣpaṃ citraṃ sugandhaṃ ca surāṃ ca trividhāmapi \|*  
*mūlakaṃ pūri kāpūpaṃ tathaivoṃḍerakasrajam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*dūrvāṃ sarvaprapuṣpāṇāṃ dattvārghyaṃ pūrṇamaḍalām \|*  
*vināyakasya jananīmupatiṣṭhettatoṃ'bikām \|\| 20 \|\|*

*rūpaṃ dehi yaśo dehi bhagaṃ bhavati dehi me \|*  
*putrāndehi dhanaṃ dehi sarvakāmāṃśca dehi me \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tataḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ \|*  
*bhojayedbrāhmaṇāndadyādvastrayugmaṃ gurorapi \|\| 22 \|\|*

18-22. The half boiled rice, meat, cooked rice and half baked fish should also be placed. With different shades of the flowers, scent, three types of beverages, reddish, fried cakes, the garland of Aunderaka, durva grass together with all the flowers, the arghya or oblation should be offered. Thereafter, going to Bhagavati Ambika - the mother of Vinayaka, one should recite the humble prayer, saying – “O goddess, bestowing on us the beauty, fame, lustre, son and fortunes, make all my desires successful.” Thereafter, clad in white costumes, white rosary and the paste, the performer should feed the Brahmanas. A couple of costumes should also be offered to the preceptors.

## \|\| 3.144.23-27 \|\|

*evaṃ vināyakaṃ pūjya grahāṃścaiva vidhānataḥ \|*  
*karmaṇāṃ phalamāpnoti śriyamāpnoti cottamām \|\| 23 \|\|*

*ādityasya tathā pūjāṃ tilakaṃ svāminastathā \|*  
*mahāgaṇapateścaiva kurvansiddhimavāpnuyāt \|\| 24 \|\|*

*śvetārkasya tu yo mūle mahāgaṇapatiḥ kṛtaḥ \|*  
*sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaḥ so'pi siddhikaraḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*saṃjapyate śucau deśe vighnaṃ nātra hi dehinaḥ \|*  
*paramaṃ pūjayennityaṃ gandhamālyasragādibhiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*kṣīṇabhāgyo'pi puruṣaḥ pūjitaśca nareśvaraḥ \|*  
*sarvasiddhimavāpnoti jayī bhavati sarvadā \|\| 27 \|\|*

23-27. Thus worshipping Vinayaka, the planets should also be adored as usual. A person who does so gets the best reward for his deeds. Thus the Sungod, Karttikeya and Mahaganapati should also be adored. With the offering of tilakam to them, one achieves the success. In case the figure of Mahagapapati is made of the flowery part of the wood of swallow wart trees, one achieves sure success. No obstruction is caused, in case the japam is performed at an auspicious place. By offering the worship with the excellent prescribed procedure, even the unfortunate person achieves respect. The king on the other hand, achieving all the success, becomes victorious.

## Chapter 145. Homa for constellation

## \|\| 3.145.1-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*agnihotre sukhāsīnaṃ gargaḥ pṛcchati kauśikam \|*  
*baṃdhane saṃnirodheṅgā vyādhīnāṃ saṃprapīḍane \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kathaṃ mokṣo bhavettasya sādhyāsādhyaṃ bravīhi me \|*  
*gargeṇa kauśikaḥ pṛṣṭa idaṃ vacanamabravīt \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ādhāne janmanakṣatre naidhanapratyayeṣu ca \|*  
*vyādhirutpadyate yasya kleśāya maraṇāya ca \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kṛttikāsu yadā kaścidvyādhiṃ saṃpratipadyate \|*  
*navarātraṃ bhavetpīḍā trirātraṃ rohiṇīṣu ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

*mṛgaśīrṣe pañcarātramārdrā prāṇaviyojinī \|*  
*punarvasau ca puṣye ca saptarātraṃ vidhīyate \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О Anga, once Ṛṣi Garga asked Kausika who was comfortably seated in his hermitage- “When the severe pain develops due to the bondage or obstruction, then how can one be relieved of the ailment? You kindly tell me the remedy for the same." When the Ṛṣis Garga so asked, Maharsi Kausika said to him - “Because of the constellation at the time of conception, constellation at the time of birth and constellation at the time of death, when the ailment develops, one has to suffer pain for a period of nine days. During the Rohini constellation, one has to suffer for three nights, during the Mrgasira constellation one has to suffer for five nights and during the Ardra constellation one is deprived of his life. During Punarvasu and Pusya constellations, if the ailment develops, one has to suffer for seven nights.

## \|\| 3.145.6-8 \|\|

*navarātraṃ tathāśleṣā śmaśānāṃtaṃ maghāsu ca \|*  
*dvau māsau phālgunī caiva uttarāsu tripakṣakam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*haste ca tanu dṛśyeta citrāyāṃ tvarddhamāsa kam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*māsadvayaṃ tathā svātau viśākhā viṃśatirdināḥ \|*  
*maitre caiva daśāhaṃ tu jyeṣṭhā caivārddhamāsikā \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. In case the ailment develops in the Slesa constellation, one has to suffer for nine nights. During the Magha constellation, one has to suffer even upto the cremation ground. During the Purva-Phalguni constellation, one has to suffer for two months and during the Uttara Phalguni constellation, one has to suffer for a months and a half; during Hasta constellation, the period of sufferings is for a month only. During Citra constellation, the period of suffering is for a fortnight and the same period in Svati constellation is two months; during Visakha, it is for ten days. During the Jyestha constellation, the period of a fortnight has been prescribed for suffering.

## \|\| 3.145.9-10 \|\|

*mūlena jāyate mokṣaścāṣāḍhāsu tripañcakam \|*  
*uttarādinaviṃśatyā dvau māsau śravaṇena tu \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dhaniṣṭhāyāmarddhamāsaṃ vāruṇe tu daśāhakaiḥ \|*  
*nava bhādrapadāṛkṣa uttarāsu tripaṃcakam \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. During Mula constellation, the person remains always a patient. During Purvasadha it is for fifteen days; during Uttarasadha it is for twenty days. During Sravana, it is for ten days. During Purva Bhadrapada, the period has been prescribed for nine days, while in Uttara Bhadrapada, the period is said to be fifteen days.

## \|\| 3.145.11 \|\|

*revatī daśarātraṃ tu ahorātraṃ tathāśvinī \|*  
*prāṇairviyojayennityaṃ garga nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. During the Revati constellation, the period is said to be of ten days; during Asvini constellation, the prescribed period is for a day and a night and then the life departs out of the body. There is no doubt about it.”

## \|\| 3.145.12 \|\|

*kauśikena samādiṣṭo nakṣatravyādhisaṃbhavaḥ \|*  
*daivajñenāpi jñātavyaṃ nakṣatramatha janmanā \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. When Kausika so revealed the periods of sufferings under each one of the constellations, it became known to the astrologers as well.

## \|\| 3.145.13-15 \|\|

*kṣīravṛkṣasya samidho juhuyādaśvadaivate \|*  
*tilānmadhuplutānyāmye yavamevāgnidaivate \|\| 13 \|\|*

*prājāpatye tu juhuyādbhogyabījakaraṃ bakam \|*  
*saumye priyaṃgavo raudre sarpirmāṃsasamanvitam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*āditye ca prayatnena ghṛtāktāḥ sitataṃḍulāḥ \|*  
*payasā sarpiṣā sākaṃ bṛhaspatyadhidaivate \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. When the ailment develops during the constellation of the births and the Asva god enjoys the prominent positions, then the offerings of the twigs of Ficus glamorata should be offered to the Yamya devata. The offerings of sesamum seeds soaked in honey should be poured. The offerings of barley should be given for Prajapatya devata, Bhogya is to be the seed, Karambhaka would be the main deity, the mustard should be used as offerings for Raudra, and the meat and ghi should be offered. For Aditya, the white unbroken rice soaked in ghi should be offered. When Brhaspati is the presiding deity, payasam mixed with ghi has to be offered.

## \|\| 3.145.16-17 \|\|

*grāmyoṣadhairvaṭapatraiḥ sarpiḥ sarpādhidaivate \|*  
*homaḥ proktaḥ priyaṃgūnāṃ nakṣatre yāmadaivate \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sāvitre dadhihomotra tvāṣṭraṃ citraudanaṃ haviḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. In case of the god of serpents, the shoots of the banyan tree together with herbs of the villages should be used as the offerings. For Yamadeva, the offerings of the mustard should be used for the offerings. For goddess Savitri, the offering of curd has to be given. For Tvastra, different types of rice have to be poured as the offerings.

## \|\| 3.145.18-20 \|\|

*yavānsahājyena hunedraudre'gnau tu payodanam \|*  
*maitreṇātha tu maṃtreṇa maitre kaṭakamiśritam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*nairṛtye tilahomaḥ syādavyakte ca hutāśane \|*  
*abdaivatye śālibījairvaiśvadevaṃ tu kārayet \|\| 19 \|\|*

*raktāśca taṃḍulāścaiva hotavyā viṣṇudaivate \|*  
*vāruṇe pārijātānāṃ puṣpāṇāṃ homa iṣyate \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. For Raudra, barley soaked in ghi should be offered, besides the barley and payasam. For the presiding deity of Anuradha constellation reciting his mantra, the offering of the sesamum seeds should be poured in the south west comer. The wild rice to Vaisvadeva should be offered; when Viṣṇu is the presiding deity, red rice should be poured as the offerings. For the presiding deity of Satabhisi constellation, the Parijata should be made as the offerings.

## \|\| 3.145.21-22 \|\|

*ajaikapāde nakṣatre prājāpatyena tatsamam \|*  
*āhirbudhnye tu nakṣatre vaiśvadevaṃ tu kārayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

*raktāśca taṇḍulāścaiva hotavyā viṣṇudaivate \|*  
*pauṣe phalānyakhaṃḍāni juhuyādaṣṭottaraṃ śatam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. During the Ajaikapada constellation, the offering should be made like in the case of Prajapatya. During Ahirbudhnya constellation, offering should be made like Vaisvadeva. When Viṣṇu is the presiding deity, the red rice should be offered. During the month of Pausa, an offering of a hundred and eight fruit items should be made.

## \|\| 3.145.23 \|\|

*sāvitrī homamekaṃ tu brahmābhihitavānpurā \|*  
*sarvajvarapraśamanaṃ sadyo jvaraharaṃ param \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. In this way, in earlier times, Brahma had spoken about the Savitri homa, which relieves one of all the fevers.

## Chapter 146. The Vrata which destroys hundreds of sins

## \|\| 3.146.1 \|\|

*śrīvasiṣṭha uvāca \|*  
*athānyadapi te vacmi vrataṃ rājanmahāphalam \|*  
*aparādhaśataṃ yena kṣayaṃ yāti śṛṇuṣva tat \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Vasistha said – О king, hereafter, I am going to speak to you about a vrata which yields enormous merits in no time.

## \|\| 3.146.2 \|\|

*ikṣvākuruvāca \|*  
*kiṃ vrataṃ tanmamācakṣva ko'parādhastu taṃ vada \|*  
*kaḥ pūjyate ca vai tasminkadā vā kriyate naraiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Iksvaku said – You kindly tell me about the vrata and also the sins which are washed out by it. Who is the deity to be worshipped in this connection?

## \|\| 3.146.3-8 \|\|

*śrīvasiṣṭha uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu rājanmahābāho aparādhaśatavratam \|*  
*yenānuṣṭhitamātreṇa kāmamokṣau labheta nā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*prāyaścittānyaśeṣāṇi sarvapāpāpanuttaye \|*  
*kṛtānyapyakṛtāni syuriti hovāca padmajaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*pāpaṃ gurutaraṃ cāpi dahyate tūlarāśivat \|*  
*aparādhaśataṃ rājañśṛṇuṣva gadato mama \|\| 5 \|\|*

*na karoti naro mohādvratametaddinedine \|*  
*anāśramitvaṃ prathamo'nagnitā vratahīnatā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*adātṛtvamaśaucaṃ ca nirdayatvaṃ spṛhālutā \|*  
*akṣāṃtirjanapīḍā ca māyitvamapyamaṃgalam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*kṣatavratatvaṃ nāstikyaṃ vedaniṃdā kaṭhoratā \|*  
*asatyatā hiṃsakatvaṃ stainyami ndriyaviplavaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

3-8. Vasiystha said - О valorous king, I am going to speak to you about the vrata which removes a hundred sins and with the performing of which, a person gets all his desires fulfilled and finally achieves moksa or liberation. Brahma also told him that for the washing out of all the sins, though several repentance rites have been prescribed, but with the non-performing of this particular vrata, all the vratas so performed are of no consequence. Therefore, I am going to speak about the Aparadhasata-vrata (the vrata which removes a hundred sins) at a time. You please listen, because with the performance of this vrata, the sins get destroyed like the heaps of cotton. When a person performs this vrata at an appropriate time, he does not have to face falling from asrama, getting deprived from the performing of the homa or vrata, giving of charities, impurity, cruelty, lack of desire, becoming intolerable, causing pain to others, illusionary ways, torture, breaking of the vratas, becoming atheist, strong denouncing of the Vedas, falsehood, killing, theft, or to become blemished for the defeats of sense organs.

## \|\| 3.146.9-21 \|\|

*manaso'nigrahaścaiva krodha īrṣyātha matsaraḥ \|*  
*daṃbhaḥ śāṭhyaṃ ca dhaurtyaṃ ca kaṭukoktiḥ pramādatā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*bhāryāmātṛsutādīnāṃ tyāgaścāpūjya pūjanam \|*  
*śrāddhahānirjapatyāgaḥ paṃcayajñavivarjanam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*saṃdhyātarpaṇahomānāṃ hāniragneḥ praṇāśanam \|*  
*anṛtau maithunaṃ pārtha parvaṇyapi ca maithunam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*paiśunyaṃ paradāreṣu dānaṃ veśyābhigāmitā \|*  
*apātradānaṃ cālpaṃ ca mūlikākulibhakṣaṇam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*aṃtyajāgamanaṃ mātṛtyāgaḥ pitṛvivarjanam \|*  
*pitrorabhaktirvādaśca purāṇasmṛtivarjanam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*abhakṣyabhojanaṃ cāpi patidroho'vicāratā \|*  
*kṛṣikarmakriyāvāhaṃ bhāryāsaṃgrahakāritā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*iṃdriyājayamāyitvaṃ vidyāvismaraṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*śāstratyāga ṛṇaṃ citrakarma cānaṃgadhāvanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*bhāryāputrasutādīnāṃ vikrayaḥ paśumaithunam \|*  
*indhanārthaṃ drumacchedo bile vāryādipūraṇam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*taḍāgāgamane vṛttaṃ vidyāvikrayakāritā \|*  
*vṛttilopo mahīpāla yācakatvaṃ kumitratā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*strīvadho govadhaścaiva paurohityaṃ suhṛdvadhaḥ \|*  
*bhrūṇahatyā parānnaṃ ca śūdrānnasya niṣevaṇam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*śūdrasya cāgnikarmatvamavidhitvaṃ kuputratā \|*  
*vidvadbhyo yācakatvaṃ hi vācāṭatvaṃ pratigrahaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*śrautasaṃskāra dīnatvamārtatrāṇavivarjanam \|*  
*brahmahatyāsurāpānarukmastainyamataḥ param \|\| 20 \|\|*

*gurudārābhigāmitvaṃ saṃyogaścāpi taiḥ saha \|*  
*aparādhaśataṃ tvetatkathitaṃ te mayānagha \|\| 21 \|\|*

9-21. Similarly, the rage of his mind, jealousy, becoming envious, cheating, wickedness, evil tongue, arrogance, the disaster of wife, mother and daughter, worship of unholy deities, unfaithfulness, having discarded the japam, who is averse to the performing of the five yajnas, one who is deprived of the performing of the evening oblation, tasting of fire, uniting with the wife out of season, union with woman at early stage, back biting, uniting with other caste woman, giving away of the charities to the unsuitable persons, meanness, mulika, consuming of prickly shrubs, uniting with a Sudra woman, disowning of the mother, hostility towards the mother or to pick up quarrel with her, disowning of the Vedas as well as the Puranas, eating of the prohibited food, cheating of the husband, thoughtlessness, farming, collection of women, one who has no control over his sense organs, being illusory, forgetting of the learnings, disowning of the scriptures, indebtedness, lustfulness, sale of wife, son and daughter, uniting with the animals, cutting of the tree for burning, pouring of water in the snake holes, to take bath in a tank, selling of knowledge which attract the sins, then loss of subsistence, killing of a woman, killing of a cow, officiating as a priest, killing of a friend, abortion, taking of the food of others, food of the Sudras, performing of the homa by the Sudras, becoming an evil son, demanding riches from the learned people, indulging in excess of talk, receiving of charities, getting deprived of the Vedic traditions, to neglect the destitute, killing of the Brahmanas, consuming of the wine, theft of gold, uniting with the wife of the preceptor and other blemishes earned by a person. О sinless one, thus I have told you about the hundred sins.

## \|\| 3.146.22-25 \|\|

*anye'pi vividhāḥ saṃti proktāḥ prādhānyatastvamī \|*  
*yadi vaktrasahasrāṇi vaktre jihvāśatāni ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tathāpyete na śakyaṃte vaktuṃ yasmādanaṃtakāḥ \|*  
*aparādhasahasrāṇi lakṣakoṭiśatāni ca \|\| 23 \|\|*

*naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇānnūnaṃ satyeśasyānupūjanāt \|*  
*pūjye bhagavānatra kṛtakṛtye parājite \|\| 24 \|\|*

*dhvaje satye sthitaścāyaṃ lakṣmyā saha jagatpatiḥ \|*  
*vāmadevastataḥ pūrvaṃ nṛsiṃho dakṣiṇe sthitaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

22-25. There are several other types of many sins, which are difficult to be counted even by a thousand of mouths or with hundred of tongues in each one of them, but still the sins cannot be counted. A person who adores the lord Satyesa performing this vrata, his crores of sins get destroyed instantly. In his flag, Satya and Viṣṇu with Laksmi reside. Vamadeva is lodged on the left, while Nrsimha is lodged to the right.

## \|\| 3.146.26 \|\|

*kapilaḥ paścimāsye tu vārāhaścottare sthitaḥ \|*  
*ūrdhvavaktro'cyuto jñeya etadvai brahmapaṃcakam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The western face is that of Kapila, while the one to the north is of Varaha. The upper (or the central) face is that of Acyuta, which is known as Brahma-pancaka.

## \|\| 3.146.27-29 \|\|

*taṃ satyeśaṃ sthitaṃ rājanpūjayecca sadaiva hi \|*  
*kṣīrodayārdhacandrasthapadmakarṇikasaṃsthitam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*padmakaumodakīśaṃkhacakrāyudhavidhāraṇam \|*  
*vāme cādhastathā dakṣe ūrdhve paścādadho nṛpa \|\| 28 \|\|*

*pādādhastādviniṣkrāṃtā gaṃgā pūtā sadā nṛbhiḥ \|*  
*śaktyaṣṭakaṃ tathā cānyattannāmāni ca me śṛṇu \|\| 29 \|\|*

27-29. О king, the lord Satyesa should always be worshipped, who looks like the Moon and who emerged out of the ocean of milk, in the pericarp of the lotus. О king, in his upper and lower right hands, he holds respectively, the lotus, Kaumodi club, conch and disc. From his auspicious feet emerges the Ganga, who always purifies the people. He possesses eight Saktis, the names of whom are being revealed by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.146.30-32 \|\|

*jayā ca vijayā caiva jayaṃtī pāpanāśinī \|*  
*unmīlinī vaṃjulī ca trispṛśātha vivarddhanā \|\| 30 \|\|*

*etābhiḥ śaktibhiryuktaṃ lokadikpālavarjitam \|*  
*śuklāṃbaradharaṃ saumyaṃ prahṛṣṭavadanaṃ śivam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ harim \|*  
*pūjayecca prayatnena vidhinā yena taṃ śṛṇu \|\| 32 \|\|*

30-32. They are known as – Jaya, Vijaya, Jayanti, Papanasini, Unmilani, Vanjuli, Trispasatha and Vivarddhana without the Lokapalas. He is accompanied with these Saktis, is clad in white garments, with peaceful appearance being form of welfare and with smiling face, adorned with all the ornaments, like the heap of grace, bestower of pleasures and salvation. Such a lord Viṣṇu should be worshipped with delight, the process of which is being spoken by me.

## \|\| 3.146.33-34 \|\|

*mārgaśīrṣādimāseṣu dvādaśasvapi sarvadā \|*  
*dvādaśyāmapyamāyāṃ vā aṣṭamyāṃ ca sitāsite \|\| 33 \|\|*

*kṛtopavāsaḥ śuddhātmā kuryādvratamataṃdritaḥ \|*  
*pakṣayorubhayorevaṃ pūjaye'haṃ janārdanam \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. During the twelve months like Margasirsa and others, on the bright or dark twelfth day of the moon or moonless day and on the day of astami, observing fast, discarding lethargy and purifying the soul, lord Janardana should be worshipped during both the fortnights.

## \|\| 3.146.35-38 \|\|

*evaṃ tu niyamaṃ kṛtvā daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam \|*  
*gacchettatastaḍāge vā puṣkariṇyāṃ gṛhe'pi vā \|\| 35 \|\|*

*snātvā tu naityakaṃ karma kṛtvā naimittikaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*kuryātsarvaṃ prayatnena yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*sauvarṇaṃ kārayeddevaṃ pūrvoktaṃ satyarūpiṇam \|*  
*śaktyaṣṭakayutaṃ lakṣmyā yuktaṃ padmāsanasthayā \|\| 37 \|\|*

*suvarṇapalamānena kāryametatsavistaram \|*  
*dugdhakuṃbhopariṣṭāttu svarṇapadmaṃ prakalpayet \|\| 38 \|\|*

35-38. With this resolve, one should brush his teeth, should take bath in a tank, step-well or even in one’s own house, should get relieved of the daily routine and then attend to the religious duties. He should get the image of lord Narayana in gold weighing a pala, displaying the eight of his Saktis along with Laksmi. The image should be placed over a blossomed lotus flowers. It should be placed over a kalasa filled with milk and covered with gold.

## \|\| 3.146.39-44 \|\|

*tatkarṇikāgataṃ devaṃ śaktivṛndasamanvitam \|*  
*pūjayedvidhivatpaścādgurumaṃtrapracoditaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*śuddhaśuklāṃbaradharo maṃtrasaṃbhārasaṃsthitaḥ \|*  
*devakṣīrasamudre'sminvṛtte candre ca puṣkare \|*  
*tatra tvaṃ satyayā sārddhaṃ satyeśa bhava sannidhau \|\| 40 \|\|*

*oṃ kṣīrasāgarakallole snāhi pāpaniṣūdana \|*  
*anena bhūtabhavyena dattena jalabindunā \|\| 41 \|\|*

*harasva sarvaṃ duritaṃ mama nātha janārdana \|*  
*vastradānena śubhreṇa satyeśa kuru me śubham \|\| 42 \|\|*

*yajñe yoge tathā sāṃkhye pavitrastvaṃ sadocyase \|*  
*yajñopavītadānena kuru māṃ sarvapāvanam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*viliptaṃ karmaṇā sarvaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ na kenacit \|*  
*mama candanaliptāṃgaḥ sarvalepāpaho bhava \|\| 44 \|\|*

39-44. In the pericarp of lotus, lord Satyadeva with Laksmi and the eight Saktis should be consecrated and worshipped. He should then offer prayer to the lord who is clad in white garments, reciting the guru-mantra he should say – “One who is adorned with crescent as well as the lotus, you always grace the lotus with truth, you kindly care to be present here. О destroyer of the sins, you have your bath in the high waves of the ocean of milk. Therefore, you kindly accept this bindu (drop) offered by me and remove all my misfortunes because you are my master. О Satyesa, О Janardana, with the giving away in charity of the auspicious costumes, bestow welfare on me. You have always been described as extremely auspicious in the Yogasastras and Samkhya philosophy. Therefore, with this yajnopavita, you kindly purify my entire body. I am speaking not only the truth, but the total truth. Except you, none else can wash out the evil deeds. Therefore, the sandal paste, oil, paste etc. given by me, may please be accepted by you and my sins be removed.

## \|\| 3.146.45-46 \|\|

*satyanātha namastubhyaṃ mūrtāmūrtasvarūpiṇe \|*  
*vāsudeva nṛsiṃhākhya kapilādivyabhūdhara \|\| 45 \|\|*

*vārāhācyuta yajñeśa lakṣmīkāṃta nṛpeśvara \|*  
*paśuṃ putraṃ ca me dehi pāpaśatro niraṃjana \|\| 46 \|\|*

45-46. О Satyanatha, I offer my salutation to you. You have a visible as well as an invisible form, you are Vasudeva, Nrsimha, Kapila, the divine carrier of the earth, Varaha, Acyuta, Yajnesa, Laksmikanta, Nrpesvara, you are quite well known as the enemy of the sins. You are without blemish, you kindly bestow animals and sons to me.

## \|\| 3.146.47-49 \|\|

*saṃkarṣaṇa mahāvīrya sarveśāmitavikrama \|*  
*aniruddhendra govinda dhṛtacakra namo'stu te \|\| 47 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa prabho rāmarāma kṛṣṇa vibho hare \|*  
*trāhi māṃ sarvaduḥkhebhyo ramayā saha mādhava \|\| 48 \|\|*

*pūjā ceyaṃ mayā dattā pitāmahajagadguro \|*  
*gṛhāṇa jagadīśāna nārāyaṇa namo'stu te \|\| 49 \|\|*

47-49. О Somkarsana, О immensely valorous one, lord of all immensely strong, Aniruddha, Indra, Govinda and the holder of disc, I offer my salutation to you. This is the mantra for worship. О Kṛṣṇa, the lord, Rama, Hari, Madhava with Laksmi, you kindly protect me from all the misfortunes. You are the grandsire, preceptor of the world. I have dedicated this adoration to you. О Jagadisa, also known as Narayana, I offer my salutation to you. You kindly accept the same.”

## \|\| 3.146.50-52 \|\|

*dhanaṃ guptaṃ mahīpāla sarvapāpāpanuttaye \|*  
*ekasyaiva tu viprasya yāvadvarṣaṃ samarpayet \|\| 50 \|\|*

*dānaṃ dadyānmahārāja hyaśaktau tadabhāvataḥ \|*  
*pakṣepakṣe prakartavyaṃ vratametanmahattaram \|\| 51 \|\|*

*saṃvatsare tataḥ pūrṇe kuryādudyāpanaṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*pūrvavatpūjayedevaṃ bahusaṃbhāravi staraiḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

50-52. O lord of the earth, the secret wealth of a person should be given over to a Brahmana at the end of a year. О king, with the availability when a person has the resources, one should keep on performing this vrata and the process should be concluded at the end of the year. Thus following the aforesaid process, making all the preparations, the deity should be worshipped.

## \|\| 3.146.53-55 \|\|

*anujñāṃ prārthayedviprānpāpaghvaṃso mamāstu vai \|*  
*pāpadhvaṃso'stu satataṃ taveti ca dvijo vadet \|\| 53 \|\|*

*tataḥ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇāya samarpya ca kṣamāpayet \|*  
*asminvrate kṛte rājanbhavedbahuphalodayaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*yatphalaṃ sarvavedeṣu sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam \|*  
*tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ vratasyāsya niṣevaṇāt \|\| 55 \|\|*

53-55. Thereafter, the performer should offer prayer with the approval of the Brahmanas – “Let all my sins get destroyed.” The Brāhmaṇa should then say – “Let all your sins be washed out” Thereafter, all the items of adoration should be given away to the Brāhmaṇas and then he should beg forgiveness. О king, with (he completion of the vrata in an appropriate manner, one achieves enormous merits. The merits of reciting of all the Vedas, visiting of all the holy places as are normally achieved by a person, he achieves a crore of times more than that number with the performing of this vrata.

## \|\| 3.146.56-60 \|\|

*ihaloke dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ putramitrasukhādikam \|*  
*prāpnoti puruṣaḥ samyagvidyārogyakalāyudham \|\| 56 \|\|*

*dharmamatha ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca nṛpasattama \|*  
*labhate nātra saṃdeho brahmaṇo vacanaṃ yathā \|\| 57 \|\|*

*yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate \|*  
*yaḥ kuryātpunaretaddhi so'nantaphalabhāgbhavet \|\| 58 \|\|*

*aśaktastu tathā śakto vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*vrataṃ kurvannaro bhaktyā labhate śāśvataṃ padam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*kṛte vai kriyamāṇe tu kartā phalamavāpnuyāt \|*  
*aparādhaśatāghaughaṃ vratenānena nāśayet \|\| 60 \|\|*

56-60. He achieves enough of wealth, food grains, sons, friends, the related pleasure, in addition to the entire learnings, good health, weapons, arms, etc., besides dharma, artha, kama and moksa are surely achieved as per the words of Brahma. A person who reads it or listens to it, is also relieved of all the sins and one who performs the same, he earns the merit beyond measure. When the same vrata is performed by a person who is not so well off, he earns the same merit. A person, who is quite well off, should never be miserly in his approach. With the conclusion of the vrata with devotion, the person achieves the eternal position. A person, who gets ready to himself perform this vrata or get it performed through someone else, achieves the entire merit, because it is said that with the performing of this vrata, the heaps of sins get destroyed.

## Chapter 147. Kancana Vrata

## \|\| 3.147.1-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śvetadvīpe sukhāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ jagatprabhum \|*  
*vāsudevaṃ jagannāthaṃ sthitisaṃyamakārakam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*parāvarāṇāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ purāṇaṃ paramavyayam \|*  
*ādidevaṃ jagannāthaṃ jagataḥ kāraṇātma kam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*praṇipatya mahādevaṃ carācaraguruṃ harim \|*  
*lakṣmīḥ provāca rājendra pādasaṃvāhane sthitā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*bhagavandevadeveśa bhaktānāmanukampaka \|*  
*praṣṭavyaṃ kiñcidicchāmi praṣṭuṃ praśnavidāṃ vara \|\| 4 \|\|*

*prakuruṣva mahābhāga dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari \|*  
*vrataṃ kiñcitkathaya me rūpasaubhāgyadāyakam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*uttamaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ vratānāmapi cottamam \|*  
*kṛtena yena deveśa sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О Rajendra, Svetadvipa or Ksirasagara is the comfortable place for the lord Jagannatha - the lord of gods, besides being the lord of the universe, who preserves the same. Once Laksmi - the spouse of lord Viṣṇu, having an ancient form, Omkara, having the supreme vision, the lord of the universe, the cause of the universe, mobile or immobile preceptor besides being the form of Hari, while pressing her feet, said to lord Viṣṇu – “O lord, you are the god of gods and compassionate over the devotees, you are the foremost of those who know the answers to questions. Therefore, О lord, I intend to ask you a question. Being merciful on me, you kindly answer the same.
