О Devesa, you kindly speak out to me about a vrata for the preserving of beauty, fortunes, etc. And is best of all the vratas, with the observing of which one achieves the same merit as of visiting all the holy places on earth.”

## \|\| 3.147.7-8 \|\|

*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*gṛhasthaścāśramāṇāṃ ca varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā \|*  
*yathā nadīṣu sarvāsu jāhnavī lokaviśrutā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*hradānāmudadhiḥ śreṣṭho devānāṃ viṣṇuruttamaḥ \|*  
*strīṇāṃ devā yathā lakṣmīstathedaṃ vratamuttamam \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Viṣṇu said- As the asrama of a householder is the best of all the asramas, Brahmana is the best in all the varnas, Ganga is the best of all the rivers, the ocean of all the water reservoirs and Laksmi is the best among all the women in the universe, similarly, the vrata about which I am about to speak to you, is the best of all the vratas.

## \|\| 3.147.9-13 \|\|

*na gaṅgā na kurukṣetraṃ na kāśī na ca puṣkaram \|*  
*pāvanāni mahābhāge yathedaṃ vratamuttamam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*gauryā devyā kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā \|*  
*rāmeṇa sītayā sārddhaṃ rājyaṃ prāpya kṛtaṃ purā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*damayantīviyogena nalena tu tathā kṛtam \|*  
*kṛṣṇayā sahitaiḥ pārtha pāṃḍavairvana vāsibhiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kṛtametadvrataṃ bhadre svargamokṣapradāyakam \|*  
*raṃbhayā menayā vāpi paulomyā satyabhāmayā \|\| 12 \|\|*

*śāṃḍilyā cāpyarundhatyā urvaśyā devadattayā \|*  
*kṛtaṃ vratamidaṃ bhadraṃ saubhāgyasukhakāmyayā \|\| 13 \|\|*

9-13. Even the river Ganga, Kuruksetra, Kasi and Puskara are not as auspicious as this vrata, which was first of all performed by Sankara with Gauri, and Sita with Rama after the crowing over the throne of Ayodhya Similarly, Nala performed it getting separated from Damayanti, Pandavas with Draupadi performed this vrata in exile, which yields the heaven as well as moksa. Thereafter, for the achieving of pleasure and comforts, this vrata was also observed by Rambha, Mena, Pauloma – the wife of Bhrgu and mother of Cyavana, SatyabhSami, Sandilya, Arundhati, Urvasi, Devadatta and several others, with the desire of achieving of fortunes.

## \|\| 3.147.14-15 \|\|

*pātāle nāgakanyābhiḥ kṛtametatsuśobhanam \|*  
*gāyatryā ca sarasvatyā sāvitryā brahmabhāryayā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*anyābhiḥ sarvanārībhiḥ sarvakāmaphalepsubhiḥ \|*  
*tasmātte'haṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. The serpent girls of the nether world also performed the same, besides Gayatri, Sarasvati, Savitri – the spouse of Brahma and several other ladies. For the success of all the desires, this vrata is performed. Therefore, I am going to speak out the details of this vrata which removes all the sins.

## \|\| 3.147.16-18 \|\|

*vasuprītikaraṃ ramyaṃ vratānāṃ paramaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*brahmahā mucyate pāpātsurāpo vasuhārakaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*gurubhāryābhigāmī ca hyeteṣāṃ saṃgamī ca yaḥ \|*  
*mānakūṭaṃ tulākūṭaṃ kanyāvṛttirgavāṃ vratī \|\| 17 \|\|*

*agamyāgamano yastu māṃsāśī vṛṣalīpatiḥ \|*  
*kuṇḍāgnibhojī yastu syādbhūbhihartā tathaiva ca \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. It is the favourite of Vasus and is the best of the vratas. You please listen. With the force of this vrata, all the sins like Brahmahatya, drinking, stealing, enjoying the wife of the preceptor, weighing less, humiliation of a respectable person, to live with the earning of the daughter, selling of a cow, visiting a prohibited place, contact with an evil woman, to cook food over a fire altar, usurping of the land, etc. get vanished.

## \|\| 3.147.19-21 \|\|

*ebhiḥ sarvairmahāpāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*ebhiḥ syānnaranārībhiḥ kartavyaṃ vratamuttamam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*ataste'haṃ vidhiṃ vakṣye vidhānamavadhāraya \|*  
*kāñcanākhyā purī nāma vrataṃ trailokyaviśrutam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*yaḥ karoti naro devi nārī vā bhaktisaṃyutā \|*  
*tasya putrāśca pautrāśca jāyate vipulaṃ dhanam \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. The process of this vrata should be followed by all the men and women equally, quite lovingly. Therefore, the process of performing the same is being spoken by me. You listen to the same with attention. The Kancipuri vrata which is well known the world over, when performed by a man or a woman, he or she achieves sons and grandsons besides the fortunes.

## \|\| 3.147.22-26 \|\|

*tasminmāse ca kartavyaṃ vratametacca sundari \|*  
*tasminmāse ca kartavyā kāñcanākhyā purī śubhā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*śuklakṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāmekādaśyāṃ ca pūrṇimā \|*  
*saṃkrāṃtirvā mahābhāge kuhūrvā cāṣṭamī tithiḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*parvasvanyeṣu sarveṣu dātavyā kāñcanī purī \|*  
*vratī snātvā tu pūrvāhṇe nadyādau vimale jale \|\| 24 \|\|*

*mṛttikālaṃbhanaṃ kāryaṃ maṃtreṇānena suvrate \|*  
*uddhṛtāsi yathāpūrvaṃ viṣṇunā kroḍarūpiṇā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*lokānāmupakārārthaṃ vandanātsiddhikāmadā \|*  
*tasmāttvaṃ vaṃditā pāpaṃ hara me'nekajanmajam \|\| 26 \|\|*

22-26. О beautiful one, in the same month, the charity of Kancipuri and the related vrata should be performed accordingly. On the third black or bright moon day or the eleventh moon day or the full moon day, during the first day of the month or on the moonless day, on the day of astami or on the festival days, one should take bath in a river with clean water. Thereafter, applying the dust over the entire body, he should then pray – “O lord Viṣṇu, as you had redeemed the goddess earth in the form of Varaha, therefore, I offer my salutation to you, because by so doing, all the desires get fulfilled. I bow in reverence to you. You kindly remove all my sins of the past birth. This is known as the Mrttika mantra.

## \|\| 3.147.27-31 \|\|

*āpastu viśvayonirhi viṣṇunā nirmitāḥ svayam \|*  
*sānnidhyaṃ tīrthasahitaṃ kartavyaṃ mama sāṃpratam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā snātvā yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ \|*  
*gṛhamāgamya śuddhātmā nālapanpiśunāṃstva rāt \|\| 28 \|\|*

*pākhaṃḍino vikarmasthāndhūrtāṃśca kitavācchaṭhān \|*  
*prakṣālya pāṇivadanaṃ kuryāttvācamanaṃ tataḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*upavāsasya niyamaṃ kuryānnaktasya vā punaḥ \|*  
*śaṃkhapravaramādāya hemayuktaṃ jalairbhṛtam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*dvādaśākṣaramaṃtreṇa tajjalaṃ cābhimaṃtrayet \|*  
*pibetto'yaṃ gṛhe gatvā harirityakṣaraṃ japet \|\| 31 \|\|*

27-31. Lord Viṣṇu, in the form of the Visvayoni (the cause of the world), created the water. Let me achieve you with all the holy places.” According to this procedure, the performer of the vrata should purify himself after taking the bath. Reaching home, he should avoid the back bites, those who have fallen from their duties, the wicked people, the cheats, gamblers besides the evil persons, keeping himself away from them. He should then wash his hands and feet. Then sipping the water, he should take a vow for observing the fast or the night fast, carrying water in a gold vase, sanctifying it uttering the ten-lettered mantra and then drink it. After drinking the water, he should recite the name of Hari.

## \|\| 3.147.32-35 \|\|

*śamīvṛkṣamayā vedī catuḥstaṃbhasamanvitā \|*  
*caturhastapramāṇena kāryyā caiva suśobhanā \|\| 32 \|\|*

*vastreṇāveṣṭitāḥ stambhā vitānavara maṇḍitāḥ \|*  
*puṣpamālānvitāḥ kāryā divyadhūpādhivāsitāḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*madhye tu maṃḍalaṃ kāryaṃ padmākhyaṃ varṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*yena dṛṣṭena deveśi sarvapāpa kṣayo bhavet \|*  
*maṃḍalasya tu madhye vai bhadrapīṭhaṃ suśobhanam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*āsanaṃ tatra vinyasya komalaṃ vastraveṣṭitam \|*  
*tasyopari nyaseddevaṃ lakṣmyā yuktaṃ janārdanam \|\| 35 \|\|*

32-35. A beautiful pedestal of four cubits should be erected with four pillars of Sami tree. The pillars should be covered with cloth. A canopy should then be erected, which should be decorated with garlands of beautiful flowers. The divine and fragrant incense should then be burnt there. In the middle of the same, a lotus with its petals of different colours should be drawn, with the mere sight of which all the sins get destroyed. In the centre of the mandala, a beautiful seat should be arranged. A fine and soft cloth should be placed over it. Janardana with the goddess Laksmi should be placed over the same.

## \|\| 3.147.36-39 \|\|

*agre tu kalaśaḥ kāryo jalapūrṇaḥ suśobhanaḥ \|*  
*kṣīrasāgaranāmā sa kalpitavyaḥ prayatnataḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ vastreṇāve ṣṭayeddhanam \|*  
*kumbhaṃ prapūrṇamudakaistasyopari nyasedbudhaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*tasyopariṣṭātsaṃsthāpya kāṃcanākhyāṃ purīṃ śubhām \|*  
*catuṣpalā hyuttamā syāddvipalā madhyamā smṛtā \|\| 38 \|\|*

*sāmānyaikapalā kāryā kalaśaistu samanvitā \|*  
*modakānsthāpayeddivyānsamaṃtātsuṃdarākṛtīn \|\| 39 \|\|*

36-39. A pitcher with the water filled in it should be consecrated there, pouring into the same the five gems and covering it with cloth. Another pitcher filled with water should be placed over the same. Kancipuri should then be placed over it. It should be made o f the four palas of gold at the top and two palas in the middle. Or alternatively, both these portions should be of the same size. The beautifully prepared sweet balls (modaka) should be placed around it.

## \|\| 3.147.40-41 \|\|

*tadagre kadalīstambhaistoraṇaṃ parikalpayet \|*  
*cātuścaraṇikāṃstatra viprānāvāhya suṃdari \|\| 40 \|\|*

*pratiṣṭhāṃ kārayettasya vedamantraiḥ suśobhanaiḥ \|*  
*tasyā madhye nyasedviṣṇuṃ haimaṃ lakṣmyā samanvitam \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. The banana trunks and a canopy should then be arranged. Four truthful and auspicious Brahmanas should be invoked, uttering the Vedic mantras and they should be seated over the pedestal. In the centre of the pedestal, Viṣṇu with Laksmi should be lodged.

## \|\| 3.147.42-43 \|\|

*netre ratnamaye kārye daśanā vajrabhūṣitāḥ \|*  
*muktāphalamayaṃ tasya bhūṣaṇaṃ parikalpayet \|\| 42 \|\|*

*aṃgaṃ svarṇamayaṃ kāryaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāyudham \|*  
*pañcāmṛtena deveśaṃ snāpya nārāyaṇaṃ vibhum \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. The eyes and the teeth of the images should be of gems and ornaments should be studded with pearls. The rest of the limbs should be decorated with conch, disc as well as the club. Lord Narayana should then be bathed with pancamrta with the chanting of the Vedic mantras.

## \|\| 3.147.44-51 \|\|

*tameva gaṃdhapuṣpādyairmaṃtramuccārya pūjayet \|*  
*brāhmaṇo vaidikairmantraiḥ pūjayenmadhusūdanam \|\| 44 \|\|*

*śeṣā varṇāḥ purāṇoktaistāñchṛṇuṣva mama priye \|*  
*vāsudevāya pādau tu gulphau saṃkarṣaṇāya ca \|\| 45 \|\|*

*trailokyajanakāyeti jānunī pūjayeddhareḥ \|*  
*trailokyanāthāya guhye jñānamayāya vai kaṭim \|\| 46 \|\|*

*dāmodarāyetyudaraṃ hṛdayaṃ viśvarūpiṇe \|*  
*nityaṃ hi pūjayeddevi uraḥ śrīvatsadhāriṇe \|\| 47 \|\|*

*kaṇṭhaṃ kaustubhanāthāya āsyaṃ yajñamukhāya ca \|*  
*daityāṃtakāriṇe bāhū svairnāmairāyudhāni ca \|\| 48 \|\|*

*śiraḥ sarvātmane devi devadevasya pūjayet \|*  
*śriyaṃ prapūjayeddevīṃ devyā maṃtraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*indrādilokapālānāṃ pūjā kāryā yathākramam \|*  
*navagrahāṇāṃ homaśca kartavyo vighnanāśanaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*pūjā gaṇapateḥ kāryā tathā homo vidhānataḥ \|*  
*agre naivadyamatulaṃ dāpayeddhṛtapācitam \|\| 51 \|\|*

44-51. Then offering the flowers, the worship should be completed. О dear, the rest of the limbs of lord Madhusudana should be worshipped with the reciting of the mantras from the Puranas. Saying salutation to Vasudeva, the feet should be adored; saying salutation to Samkarsana, the ankle should be adored; saying salutation to the creator of the three worlds, the knees should be adored; saying salutation to the lord of the three worlds, the private parts should be touched; saying salutation to the leap of knowledge, the waist should be adored; saying salutation to Damodara, the belly should be adored; saying salutation to the universal form, the heart should be adored; saying salutation to Satyadeva, the chest should be adored; saying salutation to Kaustubhanatha, the neck should be adored; saying salutation to the face of the yajna, the face should be adored; saying salutation to the destroyer of the daityas, the arms should be adored. Then speaking out the weapons one by one, they should be adored individually; saying salutation to the universal soul, his head should be adored. Thereafter, the goddess Laksmi should be adored reciting different hymns; similarly, Indra and other Lokapalas and the nine planets should be adored while performing the homa. For the removal of all the obstructions, Ganapati – the remover of the obstacles should be worshipped, in a proper way.

## \|\| 3.147.52-56 \|\|

*pāyasaṃ ghṛtapūrāṃśca modakānpūrikāstathā \|*  
*sohālikādinaivedyaṃ pheṇikāḥ śarkarāstathā \|\| 52 \|\|*

*deśakālodbhavānyeva phalāni vinivedayet \|*  
*dīpāndaśa diśo dadyātpārthivānraktavartikān \|\| 53 \|\|*

*etena tu viśālākṣi mūlamantreṇa dāpayet \|*  
*puṣpamālānvitānkṛtvā caṃdanena vibhūṣitān \|\| 54 \|\|*

*abhimaṃtrya prayatnena viṣṇustabakavācakaiḥ \|*  
*sahasraśīrṣādibhirmaṃtrairjapadbhirbrāhmaṇottamaiḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*ṣoḍaśātha sapatnīkānpūjayecca yathāvidhi \|*  
*bhūṣayecca śubhairvastraistathālaṃkāraṇādibhiḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

52-56. Thereafter, payasam mixed with ghi, the sweet balls, sohalika, seasonal fruits, sugar, besides the flower garlands should also be offered. The sandal paste should be applied over his body and the lamp should be burnt. The goddess should be adored with the recitation of Visalaksi mantra, while lord Viṣṇu should be adored with Viṣṇustavaka mantra. The prayer should then be sung, the Brahmanas should worship with devotion. Thereafter, with the mantra “Sahasrasirsa purusa” etc., lord Viṣṇu should be worshipped. As per the prevailing practice, together with sixteen co-wives, the costumes and ornaments should be given to them.

## \|\| 3.147.57-60 \|\|

*viṣṇuṃ matvā dvijaḥ pūjyo lakṣmīṃ matvā ca brāhmaṇīm \|*  
*chatraṃ copānahau caiva aṃgulyābharaṇaṃ tathā \|\| 57 \|\|*

*phalāni sapta dhānyāni bhojanaṃ ca yadīpsitam \|*  
*dātavyaṃ ca sabhāryāya kṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti \|\| 58 \|\|*

*śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ caiva vastreṇācchādya yatnataḥ \|*  
*tathā prakalpayedvittaśaktyā ca suṃdarī yathā \|\| 59 \|\|*

*vrate pūrṇe ca gaurdeyā sarvopaskarasaṃyutā \|*  
*purīṃ ghaṭāpayetpūrvaṃ vastreṇācchādyayastaḥ \|*  
*yathā kuryātprayāsena yathā kartā na paśyati \|\| 60 \|\|*

57-60. The Brahmana should be conceived as Viṣṇu and his wife should be taken as Laksmi and then worshipped. They should be given the umbrella, shoes, rings, fruits, seven cereals, the food of their liking, saying – “Let lord Kṛṣṇa be pleased with me.” After giving away the well decorated bed along with bedsheets, pillows etc., the vrata can be concluded with the giving away of a cow, which is essential. Kancipuri should be so decorated with the clothes that the performer is unable to have a look at her.

## \|\| 3.147.61-69 \|\|

*dīpāṃstu dīpitāṃstatra ānayedyajñamaṇḍapam \|*  
*śvetavastreṇa netre tu yajamānasya ca priye \|\| 61 \|\|*

*śrutavāñchāstravitprājñaḥ kṛtasarvāghasaṃkṣayaḥ \|*  
*ābadhya netre suprājña ācāryastamidaṃ vadet \|\| 62 \|\|*

*sarvakāmapradāṃ paśya kāṃcanākhyāṃ purīmimām \|*  
*varavastrayutāṃ ramyāṃ duḥkhadaurbhāgyanāśinīm \|\| 63 \|\|*

*evamukto mahābhāga paṭamunmucya netrayoḥ \|*  
*puṣpāñjaliṃ gurau kṣiptvā sa paśyettāṃ purīṃ śubhām \|\| 64 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā tāṃ nagarīṃ devi yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ \|*  
*sauvarṇaṃ pātramādāya raupyaṃ tāmramathāpi vā \|\| 65 \|\|*

*atha vā śaṃkhamādāya pātrālābhe tu sundari \|*  
*pañcaratnaṃ kṣipetpātre jalaṃ gāṅgaṃ tathā phalam \|\| 66 \|\|*

*siddhārthamakṣatāḥ pūrvaṃ rocanā dadhi vā punaḥ \|*  
*tataścārdhyaṃ pradātavyaṃ kṛṣṇāya prabhaviṣṇave \|\| 67 \|\|*

*lakṣmīnārāyaṇau devau sarvakāmaphalapradau \|*  
*rukmapuryāḥ pradānena yacchaitāṃ vāṃchitaṃ mama \|\| 68 \|\|*

*nārāyaṇa hṛṣīkeśa jñānajñeya niraṃjana \|*  
*lakṣmīkāṃta jagannātha gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namostu te \|\| 69 \|\|*

61-69. A burning lamp should be brought into the mandapa, the acarya well-versed in the scriptures, should ask the performer of the vrata, covering him with the cloth, shuttering his eyes – “look at Kancipuri who grants merit for all the desires, who has been covered with the beautiful costumes and the bed and who vanishes all the misfortunes.” О excellent one, thus speaking, the curtain should be removed and the performer should offer a bunch of flowers at the feet of the preceptor and then have a look at Kancipuri. By having a look at that Puri with a devoted mind, the yajamana should put the water in a vase made of gold, silver, copper, conch or any other vase. Then pancamrta should be dropped into the pitcher. Thereafter, in the same vase, the fruits, mustard seeds, unbroken rice, gorocana and curd should be offered as oblation to Sri Kṛṣṇa, who possesses a great force. While so doing, he should say- “Let lord Laksmi Narayana grant you success in all the desires.” With the giving away in charity the city of Kancipuri, let one be successful in all his wishes. Let lord Narayana, Hrsikesa, Jnanajneya, the spotless one, the lord of Laksmi, besides being the lord of the universe, kindly accept my arghya (oblations).

## \|\| 3.147.70-75 \|\|

*evamarghyaṃ tato dattvā viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave \|*  
*devyāstvarghyaṃ pradātavyaṃ bhaktiyukte na cetasā \|\| 70 \|\|*

*jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā maṃtrametamudīrayet \|*  
*brahmaṇā pūjitā devī viṣṇunā śaṃkareṇa ca \|\| 71 \|\|*

*pārvatyā pūjitā lakṣmīḥ skaṃdavaiśravaṇena ca \|*  
*mayā ca pūjitā devi dharmasya vijigīṣayā \|\| 72 \|\|*

*saubhāgyaṃ dehi me putrāndhanaṃ pautrāṃśca pūjitān \|*  
*gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ devi saukhyaṃ prayaccha me \|\| 73 \|\|*

*ya evaṃ purato dattvā pūrvoktavidhinā tava \|*  
*rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādbhaktiyuktena cetasā \|\| 74 \|\|*

*gītanṛtyavinodena upākhyānaiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ \|*  
*yena kena vinodena nidrā naiva prajāyate \|\| 75 \|\|*

70-75. I offer my salutation to him. Thus, to lord Viṣṇu, one should offer the oblation with a devoted and careful mind, and should offer oblation in favour of the goddess Laksmi as well. Kneeling on the ground, he should recite the hymns – “The goddess has been adored by Brahma, Viṣṇu and Siva, besides Parvati, Kubera and Skanda. I am adoring you with the same devotion. Therefore, you kindly grant me sons, fortunes and excellent grandsons. Kindly accept the oblations offered by me.” Thus offering the oblations with the aforesaid method, one should perform dancing and singing before him, reciting the Vaiṣṇava stories and the night should be spent. He should keep himself awake throughout the day and should not sleep at all.

## \|\| 3.147.76-77 \|\|

*unnidro jāgṛyādyastu śatayajñaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*prabhāte vimale snātvā saṃpūjya pitṛdevatāḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇāṃśca sapatnīkānparidhāpyānubhojayet \|*  
*dakṣiṇāśca yathāśaktyā pradāya ca kṣamāpayet \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. In case one remains wakeful, he achieves sure success at the yajna. Again in the early spotless morning, the Brahmanas should be adored with their wives and should be pleased with the sumptuous food. Then daksina should be given to them as per one’s means, finally begging forgiveness.

## \|\| 3.147.78-81 \|\|

*dīnāṃdhabadhirānpaṃgūnsarvāṃstānparitoṣayet \|*  
*paścātpāraṇakaṃ kāryamupavāsī bhavedyadi \|\| 78 \|\|*

*madhuraṃ payasā yuktaṃ suhṛdbhirbāṃdhavaiḥ saha \|*  
*evametadvrataṃ kāryamekādaśyāṃ śucismite \|\| 79 \|\|*

*śuklāyāmatha kṛṣṇāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ tathā tithau \|*  
*saṃkrāṃtivāsare vāpi vyatīpāte ca vaidhṛtau \|\| 80 \|\|*

*yadā vā jāyate vittaṃ cittaṃ ca varavarṇini \|*  
*gaurānīya pradātavyā kṛṣṇo me prīyatāmiti \|\| 81 \|\|*

78-81. Thereafter, the destitute, blind, deaf people as well as the deformed ones should be pleased. In case the performer is observing the fast, he should break the fast and take excellent food with his friends and relatives, comprising of the tasty payasam and other dishes. О king with noble wisdom, on the day of ekadasi, the vrata should be performed or alternatively, on the bright or dark tritiya of a month or on the first day of the month, on the occasion of the great calamity, at the time of the yoga star of the twenty seven planets or otherwise when the mind is fully content and the mind is quite peaceful and one has enough of riches with him, then the vrata should be performed. О damsel, at the time of the giving away of the cow, one should say – “Let lord Kṛṣṇa be pleased with me.”

## \|\| 3.147.82-83 \|\|

*evaṃ kṛte ca yatpuṇyaṃ tanna śakyaṃ niveditum \|*  
*api varṣasahasreṇa kulalakṣaśatairapi \|\| 82 \|\|*

*kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca \|*  
*brahmalokaṃ samāsādya brahmaṇā pratimodyate \|\| 83 \|\|*

82-83. After the successful completion of the vrata, the merit which is earned by the performer is difficult to be narrated by me. For thousands of years, the hundreds and thousands of generations of the performer upto thousands of crores of the kalpas, play with Brahma in Brahmaloka.

## \|\| 3.147.84-87 \|\|

*brahmakādrudralokaṃ tatparaṃ viṣṇusaṃnidhau \|*  
*indrādilokapālānāṃ vratī lokamavāpnuyāt \|\| 84 \|\|*

*tato bhuktvā śuciḥ śrīmānbhogāṃstrailokyasuṃdari \|*  
*cakravartī bhavedbhūmau brahmaṇyo vaiṣṇavastathā \|\| 85 \|\|*

*ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ vācayamānaṃ samaṃtataḥ \|*  
*kulasaptakamuddhṛtya vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāpnuyāt \|\| 86 \|\|*

*tvayā kāṃcanapuryākhyaṃ vratametatkṛtaṃ purā \|*  
*tena puṇyena labdho'haṃ bhartā trailokyapūjitaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

84-87. Then they move on from Brahmaloka to Sivaloka and from there, they move on to Viṣṇuloka. Thereafter, they move on to Indraloka and other lokas. Finally, they are reborn as cakravarti kings on earth in Brahmanya or Vaiṣṇava race. Those who listen to the stories of the vrata, they also get redeemed from the earth with seven generations, reaching Vaiṣṇavaloka finally. You had performed this Kancana-vrata in your earlier birth, as a result of which you are adored in the three worlds.

## Chapter 148. Kanyadana

## \|\| 3.148.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*brahmadeyāṃ tu yaḥ kanyāmalaṃkṛtya prayacchati \|*  
*saptapūrvānbhaviṣyāṃśca svakule sapta mānavān \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tena kanyāpradānena sa tārayatyasaṃśayam \|*  
*lokānāpnoti ca tathā dakṣasyaiva prajāpateḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*prājāpatyena vidhinā ātmānaṃ ca samuddharet \|*  
*mahatpuṇyamavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – By giving away a girl who is suitable to be given to a Brahmana, duly adorned with all the ornaments, the giver redeems bis seven past and the seven generations. The person who gives away his daughter in marriage, achieves the place of Daksa-Prajapati. As per the rules of Prajapatya vidhana (Prajapati types of practice), when the rite of the giving away of the girl is performed, the giver achieves enormous merits, besides reaching the heaven.

## \|\| 3.148.4-8 \|\|

*bhūgavāśvapradānāni gajadānaṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*dattvā tu varṇahīnāya ghore tamasi majjati \|\| 4 \|\|*

*bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi purīṣaṃ kākamaśnute \|*  
*śulkena dattvā kanyāṃ ca ghoraṃ narakamāpnuyāt \|\| 5 \|\|*

*bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi tathā aśucibhuṅnaraḥ \|*  
*savarṇāṃ ca savarṇebhyo dadyātkanyāṃ yathāvidhi \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dattvā cādhikavarṇāya dviguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*dvijaputramanāthaṃ vā saṃskuryādyaśca karmabhiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*cūḍopanayādyaiśca so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet \|*  
*anāthāṃ kanyakāṃ dattvā nākaloke mahīyate \|\| 8 \|\|*

4-8. In case, the land, cow, horse or an elephant is given to a person who is devoid of varna, one falls into a terrific heaven. Becoming a crow, he consumes the refuse for many years. In case a person gives away a girl in marriage in consideration for riches, he falls in a terrified hell and for many years, he remains in impurity. Therefore, a girl of a high family should be given to a match of a high family alone. In case, an orphan’s tonsure or name giving ceremony is performed by some other person, or when the yajnopavita ceremony of a poor boy is performed by another person out of compose, he attains the merit of performing an Asvamedha sacrifice. In case, an orphan girl is given in marriage by a person, he achieves the heaven surely.

## \|\| 3.148.9 \|\|

*kanyayā saha dattaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ vahnimūlakam \|*  
*sakalaṃ dviguṇaṃ tasya phalamuktaṃ purātanaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. In case, gold is also given at the time of the marriage of a girl, the ancient people say that he gets double the merit.

## \|\| 3.148.10 \|\|

*kanyādānādavāpnoti dakṣalokaṃ narottama \|*  
*viṣṇupūjāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ tatkanyāpūjayā bhavet \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. With the performing of the kanyadana, one achieves place of Daksa. By adoring a girl, one achieves the merit of worshiping lord Viṣṇu.

## \|\| 3.148.11 \|\|

*vimānamāhṛtya manobhirāmaṃ surāṅganāgītavilāsahṛdyam \|*  
*prāpnoti lokaṃ tridaśottamānāṃ kanyāpradānānna vicāraṇeti \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. One who gives away a daughter in marriage, then after his death, he is lodged in an excellent plane and is served by the divine damsels, with music and dance.

## Chapter 149. Service rendered to a Brāhmaṇa

## \|\| 3.149.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*brāhmaṇā daivataṃ bhūmau brāhmaṇā divi daivatam \|*  
*brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṃ nāsti nāsti bhūtaṃ jagattraye \|\| 1 \|\|*

*adevaṃ daivataṃ kuryuḥ kuryurdevamadaivatam \|*  
*brāhmaṇā hi mahābhāgāḥ pūjyaṃte satataṃ dvijāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samutpannā devāḥ pūrvamiti smṛtiḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇebhyo jagatsarvaṃ tasmātpūjyatamā dvijāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – Only a Brahmana is the adorable one on earth, who is the deity of the heaven as well. Because in the three worlds, there is nothing better than a Brahmana. It is only a Brahmana who can make a person as a god and also reduce a god to the lowest position. Therefore, the Brāhmaṇas are always respected. The Vedic texts say that the Brāhmaṇas only were instrumental in the creation of the gods. The universe was created subsequently. Therefore, the Brāhmaṇas are considered to be most adorable.

## \|\| 3.149.4 \|\|

*yeṣāmaśnaṃti vaktreṇa devatāḥ pitarastathā \|*  
*ṛṣayaśca tathā nāgāḥ kiṃ bhūtamadhikaṃ tataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. By the face of a Brahmana, the gods, manes, the Ṛṣis and Nagas receive their food. Then what more can be said about them?

## \|\| 3.149.5 \|\|

*yadaiva manujo bhaktyā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati \|*  
*tadaivāpnoti dharmajña bahujanmani janmani \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. When a person gives away something to a Brahmana with devotion, he receives the merit for the same for many births.

## \|\| 3.149.6-9 \|\|

*tālavṛṃtānilenaiva śrāṃtasaṃvāhanena ca \|*  
*utsādanena gātrāṇāṃ tathā vyaṃjanakarmaṇā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pādaśaucapradānena pādayoḥ secanena ca \|*  
*paricarya yathā kāmamekenaiva dvijottama \|\| 7 \|\|*

*aniṣṭvāpi samāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca śāśvatam \|*  
*brāhmaṇānāṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā nākaloke mahīyate \|\| 8 \|\|*

*yadbrāhmaṇāstuṣṭimanto vadaṃti pratyakṣadeveṣu parokṣadevāḥ \|*  
*tadvai śubhaṃ tasya narasya nūnaṃ bhavedatastānsatataṃ niṣevet \|\| 9 \|\|*

6-9. By fanning a Brahmana, pressing his feet, removal of fatigue from the body, besides giving water for food or washing of the feet or serving a Brahmana in any other way, even to a single Brahmana, the doer surely attains heaven inspite of several obstructions. With the rendering of the noble service to the Brāhmaṇas, the people are honoured in the heaven. When the Brahmanas are pleased they bless in the open, while the gods do so invisibly. Whatever auspicious words are spoken for a person, they surely become true. Therefore, the Brāhmaṇas should always be served.

## Chapter 150. Donating of a Bull

## \|\| 3.150.1-3 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*yuṣmadvākyāmṛtamidaṃ hyahaṃ śṛṇvañjanārdana \|*  
*na tṛptimadhigacchāmi jātaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me \|\| 1 \|\|*

*gopatiḥ kila govindastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ \|*  
*govṛṣasya pradānena trailokyamabhinaṃdati \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tasmādgovṛṣakalpasya vidhānaṃ kathayācyuta \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Yudhisthira said – О Janardana, listening to your nectar like words, I do not feel contented. I am quite anxious, О Govinda, you are the lord of the cows, this is well known in the three worlds. But it is heard that with the giving away in charity a bull and a cow, the donor attains pleasures of the three worlds, Therefore, you kindly speak out about the Go-vrsa kalpa.

## \|\| 3.150.4-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*vṛṣadānaphalaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi te \|*  
*pavitraṃ pāvanaṃ caiva sarvadānottamaṃ tathā \|\| 4 \|\|*

*daśadhenusamo'naḍvānekaścaiva dhuraṃdharaḥ \|*  
*daśadhenupradānāddhi sa evaiko viśiṣyate \|\| 5 \|\|*

*voḍhā ca cārupṛṣṭhāṃgo hyarogaḥ pāṃḍunaṃdana \|*  
*yuvā bhadraḥ suśī laśca sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – The merit of donating a bull is the highest and extremely auspicious, which is going to be revealed by me. A strong bull is equal to the ten cows. О son of Pandu, instead of giving away in charity the ten milk giving cows, the giving away of a bull is more meritorious. It is said because a healthy bull with a beautiful back is foil of strength and vigour. A young bull has nice appearance, is quite docile and is free from all the blemishes.

## \|\| 3.150.7-8 \|\|

*dhuraṃdharaḥ sthāpayate eka eva kulaṃ mahat \|*  
*trātā bhavati saṃsārānnātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*alaṃkṛtya vṛṣaṃ śāṃtaṃ puṇyehni samupasthite \|*  
*raupyalāḍgūlasaṃyuktaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. Such a bull establishes a strong breed. He is the only protector in the world. There is no doubt about it. On some auspicious day, a docile bull should be decorated. His tail should be decorated with silver and then it should be given to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.150.9-10 \|\|

*maṃtreṇānena rājendra taṃ śṛṇuṣva vadāmi te \|*  
*dharmastvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa jaga dānaṃdakāraka \|\| 9 \|\|*

*aṣṭamūrteradhiṣṭhānamataḥ pāhi sanātana \|*  
*datvaivaṃ dakṣiṇāyuktaṃ praṇipatya visarjayet \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. The mantra which is to be recited at that particular time is going to be revealed by me. You please listen – “O Dharma, in the form of a bull, you delight the universe. You are lodged as Asamurti. Therefore, you protect me.” Thus speaking, the bull with daksina should be given over to a Brahmana. It should then be sent off offering the salutation to it.

## \|\| 3.150.11 \|\|

*saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vāṅmanaḥ kāyakarmajam \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti godānasukṛtena ca \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The sins committed physically, mentally or by speech during the past seven births, disappear with the giving away of or cow (or a bull).

## \|\| 3.150.12-14 \|\|

*yānaṃ vṛṣabhasaṃyuktaṃ dīpyamānaṃ suśobhitam \|*  
*āruhya kāmagaṃ divyaṃ svarlokamadhirohati \|\| 12 \|\|*

*yāvaṃti tasya romāṇi govṛṣasya mahīpate \|*  
*tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi gavāṃ loke mahīyate \|\| 13 \|\|*

*golokādavatīrṇastu ihaloke dvijottamaḥ \|*  
*yajñayājī mahātejāḥ sarvabrāhmaṇapūjitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. A person who mounts over a decorated bullock cart, he achieves the merit of visiting the divine heaven. О king, the same person enjoys all the pleasures in the Goloka upto the number of years equivalent to the number of hair over the body of the bull. After his return from Goloka, the same donor is reborn in a high Brahmana family, he becomes a yajna priest, illustrious and respected by all the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.150.15-17 \|\|

*tavoktaṃ vai mahārāja kasya deyo vṛṣottamaḥ \|*  
*tadapyahaṃ te vakṣyāmi pātraṃ trāṇapradaṃ nṛṇām \|\| 15 \|\|*

*yeṣāṃ sadā vai śrutipūrṇakarṇā jitendriyāḥ prāṇivadhe nivṛttāḥ \|*  
*pratigrahe saṃkucitā gṛhasthāste brāhmaṇāstārayituṃ samarthāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*gātre dṛḍhaṃ bhārasahaṃ supuṣṭaṃ suśṛṅgiṇaṃ sarvaguṇopapannam \|*  
*dattvarṣabhaṃ godaśakena tulyaṃ satyaṃ bhavaṃti bhuvi tatphalabhāginaste \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. О king, whatever was asked by you, I have narrated to you the same. The merit of the donating of a bull and to whom should it be given, I am going to speak about the same. The one who is suitable to receive the same is be saviour of the mankind, the one who always listens to the Vedas, who has controlled all his sense organs, is non-violent, who is shy of getting charity. Such a bull with the intention of redeeming the human race, could be able to carry the donor on its back. It should be quite strong with beautiful horns, who possesses all the good qualities. Such a bull is equal to ten cows. A person who donates the same on earth, he achieves all the merits.

## Chapter 151. Charities of various types

## \|\| 3.151.1-3 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*śrutaḥ purāṇaviṣayastvatprasādānmayācyuta \|*  
*saṃsārāsāratāṃ jñātvā śrutaśca vratavistaraḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*bhūyaśca śrotumicchāmi dānamāhātmyamuttamam \|*  
*kiṃ dīyate kadā kṛṣṇa kenopāyena śaṃsa me \|\| 2 \|\|*

*nahi dānātparataramanyadastīti me matiḥ \|*  
*dhanaṃ dhanavatāṃ kiñcidahāryaṃ rājataskaraiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Yudhisthira said – О Acyutadeva, by your grace, taking this world to be of no consequence, I have heard your discourses on the various topics of the Puranas, in which various types of the vratas were defined exhaustively. О Kṛṣṇa, but still I am quite keen to listen to the glory of giving away the charities, which type of charities should be performed, you please tell me, because in case the charities are given with good intentions, there is nothing more auspicious than that. Such type of riches with the wealthy people cannot be stolen or usurped by the people.

## \|\| 3.151.4-13 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*aniścitaṃ nidhānaṃ yadaprayuktaṃ ca varddhate \|*  
*anītaṃ yāti cādhvānaṃ dhanaṃ viprakarārpitam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kiṃ kāyena supuṣṭena balinā cirajīvinā \|*  
*yannasattvopakārāya tajjīvitamanarthakam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*grāsādarddhamapi grāsa marthibhyaḥ kiṃ na dīyate \|*  
*icchānurūpo vibhavaḥ kadā kasya bhaviṣyati \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ekasminnapyatikrāṃte dine dānavivarjite \|*  
*dasyubhirmuṣitaścaiva divārātrau ca śocati \|\| 7 \|\|*

*yasya trivargaśūnyāni dinānyāyāṃti yāṃti ca \|*  
*salohakārabhastreva śvasannapi na jīvati \|\| 8 \|\|*

*yairna dattaṃ na ca hutaṃ na tīrthe maraṇaṃ kṛtam \|*  
*hiraṇyamannamudakaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo na cārpitam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dīnā niraśanā rūkṣāḥ kapālāṅkitapāṇayaḥ \|*  
*te dṛśyaṃte mahārāja jāyamānā punaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*āyāsaśatalabdhasya prāṇebhyopi garīyasaḥ \|*  
*gatirekaiva vittasya dānamanyā vipattayaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*nopabhogaiḥ kṣayaṃ yāṃti na pradānaiḥ samṛddhayaḥ \|*  
*pūrvārjitānāmanyatra sukṛtānāṃ parikṣayāt \|\| 12 \|\|*

*adṛṣṭaparatattvopi pātrebhyo visṛjeddhanam \|*  
*yasmānmṛtasya tannāsti tasmātsāṃśayikaṃ varam \|\| 13 \|\|*

4-13. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – The wealth given to the Brahmanas in charity becomes a different type of substratum, which cannot be imagined by anyone, because it goes on increasing without any use and is made available during the journey of a person to the other world. Those having strong and valorous bodies with long life, are of no consequence unless some good deeds are done by them for the benefit of others. When a morsel or a half of it is given to a beggar, the wealth does not increase as per the desire of a person. When a day passes without giving away of the charity, but the thieves steal the wealth o f a person, he feels worried about the same. A person who spends the days without performing dharna, artha and kama, he is not said to be alive, inspite of breathing visibly. His breathing is useless like the oven of a blacksmith and cannot be said to be alive. In true sense, one who has not given the charities, who has not performed the yajna, who has not breathed out his last in a holy place nor has he given gold or food to the Brāhmaṇas but have lived with miserable temperament, facing hunger, with dry appearance and has spent his time holding a skull in his hand, have to repeat the cycle of birth and death. It has been observed. Making all the labour and efforts hundreds of time, the wealth, which is considered to be dearer than the life by a person, the same wealth should be given away in charity to a suitable person during his life time itself.

## \|\| 3.151.14-15 \|\|

*dānāni bahurūpāṇi kathayāmi tavānagha \|*  
*vyāsavālmīkimanvādyaiḥ kathitāni purā mama \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kiñcidvrataṃ yatkriyate pūjyate ca trilocanaḥ \|*  
*dīyate yacca viprebhya etajjanmataroḥ phalam \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. О sinless one, though the charities are said to be of various types, but the Ṛṣis like Vyasa, Valmiki and Manu have spoken to me on this subject and whatever they have spoken to me, the same is going to be revealed by me to you. You please listen that whatever charities are given by the people to the Brahmanas, it is conceived to be the fruit of that particular birth.

## \|\| 3.151.16-17 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*brāhmaṇaprīṇanārthāya keśavasya śivasya ca \|*  
*yāni dānāni deyāni tānyācakṣya yadūttama \|\| 16 \|\|*

*yena caiva vidhānena dānaṃ puṇyasukhāvaham \|*  
*ehikāmuṣmikāvāptiṃ karoti nahi hanyate \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. Yudhisthira said – You kindly tell me the charities to be given to Siva, Kesava, the messengers of Yama and the Brahmanas in order to please them. You also kindly inform me about the process, with the following of which, the charities so given become purposeful, rewarding and auspicious, besides that one should be able to face comforts in this as well as the other world.

## \|\| 3.151.18-19 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*trīṇyāhuratidānāni gāvaḥ pṛthvī sarasvatī \|*  
*āsaptamaṃ punaṃtyete dohavāhanavedanaiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*godānamādau vakṣyāmi pratyakṣakramayogataḥ \|*  
*yena caiva vidhānena anyūnādhikavistaram \|\| 19 \|\|*

18-19. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – The giving away of the cows, land and learnings are considered to be the best types of the charities. One who gives away such charities, his seven generations get redeemed. Therefore, as per the present sequence, I am going to speak to you about the giving away of the cows. This process is neither brief nor too long, which is being told by me.

## \|\| 3.151.20 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*deyāḥ kiṃlakṣaṇā gāvaḥ kāśca rājanvivarjitāḥ \|*  
*kīdṛśāya pradātavyā na deyāḥ kīdṛśāya vai \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Yudhisthira said – What types of cows should be given in charity, what type of auspicious symptoms should be possessed by a cow, besides such of the symptoms which are inauspicious and should not be possessed by a cow? You please tell me.

## \|\| 3.151.21-24 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*taruṇī rūpasaṃpannā suśīlā ca payasvinī \|*  
*nyāyārjitā savatsā ca pradeyā śrotriyāya gauḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*vṛddhā sarogā hīnāṃgī vaṃdhyā duṣṭā mṛtaprajā \|*  
*dūrasthā'nyāyalabdhā ca deyā gaurna kathaṃcana \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sā dattaiva haretpāpaṃ śrotriyāyāhitāgnaye \|*  
*atithipriyāya dāṃtāya dhenuṃ dadyādguṇādhike \|\| 23 \|\|*

*akulīnāya mūrkhāya lubdhāya piśunāya ca \|*  
*havyakavyavyapetāya na deyā gauḥ kathaṃcana \|\| 24 \|\|*

21-24. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – The cow for giving in charity should be quite young, beautiful, docile, milk giving and must have been secured by noble means. She must be with a calf. Similarly, the cow for giving in charity should not be old, ailing, deprived of a limb, wicked, whose calf is dead, one who moves away and the one which is usurped by unfair means. Such a cow should never be given in charity. When a cow with the auspicious symptoms is given to a Brahmana who recites the Vedas, it washes out all the sins. Because the cow should be given in charity to a Brahmana who honours the guests, besides possessing all the virtues. The cow should never be given to a person of low family, foolish, greedy, back biter and a Brahmana, who is deprived of havya and kavya.

## \|\| 3.151.25-28 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya snātvātarpya pitṝṃstathā \|*  
*ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣekaṃ ca kṛtvā viṣṇoḥ śivasya ca \|\| 25 \|\|*

*samabhyarcya yathānyāyaṃ puṣpādibhiranukramāt \|*  
*udaṅmukhīṃ prāṅmukhīṃ vā gṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā payasvinīm \|\| 26 \|\|*

*savatsāṃ vastrasaṃvītāṃ sitayajñopavītinīm \|*  
*svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ kāṃsyadohanakānvitām \|\| 27 \|\|*

*śaktito dakṣiṇāyuktāṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|*  
*pucche kṛṣṇājinaṃ deyaṃ gāṃ pucche kariṇaṃ kare \|\| 28 \|\|*

25-28. On an auspicious day, after taking bath and offering oblation, lord Viṣṇu and lord Siva should be adored. Thereafter, their abhiseka should be performed, offering the flowers and payasam mixed with ghi. He should adore them both, then facing the north or the east, the cow should be established. The cow should be beautiful, healthy and milk giving one, should have a calf, and should be covered with a cloth. Her head should be decorated with a yajnopavita, the hoofs should be decorated with gold, while the hoofs should be decorated with silver. The milk pot of bronze, daksina as per the means of the donor and the cow should be given over to a Brahmana. The charity of black deer and the cow should be received holding the tail.

## \|\| 3.151.29-31 \|\|

*aśvaṃ sadā sukarṇe vā dāsīṃ śirasi dāpayet \|*  
*gāvo mamāgrataḥ saṃtu gāvo me saṃtu pṛṣṭhataḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*gāvo me hṛdaye saṃtu gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham \|*  
*pradakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhenuṃ dvijavarāya tām \|\| 30 \|\|*

*imāṃ ca pratigṛhṇīṣva dhenurdattā mayā tava \|*  
*evamuccārya taṃ vipraṃ deveśaṃ parikalpayet \|\| 31 \|\|*

29-31. Similarly, a horse should be given in charity holding the ear, while a slave girl should be given holding her head. The elephant should be given away with the holding of the trunk. The cows are present in my heart and back, therefore, I am living among the cows. Thereafter, going round the Brāhmaṇa and the cow, one should say – “I have given over this cow to you. Therefore, you please receive it.” Thus speaking, the cow should be given over to the Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.151.32-35 \|\|

*anuvrajecca gacchaṃtaṃ padānyaṣṭau narādhipa \|*  
*anena vidhinā dhenuṃ yo viprāya prayacchati \|\| 32 \|\|*

*sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā svargalokaṃ sa gacchati \|*  
*sapta pūrvānsapta parānātmānaṃ caiva mānavaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sapta janmakṛtātpāpānmocayatyavanīpate \|*  
*pade pade'śvamedhasya gośatasya ca mānavaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*phalamāpnoti rājendra dakṣāyaivaṃ jagau hariḥ \|*  
*sarvakāmapradā sā syātsarvakāleṣu pārthiva \|\| 35 \|\|*

32-35. О king, at the time of the departure, the performer should follow the cow upto eight steps. A person who gives away the cow following this process to a Brāhmaṇa, he getting all his desires fulfilled and becoming a highly developed soul, achieves the heaven. Such a person redeems his past seven and the future seven generations and relieves them of all the sins. He earns the merit of performing an Asvamedha sacrifice as well giving of a hundred cows in charity at every step. Thus is what Viṣṇu told to Daksa. О Parthiva, the cow makes all the desires successful at all the times.

## \|\| 3.151.36-38 \|\|

*bhavatyasau pāpaharā yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśa \|*  
*sarveṣāmeva pāpānāṃ kṛtānāmapi jānatā \|\| 36 \|\|*

*prāyaścittamidaṃ proktamanutāpopabṛṃhitam \|*  
*sarveṣāmeva dānānāmekajanmānugaṃ phalam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiścānyaiśca mānavaiḥ \|*  
*lokāḥ kāmagamā prāptā dattvaitadvidhinā nṛpa \|\| 38 \|\|*

36-38. The person who gives away a cow in charity is relieved of all the sins and he does not have to perform the repentance for them even. The giving away of a cow is considered to be the best of the charities. It yields the reward during the life time of a person. Thus, all the people including the Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras besides others, can make their present as well as the future lives comfortable.

## \|\| 3.151.39 \|\|

*gobhyodhikaṃ jagati nāparamastikiñciddānaṃ pavitramiti śāstravido vadaṃti \|*  
*tatsaṃpadaḥ surasadaśca samīhamānairdeyāḥ sadaiva vidhinā dvijapuṃgavāya \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The persons well-versed in the scriptures have declared that there is no other charity more auspicious and rewarding than the giving away of a cow. Therefore, those who want to protect their wealth, they must give away a cow to an excellent Brahmana.

## Chapter 152. Vrata for giving a cow in charity

## \|\| 3.152.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dhenūnāṃ kalpanā nṛpa \|*  
*viśeṣavidhinā yāśca deyāḥ kāmānabhīpsubhiḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*kāmaṃ yaddīyate dānaṃ samagraṃ tatsukhāvaham \|*  
*asamagraṃ tu doṣāya bhavatīha paratra ca \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О king, I am narrating to you the Dhenukalpa and the special procedure related to performing the same, with the I following of which the people, for the fulfillment of their desires, give away a cow in charity. The charity given with daksina is considered to be the complete process of, charity, which provides comforts in the present as well as the future loka. A charity which is given without the daksina blemishes both the present as well as the future lokas.

## \|\| 3.152.3-4 \|\|

*tasmānna dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ vidhānavikalaṃ tathā \|*  
*deyaṃ dānaṃ mahārāja samagraphalakāmyayā \|\| 3 \|\|*

*anyathā dīyamānaṃ tadahaṃkārāya kevalam \|*  
*pratyakṣaṃ cārthahāniḥ syānna vā tatphaladaṃ bhavet \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. О great king, accordingly, the charity given without daksina shatter the procedure and therefore, one should never resort to the same. A person who is desirous of the auspicious reward, he should perform the charities appropriately. Otherwise, the blemished charity adds to the shortages and apparently, one gets the money lost and the desired merit also cannot be achieved.

## \|\| 3.152.5-7 \|\|

*tiladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu pārthivasattama \|*  
*vārāheṇa purā proktāṃ mahāpātakanāśinīm \|\| 5 \|\|*

*yāṃ dattvā brahmahā goghnaḥ pitṛhā gurutalpagaḥ \|*  
*agāradāhī garadaḥ sarvapāparatopi vā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*mahāpātakayuktaśca saṃyuktaścopapātakaiḥ \|*  
*mucyate hyakhilaiḥ pāpaiḥ svargalokaṃ ca gacchati \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. О best of the Parthiva, I am revealing before you the giving away of a cow made of sesamum seeds which removes the worst evils and was spoken by the Varaha form of Viṣṇu in earlier times. With the giving away of this type of cow, one is relieved of the sin of killing of a Brāhmaṇa or the cow or the father, or enjoying wife of the preceptor, one who bums a house, one who administers person to others, who commits the grave or small sins, such persons are relieved of all the sins and reach the heaven.

## \|\| 3.152.8-9 \|\|

*anulipte mahīpṛṣṭhe kṛṣṇājinasamāvṛte \|*  
*dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ kṛtvā darbhānāstīrya sarvataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tilāḥ śvetāstilāḥ kṛṣṇāstilā gomūtravarṇakāḥ \|*  
*tilānāṃ ca vicitrāṇāṃ dhenuṃ sarvāṃ ca kārayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Plastering the earth with cowdung, the black deer skin should be spread over it. The kusa grass should be spread around it. Then placing kusa grass on all the four sides, a cow made with black sesamum seeds should be placed. The sesamum seeds of black, white and other colours should be used for the making of the figure of a cow.

## \|\| 3.152.10-13 \|\|

*droṇasya vatsakaṃ kuryāccaturāḍhakikāṃ ca gām \|*  
*svarṇaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ gandhavarṇavatīṃ tathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*kāryā śarkarayā jihvā guḍenāsyaṃ ca kambalaḥ \|*  
*ikṣupādāṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhīṃ śuktimuktāphalekṣaṇām \|\| 11 \|\|*

*praśastapatraśravaṇāṃ phaladaṃtavatīṃ śubhām \|*  
*sragdāmapucchāṃ kurvīta nava nītastanānvitām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*sitavastraśirālambāṃ sitasarṣaparomikām \|*  
*phalairmanoharairannairmaṇimuktāphalānvitām \|\| 13 \|\|*

10-13. The calf of the cow should be made of the sesamum seeds measuring a drona, while the weight should be four adhakas (an adhaka is equal in weight of four kilograms). Its horns should be of gold, while the hoofs should be of silver. It should be of white colour. Its tongue should be of sugar, the frills below the neck should be made of jaggery. The back should be of copper, the eyes may be made of beads and the ears should be made of praiseworthy leaves, while the fruits should be made use of for making the teeth. The tail should be made of garland. The udder should be made of butter, while the head should be made of the white cloth. The mustard seeds should be used for the hair of the body. Thus the cow should be decorated with fresh fruits, cereals, the gems and pearls over the entire body.

## \|\| 3.152.14-15 \|\|

*īdṛksaṃsthānasampannāṃ kṛtvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*kāṃsyopadohanāṃ dadyātparvakāle samāgate \|\| 14 \|\|*

*yā lakṣmīḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yā vai deveṣvavasthitā \|*  
*dhenurūpeṇa sā devī mama pāpaṃ vyapohatu \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. Together with the milk pot of the bronze, it should be given away at an auspicious time in charity. Then the donor should say – “The goddess Laksmi, who pervades in all the creatures and is surrounded by all the gods, let the same Laksmi, in the form of this cow, destroy all my sins.”

## \|\| 3.152.16-19 \|\|

*tataḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā praṇamya ca \|*  
*sadakṣiṇā mayā tubhyaṃ dattetyuktvā visarjayet \|\| 16 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā dattvā tiladhenuṃ narādhipa \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmukto paraṃ brahmādhigacchati \|\| 17 \|\|*

*yaśca gṛhṇāti vidhivaddīyamānāṃ pramodate \|*  
*dīyamānāṃ praśaṃsaṃti ye ca saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tepi doṣavinirmuktā brahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te \|*  
*praśāṃtāya suśīlāya vedavrataratāya ca \|\| 19 \|\|*

16-19. Thus speaking at that time, he should go round the figure of cow and then offer salutation to the same adoring it. Then with the giving away of daksina, he should say- “I have given this cow with daksina to you.” Thus speaking, he should send if off. О king, a person who gets the cow of sesamum seeds given over in charity, he getting free from all the sins, achieves the supreme Brahman. The Brāhmaṇa who delightfully accepts the donation of the sesamum seeds cow and the one who praises him immensely, both of them get unblemished and achieve the supreme Brahman.

## \|\| 3.152.20-25 \|\|

*dhenuṃ tilamayīṃ dattvā na śocati kṛtākṛte \|*  
*trirātraṃ yastilāhārastiladhenuprado bhavet \|\| 20 \|\|*

*ekāhamatha vā rājanna yucchedantarātmanā \|*  
*dānādviśuddhiḥ pāpasya tasya puṇyavato nṛpa \|\| 21 \|\|*

*cāndrāyaṇādabhyadhikaṃ kathitaṃ tilabhakṣaṇam \|*  
*bālatve caiva yatpāpaṃ yauvane vārddhake tathā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vācā kṛtaṃ tu manasā karmaṇā yacca saṃcitam \|*  
*udakaṣṭhīvane caiva nagnasnānena yadbhavet \|\| 23 \|\|*

*muśalenodyate nāpi laṃbite brāhmaṇe tathā \|*  
*vṛṣalīgamane caiva gurudārābhigāmini \|\| 24 \|\|*

*surāpānena yatpāpamabhakṣyasya ca bhakṣaṇāt \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti tiladhenupradāyinām \|\| 25 \|\|*

20-25. When the cow of sesamum seeds is given over to a peace loving noble Brāhmaṇa who is well-versed in the Vedas, the donor shall never have any doubt over his performance in any way. A person who consumes the sesamum seeds for three days and three nights, he achieves the merit of giving away in charity the sesamum seeds cow. With the giving away of the donations, one’s body gets purified. Therefore, performing the vrata of consuming the sesamum seeds, he earns the merit equivalent to the performing of the Candrayana vrata or even more than that A person who donates tiladhenu is also relieved of all the sins of his childhood, youthful age as well as the old age, besides the sins committed mentally by speech or those with the body. Besides the sins of spitting in the water, taking the bath removing all the clothes, to strike a Brāhmaṇa with a club, to unite with a Sudra woman and the wife of the preceptor, drinking of wine and consuming of the prohibited food also get washed out with performing of this charity.

## \|\| 3.152.26-28 \|\|

*yamamārge mahāghore nadī vaitaraṇī smṛtā \|*  
*vālukāyāḥ sthalaṃ caiva pacyate yatra pāpinaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*yatra lohamukhāḥ kākā yatra śvāno bhayāvahāḥ \|*  
*nikṛtya pāpināṃ māṃsaṃ bhakṣayaṃti bubhukṣitāḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*asipatravanaṃ caiva lohakaṃṭakaśālmalīm \|*  
*etānsarvānatikramya tato yamapuraṃ vrajet \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. In the horrible path of Yama where the Vaitarani river and the burning hot sand are found, there the sinful people get cooked. The crows with the beaks of iron, besides the awful dogs, bounce upon the sinners in hunger and eat their flesh. Similarly, there are the plants which have the leaves like the swords, growing over the trees in the forest. There is also the silk cotton tree. The donor of the cow of sesamum seeds crosses all these awful situations with absolute ease and reaches the place of Yama.

## \|\| 3.152.29-31 \|\|

*vimāne kāṃcane divye maṇiratnavibhūṣite \|*  
*tatrāruhya naraśreṣṭho gacchate paramāṅgatim \|\| 29 \|\|*

*guṇahīne na dātavyā na dātavyā dhaneśvare \|*  
*kuṇḍe gole ca lubdhe ca na ca deyā kadāpi sā \|\| 30 \|\|*

*ekā ekasya dātavyā munibhiḥ kathitaṃ purā \|*  
*araṇye naimiṣe pārtha nāradena niveditam \|\| 31 \|\|*

29-31. Such a type of donation of the sesamum cow should never be given to a person devoid of virtues, a rich person or a cheat or a greedy person. According to the words of the ancient Ṛṣis, a cow should be given to one person only. О Partha, whatever Narada had said in the Naimisaranya, I am speaking to you.

## \|\| 3.152.32-34 \|\|

*tattehaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi samyakphalasahasradam \|*  
*idaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca māṅgalyaṃ kīrtivardhanam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*viprāṇāṃ śrāvayecchrāddhe anantaphalamaśnute \|*  
*bahubhyo na pradeyāni gaurgṛhaṃ śayanaṃ striyaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*vibhajyamānānyetāni dātāraṃ pātayaṃtyadhaḥ \|*  
*sā tu vikrayamāpannā dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. This is an auspicious story which enhances welfare as well as the fame. When this story is heard from the Brahmanas at the time of sraddha, one achieves the enormous merit. With the giving of charity of a cow, a house, a bed and a girl to a wicked person, the donor falls in the hell. When the charities are sold I out, the action destroys the seven generations.

## \|\| 3.152.35 \|\|

*asyā dānaprabhāvena vimānaṃ sarvakāmikam \|*  
*samāruhya naro yāti yatra devo hariḥ svayam \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. But by giving the charities in an appropriate manner, all the desires of a person get fulfilled and mounting over a plane, he reaches the place of Viṣṇu.

## \|\| 3.152.36-38 \|\|

*eṣā caiva pradātavyā prayatenāntarātmanā \|*  
*paurṇamāsyāṃ ca māghasya kārtikyāṃ caiva bhārata \|\| 36 \|\|*

*candrasūryoparāge tu viṣuve ayane tathā \|*  
*ṣaḍaśītimukhe caiva vyatīpāte tu sarvadā \|\| 37 \|\|*

*vaiśākhyāṃ mārgaśīrṣyāṃ vā gajacchāyāsu caiva hi \|*  
*eṣā te kathitā pārtha tiladhenurmayānagha \|\| 38 \|\|*

36-38. О Bharata, while exercising self control, on the full moon days of the months of Magha and Karttika, on the days of the solar or the lunar eclipses, on the days of equinox, after reaching half year, the first day of the month, during the days of calamity, the first days of Vaisakha, Margasirsa or on the day of Gajacchaya, the vrata of the giving away of the cow made of sesamum seeds should be performed.

## \|\| 3.152.39-40 \|\|

*yāvaṃti dheno romaṇi gātreṣu nṛpapuṅgava \|*  
*tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi tadā svarge mahīyate \|\| 39 \|\|*

*yaśca gṛhṇāti vidhivaddīyamānāṃ ca paśyati \|*  
*anumodayate caiva te sarve svargagāminaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

39-40. О sinless one, thus I have described to you about the tiladhenu vrata in sufficient details. О lion among the rulers, whatever are the number of hair over the body of the cow, the donor is adored in the heaven for the years equivalent to the number of hair multiplied by a thousand crores for each hair. One who performs the donation as well as the one who receives it, or the one who supports the same, they all enjoy the pleasures of the heaven.

## \|\| 3.152.41-42 \|\|

*dhenuṃ dhanādhipatayo magadhodbhavena mānena ye tilamayīṃ caturāḍhakena \|*  
*kṛtvā yathoktaracanāṃ kṛtacāruvatsāṃ yacchaṃti te bhuvi bhavaṃti vimuktapāpāḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*pratigṛhṇāmi devi tvāṃ kuṭuṃbabharaṇāya ca \|*  
*kāmaṃ deyā dayāsmabhyaṃ dheno tvaṃ sarvadā hyasi \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. According to Magadhodbhava, a cow of four adhaka sesamum seeds should be made with calf, and one who gives it away in charity, he becomes rich like Kubera and becomes the chief on earth. The receiver should say – “O goddess, for the upkeep of my family, I am accepting you in charity. Therefore, you always grant my wish and always be compassionate on me.”

## Chapter 153. Giving away of water cow

## \|\| 3.153.1-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*jaladhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi prīyate dattayā yayā \|*  
*devadevo hṛṣīkeśaḥ pūjitaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*jalakuṃbhaṃ naravyāghra sthāpayitvā supūjitam \|*  
*ratnagarbhaṃ tu taṃ kṛtvā grāmyairdhānyai samanvitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sitavastrayugacchannaṃ dūrvāpallavaśobhitam \|*  
*kuṣṭhamāṃsīpurośīravālakāmalakīyutam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*priyaṅgupatrasahitaṃ sitayajñopavītinam \|*  
*sopānaktaṃ ca sacchatraṃ darbhaviṣṭarasaṃsthitam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*caturbhiḥ saṃyutaṃ raupyaṃ tilapātraiścaturdiśam \|*  
*sthagitaṃ dadhipātreṇa ghṛtakṣaudravatā mukhama \|\| 5 \|\|*

*savatsāṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya gomayenopaśobhitām \|*  
*sragdāmapucchīṃ kurvīta tāmradohanakānvitām \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О lion among the humans, I am now speaking to you about Jaladhenu, with the donating of which, lord Hrsikesa is adored. A pitcher filled with water is established and then worshipped. It should have water, gems, wealth and cereals put in it. It should then be covered with the white cloth and adorned with durva grass as well as the tender shoots of the trees. Besides this, it should also be decorated with heap of com, aromatic plant, lotus stalk, myrobalan, black mustard leaves. It should further be decorated with a yajnopavita. It should be placed over a pedestal with a pair of shoes and an umbrella, placed besides the same over the kusa seat. All the four hoofs of the cow should be made of silver. The vases filled with sesamum seeds should be placed on all the four sides. The neck of the same should be made of a vase in which the ghi, curd, honey should be placed, getting them mixed. This vase should stand for her face. Thus consecrating a cow with a calf, the tail should be of a garland in which the cowdung should be applied. There should a vase of copper for milking milk of the cow.

## \|\| 3.153.7-11 \|\|

*tataḥ samabhyarcya vibhuṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam \|*  
*puṣpadhūpopahāraiśca yathāvibhavamātmanaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*saṃkalpya jaladhenuṃ ca kuṃbhaṃ tamabhimaṃtrya ca \|*  
*viṣṇorvakṣasi yā lakṣmīḥ svāhā yā ca vibhāvasoḥ \|*  
*somaśakrārkaśaktiryā dhenurūpeṇa sāstu me \|\| 8 \|\|*

*evamāmaṃtrya vidhivatsaphalāṃ vatsakānvitām \|*  
*bhaktyā saṃpūjya goviṃdaṃ jalaśāyinamacyutam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*sitavastradharaḥ śāṃto vītarāgo vimatsaraḥ \|*  
*dadyādviprāya rājendra prītyarthaṃ jalaśāyinaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*śeṣaparyaṃkaśayanaḥ śrīmāñchārṅgavibhūṣitaḥ \|*  
*jalaśāyī jagadyoniḥ prīyatāṃ mama keśavaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

7-11. According to one’s means, he should worship the eternal Vasudeva. Thereafter, the samkalpa for Jaladhenu vrata should be read out. The kalasa should be sanctified. Thereafter, Laksmi who is lodged at the chest of lord Viṣṇu, Svaha - the Jakti of Soma and Surya should protect me in the form of the water cow. О Rajendra, the cow with calf and with the fruits, should thus be sanctified and then one should worship lord Govinda, who sleeps in the oceanic waters, with utmost devotion. Thereafter, wearing the white clothes, getting peaceful and detached mind, getting free from jealousy, all the materials should be given over to the lord, who sleeps in the oceanic water, for pleasing lord Kesava.

## \|\| 3.153.12-14 \|\|

*ityuccārya jagannāthaṃ viprāya prati pādya tām \|*  
*taddinaṃ govratastiṣṭhecchraddhayā parayā yutaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā dattvā jaladhenuṃ janādhipa \|*  
*sarvabhogānavāpnoti ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*śarīrārogyamatulaṃ praśamaḥ sarvakālikaḥ \|*  
*nṛṇāṃ bhavaṃti dattāyāṃ sarve kāmā na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. “Lord Viṣṇu, who sleeps over the bed of serpent and who is the carrier of Sarnga bow, is the sole cause of the universe. Let lord Kesava be pleased with me.” Thus offering prayer to lord Jagannatha, the cow should be given over to the Brāhmaṇa and with utmost devotion on the same day, one should perform the vrata for the cow. О king, with this process, when the Jaladhenu is given away in charity, one achieves all the divine as well as the worldly pleasures. He gets the body absolutely free from the ailments and his mind always remains peaceful, so much so, that with the performing of the charity of this type, all his desires also get fulfilled.

## \|\| 3.153.15-19 \|\|

*atrāpi śrūyate bhūpa mudgale na mahātmanā \|*  
*jātismareṇa yadgītamihābhyetya purā kila \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sa mudgalaḥ purā vipro yamalokagato muniḥ \|*  
*dadarśa yātanānekāḥ pāpakarmakṛtāṃ nṛṇām \|\| 16 \|\|*

*dīptāgnitīkṣṇayantrasthāḥ kvāthatailamayāstathā \|*  
*uṣṇakṣāranadīpātā bhairavāḥ puruṣarṣabha \|\| 17 \|\|*

*vraṇakṣāranipātotha kumbhīpākamahālayāḥ \|*  
*tā dṛṣṭvā yātanā vipraścakāra paramāṃ kṛpām \|\| 18 \|\|*

*āhlādaṃ te tadā jagmuḥ pāpāstadanukaṃpayā \|*  
*taṃ dṛṣṭvā nārakāḥ kecitsthitvā tadavalokinaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

15-19. In this connection, it is heard that Maharsi Mudgala, who always retained the earlier memories, arrived here in earlier times and had spoken all the above events. Maharsi Mudgala had been born in a Brahmana family in his earlier birth. Reaching the place of Yama, he witnessed the various types of tortures in which the humans had been placed. Some of them were been cooked in the fire flames. Some of them were being tortured with sharp types of weapons; some of them were placed in the pan of boiling oil. Some of them were drowning in the hot salted water rivers. О best of the humans, some of them were fallen with wounds in the altars of salt water; someone had fallen in the kumbhipaka hell. Observing such a horrible condition of the people having fallen in the hell, the Maharsi showered his compassionate grace on them. Suddenly, the sinners felt extremely blissful. Finding the great Ṛṣi with them, the sinners, even in that miserable condition, felt relieved and blissful.

## \|\| 3.153.20-23 \|\|

*tadavasthaṃ vilokyātha munirnārakamaṇḍalam \|*  
*dharmarājaṃ sa papraccha teṣāṃ praśamakāraṇam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tasmai cācaṣṭa rājendra tadā vaivasvato yamaḥ \|*  
*āhlādahetumadhikaṃ nārakāṇāṃ narottama \|\| 21 \|\|*

*dānānubhāvātsarveṣāṃ nārakāṇāṃ dvijottama \|*  
*saṃpravṛto'yamāhlādaḥ kāraṇaṃ tacchṛṇu ṣva me \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tvayābhyarcya jagannāthaṃ sarveśaṃ jalaśāyinam \|*  
*jaladhenuḥ purā dattā vidhivadvijapuṅgava \|\| 23 \|\|*

20-23. They kept on starring at the kamandalu of the great Ṛṣi. Thereafter, observing the hell, the great Ṛṣi asked Dharmaraja about the remedy by which those sinners could be redeemed. On hearing the words of Maharsi, Yama – the son of Surya, spoke to the sage for the delight of the sinners. He said – “O best of the Brahmanas, with the performing of this charity, all the dwellers of the hell shall get relief and delight. I am going to speak about the same. You please listen. О best of the Maharsis, you also in your earlier birth had performed the adoration of lord Jagannatha, the dweller in the serpent bed in the ocean of milk, by giving away a Jaladhenu in charity.

## \|\| 3.153.24-27 \|\|

*tasmātvajjanmano'tīte tṛtīye dvija janmani \|*  
*tasya dānasya te vyuṣṭiriyamāhlādadāyinī \|\| 24 \|\|*

*ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti śṛṇvaṃti ye ca dhyāyaṃti mānavāḥ \|*  
*śṛṇoṣi yāṃśca viprendra yāṃśca dhyāyasi paśyasi \|\| 25 \|\|*

*nivṛttiḥ paramā teṣāṃ sarvāhlādapradāyinī \|*  
*sadyo bhavati mā'tra tvaṃ dvijāte kuru vismayam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*āhlādahetujananaṃ nāsti viprendra tādṛśam \|*  
*jaladhenuryathā nṛṇāṃ janmānyekonaviṃśatim \|\| 27 \|\|*

24-27. With this performance, in your third birth as a Brāhmaṇa, with the influence of the same charity, you achieved an extremely pleasing reward. Such of the people who have a look at you or meditate upon you, or the people to whom you would listen, they would achieve all pleasures which bestow delight. There is no doubt about it. With the giving away of Jaladhenu in charity, for them there is no other pleasure greater than this for their nineteen future births. Because a person who donates a Jaladhenu, do not earn ay blemish for thousands of future births.

## \|\| 3.153.28-29 \|\|

*na doṣo na jvaro nārtirna klamo dvija jāyate \|*  
*api janmasahasre'pi jaladhenupradāyinām \|\| 28 \|\|*

*sa tvaṃ gaccha gṛhītvārdhamasmato dvijasattama \|*  
*yeṣāṃ samāśrayaḥ kṛṣṇe na niyamyā hi te mayā \|\| 29 \|\|*

28-29. They do not have to suffer from fever or any other type of pain. О best of the Brahmanas, accepting the arghya offered by me, you respectfully retire to your abode, because a person who lives under the protection of lord Kṛṣṇa, I cannot exercise any control on him.

## \|\| 3.153.30-36 \|\|

*kṛṣṇastu pūjito yaistu ye kṛṣṇārthamupoṣitāḥ \|*  
*yaiśca nityaṃ smṛtaḥ kṛṣṇo na te madviṣayopagāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*namaḥ kṛṣṇācyutānaṃta vāsudevetyudīritam \|*  
*yairbhā vabhāvitairvipra na te madviṣayopagāḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*dānaṃ dadadbhiryairuktamacyutaḥ prīyatāmiti \|*  
*śraddhāpuraḥsarairvipra na te madviṣayopagāḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*sa eva nāthaḥ sarvasya tanniyogakarā vayam \|*  
*janasaṃyamanaścāhamasmatsaṃyamano hariḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*itthaṃ niśamya vacanaṃ yamasya vadato'khilam \|*  
*ūcuste nārakāḥ sarve vahniśastrārkabhīravaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*namaḥ kṛṣṇāya haraye viṣṇave jiṣṇave namaḥ \|*  
*hṛṣīkeśāya keśāya jagaddhātre'cyutāya ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

*namaḥ paṅkajanetrāya namaḥ paṅkajanābhaye \|*  
*janārdanāya śrīśāya śrībhartre pītavāsase \|\| 36 \|\|*

30-36. Whosoever adores lord Kṛṣṇa or observes a fast for the sake of Sri Kṛṣṇa, I can exercise no control over them. О Brāhmaṇa, having been filled with devotion, I offer my salutation to Sri Kṛṣṇa, Acyuta and Ananta Vasudeva. He is beyond our control. Having been filled with utmost devotion, whosoever at the time of giving away of charity, has said – “Let lord Acyuta be pleased,” he also is out of our control. Because Acyuta is the lord of all and we only obey his command. I only discipline the humans, while lord Hari disciplines all of us. At these words of Yamaraja, all the dwellers of the hell, who were terribly afraid of fire, weapons or of Surya, then said – “Salutation to lord Kṛṣṇa, Hari, salutation to victorious Viṣṇu, salutation to Hrsikesa, Kesava, Jagaddhata and Acyuta. Salutation to the lotus eyed one, Kamalanabhi, Janardana, Srisa and the lord of Laksmi, who is clad in a pitambara.

## \|\| 3.153.37-38 \|\|

*goviṃdāya namo nityaṃ namaścodadhiśāyine \|*  
*namaḥ kamalanetrāya nṛsiṃhāya ninādine \|\| 37 \|\|*

*śārṅgiṇe śitakhaḍgāya śaṃkhacakragadābhṛte \|*  
*namo vāmanarūpāya krāṃtalokatrayāya ca \|\| 38 \|\|*

37-38. Salutation to Govinda, salutation to the one who sleeps in the oceanic water. Salutation to the lotus-eyed one, to Nrsimha, one who creates a terrific sound, salutation to the carrier of the bow, sharp sword, disc, the club and the one who terrifies the three worlds known as Vamana – the dwarf.

## \|\| 3.153.39-41 \|\|

*varāharūpāya tathā namo yajñāṅgadhāriṇe \|*  
*vyāptāśeṣadigaṃtāyānaṃtāya paramātmane \|\| 39 \|\|*

*vāsudeva namastubhyaṃ namaḥ kaiṭabhasūdine \|*  
*keśavāya namo rāma namastestu mahīdhara \|\| 40 \|\|*

*namo'stu vāsudevāya hyevamuccārite ca taiḥ \|*  
*śastrāṇi kuṃṭhatāṃ jagmuranalaścāpi śītatām \|\| 41 \|\|*

39-41. Salutation to Varaha — the holder of the part of yajna. Salutation to the limitless supreme soul, who pervades in the universe; salutation to lord Vāsudeva; salutation to the killer of Kaitabha; salutation to Kesava; salutation to Mahidhara, Rama as well as Vāsudeva.” When all the dwellers of the hell so recited the prayer, the weapons which tortured them got squeezed and the fire got extinguished.

## \|\| 3.153.42-45 \|\|

*samabhajyaṃta vastrāṇi samutpeturayomukhāḥ \|*  
*saṃśuṣkā kṣārasaritaḥ patitaḥ śālmalidrumaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*prakāśastamaso jajñe narakādbhānubhiḥ saha \|*  
*vavau ca yuṃjanpavano'pyasipatravane tataḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*nirutsāhā jaḍadhiyo babhūvuryamakiṃkarāḥ \|*  
*jātā gaṅgāmbuvāhinyaḥ pūyaśauṇitanimnagāḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*divyaḥ sugaṃdhi pavano manaḥprītikarastathā \|*  
*veṇuvīṇāsvanayutāḥ śabdāścāsanmanoramāḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

42-45. All the curtains of the hell were removed. All the birds with iron beaks flew away at a time. The Vaitarani river dried up. The silk cotton tree fell down and in the dark altars, the sun rays started spreading the light. In the forest of trees with sword like leaves, the wind started blowing with force. The attendants of Yama, who were devoid of wisdom, felt disheartened. The rivers in which the blood and puss were flowing, started flowing with the auspicious water of the Ganga. The wind carrying the fragrance started blowing slowly, which delighted the minds producing the pleasant sound like that of vina.

## \|\| 3.153.46 \|\|

*taṃ tādṛśamathālakṣya tadā vaivasvato yamaḥ \|*  
*kṣīṇapāpatrayāṃstāṃstu pādyārghyaiḥ samapūjayat \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. Observing this scene, with the decline of the sins, the Vaivasvata Yama started worshipping all the three, offering them padya and arghya.

## \|\| 3.153.47-50 \|\|

*pūjayitvā ca tānāha kṛṣṇāya sa kṛtāṃjaliḥ \|*  
*samāhitamatirbhūtvā dharmarājo nareśvara \|\| 47 \|\|*

*viṣṇo deva jagaddhātarjanārdana jagatpate \|*  
*praṇāmaṃ ye'pi kurvanti teṣāmapi namonamaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*acyutāyāprameyāya māyāvāmanarūpiṇe \|*  
*praṇāmaṃ ye'pi kurvanti teṣāmapi namo namaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

*namaste vāsudevāya dhīmate puṇyakīrtaye \|*  
*praṇāmaṃ ye ca kurvaṃti teṣāmapi namo namaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

47-50. Thereafter, folding his hands before Kṛṣṇa, Dharmaraja said to him – “O Viṣṇudeva, you are the creator of the universe, besides being Janardana and master of the universe, salutation to you as well as to your devotees, again and again. Salutation even to the one who had abroad bowed in reverence to him. Salutation to the extremely learned one, having the auspicious glory, besides those who offer salutation to him.

## \|\| 3.153.51-53 \|\|

*tasya yajñavarāhasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*evaṃ stutvā hṛṣīkeśaṃ dharmarājasya paśyataḥ \|*  
*vimānavaramāruhya nārakāstridivaṃ yayuḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*mudgalo'pi mahābuddhirdṛṣṭvaitadakhilaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*jātismaro bhavadvipraḥ kaṇvagotre mahāmuniḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

51-53. He took to the form of Yajna-Varaha, with unlimited lustre and was also adored as Viṣṇu and Hrsikesa. Thus the dwellers of the hell, by offering prayer to lord Viṣṇu, in full view of Dharmaraja, mounted over a beautiful plane and proceeded on to the heaven. О king, observing this astonishing situation, the highly wise Mudgala was also reminded of the ancestors of the race of Ṛṣi Kanva.

## \|\| 3.153.54-57 \|\|

*saṃsmṛtya yamavākyāni viṣṇormāhātmyameva ca \|*  
*jaladhenostu māhātmyaṃ saṃsmṛtyedamagāyata \|\| 54 \|\|*

*aho sudustarā viṣṇormāyeyamatigahvarī \|*  
*yayā mohitacittastu na vetti parameśvaram \|\| 55 \|\|*

*jīvo gacchati kīṭatvaṃ yūkāmatkuṇayonitām \|*  
*tasmāddrumalatādīnāṃ yoniṃ tasmācca pakṣiṇām \|\| 56 \|\|*

*tataśca paśutāṃ prāpya naratvamabhivāṃchati \|*  
*tato manuṣyatāṃ prāpya naro yoniṃ kṛtātmanām \|*  
*tāṃ prāpya ca śriyaṃ parāṃ naro māyāvimohitaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

54-57. Не heard the words of Yama, the glory of Viṣṇu and also understanding the auspicious nature of Jaladhenu, narrated a story as follows. He said – “The illusion of lord Viṣṇu is quite difficult (to understand) and when a person is overshadowed by the same, he is unable to realize the Paramesvara. When such people are overpowered with the illusion of Viṣṇu and forgetting about the lord Paramesvara, then passing through various yonis of insects, lice, bugs, they are grown then as trees. Thereafter, they are born as birds and then the animals, when they desire to be humans they are born as humans as well. Thereafter, under the influence of the illusion of Viṣṇu, a person gets excellent fortunes.

## \|\| 3.153.58-59 \|\|

*dustarāpi susādhyā sā māyā kṛṣṇasya mohinī \|*  
*vidyate sā manonyastā mudhaiva madhusūdane \|\| 58 \|\|*

*avāpyaivaṃ ca gārhasthyamavāpyaivaṃ ca tatparam \|*  
*chinatti vaiṣṇavīṃ māyāṃ keśavārpitamānasaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

58-59. Though the illusory Maya of lord Kṛṣṇa is quite difficult to be faced, still by having an absolute faith in Madhusudana, the same is achieved or overcome with ease. Those who are devoted to Kesava after enjoying the charm as a householder and then embrace the life of a recluse, they are redeemed from the illusion of Viṣṇu.

## \|\| 3.153.60-63 \|\|

*avirodhena viṣayānbhuñjanviṣṇuṃ samāśrayet \|*  
*bhuktvā narastaratyenāṃ viṣṇormāyāṃ sudustarām \|\| 60 \|\|*

*īdṛgbahuphalā bhaktiḥ sarvadhātari keśave \|*  
*māyayā tasya devasya tāṃ na kurvaṃti mohitāḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*mudhaivoktaṃ sudhāpānaṃ mudhā taddhi viceṣṭitam \|*  
*mudhaiva janma tannaṣṭaṃ yatra nārādhito hariḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*ārādhito hi yaḥ puṃsāmaihikāmuṣmikaṃ phalam \|*  
*dadāti bhagavāndevaḥ kastaṃ na pratipūjayet \|\| 63 \|\|*

60-63. Becoming dependent on lord Viṣṇu, a person enjoys all the pleasures in an uninterrupted way and he crosses the beautiful Maya of lord Viṣṇu. Thus, lord Kesava bestows innumerable merits which are quite rewarding. But the people, who are overpowered with the Maya of lord Viṣṇu, they cannot achieve his devotion. A person, who has not worshipped lord Viṣṇu, his consuming of the nectar and performing of the deeds making all the efforts, besides his whole life becomes infructuous and of no consequence. A person who adores lord Kṛṣṇa, he bestows the comforts in this as well as the other world to him. Therefore, one should surely worship him.

## \|\| 3.153.64-65 \|\|

*saṃvatsarāstathā māsā viphalā divasāśca te \|*  
*narāṇāṃ viṣayāṃdhānāṃ yaistu nārādhito hariḥ \|\| 64 \|\|*

*yo na vittarddhivibhavairna vāsobhirna bhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*tuṣyate hṛdayenaiva kastamīśaṃ na pūjayet \|\| 65 \|\|*

64-65. The persons who blindly enjoy the worldly pleasures and neglect the worship of lord Hari, their years, months and days become fruitless. Lord Hari gets pleased with the giving away of the charities like costumes, riches, besides other valuables. He gets pleased with the devotion alone. Who should not worship such, a great and compassionate lord Hari?

## \|\| 3.153.66-67 \|\|

*jaladhenostu māhātmyaṃ niśamyedṛgvidhaṃ narāḥ \|*  
*nātra yacchaṃti teṣāṃ vai vivekaḥ kutra tiṣṭhati \|\| 66 \|\|*

*karmabhūmau hi mānuṣyaṃ janmanāmayutairapi \|*  
*svargāpavargaphaladaṃ kadācitprāpyate naraiḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. Listening to the glory of the giving away of the Jaladhenu, the people who do not give away the Jaladhenu in charity, then there is no place for wisdom to remain with them, because in the field of activity, after several births, a jiva attains the form of human body, which is the source for achieving the heaven, moksa (liberation as the reward).

## \|\| 3.153.68-69 \|\|

*saṃprāpya ca na yairviṣṇustoṣito jaladhenunā \|*  
*te janā bhraṣṭajanmāno vaṃcitāstasya māyayā \|\| 68 \|\|*

*ūrdhvabāhurviraumyeṣa dṛṣṭalokadvayo'smi bhoḥ \|*  
*ārādhayadhvaṃ govindaṃ jaladhenuṃ prayacchata \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. Even after achieving the human body, the people who have not given the Jaladhenu in charity, their births are utterly useless. They have been deprived of the benefit. Therefore, observing both the worlds, I am speaking with my hands raised that all the people should worship Govinda, giving Jaladhenu in charity.

## \|\| 3.153.70-71 \|\|

*duḥsaho nārako vahniraviṣahyā ca yātanā \|*  
*jñātaṃ mayaitadālaṃbya kṛṣṇaṃ bhavati niścalaḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*ādeśiko deśiko hi yamamārge sudustare \|*  
*vicintya tatsatyametanmanaḥ kṛṣṇe niveśyatām \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. Because the fire of the hell is unbearable, besides the torture there. I am well aware of the fact that a person who takes refuge with Śrī Kṛṣṇa, he surely becomes quite stable. Keeping in mind the awful path of Yama and other facts, the people should devote their minds in Śrī Kṛṣṇa only.

## \|\| 3.153.72 \|\|

*iṣṭena kiṃ kratuśatena suduṣkareṇa kleśādhikena sukṛtairniyamairvrataiśca \|*  
*dattā dvijāya pitṛrājagṛhaṃ gatasya hyekā'pi gaurjalamayī sukhamātanoti \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Even after performing the several difficult yajnas and vratas with hard conditions, then what is the use of such exercises when the- person who has gone in Pitrloka could simply be pleased with the giving away of Jaladhenu to a Brāhmaṇa, which provides enormous comforts to the performer of the vrata.

## Chapter 154. Giving away of the cow of ghi

## \|\| 3.154.1-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ghṛtadhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi tāṃ śṛṇuṣva narottama \|*  
*dīyate yena vidhinā yādṛgrūpāṃ ca kārayet \|\| 1 \|\|*

*gavyasya sarpiṣaḥ kumbhāngaṃdhamālyavibhūṣitān \|*  
*kāṃsyopadohasaṃyuktānsitavastrāvaguṇṭhitān \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ikṣuyaṣṭimayāḥ pādāḥ khurā raupyamayāstathā \|*  
*sauvarṇe cākṣiṇī kārye śṛṃge cāgurukāṣṭhake \|\| 3 \|\|*

*saptadhānyamaye pārśve paṭorṇena ca kambalam \|*  
*kuryātturuṣkakarpūrairghrāṇaṃ phalamayānstanān \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tadvaccharkarayā jihvāṃ guḍakṣīramayaṃ mukham \|*  
*kṣaumasūtreṇa lāṃgūlaṃ romāṇi sitasarṣapaiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tāmrapātramayaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ kuryācchraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|*  
*īdṛgrūpāṃ tu saṃkalpya ghṛtadhenuṃ narādhipa \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – I am now going to tell you about the process of giving away a cow made of ghi. You please listen. A vase filled with ghi, adorned with fragrance and garlands, together with a bronze milk pot should be covered with a white cloth. It should then be placed over an auspicious place and a cow should be invoked in the same. Her legs should be made of sugarcane rods. The hoofs should be made of silver, while the eyes should be made of gold. The horns should be made of Agaru wood. The back portion should be made of the cereals. The frills of the neck should be made of wool. The nose should be made of benzoic and camphor. The udder should be made of fruits, the tongue of sugar, the mouth of guda and milk.

## \|\| 3.154.7-10 \|\|

*tadvatkalpanayā dhenorvatsaṃ ca parikalpayet \|*  
*maṃtreṇānena rājendra tāṃ samabhyarcya buddhimān \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ājyaṃ tejaḥ samuddiṣṭamājyaṃ pāpaharaṃ param \|*  
*ājyaṃ surāṇāmāhāraḥ sarvamājye pratiṣṭhitam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tvaṃ caivājyamayī devi kalpitāsi mayā kila \|*  
*sarvapāpāpanodāya sukhāya bhava bhāmini \|\| 9 \|\|*

*taṃ ca vipraṃ mahābhāga manaseva ghṛtārciṣā \|*  
*kalpayitvā tatastasmai prayataḥ pratipādayet \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. Thus conceiving the Ghrtadhenu with devotion, her calf should also be conceived. A person with wisdom should then adore the cow with this mantra, saying – “The ghi is the form of lustre, which is the remover of all the sins, besides being the food for the gods. Everything is established in the ghi. Therefore, I have conceived you in the form of ghi. Removing all my sins, you bestow comforts on me.” At the time of the giving away of the cow of ghi, the donor should mentally think of the Brāhmaṇa and should thus speak at the time of the giving away of the cow.

## \|\| 3.154.11-14 \|\|

*dakṣiṇāsahitā dhenuḥ kalpitājyamayī śubhā \|*  
*etāṃ mamopakārāya gṛhāṇa tvaṃ dvijottama \|\| 11 \|\|*

*ityudāhṛtya viprāya tāṃ gāṃ tu pratipādayet \|*  
*dattvaikarātraṃ sthitvā ca ghṛtāhāro yatavrataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*anena ca vidhānena navanītamayī śubhā \|*  
*dātavyā nṛpate dhenurnyūnādhikavivarjitā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*śṛṇu pārtha mahābāho pradānaphalamuttamam \|*  
*ghṛtakṣīramahānadyo yatra pāyasakardamāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

11-14. “O best of the Brāhmaṇa, this cow made of ghi along with daksina may be accepted by you for my benefit.” Thereafter, the cow of ghi should be given over to a Brāhmaṇa, observing full discipline. The night should then be spent by the donor, consuming the ghi alone. Following the same process, the cow made of butter can also be given. The glory and importance of such a type of charity has been prescribed as follows – “The givers of the Ghrtadhenu in charity, getting all their desires fulfilled, achieve such a loka, where the rivers of milk and ghi flow. The payasam is found there like the mud.

## \|\| 3.154.15-18 \|\|

*ghṛtadhenupradā yāṃti tatra kāmaiḥ supūritāḥ \|*  
*piturūrdhvaṃ ca ye sapta puruṣāstasya ye'pyadhaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tāṃsteṣu nṛpa lokeṣu sa nayatyastakalmaṣān \|*  
*sakāmānāmiyaṃ vyuṣṭiḥ kathitā nṛpasattama \|\| 16 \|\|*

*niṣkilviṣaṃ padaṃ yāṃti niṣkāmā ghṛtadhenudāḥ \|*  
*ghṛtamagnirghṛtaṃ somastanmayāḥ sarvadevatāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*ghṛtaṃ prayacchatāṃ bhītā bhavaṃtyakhiladevatāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*
