*yatra karmakarī nāsti sarvakarmakarī sadā \|*  
*na tacchataṃ kiṃkarāṇāṃ karoti śubhatāmapi \|\| 12 \|\|*

*yadekā kurute dāsī gṛhasthena bhṛtā hi sā \|*  
*bahulokākulo grāmo dāsīdāsākulaṃ gṛham \|\| 13 \|\|*

8-13. A person with miserly nature is deprived of gold, slave girls, milk, ghi or a son and his house is considered to be another hell. A village without an attendant, a house without a slave girl and the food without ghi are of no use according to my opinion. A slave girl adorned with all the ornaments when serves in a house, in the same house Laksmi of the ocean of milk, holding a lotus in her hand, always lives there for all times to come. The house with purity and the practical pleasures, but when slave girl is not found, such a house always remains unstable. Similarly, a house in which there is no slave girl to perform the various duties, no auspicious task can be performed in spite of the presence of hundreds of male servants, which could be done by a slave girl, who is well brought up in the house. The village in which there is enough of population and a house with enough of servants and the slave girl, the wisdom in such a house remains devoted to the religious works. Then, how could the mind of the householder be upset?

## \|\| 3.171.14-22 \|\|

*buddhirdharmākulā yasya tasya cetaḥ kimākulam \|*  
*yatra bhāryāgṛhe dakṣā dāsyakarmaṇyanuvratāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*bhṛtyāḥ sadodyamaparāstrivargastatra dṛśyate \|*  
*yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ loke tattaddeyamiti śrutiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*etadvicārya hṛdaye deyā dāsī dvijātaye \|*  
*sthiranakṣatrasaṃyukte some saumyagrahānvite \|\| 16 \|\|*

*dānakālaṃ praśaṃsaṃti saṃtaḥ parvaṇi vā punaḥ \|*  
*alaṃkṛtya yathāśaktyā vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaistathā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇāya pradātavyā maṃtreṇānena kaurava \|*  
*iyaṃ dāsī mayā tubhyaṃ bhagavanpratipāditā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*karmopayojyā bhojyā vā yatheṣṭaṃ bhadramastu te \|*  
*dattvā kṣamāpayetpaścādbrāhmaṇaṃ kāṃcanena tam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*anuvrajya gṛhadvāraṃ yāvatpaścādvisarjayet \|*  
*anena vidhinā dadyādaṃkayitvā surālaye \|\| 20 \|\|*

*makhe cāpi mahārāja prasiddhe vā pratiśraye \|*  
*sarvakarmakarī dattvā taruṇīṃ rūpaśālinīm \|\| 21 \|\|*

*prāpyate yatphalaṃ puṃbhiḥ pārtha tatkena varṇyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

14-22. When the lady of the house is quite intelligent, the slave girl is a devoted one, while the servants are all active, the three vargas (dharma, artha and kama) are always found successful there. B y living in the world, one should surely resort to the giving away of the charities. This has been ordained in the scriptures. Therefore, keeping all these facts in mind, the Brāhmaṇas should be given the slave girl in charity. When the constellation is stable, the planets are favourably disposed, on the moon day or on any other auspicious day, which is considered quite praiseworthy, (the slave girl should be given over in charity). Therefore, the slave girl should be adorned with all the ornaments, as per one’s means, and clad in the best of garments, the slave girl should be given over to a Brahmana in charity, saying – “I have given this slave girl to you, who shall perform all your suitable tasks.” Saying these words, the slave girl together with gold should be given over to the Brahmana. The donor then should follow her till the exit door and see her off. О great king, who could be competent enough to give away a slave girl who should be young and beautiful, in this way to a Brahmana, who could perform all the tasks in a temple, yajna or at a famous place?

## \|\| 3.171.23 \|\|

*dāsīṃ samīkṣya bahuśo gṛhakarmadakṣāṃ yo brahmaṇāya kulaśīlavate dadāti \|*  
*vidyādharādhipaśatairapi pūjito'sau lokaṃ trilokaramayāpsarasāṃ prayāti \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Thus a slave girl, who is well-versed in the household works, when given to a Brahmana of high race, the donor is respected by hundreds of leaders of the Vidyadharas and is served by the beautiful nymphs always.

## Chapter 172. Giving of place of free supply of water

## \|\| 3.172.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*prapādānasya māhātmyaṃ vada devakinaṃdana \|*  
*kathaṃ deyā kadā deyā dāne tasyāśca kiṃ phalam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said – О son of Devaki, you kindly let me know about the merit of giving away in charity for the free supply of water to the thirsty people. How could such a charity be given and what type of merit does it yield?

## \|\| 3.172.2-8 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*atīte phālgune māsi prāpte caitre mahotsave \|*  
*puṇye'hni viprakathite grahacaṃdrabalānvite \|\| 2 \|\|*

*maṃḍapaṃ kārayedvidvānghanacchāyaṃ manoramam \|*  
*purasya madhye pathi vā kāṃtāre toyavarjite \|\| 3 \|\|*

*devatāyatane vāpi caityavṛkṣatale'pi vā \|*  
*suśītalaṃ ca ramyaṃ ca vicitrāsanasaṃyutam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kārayenmaṃḍapaṃ bhavyaṃ śītavātasahaṃ dṛḍham \|*  
*tanmadhye sthāpayedbhaktyā maṇīnkuṃbhāṃśca śobhanān \|\| 5 \|\|*

*akālamūlānkarakānvastrairāveṣṭitānatha \|*  
*brāhmaṇaḥ śīlasaṃpanno vṛttiṃ dattvā yathocitām \|\| 6 \|\|*

*prapāpālaḥ prakartavyo bahuputraparicchadaḥ \|*  
*pānīyapānenāśrāṃtānyaḥ kārayati mānavān \|\| 7 \|\|*

*evaṃvidhāṃ prapāṃ kṛtvā śubhe'hni vidhipūrvakam \|*  
*yathāśaktyā naraśreṣṭha prāraṃbhe bhojayeddvijān \|\| 8 \|\|*

2-8. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – After the expiry of the month of Phalguna in the month of Caitra, at the time of the festivities, which are considered to be the auspicious ones because of the strength of the planets as well as the moon, a mandapa with thick shade should be made, which should be located in the centre of the village, over a road without the supply of water, in a temple or under the shade of a tree. Beautiful cool earthen pitchers should be placed for the supply of the cool drinking water. A jug should also be placed for the purpose. These pitchers should be covered with clothes. A Brāhmaṇa having many sons, should be engaged to serve water to the needy people. He should be paid adequate salary for the service. He should serve water to the astray people. He should make all efforts to please them. О best of the people, thus on an auspicious occasion, the place for free distribution of drinking water should be established and then the Brāhmaṇas should be served with the food as per one’s means, after the start of the operation of the serving of water.

## \|\| 3.172.9-13 \|\|

*tataścotsarjayedviprānmaṃtreṇānena mānavaḥ \|*  
*prapeyaṃ sarvasāmānyā bhūtebhyaḥ pratipāditā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*asyāḥ pradānātpitarastṛpyaṃtu ca pitāmahāḥ \|*  
*anivāryaṃ tato deyaṃ jalaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tripakṣaṃ vā mahārāja jīvānāṃ jīvanaṃ param \|*  
*gaṃdhāḍhyaṃ surasaṃ śītaṃ śobhane bhājane sthitam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*pradadyādapratihataṃ mukhaṃ cānavalokayan \|*  
*pratyahaṃ kārayettasyāṃ śaktito dvijabhojanam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā yastu grīṣmoṣmaśoṣanāśanam \|*  
*pānīyamuttamaṃ dadyāttasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 13 \|\|*

9-13. Thereafter, the drinking water place should be inaugurated in a formal way, reciting a mantra – “I have set up a water supply unit for the convenience of all the people. Therefore, all my manes or ancestors should be pleased with this and get satisfied.” The place of water supply should continue for four months. О great king, the water, which is the source of life for all the living beings, should continue for a minimum period of a month and a half. The person, who serves the water to thirsty people, should not look at the face of the people to whom the water is served by the person at service. The job should be done by him an uninterrupted manner, removing the heat (suffered by the people). By thus serving the water for drinking to the needy person, the merit so earned by him is being spoken by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.172.14-16 \|\|

*sarvatīrtheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu yatphalam \|*  
*tatpuṇyaphalamāpnoti sarvadevaiḥ supūjitaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*pūrṇacaṃdrapratīkāśaṃ vimānaṃ sodhiruhya ca \|*  
*yāti devendranagare pūjyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*viṃśatkoṭyo hi varṣāṇāṃ yakṣagandharvasevitaḥ \|*  
*puṇyakṣayādihāgatya caturvedī dvijo bhavet \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. Whatever merits are earned with the visiting of all the holy places, are earned by a person by so doing. Ultimately, he getting adored by all the gods, boarding bright plane resembling the moon and served by the nymphs, reaches the place of Indra, where he stays for twenty crores of years in a most comfortable way and then falls on earth after the decline of his merit and is born as a Brahmana well-versed in all the four Vedas.

## \|\| 3.172.17-21 \|\|

*tataḥ paraṃ padaṃ yāti punarāvṛttidurlabham \|*  
*prapādānāsamarthena viśeṣāddharmamīpsatā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*pratyahaṃ dharmaghaṭakaḥ karpaṭāveṣṭitānanaḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇasya gṛhe neyaḥ śītāmalajalaḥ śuciḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tasyaivodyāpanaṃ kāryaṃ māsimāsi narottama \|*  
*maṃḍakāveṣṭikābhiśca pakvānnaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*uddiśya śaṃkaraṃ viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇaṃ kurunandana \|*  
*salilaṃ prokṣayitvā tu maṃtreṇānena mānavaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*eṣa dharmaghaṭo datto brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakaḥ \|*  
*asya pradānātsaphalā mama saṃtu manorathāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

17-21. After his death at last, he achieves a position from where his fall on earth is rare. Keeping in view the dharma, in case a person is unable to set up a place for supply of drinking water (free of cost), a person should send a pitcher filled with water to a Brahmana daily. О best of the humans, during each month, a pitcher filled with water together with the food covered with a cloth should be daily given over to a Brāhmaṇa. О son of Kuru race, “For the sake of Brahma, Viṣṇu and Siva I have donated this pitcher of dharma therefore, by its grace all my desires should be fulfilled.” Thus saying, the pitcher with food should be given over to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.172.22-26 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yastu dharmakuṃbhaṃ prayacchati \|*  
*prapādānaphalaṃ so'pi prāpnotīha na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*dharmakuṃbhapradāne'pi yadyaśaktaḥ pumānbhavet \|*  
*tenāśvatthatarormūlaṃ secyaṃ nityaṃ jitātmanā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*aśvattharūpī bhagavānprīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ \|*  
*ityuccārya namaskṛtya pratyahaṃ pāpanāśanam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*yaḥ karoti tarormūle sekaṃ māsacatuṣṭayam \|*  
*sopi tatphalamāpnoti śrutireṣā sanātanī \|\| 25 \|\|*

*susvāduśītasalilā klamanāśinī ca prāṃte purasya pathi pāṃthasamājabhūmau \|*  
*yasya prapā bhavati sarvajanopabhogyā dharmottaraḥ sa khalu jīvati jīvaloke \|\| 26 \|\|*

22-26. Following this process, a person who gives away a pitcher in charity, surely earns the merit of setting up of a place for the free distribution of water to the people. A person who is unable to perform this regularly, then with a disciplined mind, he should drop water daily at an Asvatha or a Pipala tree, which represents lord Janardana and say- “Let lord Janardana be pleased with me.” Thus speaking, he should offer his salutation to the sacred tree which removes all the sins. In case, the water is poured at the root of the Pipala tree continuously for four months, he also earns the same merit. This has been prescribed in the Vedas. Similarly, a person who sets up a place for the free supply of water, which removes all the sufferings and make people comfortable, in one’s own city or the village or at a crossing, he earns the status of Dharmamurti and his name remains everlasting in that area.

## Chapter 173. Giving away of a brazier (angithi)

## \|\| 3.173.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*agnīṣṭikā kathaṃ deyā śiśire śītabhīrubhiḥ \|*  
*sarvasattvopakārāya karuṇīkṛtamānasaiḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said – During the winter season, because of the extreme cold, for the people who suffer badly, then how could a brazier be given to them for their comfort?

## \|\| 3.173.2-10 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*agnīṣṭikāmahaṃ pārtha kathayāmi nibodha tām \|*  
*yathā yena vidhānena sarvasatvasukhapradām \|\| 2 \|\|*

*ādau mārgaśire māsi śobhane divase śubhām \|*  
*agnīṣṭikāṃ kārayitvā sukhāsanavatīṃ śubhām \|\| 3 \|\|*

*devāṃgaṇe pathe gehe vistīrṇe catvaretha vā \|*  
*ubhayoḥ saṃdhyayoḥ kṛtvā saṃśuṣkaṃ kāṣṭhasaṃcayam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tataḥ prajvālayedagniṃ hutvā vyāhṛtibhiḥ kramāt \|*  
*anena vidhinā hutvā pratyahaṃ jvālayettataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*yadi kaścitkṣudhārthī syādbhojyaṃ tasmai prakalpayet \|*  
*sukhāsīno janastatra viśīto vijvarastathā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*yaḥ karoti kathāḥ pārtha na tāḥ śakyā mayoditum \|*  
*rājavārtā janavārtā yadi kaścinnijecchayā \|\| 7 \|\|*

*vadellokaḥ sukhāsīno na kenāpi nivāryate \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu dadyādagnīṣṭikāṃ naraḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tasya puṇyaphalaṃ rāja nkathyamānaṃ nibodha me \|*  
*vimāne cārkasaṃkāśe samārūḍho mahādhane \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca \|*  
*harṣito'tyaṃtasukhito brahmaloke mahīyate \|\| 10 \|\|*

2-10. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О Yudhisthira, I am going to speak about the giving away in charity a brazier which provides com forts during the w inter season to all the people. At the start of the month of Margasirsa, on an auspicious day, one should get a beautiful brazier made and should place it in the courtyard, or on the road, or in the home or near a wide crossing during the evening time and dry wood should be filled in the same. The fire should be ignited therein. Initially, the offerings should be poured in the fire flames. Similarly, then performing the homa daily, the fire should be made to remain lighted. In case a hungry person arrives there at the same time, then the donor should arrange for his food, as a result of which the people of the place should remain comfortable. The people should collect there and should tell the stories known to each one of them. I am unable to tell those stories, because some of them talk about the kings, some of them talk about the people and someone talks something of his own. Then who can stop him? A person who gives away the brazier in this way, then the merit so earned by him, is going to be told by me. You please listen. The donor, boarding a plane having the lustre of sun and which is filled with riches, reaches Brahmaloka, where he is adored for sixty thousand years.

## \|\| 3.173.11 \|\|

*iha lokevatīrṇaśca caturvedo dvijo bhavet \|*  
*nīrujaḥ satrayājī ca agnivattejasānvitaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. When at some stage he returns to this world, he is born in the family of Caturvedi Brahmana and shining like the fire, remains always healthy and becomes the performer of the yajna.

## \|\| 3.173.12 \|\|

*caitye surāṃgaṇasabhāvasathe subhavyāṃ ye'gnīṣṭikāṃ pracurakāṣṭhavatīṃ pradadyuḥ \|*  
*hemaṃtaśaiśiraṛtau sukhadā janānāṃ kāyāgnidīpanamalaṃ punarāpnuvaṃti \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Thus a person, who in the winter season, places a brazier at the root of a pipala tree a temple, in an assembly or near the crossing, with enough of wood therein which makes the people comfortable or gives it away in charity, he earns enormous merit.

## Chapter 174. Giving away of Vidya or knowledge

## \|\| 3.174.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*bahupradānaṃ godānaṃ tvatto vidvañchrutaṃ mayā \|*  
*bhūmidānasya māhātmyaṃ vidhiścaivāvadhāritaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sāṃprataṃ yaduśārdūla vidyādānasya yo vidhiḥ \|*  
*tamahaṃ śrotumicchāmi kathayasva janārdana \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said – I have learnt from you about several types of charities like giving away of cows, land and the related glory. О Janardana, now you kindly tell me about the giving away of the learnings.

## \|\| 3.174.3-7 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*vidyādānavidhiṃ vakṣye yāthātathyena te'dhunā \|*  
*yathā deyaṃ phalaṃ yacca dattena kurunaṃdana \|\| 3 \|\|*

*śubhe'hni viprakathite gomayena suśobhanam \|*  
*kārayenmaṃḍalaṃ divyaṃ caturasraṃ samaṃtataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*puṣpaprakarasaṃchannaṃ svastikādi vibhūṣitam \|*  
*pustakaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

*sauvarṇīṃ lekhanī kāryā raupyaṃ ca maṣibhājanam \|*  
*lekhakaṃ pūjayitvā tu āraṃbhaṃ kārayetsudhīḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*vinītaścāpramattaśca tataḥ prabhṛti lekhakaḥ \|*  
*mātrānusvārasaṃyuktaṃ padacchedasamanvitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

3-7. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О son of the race of Kuru, I am going to speak about the charity of learnings, how is it performed and the related merits earned by a person. On a day prescribed by a Brāhmaṇa, the land should be plastered with the cowdung over which a square and beautiful pavilion should be made, which should be decorated with flowers with Svastika symbol on all the sides, besides others auspicious marks. After the making of the pavilion, a book should then be consecrated therein and then worship it offering the fragrance and the flowers. A pen of gold should also be placed besides it, together with an inkpot made of silver at the time of start. Thereafter, with all humility, discarding laziness, the writer should be taught the use of a vowel mark, nasal signs, analysis, the straight line, besides the writing of the letters should be taught initially, which should be thick and circular.

## \|\| 3.174.8-11 \|\|

*samāni samaśīrṣāṇi vartulāni dhanāni ca \|*  
*lekhayedakṣarāṇīha tadgatenāṃtarātmanā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*niṣpādayitvā tacchāstraṃ śaivaṃ vāpyatha vaiṣṇavam \|*  
*niṣpādite tataḥ pūjyo lekhako vastrabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*saṃpūjayitvā tacchāstraṃ deyaṃ guṇavate tadā \|*  
*śāstrasadbhāvaviduṣe vācake ca priyaṃvade \|\| 10 \|\|*

*vastrayugmena saṃvītaṃ pustakaṃ pratipādayet \|*  
*sāmānyaṃ sarvalokānāṃ sthāpayedatha vā maṭhe \|\| 11 \|\|*

8-11. Similarly, with utmost concentration, the writers of Saiva and Vaisnava literature should be adored with the offering of the costumes and ornaments. The written literature should be dedicated to a virtuous person, who should be well-versed in the scriptures, sweet tongued, besides being an excellent orator. Otherwise, the created literature should be covered with the pair of clothes and should be handed over to a religious institution for the benefit of the people.

## \|\| 3.174.12-15 \|\|

*anena vidhinā dattvā yatphalaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ \|*  
*tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi yudhiṣṭhira nibodha tat \|\| 12 \|\|*

*yatpuṇyaṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ yatpuṇyaṃ yajvanāṃ tathā \|*  
*tatpuṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ vidyādānāllabhennaraḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*kapilānāṃ sahasreṇa samyagdattena yatphalam \|*  
*tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti pustakasya pradāyakaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*purāṇaṃ bhārataṃ vāpi rāmāyaṇamathāpi vā \|*  
*dattvā yatphalamāpnoti pārtha tatkena varṇyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

12-15. 0 Yudhisthira, with the following of this process, when the charities are given, then the merits which are earned by a donor, are being spoken by me. You please listen. All the merits for visiting the holy places and the performing of the yajnas which are earned by a person, a crore times more than those merits are achieved by a person by performing the Vidya-dana. A person who gets the merit for giving away a thousand of Kapila cows in a proper manner, the same merits are achieved by a person, who gives a book in charity. О Partha, by giving away Puranas, Mahabharata or Ramayana in charity, the merits so earned by a donor cannot be stated in words.

## \|\| 3.174.16-18 \|\|

*prātarutthāya yaḥ śiṣyānadhyāpayati yatnataḥ \|*  
*vedaśāstraṃ nṛtyagītaṃ kastena sadṛśaḥ kṛtī \|\| 16 \|\|*

*upādhyāyasya yo vṛttiṃ dattvā'dhyāpayate janaḥ \|*  
*kiṃ na dattaṃ bhavettena dharmakāmārthadarśinā \|\| 17 \|\|*

*chātrāṇāṃ bhojanābhyaṃgaṃ vastraṃ bhikṣāmathāpi vā \|*  
*dattvā prāpnoti puruṣaḥ sarvakāmānna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. After getting up early in the morning and after getting free from the routine exercises, a preceptor, who gives away the spiritual knowledge or knowledge related to music and dance to his disciples, who engages a learned person to serve as an Upadhyaya for the purpose of expanding of the studies, such a spiritual person should be considered to have given away all the charities. A person, who gives away food to the students, besides costumes, alms etc., has all his desires fulfilled. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.174.19-21 \|\|

*viveko jīvitaṃ dīrghaṃ dharmakāmārthasaṃpadaḥ \|*  
*sarvaṃ tena bhaveddattaṃ chātrāṇāṃ poṣaṇe kṛte \|\| 19 \|\|*

*śāstraṃ śastrakalāśilpaṃ yo yadicchedupārjitum \|*  
*tasyopakārakaraṇe pārtha kāryaṃ sadā manaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*vājapeyasahasrasya samyagiṣṭasya yatphalam \|*  
*tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti vidyādānānna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. For the sustenance of the students, one who has served the people with intelligence and long life making use of dharma, artha, kama etc., then he has performed all the noble deeds. I always think about the preceptor, in whose school, the scriptures, the arts as per the spiritual ethics, crafts, etc. are taught. I always think quite high about him. A person, who gains the merits after performing o f a thousand Vajapayi sacrifices, all such merits are achieved by giving away the Vidya as the charity. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.174.22-23 \|\|

*śivālaye viṣṇugṛhe sūryasya bhavane'tha vā \|*  
*yaḥ kārayati dharmātmā sadā pustakavācanam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*gobhūhiraṇyavāsāṃsi śayanānyāsanāni ca \|*  
*pratyahaṃ tena dattāni bhavaṃti bharatarṣabha \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. O lord of Bharata, a person, who arranges for the recitation of the religious texts in a Siva temple, Viṣṇu temple, Surya temple or any other place, he earns the merit of giving away a cow, land, gold, costumes, beds etc. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.174.24-25 \|\|

*dharmādharmaṃ na jānāti vidyayā rahitaḥ pumān \|*  
*tasmātsadaiva dharmātmā vidyādānarato bhavet \|\| 24 \|\|*

*trailokyaṃ caturo varṇāścatvāraścāśramāḥ pṛthak \|*  
*brahmādyā devatāḥ sarvā vidyādāne pratiṣṭhitāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. A person, who is deprived of learnings, cannot, distinguish well between the dharma and adharma. Therefore, a spiritual person should always engage himself in donating the learnings (or religious books). All the three lokas, the three varnas, four asramas, besides Brahma and all the gods get well established after donation of the learnings.

## \|\| 3.174.26-27 \|\|

*caturyugāni rājeṃdra ekasaptatisaṃkhyayā \|*  
*kalpaṃ viṣṇupure tiṣṭhetpūjyamānaḥ surottamaiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*kṣitiṃ vopetya kālāṃte rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*hastyaśvarathadānāḍhyo dātā bhoktā vimatsarī \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. О Rajendra, the donor of the learnings is adored in the heaven by the gods and the Raksasas for the duration of seventy one kalpas. In due course of time, when he descends on earth, he becomes a spiritual king, who giving the elephants, horses and chariots in charity, becomes a great donor, besides becoming a door devoid of pride.

## \|\| 3.174.28 \|\|

*rūpasaubhāgyasaṃpanno dīrghāyurnīrujo bhavet \|*  
*putraiḥ pautre parivṛto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. He possesses the beauty, fortunes, long life, good health and spends the life of a hundred years with his sons and grandsons.

## \|\| 3.174.29 \|\|

*dānaṃ viśeṣaphaladaṃ jagatīha nānyādvidyāṃ vihāya vadanābjakṛtādhivāsām \|*  
*gobhūhiraṇyagajavājirathādisarvaṃ tāṃ yacchatāṃ kimiha pārtha bhavenna dattam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Besides giving away of learnings, which resides in the lotus like mouth, there is no better charity there on earth. Therefore, a person who does so, need not give away the cows, land, gold, silver, elephants, horses or chariots in charity.

## Chapter 175. Traditional gift of food grains etc., weighing equivalent to the weight of a person’s body known as Tuladana

## \|\| 3.175.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*purā priyavrato rājā putraḥ svāyaṃbhuvasya tu \|*  
*pālayāmāsa vasudhāṃ prajāpatirivāparaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi pālayitvā mahīmimām \|*  
*saptadvīpānvibhajyāsau putrebhyaḥ pradadau vibhuḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – In ancient times, the king Priyavrata - son of Svayambhuva, during his reign, had maintained the earth like a Prajapati. The said king ruled the earth judiciously for thirty thousand years. Ultimately, he distributed the seven continents to his seven sons.

## \|\| 3.175.3-8 \|\|

*rājye nikṣipya tanayānsaptadvīpeṣu sapta saḥ \|*  
*viṣayānupasaṃhṛtya jagāma tapase vanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tapovanagataṃ śrutvā rājānaṃ paramadyutim \|*  
*samājagmurmahātmāna ṛṣayastaṃ didṛkṣavaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tānāgatānṛṣīndṛṣṭvā taponirdhūtakalmaṣān \|*  
*pūjayāmāsa medhāvī vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*pādyārghyācamanīyena priyapraśnottareṇa ca \|*  
*atha teṣūpaviṣṭeṣu brāhmaṇeṣu mahātmasu \|\| 6 \|\|*

*ājagāma mahātejāḥ pulastyo brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*dīpyamāno mahātejā dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*taṃ dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve sa ca rājā mahārathaḥ \|*  
*uttasthurvismitāḥ sarve protphullana yanāstataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

3-8. Subsequently, those seven sons were given over their respective kingdoms, where they occupied the lion thrones comfortably, detracting themselves from the worldly pleasures, controlling their sense organs and then he himself proceeded on to the forest for performing tapas. When the (fair came to know about the departure of the immensely illustrious king’s to the forest, they went to the forest to meet him. Having found the arrival of the Ṛṣis in the forest who had performed great tapas destroying all their sins, the illustrious king adored them appropriately. He offered them padhya as well as arghya water and made them comfortable with sweet words and conversation. When the Brahmanas were so comfortably seated with peaceful minds, at the same time, the great Ṛṣi Pulastya expressed surprise with his wide eyes, and the other sages welcomed the great sage, by getting up from their seats.

## \|\| 3.175.9-11 \|\|

*kṛtvā tu saṃvidaṃ tena yathāyogyaṃ vidhānataḥ \|*  
*viṣṭaraṃ ca dadustasmai pādyārghyācamanādikam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tatastu munayaḥ sarve samā sīnā yathāsukham \|*  
*cakruḥ kathā mudāyuktā vedoktavividhāśrayāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tataḥ kathāṃte kasmiṃścinmunayaste sarājakāḥ \|*  
*papracchurbrahmatanayaṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. After initial discussions about each other welfare, the king gave a seat to the great Ṛṣi, besides offering padya and arghya, and the water for sipping. Thereafter, all the Maharsis took their seats with ease and started discussions on the stories relating to the Vedas with delight. While thus discussing about the stories, the Ṛṣis asked Pulastya – the son of Brahma.

## \|\| 3.175.12 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ \|*  
*bhagavankena dānena vratena niyamena vā \|*  
*prāpyate sadgatiḥ puṃbhiḥ strībhiśca munisattama \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. The Ṛṣis said- О lord, with the performing of which one of the vrata or rules, one achieves the beautitude. All of us including the king are anxious to know about the same.

## \|\| 3.175.13-19 \|\|

*icchāmaḥ śrotumetatte rājā cāyaṃ yatavrataḥ \|*  
*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve rahasyaṃ pāpanārānam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*uttamaṃ sarva dānānāṃ samavāyaṃ vadāmi vaḥ \|*  
*yaddattvā brahmahā goghnaḥ pitṛghno gurutalpagaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kṛtaghnaḥ kūṭasākṣī ca mucyate pātakānnaraḥ \|*  
*sadyo divya tanuścaiva jāyate strī tathaiva ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

*kṛcchracāṃdrāyaṇādyaiśca tulāpuruṣasaṃjñitaiḥ \|*  
*vrataiśca pācayeddehamākāṃkṣanbrahmaṇaḥ padam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*kṛcchracāṃdrāyaṇādīni vratāni munisattamāḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇānāṃ vanasthānāṃ bhikṣo raṃḍājanasya ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kāyakleśena sidhyaṃti gṛhastheṣu na tāni vai \|*  
*mahādhanāśca ye lokā rājāno ratnabhāginaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*na teṣāṃ kṛcchrasādhyo'pi kvaciddharmaḥ praśasyate \|*  
*yadetaddraviṇaṃ nāma prāṇāścaite bahiścarāḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

13-19. Pulastya said – I am going to reveal a secret which is remover of sins, is indeed the best and is the best of all the charities. You please listen. By exercising that charity, a grave sinner who has killed a Brahmana, a cow and even his own father, an ungrateful person and the one giving false witness gets relieved of his sins, irrespective of his or her being a man or a woman. His or her body at once becomes divine. Such of the person who are desirous of achieving Brahma-pada or beautitude, should perform the Tula-purusa vrata, besides the Krchhra-candrayana vrata and reduce the weight of their bodies, because the ascetics, Brahmanas, mendicants, the widowers, unmarried ones or the people without the children, can attain success only with the performing of the Candrayana vrata. The householders cannot perform these vratas. A wealthy and greedy king, having enough of gems, is also not required to perform the Krchhra vrata, because the body is the form of wealth and the prana is something separate from it.

## \|\| 3.175.20-22 \|\|

*tasmādbahiścaraiḥ prāṇairātmā yojyaḥ sadā budhaiḥ \|*  
*dravyāṇāmuttamaṃ loke kāṃcanaṃ sārvakāmikam \|\| 20 \|\|*

*apatyaṃ suramukhyasya jyeṣṭhaṃ caivaṃ vibhāvasoḥ \|*  
*tena sārddhaṃ ya ātmānaṃ tolayetprayato budhaiḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*vidhūya sarvapāpāni sadyo divyatanurbhavet \|*  
*etatpulastyamuninā ṛṣīṇāṃ pārthivasva ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. Therefore, the pranas should be conclusive to the body. Of all the worldly things, the gold is considered to be the best which fulfills the desire, because it is considered to be the eldest son of the fire god. Therefore, a person who weighs himself with it, he atonce getting relieved of all his sins, attains a divine body. О best of kings, О Parthiva, the Ṛṣis heard this from the mouth of the sage Pulastya and I learnt it from them.

## \|\| 3.175.23 \|\|

*samākhyātaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha tebhyaśca tanmayā śrutam \|*  
*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*tulāpuruṣadānasya vidhānaṃ parameśvara \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Yudhisthira said – О great lord, being graceful on a devotee like me, you kindly speak out the glory of Tula-purusa dana (weighing a person in a scale with gold, silver, grains etc.).

## \|\| 3.175.24-28 \|\|

*kathayasva mahābhāga mama bhaktānukaṃpayā \|*  
*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇuṣvāvahito rājanvidhānaṃ gadato mama \|\| 24 \|\|*

*tulāpuruṣasaṃjñasya dānasyeha nṛpottama \|*  
*vyatīpāte'yane caiva kārtikyāṃ viṣuve tathā \|\| 25 \|\|*

*candrasūryagrahe yadvā māghyāṃ vā nṛpasattama \|*  
*janmarkṣe grahapīḍāsu tathā duḥsvapnadarśane \|\| 26 \|\|*

*yadā vā jāyate vittaṃ tadā deyamidaṃ bhavet \|*  
*anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yasmādvapuścātīva cañcalam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*keśeṣu ca gṛhītaḥ sanmṛtyunā dharmamācaret \|*  
*tasmādyadaiva jāyeta śraddhā dānaṃ prati prabho \|\| 28 \|\|*

24-28. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О best of the kings, I am going to speak about the giving away of Tula- purusa. You please listen. О best of the tongs, during the time of obstructions, half years, full moon day of the month of Kartika, equinox, solar or lunar eclipses, on the full moon day of the month of Magha or on the birth constellation, while suffering from the effect of an evil planet or witnessing a bad dream, or at the time of the loosing of enormous riches, this type of charity known as Tuladana must be performed, because life is quite unstable, the body becomes perishable and the death always hover over the head. Therefore, one should devote to this type of donation today itself.

## \|\| 3.175.29-34 \|\|

*tadaiva dānakālaḥ syātkāraṇaṃ hi yato mama \|*  
*tīrthe vāyatane goṣṭheṣvatha vā bhava nāṃgaṇe \|*  
*maṇḍapaṃ kārayedvidvāṃścaturbhadrānanaṃ budhaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*ārdraśākhānvitaṃ divyaṃ prāgudakpravaṇaṃ dṛḍham \|*  
*ṣoḍaśāratnimātraṃ ca patākābhiralaṃkṛ tam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*tanmadhye kārayedvediṃ hastamātrocchritāṃ śubhām \|*  
*caturasrāṃ samaṃtācca saptahastāṃ suśobhanām \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tasyā madhye tulāṃ divyāṃ sthāpa yedvidhipūrvakam \|*  
*hastadvayaṃ ca nikhaneccaturhastocchritāṃ budhaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*staṃbhadvayaṃ mahārāja sthāpayetsudṛḍhaṃ navam \|*  
*caṃdanaḥ khadiro bilvaḥ śākaścaiveṃguda stathā \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tiṃduko devadāruśca śrīparṇaścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

29-34. Taking it to be the time of charity, the same should be given for my sake. One should go to a vast cow-pen or in the courtyard of the house, a beautiful mandapa should be made of the green tree leaves and the branches, slippery towards the north, quite strong, covering the area of sixteen cubits, should be made. It should be covered with the flags and banners. In the middle of the same, a pedestal, which should be square of seven cubits and having-a height of a cubit, should be made. In the middle of it should be established two pillars, digging the earth two cubits below and should be erected, which should be quite new. The eight types of trees such as sandal wood, catechu, wood apple, Saka, Vengu, Tinduka, pine or cedar and Sriparna should be used for the purpose.

## \|\| 3.175.35 \|\|

*ityaṣṭau vṛkṣajātīyāḥ staṃbhāste parikīrtitāḥ \|*  
*anyathāpi bhavedvṛkṣaḥ sārajño yājñikastathā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. The wood of other trees, which are usually used in yajnas, can also be used for the purpose of erecting pillars.

## \|\| 3.175.36-39 \|\|

*suniścalaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tiryakkāṣṭhamathopari \|*  
*nyasettadvṛkṣajātīyaṃ caturhastaṃ pramāṇataḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*samānajātiṃ tu tulāṃ tanmadhye yojayeddṛḍham \|*  
*ṣaṇṇavatyaṃgulā divyā samagrā lohapāśikā \|\| 37 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇalohamayau tasyāṃ karṇau cāpi prakalpayet \|*  
*tulāpuruṣasaṃjñastu madhye kāryaḥ pumānbha vet \|\| 38 \|\|*

*evaṃvidhāṃ tulāṃ kṛtvā nānāratnairvibhūṣitām \|*  
*caṃdanenānuliptāṃgīṃ vastrālaṃkāravigrahām \|\| 39 \|\|*

36-39. A curved branch of some sacred tree should be placed over the pillar which should be of four cubits length and which should serve as a balance. It should be quite strong with a thickness of ninety six angulas. It’s all the four comers should be made of black iron. The Tula-purusa should be lodged in the middle of it. The weighing scale should be decorated with several types of gems, plastered with the sandal paste and further decorated with costumes and ornaments.

## \|\| 3.175.40-42 \|\|

*staṃbhau ca vastrasaṃyuktau puṣpamālāva laṃbinau \|*  
*caṃdanenānuliptāṃgau nānātnairalaṃkṛtau \|\| 40 \|\|*

*kuṇḍāni cātra catvāri yoniyuktāni kārayet \|*  
*hastamātrapramāṇāni mekhalātrayavaṃti ca \|\| 41 \|\|*

*pūrvottare hastamitā vediḥ kāryā suśobhanā \|*  
*lokapālagrahāṇāṃ ca pūjā tatra vidhīyate \|\| 42 \|\|*

40-42. Both the pillars of the weighing scale should be bound with long garlands of flowers and plastered with the sandal paste. Several of the gems should be studded in it. Thereafter, four altars with yonis should be prepared which should be a cubit in width, besides the three chains. Towards its north-east side, a beautiful pedestal of a cubit in size should be made. The Lokapalas with all the planets should be established over the same.

## \|\| 3.175.43-46 \|\|

*arcārcanaṃ ca tatraiva viriṃcyacyutayo rnṛpa \|*  
*śaṃkarasya bhavetkāryaṃ mālyavastraphalākṣataiḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*toraṇāni ca kāryāṇi kṣīravṛkṣodbhavāni ca \|*  
*caturdvāreṣu saṃsthāpyāḥ kumbhāḥ srakpalla vānanāḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*paṃcaratnasamāyuktāḥ saptadhānyoparisthitāḥ \|*  
*ṛgvedapāṭhakau dvau ca pūrvakuṇḍe niyojayet \|\| 45 \|\|*

*yajurvedavidau yāmye paścime sāmavedinau \|*  
*atharvaṇāvuttarato navamo dharmadeśakaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

43-46. O king, over the same pedestal, the garlands, costumes, fruits and unbroken rice should be used for worshipping Brahma, Viṣṇu and Siva. On all the four gates, which should be decorated with arches and tree leaves, a kalasa or a pitcher should be consecrated. It should comprise of five gems and should be placed over the heap of seven types of grains. Towards the east of the altar, two Rgvedic Brahmanas and the Yajurvedic Brahmanas should be lodged to the south. The Samavedi Brahmanas should be lodged to the west and two Atharvavedi Brahmanas should be lodged to the north and all of them should be adored. Thereafter, the ninth Dharmadesi should be nominated.

## \|\| 3.175.47-52 \|\|

*atraiva kecidicchaṃti ṛṣayaḥ ṣoḍaśartvijaḥ \|*  
*tāmrapātradvayaṃ deyamekaikasmai tathāsanam \|\| 47 \|\|*

*homadravyāṇi sarvāṇi tilājyaṃ samidhastathā \|*  
*sruvāḥ srucaśca śastrāṇi viṣṭaraḥ kusumāni ca \|\| 48 \|\|*

*lokapālāḥ suvarṇāstu patākāḥ paritaḥ śubhāḥ \|*  
*mahādhvajaṃ ca badhnīyātpaṃcavarṇaṃ vitānakam \|\| 49 \|\|*

*etatsarvaṃ samāhṛtya puṇye'hani vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*varddhakirbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ sarvaśilpaviśā radaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*saṃpūrṇaṃ yajamānāya darśayedyajñamaṃḍapam \|*  
*yajamānastataḥ prājñaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*śaṃkhatūryaninādena vedadhvaniraveṇa ca \|*  
*prakṣipellokapālānāmebhirmaṃtraiḥ śubhairbalim \|\| 52 \|\|*

47-52. Some of the Ṛṣis are of the opinion that there should be sixteen Rtvikas or the yajna priests. All the aforesaid Brahmanas should be given two copper vases, an asana to each one of them. Then making use of the sacrifice materials like sesamum, ghi, twigs, ladle, sruca, sruva, kusa seat and flowers, the place should be decorated with Lokapalas on all the four sides. The place should also be decorated with banners. While fixing the huge flag, the five coloured canopy should be fixed. Thus when the entire festivities are nearing completion, on some auspicious occasion, depute the learned Brahmanas, architects and artisans for the purpose of establishing the yajna-mandapa. Thereafter, getting clad in white clothes, observing purity, the learned donor should recite the hymns for Lokapalas accompanied by the playing of the religious musical instruments like conches etc. The offerings should be made thereafter.

## \|\| 3.175.53 \|\|

*ehyehi sarvāmarasiddhasādhyairabhiṣṭuto vajradharāmareśa \|*  
*saṃvījyamānopsarasāṃ gaṇena rakṣādhvaraṃ no bhagavannamaste \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. Then he should pray- “O lord Amaresa, you kindly be present in my yajna and grace me with the accepting of the offerings made by me. You are always adored by the Siddhas, gods and the Sadhyas, while the nymphs fan you. You kindly protect my sacrifice. I offer my salutation to you again and again.” By offering this mantra, the offering should be made to Indra.

## \|\| 3.175.54 \|\|

*ehyehi sarvāmarahavyavāha munipravīrerabhihṛṣṭamānasaḥ \|*  
*tejovatā lokagaṇena sārddhaṃ mamādhvaraṃ rakṣa kave namaste \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. “О lord Agni, you сапу havya for all the gods, the sages and Ṛṣis always please you. Along with the illustrious lokas, you kindly arrive here and accept the offerings as a present. You protect this yajna always. I offer my salutation to you.” Reciting this mantra, the offering should be given to the Fire-god.

## \|\| 3.175.55 \|\|

*ehyehi vaivasvatadharmarāja sarvāmarairarcitadivyamūrte \|*  
*śubhāśubhānaṃdakṛtāmadhīśa rakṣādhvaraṃ me bhagavannamaste \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. “O Dharmaraja - the son of Surya, you are adored by all the gods. You are the lord of all the performers of the good or bad deeds. You kindly protect my yajna. I offer my salutation to you. Reciting this mantra, offering should be made to Dharmaraja, also known as Yama.

## \|\| 3.175.56 \|\|

*oṃ yamāya namaḥ \|*  
*ehyehi rakṣogaṇanāyakastvaṃ viśālavetālapiśācasaṃghaiḥ \|*  
*mamādhvaraṃ pāhi piśācanātha lokeśvarastvaṃ bhagavannamaste \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. “O lord of Pisacas, you are the leader of the Raksasas, therefore, together with the army of Vetalas and the Pisacas, you kindly protect my yajna. I offer my salutation to you.” Reciting this mantra, offering should be made to Nirrti.

## \|\| 3.175.57 \|\|

*oṃ nirṛtaye namaḥ \|*  
*ehyehi yādogaṇavāridhīnāṃ gaṇena parjanya sahāpsarobhiḥ \|*  
*vidyādharendrāmaragīyamāna pāhi tvamasmānbhagavannamaste \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. “О Varunadeva, you are adored by the gods as well as the Vidyadharas. You are always adored by the clouds, the aquatic animals, besides the nymphs, all the times. Salutation to you. You kindly protect my yajna.” Uttering these hymns, the offerings should be made to Varuna.

## \|\| 3.175.58 \|\|

*oṃ varuṇāya namaḥ \|*  
*ehyehi yajñe mama rakṣaṇāya mṛgādhirūḍhaḥ saha siddhasaṃghaiḥ \|*  
*prāṇādhipaḥ kālakaveḥ sahāyo gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavannamaste \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. “О lord Vāyudeva, keeping the company of the Siddhas, you always mount over a deer. You are the lord of life and are associated with the destiny, you kindly accept my adoration. I offer my salutation to you.” Reciting these mantras, the offerings should be made to the Wind-god.

## \|\| 3.175.59 \|\|

*ehyehi yajñeśvara yajñarakṣāṃ vidhatsva nakṣatragaṇena sārddham \|*  
*sarvauṣadhībhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ sahaiva gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavannamaste \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. “O lord of yajnas, you kindly protect this yajna together with all the constellations, ausadhis, pitrs and accept my adoration. I offer my salutation to you.” Reciting this mantra, the offerings should be made to Soma – the moon god.

## \|\| 3.175.60 \|\|

*ehyehi viśveśvara viśvamūrte triśūlakhaṭvāṅgadhareṇa sārddham \|*  
*lokena bhūteśvara yajñasiddhyai gṛhāṇa pūjāṃ bhagavannamaste \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. “Let lord Visvesvara with universal form, carrying a trident and khatvanga come here with all the lokas, accept my adoration and make the yajna a success. О lord of the Bhutas, I offer my salutation to you again and again.” Reciting this mantra, the offering should be made for lord Siva.

## \|\| 3.175.61 \|\|

*ehyehi pātāladharādharendra nāgāṃganākinnaragīyamāna \|*  
*yakṣoragendrāmaralokasaṃghairanaṃta rakṣādhvaramasmadīyam \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. “О Anantadeva - the carrier of the earth, the Naga damsels as well as the Nagas always sing for your glory. Accompanied with other gods, you protect my yajna." Reciting this mantra, the offering should be made to the serpent Ananta.

## \|\| 3.175.62 \|\|

*ehyehi viśvādhipate munīṃdra lokeśa sārddhaṃ pitṛdevatābhiḥ \|*  
*viśādhvarāṃtaḥ satataṃ śivāya pitāmahastvaṃ satataṃ namaste \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. “O lord of the universe, О Munindra and Lokesa, together with the Pitr gods, for our welfare, you enter the heart of the yajna. You are a grandsire, therefore, salutation to you. Reciting this mantra, Brahma should be given an offering.

## \|\| 3.175.63 \|\|

*trailokye yāni bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇuśivaiḥ sārddhaṃ rakṣāṃ kurvaṃtu tāni me \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Let Brahma, Viṣṇu and Siva, who pervade the universe, should protect me with all the mobile and immobile beings.

## \|\| 3.175.64-69 \|\|

*devadānavagandharvā yakṣa rākṣasapannagāḥ \|*  
*ṛṣayo manavo gāvo devamātara eva ca \|\| 64 \|\|*

*sarve mamādhvare rakṣāṃ prakurvaṃtu mudānvitāḥ \|*  
*ityāvāhya surāndadyādṛtvigbhyaḥ kaṇṭha bhūṣaṇam \|\| 65 \|\|*

*kuṃḍalāni ca haimāni sūtrāṇi kaṭakāni ca \|*  
*tathāṃgulipavitrāṇi vāsāṃsi kusumāni ca \|\| 66 \|\|*

*dviguṇaṃ gurave dadyādbhūṣaṇā cchādanādikam \|*  
*āghārāvājyabhāgau tu pūrvaṃ hutvā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

*praṇavādisvanāmnā ca svāhāṃto homa ucyate \|*  
*homaḥ surāṇāṃ kartavyo ye caivātra pratiṣṭhitāḥ \|\| 68 \|\|*

*grahāṇāṃ lokapālānāṃ śivakeśavayostathā \|*  
*vanaspatibhyo brahmaṇe homaḥ kāryo yathecchayā \|\| 69 \|\|*

64-69. Similarly, all the Gods, Danavas, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas, Nagas, Sun, Ṛṣis, Manu, the cows and the divine mothers should protect my yajna with delight Thus by invoking all the gods, the yajna priests should be given the gold, garlands, earrings, gold chains, armlets, rings, costumes and flowers etc. Initially, die offerings in ghi should be made and mantras starting from Omkara and ending with Svaha should be recited. The homa should be performed for the sake of the established gods. Thereafter, the family deities, the Lokapalas, Siva, Viṣṇu, Vanaspatis and Brahma should be given the appropriate offerings.

## \|\| 3.175.70-78 \|\|

*tato maṃgalaśabdena sthāpito vedamaṃgalaiḥ \|*  
*triḥpradakṣiṇamāvṛtya gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ \|\| 70 \|\|*

*śuklamālyāṃbaro bhūtvā tāṃ tulāmabhimaṃtrayet \|*  
*namaste sarvadevānāṃ śaktistvaṃ satyamāsthitā \|\| 71 \|\|*

*sākṣibhūtā jagaddhātri nirmitā viśvayoninā \|*  
*ekataḥ sarvasatyāni tathānṛtaśatāni ca \|\| 72 \|\|*

*dharmādharmabhṛtāṃ madhye sthāpitāsi jagaddhite \|*  
*tvaṃ tule sarvabhūtānāṃ pramāṇamiha kīrtitā \|\| 73 \|\|*

*māṃ tolayaṃtī saṃsārāduddharātra namostute \|*  
*yo'sau tattvā dhipo devaḥ puruṣaḥ pacaviṃśakaḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

*sa eko'dhiṣṭhito devi tvayi tasmānnamo namaḥ \|*  
*namo namaste goviṃda tulāpuruṣasaṃjñaka \|\| 75 \|\|*

*tvaṃ hare tārayasvāsmānasmātsaṃsārasāgarāt \|*  
*puṇyakālamathāsādya kṛtvaivamadhivāsanam \|\| 76 \|\|*

*praṇamya parayā bhaktyā tāṃ tulāmāruhedbudhaḥ \|*  
*sa saṅgacarmakavacī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

*dharmarājamathādāya hemasūryeṇa saṃyutam \|*  
*karābhyāṃ baddhamuṣṭibhyāmāste paśyanharermukham \|\| 78 \|\|*

70-78. Thereafter, clad in white garments, the donor reciting the welfare mantras or the Vedic hymns, should go round the weighing scale there and then sanctify the same. Saying- “O carrier of the universe, I offer my salutation to you. You are the force of all the gods. You are established in truth. Becoming a witness, you have been created by Brahmi. On your one side is the total truth and hundreds of falsehoods are on the other side. Therefore, you are lodged between dharma and adharma. О Tula, you are the proof for all the living beings. Therefore, weighing me, you redeem me out of this universe. I offer my salutation to you again and again. Out of the twenty five tattvas, only one single person is placed with you. Therefore, salutation to you again and again. О Govinda, the form of Tula-purusa, salutation to you again and again. Let me float through the ocean of universe.” Thus during an auspicious time, performing the concluding ceremony and offering the salutation, one should ride over the weighing scale. He should be holding a sword, shield, a kavaca and adorned with all the ornaments. Together with a gold image of Surya, the fists of both the hands should be held tight, fixing the gaze to the image of Viṣṇu, one should mount the balance.

## \|\| 3.175.79-82 \|\|

*vāme yamaṃ tathā gṛhya dakṣiṇe ca raviṃ tathā \|*  
*tato'pare tulābhāge nyaseyurdvijapuṃgavāḥ \|*  
*sāmyādabhyadhikaṃ yāvatkāṃcanaṃ cātinirmalam \|\| 79 \|\|*

*puṣṭikāmastu kurvīta bhūmisaṃsthaṃ nareśvara \|*  
*kṣaṇamātraṃ tataḥ sthitvā punaretadudīrayet \|\| 80 \|\|*

*namaste sarvabhūtānāṃ sākṣibhūte sanātane \|*  
*pitāmahena devi tvaṃ nirmitā parameṣṭhinā \|\| 81 \|\|*

*tvayoddhṛtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ saha sthāvarajaṃgamam \|*  
*sarvabhūtātmabhūtasthe namaste viśvadhāriṇi \|\| 82 \|\|*

79-82. The best of the Brahmanas should keep Yama on the left and Surya on the right. In the upper part of the scale, bright gold should be placed which should be more than half the weight (of the person to be weighed). О Naresvara, for the purpose of cherishing, the side with gold should be allowed to remain touching the ground. Thereafter, standing over it for a moment, one should pray- “O goddess, you are the witness of all the living beings, besides being eternal. Paramesthi Brahma had created you. Therefore, salutation to you. You have redeemed the entire mobile and immobile world. О carrier of the universe, you always remain lodged in the souls of all the living beings. Therefore, salutation to you.”

## \|\| 3.175.83-87 \|\|

*tato'vatīrya gurave sarvamarddhaṃ nivedayet \|*  
*ṛtvigbhyo'paramarddhaṃ ca dadyādudakapūrvakam \|\| 83 \|\|*

*prāpya teṣāmanujñāṃ vā tathānyebhyo'pi dāpayet \|*  
*dīnānātha viśiṣṭādīnpūjayedbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha \|\| 84 \|\|*

*na ciraṃ dhārayedgehe hemasaṃprokṣitaṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*tiṣṭhadbhayāvahaṃ yasmātkaṣṭavyādhikaraṃ bhavet \|\| 85 \|\|*

*rātriṃ parasvīkara ṇācchriyaṃ prāpnotyanuttamām \|*  
*anenaiva vidhānena kecidraupyamayaṃ tathā ta \|\| 86 \|\|*

*karpūreṇa tathecchaṃti kecidbrāhmaṇapuṃgavāḥ \|*  
*tathāsitatṛtīyāyāṃ nāryaḥ saubhāgyavardhitāḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

83-87. Thereafter, descending from that place, half of the contents of the balance should be given over to the preceptor. The other half should be distributed among the yajna priests with water. The poor and destitute should also perform worship with the Brahmanas. A learned person should not keep the gold after performing the charity in his house for long. Because in case, it is kept in the house for long, it could cause misfortunes as well as the diseases. Therefore, the wealth which belongs to others should be given over to its owner as early as possible. By so doing, a person earns the excellent fortunes. Some of the Brahmanas are of the opinion that while following this process, the silver and camphor could also be used for the purpose of weighing. The ladies who perform the charities on the dark third moon day of the month, they have their fortunes enhanced.

## \|\| 3.175.88-89 \|\|

*kuṃkumena prayacchaṃti lavaṇena guḍena ca \|*  
*tatra maṃtrā na homo vā evameva pradāpayet \|\| 88 \|\|*

*vidhinānena yo dadyā ddānametatsamāhitaḥ \|*  
*tasya puṇyaphalaṃ rājañchṛṇuṣva gadato mama \|\| 89 \|\|*

88-89. While performing tuladana with the offering of vermilion and salt or sugarcane balls, there is no need for the performing of homa or the reciting of the mantras. О king, by following this process, the merit which is gained by a person, the same is being spoken by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.175.90-93 \|\|

*vimānavaramāsthāya nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā \|*  
*apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ gaṃdha rvanagaropamam \|\| 90 \|\|*

*nānāvṛkṣākulaṃ ramyaṃ nānāgaṃdhādhivāsitam \|*  
*anekaratnaviddhāṃgaṃ muktādāmāvalaṃbitam \|\| 91 \|\|*

*śayanāsanasaṃkīrṇaṃ patākā bhiralaṃkṛtam \|*  
*ghaṃṭāśataravoddhuṣṭaṃ cāmaravyajanānvitam \|\| 92 \|\|*

*sarvartusukhadaṃ ramyaṃ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitam \|*  
*itthaṃ vimānamāruhya gacchetsūryasalo katām \|\| 93 \|\|*

90-93. The donor woman or man boards over an excellent plane which is full of nymphs like the city of Gandharvas, having many trees of different species, having been perfumed with various types of fragrance and scents. His body always remains adorned with various types of gems and beads, besides the bunches of pearls. It has several single beds and is decorated with many flags. It issues the sounds of several pitchers. The flywhisks and the fans keep on moving. The plane is always comfortable in all the seasons and is deprived of all the miseries. By boarding in such a place, the donor travels in the abode of the Sungod.

## \|\| 3.175.94-98 \|\|

*mitvā tatra rājeṃdra kalpamekaṃ nirāmayaḥ \|*  
*viṣṇuloke tathā kalpaṃ śivaloke tathaiva ca \|\| 94 \|\|*

*viśveṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ deva rāja pure tathā \|*  
*pure ca dharmarājasya varuṇasya tathaiva ca \|\| 95 \|\|*

*dhanadasya pure sthitvā kalpakoṭiśataṃ naraḥ \|*  
*punarmānuṣamabhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|\| 96 \|\|*

*yajvā dānapatirdhīmāñchatrupakṣakṣayaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*yaścaitacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā mahādānānukīrtanam \|\| 97 \|\|*

*so'pi mucyeta pāpena trividhena na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 98 \|\|*

94-98. О Rajendra, by remaining healthy, he enjoys all the comforts there for the duration of a kalpa and he further lives for a kalpa each in Siva and Viṣṇu lokas. Thereafter, he lives in Indraloka, Visvedeva’s abode, the cities of Dharmaraja, Kubera and Varuna for the duration of a hundred crores of years. Ultimately, he is reborn in a human family and becomes a great king, performing yajnas, charities, getting quite learned and destroys his enemies. A person who listens to the story of this great charity, he is relieved of all the three types of sins. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.175.99 \|\|

*brahmeśakeśavaparo'sti na pūjanīyo naivāśvamedhasadṛśaḥ kraturasti kaścit \|*  
*gaṃgāsamaṃ tribhuvane'pi na tīrthamasti dānaṃ tulāpuruṣatulyamihāsti nānyat \|\| 99 \|\|*

99\. None else is more adorable in the three worlds than Brahma, Viṣṇu and Siva. There is no place or river more sacred than the Gangs and no charity greater than Tula-purusa dana.

## Chapter 176. Giving away of the gold in charity

## \|\| 3.176.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*bhagavansarvabhūteśa sarvabhūtanamaskṛta \|*  
*anugrahāya lokānāṃ kathayasva mamāparam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tvattulyo jāyate yena āyuṣā yaśasā śriyā \|*  
*tanme kathaya deveśa dānaṃ vratamathāpi vā \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said – О lord, you are the master of all the living beings. All the living beings offer their salutation to you. Therefore, for the affection of the people, you enlighten me on some other subject. О Devesa, you kindly speak to me about a charity by performing which, one could become like you in age, glory and the fortunes.

## \|\| 3.176.3-9 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi tava lokahitecchayā \|*  
*yenopāyena jāyaṃte mattulyā mānavā bhuvi \|\| 3 \|\|*

*na vratainopavāsaiśca na tīrthagamanairapi \|*  
*mahāpathādimaraṇairna yajñairna śrutena ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

*prāpyate mama loko'yaṃ duṣprāpyastridaśairapi \|*  
*pārthasnehānmahābhāga pravakṣyāmi hitaṃ tava \|\| 5 \|\|*

*gobrāhmaṇārthe maraṇaṃ prāptaṃ yena sumedhasā \|*  
*prayāge'naśanaṃ vāpi pūjito vātha śaṃkaraḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*prayāti brahmasālokyaṃ śrutireṣā sanātanī \|*  
*yena matsamatāṃ yāti tatte vakṣyāmyataḥ param \|\| 7 \|\|*

*dānaṃ hiraṇyagarbhākhyaṃ kathyamānaṃ nibodha me \|*  
*agnerapatyaṃ prathamaṃ suvarṇamiha paṭhyate \|\| 8 \|\|*

*pavitraṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ pāvanaṃ paramaṃ mahat \|*  
*paryāyanāma tasyoktaṃ hiraṇyaṃ sārvalaukikam \|\| 9 \|\|*

3-9. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – The charity by which a human can equate me on earth, I am going to speak about the same for the benefit of the people. You please listen. О excellent Partha, no one can reach my place by performing vratas, fasting, going on pilgrimage to the holy places, facing death at some sacred or the holy place, besides with the performing of the yajnas or the study of the Vedas, which is beyond the reach of the gods even. But because of your attachment for me, I am going to speak about the same. As narrated in the ancient Srutis that though for the sake of cows and the Brahmanas, by fasting in Prayaga a person who has adorned lord Siva, he earns the beatitude known as Brahma-salokya, but still, when a person has achieved my devotion, he is entirely different. I am now speaking about it. I am also defining the charity for gold, you please listen. The fire has been termed to be the eternal gold, who happens to be the most auspicious of all the creatures in the world. Its popular second name is Hiranya or the gold.

## \|\| 3.176.10 \|\|

*tadapāṃ garbhamāviśya punarjātaṃ tu bhūtale \|*  
*yaśca tadbrāhmaṇe dadyānmattulyo jāyate hi saḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Entering the womb of the water, the same had been reborn on earth in the form of gold. A person who gives away the same to a Brahmana, equates himself with me.

## \|\| 3.176.11 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*vidhānaṃ tasya deveśa kathayasva sanātana \|*  
*yatpramāṇaṃ yathācaitaddātavyaṃ parameśvara \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Yudhisthira said – О Devesa, you are the eternal Paramesvara. You enlighten me about the process of the same, besides the quantity in which it should be given away. You kindly enlighten me on the subject.

## \|\| 3.176.12-14 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*parvakāle pradātavyaṃ dānametanmahāmate \|*  
*ayane viṣuve caiva grahaṇe śaśisūryayoḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*vyatīpāte'tha kārtikyāṃ janmarkṣe vā narottama \|*  
*duḥsvapnadarśane caiva grahapīḍāsu caiva hi \|\| 13 \|\|*

*prayāge naimiṣe caiva kurukṣetre tathārbude \|*  
*gaṃgāyāṃ yamunāyāṃ ca siṃdhusāgarasaṃgame \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О highly learned one, this particular charity should be performed on a festive occasion at the end of half year, at equinox, on the days of lunar or solar eclipses, on full moon day of the month of Kartika, during birth constellation, on witnessing the bad dreams or when suffering (physically, mentally or otherwise), this vrata should be performed at Prayaga, Naimisaranya at Kuruksetra, Arbuda, on the Ganga or Yamuna banks or at the ocean of Sindhu confluence.

## \|\| 3.176.15-17 \|\|

*puṇyanadyaśca dānesminpraśastāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*yatra vā rocate rājangṛhe devakule'thavā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*ārāme vā taḍāge vā śucau deśe vidhānataḥ \|*  
*tatra bhūśodhanaṃ kuryātprāgudakpravaṇaṃ śubham \|\| 16 \|\|*

*hastā dvādaśa kartavyaṃ maṃḍapaṃ tu suśobhanam \|*  
*staṃbhairmanoharairyuktyārdraśākhābhiranvitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. With this charity alone, all these rivers became praiseworthy. There is no doubt about it. О king, the event could be performed at one’s own home, a temple, an orchard, a tank or at any other place, which is found suitable. At the same place, purifying the land in an appropriate manner, a pavilion of ten cubits area should be made having the two pillars decorated with green tree branches.

## \|\| 3.176.18-21 \|\|

*tanmadhye vedikāṃ kuryātpaṃcahastāmalakṛtām \|*  
*vitānamupariṣṭācca puṣpamālāvalaṃbitum \|\| 18 \|\|*

*hiraṇyagarbhaṃ tanmadhye prathame'hani kalpayet \|*  
*tasya pramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmi rūpaṃ vai sthaṃḍilodbhavam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*śilpinaṃ pūjayetpūrvaṃ vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaistathā \|*  
*brāhmaṇānvācayetpaścāttataḥ karma samārabhet \|\| 20 \|\|*

*suvarṇena saṃśuddhena śaktitaḥ kārayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*aṃgulāni catuḥṣaṣṭirdairghyaṃ ca parikīrtitam \|\| 21 \|\|*

18-21. In the middle of it, a pedestal of five cubits should be made over which a beautiful canopy should be raised. It should be painted with the figures of the sacred personalities. On the first day, in the centre of it, Hiranyagarbha should be consecrated. I am speaking about the size of the same, who were born in the high lands. The performer should initially worship the artisans giving the costumes and ornaments and then make the Brāhmaṇas to recite the welfare mantras. The yajna should be started thereafter. The learned person should make an image of pure gold as per one’s means, of the height of sixty four angulas.

## \|\| 3.176.22-24 \|\|

*tribhāgahīnaṃ vadane mūle tasyārddhavistaram \|*  
*vartulaṃ karṇikākāraṃ cārugraṃthivivarjitam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*pidhānamupariṣṭācca kartavyaṃ cāṃgulādhikam \|*  
*astrāṇi daśa kurvīta nālaṃ sūryaṃ ca kāṃcanam \|\| 23 \|\|*

*dātraṃ sapaṭṭikaṃ caiva sarvopaskaraṇānvitam \|*  
*sūcīkṣuraśca haimāni tatsarvaṃ parikalpayet \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. The face should be of a quarter size of the total height of the image which should be round in shape. The image should be free from flower plants, etc. besides the knots. For the covering of the image, a coverage of the size of two angulas greater than the image should be made and ten weapons should be provided to the same: viz., a tubular stalk, the sun, gold, a belt with all the equipments of charity, needle, dagger, all made of gold should be used in decorating the image.

## \|\| 3.176.25-27 \|\|

*pārśvataḥ sthāpayettasya hemadaṃḍakamaṃḍalū \|*  
*chatrikāpādukāyugmaṃ vajravaiḍūryamaṃḍitam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvā garbhaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*brahmaghoṣeṇa mahatā śaṃkhatūryaraveṇa ca \|\| 26 \|\|*

*hastinā śakaṭenātha rājanbrahmarathena vā \|*  
*ānayenmaṃḍapaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇamataṃdritaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. At the back of it, the Hema-danda, Kamandalu, umbrella and vajra should be decorated with lapis lazuli, which should also decorate the wooden sandals. With such type of arrangements, one should be accompanied with the musical instruments like conches and trumpets etc. The image should be brought in the pavilion by means of a cart or a Brahma-ratha.

## \|\| 3.176.28-31 \|\|

*tiladroṇoparigataṃ vedīmadhye'dhivāsayet \|*  
*samālabhya punaḥ sarvaṃ kuṃkumena sugaṃdhinā \|\| 28 \|\|*

*kauśeyavāsasī śubhre tatastaṃ paridhāpayet \|*  
*samaṃtātpuṣpamālābhiḥ pūjayedbhaktitaḥ sudhīḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*dhūpaiḥ sudhūpitaṃ kṛtvā maṃtrametamudīrayet \|*  
*bhūrlokapramukhālokāstava garbhe vyavasthitāḥ \|\| 30 \|\|*

*brahmādayastathā devā namaste bhuvanodbhava \|*  
*namaste bhuvanādhāra namaste bhuvaneśvara \|\| 31 \|\|*

28-31. The Vedi should be made over a heap of sesamum seeds. The vermilion and fragrant material should be plastered over it and then it should be covered with five silken clothes. It should further be adorned with the flower garlands and the incense should be offered with devotion. Then reciting the mantras, the worship should be done. О Bhuvanodbhava, the prominent lokas like Bhuloka and others, besides the gods like Brahma and others, are lodged in you. Therefore, salutation to you. Salutation to base of the universe. Salutation to you.

## \|\| 3.176.32-35 \|\|

*namo hiraṇyagarbhāya garbhe yasya pitāmahaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā tu tau rātrimadhivāsayet \|\| 32 \|\|*

*vedyāścaturdiśaṃ caiva kuṃḍāni parikalpayet \|*  
*catvāri caturasrāṇi teṣu homo vidhīyate \|\| 33 \|\|*

*catuścāraṇikāstatra brāhmaṇā maṃtrapāragāḥ \|*  
*homaṃ kuryurjitātmāno mauninaḥ sarva eva te \|\| 34 \|\|*

*sarvābharaṇasaṃpannāḥ sarve cāhatavāsasaḥ \|*  
*tāmrapātradvayopetā gaṃdhapuṣpādipūjitāḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

32-35. In whose belly the lord Brahma is lodged, salutation to him. Thus performing the puja the adhivasa should be performed at night. Four square altars should be made on the four comers of the pedestal or vedi, in which the homa has to be performed. The four Carana (bards) Brahmanas, who are well-versed in the mantras are respectable, adorable and well- disciplined, and they should perform the homa silently. All these Brahmanas should be adorned with all the ornaments. Besides that, each one of these Brahmanas should be presented with two copper plates each.

## \|\| 3.176.36-38 \|\|

*vedyāḥ pūrvottare bhāge grahavediṃ prakalpayet \|*  
*tatra grahāṃllokapālānbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān \|\| 36 \|\|*

*pūjayetsvarṇaghaṭitānpuṣpadhūpavilepanaiḥ \|*  
*patākābhiralaṃkṛtya maṃḍapaṃ toraṇaistathā \|\| 37 \|\|*

*kuṃbhadvayaṃ ca dvāreṣu sthāpayedratnasaṃyutam \|*  
*tulāpuruṣamaṃtraiśca lokapālabaliṃ kṣipet \|\| 38 \|\|*

36-38. Towards the north-east of the pedestal, the planets should be drawn in which the Navagrahas, Lokapalas, Brahma, Viṣṇu and Mahesvara should be represented in the form of gold images. They should then be worshipped offering flowers, incense, beside the pastes etc. Thereafter, one should enter the mandapa well decorated with flags and arches. At each one of the entrance gates of the pavilion, two pitchers should be consecrated. In each one of the pitchers, the gems should be placed.

## \|\| 3.176.39-44 \|\|

*pālāśyaḥ samidhastatra praśastā homakarmaṇi \|*  
*caruścaivendradaivatyastilā gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā \|\| 39 \|\|*

*svaliṃgairhomayetpūrvaṃ maṃtrairvyāhṛtibhiḥ pumān \|*  
*ayute dve ca homasya saṃkhyāmāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*yajamānastataḥ snātvā śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*bhaktyā hiraṇyagarbhaṃ ca parvakāle samarcayet \|\| 41 \|\|*

*namo hiraṇyagarbhāya viśvagarbhāya vai namaḥ \|*  
*carācarasya jagato gṛhabhūtāya te namaḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*mātrāhaṃ janitaḥ pūrva martyadharmāsurottama \|*  
*tvadgarbhasaṃbhavādadya divyadeho bhavāmyaham \|\| 43 \|\|*

*ityuccārya svayaṃ bhaktyā kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇām \|*  
*kṣīrājyadadhisaṃpūrṇaṃ tadgarbhaṃ praviśedbudhaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

39-44. Reciting the mantras of tula-purusa, the offerings should be made to the Lokapalas. Thereafter, in the performance of homa, the praiseworthy twigs of the palasa tree should be used, while making an offering for Indradeva. The caru should also be offered, besides the sesamum seeds and cow’s ghi. By reciting the first Lingatmaka mantra, the offerings should be made for Vyahrtis. The people of high learnings have prescribed the number of the offerings to be made in the homa as twenty thousand for the purpose. Thereafter, the yajamana should take bath in early hours, clad himself in white clothes and then offer salutation to Hiranyagarbha, Visvagarbha - the abode of all the mobile and immobile beings of the worlds “O best of the gods, earlier I had been born out of the womb of my mother, but presently, I am going to be reborn out of your womb.” Thus speaking, the yajamana with utmost forth and devotion, should pour the milk, curd, ghi and then enter the womb.

## \|\| 3.176.45-49 \|\|

*sauvarṇaṃ dharmarājaṃ tu savye kṛtvā kare tataḥ \|*  
*bhāskaraṃ dakṣiṇe caiva muṣṭiṃ baddhvā prayatnataḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*jānvoraṃtarataścaiva śiraḥ kṛtvā samāhitaḥ \|*  
*ucchvāsapaṃcaka tiṣṭheccetasā ciṃtayañchivam \|\| 46 \|\|*

*garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmaṃtonnayanaṃ tathā \|*  
*kuryurhiraṇyagarbhasya tataste dvijapuṃgavāḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*jātakarmādikāḥ kuryuḥ kriyāḥ ṣoḍaśa cāparāḥ \|*  
*tata utthāya niḥsṛtya punaḥ kuryātpradakṣiṇām \|\| 48 \|\|*

*tāvanmukhaṃ na paśyeta kasyacinnṛpasattama \|*  
*sauvarṇā pṛthivī yāvanna dṛṣṭā spaṣṭacakṣuṣā \|\| 49 \|\|*

45-49. The gold image of Dharmaraja should be placed to the left, while that of the Sun should be placed to the right hand tightly. The head should rest in between the two knees. Then breathing five times, one should devote his mind to Siva and remain in that position. Thereafter, the learned Brahmanas should perform the conception ceremony and other samskaras. О best of kings, thereafter, one should get out (of the garbha) and make a round of it. Then till such time the gold image with daksina becomes visible, upto that time he should not look at anyone else.

## \|\| 3.176.50-52 \|\|

*tataḥ snānaṃ prakurvīta brahmaghoṣapuraḥsaram \|*  
*aṣṭau dvijāḥ suvarṇāṃgā sauvarṇaiḥ kalaśaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*raupyairauduṃbarairvāpi mṛṇmayairvā suśobhanaiḥ \|*  
*dadhyakṣatavicitrāṃgairāmrapallavaśobhitaiḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*puṣpairāveṣṭitagrīvairavraṇaiḥ kalaśairdṛḍhaiḥ \|*  
*catuṣkamadhye saṃsthāpya pīṭhamavraṇamuttamam \|\| 52 \|\|*

50-52. Thereafter, he should take his bath with the reciting of the welfare mantras and then eight Brāhmaṇas should be adored with all the ornaments and should carry the pitchers of gold, or silver, or copper, or earthen pitchers filled with curd, rice etc. and decorated with the tender mango shoots at the neck, besides the flower garlands. They should be unbroken and without holes, besides being sound.

## \|\| 3.176.53-56 \|\|

*tatra sthāpya mahābhāga yajamānaṃ dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*devasya tveti maṃtreṇa kuryurasyābhiṣecanam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*adya jātasya teṃ'gāni abhiṣekṣyāmahe vayam \|*  
*divyenānena vapuṣā ciraṃjīvamukhī bhava \|\| 54 \|\|*

*evaṃ kṛtābhiṣekastu yajamānaḥ samāhitaḥ \|*  
*dadyāddhiraṇyagarbhaṃ taṃ sodakenaiva pāṇinā \|\| 55 \|\|*

*tānsaṃpūjya ca bhāvena bahubhyo vā tadājñayā \|*  
*yajñopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ gurave vinivedayet \|\| 56 \|\|*

53-56. They should be consecrated over the pedestal. Then performing the abhiseka, the Brahmanas should recite the welfare mantras and then say - “We are performing abhiseka of the limbs born with you. You should enjoy the long life and remain comfortable.” After the abhiseka of the yajamana is thus performed, he should give away in charity the Hiranyagarbha pitcher, having been filled with water. Thereafter, lovingly adoring the yajna priests, all the materials of the yajna should either be given over to the preceptor or distributed to the other Brahmanas, as per the desire of the preceptor.

## \|\| 3.176.57-62 \|\|

*pādukopānahau caiva cchatracāmarabhājanam \|*  
*anyeṣāṃ caiva viprāṇāṃ ye ca tatra sabhāsadaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ caiva pradātavyaṃ dānaṃ cātra viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca dātavyaṃ sārvakāmikam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*annasatraṃ ca kartavyaṃ yāvaddānaparigrahaḥ \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu dānametatprayacchati \|\| 59 \|\|*

*sa kulaṃ tārayetsarvaṃ devalokaṃ sa gacchati \|*  
*vimānavaramāruhya pañcayojanavistṛtam \|\| 60 \|\|*

*vāpīkūpataḍāgādyairjalasthānairalaṃkṛtam \|*  
*udyānaśatasaṃsthānaṃ padmākaraniṣevitam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*prāsādaśatasaṃkīrṇaṃ varastrīśatasevitam \|*  
*vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgānāṃ śabdairāpūritaṃ mahat \|\| 62 \|\|*

57-62. The footwear (or wooden sandals), the shoes, umbrella, flywhisks and vases should also be given over to the other Brahmanas and the courtiers. The special charities should also be given to destitute, the blind, handicapped and other poor people, besides the food at the end of the yajna. With this process when a person performs the charities, the entire race gets mounted over a plane, which is five yojanas in area and travels to the place of gods, which is decorated with the enough of wells, step-wells, tanks, full of lotus flowers, hundreds of palaces, where hundreds of divine damsels remain anxious to serve the person. The place echoes with the sound of the playing of vina, flute, cymbals.

## \|\| 3.176.63-65 \|\|

*bhūmayo yatra rājendra divyā maṇimayāḥ śubhāḥ \|*  
*vedikābhirvicitrābhiḥ śobhitaṃ bhāskaraprabham \|\| 63 \|\|*

*dhṛtaṃ stambhasahasreṇa sukṛtaṃ viśvakarmaṇā \|*  
*patākābhirvicitrābhirvajraiśca samalaṃkṛtam \|\| 64 \|\|*

*tadāruhya vimānāgryaṃ vidyādharagaṇairyutam \|*  
*sa yāti lokaṃ śakrasya śakreṇa saha modate \|\| 65 \|\|*

63-65. The land of the palace is gold like, divine and auspicious. It has many pedestals of astonishing types, which illumine like the Sun. At the time of its construction, Visvakarma had erected several of the pillars in it. It is adorned with diamonds and astonishing types of banners. Having been mounted over such a type of plane, together with the Vidyadharas, the donor reaches Indraloka and enjoys all the pleasure with Indra, there.

## \|\| 3.176.66-68 \|\|

*manvantaraśate jāte karmabhūmau prajāyate \|*  
*jaṃbūdvīpamaśeṣaṃ tu bhuṃkte divyaparākramaḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*dhārmikaḥ satyaśīlaśca brahmaṇyo guruvatsalaḥ \|*  
*daśa janmrānyasau rājā jāyate rogavarjitaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

*yastvidaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā rahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam \|*  
*so'pi varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ suraloke mahīyate \|\| 68 \|\|*

66-68. The donor enjoys all the comforts there upto a period of a hundred Manvantaras. He is reborn on earth and with his divine strength, he enjoys the pleasures of the entire Jambudvipa. He functions as a king for ten births, being a spiritual ruler, having Brahma-tejas, devoted to his preceptor and with a healthy body. One who listens to these secrets, he has his sins destroyed and is adorned in the heaven for a hundred years.

## \|\| 3.176.69 \|\|

*garbhaṃ hiraṇyaracitaṃ vidhivatpraviśya saṃskārasaṃskṛtatanuḥ punareva tasmāt \|*  
*niḥsṛtya taddvijavarāya nivedya bhaktyā mārtaṇḍavaddivi virājati divyadehaḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Thus entering in the womb of gold and after his emerging out of the same, all his worldly rites are performed. Thereafter, the golden egg should be given over with devotion to the excellent Brahmana, by which the donor achieves the body which shines like the Sun.

## Chapter 177. Giving away of a golden globe in charity

## \|\| 3.177.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*agastyena purā gīto dānānāṃ vidhiruttamaḥ \|*  
*śṛṇu tvaṃ rājaśārdūla kathyamānaṃ mayādhunā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*yena dattena rājendra sarvaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohati \|*  
*mānasaṃ vācikaṃ vāpi kāyikaṃ ca sudustaram \|\| 2 \|\|*

*maṃgalyaṃ maṃgalaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu cottamam \|*  
*dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ paralokabhayāpaham \|*  
*brahmāṃḍaṃ kāṃcanaṃ kṛtvā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О lion among the kings in ancient times, Agsatya had spoken about the glory of the giving away of the charities, which is going to be repeated by me before you. You please listen. О king, the process by which the sins committed with body, speech or mind get destroyed and earns for the donor the best of welfare and is the best of all the charities, besides enhancing the glory, by which cereals and the longevity of life increases and serves as the danger for the enemies, the same is being narrated by me. You please listen. An excellent figure of globe should be made in gold.

## \|\| 3.177.4-6 \|\|

*devāsuramanuṣyaiśca gandharvoragarākṣasaiḥ \|*  
*saṃyuktaṃ ca nadībhiśca samudraiḥ parvataistathā \|*  
*vimānaśatakoṭībhirbhūṣitaṃ cāpsarovaraiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*diggajāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ madhyasthitacaturmukham \|*  
*śivācyutārkaśikharamumālakṣmīsamanvitam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tasyāṃge kalpayedrājanbhuvanāni caturdaśa \|*  
*vitasteraṃgulaśataṃ yāvadāyāmavistaram \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. The Devas, Asuras, humans, Gandharvas, Nagas, Raksasas, the rivers, the oceans, mountains, hundreds of excellent planes, the nymphs, the eight elephants of the directions with Brahma in the middle of them, besides the other gods like Siva, Viṣṇu, Surya at the top of it, and the goddess like Uma and others should also be shown. О king, fourteens bhuvanas should be lodged in it, while making the globe. It should be of the size of a hundred fingers.

## \|\| 3.177.7-9 \|\|

*kuryādviṃśatpalādūrdhvamāsahasrācca bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*śakaladvayasaṃyuktaṃ puṭākāraṃ susaṃhitam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*śilpinā vihitaṃ yasmādbrahmāṃḍaṃ sarvakāmadam \|*  
*ayane viṣuve caiva caṃdrādityagrahe tathā \|\| 8 \|\|*

*anyeṣvapi tu kāleṣu śraddhāvittasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*puṣpamaṃḍapikāṃ kṛtvā tatra saṃsthāpayedbudhaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

7-9. The gold weighing from twenty palas to a thousand palas should be used in the making of the globe. It should have two parts. It should be made by carrying it up in a circular way. The artisan (or goldsmith) should be engaged in the making of the globe, which leads to the fulfilling of all the desires. The globe should be established in а mandapa with devotion and faith on an auspicious day, or at the end of a half year, or equinox on the solar or the lunar eclipses.

## \|\| 3.177.10-11 \|\|

*tiladroṇoparigataṃ kaṃkumakṣodacarcitam \|*  
*vāso yugmena saṃchādya puṣpagandhādhivāsitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tasya dikṣu ca sarvāsu pūrṇakumbhāṃśca vinyaset \|*  
*aṣṭādaśaiva cānyāni droṇamātrāṇyathāharet \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. It should be placed over a heap of sesamum seeds measuring a drona (wooden trough). It should be plastered with vermilion and the sandal paste. The pitchers filled with water should be placed on all its sides. Eighteen types of grains measuring a drona each should be collected, the image of globe should be consecrated in a mandapa in the house.

## \|\| 3.177.12-17 \|\|

*gṛhe vā maṃḍape vāpi sthāpayettadvicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*pādukopānahacchatrabhājanāsanadarpaṇaiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*saṃyuktaṃ kārayettatra payasvinyā tathaiva ca \|*  
*kārayetkuṇḍamekaṃ tu hastamātraṃ vidhānataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*catuścāraṇikāstatra homaṃ kuryurdvijottamāḥ \|*  
*sarvābharaṇasampannā susnātāhatavāsasaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*pracareyurdvijāstatra upādhyāyasamanvitāḥ \|*  
*tathā purohitaścaiva rājñā ṣaṣṭho vidhīyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

*itareṣāṃ tu pañcaiva kuryuryajñamataṃdritāḥ \|*  
*grahayajñavidhānena grahāṇāṃ yajña iṣyate \|\| 16 \|\|*

*brahmaviṣṇuśivānāṃ ca tannāmnā juhuyāttilān \|*  
*ayutaṃ homayetpaścānmahāvyāhṛtibhirnṛpa \|\| 17 \|\|*

12-17. The wooden sandals, the footwear, umbrella, vase, seat, mirror and the milk giving cow should be given in charity and thereafter, an altar of a cubit in size should be made in which the four learned Brahmanas, adorned with all the ornaments and clad in new clothes should perform the homa. In the said yajna, besides an Upadhyaya, four other Brahmanas and the king are required to be adored. But in the putra-yajna, only five of the priests are required to participate. During the Graha-yajna, the offerings should be made to the planets and then uttering the names of Brahma, Viṣṇu and Siva, the offerings of sesamum seeds should be given. О king, then uttering the mystic words, a thousand offerings in the fire should be made.

## \|\| 3.177.18-24 \|\|

*rudrajāpastu kartavyastasyaivānaṃtaraṃ dvijaiḥ \|*  
*tataḥ sarvasamāptau tu snātvā śuklāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*brahmāṃḍaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ \|*  
*namo jagatpratiṣṭhāya viśvadhāmne namo'stu te \|\| 19 \|\|*

*vāṅmayāṃta nimagnāya brahmāṃḍa śubhakṛdbhava \|*  
*brahmāṃḍodaravartīni yāni sattvāni kānicit \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tāni sarvāṇi me tuṣṭiṃ prayacchatvatulāṃ sadā \|*  
*brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca lokapālāstathā grahāḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

*nakṣatrāṇi tathā nāgā ṛṣayo marutastathā \|*  
*sarve bhavaṃtu saṃtuṣṭāḥ saptajanmāṃtarāṇi me \|\| 22 \|\|*

*ityuccārya tato dadyādbrahmāṃḍaṃ sarvakāmadam \|*  
*sadakṣiṇaṃ ca taṃ kṛtvā vasu saṃpādayeddvijān \|\| 23 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā dattvā yatpuṇyaṃ syānnarottama \|*  
*tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva gadato mama \|\| 24 \|\|*

18-24. Simultaneously, the recitation of Rudra should also be continued by the Brahmanas. After the conclusion of the rites, the performer should clad himself in white clothes. Getting fully purified and holding flowers in his handcups, the globe should be worshipped by him, saying – “Salutation to the one having absorbed the entire universe in himself, salutation to the abode of the universe. О globe, you form part of literature and your emergence is auspicious for all. All the souls or substances are represented in you. Therefore, you bestow on me the unparallel satisfaction. Let Brahma, Viṣṇu, Rudras, Lokapalas, planets, constellations, serpents, Ṛṣis, Maruts and others remain pleased with me for seven births.” Thus speaking, the globe, with riches and daksina should be given over to a Brahmana. О best of humans, by giving \| away the charities following this process, the merit which is earned by a donor, is going to be spoken by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.177.25-29 \|\|

*āsīdādiyuge rājā sudyumno nāma bhārata \|*  
*nāgāyutabalaḥ śrīmānbahubhṛtyaparicchadaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi kṛtvā rājyamakaṃṭakam \|*  
*tataḥ saṃsthāpya tanayaṃ rājā rājye vanaṃ yayau \|\| 26 \|\|*

*praviśya ca vanaṃ ghoraṃ tapastīvraṃ cacāra ha \|*  
*adhyātmagatitattvajñaḥ karmakāṃḍaṃ visṛjya ca \|\| 27 \|\|*

*kālena mahatā rājā diṣṭāṃtamagamatpurā \|*  
*divyaṃ vimānamāruhya nānā vādyaravākulam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*atītya śakralokādīnbrahmalokamito gataḥ \|*  
*tasyāsanaṃ dideśātha brahmāsuragaṇairvṛtaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

25-29. In earlier times, there once ruled a king named Sudyumna who possessed the strength of ten thousand elephants, besides he was quite intelligent, fortunate and had a large number of servants. After comfortably ruling for three thousand years, the king established his own son on the throne and himself embraced the life of a forest dweller. Reaching the thick forest, the king started performing hard tapas. The king was well-versed in the spiritual thought and therefore, disowning all the activities, he discarded the earth. He boarded the excellent plane and with the playing of the welfare musical instruments, he initially reached Indraloka and from there he arrived in Brahmaloka. With other gods, Brahma offered him the beautiful seat, welcoming him at the same time.

## \|\| 3.177.30-31 \|\|

*divyaṃ kanakacitrāṃgaṃ ratnālaṃkṛtavigraham \|*  
*evaṃ lokavare tasminramamāṇo nṛpottama \|\| 30 \|\|*

*āste cānudinaṃ so'tha divyabhogavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*vasatastasya rājñastu śarīraṃ paritapyate \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. The seat offered to him was decorated with various types of gems. О best of the humans, while staying in an excellent place, the king was gradually deprived of the divine pleasures. While living there, the body of the king started suffering from head.

## \|\| 3.177.32-34 \|\|

*bubhukṣayā naraśreṣṭha tathātyaṃtapipāsayā \|*  
*sa pīḍyamāno brahmāṇaṃ kṛtāṃjalirabhāṣata \|\| 32 \|\|*

*bhagavanbrahmaloko'yaṃ sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*atra sthitaṃ ca māṃ deva kṣuttṛṣṇā ca prabādhate \|\| 33 \|\|*

*kena karma vipākena kṣudhā me nāpasarpati \|*  
*brahmaloke gatasyāpi saṃśayaṃ chettumarhasi \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. О best of the humans, getting upset with hunger and thirst, he said to Brahma with folded hands- “This Brahmaloka is free from all the blemishes, but by living here, I am facing hunger and thirst. О lord, for what fault of mine, I have to face these evil situations? You kindly remove my doubt.

## \|\| 3.177.35-36 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*tvayā hi kurvatā rājyaṃ puṣṭānyaṃgāni pārthiva \|*  
*naiva dattaṃ tu bahulamātmavādaratena vai \|\| 35 \|\|*

*dānaṃ baṃdhātmakaṃ matvā tasmāddattaṃ tvayā na hi \|*  
*jñānādbrahmapadaṃ prāptamadānātkṣutprabādhate \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. Brahma said- While ruling the earth, you developed your own limbs. In spite of your being a spiritual person, you did not perform great charities. You took charities and bondages and did not perform the same. This Brahmaloka has been achieved by you by the spiritual knowledge alone. You are suffering from hunger, for your failing to give away food in charity.

## \|\| 3.177.37 \|\|

*rājovāca \|*  
*bhagavaṃstṛṣāpanuttiḥ syātkathaṃ me parameśvara \|*  
*upadeśapradānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. The king said- О lord Parmesvara, how could I be deprived of hunger and thirst? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 3.177.38-43 \|\|

*brahmovāca \|*  
*bhūyo gatvā mahīṃ rājanbrahmāṃḍaṃ sārvakāmikam \|*
