*prayaccha dvijamukhyānāṃ tena tṛptimavāpsyasi \|\| 38 \|\|*

*ityuktaḥ samyagāgatya martyalokaṃ mahīpatiḥ \|*  
*brahmāṃḍaṃ tu vidhānena brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradattavān \|\| 39 \|\|*

*sa jagāma punaḥ svargaṃ lebhe tṛptiṃ ca śāśvatīm \|*  
*etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ mahādānasya yatphalam \|\| 40 \|\|*

*brahmāṃḍaṃ yaḥ prayaccheta tena dattaṃ carācaram \|*  
*saptāvarānsapta parānsapta caiva parāvarān \|\| 41 \|\|*

*tārayetkulajāndattvā bhaviṣyāṃśca na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*manvaṃtarāṇi ṣaṭtriśadbrahmaloke mahīyate \|\| 42 \|\|*

*punarmānuṣyamabhyetya dhārmiko jāyate kule \|*  
*na dāridyaṃ na ca vyādhiṃ viyogaṃ naiva paśyati \|\| 43 \|\|*

38-43. Brahma said- “You go to the earth again and give away Brahmanda (in gold) to a Brahmana, which is sure to bring you the contentment.” At these words of Brahma, the king returned to the earth and gave away the globe in charity to a Brahmana in an appropriate manner. After return to the heaven, the king achieved the eternal and everlasting satisfaction. Thus, I have narrated to you the great merit one achieves with the giving away of the globe in charity. By giving away of the globe in charity, it is equated with the giving away of the entire mobile and immobile world. There is no doubt about it. A person who does so, redeems the seven earlier and the seven future generations. With the performing of the charity of globe, a man or a woman stays in Brahmaloka for thirty six manvantaras, enjoying all the comforts. In due course of time, he is reborn on earth in a spiritual family. He never suffers by ailments, poverty and separation, nor does he suffer from any evil.

## \|\| 3.177.44-46 \|\|

*nārī vā puruṣo vāpi dānasyāsya prabhāvataḥ \|*  
*yaścaitacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā bhaktānāṃ śrāvayecca yaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*so'pi sadgatimāpnoti kiṃ punaryaḥ prayacchati \|\| 45 \|\|*

*brahmāṃḍakhaṃḍayugalaṃ sakulācalaṃ ca digbhāgasāgarasarovarasiddhajuṣṭam \|*  
*diksaṃkhyayā guṇavatāṃ dvijasattamānāṃ dattvā pumānpadamupaiti pitāmahasya \|\| 46 \|\|*

44-46. A person who speaks the above facts to others or the one who listens to the same with devotion, he attains the beautitude. Then what to speak of the person who performs the charities? Thus two pieces of globe should be made in gold and when given to a Brāhmaṇa, he achieves the Brahmapada. The globe should display all the mountains, directions, oceans and tanks. One who gives away such a globe to a Brāhmaṇa, he definitely achieves Brahmapada.

## Chapter 178. Donating of gold Kalpavṛkṣa

## \|\| 3.178.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhagavāñchaṃkaraḥ pūrvaṃ kṛtodvāho mayā saha \|*  
*ramamāṇastayā sārddhaṃ bahuvarṣagaṇānsthitaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve paraṃ trāsamupāgatāḥ \|*  
*tayorapatyasya bhayāttameva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*vaiśvānaramukhā devā mahādevaṃ trilocanam \|*  
*prasannaścābhavatteṣāṃ vibudhānāṃ trilocanaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – In earlier times, after marrying the goddess Uma, Lord Siva enjoyed conjugal pleasures with her for long. Then getting upset with the birth of a child to the divine couple, all the gods took refuge with lord Siva who is having three eyes, and they pleased him with their prayers.

## \|\| 3.178.4 \|\|

*īśvara uvāca \|*  
*kiṃ bhītāstridaśāḥ sarve kaṃ varaṃ ca dadāmi vaḥ \|*  
*mayi prasanne vibudhā durlabhaṃ hi na kiṃcana \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. Isvara said – О gods, why are you getting frightened? What type of boon is sought by you? Because when I get pleased, nothing remains beyond the reach of a person.

## \|\| 3.178.5-6 \|\|

*devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*bhagavaṃstava saṃyogātpārvatyā saha śaṃkara \|*  
*mogho bhavatu deveśa bhītāḥ sma tanayasya te \|\| 5 \|\|*

*anapatyaśca deveśa bhava bhūtapate sadā \|*  
*aśaktāḥ sma vayaṃ sarve bhavadojo vidhāraṇe \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. The gods said – О lord Siva, let the conjugal pleasures enjoyed by you with Parvati become infructuous. All of us are afraid of your future son. О lord of the earth, you should always be without a son, because all of us are unable to face your lustre or the tejas.

## \|\| 3.178.7-11 \|\|

*śrībhagavānuvāca \|*  
*ataḥ prabhṛtyahaṃ devā ūrdhvaretā vyavasthitaḥ \|*  
*sthāṇuvacca sthitaścāsmi nāma caitadbhaviṣyati \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tataḥ kruddhā umā teṣāṃ devānāṃ vākyamabravīt \|*  
*vitathaṃ putrajaṃ saukhyaṃ bhavadbhirme kṛtaṃ surāḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*yasmāttasmādbhavaṃto'pi na putrāñjanayiṣyatha \|*  
*tataḥ prabhṛti vai devāḥ prasūyaṃte na bhūpate \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dattvā śāpaṃ tato devī devānāmāha śaṃkaram \|*  
*putrajanma mayā prāptaṃ na tāvajjagataḥ pate \|\| 10 \|\|*

*aputrasya gatirnāsti itīyaṃ śrūyate śrutiḥ \|*  
*tadādiśa mahābhāga lokadvayahitaṃ prabho \|\| 11 \|\|*

7-11. Lord Siva said – О gods, from today onwards, I shall remain a celibate person or an abstinent person and I shall also be known as Sthanu. At this, the goddess Uma got enraged and in her anger and utter rage, she cursed the gods – “You have made my pleasure of having a child infructuous. Therefore, you would also not be able to produce the children.” О great king, after pronouncing a curse to the gods, the goddess addressed lord Siva – “O lord of the universe, О excellent one, I could have the comfort of having a rebirth. But the Srutis are of the view that there is no redemption for a person without a son. Therefore, you give a command, which could benefit both the worlds.”

## \|\| 3.178.12-14 \|\|

*bhagavānuvāca \|*  
*aputraḥ puruṣo yaśca nārī vā parvatātmaje \|*  
*sauvarṇastena dātavyaḥ kalpavṛkṣo guṇānvitaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*kṛtrimaṃ vāpi gṛhṇīyādvṛkṣaṃ vā sthāvarādikam \|*  
*jātaputro'tha vā putraḥ putratve parikalpayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tena putravatāṃ lokā devi tasya na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*kalpavṛkṣastu kartavyaḥ śuddhakāṃcanasaṃbhavaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. Siva said – О daughter of Himalaya, a person, without a son, should give away in charity a kalpavṛkṣa tree made of gold. In this way, an artificial grown tree should be conceived as a son and the person is thought to be having a son. There is no doubt about it. Therefore, one should make a kalpavṛkṣa in gold.

## \|\| 3.178.15-17 \|\|

*bahuśākhaḥ suvarṇāṃgopyanekakusumānvitaḥ \|*  
*mahāskaṃdhasvarūpaśca ratnālaṃkṛtavigrahaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*phalāni tasya divyāni sauvarṇāni prakalpayet \|*  
*kuryāviṃśatpalādūrddhvaṃ śaktyā vā nṛpasattama \|\| 16 \|\|*

*dānametatpradātavyaṃ rājataṃ caivamuttamam \|*  
*pravālāṃkurasaṃchannaṃ muktādāmāvalaṃbitam \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. It should have enough of branches and should be shown blossoming with flowers. The trunks and boughs should be decorated with pearls and gems. Its fruits should also be made of gold. The tree should be made in gold or silver and should be twenty palas in weight or could be more. It should be given away in charity. It should be shown sprouting with coral and should be further decorated with the garlands or rosaries of beads, which should be kept on hanging.

## \|\| 3.178.18-21 \|\|

*catuṣkoṇeṣu kurvīta caturaḥ kāṃcanadrumān \|*  
*suvarṇasya pramāṇaṃ ca kathayāmi varānane \|\| 18 \|\|*

*sahasreṇa tadarddhena tasyāpyarddhena vā punaḥ \|*  
*nadyāstīre gṛhe vāpi devatāyatane tathā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*prāgudakpravaṇe deśe maṃḍapaṃ tatra kārayet \|*  
*daśahastapramāṇena daśahastāśca vedikāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*hastamātrapramāṇena kuṃḍamekaṃ suśobhanam \|*  
*āgneyyāṃ kārayedrājanmekhalāmupalepanam \|\| 21 \|\|*

18-21. There should be a golden tree on the four comers of the said tree. I am now going to tell you about the influence of the gold used for the purpose. You please listen. A pavilion of a thousand cubits or half of it or alternatively further half of it should be made. It should be lodged to the north-east comer of a river or a temple or a house. A pedestal of ten cubits should be made therein, while the altar should also be of the size of ten cubits. Towards the north-east corner, another mandapa should be erected with the size of ten cubits. Its pedestal too should be of the same size. In the south-east of the same, an altar of a cubit in size should be made and decorated with chains.

## \|\| 3.178.22-25 \|\|

*tatra vai brāhmaṇā yojyā ṛgyajuḥsāmapāṭhakāḥ \|*  
*upadeṣṭā ca tatraiva tṛtīyaḥ paṃcamo'tha vā \|\| 22 \|\|*

*sarvābharaṇasaṃpannāstāmrapatradvayānvitāḥ \|*  
*anuliptāścaṃdanena vastramālyādibhūṣitāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*guḍaprasthopariṣṭācca sthāpayetkalpapādapam \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇuśivopetaṃ paṃcaśākhaṃ sabhāskaram \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kāmadevamadhastācca sakalatra prayojayet \|*  
*saṃtānaṃ saha gāyatryā pūrvato lavaṇopari \|\| 25 \|\|*

22-25. Four learned Brāhmaṇas, well-versed in the Ṛk, Yajuh, Sāma, and Atharva Vedas, should be lodged on the four sides of the same. Besides the reciter or orator, they should be three or five in number. All of them should be adorned with all the ornaments, possessing two copper vases each, making the offering of the sandalwood, besides decorated with garlands of costumes. Thereafter, the kalpavṛkṣa should be established over a heap of jaggery. It should have five branches, connected with Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, Sūrya, etc. Below the same, Rati with Kāmadeva should be lodged. Towards the east, Gāyatrī with her progeny should be lodged over the heap of salt.

## \|\| 3.178.26-29 \|\|

*maṃdāraṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve śriyā saha tathā ghṛte \|*  
*paścime pārijātaṃ tu umayā saha pādapam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*surabhīsaṃyutaṃ tadvattileṣu haricaṃdanam \|*  
*kauśeyavastrasaṃyuktānikṣumālyaphalānvitān \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tathāṣṭau pūrṇakalaśānsamaṃtātparikalpayet \|*  
*agnipraṇayanaṃ kṛtvā adhivāsya ca pādapān \|\| 28 \|\|*

*dhānyāni caiva sarvāṇi samaṃtātparikalpayet \|*  
*nānā bhakṣyāṇi naivedyaṃ sarvaṃ tatra niyojayet \|\| 29 \|\|*

26-29. Towards the right, Śrī Lakṣmī placed over ghi, and over the swallowwort tree to the west, Umā should be consecrated. Then Surabhī should be consecrated over white Hari-candana. The silken cloth should be used to cover all the four sides. Thereafter, the sugarcane, garland, fruit, etc. with eight pitchers should be consecrated. Worshipping the fire and the trees, one should conceive all the grains having been spread all around. Several types of food items as well eatables should also be placed there.

## \|\| 3.178.30-31 \|\|

*dīpamālā vicitrāśca jvālayeta samaṃtataḥ \|*  
*maṃtreṇa yojayitvā tā mayoktena varānane \|\| 30 \|\|*

*kāmadastvaṃ hi devānāṃ kāmavṛkṣastataḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*mayā saṃpūjito bhaktyā pūrayasva manorathān \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. The garland of lamps should be lighted, which should look astonishingly attractive. Thus making all these arrangements, they should be worshipped uttering the mantras. Because of fulfilling all the desires of the gods, you are known as wish fulfilling tree. Therefore, I have also adored you with devotion. Kindly fulfill all my desires.

## \|\| 3.178.32-34 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā jāgaraṃ tatra kārayet \|*  
*śaṃkhavāditranirghoṣairvedadhvanivimiśritaiḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*homaṃ ca brāhmaṇāḥ kuryurmadgatenāṃtarātmanā \|*  
*āghārāvājyabhāgau tu pūrvaṃ hutvā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*talliṃgaiḥ sthāpitāndevānhomenāpyāyayettataḥ \|*  
*mahāvyāhṛtibhiścaiva homaṃ kuryustataḥ param \|\| 34 \|\|*

32-34. After thus performing worship of the trees, one should remain awake during the night. The musical instruments along with conch should be played upon throughout the night, shouting the slogans of victory. At the same time, the reciting of the hymns from the Vedas should also continue. Thereafter, keeping me in their minds, the Brahmanas should also perform the homa. The offerings should be made in favour of goddess and gods who have already been consecrated, besides the mystic symbols etc. The ten thousand offerings of the yajna should be completed.

## \|\| 3.178.35-37 \|\|

*ayutena bhavetsiddhiryajñasya varavarṇini \|*  
*tataḥ prabhāte cotthāya snātvā śuklāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*dadyātparvasamīpe tu kalpavṛkṣaṃ sada kṣiṇam \|*  
*triḥpradakṣiṇamāvṛtya maṃtrametamudīrayet \|\| 36 \|\|*

*namaste kalpavṛkṣāya vitatārthapradāya ca \|*  
*viśvaṃbharāya devāya namaste viśvamūrtaye \|\| 37 \|\|*

35-37. O chaste lady, when the yajna is thus completed, one should take bath the next morning and then clad himself in the white clothes, keeping purity. At the time of the auspicious parva, one should go round the place thrice, after which the kalpavṛkṣa should be given over to Brahman as with daksina saying- “Salutation to the kalpavṛkṣa, which bestows enormous fortunes. Having the universal form, salutation to Visvambhara.

## \|\| 3.178.38-41 \|\|

*yasmāttvameva viśvātmā brahmasthāṇudivākarāḥ \|*  
*mūrtāmūrtaparaṃ bījamataḥ pāhi sanātana \|\| 38 \|\|*

*evamāmantrya taṃ dṛṣṭvā gurave kalpapādapam \|*  
*caturbhyaścāpi ṛtvigbhyaḥ sāmaṃtādīnprakalpayet \|\| 39 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā yastu dānametatprayacchati \|*  
*tasya puṇyaphalaṃ devi śṛṇuṣva gadato mama \|\| 40 \|\|*

*vimānavaramāruhya sūryatejaḥsamaprabham \|*  
*apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ kiṃkiṇījālamālitam \|\| 41 \|\|*

38-41. You are the soul of the universe, besides being Brahma, Siva and Surya. You are the seed of the visible and invisible beings. Therefore, you kindly protect me. О goddess, by following this method, when the said tree is given away in charity, I am going to speak about the merits which are achieved by a person. You please listen. Boarding a plane having the lustre of the sun, with the nymphs crowding it and which has thousands of small bells issuing sweet sound, the performer reaches the abode of Indra, without any obstruction.

## \|\| 3.178.42-43 \|\|

*yāti lokaṃ sureśasya sarvabādhāvivarji tam \|*  
*punaḥ karmakṣitāvetya jāyate śrotriye kule \|\| 42 \|\|*

*yajvā śūro'pi vidvāṃśca naro bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*punaraṃte prāpnuyādvai lokaṃ devasya śārṅgiṇaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

42-43. Again when he returns to the earth after rebirth, he – the performer of yajnas, becomes a great soul. He becomes a great valorous person, quite learned and highly spiritual person. He gets ultimately absorbed in Viṣṇuloka.

## Chapter 179. Donation of Kalpa-lata

## \|\| 3.179.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*bhagavansarvabhūteśa sarvalokanamaskṛta \|*  
*anugrahāya lokānāṃ kathayasva mamāparam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*niṣpāpo jāyate yena āyuṣā yaśasā śriyā \|*  
*tanme kathaya deveśa dānaṃ vratamathāpi vā \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said – О lord, you are the master of all the living beings. The entire universe offers salutation to you. Therefore, for the welfare of the people, you kindly enlighten me on another issue. О Devesa, you kindly tell me the way out by which, a person getting free from all the sins, earns long life, glory and the fortunes?

## \|\| 3.179.3-8 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi tava lokahitepsayā \|*  
*yenopāyena jāyaṃte sabhāgyā mānavā bhuvi \|\| 3 \|\|*

*na vratairnopavāsaiśca na tīrthagamanairapi \|*  
*mahāpathādimaraṇairna yajñairna śrutena ca \|\| 4 \|\|*

*prāpyate mama loko'yaṃ duṣprāpyastridaśairapi \|*  
*pārtha snehānmahābhāga pravakṣyāmi hitaṃ tava \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vakṣye kalpalatādānaṃ śobhanaṃ vidhipūrvakam \|*  
*sarvaṃ pūrvavidhānaṃ ca tatra tantre prakalpayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*dikpālebhyo baliṃ tatra kṣipedvai vidhipūrvakam \|*  
*āghārāvājyabhāgau tu pūrvaṃ hutvā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tato grahamakhaṃ kuryāddhomaṃ vyāhṛtibhistataḥ \|*  
*ayutenaiva homasya samāptiriha kathyate \|\| 8 \|\|*

3-8. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О king, the method by which a person becomes a lord on earth, the same is being revealed by me to you for the welfare of the people. My place cannot be achieved by fasting, going on pilgrimage, death at an extremely holy place, performing of the yajnas, besides the reciting of the Vedas. It is beyond the reach of the gods even. О great Partha, but because of my attachment with you, I am going to speak to you about the same. It is known as the donation of Kalpalatd-ddna or donation of the wish fulfilling creeper and it should be performed in an appropriate manner. In this particular tantra, the same procedure that has been spoken earlier, has to be followed. The offering to the Lokapalas should be made in an appropriate manner, besides the offerings in ghi. Then uttering the mystic mantras, the offerings have to be made. In this particular yajna, ten thousand offerings have to be made in the fire.

## \|\| 3.179.9-11 \|\|

*tataḥ sarvasamīpe tu snātaḥ śuklāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*puṣpadhūpairathābhyarcya vāsobhiḥ saphalākṣataiḥ \|*  
*tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya maṃtrānetānudīrayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

*namo namaḥ pāpavināśinībhyo brahmāṃḍalokeśvarapālanībhyaḥ \|*  
*āśāśatādhikyaphalapradābhyo digbhyastathā kalpalatāvadhūbhyaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yā yasya śaktiḥ paramā pradiṣṭā vede purāṇe surasattamasya \|*  
*tāṃ pūjayāmīha pareṇa sāmnā sā me śubhaṃ yacchatu tāṃ nato'smi \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. Taking bath, one should clad himself in bright clothes. Then with a purified mind and body, the flowers, incense, unbroken rice, costumes and fruits should be offered and then worship should be carried out. Thereafter, one should go round, uttering the mantras- “I offer my salutation to the destroyer of the sins and nourisher of the globe, besides Lokesvara again and again. She bestows hundreds of rewards and is visible as Kalpalata in all the directions. In the Purana, she has been adored as Sakti. I am worshipping her with all humility, offering my salutation to her at the same time. Let her bestow auspiciousness on me”.

## \|\| 3.179.12-14 \|\|

*evamuccārya tāḥ sarvā brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet \|*  
*daśāśāḥ parayā bhaktyā tāstāḥ saṃkalpya cetasi \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tataḥ kṣamāpayedviprānpraṇipatya sadakṣiṇān \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu dānametatprayacchati \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tasya puṇyaphalaṃ rājankathyamānaṃ nibodha me \|*  
*iha loke sa vijayī dhanavānputravānbhavet \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. Reciting the mantras, he should give away the ten daksinas with mental resolve to the Brāhmaṇas. Thus, the performer should perform the act of charity following the prescribed rules. О king, with the following of this process, the merit earned by a person is going to be spoken by me. He remains always victorious in this world, besides being wealthy and has sons.

## \|\| 3.179.15-18 \|\|

*mṛto lokādhipapure pratimanvataraṃ vaset \|*  
*mahāśaktivṛtaḥ paścādetya rājanrasātalam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*jitasarvamahīpālaścakravartī bhavedbhuvi \|*  
*yā ca nārī mahārāja dānametatprayacchati \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sā cakravartinaṃ putraṃ sūte śaktisamanvitam \|*  
*yaśca paśyeddīyamānaṃ dattaṃ yaścānumodate \|\| 17 \|\|*

*śṛṇoti vācyamānaṃ ca sopi pretya vimucyate \|\| 18 \|\|*

15-18. Ultimately, at the time of death, he becomes a dweller of Indraloka. With his enormous strength, he becomes a cakravarti king. О king, a woman who performs this yajna, she produces an extremely powerful and influential son, who becomes a cakravarti king. At the time of giving away of the charity, a person who observes the proceedings or supports it or listens to it’s performance, he is relieved of all his sins.

## \|\| 3.179.19 \|\|

*yāḥ śakravahniyamanairṛtapāśahastā vāteṃdurājaśivakeśavaśaṃbhuśaktyaḥ \|*  
*tā vai prapūjya daśakalpalatā dvijebhyo dehi trilokavijaye yadi te'sti buddhiḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. In case you are desirous of conquering the entire world, then you should worship kalpalata which is the form of Indra, Agni, Yama, Nairrti, noose, Vayu - the Windgod, the Moon, Siva, Kesava and their Saktis in an appropriate manner. It should then be given over to the Brahmanas.

## Chapter 180. Giving away of the elephants and horses in charity

## \|\| 3.180.1-3 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*bhagavankṣatriyaiḥ śūraiḥ svavīryopāttasaṃcayaiḥ \|*  
*kāni dānāni deyāni pavitrāṇi śubhāni ca \|\| 1 \|\|*

*anyairvā puruṣaiḥ kṛṣṇa adharmabhayabhīrubhiḥ \|*  
*grahapīḍāṅisaṃtaptairduḥsvapnādyupatāpitaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*iha loke pare caiva vihitaṃ sarvakāmadam \|*  
*viśeṣavihitaṃ dānaṃ kathayasva mahāmate \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Yudhisthira said- О lord Kṛṣṇa, when the religious-minded people or the valorous Ksatriyas and other people become disturbed from domestic painful situations or witnessing the evil dreams, what type of auspicious charities should be performed by them which should fulfill the desires in the present as well as in the future world? You kindly inform me about some special charity to be made in this connection.

## \|\| 3.180.4-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu bhūpāla bhadraṃ te dānadharmamanuttamam \|*  
*viśeṣeṇa mahīpānāṃ hitāya ca na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dānāni bahurūpāṇi nānāśāstroditāni ca \|*  
*godānādīni rājendra pradhānāni na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kiṃ tu pradhānamekaṃ te dānaṃ vakṣyāmi bhārata \|*  
*vairocanāya yatsarvaṃ śukraḥ provāca bhārata \|\| 6 \|\|*

4-6. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О lord of earth, I am speaking to you about a charity, which is most beneficial for the ruling class. Though the scriptures have mentioned of several types of the charities like the cows and others, there is no doubt about it, but the one which is now being mentioned by me is the most prominent of all, which had been revealed by Sukracarya to Vairocana Bali.

## \|\| 3.180.7-10 \|\|

*śukra uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu daityapate dānaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|*  
*ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva grahapīḍā sudāruṇāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*yena dattena naśyaṃti puṇyamāpnoti cottamam \|*  
*kārttikyāmayane caiva grahaṇe śaśisūryayoḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*dānametatpradātavyaṃ viṣuve sūryasaṃkrame \|*  
*puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*saṃsthāpya dārujaṃ divyaṃ hemapaṭṭairalaṃkṛtam \|*  
*rathaṃ sucakrākṣadharaṃ yugayoktrasamanvitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. Sukra said – О lord of the daityas, I am speaking to you about a charity which removes all the sins, diseases, ailments, terrific domestic pains and it further yields great merits. On the full moon day of the month of Kartika, at the end of half year, on solar or lunar eclipses, on equinox, on the first day of the sun or on some auspicious day, shedding away the anger and controlling all the sense organs, a chariot made of wood should be built which should be divine, covered with the cloth of golden colour, quite strong with well built wheels and should have the rope as well as the yoke.

## \|\| 3.180.11-13 \|\|

*suvarṇadhvajasaṃyuktaṃ sitāsitapatākinam \|*  
*puṣpaprakarasaṃkīrṇe prāgudakpravaṇe śubhe \|\| 11 \|\|*

*nadyāstīre'tha vā goṣṭhe vicitre vā gṛhāṃgaṇe \|*  
*rathasya pūrvabhāge tu kṛtvā vedīmanuttamām \|\| 12 \|\|*

*purāṇavedavidyāvānvinayācārasaṃyutaḥ \|*  
*tasyāṃ saṃsthāpayeddevānbrahmādīnkathayāmi te \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. It should be decorated with the flags of golden and other colours, along with various types of flowers. At some auspicious place habituated by noble people or to the north-east of the bank of a river, an excellent pedestal should be made. Thereafter, the yajamana, who is well-versed in the worship of Vedas and Puranas, and on whom the gods are quite humble, besides possessing good conduct, should establish the gods like Brahma and others over the pedestal. I am going to speak about them.

## \|\| 3.180.14-17 \|\|

*madhye brahmā pratiṣṭhāpyaḥ pūjayetpraṇavena tam \|*  
*viṣṇuruttarataḥ sthāpyaḥ pauruṣeṇa tamarcayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sūktena rudraṃ raudreṇa dakṣiṇasyāṃ samarcayet \|*  
*grahānsūryamukhāṃścaiva vidhivatpūjayettathā \|*  
*puṣpairgaṃdhaiḥ phalairbhakṣyairdīpamālābhireva ca \|\| 15 \|\|*

*pūjayedgaṃdhakusumaiḥ śvetavastraiḥ sacaṃdanaiḥ \|*  
*śaṃkhabherīmṛdaṃgānāṃ śabdaiḥ sarvatragāmibhiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*brahmaghoṣavimiśraiśca kārayeta mahotsavam \|*  
*kuṃḍaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena hastamātrapramāṇataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

14-17. In the middle of the pedestal, Brahma is to be lodged who should be worshipped with Omkara mantra. Lord Viṣṇu should be lodged to the north who should be worshipped reciting the hymns from the Purusa-sukta. Rudra should be lodged towards the south and worshipped with the reciting of the mantras from the Rudra-sukta. Similarly, gods like Surya and others should be appropriately worshipped offering flowers, fragrance, eatables, fruits, lamps, fragrant flowers, white costumes, the sandal paste etc. The musical instruments like the conch, trumpets should be played upon. Tumultuous sound should be created with Brahmaghosa. The puja should thus be performed.

## \|\| 3.180.18-21 \|\|

*āgneyyāṃ diśi rājeṃdra brāhmaṇāṃstatra pūjayet \|*  
*catuścāraṇikānviprānpūjitānbrahmabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*caturoṣṭau mahārāja gurureko'thavā bhavet \|*  
*homopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ melayitvā tilānghṛtam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryādyathāvadvidhipūrvakam \|*  
*āghārāvājyabhāgau tu hutvā prāgvacca tau tataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*viṣṇave śitikaṇṭhāya maṃtraiḥ pūrvoditaiḥ śubhaiḥ \|*  
*grahayajñoditaiścaiva grahāṇāṃ homa iṣyate \|\| 21 \|\|*

18-21. Towards the south-east direction, an altar of a single cubit should be made and four Brahmanas well-versed in the Vedas should be adored offering the white costumes to them, besides the ornaments. They should then be lodged there. О great king, there should be four or eight Brahmanas present there, in addition to the preceptor. All the materials like the sesamum seeds, ghi etc. should be collected for the use in homa and one should perform the homa appropriately. The offering of Ajyabhaga should be made. Thereafter, Viṣṇu and Siva should be worshipped with the reciting of the mantras. The planets should also be worshipped in the domestic yajnas, making the offerings with the reciting of the mantras.

## \|\| 3.180.22-27 \|\|

*evaṃ yajñavidhiṃ kṛtvā yajamāno dvijaiḥ saha \|*  
*yojayeta rathe dāṃtau gajau lakṣaṇasaṃyutau \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vicitratanusaṃvītau śubhakakṣau sughaṃṭikī \|*  
*hemapaṭṭaiḥ sutilakaiḥ śobhitau śaṃkhacāmaraiḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*divyamuktāparicchannau divyāṃkuśasamanvitau \|*  
*mahāmātrānvitau caiva sarvābharaṇabhūṣitau \|\| 24 \|\|*

*evaṃ vidhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā rathaṃ taṃ sagajaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*āropayettatastasminbrāhmaṇaṃ śaṃsitavratam \|\| 25 \|\|*

*bhūṣitaṃ kaṇṭhakaṭakaiḥ karṇaveṣṭāṃgulīyakaiḥ \|*  
*āguptacolakacchatra vastrāyudhasamanvitam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*baddhatūṇiṃ dhanuṣpāṇiṃ bahucarmavibhūṣitam \|*  
*khaḍgadhenukayā naddhaṃ hārālaṃkṛtavigraham \|\| 27 \|\|*

22-27. Thus, the process of performing of the yajna should be completed with the Brāhmaṇas. Thereafter, elephants with auspicious symbols should be yoked in a chariot, which should be decorated with different type of costumes. The chariot should be decorated with a bell, golden patta, a beautiful tilakam, the conchs and the flywhisks, besides the garlands of beads. A goad should also be there and the elephant driver should be adorned with all the ornaments. Thus in the decorated chariot, the Brahmanas well-versed in the Vedas should be seated. They should be adorned with gold ornaments. They should wear the garlands of golden flowers, armlets, earrings, rings, long coats, umbrellas, costumes, the weapons with quivers, holding the bow in hands, various types of shields. The swords should be bound with Dhenuka. They should be adorned with garlands.

## \|\| 3.180.28-31 \|\|

*yajamānastataḥ prājñaḥ śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ \|*  
*rathaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*imamuccārayenmantraṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|*  
*kumudairāvaṇau padmaḥ puṣpadaṃto'tha vāmanaḥ \|*  
*supratīkoṃjanaḥ sārvabhaumo'ṣṭau devayonayaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

*teṣāṃ vaṃśaprasūtau tu balarūpasamanvitau \|*  
*tadyuktarathadānena mama syātāṃ varapradau \|\| 30 \|\|*

*ratho'yaṃ yajñapuruṣo brāhmaṇotra śivaḥ svayam \|*  
*mamebharathadānena prīyetāṃ śivakeśavau \|\| 31 \|\|*

28-31. Thereafter, the intelligent yajamana, wearing the white garments, with purity, carrying the hand-cups filled with flowers, should go round the chariot and should say- “Kumuda, Airavana, Padma, Puspadanta, VSmana, Supratika, Anjana and Sarvabhauma are the eight Deva-yonis. Both of you have been born in these races. Therefore, by giving away this chariot to you, both of you bestow boon on me. These are the yajna-purusa. The Brāhmaṇas lodged in the chariot are like lord Siva himself. Therefore, with the giving away of the elephant chariot, let lord Siva and Kesava be pleased with me.”

## \|\| 3.180.32-37 \|\|

*ityuccārya mahābhāge pūjayitvā punaḥpunaḥ \|*  
*āropayettatastasminbrāhmaṇaṃ śaṃsitavratam \|\| 32 \|\|*

*svadāranirataṃ śāṃtaṃ vedavedāṃgapāragam \|*  
*pañcāgnyabhimataṃ caiva avyaṃgaṃ vyādhivarjitam \|\| 33 \|\|*

*punaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya rathasthaṃ dvijasattamam \|*  
*ādvāramanugacchecca praṇipatya gṛhaṃ viśet \|\| 34 \|\|*

*tato yajñāvasāne tu dīnāṃdhādīñjaḍānkṛśān \|*  
*pūjayedvividhairdānairvastragodānabhojanaiḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*anenaiva vidhānena saṃkalpya rathamuttamam \|*  
*kuṇḍamaṃḍapasaṃbhārabhūṣaṇācchādanādikam \|\| 36 \|\|*

*tadeva homadravyaṃ ca homamaṃtrāsta eva hi \|*  
*viśeṣo'śvarathe rājankathyamāno nibodhyatām \|\| 37 \|\|*

32-37. Thus, with the reciting of the mantras and worshipping the deities again and again, the Brahmana should be established therein. The Brahmana so established in the chariot should be well-versed in the Vedas and should have single wife. Serving the five types of Agni, he should not be deformed, besides being free from ailments. Thereafter, going round the Brāhmaṇa lodged in the chariot, the performer should follow him upto the door and offer his salutation to the Brahmana. A t the conclusion of the yajna, charities should be distributed to the destitute, blind, poor and paupers including costumes of various types, eatables and then honour them. By following this process, one should conceive of an excellent chariot (driven by a horse), the altars, pavilion, the decorative ornaments, covering of clothes, beside the sesamum seeds, material for homa and mantras are also there, some peculiarity in the chariot driven by a horse. I am going to speak about the same. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.180.38-40 \|\|

*hayau lakṣaṇasaṃyuktau khalīnālaṃkṛtānanau \|*  
*vicitravastusaṃvītau kaṇṭhābharaṇabhūṣitau \|\| 38 \|\|*

*supragrahayutau yojyau dātā tasminnathottame \|*  
*taṃ pradakṣiṇamāvṛttya maṃtrametamudīrayet \|\| 39 \|\|*

*namostu te vedaturaṃgamāya trayīmayāya triguṇātmakāya \|*  
*sudurgamārge sukhapānapātre namo'stu te vājidharāya nityam \|\| 40 \|\|*

38-40. The horses of high breed should be decorated with the reins etc. Their necks should be decorated with ornaments. The ropes of the reins should be quite attractive and the horses should be yoked to an excellent chariot. The donor then, should go round the chariot reciting the mantra – “Salutation to the horse in the form of the Vedas, which has the three gunas and resembles the Vedas. It can travel through the difficult path with ease. Therefore, I offer my salutation to the same.

## \|\| 3.180.41-43 \|\|

*ratho'yaṃ savitā sākṣādvedāścāmī turaṃgamāḥ \|*  
*aruṇo brāhmaṇaścāyaṃ prayacchaṃtu sukhaṃ mama \|\| 41 \|\|*

*ityuccārya tatastasminrathe brāhmaṇasattamam \|*  
*āropayedgṛhāddvāraṃ yāvadetamanuvrajet \|\| 42 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā yastu dadyādvājirathaṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*tasmādvāharathaṃ rājyaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|\| 43 \|\|*

41-43. This chariot represents the Sun, the horses are the Vedas, while the Brahmana lodged in it represents Aruna. Therefore, let them shower the comforts on me.” Thus speaking, the best of Brahmana should be made to mount the chariot. The donor should then follow it upto the gate. By this process, the chariot of Asvamedha sacrifice known as Vaharatha-rajya when donated by a person, then by so doing, the merit earned by him is going to be narrated by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.180.44-46 \|\|

*sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvāmayavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*manvaṃtaraśataṃ yāvatsarvabhogasamanvitaḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇe vimāne sūryavarcase \|*  
*divyabhogānvitaḥ śrīmānkāmacārī vaseddivi \|\| 45 \|\|*

*puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*putrapautrānvitaścaiva ciraṃjīvī priyātithiḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

44-46. The donor is relieved of all the sins and the diseases and enjoys all the pleasures for hundreds of Manvantaras. He dwells in the heaven, while shining with the nymphs. In due course of time, after the decline of his merits, he appears on earth as a spiritual king who enjoys long life with his sons and grandsons. He also honours the guests.

## \|\| 3.180.47-48 \|\|

*gajenaikena nirdiṣṭaḥ kaścidgajaratho nṛpa \|*  
*ekenāśvenāśvarathaḥ kathyate vedavādibhiḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*dānamaṃtrāsta evoktāḥ phalaṃ tatra nigadyate \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. О king, there could be an elephant chariot with a single elephant and the chariot with a single horse as well. This has been stated by the learned people well-versed in the Vedas. The mantras for donating both the types of the chariots are the same, while the merits so earned are also the same. I am going to speak about the merits of the same.

## \|\| 3.180.49 \|\|

*yacchaṃti ye rathavaraṃ sudhurākṣacakraṃ vikrāṃtavāraṇayutaṃ turagānvitaṃ vā \|*  
*sopaskaraṃ kanakapaṭṭavicitritāgaṃ te syaṃdanena surarājapuraṃ prayāṃti \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. An excellent chariot should be built with two wheels, with all the equipments. The elephant or a horse should be yoked in it. The person who does so, he reaches the place of Indra.

## Chapter 181. Donation of Kala-purusa

## \|\| 3.181.1-2 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*dānānyanyāni me kṛṣṇa kathayasva yadūttama \|*  
*maṃgalyāni pavitrāṇi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca \|\| 1 \|\|*

*saṃsārasāgarottārahetubhūto'si mādhava \|*  
*dharmādharmaparijñāne tvadanyo neha kaścana \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Yudhisthira said – О best of the race of Yadus, О Kṛṣṇa, you speak to me about a charity, which should bestow welfare, besides being auspicious and could remove all the sins. О Madhava, you are the only cause to redeem a person from the ocean of the universe, because none else in this world is aware of good and evil, as you do.

## \|\| 3.181.3-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*dānāni bahurūpāṇi kathitāni mayā tava \|*  
*punareva pravakṣyāmi yadyasti tava kautukam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kathitāni mayā tubhyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yāni ca \|*  
*mahatārthena sidhyaṃti prayacchaṃti mahatphalam \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – In case you are anxious to know about the same, then though I have spoken to you about several types of the charities, but still I am speaking to you on this subject. All the types of the charities about which I have spoken to you and shall tell you further, they get established with great efforts, yielding great merits at the same time.

## \|\| 3.181.5-9 \|\|

*kāmyo dānavidhiḥ pārtha kriyamāṇaḥ prayatnataḥ \|*  
*phalāya munibhiḥ prokto viparīto bhayāya ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

*jñeyaṃ niṣkaśataṃ sarvadāneṣu vidhiruttamaḥ \|*  
*madhyamastu tadardhena tadarddhenāvaraḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*evaṃ vṛkṣaratheṃdrāṇāṃ dhenoḥ kṛṣṇājinasya ca \|*  
*aśaktasyāpi kṛṣṭo'yaṃ paṃcasauvarṇiko vidhiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*ato'nyūnena yo dadyānmahādānaṃ narādhipa \|*  
*pratigṛhṇāti vā tasya duḥkhaśokāvahaṃ bhavet \|\| 8 \|\|*

*ādau tāvatpravakṣyāmi kālākhyaṃ puruṣaṃ tava \|*  
*saptasāgaradānaṃ ca mahābhūtaghaṭantathā \|\| 9 \|\|*

5-9. One should always make all the efforts to make the kamyadana, because the sages have termed the same as fully rewarding. Giving away of a hundred niskas (an ancient gold coin) in a proper way is considered to be the best. By giving half niskas or a quarter of it, is considered to be the charity of lower type. Similarly, giving away in charity the trees, chariots, cows, the skin of the black buck, come under this category. For a person with little means, this is quite painful because the charity below the five gold coins has not been recognized. Therefore, a person who gives away lesser than this amount, the giver and the taker both remain upset and have to face grief. First of all, I shall speak to you about the donating of Kala-purusa, then charity of Sapta-sagara and thereafter, about Mahabhuta-ghata-dana.

## \|\| 3.181.10-15 \|\|

*ardhyapradānamaṃtrokta mātmapratikṛtistathā \|*  
*suvarṇāśvaḥ smṛtaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ suvarṇāśvaratho'paraḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*sarvadānottamaṃ rājankṛṣṇājinamathāṣṭamam \|*  
*viśvacakraṃ ca navamaṃ haimo gajarathastathā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*etatte dānadaśakaṃ vedmi pārthivasattama \|*  
*dehi dāpaya sadbudiṃ dāne nṛpanarottama \|\| 12 \|\|*

*dānādṛte nopakāro vidyate dhanino'paraḥ \|*  
*dīyamāno hi nāpaiti bhūya evābhivardhate \|\| 13 \|\|*

*kūpa ullikhyamāno'pi bhavatyeva bahūdakaḥ \|*  
*puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya bhūmibhāge same śubhe \|\| 14 \|\|*

*caturthyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ viṣṭyāṃ vā pāṃḍunaṃdana \|*  
*pumānkṛṣṇatilaiḥ kāryo raupyadaṃtaḥ suvarṇadṛk \|\| 15 \|\|*

10-15. О king, the aforesaid three types of 1 charities, besides arghya-dana, donating of images, horse of gold or the chariot of gold driven by a horse, the skin of black buck, Visvacakra, besides the gold chariot driven by an elephant, are the various types of charities spoken by the sages. О best of the Parthivas, with the performing of both, one should use his own wisdom. Without the giving of charities, there could be no other alternative, because the article which is given away in charity, instead of getting destroyed it goes on increasing day by day, as with the digging of a well, its water keeps on increasing. Therefore, on an auspicious day, the black sesamum should be spread on earth and a human figure should be created over it, having teeth of silver and the eyes of gold.

## \|\| 3.181.16-19 \|\|

*khaḍgodyatakaro dīrṇo japā kusumakuṃḍalaḥ \|*  
*raktāṃbaradharaḥ sragvī śaṃkhamālāvibhūṣitaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tīkṣṇāsipatradhanuṣā visphāritakaṭītaṭaḥ \|*  
*upānadyugayukto hi kṛṣṇakaṃbala pārśvagaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*gṛhītamāṃsapiṃḍaśca vāme karatale tathā \|*  
*evaṃ vidhaṃ naraṃ kṛtvā gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya gaṃdhakusumairnaivedyaṃ vinivedya ca \|*  
*tilājyaṃ juhuyāttatra tryaṃbaketi ca maṃtrataḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

16-19. The sword should be held in the hand of the figure. Both the ears should be adorned with flowers of China rose. It should be clad in red costumes, adorned with flower garland and garland of conches. It should have sharp sword, besides bow and arrows. It should have long waist, should be wearing shoes, carrying a black blanket and should have a ball of flesh in his left hand. By creating such a human, one should carry the hand-cups filled with flowers, fragrance and eatables, and all of these should be offered. After this worship, the homa should be performed reciting the Trayambaka mantra and the offering of ghi and sesamum seeds should be poured in the fire.

## \|\| 3.181.20-22 \|\|

*svagṛhyoktavidhānena śatamaṣṭottaraṃ yajet \|*  
*yajamānaḥ prasannātmā imaṃ maṃtramudīrayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

*sarvaṃ kalayase yasmātkālastvaṃ tena bhaṇyase \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ tvamasādhyo'si suvrata \|\| 21 \|\|*

*pūjitastvaṃ mayā bhaktyā prārthitaśca tathā sukham \|*  
*yaducyate tava vibho tatkuruṣva namonamaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. Following the provisions of one’s own Grha-sutras, a hundred and eight offerings should be poured in the fire. Thereafter, the donor should recite the mantra with delight – “O Suvrata, you are known as Kala, because you destroy all the people. Therefore, you are beyond the control of Brahma, Viṣṇu and Siva. О excellent one, I have offered prayer to you and worshipped you with devotion. Therefore, you bestow all these comforts to me. Salutation to you again and again.”

## \|\| 3.181.23-25 \|\|

*evaṃ saṃpūjayitvā taṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet \|*  
*brahmāṇaṃ prathamaṃ pūjya vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaistathā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāṃ śaktito dadyātpraṇipatya visarjayet \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu dānametatprayacchati \|\| 24 \|\|*

*nāpamṛtyubhayaṃ tasya na ca vyādhikṛtaṃ bhayam \|*  
*bhavatyavyāhataiśvaryaḥ sarvabādhāvivarjitaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. Thus worshipping Kala-purusa, the figure and the material should be given over to a Brāhmaṇa. But Brahmana should be adored before hand, giving him the costumes and ornaments etc. Daksina should also be given as per one’s means, offering salutation to the Brahmana at the same time. He should then be sent off gracefully. By giving away the charity in an appropriate manner, one does not attract disease, nor does he have to face the untimely death. To the contrary, he achieves an obstructed wealth and all his obstructions are removed.

## \|\| 3.181.26 \|\|

*dehāṃte sūryabhavanaṃ bhittvā yāti paraṃ padam \|*  
*puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*saṃtatyā ca śriyā yuktaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. After his death, he achieves the place of the Sun. At the decline of his merits, he becomes the spiritual king on earth and enjoys all the comforts with his sons and grandsons.

## \|\| 3.181.27 \|\|

*saṃpūjya kālapuruṣaṃ vidhivaddvijāya dattvā śubhāśubhaphalodayahetubhūtaḥ \|*  
*rogāṃtare sakaladoṣamaye ca dehī no vadhyabhāvamupagacchati tatprabhāvāt \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Thus adoring Kala-purusa in a proper way, the same should be given over to a Brahmana. By doing so, the jiva, who has to face the result of his evil and good deeds, he gets relieved of the body having all the blemishes and ailments.

## Chapter 182. Donating seven oceans

## \|\| 3.182.1-8 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi pārthadānamanuttamam \|*  
*saptasāgarakaṃ nāma sarvapāpapraṇāśanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya yugādigrahaṇādikam \|*  
*kārayetsaptakuṇḍāni kāṃcanāni vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*prādeśamātrāṇi tathā ratnimātrāṇi vā punaḥ \|*  
*kuryātsaptaśatādūrdhvamāsahasrācca śaktitaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*saṃsthāpyāni ca sarvāṇi kṛṣṇājinatilopari \|*  
*prathamaṃ pūrayetkuṃḍaṃ lavaṇena vicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*dvitīyaṃ payasā tadvattṛtīyaṃ sarpiṣā punaḥ \|*  
*caturthaṃ tu guḍenaiva dadhnā paṃcamameva ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭhaṃ śarkarayā tadvatsaptamaṃ tīrthavāriṇā \|*  
*sthāpayellavaṇasyāṃte brahmāṇaṃ kāṃcanaṃ śubham \|\| 6 \|\|*

*keśavaṃ kṣīramadhye tu ghṛtamadhye maheśvaram \|*  
*bhāskaraṃ guḍamadhye tu dadhimadhye surādhipam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*śarkarāyāṃ nyasellakṣmīṃ jalamadhye tu pārvatīm \|*  
*sarveṣu sarvaratnāni dhānyāni ca samaṃtataḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

1-8. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – O Partha, I am going to tell you about the charity of the seven oceans, which indeed is the best and removes all the sins. On some auspicious day of the start of the yuga, on the day of eclipse, or on any auspicious occasion, seven altars should be made in gold. In the making of each one of the altars, seven hundred to a thousand palas should be used. All the altars should be placed over the black deer skin. The first altar should be filled with salt; the second with milk; the third with ghi; the fourth with raw sugar; the fifth with curd; the sixth with sugar and the seventh with the water of the holy places. The image of Brahma should be placed close to the altar of salt; the gold image of Kesava with milk; and Mahesvara should be lodged in the altar of ghi. In the altar with raw sugar, the image of Bhaskara should be placed. In the altar filled with curd, the image of Indra should be kept. In the altar of sugar, Laksmi should be kept; while in the altar filled with holy water, the image of Parvati should be placed. Thereafter, in all the sides of the altars, the seven grains and gems should be spread as far as possible.

## \|\| 3.182.9-17 \|\|

*sthāpayetpuruṣaśreṣṭha yathālābhaṃ yathāsukham \|*  
*tataḥ parvasamīpe tu snātaḥ śuklāṃbaro gṛhī \|\| 9 \|\|*

*triḥpradakṣiṇamāvṛtya maṃtrānetānudīrayet \|*  
*namo vaḥ sarvasiṃdhūnāmādhārebhyaḥ sanātanāḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*jaṃtūnāṃ prāṇadebhyaśca samudrebhya namonamaḥ \|*  
*pūrṇāḥ sarve bhavaṃto vai kṣāra kṣīraghṛtaikṣavaiḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*dadhnā śarkarayā tadvattīrthavāribhireva ca \|*  
*tasmādaghaughavidhvaṃsaṃ kurudhvaṃ mama mānadāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*alakṣmīḥ praśamaṃ yātu lakṣmīścāstu gṛhe mama \|*  
*evamuccārya tāndadyādbrāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 13 \|\|*

*ekamevamathābhyarcya puṣpavastravilepanaiḥ \|*  
*bahūnāmetaduddiṣṭaṃ dānamekasya vā punaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*deyaṃ vā sarvasāmānyaṃ kriyāviprānurūpataḥ \|*  
*dānaṃ saptasamudrākhyaṃ yaḥ prayacchati pārthiva \|\| 15 \|\|*

*tasya gṛhānna calati lakṣmīryāvatkulāṣṭakam \|*  
*pūjyamānaḥ suragaṇaiḥ siddhavidyādharoragaiḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*devalokānna cyavate saptamanvatarāṇyasau \|*  
*tataśca vedasaṃskārātparaṃ brahmādhigacchati \|\| 17 \|\|*

9-17. The more the grains are spread, the more benefit would be derived by the performer. Therefore, the grains should be spread as far as possible. At the time of the festival, the performer should take his bath and then clad himself in white clothes and should then go round the altars thrice, uttering – “Salutation to the base of all the oceans, beside being eternal, salutation to you. You are the one who provides life to the living beings. Therefore, salutation to you. You are filled with (the water of) salt, milk, ghi, raw sugar, curd, sugar and the holy water of the sacred places. Therefore, removing all my sins, you kindly destroy the misfortune in my house and make Lakṣmī or fortunes to live in my abode forever.” O Yudhiṣṭhira, with the offering of the prayer like this, (the altars) should be given over to the Brāhmaṇas with respect. As far as possible, the donation should be given to the Brāhmaṇas who are quite active. O Pārthiva, one who performs the charity in this way, the fortunes (Lakṣmī) do not leave his place up to eight future generations. Ultimately, (the said donor), getting served by the Siddhas, Vidyādharas, Nāgas besides the gods, lives in the Devaloka up to seven Manvantaras. After his Vedic initiation, he achieves Brahman.

## \|\| 3.182.18 \|\|

*iti dadāti rasāmarasaṃyutāñchuciravismayadāniha sāgarān \|*  
*analakāṃcanaratnamayānasau padamupaiti hare ramayā vṛtam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. A person who performs the charity of giving away of oceans and donates gold purified with the fire, he achieves Lakṣmī and achieves the place of Hari.

## \|\| 3.182.19 \|\|

*dānaṃ pradhānatarametadatīva vipre proktaṃ yudhiṣṭhira samādhidhiyā viciṃtya \|*  
*haimānvidhāya jaladhīnvitarasva śaktyā prāpnoṣi yena sarasāni samīhitāni \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. О Yudhisthira, the oceans made in gold should be given over to the Brahmanas, as a result of which all the desires of the performer get fulfilled.

## Chapter 183. Donation of Mahabhuta pitcher

## \|\| 3.183.1-8 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi dānamanyattavottamam \|*  
*mahābhūtaghaṭaṃ nāma mahāpātakanāśanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*puṇyāṃ tithiṃ samāsādya svanulipte gṛhāṃgaṇe \|*  
*kārayetkāṃcanaṃ kuṃbhaṃ mahāratnānvitaṃ punaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*prādeśādaṃgulaśataṃ yāvatkuryātpramāṇataḥ \|*  
*śaktyā paṃcapalādūrdhvamāśatācca narottama \|\| 3 \|\|*

*kṣīrājyapūritaṃ kṛtvā kalpavṛkṣasamanvitam \|*  
*padmāsanagatāstatra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*lokapālā mahendrāśca svavāhanasamāsthitāḥ \|*  
*ṛgvedaḥ sākṣasūtraśca yajurvedaḥ sapaṃkajaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vīṇādhārī sāmavedo hyatharvā srakchubhānvitaḥ \|*  
*purāṇavedo varadaḥ sākṣasūtrakamaṃḍaluḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*saptadhānyāni purataḥ sthāpayecchaktito budhaḥ \|*  
*pādukopānahacchatraṃ cāmarāgryāsanāyudhān \|\| 7 \|\|*

*evaṃ prakalpya vidhivanmahābhūtaghaṭaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*guḍasāroparigataṃ mālyavastrairathārcayet \|\| 8 \|\|*

1-8. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – I am now going to tell you about a charity which is known as Mahabhuta-ghata-dana and performing which, one is relieved of the grave sins. On an auspicious day, a golden kalasa should be consecrated in the middle of the courtyard of the house. The pitcher should be filled with the gems. It should be of the size of a hundred angulas and should weigh a hundred and five palas in gold. It should be filled with milked ghi and should be consecrated with the kalpavṛkṣa. Thereafter, (close to it), Brahma should be lodged over the lotus seat, with Viṣṇu and Siva. Besides all the Lokapdlas, Mahendra and other gods should also be lodged there with their vehicles. Thereafter, the Rgveda with Aksa sutra (rosary); Yajurveda with the lotus; Samaveda carrying a vina, besides the Atharvaveda with a rosary and a kamandalu, should be consecrated. The Purdrias should consecrated with Budha, by the learned people. The Mahabhuta-ghata should then be offered the sandals, shoes, umbrella, flywhisk, seat and the weapons. Thereafter, the Mahabhuta-ghata should be consecrated over the raw sugar. And, the garlands and costumes should be offered to it.

## \|\| 3.183.9-11 \|\|

*atha parvasamīpe tu snātvā niyatamānasaḥ \|*  
*triḥ pradakṣiṇamāvṛtya maṃtrametamudīrayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

*yasmānna kiṃcidapyasti mahābhūtairvinā kṛtam \|*  
*mahābhūtamayaścāyaṃ tasmācchāṃtiṃ dadātu me \|\| 10 \|\|*

*atra sannihitā devāḥ sthāpitā viśvakarmaṇā \|*  
*te me śāṃtiṃ prayacchaṃtu bhaktibhāvena pūjitāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. At the time of the festival, one should take bath and observing utmost discipline, he should go round it thrice and say – “Nothing can remain in this world without Mahabhuta. Therefore, let this Mahabhuta bestow peace to me. In this house of Mahabhuta, Visvakarma has established all the gods here. Therefore, getting worshipped from me with devotion, let all the gods bestow peace on me.”

## \|\| 3.183.12-14 \|\|

*ityevaṃ pūjayitvā tu mahābhūtaghaṭaṃ naraḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇaṃ pūjayitvā tu bhūṣaṇācchādanādibhiḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*mahābhūtaghaṭaṃ dadyātparvakāle yatavrataḥ \|*  
*punaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ kṣamāpayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā yaśca dānametatprayacchati \|*  
*ekaviṃśatkulopetaḥ śivaloke prayātyasau \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. After thus adoring the Mahabhuta-ghata, the Brahmana should be adored offering him with the ornaments and costumes, at the time of the festival. Thereafter, one should go round the Brahmana, adore him and send him off gracefully. A person who performs this vrata with the aforesaid process, twenty one generations of his family enjoy stay in the place of Siva.

## \|\| 3.183.15-17 \|\|

*puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*ajeyaḥ śatrusaṃghātairmahābala parākramaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*kṣatradharmarato vidvāndevabrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*aṣṭāpadottamaghaṭaṃ vimalaṃ vidhāya brahmeśakeśavayutaṃ sahalokapālaiḥ \|*  
*kṣīrājyapūrṇavivaraṃ praṇipatya bhaktyā viprāya dehi tava dānaśataiḥ kimanyaiḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. At the decline of the merits in due course of time, the donor becomes a king in this world, who remains invincible and valorous. He remains unshakable in his Ksatriya dharma and is devoted to the gods and the Brahmanas. Thus making the Mahabhuta-ghata which should be the spotless one, it should be adored with Brahma, Viṣṇu and Siva. The ghata which remains filled with ghi and milk, one should offer salutation to it and it should then be given over to a Brahmana with devotion, offering salutation to the same. With the performing of this charity, hundreds of charities when performed, are of no consequence.

## Chapter 184. Giving of a bed in charity

## \|\| 3.184.1-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*śayyādānaṃ pravakṣyāmi tava pāṃḍukulodvaha \|*  
*yaddattvā sukhabhāgī syādiha loke paratra ca \|\| 1 \|\|*

*śayyādānaṃ prayacchaṃti sarvadaiva dvijottamāḥ \|*  
*anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yasmātkonyaḥ paścātpradāsyati \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tāvatsa baṃdhuḥ sa pitā yāvajjīvati bhārata \|*  
*mṛto mṛta iti jñātvā kṣaṇātsneho nivartate \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tasmātsvayaṃ pradātavyaṃ śayyābhojyajalādikam \|*  
*ātmaiva hyātmano bandhuriti saṃciṃtya cetasi \|\| 4 \|\|*

*ātmaiva yo hi nātmānaṃ dānabhogaiḥ samarcayet \|*  
*ko'nyo hitatarastasmātkaḥ paścātpūjayiṣyati \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О born of the race of Pandu, I am now speaking to you about the giving away in charity of bed, by which a person becomes comfortable in this as well as in the future world. Therefore, the excellent Brahmanas always give away the beds in charity, because the life is not eternal and after death, who would be able to accomplish the same? О Bharata, till such time a person remains alive, upto that time alone he is called a brother or a father and after his death, the love for the diseased disappears in a moment. Therefore, only the soul helps the soul. Thus realizing, the bed, food and water etc. should be given over in charity. In case this type of donation is not made, then who else would be a greater well-wisher than this, who would worship after death?

## \|\| 3.184.6-10 \|\|

*tasmācchayyāṃ samāsādya sāradārumayīṃ dṛḍhām \|*  
*daṃtapatracitāṃ ramyāṃ himapaṭṭairalaṃkṛtām \|\| 6 \|\|*

*haṃsatūlīpraticchannāṃ subhagāṃ sopadhānikām \|*  
*pracchādanapaṭīyuktāṃ gaṃdhadhūpādhivāsitām \|\| 7 \|\|*

*tasyāṃ saṃsthāpayeddhaimaṃ hariṃ lakṣmīsamanvitam \|*  
*ucchīrṣake dhṛtaṃ caiva kalaśaṃ parikalpayet \|\| 8 \|\|*

*vijñeyaṃ pāṃḍava sadā sanidrākalpakaṃ budhaiḥ \|*  
*tāṃbūlaṃ kuṃkumakṣodakarpūrāgaru caṃdanam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dīpakopānahacchatracāmarāsanabhojanam \|*  
*pārśveṣu sthāpayecchaktyā saptadhānyāni caiva hi \|\| 10 \|\|*

6-10. A strong bed of wood decorated with the lotus flowers, well built, ornamented with gold, together with soft cushions of cotton of white colour resembling the swans, the beautiful pillows, adorned with a bed-sheet and perfumed with fragrance, incense, should be made. The image of Viṣṇu and Laksmi in gold should be placed over it. Towards the head side, a pitcher filled with ghi should be consecrated. О Pandava, lord Viṣṇu should be conceived to be sleeping over the bed and at the back, the betel, vermilion, camphor, agaru, sandal paste, lamp, shoes, umbrella, flywhisk, seat, eatable food and the seven grains should be placed as per one’s means.

## \|\| 3.184.11-13 \|\|

*śayanasthasya bhavati yadanyadupakārakam \|*  
*bhṛṃgārakādyapuṣpāṇi paṃcavarṇavitānakam \|\| 11 \|\|*

*śayyāmevaṃvidhāṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāyopadāpayet \|*  
*sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya puṇye'hni vidhipūrvakam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*namaste sarvadeveśa śayyādānaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā \|*  
*dehi tasmācchāṃtiphalaṃ namaste puruṣottama \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. At the time of sleeping, the clothes, flowers etc. should also be placed there. The canopy of five colours should be raised over it. On an auspicious day, such a type of bed should be given over to a Brahmana couple after adoring both of them, saying- “O lord of all, О best of the humans, I am donating a bed after decorating it and as per my capacity, therefore, you kindly bestow peace on me as my reward.

## \|\| 3.184.14-20 \|\|

*yathā na kṛṣṇa śayanaṃ śūnyaṃ sāgarajātayā \|*  
*śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā janmanijanmani \|\| 14 \|\|*

*dattvaivaṃ talpamamalaṃ praṇipatya visarjayet \|*  
*ekādaśāhe'pi tathā vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*dadāti yadi dharmārthaṃ mānavo bāṃdhave mṛte \|*  
*viśeṣaṃ cātra rājeṃdra kathyamānaṃ nibodha me \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tenopabhuktaṃ yadvastu kiṃcitpūrvaṃ gṛhe satā \|*  
*tadgātralagnaṃ ca tathā vastravāhanabhājanam \|\| 17 \|\|*

*yadiṣṭaṃ ca tathāsyāsīttatsarvaṃ parikalpayet \|*  
*sa eva puruṣo haimastasyāṃtaṃ sthāpayettathā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*pūjayitvā pradātavyo mṛtaśayyā yathoditā \|*  
*svarge puraṃdaragṛhe sūryaputrālayetha vā \|\| 19 \|\|*

*sukhaṃ vasatyasau jaṃtuḥ śayyādānaprabhāvataḥ \|*  
*pīḍayaṃti na taṃ yāmyāḥ puruṣā bhīṣaṇānanāḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

14-20. As the bed of Viṣṇu in the ocean is never without Laksmi, similarly, in all my future births, my bed should not be without (my spouse) in future births. Accordingly, on an ekadasi day, the spotless bed should be given over in charity with salutation. О Rajendra, at the time of the death of a relative, in case a person gives away a bed in charity for the sake of the deceased, then I am going to relate the special position for the same. You please listen. Whatever ornaments were used by the deceased like gold etc. should be placed over the bed, besides the clothes, vehicles, vases and whatever else was liked by him, should be placed. After performing the puja, when the bed for the deceased is so given, the deceased lives with comforts in the places of Indra as well as the Sun. He is never tortured by the awful-faced messengers of Yama.

## \|\| 3.184.21-22 \|\|

*na dharmeṇa na śītena bādhyate sa naraḥ kvacit \|*  
*api pāpasamāyuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate \|\| 21 \|\|*

*vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ sevyamānopsarogaṇaiḥ \|*  
*ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvattiṣṭhetpātakavarjitaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. They also do not have to suffer from the heat of the sun or the cold. On the other hand, getting free from the sins, they are adored in the heaven. They dwell in an excellent plane, where the nymphs serve them.

## \|\| 3.184.23 \|\|

*śayyāpradānamamalaṃ tava pāṃḍuputrasaṃkīrtitaṃ sakalasaukhyānidhānametat \|*  
*tayo dadāti vidhivatsvayameva nāke talpe vikalparahitaḥ sa vibhāti satyam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. O son of Pandu, therefore, when a spotless bed is given over in charity by a person, he enjoys life in the heaven with all the pleasures.

## Chapter 185. Donating of one’s own image

## \|\| 3.185.1-7 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ātmapratikṛtirnāma yathoktaṃ kasyacitpurā \|*  
*tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi dānaṃ mānavivardhanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*dānakālaḥ sadā tasya munibhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ \|*  
*puṇyaiḥ puṇyadinaṃ pārtha prāpyate jīvitairna ca \|\| 2 \|\|*

*lohajāṃ prakṛtiṃ bhavyāṃ kārayitvātmano nṛpa \|*  
*abhīṣṭavāhanagatāmiṣṭālaṃkārasaṃyutām \|\| 3 \|\|*

*abhīṣṭalokasahitāṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutām \|*  
*tataḥ paṭṭapaṭīvastraiśchāditāṃ ratnabhūṣitām \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kuṃkumenānuliptāṃgīṃ karpūrāguruvāsitām \|*  
*strī ceddadāti śayane śayitāṃ kārayetsvayam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ kiṃcittatsarvaṃ pārśvato nyaset \|*  
*upakārakaraṃ strīṇāṃ svaśarīre ca yadbhavet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tatsarvaṃ sthāpayetpārśve svayaṃ saṃciṃtya cetasi \|*  
*etatsarvaṃ melayitvā svesve sthāne nidhāya ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

1-7. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – Now I am going to tell you about the giving away in charity of one’s own image, which enhances the prestige and which had been told by me to someone earlier and the same is now being spoken by me. The sages have prescribed the time of giving away such type of charity, which could be achieved by earning of great merits and not by remaining alive alone. One should get his own image made of iron. It should have the desired vehicle, well ornamented, accompanied with all the relatives, besides the equipments. It should be covered with strip of a cloth and decorated with gems, vermilion, camphor, and agaru. In case a woman intends to donate her image, then she should herself place it over the sleeping bed and whatever is desired by her or the things of daily use of the ladies should be placed by her over the bed.

## \|\| 3.185.8-11 \|\|

*pūjayitvā lokapālāngṛhāndevīṃ vināyakam \|*  
*tata śuklāṃbaraḥ snātvā gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

*imamuccārayenmaṃtraṃ viprasya purato budhaḥ \|*  
*ātmanaḥ pratimā ceyaṃ sarvopakaraṇairyutā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*sarvaratnasamāyuktā tava vipra niveditā \|*  
*ātmā śaṃbhuḥ śivaḥ śauriḥ śakraḥ suragaṇairvṛtaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tasmādātmapradānena mamātmā suprasīdatu \|*  
*ityuccārya tato dadyādbrāhmaṇāya yudhiṣṭhira \|\| 11 \|\|*

8-11. Then worshipping the family deity, Vinayaka and other gods, she should clad herself in white clothes and carrying flowers in hand-cups, she should stand before a Brahmana and recite these mantras – “O Brahmanas, I am going to hand over my own image to you which is decorated with all the essential things and the gems. The soul is Siva, Sambhu, God, Indra as well as the Sun. Therefore, by giving away my image, let my soul be delighted.” О Yudhisthira, thus speaking, the image should be given over to the Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.185.12 \|\|

*brāhmaṇaścāpi gṛhṇīyātkodāditi ca kīrtayan \|*  
*tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇipatya visarjayet \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. On the other hand, uttering the mantra-kodaditi etc., the Brahmana should receive the image. Then she should go round the Brahmana and see him off, offering salutation to him.

## \|\| 3.185.13-16 \|\|

*vidhinānena rājendra dānametatprayacchati \|*  
*yaḥ pumānatha vā nārī śṛṇuyātphalamāpnuyāt \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sāgraṃ varṣaśataṃ divyaṃ svargaloke surairvṛtaḥ \|*  
*abhīṣṭaphaladānena hyabhīṣṭaphalabhāgbhavet \|\| 14 \|\|*

*yatraivotpadyate jaṃtuḥ prāpte karmakṣaye punaḥ \|*  
*tatraiva sarvakāmānāṃ phalabhāgbhavate nṛpaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*iṣṭabaṃdhujanaiḥ sārddhaṃ na viyogaṃ kadācana \|*  
*prāpnoti puruṣo rājansvarge cānaṃtyamaśnute \|\| 16 \|\|*

13-16. О king, following this method, when the charity is given by a lady or a man, she or he earns enormous merit, which is being spoken by me. You please listen. He lives in the heaven for a hundred divine years, where he enjoys all the pleasures which are enjoyed by the gods. О king, wherever the jiva is born after the decline of his merits, he enjoys all his desires there also. О king, such a person can never be separated from his near and dear ones and even in the heaven, he enjoys all the pleasures.

## \|\| 3.185.17 \|\|

*yaścātmanaḥ pratikṛtiṃ varavāhanasthā haimīṃ vidhāya dhanadhānyasamākulāṃ ca \|*  
*sopaskaraṃ dvijavarāya dadāti bhaktyā caṃdrārkavatsa divi bhāti hi rājarājaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Thus, by making his own figure in gold and placing it over a beautiful vehicle, together with the riches and the grains and when the same is given away to a Brahmana, he shines in the sky like a great king.

## Chapter 186. Giving away of a golden horse

## \|\| 3.186.1-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*sāṃprataṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi hiraṇyāśvavidhiṃ param \|*  
*yasya prasādātpuruṣaḥ śāśvataṃ phalamaśnute \|\| 1 \|\|*

*puṇyaṃ dinamathāsādya pātraṃ vāpi guṇādhikam \|*  
*śaktitastripalādūrdhvamāśatācca narottama \|\| 2 \|\|*

*khalīnālaṃkṛtamukhaṃ kārayeddhemavājinam \|*  
*mukharaṃ sonnataskaṃdhaṃ dṛḍhajānuṃ savāladhim \|\| 3 \|\|*

*sthāpayedvedimadhye tu kṛṣṇājinatilopari \|*  
*kauśeyavastrasaṃvītaṃ kuṃkumena vilepitam \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – Presently, I am speaking to you about the giving away of a golden horse in charity. О best of the humans, on an auspicious day, a figure of a horse weighing from three to a hundred palas of gold, decorated with the beautiful reins, with raised shoulders, strong knees and a saddle, such a figure should be placed in the middle of the pedestal over the skin of black buck, over which a silken cloth is to be spread and the black sesamum seeds should be spread over it. Then making use of the vermilion, it should be consecrated.

## \|\| 3.186.5-8 \|\|

*saṃpūjya kusumaiḥ śvetaiścaṇakānvinivedya ca \|*  
*tataḥ parvasamīpe tu gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*imamuccārayenmaṃtraṃ purāṇoktaṃ yatavrataḥ \|*  
*namaste sarvadeveśa vedāharaṇalaṃpaṭa \|\| 6 \|\|*

*vājirūpeṇa māmasmātpāhi saṃsārasāgarāt \|*  
*tvameva saptadhā bhūtvā chaṃdorūpeṇa bhāskaram \|\| 7 \|\|*

*yasmāddhārayase lokānataḥ pāhi sanātana \|*  
*evamuccārya taṃ rājanviprāya pratipādayet \|\| 8 \|\|*

5-8. The horse should be worshipped with white flowers and the grams should be given for the menacing of the horse. Then at the time of the festival, holding flowers in the hand- cups, one should recite the Pauranic mantra – “O Sarvadevesa and in the form of a horse, О thief who stole the Vedas, you save me from the ocean of the universe. О eternal one, getting divided in seven forms, you carry Bhaskara, the form of metres, besides the lokas. Therefore, you kindly protect me.” О king, thus speaking, the horse should be given to the Brāhmaṇa and one should go round it. Then offering his salutation to it, he should offer farewell to the horse.

## \|\| 3.186.9-10 \|\|

*pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā praṇipatya visarjayet \|*  
*anena vidhinā rājanhiraṇyāśvama laṃkṛtam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*dattvā pāpakṣayādbhānorlokamāpnoti śāśvatam \|*  
*tasminnahani bhuṃjīta tailakṣāravivarjitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

9-10. О king, by following this process, the decorated golden horse when given by a person, the same horse while removing the sins, makes one to achieve the everlasting loka. Then during the day, the donor should consume the food without salt and oil and then listen to the Purana.

## \|\| 3.186.11-13 \|\|

*purāṇaśravaṇaṃ tadvatkārayedbhojanādanu \|\| 11 \|\|*

*itthaṃ hiraṇyāśvavidhiṃ karoti yaḥ supuṇyamāsādya dinaṃ nareṃdra \|*  
*vimuktapāpaḥ sa puraṃ murāreḥ prāpnoti siddhairabhipūjitaṃ yat \|\| 12 \|\|*

*iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ haimavājipradānaṃ sakalakaluṣamuktaḥ so'śvayuktena bhūpaḥ \|*  
*kanakamayavimānenārkalokaṃ prayātastridaśapativadhūbhiḥ pūjyate harmyabhogaiḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. О Narendra, when a person gives away a golden horse in charity on an auspicious day, he gets relieved of all the sins and is worshipped among the Siddhas. Together with the horse, he reaches the heaven in a plane in the abode of Kṛṣṇa. A person, who goes through the procedure of giving away a gold horse in charity, reaches the heaven and looks graceful with the divine damsels.

## \|\| 3.186.14 \|\|

*yo vā śṛṇoti puruṣo'pyatha vā smaredvā haimāśvadānamabhinaṃdati dīyamānam \|*  
*so'pi prayāti hatakalmaṣaśuddhadehaḥ sthānaṃ puraṃdaramahe śvaralokajuṣṭam \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Similarly, a person who listens to or reads this story besides the one who supports the donation, he achieves Indraloka after getting purified.

## Chapter 187. Giving away of a golden horse chariot

## \|\| 3.187.1-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tava pāṃḍukulodvaha \|*  
*puṇyaṃ hemarathaṃ nāma mahāpātakanāśanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*puṇye'hni viprakathite svanulipte gṛhāṃgaṇe \|*  
*kṛṣṇājinatilānkṛtvā kāṃcanaṃ sthāpayedratham \|\| 2 \|\|*

*caturasraṃ mahābhāga catuścakraṃ sakūbaram \|*  
*brahmāṇamagrataḥ kṛtvā gṛhītapragrahaṃ śubham \|\| 3 \|\|*

*iṃdranīlena kuṃbhena dhvajarūpeṇa saṃyutam \|*  
*lokapālāṣṭakopetaṃ padmarāgadalānvitam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*catvāraḥ pūrṇakalaśā dhānyānyaṣṭādaśaiva tu \|*  
*kauśeyavastrasaṃvītamupariṣṭādvitānakam \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О son of the race of Pandu, I am going to speak to you about an auspicious homa which destroys the grave sins. As per the advice of Brahmana, on an auspicious day, the courtyard should be plastered with the cowdung and the four wheels along with an axle which should be quite strong, should be made. Brahma should be lodged over the front seat, holding the reins of the horse. It’s kalasa should be decorated with seven sapphire gems, in which the flag should be fixed and placed over the leaf of ruby colour. Then ail the eight Lokapalas, four pitchers filled with water and the eighteen types of food grains should also be placed therein. A canopy of silken cloth should be drawn over it.

## \|\| 3.187.6-8 \|\|

*madhye tu phalasaṃyuktaṃ puruṣeṇa samanvitam \|*  
*yogayuktaḥ pumānkāryastaṃ ca tatrādhivāsayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*evaṃvidhaṃ pūjayitvā mālyagaṃdhānulepanaiḥ \|*  
*cakrarakṣāvubhau tasya kāryau viśvakumārakau \|\| 7 \|\|*

*puṇyaṃ kālaṃ tataḥ prāpya snātaḥ saṃpūjya devatāḥ \|*  
*triḥpradakṣiṇamāvṛtya gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. In the centre of the same, the fruits with flowers should be offered which should have been properly tied. Then the adhivasana should be performed. Adoration should be made offering the garment, fragrance, paste, etc. Two Visvakumaras should then be established for the protection of the wheels. Thereafter, during an auspicious time, one should take his bath, perform worship of die gods and go round the chariot thrice.

## \|\| 3.187.9-11 \|\|

*śuklamālyāṃbaradhara imaṃ maṃtramudīrayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

*namonamaḥ pāpavināśanāya viśvātmane devaturaṃgamāya \|*  
*dhātrāmadhīśāya bhavābhavāya rathasya dānānmama dehi śāṃtim \|\| 10 \|\|*

*vasvaṣṭakādityamarudgaṇānāṃ tvameva dhātā paramaṃ nidhānam \|*  
*yatastato me hṛdayaṃ prayātu dharmaikatānatvamaghaughanāśāt \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. Then clad in white clothes, carrying the flowers in the hand-cups, one should recite the mantra – “O destroyer of sins, O god, the universal soul, you are Vedas in the form of a horse, salutation to you. You bestow the place of Viṣṇu and relieves one of the (bondages of the) world. With the giving away of the chariot in a charity, let me be bestowed with peace. You are the preserver of all the eight Vasus, eleven Adityas, besides the Marudganas. You are supreme, therefore, you destroy all my sins and enlighten my heart with spirituality.”

## \|\| 3.187.12 \|\|

*iti turagarathapradānametadbhavabhayasūdanamaṃtraṃ yaḥ karoti \|*  
*sakaluṣapaṭalairvimuktadehaḥ paramamupaiti padaṃ pinākapāṇeḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Thus, with the intention of getting relieved from the bondages of the world, a golden horse chariot should be given away in charity. One who does so, he getting relieved of all the sins, achieves the best place of Siva.

## \|\| 3.187.13 \|\|

*dedīpyamānavapuṣā ca jitaprabhāvamākramya maḍalamakhaṃḍalacaṃḍabhānoḥ \|*  
*siddhāṃganānayanayugmaprani pīyamānavaktrāṃbujeṃ'bujabhavena ciraṃ sahāste \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Then having a body possessing the lustre undermining the importance of Indra as well as the Sungod, storied by the divine damsels and enjoying the beauty of their faces, he lives with Brahma for long.

## \|\| 3.187.14 \|\|

*iti paṭhati śṛṇoti vā ya etatkanakaturaṃgarathapradānamasmin \|*  
*na sa narakapuraṃ vrajetkadācinnarakariporbhavanaṃ prayāti bhūyaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. A person who listens to the story of giving away of the golden chariot with horse, or those who read or listen to it, have never to face the hell. To the contrary, they achieve the place of Siva.

## Chapter 188. Donating a black buck skin

## \|\| 3.188.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*kṛṣṇājinapradānasya vidhikālaṃ mamānagha \|*  
*brāhmaṇaṃ ca samācakṣva tatra me saṃśayo mahān \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said – О sinless one, you tell me about the giving away of the skin of a black buck in charity, besides the time, place of donating it and the type of a Brahmana to whom it should be given, because I have developed a great doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.188.2-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*yugādiṣūparāgeṣu saṃkrāṃtau dinasaṃkṣaye \|*  
*māghyāṃ vā grahapīḍāsu duḥsvapnādbhutadarśane \|\| 2 \|\|*

*deyametanmahādānaṃ dravyamātrāgame tathā \|*  
*āhitāgnirdvijo yaśca vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*purāṇābhirato dakṣo deyaṃ tasmai ca pārthiva \|*  
*yathā yena vidhānena tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu \|\| 4 \|\|*

2-4. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – The time of giving away of the skin of a black buck in charity should be the time of the start of a yuga, the time of solar or lunar eclipse, the first day of the month, the evening time, the full moon day of the month of Magha, at the time of unrest in the house, on the witnessing of a bad dream or at the time sudden influx of the wealth in the house, this great charity can be given. О Parthiva, the one who receives the charity, should also be a Brahmana, who should be an Agnihotri, well- versed in the Vedas and the Puranas, besides being quite active. The related procedure is being spoken by me. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.188.5-8 \|\|

*gomayenopalipte tu śucau deśe narādhipa \|*  
*ādāveva samāstīrya śobhitaṃ vastramāvikam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*kartavyaṃ rukmaśṛṃgaṃ tadraupyadaṃtaṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*muktādāmnā tu lāṃgūlaṃ tilacchannaṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tilaiḥ kṛtvā śiro rājanvāsasācchādayedbudhaḥ \|*  
*suvarṇenābhitaḥ kuryādalaṃkuryādviśeṣataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*puṣpairgaṃdhaiḥ phalaiścaiva naivedyena ca pūjayet \|*  
*ratnairevaṃ yathāśaktyā tasya dikṣu ca vinyaset \|\| 8 \|\|*

5-8. О lord of the people, an auspicious land near some pasture for cattle should be plastered with cowdung. Five clothes should be spread over it. The horns should be of gold, the rope should be made of the silver, the teeth should be made of beads and the tail should be of sesamum seeds, besides the head. The figure thus prepared should be covered with clothes and should be decorated with gold on all the four sides. Thereafter, the flowers, fruits, eatables etc. should be used in worship. Then the gems, as per one’s means, should be spread around the figure.

## \|\| 3.188.9-12 \|\|

*kāṃsyapātrāṇi catvāri teṣu dadyādyathākramam \|*  
*ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi kṣaudramevaṃ dattvā yathāvidhi \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tataḥ sarvasamīpe tu maṃtrametamudīrayet \|*  
*kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇamalo deva kṛṣṇājinavarastathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

*tvaddānāpāstapāpasya prīyatāṃ me namonamaḥ \|*  
*trayastriṃśatsurāṇāṃ ca ādhāre tvaṃ vyavasthitaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇo'si mūrtimānsākṣātkṛṣṇājina namo'stu te \|*  
*evaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-12. The four vases of bronze should be filled with ghi, milk, curd and honey respectively, which should be given away in charity in a proper way, reciting the mantra – “O Deva, you have a black colour like black deer skin. By giving away this charity, all my sins are going to be removed. Therefore, salutation to you again and again. You are the base of the thirty three crores of the gods. You have incarnated as Kṛṣṇa, therefore, salutation to black buck.” Thus uttering the mantras, one should go round it, offering salutation to it again and again.

## \|\| 3.188.13-15 \|\|

*tatpratigrāhakaṃ vipraṃ vedavedāṃgapāragam \|*  
*snātaṃ vastrayugācchannaṃ svaśaktyā vāpyalaṃkṛtam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*pratigrahaśca tasyoktaḥ puccha deśe svayaṃbhuvā \|*  
*pratigrahapradagdhasya viprasya ca sa bhārata \|\| 14 \|\|*

*na paśyedvadanaṃ paścānna cainamabhibhāṣayet \|*  
*anena vidhinā dattvā yathāvatkṛṣṇamārgaṇam \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. Thereafter, the Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas, who is to receive the charity, should touch the tail of the skin. According to one’s own capacity, the Brahmana couple should be given over the clothes along with other things of charity. This has been ordained by Brahma. The receiver Brahmana’s face should not be seen and no one should talk to him. With the following of this method, when a person gives the skin of a black buck, he earns a merit equivalent to the donating of the earth.

## \|\| 3.188.16-21 \|\|

*samagraṃ bhūmidānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇājinatilānkṛtvā hiraṇyaṃ madhusarpiṣī \|\| 16 \|\|*

*ye prayacchaṃti viprāya na te śocyā bhavaṃti vai \|*  
*sarvāṃllokāṃścaraṃtyeva kāmacārā viyadgatāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvatsvargaṃ prāptā na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*kṛṣṇājinasamaṃ dānaṃ na cāsti bhuvanatraye \|\| 18 \|\|*

*pratigrahopi pāpīyāniti vedavido viduḥ \|*  
*avasthātritaye yacca tridhā yatsamupārjitam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti dattvā kṛṣṇājinaṃ kṣaṇāt \|\| 20 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇekṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgasya carma dattvā dvijedrāya samāhitātmā \|*  
*yathoktametanmaraṇaṃ na śocetprāpnotyabhīṣṭaṃ manasaḥ phalaṃ yat \|\| 21 \|\|*

16-21. The sesamum seeds and gold should be placed over the skin of the black buck, besides honey and ghi, and then given over to the Brāhmaṇa and one who does so, he does not have to face any grief. To the contrary, he develops the capacity to move around all the lokas by air as per his choice. He also earns merits enough to stay in the heaven, because there is said to be no other charity equivalent to the donation of black deer skin in the three worlds. But the Vedic scholars are of the opinion that the receiver of the skin of the black buck in charity earns the sin. However, all the sins of the donor committed during childhood, youthful age as well as the old age get destroyed at the same moment. Thus, with a devoted mind, in case the skin of a black buck is given over to a Brāhmaṇa, he faces no grief at the time of death, besides earning the desired merit.

## Chapter 189. Giving away of a gold elephant in charity

## \|\| 3.189.1-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*kathayiṣye mahārāja hemahastirathaṃ tava \|*  
*yasya pradānādbhavanaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yāti mānavaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*parvakālaṃ samāsādya saṃkrāṃtau grahaṇe'pi vā \|*  
*kuryāddevarathākāraṃ rathaṃ maṇivibhūṣitam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*valabhībhirvicitrābhiścatuścakrasamanvitam \|*  
*caturbhirhemamātaṃgairyuktaṃ hemavibhūṣitam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dhvaje ca garuḍaṃ kuryātkūbarāgre vināyakam \|*  
*lokapālāṣṭakopetaṃ brahmārkaśivasaṃyutam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*madhye nārāyaṇopetaṃ lakṣmīpuṣṭisamanvitam \|*  
*kṛṣṇājinatiladroṇaṃ kṛtvā taṃ sthāpayedratham \|\| 5 \|\|*

*nānāphalasamāyuktamupariṣṭādvitānakam \|*  
*kauśeyavastrasaṃvītamamlānakusumārcitam \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О great king, I am now going to speak to you about the giving away of a golden elephant in charity, by the donation of which a person achieves Viṣṇuloka. On an auspicious day or a festival day, the first of the month or at the time of solar or lunar eclipses, a chariot should be made resembling a divine chariot. It should be decorated with gems. It should be having four wheels. Four elephants should be yoked in the chariot. Further decorating it with gold, the figures of Garuda, Vinayaka and the eight Lokapalas should be lodged, besides Brahma, Surya, Siva and Laksmi with Viṣṇu should be lodged in the middle. The chariot should be lodged over the black sesamum seeds spread out the skin of the black buck, measuring a drona (an ancient measure). Thereafter, several types of fruits, the canopy and new silk costumes should be offered to the same, along with flowers.

## \|\| 3.189.7-8 \|\|

*kuryātpaṃcapalādūrdhvamāśatācca narottama \|*  
*tataḥ snātvā samabhyarcya pitṝndevānyathāvidhi \|\| 7 \|\|*

*triḥpradakṣiṇamāvṛtya gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ \|*  
*imamuccārayenmaṃtraṃ sarvasaukhyapradāyakam \|\| 8 \|\|*

7-8. О best of the humans, in the making of chariot, pure gold from five to a hundred palas should be used. The donor should then take his bath, perform the adoration of the gods and the manes, and should go round the chariot thrice, holding flowers in his hand-cups and reciting the mantras the same time, which yield all the comforts.

## \|\| 3.189.9-11 \|\|

*namonamaḥ śaṃkarapadmajārkalokeśavidyādharavāsudevaiḥ \|*  
*tvaṃ sevyase vedapurāṇayajñaistejo hi naḥ syaṃdana pāhi tasmāt \|\| 9 \|\|*

*yattatpadaṃ paramaguhyatamaṃ purāṇamānaṃdahetugaṇarūpavimuktabandhāḥ \|*  
*yogaikamānasadṛśo munayaḥ samādhau paśyaṃti tattvamasi nātha ratheti rūḍhaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yasmāttvameva bhavasāgarasaṃplutānāmānaṃdabhāṃḍacitamadhyagapānapātram \|*  
*tasmādaghaughaśamanena kuru prasādaṃ cāmīkarebharatha mādhava saṃpradānāt \|\| 11 \|\|*

9-11. О Syandana, all the gods like Brahma, Siva, Surya, Lokapalas, Vidyadharas and Sankara, serve you always. Therefore, I offer my salutation to you. You kindly save my lustre. You have the all blissful form which is the secret for achieving the highest plane. The yogis who are free from the bondages and who remain engaged in Brahman with yogic practices, actually visualize you alone. For the people who intend to cross the ocean of the universe, you are all blissful one, who can surely be achieved in the middle. О elephant chariot of gold, you are practically the form of Madhava. Therefore, you be pleased with me, removing all my sins.

## \|\| 3.189.12 \|\|

*itthaṃ praṇamya kanakebharathapradānaṃ yaḥ kārayetsakalapāpavimuktadehaḥ \|*  
*vidyādharāmaramunīṃdragaṇābhijuṣṭaṃ prāpnotyasau padamatīṃdriyamiṃdumauleḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Thus offering salutation to the chariot, the elephant chariot made of gold in which the Vidyadharas, the gods and the sages remain established when given in charity, the donor is freed from all the sins and achieves the place of Siva, whose head is decorated with the crescent moon.

## \|\| 3.189.13 \|\|

*kṛtaduritavitānātuṣṭisadvahnipālavyatikarakṛtadehodvegabhāno'pi baṃdhūn \|*  
*nayati ca pitṛpautrānrauravādapyaśeṣātkṛtagajarathadānaḥ śāśvataṃ sadma viṣṇoḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The sinful people also in this world who remain gloomy because of the excess of their sins and having their bodies been deformed, they with the performing of this vrata of Gaja ratha, save all their relatives from falling into the horrible hell and make them achieve the auspicious place of vision.

## Chapter 190. Donating of Visva-Cakra

## \|\| 3.190.1-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*punareva pravakṣyāmi dānamatyadbhutaṃ tava \|*  
*viśvacakramiti khyātaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tapanīyasya śuddhasya viśuddhātmātha kārayet \|*  
*śreṣṭhaṃ palasahasreṇa tadardhena tu madhyamam \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tasyāpyarddhaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ syādviśvacakramudāhṛtam \|*  
*tathā viṃśatpalādūrdhvamaśakto'pi nivedayet \|\| 3 \|\|*

*ṣoḍaśāraṃ tataścakraṃ bhramannemyaṣṭakāvṛtam \|*  
*nābhipadmesthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ yogārūḍhaṃ caturbhujam \|\| 4 \|\|*
