1-4. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – I am now speaking to you about the astonishing type of the universal Cakra and the way of donating it. It is quite well known and removes all the sins. The wheel should be made of the pure molten gold. The pure gold weighing a thousand palas should be used in the making of the wheel which is considered to be the best. The one which is made of half of that weight is taken to be of medium type and still the cakra made of further half of that weight is considered to be the lower type. Even a person with limited resources should use more than twenty palas of gold in making of the cakra. There should be sixteen spokes in the cakra and eight joints. In the centre of the same, there should be shown four-armed lord Viṣṇu.

## \|\| 3.190.5-7 \|\|

*śaṃkhacakre'sya pārśvasthe devyaṣṭakasamāvṛtam \|*  
*dvitīyāvaraṇe tadvatpūrvato jalaśāyinam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*atrirbhṛgurvaśiṣṭhaśca brahmā kaśyapa eva ca \|*  
*matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca nārasiṃhotha vāmanaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*rāmo rāmaśca kṛṣṇaśca buddhaḥ kalkī ca te daśa \|*  
*tṛtīyāvaraṇe gaurī manubhirvasurbhiryutā \|\| 7 \|\|*

5-7. The conch and discus should be placed on the rear side, surrounded by the eight goddesses. In the second scene, lord Viṣṇu sleeping in the oceanic bed should be shown, besides the Ṛṣis like Atri, Bhrgu and Vasistha, Brahma, Kasyapa, Matsya, Kurma, Varaha, Narasimha, Vamana, Parasurama, Rama, Kṛṣṇa, Buddha and Lord Kalki are shown. In the third compartment, the humans, Vasus and Gauri should be shown.

## \|\| 3.190.8-9 \|\|

*caturthe dvādaśādityā vedāścatvāra eva ca \|*  
*pañcame pañca bhūtāni rudrāścaikādaśaiva tu \|\| 8 \|\|*

*lokapālāṣṭakaṃ ṣaṣṭhe diṅmātaṃgāstathaiva ca \|*  
*saptame'strāṇi sarvāṇi maṃgalāni ca kārayet \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. In the fourth compartment, the twelve Adityas and all the four Vedas should be shown. In the fifth apartment, five Bhutas, eleven Rudras and all the eight Lokapalas are to be shown. In the sixth apartment, the ten elephants of the directions should be shown. In the seventh compartment, the planets with the Sun and Mars etc. should be shown.

## \|\| 3.190.10-11 \|\|

*antarāṃtarato devānvinyasedaṣṭame punaḥ \|*  
*daśahastaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā patākātoraṇānvitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*maṃḍapaṃ kuṇḍamekaṃ ca kārayedvastrasaṃyutam \|*  
*caturhastā bhavedvedī madhye tasyāstato nyaset \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. In the eighth apartment, the rest of the gods should be established. Thereafter, the torana arch made of cloth should be of ten cubits. The mandapa should be decorated accordingly. A pedestal of four cubits should be made in the middle of it. An altar should also be made there.

## \|\| 3.190.12-15 \|\|

*kṛṣṇājinoparigataṃ viśvacakraṃ vidhānataḥ \|*  
*tathāṣṭādaśadhānyāni rasāśca lavaṇādayaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*pūrṇakumbhāṣṭakaṃ tadvadvastramālyavibhūṣitam \|*  
*phalāni dāpayetpārśve pañcavarṇavitānakam \|\| 13 \|\|*

*adhivāsya tataścakraṃ paścāddhomaṃ samācaret \|*  
*cātuścaraṇikāṃstatra brāhmaṇāṃścaturotha vā \|\| 14 \|\|*

*homaṃ kuryurjitātmāno vastrābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ \|*  
*homadravyasamopetāḥ sruksruvaistāmrabhājanaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

12-15. Thereafter, the Visva-cakra should be properly consecrated over the black deer skin. I Then, eighteen types of food grains, salt etc., juices and cotton garlands should be used in decorating the kalasas (pitchers). On the rear side, fruits should be placed, decorating the same with a canopy of five colours. Thereafter, adhivasana of the wheel should be performed and for that purpose, four Brahmanas well-versed in all the four Vedas, should be adorned with gems, costumes and ornaments and should be engaged for the religious ceremony to be performed. The material for performing homa like sruka and sruva (ladles) should be made available there.

## \|\| 3.190.16-19 \|\|

*cakrapratiṣṭhitānāṃ tu surāṇāṃ homa iṣyate \|*  
*talliṃgairjuhuyānmantraiḥ sarvopadravaśāṃtaye \|\| 16 \|\|*

*tato maṃgalaśabdena snātaḥ śuklāṃbaro gṛhī \|*  
*homādhivāsanāṃte tu gṛhītakusumāṃjaliḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*imamuccārayanmaṃtraṃ kṛtvā tattriḥpradakṣiṇam \|*  
*namo viśvaṃbharāyeti viśvacakrātmane namaḥ \|*  
*paramānaṃdarūpī tvaṃ pāhi naḥ pāpakardamāt \|\| 18 \|\|*

*tejomayamidaṃ yasmātsadā paśyaṃti sūrayaḥ \|*  
*hṛdi tatra guṇātītaṃ viśvacakraṃ namāmyaham \|\| 19 \|\|*

16-19. For the removal of all the disturbances, the disciplined Brāhmaṇas should make offerings in the fire and for the sake of their duties established in the cakra, they should recite the related mantras. Thereafter, with tumultuous welfare, the donor should take his bath, wear the white clothes and then perform the domestic homa rites. After the performing of adhivasana rites, holding flowers in both his hands, he should go round thrice, reciting the mantra – “Salutation to the lord who is the cloth of the universe. О Deva, you are the form of bliss, therefore, you protect me from all my sins. You are the great lustre, who is always visualized by the learned people in their hearts, therefore, I offer my salutation to all virtuous universal Cakra.

## \|\| 3.190.20-21 \|\|

*vāsudeve sthitaṃ cakraṃ tasya madhye tu mādhavaḥ \|*  
*anyonyādhārarūpeṇa praṇamāmi sthitāviha \|\| 20 \|\|*

*viśvacakramidaṃ yasmātsarvapāpaharaṃ hareḥ \|*  
*āyudhaṃ cādhivāsaśca tasmācchāntiṃ dadātu me \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. The said cakra is lodged in lord Vasudeva and in the centre of the cakra, Madhava is lodged. Both are depending on each other and therefore, I offer my salutations to both of them. This universal cakra removes all the sins, is attributed to lord Viṣṇu, besides being the form of adhivasana. Therefore, let it kindly bestow peace on me.”

## \|\| 3.190.22-23 \|\|

*ityāmaṃtrya ca yo dadyādviśvacakraṃ vimatsaraḥ \|*  
*vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇuloke mahīyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vaikuṇṭhalokamāsādya caturbāhunarāvṛtam \|*  
*sevyate'psarasāṃ saṃghaistiṣṭhetkalpaśatatrayam \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Thus invoking, a person who gives away the universal cakra in charity, he getting relieved of the sins, is adored in Viṣṇuloka and while living in Vaikuntha with the four-armed Viṣṇu, he enjoys all the pleasures with nymphs for the duration of three hundred kalpas.

## \|\| 3.190.24-25 \|\|

*praṇamedvātha yaḥ kṛtvā viśvacakraṃ dinedine \|*  
*tasyāyurvarddhate dīrghaṃ lakṣmīstu vipulā bhavet \|\| 24 \|\|*

*tasmāccakraṃ sadā kāryaṃ dhāryaṃ ca svagṛhe naraiḥ \|*  
*kāṃcanaṃ vātha raupyaṃ vā tadabhāve'tha tāmrajam \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. Thus making the Visvacakra in this way, a person who offers his salutation to the same daily, he attains long age and fortunes. All the people should prepare a Visvacakra at home and then consecrate it. The cakra with sixteen spokes should be made in gold or silver or alternatively of copper.

## \|\| 3.190.26 \|\|

*iti sakalajagatsurādhivāsaṃ vitarati yastapanīyaṣoḍaśāram \|*  
*haribhuvanagataḥ sa siddhasaṃghaiściramadhigamya namasyate'psarobhiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. When such a Visvacakra of pure gold with sixteen spokes and having all the deities lodged in it, is given away in charity, the donor reaches Viṣṇuloka and is served by the nymphs there.

## \|\| 3.190.27-28 \|\|

*atha sudarśanatāṃ prayāti śatrormadanasudarśanatāṃ ca kāminībhyaḥ \|*  
*sa sudarśanakeśavānurūpaḥ kanakasudarśanadānadagdhapāpaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*kṛtagurudurito'pi ṣoḍaśārapravitaraṇātpravarākṛtirmurāreḥ \|*  
*abhibhavati bhavodbhavāni bhittvā bhavamabhito bhavane bhavāni bhūyaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

27-28. This cakra is the Cupid for the damsels, destroyer of the enemies and is the form of Sudarsana cakra of Viṣṇu. A donor, who gives away such a cakra in charity, all his sins get burnt out. Therefore, one who has committed heinous crimes, but gives away in charity the cakra with sixteen spokes, he getting relieved of all the miseries of the world, dwells in the Sivaloka repeatedly.

## Chapter 191. Glory of the World

## \|\| 3.191.1-3 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*pratiṣṭhā śāśvatī kena dānena madhusūdana \|*  
*iha loke pare caiva kīrtiratyadbhutā tathā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sadgatiṃ ca tathā yāṃti sarve pitṛpitāmahāḥ \|*  
*saṃtatiścākṣayā loke vibhavaścāpi puṣkalaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*sthāpanātsarvadevānāṃ kathaṃ syādyadunaṃdana \|*  
*tadācakṣva mahābhāga dānena niyamena vā \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Yudhisthira said— О Madhusudana, what is the type of donation by which one earns everlasting glory, unprecedented fame in the world and beyond, besides earning beatitudes for father and grandfather and the evergreen progeny in the world as the enormous wealth? О lord of the race of Yadus, who all are the gods to be consecrated for this purpose or what types of charities are to be given for the purpose? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 3.191.4-11 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā rājaṃllokānāmupakārakam \|*  
*śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā guhyaṃ paramamuttamam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*bhuvanānāṃ samāsena pratiṣṭhāṃ kathayāmi te \|*  
*devāsurāstathā nāgā gaṃdharvā yakṣarākṣasāḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*pretāḥ piśācā bhūtāśca sthāpitāḥ syurna saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*kārakasyānukūle tu muhūrte vijaye śubhe \|\| 6 \|\|*

*puṇye tithau śivakṣetre dine saumyagrahānvite \|*  
*sapta hastaṃ paṭaṃ kṛtvā caturasraṃ susaṃhatam \|\| 7 \|\|*

*abhinnāṃgaṃ dṛḍhaṃ śuddhaṃ śuddhasphaṭikavarcasam \|*  
*tasminsarvāṇi rājeṃdra bhuvanāni ca lekhayet \|\| 8 \|\|*

*cāturvarṇyakamānīya vicitraṃ citrakarmaṇi \|*  
*yuvānaṃ vyādhirahitaṃ bhavyaṃ citrakaraṃ śubham \|\| 9 \|\|*

*saṃpūjayitvā yatnena divyavāsovibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*tasminkarmaṇi yuṃjīta paṭhyamānairdvijottamaiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*śaṃkhabherīninādaiśca gītamaṃgalanisvanaiḥ \|*  
*puṇyāhajayaghoṣaiśca brāhmaṇānpūjyettataḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

4-11. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О king, you have asked me an excellent question for the benefit of the world. Therefore, I am going to reveal the excellent secret You listen to me with apt attention. I shall speak to you about the procedure by which the gods, demons, serpents, Gandharvas, Yaksasas, Pretas, Pisacas and the goblins could be established in an auspicious and victorious muhurta, associated with favourable planets. On an auspicious day, in some dry ground, a cloth of seven cubits should be placed which should be without damage, strong, pure and should be spotless like the crystal. In order to complete the painting with various types of colour, some young artist should be called, who should be pleasant and auspicious, and should be adored with costumes and ornaments. For the same purpose, a Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas should also be engaged. The auspicious sound of the blowing of conches, beating of the drums, welfare songs, besides the reciting of the welfare mantras and the hymns of victory should be recited. At the same time, the Brāhmaṇa should be adored.

## \|\| 3.191.12-13 \|\|

*ācāryamapi saṃpūjya vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaistathā \|*  
*prāraṃbhaṃ kārayedrājanpaṭe tasminyathoditam \|\| 12 \|\|*

*madhye ca lekhayedrājañjaṃbūdvīpaṃ savistaram \|*  
*tasya madhye sthito merurmerorupari devatāḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

12-13. О king, an intelligent Acaiya should be adored offering to him the costumes and ornaments. The cloth should be properly painted. The Jambudvipa should be painted at the middle of it, while the Meru Mountain should be shown at the centre of Jambudvipa.

## \|\| 3.191.14-18 \|\|

*diśāsu lokapālānāṃ puro'ṣṭau surasaṃyutāḥ \|*  
*saptadvīpavatī pṛthvī sapta caiva kulācalāḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sāgarāḥ sapta cātraiva nadyo hradāḥ sarāṃsi ca \|*  
*pātālāḥ sapta cātraiva sapta svargavibhūtayaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ bhuvanāni yathākramam \|*  
*dhruvamārgastathādityo grahatārāgaṇairyutaḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*devadānavagandharvā yakṣa rākṣasapannagāḥ \|*  
*ṛṣayo munayo gāvo devamātara eva ca \|\| 17 \|\|*

*suparṇādyāśca vihagā nāgāścairāvatādayaḥ \|*  
*diggajāṣṭakamatraiva lekhayenmadamaṃḍitam \|\| 18 \|\|*

14-18. The abode of the gods should be shown over it. The eight Lokapalas should be lodged in all the directions, besides all the seven continents including the earth, all the seven mountains and the seven oceans. At the same time, the rivers, reservoirs etc. should also be shown. Besides the seven Lokas including Patala (netherworld), the seven heavens, all other lokas viz., Brahma, Viṣṇu and Siva’s dwelling places, the path of Dhruva, the planets, the stars with the Sun, the gods, the Danavas, Gandharvas, Yaksas, Raksasas, Nagas, Ṛṣis, Munis, Cows, the mother goddess, Garuda and other birds, Airavata and other elephants, besides the eight elephants of the directions should also be shown clearly.

## \|\| 3.191.19-21 \|\|

*evaṃvidhaṃ paṭaṃ rājankārayitvā suśobhanam \|*  
*daśottareṇa payasā etatsarvasamāvṛtam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tattejasā vṛtaṃ bhūyo mahatogreṇa sarvataḥ \|*  
*tejastadvāyunā vāyurākāśena samāvṛtaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*bhūtādinā tathākāśaṃ bhūtādirmahatā tathā \|*  
*avyaktena mahāṃścaiva vyāpto vai śuddhilakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. Thus the graceful garment should appear towards the north covering the ten reservoirs, and should be shown with great lustre. The lustre affects the wind, the wind affects the sky and the sky is pervaded by all the Bhutas. Thus, all the Pancabhutas along with the invisible one cover all, which having the symptom of all purity, pervade in all the directions.

## \|\| 3.191.22-27 \|\|

*avyaktaṃ tamasā vyāptaṃ tamaśca rajasā tathā \|*  
*rajaḥ sattvena saṃvyāptaṃ tridhā prakṛtirucyate \|\| 22 \|\|*

*evamāvaraṇopetaṃ brahmāṃḍamakhilaṃ nṛpa \|*  
*puruṣeṇāvṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sabāhyābhyaṃtaraṃ tathā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*etatsarvaṃ paṭasthaṃ tu kṛtvā citramayaṃ sudhīḥ \|*  
*kārtikyāmayane caiva viṣuve grahaṇe'pi vā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*pūjayedyena vidhinā tatsamāsena me śṛṇu \|*  
*purato maṃḍapaṃ tasya vicitraṃ kārayedbudhaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tatra kuṇḍāni catvāri caturasrāṇi kārayet \|*  
*dvaudvau niyojayetteṣu brāhmaṇau vedapāragau \|\| 26 \|\|*

*yajñopakaraṇopetau vastrābharaṇabhūṣitau \|*  
*homaṃ kuryurjitātmāno mauninaḥ sarva eva te \|\| 27 \|\|*

22-27. The invisible darkness covers the same, while the Tama (darkness) pervades Rajas and Rajas pervades Sattva. These three forms are known as Prakrti. Thus the entire globe is covered with protective of this type which is being drawn over a cloth (canvas). On the day of full moon in the month of Kartika, or at the end of six months, or equinox, or at the time of the solar or lunar eclipse, the performer should perform the puja, the method of which is being told by me, you please listen. A beautiful pavilion should be made on the said painting. Thereafter, four square altars should be made on the four comers of the same. At each one of the altar, two Brahmanas well-versed in the Vedas should be lodged at each one of the altars. All the items for the performing of the yajnas should be made available to them, and they themselves should be adorned with the ornaments. All the Brahmanas should perform homa silently.

## \|\| 3.191.28-31 \|\|

*paṭe sthitānāṃ devānāṃ maṃtrairoṃkārapūrvakaiḥ \|*  
*yajamānastataḥ snātaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*ācāryeṇasamaṃ kuryātpūjāmagre paṭasya tu \|*  
*puṣpairvastraiḥ samabhyarcya maṃtrametamudīrayet \|\| 29 \|\|*

*brahmāṃḍodaravartīni bhuvanāni caturdaśa \|*  
*tāni saṃnihitānyatra pūjitāni bhavaṃtu me \|\| 30 \|\|*

*brahmā viṣṇustathā rudro hyādityā vasavastathā \|*  
*pūjitāḥ supratiṣṭhāśca bhavaṃtu satataṃ mama \|\| 31 \|\|*

28-31. For the gods, the offerings should be made reciting the mantra starting with Omkara. Thereafter, the yajamana, together with the Acarya should worship the pata (painting) and offering costumes, should recite the mantras – “Having been established in the middle of the globe, all the fourteen Bhuvanas are present here and are worshipped in this function.” Similarly, Brahma, Viṣṇu, Rudra, Aditya Vasus and all the gods should be worshipped in this sacred function.

## \|\| 3.191.32-35 \|\|

*evaṃ paṭaṃ taṃ saṃpūjya kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam \|*  
*bhakṣyānnānāvidhāṃścaiva naivedyaṃ tatra dāpayet \|\| 32 \|\|*

*śaṃkhatūryaninādaiśca jāgaraṃ kārayettataḥ \|*  
*brahmaghoṣaivicitraiśca gītamaṃgalanisvanaiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*punaḥ prabhāte vimale snātvā śuciralaṃkṛtaḥ \|*  
*pūrvoktavidhinānena punaḥ saṃpūjya taṃ paṭam \|\| 34 \|\|*

*ṛtvikpūjāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā gośatena vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*athavā goyugaṃ dadyādekaika syātyalaṃkṛtam \|\| 35 \|\|*

32-35. Then performing the circumambulation, the painting should be worshipped and the offering of eatables, food etc. should also be given. Thereafter, with the blowing of the musical instruments like conches, trumpets etc. and sounding of the Brahmaghosa, the night should be spent while remaining awake. Then in the next auspicious morning, one should take his bath and wearing the new clothes and ornaments, following the aforesaid process, the painting should be adored. Then he should give away a hundred cows in charity or a couple of them should be given in charity to a Brahmana, will decorating them.

## \|\| 3.191.36-40 \|\|

*upānahau tathā chatraṃ gṛhopakaraṇāni ca \|*  
*yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ kiṃcitsarvaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*tataḥ prakalpayedyānaṃ nāgayuktamalaṃkṛtam \|*  
*alābhe vājisaṃyuktaṃ patākādhvajaśālinam \|\| 37 \|\|*

*sahasraṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā tatastvāropayetpaṭam \|*  
*brāhmaṇaṃ vā rathenātha nayeddevālayaṃ budhaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tatrasthaṃ sthāpayennītvā gandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca dhūpayet \|*  
*tatrāpi dadayānnaivedyaṃ kuryāccāpi mahotsavam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*yasminnāyatane tasya pratiṣṭhā kriyate nṛpa \|*  
*pūjā tatrāpi mahatī kartavyā bhūtimicchatā \|\| 40 \|\|*

36-40. Similarly, the footwear, umbrella, household items and all the things which are liked by the donor, should be given over to the Brahmana. Thereafter, the painting should be placed over a chariot driven by two elephants, or by two horses, decorated with banners. The painting should be established over the chariot with a daksina of a thousand gold coins. Otherwise, the painting should be placed over the chariot and should then be driven to a temple and should be consecrated therein. It should then be worshipped with the offering of incense, flowers and the eatables. A festival should also be celebrated there as well. In case it is not possible to establish the painting in a temple, but still the donor should perform puja of the painting there.

## \|\| 3.191.41-44 \|\|

*caṃdrātapatraṃ ghaṇṭāṃ ca dhvajādyaṃ dāpayetsudhīḥ \|*  
*yathāśaktyā ca rājendra guruṃ gauravayaṃtritaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*abhyarcya dakṣiṇābhiśca brāhmaṇāṃśca visarjayet \|*  
*dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca bhojanaṃ cāpyavāritam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*tasminnahani dātavyaṃ mitrasvajanabaṃdhuṣu \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

*kuryānnaro vā nārī vā pratiṣṭhāṃ sārvalaukikīm \|*  
*sthāpitaṃ tu bhavettena trailokyaṃ sacarācaram \|\| 44 \|\|*

41-44. A chatra, a bell and a flag should be given over to the preceptor, while daksina should be distributed among the Brahmanas. Then they should be sent off. Thereafter, the charities should also be distributed to the destitutes, poor, handicapped, blind, paupers, who should be served with food. Thereafter, he should serve food to the relatives and friends. Thus a man or a woman, who with utmost devotion, resorts to this popular type of consecration, he or she gets established in all the three lokas. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.191.45-47 \|\|

*kulaṃ ca tāritaṃ tena satputreṇa yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*yāvacca devatāgāre paṭastiṣṭhati pūjitaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

*tāvadasyākṣayā kīrtistrailokye saṃprasarpati \|*  
*dānena kīrtiryāvaṃti martyalokeṣu gīyate \|\| 46 \|\|*

*tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate \|*  
*gandharvairgīyamānastu apsarogaṇasevitaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

45-47. О Yudhisthira, such a noble son redeems his entire race. This should be believed that the period up to which the painting remains present in the temple, upto that time the unfading glory of such a person spreads in all the three lokas. The duration for which his fame for giving that type of charity spreads on earth, then for an equivalent number of the years multiplied by a thousand, the donor is respected in the heaven. The Gandharvas sing his glory there, while he is served by the nymphs.

## \|\| 3.191.48-49 \|\|

*vaseddhṛṣṭamanāḥ svarge yāvadiṃdrāścatu rdaśa \|*  
*puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*putrapautrānvitaḥ śrīmāndīrghāyuratidhārmikaḥ \|*  
*daśa janmāni rājendra jāyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. He enjoys all the comforts in the heaven for a period equivalent to the duration of the rule of fourteen Indras. Thereafter, with the decline of his merits, he is reborn on earth and lives a comfortable life with his family for ten births.

## \|\| 3.191.50-53 \|\|

*śrūyate ca purā rājā rajirnāma mahābalaḥ \|*  
*cakravartī dṛḍhamatirjitārirvijiteṃdriyaḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

*mahī yena purā dattā devarājasya saṃgare \|*  
*jitvā daityabalaṃ sarvaṃ dattavāṃstridivaṃ punaḥ \|\| 51 \|\|*

*mahendrāya mahābhāga sarvaṃ nihatakaṃṭakam \|*  
*sa kadācitsabhāmadhye yāvadāste mahī patiḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*tāvattatrājagāmātha pulastyo brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ \|*  
*śiṣyaiḥ parivṛtaḥ śrīmānvedavedāṃgapāragaiḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

50-53. It is heard that in ancient time, there had been a great king known by the name of Raji, who was a cakravarti king, having sharp wisdom, was always valorous over the enemies, besides being a well-disciplined monarch. In earlier time, he had donated land and had defeated the demons in the war between Indra and the demons. By this way, he gave away the thornless kingdom to Indra. О great king, once when the said king was seated in the court over a lion throne, Pulastya – the son of Brahma, arrived there. He was well-versed in all the Vedas and was always surrounded by his disciples.

## \|\| 3.191.54-57 \|\|

*dattārghastu tadā tena upaviṣṭo varāsane \|*  
*śuśubhe parayā lakṣmyā pitāmaha ivāparaḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

*atha taṃ pūjayitvāgre madhuparkeṇa pārthivaḥ \|*  
*papraccha vinayopetaḥ kathāmātmodbhavāṃ nṛpaḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

*bhagavankena dānena tapasā niyamena vā \|*  
*śrīriyaṃ mama dharmajña tejaścāvyāhataṃ bhuvi \|\| 56 \|\|*

*balaṃ puṣṭiṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ putrapautraṃ tathottamam \|*  
*etanme sarvamācakṣva sarvajño'si dvijottama \|\| 57 \|\|*

54-57. The Ṛṣi Pulastya received gracefully the arghya offered to him by the king and he was offered an excellent seat like Brahma. Thereafter, the king himself worshipped the great Ṛṣi offering honey to him. Then, with all humility, the king enquired Maharsi about fortunes- “O great Ṛṣi, with the performing of which one of the charity or discipline or tapas I could achieve various fortunes like lustre, strength, wealth, food-grains, excellent sons and grandsons? О Maharsi well-versed in dharma, you are all knowledgeable, therefore, you tell me the factual position.

## \|\| 3.191.58-62 \|\|

*pulastya uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇu rājankathāmetāmātmīyāṃ sumanoharām \|*  
*kathyamānāṃ mayā samyaksaptame tava janmani \|\| 58 \|\|*

*katheyamabhinirvṛttā śṛṇuṣvaiśvaryavarddhinīm \|*  
*āsīstvaṃ vaiśyajātīyo vārāṇasyāṃ narottama \|\| 59 \|\|*

*bahubhṛtyaparīvāro dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*dhārmikaḥ satyanirato vaṇigdharmarataḥ sadā \|\| 60 \|\|*

*tatra tvayā śrutā dharmā dharmākhyānagatena vai \|*  
*dānāśrayā bahuvidhā vratāni vividhāni ca \|\| 61 \|\|*

*prasaṃgena kadācicca pratiṣṭhā bhauvanī tvayā \|*  
*śrutā rājendra vidhivatkṛtā ca bahupuṇyadā \|\| 62 \|\|*

58-62. Pulastya said— I am going to narrate to you a pleasant story, which relates to your seventh birth and enhances your fortunes. During the last seventh birth from the present one, you were a great trader in a high Vaisya family in the city of Varanasi, having large family and many servants. Inspite of that, you had been quite a religious minded person, besides being truthful and devoted yourself in the trade. During that birth, you listened to several religious scriptures and the various forms of dharma. You also performed various types of charities and observed the vratas. In the same context, you also heard about the glory of Pata-dana (or donations of paintings) and you performed it in an appropriate way.

## \|\| 3.191.63-64 \|\|

*phalena tena jāto'si sapta janmāni bhūpatiḥ \|*  
*kīrtiste prathitā loke valaṃ cāpi mahattava \|\| 63 \|\|*

*aparāṇyapi janmāni sapta rājā bhaviṣyasi \|*  
*paścādyogikule bhūtvā nirvāṇaṃ samavāpsyasi \|\| 64 \|\|*

63-64. As a result of the same, you became a king during all the seven births and your glory was spread in the three worlds. In this way, you earned an extremely high reward. Therefore, you will reborn as a king during the next seven births as well and enjoy all the royal pleasures. Ultimately, you shall be born in a yogic race and shall achieve final beatitude.

## \|\| 3.191.65-67 \|\|

*etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ paripṛcchasi \|*  
*nārī vā puruṣo vāpi pratiṣṭhāṃ bhauvanīṃ tu yaḥ \|\| 65 \|\|*

*prakaroti vidhānena kṛtakṛtyo bhavedbudhaḥ \|*  
*ityuktvā sa munistatra rājānaṃ śaṃsitavrataḥ \|\| 66 \|\|*

*yayāvadarśanaṃ tatra sūrye vaiśvānaropamaḥ \|\| 67 \|\|*

65-67. You had put a question on this subject and I have given you a detailed reply. In this way, a man or a woman who performs the Bhuvana-pratistha (or Patadana) in a proper way, he or she becomes successful. Thus speaking to the king, the Vedic Ṛṣi Pulastya, possessing the lustre of sun, disappeared from the place in full view of all those who were present there.

## \|\| 3.191.68 \|\|

*dharmaṃ vivarddhayati kīrtiṃ śatāni dhatte kāmaṃ prasādhayati pāpamapākaroti \|*  
*khyātā mayeyamadhunā tava dānaniṣṭhā tannāsti yanna kurute bhuvanapratiṣṭhā \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. By performing this charity, the dharma gets enhanced and the glory is spread in hundreds of ways. It fulfills all the desires, destroys the sins and there is no other comfort, which it does not provide.

## Chapter 192. Donation of constellations

## \|\| 3.192.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*śruto dānavidhiḥ sarvaḥ prasādātte ramādhava \|*  
*nakṣatradānasyedānī dānakalpaṃ pracakṣva me \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said – By your grace, I came to know about the process of the performing of all the charities, now you kindly tell me about the donation of the constellation.

## \|\| 3.192.2-7 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*atrāpyudāharaṃtīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam \|*  
*devakyāścaiva saṃvādaṃ devarṣernāradasya ca \|\| 2 \|\|*

*dvārakāmanusaṃjātaṃ nāradaṃ devadarśanam \|*  
*papracchedaṃ tathā praśnaṃ devakī dharmadarśinī \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tasyāḥ saṃpṛcchamānāyā devarṣirnāradastataḥ \|*  
*ācaṣṭa vidhivatsarvaṃ yattacchṛṇu viśāṃpate \|\| 4 \|\|*

*nakṣatrayogaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvapātakanāśanam \|*  
*kṛttikāsu mahābhāga pāyasena sasarpiṣā \|\| 5 \|\|*

*saṃtarpya brāhmaṇānsādhūṃllokānprāpnotyanuttamān \|*  
*rohiṇyāṃ pāṃḍavaśreṣṭha māṃsairannena sarpiṣā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*saṃtarpya brāhmaṇānsādhūṃllokānprāpnotyanuttamān \|*  
*payo'nnadānaṃ dātavyamānṛṇyārthaṃ dvijātaye \|\| 7 \|\|*

2-7. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – In this connection, I am going to narrate the ancient story, in which Devaki as well as Devarsi Narada once had a discussion. Once in the city of Dvaraka, the divine sage Narada arrived and Devaki - the form of dharma asked him a question, in reply to which Narada replied. Whatever was told by Narada in reply to Devaki, the same is being narrated by me. You please listen. I am going to speak about the Naksatra-yoga, which destroys all the sins. О graceful, in the Krttika constellation, when the ascetics and Brahmanas are served payasam with ghi, the donor achieves the best of the lokas. О best Pandava, similarly, during the Rohini constellation when the Brahmanas are served with meat and the eatables with ghi, one achieves the best of the lokas. In all the righteous donations, the payasam should be served as food to the Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.192.8-10 \|\|

*dogdhnīṃ savatsāṃ tu naro nakṣatre somadaivate \|*  
*dattvā divyavimānasthaḥ svargaṃ prāpnotyanuttamam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*ārdrāyāṃ kṛśarāṃ dattvā tilamiśrā samāhitaḥ \|*  
*narastarati durgāṇi sarvāṇyeva narottama \|\| 9 \|\|*

*pūṣānpunarvasau dattvā ghṛtapūrṇānsupācitān \|*  
*yaśasvī rūpasaṃpannaḥ sajjano jāyate kule \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. During the Mrgasirsa constellation, by donating in charity a milk giving cow, the donor reaches the heaven after boarding a divine plane. О best of humans, during the Ardra constellation, in case the cooked grains are given away with sesamum seeds, a person overcomes all the obstructions. During Punarvasu constellation, in case the fried cakes cooked in ghi are given in charity, the donor earns beauty besides fame in the family.

## \|\| 3.192.11-12 \|\|

*puṣye tu kāṃcanaṃ dattvā kṛtaṃ vākṛtameva vā \|*  
*anālokeṣu lokeṣu somavatsa virājate \|\| 11 \|\|*

*āśleṣāsu tathā raupyaṃ yaḥ surūpaṃ prayacchati \|*  
*sarvabhayavinirmuktaḥ śāstravānabhijāyate \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. With the giving away of gold in charity during the Pusya constellation, the donor shines like moon on earth and the other world. During the Aslesa constellation, when the silver is given in charity, the donor attains beauty and getting relieved of all the dangers, he gets well-versed in the scriptures.

## \|\| 3.192.13-15 \|\|

*maghāsu tilapūrṇāni vardhamānāni mānavaḥ \|*  
*pradāya paśumāṃścaiva putravāṃśca prajāyate \|\| 13 \|\|*

*phālgunīpūrvasamaye vaḍavāṃ dvijapuṃgave \|*  
*dattvā puṇyakṛtāṃllokānprāpnoti surasevitān \|\| 14 \|\|*

*uttarāphālgunīyoge dattvā sauvarṇapaṃkajam \|*  
*sūryalokamavāpnoti sarvabādhāvivarjitaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. During the Magha constellation, in case a donor gives the vase filled with sesamum seeds, he achieves enough of sons and animals. During the Purva-Phalguni constellation, when a mare is given in charity to a Brahmana, the donor achieves the auspicious loka of the gods. When a gold lotus is given in charity in the Uttara-Phalguni constellation, the donor achieves the abode of the sun and all his obstacles get removed.

## \|\| 3.192.16 \|\|

*haste tu hastinaṃ dattvā kāṃcanaṃ śaktitaḥ kṛtam \|*  
*yātyasau śakrasadanaṃ varavāraṇadhūrgataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. During the Hasta constellation, in case an elephant figure of gold is given in charity as per one’s means, then he mounting over a king of elephants, reaches the place of Indra.

## \|\| 3.192.17-18 \|\|

*citrāsu vṛṣabhaṃ dattvā puṇyānāṃ puṇyamuttamam \|*  
*caratyapsarasāṃ loke modate naṃdanevane \|\| 17 \|\|*

*svātīṣu ca dhanaṃ dattvā yadabhīṣṭamihātmanaḥ \|*  
*prāpnoti ca śubhāṃllokāniha loke mahadyaśaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. During the Citra constellation when a bull is given in charity, then the donor roams about in the Nandana-vana or the pleasure garden of the heaven where enough of nymphs please him. One who gives away the charity of wealth during Svati constellation, he enjoys all the pleasures in the world and then attains the heaven.

## \|\| 3.192.19-21 \|\|

*viśākhāsu mahārāja dhuraṃdharavibhūṣitam \|*  
*sopaskaraṃ ca śakaṭaṃ sadhānyaṃ vastrasaṃvṛtam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*dattvā prīṇāti sa pituḥ pretya cānantyamaśnute \|*  
*na ca durgāṇyavāpnoti rauravādīni mānavaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*dattvā yatheṣṭaṃ viprebhyo gatimiṣṭāṃ sa gacchati \|*  
*kambalānyanurādhakṣeṃ dattvā prāvaraṇāni ca \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. О great king, in case a cart or a chariot is given away to a Brahmana during the Visakha constellation, in which the powerful bullocks are yoked, together with food grains and the costumes, then the donor enjoys all the comforts in the Pitrloka for a long time. He does not have to face the pain of the terrific hell Raurava. When during Anuradha constellation a blanket is given away to a Brāhmaṇa, the donor achieves the best of the state after his death.

## \|\| 3.192.22-23 \|\|

*svarge varṣaśataṃ sāgramāste suragaṇairvṛtaḥ \|*  
*kālaśākaṃ ca viprebhyo dattvā martyaḥ samūlakam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*jyeṣṭhānujyeṣṭhatāmeti gatimiṣṭāṃ ca gacchati \|*  
*mūle mūlaphalaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samāhitaḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. During the Jyestha constellation, one who gives away to a Brahmana kalasaka with roots, he lives in the heaven for hundred years and finally achieves the beatitude. During the Mula constellation by giving away root fruits to a Brahmana, the donor becomes the favourite of the manes and achieves the excellent beatitude.

## \|\| 3.192.24-29 \|\|

*pitṝnprīṇayate sarvāngatiṃ prāpnotyanuttamām \|*  
*atha pūrvāsvaṣāḍhāsu dadhipātrāṇi mānavaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kulavṛttopasampanne brāhmaṇe vedapārage \|*  
*pradāya jāyate pretya kule ca bahubhogavān \|\| 25 \|\|*

*putrapautraiḥ parivṛtaḥ paśumāndhanavāṃstathā \|*  
*udamaṃthaṃ sasarpiṣkaṃ prabhūtamadhuphāṇitam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*dattvottarāsvaṣāḍhāsu sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt \|*  
*dugdhaṃ tvabhijito bhāge \|*  
*dattvā ghṛtamadhuplutam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*dharmanityo manīṣibhyaḥ svarge vasati puṇyabhāk \|*  
*śravaṇe pustakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pradadātīha yo naraḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*svecchayā yāti yānena sarvāṃllokānna saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*goyugaṃ ca dhaniṣṭhāsu dattvā viprāya mānavaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

24-29. In case a vase filled with curd is given over to a noble Brahmana of high race during Purvasadha constellation, then such a donor, having been born in a high race, enjoys all the pleasures. He attains enough of sons and grandsons, besides animals as well as the riches. During the Uttarasadha constellation, in case the food mixed with ghi is given over, then he has all his desires fulfilled. During the Abhijita constellation, in case the milk mixed with ghi and honey is distributed among the intellectual, such an auspicious soul dwells in the heaven. In case a person gives away a book to a suitable person during the Sravana constellation, he achieves all the lokas with grace. There is no doubt about it. In case four bullocks and cows are given over to a Brahmana in Dhanistha constellation, he is respected at all the places.

## \|\| 3.192.30-34 \|\|

*sarvatra mānamāpnoti yatra yatreha jāyate \|*  
*tathā śatabhiṣāyoge dattvā sāgaru caṃdanam \|\| 30 \|\|*

*prāpnotyapsarasāṃ loke pretya gaṃdhāṃśca śobhanān \|*  
*pūrvabhādrapadāyoge rājamāṣānpradāpayet \|\| 31 \|\|*

*sarvabhakṣaphalopetaḥ sa vai pretya sukhī bhavet \|*  
*ratnamuttarayoge tu suvastraṃ yaḥ prayacchati \|\| 32 \|\|*

*pitṝnprīṇāti sakalānpretya cānaṃtyamaśnute \|*  
*kāṃsyopadohanāṃ dhenuṃ revatyāṃ yaḥ prayacchati \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sa pretya kāmānādāya dātāramupagacchati \|*  
*rathamaśvasamāyuktaṃ dattvāśvinyāṃ narottama \|\| 34 \|\|*

30-34. During the Satabhisa constellation, in case the sandal and agaru are given in charity, he achieves fragrance of high quality in the place of nymphs. During the purva-bhadrapada constellation if a person donates masa, he enjoying all the eatables, enjoys all the comforts in the heaven. During the Uttara-bhadrapada constellation, one who gives away clothes studied with gems in charity, he while pleasing the manes, reaches in the heaven. During the Revati constellation, one who gives away a cow in charity with a milking pot of bronze, he gets all his desires fulfilled. О best of the humans. During Asvini constellation, if a person gives away a chariot with two horses yoked in it, he is reborn in an excellent race possessing the elephants and horses yoked in a chariot and becomes illustrious.

## \|\| 3.192.35-37 \|\|

*hastyaśvarathasaṃpūrṇe varcasvī jāyate kule \|*  
*bharaṇīṣu dvijātibhyastiladhenuṃ pradāya vai \|\| 35 \|\|*

*gāvaḥ prabhūtāḥ prāpnoti naraḥ pretya yaśastathā \|*  
*ityeṣa dakṣiṇoddeśaḥ prokto nakṣatrayogataḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*devakyai nāradenaiva mayā ca kathitastava \|*  
*sarvapāpapraśamanaḥ sarvopadravanāśanaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

35-37. Similarly, in the Bharani constellation, if sesamum seeds com is given over to a Brāhmaṇa, the person achieves enormous glory. Thus, the giving away of charity during various Naksatra yogas has been explained by me, which had been narrated by Narada to Devaki - the holy mother of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. It destroys all the sins and removes all the disturbances.

## \|\| 3.192.38-39 \|\|

*na cātra kālaniyamo nakṣatraprakamastathā \|*  
*vittaṃ śraddhā ca rājendra kāraṇaṃ cātra kathyate \|\| 38 \|\|*

*yadyacca te bhagavatā kamalodbhavasya putreṇa dānamuditaṃ prasamīkṣya vedān \|*  
*tadyo dadāti vibhave sati sādhuvṛtte kiṃ tena pārtha na kṛtaṃ bhavatīha loke \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. O Rajendra, the rules for the giving away of the charity are not primarily based on the time, but are based on the availability of riches as well as the devotion of the mind. Thus with a great intention, availability of the wealth and following the directions about which the sage Narada had spoken, the person can perform all the noble deeds in this world.

## Chapter 193. Tithi-dana

## \|\| 3.193.1-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*tithidānamidānīṃ te kathayāmi yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvavighnavināśanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*mānasaṃ vācikaṃ cāpi karmajaṃ yadaghaṃ bhavet \|*  
*sarvaṃ praśamamāyāti dānenānena pāṃḍava \|\| 2 \|\|*

*śrāvaṇe kārtike caitre vaiśākhe phālgune tathā \|*  
*sitapakṣātprabhṛtyeva dātavyaṃ puṇyavarddhanam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*vittaṃ śraddhāsahāyaśca pātraprāptistathaiva ca \|*  
*dānakālaḥ sadaiveha kathitastattvadarśibhiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tīrthe devālaye goṣṭhe gṛhe vā niyatātmavān \|*  
*yaddadāti naraśreṣṭhastadānaṃtyāya kalpate \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – O Yudhisthira, presently, I am speaking to you about the chanties to be given on different tithis (moon days), which removes all the sins as well as the obstructions. О Pandava, with this type of charity, the mental, spoken or physical sins are destroyed from the roots. During the bright fortnights of the months of Sravana, Kartika, Caitra, Vaisakha and Phalguna, the Punya-vardhana charity should be started. The learned people who are well-versed in the tattvas have spoken about the methods of performing this vrata including the items to be given away in charity during the performance of this vrata. A person when performs this charity in a temple, religious place or in one’s own house, he earns the limitless pleasures.

## \|\| 3.193.6-8 \|\|

*pratipatsu dvijānpūjyapta pūjayitvā prajāpatim \|*  
*sauvarṇamaravindaṃ ca kārayitvāṣṭapatrakam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*kṛtvā caudumbare pātre sugandhavṛtapūrite \|*  
*puṣpairdhūpaiḥ pūjayitvā viprāya pratipāda yet \|\| 7 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā dattvā kamalaṃ kamalālayam \|*  
*īpsitāṃllabhate kāmānniṣkāmo brahmasātmyatām \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. On the first moon day of the month, the respectable Brahmanas and the Prajapatis should be given an eight-petalled lotus in a wooden vase filled with ghi, which should first be established. It should then be worshipped offering the flowers and incense. With the following of this procedure, the lotus which is the seat of Laksmi when given in charity, all the desires get fulfilled and ultimately, the donor attains the Sayujjya devotion of Brahman.

## \|\| 3.193.9-12 \|\|

*vahniṃ pūjya dvitīyāyāṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvariti kramāt \|*  
*tilājyena śataṃ hutvā dattvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*vaiśvānaraṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ sthāpayettāmrabhājane \|*  
*guḍājyapūrite rājaṃstoyapūrṇaghaṭopari \|\| 10 \|\|*

*pūjayitvā vastramālyairbhakṣyabhojyairanekadhā \|*  
*tatastaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyādvahnirme prīyatāmiti \|\| 11 \|\|*

*yāvajjīvakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*mṛto vahni puraṃ yāti prāhedaṃ nārado muniḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-12. On the second moon day, the fire should be worshipped reciting the mantra – “Bhur- bhuvah svah”, and a hundred offering of sesamun seeds and ghi should be poured into the fire. Thereafter, the Purnahuti should be offered. Then the image of the fire god should be made in gold and should be placed in a copper vase filled with sugarcane balls or raw sugar, which in turn should be placed over a pitcher filled with water. It should then be decorated with costumes, garlands and several types of eatables. Thereafter, the same should be worshipped. The donor should then say – “Let the god Agni be pleased with me,” Thus speaking, the same should be given over to a Brahmana. As a result of this, a person is freed from the sins that were committed throughout the life. There is no doubt about it. After his death, he reaches Agniloka. This is what has been told by Narada.

## \|\| 3.193.13-15 \|\|

*tṛtīyāyāṃ mahārāja rādhāṃ svarṇamayīṃ śubhām \|*  
*sthāpayitvā tāmrapātre lavaṇopari vinyaset \|\| 13 \|\|*

*jīrakaṃ kaṭukaṃ caiva guḍaṃ pārtheṣu dāpayet \|*  
*raktavastrayugacchannāṃ kuṃkumena vibhūṣitām \|\| 14 \|\|*

*puṣpadhūpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pūjayitvā dvijātaye \|*  
*dattvā yatphalamāpnoti pārtha tatkena varṇyate \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. О great king, on the third moon day, a beautiful image of Radha in gold should be placed in a copper vase filled with salt. The heaps of cumin, katuka as well as the raw sugar should be covered with two red clothes and decorated with vermilion. Thereafter, the flowers, incense and eatables etc. should be given over to a Brahmana. О Partha, the merit so earned by a person with the performing of this type of charity, I am going to relate the same to you.

## \|\| 3.193.16-17 \|\|

*prāsādā yatra sauvarṇā nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ \|*  
*gandharvāpsaraso yatra tatra te yāṃti mānavāḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

*svargādihaitya saṃsāre surūpaḥ subhago bhavet \|*  
*dātā bhoktā bahudhanaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. The region in which there are the palaces made of gold, payasam and the rivers with mud, where live the Gandharvas and Apsaras, the donor also lives there comfortably. After his return from the heaven, he gets reborn on earth with a well built body, enjoys all the pleasures, besides having enough of riches, sons and grandsons.

## \|\| 3.193.18-21 \|\|

*nārī vā tadguṇairyuktā bhavatīha na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*caturthyāṃ vāraṇaṃ haimaṃ palādūrddhvaṃ suśobhanam \|\| 18 \|\|*

*kāmayitvāṃkuśayutaṃ tiladroṇopari nyaset \|*  
*vastraiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayitvā naiveyaṃ vinivedya ca \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tatastu brāhmaṇe dadyādgaṇeśaḥ prīyatāmiti \|*  
*kāryāraṃbheṣu sarveṣu tasya vighnaṃ na jāyate \|\| 20 \|\|*

*vāraṇāḥ sapta janmāni bhavaṃti madavihvalāḥ \|*  
*vāraṇendrasamārūḍhastrailokyavijayī bhavet \|\| 21 \|\|*

18-21. His wife has the similar virtues of being a donor. On the fourth day of the moon, the donor should get an elephant made of gold and should establish it over the sesamum seeds measuring a drona. It should then be adored offering the costumes and flowers. Thereafter, offering the eatables to the Brahmana, the donor should say – “Let lord Ganesa be pleased with me.” Thus speaking, the Brahmana should be given over the image with other things. The one who does so, he never has to face hurdles in his life in any matter. After seven births, mounting over the intoxicated elephant, he conquers all the three worlds.

## \|\| 3.193.22-23 \|\|

*paṃcamyāṃ pannagaṃ caiva svarṇenaikena kārayet \|*  
*kṣīrājyapatramadhyasthaṃ pūjayitvā pradāpayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

*dvijaṃ saṃpūjya vāsobhiḥ praṇipatya kṣamāpayet \|*  
*iha loke pare caiva dānametatsukhāvaham \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. On the fifth day of the moon, the figure of a snake should be made in a tola (12 grams) of gold and should be established in middle of the vase filled with milk and payasam. It should then be given over to a Brahmana. He should also be worshipped offering the costumes and salutation should be made to him, because this type of charity grants comforts in this as well as in the future world.

## \|\| 3.193.24-25 \|\|

*nāgopadravavidrāvi sarvaduṣṭanibarhaṇam \|*  
*prāyaścittaṃ tathā proktaṃ nāgadaṣṭasya śaṃbhunā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śaktisamopetaṃ kumāraṃ śikhivāhanam \|*  
*kārayitvā yathāśaktyā hemamālāvibhūṣitam \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. This serpentine charity has also been prescribed in case of a person who suffers from miseries. The same Nagamantras also protect a person from all the disturbances and are the destroyer of all the wicked people. On the sixth day of the moon, the gold image of Kumara Kartikeya with sakti and peacock – his vehicle, should be made and decorated with gold flower garland аз per one’s means.

## \|\| 3.193.26-29 \|\|

*taṃḍulenātha śikhare vāsobhiḥ pūjya bhaktitaḥ \|*  
*ṣaṣṭhyāṃ skaṃdaṃ yathāśakti kṛtvā skaṃdaṃ hiraṇmayam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*pūjayitvā gaṃdhapuṣpadhūpainaivedyatastathā \|*  
*namaskṛtya tato dadyādbrāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine \|\| 27 \|\|*

*iha bhūtiṃ parāṃ prāpya pretya svarge mahīyate \|*  
*śūdro brāhmaṇatāmeti brāhmaṇo brahmalokatām \|\| 28 \|\|*

*saptamyāṃ bhāskaraṃ pūjya brāhmaṇānaśvamuttamam \|*  
*dadyādalaṃkṛtagrīvaṃ saparyāṇaṃ sadakṣiṇam \|\| 29 \|\|*

26-29. Thereafter, the image should be placed over a mountain or a heap of rice and the flowers and costumes should be offered to the same, while adoring the same. Then all the material should be given over to a Brahmana having a family and by so doing, the donor shall achieve enormous wealth in this world and is also honoured in the heaven. Even when a 6odra does so, he becomes equivalent to a Brahmana and attains the salokya moksa of Brahma. On the seventh moon day of a month, Bhaskara (Sun), a Brahmana and a horse made in gold with a decorated neck should be worshipped. After the adoration together with daksina, the same should be given over to a Brahmana.

## \|\| 3.193.30 \|\|

*sūryalokamavāpnoti sūryeṇa saha modate \|*  
*gaṃdharvāstuṣṭimāyāṃti datte'śve samalaṃkṛte \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. One who does so, he attains his stay in Suryaloka where he enjoys all the comforts. With the giving away of such a horse in charity, the Gandharvas also get satisfied.

## \|\| 3.193.31-33 \|\|

*aṣṭamyāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ śvetamavyaṃgāṃgaṃ dhuraṃdharam \|*  
*sitavastrayugacchannaṃ ghaṃṭābharaṇabhūṣitam \|\| 31 \|\|*

*dadyātpraṇamya viprāya prīyatāṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ \|*  
*pradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā ādvārāṃtamanuvrajet \|\| 32 \|\|*

*dānenānena nṛpate śivaloko na durlabhaḥ \|*  
*vṛṣaskaṃdhe pratiṣṭhaṃti bhuvanāni caturdaśa \|\| 33 \|\|*

31-33. On the eighth day of the moon, a strong white bull, covered with white clothes and decorated with umbrella, bell and other ornaments, should be given away in charity, saying – “Let the bull-bannered Siva be pleased with me.” Thus speaking, the bull should be given over in charity to a Brahmana by the donor, after going round the bull as well as the Brahmana. Then, donor should follow the Brahmana as well as the bull up to the gate. With the giving away of this charity, the Sivaloka does not remain beyond the reach of the donor, because all the fourteen Bhuvanas are lodged in the hood of the bull.

## \|\| 3.193.34-37 \|\|

*tasmādvṛṣabhadānena dattā bhavati bhāratī \|*  
*navamyāṃ kāṃcanaṃ siṃhaṃ kārayitvā svaśaktitaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*muktāphalāṣṭakayutaṃ nīlavastrāvaguṇṭhitam \|*  
*dadyāddevīmanusmṛtya duṣṭadaityanibarhaṇīm \|\| 35 \|\|*

*dvijātipravarāyetthaṃ sarvānkāmānsamaśnute \|*  
*kāṃtāravanadurgeṣu cauravyālā kule pathi \|\| 36 \|\|*

*hiṃsakāstaṃ na hiṃsaṃti dānasyāsya prabhāvataḥ \|*  
*mṛto devīpuraṃ yāti pūjyamānaḥ surāsuraiḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

34-37. With the giving away of the bull in charity, the donor’s merit of the charity of Bharati or learnings also gets established. On the ninth day of the moon, the devotee with his mind devoted in the goddess – the slayer of the Raksasa, when gives the gold image of a lion which is decorated with eight beads and the blue cloth to a Brahmana, all the desires of the devotee get fulfilled. With the influence of this charity, the thieves who infest the difficult terrain of the forest, the serpents and other wild animals cannot attack the donor. After the death of the donor, he getting adored by the gods and the asuras, receives the place of the goddess.

## \|\| 3.193.38-42 \|\|

*puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*daśamyāṃ nṛpaśārdūla daśāśāḥ svarṇanirmitāḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*lavaṇe ca guḍe kṣīre niṣpāveṣu tileṣu ca \|*  
*gavyatraye taṃduleṣu māṣāṇā supari sthitāḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya vastrapuṣpādyairdvijāya pratipādayet \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu pumānstrī vātha vā punaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*nirvāpayati rājeṃdra tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu \|*  
*iha loke bhūpatiḥ syātpretya svarge mahīyate \|\| 41 \|\|*

*sakalāstasya sarvāśā yāḥ kāścinmanasecchitāḥ \|*  
*tataḥ svargādihābhyetya kule mahati jāyate \|\| 42 \|\|*

38-42. Again after his death, he becomes a spiritual king in the next birth. О lion among the kings, on the tenth moon day, a gold image of the ten directions should be made and placed over a heap of salt, raw sugar, milk, sesamum seeds, curd, ghi, rice and black- gram, and then worshipped offering the flowers, costumes etc. Thereafter, it should be given ever to the Brahmanas. О king, the man or woman, who performs this charity in a proper manner, earns great merit which is being spoken by me. You please listen. Becoming a king in this world, such a person enjoys all the comforts and pleasures, and after his death, he is honored in the heaven. After descending from the heaven, he is reborn in a great family.

## \|\| 3.193.43-47 \|\|

*ekādaśyāṃ garutmaṃtaṃ kārayitvā hiraṇmayam \|*  
*yathāśaktyā tāmrapātre ghṛtasyopari pūjitam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*paṃcāgnyabhirate vipre purāṇajñe viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*dattvā kiṃ bahunoktena viṣṇuloke mahīyate \|\| 44 \|\|*

*gāṃ vṛṣaṃ mahiṣīṃ hemaṃ saptadhānyānyajāvikam \|*  
*vaḍavāṃ guraḍarasānsa rvāṃstathā bahuphaladrumān \|\| 45 \|\|*

*puṣpāṇi ca vicitrāṇi gaṃdhāṃścoccāvacānbahūn \|*  
*yathāśaktyā melayitvā vastrairācchādayennavaiḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*dvādaśyāṃ dvādaśaitāni brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet \|*  
*ekasya vā mahārāja yatphalaṃ tanniśāmaya \|\| 47 \|\|*

43-47. On the eleventh day of the moon, the golden figure of Garuda should be placed in a copper vase filled with ghi and after adoring it, the same should be given over to a Pancagni Brahmana or a Brahmana well-versed in the Puranas. The one who does so, he achieves Viṣṇuloka. What more could be said in this connection? On the twelfth day of the moon, the Brahmana should be given the cow, the bull, buffalo, gold, food grains, goat, a mare, raw sugar, several types of flowers, besides the incense. All these things should be collected together and covering them with a cloth, should be given over to twelve Brahmanas or to a single Brahmana, according to one’s means. О great king, I am now speaking about the merit, which is achieved by a donor for such a charity. You please listen.

## \|\| 3.193.48 \|\|

*iha kīrtiṃ parāṃ prāpya bhuktvā bhogānyathepsitān \|*  
*tato viṣṇupuraṃ yāti sevyamāno'psaroṇaṇaiḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. The donor earns a great glory in this world, besides enjoying all the pleasures on earth. After his death, he reaches Viṣṇuloka where he is served by the nymphs.

## \|\| 3.193.49 \|\|

*karmakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*yajñayājī dānapatirjīvecca śaradāṃ śatam \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. After decline of his merits, he is reborn on earth as a spiritual king, who performs the yajnas. He is known as the lord of charities and enjoys life for a hundred of years.

## \|\| 3.193.50-55 \|\|

*snāpayedbrāhmaṇāṃścātra trayodaśyāṃ trayodaśa \|*  
*tānācchādya navairvastrairgaṃdhapuṣpairathārcayet \|\| 50 \|\|*

*bhojayīta sumiṣṭānnaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ vinivedayet \|*  
*yathāśaktyā hemakhaṇḍāndharmātmā prīyatāmiti \|\| 51 \|\|*

*dharmarājāya kālāya citraguptāya daṃḍine \|*  
*mṛtyave kṣayarūpāya aṃtakāya yamāya ca \|\| 52 \|\|*

*pretanāthāya raudrāya tathā vaivasvatāya ca \|*  
*mahiṣasthāya devāya nāmānīha trayodaśa \|\| 53 \|\|*

*uccārya śraddhayā yuktaḥ praṇipatya visarjayet \|*  
*yaḥ karoti mahārāja pūjāmetāṃ manoramām \|\| 54 \|\|*

*yamāya sa sukhaṃ martye sthitvā vyādhivivarjitaḥ \|*  
*yamamārgagataḥ paścādduḥkhaṃ nāpnotyasau pumān \|\| 55 \|\|*

50-55. On the thirteenth day of the moon, he should arrange thirteen Brahmanas to take their bath and then provide them with new clothes, beside incense, flowers, and then adore them. Thereafter, he should serve them with sweet eatables and give them gold in charity as per his means. Then, he should say – “Let Dharmatma be pleased with me. Reciting thirteen names- Dharmaraja, Kala, Citragupta, Dandi, Mrtyu, Ksayarupa, Antaka, Yama, Pretanatha, Raudra, Vaivasvata, Mahisastha and Deva, he should offer salutation to him and see him off. О great king, a person who performs this excellent puja for Yama – the god of death, he is freed from all the ailments on earth and leads a comfortable life. While travelling through the path of Yama, he does not have to face any discomfort.

## \|\| 3.193.56 \|\|

*na paśyati pretamukhaṃ pitṛlokaṃ sa gacchati \|*  
*puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya sa sukhī nīrujo bhavet \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. While going to Pitrloka, he never meets the messengers of Yama. In due course of time, at the decline of his merits, after getting rebirth on earth, he spends a comfortable life free of ailments.

## \|\| 3.193.57-60 \|\|

*mahiṣaṃ suśubhaṃ kuṃbhaṃ caturdaśyāṃ payobhṛtam \|*  
*taṃ karṣakeṇa saṃyuktaṃ hemnaḥ sadvastrasaṃyutam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*ghaṃṭābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ vṛṣabheṇa samanvitam \|*  
*yo dadyācchivabhaktāya brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine \|\| 58 \|\|*

*vṛṣaṃ dattvā naraśreṣṭha śivaloke mahīyate \|*  
*tatra sthitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ kramādetya mahītalam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*ārogyadhanasaṃyukte kule mahati jāyate \|*  
*sarvakāmasamṛddhyarthaṃ yāvajanmaśatatrayam \|\| 60 \|\|*

57-60. On the fourteenth moon day of the month, a graceful and decorated pitcher filled with water, excellent costumes embroidered with gold, together with a male buffalo should be given over to a devotee of Siva or to a Brahmana with family. With the giving away of the male buffalo is charity, the donor is honoured in the abode of Siva and living there with comfort for long, he is reborn in a high race, lives without ailments and for three births, all his desires on earth are fulfilled and he enjoys all the pleasures.

## \|\| 3.193.61-65 \|\|

*paurṇamāsyāṃ vṛṣotsargaṃ kārayitvā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*caṃdrarajataniṣpannaṃ phalenaikena śobhanam \|\| 61 \|\|*

*pūjayedgaṃdhakusumairnaivedyaṃ vinivedya ca \|*  
*dadyādviprāya saṃkalpya vāsolaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ \|\| 62 \|\|*

*maṃtreṇānena rājendra tannibodha yathoditam \|*  
*kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūta trailokyāṃgaṇadīpaka \|\| 63 \|\|*

*umā pateḥ śiroratnaśivaṃ yaccha namonamaḥ \|*  
*dānenānena nṛpate bhrājate caṃdravaddivi \|\| 64 \|\|*

*apsarobhiḥ parivṛto yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam \|\| 65 \|\|*

61-65. Similarly, on the full-moon day, celebrating the Vrsotsarga, the silver image of the moon should be consecrated and worshipped offering the fragrant flowers and eatables. Thereafter, decorating it with costumes and ornaments, the moon made of silver should be given over to a Brahmana with respect, reciting the mantra- “You emerged out of the ocean of milk, besides being the lamp of the courtyard of the universe. You decorate the hand of Siva – the lord of Uma. You kindly shower your grace and welfare on me. I offer my salutation to you.” О lord of the human, by following this method, a person stays in the heaven in the company of the nymphs, till the time of dissolution, shining like a moon.

## \|\| 3.193.66 \|\|

*dānānyamūni vidhivatprayatikrameṇa yacchaṃti ye dvijavarāya viśuddhasattvāḥ \|*  
*te brahmaviṣṇubhuvaneṣu sukhaṃ vihṛtya yāṃtyekatāṃ saha śivena na saṃśayo me \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. When this particular charity is given over to a Brahmana in a proper way, he enjoying his stay in places of Brahma and Viṣṇu, attains the Sayujjya devotion of Siva. There is no doubt about it.

## Chapter 194. Giving of a boar in charity

## \|\| 3.194.1-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ādivārāhadānaṃ ta kathayāmi yudhiṣṭhira \|*  
*dharaṇyai yatpurā proktaṃ varāhavapuṣā mayā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*puṇyaṃ pavitramāyuṣyaṃ sarva dānottamottamam \|*  
*mahāpāpādidoṣaghnaṃ pūjitaṃ dharmasattamaiḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*deyaṃ saṃkramaṇe bhānorgrahaṇe dvādaśīṣvatha \|*  
*yajñotsavavivāheṣu duḥsvapnādbhutadarśane \|\| 3 \|\|*

*yadā ca jāyate vittaṃ cittaṃ śraddhāsamanvitam \|*  
*tadaiva dānakālaḥ syādadhruvaṃ jīvitaṃ yataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*kurukṣetrāditīrtheṣu gaṃgādyāsu nadīṣu ca \|*  
*pureṣu ca pavitreṣu araṇyeṣu vaneṣu ca \|\| 5 \|\|*

*goṣṭhe devālaye vāpi rathe vā svagṛhāṃgaṇe \|*  
*deyaṃ purāṇavidhinā brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О Yudhisthira, I am now going to speak to you about the donating of (the image of) Adi Varaha. In earlier times, I had taken to the form of Varaha and had rescued the earth from the nether world. This particular charity enhances merits, purity and intelligence. It is considered to be the best of the chanties and washes away all the grave sins and blemishes. It is adored by the best of the spiritual people. On the first day of the samkranti, or the dvadasi falling on the day of solar or lunar eclipse, performing of the yajna or of the marriage ceremony, witnessing evil dream, at the time of the earning of the enormous riches, or at the time when the mind is overwhelmed with devotion – these are the occasions during which the charity could be exercised in the life of a person. This charity could be performed at the holy places like Kuruksetra, over the banks of the river Ganga, any one of the sacred cities, innumerable cowpens, temples, the chariots or in the own house of the donor, according to the prescribed rules in the Puranas. Then the things of charity should be given over to a Brahmana having his family.

## \|\| 3.194.7-10 \|\|

*kuśairāstīrya tāṃ pārtha praṇavākṣaramaṃtritaiḥ \|*  
*upariṣṭāttilaisteṣāṃ varāhaṃ parikalpayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

*drauṇaiścaturbhiḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ tadardhenātha vā punaḥ \|*  
*āḍhakenātha kurvīta vitta śāṭhyaṃ na kārayet \|\| 8 \|\|*

*suvarṇena mukhaṃ kāryaṃ bhujau cakragadānvitau \|*  
*rājatīṃ kārayeddaṃṣṭāṃ padmarāgavibhūṣitām \|\| 9 \|\|*

*śaṃkhaṃ ca sthāpayetpārśve vanamālāṃ hiraṇmayīm \|*  
*puṣpairvā kārayedvidvānpādau rūpyamayau tathā \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. О Partha, spreading the kusa grass over which the sesamum seeds should be poured and the mantra should then be recited starting with Omkara. Then the image of Varaha should be conceived which should be made with four dronas weight of gold. One should not be miserly at that time. The face of the image should be of gold and the hands, the discus and the club should be made of silver, studded with ruby. Bronze should be used for making of the teeth and the rear side. Conch should also be shown and his neck should be decorated with long garland of forest flowers, made of gold. The feet should be made of the flowers of the silver.

## \|\| 3.194.11-12 \|\|

*daṃṣṭrāgralagnavasudhāṃ sauvarṇīṃ kārayecchubhām \|*  
*sarvadhānyarasopetāṃ vastrālaṃkṛtavigrahām \|\| 11 \|\|*

*pracchādya vastrairdeveśaṃ varāhaṃ sarvakāmadam \|*  
*romarājiṃ kuśaiḥ kṛtvā gaṃdhapuṣpairathārcayet \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. The earth goddess made of gold should be lodged over the tip of tusk (or teeth). His body should be covered with the juice of all the food grains and a cloth should be decorated over the same. The adoration of the image of Devesa Varaha fulfills all the desires. The hair on the body should be made of kusa grass. He should be worshipped offering fragrant flowers.

## \|\| 3.194.13-15 \|\|

*navagrahamakhaḥ kāryo homa ścātra tilaiḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*evaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivattataḥ stotramudīrayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

*varāheśa praduṣṭāni sarvapāpaphalāni ca \|*  
*marddamardda mahādaṃṣṭra bhāsvatkana kakuṃḍala \|\| 14 \|\|*

*śaṃkhacakrāsihastāya hiraṇyākṣāṃtakāya ca \|*  
*daṃṣṭroddhṛtadharābhṛte trayīmūrtimate namaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

13-15. In this particular yajna, the adoration of Navagrahas has to be initially performed. Thereafter, the devotee should recite the stotra – “O Lord, you are adorned with gold kundala (earrings) in your ears and have incarnated as lord Varaha. You kindly shatter all my sins. You are carrying a conch, cakra, and a sword in your hand. It is you alone who killed Hiranyaksa. You rescued the earth goddess lodged over the tip of your tusk. You are the form of the three Vedas, therefore, salutation to you.”

## \|\| 3.194.16-18 \|\|

*ityuccārya namaskṛtya pradakṣiṇamanu vrajet \|*  
*tatastaṃ brāhmaṇe dadyādvastrālaṃkārabhūṣitam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*prarigrahastu tasyoktaḥ pādayoḥ paramarṣibhiḥ \|*  
*anena vidhinā dattvā praṇipatya kṣamā payet \|\| 17 \|\|*

*evaṃ dattvā mahīnātha varāhaṃ sarvakāmadam \|*  
*yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti pārtha tatkena varṇyate \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. Thus speaking, circumambulation should be performed and salutation should be offered. Thereafter, all the things along with clothes and gems should be given over to a Brahmana. According to the sayings of the great Ṛṣis, the Brahmanas should touch the feet of the image while receiving the charity. With the following of this method, the donor should beg forgiveness. О Partha, with the giving away of the charity of the image of Maha-Varaha, one achieves the enormous merits and no one is able to describe the same.

## \|\| 3.194.19-21 \|\|

*sarvadāneṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvakratuṣu yatphalam \|*  
*tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti dattvā devaṃ janārdanam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*yathāśaktyā samuddhṛtā varāheṇa vasuṃdharā \|*  
*yathākulaṃ samuddhatya viṣṇuloke mahīyate \|\| 20 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ strīṇāṃ śūdrajanasya ca \|*  
*etatsādhāraṇaṃ dānaṃ śaivavaiṣṇavayoginām \|\| 21 \|\|*

19-21. All the merits are yielded with giving away of the image in charity. As Lord Varaha had redeemed the earth with his force, similarly, the person who has donated the image to the Brahmana, he getting redeemed from the ocean of universe along with his race, is respected in the abode of Viṣṇu. For the Brahmanas, Ksatriyas, Vaisyas, ladies and the Sudras, besides the followers of Siva, Viṣṇu and the yogis, this has been termed as an ordinary type of charity.

## \|\| 3.194.22 \|\|

*viprāya vedaviduṣe nṛvarāharūpaṃ dattvā tilāmalasuvarṇamayaṃ savastram \|*  
*uddhṛtya pūrvapuruṣānsakalatramitraḥ prāpnoti siddhabhuvanaṃ surasiddhajuṣṭam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. Thus decorating the image of Nrvaraha with costumes, made up of the best of gold and seasmum seeds, is when given over to a Brāhmaṇa well-versed in the Vedas, the donor with all his sons and friends, redeems the manes and family to the place of Siddhas.

## Chapter 195. Giving away of mountain of food grains

## \|\| 3.195.1 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*bhagavañchrotumicchāmi dānamāhātmyamuttamam \|*  
*yadakṣayaṃ pare loke devarṣigaṇapūjitam \|\| 1 \|\|*

1\. Yudhisthira said – О lord, I intend to listen to the excellent glory of the charities, which makes donor respected even by the Ṛṣis and makes one attain the Siddhaloka.

## \|\| 3.195.2-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*rudreṇa yatpurā proktaṃ nāradāya mahātmane \|*  
*matsyena manave tadvattacchuṇuṣva kurūdvaha \|\| 2 \|\|*

*meroḥ pradānaṃ vakṣyāmi daśadhā punareva te \|*  
*yatpradātottarāṃllokānprāpnoti surapūjitān \|\| 3 \|\|*

*purāṇeṣu ca vedeṣu yajñeṣvadhyayaneṣu ca \|*  
*na tatphalamadhīteṣu kṛteṣviha yadaśnute \|\| 4 \|\|*

*tasmādvidhānaṃ vakṣyāmi parvatānāmanukramāt \|*  
*prathamo dhānyaśailaḥ syaddvitīyo lavaṇācalaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

2-5. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О foremost of the race of the Kurus, in this connection Sankara has spoken to Narada and Matsya spoke to Manu, the same narration is being spoken by me to you presently, you please listen. I am going to narrate to you ten types of donation of the Meru mountain, with the donating of which one achieves the heaven. With the study of the Vedas and the Puranas as well as with the performing of the yajnas, one does not get the same reward which could be earned with the performing of this charity. Initially, I am speaking about the making of the mountains, you please listen. The first mountain should be of food grains and the second one of salt.

## \|\| 3.195.6-7 \|\|

*guḍācalastṛtīyastu caturtho hemaparvataḥ \|*  
*pañcamastilaśailaḥ syātṣaṣṭhaḥ kārpāsaparvataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*saptamo ghṛtaśailaśca rasaśailastathāṣṭamaḥ \|*  
*rājato navamastadvaddaśamaḥ śarkarācalaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. The third mountain is to be of raw sugar, while the fourth one is to be of gold. The fifth one is to be of sesamum seeds and the sixth one should be of the cotton. The seventh one is to be of ghi, while the eighth one is to be of all the juices. The ninth one is to be of silver, while the tenth one should be of sugar.

## \|\| 3.195.8-10 \|\|

*vakṣye vidhānameteṣāṃ yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ \|*  
*ayane viṣuve puṇye vyatīpāte dinakṣaye \|\| 8 \|\|*

*śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāmuparāge śaśikṣaye \|*  
*vivāhotsavayajñe vā dvādaśyāmatha vā punaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*śuklāyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ vā puṇyarkṣe vā pradhānataḥ \|*  
*dhānyaśailādayo deyā yathāśāstraṃ vijānatā \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. All of the ten mountains can be given over in charity. Therefore, on the occasion of equinox, on some auspicious time day during bright fortnight, tritya, during solar or lunar eclipses, at the time of marriage, performing of the yajna, or on the twelfth day of the moon, on the day of Sukla-pancami, or on some auspicious constellation, the donation of the food grain hill or any other hill should be given.

## \|\| 3.195.11-13 \|\|

*tīrthe vāyatane vāpi goṣṭhe vā saṃgame'pi vā \|*  
*maṃḍapaṃ kārayedbhaktyā caturasramudaṅmukham \|\| 11 \|\|*

*prāgudakpravaṇaṃ tatra prāṅmukhaṃ vā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*gomayenānuliptāyāṃ bhūmāvāstīrya vā kuśān \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tanmadhye parvataṃ kuryādviṣkambhaparvatānvitam \|*  
*dhānyadroṇasahasreṇa bhavedgiririhottamaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. An equal pavilion should be made at some holy place or in the temple of a god, or in a hall, or at the confluence of the rivers. This pavilion should face the north or the eastern side. The land over which such a pavilion is to made should be descending towards the north east and should be plastered with cowdung. The kusa grass should be spread over the ground and the Viskambha hill should be made in the middle of the same. The hill of a thousand dronas of food grains is considered to be the best.

## \|\| 3.195.14-16 \|\|

*madhyamaḥ paṃcaśatikaḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ syāttribhiḥ śataiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*merurmahāvrīhimayastu madhyasuvarṇavṛkṣatrayasaṃyutaḥ syāt \|*  
*saṃpūrṇamuktāphalavajrayukto yāmye nu gomedakapuṣparāgaiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*yaḥ syācca gārutmatanīlaratnaiḥ saumyena vaiḍūryasarojarāgaiḥ \|*  
*śrīkhaṃḍakhaṇḍairabhitaḥ pravāla latānvitaḥ śuddhaśilātalaḥ syāt \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. The one with half of that quantity of grains (i.e., five hundred dronas) is considered to of medium type and the hill of three hundred dronas of food grains is considered to be of the lowest type. In the heap of the food grains – Mahameru, three trees of gold should be established. The said heap should have the beads on the east and the gems decorating it. Towards the south, there should be onyx gems as well as topaz, decorating that side. On the western direction, emerald and sapphire stones should be arranged; towards the north, lapiz lazuli and ruby gems should be placed. Similarly, the place should be surrounded with the pieces of sandalwood and creepers of coral. That portion of land should be further decorated with spotless stone slabs.

## \|\| 3.195.17 \|\|

*brahmātha viṣṇurbhagavānpurārirdivākaro'pyatra hiraṇmayaḥ syāt \|*  
*tathaikadeśoddhatakandharastu ghṛtodakaprasravaṇāśca dikṣu \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. In the said mountain or the hill, the gold image of Brahma, Viṣṇu, Siva and Surya should be placed. On one side of the mountain, a cove should be made and on all the other sides, the springs of water as well the ghi should be made.

## \|\| 3.195.18 \|\|

*śuklāṃbaro'nyaśca surācalaḥ syātpūrveṇa kṛṣṇāni ca dakṣiṇena \|*  
*vāsāṃsi paścādatha kesarāṇi raktāni caivottarato dalāni \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. Towards the eastern side of the hill, white cloth; towards the south, the black cloth; the yellow cloth in the west and a red cloth should be placed at the northern side.

## \|\| 3.195.19 \|\|

*raupyā maheṃdrapramukhāstathāṣṭau saṃsthāpayellokapatīnkrameṇa \|*  
*nānāphalālī ca samaṃtataḥ syānmanoramāmālyavilepanādyā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The silver images of the eight Lokapalas like Mahendra and others should be established. The mountain or the hill should be surrounded by flower garlands as well as the items of fruit.

## \|\| 3.195.20-21 \|\|

*vitānakañcopari pañcavarṇamamlānapuṣpābharaṇaṃ sitaṃ vā \|*  
*itthaṃ niveśyāmaraśailamapyunmanāstu viṣkambhagaṇānkrameṇa \|\| 20 \|\|*

*turīyabhāgena caturdiśaṃ ca saṃsthāpayetpuṣpavilepanādyān \|*  
*pūrveṇa mandaramanekaphalopayuktaṃ yatrollasatkanakabhadrakadaṃbacihnam \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. A five coloured canopy should also be raised over it and the ornaments of flowers should also be made to decorate. Thus the first immortal hill should be created. Thereafter, four ganas known as Viskambhas should be placed respectively on the four sides of the same. Each one of them should be decorated with flowers, pastes etc. Towards the eastern side of the main mountain, the Mandara-giri should be created with several fruits, besides the trees of pine made of gold.

## \|\| 3.195.22 \|\|

*kāmena kāṃcanamayena virājamānamākārayetkusumavastravilepanāḍhyam \|*  
*kṣīrāruṇodasarasātha tathā vanena raupyeṇa śaktighaṭitena virājamānam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. A gold image of Kamadhenu should be decorated with flowers and the costumes, applying the paste over it. And, a forest with base of silver should also be created as per the means of a person, besides the tanks of milk, known by the name of Arunadaka.

## \|\| 3.195.23 \|\|

*yāmyena gaṃdhamadanotra niveśanīyo godhūmasaṃcayamayaḥ kaladhautajo vā \|*  
*haimena pakṣipatinā dhṛtamānasena tenādyameva sakalaṃ kilasaṃyutaḥ syāt \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Towards the south, a mount of wheat or of gold should be created which could also be conceived as the Gandhamadana mountain, with a bird of gold and a tank of ghi. It should be well decorated.

## \|\| 3.195.24 \|\|

*paścāttilācalamanekasugandha puṣpasauvarṇapippalahiraṇyayahaṃsayuktam \|*  
*ākārayedrajatapuṣpavanena tadvadvastrānvitaṃ dadhiśatodasarastathāgre \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Towards the west, a mount of sesamum seeds should be created decorating it with various types of golden flowers. The holy fig tree (pipala), the birds and the swans should also be shown there. There should be forest of silver trees with flowers blossoming over them. Thereafter, the tank with curd should be created known by the name of Satoda.

## \|\| 3.195.25 \|\|

*saṃsthāpya taṃ vipulaśailamathottareṇa śailaṃ supārśvamapi māṣamayaṃ suvapram \|*  
*puṣpaiśca hemavaṭapādapaśeṣaratnamākārayetkanakadhenuvirājamānam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Then the mount of Vipulatila making use of the sesamum seeds should be created. Thereafter, mount Suparsva should be created making use of the black grain towards the north. There should be lanes of the banyan trees of gold, besides other flowers and plants in addition to the cows made of gold.

## \|\| 3.195.26-27 \|\|

*mākṣīkabhadrakarasāvacayena tadvadrau pyeṇa bhāsvararasaiśca yutaṃ vidhāya \|*  
*homaścaturbhiratha vedapurāṇavidbhirhyetairaniṃdya varitākṛtibhirdvijendraiḥ \|\| 26 \|\|*

*pūrveṇa hastamukhamatra vidhāya kuṃḍaṃ kāryastilairatha ghṛtena samitkuśaiśca \|*  
*rātrau ca jāgaramanuddhatagītatūryairāvāhanaṃ ca kathayāmi śiloccayānām \|\| 27 \|\|*

26-27. Over the said mount, there should be tanks of honey and other juices and the forests of the shining silver. Thereafter, four Brahmanas, who are unblemished and well-versed in the Vedas as well as the Pauranika literature, should be entrusted with the task of the performing of homa and for that, a fire altar of hand size should be consecrated. Then commemorating the fire in the altar, the procedure of homa should be completed. Thereafter, with the playing of the sweet music, the night should be spent remaining awake. I am now speaking about the invoking of the mountains or hills.

## \|\| 3.195.28 \|\|

*tvaṃ sarvadevagaṇadhāmanidhe ca vighnamasmadgṛheṣvamaraparvata nāśayāśu \|*  
*kṣemaṃ vidhatsva kuru śāṃtimanuttamāṃ naḥ saṃpūjitaḥ paramabhaktimataḥ pradehi \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. One should start with the prayer – “O Amaragiri, you are the abode of all the gods, therefore, you destroy all the obstructions of our houses quickly and bestow welfare on us. I have adored you in a proper way. Therefore, you bestow the highest devotion to me.

## \|\| 3.195.29-31 \|\|

*tvameva bhagavānīśo brahmā viṣṇurdivākaraḥ \|*  
*mūrtāmūrtaparaṃ bījamataḥ pāhi sanātana \|\| 29 \|\|*

*yasmāttvaṃ lokapālānāṃ viśvamūrteśca maṃdiram \|*  
*keśavārkavasūnāṃ ca tasmā cchāṃtiṃ prayaccha me \|\| 30 \|\|*

*yasmādaśūnyamamarairgaṃdharvaiśca śirastava \|*  
*tasmānmāmuddharāśeṣa duḥkhasaṃsārasāgarāt \|\| 31 \|\|*

29-31. О eternal Deva, you indeed represents the gods like Brahma, Viṣṇu, Siva and Divakara. You are the seed of the universe. Therefore,you protect me. You indeed are the temple of Siva and Vasus. You bestow peace unto me. Your places are always filled with the gods and the Gandharvas. Therefore, you kindly redeem me out of the ocean o m iseries of the universe.”

## \|\| 3.195.32 \|\|

*evamabhyarcya taṃ meruṃ mandaraṃ cāpi pūjayet \|*  
*yasmāccaitrarathenātha bhadrāśvavariṣeṇa ca \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. Thus adoring the mount Meru, one should worship the Mandara – “O Mandara mountain, you accommodate the two varsas (continents) known as Caitraratha and Bhadrasva.

## \|\| 3.195.33-37 \|\|

*śobhase mandarakṣipramatastuṣṭikaro bhava \|*  
*yasmāccūḍāmaṇirjaṃbūdvīpe tvaṃ gandhamādanaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*gandharvairapsarobhiśca gīyamānaṃ yaśo'stu me \|*  
*yasmāttvaṃ ketumālena vaibhrājena vanena ca \|\| 34 \|\|*

*hiraṇyamayapāṣāṇastasmācchāṃtiṃ prayaccha me \|*  
*uttaraiḥ kurubhiryasmātsāvitreṇa vanena ca \|\| 35 \|\|*

*supārśva rājase nityamataḥ śrīrakṣayāstu me \|*  
*evamāmaṃtrya tānsarvānprabhāte vimale punaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*snātvā tu gurave dadyānmadhyamaṃ parvatottamam \|*  
*śeṣāṃśca paṃca tāndadyādṛtvigbhyaḥ kramaśo nṛpa \|\| 37 \|\|*

33-37. You kindly bestow contentment on me rapidly. О Gandhamadana, you are the foremost of all the mountains in the country of Jambudvipa. Let the Gandharvas and Apsaras also sing my glory as well. You kindly grant this boon to me. You have the proud possession of the forest known as Ketumala and Vaibhrajena, besides the golden rocks. Kindly bestow peace on me. The mountain Suparsva possesses the forest know n as Uttarakuru and Savitra. Kindly bestow everlasting pleasures on me.” Thus by invoking all of them, one should take bath in the spotless and clean water and should offer salutation to the Meru mountain and then to the five Brahmanas.

## \|\| 3.195.38 \|\|

*gāvo deyāścatustriṃśadathavā daśa bhārata \|*  
*śaktitaḥ sapta vāṣṭau vā evaṃ dadyādaśaktimān \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. О Bharata – the powerful one, a worthy person should give away thirty four, ten or eight cows or as per his means to the Brāhmaṇa.

## \|\| 3.195.39 \|\|

*ekāpi gurave deyā kapilā supayasvinī \|*  
*parvatānāmaśeṣāṇāmeṣa eva vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. A milk giving Kapila cow should be given over to the preceptor. This is the process prescribed for the charity of all the hills.

## \|\| 3.195.40-41 \|\|

*ya eva pūjane maṃtrāsta evopaskare tathā \|*  
*grahāṇāṃ lokapālānāṃ brahmādīnāmagaiḥ saha \|\| 40 \|\|*

*svamaṃtreṇaiva sarveṣu homaḥ śaileṣu śasyate \|*  
*upavāsī bhavennityamaśaktau naktamiṣyate \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. The mantras of all the planets which are associated with these mountains, besides the Lokapalas, the gods like Brahma and others, also have to be recited. In the yajna of the mountains, the offerings of all the well-established deities should also be given. The performer should always be spiritualist and should observe the fast during the night.

## \|\| 3.195.42 \|\|

*vidhānaṃ sarvaśailānāṃ kramaśaḥ śṛṇu bhārata \|*  
*dānakāleṣu ye mantrāḥ parvateṣu ca yatphalam \|\| 42 \|\|*

42\. О Bharata, I am now relating the process of each one of the mountains. You please listen. I am similarly narrating the time of donation, the related mantras and the merits one earns by doing so.

## \|\| 3.195.43 \|\|

*annaṃ brahma yataḥ proktamanne prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ \|*  
*annādbhavaṃti bhūtāni jagadannena varddhate \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. The food is called Brahman, because it is the food alone which keeps all the living beings alive. It is the food by which the living beings get created. The entire universe is in progress because of the food alone.

## \|\| 3.195.44 \|\|

*annameva yato lakṣmīrannameva janārdanaḥ \|*  
*dhānyaparvatarūpeṇa pāhi tasmānnagottama \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. It is the food which represents Laksmi as well as Janardana. О best of the humans, therefore, you protect me in the form of the hill of food grains.”

## \|\| 3.195.45 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yastu dadyāddhānyamayaṃ girim \|*  
*manvantaraśataṃ sāgraṃ devaloke mahīyate \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. Following this process, the hill of food grain should be given over in charity in a proper way and the one who does so, he lives in the heaven for a hundred Manvantaras, with all pleasures.

## \|\| 3.195.46-47 \|\|

*apsarogaṇagaṃdharvairākīrṇena virājatā \|*  
*vimānena divaḥ pṛṣṭhe sa yāti ṛṣisevitaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*puṇyakṣaye rājarājyamāpnotīha na saṃśayaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

46-47. Thereafter, getting served by the Ṛṣis, he travels to the heaven in a plane in the company of the nymphs and the Gandharvas. In due course of time, with the decline of the merits, he becomes an emperor on earth. There is no doubt about it.

## \|\| 3.195.48 \|\|

*dhānyācalaṃ kanakavṛkṣavirājamānaṃ viṣkaṃbhaparvatayutaṃ surasiddhajuṣṭam \|*  
*yacchaṃti ye sumatayaḥ praṇipatya viprāṃste prāpnuvaṃti parameṣṭhipadābjayugmam \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. Thus the mountain of food grains, with tree of gold, with high peaks, which is always decorated with the gods and Siddhas, should be given over to a Brāhmaṇa and one who does so, he achieves the Brahmaloka.

## Chapter 196. Donating of a salt hill

## \|\| 3.196.1-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi lavaṇācalamuttamam \|*  
*yatpradānānnaro lokamāpnoti śivasaṃyutam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*uttamaḥ ṣoḍaśadroṇaḥ kartabyo lavaṇācalaḥ \|*  
*madhyamaḥ syāttadardhena tadarddhenādhamaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*vittahīno yathāśaktyā droṇādardhaṃ tu kārayet \|*  
*caturthāṃśena viṣayānparvatānkārayetpṛthak \|\| 3 \|\|*

*vidhānaṃ pūrvavatkuryādbrahmādīnāṃ ca sarvadā \|*  
*tadvaddhematarūnsarvāṃllokapālaniveśanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*śirāṃsi kāmadevādīṃstadvattatra niveśayet \|*  
*kuryājjāgaramatrāpi dānamaṃtrānnibodha me \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – I am now speaking about the giving away of a salt hill, with the giving away of which, a person achieves the place of Siva. In the ordering of this hill, the salt of the measure of ten dronas is considered to be the best, and the one with the measure half of it is considered to be of medium type and the one still half of the above quality is considered to be of lowest type. But a poor person can also donate a salt hill of the measure of a drona or a half of it or a quarter of the same. The hill should be created from all the four sides separately and as laid down earlier, the gods, Maruts and others with golden trees and the Lokapalas should be set up over the hill of salt. At the top, the gods like Kamadeva should be placed. The night should be spent remaining awake. I am going to reveal the related mantra, you please listen.

## \|\| 3.196.6-8 \|\|

*saubhāgyarasasaṃbhūto yato'yaṃ lavaṇorasaḥ \|*  
*dānātmakatvena ca māṃ pāhi pāpānnagottama \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tasmādannarasāḥ sarve notkṛṣṭā lavaṇaṃ vinā \|*  
*priyaṃ ca śivayornityaṃ tasmākchāṃtiprado bhava \|\| 7 \|\|*

*viṣṇudeha samudbhūtaṃ yasmādārogyavardhanam \|*  
*yasmātparvatarūpeṇa pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. “O best of the humans, because you emerged out of the juice of the fortunes, you have been known as the salt hill. Therefore, with the giving away of this charity, you kindly save me. Other food items become tasteless without the addition of salt and because of that, you are the favorite of Lord Śiva and Pārvatī. You kindly bestow peace on me. Emerging out of the body of Lord Viṣṇu, you enhance the good health. Therefore, by means of this hill, you save me from this deadly ocean of universe.”

## \|\| 3.196.9 \|\|

*anena vidhinā yastu dadyāllavaṇaparvatam \|*  
*umāloke vasetkalpaṃ tato yāti parāṃ gatim \|\| 9 \|\|*
