9\. With the following of this process, a person who gives away the salt hill, he enjoys all the pleasures in the abode of Umā for a kalpa, and after which he earns the beatitude.

## \|\| 3.196.10 \|\|

*puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*putrapautraiḥ parivṛto jīvecca śaradāṃ śatam \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. In due course of time, at the decline of his merits, he becomes a spiritual king on earth. He enjoys a life of a hundred years with his sons and grandsons.

## \|\| 3.196.11 \|\|

*kurvaṃti ye lavaṇa parvatasaṃpradānaṃ saṃprāpnuvaṃti divi te sumahadvimānam \|*  
*tatrāpsarogaṇasurāsurasevyamānāstiṣṭhaṃti hṛṣṭamanaso divi vṛddhamānāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Thus a person who gives away in charity the salt hill, he boards over a bright plane in which the gods and the nymphs always remain present and then reaches the heaven with grace. He always remains happy there.

## Chapter 197. Giving away of the hill of raw sugar

## \|\| 3.197.1-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi guḍaparvatamuttamam \|*  
*yatpradānānnaraḥ svargaṃ prāpnoti surapūjitam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*uttamo daśabhirbhāraiḥ madhyamaḥ paṃcabhistathā \|*  
*tribhirbhāraiḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ syāttadarddhenālpako mataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*tadvadāmaṃtraṇaṃ pūjāṃ hemavṛkṣasurārcanam \|*  
*viṣkaṃbhaparvatāstatra sarāṃsi vanadevatāḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*homaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ tadvallokapālādhivāsanam \|*  
*dhānyaparvatavatkuryādimaṃ maṃtramudīrayet \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – Now I shall speak to you about the giving away of a raw sugar hill in charity and by so doing a person attains heaven, where he is respected by the gods. Ten bharas of raw sugar should be used for making a rich hill, the one which is made of the five bharas of raw sugar is treated to be of medium type and the one in which only three bharas of raw sugar is used is treated as smallest. As has been stated earlier, this also includes the invocation, worship, the golden tree, worship of the gods, Viskambha mountain, the tanks, besides the adoration of fire gods and then the performing of homa is required. Awaking at night, adhivdsana of the Lokapalas and other rites have to be performed similar to those of the adoration of the food grain hill. Thereafter, the following mantras are to be recited.

## \|\| 3.197.5-6 \|\|

*yathā deveṣu viśvātmā pravaroyaṃ janārdanaḥ \|*  
*sāmavedastu vedānāṃ mahādevastu yoginām \|\| 5 \|\|*

*praṇavaḥ sarvamaṃtrāṇāṃ nārīṇāṃ pārvatī yathā \|*  
*tathā rasānāṃ pravaraḥ sadā cekṣuraso mataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. “As lord Janardana - the universal soul happens to be the best among the gods; Samaveda is the best among the Vedas; Mahadeva is the best among the yogins; Pranava among the mantras; and Parvati has been said to be the best among the ladies, similarly, the sugarcane juice is considered to be the best of all the juices.

## \|\| 3.197.7-10 \|\|

*mama tasmātparāṃ lakṣmīṃ prayaccha guḍaparvata \|*  
*surāsurāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ nāgayakṣarkṣayaṃtriṇām \|\| 7 \|\|*

*vināśaścāpi pārvatyāstasmānmāṃ pāhi sarvadā \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu dadyādguḍamayaṃ girim \|\| 8 \|\|*

*saṃpūjyamāno gaṃdharvairgauṃrīloke mahīyate \|*  
*punaḥ kalpaśatāṃte tu saptadvīpādhipo bhavet \|\| 9 \|\|*

*āyurārogyasaṃpannaḥ śatrubhiścāparājitaḥ \|*  
*āsīdrājñī mahābhāgā sulabhā nāma suvratā \|\| 10 \|\|*

7-10. О raw sugar hill, kindly bestow on me the best of the fortunes. Parvati alone had been responsible for the destruction of all the Gods, Asuras, Nagas, Yaksas, Raksasas and the beings who are controlled. Therefore, let me be saved always.” A person who gives away the raw sugar hill in charity in this way, he is worshipped by the Gandharvas and attains the place of the goddess Gauri. After the lapse of a hundred kalpas, on his rebirth on earth, he becomes the leader of seven continents, remains healthy, enjoys long life and becomes invincible for the enemies. There was once a king in ancient time, known by the name of Maruta, who had the chief queen known by the name of Sulabha.

## \|\| 3.197.11-12 \|\|

*maruttasya priyā bhāryā rūpa yauvanaśālinī \|*  
*tasya bhāryā śatānyāsansapta rājño mahātmanaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*tā dāsya iva vākyāni kuryustasyāḥ sadaiva hi \|*  
*mukhāvalokanakaro rājā tasya ca sā priyā \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. She was quite young and beautiful, besides immensely devoted to her husband. The noble king had other seven queens as well, who always obeyed the command of Sulabha like slave girls. The king always used to have a look at the face of the chief queen, who also gazed at the face of the noble king.

## \|\| 3.197.13-14 \|\|

*atha kālena mahatā durvāsā ṛṣisattamaḥ \|*  
*ājagāma tadabhyāśaṃ bhramamāṇo yadṛcchayā \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tasyātha satkriyāṃ kṛttvā dattvā cārghaṃ yathāvidhi \|*  
*papraccha sulabhā vipraṃ durvāsasamakalmaṣam \|\| 14 \|\|*

13-14. After passing of a lot of time, while wandering here and there, Maharsi Durvasa arrived at the place of the king. After offering the cautionary welcome of giving padya and arghya to the Maharsi, the queen asked a question to the great ascetic.

## \|\| 3.197.15-16 \|\|

*sulabhovāca \|*  
*kena puṇyena bhagavanmama rājā priyaṃkaraḥ \|*  
*mukhāvalokanaparo vaśe tiṣṭhati sarvadā \|\| 15 \|\|*

*sapatnyaśca mama brahmansadā priyahite ratāḥ \|*  
*etadācakṣva bhagavanparaṃ kautūhalaṃ mama \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. Sulabha said – “O lord Brahman, with the performing of which one of the merit, I became immensely favourite of the king, that he looks at my face daily. As the cowives are subordinate to me, the king is always more inclined to me, which is liked by me. I would like to know about the reason for the same. You kindly tell me.”

## \|\| 3.197.17-18 \|\|

*durvāsā uvāca \|*  
*śṛṇuṣvāvahitā subhrūrātmavṛttaṃ purātanam \|*  
*jānāmi sarvaṃ subhage tava vṛttamaśeṣataḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tvamāsīrvaiśya mahiṣī girivrajapure purā \|*  
*dhārmikā satyaśīlā ca pativrataparāyaṇā \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. Durvasa said – О beautiful one, I am going to relate the story of your earlier birth. You listen to the story of your earlier life quite carefully. In earlier birth, you happened to be the chief queen of a Vaisya in the city of Girivraja. You were extremely religious minded, truthful, besides being devoted to your husband immensely.

## \|\| 3.197.19-22 \|\|

*tatra śrutastvayā vatse brāhmaṇānāṃ samīpataḥ \|*  
*purā dānavidhiḥ kṛtsnaḥ sthitayā patisaṃnidhau \|\| 19 \|\|*

*viśeṣatastatra vipraiḥ kathito guḍaparvataḥ \|*  
*dattaścāpi tvayā putri saṃbhṛtya vidhivattadā \|\| 20 \|\|*

*tasya dānasya māhātmyāttvayā bhuktaṃ varānane \|*  
*rājyaṃ janmāni catvāri niḥsapatnamanākulam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*anyāni sapta janmāni tava rājyaṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*saubhāgyamatulaṃ caiva rūpamārogyameva ca \|\| 22 \|\|*

19-22. Together with young husband, you had learnt about the process of performing all the vratas. О daughter, you specifically heard about the performing of the donation of raw sugar hill from the Brahmanas. Thereafter, you performed the same vrata in a proper manner. During the last four births, you had enjoyed the position of being a chief queen with all the pleasures and you shall enjoy the same comforts for the next seven births, in which your unparallel fortunes, beauty and good health shall increase.

## \|\| 3.197.23-24 \|\|

*bhūtaṃ caivamavaśyaṃ ca guḍaparvatadānajam \|*  
*kathā tava varārohe yāsye tvaṃ bhava pu triṇī \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tasmāddeyamidaṃ dānaṃ phalamuttamamicchatā \|*  
*gatiṃ ca śāśvatīṃ lebhe saubhāgyaṃ rūpameva ca \|\| 24 \|\|*

23-24. О beautiful one, because of your giving a raw sugar hill in charity, besides increase in your comforts, you story shall also become popular with the masses. I am now leaving this place. Therefore, the people who are desirous of the excellent results, should perform this type of charity, to enable them to have nice movements and earning of enormous fortunes.

## \|\| 3.197.25-26 \|\|

*dānametatpraśaṃsaṃti strīṇāṃ rāja nviśeṣataḥ \|*  
*pūrvoktaṃ ca phalaṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyo'bhijāyate \|\| 25 \|\|*

*kṛṣṇeṣṭasuṃdaradarīsravaṇākulena gaṃdharvasiddhavanitāśatasevitena \|*  
*dattena bhārata vidhānavatā sadaiva gaurī prasādamupayāti guḍācalena \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. This vrata is particularly beneficial for the ladies, with the influence of which they always get successful. A raw sugar hill made with the canes of lord Kṛṣṇa is always served by Gandharvas, Siddhas and the damsels. A person who gives it away in charity, he always enjoys the grace of the goddess Gauri.

## Chapter 198. Giving away of Hemacala

## \|\| 3.198.1-4 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*atha pāpaharaṃ vakṣye suvarṇācalamuttamam \|*  
*yasya prasādādbhavanaṃ vairicyaṃ yāti mānavaḥ \|\| 1 \|\|*

*uttamaḥ palasāhasro madhyamaḥ pañcabhiḥ śataiḥ \|*  
*tadarddhenāvarastadvadalpavitto'pi śaktitaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*dadyādekapalādūrdhvaṃ yathāśaktyā vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*dhānyaparvatavatsarvaṃ vidadhyānnṛpasattama \|\| 3 \|\|*

*viṣkaṃbhaśailāṃstadvacca kṛtvā maṃtramudīrayet \|*  
*namaste brahmabījāya brahmagarbhāya vai namaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

1-4. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said –Now I am going to tell you about the method for the giving away in charity the mountain of gold which removes all the sins and with the performing of which, a person achieves the place of Brahma. In the making of such a mountain, when a thousand palas of gold is used, it is considered to be the best. When five hundred palas are used for making the same, it is considered to be of medium type. But a poor person with intelligence can make the same as per his means for a little over than a pala of gold and give it away in charity. О best of rulers, in this case also, all the methods as prescribed in the case of giving away of the mountain of food grains have to be followed and while so doing, the mountain like Viskambha should also be consecrated. Thereafter, the adoration of the deities should be performed, after which the mantra should be recited – “You emerged out of the seed of Brahman and are the form a Brahman, you bestow the everlasting reward. You must protect me.

## \|\| 3.198.5-8 \|\|

*yasmādanaṃtaphaladastasmātpāhi śiloccaya \|*  
*yasmādagnerapatyaṃ tvaṃ yasmādulba jagatpateḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*hemaparvatarūpeṇa tasmātpāhi nagottama \|*  
*anena vidhinā yastu dadyātkanakaparvatam \|\| 6 \|\|*

*sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*tatra varṣaśataṃ tiṣṭhettato yāti parāṃ gatim \|\| 7 \|\|*

*hemācalātparaṃ dānaṃ na cānyadvidyate kvacit \|\| 8 \|\|*

5-8. О Nagottama, being the product of Agni and the outer membrane of the foetus, you kindly protect me in the form of the mountain of gold.” A person who gives away the mountain of gold in charity, he attains the supreme place of lord Mahadeva. Enjoying all the pleasures there for a hundred years, he achieves liberation. Therefore, there is no other charity comparable with the charity of mountain of gold.

## \|\| 3.198.9 \|\|

*haimaṃ mahīṃdramaṇiśṛṃgaśatairupetaṃ lokādhipāṣṭakayutaṃ sahitaṃ munīndraiḥ \|*  
*yaḥ śaktimānvitaratīha gaṇeśaloke kalpaṃ kumāravadasau kurupuṃgavā'ste \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. O foremost of the race of Kurus, that person who gives away the golden mountain, together with hundreds of peaks of sapphire gems along with figures of Lokapālas, such a powerful person stays in Gaṇeśaloka for a kalpa and enjoys all the comforts like Kumāra Skanda.

## Chapter 199. Giving away of the mountain of the sesamum seeds

## \|\| 3.199.1-7 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tilaśailaṃ vidhānataḥ \|*  
*yatpradānānnaro yāti viṣṇulokamanuttamam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*tilāḥ pavitramatulaṃ pavitrāṇāṃ ca pāvanam \|*  
*viṣṇudehasamudbhūtāstasmāduttamatāṃ gatāḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*madhukaiṭabhanāmānāvāstāṃ ditisutau purā \|*  
*madhunā saha tatrābhūdyuddhaṃ viṣṇoranāratam \|\| 3 \|\|*

*sahasraṃ kila varṣāṇāṃ na vyajīvata dānavaḥ \|*  
*tatra svedo mahānāsītkruddhasyātha gadābhṛtaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*patitaśca dharāpṛṣṭhe kaṇaśo lavaśastathā \|*  
*samuttasthustilā māṣāḥ kuśāśca kurunaṃdana \|\| 5 \|\|*

*hataśca hariṇā yuddhe sa madhurbalināṃ varaḥ \|*  
*medasā tasya vasudhā raṃjitā sakalā tadā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*medinīti tataḥ saṃjñāmavāpācala dhāriṇī \|*  
*hate'tha daityapravare devāstoṣaṃ paraṃ yayuḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

1-7. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – Now I am speaking to you about the mountain of sesamum seeds. By giving away the same in charity, a person achieves the place of Viṣṇu. The sesamum seeds are the best of all auspicious things. Because of its emerging out of the body of Lord Viṣṇu, the sesamum seeds are considered to be extremely auspicious. In ancient times, Diti - the wife of the sage Kaśyapa gave birth to two great daityas known by the names of Madhu and Kaiṭabha. Out of them, Madhu fought with Viṣṇu for a divine thousand years, but still the daitya could not be killed. At this, Lord Viṣṇu was extremely enraged and with that, the sweat appeared from the body of the lord which fell on earth and turned into pieces out of which the sesamum seeds, black-grains, and the kuśa grass were formed. O son of the race of Kurus, at the same time, the great daitya Madhu met with his end, while fighting with Hari. The medasa (fat) of the daitya was spread on earth, as a result of which she came to be known as Medinī. After the killing of the powerful daitya, the gods were extremely delighted and satisfied. Then, offering the prayers to Lord Viṣṇu, the gods said.

## \|\| 3.199.8-11 \|\|

*stutibhiśca paraṃ stutvā ūcustridaśapuṃgavam \|*  
*devā ūcuḥ \|*  
*tvayā dhṛtaṃ jagaddeva tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ tathaiva ca \|\| 8 \|\|*

*tvayīśa līyate sarvaṃ tvayaiva madhusūdana \|*  
*tasmāttvadaṃgato jātāstilāḥ saṃtu jagaddhitāḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*pālayaṃtu ca deveśa havyakavyāni sarvadā \|*  
*daive pitrye ca satataṃ niyojyāstatparairnaraiḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*nahi daityāḥ piśācā vā vipraṃ kurvaṃti bhārata \|*  
*tilā yatropayujyaṃte etacchīghraṃ vidhīyatām \|\| 11 \|\|*

8-11. The gods said – “You carry this earth, which had indeed been created by you only. Finally, it gets absorbed in you. O Lord Madhusūdana, let the sesamum seeds which emerged out of your body be beneficial to the people, who should use the same in the performance of the rites relating to the gods and the manes. О Devesa, О Bharata, (when the sesamum seeds are used) in the rites relating to gods and manes, the daityas would not be able to create any obstruction in them. Therefore, you kindly finish it expeditiously.”

## \|\| 3.199.12-14 \|\|

*śrutvā surāṇāṃ tadvākyaṃ viṣṇustānidamabravīt \|*  
*tilā bhavantu rakṣārthaṃ trayāṇāṃ jagatāmapi \|\| 12 \|\|*

*śuklapakṣe tu devānāṃ saṃpradadyāttilodakam \|*  
*kṛṣṇapakṣe pitṝṇāṃ ca snātvā śraddhāsamanvitaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tilaiḥ saptāṣṭabhirvāpi samarpitajalāṃjaliḥ \|*  
*tasya devāḥ sapitarastṛptā yacchaṃti śobhanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

12-14. On hearing the words of the gods, Viṣṇu said – “Sesamum seeds have emerged out of my body for the protection of the three worlds, therefore, in the bright fortnight, in order to please the gods, the water with sesamum seeds should be offered as oblation and in the dark fortnight, only eight seeds of sesamum should be offered with water as oblation. By so doing, all the gods and the manes get pleased.

## \|\| 3.199.15-16 \|\|

*śvakākopahataṃ yacca patitādibhireva ca \|*  
*tilairabhyukṣitaṃ sarvaṃ pavitraṃ syānna saṃśayaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

*etairmṛtaistilairyastu kṛtvā parvatamuttamam \|*  
*pradadyāddvijamukhyāya dānaṃ tasyākṣayaṃ bhavet \|\| 16 \|\|*

15-16. The things which are defiled by the dogs, crows and the fallen people, get purified with the sprinkling of the sesamum seeds over the same. There is no doubt about it. Therefore, by making a hill of the auspicious sesamum seeds, when it is given over to a Brāhmaṇa in charity, one achieves an everlasting reward.

## \|\| 3.199.17-20 \|\|

*uttamo daśabhirdroṇairmadhyamaḥ paṃcabhirmataḥ \|*  
*tribhiḥ kaniṣṭho rājendra tilaśailaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*pūrvavaccāparaṃ sarvaṃ viṣkaṃbhaparvatādikam \|*  
*dānamannaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvannṛpasattama \|\| 18 \|\|*

*yasmānmadhuvadhe viṣṇordehasvedasamudbhavāḥ \|*  
*tilāḥ kuśāśca māṣāśca tasmācchaṃ no bhavatviha \|\| 19 \|\|*

*havye kavye ca yasmācca tilairevābhimaṃtraṇam \|*  
*bhavāduddhara śaileṃdra tilācala namo'stu te \|\| 20 \|\|*

17-20. Sesamum seeds measuring ten dronas in weight are when used in forming the hill, it is taken to be the best. The half of that quantity is taken to be of medium type and the hill made of three dronas measure of sesamum seeds is treated to be as of the lowest type. O Rajendra, initially, all the rites prescribed earlier should be performed and Viskambha and other peaks should be created over the hill. Thereafter, mantras should be recited. At the time of the killing of Madhu and Kaitabha, sesamum seeds, kudu grass and black-grain emerged. Sesamum seeds are used in the performing of the havya and kavya rites in a yajna. Therefore, you kindly redeem me out of the ocean of the universe.”

## \|\| 3.199.21-22 \|\|

*ityāmaṃtrya ca yo dadyāttilācalamanuttamam \|*  
*sa vaiṣṇavaṃ padaṃ yāti punarāvṛttidurlabham \|\| 21 \|\|*

*dīrghāyuṣṭvamavāpnoti iha loke paratra ca \|*  
*pitṛbhirdevagandharvaiḥ pūjyamāno divaṃ vrajet \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. Thus invoking, when a person gives away the sesamum seeds hill, he earns such a Vaisnava position reaching where, the return is not possible. Such a person attains long life on the earth and even beyond that. Then after being adored by the gods, Pitrs and Gandharvas, he reaches the heaven.

## \|\| 3.199.23-25 \|\|

*puṇyakṣayādihābhyetya rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ \|*  
*nārī vā tasya patnī syādrūpasaubhāgyasaṃyutā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*dakṣā kulodbhavā caiva putrapautrasamanvitā \|*  
*vidhānamidamākarṇya vidhinā śraddhayānvitaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

*kapilādānapuṇyasya samaṃ phalamavāpnuyāt \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. At the decline of the merits, he again reaches the earth as a religious minded monarch and his wife also possesses beauty and fortunes, earns the same merits which are achieved by a chaste and noble house-wife of spotless clan and lives gracefully with her sons and the grandsons. A person who listens with devotion about this charity, he earns the merit equivalent to the giving away of а Kapila cow in charity.

## \|\| 3.199.26 \|\|

*dānaṃ tilācalasamaṃ yadi cānyadasti tadbhūta śāstranicayaṃ pravicārya buddhyā \|*  
*yairvarjitā pitṛkriyā na ca homakarma teṣāṃ pradānamiha kiṃ na karoti śarma \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. In case there be any other charity comparable with the donation of sesamum hill, then carefully consulting the scriptures, you kindly tell me. Because a person who has never performed sraddha for his manes, nor has he performed any homa for the gods, then can this type of charity given by him would be beneficial for him or not? Answer is yes.

## Chapter 200. Donating of the Cotton

## \|\| 3.200.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kārpāsācalamuttamam \|*  
*paramaṃ sarvadānānāṃ priyaṃ sarvadivaukasām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*deśakālau samāsādya dhanaṃ śraddhāṃ ca yatnataḥ \|*  
*deyametanmahādānaṃ kuloddharaṇahetave \|\| 2 \|\|*

*pūrvoktena vidhānena kṛtvā sarvamaśeṣataḥ \|*  
*parvataṃ kalpayettatra kārpāsena vidhānataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – Now I am going to speak out to you about the giving away of a mountain of cotton in charity, which is the best of all the charities and is favourite with the gods. On gaining the riches in the house, on some other auspicious occasions, for the upliftment of one’s own race, this is the great charity which should be performed by a person. Following the aforesaid process, a cotton hill should be created.

## \|\| 3.200.4-9 \|\|

*viṃśadbhārastu kartavya uttamaḥ parvato budhaiḥ \|*  
*daśabhirmadhyamaḥ prokto jaghanyaḥ paṃcabhirmataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*bhāreṇālpadhano dadyādvittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ \|*  
*dhānyaparvatavatsarvamāsādya nṛpapuṃgava \|\| 5 \|\|*

*tadvajjāgaraṇaṃ kuryāttadvaccaivādhivāsanam \|*  
*prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāmimaṃ mantramudīrayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*tvamevāvaraṇaṃ yasmāllokānāmiha sarvadā \|*  
*kārpāsācala nastasmādaghaughadhvaṃsano bhava \|\| 7 \|\|*

*iti kārpāsaśailendraṃ yo dadyātparvasaṃnidhau \|*  
*rudraloke vasetkalpaṃ tato rājā bhavediha \|\| 8 \|\|*

*rūpavānsubhago vāgmī śrīmānatulavikramaḥ \|*  
*pañcajanmāni nārī vā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

4-9. Such a hill has been described to be the best having the weight of twenty bharas, when it is of ten bharas (one bhara is equal to ninety five kilograms), it is treated to be of medium type; and when it is of five bharas, it is considered the lowest type. Shedding away the miserliness, even a poor person can make a hill of a single bhara of cotton and should be given over in charity. О foremost of the kings, all the formalities with the giving away of other hills should also be observed in this case, and then keeping awake at night, adhivdsana should be done as well. In the early morning, a prayer should be offered – “O cotton hill, you always are the cover for all the lokas. Therefore, you kindly destroy our sins.” This mantra should be recited on a festive day and when a person gives away a cotton hill, he lives in the place of Rudra for a kalpa, enjoying all the comforts. After his return from the place of Rudra, he becomes a beautiful monarch. Because of the influence of this charity, even a woman remains quite comfortable for five births.

## \|\| 3.200.10 \|\|

*kārpāsaparvatamayo jagadekabaṃdhuryasmānnatena rahito varavastrayogaḥ \|*  
*tasmādaghaudhaśamanāya sukhāya nityaṃ deyo nareṇa naranāthavimatsareṇa \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. О king, cotton is the only relative of a person, because in the absence of the same, no one can get the bush of clothes. Therefore, for his own benefit and for the removal of all the sins, the cotton hill must be given away in charity.

## Chapter 201. Hill of ghi

## \|\| 3.201.1-3 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi ghṛtācalamanuttamam \|*  
*tejo'mṛtamayaṃ divyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam \|\| 1 \|\|*

*paṃcāśadghṛtakumbhānāmuttamaḥ syādghṛtācalaḥ \|*  
*madhyamastu tadardhena tadarddhenāvaraḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*alpavittastu kurvīta yathāśaktyā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*viṣkaṃbhaparvatāṃstadvaccaturbhāgena kalpayet \|\| 3 \|\|*

1-3. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – Now I am speaking to you about the hill of ghi, which is bright, nectar like, divine and remover of the grave sins. In the making of this hill, five hundred pitchers filled with ghi should be used for the purpose, which is termed as the best. The half of that number of pitchers filled with ghi is considered to be of medium type and when still half of that are made used of in making the hill, it is called as the lowest type. A person with limited means can use the pitcher of ghi as per his resources. The Viskambha peak should be formed with a quarter of the number of pitchers, put in use.

## \|\| 3.201.4-8 \|\|

*śāleyataṃdulānāṃ ca kuṃbhāṃśca parivinyaset \|*  
*kārayetsaṃhatānuccānyathāśobhaṃ vidhānataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*veṣṭayecchuklavāsobhirikṣudaṃḍaphalādikaiḥ \|*  
*dhānyaparvatavaccheṣaṃ vidhānamiha paṭhyate \|\| 5 \|\|*

*adhivāsanapūrvaṃ ca tadvaddhomaṃ surārcanam \|*  
*prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvayāṃ gurave vinivedayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

*viṣkaṃbhaparvatāṃstadvadṛtvigbhyaḥ śāṃtamānasaḥ \|*  
*maṃtreṇānena kauṃteya tacchṛṇuṣva vadāmi te \|\| 7 \|\|*

*saṃyogādghṛtamutpannaṃ yasmādamṛtatejase \|*  
*tasmādghṛtācalaścāsmātprīyatāṃ mama śaṃkaraḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

4-8. The pitchers should then be placed over the Sali rice spurred over the ground. Then the best creation should be made. The costumes, the sugarcanes and flowers should be placed around the pitchers. All the formalities as prescribed for the hill of food grains should be observed. Thereafter, the adhivasana, homa and adoration of the gods should be done in the early morning. The Meru hill should be given over to the preceptor, while the Viskambha hill should be given over to the yajna priest. The mantra that is required to be recited at that moment with a peaceful mind, is being spoken by me. You please listen. “The ghi emerged out of the aghrta and tejasa, therefore, with the giving away of the hill of ghi in charity, lord Siva gets pleased.

## \|\| 3.201.9-12 \|\|

*tasmāttejomayaṃ brahma ghṛte nityaṃ vyavasthitam \|*  
*ghṛtaparvatarūpeṇa tasmānnaḥ pāhi bhūdhara \|\| 9 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā dadyādghṛtācalamanuttamam \|*  
*mahāpātakayukto'pi lokamāyāti śāṃkaram \|\| 10 \|\|*

*haṃsasārasasaṃyukte kiṃkiṇījālamālite \|*  
*vimāne apsarobhiśca siddhavidyādharairvṛtaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*viharetpitṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam \|\| 12 \|\|*

9-12. The illustrious Brahma always pervades in the ghi. Therefore, you protect me in the form of ghrta-parvata." By following this process, a person who gives away only the hill of ghi in charity, he achieves the place of Siva inspite of his being a grave sinner. He mounts over a plane which is being driven by the birds like swans and cranes. The plane is decorated with small bells and the nymphs, the Siddhas and Vidyadharas surround him. He enjoys the company of the manes till the time of dissolution.

## \|\| 3.201.13 \|\|

*ājyācalaṃ pracalakuṃḍalasundarībhiḥ saṃsevyamānamiha ye vitaraṃti martyāḥ \|*  
*svargaṃ sureṃdrabhavanaṃ bhavasaṃnidhiṃ vā snehānubaṃdhamacalaṃ bhavatīti sarvam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The beautiful damsels adorned with bright earrings serve him. A person who donates the hill of ghi, he achieves the place of Indra in the heaven where all his ganas pleases him always.

## Chapter 202. Mountain of gems

## \|\| 3.202.1-5 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi ratnācalamanuttamam \|*  
*yatpradānānnaro yāti lokānsaptarṣisevitān \|\| 1 \|\|*

*muktāphalasahasreṇa parvataḥ syādanuttamaḥ \|*  
*madhyamaḥ pañcaśatikastriśatenāvaraḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*alpavittastu kurvīta muktāphalaśatena ca \|*  
*caturthāṃśena viṣkaṃbhaparvatāḥ syuḥ samaṃtataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*pūrveṇavajragomedairdakṣiṇeneṃdranīlakaiḥ \|*  
*puṣparāgayutaḥ kāryo vidvadbhirgaṃdhamādanaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*vaiḍūryavidrumaiḥ paścātsāvitro vipulācalaḥ \|*  
*padmarāgaṃ sasauvarṇamuttareṇāpi vinyaset \|\| 5 \|\|*

1-5. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – Now I am going to speak to you about the process of giving away the Ratnacala - the mountain of gems. With the performing of this charity, a person achieves the abode of great Ṛṣis. This mountain of gems when formed with a thousand pearls is considered to be best, the one formed with five hundred of them is of the medium type and the one with three hundred pearls is considered to be of the lowest type. The people with limited resources can make it with a hundred gems or pearls as well. A quarter of that quantity should be used for the making of a Viskambha hill on all the four sides. Then making use of the gems and onyx, a hill should be created to the east. The Gandhamadana hill made up of sapphire as well as the topaz should be lodged to the south. Then making use of lapis lazuli and coral tree, the vast savitracala should be made towards the west. Then making use of gold and ruby, a hill should be formed towards the north.

## \|\| 3.202.6-10 \|\|

*dhānyaparvatavaccheṣamatrāpi parikalpayet \|*  
*tadvadāvāhanaṃ kṛtvā vṛkṣāndevāṃśca kāṃcanām \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pūjayetpuṣpanaivedyaiḥ prabhāte tu visarjanam \|*  
*pūrvavadguruṛtvigbhyāṃ imānmaṃtrānudīrayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

*yathā devagaṇāḥ sarve sarvaratneṣvavasthitāḥ \|*  
*tvaṃ ca ratnamayo nityamataḥ pāhi mahācala \|\| 8 \|\|*

*yasmādratnapradānena tuṣṭimeti janārdanaḥ \|*  
*pūjāratnapradānena tasmānnaḥ pāhi sarvadā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*anena vidhinā yastu dadyādratnamayaṃ girim \|*  
*sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamamareśvarapūjitam \|\| 10 \|\|*

6-10. Thereafter, all the rites should be performed as per the rites of the giving away of the hill of food grains. The gods and the trees should be invoked and all other related ceremonies should be performed by the learned people. Then adoring them, the flowers and the eatables should be offered. In the morning, the deities should be sent off reciting the mantras – “O great mountain, all the gods always pervade in all the gems and diamonds. Therefore, you please protect me.” With the following of this process, a person who gives away a hill of gems, he achieves the place of lord Viṣṇu, which is adored even by the gods.

## \|\| 3.202.11-12 \|\|

*yāvatkalpaśataṃ sāgramuṣitveha narādhipa \|*  
*rūpārogyaguṇopetaḥ saptadvīpādhipo bhavet \|\| 11 \|\|*

*brahmahatyādikaṃ kiṃcidatra cāmutra vā kṛtam \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti girirvajrahato yathā \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. О king of the people, after enjoying all the pleasures in Viṣṇuloka, gaining the beauty, healthy body and other virtues, he ultimately becomes the lord of the seven continents of earth. Like the mountains hurt with the vajra of Indra, all his sins including those of Brahmahatya, vanish in no time, irrespective of them being committed on earth or elsewhere.

## \|\| 3.202.13 \|\|

*muktāmayaṃ kanakavidrumabhakticitraṃ caṃcanmahāmaṇimarīcicayopapannam \|*  
*ratnācalaṃ dvijavarāya nivedayitvā bhāsvatprabhāmabhibhavetsuralokaloke \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. By thus giving away the mountain of gems to a Brahmana, which illuminates with the rays and shine of pearls, gold, coral and the diamonds, the donor reaching the heaven, displays the lustre of the sunshine.

## Chapter 203. Giving away of Raupyacala

## \|\| 3.203.1-6 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi raupyācalamanuttamam \|*  
*yatpradānānnaro yāti somalokaṃ narottama \|\| 1 \|\|*

*sahasreṇa palānāṃ tu uttamo rajatācalaḥ \|*  
*paṃcabhirmadhyamaḥ proktastadarddhenāvaraḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*aśakto viṃśaterūrdhvaṃ kārayedbhaktitaḥ sadā \|*  
*viṣkaṃbhaparvatāṃstadvatturīyāṃśena kalpayet \|\| 3 \|\|*

*pūrvavadrājatānkuryānmaṃdarādīnvidhānataḥ \|*  
*kaladhautamayāṃstadvallokeśānkārayennṛpa \|\| 4 \|\|*

*brahmaviṣṇuśivādīṃśca nitaṃbo'tra hiraṇmayaḥ \|*  
*rājataṃ syādyadanyeṣāṃ sarvaṃ tadiha kāṃcanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavatkṛtvā homajāgaraṇādikam \|*  
*dadyāttadvatprabhāte tu gurave raupyaparvatam \|\| 6 \|\|*

1-6. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – О best of the humans, now I am speaking to you about the mountain of Raupyacala. By donating the same, a devotee achieves the place of moon. In the making of such a mountain, the one which is made of a thousand palas of silver is considered to be the best; one which is made of five hundred palas is considered to be of medium type; and the one which is made of still half of the same has been treated – of the lowest type. A person with limited means can make it with more than twenty palas of silver and give it away in charity. A quarter of that quantity should be used for the making of Viskambha mountain. O king, while making the mountains like Mandaracala with silver and while creating the Lokapalas images, the silver images of Brahma, Viṣṇu, Siva and other gods should also be made. The lower part of the hill should be of gold and other parts should be made in silver. The other rites should be performed as stated earlier including the homa, night awakening etc. Completing all other formalities, the silver mountain should be given away in the early morning to the preceptor.

## \|\| 3.203.7-11 \|\|

*viṣkaṃbhaśailānṛtvigbhyaḥ pūjayecca vibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*imaṃ maṃtraṃ paṭhandadyāddarbhapāṇirvimatsaraḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

*pitṝṇāṃ vallabhaṃ yasmāccharmadaṃ śaṃkarasya ca \|*  
*rajataṃ pāhi tasmānno ghorātsaṃsārasāgarāt \|\| 8 \|\|*

*itthaṃ niveśya yo dadyādrajatācalamuttamam \|*  
*gavāmayutadānasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*somaloke sagaṃdharvakiṃnarāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ \|*  
*pūjyamāno vasedvidvānyāvadābhūtasaṃplavam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*rājeśa rājatagiriṃ kanakopalālīcchannaṃ prasannasalile sahitaṃ sarobhiḥ \|*  
*yacchaṃti ye sukṛtino virajo vi śokaṃ gacchaṃti te gatamalā nṛpa somalokam \|\| 11 \|\|*

7-11. The Viskambha mountain should be given over to the yajna priests. At that point of time, holding the kusa grass, getting free from arrogance and pride, one should recite the mantra mentally – “The favourite of the manes, silver bestows welfare, therefore, you protect me from the terrific ocean of the universe.” Thereafter, adoring all the gods in a proper manner, one who gives away the silver mountain, he earns the merit of giving away in charity ten thousand cows and is served by the Gandharvas and nymphs in the place of moon. Thus the mountain of silver covered with gold, has the tanks and lakes with pure and spotless clean water. A person who gives it away in charity, he having all his sins removed, is freed from all the grief and ultimately reaches the place of moon.

## Chapter 204. Donation of Mount of sugar

## \|\| 3.204.1-2 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi śarkarācalamuttamam \|*  
*yasya pradānādviṣṇvarkarudrāstuṣyaṃti sarvadā \|\| 1 \|\|*

*aṣṭabhiḥ śarkarābhārairuttamaḥ syānmahācalaḥ \|*  
*caturbhirmadhyamaḥ prokto bhārābhyāmadhamaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

1-2. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – I am now speaking to you about the donation of an excellent mountain of sugar. By donating the mountain of sugar, the gods like Viṣṇu, Surya and Rudradeva always remain happy with the person. In the making of such a mountain, eight bharas of sugar is the medium one and of two bharas is the lowest one.

## \|\| 3.204.3-5 \|\|

*bhāreṇaivārddhabhāreṇa kuryādyaścālpavittavān \|*  
*viṣkaṃbhaparvatānkuryātturīyāṃśena mānavaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dhānyaparvatavatsarvamāsādya rasasaṃyutam \|*  
*meroruparitastadvatsthāpya hematarutrayam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*maṃdāraḥ pārijātaśca tṛtīyaḥ kalpapādapaḥ \|*  
*etadvṛkṣatrayaṃ mūrdhni sarveṣvapi nidhāpayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

3-5. A person with limited resources and capacity can make the sugar hill of a single bhara or the half of it. A quarter of that quantity should be used for the making of a Viskambha hill. All the formalities as required for the giving in charity of the mountain of food grains (as discussed earlier) should be observed. Then the trees like the swallow wart, Parijata and Kalpavṛkṣa should be established over the same, which should be made of gold. The planting of all these three trees has been prescribed in all the religious rites.

## \|\| 3.204.6-8 \|\|

*haricaṃdanasaṃtānau pūrvapaścimabhāgayoḥ \|*  
*niveśyau sarvaśaileṣu viśeṣāccharkarācale \|\| 6 \|\|*

*maṃdare kāmadevaṃ tu kaṃdabasya tale nyaset \|*  
*jaṃbūvṛkṣatale kāryo garunmāngaṃdhamādane \|\| 7 \|\|*

*prāṅmukho hemamūrtiśca haṃsaḥ syādvipulācale \|*  
*haimī śreyorthibhiḥ kāryā surabhirdakṣiṇāmukhī \|\| 8 \|\|*

6-8. The Haricandana as well as Kalpavṛkṣa should respectively be planted on the eastern and the western side. At the base of the Kadamba tree over the Mandara mountain, Kamadeva should be lodged. Under the silk cotton tree, Garuda is to be lodged. Under the vast Vipula mountain, the gold image of a swan facing east should be placed. And facing south, the cow Surabhi made in gold should be lodged.

## \|\| 3.204.9-15 \|\|

*dhānyaparvatavatsarvamāvāhanamakhādikam \|*  
*kṛtvātha gurave dadyānmadhyamaṃ parvatottamam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*ṛtvigbhyaścaturaḥ śailānimānmaṃtrānudīrayet \|*  
*saubhāgyāmṛtasāro'yaṃ paramaḥ śarkarāyutaḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yasmādānaṃdakārī tvaṃ bhava śaileṃdra sarvadā \|*  
*amṛtaṃ pibatāṃ ye tu niṣpeturbhuvi śīkarāḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*devānāṃ tatsamuttho'si pāhi naḥ śarkarācala \|*  
*manobhavadhanurmadhyādudbhūtā śarkarā yataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*tanmayo'si mahāśaila pāhi saṃsārasāgarāt \|*  
*yo dadyāccharkarāśailamanena vidhinā naraḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa yāti śivamaṃdiram \|*  
*caṃdrādisārcisaṃkāśamadhiruhyānujīvibhiḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*sahaiva yānamātiṣṭhetsa tu viṣṇupade divi \|*  
*tataḥ kalpa śatāṃte tu saptadvīpādhipo bhavet \|\| 15 \|\|*

9-15. As in the case of mountain of food grains, all the rites should be completed and the best of the mountain placed in the middle should be offered to the preceptor. The rest of them should be given over to the yajna priests, reciting the mantras – “O Sailendra, you happen to be the essence of fortunes and nectar, therefore, along with sugar, you be always graceful on me. At the time of giving away of nectar to the gods, a few drops of nectar dropped over the earth, which turned into sugar. Therefore, you kindly protect me. You are linked with the middle of the bow of sugarcane of Kamadeva and are known as sugar. Therefore, you protect me from the ocean of this universe.” A person, who gives away in charity a mountain of sugar, he gets rid of all his sins. And with the attendants, he goes to the place of Viṣṇu in a plane shining like the sun and the moon, where he lives for a hundred kalpas with comfort. Thereafter, he becomes an emperor of the seven continents.

## \|\| 3.204.16-18 \|\|

*āyurārogyasaṃpanno yāvajjanmāyutatrayam \|*  
*bhojanaṃ śaktito dadyātsarvaśaileṣvamatsaraḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ vā kṣāra lavaṇamaśnīyāttadanujñayā \|\| 16 \|\|*

*parvatopaskaraṃ sarvaṃ prāpayedbrāhmaṇālayam \|*  
*āsītpurā brahmakalpe dharmamūrtirnarādhipaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*suhṛcchakrasya nihatā yena daityāḥ sahasraśaḥ \|*  
*somasūryādayo yasya tejasā vigataprabhāḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

16-18. As in the case of the mountain of food grains, all the rites should be observed. Thereafter, for the three next births, he enjoys the long life with good health. During the festivities of giving away the mountains in charity, the Brahmana should be satisfied. Then, with the permission of the Brahmana, he himself should take food with salt. The entire material connected with the donation of the mountain should be sent off at the place of the Brahmana. During the Brahma-kalpa, in ancient time, there had been a king named Dharmamurti, who because of his friendship with Indra, had killed thousands of daityas in the battle-ground. He also surprised the gods like Surya, Candra and others with his lustre.

## \|\| 3.204.19-20 \|\|

*bhavaṃti śataśo yena rājāno'pi parājitāḥ \|*  
*yathecchārūpadhārī ca manuṣyo'pyapavāritaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tasya bhānumatīnāma bhāryā trailokyasuṃdarī \|*  
*lakṣmīriva ca rūpeṇa nirjitāmarasuṃdarī \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. He also defeated hundred of kings. Changing to several forms, he caused obstruction even for the human beings. He had a wife who was a beauty of the three worlds and known by the name of the Bhanumati. She was as beautiful as Laksmi and had defeated several of the damsels in beauty.

## \|\| 3.204.21-24 \|\|

*rājñastasyāgramahiṣī prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī \|*  
*daśanārīsahasrāṇāṃ madhye śrīriva rājate \|\| 21 \|\|*

*nṛpakoṭisahasreṇa na kadācitpramucyate \|*  
*sa kadācitsthānagataṃ papraccha svaṃ purohitam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*vismayāviṣṭahṛdayo vasiṣṭhamṛṣisattamam \|*  
*bhagavankena dharmeṇa mama lakṣmīranuttamā \|\| 23 \|\|*

*kasmācca vipulaṃ tejo maccharīre sadottamam \|\| 24 \|\|*

21-24. Out of his ten thousand queens, the chief queen was dearer to the king than his life even. At the command of the king, thousands of rulers always kept his company with obedience. Once, when the royal priest arrived in the court, the king feeling surprised asked him – “As a result of which auspicious deed, I have been able to become the lord of the enormous wealth? What is the reason for my possessing such a great lustre? You kindly tell me.”

## \|\| 3.204.25-27 \|\|

*vaśiṣṭha uvāca \|*  
*purā līlāvatī nāma veśyā śivaparāyaṇā \|*  
*tayā dattaścaturdaśyāṃ gurave lavaṇācalaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

*hemavṛkṣāmaraiḥ sārddhaṃ yathāvadvidhipūrvakaḥ \|*  
*śūdraḥ suvarṇakārastu nāmnā śauṃḍobhavattadā \|\| 26 \|\|*

*bhṛtyo līlāvatīgehe tena haimā vinirmitāḥ \|*  
*taravo'maramukhyāśca śraddhāyuktena pārthiva \|\| 27 \|\|*

25-27. Vasistha said - In earlier times, there had been a whore named Lilavati, who was immensely devoted to lord Siva. On the fourteenth day of the moon, following the right procedure, she had given a mountain of salt with the golden trees to her preceptor. A goldsmith known by the name of Saunda-Sudra was employed at the place of the whore, who, with utmost devotion, had made the gold image of the deity with the tree. О Parthiva, the goldsmith had made the tree and the deities in a beautiful way.

## \|\| 3.204.28-30 \|\|

*atirūpeṇa saṃpannānghaṭayitvā tato hṛdi \|*  
*dharmakāryamatiṃ jñātvā nāgṛhīta kathaṃcana \|\| 28 \|\|*

*ujjvālitāstu tatpatnyā sauvarṇāmarapādapāḥ \|*  
*līlāvatī gṛhe pārśve paricaryā ca pārthiva \|\| 29 \|\|*

*kṛtaṃ tābhyāṃ praharṣeṇa dvijaśuśrūṣaṇādikam \|*  
*sā tu līlāvatī veśyā kālena mahatā nṛpa \|\| 30 \|\|*

28-30. Taking it to be a religions job, the goldsmith did not charge any amount from the whore. Therefore, he had made the figures and the trees in a beautiful way, receiving no wages for his labour. On the other hand, his wife painted the trees and the images with golden colour well. Thus, inspite of his stay in the house of Lilavati, both the husband and wife kept on serving the whore. Besides that, they had also served the Brāhmaṇas with utmost devotion. They lived for long.

## \|\| 3.204.31-34 \|\|

*sarvapāpavinirmuktā jagāma śivamaṃdiram \|*  
*yo'sau suvarṇakāraśca daridro'pyati sattvavān \|\| 31 \|\|*

*na mūlyamādādveśyātaḥ sa bhavāniha sāṃpratam \|*  
*saptadvīpapatirjātaḥ sūryāyutasamaprabhaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

*yayā suvarṇa racitāstaravo hemadevatāḥ \|*  
*samyagujjvalitāḥ patnī seyaṃ bhānumatī tava \|\| 33 \|\|*

*ujjvālanādujjvalarūpamasyāḥ sujātamasminbhuvanādhipatyam \|*  
*tasmātkṛtaṃ tatparikarma rātrāvanuddhatābhyāṃ lavaṇācalasya \|\| 34 \|\|*

31-34. After her death, Lilavati - the whore, getting relieved of all her sins, proceeded on to the place of Siva. The goldsmith, who inspite of his being poor, was quite a generous one and did not accept his due wages from the whore. Presently, you are the same goldsmith and are the emperor of the seven continents. The lady who had got the gold image made and decorated, she is Bhanumati – your chief queen. Because of his brightening the images, you have achieved the lordship of the three Bhuvanas. Therefore, you have achieved the reward for the giving away of the mountain of salt during the night.

## \|\| 3.204.35 \|\|

*tasmācca lokeṣvaparājitastvamārogyasaubhāgyayutā ca lakṣmīḥ \|*  
*tasmāttvamapyatra vidhānapūrvaṃ dhānyācalādīndaśadhā kuruṣva \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. You have become invincible in the world and have achieved fortunes with good health. Therefore, you should presently perform the charity of giving away the mountain of food grains.”

## \|\| 3.204.36-38 \|\|

*tatheti sampūjya ca dharmamūrti vaco vaśiṣṭhasya dadau sa sarvān \|*  
*dhānyācalādīnkramaśaḥ purārerlokaṃ jagāmāmarapūjyamānaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

*yaścādhanaḥ paśyati dīyamānaṃ meroḥ pradānamiha dharmaparo manuṣyaḥ \|*  
*śṛṇoti bhaktyā parayā'pramādī vikalmaṣaḥ so'pi divaṃ prayāti \|\| 37 \|\|*

*duḥsvapnaṃ praśabhamupaiti paṭhyamāne śailendre bhavabhayabhedane narāṇām \|*  
*yaḥ kuryātkimu nṛpapuṃgaveha samyakchāṃtātmā hariharapurameti jaṃtuḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

36-38. At these words of Maharsi Vasistha winch were duly accepted by the king, he performed the charity of giving away of the mountain of food grains and presented the same to Vasistha - the preceptor and ultimately, achieved the place of Siva. A person who listens about this charity or observes it, he achieves the best of riches and righteousness. After enjoying all the pleasures, he moves to the peaceful place of lord Viṣṇu. Therefore, what could be said about the one, who himself performs this charity?

## Chapter 205. The morality or virtue

## \|\| 3.205.1-7 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*pratipankramayogena tithīnāṃ vistaraḥ śrutaḥ \|*  
*sarahasyaḥ samaṃtraśca prāraṃbhodyāpanaiḥ saha \|\| 1 \|\|*

*navagrahamakhātsarvaṃ homakarmāvadhāritam \|*  
*snānakramaśca vidito vijñātāścotsavā mayā \|\| 2 \|\|*

*dānadharmastvaśeṣeṇa śrutaḥ sarvārthadarśitaḥ \|*  
*taḍāgotsarjanavidhirviditaḥ pādapotsavaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*evaṃ gataṃ mama mano muhyate madhusūdana \|*  
*vrataṃ kathayatā kṛṣṇa tāstāḥ saṃśritya devatāḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*devānāṃ devakīputra nānātvaṃ saṃpradarśitam \|*  
*tithikramānkathayatā pūjāmantrodhivāsanam \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vyāsādyairmunibhiḥ sarvairdhyānayogaparāyaṇaiḥ \|*  
*eka evātra nirdiṣṭo devaḥ sarvagato'vyayaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*varṇāśramācāradharmaḥ kasmānnātra pradarśitaḥ \|*  
*ete maharṣayastuṣṭāḥ śrotukāmā bhavadvacaḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

1-7. Yudhisthira said – О Madhusudana, I have heard about the description of different moon-days (tithis) in a sequence, the related secret mantras, their initiation, finalization and the procedures related thereto. The homa rites of the yajna, the sequence of taking the bath, all the festivities, the types of charities, dharma, digging of the tanks and the tree festivals etc. are also very well known to me. О Kṛṣṇa, inspite of all this, my mind is still overwhelmed with the desire to listen more and more. Therefore, understanding the same, you let me know about the respective gods of tithis. О son of Devaki, according to the sequence of the moon days, the description could be made about them. You have highlighted about several deities, the puja-mantra and the related adhivasana have also been spoken by you. But you have not spoken about a god, who is adorable to the great intellectuals like the sage Vyasa and other great Ṛṣis, is all pervading and indestructible. You have also not mentioned about the relative duties of four castes, besides the other related issues have not been discussed at length. The great Ṛṣis are also anxious to learn about the same.

## \|\| 3.205.8-13 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*vratadānaikaleśoyaṃ kathitastava pārthiva \|*  
*viśeṣataśca śaknoti vaktuṃ yadi sarasvatī \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sarvastarati durgāṇi sarvo bhadrāṇi paśyati \|*  
*varṇāśramāṇāṃ sāmānya iti dharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

*kathito'yaṃ vratatvoho devānuddiśya yo mayā \|*  
*paramārthaḥ sa evokto devastamupadhāraya \|\| 10 \|\|*

*yo brahmā sa hariḥ prokto yo hariḥ sa maheśvaraḥ \|*  
*maheśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ sūryaḥ sūryaḥ pāvaka ucyate \|\| 11 \|\|*

*pāvakaḥ kārtikeyosau kārtikeyo vināyakaḥ \|*  
*gaurī lakṣmīśca sāvitrī śaktibhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*devaṃ devīṃ samuddiśya yaḥ karoti vrataṃ naraḥ \|*  
*na bhedastatra maṃtavyaḥ śivaśaktimayaṃ jagat \|\| 13 \|\|*

8-13. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – I have spoken only a fraction of the performing of the charities and vratas, but die full aspect can be related by Sarasvati alone. Let all the people, crossing all the hurdles face benevolence and welfare. This is the common dharma of the human efforts. The vrata, which have been defined by me for the purpose of adoring the gods, should be considered as the subtle birth. Now, I am talking about the other gods, you please listen. Brahma and Hari are the same, while Hari is Mahesvara as well. Mahesvara is the Sun, while Sun is Agni or Fire. Pavaka or Agni is the same as Kartikeya, while Kartikeya is the same as Vinayaka. Similarly, the goddesses like Gauri, Laksmi and Sarasvati are the different forms of Sakti. Whatever vrata is performed by a person for the sake of pleasing a god or a goddess, no difference is envisaged in the same. The entire world has been created as the form of Siva and Sakti.

## \|\| 3.205.14-16 \|\|

*bahuprakārā vasudhā bhedāḥ sāgnyanilāṃbhasām \|*  
*paramārthataściṃtyamāno na bhedaḥ pratibhāsate \|\| 14 \|\|*

*kañciddevaṃ samāśritya karoti kimapi vratam \|*  
*trayīdharmānugaṃ pārtha ekaṃ tatrāpi kāraṇam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*yaścaiva te mayā khyāto vratadānavidhiḥ paraḥ \|*  
*saphalaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ sadācāravatāṃ satām \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. Though several forms of Vasudha (earth), Agni (fire), Vayu (wind) and water are quite apparent, still for the sake of paramartha, when all of them are adored collectively, no difference could be found. О Partha, whatever vrata is being performed by a person taking refuge under anyone of the gods, it could be the cause of the Vedic dharma. The methods of performing of the vratas or fasts, as have been spoken by me, become fruitful for the people of virtues and good conduct.

## \|\| 3.205.17-19 \|\|

*ācārahīnaṃ na punaṃti vedā yadyapyadhītāḥ saha ṣaḍbhiraṅgaiḥ \|*  
*chaṃdāṃsyenaṃ mṛtyukāle tyajaṃti nīḍaṃ śakuntā iva jātapakṣāḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*kapālasthaṃ yathā toyaṃ śvadṛtau vā yathā payaḥ \|*  
*duṣṭaṃ syātsthānadoṣeṇa vṛttahīne tathā śubham \|\| 18 \|\|*

*vṛttaṃ yatnena saṃrakṣedvittameti prayāti ca \|*  
*ahīno vittato hīno vṛttatastu hato hataḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. A person who is devoid of good conduct, when tries to perform the good deeds, they get blemished. Therefore, maintaining good conduct should be well taken care off while performing the good deeds, because the riches keep on coming and going. At some stage, a pauper could become rich, but when a person fails to perform good conduct, he gets destroyed for all time to come. О king, thus getting blemished, a person is lost forever.

## \|\| 3.205.20-21 \|\|

*evamācāradharmasya mūlaṃ rājankulasya ca \|*  
*ācārāddhi cyuto jaṃturna kulīno na dhārmikaḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*kiṃ kulenopadiṣṭen vipulena durātmanām \|*  
*kṛmayaḥ kiṃ na jāyaṃte kusumeṣu sugaṃdhiṣu \|\| 21 \|\|*

20-21. Thus, the base of dharma as well as the noble race is the good conduct. After a person falls from good conduct, he could neither be called to be of noble race nor the one devoted to dharma. Therefore, what is the use of rendering the noble advice to the vast race of the evil people? Do the worms not appear in the fragrant flowers? In other words, because the worms which grow in the fragrant flowers, are least affected with fragrance of the flowers, similarly, the good conduct proves infructuous in case of evil people.

## \|\| 3.205.22-23 \|\|

*hīnajātiprasūtopi śaucācārasamanvitaḥ \|*  
*sarvadharmārthakuśalaḥ sakulīnaḥ satāṃ varaḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*na kulaṃ kulamityāhurācāraḥ kulamucyate \|*  
*ācārakuśalo rājanniha cāmutra naṃdate \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. Even when a person is born in a low caste if he attains good conduct, he gains proficiency in dharma and artha, and is treated as belonging to the spotless race. Practically, the race of family is of little consequence, but to the contrary, one’s good conduct is considered to be the family or the race. A person possessing the good conduct, remains blissful on earth or in the other world.

## \|\| 3.205.24 \|\|

*yudhiṣṭhira uvāca \|*  
*sadācāramahaṃ kṛṣṇa śrotumicchāmi śāśvatam \|*  
*sarvaṃ dharmamayaḥ ko'tra sadācāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Yudhisthira said – О lord Kṛṣṇa, I am interested to learn about the everlasting good conduct and what type of good conduct is universal for the dharma? You kindly tell me.

## \|\| 3.205.25-29 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*ācāraprabhavo dharmaḥ saṃtaścācāralakṣaṇāḥ \|*  
*sādhūnāṃ ca yathā vṛttaṃ sa sadācāra ucyate \|\| 25 \|\|*

*tasmātkuryādihācāraṃ ya icchedgatimātmanaḥ \|*  
*api pāpaśarīrasya ācāro haṃtyalakṣaṇam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*adṛṣṭamaśrutaṃ vedaṃ puruṣaṃ dharmacāriṇam \|*  
*svāni karmāṇi kurvāṇaṃ taṃ janaṃ kurute priyam \|\| 27 \|\|*

*ye nāstikā naiṣṭhikāśca guruśāstrātilaṃghinaḥ \|*  
*adharmajñā durācārāste bhavaṃti gatāyuṣaḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*sarvalakṣaṇahīnopi yaḥ sadācāravānnaraḥ \|*  
*śraddadhānonasūyaśca sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt \|\| 29 \|\|*

25-29. Śrī Kṛṣṇa said – The dharma emerges out of the good conduct. Therefore, good conduct is considered to be the base of dharma. This is the symptom of nobility or the saintly people.

## \|\| 3.205.30-37 \|\|

*brāhme muhūrte budhyeta dharmārthāvanucintayet \|*  
*brāhmaṇānalago sūryānna meheta kadācana \|\| 30 \|\|*

*udaṅmukho divārātrāvutsargaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ \|*  
*utthāyācamya tiṣṭheta pūrvāṃ saṃdhyāṃ samāhitaḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*evamevottarāṃ saṃdhyāṃ samupāsīta vāgyataḥ \|*  
*nekṣetādityamudyantaṃ nāstaṃ yāṃtaṃ kadācana \|\| 32 \|\|*

*ṛṣayo dīrghatapasā dīrghamāyuravāpnuyuḥ \|*  
*upāsate yena pūrvāṃ dvijāḥ saṃdhyāṃ na paścimām \|\| 33 \|\|*

*sarvāṃstāndhārmiko rājā śūdrakarmaṇi yojayet \|*  
*ābādhāsu yathākāmaṃ kuryānmūtrapurīṣayoḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*śirasā prāvṛtenaiva samāstīrya tṛṇairmahīm \|*  
*grāmāvasathatīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ caiva vartmani \|\| 35 \|\|*

*na mūtramadhitiṣṭheta na kṛṣṭe na ca govraje \|*  
*antarjalādāvasathādvalmīkānmūṣakasthalāt \|\| 36 \|\|*

*kṛtaśaucāvaśiṣṭāśca varjayetpañca vai mṛdaḥ \|*  
*devārcanādikāryāṇi tathā gurvabhivādanam \|\| 37 \|\|*

30-37. Therefore, the people who are desirous of the excellent position, they must perform the good conduct. The evil in a person is also destroyed with good conduct, purifying him at the same time. The invisible and the wonderful Vedas also endear a person in the world with the performing of the noble deeds. Because of this, the atheists who disregard the advice of the religious people, the preceptors as well as the scriptures, they become irreligious, possessing evil conduct and having small span of life. The people who are devoid of all the auspicious symptoms, but by possessing the good conduct, they become devoted and unblemished, and all their desires become fulfilled.

## \|\| 3.205.38-41 \|\|

*kurvīta samyagācamya tadvadannabhuji kriyām \|*  
*aphenaśabdagaṃdhābhiradbhiracchābhirādarāt \|\| 38 \|\|*

*ācāmetprayataḥ samyakprāṅmukhodaṅmukho'pi vā \|*  
*trivargasādhane yacca sadā kāryaṃ vipaścitā \|\| 39 \|\|*

*tatsāṃnidhye gṛhasthasya siddhiratra paratra ca \|*  
*pādena kāryaṃ pāratryaṃ pādaṃ kuryācca saṃcaye \|\| 40 \|\|*

*ardhenāhāracaraṇanityanaimittikāṃtakam \|*  
*arthasyopārjane yatnaḥ sadā kāryo vipaścitaiḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

38-41. The people who are engaged in following of dharma or those who are engaged in the earning of their livelihood, should get up from the bed in the early morning and should not relieve themselves of excretion near a Brahmana’s house, the fire, or at sunrise. In other words, they should be free from their daily activities before the sunrise. The person should pass his stools farcing north during the day and facing the south during the night, after which he should rinse his mouth, take bath as well as the sandhya should be performed during the morning itself. Then the evening sandhya should be perform ed maintaining silence and one should never do so at the rising or the setting sun. With the following of this practice, the Ṛṣis perform tapas for long and achieve long life. The Brahmanas who do not perform sandhya in the morning and in the evening, they should be engaged by the king for performing the mined jobs. One should not ease himself or drop stools covering the head and spreading the same over the earth. One should not ease himself in a village, house, sacred place, field, the land which has been ploughed or the cowpen. For purifying himself after the dropping of stools, the water from the reservoir and the dust from white ant hill in the house or outside and rat holes should not be used for self purification. After adoring the gods, the preceptor should also be adored.

## \|\| 3.205.42-46 \|\|

*tatsaṃsiddhau hi siddhyanti dharmakāmādayo nṛpa \|*  
*keśaprasādhanādarśadarśanaṃ daṃtadhāvanam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*pūrvāhna eva kāryāṇi devatānāṃ ca pūjanam \|*  
*dūrādāvasathānmūtraṃ dūrātpādāvasecanam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*ucchiṣṭotsarjanaṃ dūrātsadā kāryaṃ hitaiṣiṇā \|*  
*loṣṭamardī tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī ca yo naraḥ \|\| 44 \|\|*

*nityocchiṣṭaḥ saṃkarakṛnnehāyurviṃdate mahat \|*  
*nagnāṃ parastriyaṃ nekṣenna paśyedātmanaḥ śakṛt \|\| 45 \|\|*

*udakyādarśanasparśaṃ kuryātsaṃbhāṣaṇaṃ na ca \|*  
*nāpsu mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā maithunaṃ vā samācaret \|\| 46 \|\|*

42-46. The food should also be taken after rinsing of the mouth. The water to be used for rinsing of the mouth should be clean without smell or foam etc. The rinsing of the mouth should always be done facing north. This practice is said to be the means of achieving dharma, artha and kama by which a householder attains success in this world and beyond. A quarter of one’s riches should be used for the spiritual purpose, another quarter of the same should be saved and the remaining half should be used daily for food and to meet other expenses. All learned people should engage themselves in the earning of the wealth. With the earning of wealth, all the household and other activities could be managed.

## \|\| 3.205.47-49 \|\|

*nādhitiṣṭhecchakṛnmūtre keśabhasmakapālikān \|*  
*tuṣāṃgārāsthiśīrṇāni rañjuvastrādikāni ca \|\| 47 \|\|*

*dhāriṇo na namedvidvānnāsanaṃ cāpi dāpayet \|*  
*brāhmaṇānpraṇamedvidvānāsanaṃ cāpi dāpayet \|\| 48 \|\|*

*kṛtāṃjalirupāsīta gacchaṃtaṃ pṛṣṭhatonviyāt \|*  
*na cāsītāsane bhinne bhinnaṃ kāṃsyaṃ ca varjayet \|\| 49 \|\|*

47-49. The combing of the hair looking at the mirror, brushing the teeth with tooth stick and other such activities should be carried out in the forenoon itself. One should ease himself away from the house, the water for washing of the feet as well as the leftover of the food should be thrown away (at a distance from the house). The people who mb dust with hands, beat the straw with nails, cut the nails with nail, those who always consume the leftover of the food and the men who produce the illegitimate children, can never enjoy long life. The naked women of others and one’s own refuse should not be looked upon. The sight of a woman in periods, her touch and sex with her is also prohibited.

## \|\| 3.205.50-51 \|\|

*nāmuktakeśairbhoktavyaṃ na nagnaḥ snānamācaret \|*  
*svaptavyaṃ naiva nagnena na cocchiṣṭastu saṃviśet \|\| 50 \|\|*

*ucchiṣṭo na spṛśecchīrṣaṃ sarve prāṇāstadāśrayāḥ \|*  
*keśagrahānprahārāṃśca śirasyetāni varjayet \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. One should not drop refuse in water, nor should pass urine in it. One should neither offer salutation to a person with disheveled hair, nor with forehead over which the ashes are applied, nor having the husk fire before him, nor one who wears a garland of clothes mixed with bones, and nor should he be given a seat. The salutation and seats should be offered to a Brāhmaṇa alone. When the Brāhmaṇa, after he is served well, tries to go back, one should follow him for some distance. They should not have separate seats, nor should there be separate bronze vases for them.

## \|\| 3.205.52-53 \|\|

*nānyatra putra śiṣyābhyāṃ śiphayā tāḍanaṃ smṛtam \|*  
*na pāṇibhyāṃ saṃhatābhyāṃ kaṃḍūyedātmanaḥ śiraḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*na cābhīkṣṇaṃ śiraḥsnānaṃ kāryaṃ niṣkāraṇaṃ naraiḥ \|*  
*apraśastaṃ niśi snānaṃ rāhoranyatra darśanāt \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. One should not take food with tied hair of the head, should not take bath naked, nor should one sleep naked and nor with the stale mouth. Stale food should not be touched, because all the pranas live in the same. Similarly, one should not behold by the hair, nor should anyone strike over the head of others.

## \|\| 3.205.54-58 \|\|

*na bhuktottarakālaṃ ca na gambhīrajalāśaye \|*  
*śiraḥsnānaṃ tu tailena nāṃgaṃ kiṃcidupaspṛśet \|\| 54 \|\|*

*tilapiṣṭaṃ ca nāśnīyāttathāsyāyurna hīyate \|*  
*duṣkṛtaṃ na gurorbhūyātkruddhaṃ cainaṃ prasādayet \|\| 55 \|\|*

*parīvādaṃ na śṛṇuyādanyeṣāmapi jalpatām \|*  
*sadānupahatastiṣṭhetpraśastāśca tathauṣadhīḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

*gāruḍāni ca ratnāni bibhṛyātprayato naraḥ \|*  
*susnigdhāmalakeśaśca sugandhiścāruveṣadhṛk \|\| 57 \|\|*

*sitāḥ sumanaso hṛdyā bibhṛyācca naraḥ sadā \|*  
*kiṃcitparasvaṃ na harennālpamapyapriyaṃ vadet \|\| 58 \|\|*

54-58. A son of a disciple should not be beaten holding him by the tuft. One should not rub his head with both the hands. A person should not wash his head repeatedly without any purpose, because washing the head repeatedly, except on the day of eclipse, has been prohibited.

## \|\| 3.205.59-63 \|\|

*priyaṃ ca nānṛtaṃ brūyānnānyadoṣānudīrayet \|*  
*nānyāśritaṃ tathā vairaṃ rocayetpuruṣeśvaraḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

*na duṣṭayānamārohetkūlacchāyā na saṃśrayet \|*  
*vidviṣṭapatitonmattabahuvairādisaṃkaraiḥ \|\| 60 \|\|*

*baṃdhakībaṃdhakībhartṛkṣudrānṛta kathaiḥ saha \|*  
*tathātivyayaśīlaiśca parivādarataiḥ śaṭhaiḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

*budho maitrīṃ na kurvīta naikaḥ paṃthānamāśrayet \|*  
*nāvagāhejjalaughasya vegamagre nareśvarā \|\| 62 \|\|*

*pradīptaṃ veśma na viśennārohecchikharaṃ taroḥ \|*  
*na huṃkuryācchavaṃ caiva śavagandho hi somajaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

59-63. After taking food, one should not take bath with his head in deep waters, nor should he apply oil over his body. The crushed sesamum seeds should not be taken as food, because they are heavy in nature and get digested quite late. One should not speak hash words to the preceptor. To the contrary, finding him in rage, the disciple should try to pacify him. One should not be interested in listening to the dummying of others and should always remain in a happy mood. The people should consume the praiseworthy herbs and should wear the Garuda gem. Having the charming and beautiful hair, one should apply scent over the same and then wear a garland of white flowers. The people should dress themselves in an attractive way. One should not usurp the riches of others and should never speak the evil words.

## \|\| 3.205.64-66 \|\|

*na kuryāddantasaṃvarṣaṃ na kuryāccalanāsikām \|*  
*nāsaṃspṛṣṭamukho brūyācchvāsakāsau ca varjayet \|\| 64 \|\|*

*noccairhasetsaśabdaṃ ca na muñcetpavanaṃ budhaḥ \|*  
*nakhānna vādayecchiṃdyānna nakhaiśca mahīṃ likhet \|\| 65 \|\|*

*na śmaśru bhakṣayeccaiva na loṣṭhāni ca mardayet \|*  
*pādena nākrametpādaṃ na pūjyābhimukhaṃ nayeta \|\| 66 \|\|*

64-66. One should not speak falsehood, nor should he publicly expose the evils of others. A person should not own the enmity of others. One should not use defective language. One should never rest under a tree grown over the river bank. Even the learned person should not develop friendship with an evil person, or a jealous person, a fallen man, an intoxicated man, one who is inimical to others, the slave woman and her husband, a person with mean mentality, one who narrates the false stories, one who spends enormously, one who always denounces others and the wicked people. О Naresvara, one should not travel on a path alone. One should never take bath in a forceful current of water and should not enter in a homa or fire. On should not climb at the tip of a tree. One should not utter hum on seeing a dead body, because the smell of a dead body is believed to have emerged out of the moon.

## \|\| 3.205.67 \|\|

*noccāsane samāsīta guroragre kadācana \|*  
*tasmātsadācāraparo bhavetkāmacaro na hi \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. The striking of teeth is forbidden and one should not make the noose. One should not speak without properly washing the mouth, nor should be take a deep sigh and nor should one cough openly. One should not laugh aloud on a word uttered by someone and should not exhale the breath directly on other’s. One should not scratch with nails, nor should anything be torn with them, nor should one scratch the earth with nails. The beard should not be allowed to cover the mouth, one should not practice the rubbing of dust with the hands. One should not keep one foot over the other, nor should he display his feet before the elders.

## \|\| 3.205.68-69 \|\|

*lokadvaye śubhaṃ prepsuḥ pretya svarge mahīyate \|*  
*catuṣpathaṃ caityataruṃ śmaśānopavanāni ca \|\| 68 \|\|*

*duṣṭastrīsaṃnikarṣaṃ ca varjayenniśi sarvadā \|*  
*grīṣmavarṣāsu cacchatrī maunī rātrau vaneṣu ca \|\| 69 \|\|*

68-69. One should not be seated over a high seat in the presence of the preceptor. One should always try to follow the good conduct and not a self-centered person. By thus behaving, one becomes auspicious in both the worlds and finally achieves the heaven. During the night, one should avoid coming in contact with a wicked woman standing at a crossing, near a tree, the cremation ground or an orchard. During the summer and the rainy seasons, one should keep an umbrella and light while moving in a forest during the night.

## \|\| 3.205.70-71 \|\|

*keśāsthikaṇṭakāmedhyabalibhasmatuṣāṃstathā \|*  
*snānārdrāṃ dharaṇīṃ caiva dūrataḥ parivarjayet \|\| 70 \|\|*

*paṃthā deyo brāhmaṇebhyo rājabhyaḥ strībhya eva ca \|*  
*vidyādhikasya gurviṇyā bhārārtasya mahīyasaḥ \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. After taking bath, the land spread with the hair, bones, thorns, inauspicious sacrifice, ashes and husk should be discarded from a distance. One should always give way for the Brahmanas, the rulers, the women, the learned people, the preceptors and the people carrying heavy weight.

## \|\| 3.205.72 \|\|

*mūkāṃdhabadhirāṇāṃ ca mattasyonmattakasya ca \|*  
*upānadvastramālyaṃ ca dhṛtamanyairna dhārayet \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. Similarly, for the dumb person, the deaf, the blind, besides those who are intoxicated, the path should be cleared for them. One should not use the turban, shoes, the costumes and the garlands which have already been used by others.

## \|\| 3.205.73-74 \|\|

*na hīdṛśamanāyuṣyaṃ loke kiñcana vidyate \|*  
*yādṛśaṃ puruṣasyeha paradāropasevanam \|\| 73 \|\|*

*na cerṣyā strīṣu kartavyā dārā rakṣyāḥ prayatnataḥ \|*  
*anāyuṣyā bhavedīrṣyā tasmāttāṃ parivarjayet \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. There is no other deed in this world that reduces a man’s life so much, as by enjoying the company of the wives of others. One should never be jealous of the women and as far as possible, they should be protected. The jealousy reduces the life and as such it should be discarded.

## \|\| 3.205.75 \|\|

*mūrkhonmattavyasanino virūpānmāninastathā \|*  
*hīnāṃgānadhikāṃgāṃśca vidyāhīnāṃśca nākṣipet \|\| 75 \|\|*

75\. One should not denounce the fools, intoxicate ones, the vicious people, ugly, arrogant, those with an extra limb in the body, those with a short limb in the body and those who are illiterate.

## \|\| 3.205.76-77 \|\|

*pānīyasya kriyā naktaṃ tathaiva dadhisaktavaḥ \|*  
*varjanīyā mahārāja niśīthe bhojanakriyāḥ \|\| 76 \|\|*

*nordhvajānuściraṃ tiṣṭhenna rahasyaparo bhavet \|*  
*tadvannopaviśetprājñaḥ pādenākramya vāsanam \|\| 77 \|\|*

76-77. О great king, while observing vrata at night, taking of beverages, curd and barley flour are prohibited at midnight or beyond that time. One should not raise his knees for long. One should never become secretive and should not roll his bed with his feet.

## \|\| 3.205.78-83 \|\|

*na cātiraktavāsāḥ syāccitrāsitadharo'pi vā \|*  
*na ca kuryādviparyāsaṃ vāsaso na vibhūṣaṇe \|\| 78 \|\|*

*strīṃ kṛśāṃ nāvajānīyāddīrghamāyurjijīviṣuḥ \|*  
*brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ sarvaṃ sarve hyāśīviṣopamāḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*hanyādāśīviṣaḥ kruddho yāvatspṛśati daṃṣṭrayā \|*  
*kṣatriyo'pi dahetkruddho yāvatpaśyati tejasā \|\| 80 \|\|*

*brāhmaṇaḥ sakulaṃ hanyāddhyāne nāvekṣitena ca \|*  
*nātikalyaṃ nātisāyaṃ na ca madhyaṃ dine tathā \|\| 81 \|\|*

*nājñātaiḥ saha gaṃtavyaṃ naikena bahubhiḥ saha \|*  
*nāruṃtudaḥ syānna parokṣavādī na sahī nataḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

*rohate cāgninā dagdhaṃ vanaṃ paraśunā hatam \|*  
*vaco duruktabībhatsaṃ na saṃrohati cāśatam \|\| 83 \|\|*

78-83. One should not use extremely red clothes of different types and of black colour. One should not interchange the costumes and the ornaments. A person desirous of a long life, should never humiliate other women. The Brahmanas and Ksatriyas are both like the serpents, therefore, one should always remain careful of them. The enraged Ksatriya can kill the opponent with his sword, while a Brahmna reduces the opponent together with his race into ashes, simply with a glance. In the early morning, at noon, as well as in the evening, one should not travel with a stranger. One should not cause pain at the sensitive spot of the other person. The tree in the forest should not be cut o ff with an axe, but still when one does so, the tree in the forest sprouts again, but when an opponent gives pain with the speaking of harsh words, a person cannot be restored to his original position.

## \|\| 3.205.84-85 \|\|

*nāstikyaṃ vedaniṃdā ca devatānāṃ ca kutsanam \|*  
*dveṣastaṃbhādimānasya klaibyaṃ ca parivarjayet \|\| 84 \|\|*

*na brāhmaṇaṃ parivadenna nakṣatrāṇi darśayet \|*  
*tithiṃ pakṣasya na brūyādyayāsyāyurna riṣyate \|\| 85 \|\|*

84-85. One should keep himself away from an atheist, denouncer of the Vedas, jealous and one who is miser in praising others. One should not involve in a quarrel with a Brahmana and should avoid spotting the constellations. One should also not develop the profession of revealing the moon days or the tithis, because it results in the shorting of the age.

## \|\| 3.205.86-90 \|\|

*tejo niṣṭhīvya vāsaśca paridhāyācamedbudhaḥ \|*  
*jitāmitro nṛpo yaśca balavānkarmatatparaḥ \|\| 86 \|\|*

*tatra nityaṃ vasetprājñaḥ kṛtakṛtyaḥ patau sukham \|*  
*paurāḥ susaṃhatā yatra satatanyāyavartinaḥ \|\| 87 \|\|*

*yatra striyo'matsariṇyastatra vāsaḥ sukhodayaḥ \|*  
*yasminkṛṣīvalā rāṣṭre prāyaśo nātibhāṣiṇaḥ \|\| 88 \|\|*

*yatrauṣadhānyaśeṣāṇi vasettatra vicakṣaṇaḥ \|*  
*tatra rājanna vastavyaṃ yatraitattritayaṃ sadā \|\| 89 \|\|*

*jigīṣuḥ pūrvavairaṃ ca janaśca viratotsavaḥ \|*  
*tatra rājanna vastavyaṃ yatra nāsti catuṣṭayam \|\| 90 \|\|*

86-90. One should sip water at the conception (of a lady) and changing of the red clothes. One who keeps the company of a victorious king and who always remains dutiful, for a learned person to have an audience with such a king is quite auspicious. The people of a place get united when they are believers of justice and when they are not at all jealous of one another. The life there is quite comfortable. The country' in which the farmers of the land are not at all talkative and all the herbs are found in abundance there, a learned person should stay there. О king, when the people of a place are desirous of overpowering one another, who preserve the earlier enmity and disregard the festivities, one should not stay with such people at any cost.

## \|\| 3.205.91 \|\|

*ṛṇapradātā vaidyaśca śrotriyaḥ sajalā nadī \|*  
*avalokyo na cādarśo malino buddhimattaraiḥ \|\| 91 \|\|*

91\. Similarly, a place where there is no loan giver, a physician, a Brāhmaṇa well-versed in the Vedas and a river which has the flow of water during all the seasons, a noble person should never stay there. An intelligent person should not look his face in a dirty mirror.

## \|\| 3.205.92-95 \|\|

*na ca rātrau mahārāja dīrgharājyamabhīpsatā \|*  
*hemakāragṛhe cānnamaśnīyānna ca viśvaset \|\| 92 \|\|*

*na ca mitraṃ prakurvīta hemakāraṃ kadācana \|*  
*bhinnabhāṃḍaṃ ca khaṭvāṃ ca kukkuraṃ kukkuṭaṃ tathā \|\| 93 \|\|*

*apraśastāni catvāri ye ca vṛkṣāḥ sakaṃṭakāḥ \|*  
*bhinna bhāṃḍe baliḥ prāyaḥ khadvāyāṃ ceha niścayaḥ \|\| 94 \|\|*

*nāśnaṃti pitarastasya yatra kukkurakukkaṭau \|*  
*vṛkṣamūle piśācānāṃ sarveṣāmeva saṃsthitiḥ \|\| 95 \|\|*

92-95. The king who is desirous of ruling the country for long, should not take food at night, at the place of a goldsmith, nor should he develop a faith in him. A goldsmith should never be taken as a friend. Those who use inauspicious vases for making offerings to the gods or manes, those who sleep on cots, besides who keep the cocks and the dogs in their house, the gods and manes never visit such houses, nor do they take food there and never get satisfied. The Pisacas are always lodged at the root of the trees.

## \|\| 3.205.96-97 \|\|

*atasteṣāṃ tale bhujannaśnute pūyaśoṇitam \|*  
*asaṃskṛtānnabhuṅmūtraṃ bālādiprabhavaṃ svayam \|\| 96 \|\|*

*suvāsinīṃ gurviṇīṃ ca vṛddhāṃ bālāturāṃstathā \|*  
*bhojayetsaṃskṛtānnena prathamaṃ caramaṃ gṛhī \|\| 97 \|\|*

96-97. Therefore, a person who takes his food there, he actively consumes the blood and puss. Consuming of the cooked food is also prohibited there. The young damsels, the pregnant women, the old ladies and the naughty children should be first served food in the house.

## \|\| 3.205.98-101 \|\|

*aghaṃ sa kevalaṃ bhuṃkte baddhagovāhanādikam \|*  
*yo bhuṃkte ca bahirjyeṣṭhaprekṣatāmapradāya ca \|\| 98 \|\|*

*vaiśvadevaṃ tataḥ kuryādyāvadāhutayaḥ kramāt \|*  
*prathamāṃ brahmaṇe dadyātprajānāṃ pataye tataḥ \|\| 99 \|\|*

*tṛtīyāṃ caiva guhyebhyaḥ kaśyapāya tathā parām \|*  
*tataścānumate dadyāddattvā gṛhabaliṃ tataḥ \|\| 100 \|\|*

*pūrvākhyātaṃ mayā yatte nityakarmakriyāvidhau \|*  
*dadyādatha dharitrīṇāṃ dadyāttu maṇikatrayam \|\| 101 \|\|*

98-101. Disregarding the cows and the animals yoked in the vehicles, when (the house owner) takes food himself disregarding even his elders, he does not actually consume the food, but the sins. The Vaisvadva sacrifice should be performed with all the offerings. The first offering should be made to Brahms, the second is for Prajapati, the third is for the household, the fourth is for Kasyapa and the fifth offering should be made to Anumata. After making the offerings of the household, one who indicates about the Nityakarma, he should place three pitchers filled with water at that place.

## \|\| 3.205.102-104 \|\|

*prācyādikramayogena iṃdrādīnāṃ baliṃ kṣipet \|*  
*brahmaṇe cāntarikṣāya sūryāya ca yathākramam \|\| 102 \|\|*

*viśvebhyaścaiva devebhyo viśvabhūtebhya eva ca \|*  
*kṛtvāpasavyaṃ vāyavyaṃ yakṣmaitatte nivedayet \|\| 103 \|\|*

*tataścāgraṃ samuddhṛtya haṃtakāropakalpitam \|*  
*yathāvidhi yathānyāyaṃ brāhmaṇāyopapādayet \|\| 104 \|\|*

102-104. The offerings in the eastern direction should be made for Indra and other deities. Similarly, the offerings should be made for Brahma, Antariksa and the Sungod. The sacred thread should then be placed over the right shoulder, and both Visvedeva and Vidvabhuta should be adored with the offerings in the north-west direction. First of all, the forepart of the same should be given over delightfully and following prescribed rules to a Brahmana well-versed in the Vedas.

## \|\| 3.205.105-108 \|\|

*dattvā vidhibhyo devebhyo gurubhyaḥ suśrutāya ca \|*  
*puṇyagaṃdhāṃbaradharo mālyadhārī nareśvara \|\| 105 \|\|*

*naikavastradharo'śnīyānnārdrapādo mahīpate \|*  
*viśuddhavadanaḥ prīto bhuṃjīta na vidiḍmukhaḥ \|\| 106 \|\|*

*prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vāpi na caivānyamanā naraḥ \|*  
*kutsitena hataṃ caiva jugupsāvadasaṃskṛtam \|\| 107 \|\|*

*dattvā tu bhuṃkte śiṣṭebhyaḥ kṣudhitebhyastathā gṛhī \|*  
*praśastaśuddhapātreṣu bhuñjītākupito nṛpa \|\| 108 \|\|*

105-108. О Naresvara, remembering the preceptor and the gods, offerings along with scent and incense should be offered. Then, the performer himself should clad in white clothes and carrying a single cloth, washing the feet at once, he should take his food, but not facing the comers of the directions. By becoming unconcerned, the food gets destroyed. The learned Brahmanas and those who are hungry should be served with the food first. Thereafter, the householder should lovingly take his food in a clean vase.

## \|\| 3.205.109-111 \|\|

*nāsaṃdīsaṃsthite pātre nādeśe ca nareśvara \|*  
*nā kāle nātisaṃkīrṇe dattvāgraṃ ca naro mahī \|\| 109 \|\|*

*aśnīyāttanmayo bhūtvā pūrvaṃ tu madhuraṃ rasam \|*  
*lavaṇograu tataḥ paścātkaṭutīkṣṇādikaṃ tataḥ \|\| 110 \|\|*

*mārdavaṃ puruṣośnanvai madhye ca kaṭhināśanam \|*  
*aṃte punardravāśī ca naro rogeṇa mucyate \|\| 111 \|\|*

109-111. O Naresvara, the offering should not be made in a vase placed at an inauspicious place. To the contrary, the offering should be made at an appropriate place and at an appropriate time. Thereafter, while taking food, the sweet dish should be taken first of all. Then, the saltiest food should be taken. This should be followed by pungent and then sour dishes should be tasted. While taking the sweet items of food, one should take the hard items first and one who takes food in such a manner, he becomes free from all ailments.

## \|\| 3.205.112-116 \|\|

*divādhānāsu vasati rātrau ca dadhisaktuṣu \|*  
*alakṣmīḥ kovidāreṣu sarvadaiva kṛtālayā \|\| 112 \|\|*

*aniṃdyaṃ bhakṣayennityaṃ vāgyato'nnamakutsayan \|*  
*bhuktvā samyagyathācamya prāṅmukhodaṅ mukho'pi vā \|\| 113 \|\|*

*yathāvatpunarācāmetpāṇī prakṣālya yatnataḥ \|*  
*abhīṣṭadevatānāṃ ca kurvīta smaraṇaṃ naraḥ \|\| 114 \|\|*

*prāṇāpānasamānānāmudānavyānayostathā \|*  
*annapuṣṭikaraṃ cāstu mamādyāvyāhataṃ sukham \|\| 115 \|\|*

*agastiragnirvaḍavānalaśca bhuktaṃ prapātraṃ jarayatvaśeṣam \|*  
*sukhaṃ ca me tatpariṇāmasaṃbhava yacchatvarogaṃ khalu vāsudevaḥ \|\| 116 \|\|*

112-116. During the day time, one has to take the roasted barley and during the night, curd as well as the flour of the roasted barley has to be taken. In the Kovida tree, misfortunes always reside. Therefore, it should not be consumed at that particular time. In the early morning while facing east or north, the food grains should not be denounced and only the auspicious food should be taken. After finishing the food, the mouth should be properly purified by rinsing it. Purifying both the hands and after rinsing the mouth, one should invoke the desired deities and pray – “The prana, apana, udana and vyana types of winds should bring strength with the intake of food in my stomach, by which I would attain the unobstructive comforts. Let Agastya, Agni and fire of the ocean or marine fire w ell cook the food in my stomach and after that let lord Vasudeva bestow good health to me.”

## \|\| 3.205.117-121 \|\|

*ityuccārya svahastena pīramārjya tathodaram \|*  
*anāyāsapradāyīti kuryātkarmāṇyataṃdritaḥ \|\| 117 \|\|*

*saṃdhyāyāṃ pathikaḥ kaścitsamāgacchati bhārata \|*  
*pādaśaucāsanaiḥ prahvaḥ svāgatoktyā ca pūjayet \|\| 118 \|\|*

*tataścānnapradānena śayanena ca pārthiva \|*  
*divā tithau ca vimukho yadaikaṃ pātakaṃ bhavet \|\| 119 \|\|*

*tadevāṣṭaguṇaṃ puṃsāṃ sūrye haṃsamukhe gate \|*  
*gacchecchayyāmasphuṭitāmapi dārumayīṃ nṛpa \|\| 120 \|\|*

*nāviśālāṃ na vā bhagnāṃ nāsamāṃ malināṃ na ca \|*  
*na ca jaṃtumayīṃ śayyāṃ samātiṣṭhedanāpadi \|\| 121 \|\|*

117-121. Thus speaking, one should touch his whole belly with his hands. Thereafter, the said rites should be performed. In case a visitor arrives in the evening time, then one should say – “Come on, you are welcome here.” Thus speaking, the water should be offered to him for the washing of the hands and feet. Thereafter, he should be adored offering seat, food, bed for sleeping etc. In case, a visitor or a guest returns unattended, it becomes fatal for one time only, but in case such a visitor returns disappointed, it becomes eight times more fatal. The bed should be made of the beautiful cord which should be offered to the guest for sleeping. But a small broken bed which is uneven, dirty and having the bugs should not be provided for sleeping to the guest, except under compelling situation.

## \|\| 3.205.122-126 \|\|

*prācyāṃ diśi śiraḥ śastaṃ yāmyāyāmapi bhūpate \|*  
*sadaiva svapatāṃ puṃsāṃ viparītaṃ tu rogadam \|\| 122 \|\|*

*ṛtāvupagamaḥ śastaḥ sapatnyāṃ hyavanīpate \|*  
*puṇyarkṣe ca śubhe kāle putrā yugmāsu rātriṣu \|\| 123 \|\|*

*na cāsnātāṃ striyaṃ gacchedgarbhiṇīṃ na rajasvalām \|*  
*nāniṣṭāṃ vai na kupitāṃ nāśastāṃ na ca rogiṇīm \|\| 124 \|\|*

*nādakṣiṇāṃ nānyakāmāṃ nākāmāṃ nānyayoṣitam \|*  
*sukṣāmāmatyabhuktāṃ ca svayaṃ caibhirguṇairyutaḥ \|\| 125 \|\|*

*snātaḥ sugandhadhṛgdhṛṣṭo na śrāṃtaḥ kṣudhito'pi vā \|*  
*sakāmaḥ sānurāgaśca vyavāyaṃ puruṣo vrajet \|\| 126 \|\|*

122-126. O king, at the time of sleeping, the head of a person while sleeping should be towards the east or the south which is considered to be praiseworthy, but when one sleeps in the contrary directions, it attracts ailments. O son of Avanī, when the time of the death of the first wife arrives, one can unite with another wife. During an auspicious constellation and at an auspicious time, one should unite with his wife, because it results in getting a son. One should not unite with his wife when she has not taken bath, or is pregnant, or in periods, or is in rage, or is ailing, or if she is foolish or is unconcerned, or is without passion or if belongs to some other person, or is hungry, or has overeaten the food. Even a man should unite with his wife only when he possesses the virtues, having taken bath and having applied fragrance over the body. He should not unite with his wife when he is reckless, tired or hungry.

## \|\| 3.205.127-128 \|\|

*caturdaśyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ paṃcadaśyāṃ ca parvasu \|*  
*tailābhyaṃgaṃ tathā bhogānyoṣitaśca vivarjayet \|\| 127 \|\|*

*kṣura karmaṇi cāṃte ca strīsaṃbhoge ca bhārata \|*  
*snāyīta cailavānprātaḥ kaṭabhūmimupetya ca \|\| 128 \|\|*

127-128. The loveable person should also not unite on the moon days of fourteenth, eighth, full moon days and on the days of festivities or while applying oil over the body.
